title: “Jump In And Take Her For A Spin!”☺️ My Actifit Report Card: June 16 2026
body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661414.616024) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661423.016283) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661428.3942142) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661436.2910929) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661442.7206368) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661449.052048) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661455.44362) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661462.257952) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661468.8913069) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661474.207617) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661486.740026) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101781661498.7604709) “Jump In And Take Her For A Spin!”☺️ “Liz…. Quick, snap a photo of me trying to start this piece of heavy equipment!”😇 It only took a second or two before the “Real” operator was standing right behind the Mrs as she snapped this photo!😳 Well at least he had a sense of humor….Lol!🤣 “Honey, maybe he’s a Crypto guy! He probably read my post from yesterday, about how I am a Licensed Pilot………. I’m sure he’s OK with me taking this “Big Boy Toy” for a short spin through the Lynden City Park!”☺️ With the heat back on today, Liz suggested we stop by Starbucks, to enjoy the A/C……. and a Latte or two!😊 As we started to pass the Lynden City Park, Liz slowed down and pulled our Suzuki into the last remaining parking spot! “The Park certainly is busy today, it looks like they reserved one last parking spot just for us!”🤗 We never really found out what the Park was using a telescoping forklift, with a reach of 23 feet, and a load capacity of 6000 pounds for……………..🤔 It looked like they were just trimming tree branches with this forklift!😇 How this Park changes from Summer to Winter…………….. During the rainy season, you can hike all of these trails, and never see one person all day! Today Silvertop was constantly looking over his shoulder……….. Fast moving “E-bikes” were everywhere!😳 “Silvertop, are you ready to go, I have plenty of Starbucks reward “Stars” and your Latte, and my mocha are “FREE” today!”🥰 “Free is always good honey, and with all the Summer Park visitors today, maybe we better “roll” before someone rolls over us, with one of these fast moving electric bikes Lol!”🤣😇 I hope you are enjoying Summer my friends, Silvertop definitely is!😎 Till tomorrow Mike!😊

title: Togetherness! 💞……. My Actifit Report Card: June 16 2026
body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71781656221.325086) My day began with ladies Bible study in our continuation of an in depth study on the Holy Spirit. It was a good study as always. 😇😎👍 Once home, I spent some time outside on my garden swing. @silvertop was in his birthday chaise lounge enjoying the outdoors as well. Around 2 PM, hunger drove me indoors as I’d not had lunch as of yet. After a lunch of cottage cheese and tuna fish, I suggested a coffee for us purchased for free with the stars I’d accumulated. However first, I drove us to Lynden City Park for a hike. I felt the need to try to loosen up my hip. It does not like going uphill. This park trail is mostly flat which I thought might be a good testing ground. I’ve not hiked in quite a while because of this hip conundrum. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71781656607.172297) As you can see, the weather was stellar! Much cooler than it been, but still plenty warm on the pavement. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71781656688.899321) We headed back to the car to go get the coffee. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71781656746.068087) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71781656749.4418302) It was kind of warm inside the Starbucks, so we set out for home via the scenic route and with air conditioning! 😅😎 It’s been a nice day! Tomorrow sees me headed to work with a busy rest of the week. Then, when Friday comes-after work, we pick up a rental car and pack for an early Saturday morning departure to go see baby granddaughter Olivia! 😍☺️ We can’t wait! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71781656962.262182) Airplane seeds in a hemlock?!…..🧐 That’s gonna be it for me. Take care and enjoy the rest of your day wherever you are! 🙏🌏🙏 👣☕️😁😎😇👍😅☺️😍🧐🌹🌙🥱😴 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71781657040.186976) BSB 1 Peter 1:17-21 Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners. For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers, but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot. He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake. Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God. 🙏🌹

title: Crema de Auyama| Pumpkin Cream Soup
body:
Les envío un saludo muy cordial para todos los amigos de Hive Food. En esta oportunidad les traigo una receta que durante años vi preparar a mi abuela. Es un gusto preparar la Crema de Auyama porque me recuerda a mi abuela Maita. >I’d like to send my warmest regards to all our friends at Hive Food. Today, I’m sharing a recipe that I watched my grandmother make for years. I really enjoy making this pumpkin soup because it reminds me of my grandmother Maita. ![1000455246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/AKe9UHTXNbG2MV7P3G1vTtZs1o9VEfjrU8YDtU7yu5N8NF35HCEtdn1aAwn5MeM.jpg) Ella siempre me decía que debíamos comer muy sano. A mi no me gustaba comer verduras ni ensalada, pero cuando mi abuela me preparaba esas comidas las hacia con mucho amor y magia porque con cada platillo relataba una historia. Era toda una aventura las visitas a casa de mi abuela, comer su comida formaba parte de un juego que llevo en mi mente y en mi corazón. >She always told me we should eat very healthily. I didn’t like eating vegetables or salad, but when my grandmother made those meals for me, she put a lot of love and magic into them because each dish told a story. Visiting my grandmother’s house was quite an adventure; eating her food was part of a game that I still carry in my mind and in my heart.
**Ingredientes:** - 500 gramos de Auyama (calabaza) - 1 rama de cebollín - 1 Cebolla pequeña - 2 cubitos de pollo - 1 cucharada de margarina - 50 gramos de queso rallado
**Ingredients:** - 500 grams of Auyama (pumpkin) - 1 spring onion - 1 small onion - 2 chicken stock cubes - 1 tablespoon of margarine - 50 grams of grated cheese
![1000455221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/Eoc772WDjs6S2u6ScXpNAPpyxTbPbkS9Y41ZhaJJY6y6RQfQGqXLj6ZnTTy3Nnr2Fxq.jpg) **Preparación:** Ante todo se debe quitar la concha de la Auyama y cortarla en trozos para ponerla a cocinar en agua agregando los cubitos de pollo. Aparte se pica la cebolla y el cebollin y se reservan. >**Preparation:** First of all, remove the skin from the pumpkin and cut it into chunks, then cook it in water with the chicken stock cubes. title: [ESP-ING] Mini Bible Souvenirs
body: > ![Polish_20220302_164028364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/48ZbVDw1rPe3UB5MGmsJKe1Z3uXphrpXAqpRNicQMcWZ6bwQ2AXDHSfvGY6TRpkMto.jpg) Un saludo, mi gente maravillosa de Hive, y hoy Les traigo una manualidad muy bonita y sencilla, una idea para dar pequeños recuerdos en las actividades de la iglesia, este recuerdo puede volverse llavero, pero como no tenía llavero no se lo coloque, también lo podemos hacer de la medida que queramos así que pueden cambiar las medidas Es una manualidad con una técnica muy sencilla, en las cuales se puede usar material de reciclaje y también foami o cartulina, pero me gusta más con foami ya que le da más vistosidad, además el foami es un material con el.cual se pueden realizar muchas manualidades y todas son hermosas. Este proyecto no necesita materiales costosos, sino materiales que puedan combinar o vayan según la creatividad que tengan, en este caso utilice material de reciclaje como cartón, me encantó mucho cómo quedó este proyecto, es sencillo y de seguro como llavero o tipo decorativo va a quedar hermoso, Espero que les guste este pequeño paso a paso, el cual fue realizado con mucho amor.

> ![Polish_20220302_164110218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/48eu38YaBkAfCWizTTiU2d1Pij8Px4pNYMB415n8fjQdhzn5BfZGwtKRUDGdZUVUXF.jpg) Hello, my wonderful Hive friends! Today I’m sharing a really cute and simple craft with you—an idea for making little keepsakes for church activities. This keepsake can be turned into a keychain, but since I didn’t have a keychain, I didn’t attach one. You can also make it any size you want, so feel free to adjust the measurements. This is a craft project that uses a very simple technique. You can use recycled materials, foam sheet, or cardstock, but I prefer foam sheet because it makes the project more eye-catching. Plus, foam sheet is a material you can use to make lots of crafts, and they all turn out beautiful. This project doesn’t require expensive materials just items you can mix and match based on your creativity. In this case, I used recycled materials like cardboard. I absolutely loved how this project turned out; it’s simple, and I’m sure it will look beautiful as a keychain or decorative piece. I hope you enjoy this little step-by-step guide, which was created with lots of love. ---
---
> ### Materiales: ✅️ Cartón ✅️ Foami negro y dorado ✅️ Tijera ✅️ Silicon Caliente ✅️ Regla

> ### Materials ✅️ Cardstock ✅️ Black and gold foam sheet ✅️ Scissors ✅️ Hot glue ✅️ Ruler

---

width=472 height=49 border=0>
### Paso a Paso / Step by Step

> Lo primero que haremos será cortar en nuestro cartón, cuatro cuadradrados pequeños de 4 cm de ancho por 5 cm de largo, si tenemos un cartón grueso solo Cortaremos dos, ya que la idea es que el cartón haga la parte de las hojas y se vea grueso.

> The first thing we'll do is cut four small squares out of our cardboard, each 4 cm wide by 5 cm long. If we have thick cardboard, we'll only cut two, since the idea is for the cardboard to serve as the leaves and look thick. ---
> Cortaremos una tira dorada de foami de un centímetro de ancho por 14 cm de largo, la cual usaremos más adelante.
> Cut a gold strip of foam sheet that is 1 centimeter wide and 14 cm long; we'll use it later. ---
> Dibujaremos también en foami dorado una cruz pequeña de aproximadamente unos 3 cm y vamos a recortarla.
> We'll also draw a small cross, about 3 cm across, on the gold foam sheet and cut it out. ---
> También recortaremos en foami negro un rectángulo de 8cm de ancho por 12cm de largo.
> We'll also cut a rectangle out of black foam that is 8 cm wide by 12 cm long. ---
> Vamos a pegar con silicón caliente los cuatro cartoncitos y luego vamos a colocar la cinta dorada alrededor de las dos partes pequeñas y una de las grandes.
> We're going to glue the four small pieces of cardboard together with hot glue, and then we'll wrap the gold ribbon around the two small pieces and one of the large ones. ---

> Vamos a pegar la cinta en la parte de arriba de lo que sería nuestro cartón doblada a la mitad, luego colocaremos la tapa que sería en este caso el rectángulo en negro y colocaremos silicón caliente por todo lado del cartón para ir pegando por ambos lados y en el centro.

> We're going to glue the tape to the top of the cardboard, which has been folded in half, then place the lid which in this case is the black rectangle and apply hot glue all around the cardboard to secure it on both sides and in the center. ---
> Por último pegaremos la cruz en la parte del frente de lo que sería nuestra Biblia y así tendríamos lista nuestro pequeño recuerdo de una mini Biblia.
> Finally, we'll glue the cross to the front cover of what will be our Bible, and that will complete our little keepsake—a mini Bible. ---

width=472 height=49 border=0>
### Resultado: / Result:

> Así ha quedado listo nuestro lindo souvenirs, facil y sencillo de realizar, espero que sea de su agrado, tanto como me ha gustado a mi esta pequeña y hermosa creación, Gracias por estar aquí y ser parte de mi blog.

> And there you have it our cute souvenir is ready! It’s easy and simple to make. I hope you like it as much as I’ve enjoyed this small, beautiful creation. Thank you for being here and for being part of my blog. ---
> No hay límites para la creatividad, solo tu sabes hasta donde puedes llegar, ten la libertad de crear.

> There are no limits to creativity; only you know how far you can go. Give yourself the freedom to create. --- ---

title: Photosynthesis
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYnVruekEWsM7BiaSf8UbDzRdS7whY9CAruqG9VuBXYFy/1781666677034.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYc1X3xy9TgeiUzrY4iaJN7rZKdXntM22UyjYNCEHpo4k/1781666690094.jpg)


Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants make their own food using sunlight. It is one of the most important biological processes because it provides food and oxygen for living organisms.

How Photosynthesis Works

Plants absorb:

Sunlight through their leaves.

Carbon dioxide (CO₂) from the air through tiny openings called stomata.

Water (H₂O) from the soil through their roots.


Inside the leaves, a green pigment called chlorophyll captures sunlight. The plant then uses this energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose (sugar), which serves as food for the plant. During this process, oxygen (O₂) is released into the atmosphere.

Photosynthesis Equation

Carbon Dioxide + Water + Sunlight → Glucose + Oxygen

Importance of Photosynthesis

1. Produces food for plants.


2. Releases oxygen needed by humans and animals.


3. Maintains the balance of carbon dioxide and oxygen in the atmosphere.


4. Forms the base of most food chains on Earth.



Conclusion

Photosynthesis is essential for life on Earth. Without it, plants could not produce food, and the oxygen required by most living organisms would not be available. It helps sustain ecosystems and supports life across the planet.

title: El poder de confrontar los temores: Mi control médico y un mensaje para ti / The power of confronting fears: My medical checkup and a message for you.
body:
>


¡Amigos! Este es un post de celebración. El día de hoy fui a hacerme un eco mamario. Hace algún tiempo, el endocrino me había enviado a repetirme este estudio debido a una irregularidad, y créanme que a esto le huí durante mucho tiempo. Sinceramente, me daba muchísimo miedo enfrentar cualquier mala noticia; digamos que, en medio de todo, cada vez que voy al médico salgo con algo nuevo, así que tengo como un leve trauma con las consultas.

​English: Friends! This is a celebratory post. Today, I went to get a breast ultrasound. Some time ago, my endocrinologist sent me to repeat this scan due to an irregularity, and believe me, I ran away from this for a long time. Honestly, I was terrified of facing any bad news. Let's just say that, on top of everything, every time I go to the doctor I leave with something new, so I have a bit of a mild trauma when it comes to medical visits.

​Pero he aprendido a sobrellevar esto, porque de igual forma tengo que ir por mi condición y mis problemas de tiroides. Lo postergué por algunos meses hasta que lo afronté, me encomendé a Dios y dije: \

. Hoy tengo la maravillosa noticia de que no tengo absolutamente nada malo. No saben el alivio que sentí luego de hacerme este eco, porque sinceramente había pensado tantas cosas, tantas enfermedades, y el costo tan grande que implica enfermarse.\n\n​English: But I’ve learned to cope with this, because either way, I have to go due to my health condition and my thyroid issues. I put it off for a few months until I finally faced it, commended myself to God, and said, \

Today I have the wonderful news that there is absolutely nothing wrong! You have no idea the relief I felt after getting this ultrasound, because honestly, I had imagined so many things, so many illnesses, and the massive financial cost that getting sick implies.

​Pero, gracias a Dios, tuve la suerte de salir bien. Cada día le agradezco más a Dios por mantenerme viva, con salud y con ese ímpetu de levantarme cada día a hacer mi vida cotidiana, más allá de cualquier dolor que generalmente siempre tengo y a los que me he adaptado un poco también.

​English: But thank God, I was lucky enough to be perfectly fine. Every day I thank God more for keeping me alive, healthy, and with that drive to get up every day and go about my daily life, beyond any pain that I usually have and to which I've also adapted a bit.

​Entonces, nada, siento que gané una batalla importante; realmente quedo más tranquila porque esto era algo que me atemorizaba muchísimo. Y bueno, hoy les comparto este post para incentivarlas a que sean conscientes y a que acudan a sus controles. No sean como yo, que me volví un poco cobarde con el pasar de los años y de las consultas. ¡Les dejo un abrazo enorme y la mejor de las vibras a todas!

​English: So, yeah, I feel like I won a major battle this time; I’m truly much more at peace because this was something that terrified me. And well, today I’m sharing this post to encourage you all to be proactive and go to your checkups. Don't be like me, someone who got a bit cowardly over the years and with all those doctor visits. Sending a huge hug and the best vibes to everyone!

And with that free time, I started....Scrolling through some of my recent photos.  And found these that I took with my kid a while back, at a local air show that we attended.

I'm not a huge World War 2 historian or anything, but my Dad is....So when I went with my son, we called my pops and used Facetime to show him all the planes.

He was naming them all off and really enjoyed being at the show with us....Even if it was only through FaceTime.

We passed on that lol

title: The Ideal Birthday | L.O.H #293 (EN-ES)
body:
I told you last week, I'm back, and a promise is a promise. I'm going to spend time with my loved ones, and that includes all of you, every member of #LadiesofHive. Because this place is like my home, and you are like my family. This week's topic seems very timely, as it comes at just the right moment. My birthday is at the end of July, and I'm already making plans. What about you? When is your birthday?
![ai-generated-9225462_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/AKVYi1nVPXv2Eir8JydgMj7jW94ZxvWmFViVCM6cmww9h7qvwitRnL7SE8vFUXm.jpg) [SOURCE](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-soportar-abrazo-9225462/)
#### **Do you like celebrating your own birthday? Or are you more of a celebrator of other people's birthdays? What would you like to do for your next birthday?** My birthday hasn't meant much to me in the last 20 years, but three years ago I decided to organize and celebrate it with family and close friends. It was a small gathering/party that didn't turn out exactly as I had planned, but it was the best birthday I've ever had. That's why I'd love to repeat the experience. For my next birthday, which will be in a month and a half: I would like to invite my friends to a pizzeria and hang out together. That's why I know how meaningful it is to have guests; if a friend needs my assistance at their birthday party, I would be there, because there is no better gift to give than being present for someone who needs you.
![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)
Original version in Spanish Se los dije la semana pasada, estoy de vuelta, y lo prometido es deuda. Voy a aprovechar el tiempo con mis seres queridos y eso las incluye a ustedes, a cada miembro de #LadiesofHive. Por que este lugar es como mi hogar y ustedes son como mi familia. El tema de esta semana me parece muy oportuno, ya que llega en el momento justo. Mi cumpleaños es a finales de Julio y ya estoy haciendo planes. ¿Que hay de ti? ¿cuando es tu cumpleaños?
![ai-generated-9225462_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/AKVYi1nVPXv2Eir8JydgMj7jW94ZxvWmFViVCM6cmww9h7qvwitRnL7SE8vFUXm.jpg) [FUENTE](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-soportar-abrazo-9225462/)
#### **Te gusta celebrar tu propio cumpleaños? O eres de las que disfruta más celebrar el cumpleaños de los demás? Que te gustaría hacer para tu próximo cumpleaños?** Mi cumpleaños es una fecha que no ha significado mucho para mi en los últimos 20 años, pero hubo una ocasión hace 3 años en donde se me ocurrió organizar y celebrar mi propio cumpleaños en compañía de familiares y amigos cercanos. Fue una pequeña reunión/fiesta que no resulto como lo había planeado, pero fue el mejor cumpleaños que he tenido hasta la actualidad. Por eso me gustaría repetir la experiencia. En mi próximo cumpleaños, que sera dentro de un mes y medio: Quisiera invitar a mis amigos a una pizzeria y pasar el rato todos juntos. Por eso sé lo significativo que es tener invitados, si un amigo o una amiga necesita mi asistencia en su fiesta de cumpleaños, estaría presente, porque no hay mejor regalo que dar que estar presente para alguien que te necesita.

title: A REAL LIFE STORY
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchcxfCezvwKLh6eqqLcrBery6S6CAaNeY7PXk7RtQDJE/1781666377836.png)
AI Generate 

Hii ... I hope so you all are fine ... Today i have an interesting story ... A few years ago, I was working in a small shop in my tow ... Life was not easy because my family had financial problems, and I had to work long hours every day ... Even though I was tired, I never gave up ... I always believed that hard work would help me achieve something better in the future ... One day, while returning home from work, I found a wallet lying on the side of the road ...  When I opened it, I saw a large amount of money, some important cards, and an ID card ...  For a moment, I thought about keeping the money because my family really needed it ... But deep inside, I knew it was not the right thing to do ... Using the address on the ID card, I went to find the owner ... After searching for almost an hour, I finally reached his house ... When I handed him the wallet, he looked surprised and checked everything carefully ... Nothing was missing ...  His eyes filled with tears, and he thanked me again and again ...  He told me that the money was meant for his daughter's college fees and that losing it would have caused serious problems for his family ... I felt happy because I had done the right thing. I did not expect anything in return ... However, a week later, the same man visited the shop where I worked ... He turned out to be the owner of a successful company ... He told me he had been impressed by my honesty and wanted to offer me a job at his company ... I accepted the offer and started working there ...  With time, I learned new skills, worked hard, and earned promotions ... My life slowly improved ... I was able to support my family, and our financial problems became much smaller ... Today, whenever people ask me how I became successful, I tell them this story ...  I believe that honesty may not always give immediate rewards, but it never goes unnoticed ... Sometimes, one good decision can completely change your life ... Have a nice day ...

title: The Producer Price Index
body: The Producer Price Index doesn't usually get its own day in the sun. It's the data release that exists to be quoted in someone else's report about the data release that mattered. Not this month. May's PPI came in at 1.1% on the month against a Dow Jones consensus of 0.7%, which is the kind of miss that normally triggers a one-day headline and a shrug. The annual rate hit 6.5%, the hottest since November 2022, and buried inside that number is a detail that should worry anyone still calling this an energy story: final demand goods prices jumped 2.8% in a single month, the largest increase since the BLS started tracking the series in December 2009. Sixteen years of data, and May 2026 just set the record.\n\nEnergy did most of the damage, as it has all spring. Wholesale gasoline surged 23.4%, diesel and jet fuel followed, and the chain running from the Strait of Hormuz to a trucking company's fuel surcharge to a grocery store's delivery fee is short and well understood by now. But strip out food and energy entirely, and core PPI still rose 0.4% on the month, the steepest core advance since March 2022. The narrower \

measure, which also excludes trade margins, posted 0.8%, the biggest jump in over four years. That's the number that should actually be circulating on trading desks instead of the headline figure, because it says the heat isn't confined to the pump. It's diffusing into the rest of the cost structure, the way a fever spreads before anyone notices the patient sweating.

Here's where the structural story gets interesting, and where most of the coverage stopped a sentence too early. Core goods inflation at the consumer level has been running near 1.9% year over year, against a pre-pandemic average closer to negative 0.6%. Goods disinflation, the great deflationary gift that globalization handed central banks for three decades, hasn't just stalled. It's reversed. And the reason isn't exclusively the Iran conflict or a single bad month of refinery margins. It's the tariff regime built through the second half of 2025, now fully working its way through supply chains as the cheaper, pre-tariff inventory that companies were quietly running down finally runs out. Energy is the visible shock. Tariffs are the slow leak that was always going to surface once the buffer inventory disappeared, and May looks like the month the buffer disappeared.

This matters enormously for how anyone should be reading Kevin Warsh's first weeks in the chair. A new Fed chair who has spent years calling AI structurally disinflationary now has to explain a goods-price chart that is structurally inflationary for reasons that have nothing to do with semiconductors. You cannot dot-plot your way out of a tariff pass-through. You cannot lower the federal funds rate and make a container of imported industrial chemicals cheaper. Rate policy was built to manage demand, and demand is not really the problem sitting inside this PPI report. Supply-side cost shocks layered on top of trade policy is a different animal, and it's one the Fed has historically had almost no good tools for, which is exactly why Volcker-era textbooks spend so much time on oil embargoes and so little on triumphant victories over them.

There's a smaller, almost comic detail buried in the services side of the report that says something true about where the money in this economy actually flows. Portfolio management fees rose 4.8% in May, the single largest contributor to the services component, driven by a strong month for equities. Wall Street's own fee structure, scaling up automatically as asset prices climb, is now a measurable line item in the nation's inflation data. The stock market hitting records and the cost of managing other people's money rising in lockstep is not a coincidence, and it's a small but pointed illustration of how unevenly this inflation cycle is actually distributing itself. Someone paying more for gasoline and someone collecting a fatter advisory fee are reading the same PPI release and experiencing two entirely different economies.

None of this resolves cleanly into a single villain, which is precisely the point. A geopolitical energy shock, a tariff structure built for political reasons rather than price stability, and a financial sector whose revenue model mechanically inflates alongside the assets it manages: three separate mechanisms, pushing in the same direction, none of which a 25-basis-point move addresses. FedEx and Darden both report earnings Thursday, and freight costs plus restaurant input prices will offer a faster, dirtier read on whether this pipeline pressure is already showing up at the register or still working its way there. The Fed's framework was built for a world where inflation came from one direction at a time. May's PPI report is a reminder that it rarely does, and that the next several months are going to test whether anyone in Washington still knows how to fight a fire with three separate sources of fuel.

title: Finish the Tale. Story #69
body: Every sunset that June seemed to pause, as if waiting for them to notice.\n\n

/>

Only they never did. Maya would keep looking down at her phone where her life consisted of people she did not even know, and Leo kept struggling to pen down a melody that would never feel quite like himself.

Both had decided to go to the coastal cottage to find themselves, yet all they could find there was the growing silence between them.

And then, at the very end of the month, they lost power. With no other choice than to get outside, Leo and Maya sat down on the porch and watched in amazement as their skies burned in the most vibrant purple, leaving marks on their cheeks. They both turned away from what consumed their days and stared at each other for once – Leo put his notebook down and Maya looked up from the endless scrolling of her phone.

\

Leo murmured.\n\nHe took Maya's hand in his own and they both sat down on the stairs, looking at the dying fire before them. Saltwater and wind were in the air, and although they did nothing about fixing what was broken between them, they at least stopped running away from it. All they could do in those final minutes of light was watch it fade into blackness, while holding hands.

title: Time flowers on nature's canvas.
body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejqCjSbybZq5nZi3e1RV3BDu9sCKQHyxFaowtHeTB7vg/1781665379066.jpg) The beauty of nature always envelops us in a strange illusion. One of the unique signs of that beauty is revealed in the picture. Just looking at the picture, the mind becomes refreshed in an instant. A small flower of bright pink or magenta color against a background of green leaves seems to highlight a cheerful aspect of nature. This flower is very well known and popular in our country, which is commonly known as thyme flower. The image shows a single flower unfolding in its full glory. The flower's five petals are perfectly arranged, with a bright yellow stamen in the middle. The contrast of yellow and pink makes the flower even more attractive. Beneath the flower, narrow and succulent green leaves densely wrap around the creeping stem. A special feature of this plant is that its leaves and stems can retain a lot of water, which keeps them fresh even in the hot sun. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxCJuXnVmatgKmyPxV85tGfrJaZzUsHU5cs9PkQsvU4x/1781665379304.jpg) There is a good reason behind the name Time Flower. It usually starts blooming as soon as it gets the sweet morning sun and slowly fades away when the sun starts to get harsher after noon. In sync with the clock Many people call it the time flower or nine o'clock because of its flowering. It is an ideal plant for the balcony or roof garden of urban life. Since it does not require much care, even busy people can easily grow this plant in a pot or hanging basket. You can plant them. With a little soil, enough sunlight, and a little water, they fill the entire garden with flowers. This picture reminds us that you don't always need something big to find happiness. Even a small flower blooming in the corner of your room or on your balcony can bring a slice of peace to a boring mechanical life. When we stop for a moment in the midst of our busy lives and enjoy the beauty of nature, all our fatigue seems to disappear in an instant. This small flower in the picture seems to be sending a silent message to enjoy the small moments of our lives and to smile even in the face of adversity.

title: Hardcore Townsmen! #20 Bakery & Trade [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
body:
> Hello Hive Gamers! Today I bring you the 20th part of my hardcore Townsmen run. Now that the beer industry is fully operational, I can finally dedicate resources to an objective that I have been wanting to accomplish for a long time: producing bread. It might sound like a simple task under normal gameplay conditions, but in a custom hardcore scenario locked in a permanent winter, sowing wheat locally is completely impossible. To bypass this environmental barrier, I had to execute a multi-step logistical plan. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU4MDNdPKjLQctPj22Gqf571AkgPRg5i3aiGagh79kK2M/1781623666358.jpg) First, I demolished an old hunter's hut located near the core of the village to free up flat space and build a bakery on that exact spot. Of course, I didn't want to lose my meat supply, so I rebuilt that hunter's hut in a more remote area away from the city center, placing it where the worker can track and hunt deer much more easily. With the space cleared, I assigned a worker to the local windmill to start grinding wheat into flour, which is the primary resource the new bakery requires to produce bread for the population. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS9PcujMy6QeiQTrGwbG8E96Lng5odHkUEomW78hkqKRq/1781623666455.jpg) This is where our essential ally, the merchant, enters the strategic equation. The entire system relies on external trade: we sell him our excess stockpiles of charcoal and leather to keep our treasury liquid, and in return, we buy the massive shipments of wheat and hops that the unceasing cold prevents us from farming. Additionally, during his visit, I purchased extra fish to boost the village food reserves even further, alongside a batch of tools required for future infrastructure construction. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4X6gVMxih8pJXWjCSrLw7XC7yDNvLHc9dD5Bwga9b46/1781623666538.jpg) Just like that, a tight network of production and trade is woven. The bakery is now fully constructed and actively supplying a new, high-quality food source to the townnies. With the food supply stabilized and the core supply chains secure, D-Day has passed, and I can finally turn my attention toward aggressively increasing the population and scaling up the overall infrastructure of the city. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSSGjNAHf5ruaUdx2X5aGmknxfkBr7BKUWm4dYDW4WgTw/1781623666616.jpg) |
Español
| |-| ------

> ¡Hola Gamers de Hive! Hoy les traigo la 20ma parte de mi partida hardcore de Townsmen. Ahora que la producción de cerveza está en marcha por completo, finalmente puedo dedicar recursos a un objetivo que tenía mucho tiempo queriendo cumplir: producir pan. Podrá sonar como algo simple bajo condiciones normales de juego, pero en un escenario hardcore con invierno permanente es totalmente imposible sembrar trigo de forma local. Para superar esta barrera ambiental, tuve que poner en marcha una serie de pasos logísticos. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVKSbjoADmv1fu3wkWC993FreGhTPQK6D9HhzVtebdCvU/1781623694266.jpg) Primero, demolí una antigua cabaña de cazador ubicada cerca del núcleo de la aldea para liberar terreno llano y construir una panadería en ese punto exacto. Por supuesto, no quería perder el suministro de carne, así que reconstruí esa cabaña de cazador en un área más alejada del centro de la ciudad, posicionándola donde el trabajador pueda rastrear y cazar ciervos con mayor facilidad. Con el espacio despejado, asigné un trabajador al molino para comenzar a procesar el trigo y transformarlo en harina, que es la materia prima que la panadería necesita para hornear pan para la población. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRYfJeoMpMxqajBaMjx7dW4oofZ8XjVS1FQHzrh8M7yy6/1781623694376.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeqKw7jmJoQsWKas7EJ33S8NVFuH8RUgsCzJ93uNhVGK6/1781623694486.jpg) Aquí es donde entra en la ecuación estratégica nuestro aliado esencial, el mercader. Todo el sistema depende del comercio exterior: le vendemos el carbón y el cuero que nos sobra para mantener el tesoro líquido y, a cambio, le compramos los cargamentos masivos de trigo y lúpulo que el invierno incesante nos impide sembrar. Además, durante su visita, aproveché para comprar pescado extra para aumentar aún más las reservas de alimento, junto con un lote de herramientas necesarias para las futuras construcciones. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPiKheJRaZ57rdynJvhkSj1iDBbqJkhvdY3brwioR1Bhs/1781623694583.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUSMFypJCTUWq98UE1ik48SEyC781o9JJ2h25Quz8CD5a/1781623694689.jpg) Y listo, así se teje una red eficiente de producción y comercio. La panadería ya está construida y produciendo activamente una nueva fuente de comida para los townnies. Con el suministro de alimento estabilizado y las cadenas de suministro base aseguradas, la Hora H ha pasado, y ahora puedo enfocarme completamente en aumentar la población y continuar mejorando la infraestructura de la ciudad. ------ ---- |

title: Chicken with Feather Paste (Eng/Esp)
body:
> My lunch today was a delicious chicken stew with feather-shaped pasta. I used zucchini and tomato as the main vegetables to give this chicken an incredible flavor. I also added onion and potatoes to balance out the dish. Let’s get started—let’s get to work.
![1000121029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zkrVfVu5o4h5WyYa5gxDfJ4CDhDLQ91cEwDMM3WaWzbQKMUyd7VPryotbMcFYTeAsRA.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 4 pieces of chicken - 1/2 zucchini - 1 tomato - 1 onion - 3 potatoes - 2 liters of water - 1/2 kilo of pasta (feather-shaped) - Butter - Salt to taste - Oil
![1000121018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wgMz5FCEUYvmNZspsW36JwRmb4xDFFyeEmsUmQqDvRthGS5zViYGxrcm67RAQxD5isR.jpg)
## Procedure: I washed the vegetables and herbs one by one to remove any impurities. Then I removed the seeds from the tomatoes and cut them into small pieces. Next, I peeled the zucchini and potatoes. Then I cut them into medium-sized pieces; I did the same with the onion after removing its outer layer. I washed the chicken pieces and drained them, then rubbed them with salt.
![1000121021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xKr2wQVm9Gra6cUY8yGZc8baR4eNtTNov3wqriPwniSyXuVwJauiinQjKWMuNLFjiym.jpg)
![1000121024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uR1EncL3ctXcCFgorDdW3nTDTWVedmb1NJ3pF9CAPz46gKFt8aEcuHNNw4cJHNS9pQc.jpg)
I placed all the ingredients in a skillet with a dash of oil, then stirred them to combine. This time I wanted to cook them differently because I was short on time, so I poured in half a cup of water—this would help the vegetables cook faster.
![1000121027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmN5e2KLoma2znfTPsVLYw5wEd4RPnCqEcQKc4swD7rTv1jJLHGani1DYUYkWEQ2AfA.jpg)
Meanwhile, I filled a pot with two liters of water and a tablespoon of salt. I waited for it to come to a boil and added half a kilo of pasta, which was done in seven minutes. I drained the excess water and tossed the pasta with butter. Everything was ready in twenty minutes. That’s how I enjoyed my lunch, which was delicious. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Mi almuerzo de hoy fue un delicioso pollo guisado con pasta en forma de plumitas. Usé calabacín y tomate como verduras principales para dar un sabor increíble a este pollo. Además agregué cebolla y papas, así equilibré este platillo. Empecemos, vamos manos a la obra.
![1000121029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zkrVfVu5o4h5WyYa5gxDfJ4CDhDLQ91cEwDMM3WaWzbQKMUyd7VPryotbMcFYTeAsRA.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 4 piezas de pollo - 1/2 calabacín - 1 tomate - 1 cebolla - 3 papas - 2 litros de agua - 1/2 kilo de pasta (en forma de Plumitas) - Mantequilla - Sal al gusto - Aceite
![1000121018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wgMz5FCEUYvmNZspsW36JwRmb4xDFFyeEmsUmQqDvRthGS5zViYGxrcm67RAQxD5isR.jpg)
## Procedimiento: Lavé los vegetales y los aliños uno por uno para retirar las impurezas. Luego extraje las semillas de los tomates y los corté en trozos pequeños. Posteriormente, quité las conchas del calabacín y de las papas. Luego corté en pedazos medianos, hice lo propio con la cebolla, después de retirar su primera capa. Lavé las piezas de pollo y las escurrí, luego les unté sal.
![1000121021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xKr2wQVm9Gra6cUY8yGZc8baR4eNtTNov3wqriPwniSyXuVwJauiinQjKWMuNLFjiym.jpg)
![1000121024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uR1EncL3ctXcCFgorDdW3nTDTWVedmb1NJ3pF9CAPz46gKFt8aEcuHNNw4cJHNS9pQc.jpg)
En un sartén coloqué todos los ingredientes con un toque de aceite, allí revolví para integrarlos. Esta vez quise cocinarlos diferente porque disponía de poco tiempo, por eso vertí media taza de agua, esta ayudaría a que los vegetales se cocinaran más rápido.
![1000121027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmN5e2KLoma2znfTPsVLYw5wEd4RPnCqEcQKc4swD7rTv1jJLHGani1DYUYkWEQ2AfA.jpg)
Por otra parte, monté una olla con dos litros de agua y una cucharada de sal. Luego esperé que hirviera y añadí medio kilo de pasta, la cual esponjó en siete minutos. Retiré el exceso de agua y unté mantequilla. Todo estuvo listo en veinte minutos. Así disfruté de mi almuerzo, el cual estaba delicioso.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title: The promise you need to hear about identity | El Espíritu nunca se termina — de maneras que no imaginás
body:
La fe no es ver para creer. Es creer para ver. Y cuando creemos, Dios actúa de maneras que nunca podríamos imaginar.

Dios te está diciendo hoy: dame esa carga que estás llevando, dame esa preocupación que no te deja dormir. Yo me encargo. Vos solo confiá.

¿Alguna vez te sentiste que caminas en círculos? Que no importa lo que hagas, las cosas simplemente no parecen cambiar? Conozco ese sentimiento bien.

No te rindas. No ahora. Dios está trabajando en las sombras, moviendo piezas que vos no ves. Pero pronto vas a ver Su mano actuar de una manera que te va a sorprender.

Pero allí es donde debemos recordar esta verdad: la luz de Cristo no compite con la oscuridad, la vence. La oscuridad no puede frenar la luz de Cristo, ni mucho menos apagarla.
  
> Tan compasivo es el SEñOR con los que le temen como lo es un padre con sus hijos.

Psalm 103:13 (Salmo 103:13)

## Dios te bendiga hoy y siempre!!!

<center>![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/1766838/pexels-photo-1766838.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>

*Image: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/) | Word: [Bible Gateway](https://www.biblegateway.com/)*

God always has good news for us. Regardless of your social status, your history, your past, or anything else. The message from heaven is one of grace, redemption, and forgiveness.

Today I want to leave you with this truth: God is never late, He never fails, He never makes mistakes. His timing is perfect and His love is endless. Trust Him.

But this is where we must remember this truth: the light of Christ doesn't compete with darkness—it overcomes it. Darkness cannot stop the light of Christ, nor can it extinguish it.

When you learn to let go and let God take control, that's when you really start to live. What seems like madness to the world can be your greatest blessing.

There are moments in life when things get really heavy. Moments when we have to make really tough decisions or face internal battles that don't let us move forward.
  
> As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him;

Psalm 103:13 (Salmo 103:13)

## God bless you today and always!!!

title: Organizador Leebit para el tocador/'Leebit' organiser for the dressing table ✂️🐇
body:
> 

Hello gente creativa de Hive, que tal todo?! 
Si estaban esperando la culminación de la repisa pues yo también 🤣🤣, y es que para estas alturas creí que ya estaría lista, pero la verdad es que ha tomado bastante tiempo, sobre todo porque entre paso y paso hay un tiempo de espera, además surgió un problemita de último momento que estoy resolviendo, sin embargo, aunque la repisa sigue *\

*, hoy hice una cosita súper bella para mi muñeca Miranda y se trata de un **oanizador para cepillos de Leebit** que es el Skyzoo de Lee Know (Lee Min-ho) su cantante favorito del grupo de K-Pop **Stray Kids**.

<blockquote>

Hello gente creativa de Hive, que tal todo?! 
Si estaban esperando la culminación de la repisa pues yo también 🤣🤣, y es que para estas alturas creí que ya estaría lista, pero la verdad es que ha tomado bastante tiempo, sobre todo porque entre paso y paso hay un tiempo de espera, además surgió un problemita de último momento que estoy resolviendo, sin embargo, aunque la repisa sigue *\

*, hoy hice una cosita súper bella para mi muñeca Miranda y se trata de un porta cepillos de Leebit que es el Skyzoo de Lee Know (Lee Min-ho) su cantante favorito del grupo de K-Pop **Stray Kids**. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWyGP3DvFV71wEu922F9AV34dCu6Ka9RAUWED59YiYNH1/1781665648799.png) *** Leebit es un conejito blanco súper lindo con unos ojitos muy particulares y de él ya hemos hecho algunas cositas que no hemos compartido, y digo *\

* porque como saben Miri y yo estamos trabajando en conjunto con las decoraciones de su cuarto y hace un tiempo tenía pendiente trabajar en un soporte para sus audífonos tratando de recrear unos muy lindos que hemos visto en **pinterest** y entre los muchos que vimos nos encontramos con uno de Leebit súper lindo que de hecho comencé a elaborar, pero también tiene su proceso y lo he ido trabajando por partes, ya que la base será de una mezcla de yeso y cemento y toca esperar que seque. La cosa es que para adelantar decidí hacer la cara de Leebit que será parte del soporte y mientras trabajaba en ella pensé en hacer otra cosita (normal en mi) y se trata de un porta cepillos, algo que quería hacer desde hace rato, ya que mi idea con la habitación de Miranda es ayudar en lo posible a eliminar o controlar un poco el ruido visual creado diferentes organizadores para que todo se mantenga en orden y bonito y ya que tenemos varias cosas de Leebit una más no vendría mal. Así que por aquí les dejo el paso a paso.
Leebit is a super-cute little white bunny with some very distinctive little eyes, and we’ve already made a few things featuring him that we haven’t shared yet – and I say *“we”* because, as you know, Miri and I are working together on the decorations for her room, and for a while now I’ve been meaning to make a stand for her headphones, trying to recreate some really lovely ones we’ve seen on **Pinterest** and amongst the many we saw, we came across a really cute Leebit one that I actually started making, but it’s quite a process and I’ve been working on it bit by bit, as the base will be a mixture of plaster and cement and I have to wait for it to dry. The thing is, to get a head start, I decided to make the Leebit face that’ll be part of the stand, and whilst I was working on it, I thought of making another little something (typical of me) – a toothbrush holder, something I’ve wanted to make for a while, as my aim with Miranda’s room is to help, as much as possible, to eliminate or control some of the visual clutter by creating different organisers so that everything stays tidy and looks nice, and since we have quite a few Leebit items, one more wouldn’t go amiss. So here’s the step-by-step guide.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcaaQcU3UZcbHLU1tvvjq3Qs2mQjWFzPvFLXrFA3aRTVE/1781664608116.jpg) *** ## Materiales Cartón grueso Foami blanco, negro y rosado Silicón frío Lápiz Tijera Rollo de papel sanitario Pistola de silicón Impresión del Leebit
## Materials Thick card White, black and pink foam Cold-set silicone Pencil Scissors Toilet roll Silicone gun Leebit printout
## Paso a paso/ Step by step Para este proyecto quise imprimir la carita del Leebit y así asegurar que quedara lo mejor posible en cuanto a las proporciones y forma del conejito, y lo que hice fue recortar la figura y reproducir la silueta en el cartón y cortarlas, y en este caso corté dos, para trabajar según el modelo de algunos organizadores que también vi en pinterest donde el rollo de papel queda oculto entre las dos piezas.
For this project, I wanted to print out the Leebit’s face to ensure that the bunny’s proportions and shape turned out as well as possible. What I did was cut out the figure, trace the outline onto the card and cut them out – in this case, I cut out two – to follow the design of some organisers I’d also seen on Pinterest, where the roll of paper is hidden between the two pieces.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme3NHGuYkqZuF6MNLURTMicuxQFz14sBvho5VLw8uJNbF/1781664721517.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc49LEfwAu6mV51ubqPRaCD8xYL8QUHHMnspraC2t7Euf/1781664608246.jpg) *** El siguiente paso fue marcar y cortar sobre el foami blanco la silueta de Leebit para cubrir el cartón por ambos lados y las pegué con el silicón líquido.
The next step was to trace and cut out Leebit’s silhouette from the white foam to cover both sides of the cardboard, and I stuck them on using liquid silicone.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWh7MBufVxJ5wdB4ybkFTxmfCEKkoCDKHbSibXe3phcDh/1781664608386.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd6LGEsNUkfgFTJpowLvKz5PduXSHZ5hsMoU2VdtwboQw/1781664608565.jpg) *** Listo este paso, lo que sigue es hacer la parte rosa de las orejitas de Leebit y para esto también utilicé la imagen impresa, y lo que hice fue remarcar sobre el foami la parte rosada de las orejitas, las recorté y pegué con silicón frío.
Once this step is complete, the next thing to do is make the pink part of Leebit’s little ears. For this, I also used the printed image; I traced the pink part of the ears onto the foam, cut them out and stuck them on with cold silicone glue.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQPKp7cPPt4m48TvxuRDwactyLguCb65gdodvBBt8xHTC/1781664608737.jpg) *** El paso que sigue fue una total pesadilla y les hablo de los ojitos de Leebit que tienen una forma bien particular, y nada fácil de cortar en foami, sobre todo porque se trata de piezas pequeñas, pero después de muchos intentos quedaron bastante decentes. Por su parte, la nariz, aunque me parecía muy fácil de hacer me costó que quedara como yo quería y la boca, que me parecía difícil me salió al primer intento y una vez tuve ojos, boca y nariz listos los pegué en la cara del Leebit.
The next step was a complete nightmare – I’m talking about Leebit’s little eyes, which have a very distinctive shape and are far from easy to cut out of foam, especially as they’re such small pieces – but after many attempts, they turned out quite well. As for the nose, although it seemed very easy to make, I struggled to get it just right, whilst the mouth – which I thought would be difficult – turned out perfectly on the first go. Once I’d got the eyes, mouth and nose ready, I stuck them onto Leebit’s face.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPpRAEJ9FrLFp7SUrGDjrvDU1R1S4XYC8L7HziLWKaSh/1781664721669.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVCxhs6C1c8SF5XMWEuS31iCZ9VaZwp6vDQY6GjNvgTZZ/1781664721828.jpg) *** En este punto lo que sigue es cortar un listón de foami negro un poco más grueso que el grosor de la silueta del Leebit y pegarlo con el silicón frío por todo el borde de ambas siluetas dejando que sobresalga un poco por encima del borde y de esta forma tenemos listas las dos piezas.
At this stage, the next step is to cut a strip of black foam that is slightly thicker than the Leebit silhouette and stick it down using cold silicone along the entire edge of both silhouettes, allowing it to protrude slightly beyond the edge; this completes both pieces.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRahR15PywARo1Smzp69fJK7vjDWS9eXcJaEUi5QXj8JT/1781664721966.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYfpF4imKf9oFVgR5TnnUGVhHDD1PY664XmcLBSgT4qUH/1781664722097.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsoHb5hC5a4MXTXxJzYkSBR1GMjWZrYs4vANEnFNDQaW/1781664901507.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es cubrir el rollo de papel sanitario con foami negro dejando en uno de sus extremos que sobresalga por lo menos 1 cm para luego doblar hacia adentro y pegar con silicón caliente.
The next step is to cover the roll of toilet paper with black foam, leaving at least 1 cm protruding from one end, then fold it inwards and secure it with hot glue.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyZ3uyvVE1e4V144sy4Jr3yj9CyRimLCbX69VVFLZ2af/1781664901644.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdkkh6VWGo7obEeVicErAExhF9CEQYDthvXywmzK2GsVw/1781664901769.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es cortar un círculo en cartón para la base del rollo de papel sanitario y pegarlo con la pistola de silicón, y seguidamente fijamos las dos piezas del Leebit al rollito de papel y listo. No hay excusas para no tener la cómoda ordenada y bonita! >The next step is to cut a circle out of card for the base of the toilet roll and stick it on with the hot-glue gun, then attach the two Leebit pieces to the toilet roll – and that’s it. There’s no excuse not to keep your chest of drawers tidy and looking smart! ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQNxyEBS6p7bRrvj2VyfKtHxyHkERKC66B7va3xj2LiAY/1781664901909.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYKeUqA5YZYVEpmmVhdc89DwwQsJP222jS1psUtbA6JPN/1781664902043.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYnUJKthSpuCpfGobMgEKNwbxXgF2Nd55XvFfx5xwiq7m/1781664986057.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcaaQcU3UZcbHLU1tvvjq3Qs2mQjWFzPvFLXrFA3aRTVE/1781664986168.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfV2HeGArs6zy2XK3uj95J3iKUyvQQvkxBrmzGtBW6Fec/1781664986293.jpg) *** El resultado yo lo amé y Miranda mucho más, y es que la verdad se ve precioso y quedé feliz con el acabado final ya que está bastante prolijo. Ustedes qué opinan? >I loved the result, and Miranda loved it even more – it really does look lovely, and I was delighted with the final finish as it’s very neat. What do you think?

title: Top Nệm Như Cầu Mát Giúp Ngủ Ngon, Thoải Mái Trong Mùa Hè
body:
Vào những ngày hè oi bức, việc lựa chọn một chiếc nệm có khả năng làm mát tốt là yếu tố quan trọng giúp nâng cao chất lượng giấc ngủ. Trong số các dòng sản phẩm được ưa chuộng hiện nay, nệm như cầu mát đang trở thành lựa chọn hàng đầu nhờ khả năng thoáng khí, êm ái và mang lại cảm giác dễ chịu suốt đêm dài.

Nệm như cầu mát được thiết kế với cấu trúc đặc biệt giúp tăng cường khả năng lưu thông không khí bên trong. Nhờ đó, nhiệt lượng và hơi ẩm tích tụ trong quá trình ngủ được giải phóng hiệu quả, hạn chế tình trạng bí nóng hay đổ mồ hôi lưng thường gặp ở các loại nệm truyền thống. Đây là giải pháp lý tưởng cho những gia đình sinh sống tại khu vực có khí hậu nóng ẩm hoặc những người thường xuyên cảm thấy nóng khi ngủ.

Một trong những ưu điểm nổi bật của nệm như cầu mát là khả năng nâng đỡ cơ thể tối ưu. Bề mặt nệm có độ đàn hồi phù hợp, giúp phân tán áp lực đồng đều lên các vùng vai, lưng và hông. Điều này góp phần giảm tình trạng đau nhức cơ thể sau khi thức dậy, đồng thời hỗ trợ cột sống duy trì tư thế tự nhiên trong suốt thời gian nghỉ ngơi.

Ngoài khả năng làm mát, nhiều mẫu nệm hiện đại còn được tích hợp công nghệ kháng khuẩn và chống nấm mốc. Điều này giúp giữ cho môi trường ngủ luôn sạch sẽ, hạn chế sự phát triển của vi khuẩn và các tác nhân gây dị ứng. Đây là yếu tố đặc biệt quan trọng đối với trẻ nhỏ, người cao tuổi hoặc những người có làn da nhạy cảm.

Hiện nay, thị trường có nhiều loại nệm như cầu mát với chất liệu đa dạng như foam, cao su thiên nhiên hoặc lò xo kết hợp lớp vải làm mát cao cấp. Mỗi dòng sản phẩm đều sở hữu những ưu điểm riêng, đáp ứng nhu cầu sử dụng khác nhau của người tiêu dùng. Những mẫu nệm cao cấp thường được trang bị lớp áo nệm ứng dụng công nghệ làm mát tiên tiến, mang lại cảm giác mát lạnh ngay khi tiếp xúc.

Khi chọn mua nệm như cầu mát, người dùng nên cân nhắc kích thước giường, thói quen ngủ cũng như ngân sách cá nhân. Bên cạnh đó, việc lựa chọn sản phẩm từ các thương hiệu uy tín sẽ giúp đảm bảo chất lượng, độ bền và chế độ bảo hành lâu dài. Một chiếc nệm phù hợp không chỉ giúp cải thiện chất lượng giấc ngủ mà còn góp phần chăm sóc sức khỏe xương khớp hiệu quả.

Có thể thấy rằng nệm như cầu mát là giải pháp lý tưởng cho mùa hè nhờ khả năng thoáng khí, giảm tích nhiệt và nâng đỡ cơ thể tốt. Đầu tư vào một chiếc nệm chất lượng sẽ giúp bạn tận hưởng những giấc ngủ sâu hơn, thức dậy với tinh thần sảng khoái và tràn đầy năng lượng mỗi ngày.

title: La roca más hermosa e inusual de la naturaleza / Viaje a la piedra (Esp | Eng | Pt)
body:
Saludos, amigos de @amazingnature. Se nos convoca a un concurso que tenga como tema la piedra. Debo reconocer que esta –individual o en conjunto– es uno de mis objetos naturales preferidos, y durante mi vida de aficionado fotógrafo o de escritor le he dedicado mucha atención.
![100_1706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/EpXKXebxZc7xbo2WBbEa3kyUUJwGFjDNfDyuPSGpu5TQJx7LVKfmpicWfu8dPyJj1rj.jpg)

En el mito, la piedra ocupa un lugar central; por ejemplo, en la mitología greco-latina: el originario [ónfalo](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%93nfalo), el poder petrificador de la [Medusa](https://medium.com/illumination/tales-of-people-turned-to-stone-in-mythology-e326c634bcea), el origen de los hombres y las mujeres en las piedras lanzadas por [Deucalión y Pirra](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deucali%C3%B3n), el castigo de [Sísifo](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%ADsifo) condenado a subir una piedra gigantesca por la montaña. Pero también en las tierras americanas, las antiguas culturas mesoamericanas (mayas, aztecas) o suramericanas (entre los incas). Ver, verbigracia, [aquí](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0185122516300339). Comparto de mi primer libro el poema “Piedra”, escrito a partir de esa visión mítica:
Piedra I Huesos de la tierra brotados del mundo sumergido     somos guijarros sembrados sobre las primeras huellas II El misterio brilla en nuestra piel de diluvio generación hermanada en el holocausto     nacida de un azar de polvo        de un destino arrojado a las espaldas III Emana de la piedra nuestra desnudez     la intemperie de los cuerpos amanece sobre el barro
Por su carácter originario, la piedra es memoria, identidad, permanencia, quizás eternidad. En las fotos que aquí reproduzco conviven dos elementos arquetípicos: la tierra y el mar, como han sido concebidos, desde el Génesis bíblico (“En el principio creó Dios los cielos y la tierra. La tierra era caos y confusión y oscuridad por encima del abismo, y un viento de Dios aleteaba por encima d las aguas”) hasta el Popol Vuh (“Grande era la descripción y el relato de cómo se acabó de formar todo el cielo y la tierra”, “Sólo estaban el mar en calma y el cielo en toda su extensión”). Casi todas mis fotos recogen la presencia de una piedra peculiar, a veces de una roca montañosa. Suponemos que varias de las mostradas se remontan a mucho tiempo, en la formación de esos lugares; otras son más cercanas temporalmente; sin embargo, también recogen gran paso de los años, como para que la intemperie y el agua marina hayan realizado esos efectos en ella. A mí me maravillan las huellas que van haciendo en ellas, como si se tratara de un escultor o un pintor que va formando o estampando su arte sobre las piedras. Incluí una foto donde puede observarse la convivencia entre lo vegetal y lo mineral, y también una en la que notamos cómo la piedra se hace sostén de la construcción humana.

(English version)

Nature's Most Beautiful and Unusual Rock / Journey to the Stone Greetings, friends of @amazingnature. We've been invited to a contest with the theme of stone. I must admit that this—individually or in groups—is one of my favorite natural objects, and throughout my life as an amateur photographer and writer, I've dedicated much attention to it. In myth, the stone occupies a central place; For example, in Greco-Roman mythology: the original omphalos, the petrifying power of Medusa, the origin of men and women from the stones thrown by Deucalion and Pyrrha, and the punishment of Sisyphus, condemned to roll a gigantic boulder up a mountain. But also in the Americas, in ancient Mesoamerican cultures (Mayans, Aztecs) and South American cultures (among the Incas). See, for example, [here](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0185122516300339). I share from my first book the poem “Stone,” written from that mythical vision: Stone I Bones of the earth sprouted from the submerged world we are pebbles sown upon the first footprints II The mystery shines on our skin of deluge generation united in the holocaust born from a chance of dust from a destiny cast on our backs III Our nakedness emanates from the stone the exposure of bodies dawns upon the mud By its primordial nature, the stone is memory, identity, Permanence, perhaps eternity. In the photos I reproduce here, two archetypal elements coexist: earth and sea, as they have been conceived, from the biblical Genesis (“In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. The earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters”) to the Popol Vuh (“Great was the description and the account of how all the heavens and the earth were formed,” “Only the calm sea and the sky in all its expanse remained”). Almost all my photos capture the presence of a peculiar stone, sometimes a mountain rock. We assume that several of those shown date back to a long time ago, to the formation of those places; others are more recent, yet they also bear witness to the passage of years, enough for the weather and seawater to have worked their magic. I am amazed by the marks they leave on them, as if a sculptor or painter were shaping or imprinting their art on the stones. I've included a photo showing the coexistence of plant and mineral life, and also one where we can see how the stone supports the human construction.

(Portuguese version)

A Rocha Mais Bela e Invulgar da Natureza / Viagem até à Pedra Saudações, amigos do @amazingnature. Fomos convidados para um concurso com o tema pedra. Devo admitir que este — individualmente ou em grupo — é um dos meus objetos naturais favoritos e, ao longo da minha vida como fotógrafo e escritor amador, dediquei-lhe muita atenção. Na mitologia, a pedra ocupa um lugar central; por exemplo, na mitologia greco-romana: o ônfalo original, o poder petrificante de Medusa, a origem do homem e da mulher a partir das pedras atiradas por Deucalião e Pirra, e o castigo de Sísifo, condenado a rolar uma pedra gigantesca montanha acima. Mas também nas Américas, nas antigas culturas mesoamericanas (maias, astecas) e sul-americanas (entre os Incas). Ver, por exemplo, [aqui](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0185122516300339). Partilho do meu primeiro livro o poema “Pedra”, escrito a partir desta visão mítica: Pedra I Ossos da terra brotaram do mundo submerso nós somos seixos semeados sobre as primeiras pegadas II O mistério brilha na nossa pele de dilúvio geração unida no holocausto nascida de um acaso de pó de um destino lançado sobre as nossas costas III A nossa nudez emana da pedra a exposição dos corpos amanhece sobre a lama Pela sua natureza primordial, a pedra é memória, identidade, Permanência, talvez eternidade. Nas fotos que aqui reproduzo, coexistem dois elementos arquetípicos: a terra e o mar, tal como foram concebidos desde o Génesis bíblico (“No princípio, Deus criou os céus e a terra. A terra, porém, estava sem forma e vazia; havia trevas sobre a face do abismo, e o Espírito de Deus pairava sobre as águas”) até ao Popol Vuh (“Grande foi a descrição e o relato de como todos os céus e a terra foram formados”, “Restam apenas o mar calmo e o céu em toda a sua extensão”). Quase todas as minhas fotos captam a presença de uma pedra peculiar, por vezes uma rocha de montanha. Presumimos que várias das pedras aqui apresentadas datam de tempos remotos, da formação destes lugares; outras são mais recentes, mas também testemunham a passagem dos anos, o suficiente para que o clima e a água do mar exercessem a sua magia. Impressionam-me as marcas que deixam, como se um escultor ou pintor estivesse a moldar ou a imprimir a sua arte nas pedras. Incluí uma foto que mostra a coexistência da vida vegetal e mineral, e também uma onde podemos ver como a pedra suporta a construção humana.

Hoy salí un rato con mi mejor amiga en su auto, dimos una vuelta, conversamos de todo un poco y aprovechamos para pasar tiempo juntas ❤️

También jugamos un rato al básquet 🏀 Aunque debo admitir que soy pésima jugando jajaja, aun así, nos divertimos muchísimo y terminamos riéndonos más de mis fallos que de cualquier otra cosa 😂

Después nos premiamos con un delicioso helado 🍦✨ y cerramos el día de la mejor manera posible, disfrutando una hamburguesa increíble 🍔🤤

Sin duda, esos planes simples terminan siendo los que dejan los mejores recuerdos 💕

.
.
.
.

Today I went out for a drive with my best friend, we spent some time together, talked about all kinds of things, and simply enjoyed each other's company ❤️

We also played a little basketball 🏀 although I have to admit I'm absolutely terrible at it hahaha, still, we had so much fun and ended up laughing more at my mistakes than at anything else 😂

After that, we treated ourselves to some delicious ice cream 🍦✨ and finished the day in the best possible way: enjoying an amazing burger 🍔🤤

Sometimes, the simplest plans create the best memories 💕

title: (Story) Don't read me. 🗒️ [Eng+Spa] No me leas. 📝
body:
* * *

* * *

(Versión en español más abajo).
-------------------------------

* * *

* * *

This story is my entry for the \

contest by @freewritehouse. I hope you enjoy it. * * * * * * Don't read me. ============== The man sat down on the park bench to catch his breath, and there he found a sticker stuck to the metal, as simple as a prank and as serious as a threat: **_“Don't read me.”_** He laughed, first out of weariness and then because of the kind of contradiction that only appears when life decides to speak in a low voice. Because to obey the order, one had to read it first, and by reading it, one had already disobeyed.

/>

[Image source: Generated with Ideogram.ai](https://ideogram.ai/g/xd4uPEzuRVicHWeGvfgJ2Q/3)

The Bench and the Afternoon
---------------------------

He had left work a while ago. He was walking home to save on the fare, his body stiff from the effort of carrying sacks, moving boxes, and cleaning the old dust from a warehouse that smelled of damp cardboard and resignation.

He had only sat down for a moment, he said to himself, just a moment.

\

he murmured, resting his elbows on his knees.

The park was almost empty. A child chased a ball far away, a woman gathered dry leaves with a long stick, and the air held that golden hue that comes before nightfall. The bench, the sticker, and the silence formed a scene too still to be entirely normal.

The man smiled sadly.

\

The Invisible Trap
------------------

His mind, which hadn't entirely lost the habit of thinking like a university student and arguing with the world, wandered down strange paths. He recalled stories where the absurd opened the door to other laws, as if common sense had been left outside waiting for permission to enter. He also thought of theaters where no one spoke as they should and of stories where the impossible didn't apologize for existing.

\

He looked at his hands, worn from years of hard work, and felt more tired than before. He had studied for years, pursued postgraduate studies, and dreamed of a life less cruel to his knees and shoulders, but crises, both external and internal, had pushed him to this harsh present where any daily wage seemed like a lifeline.

\

But his body did change. And at a certain age, his body didn't negotiate as much anymore.

He looked at the sticker again.

\

The Voice Beside Him
--------------------

He tried to get up but discovered his body wouldn't quite respond. Exhaustion had turned his legs into two columns of dust?

Then he heard a voice to his right:

\

He turned his head.

Beside him, at the end of the bench, sat a strange man. He was dressed in a way that was too ordinary to be reassuring, but there was something wrong with his face, as if someone had patiently and angrily molded it. He smiled with an odd thinness, and his features seemed to loosen and tighten like living clay.

The protagonist swallowed.

\

The Face of Fear
----------------

The man felt a chill.

He didn't know what that thing was. He didn't want to name it. He was worried enough just not dying right there. He thought of a carnivorous plant, a patiently set trap, a creature that didn't hunt by chasing its prey but by letting the prey approach on its own. He understood, with sudden clarity, that this wasn't about hunting; it was simply about setting a **_\

_** and waiting for the prey to fall in on its own.

Then he remembered an old prayer, one of those he had learned many years ago and never thought he would use again.

He began to recite it in a low voice. In a sacred language that, in his mouth, sounded like rusty diction, clear but showing little everyday use.

The stranger's smile broke. His face changed to features of almost caricatured rage, but there was no way he could laugh.

\

he growled.

The being's arm pointed at him and began to lengthen, slowly and twisted, as if the flesh no longer knew what form it should obey.

The protagonist stood up with effort. His knees ached, his back burned, but he continued speaking in that sacred tongue, clinging to his memory like someone holding onto a rope at the edge of a well.

\

And he ran.

The Escape
----------

He crossed the plaza without looking back. His breath caught in his chest, and each step seemed to apologize to his joints. Behind him, the stranger roared, but he didn't get up from the bench.

He only heard the voice as he ran.

\

The man didn't answer. He ran, thinking, amidst his fear, that he wasn't arrogant enough to believe he could defeat such a creature. He just wanted to get away. Sometimes winning isn't about defeating the monster; sometimes it's enough to escape the reach of its hunger. Just surviving was victory enough.

He didn't know if it was a \

or something else that language hadn't yet named. Nor did he want to find out. The only certainty was that he had grasped something useful at a crucial moment: some entities depend on rules as absurd as their traps, and old knowledge, kept like a forgotten coin in a pocket, can still save a life if used wisely.

He finally stopped by a wall and bent over to catch his breath.

\

Then he hesitated. Perhaps that square existed. Perhaps it hadn't. Perhaps it had only been a stage woven by that presence to lure him closer. But it didn't matter anymore. He was out. The Empty Bench --------------- As he retraced his steps home, he reflected on the irony of the whole affair. The sticker had seemed like a cruel joke but also a fitting metaphor for many things in life: rules written to bring down anyone who tries to obey them. It reminded him of certain human laws, drafted with such subtle malice that they seem designed to punish anyone, making escape by conventional means impossible. In the deserted square, the stranger remained seated, annoyed, knowing he had lost his prey. He raised a hand toward the sticker. The paper peeled off on its own and fell into his palm. He smiled once more, with the calm of someone already planning another hunting ground. Then he vanished into thin air, and the bench remained empty, still, as if nothing had happened. But the man walking away knew that something had indeed happened. And as he walked towards his house, his body aching and his soul alert, he thought that sometimes intelligence isn't useful for solving everything in life, but it is useful for running away at the right moment. * * *

> (English version above). ------------------------ * * * No me leas. =========== El hombre se sentó en la banca de la plaza para recuperar el aliento, y allí encontró una pegatina pegada al metal, tan simple como una travesura y tan seria como una amenaza: **_“No me leas.”_** Le dio risa, primero por cansancio y después por la clase de contradicción que solo aparece cuando la vida decide hablar en voz baja. Porque para obedecer la orden había que leerla antes, y al leerla ya se había desobedecido.

/>

[Fuente de la imagen: Generada con Ideogram.ai](https://ideogram.ai/g/wKr3h72xRIqHVoX1eTsqqQ/2)

La banca y la tarde
-------------------

Había salido del trabajo hacía rato. Caminaba hacia su casa para ahorrar el pasaje, con el cuerpo duro por el esfuerzo de cargar sacos, mover cajas y limpiar el polvo viejo de un almacén que olía a cartón húmedo y resignación.

Se había sentado solo un momento, dijo para sí mismo, solo un momento.

—Solo cinco minutos —murmuró, mientras apoyaba los codos en las rodillas.

La plaza estaba casi vacía. Un niño perseguía una pelota lejos de allí, una señora recogía las hojas secas con un palo largo, y el aire tenía ese color dorado que llega antes de que anochezca. El banco, la pegatina y el silencio formaban una escena demasiado quieta para ser del todo normal.

El hombre sonrió con tristeza.

—Qué truco tan viejo —pensó—. Una orden imposible para atrapar a cualquiera que tenga la mala costumbre de leer para entender lo que lee.

La trampa invisible
-------------------

Su mente, que no había perdido del todo la costumbre de pensar como un universitario y de discutir con el mundo, se fue por caminos raros. Recordó cuentos donde lo absurdo abría la puerta a otras leyes, como si el sentido común se hubiera quedado afuera esperando permiso para entrar. También pensó en teatros donde nadie hablaba como debía, y en historias donde lo imposible no pedía perdón por existir.

—Esto es una trampa —dijo en voz baja—. Una trampa hecha para la culpa.

Miró sus manos, gastadas por años de trabajo duro, y se sintió más cansado que antes. Había estudiado durante años, había hecho posgrado, había soñado con una vida menos cruel para las rodillas y los hombros, pero las crisis, las de afuera y las de adentro, lo habían empujado hasta ese presente áspero en el que cualquier jornal parecía un salvavidas.

—Todo trabajo honesto es digno —se dijo—. Eso no cambia.

Pero sí cambiaba el cuerpo. Y el cuerpo, a cierta edad, ya no negociaba tanto.

Volvió a mirar la pegatina.

—“No me leas”. Claro —susurró—. Bonita orden. Tan inteligente como pedirle a la lluvia que no moje.

La voz al lado
--------------

Intentó levantarse, pero descubrió que el cuerpo no le respondía del todo. El cansancio le había convertido las piernas en dos columnas de polvo.

Entonces oyó una voz a su derecha:

—¿Sabes que rompiste la regla?

Giró la cabeza.

A su lado, en el extremo de la banca, estaba un hombre extraño. Vestía de una manera demasiado común para resultar tranquilizadora, pero su cara tenía algo mal hecho, como si alguien la hubiera moldeado con paciencia y rabia. Sonreía con una delgadez rara, y sus rasgos parecían aflojarse y tensarse como barro vivo.

El protagonista tragó saliva.

—Es imposible no romperla —dijo—. Para saber qué decía, tuve que leerla. Ya estaba perdida la partida desde el principio.

El extraño inclinó la cabeza, divertido.

—Eso no importa. Las reglas son las reglas.

—¿Aunque estén mal hechas?

—Aunque estén mal hechas.

El rostro del miedo
-------------------

El hombre sintió un escalofrío.

No sabía qué era aquella cosa. No quiso ponerle nombre. Bastante tenía con no morir allí mismo. Pensó en una planta carnívora, en una trampa con paciencia, en una criatura que no cazaba corriendo detrás de su presa, sino dejando que la presa se acercara sola. Comprendió, con una claridad súbita, que aquello no perseguía: **entrampaba**.

Entonces recordó una oración antigua, de esas que aprendió hacía muchos años y que nunca pensó volver a usar.

Comenzó a recitarla en voz baja. En un lenguaje sacro que en su boca sonaba como una dicción oxidada, clara, pero que mostraba poco uso cotidiano.

La sonrisa del extraño se quebró. Su \

cambió a rasgos de rabia casi caricaturesca, pero no había manera de que diera risa.

—¿Crees que puedes ganarme? —gruñó.

El brazo del ser lo apuntó y empezó a alargarse, lento y torcido, como si la carne no supiera ya qué forma debía obedecer.

El protagonista se puso de pie con esfuerzo. Las rodillas le dolieron, la espalda le ardió, pero siguió hablando en aquella lengua sacra, apoyándose en la memoria como quien se agarra de una cuerda al borde de un pozo.

—No para ganarte —respondió—. Para que me sueltes.

Y corrió.

La huida
--------

Atravesó la plaza sin mirar atrás. La respiración se le rompía en el pecho, y cada paso parecía pedirle disculpas a sus articulaciones. Detrás de él, el extraño rugió, pero no se levantó de la banca.

Solo escuchó, mientras corría, la voz.

—¡Rompiste la regla!

El hombre no contestó. Corría y pensaba, en medio del miedo, que no tenía la soberbia de creer que podía vencer a una criatura así. Solo quería alejarse. A veces ganar no es derrotar al monstruo; a veces basta con salir del radio de su hambre. Ya sobrevivir era bastante victoria.

No supo si aquello era un \

con hambre o alguna otra cosa que el lenguaje todavía no había nombrado. Tampoco quiso averiguarlo. Lo único cierto era que había captado algo útil en el momento que le fue vital: algunas entidades dependen de reglas tan absurdas como sus trampas, y el conocimiento viejo, guardado como moneda olvidada en el bolsillo, todavía puede salvar una vida si se usa con astucia. Se detuvo al fin junto a una pared y dobló el cuerpo para recuperar el aire. —Nunca más —se dijo—. Nunca más me siento en esa plaza. Luego dudó. Tal vez esa plaza existía. Tal vez no. Tal vez había sido solo un escenario tejido por aquella presencia para acercarlo. Pero ya no importaba. Había salido. La banca vacía -------------- Mientras retomaba el camino a casa, pensó en lo irónico del asunto. Aquella pegatina le había parecido una broma cruel, pero también una metáfora exacta de muchas cosas en la vida: reglas escritas para hacer caer a quien intenta obedecerlas. Le recordó ciertas leyes humanas, redactadas con una malicia tan fina que parecen hechas para castigar a quien sea, haciendo imposible escapar por medios convencionales. En la plaza solitaria, el extraño seguía sentado, molesto, sabiendo que había perdido una presa. Alzó una mano hacia la pegatina. El papel se desprendió solo y cayó en su palma. Sonrió una vez más, con esa calma de quien ya está planeando otro sitio donde cazar. Después se desvaneció en el aire, y la banca quedó vacía, quieta, como si nada hubiera pasado. Pero el hombre que se alejaba sí sabía que algo había pasado. Y mientras avanzaba hacia su casa, con el cuerpo adolorido y el alma alerta, pensó que a veces la inteligencia no sirve para resolver todo en la vida, pero sí para salir corriendo en el momento justo. * * * * * * #Tribe #creative #fiction #writing #creativewriting #creativecoin #pimp #freewritehouse #freewrite #writingprompt #EscrituraCreativa #Creatividad #Fantasy #Fantasia * * * * * *
