title: Emptiness
body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/14573150/pexels-photo-14573150.jpeg [source]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-reflection-of-a-woman-and-a-chair-on-frozen-body-of-water-14573150/ ) Every person born in this world is born alone. That is, at the time of birth, he does not know who his partner will be, or even who his parents will be. A person is born in this world alone and without clothes, but then as soon as he is born, many relatives are created in his life, many relationships are made new and he starts to know. Gradually, when that person starts growing up, different aspects of his life start happening, but again after some age, some emptiness is seen in that person's life. When we grow up from small to large, that beautiful emotion and love that we have, that emotion and love starts to decrease again after a certain age. There comes a time in our life when we start losing a lot of things. And because of losing all this in our life, a big emptiness is created in our life. When we lose our childhood friends, there is a small emptiness. Gradually, when we lose relatives and loved ones as we grow up, a big emptiness starts to form in our life. But when we lose our parents, the biggest void is created in our lives. In the course of our life, we meet many familiar faces and also get to know many unfamiliar faces. So at some point, we have to lose those familiar faces and the faces that became familiar from strangers often disappear from our lives. However, no one can accept the loss of the most beloved person and the loss of parents. Even if we fill some small gaps in our lives or ignore the gaps, we cannot accept the void created by the absence of our most beloved person and our parents. Some gaps in our lives are such that it is impossible to fill them. With some gaps, we can live a normal life, while with some gaps, we have to live with tears and sighs all our lives. In fact, although many can tolerate the departure of a beloved person, there are many who cannot tolerate it. There are different types of people in our world, among them some people are very realistic and have very hard hearts. They can tolerate everything and accept the departure of their loved one. But there are some people who are very weak in nature, these people with soft hearts, even though they know the reality, they cannot accept the departure of their loved one in any way and the void that is created after the departure of their loved one does not allow them to return to peace or normal life. In fact, if we pay a little attention, we will see that every person in the world has some voids, some big or some small, but not everyone lives equally and not everyone has the same mentality. Some people are seen to go crazy due to the pain of losing their loved one or later leave this world themselves. Each of us has many voids in our lives, in which we sometimes neglect those voids while moving forward in life or fill them with something else. But towards the end of our age or in a quiet time, we definitely remember that void and we sigh. However, we do not need to remember the void of our dearest people and our parents separately or we do not need a quiet afternoon or afternoon, every moment in life we ​​keep remembering the void of our parents and spend our days in pain. In fact, parents are the most valuable assets of our life, so we cannot accept losing this asset in any way and any person breaks down a lot because not all the voids can be filled or all the voids can be neglected or ignored. So despite our great suffering, we have to carry the various voids in our life until our death. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/one-should-never-be-friends-with-an-enemy-kw)

title: Birthdays are not.longer a thing of Celebration - LOH #293
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS3pMLyAjPLVZ2tJaWweUUFJmUrgZMuXdPWKbtHCK5JCH/1781664489279.jpg)

Hi beautiful ladies of hive, it's Abeegail again, I love this week prompt, because it's a very touching subject to me
As a kid I have always loved celebrating my birthday. My parents always make me feel special on that day, added to the fact that my birthday is close to the festive period, and I specifically like this because everyone is already in high spirits because of the festivities and that just spills into my birthday. Ever since I was little my parents go out of their way to make my day special.

UNTIL!!

I was eleven, I told my mom that I don't want a celebration because in the neighborhood where I grew up, kids my age threw their party themselves, invited their friends and also have adult beverages and do cool things. Most of the times I was not invited and even if I was, I wouldn't go because my parents would never let me be in that scene. So I told my mom to stop putting up a celebration because I thought it was not \

the way my mom did it. My parents still celebrated me; pray for me, get me new clothes, take me out and get me new stuff, but no big celebrations like that.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtQ86huL8Kd51QwXAWsQofQFEXov7tCkmXXne9PtxSYm/1781664525550.jpg)

Fast forward to when I was fourteen, I stopped celebrating my birthday at all, that year we were tight on cash so, I didn't get anything. Funny thing is, I propose the idea. When I told my mom that I didn't want to celebrate my birthday, I saw her breath a sigh of relief instead of asking me why, she probably thought how she would explain to me how money was tight, but it's fine because I understood clearly what was going on. This year I was still prayed for, but no new clothes or anything, not was different from a regular day, I didn't feel any older and I didn't feel like I was being celebrated but it was fine because I understood.

From then on, I don't like celebrating my birthdays anymore, on my birthdays I feel like I was not different from the day before my birthday. I took my birthday casually and I didn't understand why people did heavy celebrations, for just one day, I felt that it was not that special for that sort of celebration. After we passed through the tight times, my parents still acknowledge my birthday unlike that particular year but I already lost interest in my birthdays entirely.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTCRusuh3iRdxU2GiTmV1JPgffX9sLnbPZDyX5TXZM4Fc/1781664600423.jpg)

But this year I promise myself that I'll do something for my birthday if I have the means, I'll spoil myself, treat myself, dress up to the nines because in actual fact it is just only one day, one day for me to feel special, to feel grateful for living for another year. I want to get my birthday pictures professionally taken, get cake, because it has been a while since I have eaten cake on my birthday, get a new phone to possibly. Now I understand that birthdays are a thing of celebration whether or not you have the funds to do so.

It's Still Abeegail ✨💗

__________________________________________________________________________

The images are mine
Thank you beautiful ladies for Reading 🥹🥹

title: My Visit to the Lions Club (Eng/Esp)
body:
> The first time I visited the Lions Club headquarters in Cumana was out of curiosity; an Expoferia had been set up there, and the event was being advertised on the radio. It was easy to get there because the last stop on the bus line heading to the Monument was right across the street. Later, I went back there for the ZC Miniteca’s performance, as well as one by El Conde del Guacharo, and two weddings. This venue has a large banquet hall, where various events—such as charity raffles and dance bingos—are currently held.
![1000121015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wgRrJDi3fnZgbz4cHWvGrcQxAjvrXV2AXnDMCxsS1dYnoTzLpTV7MUqSBDMnZnidDpF.jpg)
![1000118517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpJYX8KThmwvGEbUGUKtYZtwzXoXiKUuJrtR48aF5XFnxRH81CvJjKYevn65gW4yobv.jpg)
Over time, I learned that the Lions Club isn’t just a physical space but an international nonprofit organization focused on humanitarian service—which is why they offer free medical consultations and hold health fairs where they distribute medication to those most in need. The lively parties and public transportation to the entrance are now a thing of the past.
![1000118520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnDfmhH5NeGLc8nefrgbv32GonfkSHrWpgmKERDCASKjegUWfCdHoqgxevN4Z91wY6.jpg)
![1000118523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqFtRBeLwCoHiv2EAsbsy54zRFyA9F5LbEVQ3qfVz1Ji4SKL1cfbHgXvKqjikMDTong.jpg)
![1000118508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tbnc1c8QA9eEuKXWToa3shXodVMbCowvuKep1LfSVgj7EVm7VDYq5E8cGG2y6hLoC1w.jpg)
I returned to that place today to find out more about the activities that usually take place there, since there’s a preschool on the premises. I was able to walk around the place, and it’s just as I remember it, with spacious areas for holding large gatherings and even a bolas criollas court inside. From here, you can see the beach peeking out from behind Perimetral Avenue.
![1000118526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpC9uXa2Z71MtV4JRPJAj8XN4B8etaxyJFUThQdjtyAueQzJBDsvqQFM7aG6Kye6tr7.jpg)
![1000118490.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EprUduQhT4664eaVcZdBGZccbEqAynNmnpNvXhzTERZE8otyEvYZHC94DCaknqSfUUy.jpg)
![1000118495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoGwzvAEHM1c4kUK1uwGKDatupdssfcDtFvjUMDKmSCrpUfAaTAefvMWns3tH2T6noX.jpg)
![1000118496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEJkZkDNSJgt8naur8ksALkMxV7JizjSED6JyYSo3kzi5EvSd4UgTYZV2mjJWAZFVf.jpg)
My memories of this place are tied to lively celebrations, but now I see it from a different perspective. All you can see now is the large, empty hall and just a few people waiting to be seen in the examination rooms. The work these people do in offering free medical services to the community is truly commendable. That’s the beauty of walking around Cumaná—in this case, I rediscovered the Lions Club during one of my usual walks through the Monumento neighborhood. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La primera ocasión que visité la sede del Club de Leones en Cumaná fue por curiosidad, se había instalado una Expoferia y la publicidad era transmitida por la radio. Era fácil llegar allí porque al frente quedaba la última parada de la linea de autobuses que iban para el Monumento. Después fui nuevamente a ese lugar, para la presentación de la miniteca ZC, también para una del Conde del Guacharo, y a dos matrimonios. Este lugar posee un gran salón de fiestas, donde actualmente se suelen realizar diferentes eventos como loterías benéficas y bingos bailables.
![1000121015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wgRrJDi3fnZgbz4cHWvGrcQxAjvrXV2AXnDMCxsS1dYnoTzLpTV7MUqSBDMnZnidDpF.jpg)
![1000118517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpJYX8KThmwvGEbUGUKtYZtwzXoXiKUuJrtR48aF5XFnxRH81CvJjKYevn65gW4yobv.jpg)
Con el tiempo me enteré que el Club de Leones no es solamente un espacio físico sino que es una organización internacional sin fines de lucro enfocada en el servicio humanitario, de allí que ofrezcan consultas médicas gratuitas y además realizan jornadas de salud donde se entregan medicamentos a los más necesitados. Ya las fiestas bulliciosas y el transporte público hasta la entrada han quedado en el pasado.
![1000118520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnDfmhH5NeGLc8nefrgbv32GonfkSHrWpgmKERDCASKjegUWfCdHoqgxevN4Z91wY6.jpg)
![1000118523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqFtRBeLwCoHiv2EAsbsy54zRFyA9F5LbEVQ3qfVz1Ji4SKL1cfbHgXvKqjikMDTong.jpg)
![1000118508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tbnc1c8QA9eEuKXWToa3shXodVMbCowvuKep1LfSVgj7EVm7VDYq5E8cGG2y6hLoC1w.jpg)
Regresé hoy a ese lugar para indagar en las actividades que suelen realizarse, toda vez que allí funciona un preescolar. Pude recorrer el lugar y se mantiene tal como lo recuerdo, con amplios espacios para celebrar grandes reuniones y hasta posee una cancha de bolas criollas en su interior. Desde acá se puede apreciar la playa que se asoma tras la avenida Perimetral.
![1000118526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpC9uXa2Z71MtV4JRPJAj8XN4B8etaxyJFUThQdjtyAueQzJBDsvqQFM7aG6Kye6tr7.jpg)
![1000118490.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EprUduQhT4664eaVcZdBGZccbEqAynNmnpNvXhzTERZE8otyEvYZHC94DCaknqSfUUy.jpg)
![1000118495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoGwzvAEHM1c4kUK1uwGKDatupdssfcDtFvjUMDKmSCrpUfAaTAefvMWns3tH2T6noX.jpg)
![1000118496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEJkZkDNSJgt8naur8ksALkMxV7JizjSED6JyYSo3kzi5EvSd4UgTYZV2mjJWAZFVf.jpg)
Mis recuerdos sobre este lugar se relacionan con celebraciones bulliciosas, es ahora cuando lo aprecio con otra perspectiva. El gran salón vacío y apenas unas personas esperando ser atendidas en los consultorios es lo único que se puede apreciar. Es realmente loable la labor de estas personas al ofrecer servicios médicos gratuitos para la comunidad. Es lo bueno de caminar y recorrer Cumaná ya que en este caso redescubrí el Club de Leones tras una de mis acostumbradas caminatas por el sector Monumento.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title: [ESP/ENG] Delicious and juicy stewed chicken with eggplant, accompanied by spaghetti and boiled plantain.
body:
> Feliz y bendecida noche tengan todos mis queridos amigos amantes de la comida y el buen sabor, la comida en casa siempre tiene ese toque especial que conlleva a cocinar con cariño con pasión y con ganas de probar sabores sensacionales dentro de la gastronomía, el pollo es una proteína que consumimos frecuentemente en casa, siempre buscamos las maneras diferentes de prepararlo para poder disfrutar de un Rico almuerzo, de esta manera les voy a preparar un pollo guisado con berenjena que será ideal para acompañar con espaguetis y unos platanitos sancochados. >Happy and blessed night to all my dear friends who love food and good flavor. Home-cooked meals always have that special touch that comes from cooking with love, passion, and a desire to try sensational flavors in gastronomy. Chicken is a protein we frequently consume at home, and we always look for different ways to prepare it so we can enjoy a delicious lunch. This time, I'm going to prepare a chicken stew with eggplant that will be ideal to accompany with spaghetti and some boiled plantains.
![GridArt_20260616_223639226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK7xvQtHB6btaKjGATouMaFpGNPYM77yefW6muULLJg1uymoGRWpjBNnwLMA2su.jpg)
Ingredientes: 1 kilo de pollo picado, 1 berenjena, 1 cebolla,1 zanahoria , salsa de ostras, cebollín, orégano, sal, color, cubito maggi, aceite. >Ingredients: 1 kilo of minced chicken, 1 eggplant, 1 onion, 1 carrot, oyster sauce, spring onion, oregano, salt, color, maggi cube, oil. Para comenzar me gusta sazonar primero el pollo, agregándole sal, orégano, adobo, mezclando y llevando a una olla, allí le agregaré un poco de aceite para que empiece a cocinarse, luego incorporo zanahoria picada en cuadritos pequeños y un poco de salsa para ostras. >To begin, I like to season the chicken first, adding salt, oregano, and marinade, mixing it all together and putting it in a pot. There, I add a little oil so that it starts to cook. Then I incorporate diced carrots and a little oyster sauce.
![GridArt_20260616_223458196.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJmsh4sqJyr5mRHpo41nWn4F2HRURrxtR7E6Yzxp7CyqGT8CJLUDrVCzSmFeGwb.jpg)
Seguidamente cortaré el cebollín y la cebolla la llevaré a la licuadora y le agregaré un vaso de agua licuo hasta obtener una mezcla y se la agrego al pollo para brindarle mejor sabor, por último agregaré un poco de color y la berenjena picada en cuadritos dejaré cocinar por unos 25 minutos permitiendo que el pollo quede con una salsa espesa formada por la berenjena. >Next, I will chop the scallion and onion, put them in the blender, add a glass of water, blend until smooth, and add it to the chicken to enhance the flavor. Finally, I will add a little coloring and the diced eggplant and let it cook for about 25 minutes, allowing the chicken to develop a thick sauce from the eggplant.
![GridArt_20260616_223521775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJhZdjB5m5vAkDUj9czerFrvfFHXUu3bWgwxuMAttM43z7F4g4YJZZiAxQdNhBk.jpg)
De esta manera pueden preparar un delicioso pollo guisado con berenjena para acompañar unos espaguetis y un platanito, sin duda un plato bastante completo para un almuerzo en casa. >This way you can prepare a delicious stewed chicken with eggplant to accompany some spaghetti and a plantain, undoubtedly a very complete dish for a lunch at home.
![GridArt_20260616_223409534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK6XkSti9Rv7dPrGcVpT831wX6JM3iB2wXF3nh16pJrKUdariDyA6bfrHwsHKu1.jpg)
![IMG-20210518-WA0013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23vsmbX5FEuYW4QJWvpf9gV1SsdcvFYWz2pdHSV6Rbh7pKEvx1MfBLag9bwed31NV4LFw.jpg)

title: Fried fish fillets with hot rice, onions and spices.
body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmLmvw3KP4Ygb6AjDSCP8uACDz1vfVpamF2M9rjoMHKx/1781664398741.jpg) Just looking at the daily dining table, you can understand just how deep the relationship between Bengalis and fish is. Large fish like rui, katla, or hilsa are always present. But if the lunch menu includes a plate of hot rice with a small piece of fried fish, then there is no comparison to that satisfaction. Today's lunch plate had just such a nostalgic taste, which touched the heart. The attached picture is bound to make your mouth water. The small fish pieces, deep-fried in a pan, are sautéed in lots of onions, green chilies, a little turmeric powder, and pure mustard oil. Then its aroma fills half of the stomach. The combination of that tempting creamy gravy floating on the oil and the yellowish Avar puti fish is, in a word, extraordinary. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXC62x8EDsYj5fqbPU2j9Yub4nBjA7JKTssVty1DaJAvo/1781664398949.jpg) The first bite of roasted puti fish brought me back to my childhood days. The sweet taste of freshly caught puti fish from the canals, rills or ponds of rural Bengal is completely preserved in this dish. The delicious taste is perfectly balanced with the sweetness of the onion and the spiciness of the green chilies. The light crunchiness of the fish and the juicy blend of spices create an explosion of flavor in the mouth. Pure satisfaction In the crowd of big fish, this small fish has a different taste. With a slice of lemon and a little gravy, a plate of hot rice can be finished in no time. This is not just a simple curry. It is associated with the pull of mother's cooking and the ever-familiar emotion of Bengali. Whenever I touch such home-made and traditional food in my busy city life, my mind is filled with a strange peace. This simple but extraordinary fried fish made my whole day. 📸 Photography| Details 📸 |-|-| |Model|Realme-C53| |Location| Bangladesh|
꧁Thanks for reading My post꧂

title: Back on track. My Actifit Diary: June 16 2026
body:
A productive day at last again. Very much so. I did end my work on an Excel-VBA command structure, with help from Gemini. A simple one, but I have no idea about coding, so it was fun to build it. It worked fine until Whatsapp decided that it was too many messages to numbers that didn’t have our contact saved, and restricted messaging for 24h. Well, no biggie. In the end, it would be the same amount of work as just running things through the broadcast system, as those need the number being saved, too. It was still fun to build. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/df82cd99-9948-41ca-b69a-ee834ec449ab.jpg) [I wrote a post today, too.]( https://peakd.com/hive-126152/@beelzael/count-thy-blessings) It started out with a darker tone, but then swung into something more cheerful which I hadn’t expected. Doesn’t mean I’m fine. Meditation was rough today. Very rough. Like I drew a needle into a bubble of sadness that suddenly invaded me so completely that it hurt. I let it all out, cried for a while. Didn’t feel much better on the surface, but who knows. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/957dd0e3-9c1d-4722-b6f8-5309fc5114e1.jpg) Gym was fine, but my trousers are tearing everywhere now, and the new ones aren’t ready yet. Gotta make them hold up a little longer. I don’t mind, but people at the gym sometimes look at me funny. I hope they don’t mind, don’t want to make anyone feel uncomfortable. Ellie came over afterwards, had me try a version of jogging trousers that she has. Funny enough, they seemed my size, although Ellie is quite a bit shorter than I. Turned out she wears the trousers at the waist, and I around the hip. Well, that explains it. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7994d685-047b-4ff2-9449-8903c7c61172.jpg) That’s almost it. Went for a couple of alcohol free beers with a friend who I haven’t seen in a while. We didn’t really connect this time, which is fine, and probably based on my emotional state. I’m not that social. It’ll pass, as all things shall. Thank you for reading, and have a good night!

![img_20260616_181529-338d170fa260.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/snowli/lkt-mqg3cc8o-n3k9nj9p/img_20260616_181529-338d170fa260.webp)

自从帅哥来了之后我就很少做饭，因为我的掌勺大权已经交给他了。我一天天就等吃等喝，所以我也越来越懒，体重也越来越增长。

这不帅哥回去帮亲戚家搞装修了，然后我又开始掌勺了。其实要不是同事约我去逛菜市，我也不想做饭了，因为沃尔玛里面的快餐已经能解决我的温饱问题了，还能去看榴莲，我不知道有多开心。

这天同事邀约逛菜市，一下子买了番茄、丝瓜、金针菇，家里还有没吃的苦瓜和卤味鸭肠和鸭头鸭肝还是啥的，还有一个盐焗鸡腿，根本吃不完。

我一个人吃，心大肚子小，吃又吃不完。第一顿的时候随便一锅炖，盐油都没有放，以为那些卤味可以调味，结果卤味放了一天在冰箱，天气太热已经馊掉了。然后只能吃萝卜干了。鸭肠倒了，肝好吃舍不得倒继续吃。但是吃着感觉自己好命苦的感觉。一点味道都没有。

第二顿长记性了。不敢偷懒了。先放番茄在锅里炒出沙，然后放水进去继续炖，然后金针菇和丝瓜一起倒进去继续煮，放盐和耗油酱油，之后收汁，旁边水煮面条也熟了，捞过来一起拌拌，美味的晚餐就制作完成啦。🙈酸咸酸咸的，我可太喜欢啦，番茄真的是好东西，炒猪肉或者炒鸡蛋也好吃，超级下饭。🥰

body: 世界盃到來，不同商戶都趁機推出優惠或獎賞，我手頭上的一張信用卡就搞了一個小遊戲，有獎賞的。 小遊戲是一個12碼遊戲，只要當天使用信用卡消費滿100元，第二天就有一次遊戲機會，遊戲一共有5次12碼，入球有1分，如果是掛網入球有2分，每天最高分的100名會有88塊獎賞。這遊戲一直持續到7月20日，如果每天都中獎，可以賺差不多3000塊。 作為擼錢狂魔的我，當然要參加了，問題就是要如何每天都消費100塊，我也沒那麼多消費呀。這其實不難，現在的酒店平台基本都有免費取消，先訂個酒店，到遊戲完了獎賞派了再取消酒店就行了，太邪惡了。
/> 不過這遊戲也不容易，第一天我是一球不進，第二天進了3分但排名100名外，到了第三天，我開始摸到一點技巧，進4球了，排名88有獎賞，到第四天更是5球都進有6分，排名11。現在我基本是進球沒問題，唯一是要再練習如何掛網得2分，因為其他人每天都玩也會慢慢進步，進頭100名的要求也一定越來越高。 [

title: A Busy Day at Work (ENG|SPA)
body: > Today was one of those days at work where you barely have time to catch your breath. A heavy shipment of new merchandise arrived unexpected, which meant a lot of extra effort to get everything organized. I spent the first few hours moving boxes and arranging a new display of whisky bottles. Once the shelves were neatly aligned, I noticed how nice the bottles looked under the store lighting, so I decided to take a few quick shots with my camera to capture the result of the hard work. # Just as I was finishing up with the display, the brand promoter for Zulia beer arrived at the store. Since Zulia is our best-selling beer, she visits us every weekend to check on stock and engage with customers. Her visit always brings a great energy to the workplace, breaking up the monotony of a tough shift. # Seeing an opportunity to practice some commercial portrait photography, I asked her if she would mind posing for a few quick photos. She was thrilled with the idea and was a natural in front of the lens. We set up a brief session right there, using the vibrant branding of the beer to create some dynamic and lively images that turned a hectic workday into a very creative afternoon. # It is amazing how a demanding day can completely turn around with a little bit of creativity and good company. Thank you for stopping by and sharing this moment with me.

> Hoy fue uno de esos días en el trabajo donde apenas tienes tiempo para tomar un respiro. Llegó un cargamento pesado de mercancía nueva que no teníamos planeada, lo que significó un esfuerzo extra para dejar todo organizado. Pasé las primeras horas moviendo cajas y ordenando una nueva exhibición de botellas de whisky. Una vez que los estantes quedaron alineados, noté lo bien que lucían las botellas bajo la iluminación de la tienda, así que decidí tomar unas fotos rápidas con mi cámara para capturar el resultado del arduo trabajo. # Justo cuando estaba terminando con la exhibición, llegó a la tienda la promotora de la cerveza Zulia. Como la Zulia es la cerveza que más vendemos, ella nos visita todos los fines de semana para revisar el inventario y compartir con los clientes. Su visita siempre trae una excelente energía al lugar de trabajo, rompiendo un poco con la monotonía de una jornada dura. # Al ver la oportunidad de practicar algo de fotografía de retrato comercial, le pregunté si le importaría posar para unas fotos rápidas. A ella le encantó la idea y demostró una gran naturalidad frente al lente. Armamos una breve sesión allí mismo, aprovechando los colores vibrantes de la marca para crear imágenes dinámicas que transformaron un día agitado en una tarde muy creativa. # Es increíble cómo un día exigente puede cambiar por completo con un poco de creatividad y buena compañía. Muchas gracias por pasar por aquí y compartir este momento conmigo. ------ ---- |

title: Why Do We Feel Far Away From God?
body:
God is going to listen to us. He has never been far away from us. We are the ones who are taking the path.

We are not supposed to be far from God.
It is because we are used to feel that part that God takes the path of God, that we see God is not far from His creation. He loves us. And He has not abandoned us. So we are those who are not willing to say he has ordained for us.

We know that God is present everywhere at all times. You must think that anytime that God can be with us, but God is everywhere. No matter what we do, where we are, God is always watching us.

We are the ones that are far from God, not God. God is always close to us, both when we are sinning and when we are not sinning. God is not far from us. Let us return back to God. Let us come back from the path of sin that we might be treading.

Let us keep the commandment of God. Because it is only who keeps the commandment of God that God comes and dwells in him always.

title: Full filming day
body:
Hi, guys!

Today I'll be filming all day because I want to try to shoot all the books I haven't reviewed yet. There are about ten of them, so it's quite a lot, but I think if I quickly jot down a filming plan now, I'll have time to get everything done before training, and then I'll have editing left over for tomorrow, and then I can take a couple of days off. This option suits me, so I'll probably be counting on it. Plus, tomorrow I'll likely be bringing the blog back from hiatus, so I need to get ready to return online. We'll see if the hiatus has yielded any results. I'd really like it to.

So today I'm dedicating the day entirely to filming, and then running off to a three-hour workout, trying to make it as relaxed as possible. I'm still not used to having training days, but I'm trying to get used to it and learn to take it as calmly as possible. But it will take some time before my brain adapts to this and stops perceiving them as a threat. For now, it does.

But I don't plan to give up and will try to simply not miss classes for now, and then we'll see how things develop. The first task is simply getting used to the fact that I'm going to classes now, and then we'll see what I need to adapt better.

So for now, I'm simply working on my calm in a situation where I'm doing something I'm not yet fully accustomed to.

Have a great day, everyone!

After visiting the historic Vargas Reservoir, we continued our adventure through Boyacá and arrived with my biker friends at one of the most charming and iconic towns in the department: Ráquira, known as the artisan capital of Colombia.

The history of this wonderful place is deeply tied to clay and the traditions of the Muisca indigenous people, who have been crafting pottery since ancient times, taking advantage of the region’s rich clay deposits. Over the years, this art form has become the soul of the town, and today its colorful streets are filled with workshops, shops, and artisans who keep alive a tradition that has been passed down from generation to generation.

Ráquira is an incredible place, full of history, culture, and color. I was pleasantly surprised to find beautiful handicrafts at very good prices, as well as its cuisine and other products that are very affordable compared to my city, Medellín. 

But if there’s one thing that makes this town special, it’s its people. The people of Ráquira are kind, friendly, and always welcome visitors with a smile that makes anyone feel at home. The region’s cool climate invites you to stroll leisurely through its streets, and, as in much of Boyacá, it’s common to see traditional ruanas—authentic woven works of art that not only keep you warm but also represent an important part of Boyacá’s cultural identity.

During our visit, we decided to go to the famous Casa al Revés, a very fun place where imagination seems to defy the laws of gravity. There, we took the opportunity to snap numerous photos, as each space is designed to create unique and intriguing images. We also enjoyed a hot-air balloon anchored to the ground, designed specifically to capture spectacular photos and admire the area’s beautiful landscapes from a different perspective.

As the afternoon drew to a close, it was time to meet up with the group again and continue our journey to a new destination. However, that’s another story.

Spanish 

>Después de visitar el histórico Pantano de Vargas, continuamos nuestra aventura por Boyacá y llegamos con mis amigos moteros a uno de los pueblos más encantadores y representativos del departamento: Ráquira, conocido como la capital artesanal de Colombia.

>La historia de este maravilloso lugar está profundamente ligada al barro y a las tradiciones indígenas muiscas, quienes desde tiempos ancestrales trabajaban la cerámica aprovechando la riqueza de las arcillas de la región. Con el paso de los años, este arte se convirtió en el alma del municipio y hoy sus coloridas calles están llenas de talleres, tiendas y artesanos que mantienen viva una tradición que ha pasado de generación en generación.

>Ráquira es un lugar increíble, lleno de historia, cultura y color. Me sorprendió gratamente encontrar artesanías hermosas a muy buenos precios, al igual que su gastronomía, y otros productos muy economicos si los comparo con mi ciudad, Medellín. 

>Pero si algo hace especial a este pueblo es su gente. Los raquireños son amables, cordiales y siempre reciben a los visitantes con una sonrisa que hace sentir a cualquiera como en casa. El clima fresco de la región invita a recorrer sus calles con calma y, como en gran parte del territorio boyacense, es común encontrar las tradicionales ruanas, auténticas obras de arte tejidas que además de abrigar, representan una parte importante de la identidad cultural de Boyacá.

>Durante nuestra visita decidimos ir a la famosa Casa al Revés, un lugar muy divertido donde la imaginación parece desafiar las leyes de la gravedad. Allí aprovechamos para tomar numerosas fotografías, ya que cada espacio está diseñado para crear imágenes únicas y muy curiosas. También disfrutamos de un globo aerostático anclado al suelo, pensado especialmente para capturar espectaculares fotografías y contemplar desde otra perspectiva los hermosos paisajes de la zona.

>Acercandose el final de la tarde llegó el momento de reunirnos nuevamente con el grupo y continuar nuestro viaje hacia un nuevo destino. Sin embargo, ¡esa! es otra historia.

title: Barbering at the Stadium [ENG-SPA]
body: > This afternoon, I decided to mix my two worlds and do a haircut right where I spend my free time. My model for the day was a fellow workout partner with whom I share the bars at the Independencia Stadium, and it was actually his very first time getting a haircut from me. The main challenge of the session was managing the clock, as we needed to take full advantage of the remaining afternoon light while the sun was slowly setting behind the horizon. # With the help of another training partner who took care of the camera, we managed to capture a truly meaningful moment. While I was working, we shared stories, experiences, and laughs, creating a great bond. What made it even more special was the atmosphere around us; the people at the stadium supported us in a very positive and welcoming way. In all the time I've been coming here, this was the first time I had ever done a haircut on the grounds, and seeing such a warm reception from the crowd was incredibly motivating. # Many people stopped by out of pure curiosity, asking questions and watching the process closely. It turned out that a lot of them had no idea I was a barber by profession, so they were curious to know when and how I first started out in this beautiful career. This gave me a wonderful opportunity to interact on a deeper level with the community and especially with my new client, who trusted me completely to change his look right there in the open air. # For him, getting a haircut at the stadium was a perfect solution, as his tight work schedule makes it really difficult to visit a shop during regular hours. We managed to finish up the sharp look just as the last rays of sun disappeared, leaving him completely satisfied with the result. Right after packing up the tools, we jumped straight back into our routine to finish up our workouts for the day. # Breaking the routine and bringing my passion out into the open space where I clear my mind was a refreshing experience. It proved to me once again that barbering goes far beyond a closed room; it's about connection, trust, and sharing good vibes with the people around you. Thank you so much for reading my publication and supporting my journey!

> La tarde de hoy decidí hacer algo diferente y realizar un corte en el lugar donde suelo pasar mi tiempo libre. Mi modelo fue un compañero con el que comparto las barras en el estadio Independencia, siendo esta la primera vez que se afeitaba conmigo. El principal reto de la sesión fue jugar contra el reloj, ya que debíamos aprovechar al máximo la claridad de la tarde con el sol aún ocultándose en el horizonte. # Con la ayuda de otro compañero de entrenamientos que se encargó de la cámara, logramos captar un momento bastante emotivo. Mientras trabajaba, compartimos relatos, vivencias y risas, creando un ambiente muy ameno. Lo mejor de todo fue la receptividad de las personas a nuestro alrededor, quienes nos apoyaron de manera positiva y agradable. En todo el tiempo que llevo asistiendo a este lugar, esta es la primera vez que realizo un trabajo así en las instalaciones, y ver ese buen recibimiento me hizo sentir muy motivado. # Muchos de los presentes se acercaron por pura curiosidad, haciendo preguntas y observando el proceso con atención. Resulta que varios de ellos no sabían que yo me dedicaba a la barbería, así que les dio curiosidad saber cuándo y cómo comencé en esta profesión. Esto me permitió interactuar más a fondo con la comunidad y, en especial, con mi nuevo cliente, quien me dio toda su confianza para afeitarlo al aire libre. # Para él, esta dinámica fue una solución ideal, ya que se le complica muchísimo asistir a una barbería debido a su pesado horario de trabajo. Logramos terminar el corte justo cuando el sol terminaba de ocultarse, dejándolo totalmente conforme con el resultado. De inmediato, guardamos las herramientas y nos reincorporamos a la rutina para seguir con los entrenamientos del día. # Salir de la rutina y llevar mi pasión al espacio donde despejo la mente fue una experiencia renovadora. Me demostró una vez más que la barbería va mucho más allá de un espacio cerrado; se trata de conectar, generar confianza y compartir buenas vibras con las personas. ¡Muchas gracias por pasar a leer mi publicación y apoyar mi trabajo! ------ ---- |

title: San Luis Beach: A Walk and Memories (Eng/Esp)
body:
> Today’s adventure takes me to San Luis Beach, the longest beach in Cumana. I’ve always loved taking in the seaside scenery as I walk with the sand between my toes and the breeze on my face. Sometimes that’s all it takes to be happy—those little details that are so precious, especially when they nourish the soul.
![1000121000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQp8JVuA5YCW6timEExP8FZjRDRNFFFKtmZsPq6kzHrDeLcgVJztb562EJPVzk35BT6.jpg)
The wide boardwalk is perfect for reflection, with the sea as a backdrop. You can walk along it many times, and each time you’ll see a different view—which is truly amazing, since your gaze always finds interesting details to focus on.
![1000107650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpEHFyrA3VPJH1SQNAtQqVwLYAeMBqkTmEK1hHnyxZD73LGVcsitykbP6XJdBfgc6Ly.jpg)
![1000107644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep1Wtf2Rc9Qroc1Sh7kj7X2EbPBAoSGB34EcsUSzQkVFFrj1itKujUKUyqtRT9S8Bxq.jpg)
Just now, as I’m walking through the Medical Association on my way to the Military Casino, a memory came to mind of those beach volleyball tournaments with my college friends. It was fun to participate and enjoy a morning of sports and healthy recreation, especially when our youth and competitive spirit were still at their peak. Images of my vacations with my family also came to mind—enjoying the adrenaline rush of feeling the sea on a banana boat, speeding along and watching the shore in the distance, aware that we were in deep water. Without a doubt, every experience is unique and becomes part of our collection of memories; it’s a pleasure to look back on them, and they always bring a smile to my face.
![1000121003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244e3bSJJWF96xcLT2sQvfG1apn8i2nqkMGMKsPN6i5B5V8SdXXzB8FrYNkB5EiPHybs9.jpg)
![1000107616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EonkXTKZD1baWS2SmLjc1xFygr7TjMhkv86Mki6V8zgE6bVea7JHvpsAtR3tkbXPCDb.jpg)
San Luis is a tourist beach that you enjoy from the very moment you set foot on it. While it evokes a sense of peace and tranquility, it can also offer more intense experiences, because it’s so vast that a “mini-disco” battle can be taking place on one side, a sporting event in the middle, and a religious ceremony at the other end—and I speak from experience, having witnessed this myself while walking back from the Los Bordones neighborhood during Holy Week.
![1000107603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep3dqemasULbNepzfWK4tJE1ExFdsNWq1eUFDbtRCuwq1oBnjuFtTg2w51qHyjCrUya.jpg)
![1000107570.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wqkWKVPupV6XC9f2RifHEuXgG75DD62fWHYcQSPTxWyJXbJ4GskAooF3dwAHpdBdcpe.jpg)
At that time, in front of the building where the Jamaica nightclub used to be, a triathlon was taking place; the athletes were swimming in a marked-off area, with the organizers keeping a close eye on the action, while further ahead, near the El Águila neighborhood, a religious group was making offerings to the sea in a very discreet manner.
![1000121007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zRvdu82PFa4HJQmNbibJHKMAP6zWkXQJwHmSURPGcFqWTNTeoKmwXGREmnhzNcKW2Hf.jpg)
![1000121006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tSWg56FpRffyf1t4skg3uyDBYJJ5mHo4ZYxRbTz8KZj1eR4R3zBt6NcQNm3xSMXzr7X.jpg)
By then, I enjoyed walking and was able to make the entire trip from my home to the beach without much difficulty, carrying my water bottle with me. I remember all those contrasting images because I experienced them so vividly, even though I didn’t participate in any activities. That day, I simply went to the beach to clear my mind, and there was nothing better than going there knowing I could walk back home. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La aventura de hoy me sitúa en playa San Luis, la más extensa de Cumaná, siempre me ha gustado disfrutar del paisaje marino mientras camino con la arena en mis pies y la brisa en el rostro. A veces solo se necesita de esto para ser feliz, esos pequeños detalles llenos de valor, sobre todo, cuando son significativos para alimentar el alma.
![1000121000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQp8JVuA5YCW6timEExP8FZjRDRNFFFKtmZsPq6kzHrDeLcgVJztb562EJPVzk35BT6.jpg)
La amplia caminería es perfecta para reflexionar con el mar como escenario. Se puede recorrer muchas veces y cada vez se tendrá un panorama distinto, lo cual es realmente sorprendente, pues la mirada siempre encuentra elementos interesantes sobre los cuales fijarse.
![1000107650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpEHFyrA3VPJH1SQNAtQqVwLYAeMBqkTmEK1hHnyxZD73LGVcsitykbP6XJdBfgc6Ly.jpg)
![1000107644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep1Wtf2Rc9Qroc1Sh7kj7X2EbPBAoSGB34EcsUSzQkVFFrj1itKujUKUyqtRT9S8Bxq.jpg)
Justamente ahora, mientras tránsito por el Colegio de Médicos y voy rumbo al Casino Militar la memoria me hizo recordar aquellos torneos de vóleibol playero con amigos universitarios, era divertido participar y disfrutar de una mañana deportiva de sano esparcimiento, sobre todo cuando se mantenía altiva la juventud y el espíritu competitivo. También regresaron a mi mente imágenes de mis vacaciones junto a mi familia, disfrutando de la adrenalina de sentir el mar sobre una banana acuática, saltando a toda velocidad y observando la orilla a lo lejos, conciente de estar en zona profunda. Sin duda, cada experiencia es única y queda en la colección de los recuerdos, es grato revisarlos y que vengan acompañados de una sonrisa.
![1000121003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/244e3bSJJWF96xcLT2sQvfG1apn8i2nqkMGMKsPN6i5B5V8SdXXzB8FrYNkB5EiPHybs9.jpg)
![1000107616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EonkXTKZD1baWS2SmLjc1xFygr7TjMhkv86Mki6V8zgE6bVea7JHvpsAtR3tkbXPCDb.jpg)
San Luis es una playa turística y se disfruta desde el primer momento en que se coloca un pie sobre ella. Así como genera sensación de paz y tranquilidad, también puede ofrecer emociones más intensas, porque su extensión es tan considerable que en un lado puede desarrollarse una guerra de minitecas, en medio una actividad deportiva y en otro extremo una actividad religiosa, lo digo con propiedad porque una vez lo pude apreciar, regresando a pie desde el sector Los Bordones en una Semana Santa.
![1000107603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep3dqemasULbNepzfWK4tJE1ExFdsNWq1eUFDbtRCuwq1oBnjuFtTg2w51qHyjCrUya.jpg)
![1000107570.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wqkWKVPupV6XC9f2RifHEuXgG75DD62fWHYcQSPTxWyJXbJ4GskAooF3dwAHpdBdcpe.jpg)
Luego, frente al local donde estaba ubicada la discoteca Jamaica, se escenificaba un triatlón, los atletas nadaban en un espacio delimitado, con los organizadores atentos a los sucesos, en tanto más adelante, cerca del sector El Águila, un grupo religioso realizaba ofrendas al mar de forma muy discreta.
![1000121007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zRvdu82PFa4HJQmNbibJHKMAP6zWkXQJwHmSURPGcFqWTNTeoKmwXGREmnhzNcKW2Hf.jpg)
![1000121006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tSWg56FpRffyf1t4skg3uyDBYJJ5mHo4ZYxRbTz8KZj1eR4R3zBt6NcQNm3xSMXzr7X.jpg)
Para entonces me gustaba caminar y pude realizar todo el recorrido de mi hogar a la playa sin mayores dificultades, acompañada de mi termo con agua. Recuerdo todo ese contraste de imágenes porque las viví con intensidad, aunque no participé en ninguna actividad. Ese día solamente acudí a la playa para despejar la mente y nada mejor que acudir con la certeza de que podía regresar a casa caminando. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

That's great for my team and my upcoming victories; it's a huge advantage. Here's a summary of the maximum levels reached and some of the fusions I did today: Let's level up some cards ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EpC9Tq4EkJBGQNpKYJ2hatV7xiQekesWQYgC2XtMJyML129N3N9jhSkUwQuAhYnjACu.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23zGa6u17n8V1jr7pZPoZDLn2HEz8GhR8PVq46nUaNc1jyNMtmREkb12uU88qMFkyHjTE.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xeC9gUmK5MZwJeN867vRkwrpuE6wwHLr8t7cktxDHkVbsYuHwUPRne2LTDGofdYZyVD.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23w2HY5oH9kv54i4MPBvX7EvkmS3A2zA7J57WPzRsHusTqDmLmksZEQfdGimdn8uBn2kU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wzxUkvHXCSrzRoueLdphQ9oJZDTcZT9cHsqCgaEaKmojC1tHPZAAJMPBEwCymNMafdo.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wWTgKm7o2vUErJwqu5Hb2jntyvCZdEnt1nVoHDcrnUAwbBYwZKYDYwgsG2JgbBXch9n.png) | ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EoAT2r5nnhqrApG4jT9XU4aT76V6Jqu87FJxXU3La3YNeG5PANf6Q4Yyk15Sb4hKnkc.png) | ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wWpHncr3erAdMeUd5CXtzAkvB4CZEoYz68fEkj8Z142SwSshfFrEiCmMmfdkS1jri2m.png) -|-|-
**Sherrigham Lumberjack** at maximum level

**Unceasing Sage**, my Archon at a new level

Ever wiser and stronger, it's a necessary card because it's an Archon, and all Archons at a high level are good. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EoCboDenALG4oJYkivz8zVc8XukoLvs2iK9NUaKNEXctm4WXGqFC1ExbmBeC4wQYHp6.png) ### Level 3 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wBfhX3LYEFKTU8bAkwghhJ9DFvbeWCTV76u9Bsh9dpwbghGDetgDuTWbm68NNMZjdRP.png) Check out these 26 cards to level up the **Black Widow** **Black Widow**: She had amassed an army of no less than 26 cards waiting to be fused. Watching them all come together to create a supercharged version of Black Widow was absolutely fantastic. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xAK9tYNr7tqXNuhhueeqqFHQV1Nzaz5Qgsj7X4TpKeWyVhkRNK2Dbi9Jse7v8Y4qaif.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23uQJE3cQAaHQzgoX21mK1hBk1jrJ8mq6HrvRC9sk1nCQSfYrLXN1WqdAL35gpiDxjbmx.png) Leveling up the **Little Sister** hehehe she doesn't have a name hehehe or I think that's her name. The massive fusion has given his stats a huge boost, transforming him into a much more competitive support or attacker for my upcoming duels. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xAPAH8F3288wRmVor5ifRNKo4jpKuLdvg6sC9WFUhv7gEuCtFV5QDMX753kmqBBVSxm.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23vrtjrw4wmRs94mFfY8i4gDo1kf8njSNtKAbxCBokitYUV236ZRHKNG5Wqst9fCYn2fX.png) And finally, a fantastic and very powerful card: **The Monk Vengeful** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wqZkWwLANRdR9Tg95XUyFPBvehgKMTNCzuc2ZwTvsMJMKDp3EdhPjpkBkQJNWCJkeSY.png) This card is now at Level 3. My team is getting stronger every day, and I feel better prepared for my future battles. Thank you for joining me on this journey to improve my cards. See you in a new post. Cada vez más sabio y más fuerte, es una carta necesaria porque es un Arconte y todos los arcontes en un nivel alto es bueno. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/EoCboDenALG4oJYkivz8zVc8XukoLvs2iK9NUaKNEXctm4WXGqFC1ExbmBeC4wQYHp6.png) ### Nivel 3 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wBfhX3LYEFKTU8bAkwghhJ9DFvbeWCTV76u9Bsh9dpwbghGDetgDuTWbm68NNMZjdRP.png) Miren 26 cartas para subir de nivel a la **Viuda Negra** **Viuda Negra**: Tenía acumulado un ejército de nada más y nada menos que 26 cartas esperando para ser fusionadas. Ver cómo se unieron todas para dar vida a una versión sumamente potenciada de la **Viuda Negra** ha sido completamente genial. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xAK9tYNr7tqXNuhhueeqqFHQV1Nzaz5Qgsj7X4TpKeWyVhkRNK2Dbi9Jse7v8Y4qaif.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23uQJE3cQAaHQzgoX21mK1hBk1jrJ8mq6HrvRC9sk1nCQSfYrLXN1WqdAL35gpiDxjbmx.png) A subir de nivel a la **Hermana Menor** jejjeje no tiene nombre jejjej o creo que ese es su nombre. Está en su Nivel Máximo. Esta pequeña es una joya. Un gran logro para cerrar ciclos de mejora. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xAPW5tuunTLvsF95oqG83Ynts26Y5xt1gybp85gmrYQ8Zb2bPiRW2D9Eq2zr9BiVWxj.png) Super poderosa y lista para la batalla. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23u5ZgDYtFjxj1o7V2syBa5LCpzdx6y68Qx29WotkFs3NrXnSXvh9ZW6cvpuZy4Vtut3s.png) Tenemos 28 cartas del **Gran Cónsul Minion**. La fusión masiva le ha dado un gran subidón a sus estadísticas, transformándolo en un soporte o atacante mucho más competitivo para los próximos duelos que tendré. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xAPAH8F3288wRmVor5ifRNKo4jpKuLdvg6sC9WFUhv7gEuCtFV5QDMX753kmqBBVSxm.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23vrtjrw4wmRs94mFfY8i4gDo1kf8njSNtKAbxCBokitYUV236ZRHKNG5Wqst9fCYn2fX.png) Y por último una carta genial y muy poderosa: **El Monje Vengativo** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wqZkWwLANRdR9Tg95XUyFPBvehgKMTNCzuc2ZwTvsMJMKDp3EdhPjpkBkQJNWCJkeSY.png) Esta carta ha quedado en el Nivel 3, es una de mis mejores cartas con un poder demasiado espectacular. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23u5ZEhfjfpQX5ToxSKNHky1AckBJNDLXUWavx4jRvUQXDs3mvpyiNQRMktZxnA8cYebd.png) Ha sido una jornada en **Splinterlands** maravillosa, mi equipo cada día se potencia más y lo siento mejor preparado para mis futuras batallas. Gracias por acompañarme en este recorrido para mejorar mis cartas. body: > Hive / Open mic - Week #323 (ACAPELLA) Cover - Somos Tú y Yo/Victor Drija & Sheryl Rubio by D-rock [Esp]-[Eng]

>



<center>


![Picsart_26-06-16_22-01-26-745.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/23tvgSiQUfELD1KuoiEUL3GcgaqfC5i198puCF7bnp85cdj6cGUnJjXMDCsTQrNFWP5YC.png)





</center>


Hola amigos de Open mic y de hive! Espero se encuentren espectacular en esta querida semana, estoy emocionado de traerles un nuevo cover y está vez de esta canción, tal vez algunos venezolanos de esta comunidad conocerán o tal vez no, está canción es de una serie Venezolana qué hay he traído varias veces aquí a la comunidad llamada \

y justamente la canción se llama igual, hacer un cover de esta canción me conecta mucho con mi niño interior ya qué crecí viendo está linda serie de adolescentes y anhelando ser uno de ellos cuando sea grande, gracias a este tipo de series soy cómo soy y me encanta, espero que les guste mis videos, les recuerdo que lo hago por diversion y porque me gusta cantar, no soy para nada experto y no busco burlarme de nadie perteneciente a este arte, un saludo a todos y que pasen excelente semana.


<center>


![photo_4936476771566594757_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/243MHgc6wWxWkEeujvJf9xn7aiYoi1FFwzCJjpXTr6ZCwFcKK4JVw3zTUaXDBTZPjPh5C.jpg)


</center>
</center>


# <center><div class=\
> Hive / Open mic - Week #322 (A cappella) Cover - Amor Prohibido/Selena Quintanilla by D-rock [Esp]-[Eng]\n\n

>

>Hello, Open Mic and Hive friends! I hope you’re all having a brilliant time this week. I’m excited to bring you a new cover, and this time it’s of this song. some Venezuelans in this community might recognise it, or perhaps not. It’s from a Venezuelan series – I’ve mentioned it here in the community a few times – called ‘Somos tú y yo’, and the song is actually called the same thing. Doing a cover of this song really connects me with my inner child, as I grew up watching this lovely teen series and longing to be one of them when I grew up. Thanks to series like this, I am who I am, and I love it. I hope you like my videos. Just a reminder that I do this for fun and because I enjoy singing; I’m by no means an expert and I’m not trying to make fun of anyone involved in this art form. Best wishes to you all, and have a brilliant week.





<center>
***
***somos Tú y Yo - Victor Drija & Sheryl Rubio***
***
<div class=pull-right>




![ab67616d0000b273d2b1272609a64758a0a77dc9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/AK57kd82V1KQktEEmqAcHGphwiizB2twBPNMZLDEWPnNuPaYiRnqs9pzykNMDb2.jpeg)






<center><a href=\

es básicamente el himno de toda una generación que creció pegada a la pantalla viendo la serie juvenil venezolana que llevaba el mismo nombre, donde Sheryl Rubio y Víctor Drija eran los protagonistas absolutos. La canción es súper pegajosa, alegre y habla de ese primer amor de colegio, lleno de mariposas en el estómago, drama juvenil, bailes geniales y muchas ganas de comerse el mundo junto a esa persona especial. Es una mezcla perfecta de pop latino con un ritmo súper bailable que te hace querer saltar de la silla e imitar las coreografías icónicas que salían en la televisión. Víctor le mete todo el Flow con su voz y sus pasitos de baile estilo Justin Timberlake caribeño, mientras que Sheryl le da ese toque dulce, tierno y súper fresco que te enamoraba al instante. Al final, este tema no es solo una simple canción pop con letra bonita, sino una máquina del tiempo nostálgica que nos recuerda los mejores momentos de los años dos mil, los estrenos por Venevisión, los conciertos en vivo llenos de fanaticadas gritando y esa linda etapa de la vida donde todo era más sencillo y la única preocupación real era aprenderse la letra para cantarla a todo pulmón con tus amigos del salón.




<centro>

![IMG_20221206_192346_917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/243MHuAQSZG8uEX2JTKG2g5Mef5cfc6wwLCozn3QKGp2aWxi5qhX29BFdYiKaRYiENbU6.jpg)


<centro>


>\

is basically the anthem of an entire generation who grew up glued to the screen watching the Venezuelan teen series of the same name, in which Sheryl Rubio and Víctor Drija were the undisputed stars. The song is super catchy, upbeat and tells the story of that first school crush, full of butterflies in the stomach, teenage drama, brilliant dance routines and a burning desire to take on the world alongside that special someone. It’s a perfect blend of Latin pop with a super danceable beat that makes you want to jump out of your seat and copy the iconic dance routines you used to see on TV. Víctor brings all the flow with his voice and his Caribbean-style Justin Timberlake dance moves, whilst Sheryl adds that sweet, tender and super-fresh touch that made you fall in love with her instantly. Ultimately, this track isn’t just a simple pop song with pretty lyrics, but a nostalgic time machine that reminds us of the best moments of the 2000s: the premieres on Venevisión, the live concerts packed with screaming fans, and that lovely stage of life where everything was simpler and the only real worry was learning the lyrics so you could sing them at the top of your lungs with your classmates.

title: On Rapidly Increasing Wealth Inequality
body:
I am by no means an economist and am very much learning at this point, so I encourage anyone reading to add to the conversation and point out any of the many things I'm probably missing. There is lots more to talk about here and I want to continue the discussion in another post, hopefully adding in discussion generated from this one.
![1781661772534997531718808242426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/minismallholding/242DESNVDoGJjjamxg79XLKtygDJXEQ5uhLY4JJLTA5aojQbotpxB2drZqVC3h3ukafmA.jpg) [Image courtesy of @barge](https://peakd.com/hive-118554/@barge/hive-stock-images-money-cash-fiat-currency-banknotes-coins-cashmachine)
Growing up it seemed like the quality of life would only continue to improve for each generation. My grandparents grew up with the great depression then lived through a world war (one of them even lived through two). My parents were born into a period of rebuilding and growth, so lifestyles started to improve for the working classes and they saw the creation of the welfare system. Probably for the first time someone working a basic level job could easily attain buying a house. In addition to this they could afford to save towards retirement and go on holiday abroad. We grew up in council houses, but when my parents were in their late 20s early 30s they were able to buy their first home. When my now husband and I bought our first house, in the late 1990s, we were in our early 20s. So it felt like each generation would find these things easier. It didn't take long to realise that this was not going to be the case. Everything had been built on the premise that we would have a perpetually growing economy and we realised that this could not continue indefinitely. We knew that as we got older the retirement age would get extended and there would be a good chance that the aged pension we were paying our National Insurance contributions into may not even exist by the time we reached retirement age, as the government got further and further into debt. We decided to take things into our own hands and start paying into private superannuation funds of our own, but lost our ability to even pay into them as the economy worsened.

The downward spiral

The economy in first world countries has been on a downward slope for some time now, but it's only recently started to become so apparent that the majority of the population are feeling it now, even the lower middle classes. Depending on who you speak to the cause of this seems to have lots of explanations usually along the lines of it being the fault of certain groups of people. It's the boomers, it's too many immigrants, it's landlords, it's capitalism, it's bad government spending...but none of these things make enough sense to be the cause, certainly not on their own and many are probably more symptoms than causes. It's only recently after coming across some interviews with Gary Stevenson that I've started to be able to make more sense of things and see the bigger picture. *Gary Stevenson is an economist from an impoverished background who made his money in trading, in particular through betting that the economy was going to collapse indefinitely and being right. He's well worth a listen to and has a YouTube channel, [Garys Economics,](https://youtube.com/@garyseconomics?si=-cLgonBr2Yjq8QB2) which he uses to try and create awareness of the issues facing us and the causes as he sees them.* As Gary sees it the main cause of the economic collapse is wealth inequality. I've been hearing for years from multiple sources that if we lose the middle classes then we go back to poverty for the majority while a handful of people hold all the wealth. I was never sure how losing the middle classes would cause that, though. Now I'm realising that it's not so much a cause as a symptom or perhaps the sign that the tipping point has been reached. Some describe what is happening as a wealth transfer, which is probably the best description. That transfer is happening in ways that aren't always obviously apparent, which explains why blame isn't going where some of the biggest causes are. Take, for example, the housing crisis across developed countries. House prices have increased far beyond what the working classes can afford. We see a boomer generation in houses that cost just 3 times their yearly wage when they purchased them and wonder if they must have done something to make sure future generations couldn't also do that. Migration levels have increased and we're seeing many more foreigners than we used to, so surely it must be because they are buying up all the houses and taking up all the government houses and we can't keep up with building enough new ones. News articles on Canada's initial drop in housing and rent prices since they reduced immigration in 2024 seem to corroborate this, but there are also others arguing that there is plenty of housing stock and lots of houses are sitting empty, both privately or housing trust owned, so that must be the real problem. While these factors are contributing to the problem, there is another less visible contributor that isn't being talked about as much and that is what the ultra rich are doing. You see, when you have everything you could ever need or want and you get some more money you buy assets. The more assets being bought up and held reduces what is available and increases the prices of assets across the board. That includes residential property, despite the fact that billionaires have no interest in buying physical residential property. It will even affect consumables like food and fuel, because on the stock exchange these can be classed as assets. This wasn't so much of a problem when we had a rapidly growing economy and lots of new resources being discovered, but now the rate of growth is lower than the rate at which the top end wealth is expanding, so that expansion has to come from somewhere, which seems to be the rest of the population. While governments make shows of trying to do something about what we see as the visible causes of the housing crisis like agreeing to reduce immigration or implenting extra taxes on older generations in bigger properties or with investment properties to try and force them to relinquish them, it feels like they are just tinkering around the edges and not addressing the cause of wealth and assets being siphoned over to a few people at an ever increasing rate due to compound interest. Any benefits gained from the tinkering will only be temporary while the wealth transfer floodgates remain open. Thus we are hearing more and more people calling for a wealth tax to try and at least slow some of that transfer and bring some back down into circulation at the bottom end. It sounds like a simple solution, but would it even work if it was implemented?

Other factors

There's another factor that isn't often talked about, probably because it's not a nice topic and most don't want to think about it too much. It's population. The reality is that the times when the lower classes have been better off for a while have been after rebuilding following an event that has decimated a population. Most recently for the western world that was two world wars. When there aren't as many people around to do work then the wealthiest are in a position where they have no choice but to make better employment offers in order to keep their workers. It's also a fact that the more people there are the more thinly the available resources need to be spread around, meaning that everyone gets a bit less as the population grows. *It's no wonder then that resentment will grow towards those hoarding more than they could ever use in multiple lifetimes.* There are differing viewpoints on what needs to be done to solve this problem. Some say tax wealth not income so that the working classes struggle less and some of the hoarded wealth is brought back into circulation. Some say the government needs to stop interfering to allow small businesses to be able to thrive and even start in the first place. I'd say why not both? One approach is considered left wing, the other right wing and people then end up arguing over who's right and who's wrong when neither solution on its own is likely to work, but applied together they could make a difference. The reality is that both sides are mad at the government for doing neither, but it's the very same people who are outbidding us for our governments who are the ones benefiting the most from them doing neither of these things. The reality is that the situation we're in today is completely different to the one following the second world war and we will likely never be able to replicate that level of wealth distribution again and even if we did it would be spread thinner due to the population level being so much higher. There is probably no harm in trying, however, especially as there isn't much to lose at this point. There are those who say there is no point in even trying to petition government any more, they have all sold out to the highest bidders, then there are those who say if we could just stop fighting among ourselves there are enough of us to demand change and override the billionaires who have the governments in their pockets. What do you think?

title: [ESP-ENG] Te enseño paso a paso a hacer deliciosas Galletas  con forma de Balón de Fútbol // I'll teach you step by step how to make delicious soccer ball shaped cookies
body:
Saludos queridos amigos de Gems, es un verdadero placer para mi estar nuevamente con todos ustedes. Y siguiendo con la onda futbolística el día de hoy les traigo unas deliciosas Galletas con forma de Balón de Fútbol, ideales para una fiesta tematica infantil o para picotear cuando se esta viendo algún partido de fútbol y estar a tono con la temporada del mundial. La combinanción de estos dos sabores es realmente sabrosa. Lo mejor de todo es que es muy fácil de hacer, a continuación les muestro el paso a paso para su preparación. >Greetings dear friends of Gems! It's a real pleasure to be back with you all. And continuing with the football theme, today I bring you some delicious Soccer Ball Shaped Cookies, ideal for a children's themed party or for snacking while watching a football match and getting into the World Cup spirit. The combination of these two flavors is truly delicious. Best of all, they are very easy to make. Below, I'll show you the step by step instructions. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb8DBwaq5Q9XsTzRkJMbeBst6FZA1YMGKzCfsQSTiSSV8/1781650712173.jpg)
**Ingredientes:**
• 70 gramos de margarina con sal. • 40 gramos de azúcar blanca. • 120 gramos de harina de trigo. • 1 cucharada de cacao en polvo sin azúcar. • 1 cucharadita de esencia de vainilla. >
**Ingredients:**
• 70 grams of salted margarine. • 40 grams of white sugar. • 120 grams of wheat flour. • 1 tablespoon of unsweetened cocoa powder. • 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXAQXeDRCGVvV8hGXLFqEHiVvd1ogakhX5nhfxHzaxXsD/1781650879827.jpg)
**Paso a paso:**
>
**Step by step**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyMcRUDXN4TNiUzoXqjNnpCeTfwMDCuRmrYeQMiTosVb/1781651034414.jpg) Vamos a iniciar nuestra preparación agregando en un recipiente la margarina con sal, seguidamente adicionamos el azúcar y mezclamos con un batidor de globo hasta cremar completamente. >Let's begin our preparation by adding the margarine to a bowl. Next add the sugar and mix with a whisk until completely creamy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYPJk5sPaG8cw9brYpDKv29DvPrLi1SGUy7rEJBYEJ8gh/1781651309682.jpg) Luego agregamos la esencia de vainilla. Integramos, para después añadirle la harina de trigo. Amasamos hasta que nos quede una masa suave. No se debe amasar en exceso, cuando ya se hayan incorporado los ingredientes estara lista. >Then add the vanilla extract. Mix it in and then add the wheat flour. Knead until you have a smooth dough. Do not over knead; it will be ready once the ingredients are incorporated. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYAtsoDJLAYt4ZZZ6CRuMZJqLcKbCMTi8unFyKBD9FSK8/1781651420973.jpg) Dividimos la masa, aproximadamente tomamos 1/3 de la misma y añadimos el cacao en polvo. Integramos y llevamos las dos partes de masa a refrigerar por 15 minutos. >Divide the dough, taking approximately 1/3 of it and add the cocoa powder. Mix it in and refrigerate both portions of dough for 15 minutes. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoTXeWnZcEpUThKS33A5w814AikY75JhRU3ht2RGtWt8/1781651608322.jpg) Una vez pasado el tiempo sacamos la masa del refrigerador y hacemos peloticas de 5 gramos de cada parte de masa. >After 15 minutes, remove the dough from the refrigerator and form 5-gram balls from each portion. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQgQDAuQacTtLFA1MKy1J4MbxPMEWDEp3cJr6nMq6nMwq/1781651872444.jpg) Es momento de darle forma a nuestro balón. Iniciamos colocando en el centro una pelotica de color oscuro, seguidamente colocamos en el alrededor cinco peloticas de color claro. En la unión de cada pelotica de color claro disponemos una de color oscuro y por último llenamos los vacíos con peloticas de color claro. Aplastamos un poco con ayuda de una tapa plastica y tenemos listo el balón. También puedes cortar el borde para darle mejor forma. >Now it's time to shape our balls. Start by placing a dark colored ball in the center, then place five light colored balls around it. At the junction of each light colored ball, place a dark colored ball, and finally fill the gaps with light colored balls. Flatten it slightly with a plastic lid, and the soccer ball is ready. You can also trim the edges to give it a better shape. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYeZ27F6u6a6Phtmrue2UiNDxav1aMej5gfQUtyCmPNYo/1781651981707.jpg) Llevamos a cocción en la freidora de aire por 12 minutos a 180°C. Sacamos y dejamos enfríar para después consumir. Si deseas puedes hacerlas mas pequeñas y si quieres hacer mayor porción solo aumentas las cantidades. >Bake in the air fryer for 12 minutes at 180°C (350°F). Remove and let cool before eating. You can make them smaller if you wish and if you want a larger portion simply increase the quantities. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYnsZTZE8cvBqbaKiVb9pYzDwBFn1YVbwENaRJpmKt4B4/1781652079364.jpg)
**El resultado final de mis deliciosas Galletas con forma de Balón de Fútbol.**
>
**The final result of my delicious Soccer Ball Shaped Cookies.**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUCC9ukrYJkooV35vLSE9aPs6N4hnUJ7atmsTYPi9JADL/1781652147230.jpg) Hasta aquí mi receta del día de hoy, muchas gracias a todos los amigos de la comunidad por su importante apoyo. Me despido hasta la próxima receta apreciados amigos. >That's all for today's recipe. Thank you so much to all the friends in the community for your important support. Until the next recipe dear friends.

Hello, good evening to all my dear Hive friends ❤️ I sincerely hope you are all doing well and enjoying tonight ✨️ It's always a pleasure to greet you and share something new with you each day 😘 This time I want to share with you how to make a beautiful pair of women's shorts. They have a loose fit but a slim waistband to accentuate the feminine figure ☺️ I invite you to join me in each of the steps ✨️.

![PhotoCollage_1781660058926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/Eqb28Hobyo4Ww1SZx3G1D1qRx11S9Btu5mMu2LrrB7zcHaqLYJZdVRTQevPBQpyEuYu.jpg)


<center>![Dark Blue Elegant 3d Illustration Geometric Learn Trading LinkedIn Banner_20250330_124521_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EoeD4ZNgLsZrviZqdPsH7xDD7uLcVT8ok3iUD5LtWPJXPUQsgVdrTxMmpRxXsXRS4hF.png)</center> 

• 🧵Sewing machine 
• ✂️Scissors 
• 🧵Sewing thread 
• ✂️Fabric 
• 🧵Needle N°9



 <center>![Dark Blue Elegant 3d Illustration Geometric Learn Trading LinkedIn Banner_20250330_124734_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EoeDQzxM1SGG8LqXYo2qXvLmwwH3hFcVRwvaA6yn2xJbP35dAMJXKMysNWoBF9EaQtY.png)</center>

•✨️☘️I'm going to start by cutting all the pieces for my pants: two side pieces with a front drop and a thick waistband cut in two.
|![20260607_180929.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/Eokf3LySxMSzTrqktPT2dL5yL5EnU3qoFPJ1jdLYPU9fLUkB3Fso5T9cXDxVKPWjxg7.jpg)|![20260607_180937.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EoCj6xjw1zUNHZFy1H5ygg3j3QGys7jMr5aC9cdPdXA29kfDYiySdr2khTdy7nQcS6A.jpg)|
|-|-|

 •✨️☘️I continue by sewing the inner side seam of each side piece with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch to secure it. Then I'll sew both ends with two straight stitches and a zigzag stitch to assemble the body of the shorts. 
|![20260607_184913.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23w2woKVqGWantn9VsbTS4rDkj8oF7VRFGrufUHGQKDpqa2aPT6BbxDMJS4E3gup8FdCj.jpg)|![20260607_185022.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23w2wrcWMTB8bJhvFMxSU5trfv2LEbuEUffY1RwbVGmsT3nNer5qUCyxaqWCinb492hhj.jpg)|![20260607_185153.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23wgWJ4eGxcn2F3LdTi4Co6Kp15hng9DLytt3VVMb5zkDzGQhRRyYLFwhaL5rGzyDSSUh.jpg)|![20260607_185450.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23w2yidtMBzEnmjae3SgAV4g2M8TAU2MhoqUS5iJgVWTJDi9uXrd3N4xz6inTcYEMyV5k.jpg)|
|-|-|-|-|

•✨️☘️I continue by joining the waistband to make it wider with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch. Then I'll sew along the top edge with a long straight stitch to pull the threads and gather the pants a little. Finally, I'll sew the waistband with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch to secure it. 
|![20260608_152901.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23vsYjNHJrdotbhdX3GzPR71CV2nUSaDVWnzU7n2VD1TiK35CdXGuXm4qCKkuSjWzqV5i.jpg)|![20260608_154438.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23tmUJdUSoK3EY1YjehusXgi4mAJHfMPMxZyFFSeSavZhXEVwqHp2J8aQfq1RtZSRRUv8.jpg)|![20260608_154914.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23uFeSsej5AsTQJADrwJR3mKYadNbYxK7knStkrXgQAytzBrNFT49rvYXomELXebpY19Y.jpg)|![20260608_155828.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23w2ww1Wn14zxk7EhkVb54s3KLdscTmNKSgk5JodwXuamrESwq6SWWFTgQ9t7XD3XCZgu.jpg)|
|-|-|-|-|

•✨️☘️Next, I'll sew the guide seams to create the opening where I'll insert the elastic, which will be right in the middle. Then I'll stretch it and sew it with a straight stitch. 
|![20260608_160318.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23u6DmLNGEgn7S4C2N2jh34rVgyngMaznsS71pwzaoBMDpPvyTUN2VBfacg6cue94voY4.jpg)|![20260608_173804.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23tc3nEbWpA6c82LvwRmNEpgF9ojKLFRUrhf7qyYjrK3pe6n5prwBki5r3AeAXTnENyoq.jpg)|![20260608_174341.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23wC7QKGNFL5dzFS2kGZwUBgcPZCFD6Vi6Tnauxn3PaGVxWJ7AbmFjQjJPrnjYz44SoPv.jpg)|![20260608_175600.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23uFe7dqiy6UeZipDzEa3EnA8xb85hidyUPP5HYv9yQnkDrheMxNCRq1iK92Fnfb3V3dv.jpg)|
|-|-|-|-|

•✨️☘️To finish, I'm going to sew the hem with a zigzag stitch while folding and sewing, then I'm going to sew the decorative braid and I'll sew it right in the middle with a straight stitch.

|![20260608_175803.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23w2yo27y5uMSyZtJ3FTB4YMy9m9TnPkqAmGKL99PnEuE9oQftYKrTtsLeCHLk7LU2h4r.jpg)|![20260608_180933.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23vsbRUuCBTyqJJSyAfyBHDrcsHpfFBLf5itt7ChmYjWvYSDaQL9CTKkJNLBUAuf1EiUF.jpg)|![20260608_181127.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23vsUxyZEhNGenWQDionf7AFR8xcZ1aKC4nha4aaxtdp4RiCXviQ1RjsPpkikvz3xegMf.jpg)|
|-|-|-|


<center>![Dark Blue Elegant 3d Illustration Geometric Learn Trading LinkedIn Banner_20250330_124945_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EoeD4ZYmGMcA1CW4Rjb37hbEFRKYdA8eaJ5Hb6LesXz16fMLJLcPWrUhe54zA22QQuk.png)</center> 

It's a comfortable and beautiful pair of shorts that will flatter your figure, and it comes in a lovely color ☺️☘️✨️ Thank you, my dear friends, for joining me on this wonderful journey of learning and stitching, where we'll bring a piece of fabric to life, creating a beautiful garment 🥰 Thank you for getting this far ❤️ Greetings and have a lovely night, everyone 😘.
![20260609_231842.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23y8r2xjM2Gm6STHxh4unb7hsHhVUx5xsyVbifQ4GXhND22HHEF8HMdg6R7KpgPTxtgw4.jpg)

>

Excelente día a todos los que pasan por este post, en este casi terminando martes les traigo mi presentación para Hive Music Festival en su semana 192 ronda 3.
Para esta ronda les traigo un tema de Chayanne, \

, este tema me gusta mucho ya que es de aprender a reconocer cuando fallas y pides perdón, aun espero que me la canten y me pidan perdón jaja pero como no pasa la cantare yo jeje Este actividad es organizado por @musiczone y este es el [post](https://ecency.com/@musiczone/hive-music-festival-week-n-192-round-3-june-15-to-20-engesp?referral=josueelinfame), para que puedan unirse.

>\n\nGood day to everyone who visits this post! As this Tuesday draws to a close, I'm sharing my performance for Hive Music Festival, week 192, round 3. For this round, I'm performing a song by Chayanne, \

(A Century Without You). I really like this song because it's about learning to recognize when you've made a mistake and asking for forgiveness. I'm still hoping someone will sing it to me and apologize, haha, but since that's not going to happen, I'll sing it myself, hehe. This activity is organized by @musiczone and this is the [post](https://ecency.com/@musiczone/hive-music-festival-week-n-192-round-3-june-15-to-20-engesp?referral=josueelinfame), so you can join. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd7Tym6uiiwzDNcrwCCWFNnjXwbJPdVMKmwEw4ctUYZ9k/192.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrzLPxkSi87uXp7jdCvHw1LR1sTegpnDFGJYbZQg9w37/letra.png)

> Mil y una historia me he inventado Para estar aquí, aquí a tu lado Y no te das cuenta que Yo no encuentro ya qué hacer Sé que piensas que no he sido sincero Sé que piensas que ya no tengo remedio ¿Pero quién me iba a decir que sin ti no sé vivir? Y ahora que no estás aquí Me doy cuenta cuánta falta me haces Si te he fallado, te pido perdón De la única forma que sé Abriendo las puertas de mi corazón Para cuando decidas volver Porque nunca habrá nadie que pueda llenar El vacío que dejaste en mí Has cambiado mi vida, me has hecho crecer Es que no soy el mismo de ayer Un día es un siglo sin ti [Letra](https://www.letras.com/chayanne/1748676/)
