title.title: Nubes grises...esperando que salga el sol.............Esp-Eng
title.body:
> Cuando vemos en el cielo tan bonito azul, que de repente se pone oscuro porque las nubes grises amenazan con una fuerte lluvia, que para unos les gusta, a otros no, que anhelamos, pedimos que salga el sol. Asi mas o menos a veces me siento cuando creo siento ahogarme y no en un rio, o tomando un vaso de agua, sino ahogarme en las preocupaciones, mas que todo cuando se es madre sola, con hijos que aunque esten grandes, pero estan con una la madre, no dejamos de sentir angustias y preocupaciones por muchas cosas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23xeYvmvjB3fmdjAULT5GRryo5dixLhY68ajnbe3bNwzp96Brc8S58LVk6Sv6JcGwnopJ.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/un-vaso-de-agua-sombra-solitario-904698/)

> Estamos solos desde que el papa se fue a otro hogar, pero lo que mas me lastima es que no atiende a sus hijos, no por mi, sino por ellos, y el mismo el padre esta buscando no el odio, sino que no lo quieran, que es algo diferente a odiar, porque odiar enferma el alma, el espiritu, mientras que no querer, no se quiere y ya. Desde entonces los he ido llevando yo sola, claro con el apoyo de mi familia, que siempre hemos sido asi, con todos, no solo por mi. Pero de quien necesite estamos los demas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EonntdMwjMXbcAC9UXHScpqRcvQbC5Z3CdThqzvmYaeAGC2MP9F3JZD6ucCkSsYaq6z.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/esp%C3%ADritu-de-equipo-trabajo-en-equipo-2447163/)

> Como estan las cosas en la actualidad, a veces me da como pena, no tener para ellos para sus tres alimentos diarios como debe ser, siempre falta algo, hubo un tiempo en que los alimentos escasearon y teniamos con que comprar, ahora hay alimentos, pero no nos alcanza para comprar, mas ahora con esa tasa de dólar, que cada dia va en aumento a una velocidad increible. Mi salario como maestra jubilada son 350,00 bs, que puedo comprar realmente con ello, que servicio puedo pagar con ello, ninguno porque quedaria debiendo y me lo cortan. Las recompensas aquí si ayudan como digo me sirven para completar y comprar algo para comer como: 1 kilo de arroz, medio pollo, porque nuestra moneda tambien ha bajado, pero siendo constante puedo hacer unos cambios diariamente si es necesario hacerlo, sino dejo que se siga acumulando y cambiar mas. A veces me he visto mas en la necesidad de hacer unos apagados por eso mismo, para comer sobre todo, porque para mas nada me alcanza.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vi3sMM9qV4qz3X83AsFgDqA4W7tAK4kc8W5zpWVEhPV9pfzGrpo79RZ9bjUrgH5P7tE.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/pollo-leche-huevos-frutas-pez-559892/)

> Es ahi donde nos tenemos que ingeniar para hacer otras cosas, emprender en hacer: dulces, comidas, colas, lo que genere otro ingreso pero que uno le guste hacerlo. Pero hay dias en que las cosas no salen tan bien como las pensamos, la planificamos, por eso hay dias de nubes grises, esperando que salga el sol. Me ha tocado dias duros, que algo que creo nos preguntamos todas las madres: que les damos de comer a nuestros hijos, cuando no se tiene, o se tiene poco, a tocado comer arepa sola con margarina y agua, no es malo, somos bendecidos, porque otros comen menos que eso. Pero siendo un pais con tantas riquezas y que tengamos que pasar muchas necesidades y penurias, yo siempre digo: uno puede aguantar, pero los hijos no. Pero tampoco me gusta que mis hijos me vean asi, entonces lloro en silencio, me trago las lagrimas, hablo normal, porque ya mis hijos estan en una edad de que entienden y que la situacion se nos pone dura a veces. Asi que ya saldra el sol, porque las nubes grises van pasando porque el viento se las lleva.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoGxUEREoNnWeMpUYER5RWuGUwLfJUk3QmPhw97xLFtMhgu73BSHcT9pNKLNosWgqro.png) Foto de mi archivo personal tomada con celular Samsung Galaxy A16

> Todo con Dios como siempre, que nunca nos abandona. Contenido propio y original, traducido con la app DeepL. Portada editada en Canva.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23z7fUxN9hsnf5bzVgj64rU74PCh8dmMRc9a4ZcTgi93cosMQchrBxFShDQQJgE9zDj6k.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23xKvd7Sw3AtCxknhjxKfSo7qbMkJJYXKTZrwzgv1jd6UD2oKiZwReSCdZe3xtQWdJZLU.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/nubes-cielo-nube-nubes-oscuras-68584/)

> When we look up at the beautiful blue sky, which suddenly turns dark as gray clouds threaten a heavy downpour—which some people like and others don’t—we long for and pray for the sun to come out. That’s more or less how I feel sometimes when I feel like I’m drowning—not in a river, or while drinking a glass of water, but drowning in worries—especially when you’re a single mother with children who, even though they’re grown, are still with you, their mother; we never stop feeling anxiety and worry about so many things.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23xeYvmvjB3fmdjAULT5GRryo5dixLhY68ajnbe3bNwzp96Brc8S58LVk6Sv6JcGwnopJ.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/un-vaso-de-agua-sombra-solitario-904698/)

> We’ve been on our own since Dad left for another home, but what hurts me the most is that he doesn’t take care of his children—not for my sake, but for theirs. And Dad himself isn’t seeking hatred, but rather that they not love him, which is different from hating, because hatred sickens the soul and the spirit, whereas not loving someone simply means not loving them—that’s all. Since then, I’ve been taking care of them on my own—of course, with the support of my family, who’ve always been there for everyone, not just for me. But whoever needs us, the rest of us are here.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EonntdMwjMXbcAC9UXHScpqRcvQbC5Z3CdThqzvmYaeAGC2MP9F3JZD6ucCkSsYaq6z.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/esp%C3%ADritu-de-equipo-trabajo-en-equipo-2447163/)

> The way things are right now, it sometimes makes me sad that I can’t provide them with three proper meals a day as they should have; there’s always something missing. There was a time when food was scarce, but we had the money to buy it. Now there’s food, but we can’t afford to buy it—especially now with the dollar exchange rate, which is rising at an incredible pace every day. My pension as a retired teacher is 350.00 Bs. What can I really buy with that? What bills can I pay with it? None, because I’d end up in debt and they’d cut off my benefits. The rewards here do help—as I said, they let me make up the difference and buy something to eat, like 1 kilo of rice or half a chicken, because our currency has also lost value. But if I’m consistent, I can make small exchanges daily if necessary; otherwise, I let the rewards accumulate so I can exchange more later. Sometimes I’ve found myself having to make some exchanges for that very reason—mainly to eat—because I can’t afford anything else.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vi3sMM9qV4qz3X83AsFgDqA4W7tAK4kc8W5zpWVEhPV9pfzGrpo79RZ9bjUrgH5P7tE.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/pollo-leche-huevos-frutas-pez-559892/)

> That’s when we have to get creative and do other things—start making things like sweets, meals, or drinks—anything that brings in extra income but that we actually enjoy doing. But there are days when things don’t go as well as we’d hoped or planned, which is why there are days of gray clouds, waiting for the sun to come out. I’ve had my share of tough days—days when we all ask ourselves the same question, I think, as mothers: what do we feed our children when we have nothing, or very little? We’ve had to make do with just an arepa with margarine and water. It’s not so bad; we’re blessed, because others have even less than that. But in a country with so much wealth, yet where we have to endure so many hardships and privations, I always say: I can endure it, but my children can’t. But I also don’t want my children to see me like this, so I cry in silence, swallow my tears, and speak normally—because my children are now at an age where they understand that things get tough for us sometimes. So the sun will rise again, because the gray clouds will pass as the wind blows them away.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoGxUEREoNnWeMpUYER5RWuGUwLfJUk3QmPhw97xLFtMhgu73BSHcT9pNKLNosWgqro.png) Photo from my personal archive taken with a Samsung Galaxy A16 cell phone

Camera tech has improved throughout the years, and this display at Science World shows how the technology used to photograph the game of soccer has changed across time. There were different lenses, including massive ones that can capture all the action without missing a beat.

title.title: With Trump at G7... \
title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWwT3MPwitG9BGHEMXaXjqLTtTpNXkDJnc5y9PuVCxoZ/image.png)



>[Anchor]
President Lee Jae-myung, who attended the G7 summit for the second consecutive year since last year, had an unscheduled \

with U.S. President Donald Trump.
He directly asked for a peaceful resolution of the North Korean issue, and President Trump reportedly expressed his intention to try.
Reporter Kang Jin-won's report.

>[Reporter]
Seven major countries and EU leaders who attended the G7 summit in Evian, France, gather in the middle of the podium for a commemorative photo.
The leaders of five invited countries, including President Lee Jae-myung, who has been invited for two consecutive years, will also come forward to greet them.
While the leaders of each country chatted before taking the picture, President Lee talked with U.S. President Trump for about 30 seconds.

>In an unscheduled 'surprise talk', U.S. President Trump asked about the current state of inter-Korean relations, and President Lee asked to lead the peaceful resolution of the North Korean issue.
He asked him to play a role as if he had solved the Middle East war, but President Trump reportedly responded by expressing his intention to try.

>There were many other issues such as security and trade, so attention was paid to whether the two leaders of South Korea and the U.S. would hold bilateral talks, but Cheong Wa Dae explained that it is not yet at a specific stage.

>As Korean and German companies compete for the Canadian next-generation submarine project worth up to 60 trillion won, talks with the leaders of Canada and Germany took place respectively.
[Lee Jae-myung / President: The relationship between our two countries is developing very well. Since we have a lot to cooperate with each other, let's discuss more concretely about what kind of cooperation we will have today.]
[Mark Carney / Canadian Prime Minister: The partnership between the two countries has continued to grow. We have strengthened cooperation in various fields, including defense, investment, and culture.]
President Lee pointed out the reality that donor countries' development aid budgets to underdeveloped countries are being reduced at an expanded meeting where the leaders of participating countries gathered.
He stressed the need to pave the way for new growth in countries receiving aid through private investment, and that public resources should play a role in promoting it.
President Lee is expected to continue his schedule on the second day of the G7 summit today (17th) and convey his commitment to become a bridge for cooperation between developed and developing countries.
YTN Gangjinwon in Geneva near the summit hall.
Video Reporter: Choi Kwang-hyun
Video editing: Yeon Jinyoung
Kang Jin-won (jinwon@ytn.co.kr )

The President is making every effort, using every opportunity, to solve our problems.

This is the right thing, and such reporting is normal.

During the era of the insurrection leader, they even spouted nonsense calling such things “summits.”

And the content was truly insignificant, ultimately making the people seem as if they had hearing problems.

Let us see our President’s sincerity exactly as it is.

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQEKYk2ZnB9f7cahiBhh9W1uWvzyLxVyKzmYcxuaizdhj/1781660222945.jpg)

ဒီနေ့ မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာ ကစားတဲ့ France vs Senegal ပွဲစဉ်မှာ France က ၃-၁ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ပထမပိုင်းမှာ ဂိုးမရှိ သရေနဲ့သာ ပြီးဆုံးခဲ့ပြီး ဒုတိယပိုင်းရောက်မှသာ သွင်းဂိုးတွေကို တွေ့မြင်ခွင့်ရခဲ့တာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ၆၆၊ ၈၂ မိနစ်တို့မှာ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး ၂ ဂိုး သွင်းယူခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ၉၀+၅ မိနစ်မှာတော့ Senegal တို့ ချေပဂိုး ၁ ဂိုး ပြန်လည်လို့ သွင်းယူနိုင်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဒါပေမဲ့ ၉၀+၆ မိနစ်မှာတော့ France အနေနဲ့ တတိယ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးကို သွင်းယူသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ 

ဒီနှစ် ကမ္ဘာ့ဖလားမှာ အာရှဇုန်က အသင်းတွေ အတော်လေး အစွမ်းပြထားနိုင်နေတာကို တွေ့ရပါတယ်။ အသင်းကြီးတွေကို အပြန်အလှန် ကစားပြထားပြီး အမှတ်တွေ ခွဲဝေယူနေကြပါတယ်။ ငါတို့ဟာ တန်းတခု ရှိတယ်ဆိုတဲ့ အနေအထားမျိုးကို ဒီတကြိမ် ကမ္ဘာ့ဖလားမှာ ပိုမို ပြသနိုင်နေတာကို တွေ့ရပါတယ်။ အရင်တုန်းကလို ကွာတားဖိုင်နယ် ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ် အဆင့်တွေမှာ အာရှက အသင်းတွေကို တွေ့မြင်ခွင့်ရလာမလားကတော့ ဆက်လက် စောင့်ကြည့်သွားရဦးမှာပါ။


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNa29ehTYGjBhmMmnSqomGKCLsgfWvQ5FXnRcVCdFAbva/1781660222960.jpg)


အာရှက အသင်းတွေ စွာနေတယ် ပြောထားခါမှ ဒီနေ့ မနက် ၄ နာရီခွဲမှာ ကစားသွားတဲ့ Iraq vs Norway တို့ရဲ့ ပွဲစဉ်မှာ Norway က ၁-၄ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ Norway ရဲ့ တကျော့ပြန် ကမ္ဘာ့ဖလား ခရီးစဉ်ကို Iraq တို့ အခက်တွေ့အောင် မလုပ်နိုင်ခဲ့ပါဘူး။ Norway အသင်းအတွက် တိုက်စစ်မှူး Haaland က ၂ ဂိုး သွင်းယူပေးသွားခဲ့တာပါ။ ကမ္ဘာ့ဖလား ပြိုင်ပွဲအတွက် အသင်း ဓါတ်ပုံ ရိုက်စဉ်က ဗိုက်ကင်းအထာနဲ့ ဂိုက်ပေးကြမ်းထားတဲ့ Norway တို့ အဖွင့်ပွဲစဉ်မှာ အမှန်အကန် ကစားပြ၊ ကြမ်းပြနေပြီ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

မနက် ၇ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ လက်ရှိ ချန်ပီယံ Argentina vs Algeria တို့ရဲ့ ပွဲစဉ် ကစားသွားဖို့ ရှိနေပါတယ်။ ကျနော် စာရေးနေတုန်းမှာ Argentina က ၁ ဂိုး သွင်းထားပါတယ်။ ၁၇ မိနစ်မှာ De Paul ရဲ့ ဖန်တီး ပေးပို့မှုကနေ Messi က သွင်းယူ ပေးသွားခဲ့တာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ပြန်အိပ်ရမလား ဘောလုံးပွဲ ကြည့်ရမလားက ဇဝေဇဝါ ဖြစ်နေပါတယ်။

၄၈ သင်းနဲ့ တိုးမြှင့် ကျင်းပတဲ့ ပြိုင်ပွဲ ဖြစ်တာရယ်။ အမေရိကတိုက်မှာ လက်ခံ ကျင်းပတာရယ်ကြောင့် ပွဲစဉ်တွေက ညဦးပိုင်း မရှိသလောက်ပါပဲ။ သန်းခေါင်ကျော်၊ အာရုံတက်ချိန်၊ မနက်ခင်း အချိန်တွေ ဖြစ်နေခဲ့တာပါ။ ၄ နှစ်မှ တကြိမ် ဆိုတော့လည်း ဘာလုပ်လို့ လုပ်ရမယ် မသိနေတော့ပါဘူး။

_(photos from FIFA World Cup page)_

title.title: Once a king, always a king.
title.body:
[The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/video/movies/100000010945475/disclosure-day-anatomy-of-a-scene.html)
Perhaps you are one of those people who (still) don't know that the concept of so-called *blockbuster movies* was created by none other than **Steven Spielberg**. Cinema purely for the sake of entertainment arrived in American cinemas to foster a new way of watching movies (especially during the mid-year periods in the United States... famous for school holidays, so to speak), and to bring more money to the studios. Since 2008, we haven't seen Spielberg release any purely commercial movie within a plot with a more original argument. Since then, his bet has been on projects with a much more personal approach and dramatic touches (which are definitely not the types of projects that attract the vast majority of people to the cinemas). However, with the release of ***Disclosure Day***, everything changes; and the box office proves that once a king, always a king.
[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/timlammers/2026/06/10/disclosure-day-box-office-projections-on-soft-side-for-a-spielberg-film/)
Completely contradicting all the predictions of box office experts (and cinematic financial profits), this movie was projected to gross around **US$ 65 million** in total, both within and outside of Canada and the United States; but it ended up grossing no less than almost **US$ 93 million**. Therefore, this movie exceeded all expectations and has a chance of becoming very profitable. Within Spielberg's own filmography, ***Disclosure Day*** became the fifth highest-grossing movie (overall) on the list of his most profitable movies. It's worth mentioning here that this is not a remake, franchise, or even a sequel... But rather, an original within its context. This only confirms that those who know how to make movies remain on the throne when they truly have the soul of a filmmaker (and make a point of exuding it in all their attempts). ---
**Una vez rey, siempre rey.**
Quizás seas de los que aún desconocen que el concepto de las llamadas *películas blockbusters* fue creado nada menos que por **Steven Spielberg**. El cine puramente comercial llegó a las salas estadounidenses para impulsar una nueva forma de ver películas (sobre todo durante las vacaciones escolares en Estados Unidos) y para generar más ingresos para los estudios. Desde 2008, Spielberg no había estrenado ninguna película puramente comercial con una trama original. Desde entonces, ha apostado por proyectos con un enfoque mucho más personal y toques dramáticos (que, sin duda, no son el tipo de proyectos que atraen a la gran mayoría del público a las salas). Sin embargo, con el estreno de ***El Día de la Revelación***, todo cambió; y la taquilla demostró que quien fue rey, siempre será rey. Contrariamente a todas las predicciones de los expertos en taquilla (y a las ganancias financieras del cine), se proyectaba que esta película recaudaría alrededor de **US$ 65 millones** en total, tanto dentro como fuera de Canadá y Estados Unidos; pero terminó recaudando casi **US$ 93 millones**. Por lo tanto, esta película superó todas las expectativas y tiene muchas posibilidades de ser muy rentable. Dentro de la filmografía de Spielberg, ***El Día de la Revelación*** se convirtió en la quinta película más taquillera (en general) en la lista de sus películas más rentables. Cabe mencionar que no se trata de un remake, una franquicia ni una secuela... sino de una obra original dentro de su contexto. Esto solo confirma que quienes saben hacer cine se mantienen en la cima cuando poseen el alma de un cineasta (y se esfuerzan por transmitirla en cada uno de sus trabajos). ---
**Quem é rei, nunca perde a majestade.**
Talvez, você seja uma daquelas pessoas que (ainda) não sabem que o conceito dos chamados *filmes blockbusters* foi criado por ninguém menos do que **Steven Spielberg**. O cinema apenas pela diversão do próprio entretenimento chegou aos cinemas americanos para fomentar uma nova maneira de assistir filmes (em especial, durante os períodos do meio do ano em solo norte-americano... famosos pelas férias escolares, por assim dizer), e trazer mais dinheiro aos estúdios. Desde 2008 não víamos Spielberg lançar nenhum filme puramente comercial entro de uma trama com argumento mais original. De lá para cá, a aposta dele foi em projetos com uma abordagem muito mais pessoal e com toques dramáticos (que definitivamente não são aqueles tipos de projetos que chamam a grande maioria das pessoas para ir aos cinemas). No entanto, com o lançamento de ***Dia D***, tudo muda; e as bilheterias provam que quem é rei, nunca perde a majestade. Indo totalmente de encontro com todas as previsões dos especialistas em números de bilheterias (e lucros financeiros cinematográficos), esse filme estava sendo projetado para arrecadar algo em torno de **US$ 65 milhões** na soma de sua arrecadação dentro (e fora) de domínios canadenses e estadunidenses; mas acabou arrecadando nada menos do que quase **US$ 93 milhões**. Sendo assim, esse filme superou todas as expectativas e tem chances de se tornar bem rentável. Dentro da filmografia do próprio Spielberg, ***Dia D*** se tornou o quinto filme com a melhor esteia (de um modo geral) na lista dos seus filmes mais rentáveis. Vale mencionar aqui que não se trata de nenhum remake, franquia ou até mesmo uma sequência... Mas sim, de uma original dentro do seu contexto. Isso só traz a certeza de quem sabe fazer filmes, se mantém no trono quando realmente tem a alma de cineasta (e faz questão de exalar isso em todas as suas tentativas). Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/once-a-king-always-a-king-do9)

title.body:
> >«La experiencia adquirida al escribir un libro no sirve para nada a la hora de construir el siguiente y todos los trucos del oficio aplicados en las ficciones anteriores se escurren entre los dedos como si no fueran más que puñados de arena». Estoy de acuerdo contigo Mariana Travacio... Sé exactamente de qué habla Mariana Travacio porque lo he vivido con cada libro que he escrito. El primero fue una epifanía, una especie de milagro que no supe explicar entonces ni sé explicar ahora. Escribir «Convite de Cenizas» fue como descubrir un idioma que siempre había estado durmiendo en algún pliegue de mi cerebro, esperando que le diera cuerda. Terminé esos relatos convencido de que había encontrado la fórmula, de que los siguientes serían más fáciles, más fluidos, más profesionales. Qué ingenuo. El segundo «Tras la Piel» me esperaba con la paciencia de un depredador. Me senté frente al ordenador con la soberbia del que cree saber, y las palabras se negaron a venir. Los trucos que había usado, la estructura que tan bien funcionó, ese ritmo que parecía tan natural se habían convertido en esqueletos inútiles. Los personajes se negaban a caminar. Las tramas se deshilachaban. Cada frase sonaba a falsa, a copia barata de algo que ya había hecho. Ahí entendí que el oficio de escribir no se acumula como monedas en una alcancía. Cada historia exige su propio pozo, su propia sed. ***
![Screenshot_20260616_154544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/23ycyrMrxCfkAMqAwZHmoPiqG7h8nUSp1uNDBUzRNQQ9EANsm6RWNihDtanYxGxShRyn5.jpg) [Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/un-puente-de-madera-en-medio-de-un-bosque-qo3y0PyEFmU)
***

> Esa sensación de desamparo, esa certeza de estar empezando desde cero (otra vez, siempre otra vez) tiene algo de ritual iniciático. Cuando arranco un proyecto nuevo, soy exactamente el mismo escritorzuelo inseguro que se sentó a escribir su primer cuento adolescente en una libreta. Las páginas publicadas, las reseñas, los lectores que han confiado en mis historias... todo eso se desvanece como el humo de un cigarrillo. Quedo desnudo frente a la página, sin más armas que mi torpeza y mi obstinación. Por eso entiendo la copa de vino de que habla Mariana Travacio. No es evasión. No es alcoholismo de escritor de folletín. Es un gesto casi ceremonial, una manera de decirle al miedo: estoy aquí, te veo, y sin embargo voy a intentarlo. El vino no despeja las dudas, no aclara el camino, pero calienta algo en el pecho. Baja las defensas. Hace que el desamparo sea menos frío. La literatura nació alrededor del fuego, con la garganta húmeda, con la noche fuera y las historias adentro. He llegado a pensar que el verdadero oficio del escritor no está en dominar la técnica, sino en aprender a convivir con el terror. En aceptar que cada libro es una primera vez. En no huir del abismo, sino sentarse al borde y mirarlo fijamente, mientras el vino tiñe de rojo la incertidumbre. ***
![Screenshot_20260616_202229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/EoJy53sTjj3KtNehwZxrqLMGH8dCdP6cJYCSpWRd3HJAEHW35HoUT57DPRdWRsC6Xkw.jpg) [Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/un-viejo-puente-de-madera-con-barandillas-naranjas-zFeV83GTJfw)
***

> Mariana Travacio tiene razón, y yo he dejado de avergonzarme por ello. Cuando alguien me pregunta si escribir se vuelve más fácil con los años, digo la verdad: no, no se vuelve más fácil. Te vuelves más resistente, aprendes a no entrar en pánico cuando las palabras niegan su lugar, desarrollas cierta paciencia estoica para esperar a que la tormenta pase. Pero la tormenta siempre llega. No hay truco que valga. No hay atajo. La página en blanco es siempre la misma: un abismo que te devuelve tu propia mirada. Pero el vino ayuda a sostener esa mirada sin desviarla. A veces, cuando el alcohol hace su trabajo lento y generoso, las palabras empiezan a llegar. No siempre. No todas las veces. Pero cuando llegan, saben a recompensa, a algo conquistado. Escribo con dudas. Escribo, a veces con una copa de vino a mi lado, a veces, el desamparo, bien acompañado, puede ser el mejor territorio para empezar. Y al terminar el libro, cuando lo cierro y lo entrego a los lectores, ya sé que el próximo será igual. La misma sensación de vértigo. La misma página en blanco. Y tal vez, una copa que espera. ***
> **© Marabuzal, 2026. Contenido Original. Todos los derechos reservados.** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUKVA6YugQdRrhGACmnps8ddBkV8W6UwGEo9DwaNQxF/1768408479017.jpg) 📍 **Reflection: \

They slip through your fingers like handfuls of sand.

I agree with you, Mariana Travacio...

I know exactly what Mariana Travacio is talking about because I've experienced it with every book I've written. The first was an epiphany, a kind of miracle I couldn't explain then, and I still can't. Writing \

(Feast of Ashes) was like discovering a language that had always been dormant in some fold of my brain, waiting for me to wind it up. I finished those stories convinced I'd found the formula, that the next ones would be easier, more fluid, more professional.

How naive.

The second, \

(Behind the Skin), awaited me with the patience of a predator. I sat down at the computer with the arrogance of someone who thinks they know everything, and the words refused to come. The tricks I'd used, the structure that had worked so well, that rhythm that had seemed so natural had become useless skeletons. The characters refused to move. The plots unraveled. Every sentence sounded fake, a cheap imitation of something I'd already done. That's when I understood that the craft of writing isn't something you accumulate like coins in a piggy bank. Each story demands its own well, its own thirst. ***
![Screenshot_20260616_154544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/23ycyrMrxCfkAMqAwZHmoPiqG7h8nUSp1uNDBUzRNQQ9EANsm6RWNihDtanYxGxShRyn5.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/un-puente-de-madera-en-medio-de-un-bosque-qo3y0PyEFmU)
***

> That feeling of helplessness, that certainty of starting from scratch (again, always again) has something of an initiation ritual about it. When I start a new project, I'm exactly the same insecure little writer who sat down to write his first teenage story in a notebook. The published pages, the reviews, the readers who have trusted my stories... all of that vanishes like cigarette smoke. I'm left naked before the page, with no weapons but my clumsiness and my stubbornness. That's why I understand the glass of wine Mariana Travacio talks about. It's not escapism. It's not the alcoholism of a pulp fiction writer. It's an almost ceremonial gesture, a way of saying to fear: I'm here, I see you, and yet I'm going to try. Wine doesn't dispel doubts, it doesn't illuminate the path, but it warms something in the chest. It lowers the defenses. It makes helplessness less cold. Literature was born around the fire, with a wet throat, with the night outside and the stories inside. I've come to think that the true craft of the writer lies not in mastering technique, but in learning to live with terror. In accepting that every book is a first time. In not running from the abyss, but sitting on the edge and staring at it, while the wine stains the uncertainty red. ***
![Screenshot_20260616_202229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/EoJy53sTjj3KtNehwZxrqLMGH8dCdP6cJYCSpWRd3HJAEHW35HoUT57DPRdWRsC6Xkw.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/un-viejo-puente-de-madera-con-barandillas-naranjas-zFeV83GTJfw)
***

> Mariana Travacio is right, and I've stopped being ashamed of it. When someone asks me if writing gets easier with age, I tell the truth: no, it doesn't. You become more resilient, you learn not to panic when words refuse to come, you develop a certain stoic patience to wait for the storm to pass. But the storm always comes. There's no trick to it. No shortcut. The blank page is always the same: an abyss that reflects your own gaze back at you. But wine helps you hold that gaze without looking away. Sometimes, when the alcohol does its slow and generous work, the words begin to flow. Not always. Not every time. But when they do, they taste like a reward, like something conquered. I write with doubts. I write, sometimes with a glass of wine by my side; sometimes, helplessness, in good company, can be the best place to begin. And when I finish the book, when I close it and give it to the readers, I already know that the next one will be the same. The same feeling of vertigo. The same blank page. And perhaps, a glass waiting. (Google Translation) ***

title.title: Ria's Exciting First Week of School
title.body: Today I want to share about my daughter Ria's first day at school. She was very excited and honestly, I was excited too. I woke up early to prepare everything for my two children. I cooked breakfast, prepared their uniforms, packed their things, and made sure that nothing was forgotten.\n\n<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23zGsBUak5GVdFMpPC8i7Lvf1oDDwZdk3KoQpmGe3G3pK7k36k9RsVi2PU1tNVGMwsbuz.jpg The most exciting part for me was bringing Ria to school. As soon as we arrived, I could already see her happiness. She quickly spotted some of her friends and started talking with them. It was funny because they were chatting like grown ups already. They looked so comfortable with each other even though classes had just started.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/2432J2yYk1DGLR1bpWvrfsnbPT5pn9ocT2spy6XVugfh1GzW4M2zPEv3GwJrwzJVTYsLf.jpg After a while, all the students were called for the flag ceremony. The school grounds were full of children, parents, and teachers. While the students were busy lining up, me and some co-parents stayed together and had a long conversation. We talked about our children, school supplies, and how fast they are growing.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23xp2PKZ4PX9dmR4o8jmf6gyvLbVDJrTt41fLVsQF3fbGU7NpJiKZT3mq9WL7PM4nDPD7.jpg When the opening program ended, the students went back to their classrooms. That was the time we needed to leave them. I always feel a little worried whenever I leave my children at school, but seeing Ria smiling made me feel at ease. She looked ready for another school year.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/241tNpHp4wzocTHVqD1ih7gf4yTZaQDHKJbdm1Gnk8kyBY6E46yehtAszfX4nj59PJQmh.jpg Before the first week ended, the school scheduled their ID picture and class picture. Some of the students who were present during the first day were no longer there, while a few new students joined the class. That is normal during the opening weeks because some families are still fixing school requirements.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/24244EyyNXoyPCPtuVeEv7xoyMQHEu23J7AoGz748XsinRu2WQ8KBAedibPg7DUZ98tSt.jpg While waiting outside, I noticed one of my friends taking pictures. Then my attention was caught by the photographer assigned by the school. I could tell that he was professional and experienced. He patiently arranged the students and made sure everyone was included in the picture. It was nice watching how organized everything was. ![2181.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/EoCieQU7AoEoHoMTzRPRtq9S8SoPrsEUc45nXPJaZNYBQRB2qvywRYWksUZ94tdThDT.jpg) ![2179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/EoGyTkq3LsGFbErREyu2hUu8WrKUBkKW7Wq7j6Ut5XtD6EqSkfPXWgDqoHkvZj8gE2D.jpg) Looking at these photos now makes me happy. Another school year has started, and another chapter is waiting for my daughter. Time really flies so fast. It feels like yesterday when she was still very small, and now she is already enjoying school with her friends. I hope she will continue to learn, make good memories, and enjoy every moment of being a student. *Thank you for reading my post* *@usagigallardo015*

昨天我吃完寿司郎后三点多就下去一楼找冰淇淋🍨了，因为在抖音团购的！找了很久没找到，又说在一楼大门口前面，原来是里面啊，就是在一个美食店的隔壁遛弯处！还好给我找到了，哈哈，看到两个女在排队，我也去排队，很快就到我了！而且感觉挺干净卫生的，本来想在古田居吃，但是一份太贵了，而且量没这个大，拿到实物发现挺大份！

还是出来试试这个抖音一直推荐的产品吧，价位还可以，而且产品挺多的！我觉得我选择这个分量挺大了，店员跟我说搞活动，现在加量不加价啦，所以挺划算的！其实上年就是出这个了，但是过来吃太远了哈哈，十几块一个很划算了！

DQ雪山堆堆乐造型很萌，火山熔岩嘉年华是DQ招牌，DQ火山熔岩嘉年华有圣诞特色，DQ雪山堆堆乐口味有特色，雪山堆堆乐是他家招牌，火山熔岩嘉年华是他家特色。所以我必须试试，就算肥都要试试的！

而且我亲眼看到店员做的，采用3d火山造型，外形挺像一座火山的，拍照挺好看的！中间有酸甜的草莓果酱，好像火山熔岩爆发一样缓缓流出来，看到我流口水！外层有黑巧克力脆皮酱，模拟火山熔岩流淌的效果！周围有蛋筒碎和曲奇饼干碎，挺好的，整个白色雪山就是浓郁奶味冰淇淋！

口感就是绵密丝滑的，性价比较高啦哈哈哈！我吃起来觉得像妈妈小时候做给我红豆雪糕！不算很惊艳，但是怀旧吧哈哈哈哈哈！我还是比较喜欢雪花冰，它这个就是冰淇淋加各种酱料和配料的品种！

title: The Lumy Ecosystem Explained: Why Web3 Needs Decentralised Intelligence
body:
The evolution of the internet has always followed a predictable path. We started with the simple transfer of information. We moved to interactive social platforms. Recently, we have entered the era of verifiable digital ownership enabled by blockchain technology. But as the decentralised web matures, a massive void has become apparent. Smart contracts are brilliant for executing predetermined logic, but they cannot think, adapt, and process complex cognitive tasks.

Web3 has successfully decentralised money, art, and data storage. However, the most critical resource of the twenty-first century remains locked inside corporate vaults. That resource is artificial intelligence.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQme2UyMBgMrp3pBZUwBxBFbpeyu69EHDAMiJuTg4BJwZTC/image.png)

Today, we are taking a comprehensive look at an infrastructure project that is actively solving this problem. This deep dive will explore the complete architecture of Lumy AI, the physical contribution of the Lumy node network, and the economic fuel provided by the Lumy token. By the end of this analysis, you will understand exactly why decentralised intelligence is not just a luxury for the blockchain space, but an absolute necessity for its survival and growth.

### The Broken State of Centralised Intelligence
To appreciate the solution, you must first understand the severity of the problem. Currently, artificial intelligence is the most powerful technological force on the planet. Yet, the development and deployment of these intelligent models are entirely controlled by a handful of massive technology monopolies.

These corporations own the gigantic server farms required to train machine learning algorithms. Because they hold a monopoly on the physical hardware, they dictate the rules of engagement. They set exorbitant pricing models that price out independent developers. They throttle computational speeds based on tiered subscription plans. Most alarmingly, they require users to upload sensitive, proprietary data into their centralised black boxes, creating massive privacy and security risks.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQErcsemQLfFvEonTmnEeb83mfXjioHJNbKJkzjpq6KUt/image.png)

This centralised model runs counter to the core ethos of Web3. The decentralised internet was built on the promise of permissionless access, absolute privacy, and community ownership. If the blockchain relies on centralised corporate APIs to access artificial intelligence, the entire concept of decentralisation is fundamentally compromised.

The industry desperately needed a decentralised computing grid that could handle the immense workload of machine learning without sacrificing privacy or relying on corporate monopolies. This is the exact technological gap that the developers behind this new ecosystem stepped in to fill.

### Enter Lumy AI: The Foundation of Decentralised Computation
The core premise of Lumy AI is both elegant and highly disruptive. Instead of building a massive, expensive centralised data centre, the protocol leverages the collective computing power of thousands of independent machines scattered across the globe.

When a decentralised application requires intelligent processing, such as analysing market trends, generating procedural assets for a Web3 game, or automating complex trading strategies, the request is not sent to a corporate cloud provider. Instead, the task is routed directly into the decentralised grid.

The protocol utilises advanced cryptography to fragment the computational task. These fragmented pieces of data are encrypted and distributed across the network. Because the data is split and secured mathematically, no single participant in the network can read or steal the underlying proprietary information. Once the decentralised grid processes the task, the outputs are verified for accuracy and instantly reassembled for the end user.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQsJ3zEHsZda2W6v5iSYUpnDnsZVNzqBbv9YcRH9EFqY/image.png)

This architecture creates a trustless environment for machine learning. Developers can now build intelligent applications that are censorship-resistant, highly secure, and significantly cheaper to operate than traditional alternatives. The barrier to entry for utilising high-level artificial intelligence drops dramatically, opening the floodgates for global innovation.

### The Physical Engine: The Power of the Lumy Node
Software cannot exist without hardware. A decentralised intelligence network requires an army of physical processors to handle the data load. This physical infrastructure is provided entirely by the community through the operation of a lumy node.

A node is simply a piece of lightweight software running on a computer that connects to the broader network grid. When you choose to run this software, you are volunteering your idle processor power and memory to help execute the complex machine learning models requested by network users.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZcYLiFaHrzN6FfAPjSwB2tkeYoJ8j268TfWbn4wFXPJ8/image.png)

Historically, operating blockchain infrastructure was incredibly difficult. It required specialised coding knowledge, expensive mining rigs, and massive electricity overhead. The team recognised that this complexity severely limits network growth. To ensure maximum decentralisation, they engineered their node client to be remarkably accessible. Today, almost anyone with a standard commercial computer and a reliable internet connection can deploy the software and begin contributing to the ecosystem.

The genius of the Lumy node system lies in its incentive structure. The network does not ask people to donate their computing power for free. Node operators are engaged in a highly lucrative digital business. By keeping their hardware online and accurately processing network data, operators generate a consistent stream of passive income.

This creates a self-sustaining physical network. As demand for AI services increases, the potential rewards for processing data grow. This financial incentive attracts more independent node operators to the network, which simultaneously increases the overall computing capacity and security of the grid. It is a perfect architectural feedback loop designed for infinite scaling.

### The Financial Fuel: The Utility of the Lumy Token
Every decentralised network requires an internal economic system to facilitate transactions and reward participants securely. In this ecosystem, that role is filled by the native cryptocurrency. The $LUMY token is the absolute centre of the digital economy, designed with deep utility that drives organic, sustainable demand.

Unlike speculative tokens that rely entirely on social media trends for price appreciation, this asset serves as a required utility mechanism. When developers, gaming studios, or enterprise businesses want to utilise Lumy AI for their computational needs, they must settle those transaction fees using the native Lumy coin. This creates a permanent and growing baseline of buying pressure on the open market.

Simultaneously, the token serves as the reward mechanism for the infrastructure providers. The individuals operating the nodes receive their compensation directly in the native asset. Instead of paying billions of dollars to legacy tech giants, the network automatically redistributes that capital back to the community members who are actually powering the grid.

Furthermore, the token design incorporates a brilliant collateral mechanism. To launch and operate a node, users must hold and lock a specific amount of tokens within a smart contract. This security measure ensures that node operators act honestly, as malicious behaviour would result in the loss of their locked collateral. From an investor's perspective, this dynamic is incredibly powerful. As the network expands and more nodes are brought online, massive amounts of the circulating token supply are locked away. When you combine decreasing liquid supply with increasing commercial demand, you create an economic environment primed for long-term value appreciation.

### Why the Web3 Space Desperately Needs This Now
Timing is everything in the technology sector. The blockchain industry is currently experiencing a massive shift in focus. The initial hype phases of digital collectables and basic decentralised finance have matured. The current cycle is dominated by the demand for decentralised physical infrastructure networks and real-world utility.

Web3 gaming is a perfect example of why this technology is critical right now. Next-generation blockchain games require dynamic, intelligent environments. Non-player characters need to react intelligently to player choices, and in-game economies require sophisticated predictive modelling to remain balanced. Relying on centralised servers to process these gaming mechanics introduces latency and single points of failure. By tapping into a decentralised intelligence grid, gaming developers can build richer, more immersive experiences that remain truly trustless and decentralised from the ground up.

Beyond gaming, the enterprise sector is heavily scrutinising the cost of traditional cloud computing. Businesses are actively seeking ways to reduce their operational overhead while maintaining high data security standards. A decentralised grid offers enterprise clients a way to process massive datasets at a fraction of the traditional cost, without ever handing control of their proprietary data over to a third-party cloud provider.

The ecosystem we are discussing today is perfectly positioned to capture both of these massive demographic shifts. By providing the essential infrastructure required to merge blockchain permanence with machine learning capabilities, the project is cementing itself as a foundational layer for the next decade of digital development.

### Strategic Market Positioning and Future Growth
When evaluating the long-term potential of a digital asset, seasoned SEO and market analysts look for projects that lead a specific narrative. The narrative surrounding decentralised intelligence is currently the strongest macro trend in the entire technology sector.

The Lumy token is not just riding this wave; the underlying protocol is actively building the infrastructure that makes the narrative possible. Because the token is deeply integrated into the operational mechanics of the data processing grid, its market cap and value are directly tethered to the physical growth and commercial adoption of the network.

The development roadmap points toward aggressive expansion. As the core team finalises new strategic partnerships with data providers, enterprise software suites, and cross-chain liquidity hubs, the transactional volume flowing through the network will multiply. For the patient investor or the dedicated node operator, getting involved during the foundational infrastructure phase offers an unparalleled opportunity to capture value before the broader institutional market fully prices the technology.

### How to Get Involved in the Intelligence Revolution
Understanding the theoretical value of a network is only the first step. To truly benefit from this technological shift, you must take action and position yourself within the community. The development team has engineered multiple frictionless pathways for new users to enter the ecosystem securely.

Your educational journey should begin at the official project portal located at https://www.lmos.info. This website is the definitive source of truth for the entire ecosystem. Here you will find the comprehensive technical whitepaper, software downloads, and real-time network statistics.

If you are interested in generating passive income while supporting the network, the website provides highly detailed documentation on how to provision a node. The guides are written clearly, ensuring that even those without a computer science degree can successfully deploy the software and begin contributing computing power today.

To stay ahead of the market and track the rapid evolution of the protocol, you must plug into the official social channels. The cryptocurrency landscape moves at lightning speed, and early access to information is your greatest edge. Follow the core team on X by visiting https://x.com/lumyinfo for immediate updates on ecosystem partnerships and major technical milestones.

For vital security alerts and network upgrade notifications, you should immediately subscribe to the official announcement broadcast at https://t.me/LUMY_Announce. Finally, to truly grasp the scale of the global movement, join the thousands of active members in the primary discussion hub at https://t.me/LUMYCommunity. In this channel, you can network with veteran hardware operators, discuss advanced tokenomics, and get direct technical support from passionate community members.

The internet is evolving, and the future belongs to networks that are intelligent, decentralised, and owned by the community. The architecture provided by Lumy AI represents the next logical step in Web3 infrastructure. By operating a node or securing the native asset today, you are not just making a financial decision. You are taking an active role in building the definitive powerhouse of the decentralised intelligence era.

### LUMY Ecosystem Deep Dive: The Future of Web3 Intelligence

title: The selfish frog (La rana egoísta) [EN/ES]
body:
![portada la rana egoista.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rinconpoetico7/AJpiYvx8oBW43HKdZUodVSgBiGsSmHw3zc9Nam5e6mBHZJkYZpkaMrYeqjnAQ1r.jpg) ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)
English #### The selfish frog

>

In a small pond full of tasty flies lived a frog, green from end to end, bulging eyes and a tongue as long as a rope. 

That frog was very happy in that pond, it was her beloved home, where she had lived all her existence, since he was a little egg floating in the murky water. She grew up, had memories and took over that endearing place. 

The days passed like rays of light, but the frog didn't care about that, she was still in her pond, eating her flies that she caught with her tongue, they were her delicious feast and she had so many that she was full, then she went to her little cave and fell asleep.

Her life was perfect, she could not be more comfortable, but what the frog did not know is that everything that seems perfect, is not perfect forever and life always gives surprises, often unpleasant and that collapse perfect worlds.

It was dawn at the pond, the rays of the morning sun were a pleasant caress on everything they touched. The frog opened her mouth and blinked to moisten her eyes, she began to jump to get to her favorite place to eat her delicious flies, her eyes were fixed on a frog, dark green, who was eating her flies, the flies that belonged to her. This caused the frog to feel an anger flowing from her stomach to her head.

She jumped a few paces to get closer to the dark green frog. I try to calm down and talk calmly with that invader, who had appropriated her own thing.

\
The dark green frog was croaking.\n\n\
The frog was trying to contain her anger.\n\n\
The dark green frog was pointing with one of its paws.\n\n\
The frog was starting to get angry.\n\n\
The frog was making a gesture of disgust.\n\n\
The dark green frog was still eating flies.\n\n\
The frog looked at her strangely.\n\n\
The frog jumped up angrily and wanted to fight with that invader. \

The frog was pushing the dark green frog into the water and then laughing. The dark green frog was disappearing under the water. The selfish frog felt that she had won and cheerfully started eating her flies as if nothing had happened.

At that moment, a blinding light appeared and a fairy was coming out of it. 

\
The fairy was flying around the frog.\n\n\

The fairy was waving her wand. The frog saw this and quickly jumped into the water, but the fairy's magic caught up with her and turned her into stone, leaving her with petrified legs out of the water. That selfish frog remained like a statue in that pond and became a warning symbol for others. The frogs that came to that pond lived in peace and shared the spaces, while the fairy continued to keep watch. ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)
Español #### La rana egoísta

> En un estanque pequeño y lleno de sabrosas moscas vivía una rana, verde de cabo a rabo, ojos saltones y una lengua tan larga como una soga. Aquella rana era muy feliz en aquel estanque, era su hogar querido, donde había vivido toda su existencia, desde que era un pequeño huevo flotando en el agua turbia. Creció, tuvo recuerdos y se adueñó de aquel lugar entrañable. Los días pasaban como rayos de luz, pero a la rana eso no le importaba, ella seguía en su estanque, comiendo sus moscas que atrapaba con su lengua, eran su delicioso banquete y tenía tantas que quedaba repleta, luego se iba hasta su pequeña cueva y se quedaba dormida. Su vida era perfecta, no podía estar más cómoda, pero lo que la rana no sabía es que todo lo que parece perfecto, no lo es para siempre y la vida siempre da sorpresas, muchas veces desagradables y que derrumban mundos perfectos. Amaneció en el estanque, los rayos del sol mañanero eran una caricia agradable en todo lo que tocaban. La rana abrió su boca y parpadeo para humectar sus ojos, empezó a saltar para llegar a su sitio predilecto para comer sus deliciosas moscas, sus ojos se fijaron en una rana, verde oscuro, que estaba comiendo sus moscas, las moscas que le pertenecían. Esto hizo que la rana sintiera una ira que fluía desde su estómago hasta su cabeza. Dio algunos brincos para acercarse a la rana verde oscuro. Trato de serenarse y hablar tranquilamente con aquella invasora, que se había apropiado de lo suyo. «Oye, amiga, te informo que ese es mi lugar». «No veo tu nombre escrito por ningún lado». La rana verde oscuro croaba. «No tiene mi nombre, pero me pertenece porque vivo aquí». La rana trataba de contener su ira. «Hay muchos lugares para comer, mira allá hay uno». La rana verde oscuro apuntaba con una de sus patas. «No quiero otro lugar, quiero mi lugar». La rana empezaba a enojarse. «No sé porque no puedes cambiar de lugar. ¿Qué tiene de especial este?». «Ese es mi lugar y siempre me pongo ahí para comer». La rana hacía un gesto de disgusto. «Creo que al hada de los estanques no le gustará esa actitud egoísta». La rana verde oscuro seguía comiendo moscas. «¿El hada de los estanques?». La rana la miraba extrañada. «Así es, el hada de los estanques es la que cuida porque en los estanques haya paz y buena convivencia entre nosotras». «Estas loca, nunca he escuchado de la hada de los estanques». La rana brincaba furiosa e iba con deseos de pelear con aquella invasora. «Ya me cansé de estupideces. ¡Fuera de mi lugar!». La rana empujaba a la rana verde oscuro al agua y luego de reía. La rana verde oscuro desaparecía debajo del agua. La rana egoísta sentía que había ganado y animosa empezaba a comer sus moscas como si nada hubiera pasado. En ese momento, una luz cegadora apareció y de ella salía una hada. «Rana egoísta, no mereces vivir en este estanque». El hada volaba alrededor de la rana. «Espere, señora hada, este es mi lugar desde que tengo memoria y esa rana invasora quiso adueñarse de él». La rana estaba aterrorizada. «Si tanto te gusta tu lugar, estarás aquí por siempre». El hada movía su varita. La rana vio esto y saltó rápidamente al agua, pero la magia del hada la alcanzó y la convirtió en piedra, quedando con patas petrificadas afuera del agua. Aquella rana egoísta quedó como una estatua en ese estanque y se convirtió en un símbolo de advertencia para las demás. Las ranas que llegaron a ese estanque vivieron en paz y compartían los espacios, mientras el hada seguía vigilando. ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

links.title: Carta 3: Mientras te esperaba
links.body:
Querido Lukas:
Después de descubrir que venías en camino y que ya estabas creciendo dentro de mi vientre, comenzó una de las etapas más especiales de mi vida.
Nunca había vivido algo tan bonito como tenerte dentro de mí.
Cada día despertaba sabiendo que estabas conmigo. Aunque todavía no podía verte, ya formabas parte de cada uno de mis pensamientos. Mi mano siempre descansaba sobre mi barriga antes de dormir, como si quisiera recordarte que yo también estaba allí para ti.
Poco a poco empecé a sentirte.
Sentía tus movimientos, tus latidos y aquellas pequeñas pataditas que casi siempre dabas por el lado izquierdo. Los médicos me recomendaban dormir sobre ese lado para ayudarte a crecer mejor, pero tú parecías tener tus propios planes. Muchas veces terminabas pateando hacia el lado derecho de mi barriga, justo donde dormía tu papá. Yo bromeaba diciendo que querías dormir junto a él desde antes de nacer.
Durante aquellos meses aprendí a imaginarte.
Me preguntaba cómo sería tu carita, tu sonrisa, si tendrías las orejas grandes o pequeñas, si serías rubio o trigueño. Pasaba horas pensando en cómo sería el niño que estaba creciendo dentro de mí.
También hablaba contigo en silencio.
Te cantaba canciones, te contaba mis sueños, mis preocupaciones y mis esperanzas. Nunca supe si realmente podías escucharme, pero me gustaba pensar que sí.
Mientras crecías dentro de mí, también crecía algo nuevo en mi corazón. Estaba aprendiendo a convertirme en mamá, algo que jamás imaginé que sucedería tan pronto.
Tu papá y yo siempre decíamos que tendríamos hijos después de los treinta años, cuando tuviéramos una casa propia y una vida más estable. Sin embargo, la vida tenía otros planes. Yo tenía apenas 24 años y tu papá 26 cuando llegaste para cambiar nuestra historia.
No todo fue fácil.
Hubo días de cansancio, incertidumbre y mucho miedo. También hubo momentos difíciles en los que apenas teníamos qué comer. Me preocupaba no poder alimentarme bien y que eso afectara tu crecimiento. Me preguntaba constantemente si estaba haciendo las cosas correctamente y si sería capaz de darte todo lo que necesitarías cuando nacieras.
Además, cada consulta médica se convertía en una prueba para mi corazón.
Algunas ginecólogas me decían que estabas creciendo con bajo peso y que quizás no te estaba alimentando correctamente. Cada vez que escuchaba esas palabras me sentía culpable. Llegaba a casa llorando y le preguntaba a tu papá si estábamos haciendo algo mal.
Tenía miedo.
Mucho miedo.
Pero también tenía algo más fuerte que el miedo: el amor.
Yo te amaba profundamente, aunque todavía no conocía tu rostro. Me costaba creer que dentro de mí estuviera creciendo el niño que cambiaría mi vida para siempre.
Durante aquellos meses aprendí algo muy importante: los hijos comienzan a enseñarnos mucho antes de nacer.
Recuerdo que te cantaba una canción de Tarzán que decía: \

. Cada vez que la escuchabas, te movías dentro de mi barriga como si quisieras responderme.
Tú me enseñaste paciencia mientras esperaba tu llegada.
Me enseñaste esperanza cuando tenía dudas.
Y me enseñaste que el amor puede crecer cada día, incluso antes de conocer a la persona que lo inspira.
Mientras te esperaba, mi mundo se llenó de ilusiones.
Y aunque todavía faltaba tiempo para conocerte, yo ya sabía una cosa con absoluta certeza:
Te amaba más de lo que las palabras podían explicar.
Con todo mi amor, Te Amo
🤍👣🤍👣🤍👣🤍👣🤍👣🤍👣🤍👣🤍👣
![IMG-20260505-WA0089.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/Eos1kELamsfdYxoWg8zeSGuMy4XiAZ3t5hgMYZQu23mMASnVRGR9RtuFzGfiYuCijLg.jpg)

Quiero tomarme un momento para agradecer de corazón a todas las personas que siempre pasan por mis publicaciones en Hive. Gracias por cada voto, cada comentario y cada palabra bonita que me dejan. Aunque muchas veces no tenga el tiempo o la conexión suficiente para responder como quisiera, sepan que leo todo y valoro muchísimo el cariño y el apoyo que me brindan.
También quiero disculparme por las veces en que desaparezco o no publico con frecuencia. La situación con la conexión aquí en Cuba muchas veces hace todo más complicado, y en ocasiones simplemente no logro mantener la constancia que quisiera. Aun así, siempre trato de regresar y compartir contenido sincero, interesante y hecho desde el corazón.
Hive se ha convertido en un espacio muy especial para mí. Un lugar donde puedo expresarme, compartir mis vivencias y sentirme acompañada por personas increíbles de diferentes partes del mundo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por estar siempre a mi lado, apoyándome incluso en los días más difíciles. Gracias por impulsarme a seguir creando y nunca dejarme rendirme.
También quiero agradecer a mi querida mamá canadiense, @catthyarrow, por tanto cariño, apoyo y amor hacia nuestra familia. Y a su esposo, @bradleyarrow, quien ha sido como un ángel de la guarda para nosotros. Nunca voy a olvidar todo lo que han hecho y siguen haciendo por mí, por mi esposo y por nuestro hijo.
Y por supuesto, muchísimas gracias a toda la comunidad de BBH por hacerme sentir bienvenida, apoyada y motivada a seguir creciendo dentro de esta hermosa plataforma.
Gracias por acompañarme en este camino, por leerme y por estar aquí 💛

links.body:
> **Hoy publiqué el segundo vídeo consecutivo por semana en YouTube para mi canal de jardinería.** Siento que este es un logro digno de celebrar porque no es solo un vídeo, es el esfuerzo de grabar, revisar, editar, exportar, hacer la miniatura, escribir la descripción, pensar en un buen título y subir el vídeo. Me gusta crear contenido, sobre todo hablar a la cámara, pero todo el proceso no es nada sencillo. Y siento que ser constante en ello se me ha puesto cuesta arriba. Tanto que hace un rato le comentaba a mi hermana que cuando intento hacer algo, otra cosa sucede. No sé a qué se deba, pero no me agrada que pase. Así que aquí estoy, trabajando contra viento y marea para mantener la constancia en mi canal de YouTube. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Today I posted my second consecutive weekly video on YouTube for my gardening channel.** > >I feel like this is an achievement worth celebrating because it's not just a video; it's the effort of recording, reviewing, editing, exporting, creating the thumbnail, writing the description, thinking of a good title, and uploading the video. > >I enjoy creating content, especially talking to the camera, but the whole process isn't easy. > >And I feel like being consistent has become a real challenge. So much so that I was telling my sister a little while ago that when I try to do something, something else happens. I don't know why, but I don't like it when it happens. > >So here I am, working against all odds to maintain consistency on my YouTube channel.
![photo_2026-06-16_21-12-52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23wCNkJkazmD8rLsiDR5G6WrpcCq88gRJPGUrrcmm3JFuRaX22cnjxgVJpMAqeKCPcM8P.jpg)

> **Porque esa perseverancia, curiosamente, es como una planta que riegas cada día** *Hoy graba, en una hora edito, mañana reviso todo con calma y subo el vídeo.* A veces no puedo editar el mismo día que grabo porque ambas tareas pueden ser un poco pesadas si las juntas, y más si tienes otras actividades. Por lo que debo organizarme bien para lograrlo. Hasta ahora el sistema que hace años uso funciona; solo tengo que seguirlo llevando a cabo cada día. Ser ordenada para mí ha sido fundamental en el trabajo online; de lo contrario, todo colapsaría y no podría cumplir con nada. En el caso de YouTube, al tratarse de audio e imagen, es más complejo. No es algo que pueda hacer con ruido, ni tampoco con el vecino taladrando todo el día en mi oído, o con alguien vigilando constantemente lo que hago. Han pasado un sinfín de cosas estos meses. Cosas sobre las que no hablo, cosas sobre las que no escribo. Solo trato de resolverlas lo mejor que puedo, aunque debo admitirte que estoy cansada. Así que todo ello se refleja en la perseverancia. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Because that perseverance, curiously, is like a plant you water every day.** > >*I record today, I edit in an hour, tomorrow I review everything calmly and upload the video.* > >Sometimes I can't edit on the same day I record because both tasks can be a bit overwhelming if you combine them, especially if you have other activities. > >So I have to organize myself well to achieve it. So far, the system I've been using for years works; I just have to keep using it every day. > >Being organized has been fundamental for me in online work; otherwise, everything would collapse and I wouldn't be able to accomplish anything. > >In the case of YouTube, since it involves audio and video, it's more complex. It's not something I can do with noise, nor with the neighbor constantly nagging me, or with someone constantly watching what I'm doing. > >A lot has happened these past few months. Things I don't talk about, things I don't write about. > >I'm just trying to solve them as best I can, although I must admit I'm tired. > >So all of that is reflected in perseverance.

> **A veces no es solo perseverancia, sino también mantener el estado de ánimo, ser creativa en mantener esa constancia como una llama viva** Con todo eso me di cuenta de que no puedo seguir postergando mis proyectos. He tenido que poner en pausa muchas cosas. Pero, realmente, ya no es algo que piense hacer nuevamente. Pase por donde pase (como suelen decir), llueva, truene o relampaguee, esa llama deberá estar encendida. Sé que no es fácil. Por ejemplo, hoy son las 8 de la noche, batallé con algunas cosas, pero aquí estoy, invicta, regia. Logré trabajar, y también mantener la constancia en mis proyectos personales. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Sometimes it's not just about perseverance, but also about maintaining a positive attitude, being creative in keeping that flame alive.** > >With all of that, I realized I can't keep putting off my projects. I've had to put many things on hold. But honestly, it's not something I plan to do again. > >Wherever I go (as they say), come rain or shine, that flame must stay lit. > >I know it's not easy. For example, it's 8 PM tonight, I struggled with some things, but here I am, undefeated, strong. I managed to work, and also maintain consistency in my personal projects.
![photo_2026-06-16_21-12-50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/244eAWMY7iwrFHr33kktCWFNMkqiWwnnvFG3jMS3fAh9RrzE2oqZTm8NHrDRgpXJhfqxX.jpg)

> **He hablado anteriormente de obligar al cuerpo, ¡y qué duro es!** Al escribir esa última línea, recordé uno de los videos que hice para YouTube sobre que, para mantener la constancia, hay que obligar al cuerpo. No es sencillo. Por lo que pienso que, si lo he hecho para cumplir a nivel laboral, así mismo debo hacerlo por cada meta que me he trazado. Así como lo he hecho por mis estudios universitarios, puedo hacerlo para otras cosas. No es que no pueda, porque ya se ha comprobado que puedo hacerlo. Quizás ha sido bastante cuesta arriba por las circunstancias; sin embargo, considero que puedo dar un 250%. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**I've talked before about pushing your body, and how hard it is!** > >While writing that last line, I remembered one of the YouTube videos I made about how, to maintain consistency, you have to push your body. > >It's not easy. So I think that if I've done it to succeed at work, I should do the same for every goal I've set for myself. > >Just as I've done it for my university studies, I can do it for other things. > >It's not that I can't, because I've already proven that I can. links.title: Freewrite || A Sunset Full of Lessons
links.body:
![PSX_20260617_081227.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFQY5CjMxbCBazai2B6c2Kud8KK9ZnKR4Tw6EwUKdqMW/PSX_20260617_081227.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
This evening, the sky once again revealed its breathtaking beauty. The sun slowly descended toward the horizon, casting a golden glow across the village. Tall coconut trees stood gracefully against the colorful sky, creating a peaceful scene that felt almost like a painting.

For a moment, I stopped to admire the view. Amid the busyness of daily life, moments like this remind me that peace can often be found in the simplest things. There is no need to travel far to witness beauty because nature presents it to us every day if we take the time to notice.

The clouds stretched across the sky in unique patterns, illuminated by the warm light of the setting sun. A gentle breeze moved through the trees, making the atmosphere even more relaxing. The road that had been busy throughout the day slowly became quieter as people returned home from their activities.

Watching the sunset always encourages me to reflect on life. Every sunset marks the end of a day, reminding us that both our successes and struggles are temporary. No matter what happens today, tomorrow will bring another opportunity to start again with renewed hope and determination.

This beautiful scene also reminds me to be grateful. Being able to enjoy fresh air, witness nature’s wonders, and spend time with loved ones are blessings that are often overlooked. True happiness does not always come from extraordinary achievements. Sometimes, it comes from appreciating the small moments that bring comfort to our hearts.

As darkness gradually replaced the daylight, I left with a sense of calm and gratitude. The sunset had delivered a simple but powerful message: every ending is the beginning of something new. After every night, a new morning will always arrive, carrying fresh hope and endless possibilities.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

links.body:
>



The latest developments in AI and cybersecurity, focusing on how frontier models like Mythos are changing the threat landscape by collapsing patch windows weeks to minutes, and what organizations need to do to adapt.

My latest presentation discusses how Mythos and frontier AI models are reshaping vulnerability discovery and exploitation, the new challenges for patch management and response times, impacts on security operations and incident response, and how cybersecurity must strategically adapt to this new reality!

Takeaways

  • AI models like Mythos are identifying vulnerabilities at an unprecedented scale, potentially discovering over 500,000 in 2025.
  • The window for patching vulnerabilities is collapsing from weeks to minutes, requiring fundamental changes in cybersecurity practices.
  • Organizations must adopt AI tools that attackers are using to proactively identify and fix vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding adversaries and their tactics is crucial for effective defense, similar to military strategies.
  • Security teams need to increase operational cadence and collaborate closely with executive leadership to manage risks.

links.title: Film Review: Spectre (2015)
links.body:
![(source: tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/n1VZsWIi4missUgUXRfCG9HXFKe.jpg)



The James Bond franchise, having endured for more than half a century, has survived through a willingness to adapt to changing circumstances. Its previous instalment, [*Skyfall*](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-skyfall-2012), represented perhaps the most radical departure from Ian Fleming's original formula: a dark, at times intimate drama in which a weary, middle-aged protagonist spent less time battling colourful villains and more wrestling with his own demons. Critics embraced this shift as the series' most significant refreshment to date, and audiences responded in kind. *Spectre*, directed once again by Sam Mendes, attempts to continue along this path, but with noticeably less intensity—and considerably less success.

The film's title alone signals its intentions. Following *Skyfall*'s \

of the series' supporting cast—Naomie Harris as the new Moneypenny, Ben Whishaw as Q, Ralph Fiennes as M—*Spectre* completes the restoration by pitting Bond against his most enduring adversary: the criminal organisation SPECTRE, led by Ernst Stavro Blofeld. The narrative opens promisingly enough in Mexico City, where Bond, acting on unofficial orders from the previous M, infiltrates a Day of the Dead celebration to eliminate a gangster with suspected links to the shadowy organisation. This spectacular pre-credits sequence, featuring an unbroken tracking shot through streets teeming with hundreds of costumed extras, represents the film's high-water mark. Tragically, nothing that follows comes close to matching it.

What follows is a globe-trotting investigation that takes Bond from Rome to the Austrian Alps, where he encounters the dying Mr. White (Jesper Christensen, reprising his role from [*Casino Royale*](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-casino-royale-2006) and [*Quantum of Solace*](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-casino-royale-2008)) and his daughter Madeleine Swann (Léa Seydoux), a physician who becomes both Bond's ally and romantic interest. Along the way, there are moments of genuine excitement: a car chase through Rome's nocturnal streets, and a brutal fight aboard a train that will evoke fond memories of [*From Russia with Love*](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/retro-film-review-from-russia-with-love-1963) and [*The Spy Who Loved Me*](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-the-spy-who-loved-me-1977) for long-time fans.

Yet these highlights are vastly outnumbered by sequences that appear to belong to a film suffering from budgetary constraints or, worse, a shortage of screenwriting inspiration. A disconcerting portion of the action unfolds in derelict, neglected or abandoned structures—ruined buildings that seem to visually articulate what Mendes perhaps dare not state explicitly: that Bond himself has become a relic of a bygone era. Instead, the screenplay—credited to the customary committee of John Logan, Neil Purvis, Robert Wade and Jez Butterworth—opts for a tired commentary on the surveillance state, suggesting that modern espionage has been reduced to data collection and drone strikes. The villains no longer require elaborate doomsday devices; merely hijacking the security infrastructure that states themselves have constructed under the guise of counter-terrorism will suffice.

This contemporary angle might have proven compelling had it not been undermined by one of the most ill-conceived narrative twists in the franchise's history. The \

of Blofeld's identity—spoiled utterly by the film's marketing campaign and Christoph Waltz's prominent billing—lands with all the impact of a damp squib. Worse still is the decision to render Bond's relationship with his arch-nemesis \

a contrivance that feels cheap and unearned. The screenplay's deficiencies extend to its treatment of Madeleine Swann, whom Seydoux portrays with considerable presence but with whom Craig shares not a spark of chemistry. Her character is further sabotaged by clunky dialogue and increasingly desperate narrative choices. Monica Bellucci, meanwhile, appears visibly disinterested in her brief appearance as a grieving widow; her casting served primarily to break the record for the oldest Bond romantic interest, a gimmick that does neither actress nor film any favours.

The sole performer to emerge with credit is Dave Bautista as Mr. Hinx, SPECTRE's chief assassin. The former MMA fighter, who utters not a word throughout the film, proves a physically imposing and genuinely threatening adversary—perhaps the most worthy opponent Bond has faced since Jaws in the 1970s. His presence recalls the franchise at its most inventive, a reminder of what *Spectre* might have been.

Indeed, the film's most effective moments are those that explicitly or implicitly evoke the series' storied past. Bond's interrogation in Blofeld's lair deliberately recalls the laser sequence from [*Goldfinger*](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-goldfinger-1964), and there is undeniable pleasure in these nostalgic callbacks. Yet nostalgia cannot sustain a narrative that runs nearly two and a half hours, particularly when the climactic confrontation—a nocturnal chase through London's streets—proves a complete disappointment, bearing unfortunate similarities to the finale of [the most recent *Mission: Impossible* instalment](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/capsule-film-review-mission-impossible-rogue-nation-2015).

Daniel Craig, so compelling in *Casino Royale* as a raw, vulnerable operative redefining the character for the twenty-first century, appears here tired and unenthusiastic. The \

demands placed upon him by the screenplay—particularly the forced personal connection to Blofeld—sit uneasily with his established interpretation of the character. The film's coda, suggesting a possible conclusion to this chapter of Bond's history, feels less like a satisfying resolution than a tacit admission that the creative team have exhausted their current trajectory.

*Spectre* arrives with a reported budget between $250 and $350 million, making it the most expensive Bond film ever produced. That expenditure is evident in the Mexico City opener and certain set pieces, yet the overall impression is of a franchise uncertain of its direction—caught between the grim realism of the Craig era and the retro appeal of classic Bond, succeeding at neither. Where *Casino Royale* (2006) represented a bold reinvention and *Skyfall* (2012) a respectable if overrated deconstruction, *Spectre* offers only diminishing returns.

Should this prove to be Craig's final outing as 007, it would constitute a decidedly underwhelming conclusion to what remains, on balance, the most interesting period in the character's cinematic history. Yet perhaps that disappointment is itself reason for optimism: if *Spectre* demonstrates anything, it is that the series has painted itself into a corner from which only another radical reinvention can rescue it. Bond will return, as the credits promise; one hopes he brings with him a renewed sense of purpose.


RATING: 5/10 (++)


*(Note: The text in the original Croatian version is available [here](https://draxblog.com/2015/11/26/recenzija-spectre-2015/).)*

<center>🪷 ═══════ ೋღ ❤ ღೋ ═══════ 🪷</center>


¡Hola, querida comunidad!

​Hay días en los que la vida nos recuerda lo frágil que es, pero también nos demuestra la fuerza inmensa del amor y de la unión familiar. Hoy es uno de esos días felices, un día para agradecer y celebrar un verdadero milagro.

​Hace apenas unos pocos días pasamos por un gran susto cuando mi abuelo sufrió un ACV (accidente cerebrovascular). Fueron momentos de mucha preocupación, pero hoy, contra todo pronóstico y con el corazón lleno de gratitud, nos reunimos para celebrar su cumpleaños.

Como ya es una hermosa costumbre en nuestra casa, no podíamos dejar pasar esta fecha sin picarle su tradicional torta. Decidimos juntarnos todos, desde los más pequeños hasta los más adultos, para cobijarlo con nuestro cariño y recordarle lo mucho que lo amamos.

Ver a mis abuelos en la foto es mi parte favorita. Ellos tienen muchísimos años de casados; una vida entera compartida donde han estado firmes en las buenas y en las malas. Hoy, verlos allí sentados, tomados de la mano y superando juntos una batalla más, es el testimonio más hermoso de amor verdadero que puedo pedir.

Hoy no solo soplamos una vela más en el calendario; hoy celebramos el milagro de la vida, la salud que se va recuperando paso a paso y la bendición de tener a nuestra familia unida en los momentos que más importa. ¡Feliz cumpleaños, abuelo! Que Dios te siga llenando de fuerza y salud.

<center>🪷 ═══════ ೋღ ❤ ღೋ ═══════ 🪷</center>

(English Version)

Hello, dear community!

There are days when life reminds us of how fragile it is, but it also shows us the immense strength of love and family unity. Today is one of those happy days, a day to give thanks and celebrate a true miracle.

Just a few days ago, we went through a big scare when my grandfather suffered a stroke. Those were moments of great worry, but today, against all odds and with hearts full of gratitude, we gathered to celebrate his birthday.

As is a beautiful tradition in our home, we couldn't let this date pass without cutting his traditional birthday cake. We decided to get together, from the youngest to the oldest, to shower him with affection and remind him of how much we love him.

Seeing my grandparents in the photo is my favorite part. They have been married for many years; a whole life shared where they have stood firm through thick and thin. Today, seeing them sitting there, holding hands and overcoming one more battle together, is the most beautiful testimony of true love I could ever ask for.

Today we are not just blowing out another candle on the calendar; today we celebrate the miracle of life, the health that is being recovered step by step, and the blessing of having our family united when it matters most. Happy birthday, grandpa! May God continue to fill you with strength and health.
