body.title: Digital Art | Sourlanna, Alien Mercenary 🔫
body.body: \n\n<div class=\

>

Good evening, my dear readers in the #Hive art community. Happy Tuesday to everyone! I hope you’re all doing great and, of course, having a wonderful and productive week. For those of you who don’t know me yet, let me introduce myself: my name is Manuel, and I’d like to welcome you to my art blog—the place where I love to share each and every one of my daily creations. >*Muy buenas noches mis queridos lectores y lectoras de la comunidad artística de #Hive, feliz martes para todos, espero que se encuentren super bien y que, por supuesto estén teniendo una maravillosa y productiva semana, para quienes aún no me conocen pues me presento, mi nombre es Manuel, y les doy la bienvenida a mi blog de arte, el lugar donde me gusta compartir todas y cada una de mis creaciones del día a día.*

![50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJpip2EfNDnc13CBtywBvdfJQpik82NwNqyMJCMQLnMbfcuJUsf5d1E9pU5rHsV.jpg)
This time, I’m here to share a piece I’ve been working on for the past couple of days. In it, I came up with a character—a sort of space mercenary named Sourlanna—who, during her youth, was part of her planet’s militia, but that wasn’t enough for her. Her ambition for money and riches led her to desert and become a cold, ruthless bounty hunter—someone capable of doing whatever it takes and taking out anyone who gets in her way to complete her mission, even eliminating anyone who interferes with her plans: >*En esta oportunidad me encuentro por aquí para traerles una obra en la cual estuve trabajando el ultimo par de días, en ella se me ocurrió crear a una especie de mercenaria espacial llamada (Sourlanna), la cual durante su juventud formo parte de la milicia de su planeta, pero eso no fue suficiente para ella, su ambición por el dinero y las riquezas la llevo a desertar y convertirse en una fría y despiadada caza recompensas, alguien capaz de hacer lo que sea y llevarse a quien sea por el medio para cumplir con su misión, incluso eliminar a todo el que se entrometa en sus planes:* ###
PROCESS / PROCESO
![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFFUP7oGZ6yYeDK8NaSkCDoPyJXabgKCHQLNLECyzdyNk6xhGFadE9HQJBXTW.jpg)
Well, in this case, it occurred to me that the character (Sourlanna) could have a slender, feminine appearance, with a cold, almost emotionless gaze, and I complemented her design by adding a sort of gun or space blaster. With the sketch finished, I moved straight on to the coloring stage. Since this is an alien character, I decided to use bluish tones as a base for the skin. I used an airbrush to build up the volume on the face, really highlighting the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose. >*Bueno, en este caso se me ocurrió que el personaje de (Sourlanna) podría tener una apariencia delgada y femenina, con una mirada fría y casi sin sentimientos, y en este caso complemente su diseño agregándole una especie de pistola o blaster espacial. Con el boceto culminado pase directamente al apartado de coloreado, como se trataría de un personaje alíen se me ocurrió usar tonos azulados para trabajar la piel desde la base, use el aerógrafo para conformar los volúmenes en el rostro, resalte mucho la zona de los pómulos y también el tabique de la nariz.*
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK3dfbuSXBc87kW51EGzAmvKAxBZu8r8qTGJY5kreDVDnKturN4H7gG8fppuZrm.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK3dfbuSJTr4Lkv3rar7mixWgThRrR4NKqnun8SiUz61Dcbb1CW99GGe3EmQEXY.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54t9Sx6ofAY1FLtAJWH9ydQ7jwRLiXV27RaTjT8nHGbkpaZWXAm1Qe1V1HB37.jpg)
As for the eyes, I tried to use fairly intense shades like electric blues and purples; as I mentioned before, my idea for the character was for her to have a cold and somewhat sinister gaze. Then, for the lips, I used slightly more violet shades to contrast a bit with her skin tone. For the hair, I used shades of violet and pink. My idea was to give the character (Sourlanna) long hair pulled back at the nape of her neck into a sort of bun. I used my bristle brush to add fine detail and volume to the hair, as well as to the eyebrows. >*En lo que respecta a la mirada trate de usar tonos bastante intensos como los azules eléctricos y los morados, como les comenté antes mi idea para el personaje era que tuviese una mirada fría y un tanto siniestra; luego para los labios use un poco mas violetas que contrastaran un poco con la piel de la cara. Para el pintado del cabello use violetas y rosados, mi idea qui era crear para el personaje de (Sourlanna) un peinado largo pero recogido detrás de su cabeza con una especie de moño, use mi pincel de cerdas para detallar bien y darle volumen al perlo, así como también a las cejas.*
![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54t9Sx6ofAY1FLtAJWH9ydQ7jwRLiXV27RaTjT8nHGbqEcsYqmwRWQirn6xaB.jpg) ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54uEtSvVexKHZkYemmgHAk8Y6JmorxjioLsNvE1LdPCxXgHNzar1hFZG3Ahxx.jpg) ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK6W7nWB2pKJSGuf6mamPrzV95SihrcnMKHuk5S8oas6Zhk35BaJerjYHEcN16i.jpg)
For the clothing section, I decided to create a somewhat rudimentary style—travel-inspired attire. To achieve this, I used shades like light purple for a shirt, and on the forearms I added blue leather-like straps wrapped lengthwise; using the same shades of blue, I created a scarf around (Sourlanna)’s neck. To design the pistol or blaster, I started with the idea of creating a weapon with a rough metallic texture. I used light blue tones as a base and gradually built up the shades by adding long strokes. Then, using shades of pink and fuchsia, I created a sort of liquid container in the center, which serves as the energy core of her space weapon. >*Para el apartado de la vestimenta se me ocurrió crear una ropa con un estilo un poco rudimentario, ropa como de viajera, para ello use tonos como el morado claro para crear una camisa, y en la zona de los antebrazos cree correas como de cuero azul enroscadas a lo largo; y con los mismos tonos azules cree una pañoleta alrededor del cuello de (Sourlanna). Para la creación de la pistola o blaster partí de la idea de crear un arma con textura metálica rugosa, use como base unos tonos azules claros, y poco a poco fui escalando los tonos agregando trazos largos, luego con tonos rosados y fucsia cree en la parte central una especie de contendor con liquido el cual es el núcleo de energía de su arma espacial.*
![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK6VqRihrA2rhzLJoDcDqJxqMiWSeygLyuD66EnfWyDu8yCdvtPLJE68yzwhf1W.jpg) ![33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK7wLhVYiAFdmch55hpyoRVk5Smu2j2ingTH4iP5C28PhVnYAPgXrTicvXh6vXn.jpg) ![36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJhUmov9bWjf4uHtFvSwZ4i697nxm3QFSyao7LdLDPsWitPTBXVJnvjsCT2C5J7.jpg) ![41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJg3am2KTjYo5v59fnmaNR9LQMUaYvk81pQ5urQmy9Brx1mKRyGmxYJrLWC7xGH.jpg)
###
MATERIALS / MATERIALES
- Sai Paint Tool Program - Huion inspiroy h610 v2 tablet >- *Programa Paint Tool Sai* >- *Tableta Huion inspiroy h610 v2*
![PROCES.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFFUDjGGWVDossa15i3LuhALvw2eDo8sHsEvWXu6SuNCWNhGnAxUQ2dfRBBLp.gif)
Well, guys and girls, that's all for now. I hope you enjoyed following along with my drawing process, and that you loved the final result as much as I did. With nothing more to add, I'll sign off now. Sending you my warmest regards, and we'll meet again in the next post… See you later!😎. >*Bueno chicos y chicas, eso fue todo por esta ocasión, ojalá hayan disfrutado con el proceso de mi dibujo, y que les encantara el resultado final tanto como; sin nada mas que añadir, me despido, les mando un fuerte saludo, y ya nos volveremos a encontrar en un siguiente post…hasta luego!😎.*

body.title: I still find the Slime anime marvellous... —eng/esp
body.body:
https://img.anmosugoi.com/file/media-sugoi/2021/03/gTcNq37X-Tensei-Shitara-Slime-Datta-Ken-wall.jpg [_Source_](https://anmosugoi.com/el-anime-tensei-shitara-slime-datta-ken-s2-anuncia-la-fecha-de-estreno-de-su-segunda-parte/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. ¿Cómo están? ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Espero que muy bien. Particularmente, estos dos últimos días he estado viendo bastante anime; no diverso, sino más bien un maratón del mismo. Lo tuve pausado durante algún tiempo, pero ya decidí seguirlo debido a una imagen interesante que me encontré en Twitter (que así fue también como lo comencé a ver). Si mi memoria no me falla, acá escribí sobre mis primeras impresiones y, pues, como ya he terminado la segunda temporada y ya tengo vistos algunos capítulos de la tercera, qué mejor que actualizar mi opinión diciendo los aspectos que más me gustan y, evidentemente, mis personajes favoritos. Mi género favorito, podría decirse, no es el isekai, pero este lo encontré bastante divertido para pasar el rato, desconectar la mente y vivir una pequeña aventura con los protagonistas de la historia; y vaya que, por el momento, no me ha fallado en lo absoluto. Así que sin más dilación, hablemos un poco de la segunda temporada de That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (o, como a mí me gusta llamarlo: el héroe del slime, jajaja).

Good morning, good afternoon, or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. How are you? How are you finding today? I hope very well. Personally, these last couple of days I have been watching quite a bit of anime; not a diverse selection, but rather a marathon of the same series. I had it on pause for a while, but I decided to continue it because of an interesting image I came across on Twitter (which is also how I started watching it in the first place). If my memory serves me right, I wrote about my first impressions here, and since I have now finished the second season and have watched a few episodes of the third, what better time to update my opinion by mentioning the aspects I like the most and, obviously, my favourite characters. My favourite genre is not really isekai, but I found this one quite fun for killing time, switching off my brain, and going on a small adventure with the protagonists; and so far, it hasn't let me down at all. So, without further ado, let's talk a bit about the second season of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (or, as I like to call it: the slime hero, hahaha).

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/48etFXftiX6eT6Bt5NaJVTksqyv9ZYDq2cH2d9iumdK2dKDPxxpp5VYpSHcmyeRaEH.jpg [_Source_](https://elpalomitron.com/fecha-estreno-y-trailer-segunda-temporada-that-time-i-got-reincarnated-as-a-slime/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

En esta segunda temporada, después de tener un inicio prácticamente pacifista en la primera, se ven indicios de una gran guerra donde, por fin, podremos ver víctimas y las consecuencias de los actos de avaricia de la humanidad. Aunque, como todos sabemos, nuestro querido amigo el Slime es un ser ultra poderoso, al final no habrá repercusión alguna con todo lo que ocurrirá, debido a que incluso podrá revivir a los muertos. ¿Fue inesperado? No. ¿Lloré igualmente por las muertes? Sí. Soy un hombre sencillo; aunque sabía que el Slime ganaría, igual caí ante la vil trampa del sentimentalismo. Este anime podría considerarlo un poco raro, ya que, aunque sepamos que el protagonista siempre va a ganar todos los combates, aún es interesante de ver y se siente un progreso real durante toda la trama, porque se te va presentando más cosas acerca del universo que lo rodea y se vuelve todo más llamativo. Además, se presentan misterios que quieres en serio ver cómo se resuelven. Creo que todo esto está fantásticamente hecho debido al excelente trabajo de world building que se maneja, donde podremos encontrar capítulos enteros llenos de políticas y negociaciones que explican el funcionamiento del mundo que estás viendo, lo que provoca que se sienta bastante real.

In this second season, after a practically pacifist start in the first, we see signs of a great war, where we finally get to see casualties and the consequences of humanity's greedy actions. Although, as we all know, our dear friend the Slime is an ultra-powerful being, in the end there will be no repercussions for everything that happens, because he can even bring the dead back to life. Was it unexpected? No. Did I still cry over the deaths? Yes. I am a simple man; even though I knew the Slime would win, I still fell for the vile trap of sentimentality. I would consider this anime a bit strange, because even though we know the protagonist will always win every fight, it is still interesting to watch, and you feel real progress throughout the plot, as more things about the surrounding universe are revealed and it all becomes more striking. Also, mysteries are introduced that you genuinely want to see resolved. I think all of this is fantastically done due to the excellent world-building, where we can find entire chapters full of politics and negotiations that explain the workings of the world you are watching, which makes it feel quite real in the process.

https://animesolution.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Tensei-Shitara-Slime-Datta-Ken-18_06.57_2019.02.04_13.24.57.jpg [_Source_](https://animesolution.com/2019/02/04/tensei-shitara-slime-datta-ken-t-v-media-review-episode-18/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Considero que la primera parte de la segunda temporada fue más choqueante que la segunda, debido a que se sentía un peligro más pronunciado y, además, los enviados del otro mundo parecían ser unos enemigos a temer. En contraparte, luego tenemos la conspiración de Clayman, que se siente como si fuera nada: un insignificante insecto al que la asistente del Slime fácilmente pudo hacerle frente. Pero bueno, eso no quita el hecho de que tanto Veldora como Milim sean, sin lugar a dudas, de mis personajes favoritos; de lo mejor que hay. Me encanta el diseño y la personalidad de ambos. Creo que mi única queja es que quizás los momentos épicos no duran mucho, no son suficientes para mí, ya que las peleas no suelen durar mucho; pero lo poco que duran consigue tener una buena animación que puede llegar a compensar, aunque no lo suficiente. Al parecer, la tercera temporada trata sobre la iglesia; supondré que habrá el enfrentamiento definitivo entre Hinata y nuestro Slime. Aunque pareciera que van a firmar un acuerdo, seguro que todo se termina torciendo, quién sabe. Seguiré viendo y actualizaré luego de terminar la tercera temporada, que parece iniciar lenta pero seguro que agarra después un buen ritmo. Así que, sin más nada que decir, me despido por el día de hoy.

I consider the first part of the second season to be more shocking than the second, because the danger felt more pronounced, and the envoys from the other world seemed like fearsome enemies. In contrast, we then have Clayman's conspiracy, which feels like nothing – an insignificant insect that the Slime's assistant could easily handle. But anyway, that doesn't take away from the fact that both Veldora and Milim are without a doubt amongst my favourite characters – some of the best out there. I love both their designs and personalities. I think my only complaint is that perhaps the epic moments don't last long enough for me; the fight scenes don't usually last long, but what little they do last manages to have good animation that can make up for it, though not quite enough. Apparently, the third season deals with the church; I suppose there will be the definitive showdown between Hinata and our Slime. Although it looks like they are going to sign an agreement, surely everything will end up going wrong – who knows. I will keep watching and update again after finishing the third season, which seems to start slowly but will surely pick up a good pace afterwards. So, with nothing more to say, I will say goodbye for today.

___

My thoughts on responsible disclosure are not that controversial.  I believe the same principles apply.  In fact, they are more important than ever as the timelines will be accelerated.  
1. Organizations should truly respect and reward ethical vuln researchers, and continuing to improve ways to work together!
2. Vuln researchers should continue to notify organizations of vulnerabilities, with proper proof and documentation
3. It is likely that vuln reporting will transform into vuln+exploit example reporting
4. The timelines for reporting processing, validation, and recognition should tighten as the exposure from attackers is happening sooner
5. The risk of unethical vulnerability researchers/blackhat hackers rises as well.  We must understand they are the catalyst for timeline acceleration.
6. Recognize that the tools the white/blackhat teams use will likely be the same or similar.  This has always been the case (ex. network sniffers, remote access tools, vulnerability scanners, encryption, etc.)
7. Remediation prioritization must be re-evaluated by organizations with consideration of the risks introduced by new AI models.  They must make informed business choices, which will define the prioritization process and ultimate outcomes.
8. Information sharing is crucial for cybersecurity, but it must be done in a proper way so it does not create unintentional risks.  Our adversaries already are very good at information sharing!

body.body:
Excelente cuando nos enseña las estrategias para evaluar nuestros logros, y me encanta que en primer lugar sea dar las gracias por todo lo que logremos y por lo que tengamos, porque a veces creemos que por ser cosas simples no representan nada en nuestra vidas ó no puede ser considerado como un logro porque lo vemos como algo cotidiano...

En mi caso ser agradecida me impulsa a seguir viendo de los pequeños logros algo que en un futuro me ayudará a crear, formar y alcanzar más cosas que puedan ser significativas de acuerdo a esos anhelos que quiero cumplir y que veo aún más complejos, pero sé que dando un paso me ayuda a saber que voy en un proceso continuo y que debo continuar con mucho amor, dedicación y esfuerzo. 

Le cuento que hace aproximadamente un mes llegué a esta plataforma gracias a mi hermana que me dijo que yo también era capaz de estar aquí, ya que me gusta mucho escribir y ella creía y confiaba en que iba a dar lo mejor de mí, sin embargo yo tenía dudas y no quería dar ese paso. Gracias a Dios hoy puedo decir que es un logro para mí haber escuchado sus palabras, principalmente tuve que vencer ese temor y tener más confianza.

Pareciera ser algo simple, pero a veces cuando restamos importancia a lo que Dios ha depositado en nosotros y a lo que hemos aprendido en el transcurso de nuestras vidas, ese miedo de enfrentarnos a lo desconocido puede estar ahí de manera latente y podemos pensar que muchos otros son capaces de lograrlo, menos nosotros...

Es de provecho aprender lo que usted dice que lo que hacemos tenemos que verlo como un proceso que tiene diferentes fases, porque particularmente a mí me enseña que de esa forma tendremos presente que para lograr nuestros objetivos no podemos saltarnos ningún paso y además saber que todo lo trabajamos a nuestro propio ritmo, esforzandonos cada día por lograr lo que queremos. 

Agradecida por este post con enseñanzas que realmente valen la pena poner en práctica y me impulsan a no desmeritar mis logros, aún por más pequeños que sean.

Un gran abrazo, mi respeto para usted, mi apoyo y muchos éxitos. 🙌🫂🙏😊

Siempre es satisfactorio poder leer su contenido y aprender de usted. ♥️

body.title: Top 12 mẫu gối cho người thoát vị đĩa đệm cổ giúp ngủ ngon
body.body:
Thoát vị đĩa đệm cổ là tình trạng phổ biến gây đau nhức, tê bì vùng cổ vai gáy và ảnh hưởng nghiêm trọng đến chất lượng giấc ngủ. Những cơn đau kéo dài khiến người bệnh khó tìm được tư thế nằm thoải mái, thường xuyên tỉnh giấc giữa đêm và cảm thấy mệt mỏi khi thức dậy. Bên cạnh việc điều trị theo chỉ định của bác sĩ, lựa chọn gối phù hợp đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc hỗ trợ cột sống cổ, giảm áp lực lên đĩa đệm và cải thiện giấc ngủ mỗi ngày.

Khi chọn gối cho người thoát vị đĩa đệm cổ, yếu tố đầu tiên cần quan tâm là khả năng nâng đỡ vùng cổ gáy. Một chiếc gối có độ cao phù hợp, thường từ 9 đến 12cm, sẽ giúp duy trì đường cong sinh lý tự nhiên của cột sống cổ, hạn chế tình trạng gập cổ hoặc võng cổ khi ngủ. Ngoài ra, chất liệu gối cũng ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến hiệu quả hỗ trợ. Các dòng gối làm từ memory foam hoặc cao su non được đánh giá cao nhờ khả năng đàn hồi tốt, ôm sát đường cong cổ và phân tán áp lực hiệu quả.

Hiện nay, các loại gối công thái học, gối lượn sóng và gối chỉnh hình đang được nhiều chuyên gia khuyến khích sử dụng cho người mắc các vấn đề về đốt sống cổ. Những thiết kế này giúp giữ đầu, cổ và vai ở vị trí cân bằng, giảm áp lực lên các đốt sống và hạn chế tình trạng đau mỏi sau khi thức dậy.

Trong số những sản phẩm nổi bật trên thị trường, Goodnight Nori 1.0 là mẫu gối foam lượn sóng được nhiều người lựa chọn nhờ khả năng nâng đỡ cổ vai gáy hiệu quả. Chất liệu PU Foam đàn hồi cao giúp giảm áp lực lên vùng cổ và hỗ trợ duy trì tư thế ngủ đúng. Bên cạnh đó, Goodnight Astro sử dụng Memory Foam mật độ cao, mang lại cảm giác êm ái và nâng đỡ toàn diện vùng đầu, cổ và vai.

Ngoài các sản phẩm của Goodnight, người dùng cũng có thể tham khảo nhiều mẫu gối chất lượng khác như Gummi Contour Massage, Aeroflow iCool, Comfy Nami, Gummi Puri, Doona Restful, Doona Memory Foam L’Amore, Liên Á Contour, Aero Memory Foam iComfy Sofy Air hay Kim Cương Siny A. Hầu hết các sản phẩm này đều được thiết kế theo nguyên lý công thái học, kết hợp chất liệu memory foam hoặc cao su thiên nhiên nhằm hỗ trợ tối ưu cho người bị thoát vị đĩa đệm cổ.

Để phát huy tối đa hiệu quả của gối, người bệnh cần sử dụng đúng cách. Phần nâng đỡ của gối nên nằm dưới gáy thay vì kê cả vai lên gối. Đồng thời nên hạn chế nằm sấp vì tư thế này khiến cổ phải xoay lệch trong thời gian dài, làm tăng áp lực lên đĩa đệm. Việc giữ đầu và cổ thẳng hàng khi nằm nghiêng cũng giúp giảm đau và cải thiện tuần hoàn máu tốt hơn.

Một chiếc gối phù hợp không chỉ mang lại cảm giác dễ chịu khi ngủ mà còn góp phần hỗ trợ quá trình phục hồi của người bị thoát vị đĩa đệm cổ. Đầu tư vào một sản phẩm chất lượng với thiết kế công thái học sẽ giúp giảm đau, nâng cao chất lượng giấc ngủ và bảo vệ sức khỏe cột sống cổ lâu dài.

# LIMA STREET DIARIES: THE TREBOL GHOSTS / FANTASMAS DEL TRÉBOL [ENG-ESP]
### Urban Photography / Fotografía Urbana

<center>

![_DSC4559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/48ikacmTSAp9DymGYt73Tw7Kec5V49akjeCB5adfJnmFNZgYPVL2zUWYfYS6Gegq5t.jpg)

**\

*

*“Capturing the rush of the bypass: where time blurs and people become echoes.”*
*“Capturando la prisa del bypass: donde el tiempo se desdibuja y las personas se vuelven ecos.”*

</center>

![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

<div class=\

>

### English

Hello friends of the B&W community and the MonoMad Challenge! Another day, another opportunity to grow. Today, I walked through \

a complex bypass of bridges that connects different districts in Lima. It’s a fascinating place. The sun was going down, giving me that perfect light to play with shutter speeds, framing, and movement.

I’m exhausted after coming back from classes, but I made a commitment to myself and this community to post daily. My main photo is one I've wanted for a long time: the bridge felt like it was going to collapse under the pressure of the crowd, yet there was a woman trying to sell her goods amidst the chaos. I wanted to capture the people as ghosts or blurs, and I think I nailed it. Throughout the series, you’ll see the geometry of the bridges framing life: a boy under a sign, a family trapped between fences, and the exhaustion that eventually makes us fall asleep even while standing on the bus. Enjoy the series!

### Español

¡Hola, amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro y del MonoMad Challenge! Un día más de vida y de aprendizaje. Hoy caminé por \

, un sistema de bypass muy interesante que conecta distritos. Aproveché que el sol bajaba para jugar con velocidades, encuadres y composiciones. Acabo de llegar de clases y estoy exhausto, pero mi compromiso diario con ustedes y conmigo mismo es inquebrantable. La foto principal es una que siempre quise tomar. El puente temblaba, casi como si se fuera a caer, mientras una señora intentaba vender sus cosas en medio de la ráfaga de gente. Quería captar a las personas como fantasmas o ráfagas, y creo que el resultado es exactamente lo que buscaba. En esta serie encontrarán encuadres precisos entre las rejas, personas atrapadas por la arquitectura del puente y ese cansancio colectivo que nos hace dormir hasta parados en el bus. ¡Espero que disfruten estas 8 fotografías! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

body.title: Splinterlands: End Of Season Full Report and Rewards.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUsxi8XfeeNiGsUuURAAVoGHJSkR49yFGfYaskxuCgeh4/1781570932275.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbxpRPX5CxU8DuiwVXJ3cGi5mCbuurnJX3rCASn2ksXiD/1781570932366.jpg)

Good morning, warriors! A new season is here, and I’d like to take this moment to recap my performance from last season. Overall, it was a truly satisfying campaign, marked by tough battles, great rewards, and important lessons learned.


**Splinterlands is no walk in the park,but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building.Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)

Let me start with my glints reward and how I spent them:


At the end of the season,I got a total glints reward of **55,409**,from Modern ranked and Survival battles.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQzE8wo8iNPBZn3ytfKhY5LXa2EV5iPyq2X8bM9A97WA1/1781574988552.jpg)And without any second thought,I got myself three epic cards,for a total of **45,000** glints.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNt9ScR18xzbmNLde6gmJrpspRA2kR5ZLLsA2dDMWUabp/1781575289634.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdbzYzW3dFj35At4vf4Kmx3JDDmzs3DRqqvwvQmiShrX/1781575148416.jpg)

This is the real beauty of the game 😍 — it’s not just about the battles (win or lose). There’s also the rewarding benefits and profit side to it. It’s genuinely play-to-earn! These cards can generate solid $/DEC if I decide to sell or rent them after upgrading them well.And their starts and abilities at full max,are impressive.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXxrEyTksAVxiEnRdqsJyRn6Xy8eVRZuytsi9wkPnr9uU/1781577741262.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYeV9eMYwWzv2RGrk1Ymbkg8AeWKQrJR7wFaY7FvFtdhG/1781577741306.jpg)

I used the remaining glints balance to purchase 5 rare cards from the rarity draw cards.And the cards I got were upgraded immediately.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8U7Z3AHvb75oXqp5deS5DAGZGFqoNtijpLxRUygwUmy/1781580130940.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRAv8xzYYRSb2qJu35Dp556rKrxnth9Ykk9FH4pknZgRW/1781580130982.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmddtajJNxDSPLqoyCZnG4o2EU6KUtDv2zHmMH4UppAkaR/1781580131023.jpg)




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)Moving forward, I also got some copies of Darkguard Hellion from participating in Survival, and I’ve just upgraded them to level 2.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme8PymDnbCDP3eqzfHCEmroFp2J8uxuRPj39gwWFW6jPq/1781577926221.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXPD1YFWogHMBtuXr4pgVUYe8eXhhuvmGHg9rVu8GM3fm/1781578224466.jpg)
From there, I opened all the accumulated Foundation cards I earned playing Frontier ranked using the Magic Well. With ten chests near the end of the season, I received 50 Foundation cards in total.Not to bore you with screenshots,they included a variety of Splinters—rare, epic, and legendary—and even some gold-foil cards. It was an awesome haul.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZtjzrjgCvmh2qBv2pjyuayXWqx7xf4yYB5ogpcmQJQD/1781578490523.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiEmzfNSdvkeSBxNu9HCwRyzDbsamQJLVJCh1fuoE66d/1778919641340.gif)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)



**SPS, MERITS AND GLADIUS CASES**:
I said that the SPS I earn from my brawl fights goes straight to my staked SPS, no matter how small. My guild has been performing really well, shuttling between first and third place. We finished second in the last brawl that just ended. I have an accumulated, staked 75.799 SPS from brawl battle rewards that is yet to be claimed.My Current Staked SPS is 788.937. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNwH91mJk1gzGN2RMLYGQfkyd6xYBxjmjwm6yQbMtx7i/1781580566559.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdwee4qDnz6iJsVgNMcCiZGHdycNNj6c9oQrk2hxC48C3/1781580566613.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc3WKDMmuZevYLQNrx3ZonhxK4uBhTVqX7tRVbgeym7GN/1781580566642.jpg)

My total staked SPS after claiming the accumulated SPS from past brawl is **864.716** SPS.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYxiXfikZiWaALm3B3HeYoA4GpzCZ7xPZCAgtJBHvx2BK/1781590940255.jpg)


**MERITS**:At the moment,I have a total of 4,103 merits in the Guild Store.That would give me two gladius cases.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbX1uPZ66KkWNapWk19wiNmRCY4neffdZvaH5FMSnib9K/1781591084312.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQistF6kBtWq18oXqBm5ckpHgXwoCdCZfrEx4BjbPLz9W/1781591084358.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcY5d8Sw23Bh5wUd7HfddfwDsWH2Eio1C9qBAwT4jRXtp/1781591084396.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)

**OPENING THE GLADIUS CASES**:![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmapP9xRN7FbttREE6QYg4hxecB4aEzLNLC99HerpNqB6g/1781591257436.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4aCUXiDxPCbxEHx9FAJHuHRttautELSFnsmdsgfWvBP/1781591257494.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyNyQqmyCP4EqU2EcLCJ1FtbJdzcQqJefTBfneJQSWtE/1781591310040.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3Fqjxw4GiKWozP89XJmgCgXvGthNtzTUQNFv7yWyeyy/1781591310095.jpg)

Yeah! I got my very first legendary gladiator **SOLA RANIEL**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWw48PLBrQn3ndXSBsbutwJ3bVWAxmRQDVAF24X16C44k/1781591862967.jpg)

This is how it would look like at full max.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVP6vXefyky7o8ToF7mkCmy2Dx22KpwtKEtdLzPoKs3kN/1781591875923.jpg)




The season was very satisfying for me indeed.
I am truly grateful to be part of this wonderful community. Shoutout to everyone who makes #Splinterlands thicks! Please support and upvotes my post, thank you 🙏.

Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

Thank you for reading my post. @zusi78 signing off.
See you in battlefield!

body.title: Starting the Day With Flowers
body.body:
How do you start your day? Some people start with breakfast, some meditate, while others go straight to work. I think everyone has their own way of preparing themselves for whatever the day will bring. For me, I like to start my day by breathing fresh air, walking slowly, and taking photos of flowers. It is a simple routine, but it gives me a calm feeling before the busy part of the day begins. I don’t need anything fancy to feel refreshed. Sometimes, a quiet walk and a few beautiful flowers are already enough. Today, I was able to take these black-and-white photos of flowers during my walk. What I like about flowers is that they always seem to have their own character. Some look soft and graceful, while others look a little rough around the edges, but still beautiful. The first flower caught my attention because of the way it opened widely, almost like it was welcoming the morning. The other flowers were smaller and more subtle, but they also had their own charm. In black and white, the shapes, shadows, and textures become more noticeable. Without color, I feel like the details speak more quietly but also more deeply. Moments like this remind me that the way we begin our day matters. A peaceful start can help us feel lighter, more focused, and more grateful. Even a short walk can change the mood of the whole morning. I’m happy to share these photos with you, and I hope they also remind you to appreciate the simple beauty around you. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000162068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6D87DfjhXNY5JQtx13Va86F7Y3dAjD8qA8i2gQqKedYST1gZia5e4HGvkvZaMBdUN.jpg) ![1000162032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoCfdgmGXBtBkcZQamvaYsBRrci9BVGomAxdCuf8EU15tTRkW6pjCsRu6L4t6uvf1uU.jpg) ![1000161934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoChi8zp9Po1CpjFXDFu5KBgd34UeSe6xxiyyfY582a12RxkdRYyeiRnLdNMrT7NsUP.jpg) ![1000152000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoCfi3nFLzvrUUZiMHtrQMuFBtjjokN64rEX91DNrHy6ygCq1AHR5jDq8oafVoCnLTp.jpg) ![1000128110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoGvS5EEJo4xkZfuX7MwUf1PTLjhDECUFePMNh4gsChBLz64sjddiHYkbpqCRBShzWD.jpg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

*~ Andri Cauldwell*

body.body:
En una oportunidad de mi vida sentí que había perdido el rumbo. Me sentía desconcertado, triste y pensaba que todo lo que me rodeaba no sumaba para bien. Comencé a renegar de mi profesión, de lo que había hecho o logrado, y hasta peleaba con mis creencias. El divorcio me había golpeado duro, y la ausencia de mis hijos, aún más.

Hasta que un día me topé con un hermano de la iglesia y él notó que algo me pasaba.

Le dije que no daba pie con bola, que nada me salía bien, que no le veía sentido a nada.

Su respuesta todavía la escucho.

—Posees el manto del sacerdocio. Eres hijo de ese Padre maravilloso que está en los cielos. No hay nada imposible para ti y cuentas con las herramientas necesarias, que son tu fe, tus conocimientos y habilidades, para lograr tus objetivos, ayudarte y ayudar a otros.

Eso que me dijo aquel amigo, a quien más nunca volví a ver, me marcó.

Pasé veinticuatro horas centrado en cada una de sus palabras. La consecuencia fue que mi respiración se hizo pausada y comencé a analizar, a hacer un inventario de todo lo que había logrado, de cómo lo había conseguido y del aprendizaje obtenido a lo largo de mi vida.

De alguna parte salió una energía poderosa que me hizo levantar el rostro y, como por obra de un milagro, todo comenzó a ordenarse.

Una de las primeras cosas que sucedieron fue que, después de varios meses de haber participado en un taller de autosuficiencia titulado \

, recibí una laptop con las características exactas que deseaba, junto con una multifuncional poderosa, sin haber pagado un centavo.

Las herramientas habían llegado. Con eso podía levantarme y mejorar la situación económica que me tenía con la empalizada en el suelo.

Algunos lo llamarán magia; yo lo llamo milagro. Pero un milagro que se consolidó porque, meses antes, ya tenía la convicción de querer montar un negocio y me había esforzado por capacitarme para ello. 

En resumidas cuentas, aquellas palabras del hermano y la llegada de aquellas herramientas elevaron mi alma.

Las frases que me dijo no se quedaron guardadas en alguna gaveta de los recuerdos; permanecen siempre al frente. Cada vez que aparece una dificultad o una traba, hago ese inventario del que nos hablas en tu publicación —o al menos, el que yo logré descifrar de tu texto— y comienzo a hacerme preguntas:

¿Qué sé ahora que otros no saben?
¿Puedo sumar con eso a mi negocio o a un nuevo emprendimiento?
¿Qué he aprendido que me haga útil para los demás?
¿Qué tengo que para mí parece común, pero que para otros puede ser valioso?

Y allí aparecen las respuestas. Entonces comienzo a ejecutar.

Sí sigo, mi estimado y querido @emiliorios. Voy a terminar escribiendo más de mil palabras.

Hay tanto que contarles a los demás, tanto que enseñar y tanto que dar como ejemplo para que otros sepan que pueden salir adelante, que no todo cabe en un escrito. Hay cosas que solo cobran sentido cuando se llevan a la acción.

No recuerdo si fue en una publicación tuya, pero una vez comenté que, para motivarse y escribir un contenido para Hive, solo hacía falta observar alrededor. Que el bloqueo no es piedra de tranca. Que Dios nos da la herramienta y nosotros solo debemos tomarla y proceder.

Estoy totalmente de acuerdo contigo en que reconocer y medir los propios logros, por pequeños que sean, es la base del crecimiento personal y profesional.

Hay algo que parece insignificante, pero posee un poder enorme: el agradecimiento. Levantarse todos los días dando gracias por lo que se tiene y por lo que vendrá.

Y vivir con pequeños propósitos que, una vez alcanzados y sumados, nos llenarán de satisfacciones sin necesidad de compararnos con nadie.

Como siempre, hermano mío, leerte es una sabrosura maravillosa.

Para allá sale, desde aquí, un camión de abrazos virtuales.

!ALIVE

body.title: If Punishment Works, Why Does Crime Still Exist?
body.body:
If people know the consequences of crime, why do they still commit crimes ? This makes me ask, does punishment truly work? Considering the fact that many people know the punishment that comes with committing these crimes and still commit these crimes daily. If these punishments have effects, then the rates of crime is meant to reduce the fear of consequences of prison, death sentence and many other consequences. The rate of people committing crimes keeps increasing daily because people keep breaking the law. |
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdEoMiJHoUD8yKHEKx5uqgKtwhxxDZwSqEQXFNaCFnzu9/1781656102463.png)
***Image is generated with ChatGPT***| |-------| I still believe punishment still works and there are few people who are still scared of punishment that comes with committing a crime. There are people who do not steal, assault or even have a thought of committing murder and that's because they have a conscience and fear punishments. But then, if people know the punishment that comes with a crime, why do they still commit the crime? Why is crime still a major issue in our society today? It might seem like punishment doesn't work, but it does work to an extent. If there weren't punishments for crime in our society , society would be more dangerous and threatening to us. A society without punishment for crime will only increase the rate of crime in society and cause more chaos in the society. The existence of these punishments and laws is the reason everyone in the world isn't committing crimes. There are people who fear the consequences of crimes. The fear of legal consequences and legal actions has helped in controlling crime. So, yes, punishment still works in our society, it creates a restraint and fear of committing crimes. |
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPRiwPDHBW1iDoDVkQpmWS1KMJXmgz1QcxkcMRNa9aZuZ/1781656131590.png)
***Image is generated with ChatGPT***| |-------| Punishment cannot totally stop crime. Most of the time, people commit crimes and go unpunished too. Many criminals commit crimes without the fear or consciousness of being caught. Many of them aren't even caught. To them, punishment isn't a threat, because they can't be caught to start with. Punishment cannot stop people from committing crimes in our society, it only makes them careful and stay undetectable and careful while committing crimes. Also, most crimes committed come from anger, rage and pain. They are mostly unplanned for and happen so fast. This is why crime can stop. The truth is people commit these crimes without thinking of the consequences of their offense. They only reacted and acted based on their intense/uncontrolled emotions and feelings. In circumstances like anger, rage, jealousy and many other emotional distress, the fear of punishment becomes less effective. Apart from intense emotional , many other factors like difficult life situations and hardship make people commit crimes. When people face poverty, negative addiction and other painful circumstances in life, they are being pushed to commit crimes, not because they don't know the punishment, but because they need to survive or aren't even scared or frightened about punishment due to their circumstances. |
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSYt6kdr3kUPWe8NS7fY7MJSBvNEWeqV1511k4xoCdBXZ/1781656157470.png)
***Image is generated with ChatGPT***| |-------| Punishment alone can't solve the problems of crime in our society. Human behavior is greatly influenced by their emotions, circumstances, opportunities, and choices. Addressing the root cause of a crime is necessary, because crimes are being influenced by many circumstances, not trying to justify crime, but then punishment isn't the only solution. Apart from harsh punishment, there should be other ways to address crimes, like rehabilitation of some offenders, getting to the root cause and offering a solution. There are many other ways to address crimes, rather than punishment, getting to the root cause of a problem and rendering a solution when necessary.Punishment alone cannot eliminate every motive that drives human beings to commit crime in our society.

Price and rewards matter, but user creation and retention tell us whether the chain is replacing attention faster than it loses it. Hive has a lot of strong internal activity, but the long-term question is whether new accounts become recurring users or just one-time signups.

A cohort view would be useful here: accounts created in a month, how many post or vote again after 30 days, and how many are still active after 90 days. That would turn the headline user number into a much stronger health signal.

Hey friends! This is another drawing I made during my TikTok live streams. I have to say that even though I haven't received a single donation, the experience of drawing and interacting with the people who tune in (usually between 4 and 10 viewers) makes it really fun. Except when they get toxic; I just block them and move on, haha.

This time, I drew the statue of a virgin. Leaving a light gray tone as the shadow base and using pure black for the deepest shadows gives the impression that it's made of stone or marble. Also, the cracks in her skin emphasize the feeling that it's a statue caught in mid-prayer. Hope you guys like it!

body.title: Conéctate Contigo más allá de las etiquetas || Connect with Yourself beyond labels✨🌷🧠
body.body:
«¿Estamos entendiendo mejor la salud mental o estamos convirtiendo términos clínicos en etiquetas cotidianas?»
---

>

Como psicóloga, me alegra enormemente que hoy se hable más sobre salud mental que hace algunos años. Temas que antes permanecían ocultos o rodeados de estigmas ahora forman parte de conversaciones cotidianas, publicaciones en redes sociales e incluso reuniones familiares. Cada vez más personas reconocen la importancia de cuidar su bienestar emocional y buscar ayuda cuando la necesitan, y eso es, sin duda, una gran noticia💙

Sin embargo, en medio de esta mayor visibilidad de la psicología, he notado un fenómeno curioso: pareciera que ahora se tiene una <em>\

para casi cualquier comportamiento. Basta con abrir una red social para encontrar diagnósticos, análisis de personalidad o interpretaciones emocionales sobre personas que ni siquiera conocemos; y, lo que llama más la atención, es contenido hecho por individuos que no tienen los conocimientos pertinentes. Y entonces surge una pregunta importante: ¿estamos comprendiendo mejor la salud mental o simplemente estamos aprendiendo nuevas etiquetas para describir aquello que vemos?
«Are we gaining a better understanding of mental health, or are we turning clinical terms into everyday labels?»
As a psychologist, I’m absolutely thrilled that people are talking more about mental health today than they did a few years ago. Topics that used to be hidden or stigmatized are now part of everyday conversations, social media posts, and even family gatherings. More and more people are recognizing the importance of taking care of their emotional well-being and seeking help when they need it, and that’s undoubtedly great news💙 However, amid this increased visibility of psychology, I’ve noticed a curious phenomenon: it seems that there’s now a “psychological explanation” for almost any behavior. All you have to do is open a social media platform to find diagnoses, personality analyses, or emotional interpretations of people we don’t even know—and, what’s most striking, these are made by individuals who lack the relevant knowledge. And so an important question arises: Are we gaining a better understanding of mental health, or are we simply learning new labels to describe what we see?
alt=\

>


---

<div class=\

>
Cuando hablar de salud mental se convierte en algo positivo🩵
 No podemos negar los avances que hemos logrado. Hoy existe más información disponible, más personas acuden a terapia y más familias reconocen la importancia de la salud emocional. Conceptos como ansiedad, autoestima o límites saludables han permitido que muchas personas comprendan experiencias que antes no sabían cómo nombrar. Hace apenas algunos años, hablar de salud mental seguía siendo un tema rodeado de prejuicios. Hoy, afortunadamente, cada vez más personas entienden que pedir ayuda no es una señal de debilidad, sino un acto de cuidado personal💙 Situaciones que antes podían pasar desapercibidas ahora reciben más atención, facilitando que muchas personas accedan a apoyo profesional de manera más temprana. Y las redes sociales han jugado un papel importante en este cambio, dado que han servido para difundir información, compartir experiencias y acercar temas psicológicos a personas que quizás nunca habrían tenido contacto con ellos. Esta mayor apertura ha ayudado a que muchas personas se sientan acompañadas, debido a que descubrir que otros han vivido situaciones similares puede generar alivio y validación. La psicología ha dejado de ser un tema exclusivo de consultorios y universidades para convertirse en una conversación social mucho más accesible.
When Talking About Mental Health Becomes a Positive Thing🩵
 We can’t deny the progress we’ve made. Today, there’s more information available, more people are seeking therapy, and more families recognize the importance of emotional health. Concepts like anxiety, self-esteem, and healthy boundaries have helped many people make sense of experiences they previously didn’t know how to name. Just a few years ago, talking about mental health was still a topic shrouded in stigma. Today, fortunately, more and more people understand that asking for help isn’t a sign of weakness, but an act of self-care💙 Situations that might previously have gone unnoticed now receive more attention, making it easier for many people to access professional support at an earlier stage. And social media has played an important role in this change, as it has served to spread information, share experiences, and bring psychological topics to people who might never have encountered them otherwise. This greater openness has helped many people feel supported, as discovering that others have gone through similar situations can bring relief and validation. Psychology is no longer a topic confined to therapists’ offices and universities; it has become a much more accessible part of everyday conversation.
alt=\
>\n\n<a href=\
>source ---

>
El problema aparece cuando todo parece ser un diagnóstico❌
 Pero una mayor conversación no siempre significa una mayor comprensión. En ocasiones, conceptos psicológicos complejos terminan utilizándose de manera simplificada para explicar cualquier conducta que nos resulta incómoda o difícil de entender. Es frecuente escuchar frases como \
o \

. Aunque algunas de estas situaciones pueden existir realmente, también es cierto que no siempre contamos con la información suficiente para llegar a esas conclusiones. A veces una persona puede actuar de manera egoísta sin tener un trastorno de personalidad. A veces una relación puede ser conflictiva sin que exista manipulación psicológica. Y a veces, simplemente, las personas cometen errores. Parte de este fenómeno ocurre porque los seres humanos buscamos explicaciones para todo. Nos resulta más cómodo colocar una etiqueta que aceptar que la conducta humana es compleja, cambiante y muchas veces difícil de interpretar.
The problem arises when everything seems to be a diagnosis❌
 But more conversation doesn’t always mean greater understanding. Sometimes, complex psychological concepts end up being used in a simplified way to explain any behavior that we find uncomfortable or difficult to understand. It’s common to hear phrases like “that person is a narcissist,” “they must have trauma,” “they’re bipolar,” or “they gaslighted me.” Although some of these situations may actually exist, it’s also true that we don’t always have enough information to reach those conclusions. Sometimes a person may act selfishly without having a personality disorder. Sometimes a relationship can be conflict-ridden without any psychological manipulation. And sometimes, people simply make mistakes. Part of this phenomenon occurs because we humans seek explanations for everything. We find it easier to apply a label than to accept that human behavior is complex, ever-changing, and often difficult to interpret.
alt=\
>\n\n<a href=\
>source ---
>\n\nEn plataformas donde la información debe ser breve, rápida y fácil de consumir, conceptos que requieren años de estudio suelen resumirse en listas de señales o características. Frases como <em>\
o \

pueden resultar llamativas, pero rara vez reflejan la complejidad que existe detrás de una evaluación psicológica. El problema no es que las personas se interesen por estos temas. De hecho, la curiosidad por comprender la salud mental puede ser algo muy positivo. El riesgo aparece cuando comenzamos a utilizar términos clínicos como si fueran explicaciones definitivas, olvidando que cada persona cuenta con factores biopsicosociales únicos y que, detrás de cada diagnóstico, existe un proceso de evaluación, análisis y contextualización que no puede reducirse a unos pocos síntomas observados. Como profesionales de la salud mental, solemos repetir una idea importante: las personas no son diagnósticos. Los diagnósticos son herramientas que ayudan a comprender ciertas dificultades, pero nunca alcanzan a describir por completo la individualidad de una persona.
On platforms where information needs to be brief, quick, and easy to consume, concepts that require years of study are often summarized in lists of signs or characteristics. Phrases like “five signs that your ex is a narcissist” or “how to tell if you have ADHD” may be eye-catching, but they rarely reflect the complexity behind a psychological evaluation. The problem isn’t that people are interested in these topics. In fact, curiosity about mental health can be a very positive thing. The risk arises when we start using clinical terms as if they were definitive explanations, forgetting that each person has unique biopsychosocial factors and that, behind every diagnosis, there is a process of evaluation, analysis, and contextualization that cannot be reduced to a few observed symptoms. As mental health professionals, we often reiterate an important point: people are not diagnoses. Diagnoses are tools that help us understand certain difficulties, but they can never fully describe a person’s individuality.
alt=\
>\n\n<a href=\
>source ---

>
El riesgo de patologizar experiencias humanas🌧️
 Otro aspecto que me preocupa es que, poco a poco, pareciera que algunas experiencias normales de la vida están siendo interpretadas automáticamente como señales de un problema psicológico. En ocasiones olvidamos que sentirnos mal también cumple una función. La tristeza puede ayudarnos a procesar una pérdida. El miedo puede alertarnos ante una situación de riesgo. La frustración puede impulsarnos a desarrollar nuevas habilidades o buscar alternativas. Las emociones, incluso las más incómodas, forman parte de nuestra adaptación al mundo y no son necesariamente señales de que algo esté mal en nosotros. Sin embargo, vivimos en una época donde parece existir cierta incomodidad frente al malestar emocional, como si cualquier emoción desagradable debiera ser eliminada, corregida o explicada mediante un diagnóstico.
The Risk of Pathologizing Human Experiences🌧️
 Another concern I have is that, little by little, it seems that some normal life experiences are being automatically interpreted as signs of a psychological problem. Sometimes we forget that feeling bad also serves a purpose. Sadness can help us process a loss. Fear can alert us to a risky situation. Frustration can drive us to develop new skills or seek alternatives. Emotions—even the most uncomfortable ones—are part of how we adapt to the world and aren’t necessarily signs that something is wrong with us. However, we live in an era where there seems to be a certain discomfort with emotional distress, as if any unpleasant emotion should be eliminated, corrected, or explained through a diagnosis.
alt=\
>\n\n<a href=\
>source ---

> Algo similar ocurre en la infancia. Muchas veces esperamos que los niños regulen sus emociones de manera inmediata o que respondan siempre de forma tranquila y adecuada. Sin embargo, una rabieta ocasional, la dificultad para tolerar la frustración o ciertos miedos evolutivos pueden formar parte del desarrollo. No todo comportamiento desafiante es una señal de un trastorno; en muchas ocasiones, es simplemente un niño aprendiendo a comprender y gestionar sus emociones. Por supuesto, esto no significa minimizar el sufrimiento psicológico ni ignorar señales que requieran atención profesional. Los trastornos mentales existen y merecen ser tomados con seriedad. La diferencia está en reconocer cuándo estamos frente a una condición clínica y cuándo estamos frente a una experiencia humana esperable dentro de determinado contexto. El desafío es encontrar un equilibrio: validar el malestar sin patologizarlo, reconocer el sufrimiento sin convertir cada emoción en un diagnóstico y entender que la salud mental no consiste en sentirnos bien todo el tiempo, sino en desarrollar recursos para afrontar tanto los momentos agradables como los difíciles de la vida💙
Something similar happens in childhood. We often expect children to regulate their emotions immediately or to always respond calmly and appropriately. However, an occasional tantrum, difficulty tolerating frustration, or certain developmental fears can be part of normal development. Not all challenging behavior is a sign of a disorder; in many cases, it is simply a child learning to understand and manage their emotions. Of course, this does not mean downplaying psychological suffering or ignoring signs that require professional attention. Mental disorders exist and deserve to be taken seriously. The difference lies in recognizing when we are dealing with a clinical condition and when we are dealing with an expected human experience within a given context. The challenge is to find a balance: to validate distress without pathologizing it, to acknowledge suffering without turning every emotion into a diagnosis, and to understand that mental health isn’t about feeling good all the time, but about developing the resources to cope with both the pleasant and difficult moments in life💙
alt=\
>\n\n<a href=\
>source ---

>
Más comprensión, menos etiquetas✨
 La popularización de la psicología ha traído beneficios importantes y ha contribuido a que la salud mental ocupe el lugar que merece dentro de la conversación pública. Sin embargo, quizás el reto actual no sea aprender más términos psicológicos, sino aprender a utilizarlos con responsabilidad. Porque detrás de cada conducta, de cada emoción y de cada persona existe una historia que no siempre podemos ver a simple vista. Y aunque los términos pueden ayudarnos a comprender algunas realidades, nunca deberían sustituir la intervención profesional. Tal vez la próxima vez que sintamos la tentación de diagnosticar a alguien en una conversación o en redes sociales, valga la pena hacer una pausa y recordar que comprender a las personas suele ser mucho más complejo —y mucho más humano— que ponerles una etiqueta.
More understanding, fewer labels✨
 The popularization of psychology has brought significant benefits and has helped mental health take its rightful place in the public discourse. However, perhaps the current challenge is not to learn more psychological terms, but to learn how to use them responsibly. Because behind every behavior, every emotion, and every person lies a story that we cannot always see at first glance. And while these terms can help us understand certain realities, they should never replace professional intervention. Perhaps the next time we’re tempted to diagnose someone in a conversation or on social media, it’s worth pausing to remember that understanding people is often much more complex—and much more human—than simply labeling them.

body.title: Comprando cartas de la bruja - Squad Busters [ESP-ENG]
body.body: \n\n<div class=\

> ![brujaa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXtHTzXvSHwGdZN9rTc5kgJgfYiHH6n6JzYDjX94PMaKB/brujaa.jpg) Saludos amigos, comenzamos la semana de la mejor manera con algunas partidas de Squad Busters, donde ya vamos por mitad de mes y por eso es importante seguir activo para poder completar el pase de gemas de todo mes de junio, donde ya tengo los primeros días y me dieron buenas recompensas para mi cuenta. Con esta semana que está correinado las recompensas mejoran, ya que como son los últimos días mejoran, sin embargo, la dificultad sube porque entre día y día nos piden más gemas y para poder lograr se necesita hacer batallas, por eso desde que inicie este juego no he podido completar un pase de gemas por la misma razón. Aun así espero poder dar lo mejor en este y en una de las recompensas me toco un cofre que son raros y por eso también es importante jugar y entrar cada día al juego. >Hello, friends! We’re kicking off the week in the best way possible with a few rounds of Squad Busters. We’re already halfway through the month, so it’s important to stay active to complete the June Gem Pass. I’ve already completed the first few days and earned some great rewards for my account. As the week progresses, the rewards get better—since these are the final days—but the difficulty also increases because they’re asking for more gems each day, and to earn them, you have to play matches. That’s why, ever since I started this game, I haven’t been able to complete a gem pass. Even so, I hope to do my best this time. One of the rewards I got was a rare chest, which is why it’s also important to play and log in to the game every day. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR3nkjxpNhjpZ48DAHEpREhAdTnFcKdUzfRMUYwJ7YYyv/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRirzi1rgrcYgjzmNpKxzVqaeuRJyGr8QcpqNjZhvJt5P/image.png) Las monedas en este juego son muy importantes y cada vez que puedo tratar de ir reuniendo, ya que uno nunca sabe que puede llegar salir en este juego que se pueda comprar, además en la tienda colocan ofertas que valen la pena y por eso salió la opción de poder comprar cartas de la bruja, la cual es un personaje típico épico y conseguir estas cartas no son nada fácil. La compra consistía en 60 cartas de la bruja en nivel bebé con un costo de 13 monedas, la cual es algo elevado, sin embargo, son cartas raras valen eso. Esta es una gran inversión y seguramente me servirá para así poder darle unas pequeñas mejora al personaje y una vez que lo use en las batallas pueda causar más daño y allí es donde voy a recuperar esta inversión. >Coins are very important in this game, and I try to collect them whenever I can, since you never know what might appear in the game that you can buy. Plus, the store has some great deals, which is why they added the option to buy cards featuring the witch—an iconic epic character—and getting these cards is no easy feat. The purchase consisted of 60 baby-level witch cards for 13 coins, which is a bit pricey; however, they’re rare cards, so they’re worth it. This is a great investment and will surely help me make some small upgrades to the character. Once I use her in battles, she’ll be able to deal more damage, and that’s when I’ll recoup this investment. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXpemdtPPNXk7jMcCAfKb1bYEvCKJ54w6MGCLyXe4QmcP/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdmcn51bggULbNF12uooqTnKyjrwiEmu2mVprqkWAWRCh/image.png) Jugué una partida en la modalidad de atrapagemas, donde es unos de mis favoritos, ya que allí se puede conseguir recursos y a la vez poder usar esos personajes que uno va mejorando en los diferentes niveles que uno puede tener. En este caso la partida fue muy distinta, puesto que colocaron algunas piñatas por todo el campo de batalla que uno podía destruir y dentro de las piñatas había gemas y monedas, monedas que era perfectamente para poder desbloquear cofre y que el equipo de uno fuera creciendo, sin duda fue todos una gran partida llena de mucha acción y goles. Los resultados no fueron los mejores, ya que quede en el puesto número 8 y ya estaba a punto de morir, pero el tiempo me salvó y puede terminar la partida. >I played a game in Gem Grab mode, which is one of my favorites, since you can earn resources there while also using the characters you’ve been upgrading across the different levels. In this case, the match was very different, since they placed some piñatas all over the battlefield that you could destroy, and inside the piñatas were gems and coins—coins that were perfect for unlocking chests and growing your team. It was definitely a great match full of action and goals. The results weren’t the best—I ended up in 8th place and was on the verge of being eliminated—but time ran out before I could be eliminated, so I was able to finish the game. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdkKfjqAt7XBcMdKofANnXDgVZ5ujHjix3WHNgxJYaAnF/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWfCeqGnntANtKbzLkyduQPDbKemeKGknKMhJgv3JnPC6/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUBEPGAkQkSM9J9gDP4yiQDfrF8rKWnyXyPPmkMAmpnpE/image.png) Como la semana está comenzando ya se actualizaron las misiones semanales, donde muchas de ellas son por cantidad, la cual tocará dar lo mejor y así poder completarlas donde está eliminar a 90 monstruo, eliminar a 10 jefes y muchas otras que estarán allí durante toda la semana y la idea es poder completarla, antes de que de terminar la semana. Mientras que, por otro lado, está el libro de logro, la cual ya tenemos un gran progreso allí y muchos de esos logros ya están a punto de poder completarse y por eso también nos darán buenas recompensas, por eso estoy seguro de que esta semana podré completar una gran cantidad de esas tareas que nos están pidiendo. >Since the week is just beginning, the weekly quests have already been updated. Many of them are quantity-based, so we’ll have to give it our all to complete them—such as defeating 90 monsters, defeating 10 bosses, and many others that will be available throughout the week. The goal is to complete them before the week ends. Meanwhile, there’s the achievement book, where we’ve already made great progress—many of those achievements are on the verge of being completed and will earn us some great rewards. That’s why I’m confident that this week I’ll be able to complete a large number of the tasks we’ve been asked to do. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYEpheWxzsRzDYh8MCDKREnmubPnwQwqsupqdgthw7ugR/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQkYUr6RYFPSJT4MfK78GWmi9cgS8NASTLZbA9z5QWsbb/image.png) Me gusta mucho este juego y en cada gameplay que les voy compartiendo se puede notar ese progreso que vamos construyendo en este juego, donde cada moneda, cada batalla y cada carta del cualquier personaje suma para así poder ir creciendo y que se pueda notar la diferencia. Por ahora sol queda cumplir con todo y si alguno de la comunidad está jugando este juego me lo deja en los comentarios y así poder realizar una partida en los modos de amigos y ver quien se llevará esa victoria, ojeos y que mi equipo sigue creciendo y cada esta mas fuerte y está listo para cualquier batalla que le toco hacer. >I really like this game, and in every gameplay video I share with you, you can see the progress we’re making in it—where every coin, every battle, and every card from any character adds up so we can keep growing and really make a difference. For now, all that’s left is to complete everything, and if anyone in the community is playing this game, let me know in the comments so we can play a match in Friends mode and see who’ll come out on top. Keep an eye out—my team keeps growing, getting stronger, and is ready for whatever battle comes our way.

body.title: Not everything needs to be corrected...
body.body:
___
___

<center>![1000547338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janitzearratia/Eoke1vJrcphXF9YFuvYzL2DoFedVBcitxV8Yx4eDKYTbh2yDNGn5wgnTxtLgddBj66t.jpg)</center>

___
___


<div class=\

>

\n

>

My failures have taken me to unexpected places, where I have gained great victories. There was a time when I wanted to learn everything from others. I read books. I crossed my internal storms looking for answers outside.And that was good. Because every human being woman or man needs references before entering the forest of himself. But there comes a silent and fierce moment when one gets tired of repeating other people's voices. That's when the true path to unlearning begins, and by doing so we don't forget the old obediences, it's like taking layers off the onion, it's even like stopping talking from inherited phrases and starting to breathe from the truth itself. This learning includes something essential: not all knowledge is healthy and not everything we learn heals us because there is knowledge that adorns the ego but moves away from the spirit. *There are teachings that fill the head and empty the heart*. I've learned to keep quiet more often, to ask for permission to feel what I feel and to look more closely at which part of me constantly needs approval. There's still a scared little girl living there... It will be...? For now I better take off the mask and the costume, that makes me a real person who appreciates the simple, not so much the special, and to sit alone without having to be distracted. >I am my best remedy and when the soul speaks low. I honor my teachers, but I do not live kneeling before any. Maybe eternity starts exactly there when we stop running away from ourselves. Nowadays I observe little tolerance to frustration, anxiety, depression and personality disorders, which go unnoticed by the common eye. We cling to what changes, to what does not belong to us, to what cannot stay, ... and then it hurts us when life does its job: to move, to transform, to close cycles. Then the fruit of attachment comes, which are tears, that is, fear disguised as love, because attachment is not love.To love is to hold with open hands. It is to allow what is, to be, and what is leaving, to leave.And that when we truly let go, what is for us, we find the way back. Sometimes our body is the stage where all our unresolved conflicts are projected. And sometimes, *\

* means saying that there are no opportunities that do not vibrate with our purpose. There are changes that seem small at first... a new mindset, a different decision or just stop settling for the same old thing. But many times our whole life begins to move there. We must force ourselves to find ourselves by ourselves, and not everything has to be amended. Janitze.🌷❣️

>

I wasn't able to watch last week's Broncos game as I had to fly out for work but here's a midweek update on how the Broncos went over the weekend along with the results of all the games they've played so far this year. It's a game to forget and I think it might be time for the coaching staff to shift focus to building for next season; sure, there's still a long way to go but it's a big stretch to think they may make the final eight considering how they're playing. 

- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (0) V's Penrith Panthers (26) - What the fuck.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (32) Vs Paramatta Eels (40) - What the fucking fuck.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (18) V's Melbourne Storm (14) - A solid comeback win.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (26) V's Dolphins (12) - The momentum builds.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (26) V's Gold Coast Titans (12) - A win but worrying injuries.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (31) V's North Queensland Cowboys (35) - Tough game they should have won.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (21) V's Wests Tigers (20) - A one point win - I'll take it.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos Win: (32) V's Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs (12) - A dominant display.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (24) V's Sydney Roosters (38) An epic loss despite such effort.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (4) V's Manly-Warringah Sea Eagles (32) - I'm not fucken happy.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (12) V's New Zealand Warriors (42) - A lack of discipline cost the Broncos.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (26) V's St. George Illawarra Dragons (30) - I don't even know what to say.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (23) V's Gold Coast Titans (28) - A season ending loss? (Possibly)
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (6) V's South Sydney Rabbitohs (48) - I have no words.

**Upcoming game:**

body.title: The Magic of Yemeni Eye Agate: From Raw Stone to Polished Gemstones 👁️✨
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXSBrkiD12eDqUcztHod2QkpKEXA9PPYqd6kQ6QtBdaQ/1781654638577.jpg)

Hello Hive and photography community friends,

​Today, I want to take you on a unique visual journey from inside my workshop here in Yemen, where raw nature meets patience and craftsmanship.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahg19LXjEcsoKuZ2C3Nu1AokKSoKQmUQtZaNe9S9EmQt/1781654835471.jpg)

Yemeni Agate has always been famous for its premium quality, but there is a specific type that never fails to amaze: The Eye Agate. In this post, I wanted to document how these miraculous \

look while still inside their raw, rustic state (as seen in the first photos). The way these concentric circles and layers form naturally over thousands of years is mind-blowing.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRGKyweN2LJtWwXJtRueDLwSRU8qEz1giaQbnHP7mKs9m/1781654927542.jpg)

The real challenge for me as a lapidary artist is knowing exactly where to cut and slice the stone to preserve the perfect center of the \

without ruining it during grinding. After hours of precise cutting, shaping, and water-polishing, I managed to bring out this rare collection of finished gemstones (the last photo). They feature incredible clarity and natural \

, showing single and double eyes in all their natural glory.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZmK28aU4ZN6EsrR8vLGmpkojQnbbMLBVEWgPfJypWfj4/1781655039485.jpg)

In the end, agate is not just a hard rock that we shape in the workshop; it is a mirror reflecting the tales of Yemen's mountains and the creator’s miracles beneath the earth. Each \

in these gemstones seems like a witness to time, gazing back at us and whispering nature's secrets. I leave you with these masterpieces, and I look forward to reading your thoughts and reflections on this divine beauty. Stay safe, and see you in the next post with another story from our ancient heritage.

body.title: A regular Tuesday 🙁😕
body.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![A regular Tuesday 🙁😕](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/21596e85-c2f3-4ae8-9a55-c49b9189bed5.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/vem1jBGSdKW1WD5r5EY2xB) 
 
 Tuesdays are always the same routine for me, no cap. I start lectures by 9am sharp. That first class sets the tone for the whole day. Sometimes it’s boring, sometimes the lecturer is actually teaching, but I just sit there and push through. By the time we’re done with morning classes, my head is already full of notes and gist from classmates. 9am to afternoon feels long, but it moves once you get into it.

Then classes run till 3pm. That’s the real work. Back-to-back lectures, moving from one hall to another, writing, listening, and trying to stay awake after lunch. It’s not the hardest day of the week, but it’s steady. No big breaks, just lectures and small gist in between. I’m always glad when 3pm hits because that means I survived the whole teaching period without dozing off too much 😂

After 3pm I don’t just run home straight. I do a bit of walk around school — buy something small, gist with friends, maybe check notice board or just clear my head before leaving campus. That walk takes time, so by the time I’m done and enter bus, I usually get home around 4pm. Tired but fine. Tuesday ends calm for me, no rush, just school → walk → house → rest.
THANKS FOR VISITING  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/vem1jBGSdKW1WD5r5EY2xB)
