body.title: Ese Fuego interior es el motor de todo |That inner fire is the driving force behind everything
body.body:
![Ese Fuego interior es el motor de todo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xVF8tvGFeEPP2TbyPsKneRcoo7nkZh6sUsV35BkZ8GhB3V4jwVTQfHTP5dprvFBbox9.jpg)


<div class=\

>

En Español

Saludos a todos, amigos de la comunidad de #EmpowerTalent , con el tema que nos traen cada semana, especialmente con nuestra querida @angelica7 , para invitarnos a escribir sobre: \

, en esta oportunidad, el ejercicio será desde cualquier perspectiva que la imaginación les brinde, a continuación  mi participación:

Creo que reconocer que la verdadera fuerza no viene de fuera, sino de esa llama interna que todos llevamos dentro, pero que en realidad pocas personas se atreven a avivar.


<h4>Ese \
es el motor de todo\n\nEse \

es el motor de todo, pues cuando me permito conectar con él, dejo de actuar por inercia y empiezo a actuar por propósito. Entonces descubrir y aceptar el fuego interior como un símbolo de la fuerza que habita en mí ser, es un aspecto muy importante de conocernos a nosotras mismas como personas, es lo que me ayuda a descubrir mí espíritu creativo o emprendedor, con energía, inspiración y genio. Por ejemplo, cuando me permito tener un momento de introspección, con la idea de estar sintiendo que este fuego se enfoca hacia mi crecimiento personal y la autoestima, estaría invirtiendo en los cimientos de mi vida.

Buscar que ese fuego trabaje en mi autoestima

De todas maneras no estaría buscando validar un proyecto hacia afuera, no se trata de ser egoísta, sino reconstruir y fortalecer la relación más importante que tengo: esa conmigo misma. Usar esa energía para mí es un acto de amor propio, de buscar que ese fuego trabaje directamente en mi autoestima, con aceptación incondicional y una defensa inquebrantable de mi propio valor. Cuando el fuego como transformador de la autoestima quema las viejas narrativas, ese \

e inspiración me ayudan a ver con claridad las etiquetas o las críticas, ya sean propias o de los demás, pero que ya no me sirven, porque el fuego las consume para dejar espacio a una versión más libre de mi personalidad. ![Ese Fuego interior es el motor de todo (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23tbkxdEkZu4nXHqUuqec88cKA4oivLQrQyxErmYHxPMCv9vNCWTYDM4JuBuzbpXJzj4e.jpg)

Alimentando la autoconfianza

Cada vez que me dejo guiar por esa energía interna y puedo lograr algo por pequeño que sea, le estoy diciendo a mi mente que soy capaz, que soy fuerte y que puedo confiar en mí. El fuego también es protección que me ayuda a mantener una autoestima sana, a poner límites firmes, esa fuerza interior es la que me da el coraje de decir *\
* a lo que apaga mi luz y *\

* a lo que la aviva.

De todos modos, sé que debo  de buscar la aprobación en el reflejo de los demás para empezar a brillar con luz propia.


En particular, en este proceso de autorreflexión, puedo decir que el mayor cambio que he notado desde que comencé a conectar con esa fuerza interior, es lograr llenar mis días de tranquilidad ante lo que no puedo cambiar, es como un desafío para llenarme de paz mental.


![Ese Fuego interior es el motor de todo (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23zkZksVoZiUFCmgTubyj9VTF6EYyWStE7YLGHCYtHTyzbJxETWJzENkzJmgSNFq72dtK.jpg)


<h4>Lo mejor de haber descubierto ya ese \
\n\nMuchas veces pensamos que tener \

significa estar siempre en pie de guerra, luchando contra todo. Pero la mayor muestra de fuerza y madurez emocional es saber cuándo usar ese fuego para avanzar y cuándo transformarlo en una luz cálida que acepta la realidad tal y como es. El crecimiento personal no es un camino recto, pues habrá días de hoguera intensa y días de brasas tranquilas. Lo mejor de haber descubierto ya ese fuego en nosotros es que ya sabemos que existe. Cuando nos aceptamos a nosotras mismas, llegamos a darnos cuenta de que nuestra fuego está directamente conectado con un poder más grande que nosotras, el de nuestro creador y que al reconocerlo, sabemos que tenemos toda la fuerza que necesitamos para cualquier cosa que suceda. Aunque a veces parezca que disminuye, la chispa está ahí, lista para volver a encenderse en cuanto me dé un momento de cuidado y prenda mi propia llama, donde ese fuego interior sea lo suficientemente fuerte para encender mis sueños, y lo suficientemente sabio para iluminar mí aceptación. Si desean unirse a la iniciativa y al encuentro de Talentos, deben hacer [Click aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-fuego). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeSQM6xDrDb7y7LHKxZju22v1aLmzmqmbCBsbDCKQoTVz13Y2bM2eGiuKHFMjDEsiB.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. Las fotografías en mi galería tomadas de mi teléfono Honor Magic6 y editadas en canva Traducido con www.DeepL.com/Translator (versión gratuita) ![Ese Fuego interior es el motor de todo (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xVF8uv4bJpNYqreah8PSXwV94SNkY2NXpzzKR9TWuJejuVrB5puZWeKnR67HM2hd2QS.jpg)

In English

Greetings to everyone, friends of the #EmpowerTalent community. With the topic you bring us each week – and especially with our dear @angelica7 inviting us to write about: “Fire” – this time, the exercise is to be approached from whatever perspective your imagination takes you. Here is my contribution: I believe that true strength does not come from outside, but from that inner flame we all carry within us – a flame that, in reality, few people dare to fan into life.

That ‘inner fire’ is the driving force behind everything

That ‘inner fire’ is the driving force behind everything, because when I allow myself to connect with it, I stop acting out of habit and start acting with purpose. So discovering and embracing the inner fire as a symbol of the strength that dwells within me is a very important part of getting to know ourselves as people; it is what helps me to discover my creative or entrepreneurial spirit, with energy, inspiration and ingenuity. For example, when I allow myself a moment of self-reflection, with the idea that this fire is focused on my personal growth and self-esteem, I would be investing in the foundations of my life.

Seeking to channel that fire into my self-esteem

In any case, I wouldn’t be seeking validation for a project from the outside world; it’s not about being selfish, but about rebuilding and strengthening the most important relationship I have: the one with myself. For me, using that energy is an act of self-love, of seeking to let that fire work directly on my self-esteem, with unconditional acceptance and an unwavering defence of my own worth. When the fire—as a transformer of self-esteem—burns away the old narratives, that ‘genius’ and inspiration help me to see clearly the labels or criticisms, whether my own or those of others, that no longer serve me, because the fire consumes them to make way for a freer version of my personality. ![Ese Fuego interior es el motor de todo (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23tbkxdEkZu4nXHqUuqec88cKA4oivLQrQyxErmYHxPMCv9vNCWTYDM4JuBuzbpXJzj4e.jpg)

Nurturing self-confidence

Every time I let myself be guided by that inner energy and manage to achieve something, however small, I am telling my mind that I am capable, that I am strong, and that I can trust myself. Fire also offers protection that helps me maintain healthy self-esteem and set firm boundaries; it is that inner strength that gives me the courage to say *‘no’* to what dims my light and *‘yes’* to what kindles it. In any case, I know that I must stop seeking approval in the eyes of others if I am to start shining with my own light. In particular, in this process of self-reflection, I can say that the biggest change I have noticed since I began to connect with that inner strength is being able to fill my days with serenity in the face of what I cannot change; it is like a challenge to fill myself with peace of mind. ![Ese Fuego interior es el motor de todo (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23zkZksVoZiUFCmgTubyj9VTF6EYyWStE7YLGHCYtHTyzbJxETWJzENkzJmgSNFq72dtK.jpg)

The best thing about having already discovered that ‘fire’

We often think that having ‘inner fire’ means always being on the warpath, fighting against everything. But the greatest sign of strength and emotional maturity is knowing when to use that fire to move forward and when to transform it into a warm light that accepts reality just as it is. Personal growth is not a straight path; there will be days of intense flames and days of quiet embers. The best thing about having already discovered that fire within us is that we now know it exists. When we accept ourselves, we come to realize that our inner fire is directly connected to a power greater than ourselves, the power of our Creator. And by recognizing this, we know we have all the strength we need for whatever comes our way. Even though it may sometimes seem to diminish, the spark is there, ready to reignite as soon as I take a moment to nurture myself and ignite my own flame, where that inner fire is strong enough to fuel my dreams and wise enough to illuminate my acceptance. If you wish to join the initiative and the Talents meeting, you should do the following [Click here](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-fuego). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeSQM6xDrDb7y7LHKxZju22v1aLmzmqmbCBsbDCKQoTVz13Y2bM2eGiuKHFMjDEsiB.jpg) The designs and images in canva The pictures in my gallery taken from my Honor Magic6 phone and edited in canva Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version) ![@cautiva30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/48GiSTWr5WSgTvFxKvXP6Ch8otHKnPQ8WjMoVet5AZAgPzubefko1YcEdh7C14ZkAp.jpg)

body.title: Three Songs by Paramore | Music & Natto (Three Tunes Tuesday Edition) [ENG/SPA]
body.body: /></center>\n\n<div class=\
>\n<div class=\

>\n\nHello, fans of great music. Today is Tuesday, so as is customary on my Hive Blog, I’m bringing you a special selection of three songs by a truly beloved Rock band. They’re well-known for their unique sound and blend of genres, not to mention featuring one of the most beloved female singers of an entire generation. Just like

>Evanescence, this was another Rock band with a female lead singer that left a huge mark on my teenage years and early adulthood. The band in question is none other than Paramore, featuring Hayley Williams, Taylor York, Zac Farro, and others. Hailing from Franklin, Tennessee, this band formed in 2004 and has since gained worldwide recognition thanks to its distinctive sound that blends Rock with Punk and Pop. In their early days, they had a heavy sound, even leaning toward Emo, but over the years their sound gradually evolved to become more upbeat, vibrant, and commercial. However, here I’ll talk about just three of their many songs. We're able to share this special section with you thanks to the weekly Music community contest known as \
which is always brought to us by the great @ablaze.

>
Hola, fanáticos de la buena música. Hoy es martes, así que como ya es costumbre en mi Blog de Hive, les traigo una selección especial de tres canciones de una banda de Rock muy entrañable. Una banda muy conocida debido a su sonido y mezcla de géneros tan especial, además de tener a una de las cantantes más queridas de toda una generación. Así como ocurrió con

>Evanescence, esta también fue otra banda de Rock con una cantante femenina que ha marcado gran parte de mi adolescencia y juventud. La susodicha banda es nada más ni nada menos que Paramore, compuesta por Hayley Williams, Taylor York, Zac Farro, entre otros. De Franklin, Tennessee, esta banda se formó en 2004 y desde entonces se ha dado a conocer a nivel mundial gracias a su sonido particular que mezcla el Rock con el Punk y el Pop. A sus inicios tenían un sonido fuerte, incluso tirando a ser Emo, pero con el paso de los años su sonido cambió poco a poco hasta ser ahora más movido, colorido y comercial. Sin embargo, aquí les hablaré de solo tres de sus muchas canciones. Esta sección especial es compartida a ustedes gracias al concurso semanal de la comunidad de Music conocido como \
que siempre nos trae el gran @ablaze.

/>

Misery Business - Paramore

/></center>

https://youtu.be/aCyGvGEtOwc?si=6ZeRO1Ovg3dlMU4h
<center><strong><em></br><s5>Source: <a href=\
>Paramore.\n\n
/>
>\n<div class=\

> Let’s start with one of the most popular and widely listened-to songs in their entire discography—a song that introduced me to Paramore when I was just starting high school and discovering the vast world of Rock music. Taken from their second studio album, Riot! (2007), “Misery Business” is their first single. The song is widely known both for its lyrics and for its Pop-Punk rhythm and sound blended with Alternative Rock. “Misery Business” tells the story of a love triangle in which the singer tries to steal the heart of a man who’s already in a relationship. Yes, the lyrics of this song aren’t at all what I expected, though I’m not saying they’re as inappropriate as other songs I’ve heard in my life. However, the story the Paramore singer tells us here makes us think about something that could happen to anyone. After meeting and falling in love with someone who’s already in a relationship, it’s hard not to think about being with her, and you’re always scheming or waiting for the perfect moment to steal her away so you can “have her right where you want her now.” “Misery Business” also speaks to that feeling of satisfaction you get when you do something like that. As you can hear in the chorus: “Whoa, it was never my intention to brag, to steal it all away from you now; but, God, does it feel so good.” That part of the song makes it clear that, no matter what our intentions may be, when we end up doing something like this—even knowing that someone else might get hurt—that final sensation is indescribable. Who knows what Hayley means by that final line, but since I’ve never experienced anything like that, I don’t know how to relate to the song. I’ll just say that I’m really fascinated by both the rhythm and the melody.

>
Empecemos con una de sus canciones más populares y escuchadas de toda su discografía, una canción con la que llegué a conocer a Paramore cuando apenas iba a secundaria y estaba descubriendo todo este amplio mundo del Rock. Basada en su segundo álbum de estudio titulado Riot! (2007), Misery Business es su primer sencillo. La canción es popularmente conocida tanto por su letra como también por su ritmo y sonido Pop Punk con Rock Alternativo. Misery Business nos habla de un triángulo amoroso donde nuestra cantante busca robarle el corazón a un hombre que ya tiene pareja. Si, la letra de esta canción no es para nada lo que esperaba, aunque no digo que sea tan indecente como otras canciones que he escuchado en mi vida. Sin embargo, la historia que nos cuenta la cantante de Paramore aquí nos pone a pensar en algo que puede llegar a sucederle a cualquiera. Luego de conocer y enamorarte de alguien que ya tiene pareja, es difícil no pensar en estar con ella y siempre maquinas o esperas el momento perfecto para robársela y así “tenerla donde la quieres ahora”. Misery Business también nos habla de esa sensación de satisfacción que uno siente cuando uno hace algo así. Como se puede escuchar en el coro: “Whoa, it was never my intention to brag, to steal it all away from you now; but, God, does it feel so good”. Dicha fracción de la canción nos deja claro que, sin importar las intenciones que tengamos, cuando llegamos a hacer algo como esto, aún sabiendo que alguien más puede salir lastimado; es indescriptible dicha sensación final. Quién sabe a qué se referirá Hayley con esa frase final, pero bueno, como yo nunca he experimentado nada así, no sé cómo empatizar con dicha canción. Solo diré que tanto el ritmo como la melodía que posee la misma me fascina bastante.

/>

The Only Exception - Paramore

/></center>

https://youtu.be/-J7J_IWUhls?si=75M6mc4WuTUk0-cK
<center><strong><em></br><s5>Source: <a href=\
>Paramore.\n\n
/>
>\n<div class=\

> We continue with another great song by Paramore that has left its mark on an entire generation and features lyrics and a story that are both fascinating and moving. “The Only Exception” is the third single from the band’s third studio album, Brand New Eyes (2009). It’s a song very different from anything the band has released since then, with a sound that evolves from a sort of Rock Ballad into the Pop-Rock sound that has come to define them. “The Only Exception” tells the story of a woman—likely the singer herself, Hayley Williams—who, as a child, promised to “never sing of love if it does not exist.” But it seems that one day, as an adult I believe, she met someone who became “the only exception” for her, and so she was able to sing about love, just as she conveys in the chorus. The song also tells us about the life she led in solitude, assuming that everything was fine and that she could live without love. All of this stemmed from a fear of falling in love, since “none of it was ever worth the risk.” We’ve all likely gone through a phase like that in our lives—a time when we believe we don’t need to experience love firsthand to be happy. We believe that simply filling that loneliness with a hobby or some other distraction is more than enough to be happy and live peacefully, without fear of being betrayed or hurt by someone we supposedly love. But in the end, sooner or later, we’ll meet our “only exception” who will change our minds and teach us to “believe again” in love.

>
Seguimos con otra gran canción de Paramore que ha marcado a toda una generación y que posee una letra e historia bastante fascinante y emotiva a su vez. The Only Exception es el tercer sencillo del tercer álbum de estudio de la banda titulado Brand New Eyes (2009). Es una canción muy diferente a todo lo que se ha llegado a escuchar de esta banda desde entonces, con un sonido que pasa de ser una especie de Balada Rock a convertirse poco a poco en ese sonido Pop Rock que tanto la identifica. The Only Exception nos cuenta la historia de una mujer -probablemente sea la propia cantante, Hayley Williams- que desde pequeña prometió “never sing of love if it does not exist”. Pero tal parece que, un día, ya de adulta creo yo, conoció a alguien que se convirtió en “la única excepción” para ella y así pudo cantar sobre el amor, tal y como nos lo transmite en su coro. La canción también nos cuenta sobre la vida que tuvo ella en soledad, asumiendo que todo estaba bien y que podría vivir sin amor. Todo esto por el temor de enamorarse ya que “none of it was ever worth the risk”. Todos podemos haber llegado a vivir una época así en nuestras vidas, una época en la que creemos que no hace falta experimentar el amor en carne propia para así ser felices. Con solo solventar dicha soledad con algún hobby o cualquier otra distracción creemos que es más que suficiente para ser felices y vivir tranquilos, sin temor a ser traicionados o lastimados por alguien a quien, supuestamente, amamos. Pero al final, tarde o temprano llevaremos a conocer a nuestra “única excepción” que nos hará cambiar de parecer y nos enseñará a “creer de nuevo” en el amor.

/>

Ain't It Fun - Paramore

/></center>

https://youtu.be/EFEmTsfFL5A?si=rIaUwogS744WKa9g
<center><strong><em></br><s5>Source: <a href=\
>Paramore.\n\n
/>
>\n<div class=\

> To wrap things up, let’s talk about another Paramore song that really captivated me—one from right around the time their sound was transitioning from Emo/Punk to something more Pop and Alternative. This is possibly my favorite song from their entire discography, not just because of its catchy, energetic, and powerful sound, but also because of its lyrics and their profound meaning. “Ain’t It Fun” is the fourth single from their fourth studio album, titled Paramore (2013). The song explores the irony of independent life as seen through the eyes of our beautiful lead singer. Lines like “you’re not the big fish in the pond no more, you are what they’re feeding on” and “so what are you gonna do, when the world doesn’t orbit around you?” make it clear that Hayley Williams is talking about life and its two sides of the coin. The chorus confirms this with the line: “Ain’t it fun living in the real world?” And it’s true that the real world is nothing like what one might have imagined as a child or teenager, when everything revolved around us. Real life can be hard, painful, cruel, and even unfair on many occasions. The way the song’s lyrics contrast so perfectly with its upbeat rhythm and cheerful sound sends a powerful message of irony. The irony of life—of everything we came to know and learn from a young age, only to end up on the street or, worse, facing reality with nothing but what we have in our hands. But that’s how we grow and mature—not by depending on our mothers, as the song says, but by doing things for ourselves. Only we know how to rebuild our lives, but to do that, we must wake up and see things as they are.

>
Para finalizar, hablemos ahora de otra canción más de Paramore que me fascinó bastante y que justamente es de aquella época en la que su sonido estaba transicionando de ser algo Emo/Punk a algo más Pop y Alternativo. Esta es posiblemente mi canción favorita de toda su discografía, no solo lo digo por el pegajoso, enérgico y poderoso sonido que posee; sino también por su letra y su valioso significado. Ain't It Fun es el cuarto sencillo del cuarto álbum de estudio titulado Paramore (2013). La canción nos habla sobre la ironía de la vida independiente vista por los ojos de nuestra hermosa cantante. Frases como “you're not the big fish in the pond no more, you are what they're feeding on” y “so what are you gonna do, when the world don't orbit around you?”, nos dejan claro que Hayley Williams nos habla de la vida y sus ambas caras de la moneda. Su coro nos confirma esto con la siguiente frase: “Ain’t it fun living in the real world?”. Y es cierto que el mundo real no es para nada como lo que uno se hubiera llegado a imaginar cuando era joven o adolescente y todo giraba a nuestro alrededor. La vida real puede llegar a ser dura, dolorosa, cruel y hasta injusta en muchas ocasiones. La forma en la que la letra de la canción contrasta tan perfectamente con el ritmo tan movido y el sonido tan alegre que posee es un fuerte mensaje de ironía. La ironía de la vida, de todo lo que uno llegó a conocer y aprender desde pequeños para luego terminar en la calle o peor al afrontar la realidad con solo lo que tenemos en nuestras manos. Pero es así como llegamos a crecer y madurar, sin depender de nuestras madres como lo dice la canción, sino haciendo las cosas por nosotros mismos. Solo nosotros sabemos cómo rehacer nuestras vidas, pero para eso debemos despertar y ver las cosas como son.

links.title: Quinta Edición
links.body: Hola amigos de Hive, otra vez por aquí deseándoles una linda semana en los comienzo del verano que llega con nuevas motivaciones para hacer de los días el mejor de la vida.🌾 Está vez les traigo otra de las actividades entre amigos, ya hace 5 años nos reunimos para crear un nuevo proyecto, al que llamamos *Captura Natura* Lo más interesante que fue una convocatoria que salió por facebook. Nadie se conocía, pero todos con deseo de conocer más sobre la naturaleza. Pasamos el curso de 6 meses entre teórico - práctico. Nos fue gustando tanto que ya celebramos la Quinta edición está vez con el Título Arte Natura.

> El título estuvo motivado por qué decidimos ampliarnos a las artes plásticas, además de la fotografía. Hubo una lluvia de obras, de iniciativas y de nombres difíciles como Barbatus, Es un lagarto que tiene barbas, muy extraño porque nunca lo habíamos visto. Así comenzó la jornada del sábado 13 de junio a las 2pm.

> Aquí les presento el equipo de la Galería Mariano Rodríguez de la Villa Panamericana. Un espacio muy acogedor, así como la calidad humana y el amor de sus trabajadores. De Izquierda a Derecha, Magalis la especialista, Roberto el Director, Elsa la organizadora del proyecto y Emma la Curadora. Así comenzó todo.

> Aquí una representación de los artistas, amigos y familiares que nos acompañaron con la inauguración. Cómo les decía combinamos las artes plásticas con la fotografía y ahí estuvo Tania y Flavia dos artistas que nos deleitaron con sus obras hechas con cariño y amor.
> Aquí le pongo las obras de Flavia.

links: > Así transcurrió nuestra tarde de sábados entre buenas personas que compartimos los mismos hobby de la fotografía de naturaleza.
> Aquí les pongo mis fotografías. Espero les gusten y que pronto podamos vernos.

> Hasta aquí mi post, espero les haya gustado. Pero no me puedo ir sin invitarles a que visiten la expo, porque vale la pena ver tanta belleza de personas talentosas. Gracias por llegar hasta aquí Las fotos son de mi autoría hecha con mi infinix. Y el texto también lo redacté. Los espero por los comentarios. Un gran abrazo Mi idioma natal es el español por lo que uso traductor de Google.
English Text here

Hello Hive friends, back again wishing you a wonderful week as summer begins, bringing new motivations to make the most of every day. 🌾 This time I'm sharing another activity we did together. Five years ago, we got together to create a new project called *Captura Natura* (Nature Capture). The most interesting thing was that it was a call for participants posted on Facebook. No one knew about it, but everyone had a desire to learn more about nature. We completed a six-month course combining theory and practice. We enjoyed it so much that we've already celebrated the fifth edition, this time titled *Arte Natura* (Nature Art).

> The title was inspired by our decision to expand into the visual arts, in addition to photography. There was a flood of artworks, initiatives, and challenging names like Barbatus, a lizard with a beard, which was very strange because we had never seen one before. This is how the day began on Saturday, June 13th at 2 pm.

> Here we present the team at the Mariano Rodríguez Gallery in the Pan American Village. A very welcoming space, as well as the human warmth and love of its staff. From left to right: Magalis, the specialist; Roberto, the Director; Elsa, the project organizer; and Emma, ​​the Curator. This is how it all began.

> Here's a glimpse of the artists, friends, and family who joined us for the opening. As we mentioned, we combined visual arts with photography, and Tania and Flavia, two artists, delighted us with their lovingly crafted works.
> Here I put Flavia's works.
> This is how our Saturday afternoon unfolded among good people who share the same hobby of nature photography.
> Here are my photos. I hope you like them and that we can see each other soon.

> That's all for my post, I hope you liked it. But I can't leave without inviting you to visit the expo, because it's worth seeing so much beauty from talented people. Thanks for reading this far. The photos are mine, taken with my Infinix camera. And I'll also write the text. I look forward to your comments. A big hug. My native language is Spanish, so I use Google Translate.

links.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![#NOTYOURREGULAREXIBITIONMATCH1](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/fd44ee55-6d38-4049-963e-00e5a80ddae7.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/nsUs6CH7672QRHzBKH6UPK) 
 
 I just played an exhibition match, but not your regular “pick random teams and play” type. I decided to recreate El Clásico myself — Real Madrid vs Barcelona, full vibe. Set the squads, the kits, even tried to imagine the Bernabéu noise in my head. Match ended 2:0 in favor of Madrid and I was buzzing. Felt like a real win because I played with that El Clásico energy, not just casual button-mashing.

To be honest the match level wasn’t very tough. The AI or whoever I played didn’t give me much fight, so Madrid dominated possession and chances. But I still took it serious. First goal came from a quick counter down the right, cutback and tap in. Second one was a banger from outside the box that just flew in. After the 2:0 I felt like I won something real, even though it was just exhibition. El Clásico hits different no matter the mode.

Tomorrow I’m running the reverse fixture — Barcelona vs Real Madrid. Today Madrid was home and Barca was away, so tomorrow Barca will be home and Madrid away. Want to make it feel like a two-legged tie. Let’s see if Barca can get revenge at Camp Nou or if Madrid will do a double. Either way I’m hyped already. 
THANKS FOR VISITING

links.title: Un porta velitas con cemento 🕯 [Esp/Eng]
links.body:
> ##
Hola amigos, ¡bienvenidos a mi mundo!
  Cómo están ? Yo estoy bien, al fin tengo varios días seguidos sin exámenes, tengo evaluaciones pero son talleres y trabajos y no hay que estudiar, hoy tuve examen de matemática y castellano y creo que salí bien aunque de castellano ni terminamos la profesora se llevó los exámenes y tenemos que terminar el lunes. Bueno como por fin tengo tiempo pude escribir el post para enseñarles un adorno que hice con una mezcla que hizo mi mamá en estos días y es un porta vela para poner en algún lado en mi cuarto 🤣 ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPxz5feBS9tmdBUrDpbZwnY3Cv4nMY5MaGwyicizCm7FX/1781654612487.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Bueno la mezcla que hizo mi mamá está en [este post](https://peakd.com/@rlathulerie/hagamos-una-base-decorativa-para-macetaslets-make-a-decorative-base-for-plant-pots) y es distinta a la de la flor que les enseñé la otra vez porque esta no es dura sino es aguada y la eché en un potecito que ella tiene para meter ponques para vender y hay que esperar para que se seque bien y ya. Todavía no tiene la velita porque me la tienen que comprar que son unas chiquitas que venden en los chinos que vienen como en una cosita de metal o bueno, plateada. ## Necesitan esto 💗 Cemento blanco (3 cucharadas) 💗 1 cucharada Aditivo acrílico o pega blanca 💗 Agua 💗 Colorante rosado 💗 Un poquito de aceite 💗 Un potecito chiquito del tamaño de la vela 💗 Pincel 💗 Algo que pese un poquito y que entre en el potecito chiquito ## Ahora el paso a paso Esta mezcla es parecida a una crema y mi mamá la hizo con cemento blanco y algo que parece como pega que se llama aditivo acrílico pero si no tienen eso también le pueden echar pega de la blanca. Primero se echa el polvo después la pega y se mezcla y después se le pone agua pero de poquito hasta que quede como medio espesa como una mayonesa más o menos. Bueno esa ella la hizo para hacer una bandejita donde poner mi cactus que tengo en el cuarto en la mesita de noche, y de esa a ella le quedó mezcla y yo le dije que si podía hacer un porta velita y otra cosita que hice, que es para poner photocards (cuando termine le enseño la foto para que vean). Bueno ella me dijo que podía usar la mezcla porque ella no lo iba a usar más y me dijo que agarrara un potecito de los de ponque que son unos potecitos plásticos, entonces yo le puse una gotica de aceite y con el pincel se lo regué por toda por toda la parte que tiene rayitas y después le eché la mezcla con una cucharita como de dos dedos de alto nada más. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS3s3eLgwgPsRVGd6AhSqYRBZr4gzaqKwtr6G12Aoiyvz/1781653760924.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZWJN1ThqrBbZXU5mMovchvYDEAsyjy7baDCE2gX15mnM/1781653761445.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Después agarré el potecito chiquito que es de los que mi mamá tenía para darnos las medicinas cuando estábamos más chiquitos y le metí una metra de mi hermano y unas semillas y le eché aceite por la parte de afuera y lo metí en el medio de la mezcla dd cemento pero no hasta abajo sino una parte. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUvqDNBW7B1uayTQzHvHHotrGs6dfWgodjiD3r3Xx2tGq/1781653761691.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNebLXF3RQR8LqHc7cMDjokmN3oMJXHCVKuX5pXe1E7QR/1781654175145.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Después lo dejé en mi cuarto para que se secara y a mí se me olvidó eso y como a los 5 días fue que me acordé y lo fui a ver y ya estaba seco 🤣 Para sacarlo por si acaso no se me cayera yo lo volteé sobre la cama y salió facilito y mi mamá después me la lijó por la parte de arriba y ya así estaba lista ahora hay que comprar la velita. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPb7FQ2bW4CARVY3FSWPan5DAihECAz8zuaZp8xmnpZAy/1781654175243.jpg) me dejó usar lo de los hielos 🤣 y me dio otro potecito de los de medicina y también le puse aceite, eché el yeso y esperé como una hora para que eso se pusiera un poquito espeso y metí el clip y listo pintarlas ni nada. Gracias por leer mi post. Chaoooo ❤❤💕💕
![PicsArt_11-23-08.48.18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/EpJZ9gWSo3WTMQUHBrJxzUKwRzwVXPPH5zrUqDQBD4QcbxmNnPVJQbY8oPJSqWS8oeN.png)
##
Hello friends, welcome to my world!
How are you all? I’m fine. I’ve finally got a few days in a row without exams. I’ve got assessments, but they’re workshops and assignments, so I don’t need to study. Today I had maths and Spanish exams, and I think I did well, although we didn’t even finish the Spanish one – the teacher took the papers away and we have to finish it on Monday. Well, as I’ve finally got some time, I’ve managed to write this post to show you a decoration I made using a mixture my mum put together the other day – it’s a candle holder to put somewhere in my room 🤣 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Anyway, the mixture my mum made is in [this post](https://peakd.com/@ rlathulerie/hagamos-una-base-decorativa-para-macetaslets-make-a-decorative-base-for-plant-pots) and it’s different from the one with the flower I showed you last time because this one isn’t hard – it’s runny – and I poured it into a little pot she has for putting cakes in to sell, and now I just have to wait for it to dry properly and that’s it. It doesn’t have the little candle on it yet because I still need to buy one – they’re the tiny ones sold in Chinese shops that come in a little metal or, well, silver-coloured holder. ## You’ll need this 💗 White cement (3 tablespoons) 💗 1 tablespoon acrylic additive or white glue 💗 Water 💗 Pink food colouring 💗 A little bit of oil 💗 A tiny little pot the size of the candle 💗 Paintbrush 💗 Something that weighs a little and fits inside the tiny little pot ## Now, the step-by-step guide This mixture is similar to a cream, and my mum made it with white cement and something that looks like glue called acrylic additive, but if you don’t have that, you can also use white glue. First, add the powder, then the glue, and mix it together. Then add water, a little at a time, until it’s about as thick as mayonnaise, more or less. Well, she made that to create a little tray to hold my cactus, which I have in my bedroom on the bedside table, and she had some mixture left over, so I asked her if I could make a candle holder and another little thing I made, which is for holding photocards (I’ll show you a photo when I’ve finished so you can see). Well, she told me I could use the mixture as she wasn’t going to need it any more, and she told me to grab one of those little plastic cake tins. So I added a drop of oil and, using a brush, spread it all over the part with the little lines, and then I poured the mixture in with a teaspoon – just about two fingers’ high. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS3s3eLgwgPsRVGd6AhSqYRBZr4gzaqKwtr6G12Aoiyvz/1781653760924.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZQtKGyjG3NoiF4JdcdaWUrKS85KRw6P2p1xAgXrYHWfb/1781653761327.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZWJN1ThqrBbZXU5mMovchvYDEAsyjy7baDCE2gX15mnM/1781653761445.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5ZwSDmiLuMuch2X7zRgZwtKDjJWpviZJagNNgZ1yo59/1781653761565.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Then I took the little pot – the sort my mum used to have for giving us medicine when we were little – and put a bit of my brother’s hair and some seeds in it, poured oil over the outside, and placed it in the middle of the cement mixture, but not all the way to the bottom, just part of the way. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUvqDNBW7B1uayTQzHvHHotrGs6dfWgodjiD3r3Xx2tGq/1781653761691.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNebLXF3RQR8LqHc7cMDjokmN3oMJXHCVKuX5pXe1E7QR/1781654175145.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Then I left it in my room to dry, but I completely forgot about it. It was only about five days later that I remembered and went to check on it – and it was already dry 🤣 To take it out – just in case it fell over – I turned it upside down on the bed and it came out easily. My mum then sanded the top for me, and that was it – it was ready. Now I just need to buy the little candle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWRdsHCKBpohXiUEeUcarVvJpvFeWT9zoSESxKQJ7U6Wo/1781654175354.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPb7FQ2bW4CARVY3FSWPan5DAihECAz8zuaZp8xmnpZAy/1781654175243.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Well, the other thing I told you I made was a holder for photocards that I saw on Pinterest: you pour cement into one of the ice cube trays and then put a paperclip in it, but my mum wouldn’t let me use the ice cube tray 🤣 so she gave me another little medicine bottle and I added some oil to it, poured in the plaster and waited about an hour for it to thicken a bit, then I put the paperclip in and that was it – and I remembered that too when I remembered the other thing 🤣 ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb6jc6QheBfzLVzakFop5Bqt7TKkhK2wvHiCBhbVgJ9aU/1781654175478.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Well, that’s all, folks. I hope you like these two things – they’re really easy to make and you don’t even need to paint them or anything. Thanks for reading my post. Bye for now ❤❤💕💕
![PicsArt_11-23-08.37.42.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/23zkpiQrPG4B2ZfFRgwU1v1td2GybzN5DFW2NVYSaDaUXJ5hwJKdnGAiYyGGw82s144rx.png)

links.title: Classic Game: Louis Paulsen vs Paul Morphy, 1857
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdhihW7EYnpAQNc2SZzLoeJmXLhgvaVTmG9fTC2YBh4B5/image.png)
source: chessbase.com

Paul Morphy was an American chess player who is considered as the strongest chess player in the world during the late 1850s. Many historians consider him the unofficial world champion of his era although there was no world championships at that time.

In 1858, Morphy traveled to Europe and defeated many of the continent's best players, including [Adolf Anderssen](https://peakd.com/hive-157286/@iamchessguy/adolf-anderssen-legendary-chess-player), who was regarded as Europe's strongest player at the time. His dominant results convinced many that he was the best player of that era.

***Louis Paulsen vs Paul Morphy***

The most famous game between Paul Morphy and Louis Paulsen was played during the final match of the First American Chess Congress in New York in 1857. It was famous because it showcased Morphy's style: rapid development, control of the center and a stunning tactical finish.

The game started with 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bb5 Bc5 5. O-O O-O 6. Nxe5 Re8 7. Nxc6 dxc6 8. Bc4 b5 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPynhHhUbrq62i5TgMGWmwtyy7QNpxUxmRBexMmu3KVF9/image.png)

Right at the opening, Morphy already has the advantage in space. 9. Be2 Nxe4 10. Nxe4 Rxe4 11. Bf3 Re6 12. c3 Qd3 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTGY4ZTNw7XEFJEDyd85ewFmb3oATagBvrNjrmbMDKZ1z/image.png)

White's position is already cramped. Most of his pieces are still undeveloped. 13. b4 Bb6 14. a4 bxa4 15. Qxa4 Bd7 16. Ra2 Rae8 17. Qa6

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfWCGYNBT1EtvyM32zEduJa1QEZaTtFrvbdURpoBv8nyc/image.png)


White offers a queen trade. It's a sound strategy when your opponent has a lead in development. But Morphy has other plans. 17. ...Qxf3! 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekiHFKMZhVgbEujjcx86BvvFUdYuAJxt3Er5PSmQYf4Y/image.png)



A queen sacrifice that opens up White's position. The remaining Black pieces are enough to mate the White King. 18. gxf3 Rg6+ 19. Kh1 Bh3 20. Rd1 Bg2+ 21. Kg1 Bxf3+ 22. Kf1 Bg2+ 23. Kg1 Bh3+ 24. Kh1 Bxf2 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVP1Hv5eLtX2kM9fEhtSYGHGL3h6Hp2F4ZUFcZfC45Lh/image.png)

Morphy made a mistake and lost the forced mate. He was still winning though inspite of the opponent's lead in material. 25. Qf1 Bxf1 26. Rxf1 Re2 27. Ra1 Rh6 28. d4 Be3 0-1

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhgmuGSWAh9Z2exhg6ds9JhsYoPjTr1TqoyEbjUhLEBi/image.png)

Game link: https://lichess.org/study/khc4h368/XY5d9wsR

An exciting game showcasing Morphy's style at his best.

links.title: Celebrating My Mother's Birthday...!   🎂 🎉 || Family Gathering
links.body:
>

*Uno de los mejores motivos para reunirse la familia es sin duda los cumpleaños, ocasiones que definitivamente hay que celebrar y brindar por esa persona especial, que como bien decía mi abuela nunca debe pasar por debajo de la mesa; por lo que en mi familia siempre hemos procurado celebrar en ese día especial con los más allegados y cantar el cumpleaños feliz, por lo que hoy les comparto lo que fue el cumpleaños de mi querida madre luz maría, quien arribo a un añito más gracias a dios con salud y mucha alegría al lado de sus hijas y nietos.* *Les cuento que mi madre es un tanto dulcera, a ella le encantan las tortas frías de chocolate, al igual que las fresas, así que decidimos mandarle hacer una torta con esos sabores para sorprenderla en casita esa noche cuando llegamos de pasear del centro comercial traki, que fue una salida anterior a almorzar que tuvimos previamente.* *En fin, esa noche nos reunimos junto con mi prima, su esposo y las sobrinas para agasajar a mi mamá, que siempre está pendiente de los cumpleaños y nos acompaña en cada uno de ellos, a pesar de la lluvia de todo el día y la interrupción del servicio eléctrico, nos reunimos en familia brindando con algunos pasapalos y unos refrescos logrando ponernos al día de tantas cosas que a veces el trabajo y el día a día nos distancia y no nos podemos ver con tanta frecuencia, igual el cariño es el mismo.* *Mi mamá estaba feliz y muy contenta que estuviéramos a su lado y le encanto la torta que se le pico ese día, que como les dije era de chocolate, arequipe, y fresas; que probamos justo después de mi madre pedir sus acostumbrados deseos de cumpleaños, que desde ahora le deseo se cumplan todos y deseándole muchos añitos de vida que la pueda pasar a nuestro lado con bienestar y felicidad.* *Antes de despedirme les aconsejo que si tienen la fortuna de tener a su madre a su lado, aprovechen el momento para decirle cuanto la aman, denle muchos besos y abrazos y sobre todo dedíquenle atención y tiempo, ya que la familia siempre debe estar de primero, en cualquier circunstancia, hasta una nueva oportunidad.* ****

>

***One of the best reasons to get together as a family is undoubtedly birthdays, occasions that definitely need to be celebrated and toasted to that special person, who, as my grandmother said, should never go under the table; So in my family we have always tried to celebrate that special day with those closest to us and sing happy birthday, so today I share with you what was the birthday of my dear mother Luz María, who arrived to another year, thank God, with health and a lot of joy alongside her daughters and grandchildren.*** ***I tell you that my mother is a bit of a sweet tooth, she loves cold chocolate cakes, as well as strawberries, so we decided to have her make a cake with those flavors to surprise her at home that night when we arrived from walking to the Traki shopping center, which was a previous outing to lunch that we had previously.*** ***Anyway, that night we met together with my cousin, her husband and the nieces to entertain my mother, who is always aware of birthdays and accompanies us on each one of them, despite the rain all day and the interruption of the electrical service, we met as a family toasting with some party favors and some soft drinks, managing to catch up on so many things that sometimes work and day-to-day life distance us and we cannot see each other as often, but the affection is the same.*** ***My mother was happy and very happy that we were by her side and she loved the cake she had that day, which as I told you was made of chocolate, arequipe, and strawberries; that we tried just after my mother made her usual birthday wishes, which from now on I wish her all come true and wishing her many years of life that she can spend at our side with well-being and happiness.*** ***Before saying goodbye, I advise you that if you are fortunate enough to have your mother by your side, take advantage of the moment to tell her how much you love her, give her many kisses and hugs and, above all, dedicate your attention and time to her, since the family should always come first, in any circumstance, until a new opportunity.*** ***

>

links.title: Hot Bath
links.body:
It rained for most of today, so when I went into the bathroom this evening to take a bath, I decided to do something I rarely do; I decided to heat the water up to have a nice hot bath. And trust me when I say it was enjoyable because it felt wonderful, which made me remember the last time I had taken a cold bath that almost took my life.

![1001155951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23sdpGymg2W9nTyn47LvSHZ8SKFGqEFpafMjCzyyXAWj91T2yP98uGXac2qsiJWTE8Pe2.jpg)
<sub> [photo by Logan Fisher](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-sitting-in-water-with-fog-during-daytime-kn5PFW6kH_M) </sub>

You see, I've always been one of those guys who do that silly thing where we give ourselves private tasks and try to prove to ourselves that we can accomplish them. For the longest time, I've always told myself that people who bathe with hot water were sissies, not because I believed it, but because I felt it would be a fun task challenging myself all the time to bathe with cold water no matter the weather condition.

Well, on this fateful morning while I was still in the NYSC military camp, I had woken up by 2am as usual to go have my bath. When I first got up, I could tell that everywhere was unusually cold. Normally, I would have postponed the bath, seeing how there was no way I could heat the water up in camp, but I knew that if I didn't take my bath that morning, I would have to fight for a space in the bathroom later that day with over a hundred other guys, and I hated that, so I decided to go take the bath anyway.

I still remember that morning like it was yesterday because the moment the cold water touched my body, I knew I had made a huge mistake. I probably spent less than two minutes in that bathroom, and by the time I was out, I was shivering, almost like someone who had been locked in a freezer.

Tkkk date, I've never felt any cold like that. Thinking about how I felt then and how nice this hot water feels on my body made me realize how stupid I've been all these years for always opting for cold water. Don't get me wrong, taking a cold bath has its moments, but please, if the weather is cold, do not hesitate to heat that water up and have a pleasant hot bath.

It will be worth it.

“OK … Tinyville does have its own treasure map, but it's also a cold case map.”

“Yep. Your father, being my son and therefore Jubilee-of-the-mountain born out of his maternal line, called Capt. Hamilton for a very good reason about the chest, because that tree is at least a century old, and if it is 150 years old, and was planted on purpose, there's several things that could be in it, and a few of them ain't nothing nice.”

Eleven-year-old Velma Trent was talking with her father's mother, Mrs. Gladys Jubilee Trent, aka Grandma Jubilee.

“What I'm getting from this is that if you are going to live in Lofton County you really gotta know where you stand,” Velma said.

“That's true everywhere, baby,” Grandma Jubilee said, “but in Lofton County, history is close.”

As those two were speaking, Capt. Ironwood Hamilton and his team of workmen were methodically cutting the fallen tree apart, moving toward the massive root ball that held the massive chest in its grasp. Laid out in the Trent porch was a 19th-century map of what became Tinyville very early in the 20th century, a map from when it was still part of what General Joseph James Lofton had called “the bad sixty” in 1840, a sixty-mile tract of exhausted farmland he had purchased in addition to the twelve better miles he had made into Fruitland.

“But see, even as Confederates go, Gen. Lofton was almost as progressive as his younger brother,” Grandma Jubilee said to Velma. “He never owned a slave and spent decades buying folks out of slavery. Fruitland as his personal residence was a stop on the Underground Railroad because he allowed it. But, he just couldn't see the local boys marched off in 1861 without shoes or knowing how to march at all, and that's how they reeled him in – but anyway, before that, he had 72 miles of property, and he had bought a lot of it from failed slave owners in his own family circle. He allowed them to remain on the property on the condition that they compensated their workers, and in return he shared with them methods to support and enrich the land so it could produce better.”

“But probably everybody wasn't with that program, and 72 miles is a lot to keep an eye on without the Internet and drones and stuff,” Velma said.

“A horse and buggy would not even allow the general to see his property from end to end without taking the whole day to do it,” Grandma Jubilee said. “But that wasn't the problem. The problem was, General Lofton and later Major Lofton quietly let it be known that all people had the right of self-defense on their lands – so if land managers weren't going to get with the positive half of the Lofton program, the Lofton Brothers simply closed their eyes to them getting their consequences when other people decided they were people, no matter what the person abusing them thought, and struck back.”

“Oh,” Velma said, “so that chest might contain some evidence of people striking back, and why.”

“Wouldn't be the first time,” Grandma Jubilee said, “and there is a infamous disappearance in this area that no one has been able to solve: three other Lofton brothers who thought that between the general's death in 1864 and the major getting a firm grip on things in 1866 they could do what they wanted to the people around them. But Jules, John, and Joe Lofton were never seen again after September 5, 1866. Their wives, presumed abandoned, placed themselves under the major's protection, and life went on.”

“And nobody investigated; that's a bit sus,” Velma said.

“And this is where the saying, 'what's understood ain't gotta be explained' comes in, baby,” Grandma Jubilee said. “Those three Lofton brothers were known for the same thing their father and grandfather were: unnatural cruelty. So they went out drinking and carousing one Saturday night and never came back, and a lot of people breathed a sigh of relief.”

“I feel like there is a life lesson here,” Velma said. “Live like a good person so people actually want you to come home, and actually call the police because they care if you don't.”

“Ain't it the truth, Velma,” Grandma Jubilee said, – and also, so your rich relatives and your dangerous relatives don't all collectively go 'Oh well' when the wives' stories are making absolutely no sense at all.”

“Oh, it was that kind of party, huh?” Velma said.

“Just remember, baby, no matter what is in the chest: you can choose how to treat people, but you can't choose how that comes back to you. As the Bible says about a particular wicked king: Jules, John, and Joe Lofton departed, however they departed, without being desired. That's the result of choices they made long before September 5, 1866.”

links.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes mi entrenamiento de caminata de montaña que realicé en la ruta del cerro Toquito II, en la comunidad de Villa de Cura, municipio Zamora, estado Aragua.
![GridArt_20260616_194840809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243M9Aeo8veD9rvq6j53M5QWUoSaVYRqhJocGh4etKb78Dc4cpYBtjmcsjewsBC46qFP2.jpg) Cabe destacar que este entrenamiento lo realicé el día de hoy martes, como mi último entrenamiento que fue el domingo hice-otro-stitch una ruta plana, entonces decidí hacer esta ruta que tiene parte plana para llegar a la montaña, salí desde la calle doctor Morales, activando la aplicación Strava a las 4:45 pm, el sol estaba presente a pesar que al mediodía llovió y parecía que toda la tarde iba a ser lluvioso, pero el tiempo cambio y pude realizar mi entrenamiento. ![IMG_20260616_171243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23vPLcKCwJFSZueYBiobiPxzpCQKq5tNehkfbV36YPK3JTgt9p9fNT76sx1jzmPXUP8ER.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_172503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/245HicWAm71yLdi2fGcuYmppf1coQV75ScZp4E8hC6NzxaFx1KJ9sZqpyXwjBSEXsSta4.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_171128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243WMaCYb1tdJQCJjygvYb8NBAt1tvc8hfmQqipQndgjJ42ke4x3THh1AqnMBrhmdWL8m.jpg) Asimismo subí por una parte de la doctor Morales y después me desvíe por la Urdaneta, para llegar al sector El Toquito y subir por detrás de los edificios, completando el recorrido de esta comunidad en 19 minutos con 49 segundos. Luego comencé adentrarme al cerro El Toquito II, subiendo por una carretera nueva que realizaron las personas de Corpoelec, para hacerle mantenimiento a las torres eléctricas,en esta parte se inicia el ascenso con una distancia de 400 metros. ![IMG_20260616_172710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/246ajYJpkKEdURQoBEBjEdh3pheMATia8pHpASTs4GeaV4peSPxmndGtuFk6jmVfDem57.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_173307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244KLucELtGstnEKXUkbcACWmMv3PzwwqboeX3F3SKbEE64xqeHTNHnWHxVoYpsDD1qQp.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_172721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23qrSrV2cStYEVvagdDN3UTWb6Zyty298kj7FkyAfSkTBZTM5NaH5xEE3zzd6U4N8wPXG.jpg) Luego de llegar a la parte final de la carretera, continúe subiendo la montaña la cual la subida eran más pronunciada, el verdor de la montaña se comienza apreciar y la brisa que se siente en la cima al completar la distancia de 4K, en esta parte me detuve para hidratarme un poco y después comencé a descender, hay que bajar con cuidado debido a las piedras que están en el camino. Al terminar de bajar y llegar nuevamente a la carretera, no baje por el mismo lado sino que camine para llegar aa dirección hacia la pista de atletismo. ![IMG_20260616_173756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/241F324DZnTSwabUHJQpnPqxYAuwDjq7FSDPK9CiCThPRAtAp2dfPW32SAjymHjzgRDYm.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_174231.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/241F2QxzYAyWzSKkcwquZoGuRqGajvJr3AhP1CireyvxDxAhHaDMpnQyKs5sqFNbXdopQ.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_174008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/246G74xURucuoEMY81SYkthsysAvt8Vk8SCcgoLPg5K66XqBfdNf6vZv9Te5DHb58marf.jpg) Por último caminé por un camino detrás de la pista y saludé algunos amigos que estaban entrenando para continuar mi recorrido y llegar nuevamente al sector El Toquito, para bajar por la carretera que conduce al sector de La Represa y llegar nuevamente al centro y terminar mi entrenamiento en la avenida Lisandro Hernández, con una distancia de 8.65K, con un desnivel positivo de 357 m un desnivel máximo 83 m y un tiempo de 1 hora 51 minutos, registrado en la aplicación Strava. ![IMG_20260616_174910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23sddPWrSKqEjTSX3qC6jTrspuNwzYp5j4oLKRqdY58KY4QcpGvdy6nGs921raHmMBroH.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_174824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/246arTLcnB1aEDDshC26FMyDW7DF7vRPMA41E9mid1FaT4EBpf8Xa9DCNhqYaRMSwzMfF.jpg) ![IMG_20260616_180532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/241F4nk73iqLNbBFWHQa6iidQAbLiM1hQ3aFZYTqiQ2eqAjWvikDN9k2CiRKdXDBZ6FiR.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. links.title: [Esp./Eng.]   Entre la Chispa de la Vida y el Incendio del Alma.   ||
links.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> ¡Qué maravillosa invitación nos hacen esta semana! El fuego es, quizá, el elemento que mejor define la complejidad del alma humana; pues tiene el poder de iluminar el camino más oscuro, de calentar el hogar más gélido, pero también la capacidad de reducirlo todo a cenizas si no se sabe gobernar. Para participar en esta [iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-fuego) semanal de **@talentos**, he preparado una reflexión que entrelaza la magia del cine con la realidad de nuestras propias vidas. Espero que les guste.

# ***
Entre la Chispa de la Vida y el Incendio del Alma
*** Desde que Prometeo robó el fuego a los dioses para entregárselo a los hombres (¿recuerdan?), la humanidad ha entendido que llevar esa llama por dentro es una bendición cargada de responsabilidad. A menudo, confundimos ese fuego con el \
, pero la cinematografía nos ha regalado espejos maravillosos para entender que la verdadera llama es algo mucho más sutil y, a la vez, mucho más poderoso.\n\nEn la película **\
(2020)**, Pixar nos da una lección de humildad existencial. Joe Gardner pasa toda su vida creyendo que su \

es el jazz, que su fuego interno solo arde cuando está frente a un piano. Sin embargo, la gran revelación de la historia es que la verdadera chispa no es el talento ni la vocación profesional; es el deseo mismo de vivir. Es el asombro ante una hoja que cae, el sabor de una pizza caliente o la conexión con otro ser humano. Como bien dice un diálogo de la película: *\
*. En la vida real, muchos permitimos que nuestro fuego se apague porque no hemos alcanzado una \

, olvidando que la llama se alimenta de los pequeños momentos, de lo cotidiano.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeEj7zFuhqLqBdow7STSywCQnR2xwL6HBZpYSdaB2YVhy/soul_2020_.jpeg)
<sup>[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=laS2MONU97c)</sup>
</center>

Esa necesidad de encontrar la propia voz se siente con una fuerza electrizante en **\
(1989)**. El profesor John Keating no solo enseña literatura; enseña a sus alumnos a no ser \
, a aprovechar el día (*Carpe Diem*). Ese fuego interno es la resistencia contra el conformismo. Walt Whitman, citado en el filme, lo resume perfectamente: *\

*. El fuego aquí es la pasión por la belleza y la libertad de ser uno mismo en un mundo que nos quiere moldeados y silenciosos.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNxYKgVCaHMTCCZTbiyVWS7yR1CSEbuo7L9QgfdTq6NtY/el_club_de_los_poetas_muertos_1989_.jpeg)
<sup>[](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0097165/mediaviewer/rm1865468928/)</sup>
</center>

Sin embargo, encender esa llama suele generar incomodidad en los demás. Lo vemos en **\
(2000)**. Billy vive en un entorno de mineros, de sudor, de huelgas y de una masculinidad rígida y asfixiante. Su fuego es el ballet, algo que para su entorno es \
. Billy nos enseña que el fuego interno es una fuerza física; cuando baila, dice sentir *\

*. A veces, nuestro fuego molesta a quienes viven en la oscuridad o a quienes han dejado que sus propias llamas se extingan por miedo. La envidia o el egoísmo de otros son los baldes de agua que intentarán apagar nuestra pasión, pero como Billy, debemos entender que aferrarse a lo que enciende el alma es, literalmente, un acto de supervivencia.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYWGEqyQHS9nU2Qq92BnLCUjXvTLSM9hNQb8JxqwaooE4/billy_elliot_2000_.jpg)
<sup>[](https://www.facebook.com/groups/157490990972533/posts/9144126432308899/)</sup>
</center>

No obstante, debemos ser cautos, pues el fuego no siempre es benévolo. Existe un punto donde la pasión se desvirtúa y se convierte en una obsesión ciega, desencadenando una crueldad extrema e inhumana. En **\

(2014)**, somos testigos de cómo el deseo de grandeza puede transformarse en un incendio forestal que lo devora todo. El profesor Terence Fletcher utiliza el abuso psicológico bajo la premisa de que *\

*. Aquí, la llama interna del joven baterista Andrew Neiman ya no busca la alegría ni la expresión, sino la validación a través del sufrimiento. Cuando el fuego interno se convierte en una búsqueda de perfección sin empatía, se vuelve una fuerza destructiva que nos desconecta de nuestra humanidad, recordándonos que un fuego sin control no ilumina, solo calcina al portador y a quienes lo rodean.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZYLGGzmTsVEqzq5mZNPtvo5XerYAbL1AVSMGVAhnRR9G/whiplash_2014_.png)
<sup>[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V__MnNXXjnY)</sup>
</center>

En la vida real, todos somos portadores de esta antorcha. Hay días en los que nuestra llama es apenas una brasa tímida que necesita el aire de un amigo o de una película para reavivarse. Otros días, es una llamarada que inspira a otros a encender sus propias luces. Lo importante es entender que ese fuego es nuestro tesoro más preciado.

Como bien señaló el psiquiatra **Viktor Frankl** en su obra *El hombre en busca de sentido*: 
> *\

que la vida espera es, precisamente, que mantengamos nuestra llama encendida, con la calidez suficiente para amar y la luz suficiente para no perdernos, para no encandilar. Pero siempre cuidando que no se convierta en el incendio de la ambición desmedida. Amigas(os) lectores, los invito a mirar hacia adentro. ¿Qué está alimentando su fuego hoy? ¿Es el asombro de la vida, la pasión por el arte, la resistencia ante la adversidad o, quizás, una obsesión que necesita equilibrar? No dejen que nadie apague su chispa, pero tampoco permitan que su fuego queme la humanidad de los demás. ¡A brillar con luz propia!
*** *** #
**[𝗘𝗻𝗰𝘂𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼 𝗱𝗲 𝗧𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼𝘀: «Fuego»](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-fuego)**

## Dedicado a todos aquellos escribas que contribuyen, día a día, a hacer de nuestro planeta, un mundo mejor.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWiJfhRxoQFbzdHDtvM9Ad3FQAAJg4UBPrFna6YP2mMf/512espa_ol8.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)

*** *** ***


# ***
***

> What a wonderful invitation we’ve been given this week! Fire is, perhaps, the element that best defines the complexity of the human soul; for it has the power to light up the darkest path and warm the coldest home, but also the capacity to reduce everything to ashes if it is not properly controlled. To take part in this weekly [initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-fuego) by **@talentos**, I’ve prepared a reflection that weaves together the magic of cinema with the reality of our own lives. I hope you enjoy it.

# ***
Between the Spark of Life and the Fire of the Soul
*** Ever since Prometheus stole fire from the gods to give it to mankind (remember?), humanity has understood that carrying that flame within is a blessing laden with responsibility. We often confuse that fire with ‘success’ or an ‘ultimate goal’, but cinema has given us wonderful mirrors through which to understand that the true flame is something far more subtle and, at the same time, far more powerful. In the film **‘Soul’ (2020)**, Pixar teaches us a lesson in existential humility. Joe Gardner spends his whole life believing that his ‘spark’ is jazz, that his inner fire only burns when he is sitting at a piano. However, the story’s great revelation is that the true spark is neither talent nor a professional calling; it is the very desire to live. It is the wonder at a falling leaf, the taste of a hot pizza or the connection with another human being. As a line from the film so aptly puts it: *“Your spark isn’t your purpose. The final box is ticked when you’re ready to live.”* In real life, many of us allow our fire to go out because we haven’t achieved a ‘big goal’, forgetting that the flame is fuelled by the small moments, by the everyday.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeEj7zFuhqLqBdow7STSywCQnR2xwL6HBZpYSdaB2YVhy/soul_2020_.jpeg) [](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=laS2MONU97c)
That need to find one’s own voice is felt with electrifying force in **“Dead Poets Society” (1989)**. Professor John Keating doesn’t just teach literature; he teaches his students not to be “food for worms”, to seize the day (*Carpe Diem*). That inner fire is resistance against conformism. Walt Whitman, quoted in the film, sums it up perfectly: *“Let the mighty drama continue, and you may contribute a verse.”* The fire here is a passion for beauty and the freedom to be oneself in a world that wants us to be moulded and silent.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNxYKgVCaHMTCCZTbiyVWS7yR1CSEbuo7L9QgfdTq6NtY/el_club_de_los_poetas_muertos_1989_.jpeg) [](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0097165/mediaviewer/rm1865468928/)
However, kindling that flame often makes others feel uncomfortable. We see this in **‘Billy Elliot’ (2000)**. Billy lives in a world of miners, sweat, strikes and a rigid, suffocating masculinity. His fire is ballet, something that, to those around him, is ‘a forbidden flame’. Billy shows us that inner fire is a physical force; when he dances, he says he feels *‘electricity’*. Sometimes, our fire bothers those who live in darkness or those who have let their own flames die out through fear. The envy or selfishness of others are the buckets of water that will try to extinguish our passion, but like Billy, we must understand that clinging to what ignites the soul is, quite literally, an act of survival.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYWGEqyQHS9nU2Qq92BnLCUjXvTLSM9hNQb8JxqwaooE4/billy_elliot_2000_.jpg) [](https://www.facebook.com/groups/157490990972533/posts/9144126432308899/)
However, we must be cautious, for fire is not always benevolent. There comes a point where passion becomes distorted and turns into a blind obsession, unleashing extreme and inhuman cruelty. In **‘Whiplash’ (2014)**, we witness how the desire for greatness can turn into a wildfire that consumes everything in its path. Professor Terence Fletcher employs psychological abuse under the premise that *‘there are no two more harmful words in our language than “good job”’*. Here, the inner flame of the young drummer Andrew Neiman no longer seeks joy or expression, but validation through suffering. When the inner fire becomes a quest for perfection devoid of empathy, it turns into a destructive force that disconnects us from our humanity, reminding us that an uncontrolled fire does not illuminate; it merely scorches the bearer and those around them.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZYLGGzmTsVEqzq5mZNPtvo5XerYAbL1AVSMGVAhnRR9G/whiplash_2014_.png) [](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V__MnNXXjnY)
In real life, we are all bearers of this torch. There are days when our flame is barely a timid ember that needs the breath of a friend or a film to be rekindled. On other days, it is a blaze that inspires others to light their own lights. The important thing is to understand that this fire is our most precious treasure. As the psychiatrist **Viktor Frankl** rightly pointed out in his book *Man’s Search for Meaning*: > *“What is needed is a change of attitude towards life… what really matters is not what we expect from life, but what life expects from us”* (Frankl, 1946).
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcB7qX225UsycVuC7GYVi8QbdXjFMWiRB4Gvs2FFxzVH/image.png) [](https://misionesonline.net/2019/02/19/guardavidas-de-posadas-festejaron-su-dia-con-la-tradicional-antorchada/)
That ‘something’ which life expects is, precisely, that we keep our flame alight – with enough warmth to love and enough light so as not to lose our way, yet without blinding others. But we must always take care that it does not turn into the blaze of unbridled ambition. Dear readers, I invite you to look within. What is fuelling your fire today? Is it a sense of wonder at life, a passion for art, resilience in the face of adversity, or perhaps an obsession that you need to bring into balance? Do not let anyone extinguish your spark, but neither should you allow your fire to burn away the humanity of others. Shine with your own light!
*** *** #

links.title: Qwen 3.5 and 3.6: Alibaba and the ambition to cover every use case
links.body:
Alibaba's strategy with the Qwen series is different from that of the other manufacturers. While Meta releases three models, DeepSeek releases two, and Mistral releases one, in 2026 Alibaba simultaneously covers mobile devices with fewer than 1 billion parameters and datacenter servers with 397 billion — all in the same family, with the same base architecture, under the Apache 2.0 license.

## Qwen 3.5: a complete family

Qwen 3.5 was released in March 2026 with an unusual proposition: eight model sizes in a single version. The small models — 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B — were released in the same cycle as the 397B-A17B flagship (397 billion total parameters, 17 billion active via MoE).

The logic is one of platform: a company that adopts Qwen 3.5 can use the 9B model for local inference at the edge, the 27B or 35B for medium-sized on-premises servers, and the 397B via API for high-complexity tasks — all with the same model family, consistent behaviors, and fine-tuning that is portable across sizes.

### Hybrid architecture

Qwen 3.5's technical differentiator is the combination of architectures: Gated Delta Networks (linear attention) integrated with a sparse MoE system. Linear attention reduces the quadratic growth of computational cost as context increases — critical for models that support up to 1 million tokens.

All models in the family are natively multimodal, processing text, images, and video via early fusion of multimodal tokens — the technical equivalent of having been trained with all modalities from the start, rather than having received vision as an add-on module. Support for 201 languages and dialects.

### Benchmarks

The 9B model scores 70.1 on MMMU-Pro (a visual reasoning benchmark), 22.5% above GPT-5-Nano on the same benchmark. The 397B-A17B flagship competes with frontier closed models on reasoning and agentic tasks.

## Qwen 3.6: focus on code and agents

In April 2026, Alibaba released Qwen 3.6, specifically the 3.6-35B-A3B model (35 billion total, 3 billion active per inference). It is a model designed for coding and agentic tasks, not for general use.

The 3.6-35B-A3B's results on Terminal-Bench 2.0 reach 51.5, and on SWE-Bench Verified they reach 73.4 — within the competitive range of much larger coding models. Released under Apache 2.0, it runs comfortably on consumer hardware with a single GPU of adequate memory.

Qwen 3.6-Plus, the larger version of the family, has a standard context of 1 million tokens and agentic benchmarks comparable to Claude Opus 4.5. The cost via API is US$ 0.38 per million input tokens — for comparison, Gemini 3.1 Pro costs US$ 2.00 on the same benchmark. The cost difference is 5x for similar performance on many tasks.

## What makes Alibaba different

There are two aspects that set the Qwen strategy apart from the rest.

The first is the scale of language support. 201 languages is more than any other frontier model. For applications in Asian, Middle Eastern, and African markets, where other models' support for local languages is superficial, the Qwen models have a practical advantage.

The second is the consistency of the family. Most competitors release models with distinct architectures for each market segment — one model for edge, another for cloud, another for coding. Alibaba maintains a coherent family with consistent behavior and training, which simplifies the workflow for anyone who needs multiple sizes for different deployment targets.

## The strategic context

Like DeepSeek, Alibaba operates under American export restrictions on advanced hardware. The architectural efficiency of Qwen 3.5 and 3.6 — especially in the combination of linear attention with MoE for long contexts — is in part a response to these restrictions.

The result: models that are competitive with the state of the art while using less compute per inference. For those running these models in production, that translates into lower cost and higher throughput per available GPU.

Apache 2.0 across the entire family removes legal barriers to enterprise adoption. With Llama 4 restricted in Europe and DeepSeek under MIT, the Qwen 3.5/3.6 models become one of the most legally straightforward options for global use without regional restrictions.

## Position in the ecosystem

In May 2026, the Qwen series occupies a specific space: it is not the best model on any single benchmark, but it is one of the few options that offers the full range of sizes, native multimodality, extensive language support, and a truly open license in a single family. For those who need broad coverage with a unified platform, it is the lowest-friction choice available.

links.title: #NOTYOURREGULAREXIBITIONMATCH
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ9kA63gjegrybEGqMQWeBL7HQFeLHzdhZfZNVLfryvvB/img_4414.png)
_____________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmagq7qR2HGCzqvS5HMkuyJ7WwDfDiDbwHfn67DjV7cqej/img_4413.png)
_____________________________________________________

I just played an exhibition match, but not your regular “pick random teams and play” type. I decided to recreate El Clásico myself — Real Madrid vs Barcelona, full vibe. Set the squads, the kits, even tried to imagine the Bernabéu noise in my head. Match ended 2:0 in favor of Madrid and I was buzzing. Felt like a real win because I played with that El Clásico energy, not just casual button-mashing.

To be honest the match level wasn’t very tough. The AI or whoever I played didn’t give me much fight, so Madrid dominated possession and chances. But I still took it serious. First goal came from a quick counter down the right, cutback and tap in. Second one was a banger from outside the box that just flew in. After the 2:0 I felt like I won something real, even though it was just exhibition. El Clásico hits different no matter the mode.

Tomorrow I’m running the reverse fixture — Barcelona vs Real Madrid. Today Madrid was home and Barca was away, so tomorrow Barca will be home and Madrid away. Want to make it feel like a two-legged tie. Let’s see if Barca can get revenge at Camp Nou or if Madrid will do a double. Either way I’m hyped already.

links.title: Day 47: I Think My Office Security Camera Is Judging My Snack Choices
links.body:
So, I was sitting at my desk today, minding my own business, absolutely demolishing a pack of spicy chips at 9:00 AM (don't judge me, breakfast is a social construct). Suddenly, I felt it. That cold, unblinking stare.
I looked up, and this is what I saw:

![cai-fang-L8sCDG5MO5Y-unsplash.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSy26vwYrJh1ydXn1Rn8CxengMLUTq6XJtvdNUAt8H4LL/cai-fang-L8sCDG5MO5Y-unsplash.jpg)

>*<center> Photo source: Unsplash</center>*

Look at it. Just look at the dramatic lighting. The stark, minimalist wall. The long, ominous shadow stretching down like a judgmental finger pointing directly at my poor life choices.
It doesn’t just look like a security camera; it looks like an **art installation titled *\

*.**
### A Few Things This Camera Knows About Me Now:
 * **My exact yawning schedule:** It peaks around 2:15 PM, right after the heavy lunch kicks in.
 * **My \
:** Which highly resembles a confused pug trying to solve a Rubik's cube.\n * **The \

dance:** Where I furiously type nonsense to look busy when the boss walks past.
Honestly, with that long shadow, it looks less like a tech gadget and more like a Pixar character that’s about to sigh heavily, break away from the wall, and tell me to go touch some grass.
I’m half tempted to print out a tiny top hat and tape it on top just to soften its existential glare.
**What about you guys?** Do you have a silent electronic overlord watching your every move at work, or are you blessed with a camera-free blind spot? Let me know in the comments!

links.body:
![1-fcb725072eec.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mqhanpf3-h679eyq9/1-fcb725072eec.webp)

![2-bf6e7d236dbf.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mqhanpf3-h679eyq9/2-bf6e7d236dbf.webp)

![3-7ca714f0eafc.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mqhanpf3-h679eyq9/3-7ca714f0eafc.webp)

![4-949dd9b36150.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mqhanpf3-h679eyq9/4-949dd9b36150.webp)

![5-145ac7c30e06.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mqhanpf3-h679eyq9/5-145ac7c30e06.webp)

昨天为了省钱，剩下来的都自己的，都骑车，骑着电动车回农村的乡下的家里睡觉，30公里的里，开着破电动车，也是和晃晃悠悠的，反正各种滋味吧，人到了这个地步，一定要平静而祥和。

今天早上骑车回店铺的路上，热风吹在脸上，地里很多人在给玉米浇水，我骑车来店铺开业，人的职业没有高低贵贱，但是人心不古，人心有比较，有取舍。

比较是偷走幸福的小偷，没有攀比何来的虚荣和痛苦，抬头看看天空，很蓝很美很漂亮，以前仔细看天气的时候，还是小学的时候吧，没有想到自己也是到了落叶归根的年纪了。

对于这个地方我是没有任何归属感和安全感的，可能是原生家庭的缘故，需要我一生来修复自己，这个地方没有我的家，郑州也没有我的家，我打拼了一生，就是一场空，可笑的梦，我的余生，没有放弃我自己，我希望我能达到我的理想，重新站起来，我一定要可以。

存钱，有一个真正意义上的自己的家，自己的窝，自己的汽车，今天的忍气吞声是为了明天的更好。

加油，今天我会更加的努力。
