links.body:
> Saludos mi gente bella y positiva,hoy estoy animada de estar en esta gran comunidad **EmpoderarTalent**, deseándole muchas Bendiciones. Es grato estar participando en la iniciativa de mi querida amiga @angelica7, la cual invita esta semana en [ Encuentro de Talentos]( https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-fuego ), con el Tema **El Fuego**. > _Greetings, my beautiful and positive friends! Today I’m thrilled to be part of this wonderful **EmpoderarTalent** community, and I wish you all many blessings. It’s a pleasure to be participating in the initiative of my dear friend @angelica7, who is hosting this week’s [Talent Gathering](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-fuego ), with the theme **Fire**._
![1001773527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23tbPF9bAYHwz8P8AwyKPQQWjD8DNvTYhCXGF5GxY3Vgq5L4jJ3811c2mpZEG8WqC1P3z.jpg)

> El fuego es la fuerza interior que nos permite avivar esa llama para eliminar el temor y la debilidad. Cuántas veces nos sentimos desanimados por las dificultades que se nos presentan, nos dejamos llevar por el miedo, impidiendo lograr nuestros objetivos. > Fire is the inner strength that allows us to fan that flame to dispel fear and weakness. How often do we feel discouraged by the difficulties we face, letting fear get the better of us and preventing us from achieving our goals.
![1001773530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23xVAqFJSfpJdq2scxorx2oy5eWdyHxuaKFW4cVpWhfgoMvhvqK5gFWFMEza3uzLNf483.jpg)

> Cuando hacemos algo con pasión, com amor y esas ganas que nos impulsan a alcanzar nuestros sueños, eso es el fuego interior tan poderoso que ilumina nuestro camino hacia senderos iluminados, metas claras donde sentimos felicidad, porque cuando hacemos las cosas con pasión, será el motor que transforma las tareas cotidianas en experiencias con propósito. >When we do something with passion, with love, and with that drive that propels us toward our dreams, that is the powerful inner fire that lights our path toward bright trails and clear goals where we feel happiness—because when we do things with passion, it becomes the driving force that transforms everyday tasks into meaningful experiences.
![1001760185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Ep3ghyt95PiyEF2UhCVbxMUN1ZuTcqm4QYRCxqpaQN5tSa8fqKZyrv2yZ4SMgq4BTTn.jpg)

> En efecto,cuando amamos lo que hacemos, entregamos nuestra mejor energía y contagiamos esa motivación a todos los que nos rodean; encendemos esa chispa que nos mantiene motivados, creativos y buscando siempre la excelencia y mejorando nuestro bienestar para obtener resultados de mayor calidad. > Indeed, when we love what we do, we give our best energy and inspire those around us with that motivation; we ignite that spark that keeps us motivated, creative, and always striving for excellence and improving our well-being to achieve higher-quality results.
![1001760186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EpCCkBZiZfX6SsAMEwxsHmdjKgR1rptQRTM8SkDxQMZsnTg46NwX5X8p55yZhEfYjTF.jpg)

> Cuando nos enamoramos, encendemos ese fuego, donde nos sentimos apasionados y felices; por eso debemos mantener viva esa chispa para mantener esa relación. Siempre escucho por allí que cuando la llama se apaga, se acaba el amor; así sucede en todas nuestras relaciones, por eso es importante encender ese fuego para mantener viva esa pasión por la vida y nuestros seres queridos. > When we fall in love, we ignite that fire—it’s what makes us feel passionate and happy—which is why we must keep that spark alive to sustain the relationship. I often hear people say that when the flame goes out, love ends; that’s how it is in all our relationships, which is why it’s important to keep that fire burning to keep alive our passion for life and for our loved ones.
![1001760199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23ynd88U3Pjwgk34f4ewq1mHw8dQKZHKW368CXUNHKC67SRFNxNG344PPmXXdEHaVBPDf.jpg)

> El fuego es aquella energía que permite avanzar y continuar nuestras vidas, cuyo resultado final aspire al éxito, no puede faltar su principal motor. > Fire is the energy that allows us to move forward and carry on with our lives; if we want the end result to be success, we cannot do without its main driving force.
![1001760149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EpA4rGjgr2gebRNryHnJy1MxidbPLdgH4CKW3WX4KFBuifdnPZKrzvGHEtCgz88zNyP.jpg)

## 🕰️ Ronda Retro — 16 jun.

links.title: El regreso repotenciado de MusicaVenezuela
links.body:
![](https://musicavenezuela.com/public/assets/blog/mv-ylich-459790.webp) Cuando lanzamos nuestra primera versión de MusicaVenezuela.com, no podíamos imaginar el futuro de las redes ni que 25 años después estaríamos haciendo un relanzamiento. Una idea surgida en el 2000, que vio la luz a finales de 2001 y que 25 años más tarde cobra nuevo impulso para contribuir a atender necesidades de estos nuevos tiempos. ## La primera etapa.
![](https://musicavenezuela.com/public/assets/blog/mv-ylich-380486.webp)
Aparte del poco contenido existente que hablara sobre nuestros cantantes, bandas y orquestas, se hacía inaccesible, pues no existían los buscadores tal como los entendemos hoy. Para ese momento los sistemas de indexación en buscadores no existían y \

las páginas web era una tarea que se hacía manual, y aun así era muy limitado el alcance. La forma más fiable era convertirse en editor de un megaproyecto (en aquellos tiempos) llamado [Dmoz.org](https://musicavenezuela.com/Artistas/publicado) -que era una especie de directorio- y ese te daba cierta visibilidad en sitios como [Yahoo.com](https://yahoo.com) y algunos otros buscadores que se empezaban a desarrollar.\r\n\r\nLuego de empezar a \

nuestra base de datos para nuestro proyecto, tuvimos que integrarnos a esa plataforma para dar cierta visibilidad a algunos grupos concretos. En ese momento comenzamos a desarrollar estrategias para proyectar a cuatro artistas: la orquesta [Billo's Caracas Boys](https://musicavenezuela.com/Artistas/billos), [Los Cañoneros](https://musicavenezuela.com/Artistas/los-canoneros), [Desorden Público](https://musicavenezuela.com/Artistas/desorden-publico) y [Malanga](https://musicavenezuela.com/Artistas/malanga). Los sitios web de estos artistas también sirvieron como páginas de enlaces a otros proyectos. Así empezaron a afianzarse enlaces que contribuían a posicionar mejor a las otras webs. ## Algunos frutos
![](https://musicavenezuela.com/public/assets/blog/mv-1-post-1-477661.webp)
Sabemos bien que había otras personas y proyectos apuntando hacia el mismo lado y que cada uno hizo su aporte para que paulatinamente tuviera más alcance y posicionamiento el talento venezolano en la WWW. Han sido muchas las vías por las que hemos recibido una respuesta clara a lo que ha sido nuestra labor y el impacto que ha tenido, tanto para el usuario general como para muchos artistas. Una de las pruebas más fehacientes es la constancia del público que sigue llegando día a día a nuestras páginas en busca de artistas y letras de canciones, los artículos de prensa en medios digitales que nos mencionan como referencia directa, incluyendo algunas reseñas de artistas en Wikipedia, que citan como fuente a **MusicaVenezuela.com**. ## Los nuevos tiempos Mucha agua ha corrido bajo el puente desde aquel momento. Hacía apenas unos diez años que el cassette había sido desplazado por el CD y dos años antes había iniciado la fiebre de **Napster**, como primera plataforma de intercambio de mp3, lo cual marcó el inicio del desplazamiento de los formatos físicos para la música. Ahora estamos en el medio de la era del *streaming*, aunque con un número mayor cada día de quienes apuntan al *revival* de los formatos físicos, siendo el vinil en este momento una alternativa de lujo para esos amantes de \
.\r\n\r\nEstamos en un momento en que parece tener prioridad el \
por encima del artista y el \

en lugar de la obra, de la canción. Una industria musical que ha sido sustituida por la del entretenimiento, donde los cantantes, bandas y orquestas se ven muchas veces arropados por máquinas y por la inteligencia artificial.\r\n\r\nAunque se han abierto canales que prometían la \

de los medios para crear y difundir tu música, también han traído consigo una gran dispersión, además, con unos algoritmos que juegan en contra. ## Un punto de apoyo A lo que aspiramos es que **MusicaVenezuela.com** se convierta en una herramienta que contribuya a valorizar a los creadores de música de nuestro país, que sea una vitrina que consolide la imagen y trayectoria de quienes dedican con seriedad y profesionalismo su vida a esta musa. Que no dependan de un algoritmo, que en un solo lugar se pueda acceder a la mayor cantidad de información posible, de los nuevos talentos, así como de quienes labraron un camino con anterioridad. Queremos mantener el archivo histórico, ampliarlo y, al mismo tiempo, brindar información sobre lo más nuevo, lo reciente. Te invitamos a explorar nuestro archivo histórico, a descubrir las novedades de nuestros creadores y a formar parte de este espacio concebido para la difusión y el respeto por la música y los músicos venezolanos. **¡Bienvenidos a la nueva etapa de MusicaVenezuela.com!** ![](https://musicavenezuela.com/public/assets/blog/mv-1-post-1-478921.webp) | Version original | |:--:| | [Ir a la version original](https://musicavenezuela.com/blog/el-regreso-repotenciado-de-musicavenezuela) | ![MusicaVenezuela](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/EpLhWB4thkBK3EwvsQk2dB1mSUEWSYziS9anLVtrLb2awcgSicvqatNARZotBPmiedX.png) ------ | [![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23uQG5bMpA2yUvU3w1TEuFvZjXBPfgBshBVfZZUN4RJ2XPWixaH1Ufw18aV1csBHocF2m.gif)
Vote la-colmena for witness
By @Ylich](https://vote.hive.uno/@la-colmena) | |:----:|

links.title: Victory Regained.
links.body: > Pushing to retake Grantebridge, I fought alongside allies before regrouping with Soma at the longhouse. Though Wigmund escaped, I defeated his massive Saxon soldier. After Eivor sounded the horn to trigger victory celebrations, Soma pulled Eivor aside to reveal a secret tunnel and request help finding a traitor. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSkgwSiDeQxj8spzZ6d8wr7UZxwtKxQw2TLajoiPgbGpV/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ4WoEp6MG8MwcuxenCV63MjB9EbGCqQJDTiMjfM5Z8jc/screenshot_2_.png) As we had to retake Grantebridge, we kept moving ahead and looked for the enemy leaders, while I took down as many enemies as I could, fighting beside with the soldiers on our side. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVspuHLCaTjGCQpbC53tYhLhX5BEdtbaSzTVgTYjM2kR/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPqeysnzKwkSCge2odAusZboYwaB75nsk1xeCp2AFnEoJ/screenshot_4_.png) I had to regroup with Soma at the entrance of a longhouse where Soma thought Wigmund was hiding, but it looked like he escaped, leaving one of his big Saxon soldiers along with more behind to fight us, barricading the path to the inner chamber. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMzmrqKvwUbbn1zD7Vg8F3SaQY1whkjm2Vh6DVnaEVFc/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVME6mPnWFfYAGHWG7YYBRAGNbE7LrxEJRp6wEkZQNKFB/screenshot_6_.png) At first I thought fighting this big man would be a hard deal, but when I started fighting him, it looked easy. His massive weapon swung slowly, giving me plenty of time to read his movements and prepare my counter-strategy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSKzqt5Y9jfuVwkN1GGomzoUG26f1w1G1bnVLatqWdxy6/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmas9EaGqkBBUKFBc6Tue2M6AQVZxGoVNjPWDQPV8wgo12/screenshot_8_.png) I just had to dodge some of his attacks and attack him back, and at last he fell down. So Eivor choked him to death, and permanently neutralized the formidable threat. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrXCZ3XqqfvMBEwPFg6yQZdPPc3W2XX2Xptc1AgGRhwE/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTVD75E3m6nGpDkQhYwmWt8o6hKEmwhCvv4wVwBYU1xLy/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYk7YyS5fMtM1z7tbWzfWBKq7hmSKgXtcPYKs35tCA6qc/screenshot_11_.png) Soma didn't want to search for Wigmund, mentioning he'll be gone. And then he asked Eivor to sound the horn, that means prosperity, long life, bounty. So I went for it, stepping up to the wooden platform to raise the massive horn and let out a resounding blast. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPc3irkqRtvbiZqMmPb5FaHAgU8sxAbenLrctnb5Zvh9K/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTLWocfd9ecoUs8YHKbjjCRk4HDWrhypHphTuYFB6tkNf/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfN42xTLc6yYdp8TTwTrACiF6Sp1jrePq9R1xjzwraSPq/screenshot_14_.png) After the horn was blown up, the scene shifted into a victory party where the winter soldiers were drinking beside Soma, and Soma was cheering all of them up, raising her cup high to celebrate the liberation of the strategic settlement. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUDfwWxk8DmYd2CgGGKcN9h9ibtDw17gMeRtnoiy55yr/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXeHBcfb2Fsr4bAns5pcay7bCfYSC6dZPH34BzAfyo5yE/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZkYXx4nzeQjJDeuaUXfR7DbEd1ysbWMAqiD76MmC91Le/screenshot_17_.png) After Soma finished cheering them up, she turned to the other side, and Eivor noticed Soma was not really happy with this. Her smile faded instantly into a deep, troubled expression as she looked out over the quiet parts of the crowd. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmafMTUTfdF6mAnGoz2S3oUxcBVdz2Dtvv1wxjZjBz4Roz/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZm67dcQAGBatcyN5G7U3mWipz4MJADLgSMMGDyCBEVQ5/screenshot_19_.png) It was later in the night, when most of the soldiers were sleeping, and Eivor was also taking some rest. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQaDs4zfZphu6ZY7yPP2DgkbPaDiA4iDvAChmciSKm7x7/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbSs7Qswaj3KwmBt7VgYmEReBVsDXpMKsZg4YwB25EvLR/screenshot_21_.png) Soma came over to Eivor and it looked like she had something important to talk about so she awake Eivor quietly without disturbing anyone else, or maybe she wanted it to be a secret. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUpMLQ2KMAuPpFtHRL8zwHCj2EJMd5G7aYLYjsLyn7sq/screenshot_22_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXxp8oMVWt2z9KQRvKGaRyy66Qc6wYcbWyWtb39yuhmoy/screenshot_23_.png) Eivor got up and Soma showed him a tunnel that was her most careful project, which she kept secret in the city. And she believed she was betrayed by one of her advisors, as only she and her advisors knew about the tunnel. Then she requested Eivor to find the culprit, and Eivor accepted the job. That's all for now. --- ▶ [Watch on 3speak.tv](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/victory-regained-205)

links.title: 公司wifi坏了
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![xHlkiSWa3x3TGr07_vxt20.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/xHlkiSWa3x3TGr07_vxt20/xHlkiSWa3x3TGr07_vxt20.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天早上来到公司和往常一样用手机连接公司wifi，可是怎么也连不上去，于是打开电脑试试，还是连不上去。这是怎么回事，我随便找了几个同事问问，都说连不上去。这可怎么办呢，我只能打开手机热点，让电脑连接热点然后用VPN接入公司网络。到了9点负责网络的同事来公司开始排查问题，原本我以为很快就能搞定，最简单方法就是重启嘛，可是迟迟不见修好。早上10点左右，群里有人说修好了，我试了下还是不行啊，许多同事在群里发言说还是连不上。

负责网络的同事说是，有一部分同事可以连入公司wifi，但是另外一部分连不进去，已经联系了思科的售后排查。还是得继续用自己的手机热点，这样很耗流量，因为电脑打开网页会加载许多图片和视频。下午还有一个会议，没有网络的话，会议室里的设备也用不了啊，中午吃饭时候依然没有修好。到了中午12点多，网络的同事发消息说终于修好了，我试了一下果然可以接入公司wifi，此时手机因为长时间开着热点，发热量大机壳后面已经烫手了。

虽然公司网络好了，但我没用多久就回家办公了，因为下午要早接孩子放学。早知道公司网络有问题的话，我就在家办公好了。来公司图的就是一是可以吹空调，二是网络比家里好，结果网络坏了一上午。回到家后我躺在沙发上睡了一会，2点起来办公，感觉精神舒服多了。

---

links.title: Reintroducing myself.
links.body:
Hello,
My Beautiful hivians Community.
Wow where do I even begin?

It's been a while actually and if I'm being honest, I've missed you all, I've missed this space, I've missed our conversations, your contributions, your stories.
Some of you have been here since the very beginning, you remember my early posts, my awkward food photos, and my endless enthusiasm for food Some of you joined just before I went quiet maybe you're wondering what happened. 
And some of you might be completely new welcome by the way I'm so glad you're here.
---
But today I want to do something simple, Something I probably should have done a long time ago.
I want to reintroduce myself.
Not because you've forgotten me, But because I've changed,  I've grown, I've learned, I've evolved and I want you to meet the person I am today not the person I was when I left.
---
For Those Who Remember Me.
Hi again! 👋
You might remember me as the person who used to share recipes, talk about healthy eating, and ramble endlessly about  natural medicine I want to say thank you truly from the bottom of my heart.
Thank you for being here. Thank you for engaging on my posts, commenting, sharing your own journeys, and encouraging me when I was just starting out. You have no idea how much that meant to me you gave me confidence when I had none, you made me feel like I had something valuable to share.
---
And I want to apologize 🙏I disappeared without much explanation. One day I was posting regularly, and the next silence. I know that must have been confusing I know some of you probably wondered if I was okay,  I know I left without saying goodbye properly
 Life happened things got busy  i got overwhelmed and somewhere along the way I stopped showing up not because I didn't care but because I didn't know how to show up authentically anymore.
But I'm back now and I'm ready to show up differently, Better, More focused, More honest, and More me.
---
For Those Who Are New Welcome.
If you're just finding me now let me properly introduce myself.


![1001121500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladygospel/23uFU4o3p6Lk6KPfiBrj8mUmF1nLbQB9Bmg3RZ14LpwYhqPHmqm7y7e2gPoxy7R5uokQp.jpg)
Future nutritionists.
![1001121498.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladygospel/23vhyMztpcXGCMpKPR4kD6WhBxJgrPhWKQBzLQziBcXzF6tSWmt1CYZgRVoixSp13szd6.jpg)

My name is lady blessing @ladygospel and I'm passionate about one thing which is helping people use food to heal their bodies.
I'm a nutritionist still early in my journey, still learning every single day but deeply committed to this path. I'm also a lover of cooking, a student of microbiology, and someone who genuinely believes that what we put on our plates matters a lots not just for our weight  but for our energy, our mood, our immunity, and our longterm health.
I'm not here to sell you a magic pill, I'm not here to shame you for eating rice or bread or your grandmother's favorite recipe  I'm not here to tell you to cut out everything you love I'm here to walk with you  to share what I'm learning, to show you that healthy food can be delicious, colorful, and deeply satisfying. To remind you that you're capable of more than what you think to be a companion on your health journey not a dictator.
So welcome i'm so glad you are  here 
Pull up a chair  Stay a while 
---
**What Happened Why Did I Leave?
You deserve to know the truth  no sugar coating,  No excuses,  Just honesty.
The truth is, I stepped away because I needed to grow i needed to learn  I needed to figure out what I actually believed what I wanted to say and how I wanted to say it.
When I started this journey, I was excited but also insecure
 I felt like I had to be an expert right away  i  felt like I had to have all the answers I felt like I couldn't make mistakes or admit when I didn't know something.
So I shared a lot of information recipes, tips, science facts but i wasn't sharing me,  I was hiding behind the content  i was afraid to be vulnerable, afraid to be wrong afraid to be imperfect.
Over time, that became exhausting  i felt like I was performing instead of connecting i  felt like I was giving advice without truly understanding my own philosophy i  felt like I was running on empty So I stepped back i  took time to study, I dive deeper into microbiology and nutrition science i read books, attended workshops go back to school and had long conversations with mentors.
 I experimented in the kitchen sometimes successfully, sometimes disastrously I worked with a few people one-on-one and learned from their experiences. I made mistakes. I had breakthroughs  I cried, I celebrated and somewhere in that process, I realized something important that I'm about to share.
I wasn't ready to show up before.
I was sharing information yes But I wasn't sharing my heart and that's what YOU deserve.
So this time, I'm showing up differently. I'm showing up as the full person the cook, the scientist, the student, the human who sometimes burns dinner and sometimes cries over a failed recipe. 
The person who is still learning but deeply passionate about helping others the person who doesn't have all the answers but is committed to finding them alongside you
---
**What's Changed About Me?
Let me tell you what's different now. Because a lot has changed, and I want you to know exactly who you're welcoming back.
---
1. I Have a Clearer Philosophy
Back then, I was still figuring out what I believed  I bounced between different approaches unsure of my own voice now I know now I'm certain.
---
Eat to beat disease our slogan 
Not to beat the scale not to fit into smaller clothes not to impress anyone at a reunion  But to fight inflammation, support your gut, balance your blood sugar, and protect your long term health. 
Every meal is an opportunity either you're feeding disease or you're fighting it  there's no neutral ground.
This philosophy isn't about deprivation It's about abundance  It's about adding more color, more flavor, more nutrients, more life to your plate. It's about loving yourself enough to nourish your body well.
2. I Understand the Science Better
My background in microbiology has become the foundation of everything I do. I understand how food communicates with your cells, i understand the gut brain connection i understand why inflammation is the root of so many chronic illnesses diabetes, heart disease, autoimmune conditions, and more.
I'm not just guessing anymore  I'm not just following trends  I'm applying real science to real lives, and I've seen it work.
3. I'm a Better Cook
I've spent countless hours in the kitchen experimenting with new ingredients, flavors, and techniques. I've learned how to make healthy food taste genuinely incredible
No more boring salads no more bland chicken no more flavorless meals that leave you feeling deprived. 
We are talking vibrant, spiced, comforting, satisfying meals that nourish your body and soul.
I've also learned to work with local, affordable ingredients,  You don't need expensive supplements or exotic superfoods to be healthy all you need is  real food prepared with love and intention.
4. I'm More Honest
I used to feel like I had to be an expert with all the answers i used to be afraid to admit when I didn't know something now I know that's not true.
I'm still learning,  i still have questions, i still make mistakes, snd that's okay. 
I will rather be honest with you than pretend to know everything. 
I will rather say i don't know  let me find out than give you a half truth.
You deserve honesty and I'm ready to give it.
5. I Have a Framework
I've developed a simple system I call the 5 Pillar Method It guides everything I do and I will be sharing it with you in the coming weeks.
But here's a quick preview
· Pillar 1: Know Your Body  You are unique. Your genetics, stress, sleep, and environment all matter.
· Pillar 2: Fight Inflammation Chronic inflammation is the root of most disease We cool it with nutrient dense foods.
· Pillar 3: Heal Your Gut Health begins in the digestive system  feed your good bacteria.
· Pillar 4: Balance Blood Sugar  Stable energy, clear thinking, and better moods come from steady blood sugar.
· Pillar 5: Build Sustainable Habits  no extremes no quick fixes  Just small changes that last.
---
***What You Can Expect From Me Going Forward
So here's what I'm committing to this is my promise to you.
° Honest conversations no sugar coating, no false promises, no exaggeration Just real talk.

° Practical tips things you can actually do in your real, busy, imperfect life not unrealistic expectations.
°Delicious recipes food that tastes amazing and supports your health  Because healthy shouldn't mean boring.
° Science simplified I will break down the research so you can understand it and apply it.
°Community support we're in this together. I will  always respond to your questions and celebrate our wins.
°Vulnerability I will share my struggles, my mistakes, and my wins. I'll be real with you.
°Consistency I'm not disappearing again. I'm here for the long haul.
I can't do this alone this is a community, and communities work best when everyone participates.
So I have a small favor to ask🙏
Tell me about you🤲
What is  your biggest health struggle right now?
 What questions do you have about food and nutrition? What would you love to learn more about? What's one thing you wish someone would explain clearly?
Comment, engage in my blog reply to this post I genuinely want to know.
Your questions will shape what I share moving forwar, this isn't just about me talking it's about us having a conversation. It's about building something together
Thank you for having me back 🙏

>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiE3rKMTGRNMHtXAiEAeiNt7T1gPVCSuLxpVbHH4MeMv/re_zero_stair.png)

Season 4 begins with Emilia and Subaru's group, along with \

and her knight Julius, preparing to go to the desert after the wise man, looking for some answers. After the events in the city of Pristella, with several people transformed into giant flies and one into a giant dragon, there was no one who knew how to save these people, so they were frozen until an answer was discovered, this is the first reason.\n\nIn addition to the reason to save people, in Subaru's case he seeks the Sage's knowledge to solve the problem of Rem, who had everyone's memory of her erased and was in a \

state, still alive, but in a type of deep sleep. A similar reason is what moves Julius to find the wise man, because in his case, everyone's memory has disappeared, but he still remembers. Finally there is \

, which is in quotes because it is actually revealed that, due to the battle against the archbishops, the artificial spirit Echidna took control of Anastasia's body and is unable to return it to the original owner. I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

>

## Re Zero Season 4 - The Stairs!
It's very curious to think that they are all going to one of the most dangerous places in the work, where no one was successful and they didn't have any more \

to follow in the story. After all, Subaru has limited mana to use Beatrice's powers, Julius can't use the spirit's powers, Echidna can't use magic if she doesn't end up using Anastasia's life. The worst of all is that they decide to take Rem, who cannot move, to a place where there is no information and that not even Reinhard could find. A very complicated situation.

All this preparation for the desert was basically very strange and full of plot holes, like why didn't they wait for Reinhard to escort the archbishop and then ask for help so he could travel to the tower to find the Sage? Why take Rem on this trip, which ended up being a major source of concern for Ram and Subaru?
<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5QC5RYcmTTjWrwrMaP1JaspCw3zVBQKq6if3G54MLiP/stair.gif) </center>
<center>[Source: Re Zero Season 4]</center>

It's as if they were betting all their chips on a game that they don't even know the rules of. And this is quite literal, because upon arriving at the tower there were several rules that could not be broken, not to mention a hidden rule that has not yet been disclosed in the anime. All of this ends up being the reasons that lead to one of the worst arcs in history for Subaru.

Before even arriving at the tower, the protagonist already returns 2 to 3 times. And when he enters he manages to pass the first challenge easily, but then when he finds the guardian it seems to be a wall with no option to pass. The worst thing is that in order to try to win the room with guardian Reid, Subaru has the brilliant idea of ​​finding the book and soon after appears without the memories of everything he went through in the world of rezero. With a little more history we come to the famous staircase scene, in which after being pushed down the stairs, Subaru no longer trusts anyone and finds himself ready to discover the truth through the books of the dead!

<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTcerA49b4DkDefiL9JgApL6fNHcAMbsHJ3SH6bjUaDpa/image.png) </center>
<center>[Source: Re Zero Season 4]</center>

This is one of the moments in which Subaru found itself in such despair that it is precisely an IF point. In the IF story of gluttony, Subaru is consumed by the sin of gluttony which would be the desire to know the truth by devouring the memories of his companions and to do so he decides to kill everyone who knew the \
... --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiE3rKMTGRNMHtXAiEAeiNt7T1gPVCSuLxpVbHH4MeMv/re_zero_stair.png)

A season 4 de começa com o grupo da emilia e do subaru, junto da \

e do cavaleiro dela o Julius, se preparando para ir até o deserto atrás do sábio, buscando algumas respostas. Depois dos acontecimentos na cidade de Pristella, com diversas pessoas transformadas em moscas gigantes e uma em um dragão gigante, não havia ninguém que soubesse como salvar essas pessoas, por isso elas foram congeladas até que uma resposta fosse descoberta, essa é o primeiro motivo. \n\nAlém do motivo de salvar as pessoas, no caso do Subaru ele busca o conhecimento do Sábio para que resolvesse o problema da Rem, que teve a memória de todos sobre ela apagada e estava em um estado \

, ainda viva, mas em um tipo de sono profundo. Um motivo parecido é o que move o Julius para encontrar o sábio, porque em seu caso, a memória de todos desapareceu, mas ele ainda se lembra. Por fim tem a \

, que está entre aspas porque na verdade é revelado que na verdade, por conta da batalha contra os arcebispos, o espírito artificial Echidna assumiu o controle do corpo da Anastasia e não consegue devolver para a dona original. Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

>

## Re Zero Season 4 - The Stairs!
É bem curioso pensar que todos eles estão indo para um dos lugares mais perigosos da obra, em que ninguém teve êxito e não levaram mais nenhum \

para acompanhar na história. Afinal o Subaru tem mana limitada para usar os poderes da Beatrice, o Julius não pode usar os poderes do espírito, a Echidna não pode usar magia se não acaba utilizando a vida da Anastasia. O pior de tudo é que eles resolvem levar a Rem que não pode se mexer para um lugar que não se tem nenhuma informação e que nem mesmo o Reinhard conseguiu. Uma situação bem complicada.

Todo esse preparo para o deserto foi basicamente bem estranho e cheio de furos de roteiro, como porque não esperaram o Reinhard escoltar a arcebispa e depois pediram ajuda para ele ir na viagem até a torre encontrar o Sábio? Porque levar a Rem nessa viagem, que acabou sendo uma grande fonte de preocupação para a Ram e o Subaru?
<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5QC5RYcmTTjWrwrMaP1JaspCw3zVBQKq6if3G54MLiP/stair.gif) </center>
<center>[Source: Re Zero Season 4]</center>

É como se eles estivessem apostando todas as fichas em um jogo que não sabem nem as regras. E isso é bem literal, porque ao chegar na torre tinham várias regras que não podiam ser quebras, sem contar uma regra oculta que ainda não foi divulgada no anime. Tudo isso acaba sendo os motivos que levam para um dos piores arcos da história para o Subaru.

Antes mesmo de chegar na torre o protagonista já volta umas 2 à 3 vezes. E ao entrar ele consegue passar do primeiro desafio facilmente, mas depois quando encontram o guardião parece ser uma muralha sem opção para passar. O pior é que para tentar conquistar o andar com o guardião Reid, o Subaru tem a brilhante ideia de encontrar o livro e logo depois aparece sem as memórias de tudo que passou no mundo de rezero. Com mais um pouco de história chegamos na famosa cena da escada, em que depois de empurrado da escada, Subaru não confia mais em ninguém e se vê pronto para descobrir a verdade através dos livros dos mortos! 

<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTcerA49b4DkDefiL9JgApL6fNHcAMbsHJ3SH6bjUaDpa/image.png) </center>
<center>[Source: Re Zero Season 4]</center>

Esse é um dos momentos em que o Subaru se encontrou em um desespero tão grande que é justamente um ponto de IF. Na história do IF da gula, Subaru é consumido pelo pecado da gula que seria a vontade de saber a verdade devorando as memórias dos companheiros e para isso ele resolve matar todos que conheciam o \

... ---

body.title: Una noche de fútbol y amigos
body.body:
![1000298414.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/23tmBKjTuuh2tmtVQZd25pcfqngnfffqUxysSPXTuNPwhMbn6VA4m21EbdLgqd8cJp3PQ.png)


# Una noche de fútbol, amigos y un gato muy entretenido

Hay noches que no necesitan grandes planes para convertirse en recuerdos especiales. Hace unos días tuvimos la oportunidad de visitar a unos amigos para ver juntos el partido entre Ecuador y Costa de Marfil. Desde que llegamos, el ambiente era perfecto: buena compañía, conversación, risas y la emoción de un partido que prometía mantenernos atentos hasta el último minuto.


![1000298407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/EpEKHbo9kL4agjQvnodmrwUoU46AbyMPWaxsabid3F8tJvjiFbZXpcJaPNCVbaGBzyF.jpg)


Como buena aficionada, yo iba apoyando a Ecuador. Durante todo el encuentro mantuve la esperanza de ver a mi equipo conseguir la victoria. El partido estuvo bastante disputado y por momentos parecía que terminaría empatado. Cada jugada generaba comentarios, opiniones y alguna que otra predicción entre los que estábamos reunidos frente al televisor.

Pero el fútbol no fue el único protagonista de la noche. Sobre la mesa nos esperaba una merienda sencilla y deliciosa: chocolate caliente acompañado de pan. Es de esas combinaciones que hacen que cualquier reunión se sienta más acogedora. Mientras disfrutábamos de la comida y seguíamos cada jugada del partido, apareció otro personaje que terminó robándose gran parte de nuestra atención.


![1000298408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/EoK5pZu4VYjZu1FYCJKv7QPR1zHweiRfW9qP975FnWBG2SxMjHNazA9f4U7E3hV3c6P.jpg)

El gato de la casa decidió que él también quería participar en la reunión. Desde el principio mostró un interés muy particular por todo lo que ocurría. Primero intentó acercarse al chocolate, como si estuviera convencido de que también le correspondía una taza. Después comenzó a investigar la mesa, los vasos y todo lo que encontraba a su alrededor.


![1000298410.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/23wfqyvZ7zPL4Bnx4mfDJbqC39g87V2dxM1xW4a94RDHWeRaXt3C5P9gL54vpY5BGz3BG.jpg)

Sin embargo, lo más divertido fue verlo interactuar con el televisor. Cada vez que aparecía movimiento en la pantalla, el gato se quedaba observando con una concentración impresionante. En varios momentos se levantó sobre sus patas traseras e intentó atrapar a los jugadores y al balón que veía moverse frente a él. Parecía convencido de que realmente podía alcanzarlos. Sus saltos, movimientos y expresiones provocaron más de una carcajada entre todos los presentes.


![1000298409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/Ep7vXv81VBvPHZUkk29mnQF1DeTDGo4GBXQ6cHDP636uj12xsFJQUQ1ikU7EB2gb56f.jpg)


Cuando el partido parecía encaminado a un empate, llegó el momento más inesperado de la noche. Casi al final del encuentro, Costa de Marfil consiguió marcar el único gol del partido y terminó llevándose la victoria por 1 a 0. Aunque me dio un poco de tristeza por Ecuador, fue imposible no reconocer que había sido un final emocionante.

Al final, más allá del resultado, lo que quedó fue el recuerdo de una noche agradable entre amigos, compartiendo chocolate, pan, conversaciones y las ocurrencias de un gato que, sin proponérselo, terminó siendo la verdadera estrella del partido. ⚽🐈☕🥖

Hola, amigos, nuevamente estoy aquí para participar en otro encuentro de talentos. Esta vez nuestra amiga @angelica7 nos invita a participar con un tema muy ardiente; se titula El fuego. El fuego es el elemento que nos acompaña todos los días en casa, en el amor a través de la pasión y en la amistad, que es la luz que nos reconforta. Sí, amigos, así es este elemento, lleno de cambios y transformación.

El fuego es energía, es transformación y nuestro poder; tiene un gran secreto que nos ayuda a impulsar en la vida. El fuego representa la fuerza vital y la renovación espiritual; es el que nos lleva a ir más allá de los límites, por eso debemos controlarlo. Cuando hablo del fuego, recuerdo una frase que siempre escuchaba en las personas y yo también la repetía: \

, y esto lo decían para que uno no se involucrara en situaciones imprudentes. De verdad que el fuego ha estado en nuestra vida desde que nacemos, y pienso que es muy peligroso, ya que tiene un poder muy grande que puede destruir, pero así mismo como destruye, también tiene el poder de transformar y de hacernos cambiar; él es el que nos ayuda a limpiar, el que nos hace cambiar y nos ayuda a renacer desde sus cenizas. Ahora déjenme decirles que pertenezco al signo zodiacal Sagitario, un signo que representa el signo de fuego. Me identifico mucho con este signo, ya que es fuerte y muy poderoso; aunque es aventurero, yo no lo soy, ya que no me gusta arriesgarme mucho, pero sí pienso que mi mayor aventura es la que se ha desarrollado en mi interior. Y les puedo decir que brillo con mi fuego del amor, cuando comparto con la familia, cuando preparo los platos que más me gustan y, lo más importante, cuando encuentro esa fuerza interior para superar todo lo que me depara la vida y mis miedos. Ese es mi elemento fuego, el que me ayuda a tener fuerza, el que me da la luz y el que me hace brillar cada día de mi vida. También les puedo decir que el fuego es un compañero de mi día a día, ya que cada vez que estoy en la cocina, enciendo el fuego y hace que todos mis ingredientes se transformen en unos deliciosos platos, y eso hace que mi hogar se llene de aromas que encienden toda la casa y abrazan el alma. El fuego es la llama que enciende la unión familiar, es el símbolo del calor fraternal, del amor. Es por eso que esa llama no se debe terminar, así que siempre esta llama debe estar encendida, iluminando nuestros días. Así pues, amigos, mantengamos viva esa chispa de amor, amistad y vida. Incluso cuando la vida nos plantee retos difíciles, seamos como el fénix que renace de sus cenizas; no perdamos el ánimo: debemos seguir avanzando sin mirar atrás. Recordemos que somos como el oro: resplandeciente y purificador. Mantengamos siempre viva esa chispa de amor, esperanza y fe. Gracias por leerme y por visitarme. Hasta la próxima.

body.title: A SPEAKING GENERATION.... IT'S POSSIBLE IN THE ABSENCE OF FEAR!
body.body:
This is a noble call 🤙, and moment to be outspoken about the necessity around and within our environment.
Being silent out of fear won't help at any point.

![IMG_20260516_073503_541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKiSaX5EboeRhjNeM4yLHaYrsExrpenBRjmb9t42XY4QFTgt9PS1MFmRK4q6wBq.jpg)


When children are grown, fathers do not need to speak. As it is written in Psalm 127:4, children are like arrows in the hands of a mighty man...meant to be released, not kept idle. Christians, it is time to grow.

There is a clear contrast between light and darkness, and darkness must not be allowed to overthrow light. 

The Christian youth are meant to be arrows that fathers shoot into territories... stop waiting for fathers to speak. 

Consider Moses... he did not go into every battle himself; he raised and sent the children of Israel. Even when King David desired to go to battle, there were times the people restrained him, recognizing the need for order and preservation.

The children are the ones who should stand at the gates and speak against the enemy.
But we must be honest... we have not grown.Children who wait for fathers to do what they themselves ought to do have not matured.

![IMG-20260525-WA0058.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/243M35KpM1gJ3zmnW2HEfufdGVUWxETtxsd9dmmtUDNbVaQkBDB4PwkwhdnVNazdNfgLQ.jpeg)


 According to Ephesians 4:11, fathers are given to equip the saints, not to replace them. When fathers are still doing all the speaking, it is either because the children are still young, or they are not yet grown into responsibility.

We must all be ready to sacrifice for the Gospel. It's a sacrificial mandate.

A prophet speaks before the problem arises; when the problem comes, he reminds the people of what he has already spoken. Thank God for all who is speaking in recent times. 

Today, we see a strange pattern...children trying to correct fathers .

Most believers  focused on personal gain than on God’s agenda. Many are concerned only with what they can receive from God, not what they can give for His Kingdom.

How many Christians truly pray for the Body of Christ? How many will attend a meeting where they will be taught how to lay down their life for the gospel? No way, it always about them, for them to show up in Christian gathering. 

The call is clear:
The Church must grow.
The Christian youth must arise, and every believer must take responsibility for the advancement and defense of the Gospel.

This sweet looking writing from your handsome friend John Petra emanate from a Burdened spirit for the Saint globally. Please read and share the knowledge.

Peace 🕊️ and love 💕

Muy feliz martes, saludos a todos los miembros de la comunidad en general, espero tengan un buen día y que esta semana sea bendecida en salud y prosperidad, en esta oportunidad me encuentro con ustedes para compartir una idea creativa con limpiapipas. Esta semana ha sido cargada para mí ya que me encuentro en evaluaciones finales de la uni pero aún así me ha alcanzado el tiempo para terminar esta manualidad.

>Happy Tuesday! Greetings to all members of the community. I hope you have a wonderful day and that this week is blessed with health and prosperity. Today I'm here to share a creative idea using pipe cleaners. This week has been busy for me as I'm in the middle of my final exams at university, but I still managed to find the time to finish this craft.



![Pinzas de margaritas_20260616_191017_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcyXnaAHq3NjEVXzk9iG4U57H4xiGG1aaScoGCVCK6oSW/Pinzas%20de%20margaritas_20260616_191017_0000.jpg)





Les comparto un llavero de guitarra inspirado en la carta de Taye Loreswift del juego Splinterlands, este personaje lleva una guitarra y con su música cautiva al público, es súper fácil de realizar así que te invito a que le eches un vistazo a este tutorial.




>I'm sharing a guitar keychain inspired by Taye Loreswift's card from the game Splinterlands. This character carries a guitar and captivates audiences with his music. It's super easy to make, so I invite you to check out this tutorial.


<center>
![Taye Loreswift.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYYvkRqQNTkpohm1R3BVRkDSYkJzev5xiu7u9Rur1Bh82/Taye%20Loreswift.jpg)
[Taye Loreswift](https://splinterlands.com/card-detail/793/regular/14/?tab=lore) 
</center>


Este tipo de llavero es una buena idea para obsequiar a una persona especial, y aquí te enseño a realizarlo en pocos pasos, a continuación los materiales, espero les guste y puedan intentarlo en algún momento.


>This type of keychain is a great gift idea for someone special, and here I'll show you how to make it in a few steps. Below are the materials. I hope you like it and can try it sometime.


<center>
![ezgif-58b342d716f643de.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZUrarb5SkneYHKnsKvKTjEPwTFirfvtCgVFujHwYHu9M/ezgif-58b342d716f643de.gif)
</center>

![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)



| Materiales | Materials|
| --------|---------|
| Limpiapipas marrón, piel, negro, beige |Brown pipe cleaners, leather, black, beige |
| Tijera, silicón |Scissors, silicone|
| Cartón |Cardboard|
| Aro para llavero |Keychain ring|
| Encendedor| Lighter|
| Sombras, marcadores | Shadows, markers|


![1001568997.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23w2sLvpTvF4W6Xmehbuvfw6k9Zi1GTXDMdup1t5SFgxw9zK3ppwH6XnLqoYkTNz9oX2s.jpg)


![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)



### *Paso a paso / Step by step*
#



El primer paso que vamos a realizar será realizar la forma de la guitarra sobre un cuadro de cartón, luego recortamos por separado ambas piezas para forma la guitarra.

>The first step we will take is to draw the shape of the guitar on a piece of cardboard, then we will cut out both pieces separately to form the guitar.


|![1001569076.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23w2s4akjA2hzTB6rUKgDeRQ7nDMBfRJqj92cSzvDTsRNeB4FBRhyVx4JV2gvtmqGyiUY.jpg)|![1001569082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQxbUpwenHsSRynCD3SsF6Hv2aWGVKY5U56TtA8fokW8jcY4FhgzrWzKEbqE9RcfBnk.jpg)|
|-|-|




Voy a seleccionar el limpiapipas color piel y empezamos a pegar sobre el cuerpo de la guitarra, cubrimos toda la figura. En este punto se me fue la luz y tuve que continuar con el silicón líquido pero no me gusta mucho para el limpiapipas ya que tarda en pegar.


>I'm going to select the skin-colored pipe cleaner and we'll start gluing it onto the guitar body, covering the entire shape. At this point, the power went out, and I had to continue with liquid silicone, but I don't really like it for pipe cleaners because it takes a long time to bond.


|![1001569131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFa9GBovazHGUHNNAQrwvjxFvcHq3h1gkC7MP1TsZ24g3nUzWrpHmLeANiasQ5K9WC5.jpg)|![1001569137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQxePYmMrGVuhAv1LHkoe1nBzrkpqdN4CuJNsiAoXbss5TYym9J1tXDLTiBYQwDHX4L.jpg)|![1001569167.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmQ5i56ufHaB2HfYiGVk9ZRi9St4UEQJhWndUPP5rMTHjc5nrHhvVrvXS3GSDUYftyT.jpg)|
|-|-|-|





Ahora vamos con la segunda parte que será cubierta con limpiapipas color marrón oscuro, pegamos al cuerpo de la guitarra, en el centro también colocamos un círculo del mismo color.



Puedes cubrir el borde con limpiapipas marrón, ahora tomaré el limpiapipas negro, rebajamos la pelusa, y cortamos en tres partes para formar las cuerdas.



>Now we'll move on to the second part, which will be covered with dark brown pipe cleaners. We'll glue them to the guitar body, and in the center, we'll also place a circle of the same color.

>You can cover the edge with brown pipe cleaners. Now I'll take the black pipe cleaner, trim off the fuzz, and cut it into three pieces to form the strings.


|![1001569689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23xAgZcrtF8fghQdbn4juzpua3MMEkb1m1MYjFB7P8oxn5M6kNryYjeQCRtYq3QwzgwZy.jpg)|![1001569759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wgWTF2XCGQo8Kvteh1fWrvnFz9b1D9Q7ffFueHCc9Hc8icSRdnAt6GAHUubrESEuNz8.jpg)|![1001569815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wCFwPLm91R9CtPXoJtN9twDeyG63Sb8GjC88oYpqPu3CKSgPntRtjdgCjVnJsjsEhs6.jpg)|
|-|-|-|





Agregamos los detalles sencillos que lleva la guitarra, con limpiapipas marrón y dorado, en la parte superior vamos a utilizar limpiapipas color marrón claro para formar lo que sería las clavijas. Puedes rebajar la pelusa con un encendedor, y con marcador color marrón claro pinte un poco el limpiapipas para dar este tono.


>We added the simple details to the guitar using brown and gold pipe cleaners. On the top, we used light brown pipe cleaners to form the tuning pegs. You can smooth down any fuzz with a lighter, and then lightly color the pipe cleaners with a light brown marker to achieve this shade.


|![1001569844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23z7N16rjUGXGyTrRXmGuvjNLVbt9YPoRTdktyBXLa6YmMffrfRKzsV8A2pgzBKfPBGgG.jpg)|![1001569847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23xpF5pyYXwbw6CsYYVEbCGVjuViBQYKKg9mB3yPAmxoeBhr4nyS62tTwuACk9wkPpeyu.jpg)|![1001569878.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23y94KUQZs1JtWxhcwJQtLmDfQMN1YY4HF9cMHZW98Ks84iVgVnbN4hK4SL9R5a6M8RwF.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Cómo último paso será aplicar un sombreado marrón claro en el borde del limpiapipas color piel, y rebajar un poco la pelusa del borde marrón. Y listo, puedes quitar el exceso de silicón y pelusa con la tijera y con adhesivo y se verá más limpia tu figura.


>As a final step, apply a light brown shade to the edge of the skin-colored pipe cleaner and trim the fuzz from the brown edge. And that's it! You can remove any excess silicone and fuzz with scissors and glue for a cleaner look.


|![1001569894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wMh2cAjMGitgbdSMPDqnVjBEjEqzYYKpWqfCos9nQV8HR3jY4UzGXSF69orincicwTL.jpg)|![1001570110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23ywyJNrPcJcFvX1anTR56hVBv2Q9fdj3kLC1BgjTGmXu198UMtJze9XypxQUv8XQowqW.jpg)|
|-|-|



De esta forma terminé esta linda guitarra inspirada en Taye Loreswift, espero les haya gustado el resultado, muchas gracias por el apoyo y por visitar mi publicación, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad con más ideas creativas.

>This is how I finished this lovely guitar inspired by Taye Loreswift. I hope you liked the result. Thank you so much for your support and for visiting my post. See you next time with more creative ideas.


![1001572444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/Eos1p2TVzdezywpP6zpmNNRrhxeVQPyJmnAu7xPeJeWrLr4GeX79miXGvvtgD7442mq.jpg)




Más del resultado final:

>More on the final result:



![1001572448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23z7FbTwouiuis9aZCgTJ5zQDYNJH5Nqme7WNyCfRzgHePdZZiuLpFAL6rsVTWx87FHHh.jpg)

![1001572468.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wCLEBAp6q2Momg4FDg6kxdE5n3Nt4HerVfuBvRqQVAZ69RtY1QuNKwHubRZY6m8jsT7.jpg)

![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


![1000095868.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWG8Jt6SU3neCCGF5ZCDw8KzpFGS63KR5cYgcCEoKEYgi/1000095868.png)

body.title: Crypto Rails Meet TradFi Assets: Gate Integrates Over 1,000 Hong Kong Equities
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT7AmiRVwAchCZ8xDnmN9TyyUcBRUNMvvewAzC7GD3Du9/trade.png 


The convergence between virtual asset platforms and traditional equity markets has reached an aggressive milestone. Gate has officially launched its Hong Kong stock trading functionality within its ecosystem, onboarding over 1,000 Hong Kong-listed equities in its primary phase. This expansion allows crypto-native participants to allocate capital directly into heavyweights listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX), including Tencent Holdings, Xiaomi Group, Meituan, and BYD, alongside banking institutions like HSBC Holdings.

The technical architecture integrates these Hong Kong equities into a unified stock account system previously used for U.S. shares. This structural decision provides users with centralized portfolio management, profit-and-loss inquiries, and consolidated historical records directly from the application. However, experienced market allocators must evaluate the structural constraints carefully. Unlike the 24/7 continuous settlement cycles of crypto assets, this product line strictly supports intraday trading during standard market hours, completely excluding pre-market and after-hours execution. Furthermore, pricing structures, asset valuations, and realized PnL are denominated natively in Hong Kong Dollars (HKD), meaning investors carry an underlying foreign exchange risk as trading fees are dynamically converted based on live rates.

This development highlights an intense race among centralized exchanges to dominate Real World Asset (RWA) frameworks and traditional equity structures. Competitors have taken multiple structural paths: some utilize Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) to package pre-IPO tokens, others deploy tokenized IPO allocations backed by 1:1 physical share custody without giving direct shareholder voting rights, while certain exchange configurations operate on contingent payment notes with minimal disclosure regarding underlying hedging exposure. Gate’s strategy focuses on building a unified, compliant cross-market investment channel to capture capital that would otherwise exit back to legacy brokerages. In analyzing this transition, investors must decouple their expectations from typical decentralized finance yields. Investing in multi-billion dollar enterprises via an exchange wrapper demands strict risk management surrounding traditional equity liquidity, regulatory compliance boundaries, and systemic exposure to regional economic shifts, rather than the volatile speculative patterns driven by community sentiment in standard altcoin markets.

Source : [bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/from-tencent-to-byd-gate-adds-massive-hong-kong-equity-portfolio-for-crypto-investors/)

body.title: 16 June 2026 @marinnewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 3136: Unnatural Cruelty.
body.body:
![1000801167.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ubglo17/23u5taqDJzcyc13NJ3iUcMCeKqXgnqKtVbMgBRSr5EFm88Zk2ELpc7CZH9JWNWuSS4iFZ.jpg)[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/clown-scaring-a-terrified-boy-5427383)
This is my post on #freewriters3136 #dailyprompt unnatural cruelty hosted by @marinnewest's.
The harmattan wind rattled the rusted corrugated sheets of the shack, but it was the silence inside that chilled Enobong to the bone. Her stepmother, Nneka, stood by the kerosene stove, her shadow stretching like a jagged blade across the uneven dirt floor.
​Enobong stood trembling, her hands behind her back, hiding the bowl she had accidentally chipped while washing. It was a fragile, ceramic relic—the only thing left of her mother.
​\

Nneka commanded, her voice devoid of heat, sounding like gravel grinding against glass.\n​When Enobong hesitated, Nneka didn't shout. She didn't strike out in a fit of rage. Instead, she moved with terrifying, surgical precision. She reached into the bubbling pot of pepper soup, snatched a long, metal stirring spoon, and held it over the open flame until the tip glowed a dull, punishing orange.\n​\
Nneka whispered, her eyes devoid of mercy, \

\n​She grabbed Enobong’s wrist. The heat radiating from the iron felt like the breath of a furnace. There was no theatrical cruelty, only the cold, calculated intent to leave a permanent mark of ownership upon the child’s skin. As the metal hissed against flesh, the room smelled of burning hair and scorched innocence. Nneka did not blink. She watched, satisfied, as Enobong’s scream died in her throat, extinguished by the sheer, unnatural void of a woman who had long ago traded her own soul for the exercise of absolute power.

body.title: Qurator's: Hive Top Chef! | Healthy | Stuffed Lettuce Rolls
body.body:
<center>

![1781648285838.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVV67ufk6wH1Mq5KnFHZetqd86xyzYNAbmzrNQpuwwtP9/1781648285838.jpg)

</center>

<hr>

_<div class=\

>Greetings dear friends, welcome to my blog. Today I am once again joining the weekly contest [Qurator's: Hive Top Chef! | Healthy]( https://hive.blog/qurator/@qurator/qurators-hive-top-chef-or-healthy). Eating healthy is one of my priorities, especially when I get back from a workout. For weeks now, I've been wanting to make some lettuce wraps—something like a rolled-up sandwich, but without bread or other carbs. Although I saw similar recipes online, I added my own personal touch, which never fails._
![1781648285916.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT4h8umh1aEz7KsDUVcuuAwz2rk7xtGSDWNCU1ke1L2QQ/1781648285916.jpg)

>I made this dish for dinner; it’s low in calories, simple, and above all, very nutritious. In addition to lettuce, which is rich in fiber and water, this wrap contains good sources of protein, such as chicken and eggs. I’ve also included monounsaturated fats that lower bad cholesterol—in other words, good fats. I added tomato to give it a bit of acidity. You can put many different ingredients in this wrap; I chose these ones, making sure not to use too many so it would roll up easily.<div>

<hr>

<div class=\

> Although I decided to separate the lettuce leaves to make it easier to roll, I think it would have been better to leave them as they were. Let me know how it turns out when you try it.<div>

<hr>



## Ingredients

<hr>

<div class=\
>- 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour\n
>- 90 grams of romaine lettuce\n
>- 175 grams of chicken breast fillet\n
>- 50 grams of tomato\n
>- 115 grams of avocado\n
>- 2 eggs\n
>- 1 teaspoon of white vinegar\n

>- Salt to taste
![1781648286013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQm177LoVNudgN4yFW3EC8jLZqjfkfCD2EJrRWVfSZpa/1781648286013.jpg)
![1781648286000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNNSPbq1PErtiXpvufxMYXe6arjPPoNsi88QDqz6A55xZ/1781648286000.jpg)
#### Preparation

>1.- Wash the lettuce and let it soak in a teaspoon of white vinegar for 15 minutes to disinfect it. After 15 minutes, wash it again to remove the vinegar, then separate the leaves. Set aside.
![1781648285890.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbrBU5aegebUc2tJC2Fsi7mjm9vFq8LvFU1gZRdVutxRR/1781648285890.jpg)

>2.- Boil the eggs for 8 minutes and let them cool to room temperature.
![1781648285986.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQBqzKuo48TyffERNYdxNdHqFqzPuFV3Yuoba97qMZJas/1781648285986.jpg)

>3.- Season the chicken breast fillets with salt to taste. Cook them in their own juices until they are slightly browned. Once they have cooled to room temperature, cut them into small pieces. Set aside.
![1781648285900.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWQWeDsihycJzokGBmYc1LfKRo9Mg1xsgVPFGXviUR28z/1781648285900.jpg)
![1781648285941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EoGzRMJUHH17wKJbUcEpmRdhwuhAyFJKZaTfEn2uUqDokuhWgtjJRyvw3WsqxBhETzR.jpg)

>4.- Wash the tomato, remove the seeds, and cut it into cubes. Cut the avocado into cubes as well. Set aside.
![1781648285862.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcJ4yQoQcAksUXrVMXCuRQjbiadahVZ7AwAk5xrgUSxvZ/1781648285862.jpg)
![1781648285851.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWNXAMJeMTUsNK13kQMMpWf8YCJ1mYEMXk2v93Pu9HbN3/1781648285851.jpg)

body.title: Saving a little bird storytime - Show Me A Photo Contest Round 275
body.body:
<div class=text-justify> One night I noticed something unusual: a small bird perched on a branch near the busy street. It caught my attention because these little birds usually sleep at night.

---

So I carefully picked it up, and when it didn't resist, it was obvious to me that something was wrong. From that night on, I did what I could to save it.


<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center> 


![435CBC40-48B5-4908-9D95-D28A04C28AF3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kitzune/23xVK5QYwocddFtPuFaTVKRwNwFA2tCTmteHxFBrY2HiDHmL7vSC1AMC6CJL64SZdz9Po.JPG)


<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center>

I thought it was a chick, although even now I'm not 100% sure if it was a baby bird or an adult. I fed it fruit puree and gave it water with a syringe. On the second day, it was much more lively, fluttering and singing, but it still didn't look completely well.

On the third and fourth days, it declined again. Even though it was eating well, I could see its health deteriorating. Nevertheless, I cared for it for about four days.


<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center> 

![355B05AD-D070-4A89-9E9C-AF7C0FD47778.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kitzune/23wCGSpVweEbdVfuEyHcZ4rYyGfXm2DGqyzScmbunGZyf8qhZAtxp7Wgudr2syxWRSTB5.JPG)

<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center>


![IMG_5064.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kitzune/242DNNiNcXtFJG4ENaqxcg1YhCxAFYndkTrR9YJEokwq3iX3CYjrjBZ5pe2KVogUzWTNP.jpeg)


I kept it in a small cage, and in the afternoons, I placed it on the windowsill. On his last day, he sat at the window for a while, singing peacefully as the breeze blew. He gazed up at the sky and the trees.

His energy was lower than usual, but he still seemed lively. By late afternoon, he couldn't hold on any longer; he grew weaker and his chirping grew softer and softer. I held him in my hands until it passed away.

<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center> 



![IMG_5074.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kitzune/23wMf2ty2zpHCfUSvLYT1opBjHXPx5EMEP53muc5rNjL6ADbEo9ofARDGZ7J6BhGfovqY.jpeg)



<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center>

It was a sad moment. I placed him on a table and prepared to bury him in the garden. A little while later, before taking him away, I saw a terrible scene that explained the cause of his illness.

Several larvae had emerged from his small body, from an abscess on his neck, which I had noticed before but didn't know what it was.

I assume they were larvae of some kind of fly or other parasitic insect; they even had the color of the food I gave the bird, meaning they were feeding on it directly. Of course, I didn't take any pictures of that moment. I cleaned the area and removed the larvae, then left it in the garden.

Although this is completely natural, including death, it was a sad moment not being able to help this little bird, but at least it had a few last peaceful days instead of dying that one cold night.

<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center> 


![A4CD536F-9F95-4D9C-A5A8-32CDD149849A.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kitzune/23swi66SqwXF6UG5DNB5QBAEYZfh7cP4GPtXvhkf1kUVT9K1hBEqaBVex4mh2tsNWQ8Cv.JPG)


<center> ◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦❀◦</center>

I haven't yet investigated what kind of parasite it had, although it's surely common among many types of birds.

**I'm sorry to share this sad and maybe long story, but I wanted to remember the life of this little bird and how it fought for its life. I wish it could have returned to nature and I could have photographed him in its natural environment and not in my room.**


<center> ![Video Project 2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kitzune/23xyV8urWAPa7cyPgMiC7jk5wXLZkov514ehJuQ6d8dPX9mDGQevV2t7yw4uspiqc7iGi.gif) </divcenter>


*Rest in peace, little friend.* </divcenter>
----

By Kitsune Fer @kitzune 🌸 </center>

body.title: Podaron el árbol de la vereda: ¿Necesidad o Egoismo? / They pruned the tree on the sidewalk: Necessity or Selfishness?
body.body:
<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ8wBrHyTDjTWuvuDuBJkqnKKzWeVdDaDjTFeb6ETgNSe/antes.png</center>


Aunque yo estoy en contra de la deforestación, quema y tala de los árboles, y de todo aquello que implique dañar la naturaleza, he de reconocer que en ciertas circunstancias hay que sopesar los pros y contras de una acción como esta. Y justo hoy me han puesto a prueba en casa.

En la vereda frente al edificio donde vivo, está sembrado un gran e imponente árbol que durante los días de verano es una gran ayuda para con su follaje mantener el departamento bastante fresco, pues cubre prácticamente la mitad del inmueble, sin embargo, al estar tan alto, sus ramas también son sinónimo de riesgos.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXYFKaQcB63UdvzLxU1v8Vqinugkq5zdabR6qrZJAadgw/antes_1_.png</center>

Cuando han habido tormentas con mucho viento, esas mismas ramas han generado cortes eléctricos, pues rozan con los cables y produce que el servicio se interrumpa momentáneamente, lo cual ya era un tanto peligroso. De hecho, en más de una oportunidad, el chispazo lo he visto en primer plano a través de la ventana de la sala o de la pieza. Esta queja se la había hecho saber a la administradora, pero no se tomaban medidas, o simplemente las omitía.

Para mi sorpresa, al llegar a casa al mediodía, unos obreros estaban en el proceso de cortar las ramas que estaban sobre el techo, además de las que colindaban con los cables de electricidad, aprovechando que hay mejor visibilidad por la pérdida del follaje debido al otoño.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmccjAFJToTbQC9xCmtL51AShCAonSfkhM7GrjYbLP9ArT/5012677385551285298.jpg</center>

Y aunque los ruidos de la motosierra, los grandes golpes de las pesadas ramas sobre el techo y el consecuente polvillo y desechos que genera este proceso, se agradece que por fin hayan atendido este problema, antes de que se hiciera algo más peligroso tanto para la estructura como para las personas que vivimos en el edificio o aquellas que pasan por la vereda.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHYkR2rkxumhtjy9U6qdXDnGEeLMFvHFKJ6SLCu5gJsV/5012677385551285301.jpg</center>

Lo único malo fue que al llegar a casa, encontré a mi gatita hecha un mar de nervios por los ruidos, y al verme maullaba de manera extraña, como reclamando el hecho de dejarla sola en medio de todo, pero realmente nadie nos avisó que eso se realizaría hoy, así que la tomé entre mis brazos y la dejé estar en la habitación, donde de inmediato pasó a esconderse debajo de la cama.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzvpdmUC3Qq6a43zmNFLnwGsb3eCNgPFbcVf3EeEYesY/5012677385551285294.jpg</center>

Ahora solo toca esperar a que terminen el trabajo, para proceder con la limpieza, tanto del frente como del balcón, pero más vale eso, que seguir con la incertidumbre de que en cualquier momento pudiéramos pasar un susto o algo peor por culpa de las ramas que se extendieron demasiado sobre el techo del departamento.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmPZXbubwtV62nWi57UayBz9XnQDSmuuaNJHCETsQs855c/5012677385551285296.jpg</center>

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQU8tzfuhBgLVpPoqSvwci2KtMoVmHNbUzPnrj28jtpN9/image.png</center>

Although I am against deforestation, burning, and cutting down trees—and anything else that harms nature—I have to admit that in certain circumstances, we must weigh the pros and cons of an action like this. And just today, I was put to the test at home.

On the sidewalk in front of the building where I live, there’s a large, imposing tree whose foliage helps keep the apartment quite cool during the summer, as it covers practically half the building; however, because it’s so tall, its branches also pose risks.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXYFKaQcB63UdvzLxU1v8Vqinugkq5zdabR6qrZJAadgw/antes_1_.png</center>

During storms with strong winds, those same branches have caused power outages, as they brush against the power lines and cause the service to be momentarily interrupted—which was already somewhat dangerous. In fact, on more than one occasion, I’ve seen the sparks up close through the living room or bedroom window. I had brought this issue to the property manager’s attention, but no action was taken—or perhaps she simply ignored it.

To my surprise, when I got home at noon, some workers were in the process of cutting the branches that were hanging over the roof, as well as those near the power lines, taking advantage of the improved visibility due to the loss of foliage in the fall.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmccjAFJToTbQC9xCmtL51AShCAonSfkhM7GrjYbLP9ArT/5012677385551285298.jpg</center>

And even though there was the noise of the chainsaw, the loud thuds of heavy branches hitting the roof, and the resulting dust and debris generated by this process, I’m grateful that they finally addressed this problem before it became even more dangerous—both for the building’s structure and for those of us who live in the building or pass by on the sidewalk.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHYkR2rkxumhtjy9U6qdXDnGEeLMFvHFKJ6SLCu5gJsV/5012677385551285301.jpg</center>

The only downside was that when I got home, I found my little cat a bundle of nerves from the noise, and when she saw me, she meowed strangely, as if complaining about being left alone in the middle of it all—but honestly, no one warned us that this would be happening today, so I picked her up and took her into the bedroom, where she immediately hid under the bed.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzvpdmUC3Qq6a43zmNFLnwGsb3eCNgPFbcVf3EeEYesY/5012677385551285294.jpg</center>

Now we just have to wait for them to finish the work so we can clean up both the front of the building and the balcony, but that’s better than continuing to live with the uncertainty that at any moment we might have a scare—or something worse—because of the branches that had grown too far over the apartment’s roof.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmPZXbubwtV62nWi57UayBz9XnQDSmuuaNJHCETsQs855c/5012677385551285296.jpg</center>
