body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260613_145134776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsFwCtrgipaBCUDgbJwe7qKbNuVAXoE2ox5ePZBFrZwGyN6i6kCiRPLU674SPABTGWz.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 25.28% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.051 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.978 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.0241789 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.110262 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00073311 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.151217 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001381 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 65,646.20 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 218.55 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 45.36 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,344.06 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 70.32 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #125 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#99 (among active witnesses only)/654.7k HP in votes/50 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 In my Hive profile description (*which I really need to update soon*), I mention how balance, integration, wholeness, and vitality are very important to me, and while this is indeed true, it's unfortunately not reflected in the current iteration of my life and experience. In part because of my deeply broken/shattered heart, and my subsequent withdrawal from close and intimate human connections, and because of the passion that I had for Hive, Arch/Artix Linux, Qortal, and now also locally-run agentic-AI frameworks, among others, I basically hyper focused on these in a non-negotiable daily and weekly routine and schedule that removed even the possibility of socializing and connecting with other people again in any deep way at all. Although I've been able to make that work for years now, I'm now very strongly feeling the absolute necessity of making some significant changes in my life. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260613_144740811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5vWcLV4xm2G8nzLz1vYH3d4b5EzPm7A2xcmXfwsTK4GAeDBQ8ydNUmb5RWLJiUkaWv.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_075001171.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMYNHkB6zNAbgX5Vd7MwVZcM7rUkBHuPy8gEXTUtL9gm8mTDxMTCPAGEmYquvMa4Vgb.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) While what and how I do it on a day-in-day-out basis is important and meaningful for me, it's not generally fulfilling on a deep human level for me, exactly because it's so ridiculously imbalanced and lopsided when compared to the rest of my life. The need for important changes is jumping up and down, screaming in my face, and yet I mostly don't listen, because honestly at this point, and where and who I am now, I don't really know how to shift things in a beneficial and positive direction without drastically disrupting the daily and weekly routine that I've had for so long, which includes what and how I do Hive. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_075308340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsBTMMsv29XQxN4bSUToRssnv4nGaJkk2WuZaMtbbDiwx5EnWAPikatFNKHUw1ozgby.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_075522140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23x14mgVF1Gu9GiCGD256GjJxbzFHULPSYMqTVrg6W2bS35DZDah7iDHqRuPLngnuTYLC.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I do love and appreciate a consistent schedule and activities, but I also do very much need new experiences and interesting and enjoyable variety in my days and weeks. This has mostly been pushed off to the side, and it's been this way for more than a few years now. That is driving me crazy. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_080457670_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsC5QqxKMDqNJALD3gxsocCxCtXe3Wjt1QEDFcEZMuXUvv6zt6PZAf5YUE8NLEfN9gu.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_080638286.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/242DStSoQR2vShxom3Qpp5XoYDzgiT3gxu4JoAT98sL7rMh2r6XNmFSZa58FxWJAfLEfJ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) For me to return to a more balanced, integral, whole, and vital expression of myself and my life, I need to heal my heart, and to do that I need to be willing to face my profound pain, sadness, and grief that I've locked away inside. That is a pretty scary and formidable task, I've got to say, and I don't even know where or how to start anymore. That's a bit of a bugger. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_080915706_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xp69g6seU76gaNYWAdmiRxEf6LBLihwwWf36vqLc7KYZxN8PHJogzw5dBPUUNaEEsqN.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_084158763.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tm93HeLfLV7NT9A9ut6MvebqGEDCiZ8g1CkXCDtNCZqadAewNSmSApXXfErpzVfhEpC.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I truly wish that healing my shattered heart were a quick and easy thing to do, but sadly it's not, at all. It feels like I'm up against a rock and a hard place, as the saying goes, and something's got to give, so some notably different decisions and actions on my part are indeed necessary, and soon. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_084259448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5ZhhciarLhVbAatybTY2bA1ud9hdG5HNsj2mEqpBDjP2pB2iYuRdtmeJq74fi9zJ8q.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_084359440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQhqRDjTSCqejW9TxD8dMkttqvfM9zeQWzqJY9yX2ujUKuoTXAFMbA8bu4RLP83X9AC.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Monday, I wasn't feeling well pretty much the entire day, so after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, I laid down in my bed, to close my eyes and rest for a short while. I finally left the Flow House somewhere around 3PM, giving my attention to some photography for my posts first. I didn't have the energy, focus, or motivation to do almost anything, so aside from chopping and dumping some bad/used coconuts at the upper coco bar, I spent a good portion of the day laying in the sun on the trampoline in the Peanut Lawn, which did help. The sun always makes me feel better, so when I'm not feeling well, getting sun is one of the first things that I do. I finally went to Wabisabi to make myself some food, which I ate there, as I finished the rest of my superfood fire coffee. After that, I returned to the Flow House to focus on getting everything on Hive done, and then going straight to bed, which I ended up doing by just after 8:15PM. The sleep definitely helped, and I did feel a bit better when I woke up around 6:45AM. After uploading the photos for this post, I went to make my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then I headed back to the Flow House to write and publish my Weekly-Hive-Goals-and-Progress update, and to write this post. I've been feeling pretty off so far again today, even after laying down in bed for a bit. Yep, changes are coming soon, one way or another. It's now just after 1:15PM, so it's a good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on photography for my posts, and then on some jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's expression of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁 🙏 💚 ✨ 🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_084431640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQP5Xm9mcG4ZZC6T1yvrShKirni31yykSKUW8zLa52QMELK5oDJZSKLqf3zKsz4e6Ze.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260614_091710938_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tv6DDQGnNhiWzAK4viGMHMfJs311sDuHfoCGDxjvqkNnWvzDncRPCa9xfj9BZqsuR82.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! ‎Hello everyone! It's a beautiful moment of thoughts and sharing valuable knowledge, information and life awareness about involving in Dating with a man that is 35 years and above.


![IMG-20260615-WA0012.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/242YAJaqe2B3jhMBKW56dHw4HnHKLezWgAxoddrDXt2UjdkeHKR7pRrvgMypp2KXZm83d.jpeg)

‎
‎Here are valuable things you might not understand as a young girl and would truly appreciate it's knocking at your knowledge bank.
‎
‎Kindly stay with me as we journey through this beautiful avenue of love and reality.
‎
‎1.He's allergic to unnecessary stress.
‎
‎At that age, his patience for drama is zero. Even small chaos drains him.
‎He wants a woman who calms him, not one he has to survive.
‎
‎2. He moves slower because he's thinking long term.
‎He's not scared of commitment. He's scared of committing to the wrong woman. That caution is not lack of interest... it's maturity.
‎
‎3.His career pressure is real. At this age, a man is fighting silent battles: finances, stability, responsibilities. So if he's not texting 24/7, it's not neglect... it's life.
‎
‎4. He's tired of begging for understanding.
‎
‎If he says he's stressed and you take it personal, he'll stop opening up. Grown men close their hearts quietly.
![IMG_20260506_193934_982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKYPJiVQwTm9E9mjMzXFQuFkNpbhG6GisRXJ4TG24nANgcfAoNfPTW4oa2cCJgu.jpg)
![IMG_20260506_193854_500.jpg](image-3-IMG_20260506_193854_500.jpg)
‎
‎5. Disrespect switches him off instantly.
‎
‎You might think it's a small statement or attitude, but to him, it's a sign of the future.
‎
‎Respect is currency for a grown man.
‎
‎6. His appreciation meter is sensitive.
‎
‎If he feels like you only notice what he didn't do, he'll stop doing anything at all. Men that age shut down when they feel unappreciated.
‎
‎7. He already knows what he doesn't want. He won't force a vibe, tolerate immaturity, or entertain emotional games. One wrong pattern, and he'll quietly move on.
‎
‎8. He loves in a steady way.
‎
‎Not loud. Not chaotic.
‎
‎Not childish. He'll show up for you, protect you, guide you, invest in you. But if you want drama over stability, you'll miss the beauty of a grown man's love.
‎
‎It's Your handsome friend John Petra you're reading from, please endeavor to share after reading.
‎
‎There's love in sharing they said.
‎Peace and love!
‎

body.title: La Desvalorización de Nuestros Logros -¿Cómo medir nuestros avances sin alterar emociones latentes?- Pensamiento de Poder (ES/EN)
body.body:
<center>![español willi-van-de-winkel-ai-generated-8021268_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23yd8QJGz4p5q9JMNxT4Vz1H4nxYj9zPqkUngJMt7F3LCLFhMfRPZ2sEDKv7XzS9uNbZK.jpg)</center>

> *<center>[Pixabay-Willi-van-de-Winkel; editada en Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-hombre-bote-lago-8021268/)</center>*

###### <center>*Para un **Pensamiento de Poder**, siempre hemos sugerido la evaluación o autoevaluación constante; y es que mucha gente ni siquiera es capaz de ver sus propios logros, y esto pasa hasta en las consultas médicas, en las que tenemos que reforzar lo positivo que tiene un paciente para que este pueda verlo y valorarse.*</center>

###### <center>***¿Qué es lo que está pasando para que tú no puedas reconocer tus logros y alejar de ti el empoderamiento?** Es importante que podamos ver lo que tenemos de positivo en nuestras vidas, los logros, que son desde dónde arrancamos para perfeccionar o mejorar, y para esto necesitamos un buen autoconcepto y una buena autoevaluación de vida, lo que funciona tanto en emprendimientos como en nuestra existencia diaria.*</center> 


<center>![mohamed_hassan-camping-7397346_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23tvB1sWmUEGvNL9Nvhb48Cv6H2BP7hndUyUL2utFWYHeKHTAA3BEj4CX3WiBynkdfu82.png)</center>
> *<center>[Pixabay-Mohamed_hassan](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/c%C3%A1mping-amigos-hoguera-acampar-7397346/)</center>*

<div class=\

> ###
La claridad es poder
Esta es una frase de **[Tony Robbins](https://www.tonyrobbins.com/es)**, quien dice que *[las personas de alto rendimiento funcionan desde la claridad, no desde el caos.](https://www.tony-robbins-europe.com/es/publicaciones/habitos-de-alto-rendimiento)* Porque nadie mide un progreso ni anda por la vida en oscuridad. Necesitamos saber dónde estamos parados, qué tenemos, saber los resultados obtenidos para poder tomar decisiones y hacer proyectos. Cuando sabemos lo que funciona y lo que no, hacemos los ajustes necesarios para que todo avance. *¿Saben cuántas personas me llegan a la consulta desconociendo que tienen grandes bendiciones en su vida y quejándose de lo que no hay, sin valorar lo que realmente tienen, la mayoría de las veces mucho?* Aunque no lo creas, es el pan nuestro de cada día, porque **[reconocer los logros propios](https://psicologiaymente.com/social/importancia-de-recibir-reconocimiento-por-nuestros-logros)** es la base de un pensamiento de poder para impulsar tu propia existencia y para lograr tus propios objetivos. Esto le ha funcionado a muchas empresas, el reconocer qué es lo que se ha logrado, lo que se tiene para reajustar las estrategias, lo que ayuda a explicar a fondo las acciones a tomar para seguir creciendo; porque, seamos honestos, todos crecemos día a día. *Y sí, es un error cultural, ya que nos hacen creer que solamente podemos valorar lo que aparece en las redes sociales, lo grande y vistoso, como genios, algunos millonarios y aquellas grandes estrellas de cine que aparecen en películas muy taquilleras.* Cuando todas las personas podemos estar empoderados desde nuestro centro y logros, buscando crecer cada día más.
![mohamed_hassan-seo-5263612_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wgS1KRoYRimXMHNj9gugE3Gf2jBJSzJF7B3eGqSnbJTacndmhZEveTLPKJ8kqsq8Phq.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Mohamed_hassan](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/seo-rango-sitio-web-uno-an%C3%A1lisis-5263612/)
* ###
¿Cómo destacar lo logrado sin que tu ego se infle demasiado?
Ante todo, es necesario trabajar duro por conseguir los objetivos; y sé que muchas veces la salud mental nos lo impide, pero buscamos ayuda y nos fortalecemos, porque en la vida cada día cuenta. Pero tener una vida exitosa, un empleo exitoso o un emprendimiento que funciona amerita de evaluación para entender lo logrado y lo que debemos mejorar o corregir. El **[seguimiento de los logros](https://www.zurekincoach.com/blog/aprende-a-medir-tu-avance-de-forma-efectiva)** es sumamente importante para establecer metas, llevar un diario y revisar siempre la descripción de lo que haces, midiendo objetivos conseguidos. *Y es algo que yo pongo en práctica hasta en la consulta, porque si tú no sitúas a un paciente en lo que tiene, en las bases desde las cuales va a navegar por la vida y afrontar los desafíos, este se va a encontrar sin tener de dónde asirse para la lucha diaria por comprender y surgir.*  Las metas deben medirse regularmente, bien sea mensual, trimestral o anual, y el registro de lo que has logrado, de lo que tienes y te solidifica, es sumamente importante para describir lo que falta por conseguir. Son dos cosas a resaltar: por un lado, ***la cultura de la red*** debe ser medida en forma realista, pues los altos estándares casi siempre son inflados. Y, por otro, ***el ego excesivo*** tampoco ayuda, ya que no reconocer fallas o el exceso de triunfo nubla la mirada crítica y reflexiva.
![mohamed_hassan-strategy-10259346_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23w2oCRXEb97pf6ZKgVYokhXjQEa2EA5obD9amKYxroHSjC9WkfUFqzE1gdsD6YEzoiUu.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Mohamed_hassan](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/estrategia-ajedrez-decisi%C3%B3n-l%C3%B3gica-10259346/)
* ###
Unas simples estrategias para evaluar el logro
***[Alejandra Schatzky en generacionepi.com](https://generacionepi.com/mis-logros-no-valen-para-nada/)*** nos dice que cuando participamos en algún videojuego, las monedas de oro o las criptomonedas que generamos nos estimulan y nos hacen tener una sensación de logro que nos vuelve más adictos al juego. *¡Nos encanta sentirnos retribuidos!* Pero más allá de la retribución, es necesario conocer estos logros para medir los resultados, por lo que existen tres estrategias que esta escritora nos propone; y yo añadiría una más. Está la práctica de los agradecimientos diarios, que es reconocer lo que tenemos y dar gracias por ello; la oportunidad, incluso, de tener comida en nuestras mesas. Otra estrategia es que contemos hasta tres pasos o fases de cualquier acción que emprendamos; por ejemplo, al cepillarnos los dientes, un primer paso sería tomar el cepillo, un segundo paso es poner la pasta de diente en él y, como tercer paso, poner el cepillo en nuestras bocas. Esto va a estimular la creación de programas para alcanzar un objetivo; y sí, parece tonto, pero es una forma de ser organizados y de cubrir cada una de las fases de un proceso. Tercero, utilizar el reconocimiento personal, pues no basta con decirnos cuáles triunfos hemos logrado, sino también escribirlos y hasta recompensarnos, lo que eleva el estado de ánimo. *Y como cuarta estrategia, yo añadiría que **compartamos nuestras lecciones, herramientas y experiencias**, ya que el testimonio compartido se fortalece y es una forma muy importante de reconocer logros y también lo que nos falta aún para perfeccionarlos; y además ayuda a los otros.* Obtener resultados es importante en nuestras existencias y en nuestros emprendimientos, ya que los resultados no son accidentes, son producto del esfuerzo, el compromiso y la responsabilidad de cumplir nuestros sueños.
*La medición de los logros termina siendo un motivo de esperanza y un motor que nos impulsa a alcanzar otros mayores y mejores.*
***Recuerda que la claridad se mide por la capacidad de entender la realidad circundante, y ese es nuestro objetivo en esta comunidad de emprendimiento y en toda la plataforma de #Hive***
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23sU8X8kHo4RRNfMPGRoEKW7qYaWBnkjL5TniWv5UVfZKTaY2EE59CM4kckqCzG6CaUZa.png)
![English in título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23t7hKjehKmQwZwL5yqYdUKuZTy2hyxiCfkRXmxQWpTuT5D1819NmeoindmgATcgGdxpb.png)
#
The Undervaluation of Our Achievements -How Can We Measure Our Progress Without Stirring Up Latent Emotions?- Power Thinking
![willi-van-de-winkel-ai-generated-8021268_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23yd7s4ZSGJ1ZezJJz4JDifL7fwcqvvAU1TqfCK8227ha9JEMfSsz7HUAYXPZJQDY22Q6.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Willi-van-de-Winkel; edited in Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-hombre-bote-lago-8021268/)
* ######
*When it comes to **Power Thinking**, we’ve always recommended constant evaluation or self-assessment; the fact is, many people aren’t even able to see their own achievements, and this happens even during medical appointments, where we have to highlight a patient’s positive qualities so they can see them and value themselves.*
######
***What is preventing you from recognizing your achievements and holding you back from feeling empowered?** It’s important that we recognize the positive aspects of our lives—our achievements—which serve as the foundation from which we can build and improve. To do this, we need a healthy self-concept and a constructive self-assessment of our lives, which applies equally to entrepreneurial endeavors and our daily lives.*
![mohamed_hassan-camping-7397346_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23tvB1sWmUEGvNL9Nvhb48Cv6H2BP7hndUyUL2utFWYHeKHTAA3BEj4CX3WiBynkdfu82.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Mohamed_hassan](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/c%C3%A1mping-amigos-hoguera-acampar-7397346/)
*

> ###
Clarity is power
This is a quote from **[Tony Robbins](https://www.tonyrobbins.com/es)**, who says that *[high-performing people operate from a place of clarity, not chaos.](https://www.tony-robbins-europe.com/es/publicaciones/habitos-de-alto-rendimiento)* Because no one measures progress or goes through life in the dark. We need to know where we stand, what we have, and what results we’ve achieved in order to make decisions and plan projects. When we know what works and what doesn’t, we make the necessary adjustments to keep things moving forward. *Do you know how many people come to me for counseling unaware that they have great blessings in their lives, complaining about what they don’t have, without appreciating what they actually do have—which, more often than not, is a great deal?* Believe it or not, this is a daily occurrence, because **[recognizing your own achievements](https://psicologiaymente.com/social/importancia-de-recibir-reconocimiento-por-nuestros-logros)** is the foundation of a mindset of power that propels your own existence and helps you achieve your goals. This has worked for many companies: recognizing what has been achieved and what they have in order to readjust strategies—which helps thoroughly explain the steps to take to continue growing; because, let’s be honest, we all grow day by day. *And yes, it’s a cultural misconception, since we’re led to believe that we can only value what appears on social media—the big and flashy things—like geniuses, some millionaires, and those big movie stars who appear in blockbuster films.* When in fact, all of us can be empowered from within, drawing on our own strengths and achievements, and striving to grow more and more every day.
![mohamed_hassan-seo-5263612_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wgS1KRoYRimXMHNj9gugE3Gf2jBJSzJF7B3eGqSnbJTacndmhZEveTLPKJ8kqsq8Phq.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Mohamed_hassan](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/seo-rango-sitio-web-uno-an%C3%A1lisis-5263612/)
* ###
How can you highlight your achievements without letting your ego get too big?
First and foremost, you have to work hard to achieve your goals; and I know that mental health often gets in the way, but we seek help and grow stronger, because in life, every day counts. But having a successful life, a successful job, or a thriving business requires reflection to understand what you’ve accomplished and what you need to improve or correct. **[Tracking your achievements](https://www.zurekincoach.com/blog/aprende-a-medir-tu-avance-de-forma-efectiva)** is extremely important for setting goals, keeping a journal, and regularly reviewing what you do, while measuring the goals you’ve achieved. *And it’s something I put into practice even in my practice, because if you don’t help a patient understand what they have—the foundation from which they’ll navigate life and face challenges—they’ll find themselves without a foothold in the daily struggle to understand and thrive.* Goals should be assessed regularly—whether monthly, quarterly, or annually—and keeping track of what you’ve achieved, what you have, and what gives you strength is extremely important for identifying what still needs to be accomplished. There are two points to highlight: on the one hand, **the network’s culture** must be assessed realistically, as high standards are almost always inflated. And, on the other hand, **excessive ego** doesn’t help either, since failing to acknowledge failures or overemphasizing successes clouds critical and reflective judgment.
![mohamed_hassan-strategy-10259346_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23w2oCRXEb97pf6ZKgVYokhXjQEa2EA5obD9amKYxroHSjC9WkfUFqzE1gdsD6YEzoiUu.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Mohamed_hassan](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/estrategia-ajedrez-decisi%C3%B3n-l%C3%B3gica-10259346/)
* ###
Some Simple Strategies for Evaluating Achievement
***[Alejandra Schatzky at generacionepi.com](https://generacionepi.com/mis-logros-no-valen-para-nada/)*** tells us that when we play a video game, the gold coins or cryptocurrencies we earn motivate us and give us a sense of achievement that makes us more addicted to the game. *We love feeling rewarded!* But beyond the reward itself, it’s important to track these achievements to measure our progress. This writer suggests three strategies for doing so—and I’d like to add one more. One is the practice of daily gratitude, which involves recognizing what we have and giving thanks for it—even for the simple opportunity to have food on our tables. Another strategy is to count up to three steps or phases of any action we undertake; for example, when brushing our teeth, the first step would be to pick up the toothbrush, the second step is to put toothpaste on it, and the third step is to put the toothbrush in our mouths. This will encourage us to create plans for achieving a goal; and yes, it may seem silly, but it’s a way to stay organized and ensure we complete each step of a process. Third, practice self-recognition—it’s not enough to simply tell ourselves about our achievements; we should also write them down and even reward ourselves, which boosts our mood. *And as a fourth strategy, I would add that **we should share our lessons, tools, and experiences**, since shared experiences are more powerful and serve as a very important way to recognize our achievements as well as what we still need to do to improve them; they also help others.* Achieving results is important in our lives and in our endeavors, since results are not accidents—they are the product of effort, commitment, and the responsibility to fulfill our dreams.
*Measuring our achievements ultimately becomes a source of hope and a driving force that propels us toward even greater and better ones.*
***Remember that clarity is measured by our ability to understand the reality around us, and that is our goal in this entrepreneurial community and across the entire #Hive platform.***
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23sU8X8kHo4RRNfMPGRoEKW7qYaWBnkjL5TniWv5UVfZKTaY2EE59CM4kckqCzG6CaUZa.png)
![banner Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23u6ai4Y7sckd9zjCfoPgRCqPdPk6NnCyQe7xHpoLX9XPaFnqNydA3ND7c2brg2M3Mazj.png)

body.title: Add Maddarings Beginnings
body.body: A new series of hands needing rings, specifically, Maddarings. https://youtu.be/z1hvcjd3FtQ Maddarings is the shop at Camden Market I get all my rings from. I've only just started wearing rings. Cheap ones costing £5-£25 each. No money in the world could buy better ones. I've filled all my fingers and don't think I'll do thumbs or any other kind of jewellery. 8 fingers holding between two and four rings each. I'd guess a total spend of around £150.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/>Maddarings is on Makers Alley near Cyberdog and the Amy Winehouse statue. You walk through the Stables Market entrance on Chalk Farm Road, turn right up the cobbled path then straight ahead on your right to 620 Makers Alley. Each artwork comes with a map showing how to get there. I did 15 of the paintings at [Billy's](https://edgeworth.blog/2023/03/22/chatham-dockyard-diary-episode-18/) and the pencil drawn maps at home. \n
alt=\

/> They still need gluing to cardboard, that I'll paint black like the [Jompiy G's](https://bitcoinofart.com/series-g/) and [Blond Cards](https://blondcards.com/). An earlier series I give out at [The Camden Market Free Art Man](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/) promotes [Kozmic Records](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/05/19/kozmic-records-lps-1-to-24/), a record fair near Camden Lock bridge where I set up my display every weekend. There's Blond Cards promoting Camden venues such as The Elephants Head and The Black Cap. None of these places asked me to do them, and like everything The Camden Market Free Art Man, no money changes hands. There's also a [series of acrylic paintings themed on Maddarings](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/02/25/madda-rings-paintings-a4-hand-on-yellow/) that were available to buy at the shop, but none sold. I think we were asking £5 a painting. Roughly the same the Camden Market ice cream van charges if you choose against the extra chocolate flake. Camden go-ers pay top dollar for taste, touch, sound and smell stimulation, but not sight.
alt=\

/>It's noticeably less busy online recently. YouTube views for my Camden videos are significantly down, as is engagement on other platforms. Not sure why, probably something I'm doing wrong, but I'll figure it out eventually. I've been spending an extra few hours a week making and posting YouTube shorts. Maybe that'll help. I eventually got round to doing Camden TikTok's last week. In a few years I'll probably get started on AI. The Add Maddarings were started at Billy's studio on Monday as I forgot to take the drawing I'd prepared for the [Offgridlife Claymation series](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/05/19/offgridlife-claymation-oil-transfer-drawings/). A series I've been working on every Monday for the last three weeks after @offgridlife YouTube shorts about [FREE ART FREES ART](https://freeartfreesart.com/). I had to quickly come up with something to do, and for some reason came up with this.
alt=\

/>

Shelley, who runs Maddarings, was the singer in [Elbow Sisters](https://edgeworth.blog/music/elbow-sisters/). A two-piece band we did when we were married for a few years, starting in 2009. I think we started the band after getting married.  
The first set of oil transfer drawings I made using this method were after The Rite of Spring. Billy and I then collaborated on a series of using this method that, unfortunately, were attributed solely to him. Welcome to the art world! Pristine on the outside, dodgy second-hand car dealers behind the scenes. I was quite put out by this deliberate misattribution, as I [moaned about extensively](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/05/13/my-response-to-to-ease-my-troubled-mind-the-authorised-unauthorised-history-of-billy-childish/) in a recent video addressing another case of my artistic contributions with Billy being understating/ eradicating of my role in order to falsely elevate his. None of this is Billy's fault, as far as I'm concerned, it seems to be how others have chosen to attribute our work irrespective of the truth. FREE ART FREES ART is the antithesis of this, as is [Black Ivory](https://blackivory.org/). If there's no credible art world available, make one. Or as my mum would say \
\n\n
alt=\

/> \nThe red and green text above were all individually hand stamped this morning. They'll go on the front somewhere with the painting and map. Despite being in oil, even the thickly painted Add Maddarings dry in only a few days. The pencil drawings of the map are traced from my initial sketch showing where Maddarings is in relation to Cyberdog and the Amy Winehouse statue. \n
alt=\

body.title: PhotoFeed Contest - Cityscape Photography Round 173
body.body: <center>\n\n***This is the Palacio Salvo in Montevideo, a historic skyscraper in Uruguay. For years it was the tallest building in South America. It stands in Plaza Independencia, an iconic landmark of the city, and has a \

in Buenos Aires: the Palacio Barolo, designed by the same architect. Legend has it that during its construction, when the lights on its dome were turned on, they could be seen from across the Río de la Plata, symbolically connecting the two cities. This is my post for this week.***

Este es el Palacio Salvo, en Montevideo, un rascacielos histórico de Uruguay. Durante años fue el edificio más alto de Sudamérica. Se encuentra en la Plaza Independencia, un sitio emblemático de la ciudad, y tiene un “hermano gemelo” en Buenos Aires: el Palacio Barolo, diseñado por el mismo arquitecto. Se cuenta que en la época de su construcción, cuando se encendían las luces de su cúpula, podían verse desde la otra orilla del Río de la Plata, conectando simbólicamente ambas ciudades. Esta es mi entrada para esta semana.

body.title: Coffee Camp 612
body.body:
Coffee Camp 612 is one of those modern and fusion boutique restaurant. The location of this restaurant is a little out of the way.
> Coffee Camp 612 算是一家走現代融合路線的精品網紅餐廳。不過說實話，這家店的位置稍微有那麼一點點偏僻。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejo9izS4NWipGKdaqHfHW4ieopexzLyEoHutz968Uwbo/1781577375789.jpg)

If we are going to give it a simple introduction, it is going to be \

cafe that was located by the river. Fortunately, the river walk itself is one of the hottest tourist spot in Ipoh.
> 如果用一句最簡單的話來介紹它，那就是「那家開在河邊的咖啡館」。幸好，這條近打河畔步道（Kinta River Walk）本身就是怡保最熱門的旅遊景點之一。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNZKn4Jvv81nKrie7xDrK2CwWkDjGiZH55JUTybZo6TqN/1781577375876.jpg)

The crown jewel of this main attraction is the night market. With the blessing of Malaysia kind of unusually hot climates, it's only natural reaction of the crowd is to find a place to camp for a cup of iced cold coffee.
> 而這裡最大的金字招牌，當屬當地的夜市。加上馬來西亞那份外「熱情」、熱到有些不尋常的天氣，大家唯一的本能反應就是——趕緊找個能「安營紮寨」的地方，狠狠灌下一杯冰鎮咖啡。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPPnBYg6wnmfLQeDjX1CsCBsaQCJkfPc386DWwDFosbDR/1781577375938.jpg)

Inside the restaurant, immediate to the right is a small section of merchandize. There is an acrylic rack supposed to display an array of camping equipment, but I guess either they didn't replenish or they sold out due to the sudden flux of public holiday crowd. As you can see this restaurant was featured in many public media.
> 進到店裡，右手邊立刻能看到一小塊商品展售區。原本那裡有個壓克力架子，應該是用來展示各種露營裝備的，但我猜要嘛是店家沒來得及補貨，要嘛就是被公共假期突如其來的人潮給一掃而空了。正如你所見，這家店確實上過不少大眾媒體的報導。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWB7DtfyoRmnTnu4x9VW4YXgrSN1Dj5j8Npxs7hJtf5TH/1781577376010.jpg)

As the name of the restaurant suggested, the main feature of this restaurant is camp. The decorations, seats, camping table, are all suggesting a heavy influence of a camping site. I'm sure if you're a real camper, you DO NOT enjoy it here 🤣 this is absolutely NOT what a camper would want, overly crowded, kids screaming and running around, kicking up dust from the decorative sand, camp table and foldable chairs squicking, and people are talking way too loud since the environment is unsettling.
> 顧名思義，這家店的主題就是「露營」。店內的裝飾、座椅、露營桌，無一不在彰顯著濃郁的野營風格。但我敢打包票，如果你是個真正的露營愛好者，你絕對不會喜歡這裡🤣。本來露營就是要避開一下“凡間”，這完全不是露營客想要的感覺：人多到爆炸、小孩在身邊尖叫著橫衝直撞、把裝飾用的沙子踢得漫天飛揚、露營桌和摺疊椅吱吱作響，而且因為環境實在太浮躁，每個人說話都不得不自帶擴音喇叭。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMMcnLJLrHaDMkDFf4PKUK7ngxgyYjKtfF3T1cGXDraw/1781577376098.jpg)

These plates tat was properly stack on the wall are all checklist board. I'm not exactly sure what was the motive of this, but everyone is taking a photo of it, so did I. Maybe its supposed to be a unique \
feature, a thing for the customer to remember, \

. Too long, maybe not. Bleh... Lame. Now I'm being suspected make up words for my restaurant review.
> 至於牆上整整齊齊排開的這些板子，其實都是留言板。我不太確定店家的意圖是什麼，但既然大家都在拍，那我也跟風來一張。也許它被設計成一種獨特的「打卡」特色，好讓顧客記住：「哦，就是那家牆上掛滿馬賽克打卡板子、上面還寫著怡保的店啊。」放過我吧，我這一段都不知怎麼寫了。雖然有湊字數的嫌疑（我就是趁機會湊字數），總之一句到底這些checklist 不知什麼用途但每個人都搶著拍照打卡就是了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNxKcfXeU8dVkHTN1D2bdWnudsMQYfzv3C7oK6r3EQ2G/1781577427686.jpg)

The plain cheese cake, in my honest opinion, the taste is marvelously good. I believe the chef induced a little bit(probably tiny little bit) of vinegar to it or lime/lemon juice I'm not too sure, but I couldn't find the natural citrusy taste, yet I brings up a mouth watering level of sourish. And the cake base is way more saltier than my usual cheese cake. Once again, I suspect they have added extra salt wilst crushing the biscuits to form the cake base. I should really try thisnew discovery on my next cheese cake(ok. Slowly wait. I am NATO. No Action Talk Only). Texture wise, this cake is unusually dry. I suspect the restaurant operator throw it in extremely low temperature fridge or it was accidentally stored in a freezer. Other than that, perfect slice of cheese cake with all those additional surprises.
> 接下來說說吃的。這款原味起司蛋糕（Plain Cheese Cake），老實說，味道驚艷得不得了。我懷疑主廚在裡面加了（可能就那麼一丁點）醋，或者是青檸汁/檸檬汁，我不太確定。雖然我吃不出那種天然的柑橘果香，但它卻成功勾出了一種讓人瘋狂分泌唾液的酸爽感。而且，蛋糕底部的餅乾碎比我平時吃的起司蛋糕要鹹得多。我再次強烈懷疑，他們在敲碎餅乾做餅底的時候手抖多加了鹽。這種新發現，我下次自己做起司蛋糕時真的應該試試（行了，慢慢等吧，我就是傳說中的 NATO——光說不練，No Action Talk Only）。從質地上來說，這蛋糕有些反常地偏乾，估計是店家把它扔進了超低溫冰箱，或者是不小心塞進了冷凍庫。不過除了這點之外，這塊帶來源源不斷驚喜的起司蛋糕，堪稱完美。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZQzPG73rjz3Qod3XFCuN3q9D11tCdjnp7cCKPpnWzQX4/1781577427759.jpg)

Coffee selection are quite limited. Since this is one of those unique boutique restaurant, we wouldn't expect they have a full range of Cafe drinks menu, home minister ordered special Osmanthus Latte. If you ask me how does it taste, I can only say, it's A latte with a dash of flower base. It's a mixture of the next door garden smell, coffee, milk and topped up with ice. It has no soul. Don't order Osmanthus latte here.
> 咖啡的選擇就相當有限了。既然是那種標榜獨特路線的精品店，我們自然不能指望它有像普通咖啡館那樣齊全的飲品菜單。我家「內政部長」（母老虎大人）點了一杯特色桂花拿鐵。如果你問我味道如何，我只能說：這就是一杯「加了點花香底料」的拿鐵。它完美的融合了隔壁花園的泥土味、咖啡、牛奶，最後再加滿冰塊。只能說，毫無靈魂。聽我說，來這千萬別點桂花拿鐵。🤣

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRM9pgSj29JSQL7J3UnrJstYoUTGLSP3jgCqRycoimLp8/1781577427850.jpg)

Followed by a roasted tea latte. I am not exactly sure if this should taste like this. I have a vision of the barista grind the tea leaf to grain, stuck them in the espresso machine and forced the machine to brew a tea based espresso. Whilst it sounded all that fancy, but the actual taste is kinda horrible. I can do milk tea. I can do heavy black tea. But I can't with this kind of \

tea. It's outright yulky. My girl forced it down anyways.
> 緊接著是烘焙茶拿鐵（Roasted Tea Latte）。我真拿不準這玩意兒到底是不是這個味。在我的腦補畫面裡，咖啡師是把茶葉磨成了粉，然後硬生生塞進義式咖啡機裡，強行逼機器萃取出一份「茶底濃縮」。聽起來挺花哨、挺高級對吧？但實際味道簡直是場災難。奶茶我可以，濃郁的黑茶我也行，但這種所謂的「烘焙」茶，我真的達咩。簡直可以用難喝來形容。不過我家閨女最後還是硬著頭皮把它灌下去了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd4Cs1G3yQUnWWTeNvnqXGRjUUZgxcYpcuPkFViPx37eD/1781577427925.jpg)

I ordered a Bellagio Cocolate. Strong taste. Not too sweet. No extra surprises. I am happy that this turns out quite ok. If there's anything I would like to comment, it's the volume. I took a stronger sip and the whole thing gone. 
> 我自己點了一杯貝拉吉奧巧克力（Bellagio Chocolate）。味道很濃郁，不會太甜，沒什麼額外的驚喜。看到這杯表現正常，我已經謝天謝地了。如果非要挑點毛病，那就是分量太少。我大口嘬了一下，整杯就直接見底了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6kYrtvjmhGC8HWkoBzwgjzGbZrTvceWeDn4jnfDprbu/1781577427997.jpg)

It was a lost course, since 2 out of 3 drinks are bad, I decided might as well go Britney Spears, hit me barbie one more time! I got us a caramel macchiato, hmmm... Surprisingly, it's not surprise good. It's just as I |XP|cted, good caramel taste. Proportion of milk and coffee are correct, not overly milky, espresso taste just right.
> 既然三杯裡有兩杯都踩了雷，橫豎都是輸，我乾脆學小甜甜布蘭妮——寶貝，再傷害我一次吧（Hit me barbie one more time）！於是我又點了一杯焦糖瑪奇朵。嗯……驚喜的是，它居然沒有驚嚇。完全在預料之中，焦糖香氣很足，牛奶和咖啡的比例拿捏得剛剛好，不會有太重的奶味，espresso濃縮咖啡的風味也恰到好處。

---

# Coffee CAMP 612 Cafe Ipoh (Muslim friendly) Custom Gifts & Ipoh Souvenirs Hub

My honest review, I should have seen that coming, but I didn't because it's a self service order at counter restaurant. It was a rush decision to try new things at their boutique restaurant(since it's a boutique restaurant, they always do unique things to surprise their customers), by the time I realize their \

drinks are wayyyyyyy too special for my ordinary tastebud, the only fall back was the caramel macchiato. I regret I didn't order more cheese cakes and perhaps a famous Ipoh white coffee. Will I come back again? Maybe, but let me assure you I will put my hands off the \

flavor drinks 🤣

**拉叔的大實話總結：**
其實我早該料到會是這個結果，但因為這家店是要自己去櫃檯自助點餐的，當時光顧著趕緊做決定，想在精品店裡嘗試點新鮮玩意兒（畢竟精品店總喜歡搞些特立獨行的東西來給顧客「驚喜」）。等我意識到他們的「特調」飲品對於我這普通的味蕾來說實在是太過「特別」時，一切都太遲了，最後只能靠那杯焦糖瑪奇朵來救場。早知道當初就多點幾塊起司蛋糕，或者直接來杯怡保著名的白咖啡了。如果問我，拉叔！下次還會再來嗎？也許吧。但我保證，我絕對不會再碰那些奇奇怪怪的「獨特」口味飲品了🤣。

Google maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/NYgf2WMWqNuuzgwE7

Address: Lot A-25, No. A-9, Kinta River Walk, Lebuhraya Istana, Taman Istana, 30300 Ipoh, Perak

Call: 016-342 5710

body.title: [ENG - ESP] Spiced Apple Mango Salsa Side 🍎🥭
body.body:
## Warm greetings to lovely hivers and plants veganlovers 🥰🌹

![29E4E77E-8FF3-4780-8EEF-616B2F291A6A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9STgTzUdDqCRtuyxHh6CJWRySMV2UJR6J3fiN7n1W2dWvpZm8wvV7gE7HCWkj.jpeg)

![4CBE73FC-50EE-46B5-8CE8-57F6DE962A46.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x1RzFuaZuo7NKb4CmkUir9ZaB3irxyCrzGgSXe7q1hdMyT1ANrszT9PgrmAQHpUJW5p.jpeg)

![DCFF1CE6-96E2-476F-B9AE-33F9EEDF2E76.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynjGMGQzbBh4TUqGSZ7DRtx8Gxb7gfRUUaDPU9K9Udi6xjbMCRpjKVVQB2puVrfChkb.jpeg)

Am always happy 😃 when I have some new recipes to share with you from my kitchen. And today’s recipe is all about fruit salsa you will not want to miss out on because its full of deliciousness and so refreshing.

Loving fresh Mango 🥭 and succulent juicy apple 🍎 are the two base ingredients for this recipe and adding some red chili 🌶 powder, salt and sugar gave the mixture a good spice for that salsa you can enjoy as toppings or as side for that desired meal 🥘 you wish to pair it with.

A side dish from the Bahama Breeze, as the Americans 🇺🇸 love to make their salsa simple, although with some onion 🧅 and bell pepper 🫑.  And to make this salsa more crunchy, I decided to not peel off the mango 🥭 and apple back because that’s what I enjoy most.

![7CAA80F6-D390-480F-A515-8244E9775044.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xexoJTFQDszap1Mu2PNkZm4TAZc7fVPRW4YVGyUByJ4a8Mfi4qhDiE6Mz6qUWuSa3kv.jpeg)

Its very simply and quick to pair with lunch or dinner 🥘. But you can especially enjoy this mango 🥭 apple 🍎 salsa on grilled fish as toppings . 

Lets get into the process with detailed step by step.

# INGREDIENTS:

![75378628-95FD-46D8-B902-4E23B78EC0AF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yd3v8FW63DLdHASWKLeqKNn7Xio6hbMbwosJA3BRxvPLBUtVcFbGu5bD7G1wryTM6Cq.jpeg)

1 large fresh succulent mango 
1 large radish juicy apple 
1/2 teaspoon of chili powder 
1 teaspoon of premium sugar 
1/4 teaspoon of salt 

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![3C572AD8-AFF6-4ED3-B41E-EC7046D6D113.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244V6PtrecmnPWxPwaXNcYY98gjtUXTqH3o8CEGH8tgUxV51BW3MGEJSFdbceoDoAEFq2.jpeg)

![AE6E8DA8-23EB-4C95-8FE1-9E5D94A39B8E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKxoCawSrmQYgedFcQpsHg7ajXNkcAVDD6GzT2q11ctGphQmxcGXwmXRDCZcCnc.jpeg)

We start this recipe by cutting into two equal parts our washed and sterilize  apple 🍎 here above.

![A166B812-96D8-4764-96BF-59A9B0DFC564.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGeWHpkzhrETikkQjJw39HCVhwQ3Jt4GVwVz4gQ8fEM1XFZF324vzSjVbxXCioPH8Y5.jpeg)

Then, we further thinly slice each part, removing the inner core.

Step 2.

![A8B57C7A-6D3B-4A5A-B6A6-E72C8AE646F3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp6Q8QwAghWfCq1QAbLmgX1d773HXDmsykZwCtseu38UvWx96psoJGHCpcsLgjhq8gJ.jpeg)

![6973A2AF-F4DF-4880-AA9A-1065DD04167D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp6cCZwS9mLnmZNt24XYqaZwAaxTYWHBYFWJqPehL35XEukXcALSxyWczDbcrgxZL5L.jpeg)

![63CE3F90-5A4D-44AE-9F41-D43B20E268E5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KiBdTYFLLDWU2GbTHhDVN6EGNUReCYsiD6MCJ7o17EbWfyNJcQiQQxS86yWnFtyL2G.jpeg)

Next, we gradually chop the slices into thin square shapes above.

Step 3

![2868FD75-55B5-412A-AEA9-763F16C4D4CE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALHSxmCwPw9FcHKejnP3DP3owaf3XYAMfCnweSaibqc21CrAFgvTSQjzfxtwZSB.jpeg)

We slice out the flash of the washed sterilized mango 🥭 . 

![E6C098DE-040D-4D5B-8DD6-A56F4DEA47BE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x16s4WraAiTTbNetiGDqE9jthuqM2nyDcgJ6b6ZmchVdSfvvNJ3e4VwHiUJTzGUP1fA.jpeg)

![0B801788-5219-4E65-9A9F-41B87B4DDD8A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALD9JRC4wLof1nD3JoHUBtFGzgGLNi5btunyEC7umdbWVbCpZafKPoDLc15eYHY.jpeg)

Slice them in straight strips and chop them into square shape as well.

Step 4.

![412449EF-DB94-4E83-BA0D-9AB0372F3FA2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsQpsjrXc34ijXFmoNkGe5KzVx4RyhcEEGhNbWSk6DUz4K9qwiQAz8iotsEZpZTDqUT.jpeg)

We have the two basic ingredients ready 

Step 5.

![81745CCC-CF0F-40CC-A6B8-15F1B6EA47C6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK3fxSWBbVCdnxYiFEMMDkQigH3o4bW5x9haS3WMuCM6ga8zMQjZDYadN7gnKn8.jpeg)

And add them into a bowl 🥣 here above 

Step 6.

![D986AEF0-5EDD-45FD-BF83-AAD176C0756F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK56rzya8Qj6ZiqNEEmtrvYVAhyPAL6MMuoDxuP16xQQnVSEvFfiHRZN6r8PJDB.jpeg)

Next, we add the sugar, chili 🌶 powder and salt to taste .

![333C2F88-CC9E-4797-84C6-3934C6FC3914.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xemxevgA26WE7epLePf8q5fk4wKuJMz2Zr4ZySLjt3L6dN1b6KBZDymW6stCGVVnAGr.jpeg)

![97F50668-6794-4326-B96E-2BB55A47E028.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp8J89EryFjKN7dfegYAXDsP4U6koLVMLNcfyARszhXwNr8rzCckXDBSkD1ipdThU4W.jpeg)

We stir to incorporate them properly.

Step 7.

![D959B206-42CB-4EF4-B4CD-30D0D211C0EC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245TG8jxDkGPNMhk3nyAi2K1iAEdFt1qhsPKfyGPPmEJ6iXTJpsCeSw7GHikW2Tqai5V6.jpeg)

![6918AC8F-AE39-40F4-82B7-2CE5D642F93A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uaTmivKvoapE42tmgDmzNtNiBPcQ4qsoJzjquYgXHFebDkuxYGHnmx8bbqLRbqLH8Jn.jpeg)

Here, we take the mix into the preheated microwave for about four (4) minutes to quickly heat it up for some warmness 

Step 8. 

![4DA0AD71-B837-4183-8FC2-BDFE060157C8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r1wWsMN25MotAunrnizaPFKZu8cGcTM9LEBHjN7tb3faP3tkqgPa6tYgrEkgFVqvFx3.jpeg)

![878C3CBA-B18F-46B6-8521-DF236A2A4DE3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yJSr95XCAWnb3sZcd7V8wr2Erzie85Y8gC7o2Zaa8tWjDNLNGqie5wLmgsvYuwwsZ7Q.jpeg)

And we serve this rich and delicious fruity salsa side .

![B8511B12-855D-402B-B79C-8E669922E8BA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgh4HxJkysvomorGWs4BPwz1N7fUxxhQ9wfsU74B25Z1UJkGN2hZz6yX8TBE4BnaCrU.jpeg)

This is so exquisite that you may like to get the party 🎉 started with this refreshing and delicious apple, mango salsa. Or make it for a family dinner side everyone will love ❤️.

![A9DA56A7-671D-484A-88C6-682AFD32149F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGuciDD5o1Cpx6EjRqbrEiQby4mpvwt8vM4dsF1krE76HXJP5fVnCc6BbTKuUHeoe9Y.jpeg)

Taste so good especially with little kick of spice and warmth that made it more flavorful . You can decide to add more ingredients like red onions 🧅, tomatoes 🍅, garlic 🧄 and more to this salsa. Don’t miss out on this.

# Thank you friends for your time coming with me through this recipe 🥰💕. Hugs 🤗 🌹.

![97C37C2D-361A-4B1E-8B82-363651D2BF17.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMwo9dpnWRR6a5qCdw8UPgbcTmU3uyb1RSZx1SzchJyqsdt3XBQwAvLaRCVfYtYN4U5.jpeg)

## Espanol Version

## Un cordial saludo a todos los encantadores miembros de Hive y a los amantes de las plantas veganas 🥰🌹

![29E4E77E-8FF3-4780-8EEF-616B2F291A6A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9STgTzUdDqCRtuyxHh6CJWRySMV2UJR6J3fiN7n1W2dWvpZm8wvV7gE7HCWkj.jpeg)

![4CBE73FC-50EE-46B5-8CE8-57F6DE962A46.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x1RzFuaZuo7NKb4CmkUir9ZaB3irxyCrzGgSXe7q1hdMyT1ANrszT9PgrmAQHpUJW5p.jpeg)

![DCFF1CE6-96E2-476F-B9AE-33F9EEDF2E76.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynjGMGQzbBh4TUqGSZ7DRtx8Gxb7gfRUUaDPU9K9Udi6xjbMCRpjKVVQB2puVrfChkb.jpeg)

Siempre me hace mucha ilusión 😃 poder compartir con vosotros nuevas recetas de mi cocina. Y la receta de hoy es una salsa de fruta que no os podéis perder, porque está riquísima y es muy refrescante.

El mango fresco 🥭 y la jugosa manzana 🍎 son los dos ingredientes básicos de esta receta, y al añadir un poco de chile rojo 🌶 en polvo, sal y azúcar, la mezcla adquiere el toque picante perfecto para esta salsa que podéis disfrutar como acompañamiento o como guarnición de ese plato 🥘 con el que queráis combinarla.

Un acompañamiento al estilo de Bahama Breeze, ya que a los estadounidenses 🇺🇸 les encanta preparar la salsa de forma sencilla, aunque con un poco de cebolla 🧅 y pimiento 🫑. Y para que esta salsa quede más crujiente, decidí no pelar el mango 🥭 ni la manzana, porque eso es lo que más me gusta.

![7CAA80F6-D390-480F-A515-8244E9775044.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xexoJTFQDszap1Mu2PNkZm4TAZc7fVPRW4YVGyUByJ4a8Mfi4qhDiE6Mz6qUWuSa3kv.jpeg)

Es muy fácil y rápido de combinar con el almuerzo o la cena 🥘. Pero esta salsa de mango 🥭 y manzana 🍎 se disfruta especialmente como acompañamiento de pescado a la parrilla. 

Veamos el proceso paso a paso con todo detalle.

# INGREDIENTES:

![75378628-95FD-46D8-B902-4E23B78EC0AF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yd3v8FW63DLdHASWKLeqKNn7Xio6hbMbwosJA3BRxvPLBUtVcFbGu5bD7G1wryTM6Cq.jpeg)

1 mango grande, fresco y jugoso 
1 rábano grande y jugoso 
1/2 cucharadita de chile en polvo 
1 cucharadita de azúcar de primera calidad 
1/4 de cucharadita de sal 

# PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![3C572AD8-AFF6-4ED3-B41E-EC7046D6D113.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244V6PtrecmnPWxPwaXNcYY98gjtUXTqH3o8CEGH8tgUxV51BW3MGEJSFdbceoDoAEFq2.jpeg)

![AE6E8DA8-23EB-4C95-8FE1-9E5D94A39B8E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKxoCawSrmQYgedFcQpsHg7ajXNkcAVDD6GzT2q11ctGphQmxcGXwmXRDCZcCnc.jpeg)

Empezamos esta receta cortando en dos partes iguales la manzana 🍎 que vemos arriba, ya lavada y esterilizada.

![A166B812-96D8-4764-96BF-59A9B0DFC564.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGeWHpkzhrETikkQjJw39HCVhwQ3Jt4GVwVz4gQ8fEM1XFZF324vzSjVbxXCioPH8Y5.jpeg)

A continuación, cortamos cada parte en rodajas finas y retiramos el corazón.

Paso 2.

![A8B57C7A-6D3B-4A5A-B6A6-E72C8AE646F3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp6Q8QwAghWfCq1QAbLmgX1d773HXDmsykZwCtseu38UvWx96psoJGHCpcsLgjhq8gJ.jpeg)

![6973A2AF-F4DF-4880-AA9A-1065DD04167D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp6cCZwS9mLnmZNt24XYqaZwAaxTYWHBYFWJqPehL35XEukXcALSxyWczDbcrgxZL5L.jpeg)

![63CE3F90-5A4D-44AE-9F41-D43B20E268E5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KiBdTYFLLDWU2GbTHhDVN6EGNUReCYsiD6MCJ7o17EbWfyNJcQiQQxS86yWnFtyL2G.jpeg)

A continuación, cortamos cada parte en rodajas finas y retiramos el corazón.

Paso 3

![2868FD75-55B5-412A-AEA9-763F16C4D4CE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALHSxmCwPw9FcHKejnP3DP3owaf3XYAMfCnweSaibqc21CrAFgvTSQjzfxtwZSB.jpeg)

Cortamos la piel del mango lavado y esterilizado 🥭. 

![E6C098DE-040D-4D5B-8DD6-A56F4DEA47BE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x16s4WraAiTTbNetiGDqE9jthuqM2nyDcgJ6b6ZmchVdSfvvNJ3e4VwHiUJTzGUP1fA.jpeg)

![0B801788-5219-4E65-9A9F-41B87B4DDD8A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALD9JRC4wLof1nD3JoHUBtFGzgGLNi5btunyEC7umdbWVbCpZafKPoDLc15eYHY.jpeg)

Córtalas en tiras rectas y pícalas también en cuadraditos.

Paso 4.

![412449EF-DB94-4E83-BA0D-9AB0372F3FA2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsQpsjrXc34ijXFmoNkGe5KzVx4RyhcEEGhNbWSk6DUz4K9qwiQAz8iotsEZpZTDqUT.jpeg)

Ya tenemos preparados los dos ingredientes básicos. 

Paso 5.

![81745CCC-CF0F-40CC-A6B8-15F1B6EA47C6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK3fxSWBbVCdnxYiFEMMDkQigH3o4bW5x9haS3WMuCM6ga8zMQjZDYadN7gnKn8.jpeg)

Y añádelos al bol 🥣 que ves aquí arriba 

Paso 6.

![D986AEF0-5EDD-45FD-BF83-AAD176C0756F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK56rzya8Qj6ZiqNEEmtrvYVAhyPAL6MMuoDxuP16xQQnVSEvFfiHRZN6r8PJDB.jpeg)

A continuación, añadimos el azúcar, el chile 🌶 en polvo y sal al gusto.

![333C2F88-CC9E-4797-84C6-3934C6FC3914.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xemxevgA26WE7epLePf8q5fk4wKuJMz2Zr4ZySLjt3L6dN1b6KBZDymW6stCGVVnAGr.jpeg)

![97F50668-6794-4326-B96E-2BB55A47E028.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp8J89EryFjKN7dfegYAXDsP4U6koLVMLNcfyARszhXwNr8rzCckXDBSkD1ipdThU4W.jpeg)

Removemos para mezclarlos bien.

Paso 7.

![D959B206-42CB-4EF4-B4CD-30D0D211C0EC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245TG8jxDkGPNMhk3nyAi2K1iAEdFt1qhsPKfyGPPmEJ6iXTJpsCeSw7GHikW2Tqai5V6.jpeg)

![6918AC8F-AE39-40F4-82B7-2CE5D642F93A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uaTmivKvoapE42tmgDmzNtNiBPcQ4qsoJzjquYgXHFebDkuxYGHnmx8bbqLRbqLH8Jn.jpeg)

Ahora metemos la mezcla en el microondas precalentado durante unos cuatro (4) minutos para calentarla rápidamente y que esté un poco templada. 

Paso 8. 

![4DA0AD71-B837-4183-8FC2-BDFE060157C8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r1wWsMN25MotAunrnizaPFKZu8cGcTM9LEBHjN7tb3faP3tkqgPa6tYgrEkgFVqvFx3.jpeg)

![878C3CBA-B18F-46B6-8521-DF236A2A4DE3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yJSr95XCAWnb3sZcd7V8wr2Erzie85Y8gC7o2Zaa8tWjDNLNGqie5wLmgsvYuwwsZ7Q.jpeg)

Y servimos esta salsa afrutada, tan sabrosa y deliciosa, como acompañamiento.

![B8511B12-855D-402B-B79C-8E669922E8BA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgh4HxJkysvomorGWs4BPwz1N7fUxxhQ9wfsU74B25Z1UJkGN2hZz6yX8TBE4BnaCrU.jpeg)

Es tan delicioso que quizá te apetezca dar comienzo a la fiesta 🎉 con esta refrescante y deliciosa salsa de manzana y mango. O prepararla como acompañamiento para una cena familiar que encantará a todos ❤️.

![A9DA56A7-671D-484A-88C6-682AFD32149F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGuciDD5o1Cpx6EjRqbrEiQby4mpvwt8vM4dsF1krE76HXJP5fVnCc6BbTKuUHeoe9Y.jpeg)


Está riquísima, sobre todo con ese toque picante y cálido que le da aún más sabor. Puedes añadirle más ingredientes a esta salsa, como cebolla roja 🧅, tomates 🍅, ajo 🧄 y mucho más. No te la pierdas.

## Gracias, amigos, por dedicarme vuestro tiempo y acompañarme en esta receta 🥰💕. Un abrazo 🤗 🌹.

## Un saludo, @sunshine29 🧡

body.title: Wildfire Season is Here
body.body:
Today, a big wildfire flared up east of Spokane in the vicinity of the Millwood and Spokane Valley suburbs. A heatwave and windy weather combined with a drier-than-usual winter have left us with hazardous conditions, but mid-June is remarkably early.

I'm not anywhere near the danger zone, but my sister reported heavy smoke and emergency vehicle traffic on her drive home from work, and we discussed alternate plans in case she needs to evacuate. Avista has [de-energized the electrical grid](https://www.kxly.com/news/avista-de-energized-lines-in-the-area-of-the-upriver-fire/article_41de5aa9-c9d5-43bd-b450-c43efe50528e.html) in the region of the fire. She may be affected if that expands even without direct fire risk.

<center>![6a31aea631b2f.image.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/EptbTn3cnJJKrCB1ydDaoGWr3VXwUt4e9pH3hrM1wDsVgCBgGKcve7LgCxxf9JVzh7X.jpg)
*[Image from Spokane County Fire District #9 via KHQ](https://www.khq.com/news/292-acre-wildfire-on-upriver-drive-east-of-spokane-prompts-evacuations/article_8b89eba3-b527-4629-a630-2df4a62778d3.html)*</center>

Now is a good time for us all to re-evaluate our emergency preparedness, so here are some useful links.

**[Disaster Preparedness:](https://peakd.com/hive-174578/@jacobtothe/disaster-preparedness)**  I wrote about what you might stash in a \

what to gather if you have some extra time to prepare, and advice on planning an evacuation with alternate routes *before* traffic jams and road closures occur. This was back in September of 2020, but remains applicable.

**[United States Geological Survey Wildfire Activity Map:](https://www.arcgis.com/apps/mapviewer/index.html?webmap=df8bcc10430f48878b01c96e907a1fc3)** North American wildfire and response data, with up-to-date information especially on US incidents

**[Canadian Wildland Fire Information System Interactive Map:](https://cwfis.cfs.nrcan.gc.ca/en/interactive-map)** Specific to our northern neighbors, and useful for those of us near the border in the US, too.

Consider this post your early warning, and a reminder to be aware, be prepared, and be safe. As the old proverb says, \

body.title: Mosman Art Gallery: Sydney, AUSTRALIA
body.body: <div class=\

>
![Mosman Art Gallery: Sydney, AUSTRALIA.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-06-16-22-06-494-img_20260612_101923340-jpg)
Starting to discover some of the smaller venues in Sydney... and this Art Gallery in Mosman in Sydney is one of the more common ones, with a regular concert series for chamber sized ensembles. Mosman (in Sydney), for those who don't know, is one of the more affluent suburbs in Sydney... its pretty nice, and the people there are pretty damn well off as well. Sort of the thing that gets annoyingly associated with Classical music... something that my wife and I are trying break... but we are fighting decades of entrenched perception. Anyway, off topic... the art gallery seems to be a repurposed church of some sort... and there are quite a few things that are going on... kids concerts, concert concerts, art lectures, and other community events.
![Mosman Art Gallery: Sydney, AUSTRALIA.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-06-16-22-06-666-img_20260612_101825567-jpg)
I didn't think that I had been here before... but somehow, the place seemed quite familiar. Sure, I did some house-sitting in the are when I was a student... but I think that I also had played a concert in this place a very long time ago as well.
![Mosman Art Gallery: Sydney, AUSTRALIA.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-06-16-22-06-961-img_20260612_101750406-jpg)
So, the main business of the gallery is... gallery stuff. So, the walls are lined with lots of artwork that is for display and sale. No surprise there!
![Mosman Art Gallery: Sydney, AUSTRALIA.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-06-16-22-06-632-img_20260612_115031636-jpg)
But one of the old large spaces (I wonder if it was the gym or the church hall?) has been converted into a large performance space.... which I guess also doubles as a community space, and likely hosts yoga classes as well! ... but for this moment, a very high spaced concert space! And as you would expect from all the wood and brick, it is a very live acoustic to play in... but interestingly enough, as soon as there was an audience... they really soaked up the reflections and resonance... not a problem on the bass end, but the trebles lost carrying power and definition.
![Mosman Art Gallery: Sydney, AUSTRALIA.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-06-16-22-06-173-img_20260612_132437255-jpg)
... and in the park, there was a really aggressive kookaburra that snatched my lunch out my hands. Bastarad!

body.title: Psychologia a życiowe pytania egzystencjalne
body.body:
![w2.png](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/web2.support/870946a659c0bdd4c154e8829fdbec643908a39b.png)

Psychologia może zaszkodzić? Kwestia wewnętrznego cienia. Ważne cytaty mówią o przejściu przez cień, zaakceptowaniu i przepracowaniu go. Psychologia nie powinna być oddzielona od sfery ducha, lecz często oferuje tylko chwilowe rozwiązania. Racjonalistyczna psychologia nie odpowiada na fundamentalne pytania, a filozofowanie o sensie życia jest zawstydzane. Cytaty: George R. R. Martin, Viktor E. Frankl, Colin Sisson, Osho.

Source: https://jarek-kefir.art/2026/06/17/psychologia-a-zyciowe-pytania-egzystencjalne/

body.title: Justification in Christianity: And now that the way of faith has come, we no longer need the law as our guardian. Galatians 3:25
body.body: The apostle Paul was surely the greatest Christian preacher and theologian of the first century AD. His writings, that is, his letters to the different Churches, were the first texts of the New Testament. \nAnd one of the fundamental themes of his theology is the doctrine of justification by faith, a theme that arose due to the spiritual experience he gained during his three missionary trips. It must be understood that in Paul's time, Judaizing Christians maintained that a person could only be declared righteous before God through circumcision and the practice of the Law of Moses, something that Paul flatly rejected, and thus Paul wrote about the doctrine of justification by faith in the Epistle to the Galatians. \nAnd concerning the law, Paul wrote: \

Galatians 3:19. The apostle Paul explained in his letter to the Galatians that spiritual rebirth and consequently the spiritual gift of eternal life could not be attained by fulfilling imperatives or commands. That is why he added with wisdom: \
Galatians 3:21. For Paul, the law was related to the promise of a land, but not to changing hearts. As a consequence, with the arrival of Jesus as the \

, there is a new Israel according to the spirit, and not according to the flesh, and so the law loses its importance in forming the new man, who can only emerge through faith. And so, Paul concluded: \

Galatians 3:25. In other words, a Christian is called a child of God through faith in Jesus, and through this faith is called to the promise of eternal life through grace. And these spiritual teachings had a very deep impact on the new Christians, because with this spiritual doctrine, the doctrine of justification by faith, the apostle Paul laid the theological foundation of Christianity as a world religion.\n![Justification in Christianity. And now that the way of faith has come, we no longer need the law as our guardian. Galatians 3,25.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW2sCnvrenq12FA1DWgHSYudZi25X4yzzkjBCec8Crjea/Justification%20in%20Christianity.%20And%20now%20that%20the%20way%20of%20faith%20has%20come,%20we%20no%20longer%20need%20the%20law%20as%20our%20guardian.%20Galatians%203,25.jpg)\nFor more information, check out my profile, follow the link, and download my ebook.

今天看到一个同事，我既然不认得她，走到她面前，我既然以为是一个陌生人，还好旁边有个同事，我跑过去叫他，可是没有叫那个不认识的同事

那个同事是个女孩，我还以为是另外一个人，直到那个同事叫出来她的名，我吓了一跳，是她？原来她是很漂亮的，很高贵的，怎么一下老得不认得了，问了全哥，原来她退休了。

可是退休也至于老成这样呀，以至于我不认得，我心里有点遗憾，有次舞狮，过年时她还给了100块钱红包给我呀，搞得我不好意思了，都没叫她，其实她的职位还挺高的，是高级总监，全哥还说她退休了，又到公司找点事做，管后勤了。

可能退休也无聊了，难道后勤的事也很让人累吧，以至于好像变了一个，我真的不认得她。 这人生真的感慨万分，有时想不通，这几天都是下雨，天天在下大雨，感觉有时候天都塌下来，路上如果你不随身带着一把伞，你准备随随时变成落鸡汤。

临近节日，不知道给家里买点什么东西，从昨天到今天都想了好久，选来选去，在网上也没选择，最后还是选择了牛奶，寄了三箱牛奶给小孩吃，给爸妈买东西还没想好，老公只是说他会在网上买一些菜，买一些肉，会寄送到家里。

这天气有时下雨有时不下雨，记得昨天我还丢了一把伞在车上，回来的时候又下起了大雨，结果我在路上没伞用了还，还叫老公去接我，真的是搞笑的一天。

---

body.title: Mbappé hizo historia: Francia 3-1 Senegal en el debut mundialista | ¿Penal que no fue?
body.body: Che, hablando bien clarito: este partido tuvo de todo. Golazos, polémica, un récord histórico y un final de locos que te hace acordar por qué el Mundial es lo más grande que hay. Francia y Senegal se enfrentaron hoy en el MetLife Stadium de Nueva Jersey, 82.500 personas en la cancha, y la verdad que el partido no defraudó para nada.\n\nSi viste solo el resultado, decís \

. Pero no, amigo, no fue así. Te voy a contar cómo pasó todo porque vale la pena.

**El primer tiempo: Senegal dominó a Francia**

Y sí, leés bien. Senegal, la selección africana, le jugó de igual a igual al campeón del mundo y en varios momentos fue superior. Nicolás Jackson la tuvo clarísima, remató al palo. Ismaila Sarr tuvo un cabezazo que, no sé cómo, se fue por arriba estando solo en el área chica. Mamá mía, ese gol errado puede pesar después en el grupo.

Francia se veía incómoda. Upamecano y Konaté sudaron frío con la velocidad de Jackson y Diao. El mediocampo de Senegal, con Pape Gueye y Nampalys Mendy, le ganaba la pulseada a Tchouaméni y Rabiot. Griezmann bajaba a recibir pero no encontraba socios. Terminó 0-0 el primer tiempo pero Senegal merecía más.

**La polémica que armó bardo**

Minuto 58. Mbappé encara, entra al área, Mané lo toca —no sé si fue penal o no, la verdad— y Vinčić, el juez esloveno, señaló el punto del penal. Pero acto seguido, el VAR lo llamó. Fue a revisar, miró la pantalla... y anuló el penal. Incluso le sacó amarilla a Mané por la patada pero no fue penal. Una decisión que generó de todo en las redes, unos diciendo que era clarísimo, otros que Mané tocó pelota primero. ¿Vos qué opinás?

**El show de Mbappé arranca en el 66'**

Porque al final, cuando un genio se despierta, no hay VAR que lo pare. Dembélé desbordó por derecha, centro atrás, y Mbappé, de primera, la puso contra el palo. Golazo. 1-0. Y ese no fue cualquier gol.

Ese fue el gol número 58 de Kylian Mbappé con la camiseta de Francia. Ahí nomás, pasó a Olivier Giroud (57) y se convirtió en el **máximo goleador histórico de la selección francesa**. Con 27 años. 27 años, loco. ¿Te das cuenta de lo que es eso? Lleva 58 goles en 88 partidos. Promedio de 0.65 por partido. Es una máquina.

**Barcola liquidó el partido (o eso parecía)**

Minuto 82. Mbappé, que ya estaba encendido, recibió por izquierda, enganchó para adentro y habilitó a Bradley Barcola, que entró fresco desde el banco. El pibe de 22 años, primer Mundial, primer gol. Definición cruzada, imposible para Édouard Mendy. 2-0. Partido liquidado, pensaban todos.

Pero Senegal no se rindió.

**El final de locos**

90+5. Tiro de esquina. La defensa francesa durmió, Ibrahima Mbaye saltó solo y metió un cabezazo que dejó a Maignan sin reacción. 2-1. Aprieten los dientes, que esto no terminó. Quedaba un minuto y el partido se volvió loco. Senegal fue con todo, Koulibaly subió, hasta Mendy fue al área...

Y en la contra, Coman agarró la pelota, vio la subida de Mbappé y se la puso al espacio. Mbappé, con la cancha abierta, encaró a Jakobs, lo dejó sentado y definió cruzado. 3-1. Golpe final. Mbappé otra vez. Doblete. Récord. Historia.

**Datos que no te podés perder**

— Mbappé: 27 años, 58 goles con Francia. Es el máximo goleador de la selección y está entre los 5 máximos goleadores activos del mundo en selecciones (solo atrás de CR7, Messi, Lewandowski y Lukaku).
— Senegal tuvo 45 minutos de primer tiempo increíbles, dominó a Francia, generó chances claras. Si Jackson no tiraba al palo... ¿quién sabe?
— Francia no mostró su mejor versión, pero tiene algo que los grandes tienen: pegada. Cuatro chances claras, tres goles. Eso es efectividad de campeón.
— El Grupo I quedó así: Francia 3 puntos (+2), el que gane de Países Bajos vs. Corea del Sur sale segundo. Senegal se quedó con las manos vacías mereciendo más.

**Mi opinión sincera**

Francia no me gustó del todo. El mediocampo perdió muchas pelotas, la defensa sufrió en velocidad y si Senegal tenía un poquito más de precisión en los últimos metros, hoy estábamos hablando de un empate o incluso una sorpresa. Pero en el Mundial los detalles importan, y Francia tiene a Mbappé, que en este momento es el jugador más determinante del planeta. Simple.

Senegal me dejó re buen sabor. Juegan bien, tienen un equipo sólido, Jackson va a ser figura si agarra confianza. Todavía pueden clasificar, el grupo está abierto.

**Ahora te pregunto a vos**

¿Fue penal lo de Mané sobre Mbappé o el VAR hizo bien?
¿Mbappé ya es el mejor jugador del mundo hoy o todavía falta?
¿Senegal tiene chances de clasificar todavía?

Dejá tu comentario, vamos a debatir como siempre, total para eso estamos acá. El Mundial es esto, che, pasión y debate. Nos leemos.

**********

Alright guys, for my English followers — France beat Senegal 3-1 in their World Cup opener at MetLife Stadium. Mbappé scored twice (66', 90'+6) and became France's all-time top scorer with 58 goals, passing Olivier Giroud. Barcola scored his first World Cup goal (82'). Senegal scored through Ibrahima Mbaye (90'+5) but couldn't complete the comeback. Big controversy at 58' when a penalty for France was overturned by VAR. Senegal hit the post through Jackson and missed a sitter through Sarr — totally dominated the first half. France showed why they're favorites: they don't need to play well to win. Mbappé makes the difference.

What do you think about the VAR call? Drop a comment. ⚽🔥

body.title: Ahogarse en un vaso de agua: Cuando el drama bloquea las soluciones | Drowning in a Glass of Water: When Drama Blocks Solutions
body.body:
![Más allá (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/s-alvarez/EoK5qek9An6XQXtUh4obTen2y4rA454Kujueia4XtMcM4W7bLkBnnjigygGbEFKMUiE.png)

<div class=\

> Hace unos días estuve en una conversación con una persona que no hacía más que hablar de forma negativa y pesimista sobre un problema que tenía, aunque a mí no me parecía un problema tan grande como para hacer tanto drama. Para ponerlos en contexto, a esa persona le habían prestado un teléfono para hacer unas grabaciones y, luego de terminar todo, se dio cuenta de que no tenía una app para transmitir datos como WhatsApp o Telegram y el dueño no quería tener sus cuentas en ese dispositivo. La respuesta a ese problema fue quejarse, mencionar repetidamente que había perdido su tiempo y seguir quejándose como si formara parte de una novela latinoamericana o hubiese perdido una tesis.
\n\n

> Ella me pidió ayuda; sin embargo, ninguna de mis soluciones le parecía bien, decía que era demasiado complicado y volvía a repetir que había perdido su tiempo una y otra vez. Yo no tengo mucha paciencia para eso, no me gusta el drama a menos que sea en alguna serie, así que fui con el dueño para preguntarle si podía agregar mi cuenta y me dijo que sí. Rápidamente descargué Telegram, inicié sesión y listo, eso fue toda la solución en menos de diez minutos. En estas circunstancias podemos decir que se estaba ahogando en un vaso de agua porque la solución era demasiado simple; si la hubiese aceptado cuando se lo propuse unas cuatro horas antes, nos habríamos ahorrado mucho tiempo.
\n\n

> Si soy sincera, yo antes era exactamente igual, solo armaba dramas y culpaba a los demás mientras esperaba que otra persona me solucionara los problemas, hasta que fui a casa de mis abuelos maternos y me di cuenta de que esa forma de actuar no era correcta. Por eso intenté explicarle ese hecho, ya que si yo lo había comprendido, esa persona también lo haría, pero nada más fuera de la realidad; tal vez deba aprenderlo a la mala como yo lo hice.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/3812739/pexels-photo-3812739.jpeg
Imagen de
> Pexel \n\n

> Ese tipo de pensamiento o forma de enfrentar un problema se aprende al crecer mientras vemos a las personas de nuestro entorno; quizás no sea la razón de todas las personas porque nada es absoluto, pero sí debe serlo para muchos, como fue mi caso. Así que, posiblemente, la persona que actúe de esa manera no lo haga pensando que está actuando de forma incorrecta, por lo tanto, debemos tener paciencia con ellos. Si es el caso de alguien cercano, como un hijo o sobrino pequeño, podemos intentar corregirlo porque a temprana edad se puede hacer algo, ya cuando son mayores se vuelve bastante complicado.
\n\n

> Ese tipo de pensamientos está lejos de ser bueno e indica la inmadurez de una persona para enfrentar situaciones difíciles. Esto bloquea por completo la perspectiva de las personas y las vuelve limitadas, como si tuvieran una venda sobre los ojos. Eso las vuelve emocionalmente desgastantes, por eso no debemos involucrarnos mucho, ni tomarnos las cosas personal, tampoco permitir ser el receptor constante de sus quejas; en esos casos es mejor tener una postura neutral. Nuestra energía es muy importante, así que mantengámonos rodeados de personas que nos sumen, y si es alguien con el que debamos relacionarnos, debemos mantener límites claros. Ese será el camino más seguro para mantener nuestra salud mental.

Gracias por leer

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbWiLfXdQC69eQCsnyduRBZPQct12Fwh1iXv1wLx7hHP/11.png

English

![Más allá (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/s-alvarez/EoK5qek9An6XQXtUh4obTen2xzb6MgXFUVgvF4bJbrWnVGeXwa5QswV1kr2ZZVX1Jxj.png)

> A few days ago, I was talking to someone who kept talking negatively and pessimistically about a problem they were having, even though it didn’t seem like such a big deal to me—not worth making such a fuss over. To put it in context, this person had been lent a phone to make some recordings, and after finishing everything, they realized it didn’t have a messaging app like WhatsApp or Telegram, and the owner didn’t want their accounts on that device. Their response to this problem was to complain, repeatedly mention that they’d wasted their time, and keep complaining as if they were in a Latin American novel or had lost their thesis.
\n\n

> She asked me for help; however, none of my solutions seemed to work for her—she said they were too complicated and kept repeating that she’d wasted her time over and over again. I don’t have much patience for that—I don’t like drama unless it’s in a TV show—so I went to the owner to ask if I could add my account, and he said yes. I quickly downloaded Telegram, logged in, and that was it—the whole problem was solved in less than ten minutes. In this case, we could say she was making a mountain out of a molehill because the solution was so simple; if she’d accepted it when I suggested it about four hours earlier, we would have saved ourselves a lot of time.
\n\n

> To be honest, I used to be exactly the same—I’d just make a big fuss and blame others while expecting someone else to solve my problems—until I went to my maternal grandparents’ house and realized that behaving that way wasn’t right. That’s why I tried to explain that to them—since if I had understood it, they would too—but it was completely unrealistic; maybe they’ll have to learn the hard way, just like I did.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/3812739/pexels-photo-3812739.jpeg
Imagen de
> Pexel \n\n

> That kind of thinking or way of dealing with a problem is learned as we grow up by observing the people around us; it may not be true for everyone—because nothing is absolute—but it certainly must be true for many, as it was in my case. So, it’s possible that someone who acts that way doesn’t do so thinking they’re doing anything wrong; therefore, we must be patient with them. If it’s someone close to us, like a child or a young nephew or niece, we can try to correct them because it’s possible to do something at a young age; once they’re older, it becomes quite complicated.
\n\n

> That kind of thinking is far from healthy and indicates a person’s immaturity when it comes to dealing with difficult situations. It completely blocks people’s perspective and limits them, as if they were wearing a blindfold. This makes them emotionally draining, which is why we shouldn’t get too involved, take things personally, or allow ourselves to be the constant recipient of their complaints; in those cases, it’s best to maintain a neutral stance. Our energy is very important, so let’s surround ourselves with people who uplift us, and if there’s someone we have to interact with, we should set clear boundaries. That will be the surest way to maintain our mental health.

Thank you for reading
