title.title: El pulso de las comunidades — 16 jun.
title.body:
![Analisis de comunidades](https://images.pexels.com/photos/7788009/pexels-photo-7788009.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)

## 🌐 La vida en las comunidades de Hive — 16 de junio de 2026

Hoy quiero hacer algo distinto. En lugar del reporte clasico con numeros frios, quiero hablar de lo que realmente mueve esta red: las comunidades. Porque al final, Hive no es solo tecnologia blockchain, es gente. Y la gente se reune en comunidades.

### 📍 Comunidades con mas movimiento

Mire las estadisticas de las comunidades mas activas y esto fue lo que encontre:

• **Ecency** — 0 subscriptores
• **Photography Lovers** — 0 subscriptores
• **Freewriters** — 0 subscriptores
• **Worldmappin** — 0 subscriptores
• **Hive Learners** — 0 subscriptores
• **Lifestyle** — 0 subscriptores

Lo interesante es que la mayoria de estas comunidades tienen contenido variado y de calidad. No es solo un tema, hay de todo. Y eso habla bien del ecosistema.

### 🏆 Post destacados de comunidades

Estos son los posts que mas estan dando que hablar en las comunidades hoy:

💎 **$9.71** — [@hanshotfirst en **sports**](https://hive.blog/@hanshotfirst/nba-finals)
🔥 **$7.55** — [@acidyo en **thoughts**](https://hive.blog/@acidyo/aides)
⭐ **$7.28** — [@tarazkp en **hive-126152**](https://hive.blog/@tarazkp/lock-away-baggage)
👏 **$6.35** — [@cryptoandcoffee en **hive-167922**](https://hive.blog/@cryptoandcoffee/the-south-africa-economy-is-on-life-support-evm)
📌 **$6.01** — [@ecency.waves en **hive-125125**](https://hive.blog/@ecency.waves/waves-20260616945o85)

Cada uno de estos posts merece un vistazo. Pase por algunos y deje comentarios porque vale la pena apoyar el contenido original.

### 🔥 Top general de la red

💎 **$9.71** — [@hanshotfirst — \

](https://hive.blog/@plantfuljourney/garden-in-june)

### 📊 Datos rapidos

• **107.333.829** bloques procesados
• **2.615.133** cuentas en la red
• **37.9%** del supply stakeado — la comunidad confia
• **421 upvotes** vs **0 downvotes** en el periodo
• Reward pool: **754,144 HIVE** disponible

### 💬 Un poco de feeling

La verdad que cuando uno se pone a revisar comunidad por comunidad, se da cuenta de algo: Hive esta vivo. No es solo trading ni precios. Hay gente creando, compartiendo, curando. A veces nos enfocamos tanto en el precio que nos olvidamos de lo importante: el contenido y la gente que lo genera.

Hoy especialmente vi movimiento en **Ecency**, con posts que realmente valen la pena. Si no estas participando activamente en al menos una comunidad, te recomiendo que te metas. Es ahi donde realmente se siente el pulso de la red.

¿Cual es tu comunidad favorita? ¿En cual pasas mas tiempo? Dejalo en los comentarios, los leo a todos!

---

*Datos de las APIs publicas de Hive. Analisis hecho con onda, no solo con numeros. Nos vemos en la cadena!* 👋

>This turned out to be a somewhat positive post. That wasn't obvious from the start. I thought it would rather become dark again. 

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://usermedia.actifit.io/61bd6172-cddd-4bda-9e89-fb7b7e75760b.jpg

Friday is my birthday. 37 it is. Can't say I care too much about that in and of itself. There was one thing that made me care about them, though - Lily. This is going to be my first birthday in a long time without her. Father's Day and my birthday are always very close (this year they're only 2 days apart), a good excuse to have Lily spend the month of June with me. That included also the Inti Raymi, the Sun Festival, celebrated by the indigenous here. Since many of my friends, including Lily's former nanny, are Kichwa, Lily is always invited to join them (more than I...). They dress her up in traditional clothing, and she gets stuffed with sweets and other stuff that I grumpily smile upon and say \

Not this year. I still have no clue where they are. The legal process is taking its time, as predicted. All parts of it. But being at the courthouse also allows me to see the rest of it. My case, though loathsome to me, is not as bad.

*I have many blessings.*

And it's good to be reminded of them. My family, by blood and by choice. My community. My education. My upbringing. My relative wealth. My health. My looks. My mindset. And I could probably go on, going further into detail about all the little things I'm grateful for (like the awesome coffee mill that my brother gifted me). 

*A blessing never comes alone.*

At least for me. In every blessing lies responsibility. On how to use it. In an inter-connected world, we're not the result of \
hard work and self-development. Everything relies on our relations to others, both humans and the environment. \
alone does not exist, it only exists in the relation \

. *Anyone knows from which half-forgotten German philosopher that statement is paraphrased?* Hence, nothing I have is entirely mine. Yes, I did my part to obtain a few of them. Others are more like privileges (a trigger word for some 😉), pure luck. Or bad luck, for others. There is the possibility of re-incarnation as what you deserve to be, but I could never wrap my mind around that. I rather believe in the combination of self-obtained and gifted blessings. *What to make of them?* That, too, is part of the responsibility. To turn the blessings into more than just the ego-centered acceptance of them, but to use them to do good by others. To give back. Which will probably lead to more blessings somehow, at least in my experience. Everything I shared genuinely and altruistically came back 10 fold. An epiphany that somewhat compromises the altruistic component. Oh, well. It's still genuine. *It all fades, anyway.* Just today I commented on a [post quoting Marcus Aurelius](https://peakd.com/hive-181290/@galenkp/mind-fuel). MA has many blessings, so to speak, being an emperor. But he never gets complacent about that. He always reminds himself of what is more important than anything material - working on one's self. *Which is a blessing, too.* Being able to do so. Being able to wanting to do so. Being able to even realize there's work to be done. I know way too many people who don't have that ability. I believe that working intrinsically is the path to true happiness. Which aligns me a lot with the Stoics. And I'm glad that a friend of mine talks about them often enough that I bough Meditations when I saw them on sale in Germany. *I'm blessed.* Despite my aching heart. Despite the injustice. It's good to remember that from time to time. ___ What are your thoughts about this topic? Please feel free to engage in any original way, including dropping links to your posts on similar topics. I'm happy to read (and curate) any quality content that is not created by LLM/AI, as well as read your own experience and point of view, I love to learn! > Pictures taken with a Motorola Edge 60 Pro, I reserve the copyright - but feel free to ask if you want to use one of the pictures!

title.title: Punishment For Who???
title.body:
![Yelllow and Blue Modern Geometric How To Design Youtube Thumbnail (51).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23xedoMsaqfRAoTvtwe2dL5Cjd3kspY3PdLcwKdCyw9Y6XD2j1dLpm5mtUeWcJ6jVMpMt.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) Omo… from what I’ve seen, the threat of punishment is the one thing that keeps society running and structured. Knowing that if you do something that you shouldn’t, you could be punished severely, it deters 90% of the population from doing it. And that way, many people continue to be functioning members of society. Because if this weren’t the case, then there would be more people in prison than out of it. So, it shows that the threat does work. But then, how can I say this? Especially when there are so many people locked up in prison right now? Or the fact that some have an ongoing trial that will most definitely land them in prison for a very long time. And then, there are those that, at this very moment, I’m making this post, they are either involved in a criminal act, planning to engage in a criminal act, or basking in the rewards they got from a criminal act. Either way, it’s only a matter of time before they end up in the same place all criminals go. Prison. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) One of the reasons crimes are so rampant is not because the punishment doesn’t work. The threat of being uprooted from your home and isolated from society and development, letting the world go by while your entire life comes to a startling halt, is enough to make anyone rethink a life of crime. If that threat is removed, many people will become criminals overnight. Once people realize that they can get away with something, they will most likely do it. And that is the reason many people don’t get into crime, because they believe they’d get caught and be in a pot of hot mess But then, there is only a tiny fraction of the population that actually commits the crimes. The thing is, there will always be those who think they can game the system. They believe that they can outsmart it and commit their crime and avoid punishment. And while that usually happens, it’s not always the case. Because more often than not, cases are being solved every single day. ![IMG_20230610_010223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/243WU7RNBshb8Pkf1pJLjTpyYGdXHpBACHzsRfCBMTLvDZcE3TrmBayho5y9sSsVEkmJg.jpg) And then, there are those who just don’t care about the consequences of their actions. They really don’t mind going to prison; they simply do what they want and accept whatever punishment comes their way. In a nutshell, people are funny, and they will only do what is on their mind. For a majority of the populace, the looming threat of prison is enough to deter them from a life of crime, which is our saving grace. And that’s why when there’s even the tiniest break in law and order, maybe when a protest gets out of hand and turns into a riot, you see people resorting to senseless violence and looting. These are things that we’re all capable of, but in the end, we don’t do them because they are against the law and could get us in serious trouble. The punishment is not the problem. It’s just people being people. ![IMG_20230518_1629282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23zaokZrHxY1G7fCu9mKew7D2wzsnR6s4uA7Pcvtc3q4rs2kJbvNLXJnn8NDAcLC4L5V6.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***
Watch My Engaging Stories on: [Facebook](https://web.facebook.com/brunokemaofficial), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@bruno_kema), and [TikTok]( https://www.tiktok.com/@bruno_kema?_r=1&_t=ZN-91fKKHrMpuw).
***
N.B: All images used in this post are mine. The thumbnail was designed using Canva.

title.title: My childhood days..
title.body:
‎Hello guys, good day all.
‎This week's prompts is kid of funny to me because I involved my self in so many children's play,they are more memories of childhood that I can never forget easily,I could remember those days when I used to played in the rain naked, when I had to play football even if i don't know how to play, I could remember a day when I hit my brother on his leg with a pressing iron just because of a hid and seek game,he took it to the next level and turned into a scary being, so I had to save my life.
(Sorry bro for that)

![dieter-van-hammee-KuHPCIqXA-M-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/favour20045/23vhU22CXBJ4JwBaqGkvfwMd5obPdzUbZu8cx332nB8yHJGiJdYMJ7HyoMoLRbzFzeGz9.jpg)[img sur](https://unsplash.com/photos/two-children-sitting-on-the-grass-playing-with-each-other-KuHPCIqXA-M)

I will be sharing the most funniest and unforgettable one here 
‎I grew up in a compound where a lot of children live. After every school hour, it was time to play, and my street will be filled with lots of children who also came from other compound to play with us.
‎
‎As a kid, we always watch our parent cook for us while we sit down and eat, sometimes  then, we (my friends and I) decided to cook and make it our own, we shared the food items accordingly and prepared for the cooking. Many of us steal from our home, and sometime when they get caught, they lie to cover up.
Sometimes it works and sometimes you just get the beaten

title.title: How do you store your potatoes? A tragic reminder we overlook
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZCdcQWQXMZrdnvhrtQtqRzmekPHeHHVAAmp8sKNDkeWW/image.png)
>Image Credit: [M Kazim](https://www.pexels.com/photo/freshly-harvested-potatoes-in-burlap-sack-35873595/)


I got far too comfortable with potatoes because they are such a familiar food that everyone eats, and it doesn't really seem possible they could harm anyone until I read about an unusual incident that happened a few years ago. I took it seriously enough to look this up.

In 2014, a family in Russia died after going into their basement to check on potatoes that had been left there for a long time. One by one they went down and then collapsed inside, and only the 8-year-old girl survived after being left upstairs. Apparently they were overcome by gases that had built up in the enclosed area where the potatoes had rotted, turning it into a dangerous atmosphere.

Reading this led me into looking more into the proper storage of potatoes, and I also found out about solanine (unrelated to the incident but worth mentioning). 

Solanine is a natural toxic compound (glycoalkaloid) found in potatoes, which the plant produces to defend itself against pests. It occurs in higher concentrations after exposure to light, if the potatoes turn green, if they sprout heavily, or if they start to rot. It can cause nausea, vomiting, stomach cramps, headaches, dizziness, and, in severe cases, neurological symptoms. This is not a gas being generated; it's a compound within the potato itself.

The more I read, the more I realised that potatoes are one of those foods we often leave forgotten in the back of a cupboard or cellar because they seem so harmless. 

In fact, modern retail even sells potatoes individually shrink-wrapped in plastic, despite the fact they’re naturally a bulk, breathable storage food.

In reality, they should be stored in a cool, dark, dry, and well-ventilated place. They should be protected from direct sunlight to prevent greening, kept away from excess moisture that encourages rot, and checked regularly so that any spoiled potatoes can be removed before they affect the rest. If one potato starts rotting, it can quickly spread decay to the others.

They should also never be left in sealed or poorly ventilated spaces for long periods. While this is extremely unlikely in a normal household, allowing large amounts of organic matter to decompose in an enclosed area can create unsafe conditions.

So, apart from the important distinction that solanine itself is not a gas, the more general lesson is how easily we can become complacent with very ordinary, well-known foods. 

Potatoes are perfectly safe when stored and handled properly but they still need proper care and storage just like any other food.

We cannot be too relaxed about them. Storing food properly and using it safely not only helps reduce waste but also protects our health.

References:

European Food Safety Authority. (2020). https://doi.org/10.2903/j.efsa.2020.6222

Food Standards Agency. (n.d.). Food safety and hygiene. https://www.food.gov.uk

Huffington Post UK (2014) 
[Girl, 8, Orphaned After Gas From Rotting Potatoes Killed Her Entire Family](https://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/2014/08/14/girl-8-orphaned-after-gas-from-rotting-potatoes-killed-her-entire-family_n_7360976.html)

title.title: Aides
title.body:
In an effort to refrain from relying on DHF/reward pool support in the future, I've been working on some of my projects switching to ad revenue, primarily google adsense. The hard part, however is to get accepted there as for most of my newer projects there's little activity. 

In the near future I'll be hosting a series of contests and awards to make some of these (especially non-profit) projects grow in activity, non-profit meaning they don't benefit me personally, think POSH, Decentmemes, scrobble.life and in a way you could even imagine holozing considering we launched the token fairly. 

Some of these sites I do however not want to have ads because it won't make much sense, but they may still be added into the bulk temporarily in order to get accepted for advertising as a whole. I've largely ran some of these projects using the rewards pool in the past, some of them slightly controversial based on who you ask but most deemed okay since the nature of them has been to bring value to hive as a whole and not a specific project/entity. 

It'd still be nice however if we can offset some of those costs with ads. 

There's a new advertisement for web games I learned about recently called H5 Games Ads by google, it attempts to mimic how ads work in mobile games on the playstore onto website based games. I.e. to get certain boosts/skip some waiting time/etc, you take 10-30 seconds to watch an ad to receive said in-game boost. While testing some mobile games in the past few months as \
, I've encountered that most operate in this way and most players deem it an okay way to obtain things that give them a boost in the game. While I'm going to attempt my best to not make it \

but simply a convenience thing, I think more of our projects ought to look into this new advertisement offer and see if they can implement it into their games. 

Either way, just a short post today, I'm quite busy juggling a few projects at the moment and will be hosting a few contests here soon hopefully with the help of a few other people so we can populate some of these projects a bit more to make them adsense viable which should help with hive sell pressure/server costs even a little.

title.title: Англійська, якої нас учили, і англійська, якою говорять люди
title.body:
/>

Ми вчили в школі:  
“The weather is fine.”

На урок англійської треба було принести маленькі дзеркальця, так ми тренували англійські звуки:  
s, z, th, w, sh та інші.

Правильно складали губи.  
Правильно ставили язик.  
Правильно відкривали щелепу.

І фраза “London is the capital of Great Britain” вбилась у пам’ять назавжди. Разом із тим ідеальним “the weather is fine”😎

А потім минають роки.  
І ти приїжджаєш в Ірландію.

Де НІХТО не вимовляє ці звуки так, як нас учили.

А місцева погода описується словами:  
“miserable”,  
“awful”,  
“grand”,  
“soft day”,  
але ніяк не “fine”.

І мені здається, що радянські підручники англійської готували нас не до реального життя, а до зустрічі з якимось міфічним англійцем. Який стоїть десь у Лондоні ідеально вимовляє every single sound і насолоджується fine weather, якого ніхто ніколи не бачив😉

title.title: There are no \
teams in this World Cup [EN/PT]
title.body:
> Today I was rooting against France. I really wanted to see Senegal win this match, and for a good portion of the game, that seemed entirely possible. The African side put in a balanced performance and, if not for that shot that hit the post in the first half, they might even have taken the lead. Would that moment have changed the entire story of the match? Maybe. Football is made of talent, skill, physical preparation, and often, small moments. A goal at that point could have boosted Senegal's confidence and forced France to play under pressure. We'll never know. In the end, the 3–1 scoreline was actually quite comfortable for the French. And that is exactly why I consider France the biggest favorite to win the tournament. As a Brazilian, I admit that I always root against them. Maybe it's the frustration of seeing such a strong national team that isn't ours. Since the first World Cup I followed, back in 1998, France has always been one of the most feared teams in the world. Just like Germany, which left us with an unforgettable memory in 2014, now recalled in their match against Curaçao, and, of course, Argentina, our greatest rival, the French somehow manage to renew themselves generation after generation without losing competitiveness. That is why it's hard not to feel a certain sadness when seeing the Brazilian national team so far from that level. Our opening match against Morocco was well below expectations. Can we still go far? Of course we can. After all, football is not decided on paper. But looking at the competition so far, it's difficult to place Brazil among the main favorites. Then again, given the balance we've seen in this World Cup, nothing is truly decided. It's hard to make any firm predictions, and I'm not sure whether that's a positive or a negative thing for our team. In fact, one of the things that has impressed me the most in this World Cup is the level of balance between the teams. Nations considered smaller are putting up extremely tough fights against traditional powers. I was surprised by the United States' performance against Paraguay, a team I follow more closely and one that is far from weak. We've also seen very competitive matches involving Spain and Belgium against theoretically inferior opponents. Cape Verde holding Spain for much of their match is a perfect reflection of what I've been seeing in this tournament. There are no easy games anymore. The technical gap still exists, but it feels smaller than in previous editions. And when that happens, surprises become much more likely. So far, that was my favorite match, even though it ended 0–0. Now I hope Brazil's match against Haiti is a little more comfortable. A convincing victory, perhaps by two or three goals, would do a lot to boost the team's confidence. On paper, it is an accessible matchup. In practice, however, this World Cup has already shown several times that theory and reality do not always go hand in hand. I want to see our young prospects on the field. Endrick and Rayan deserve an opportunity; they are our hope for the future. There are no more easy opponents. Every team arrives organized, physically prepared, and capable of competing. That is turning this World Cup into an extremely interesting tournament. And if someone manages to eliminate France, I believe the path to the title will become completely open. Today, in my view, there is one team above all the others. France seems to be a few steps ahead of the competition. But football loves to defy expectations, and perhaps that is exactly what makes a World Cup so fascinating. What could happen next? I only know one thing: I don't want France to win, even if they deserve it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVuLW4MCHGadXZxxRtKFnetXhwEoaZ5gN9E2h5JCagFYr/image.png)
[Source](https://www.lance.com.br/fora-de-campo/gol-perdido-em-franca-x-senegal-impressiona-torcida-chocante.html)
Hoje eu estava torcendo contra a França. Queria muito ver Senegal vencer essa partida e, durante boa parte do jogo, isso pareceu perfeitamente possível. A equipe africana fez um confronto equilibrado e, se não fosse aquela bola na trave no primeiro tempo, poderia até ter saído na frente do placar. Esse detalhe teria mudado toda a história da partida? Talvez. O futebol é feito de talento, habilidade, preparo físico e, muitas vezes, de pequenos momentos. Um gol naquele instante poderia aumentar a confiança de Senegal e obrigar a França a jogar sob pressão. Nunca saberemos. No fim, o placar de 3 a 1 acabou sendo até confortável para os franceses. E é justamente por isso que considero a França a grande favorita ao título. Como brasileiro, admito que sempre torço contra eles. Talvez seja aquela dor de cotovelo de ver uma seleção tão forte que não seja a nossa. Desde a primeira Copa que acompanhei, em 1998, a França sempre esteve entre as equipes mais temidas do mundo. Assim como a Alemanha, que nos deixou uma lembrança inesquecível em 2014, relembrada agora contra a seleção de Curaçao.. e bem, a Argentina, nossa maior rival, os franceses conseguem se renovar geração após geração sem perder competitividade. Por isso é difícil não sentir certa tristeza ao ver a Seleção Brasileira distante desse nível. Nossa estreia contra Marrocos foi muito abaixo do esperado. Podemos ir longe? Claro que podemos, afinal futebol não é decidido apenas no papel. Mas olhando para o contexto da competição até aqui, é difícil colocar o Brasil entre os principais favoritos, mas pelo equilíbrio dessa copa, bem, não temos nada definido e é difícil cravar qualquer coisa e não sei se isso é um ponto positivo ou negativo para a nossa seleção. Aliás, uma das coisas que mais me chamou atenção nesta Copa foi justamente o equilíbrio entre as seleções. Equipes consideradas menores estão fazendo jogos duríssimos contra potências tradicionais. Fiquei surpreso com a atuação dos Estados Unidos contra o Paraguai, uma seleção que acompanho mais de perto e que está longe de ser fraca. Também vimos partidas equilibradas envolvendo Espanha e Bélgica contra adversários teoricamente inferiores. Cabo Verde segurando a Espanha durante grande parte do confronto é um retrato perfeito do que estou vendo nesta Copa. Não existem mais jogos fáceis. A diferença técnica ainda existe, mas ela parece menor do que em edições anteriores. E quando isso acontece, as surpresas se tornam muito mais prováveis. Até aqui, foi meu jogo favorito, mesmo sendo um placar de 0 x 0. Agora espero que o jogo do Brasil contra o Haiti seja mais tranquilo. Uma vitória convincente, quem sabe por dois ou três gols de diferença, ajudaria bastante a elevar a confiança da equipe. Na teoria, é um confronto acessível. Na prática, porém, esta Copa já mostrou várias vezes que teoria e realidade nem sempre andam juntas. Quero ver nossas promessa em campo, Endrick e Rayan merecem uma oportunidade, são nossa esperança. Não existem mais seleções bobas. Todos os times chegam organizados, preparados fisicamente e capazes de competir. Isso está transformando esta Copa em um torneio extremamente interessante. E se por acaso alguém conseguir eliminar a França, acredito que o caminho para o título ficará completamente aberto. Hoje, para mim, existe uma seleção acima de todas as outras. A França parece estar alguns passos à frente da concorrência. Mas o futebol adora contrariar as previsões, e talvez seja exatamente isso que torne uma Copa do Mundo tão fascinante. O que será que pode acontecer? Eu só sei que não quero que a França vença, por mais que ela mereça.

title.body:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVhGLSUbc87fTqpGEEqWVmTmL1fwLMLzt68suRGQDoSbG/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/sat-boy-childhood-line-simple-9706519/) *When we were young, we wished we were adults, and when we became adults, we started missing our childhood days that were free of worries and responsibilities.* *I have a lot of memories from growing up, and many of them are no longer cherished in this new era, or maybe it is just the environment I find myself in.* *I remember back then, my favourite games were Suwe, Police and Thief, Boju Boju, and I Call On. Now, I can’t remember the last time I saw kids playing these games on the streets because we are now in the digital age. Children are no longer behaving like children; they prefer spending time online with their mobile devices.* *One memory that never leaves me is our house’s main door. I was so small and short that my hand couldn’t reach the lock. As the years passed and I grew older, I started climbing a chair just to reach it. Whenever I visit home, I always remember how I used to be that little boy whose hand couldn’t reach the door lock. That memory will forever remain green in my heart.* *There were also some adverts I never joked with back then. I used to monitor the time just so I could watch them. One was the Skye Bank advert where they sang, “I wish I had someone who can help with my dreams,” and the other was the Cowbell advert where they sang, “Oyoyoyoyoyoyo, our milk…”*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZykZxPMfHBx95zVHGyjSWuDcGGsY1er6keKriUmVydX1/image.png)

I loved RoboCop. Back then, it was on a video cassette, and whenever a part of the movie started skipping, we would roll the tape a little to fix it*. *Then came the CD era, which gradually replaced video cassettes. I also remember the famous 300-in-1 game CDs. I loved playing Battle City, Contra, and a few other games. Those games brought me so much joy that when I grew older, I even tried to buy the CD again, only to discover that it was no longer being sold.* *I miss those games, those adverts, those childhood street games, and the little moments that seemed ordinary at the time but became priceless memories later in life.*

Я завжди була тією дівчиною, яка хотіла більшого.

Начитавшись Жюль Верна, мріяла відчалити в навколосвітню подорож. Побудувала човен зі старого корита, замість паруса - бабусин підодіяльник.

Взяла провіант в торбу, написала бабусі записку: «повернусь в кінці літа, до школи встигну, батькам не кажи»

І відчалила від берега.

Корито затонуло одразу, де річка ще по коліно😌

Ридала, волокла те корито городами назад у двір (щоб ніхто не бачив прозора). Бабуся навіть не помітила моїх судноплавних спроб. Поралась з качками.

Річку Конку я так і не підкорила (Запорізька область), але мріяти про подорожі не перестала.

Наступного літа побудувала човен з картону. Більший і ширший. Надійніший, як мені здавалось.

Про фінал ви здогадались, так?🙂

Мені було вісім. Років з десяти я почала влаштовувати сільські концерти. З репетиціями, солістами, віршами, ведучими. В рамках одного бабусиного двору. Залучила всіх городських дітей, хто відбував літо на городах, як я.

Ну і далі все було в такому ж темпі. Якщо кохання - то щоб як книжках, де бʼються за один лише погляд.

В пʼятнадцять хотіла стати продюсером. В ті часи далеко не всі знали що те слово означає. Бабуся хрестилась і казала: «краще конюхом, як твій дід. Чи йди вже на станцію, як батьки»

Деякі мрії таки збувались. З часом. І в кіно я працювала, як частина команди. Нехай важче, нехай виснажливо, але щоб серце билося швидше від того, що ти робиш. А не стабільність як на АЕС (ну зараз я так не думаю)

Подорожувати так, щоб мої історії читали в журналах і дивилися по телебаченню. Писати книжки не на один вечір, а такі, що живуть довше за автора і передаються з покоління в покоління.

Навіть коли життя привело мене в еміграцію, я не перестала мріяти. Я не хотіла прожити роки, просто виживаючи. Хоч починалось все досить неромантично- з наметів і прибирань чужих будинків.

Але я не хотіла назавжди залишитися людиною, яка відкладає свої бажання «на потім». Я хотіла бачити красу навколо себе, працювати в розкішному замку, відкривати нові двері й доводити собі, що походження, обставини чи чужі сумніви не визначають межі моїх можливостей.

Можливо, мої мрії здавалися надто великими. Але саме вони вели мене вперед тоді, коли було страшно, важко і невідомо.

Бо іноді найбільший ризик — це не мріяти взагалі💝

title.title: «А куди мені повертатися?» — питання, на яке в мене досі немає відповіді\n
title.body:
/>

Вчора колеги запитали мене:  
— Коли закінчиться війна, ти повернешся додому?

Я відповіла, що багато українців справді повернуться. Бо в них є куди повертатися. Є дім, квартира, вулиця, місто, яке чекає на них. Зараз вони тут через війну, бо навіть у відносно спокійних містах України може прилетіти ракета.

Але як повертатися тим, у кого дому більше немає?

Як повернутися людині, чиє місто залишилося лише назвою на мапі? Де все зруйноване.

Як повернутися мені?  
Моє місто вже понад чотири роки в окупації. Воно заміноване, розграбоване і спустошене. Вигоріли соснові ліси. Немає Каховського водосховища, яке живило атомну станцію. Немає прогулянкового каналу. Немає багато того, що я пам’ятаю і люблю.

І ніхто не знає, що там залишиться після окупантів. Коли вони підуть. Якщо підуть. Скільки років знадобиться на розмінування. Що буде зі станцією. Чи не перетвориться вона на ще одну законсервовану зону, як Чорнобиль?

Простої відповіді не має. І я розумію ірландців, що для багатьох Україна — це щось дуже далеке і незрозуміле. Що для свого колективу я така ж невідома, як людина із Сомалі чи Зімбабве. І вони ставлять запитання не тому, що хочуть образити. Вони не хочуть гуглити щоб розібратись. Простіше напряму, через мене.

Відчуваю себе як маленьке консульство України☺️ Тому беру аркуш паперу і малюю їм Україну. Показую лінію фронту. Пояснюю, що таке окупація. Чому Крим, Донецьку і Луганську окупували раніше, чому це для росіян було важливо. Які території залишаються окупованими зараз.

Я не знаю, що буде далі. Не знаю, які рішення ухвалять щодо українців в Ірландії. Не знаю, як працюватимуть нові схеми переходу, що буде з громадянством і як усе це виглядатиме через рік.

Питань багато. Відповідей мало. Навіть про ту транзитну схему - два роки штампу 4 з можливістю подовження ще на 2. Але де взяти пʼятий рік для того громадянства?

Зараз кожен другий в інтернеті експерт. Консультує, бере гроші, щось обіцяє…

Я зрозуміла одну річ.

Якщо намагатися вирішити всі питання, що сиплються на голову щоденно, і всі виклики навколо -одночасно, можна просто зламатися.

Тому за два роки еміграції я вивчила одне дуже важливе слово. Потихеньку.

Саме так ми і живу.  
Потихеньку.  
Від дня до дня.  
Від виклику до виклику.  
Від надії до надії.

title.title: Queen Victoria Statue
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNmdaeKKb8UdeXsEq5w9tE6jpvQBuJEhg7Xdm4rhg8Wod/img_8991.jpg)

There are somewhere in the region of 175 statues and public artworks that depict Queen Victoria across the country. 

The nearest one probably to where I live is in Reading just outside the fantastic piece of architecture that is Reading’s town hall. 

Created by prominent local artist and businessman George Blackall Simonds (who also sculpted the iconic Maiwand Lion in Forbury Gardens). George’s family were also the owners of the brewery that bore the family name. There’s a lot of references to the Simonds family around the area. 

I’ll be posting more of these over time, my aim is to chart historic points of interest around my local area.

title.title: Tax Filing
title.body:
Hello Hive Fam

Good day to you all, and I hope you're having a good time wherever you are.

Tax filing is a once-a-year activity, and in India, it generally starts from the end of June after the employers provide Form 16. I'm not sure how it works for the businesses because I'm not a businessman, but for the people who are salaried, this cycle starts from this time only. Since I'm a salaried person, I also follow the same, and for many years, I have been doing my tax filing either at the end of June or in July, before the month ends. Generally, this deadline is 31st January, but sometimes it is extended by the government on public demand; however, I prefer not to wait for the last day and finish my tax filing on time to avoid last-minute hassles.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23wCUdTYeQQcWC2RhrrQnqcB7GqAHwWHA9juVCUERGiAjP2fLTFa2jx4zvcLTVAm5rSJp.png)

**GPT AI Image**

I have got the required documentation from the employer. Now, since I have the documentation ready with me, I am trying to get it done as soon as I can, but before I do that, I also try to read a lot on the Internet about the latest news and updates. I do my tax filing on my own, and I do not ask for assistance. This is why it is very important for me to get updated about the latest rules and regulations so that I abide by the government guidelines.


I will be spending the next few days reading and going through all the latest updates related to the tax filing, and after that, I will proceed to submit my tax filing in the government portal. There are some 3rd party portal also which are integrated with the government portal. I have been doing it on the government portal because I can't share my personal information on the 3rd party server, which I am not sure how it will be handled. So even if the government site works slowly sometimes, that's OK since this is the only option I am going to use, no matter what.

I understand that process sometimes, because generally things can be complex, but that's OK since it's a once-a-year activity, and I'm all good to spend time on it so that I am aware of what I have filed, and it gives me good confidence that I should get it done through someone else when I can do it by myself, just by spending some time. Because it gives me better control and helps me learn new things in terms of taxation. Thank you!

title.title: Trying to love digital again and failing
title.body:
![Timeline 1_01_00_01.19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23xoyovQ9xXo4sUxXB1WvPGDJULoyqdeCRkb7fqDrBp29GTvdLRRqexAQiBqdLQdCVSq3.jpg)

I have been shooting film a lot more recently and I have fallen back in love with it. I even feel like I'm not necessarily conservative with shooting the film based on the price but also just more aware of what I want to shoot now. So I don't go crazy like I would with digital. And even there I feel like I've slowed down a bit. Perhaps from walking the same streets so much to the point of exhaustion. Where only at events does it seem like there's something worthy of shooting. In a few days I will have a Canon FD 28mm F2.8 for the Canon AE-1, another vintage lens but actually for the vintage camera it was made for. I'm really excited to use it, and I do think that given I'm 10 shots into a roll of film now, I'm almost waiting for that lens to continue again.

![Timeline 1_01_00_08.19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23tvVh1YhZE6TvX2aL7Ux86KHSBHWMyn7KkVuUnmneo9wwQLXGoi4nRSjvM6ez7ZERypY.jpg)

So I switched to digital today and I just could not enjoy it. Everything felt a bit too blown out with the digital camera, the strong Armenian sun had some really harsh light that just did not work with the lens and camera. Everything felt tighter given the digital camera has an APS-C sensor and 35mm is full frame. I feel like I really need that extra space of a wider focal length and I've definitely said it a few times before here. But maybe that's why I switched to film again, knowing that it is actually full frame. Feeling more manual and in control than with the digital. Where film can look good in intense light, but digital needs ND filters and such, and that's where shooting digital at the moment just hasn't been that fun.

![Timeline 1_01_00_19.17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23vsGDSiusBfXYKYKMT3eBqXXtkFsNn5sbUbhBEJE5Ryfg72n1W2EnhiQyqGVjHRLtn9R.jpg)

I don't think I'm ultimately giving up with digital, I just think that it has some limitations at the moment that have been pulling back my creative potential, and I can definitely feel it in the moment. Whereas going back to the film camera has almost felt like a form of liberation. Back to the simplicity of a more mechanically feeling camera. Even with the vintage lenses on the Sony something still feels a bit off, but again I do think it's the sensor as well as the crop that is introduced on those lenses. It definitely feels more challenging to take anything I feel like I actually enjoy. But the fun of photography is that you can just switch to some other camera with a different format and find something new in it.

title.title: Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest - Round #430 Shadows on my last day of classes [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
> Hey [Shadow Hunters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-179017) friends! Welcome to my entry in the SMASH contest [Round #430](https://ecency.com/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-62cfc426e602c), the third of June, and we can already feel the first days of summer. Unfortunately, I haven't been able to fully enjoy them because I fell ill with a virus that knocked me out on Friday, and I've been fighting it almost stoically! This Tuesday, I not only finished my theory classes, but I also had to give my students the introduction to my lab practice, which is basically a hematology lab. In short, today was a long day that required all my strength to complete, so I rested almost strictly yesterday, Monday, to wake up in the best possible mood and be able to teach those four continuous hours of class. The day dawned in the worst possible way, cloudy and rainy. It was as if fate didn't want me to finish my teaching load that day. But duty called. My voice had recovered and the sore throat was gone, so I went and taught my four consecutive hours of classes. I won't lie, I was exhausted and terribly thirsty. I bought a bottle of water and decided to refresh myself on the lab stairs, and there, almost as a kind of reward, the sky cleared and the clouds parted, revealing a radiant sun that gifted me these wonderful shadows I'm sharing with you today. And after all that effort, it felt like a reward, since I had arrived early at the Faculty hoping to capture a couple of worthwhile shadows, but with the overcast sky, it was impossible to get anything interesting. Just as I was about to leave, almost resigned to my fate, I was gifted this shadow projected on the walls of the research lab's stairwell.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5cjRXBGbVagS1dexA5cFdYoF1bkc2fuXzrjFpQUrvG1/photo_1_2026_06_16_15_18_57.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbAvvmmqe44tN1ipZKgwCse9LHx3jpcPNcLW4VM9fMTZC/photo_5_2026_06_16_15_18_57.jpg) --|--

> This part of the lab buildings is one of my favorites, not only because I can find free Wi-Fi, but also because it tends to create quite interesting shadows depending on the time of day. In this case, it was already 11 a.m., and the long concrete walls intersect with the metal railings that serve as handrails for going down the stairs. These perpendicular shadows are formed where the three railings cast a horizontal shadow that cuts across the shadows of the vertical walls. An interesting perspective because the long shadow of the walls is interrupted by the horizontal shadow of the railings, and as you can see, it's an indicator that we were already close to reaching midday because these 3 railings almost merge into a single shadow.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPeEk5CsJbP9aNJ3YRg8tjXb7q31t3amBL42SUhqa2wbN/photo_2_2026_06_16_15_18_57.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tRvWxqnFqswK34rLXwwDzLFHimD2xstYf7ZmmjmX39TA7DFGfV3AbTDuBxHmK6AMydA.png)

> Well, friends, this was my weekly contribution to this week's SMASH contest. I hope you liked this shadow I managed to capture at the last minute after class. I left quite satisfied with a job well done and having captured this interesting shadow to share with you and fulfill my contribution to this wonderful community. See you in the next contest. Best regards!
--- # Versión Español ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUKn6KQwkAsFCWeUge11bBA7jrWgiVdr8npRa2dbQSDrZ/photo_4_2026_06_16_15_18_57.jpg)

> Que tal amigos de [Shadow Hunters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-179017) sean bienvenidos a mi participación en el concurso SMASH [Round #430](https://ecency.com/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-62cfc426e602c), el tercero del mes de junio y ya podemos sentir los primeros días del verano. La mentablemente no los he podido disfrutar plenamente pues caí enfermo de una virosis que me derrumbó desde el viernes y estuve luchando contra ella de forma casí estoica! Y es que este martes no sólo terminaba mis clases de teoría, sino que debía darle a mis estudiantes, la introducción de mi práctica de laboratorio que es básicamente una práctica de hematología. En resumen hoy fue fue un día largo que requirió de todas nis fuerzas para poder completarlo, así que guardé reposo ayer lunes casi de forma estricta para amanecer del mejor ánimo posible y poder dictar esas 4 horas continuas de clase. El día amaneció de la peor manera posible, nublado y lluvioso, era como que el destino no quisiera que fuera a terminar mi carga docente ese día. Pero el deber llamaba, ya había recuperado la voz y el dolor de garganta había desaparecido, así que fui y dí mis 4 horas de clases seguidas. No les mentiré quedé exhausto y con uan sed terrible, compre una botella de agua y decidí refrescarme en las escaleras de los laboratorios y allí casi como una especie de recompensa, el cielo se despejo y las nubes abrieron paso un sol radiante que me regalo estas maravillosas sombras que les traigo el día de hoy. Y es que después de todo este esfuerzo me pareció una recompensa, ya que había llegado temprano a la Facultad para tratar de cazar algún par de sombras que valieran la pena pero al estar tan nublado fue imposible conseguir algo interesante, solo cuando ya estaba por irme, casi resignado el destino me regalo esta sombra proyectada en los muros de las escaleras de los laboratorios de investigación.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5cjRXBGbVagS1dexA5cFdYoF1bkc2fuXzrjFpQUrvG1/photo_1_2026_06_16_15_18_57.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbAvvmmqe44tN1ipZKgwCse9LHx3jpcPNcLW4VM9fMTZC/photo_5_2026_06_16_15_18_57.jpg) --|--

> Esta parte de los edificios de laboratorios es una de mis favoritas, no solo porque puedo encontrar WiFi gratis, sino porque tiende a formar sombras bastante interesantes dependiendo de la hora del día. En este caso ya eran las 11 am y los largos muros de concreto se cruzan con las barandas de metal que actúan de pasamanos para bajar las escaleras, se forman estas sombras perpendiculares donde las 3 barandas forman una sombra horizontal que corta las sombras de los muros verticales. Una perspectiva interesante porque la sombra alargada de los muros se ve interrumpida por la sombra horizontal de las barandas y como puedes ver es un indicador de que ya estábamos próximos a alcanzar el mediodía porque estas 3 barandas casi se fusionan en una sola sombra.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPeEk5CsJbP9aNJ3YRg8tjXb7q31t3amBL42SUhqa2wbN/photo_2_2026_06_16_15_18_57.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tRvWxqnFqswK34rLXwwDzLFHimD2xstYf7ZmmjmX39TA7DFGfV3AbTDuBxHmK6AMydA.png)

> Bien amigos este fue mi aporte semanal para el concurso SMASH de esta semana, espero que les haya gustado esta sombra que conseguí a ultima hora después de clases. title.title: Three Tunes Tuesday: X [ES/EN]
title.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS95aMsjz5aN1Sgxih2BBNBURonytu7AKauK2RPwRfgfJ/chatgpt_image_16_jun_2026_04_37_20_p.m..png)</center>

Siempre se ha dicho que, en buena medida, la historia social —más que política— de Cuba en los últimos años hay que buscarla en el cine. Yo extendería esta línea de pensamiento al arte en general. Por ejemplo, manifestaciones como el teatro o la música también entran en el cuadro. En el último caso, tenemos bandas como Los Van Van o NG La Banda, donde baluartes como Juan Formell y José Luis Cortés se destacaron como cronistas sociales excepcionales a través de sus composiciones.

Hoy quiero comentar la música de un artista que también discute —con mucha fuerza— la posición cimera en este grupo de vanguardia: **X Alfonso**. La obra de X siempre ha tendido a la crítica sociopolítica, con énfasis en la situación de las capas más vulnerables de la sociedad. Su trabajo, además, trasciende lo meramente musical porque, desde muy temprano, también despuntó como un extraordinario realizador audiovisual y, con el tiempo, como un gran emprendedor.

Su último disco, \

, lanzado recientemente, es un himno al escenario de crisis total que se vive en Cuba, construido a partir de revisiones a piezas antológicas de su propia cosecha y de otros trovadores como el clásico Silvio Rodríguez, el inolvidable Santiago Feliú, y ese disidente eterno que es Carlos Varela. Comparto y comento brevemente las tres pistas con las que más conecté del disco.

<details>
  <summary>ENGLISH VERSION</summary>

It has always been said that, to a large extent, the social history — rather than the political one — of Cuba in recent years must be found in cinema. I would extend this line of thought to art in general. For example, manifestations such as theater or music also fit into the picture. In the latter case, we have bands like Los Van Van and NG La Banda, where fallen pillars such as Juan Formell and José Luis Cortés stood out as exceptional social chroniclers through their compositions.

But today I want to comment on the music of an artist who is at the forefront of that group, strongly contending for the top position due to the comprehensiveness of his work: **X Alfonso**. X's work has always tended toward sociopolitical criticism, with an emphasis on the situation of the most vulnerable layers of society. His work also transcends the merely musical, as from a very early age he stood out as an extraordinary audiovisual creator and, over time, as a great entrepreneur.

His latest album, [*Aire*](https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/album/5NxH7BN1Lk3h1wpTuVc9uB), recently released, is a hymn to the immense crisis scenario in which Cuba is immersed, built from revisions of anthological pieces from his own repertoire and other troubadours such as the classic Silvio Rodríguez, the unforgettable Santiago Feliú, and that eternal dissident Carlos Varela. Below, I share and briefly comment on the three tracks I connected with the most from the album.
</details>

<iframe data-testid=\

></iframe>\n\nSabía que existía el tema y el disco, pero no recuerdo haberlo escuchado jamás de manera específica hasta ahora, en una versión que me parece superior a la original por muchas razones. La fundamental es que se siente más cubana con la incorporación de las congas y un ajuste más exacto al ritmo bolero-son del clásico \

de Miguel Matamoros, del que Varela incorporó genialmente algunos versos cuyo significado original —orientados al desamor *de pareja*— transforma y pone en función de un mensaje *político* que habla de desamor y abandono institucional. Uno de los puntos más claros de esta pista es la crítica al entorno socioinformativo cubano, marcado por la (auto)censura y los silencios, aunque X y Varela no abordan con toda justicia todas las variables que intervienen en él.

<details>
  <summary>ENGLISH VERSION</summary>

I knew the song and the album existed. Still, I don't recall ever having listened to it specifically until now, in a version that I think is superior to the original for many reasons. The main one is that it feels more Cuban with the incorporation of congas and a more precise adjustment to the bolero-son rhythm of the classic \

by Miguel Matamoros, from which Varela brilliantly incorporated some verses whose original meaning — aimed at *couple* heartbreak — he transforms and places in the service of a political message that speaks of institutional disaffection and abandonment. One of the clearest points in this track is the criticism of the Cuban socio‑informational environment, marked by censorship and silences. However, X and Varela do not do full justice to all the variables involved.
</details>

<iframe data-testid=\

></iframe>

Esta es otra composición original de Varela, quien, al igual que X, ha permitido que la gente llana y simple del pueblo —que nunca pudo cumplir sus sueños y aspiraciones— hable a través de sus canciones. Aunque, en este sentido, siempre pienso que hay problemas sociales que afectan *al mundo* y que en Cuba entendemos como autóctonos o exclusivos.

En verdad, gente frustrada que aspiró al cielo y hoy está en el subsuelo abunda en cualquier país. El propio X lo reconoce cuando canta, en otra pista, que \
. Pero, en todo caso, lo más rescatable del mensaje de Varela y X con esta nueva versión de \

es la idea de transformar, cambiar. La noción de que siempre hay espacio para ensayar nuevas alternativas y crecer como seres humanos y como colectividades.

<details>
  <summary>ENGLISH VERSION</summary>

This is another original composition by Varela, who, like X, has made the common and simple people — who could never fulfill their dreams and aspirations — speak through his songs. Although in this sense, I always think that there are social problems that affect the world, but that in Cuba we understand as autochthonous and exclusive.

In truth, frustrated people who aimed for the sky and today are in the basement abound in any country. X himself more or less acknowledges this when he sings, on another track, that he has \
But in any case, the most important part of \

is the idea that there is always room to try new alternatives and grow as human beings and as collectivities.
</details>

<iframe data-testid=\

></iframe>

Esta es una obra maestra original de X, con metáforas impresionantes que uno toca y experimenta por la fuerza que encarnan. X le habla a la gente —de nuevo, el llamado a superar la resignación— pero también, y sobre todo, a las estructuras políticas.

> ¿Qué vas a hacer? De ti depende este mundo  
> Quita las vendas de una vez, sólo de ti dependen los tuyos  
> Enséñame otro amanecer, dibujo otro destino a los que faltan por nacer  
> Distinto al que vivimos  
> Una vez yo soñé que podíamos volar sobre los muros  
> Los muros que no dejan ver ese sueño que yo tengo de otro amanecer

<details>
  <summary>ENGLISH VERSION</summary>

This is an original masterpiece by X, with impressive metaphors that one touches and experiences because of the force they embody. X speaks to the people — again, the call to overcome resignation — but also, and above all, to political structures.

> What are you going to do? This world depends on you  
> Remove the blindfolds once and for all; only your loved ones depend on you  
> Show me another dawn, I draw another destiny for those yet to be born  
> Different from the one we live in  
> Once I dreamed we could fly over the walls  
> The walls that do not let me see that dream I have of another dawn
</details>

<iframe data-testid=\
></iframe>\n\nLo que sigue es una versión en vivo de \

durante un concierto en el emprendimiento de X, la Fábrica de Arte Cubano, con el acompañamiento del gran pianista cubano Roberto Fonseca. Con este memorable performance cierro mi contribución a esta edición semanal del *Three Tunes Tuesday*.

<details>

What follows is a live version of \

during a concert at X's venture, the Fábrica de Arte Cubano, with the expert accompaniment of the great Cuban pianist Roberto Fonseca. With this memorable performance, I close my contribution to this weekly edition of *Three Tunes Tuesday*.

title.title: My relationship with electricity is very toxic, but I can’t leave it🇬🇧///Mi relación con la electricidad es muy tóxica, pero no la puedo dejar🇪🇸
title.body:
🇬🇧
![file_0000000027d0722f9122ed0248261e46.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/AJoJF8EjXCQFFKYHvDZ9r5DnUzsP4epWZHWcjHMfucphFa4r6khMo31GohsLJyB.png)
There are relationships you don’t choose, but you learn to live with them. My relationship with electricity is one of those. It’s not stable, it’s not constant, it doesn’t warn you when it arrives… it simply shows up, stays for a while, and leaves as if nothing happened. And I, as if I never learn, keep waiting for it.
It’s a strange relationship. One of those that constantly sends mixed signals. Sometimes it comes several times in a single day, as if it were trying to fix things. And you even get hopeful, thinking, “maybe now it has changed.”
But no. It leaves in seconds. No explanation. No goodbye. No emotional closure.
Other times it disappears completely. Days. Weeks. And there are moments when you even get used to its absence, as if that were normal. And just when you finally manage to organize your life without it… it comes back. As if nothing ever happened.
And the crazy thing is that you never know how long each phase will last. It can be a short visit of minutes, an intermittent presence throughout the day, or a long disappearance that feels like a human patience experiment.
It’s a relationship without stability. Without schedule. Without promises. Sometimes it seems like it’s there, but it isn’t. And other times you don’t even know if you’ll see it again that same month.
I’ve tried to be understanding. Really. I’ve practiced patience, meditation, and even the ancient art of walking in the dark without breaking a toe. But there are days when I feel this relationship has gone far beyond healthy limits.
The funny thing is that you adapt. You learn new routines. I already know what to do “if it comes,” what to leave ready “just in case,” and what to assume will probably have to wait for another electric lifetime.
The fridge, on its part, has become a kind of emotional safe. It doesn’t store jewels or money, but it stores hope… and sometimes food, if the relationship is in a good phase that day.
I’ve noticed that people around me are going through the same thing. Nobody asks anymore “is there electricity?” but rather “how long did it last this time?” It’s a shared relationship, as if we were all dating the same unstable person, but without the option of breaking up.
And while the rest of the world argues about football, goals, tactics, and sports controversies… here the debate is different: who had electricity longer, who lost it first, and who has been in the “almost stable relationship” phase the longest. It’s like a silent competition where nobody wants to win, but everyone participates.
I’ve seen families reinvent conversations, children invent games without screens, and adults master the art of sitting still doing nothing with championship-level focus. All of this while somewhere in the neighborhood someone shouts the most important phrase of the day: “The power is back!” as if it were a last-minute goal.
I won’t lie: sometimes you get angry. Other times you laugh. And other times you simply accept that electricity is like that unpredictable friend who says “I’m on my way” and you never know if that means today, tomorrow, or in another dimension.
But well… in the end you stay here, in this kind of unrequested spiritual training, learning that light doesn’t just illuminate the house, it also illuminates patience… although sometimes it drains it.
And who knows, maybe one day this relationship will improve. Or at least become more punctual. Meanwhile, I’ll keep being here with my fan, my emotional candle, and my optimism in energy-saving mode.
Sometimes it comes, sometimes it goes, sometimes it stays for a while just to confuse you… and sometimes it simply disappears completely, as if it had never existed.
But well… you keep going in this complicated relationship, learning that stability doesn’t always depend on you. And that patience, more than a virtue, here is a mandatory requirement.
And who knows… maybe one day this relationship will stop being toxic. Or at least stop being so unpredictable. Meanwhile, I’ll keep being here, between candles, fans, and the hope that this time it lasts a little longer.
I will never get tired of thanking the BBH community 💪, @thebbhproject  @thebbhfoundation
![IMG_20260509_184440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mgt7eGV3G9mCNEZQmApgHimF3SZJYMbKhVXTpmy8V5wTqQSYZ8ybTDg.jpg)
To its creator @brdaleyarrow and my mom from Canada @cathyarrow.
I hope we will be together soon.
Thank you for your support and may God bless you 🙏🙏🙏
/////

🇪🇸

![file_0000000027d0722f9122ed0248261e46.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/AJoJF8EjXCQFFKYHvDZ9r5DnUzsP4epWZHWcjHMfucphFa4r6khMo31GohsLJyB.png)

Hay relaciones que uno no elige, pero aprende a convivir con ellas. La mía con la electricidad es una de esas. No es estable, no es constante, no avisa cuando llega… simplemente aparece, se queda un rato, y se va como si nada. Y uno, como si no aprendiera nunca, sigue esperándola.
Es una relación rara. De esas que te dan señales confusas todo el tiempo. A veces viene varias veces en un mismo día, como si estuviera interesada en arreglar las cosas. Y uno hasta se emociona, piensa “bueno, quizás ahora sí cambió”.
Pero no. Se va en segundos. Sin explicación. Sin despedida. Sin cerrar el ciclo emocional.
Otras veces desaparece por completo. Días. Semanas. Y hay momentos en los que hasta te acostumbras a su ausencia, como si fuera lo normal. Y justo cuando ya logras organizar tu vida sin ella… vuelve. Como si nada.
Y lo más loco es que nunca sabes cuánto va a durar esa fase. Puede ser una visita corta de minutos, una presencia intermitente durante el día, o una ausencia prolongada que se siente como un experimento de paciencia humana.
Es una relación sin estabilidad. Sin horario. Sin promesas. A veces parece que está, pero no está. Y otras veces ni siquiera sabes si la vas a volver a ver ese mismo mes.
Yo he intentado ser comprensivo. De verdad. He practicado la paciencia, la meditación, y hasta el arte ancestral de caminar en la oscuridad sin romperme un dedo. Pero hay días en los que siento que esta relación ya pasó todos los límites saludables.
Lo curioso es que uno se adapta. Aprende rutinas nuevas. Ya sé qué cosas hacer “si viene”, qué cosas dejar listas “por si acaso”, y qué cosas asumir que probablemente se quedarán para otra vida eléctrica.
La nevera, por su parte, se ha convertido en una especie de caja fuerte emocional. No guarda joyas ni dinero, pero guarda esperanza… y a veces comida, si la relación ese día está en buena fase.
He notado que la gente en mi entorno también vive lo mismo. Ya no se pregunta “¿hay luz?”, sino “¿cuánto te duró esta vez?”. Es una especie de relación compartida, como si todos estuviéramos saliendo con la misma persona inestable, pero sin opción de romper.
Y mientras el mundo discute de fútbol, goles, tácticas y polémicas deportivas… aquí el debate es otro: quién la tuvo más tiempo, quién la perdió primero, y quién lleva más días en “casi relación estable”. Es como una competencia silenciosa donde nadie quiere ganar, pero todos participan.
He visto familias reinventando la conversación, niños inventando juegos sin pantallas, y adultos dominando el arte de sentarse sin hacer nada con una concentración digna de campeonato mundial. Todo esto mientras alguien en algún punto del barrio grita la frase más importante del día: “¡Llegó la luz!” como si fuera gol en el minuto 90.
No voy a mentir: a veces uno se enoja. Otras veces se ríe. Y otras simplemente acepta que la electricidad es como ese amigo impredecible que dice “ahora voy” y uno no sabe si eso significa hoy, mañana o en una dimensión paralela.
Pero bueno… al final uno sigue aquí, en esta especie de entrenamiento espiritual no solicitado, aprendiendo que la luz no solo ilumina la casa, también ilumina la paciencia… aunque a veces la funda.
Y quién sabe, tal vez algún día esta relación mejore. O al menos se vuelva más puntual. Mientras tanto, seguiré aquí, con mi abanico, mi vela emocional y mi optimismo en modo ahorro de energía.
A veces viene, a veces se va, a veces se queda un rato engañando… y a veces simplemente desaparece por completo, como si nunca hubiera existido.
Pero bueno… uno sigue aquí, en esta relación complicada, aprendiendo que la estabilidad no siempre depende de uno. Y que la paciencia, más que una virtud, aquí es un requisito obligatorio.
Y quién sabe… tal vez algún día esta relación deje de ser tóxica. O al menos deje de ser tan impredecible. Mientras tanto, seguiré aquí, entre velas, abanicos y la esperanza de que esta vez sí dure un poco más.
No ve voy a cansar de agradecer a la comunidad BBH 💪 a @thebbhfoundation  y @thebbhproject 

![IMG_20260509_184440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mgt7eGV3G9mCNEZQmApgHimF3SZJYMbKhVXTpmy8V5wTqQSYZ8ybTDg.jpg)

And here lies today’s reflection: despite all that, the bicycle draws you closer to places and their people. That is how you find yourself thrilled by those adventures, those magical corners brimming with stories and curiosities, reached through your own strength and determination. title.title: The unexplained loops on us
title.body:
>

  Last week I really finally accepted that identifying logic patterns behind human responses to feelings and decisions is unbearable. It is just a waste of time. Just check the news and see how people behave in the so-called polarization behind specific topics, especially in politics. But it is everywhere. I saw a discussion about what people think about Pluto being classified as a planet again. And one of the pro-planet sides called a pro-dwarf-planet a leftist just because he disagreed with his theory that Pluto needs to be a planet because of its volcanic activity. Independent of the debate, what we humans are doing with simple debates and polarizing them?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23rB5UtAB4tzxGJSfiNKS15sinQWA4cCpSgDK8V3MeLaA6X38ZbbZwBbyRFtukZHSEgah.png)

>Humanity is focused on endless debates that won't have an end [Free-for-use in FreePik]

  The whole current political environment after the failed conflict with Iran also made us question why that instability happened if the US never intended to do much that they were shouting. In the end just created economic instability for a good amount of time, which created fear all around the world. The famous TACO acronym released a while ago (Trump Always Chicken Out) was confirmed after the end of the war. The president, in the end, is following a logic in this case. He creates controversial statements and actions just to retreat. But it is still impossible to understand the logic behind the voters that elected him. Because, in the end, what were his accomplishments after his term? the TACO?

  Even at home, I tried so much to find logic behind everything that happened. But maybe acting is better. So many years just accepting my status quo. I just asked to be gently treated. Ok, I can help you, but please just ask me with a please and not like an employee or son. We try to educate our children to say the word 'please,' which is the minimum when we want some help, but then you don't use it because it is a house obligation to prepare something, and I should do it automatically without even the need to be asked?

  So, this type of interaction stood for the argument that we should change our communication patterns, and instead of being listened to, I received a list of things of \

that I commit that make me look like the worst husband in the world. I raised a concern about how we communicate. Instead of discussing that concern directly, the conversation quickly shifted to a list of my own shortcomings. I later learned about the concept of DARVO (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim and Offender), and parts of that pattern felt familiar to me. I exposed a feeling, and instead of discussing it first, my feeling was denied, my credibility was attacked, and there was a reversal of the victim. That happens for a while, but this time, I chose to stand by my perspective, and maybe the consequences will lead to another path, which I can't predict the outcome.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23uFaSWTRPnnMHKz6DCjgpCQydozyGoFPvSsRQFK3Hjt5KW4QyFg2EySPS6xkBM8WhaQR.png)

>Difficult to find the exit of a circular staircase; sometimes it looks endless.[Free-for-use in FreePik]

  I can't control other people's behaviour; I am a human that commit mistakes, and I am always willing to learn with them and be better. But why people sometimes don't is a mystery. A husband/wife that doesn't listen to their partner and keeps feeding a loop where someone always gets hurt is difficult to understand. The same way that sometimes we don't understand the voters of a president who, since his first mandate, acts the same way, going in loops. And people continue blind in their polarization.

[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23wMS5Mk5RaoA6EdKv35TPtYzT2oppCtUWD6qwC5GUBMb877AgJ5rGzJeoTew2bGQJQWZ.png)](https://vote.hive.uno/@gwajnberg)
Banner created in canva

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpjQ6Eiqz8JMMjig1nLZFvxM1sFhvNmiGYA2snkPD7Z4TnmFxxRyih87.png)

  Na semana passada, finalmente aceitei que identificar padrões lógicos por trás das respostas humanas a sentimentos e decisões é insuportável. É pura perda de tempo. Basta ver as notícias e observar como as pessoas se comportam na chamada polarização em torno de tópicos específicos, especialmente na política. Mas isso está em toda parte. Vi uma discussão sobre o que as pessoas pensam a respeito da reclassificação de Plutão como planeta. E um dos defensores da classificação como planeta chamou um defensor da classificação como planeta anão de esquerdista só porque ele discordava da teoria de que Plutão precisa ser considerado um planeta devido à sua atividade vulcânica. Independentemente do debate, o que nós, humanos, estamos fazendo com debates simples e polarizando-os?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23rB5UtAB4tzxGJSfiNKS15sinQWA4cCpSgDK8V3MeLaA6X38ZbbZwBbyRFtukZHSEgah.png)

>A humanidade está focada no infinito. Debates que não terão fim [Uso gratuito no FreePik]

  Todo o atual ambiente político após o conflito fracassado com o Irã também nos fez questionar por que essa instabilidade aconteceu se os EUA nunca pretenderam fazer muito do que alardearam. No fim, apenas criaram instabilidade econômica por um bom tempo, o que gerou medo em todo o mundo. O famoso acrônimo TACO, divulgado há algum tempo (Trump Always Chicken Out - Trump Sempre Covarda), foi confirmado após o fim da guerra. O presidente, no fim das contas, está seguindo uma lógica neste caso. Ele cria declarações e ações controversas apenas para recuar. Mas ainda é impossível entender a lógica por trás dos eleitores que o elegeram. Porque, no final, quais foram suas realizações após o término do mandato? O TACO?

  Mesmo em casa, tentei muito encontrar lógica em tudo o que aconteceu. Mas talvez agir seja melhor. Tantos anos apenas aceitando meu status quo. Eu só pedi para ser tratado com gentileza. Ok, eu posso te ajudar, mas por favor, me peça com um \
e não como se eu fosse um funcionário ou um filho. Tentamos ensinar nossos filhos a dizer \

, que é o mínimo quando queremos ajuda, mas você não usa a palavra porque é uma obrigação doméstica preparar algo, e eu deveria fazer isso automaticamente sem nem precisar ser solicitado?

\n\n

  Então, esse tipo de interação representou o argumento de que deveríamos mudar nossos padrões de comunicação e, em vez de ser ouvido, recebi uma lista de \

que cometo e que me fazem parecer o pior marido do mundo. Eu expressei uma preocupação sobre como nos comunicamos. Em vez de discutir essa preocupação diretamente, a conversa rapidamente mudou para uma lista das minhas próprias falhas. Mais tarde, aprendi sobre o conceito de DARVO (Negar, Atacar, Inverter Vítima e Ofensor) e partes desse padrão me pareceram familiares. Eu expus um sentimento e, em vez de discuti-lo primeiro, meu sentimento foi negado, minha credibilidade foi atacada e houve uma inversão de vítima. Isso acontece por um tempo, mas desta vez, escolhi manter minha perspectiva, e talvez as consequências me levem a outro caminho, cujo resultado não posso prever.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23uFaSWTRPnnMHKz6DCjgpCQydozyGoFPvSsRQFK3Hjt5KW4QyFg2EySPS6xkBM8WhaQR.png)

>Difícil encontrar a saída de uma escada circular; Às vezes parece interminável. [Uso gratuito no FreePik]

 Não posso controlar o comportamento de outras pessoas; sou um ser humano que comete erros e estou sempre disposto a aprender com eles e a ser melhor. Mas por que as pessoas às vezes não fazem isso é um mistério. Um marido/esposa que não ouve o parceiro e continua alimentando um ciclo onde alguém sempre se machuca é difícil de entender. Da mesma forma que às vezes não entendemos os eleitores de um presidente que, desde seu primeiro mandato, age da mesma maneira, entrando em ciclos. E as pessoas continuam cegas em sua polarização.

title.title: Haciendo un ramo de 5 rosas eternas para regalar🎀Making a bouquet of 5 eternal roses as a gift🌹
title.body:
>
![1000537010.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23uQtCx312SGegvhuxevLaUAFUjbokat4ed1isSoq7pBDC7bDzk4Xw8ufmvre7u2G56a6.gif)
![4i88GgaV8qiFkxbnGCXnHNbt8wcgAMNP6xb3BathL8VqeDFYKXuNAkzuy93dktowueGi3RoFYVhvEXNb9xEGGboKv868CQ23RXXeYYeYrNtSH2gdLPsCWMxRBM.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23xpVZzYxFW2F9aJummQps1BNSRcmiVKW31mFkdx8GDh13QzYtWw9aZcmYJgdS3rGYDhG.webp)
Hola comunidad de artesanos y manualistas como están ? Cómo han estado estos días ? ,hoy les quiero compartir un post de como hice un ramo de rosas eternas con cintas con detalles en dorado y negro, de una manera sencilla pero dandole una presentación bonita y delicada que no le va a tener que envidiarle nada a los ramos Buchones😂 y de alto presupuesto.Aquí les dejo los materiales y los fotos del paso a paso.
![1000272910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wr5RNMKVK5XYKsfKftjqYrP7MdrE8oBhHS7cYA6XumWBdcUwwiCLatbWvFryK33mafz.jpg)
Cinta n9 raso rojo oscuro Yesquero Tijeras Regla Silicón caliente Pieza de botella de plástico Retazo de Tull Cartulina reciclada Papel coreano negro Papel de seda dorado Cristales Mariposa de foami **Manos a la obra**
English Version

Hello fellow artisans and crafters! How are you? How have you been these past few days? Today I want to share a post about how I made a bouquet of preserved roses with ribbons featuring gold and black details. It's a simple way to make it, but it gives it a beautiful and delicate presentation that rivals even the most extravagant and expensive bouquets. Here are the materials and step-by-step photos.

![1000272910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wr5RNMKVK5XYKsfKftjqYrP7MdrE8oBhHS7cYA6XumWBdcUwwiCLatbWvFryK33mafz.jpg)
Dark red satin ribbon (size 9) Lighter Scissors Ruler Hot glue Piece of plastic bottle Scrap of tulle Recycled cardstock Black Korean paper Gold tissue paper Crystals Foam butterfly **Let's get to work**

![1000272906.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23u5vesEkymmpV2AXbs2gepsLkFh5GYRhJQ1rntofnZaR4QNTrwcioEVyCn8g56RcLMvj.png)
![1000527722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23tmDZSjHwyGYhSHeZ4AuM8ZMxkhvd2gLREbWgzh4qbzzdoh8KmzsrSWAGT3mSULV5DXy.jpg) ![1000527771.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23uFRQ9XhasL9LrjSZhvvKJbFWYcV3ciN7ArnU18zRXFvzBpQJRjDrLSPBfhDdUyCe39P.jpg) ![1000527771.jpg](image-2-1000527771.jpg)|![1000527779.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23vhsjJU8iM4N4M2JX34SrEYVREQ7Qqcj42CsEsk8kjtZCvvDLggmBFZ1va322HVtmmhK.jpg) ![1000527783.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23tbq7CTZvRqBeNphXhPf3YBhJdX7yT8UUEwvNFXmJyRsGgobP1HQgYZe6HN4y49svaVM.jpg) **#1 Como primer paso, hice las rosas , que serían 5, corté rectangulos de cinta de raso de unos 6 cm de largo o del tamaño de una tarjeta de débito, el pétalo se hace doblando hacia dentro la esquinas ,sellando con el yesquero y luego de nuevo esas puntas triangulares que van a formarse, se doblan hacia dentro de nuevo, hasta que quede con la forma de una casita y luego sellar de nuevo con el yesquero,tengo varios tutoriales haciendo esas rositas eternas, así que aquí no tome tantas fotos del paso a paso, pero una vez tengas los diez pétalos se van pegando enrrolando el primero en un palito de altura para el centro de la flor y de allí se van pegando como si fuera una cadena seguida de pétalos enrrolandose en el palito de altura. Hice cinco rosas de 10 pétalos cada una, y luego corté cuadrados de tul blanco , introduciendo el cuadrado de tul por la parte de atrás de la rosa para qué este quedé pinchada en la rosa.**
English Version

**#1 As a first step, I made the roses, five in total. I cut rectangles of satin ribbon about 6 cm long, or the size of a debit card. To make the petals, fold the corners inwards, seal them with a lighter, and then fold the resulting triangular points inwards again, until they resemble a little house. Seal again with the lighter. I have several tutorials for making these everlasting roses, so I didn't take many step-by-step photos here, But once you have the ten petals, you start gluing them together by rolling the first one around a stick at the center of the flower, and from there you continue gluing them together as if it were a chain followed by petals rolling around the stick. I made five roses with 10 petals each, and then cut squares of white tulle, inserting the tulle square from the back of the rose so that it would be pinned to the rose.**

![1000527826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/EoAYsARqhSzy2KR7abaMchuzinQnEF4PdYzCyZ7CiLAva9Ye73wGKvGgz6PPjJDBzMw.jpg) ![1000527827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/Eo8TkKfR4U4GqsoevqjJxjF3Qv8kA6fzAVuJiSB2heffQsoQH5qE52Wg2xnYorotSUV.jpg) ![1000527829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/EoGwWePxPKavRV997ZsbViatee9F7Vct5UqedMd9SDyQTmzbjSUuSHPZLUVE8SejJzi.jpg) **#2 En cartulina dorada recorté algunos elementos para decorar, una mariposa y unas ramas con hojitas, con un envase de refresco reciclado usé un círculo de acetato que me sirvió para poder introducir allí las los tallos de las rositas que hice así quedarán bien sujetas y no se moverán. Usé una hoja reciclada para hacer un cono y darle cuerpo al ramo.**
English Version

**#2 From gold cardstock, cut out some decorative elements: a butterfly and some branches with leaves. Using a recycled soda bottle, I cut out an acetate circle to hold the stems of the little roses I made, so they would stay in place and not move. I used a recycled leaf to make a cone and give the bouquet some shape.**

Tambien agregué unos cristales en la mariposa, y en los centros de cada rosa.** **🎀🌹 Y este sería el resultado, es un ramo sencillo de 5 rosas ,y con un papel básico pero la combinación de dorado y negro y agregarle los puntitos dorados , hace que se vea mucho más lindo, al igual que los pequeños detalles de las hojas en dorado con la mariposa y los destellos en el centro de la rosa, 🌹 ,son estos detallitos que al ir los agregando pueden hacer que un ramo básico o sencillo sin muchos materiales pase a ser un Ramo más coqueto que se vea lujoso.
