body.title: Belgrade Unscripted
body.body: alt=\

/> Honestly when I first saw this scene in Street I was totally shocked and just stood there for a moment wanting to watch rather than shoot But then I realized how incredible the details were so I quickly grabbed my camera to make sure I could look back at it later If you ever find yourself in Belgrade you absolutely have to explore it because this city is packed with surprises like this around every single corner Cheers 🥰 Morteza Yousefi
alt=\

/>

belgrade is the capital and largest cuz city of serbia and it holds a position as one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in europe the history of the city is defined by its location at the confluence of the sava and danube rivers which made it a strategic prize for empires ranging from the celts and romans to the byzantines and ottomans  
  
because it has been destroyed and rebuilt dozens of times throughout its long life belgrade has developed a truly unique and resilient character that you can feel as soon as you start walking its streets today  
  
the city is a blend of different architectural styles including the brutalist structures from the socialist era and elegant buildings from the 19th century that show its austro hungarian influence beyond the history  
  
belgrade is vibrant and alive with a legendary nightlife scene and a cafe culture that invites you to just sit and observe the rhythm of the local people it's a place that doesn't try to be perfect which makes it feel incredibly human and real compared to many other european capitals that are fully sanitized for tourists whether you're exploring the massive kalemegdan fortress that overlooks the river or wandering through the bohemian streets of skadarlija  
  
you will find that the city rewards those who are curious enough to look past the surface i highly recommend adding it to your travel list because it's one of those rare places where you can genuinely see layers of history colliding with modern life in the most unexpected ways it's the kind of city that leaves an impression on you not because it's flashy but because it's honest and full of untold stories waiting for you to find them

* * *

body.body:
Esta mañana me quedé mirando mi taza de café y pensé en algo curioso, llegar a cierta edad no significa que ya lo entendiste todo.

Uno cree que con los años vienen todas las respuestas, y No, a veces llegan más preguntas. A veces sigues sin saber qué hacer mañana. A veces todavía te equivocas, todavía te da miedo, todavía extrañas, todavía sueñas.

Porque envejecer no significa dejar de vivir. Significa seguir viviendo, pero con más historias en la espalda.

Y qué bonito cuando uno entiende eso.

Qué bonito descubrir que todavía hay canciones que emocionan, lugares que conocer, personas que abrazar y mañanas que agradecer.

Porque mientras haya ganas de levantarse, de preparar un café, de abrir una ventana y mirar el mundo,  todavía quedan capítulos por escribir.

Y eso, para mí, es una de las mejores noticias que trae la edad.

Que la vida no se acaba cuando aparecen las arrugas.

La vida se acaba cuando dejamos de asombrarnos.

Así que hoy, aunque duelan las rodillas, aunque falte alguien en la mesa, aunque el espejo cuente una historia distinta, todavía estas aquí, y todavía pueden pasar cosas bonitas.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVWkYSxKngL3YcS1uDXPoJUKFv4Wo6jgNUvLymwGUicjc/1781637387266.jpg)

ENGLISH

This morning I found myself staring at my coffee cup, thinking about something curious: reaching a certain age doesn't mean you've already understood everything.

You think that with the years come all the answers. But no — sometimes more questions arrive. Sometimes you still don't know what to do tomorrow. Sometimes you still make mistakes, still feel afraid, still miss things, still dream.

Because growing older doesn't mean you stop living. It means you keep on living, but with more stories behind you.

And how beautiful it is when you realize that.

How beautiful to discover that there are still songs that move you, places to see, people to hug, and mornings to be grateful for.

Because as long as you have the desire to get up, to make a cup of coffee, to open a window and look out at the world — there are still chapters left to write.

And that, for me, is one of the best things that comes with age.

That life doesn't end when the wrinkles appear.

Life ends when we stop being amazed.

\

body.title: Back To K-Dramas, Back To Learning.
body.body: <div class=\

> Of late, I have been using my free time to learn some Korean words, and I must say it has been quite an interesting experience for me, what surprises me the most is that before the words are even pronounced in the app, I already have an idea of what they are or how they should sound, sometimes I get them right, and honestly, it makes me feel proud of myself. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTGzm1mWZSSo6ZXZik4JYhw9YAR4P4gDkn9Fbk7wNu9Df/1781637128424.png) The funny thing is that I didn't intentionally set out to learn Korean, it all happened because I recently went back to watching Korean dramas again, anyone who watches K dramas regularly will understand what I mean, the more you watch them, the more certain words begin to stick in your head without you even trying. All thanks to my very recent return to watching Korean dramas, I have noticed that my knowledge of the language has improved, from late last month till now, I have watched two series that really kept me entertained, one is called Castle Beauty and the other is called My Royal Nemesis. I must say, both series played a huge role in brushing up my Korean knowledge, while watching them, I found myself recognizing words and phrases that used to sound completely foreign to me, simple expressions that I would normally wait for subtitles to explain now sound familiar the moment I hear them. There were even times when a character would start speaking and before I looked at the subtitle, I already had an idea of what was being said, that feeling is actually very satisfying because it shows that I am learning, even if it is little by little. What I find interesting about learning Korean through dramas is that it does not feel like studying, It just feels natural and fun, instead of sitting down with books for hours trying to memorize words I am learning Korean while enjoying stories, characters, romance, comedy and all the drama that comes with Korean series. Of course, I am still far from being able to speak Korean fluently, let me not get too ahead of myself like this, but compared to where I was before, I can confidently say there has been progress, seriously, the more I watch, the more familiar the language becomes really , the more familiar the language becomes, the easier for me it is to learn new words, and the easier it becomes to learn new words, the more motivated I feel to continue, at this point, I do not plan on stopping at all In fact, I think I am enjoying the process even more like this, because I can see the results, every new word I recognize just feels like a small achievement, and those small achievements really make me want to keep going, ehnnn who knows? maybe one day I will be able to hold a very simple conversation in Korean without relying on subtitles. For now, though, I am happy learning one word at a time, one drama at a time, and enjoying every moment of the journey, sometimes the best way to learn something new is just through something that you already love, and for me, K dramas have always already become exactly that. *** --- ***Image is Generated With Chatgpt*** ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

body.body: \n![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc4AW9LCFt32dhtpB8dXvYfx8D9ooiWmn7ZiEiDG2m3Zm/1781629355300.png)\n‎<div class=\

> ‎Justice has always been defined by a very simple structure for ages, it has always been about giving befitting punishment to crimes committed. For every crime committed in the society, there is a lawful punishment attached to it, but it is never about ensuring justice only. As a lover of social science, I have always stated that, humans are not the peaceful creatures we think we are. We have lived as humans for so long that we have forgotten about our true nature. ‎ ‎It is the laws made by the society that moderated human conduct, we are higher animals after all. The animal side of us used to be unhinged, laying waste to everything on earth. In order to andure the safety of ourselves and the ecosystem, nations were founded, borders were defined and laws were created. All this was done to put the animal in us under control, at least we taught we did. ‎ ‎Narurally, loving our fellow humans should be enough to protect us, humans shouldn't intentionally cause harm to fellow humans. We forgot the predator in us, we forgot are just like a Lion's pride, a group of predators that will gladly kill the cubs of another. That is how far our love for each other goes. Knowing this about ourselves, punishment became the reward for every crime. At least if love is not enough to prevent humans from committing atrocities, the fear of being punished should prevent us from doing so. ‎ ‎Fear terrifies many, it is an emotion that plagues the minds of the strongest of humans. Knowing what kind of punishment awaits, after a crime is committed; humans became more obligated to do what is right. We have been following this process for centuries, to the extent that we have convinced ourselves that, doing what is right; is the nature of mankind. If that was true, punishment will not exist. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVu6qAJGwiyx7w7NFPgYetcJ9tqXwSfnmzfeuQk8afofY/1781630287911.jpg) ‎Despite how terrifying the punishment for some crimes are, people still commit crimes. The percentage of crimes committed keeps rising across the continent. It makes you wonder, do people still fear being punished? Is the system still working? is the punishment not enough? Apart from the chaotic nature of mankind, there is something else about us that most people think about positively, we are adaptive creatures, we evolve. We have survive all kinds of plagues, revolution, nothing can be compared to mankind desire to survive. ‎ ‎Even if the planet is against our survival, we will sacrifice it and move to another, that is what being humans means. Surviving is not a choice, it is a must. If a circus lion can learn to dance, believe me, we can do better. We humans have lived with the punishment system for so long, to the extent it no longer freaks us any more. We have experienced far more pain than what punishment could inflict on us. You think punishment is painful, try hunger, try humiliation. Believe me, there are more emotional pain, than are more painful than any punishment. ‎ ‎So humans would say, even if I have to live for just a year, the way I want, I won't mind doing anything. Now, there is another fear that is more terrifying than the fear of punishment, it is fear of poverty. There is a love that is more potent than the need to live, it is the love for money. People would do anything to add more pennies to their pocket, everything now has a price. The punishment system is no longer enough to keep our demons under control. ‎ ‎As if that is not bad enough, our justice system now lacks force and authority. A constitution is just like a storybook without an entity to enforce it. People have ways to escape being prosecuted, victims cry more tears than criminals. Nothing protects the innocent anymore, now even the innocent have learnt to be the villain. It is easy to judge, have you ever lost everything before? have you ever felt helpless before? have you ever been damaged by the justice system built to protect you? ‎ ‎If you have, then you will understand that, we are the ones that create the monsters that hunt us, terrorist and criminals are once normal civilians, something happened. So this is not the time to find more effective punishment, it is time to search for solutions that comfort people. if lions can be domesticated, the animal in us can be caged through appropriate measures. ‎ **** ***** ‎_This write-up was inspired by weekly featured content titled ***Punishments*** in hive learners community._ ‎ ****** ***** ‎ ‎_***Cover Image - generated using chatgpt***_ _***[Image 1](https://pixabay.com/images/download/x-4127187_1920.jpg)***_ ‎ **** ***** ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNhTyUg4Aq2RTHWnTXsaS4758biE3M9xtHurNqYAe8XT/img_0.8353900969042101.jpg) ‎

body.title: The Death of Consequences: Why Criminals No Longer Fear the Law and Punishment
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQma4XgghLwPxDmJLoc4voS1iDUhN1AH3JNrifgdc9DYH5z/1000180962.jpg 
<sub> image using Ai. </sub> 

<div class=\

> Gone are the days when punishments used to that harsh where at times people would fear to commit a crime that had sever punishment.
it should be like that like making you scared of a crime that could punish you in ways your soul will remember. What even is the point of punishment if it isn't bringing the crime rate lower? What even is the point of punishment if it isn't making a person reflect on things and become better?

The punishments are no longer that scary

People don't usually think of the consequences while committing a crime, sometimes it's the situation that makes them do the crime like a robber would rob someone out of poverty Someone could unalive someone out of jealousy, anger or for all those reasons and still one won't fear the punishment they'd end up getting nowadays The moment some people commit crime the first immediate thought must be like for how long they'll have to the time before any actual consequences Can you tell a person won't do more crime when the first thought of that person is he'll be out in this long?

I'll do the time kind of mindset

We have seen more crime because people know they'll do the time and come out of prison, live freely again amongst people and will commit those things again Have seen a lot of murder cases because judges allowed those criminals to walk freely because they've did the time? A lot of people would'nt pay taxes, a lot of these people keeps on scamming through crypto, internet and much more ways that ruins other people life Yet they get bailed out or come out once they've done the time and have pretended to show a little improvement in behaviour. Those old school punishment that used to be gut wrenching were better as it would have left fear in that person mind and the one watching the consequences of committing crime could lead do that, the real justice is when the both criminal and the viewers like society get the message and become the example for the rest of the people. People have got a lot emotional now that they'd start calling anyone talking a little senses to them extremist, like are you sure you want criminals to roam on street freely with you? Or one who did something and now is an example for other people. I mean the more severe a crime is, the more severe a punishment should be to see any impact or change in behaviour of person otherwise it's just going to be wild out there but I do wonder what's your thoughts are about it? Do share in the comments. that's all folks. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@idksamad78699/the-death-of-consequences-why-criminals-no-longer-fear-the-law-and-punishment--dua)

⚽🔥 KICK IT LIKE LUVSICK – 20 YEARS ANNIVERSARY EDITION (2026) 🔥⚽
Originally released in 2006 for the FIFA World Cup in Germany, Kick It Like Luvsick became one of the defining mixtapes of that football summer. Created by DJ Luvsick and hosted by Trini P, the project combined Hip-Hop, Reggae, Dancehall, and football fever into a unique soundtrack for fans around the globe.
Now, 20 years later, as the world prepares for the FIFA World Cup 2026, we proudly re-release this classic in its original spirit and energy.
At the time of the original release, DJ Luvsick and Trini P were known collectively as \

, a crew recognized for their mixtapes, exclusives, and distinctive blend of Hip-Hop and Caribbean influences. The project was released during a period when DJ Luvsick was also active as the official DJ for Megaloh, helping shape the sound of the German underground Hip-Hop scene of the mid-2000s.
This anniversary edition features a total of 10 exclusive specials created specifically for the mixtape:
🎤 5 exclusive specials from Megaloh, KD Supier, and the Level Eight Crew
🎧 5 exclusive specials from DJ Luvsick / Broken Needles
These exclusives make Kick It Like Luvsick much more than a football mixtape—they capture a unique moment in underground Hip-Hop culture and the creative energy surrounding the 2006 World Cup.
Whether you were there in 2006 or are discovering this project for the first time, this anniversary release celebrates two decades of music, football, friendship, and independent mixtape culture.

Ursprünglich zur FIFA Fußball-Weltmeisterschaft 2006 in Deutschland veröffentlicht, wurde Kick It Like Luvsick schnell zum Soundtrack eines unvergesslichen Fußballsommers. Gemixt von DJ Luvsick und gehostet von Trini P, vereinte das Mixtape Hip-Hop, Reggae, Dancehall und die einzigartige WM-Euphorie zu einem musikalischen Erlebnis.
20 Jahre später, pünktlich zur FIFA Fußball-Weltmeisterschaft 2026, veröffentlichen wir diesen Klassiker erneut – als Hommage an die goldene Ära der Mixtapes und an die verbindende Kraft von Musik und Fußball.
Damals waren DJ Luvsick und Trini P gemeinsam als „Broken Needles“ bekannt. Mit ihren Mixtapes, Exclusives und ihrer Mischung aus Hip-Hop- und Dancehall-Kultur prägten sie die unabhängige Mixtape-Szene der 2000er Jahre.
Zum Zeitpunkt der Erstveröffentlichung war DJ Luvsick außerdem offizieller DJ von Megaloh und Teil einer kreativen Phase, die die deutsche Underground-Hip-Hop-Szene nachhaltig beeinflusste.
Diese Anniversary Edition enthält insgesamt 10 exklusive Specials, die eigens für das Mixtape aufgenommen wurden:
🎤 5 exklusive Specials von Megaloh, KD Supier und der Level Eight Crew
🎧 5 exklusive Specials von DJ Luvsick / Broken Needles
Damit ist Kick It Like Luvsick weit mehr als nur ein Fußball-Mixtape – es ist ein Zeitdokument der Hip-Hop-Kultur, der Mixtape-Ära und des legendären WM-Sommers 2006.
Egal ob ihr das Original bereits vor 20 Jahren gehört habt oder das Mixtape heute zum ersten Mal entdeckt: Diese Neuveröffentlichung steht für Leidenschaft, Gemeinschaft, Musik und die Liebe zum Fußball.
🏆 20 Jahre Anniversary Edition
⚽ Ursprünglich veröffentlicht zur FIFA WM 2006
🌎 Neuveröffentlichung zur FIFA WM 2026
🎧 Mixed by DJ Luvsick

📜 Die vollständige Tracklist wird in Kürze auf DJLuvsick.com veröffentlicht.
Vielen Dank an alle, die das Original damals unterstützt haben und den Spirit der Mixtape-Kultur bis heute weitertragen.

body.body:
​
​Hello Hive community!

​Welcome to Day 7 of my daily game logs. Today marks one full week of sharing my progress here, and the milestones are getting bigger and better!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSHhLi5e4TVYSdqkxrtART5YQw3Eh8kzBHD8whjHhBdUs/1781636693457.jpg)


​The biggest highlight of the day is that I have officially hit Day 9 on my continuous activity streak! As you can see in the first image, this achievement has unlocked Spark Bonus II, giving me a permanent +15% bonus on my earned Sparks. It feels great to see the consistency paying off with higher multipliers.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPNkqw3K5BSPSesNQNTCmzaTz1QD7KPZeMhwgvH6qYN6i/1781636727909.jpg)


​With my new Tier II status unlocked, I headed over to take my daily spin on the wheel. The reward wheel is looking much better now with the active +15% tier multiplier applied to my potential wins.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ86K9UWRnGVUCoUQ5CkQrToh2mYqg9PZT2WAUzArbQrj/1781636785877.jpg)


​On the battlefield, I am pushing deeper into the campaign phases. Here is a snapshot from the middle of a strategic match in Round 2. My Water-element team layout is holding up nicely, and navigating through these rounds is giving me a much better grasp of proper card positioning and grid synergy.

​To wrap up a successful day, I cleared another campaign step.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfDBbAeij5vKQtM8g35mGbJqgMRygaszwGoJ9c7xo3bdb/1781636809708.jpg)


​Battle Challenge 1 Progress Another stage is successfully completed and marked as claimed, adding another steady 200 tokens to the collection.

​My long-term plan is moving along perfectly. I am continuously stacking up my resources while saving up my Hive to make the big jump into buying the Spellbook very soon. Keeping up this daily routine is definitely the secret!

​Thank you all for the upvotes, tips, and encouraging words on my recent posts. Let me know what you think of my current battle line-up in the comments!

​See you tomorrow for Day 8!

Hello friends, its a nice day and today we will be talking about the @peakd Mobile app, how to install it and log-in your hive account with the peakd-lock. * Go to a browser on your mobile device and search for peakd.com

* Click on add to home screen.

![Screenshot_20260614-194554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/calebmarvel24/23wMuaVBeiWCHdwS3NBi6uW9WwjXqafKySxo1dKzdoZPBWBw2gtRf4QHf9aD6VZqX4Gfh.jpg)

* Click on install.

![Screenshot_20260614-194716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/calebmarvel24/23tbyS6WYAUb5AJQPYnWKFCFuarvyVRBh4zh6262HCQhexCrx9ousHa9bGiFE3XGwcEpq.jpg)

* After installation, go to the app on your device.

![Screenshot_20260614-194942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/calebmarvel24/23uFGsSCzuxTRkpop7ZtepdmnWBKpKvnSvYQKrEvvVAkupqzfa6L5FPULAVtyd1da1NtY.jpg)

![Screenshot_20260614-195003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/calebmarvel24/23zS7UQU8Pfs9nwQTGXJyYEEEXngVcWitGyz5QRyXo8dgMftC2vqzegRBbPBDpaP6EdeV.jpg)

body.title: 𝐄𝐍𝐃𝐋𝐄𝐒𝐒 𝐀𝐏𝐄 || 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐋𝐎𝐍𝐆𝐄𝐑 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐁𝐀𝐓𝐓𝐋𝐄, 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐎𝐍𝐆𝐄𝐑 𝐈𝐓 𝐆𝐄𝐓𝐒
body.body: alt=\

/>

Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post.

It's time for another card spotlight, and today I want to talk about a card that looks simple at first but can become an absolute monster in the right battle.

The card is, Endless Ape.

When I first saw this card, my reaction was basically:

\
But after looking at its abilities, I realized this card can become really scary in longer matches.
alt=\

> 𝐅𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭 𝐈𝐦𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 ================================= Let's start with the stats at max level. * Mana Cost: 8 * Melee Damage: 4 * Health: 12 * Armor: 2 * Speed: 3 Honestly, these are already pretty solid numbers for a Common card. Twelve health gives it good survivability, and four melee damage means it can hit pretty hard when it gets the chance. It's not the fastest card in the game, but it doesn't really need to be. This card is built to stay alive. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟏: 𝐒𝐜𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐫 ===================================== **Scavenger**: +1 health and max health each time any unit is defeated.
alt=\

> Every time something gets knocked out, Endless Ape becomes tankier. In a battle with lots of units, this can get out of control pretty fast. Imagine starting with 12 health and ending the battle with 18 or even 20+ health. That's a lot of extra survivability. The longer the battle goes, the stronger this giant ape becomes. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟐: 𝐃𝐞𝐟𝐥𝐞𝐜𝐭 ================================= **Deflect**: 0 damage from Corrosive Ward, Magic Reflect, Thorns, Return Fire, and Blast splash damage.
alt=\

></center>

This ability is actually really underrated.

A lot of battles involve indirect damage.

Sometimes your strongest attacker hurts itself by hitting a unit with Thorns.

Sometimes Blast damage slowly chips away at your team.

Endless Ape simply ignores all of that.

No reflected damage.

No thorn damage.

No blast splash damage.

That's huge.

It allows the card to stay alive much longer than people expect.

𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐈 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐤 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐒𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬
=======================================================

Personally, I think Endless Ape works best in:

*   Long battles
    
*   High mana battles
    
*   Matches with lots of units
    
*   Rulesets where many creatures are expected to die
    

The more units that get defeated, the more value Scavenger provides.

And because Deflect keeps it safe from several common damage sources, it can stay around long enough to benefit from all those extra health boosts.

It's one of those cards that quietly becomes the strongest unit on the battlefield.

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

After looking at Endless Ape, I think it's one of those cards that gets stronger the longer you play.

It may not have five flashy abilities.

It may not be a legendary card.

But sometimes simple cards are the most effective.

Scavenger keeps making it bigger and bigger, while Deflect helps it ignore several annoying forms of damage.

That's a pretty nice combination.

And honestly, watching a giant gorilla become stronger every time something dies is kinda fun.

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Wenn Trading nicht nach Gewinn aussieht/ When trading doesn't look like a win
body.body:
Erst sah alles kontrollierbar aus. Die Plattform funktionierte. Gewinne wurden angezeigt. Der Broker klang kompetent. Die Trades wirkten real. Vielleicht gab es sogar Auszahlungen, kleine Erfolgserlebnisse, wachsende Sicherheit.

Dann kam dieser eine Moment.

Eine Nacht. Eine Bewegung am Markt. Eine geschlossene Position. Ein Kontostand, der plötzlich fast bei null steht.

Die Erklärung klingt technisch: Liquidation. Margin. Hebel. Marktbewegung.

Für Betroffene klingt es anders: Das Geld ist weg.

Und genau an dieser Stelle beginnt die juristisch entscheidende Prüfung. Denn nicht jeder Verlust ist Betrug. Nicht jede Plattform ist frei erfunden. Nicht jede negative Position führt automatisch zu einem Schadensersatzanspruch. Aber ebenso falsch wäre es, jeden Totalverlust beim gehebelten Krypto- oder Online-Trading vorschnell als „normales Risiko“ abzutun.

Wenn Ihr Tradingkonto nach angeblicher Liquidation leer ist, Sie aber Renditeversprechen, Brokeranweisungen, Nachforderungen oder verweigerte Auszahlungen dokumentieren können, sollte der Fall nicht als bloßer Marktverlust abgelegt werden. REXUS prüft bei substanziellem Schaden, ob Zahlungswege, Plattformstruktur, Banken, Zahlungsdienstleister oder andere Intermediäre eine zivilrechtliche Anspruchsstrategie ermöglichen.

Warum 1 % pro Tag kein seriöses Sicherheitsversprechen ist
„1 % pro Tag“ klingt nach Mathematik. Tatsächlich ist es häufig ein psychologischer Einstieg.

Der Anleger soll nicht über Risiko nachdenken, sondern über Regelmäßigkeit. Nicht über Verlustmechanik, sondern über Skalierung. Nicht über die Frage, wer im Hintergrund profitiert, sondern über die Vorstellung, dass ein System dauerhaft funktioniert.

Das Problem liegt im Hebel.

Wer 1.000 Euro einsetzt und mit einem 100-fachen Hebel handelt, bewegt wirtschaftlich nicht 1.000 Euro, sondern eine Position von 100.000 Euro. Läuft der Markt nur geringfügig gegen diese Position, kann der eingesetzte Betrag vollständig aufgezehrt sein. Die Position wird dann nicht deshalb geschlossen, weil der Anleger langfristig falsch lag. Sie wird geschlossen, weil der Risikopuffer technisch verbraucht ist.

Das ist der Unterschied zwischen einem steuerbaren Risiko und einem Risiko, das den Anleger überrollt.

Beim Spot-Trading kauft der Anleger den Coin oder Vermögenswert unmittelbar. Fällt der Kurs, fällt der Wert des Portfolios. Aber die Position wird nicht allein wegen einer Margin-Anforderung automatisch geschlossen. Beim Hebel-Trading dagegen kann eine kurze Gegenbewegung reichen, um den gesamten Einsatz zu vernichten.

**Für den Anleger ist das oft der Moment, in dem die Geschichte kippt: Aus „Trading“ wird Kontrollverlust.**

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...

https://www.anwalt.de/rechtstipps/1-pro-tag-wenn-trading-nicht-nach-gewinn-aussieht-sondern-nach-kontrollverlust-270380.html

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Der Grund warum 99% aller Trader Verlust machen. Weil sie spielsüchtig sind und nicht wissen was investieren bedeutet. Kryptostraßenwetten Communitys gibt es mittlerweile auf jeder großen Sozialen Medien Plattform.

---


![62663.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwuuVL6SDGW8Y4MMxkFbkFczQsoJB6nCs8CBrGdz6cka/62663.jpg)


English 

At first, everything seemed manageable. The platform worked. Profits were displayed. The broker sounded competent. The trades seemed real. Perhaps there were even withdrawals, small successes, growing confidence.

Then came that one moment.

One night. A market movement. A closed position. An account balance suddenly almost at zero.

The explanation sounds technical: liquidation. Margin. Leverage. Market movement.

For those affected, it sounds different: the money is gone.

And this is precisely where the legally crucial examination begins. Because not every loss is fraud. Not every platform is fictitious. Not every losing position automatically leads to a claim for damages. But it would be equally wrong to dismiss every total loss in leveraged crypto or online trading as \

If your trading account is empty after alleged liquidation, but you can document promised returns, broker instructions, additional charges, or refused withdrawals, the case should not be dismissed as a mere market loss.  In cases of substantial losses, REXUS examines whether payment methods, platform structure, banks, payment service providers, or other intermediaries offer a viable civil claim strategy.

Why 1% per day is not a reliable guarantee of security

\

sounds like math. In reality, it's often a psychological entry point.

The investor is meant to think not about risk, but about consistency. Not about the mechanics of losses, but about scalability. Not about who profits behind the scenes, but about the idea that a system will work in the long run.

The problem lies in the leverage.

Someone who invests €1,000 and trades with 100x leverage is not effectively moving €1,000, but rather a position worth €100,000. If the market moves even slightly against this position, the invested amount can be completely wiped out. The position is then closed not because the investor was wrong in the long term. It is closed because the risk buffer has been technically exhausted.

 This is the difference between manageable risk and risk that overwhelms the investor.

In spot trading, the investor buys the coin or asset directly. If the price falls, the value of the portfolio falls. But the position isn't automatically closed simply because of a margin requirement. In leveraged trading, however, a brief rebound can be enough to wipe out the entire investment.

**For the investor, this is often the moment when things take a turn for the worse: \

becomes a loss of control.**

I quoted from the following article...

https://www.anwalt.de/rechtstipps/1-pro-tag-wenn-trading-nicht-nach-gewinn-aussieht-sondern-nach-kontrollverlust-270380.html

My personal conclusion:

The reason why 99% of all traders lose money: Because they are gambling addicts and don't know what investing means. Crypto street betting communities now exist on every major social media platform.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@der-prophet/wenn-trading-nicht-nach-gewinn-aussieht-when-trading-doesnt-look-like-a-win-ew3)

body.title: Culpable [ES - EN]
body.body: ![1000314311.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/23xArwD5G2Scq9rCzJEDDNEwuchGavAZTDoG6fM21N3Rzs2AFvKDSa69z4xPp6uAtwJqm.png)

> Se llevó a cabo el quinto día de encuentros en el Mundial de Fútbol 2026 con la particularidad de que, en los cuatro realizados, todos empataron y eso llamó la atención porque en esos juegos fue la presentación de selecciones como Uruguay, Bélgica y España; justamente la actual campeona de la Eurocopa y una de las llamadas favoritas generó impacto en el mundo del fútbol, al no poder superar a su similar de Cabo Verde, selección que demostró un despliegue defensivo de alto nivel y, sumando la gran actuación del portero Vozinha, quien realizó hasta 8 atajadas, ofreció la primera gran sorpresa del torneo.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

The fifth day of matches at the 2026 World Cup took place, notable for the fact that all four games ended in draws—a surprising outcome given that these matches featured the debuts of teams such as Uruguay, Belgium, and Spain; In fact, the reigning European champion and one of the tournament favorites made waves in the soccer world by failing to defeat Cape Verde, a team that displayed top-notch defensive play. Combined with a stellar performance by goalkeeper Vozinha, who made as many as eight saves, Cape Verde delivered the tournament’s first major upset.


![1000314312.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EpNos5ddwHzYu68DirhfCKq3xKQafBQnkH9pcGaeSAAVfoMx6VuJbh3uFBFYCXtTKeA.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2066571876571177378)

Sin minimizar la actuación formidable de Cabo Verde en su presentación en el mundial, no hay ninguna duda de que lo sucedido en el primer encuentro del Grupo H, pudo tener un resultado diferente, pero, como he dicho anteriormente, el fútbol no se basa en merecimientos, sino en goles y, lamentablemente para la selección de España, el gol fue un gran ausente y es que, en mi opinión, creo que ni siquiera tuvo una invitación a la fiesta en donde la selección africana fue la gran protagonista; ahora la gran pregunta, con muchas respuestas sobre lo sucedido en este juego fue la siguiente: \

Y una de esas preguntas la respondí en el párrafo anterior y eso ahora me lleva a analizar la actuación de España la cual es una respuesta ofrecida por aficionados y prensa de la selección ibérica, en dónde se divide en señalar a jugadores y a su entrenador.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Without downplaying Cape Verde’s formidable performance in its World Cup debut, there’s no doubt that the outcome of the first match in Group H could have been different, but, as I’ve said before, soccer isn’t about merit—it’s about goals—and, unfortunately for the Spanish national team, goals were sorely lacking. In my opinion, Spain wasn’t even invited to the party where the African team stole the show; Now, the big question—with many answers regarding what happened in this game—was the following: “How is it possible that Spain didn’t score a single goal against Cape Verde?” I answered one of those questions in the previous paragraph, and that now leads me to analyze Spain’s performance—an analysis offered by fans and the press covering the Spanish national team, which is divided between pointing fingers at the players and their coach.


![1000314313.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EopsrqXYGF1tHzbw6kVuzVGP6D3J8TCvo6jicoE3s9xkgKAGG63frTH7i7h2n12rrcQ.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2066587733170995621)

Desde la revelación del equipo titular de España, hubo críticas con respecto al uso de Gavi, en el cual no se sabía en qué posición jugaría; personalmente, me sorprendió la decisión de jugar con cuatro centrocampistas y dos delanteros, pero pensé que De La Fuente usaría el esquema 4-4-2, lo cual me parecía extraño porque era de conocimiento que Cabo Verde tendría una posición netamente defensiva en el mayor tiempo de juego y que, a pesar de no contar con los extremos titulares en su mejor condición física, creo que en el seleccionado español cuenta con los jugadores necesarios para ocupar ciertas posiciones y así practicar un esquema más ofensivo. Para mi sorpresa, el esquema final del equipo español fue 4-3-3, en donde la posición de Gavi y Ferrán Torres fue de extremos; desde ese momento me pareció que existía un gran problema para el equipo porque, al no contar con extremos puros, le restaría vértigo al ataque y lo haría netamente predecible, y así fue; esa decisión de hacer jugar a Gavi por izquierda, fijarlo en esa posición, lo volvió un jugador intrascendente, ya que no tuvo peso ofensivo en su equipo.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Ever since Spain’s starting lineup was announced, there has been criticism regarding the use of Gavi, as it was unclear what position he would play; personally, I was surprised by the decision to field four midfielders and two forwards, but I thought De La Fuente would use a 4-4-2 formation, which seemed strange to me because it was well known that Cape Verde would adopt a purely defensive stance for most of the game, and even though the starting wingers weren’t in peak physical condition, I believe the Spanish national team has the necessary players to fill certain positions and thus employ a more offensive formation. To my surprise, the Spanish team’s final formation was a 4-3-3, with Gavi and Ferrán Torres playing as wingers; from that moment on, it seemed to me that there was a major problem for the team because, without true wingers, it would take the pace out of the attack and make it entirely predictable—and that’s exactly what happened; that decision to play Gavi on the left and pin him in that position rendered him an inconsequential player, as he had no offensive impact on his team.


![1000314314.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eonk71rFG6ExpMFZdmkPUcNtExY1sJfasDyLm8oQmsqY4P1hpuCRsBU2WpUxr2YmFEQ.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2066580902025494706)

Otro gran problema que se visualizó en el juego fue primeramente el doble pivote conformado por Fabián Ruiz y Rodri; ninguno de los dos tuvo peso ofensivo en el equipo, no fueron ejes en la conducción, no ayudaron a sus compañeros en la presión, recuperación y circulación del balón, fueron completamente nulos. Al mal desempeño de ambos jugadores, sumo los laterales defensivos; tanto Llorente como Cucurella no ofrecieron el apoyo necesario para su incursión en el ataque, algo que debería ser más que evidente por el esquema defensivo del rival. Posiblemente, la actuación de Cucurella debería ser más señalada, ya que, en palabras del entrenador español, debería tener mucho más peso ofensivo, pero la verdad es que poca proyección tiró abajo ese plan de ataque. La ofensiva de España, en dónde no hubo extremos hasta el minuto 70 con el ingreso de Lamine Yamal que en más de 20 minutos hizo más regates (5 en total) que sus compañeros, fue el gran problema de esta selección y lo que conllevó al sopresivo empate a cero goles; tener a un delantero cento como Oyarzabal que superó un record de no tocar el balón por más de 30 minutos de juego y a Ferrán que tuvo hasta 20 perdidas de balón, con un solo chute de peligro en 80 minutos jugados, fue en parte la gran respuesta sobre porque España no ganó ese juego, pero es Gavi quien se está llevando toda crítica por su nulo aporte ofensivo y es que al ser usado como extremo para fijar al lateral derecho rival junto al defensor central en esa zona, era más que evidente que Gavi no era el jugador necesario para ese trabajo y al intentar sin obtener ninguna recompensa, quedó frente al paredón de toda crítica.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Another major problem that became apparent during the game was, first and foremost, the double pivot formed by Fabián Ruiz and Rodri; neither of them had any offensive impact on the team, they did not serve as focal points in ball movement, and they did not help their teammates with pressing, ball recovery, or ball circulation—they were completely ineffective. Adding to the poor performance of these two players were the defensive fullbacks; neither Llorente nor Cucurella provided the necessary support for the team’s attacking runs, something that should have been all too obvious given the opponent’s defensive setup. Cucurella’s performance perhaps deserves special mention, since, in the words of the Spanish coach, he should have had a much greater offensive impact; but the truth is that his lack of forward runs derailed that attacking plan. Spain’s offense—which lacked wingers until the 70th minute, when Lamine Yamal came on and, in more than 20 minutes, made more dribbles (5 in total) than his teammates—was the team’s biggest problem and what led to the surprising scoreless draw; having a center forward like Oyarzabal—who set a record for not touching the ball for more than 30 minutes of play—and Ferrán, who had as many as 20 turnovers and just one dangerous shot in 80 minutes of play, was partly the main reason Spain didn’t win that game, but it is Gavi who is bearing the brunt of all the criticism for his lack of offensive contribution. The fact is that, when used as a winger to pin down the opposing right back alongside the center back in that area, it was more than evident that Gavi was not the right player for that role, and as he tried without reaping any reward, he found himself on the receiving end of all the criticism.


![1000314315.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eou7jQa6maoqNNG87gSB7MSy72ZuNABJ19XHBSubVoz9ziW1RNh2fagufsd5H3TFqQs.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2066583456931336661)

Toda señalización hecha en anteriores párrafos pueden ser consideradas como factores influyentes del resultado final en ese encuentro, cada uno de los jugadores nombrados tiene culpa por su pobre desempeño contra un equipo considerado con un nivel menor, pero que demostraron una mejor actitud y convicción al plan ideado por su entrenador y es aquí en dónde personalmente señaló al culpable de que España nuevamente sumo otro mal resultado en un mundial, Luis De La Fuente sigue sumergido en la equivocacion sobre el posicionamiento de los jugadores y su nula convicción a los considerados como no habituales; impresiona que teniendo el conocimiento del estadio físico de importante jugadores de la selección, no haya pensado en usar a quien está mejor y hacerlos jugar, no pensar en uar a extremos como Yeremi Pino y Victor Muñoz para jugar por las bandas, o hasta el mismo Porro para contar con velocidad y el aporte de centros al área; lo otro fue con contar con Borja Iglesias que son su altura pudo fijar a ambos centrales rivales lo cual pudiera ayudar a los espacios o por lo menos usar a Dani Olmo para ser el compañero ideal de Pedri que se fundió en buscar toda manera para ganar el juego. La nulidad de aporte del entrenador que decidió no cambiar y mantener una idea estéril que llenó de frustración a sus jugadores es lo que considero que fue el verdadero factor de un resultado inesperado para España y, en mi opinión, es lo que considero que puede ser una grave problemática para lo que queda de mundial, porque es evidente que su entrenador no cambiará de opinión sobre sus ideas y habrá que esperar a que los jugadores demuestren iniciativa para ser ellos los que pueden tener posibilidades de trascender en el torneo.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

All the points raised in the previous paragraphs can be considered factors that influenced the final result of that match; each of the players mentioned bears some blame for their poor performance against a team considered to be of a lower caliber, but one that demonstrated a better attitude and commitment to the plan devised by their coach. And this is where I personally pinpointed the culprit for Spain’s yet another poor result in a World Cup: Luis De La Fuente remains mired in mistakes regarding player positioning and his lack of confidence in those considered non-regulars; it’s striking that, given his knowledge of the physical condition of key players on the national team, he didn’t consider using those in better shape and putting them in the game, He didn’t consider using wingers like Yeremi Pino and Victor Muñoz on the flanks, or even Porro himself to provide speed and deliver crosses into the box; another missed opportunity was not utilizing Borja Iglesias, who, thanks to his height, could have tied up both opposing center backs—which might have opened up spaces—or at least using Dani Olmo as the ideal partner for Pedri, who gave his all trying to find any way to win the game. The coach’s failure to contribute—having decided not to make changes and to stick to a fruitless strategy that filled his players with frustration—is what I believe was the real factor behind this unexpected result for Spain, and, in my opinion, it’s what I consider could be a serious problem for the remainder of the World Cup, because it’s clear that their coach won’t change his mind about his strategies, and we’ll have to wait for the players to show initiative so that they themselves can have a chance to make an impact in the tournament.

The thoughts of humans are unique and that makes humans different from each other. Even if each human can be different but we can divide them into two categories. The two categories are good and evil as well as bad people. It would be good if there were only good people in this world and in that case, we could live a peaceful life. Unfortunately, evil people always exist, and they keep thinking about evil for others. They commit crime and break the rules and create chaos in the world. To control the evil people there are punishments for crime. But can punishment stop them from committing crime? ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUehKX3SzcMUfhy1x142vE13EHSVSW2vHVFCtDmhnDQ6/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-of-person-on-window-PEJHULxUHZs) In every country there are laws and they are for protecting the good people and punishing the evil people for their crime. If there were no punishments, the people who seem normal may end up committing many crimes for their selfish desire as humans are greedy by nature and I can’t deny it. There are some people who don’t care about anything. They don’t fear the consequences and the punishment for their actions. Admit it, we've all envisioned that we were all a sudden struck with great riches.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcHSWro12EGUFLxSRcA59u74WkbwcVu8DN2jcYHjAvUi8/file_00000000457871f4bacc43edcb7dfd5a.png)

No more worrying about bills.

No more worrying about the unsuspecting bills.

Never again have to question how some dreams might come true.

If I woke up tomorrow and found out I had won $1,000,000 I'd be very glad but once all the fun had died down, I don't believe my life would be like one of the scenes in a movie, where a person just left everything and toured the world.

I think the money would alter my options more than the person.

I would first be sure that my family is safe and comfortable.

A lesson I've learned in life is that no matter how bad the money is, no one is really alone. If one member of the family is down, it's felt by all members in some way. My biggest satisfaction would probably be to take some of those burdens off.

For not because I want praise but for the fact that those who helped you are now breathing a little easier because of it.

Then I would work on developing long-term stability.

Numerous lottery winners find themselves in the public spotlight, but with little money in their pockets. I would do anything to avoid that.

Much of the funds would be spent on the investments and income generation activities instead of luxuries.

I would want the money to continue to pay tribute long after the excitement of winning had been lost.

Self-investment, of course!

I have some goals that take resources, education, and time. If they were able to have their flow of money, the idea of following them wouldn't be so difficult without having to worry about their next meal.

body.title: ‎How Modern Wars Affect Global Food Prices
body.body:
Hello Hive,

‎Most of us see news about wars on television or social media and think about the immediate consequences, such as loss of lives, destruction of buildings, and people being forced to leave their homes. While these are certainly the most visible effects, wars often create problems that reach far beyond the countries involved. One of those problems is the rising cost of food around the world.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmanfvTigNdw9p6kCbk5bAhqYKJwn3EjzjT6uCSBpyycSK/mikecook1-vehicle-3104459_1920.jpg 

‎[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/vehicle-transportation-system-war-3104459/)
‎
‎I think it might seem strange at first glance that a conflict happening thousands of kilometers away can affect the price of food in our local markets. However, the world is more connected than ever before. Many countries rely on imports for essential food items, fertilizers, and agricultural supplies. When war disrupts production or transportation, the effects are globally felt.
‎
‎A good example is the war between Russia and Ukraine. Before the conflict started, both countries supplied large amounts of wheat, corn, sunflower oil, and fertilizers to many parts of the world. When the fighting started, exports became more difficult and supplies dropped. As a result, food prices increased in many countries, including places that had no direct connection to the war itself.
‎
‎Another factor that people don't always consider is fuel. Modern farming depends heavily on fuel for machinery, transportation, and food processing. Wars often cause oil and gas prices to rise, which means farmers and food producers have to spend more money to keep their operations running. Eventually, those extra costs find their way to consumers through higher prices at grocery stores and local markets.
‎
‎The people who suffer the most are usually those in developing countries. Many families already struggle with the rising cost of living, and a sudden increase in food prices can make daily life even more difficult. What might seem like a small price increase to some can mean fewer meals on the table for others.
‎
‎I think situations like these remind us that we live in a truly connected world. Events happening in one region can have huge consequences that spread across continents. While wars are often discussed in terms of politics and military actions, their economic effects can touch the lives of ordinary people like me everywhere.
‎
‎The next time food prices rise unexpectedly, it may be worth looking beyond local factors. Sometimes the reason is not just what is happening in our own country but what is happening on the other side of the world.
‎
‎Thanks for reading!!!!
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

body.title: Dinosaurios: gigantes que dejaron huellas más allá del tiempo. Por Florencia Renata
body.body: <div class=\

>

¿Qué nos viene a la mente cuando pensamos en dinosaurios?: quizás un Tyrannosaurus Rex rugiendo en medio de un ambiente selvático, tal vez un montón de huesos enormes en un museo, o probablemente la colección de figuras de plástico que tuvimos de pequeños, mientras intentábamos aprender nombres impronunciables.

Sin embargo, todos sabemos que los dinosaurios son mucho más que eso, y formaron una era entera de la Tierra; un reinado de 165 millones de años (mientras que los seres humanos apenas llevamos 300 mil años). Su impacto fue tan impresionante que, aunque ya no estén, sus huellas no son solo de barro fosilizado, sino que siguen siendo motivos de preguntas que seguimos formulando: ¿cómo vivían? ¿por qué desaparecieron? ¿cómo fueron realmente? Y muchas más que esperan respuestas ocultas en ese pasado que todavía exploramos…

Viaje hacia el pasado: datos curiosos

1. La palabra \
significa literalmente \

y fue acuñada en 1842 por el paleontólogo británico Richard Owen. Al principio, Owen quería transmitir la idea de que estos animales eran enormes y temibles, sin embargo, para ese momento que creó el término, solo conocía tres géneros: Megalosaurus, Iguanodon y Hylaeosaurus

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBwyPbT2QYZWtHLQuWwD4MozhmkTt13imL545XDSTEeg/gemini_generated_image_wl918uwl918uwl91.png)
[Imagen generada a través de Gemini IA](gemini.google.com)

2. El Argentinosaurus es considerado uno de los dinosaurios más grandes que jamás existieron. Este coloso podría haber alcanzado los 35 metros de longitud, mientras que el Velociraptor, era un corredor ágil que podía alcanzar velocidades de hasta 40 km/h.

Por su parte, el dinosaurio con el cerebro más pequeño fue el Stegosaurus, aunque es famoso por su doble fila de placas óseas en la espalda, su cerebro era del tamaño de una nuez; a pesar de ello logró sobrevivir en su entorno durante millones de años.

Se estima que existen más de 700 especies diferentes de dinosaurios conocidas hasta la fecha, y los paleontólogos continúan descubriendo nuevas especies cada año.

3.Raíz etimológica real de su nombre: Deinos (δεινός) = \
. Sauros (σαῦρος) = \

.

https://i.ecency.com/DQmfU7yVdRf4V7mXtUTFGTG3Z9hEczYmyGefsvcPotvXccW/gemini_generated_image_8eq6pl8eq6pl8eq6.png
[Imagen generada a través de Gemini IA](gemini.google.com)

Espacios jurásicos: entendiendo las eras prehistóricas.

El Triásico: se considera el amanecer de los dinosaurios. El periodo Triásico, hace aproximadamente 250 millones de años, fue el comienzo de la era de los dinosaurios. Durante este tiempo, los continentes se encontraban unidos en un supercontinente llamado Pangea, donde los primeros dinosaurios comenzaron a emerger, destacando el Coelophysis, carnívoro pequeño que cazaba en manadas.

El Jurásico o también llamada “la era dorada de los gigantes”. Este periodo tuvo lugar, entre 201 y 145 millones de años atrás. Aquí los continentes comenzaron a separarse, creando nuevos hábitats y climas que permitieron una amplia diversidad de vida. En este periodo podemos destacar al famoso Brachiosaurus, un herbívoro de cuello largo que podía alcanzar las hojas más altas de los árboles.

El Cretácico: corresponde al ocaso de los dinosaurios. Sucedió hace 145 a 66 millones de años atrás, siendo su periodo final. Durante esta época surgieron muchos de los dinosaurios más conocidos, como el Tyrannosaurus rex y el Triceratops. Este periodo concluyó con un evento catastrófico que llevó a la extinción de los dinosaurios.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP8dAXqiHgY1dGrp36RT1hbV5FAKU5gmZDFmnZE24CQZy/gemini_generated_image_mhquubmhquubmhqu.png)
[Imagen generada a través de Gemini IA](gemini.google.com)

Dinosaurios destacados: Conociendo a los gigantes

Tyrannosaurus rex: Considerado el rey de los dinosaurios es, sin duda, el más emblemáticos y hasta simbólico de ellos. Con su poderosa mandíbula y su temible apariencia dominaba su entorno en el Cretácico tardío. Aunque su fama le genera un imponente imaginario, los científicos creen que este depredador también era carroñero oportunista.

Triceratops: también llamado el gigante con cuernos, es conocido por sus tres cuernos y su gran escudo de hueso. Pese a su apariencia intimidante, era un herbívoro pacífico que se alimentaba de plantas bajas. Su cráneo es uno de los más grandes y complejos entre los dinosaurios, lo que le otorgaba una defensa formidable contra los depredadores.

Brachiosaurus: el legendario coloso de cuello largo, con un peso de hasta 30 toneladas y una longitud que podía superar los 25 metros, era herbívoro y a diferencia de otros saurópodos, tenía las patas delanteras más largas que las traseras, lo que le daba una postura erguida.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcCjtvL5rfxUya57X2ySZ1UP8437sTNHSeK9Wj4WF1cu/gemini_generated_image_ovj6vhovj6vhovj6.png)
[Imagen generada a través de Gemini IA](gemini.google.com)

Los dinosaurios son más que fósiles en un museo o personajes temibles en películas; son los principales testigos de un pasado remoto que nos enseña sobre la evolución, la adaptación y la extinción. Conocer sobre su historia nos ayudará a entender mejor nuestro propio lugar en el mundo y cómo las especies deben adaptarse para sobrevivir. Surgen preguntas como: ¿Qué podemos aprender de su desaparición para proteger a las especies actuales?

La historia de los dinosaurios es un recordatorio de la fragilidad de la vida en la Tierra y la importancia de preservar nuestro entorno para las generaciones futuras. Investigar el pasado, explorar la majestuosidad de los dinosaurios, comprender su impacto duradero nos ayuda a tomar consciencia. La próxima vez que veamos un fósil o un dinosaurio de juguete, recordaremos que estamos mirando a un antiguo gigante que dejó su huella más allá del tiempo.

Cuéntame en comentarios si prefieres un Tyrannosaurus Rex gruñón o un Triceratops vegetariano. Y si llegaste hasta aquí... gracias por desenterrar este espacio conmigo.

body.title: Success, Timing, and Opportunity
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaCekUxCWknackUYi71mE6HTLwZj6sMiSMbUVbAt9AMxC/img_0267.jpg)[source](https://www.theverge.com/tech/948917/elon-musk-trillionaire-how-much-visualization)
Yesterday, I was going through a blog when I saw how the writer glorified Elon Musk because he is currently number one on the list of the world’s wealthiest people. Before now, people like Bill Gates and others occupied that position for a long time, but what changed was time and the opportunities they took advantage of.

One thing this has taught me about life is that nothing lasts forever. There are people who are unknown today but may be in the spotlight tomorrow. That is one aspect of life that has always amazed me. Some of those who are in the limelight today may not be there a decade from now. This is not necessarily because of death or other natural causes. There are many reasons why people may lose relevance over time, while others manage to remain in the spotlight for a very long period.

Everyone knows that Elon Musk is a risk-taker. We know how he started by launching his companies and how he sold his shares in PayPal and other businesses to invest in what he believed in. He also built several other companies along the way. Although some people argue that he benefited from government resources, it happened partly because he positioned himself to take advantage of the opportunities available. How many people would be willing to take risks the way Elon did? Even his electric cars faced heavy criticism at the beginning, yet he refused to give up and continued pursuing his vision.

Now, it is becoming increasingly difficult for others on the rich list to catch up with him. He is undoubtedly a very smart individual.

Being smart is important, but being willing to take risks when necessary is equally important. Elon is a good example of this. Now, is it possible for someone to come from nothing and become successful? Well, it depends. We have heard many stories of people who started with very little or came from poor backgrounds and still succeeded in the end. The difference is that achieving success without support is usually much more difficult. Support is often essential because it makes the journey easier and increases the chances of breaking through compared to someone who has to start completely from scratch.

In Elon Musk’s case, we cannot exactly say he came from a very humble background. However, he is a South African-born entrepreneur who went on to achieve extraordinary success in another country as an immigrant. This demonstrates his commitment to personal development, innovation, and achieving his goals.

body.title: Being depressed isn't easy every day but it's better to get out and do little things./ Estar deprimido no es fácil todos los días, pero es mejor salir y hacer pequeñas cosas.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3rTdhKrFEoptHhRTiYfL8NSqA6jdEq3JH6eMkVQoXRZ/1781635195239.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, I'm back with you again with a new post. I don't know why depression is hitting me harder lately, maybe it's because summer is starting, or maybe it's just the way the illness is. Sometimes even the simplest tasks seem difficult to do with this illness. Anyway, today I went out and did some simple tasks, even just to avoid staying depressed on the couch or in bed all day. First, I got ready, because taking care of myself is important too. I took a shower, put on a nice t-shirt, and did some skincare—nothing excessive, but still something that makes me feel better. Then I did some housework, sweeping, washing up, dusting, and mopping up. Then I prepared a simple lunch: some pork loins with a simple salad, quick and delicious, and then I relaxed a bit after lunch, watching a TV series in peace.

> Buenas noches, amigos del blog, estoy de vuelta con ustedes con una nueva publicación. No sé por qué la depresión me está afectando más últimamente, tal vez sea porque empieza el verano, o tal vez sea simplemente la forma en que se manifiesta la enfermedad. A veces, incluso las tareas más simples parecen difíciles de hacer con esta enfermedad. En fin, hoy salí e hice algunas tareas simples, aunque solo sea para evitar quedarme deprimida en el sofá o en la cama todo el día. Primero, me arreglé, porque cuidarme también es importante. Me duché, me puse una camiseta bonita y me hice un poco de cuidado de la piel; nada excesivo, pero algo que me hace sentir mejor. Luego hice algunas tareas domésticas: barrí, lavé los platos, quité el polvo y fregué. Después preparé un almuerzo sencillo: unos lomos de cerdo con una ensalada simple, rápido y delicioso, y luego me relajé un poco después de comer, viendo una serie de televisión en paz.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYPeXbUwJrvKFWZfCpAuhzXuvUfcBGs31iPsGneGxsPos/1781635285467.jpg)


Then, after getting dressed and ready, I decided to go out for a bit. I put on a bit of makeup, a nice t-shirt, and then I went out for a coffee. Even something as simple as a coffee outside on a nice day can lift your mood. It's a nice, simple little café in the area where the coffee is very good. Then my husband came home, and we went shopping at the supermarket. I found various vegetables at a good price, as well as fruit, kale, apricots, peaches, tomatoes, corn on the cob, radishes, and eggplant. Now my fridge is full of good vegetables. Finally, we took a drive around the area so as not to immediately lock ourselves in, enjoying the view and the sunny day. In short, today was fine again. Now I'm feeling a little better. I'm relaxing by watching Bates Motel and asking my anxious and depressed brain for a break.

> Después de vestirme y arreglarme, decidí salir un rato. Me maquillé un poco, me puse una camiseta bonita y salí a tomar un café. Incluso algo tan simple como un café al aire libre en un día agradable puede levantar el ánimo. Es una cafetería pequeña y sencilla en la zona donde el café es muy bueno. Luego mi esposo llegó a casa y fuimos de compras al supermercado. Encontré varias verduras a buen precio, así como fruta, col rizada, albaricoques, duraznos, tomates, mazorcas de maíz, rábanos y berenjenas. Ahora mi refrigerador está lleno de verduras frescas. Finalmente, dimos una vuelta en coche por la zona para no quedarnos encerrados de inmediato, disfrutando de las vistas y del día soleado. En resumen, hoy fue un buen día. Ahora me siento un poco mejor. Me estoy relajando viendo Bates Motel y pidiéndole un respiro a mi mente ansiosa y deprimida.

body.title: La esperanza tóxica de que el otro cambie
body.body: >
data-align=\

>Si bien esto es algo que ya abordé parcialmente en mi post ¿Por qué a veces la gente quiere ser engañada?, ahora quiero analizar otro aspecto asociado al autoengaño: la esperanza. Hay un lado oscuro de la esperanza del que la gente rara vez suele hablar; si bien esta puede ser un impulsor para que las personas puedan salir de situaciones difíciles, también puede ser la fuerza que haga que queden atrapadas en ellas.
Por ejemplo, la esperanza de la esposa maltratada de que su marido cambie y deje de golpearla o de humillarla hace que quede atrapada en una situación de abuso doméstico. La esperanza de que el hijo que está metido en una banda deje atrás su mala vida —cuando no hay ninguna base real que indique que este realmente lo va a hacer— puede exponer a las personas a situaciones de riesgo (quedarse atrapado en una guerra de pandillas o tener que endeudarse para pagarle a la banda por protección, por ejemplo). Asimismo, la esperanza de que un hermano deje las drogas puede atraparte en una situación en la que corras el riesgo de que este te agreda cuando critiques su comportamiento o te robe para financiar su adicción.
La esperanza sana se basa en evidencias y acciones concretas, mientras que la esperanza en contextos de abuso o adicción suele ser un pensamiento mágico que se vuelve peligroso cuando se convierte en una excusa para no tomar decisiones difíciles o para justificar la inacción ante el maltrato. Esperar que alguien cambie solo porque lo deseas o porque «el amor todo lo puede» es ceder el control de tu vida al maltratador o a la persona autodestructiva.
Cuando financias la deuda de un adicto o justificas el primer golpe del maltratador con la esperanza de que «será la última vez», te conviertes, sin quererlo, en un habilitador de su conducta. La esperanza tóxica actúa como un anestésico que te impide ver que, al intentar salvar a quien no quiere ser salvado, estás financiando tu propia destrucción.
Las estadísticas globales y de organismos como los CDC de Estados Unidos respaldan la esta cruda realidad: mientras que 1 de cada 3 mujeres sufre de violencia doméstica a lo largo de su vida, los programas clínicos de rehabilitación para agresores muestran un panorama desalentador, con tasas de reincidencia que oscilan entre el 60% y el 80% a mediano plazo. Esto nos indica, que la gran mayoría de las veces, la otra persona no va a cambiar, al menos no de manera positiva ni por voluntad propia.
Puede ser doloroso admitirlo abiertamente, pero cuando alguien cercano a uno emprende un camino hacia la autodestrucción, se tienen dos caminos: se le puede tender la mano y ahogarse junto con esa persona, o se puede cortar con esa relación porque va a hacer daño. Hacerlo no es nada sencillo, porque implica matar la ilusión de un futuro mejor al lado de quien amamos.
>
data-align=\

>La cultura occidental actual nos ha vendido la idea de que abandonar a alguien en su peor momento es un acto de crueldad, cuando en realidad, quedarse a naufragar con él es irracional. Sin embargo, salvar tu propia vida jamás debería ser motivo de culpa. La esperanza debe ser un faro que te guíe hacia adelante, no una cadena que te ate al fondo del océano junto a un barco que ya se está hundiendo.
Algunos especialistas en psicología, señalan que a veces hay que hacer el duelo de la persona mientras aún está con vida. Ese duelo significa aceptar que el hermano, el hijo o la pareja que conociste (o que idealizaste) ya no existe, y que la persona real actual es un peligro para tu estabilidad financiera, física o emocional. Abandonar la esperanza de que alguien cambie no es un acto de egoísmo; es un acto de autopreservación.
Entender esto no nos vuelve seres fríos o desalmados; nos vuelve realistas. El amor por el otro tiene un límite infranqueable, y ese límite es tu propia dignidad, tu paz mental y tu seguridad física. No puedes obligar a alguien a ver la luz si ha decidido abrazar la sombra, y pasar tu vida esperando que ocurra un milagro solo te garantiza ser la víctima colateral de su caída.
Al final, la esperanza más valiosa, y la única que realmente puedes controlar, es la esperanza en ti mismo: la certeza de que tienes el poder de elegir la vida, incluso si eso significa dejar atrás a quienes decidieron destruirse.
>
data-align=\

>¿Alguna vez has tenido que renunciar a la esperanza de que alguien cambiara para poder salvarte a ti mismo?
Los leo en los comentarios.
data-align=\
>Nota. Todas las imagenes fueron generadas con Gemini AI.

links.title: [ESP/ENG] Food review: Alaska roll en D' la Costa -viendo FIFA / Alaska roll in D' la Costa -watching FIFA 🍣⚽
links.body:
>



Hola amigos. 
¡Qué fin de semana! Brasil jugaba en el mundial, y como mi novio es un gran fanático de ese equipo, incluso se compró una camisa del equipo jeje, decidimos aprovechar la ocasión para hacer algo especial juntos y ver el juego en pantalla gigante. Pensamos que, sería genial combinar la pasión por el fútbol con una cita. Así que, fuimos al restaurante De la Costa, ubicado en la hermosa ciudad de Cumaná, en el Estado Sucre, Venezuela.
>Hey friends!
What a weekend! Brazil was playing in the World Cup, and since my boyfriend is a huge fan of that team—he even bought a team jersey, haha—we decided to take advantage of the occasion to do something special together and watch the game on a giant screen. We thought it would be great to combine our passion for soccer with a date. So, we went to the De la Costa restaurant, located in the beautiful city of Cumaná, in the state of Sucre, Venezuela.


![Screenshot_20260616_143809_com_android_chrome_ChromeTabbedActivity.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQzjydzC3c4NtkL3YmTXvhN91jyBi3b8V2njnRn6QmuzK/Screenshot_20260616_143809_com_android_chrome_ChromeTabbedActivity.jpg)

Ya hemos ido en varias oportunidades a este restaurante, y la verdad nos gusta mucho la vibra qué transmite el local, me encantan las luces dispuestas en el techo, porque crean un ambiente relajante y bastante romántico para los que van en pareja. Así mismo, fuimos en una cita de 4, pues unos amigos de mi novio fueron los que nos invitaron, y mientras ellos veían su juego, nosotras  las chicas conversábamos de todo un poco. 
> We've been to this restaurant several times, and we really like the vibe it has. I love the lights on the ceiling because they create a relaxing and quite romantic atmosphere for couples. We went on a date with four people; some of my boyfriend's friends invited us, and while they watched their game, we girls chatted about everything.


![IMG_20260613_183216.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU149jDMH4YbxXFtVZaEmvBbR2fY1BigV8maT1VZ87aGH/IMG_20260613_183216.jpg)



![IMG-20260613-WA0068.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVv9R26VCvELZK7rkPbE9jgFg2Mn3Vj3qBy8FjRzKm1PM/IMG-20260613-WA0068.jpg)


Vale destacar que, la comida allí me parece un poco costosa en comparación con otros restaurantes, sin embargo, la atención fue simplemente genial, algo que se agradece muchísimo cuando vas a probar algo diferente y quieres que todo salga perfecto. 
> It's worth noting that the food there seems a bit expensive compared to other restaurants; however, the service was simply great, something that is greatly appreciated when you're going to try something different and want everything to be perfect.


![IMG_20260613_183229.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSBoDeq7Cdiu8fVmfdrKddwksVwKVi8W68Lb6ANHqft1L/IMG_20260613_183229.jpg)


Para aprovechar el momento distinto a lo que estoy acostumbrada, me pedí un combo de sushi \

, si mal no recuerdo. Estaba muy rico, me gustó bastante la ensalada de salmón qué tenía como topping, fue el toque más especial del plato, a mi parecer. > To take advantage of the unusual situation, I ordered an Alaska roll sushi combo, if I remember correctly. It was delicious; I especially liked the salmon salad topping—it was the most special touch of the dish, in my opinion. https://images.hive.blog/DQmWre3qsJSGkuoWa9npbwm721Vj9TPWvGtKrQ48knPsK5T/IMG_20260613_180630.jpg En este tipo de restaurantes, siempre me gusta aventurarme y pedir cosas diferentes a lo que normalmente estoy acostumbrada. Me encanta elegir platos que tengan comida de mar, sushi o cualquier especialidad que se salga de mi rutina habitual. Siento que el valor de la experiencia lo vale totalmente, porque no solo disfruto de sabores frescos y únicos, sino que también le doy a mi paladar la oportunidad de descubrir nuevas sensaciones. Además, probar platos nuevos me hace sentir que estoy aprovechando al máximo la ocasión, convirtiendo la visita en algo especial. > In these kinds of restaurants, I always like to be adventurous and order things that are different from what I'm used to. I love choosing dishes with seafood, sushi, or any specialty that's outside my usual routine. I feel the experience is totally worth it because I not only enjoy fresh and unique flavors, but I also give my palate the chance to discover new sensations. Plus, trying new dishes makes me feel like I'm making the most of the occasion, turning the visit into something special. ![IMG_20260613_184917.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTtSMvDr6Wn8YDnVRgosC9X1rWhHcByBkJuEdh1L6sxWE/IMG_20260613_184917.jpg) Me sentí muy feliz de haberme animado a probar algo distinto. Saludos. > I was so glad I decided to try something different. Sometimes, paying a little more for a delicious and well-prepared meal is totally worth it. I hope to return soon, when I can afford it, haha! Cheers. ![IMG_20260613_183242.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFiEmRigHsakyeNbuUoKKz8RMdW6RVKm7ayPniqpvcoY/IMG_20260613_183242.jpg) ______ #hivefood Fotografía por | Photography by: @mairimmorales, HONOR MAGIC 7 LITE. In this video, I respond to a comment on my YouTube channel regarding the 'fun' aspect of Splinterlands. The truth is, I find the game incredibly fun and addictive and it's one of the few games I've played for as long as I have - going on almost 5 years now. I know the bull run in 2021 brought many people in who only found it fun because there were financial prizes, and honestly speaking I was one of them, but the game itself has always been fun for me and I think we are finally getting back to the point where only people who truly enjoy the game for what it is are sticking around.

links.title: More an art...
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbF1gDPNwL1vq34DS77ne4GpkLBHEQPv1rqaTY2KWReUX/1781635744310.jpg)
Picture by @wakeupkitty

The history of this sculpture is traced to a tradition in European contemporary art that uses the human form to explore uncertainty, change, vulnerability and self-discovery. By depicting a figure submerged headfirst in water, there's something i find amusing here, which is that the artist disrupts ordinary expectations and encourages viewers to reflect on the moments in life when direction, certainty, and control seem out of reach. Rather than offering answers, the artwork invites contemplation.

Actually, i'm struck in the contrast between the figure and its surroundings. The stream is calm, the vegetation flourishes along the banks, and the historic building stands firmly in place. Everything appears settled and enduring, yet at the center of this tranquil setting is a figure positioned in a way that feels unnatural, almost impossible to ignore.

What I see is not someone drowning, but someone suspended in a moment of transition. The sculpture captures a feeling that many people experience but rarely express, the sensation of navigating unfamiliar circumstances while trying to maintain a sense of self. The water conceals part of the figure, leaving room for imagination and interpretation. 

What remains visible suggests persistence rather than surrender.

The artwork resonates with me because it mirrors periods when my life feels uncertain. There are times when plans unravel, familiar paths disappear, and progress becomes difficult to measure. 

In those moments, it can seem as though everything has been turned upside down. Yet the sculpture suggests that such experiences are not merely obstacles, they can become opportunities for reflection and growth.

Its historical and artistic significance lies in its ability to transform an ordinary scene into a profound statement about the human condition.

 Looking at it, I feel thoughtful and introspective, all I see is endurance amid uncertainty, movement within stillness, and possibility hidden beneath the surface. 

Above all, I think the sculpture reminds us that transformation often begins in moments that challenge our understanding of where we are and where we are going.

what do you think?

links.title: Registering the romance of the bride and groom, the moment of connection
links.body:
Hello to all friends. I hope you are well. I am very happy to be here with you and to be able to share my experiences with you.

You may not believe that we photographers, the experiences we gain during photography sessions are often more valuable than the person who entrusts us with their pure moments. 
Today I want to share with you some selected shots of the moments of a lovely couple.

Let's go see together 



![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSr2RMZgUG9jKVrWcbe1P6EE4TmKNM6XxBaWgH3zzygoK/1.jpg)

![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctwbe3McmWd4mpD5wCkuDEjoytUR3pudWrXwSu7GohWT/5.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcHXx91M5dvzjzRMA6aV7iwp6gdA4JowEeaVj4TXjk1ew/3.jpg)

Every photo has a story for me. Usually, after I give the poses to the bride and groom, before I press the camera shutter, I think about the feeling that is going to be conveyed from that photo.

Sometimes a deep feeling, sometimes mischief and sometimes pride etc. can be conveyed to the viewer. 
In my opinion, every photo should have its own scenario. 
Especially in multiple designs, this scenario should be much stronger. 
Because of this type of sensitivities, it usually takes more time for me to deliver the work.

In the first photo, I considered the sense of closeness and portrait mode and using the power of the camera's flow focus, all together. And the bride's smile in this photo was very valuable to me.

In the second picture, I wanted them to stare at a deep point with a smile, together and in each other's arms.

In the third photo, which is a single photo of the bride, I took the back angle to the camera and a little rotation with the bouquet. And I wanted to capture all the beauty of the bride's make-up, chignon, dress, etc. in the best possible way. 

![6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSVxmGYsrdkz4LZaRyV9nkRppcKVMcqfEoiYNb6BibPKB/6.jpg)
And as for this photo, which is one of the most attractive poses for me, considering the type of posing of the couple together, I want the bride to look at a distant point with a smile while she is mischievously and smilingly and proudly holding the ring towards her husband, and I want the sparkle of the first smile to be seen in her eyes.
In this lighting, along with the soft box and camera settings, I did it so that the contrast is high and the difference between the shadows and brightness is greater and the viewer's gaze is more dazzling. 
And then I gave the photo a cinematic color in Photoshop using the powerful camera raw filter.


![7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQQyDcWRt177UxXbXLk76Ng3p36L1PQsZ4VBdSRcDTDce/7.jpg)

Wow! I will not tell you about this photo and this type of lighting. which has always been in great demand and has been attractive for every kind of taste. 
Usually, in such photos, the subject is in front of the camera. And I turn the branches of light towards the background and then the subject and then the camera.
And I do the rest of the settings for more darkness with the camera settings.
I was always satisfied with the result

In this angle, usually the subjects are not very satisfied with their profile view, but with the help of photoshop, I set the angles to be normal so that they don't get tired of looking at the photo.

All my friends who do wedding photography know that the number of shots is usually too high, but I have chosen 5 photos for you to share with you.

And I would be very happy if all my friends who have photography experience remind me of my strengths and weaknesses with their criticisms and suggestions so that I can record better results for others. 

It is a beautiful feeling to record these moments.

I hope you liked it.
Here, I thank my dear friends @dimascastillo90 and @jlinaresp and other friends who manage this popular forum. 
And God willing, I will be with you more from now on 
 good nigh

Photographer:@azamsohrabi
