links.title: Warmia skuwa lód, czyli mazurskie nordic noir. Recenzja „Chłodu” Weroniki Mathii
links.body:
>

![239.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23wBzyjdnYRvzvaaS7gKNxcwumps8E1FrmJVm9YDLjNq75XaqHeyqpbcwkEvvhjZGAGFP.png)

---

Często łapię się na tym, że czytając współczesne kryminały, zastanawiam się, dlaczego ich autorzy tak uparcie omijają moje rodzinne strony. Książek, których akcja dzieje się na Warmii i Mazurach, jest wciąż jak na lekarstwo. Podczas gdy Dolny Śląsk ma całą armię pisarzy rozsławiających tamtejsze zamki i podziemia, nasz region ląduje w literackim cieniu. Na szczęście Weronika Mathia próbuje odwrócić te krzywdzące statystyki. I robi to w wielkim stylu.

### **Wreszcie dostałem do rąk książkę, która oddycha moim lokalnym powietrzem.**

Mathia umiejscawia akcję swojej najnowszej powieści „Chłód” na Warmii, a dokładniej w Pasymiu i okolicach – urokliwym, niewielkim miasteczku na południowy wschód od Olsztyna. To właśnie tam, na terenie niszczejącego, dawnego ośrodka turystycznego Rudka, zostają znalezione zwłoki młodego chłopaka, Patryka Białego. Nie wiadomo, czy popełnił samobójstwo, skacząc z okna, czy ktoś mu w tym pomógł. Faktem jest jednak, że zarówno przed, jak i po śmierci został potwornie skatowany. Miejscowi uznawali go za lokalnego dziwaka – tylko dlatego, że miał odwagę wyrażać siebie poprzez makijaż i długie włosy.

Na miejsce tragedii przybywa Karolina Rawa, błyskotliwa technik kryminalistyczna z Olsztyna. Dla niej to nie tylko zawodowe wyzwanie, ale też bolesny powrót w rodzinne strony – w Pasymiu wciąż mieszka jej babcia oraz wujek z córkami. Śmierć Patryka niemal natychmiast zaczyna wiązać się z postacią jego dziadka, Szymona Białego. Mężczyzna dopiero co opuścił mury więzienia, gdzie odsiedział blisko trzydzieści lat za brutalny mord na koledze, dokonany w noc sylwestrową.

Gdy Karolina odkrywa, że jej własna rodzina jest uwikłana w tę lodowatą sieć sekretów, rozpoczyna prywatne śledztwo. Odpowiedź na pytanie, kto zabił chłopaka, tkwi głęboko w wydarzeniach sprzed trzech dekad. Autorka regularnie zabiera nas w podróż do lat 90., kiedy to personel ośrodka wczasowego Rudka przygotowywał się do pierwszej (i jak się okazało – ostatniej) zabawy sylwestrowej pod wodzą nowego inwestora z Niemiec. Mathia buduje ten retrospektywny obraz metodycznie – fragment po fragmencie, wspomnienie po wspomnieniu.

### **Moje wrażenia – Nie dla tych, którzy szukają adrenaliny**

Twórczość autorki była dla mnie całkowitą niewiadomą, nigdy wcześniej nie miałem w rękach jej książek. Ponieważ jednak uwielbiam literackie eksperymenty, ogromnie cieszę się, że na nią trafiłem. „Chłód” to kapitalny, gęsty thriller psychologiczny, w którym klasyczne pytanie „kto zabił?” w pewnym momencie schodzi na dalszy plan.

Zagadka śmierci Patryka staje się jedynie punktem wyjścia do opowiedzenia znacznie bardziej złożonej, wielopokoleniowej tragedii. O wiele bardziej frapujące okazuje się odkrywanie prawdy sprzed lat: dlaczego Szymon zabił przyjaciela? I czy na pewno to on trzymał wtedy narzędzie zbrodni?

Nie znajdziecie tu pościgów, dynamicznych strzelanin ani szalonych, hollywoodzkich zwrotów akcji. Nie ma tu też bohaterów, których moglibyśmy z czystym sumieniem podzielić na dobrych i złych. Weronika Mathia udowadnia za to, że potrafi tworzyć piekielnie emocjonalne, wielowymiarowe portrety zwyczajnych ludzi.

Szymon Biały, ochrzczony przez media „Rzeźnikiem z Pasymia”, to jedna z najciekawszych i najbardziej niejednoznacznych postaci, jakie spotkałem w polskiej prozie w ostatnich latach. Stare rany otwierają się na nowo, a każdy, kto wie cokolwiek o tamtej sylwestrowej nocy, milczy. Jakby najmniejsze słowo miało skruszyć cienki lód pod ich stopami. Do samego końca nie wiesz, co masz do Szymona czuć. Potwór? Ofiara? Człowiek, który odpokutował swoje winy, czy ktoś, kto sam wymierza sobie wewnętrzną karę każdego dnia?

Ogromną rolę gra tu warmińska sceneria. Rozległe lasy i skute lodem jeziora, które mróz zamienia w srebrzyste, głuche tafle, budują niesamowity klimat. Porównania prozy Mathii do skandynawskiego *nordic noir* są w pełni uzasadnione: ta sama surowość, to samo powolne, hipnotyzujące tempo i ta sama teza, że małe miasteczka potrafią skrywać najbardziej potworne sekrety.

Mnie to totalnie kupiło i na pewno nadrobię poprzednie książki autorki. Polecam, ale ze świadomością, że nie jest to lektura dla fanów dynamicznej akcji. To kryminał dla tych, którzy lubią, gdy literatura zostawia ich z poczuciem autentycznego, wewnętrznego chłodu.

### **Ocena: 8/10 ⭐**

![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23uQLH57HnqBkY3san2JzZMxXKwWE3aLne4Ng6sZHSRMVErM61PhK4Kfww3dTP55SWBUP.png)

---

<div class=\

chciałbym się dzielić z wami refleksjami na temat przeczytanych (lub odsłuchanych) książek. Kryminały i powieści sensacyjne są mi zdecydowanie najbliższe, ale często sięgam po political-fiction albo książki dokumentalne, biogramy czy wspomnienia. ***

links.body:

. 
Hello with another idea💡
These are some handmade jars which can be use as gift of favors for wedding events, birthdays, gender reveal or any other celebrations. They are easy to make and decent to present. They can be customized and decorated according to the event and choice of the person. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoUuxUTAJHZgqJNGguSKysc3qN9JrZ54kDb4XDvQ2PDM/1781634981073.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUnYwd3pdNS4tzus1xuaopsZ3nW735arBZUsnMejnVNpv/1781634981277.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc25KXahCu82tmyG6o4BnJDqgpF2XCkw6H8CsBokaafF4/1781634981460.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNcDkW8rKmgwz4Mt3Wy9skD9PZQ51XcGDm5CaqVqBF3P/1781634981500.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb17mWTxw5HMwzhESonZxt2a5FMPT3aYCuo2jeLEyU5Gh/1781634981529.jpg)
---
## Materials Required
---
1. Small jars with lids. 
2. Pure honey
3. Ribbons 
4. Pearls 
5. Glue gun
6. Jute fabric for lids or any other fabric of choice
7. Scissors
8. Personalized Stickers and labe. 

![](Uploading... 1781635178772.jpg)

![](Uploading... 1781635178826.jpg)

![](Uploading... 1781635178875.jpg)

![](Uploading... 1781635178926.jpg)

![](Uploading... 1781635178972.jpg)
---
## Making
---
Line up the empty jars and clean them, you can also use heat gun for bubble free jars. Fill each of them equally with pure honey. Clean the edges and cover them with their lids. Cut the jute clothes in same size to cover the lids. With the help of ribbon or jure rope tie them and place the embellishments and pearls upon it. Arrange their packaging with customized labels and dispatch to the place of event. 
---

body.title: Splinterlands- Mystic Scaleweaver or Great Bear Druid?
body.body:
Hello everyone. I am @naturaluttom, today I will share with you some of my experiences about two powerful cards from my favorite game Splinterlands. These two cards are Great Bear Druid and Mystic Scaleweaver. I use these two cards occasionally, so I will share the good and bad with you from my experience.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRPBcd1Cit2kSsScagSiL9NCkbjkpWyJpKFf9VUBb88ip/1781634978383.png)



[‎The image was created with AI.]()

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)




First, let's talk about the Great Bear Druid card. It is a Human card and its Mana Cost is 9. The card has Magic Attack 1, Speed ​​1 and Health 6. The most important ability of this card is Cripple. Due to this ability, whenever the card successfully attacks, the maximum Health of the opponent's unit is reduced by 1. As a result, the longer the match, the harder it becomes for the opponent to survive.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbXXJdpxxHxiEaSSK6b8bbNHR3Rxi1EoB6AQNLhCukzwE/1781634888874.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)





On the other hand, the Mystic Scaleweaver card is also a powerful Magic card of 9 Mana. It is a Saurian type card. Its Magic Attack 2, Speed ​​2 and Health 7. The specialty of this card is that it carries Slow and Cripple Ability together. Due to Slow Ability, the Speed ​​of all the opponent's units is reduced by 1. This gives my team's cards a chance to attack first. Also, Cripple Ability gradually reduces the opponent's Health.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtUQA7eev1y8CWhcZzZTxHV2MvVfbS1ARPQ9TCPEmnZu/1781634889086.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)




I find the Mystic Scaleweaver card a little more powerful, because it slows down the opponent's speed and weakens their Health at the same time. However, Great Bear Druid also works quite well in long matches.

I really like experimenting with such cards in Splinterlands, and since I'm new, I try to discuss each card a little and make thoughtful decisions. Each card has a different strategy, and if you can use that strategy correctly, it is possible to bring the outcome of the match in your favor.

Thank you everyone.

body.body:
Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

>समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है।



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfvnsGNhiMfQwDV6uVR9jM44BSdxoii8xfgF3Tgp94HG/img_5341.jpg)

While coming back home at night, I noticed a white car parked quietly on the roadside, and what caught my attention were the shadows falling across it. The bushes growing nearby were being lit by a streetlight, and their shadows stretched beautifully over the side of the car. Because the car was white, every little detail of the branches and leaves stood out clearly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQeb3iZUComcAn3MgWmkKv7CAPmYwscgiMPP6UxyKD18c/img_5342.jpg)

रात को घर वापस आते समय मैंने सड़क किनारे खड़ी एक सफेद कार देखी, और सबसे ज़्यादा मेरा ध्यान उस पर पड़ रही परछाइयों ने खींचा। पास में उगी हुई झाड़ियों पर स्ट्रीटलाइट की रोशनी पड़ रही थी, और उनकी परछाइयाँ कार के साइड पर बहुत खूबसूरती से बन रही थीं। कार सफेद होने की वजह से शाखाओं और पत्तियों की हर छोटी-सी आकृति बहुत साफ़ दिखाई दे रही थी।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWPaqQk1StNArL3xrB5qefiKRyiJz8SQQbJbRjaABBVRM/img_5343.jpg)


The road was quiet, the sky was dark and open, and the warm streetlight in the distance .. gave everything a soft glow. Even though it was such an ordinary moment, the shadows made it look artistic and slightly dreamy. 

>सड़क बिल्कुल शांत थी, ऊपर आसमान गहरा और खुला हुआ लग रहा था, और दूर जल रही स्ट्रीटलाइट की हल्की गर्म रोशनी पूरे दृश्य को एक नरम चमक दे रही थी। वैसे तो यह एक बहुत साधारण-सा पल था, लेकिन उन परछाइयों ने उसे कुछ कलात्मक और थोड़ा सपनों जैसा बना दिया था।


That's all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙

Thankyou for visiting 🌸

There are wounds that bleed for people to see and also there are wounds that learn to hide from the sight of people 

I am Bisi and this is my short story

I grew up in a small village where everyone knew everyone, where secrets traveled faster than the wind and kindness was supposed to be found within family walls but some homes carried storms no one dared to speak about. Our village was indeed a small world

My grandmother was one of those storms and struggles I prayed silently to overcome her...

People saw an old woman with a walking stick and a weathered smile. They would greet her at the market, praised her wisdom, and admired her age. At the main time what they never saw were the marks she left behind not on my skin, but on my spirit.

The strange thing about cruelty is that it rarely announces itself, it just hides behind ordinary faces and familiar voices and sits beside you at family gatherings and shares meals with those who believe it is harmless.

For years, every word she spoke to me felt like another scratch on a wound that never had time to heal like pouring fuel in a burning fire 

\
\n\n\
\n\n\
\n\n\

she would say

Actually, the words were invisible, yet they cut deeper than any blade.

I often wondered how someone could wake up every day and choose unkindness. How a heart could become so comfortable inflicting pain that another person's tears became ordinary.

In the village, people called it discipline, I called it survival.

Looking back now, I realise something important, that cruelty is not always loud, sometimes it is a slow, deliberate erosion of someone's confidence, dignity, and hope.

The scars remain, not because I deserved them nor because they were true.

But because wounds inflicted by those who should have loved us often take the longest to heal.

Today, when I remember her, I no longer see the grandmother everyone else admired. I see the lesson she left behind, the marks on my soul that still bleeds... 

A reminder to us all, there are some acts that go beyond wickedness, they become a crime against the human heart and though the wounds may no longer bleed, their stories still do, the scars still hurt and it still bleeds


let's stay positive

body.title: Benefits of Personalised Healthcare from Private Clinics in Preston
body.body:
### Introduction to Personalised Healthcare in Private Clinics

Personalised healthcare represents a shift from generic treatment models to care that is meticulously adapted to the individual. In private clinics across Preston, Lancashire, England, this approach is becoming increasingly prominent. Instead of treating symptoms in isolation, clinicians evaluate the whole patient—medical history, lifestyle, genetics, and emotional wellbeing. The result is a more refined and intelligent form of healthcare delivery, designed to treat people, not just conditions.

Quality Healthcare Close to Home

Access to timely medical care is essential for maintaining overall wellbeing in busy communities. Many residents look for convenient healthcare options, and a [private GP Fulwood](https://www.myprivateclinic.co.uk/locations/fulwood) service provides faster appointments, personalised attention, and flexible scheduling compared to standard clinics, helping patients receive diagnosis and treatment without unnecessary delays in a comfortable and supportive environment. Services like this are designed to improve patient experience by offering continuity of care, quick consultations, and professional medical advice, ensuring individuals feel supported throughout their health journey while reducing waiting times and enhancing overall healthcare accessibility for families and working professionals in the region today.

### Why Personalisation Matters in Modern Medical Care

Modern healthcare systems often struggle with time constraints and high patient volumes. Within such environments, treatment can become mechanical and standardized. Personalised care disrupts this pattern by restoring individuality to medicine. Every patient presents a unique biological and psychological profile. When treatment is tailored accordingly, outcomes tend to improve significantly. It reduces misdiagnosis, enhances responsiveness, and cultivates a more meaningful therapeutic experience.

### Faster Access to Diagnosis and Treatment

One of the most notable advantages of private clinics is the rapidity of service. Waiting lists are minimal, and diagnostic procedures are scheduled promptly. This immediacy can be critical, especially in cases where early intervention determines long-term prognosis. Advanced screening, same-day consultations, and expedited referrals allow patients to move from uncertainty to clarity with remarkable efficiency. In healthcare, time is not just convenience—it is often a clinical determinant.

### Continuity of Care and Strong Doctor–Patient Relationships

Personalised healthcare thrives on continuity. Private clinics often enable patients to see the same practitioner over time, fostering familiarity and trust. This sustained relationship allows doctors to understand subtle changes in a patient’s condition that might otherwise go unnoticed. Over time, this rapport transforms clinical interactions into collaborative partnerships. Patients feel heard, and clinicians gain deeper insight into long-term health trajectories.

### Advanced Technology and Tailored Treatment Plans

Private healthcare environments frequently integrate cutting-edge diagnostic tools and medical technologies. From precision imaging systems to digital health monitoring, these tools refine diagnostic accuracy. However, technology alone is not the defining factor—it is how it is applied. In personalised care models, data is interpreted in context. Treatment plans are then customised with surgical precision, ensuring that interventions align closely with individual physiological needs and recovery patterns.

### Privacy, Comfort, and Patient-Centred Experience

Healthcare is not solely a clinical process; it is also an emotional journey. Private clinics place significant emphasis on privacy, discretion, and comfort. Consultations are often conducted in calm, minimally disruptive environments that contrast sharply with crowded public facilities. This atmosphere reduces anxiety and encourages open communication. Patients are more likely to disclose sensitive concerns when they feel secure, leading to more accurate diagnoses and holistic care planning.

### Preventive Care and Long-Term Health Advantages

Personalised healthcare extends beyond immediate treatment. It actively focuses on prevention. By analysing risk factors unique to each individual, clinicians can anticipate potential health issues before they escalate. Lifestyle adjustments, dietary guidance, and regular monitoring form a proactive health strategy. This preventative philosophy reduces the likelihood of chronic conditions developing unnoticed and supports long-term wellbeing rather than short-term fixes.

### Personalised Care for Growing Families

Access to high-quality healthcare for children is becoming increasingly important for families seeking faster and more personalised medical attention in Preston. In the heart of the community, a [private children's GP Preston](https://www.myprivateclinic.co.uk/services/childrens-health) service offers dedicated consultations, shorter waiting times, and tailored care for infants, toddlers, and teenagers. We focus on preventive health, early diagnosis, and compassionate treatment plans designed to support long-term wellbeing and healthy development for every child. Parents appreciate the calm environment, flexible appointment options, and continuity of care that help build trust between clinicians and families over time. Ensuring accessible healthcare makes a real difference locally.

### Conclusion

Personalised healthcare from private clinics in Preston signifies a refined evolution in medical practice. It blends scientific precision with human understanding, creating a model that prioritises individuality at every stage of care. From faster diagnoses and advanced technology to stronger patient relationships and preventative strategies, the benefits are both immediate and enduring. In an era where healthcare can often feel impersonal, this approach restores a vital sense of attentiveness and human connection, ultimately redefining what quality medical care truly means.[Health & Nutrition](https://www.waivio.com/object/hmr-health-and-nutrition/list)

wobjects.name: Health & Nutrition
wobjects.description:
Health & nutrition cookbooks are indispensable resources for anyone looking to improve their diet, achieve better health, and enjoy delicious, nutritious meals. Whether you're aiming to lose weight, enhance athletic performance, manage a chronic condition, or simply eat more healthfully, these cookbooks provide a wealth of recipes and expert guidance tailored to your specific nutritional needs. Ideal for busy professionals, home cooks, and health enthusiasts, investing in a health & nutrition cookbook ensures you have the tools and knowledge to make informed dietary choices and create meals that support your wellness goals.

Using a health & nutrition cookbook is straightforward and can significantly enhance your dietary habits. Start by selecting a cookbook that aligns with your health objectives, whether it's weight loss, heart health, diabetes management, or plant-based eating. Read through the introductory sections to understand the nutritional principles, key ingredients, and cooking techniques emphasized in the book. When trying new recipes, gather all necessary ingredients and equipment, and follow the step-by-step instructions carefully. Many health & nutrition cookbooks also include meal planning tips, portion control advice, and nutritional information for each recipe, helping you make balanced and informed choices.

A health & nutrition cookbook is a great option for anyone looking to take control of their diet and achieve specific health goals through food. These cookbooks provide a focused approach to healthy eating, offering recipes that are not only nutritious but also flavorful and satisfying. The detailed nutritional information and expert tips make it easier to understand the impact of your food choices and tailor your diet to your individual needs. Additionally, health & nutrition cookbooks often feature beautiful photography, inspiring you to create visually appealing and delicious meals. With a wide range of cookbooks available for various dietary needs and health goals, you can find one that matches your lifestyle and preferences. Easy to use and a source of ongoing inspiration, a health & nutrition cookbook is a valuable addition to any kitchen, offering the benefits of improved dietary habits, better health, and consistently nutritious home-cooked meals.

body.title: [ENG-SPN] The Wild Memory of Asturias / La Memoria Salvaje de Asturias
body.body:
![Asturias septiembre 2012 509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eou6rpxXc1mFoigqJT1baaFpuyGV2N1c4mYfLD1GNc86Zaj2rNnZoZzDif3bHJxVAit.jpg)

Nature has always been both the great concealer and the most faithful protector of that impetuous set of archetypes, which, born from the stormy amniotic waters of the collective unconscious, was christened, after its birth at the dawn of time, as Mythology.

![Asturias septiembre 2012 474.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EokbGH7Q8GAFXbZjta8vAbMTXnjBwzMBB9q2oXsYMiAi23ebrh2Uy857vE4K87FtWpX.jpg)

Perhaps that is why rural environments, due to their proximity, retain the ability to intuit or sense intriguing presences, which, depending on that metaphorical labyrinth that is the environment still little or not at all altered by the hand of man, retain all the force of their relevance, even though they are generally presented to us under the name of Folklore.

![Asturias septiembre 2012 513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqNCE7Xe5sRtxMtBUjeAG9fBfsBC539ivNkbQGvWWR1cNYEA25djdTFuibRRLfiTtuZ.jpg)

In Asturias, places like this still survive, such as the mysterious Xanas Gorge, which also coincides with the so-called Route of the Relics. This route, crossing several mountainous municipalities, ends at the summit of Monsacro, where even the city-dwelling adventurer can still sense, upon venturing a little, that they are never truly alone.

![Asturias septiembre 2012 525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoTbQMBZtpuDR3Y9x42xj2BwQcPNtQdfQVwbx2iM1GnM7SGC9C8jG2bynKeFfnZ3puJ.jpg)

La Naturaleza siempre ha sido la gran encubridora y a la vez, la más fiel protectora de ese impetuoso conjunto de arquetipos, que, naciendo de las tormentosas aguas amnióticas del inconsciente colectivo, fue bautizado, tras su nacimiento en el alba de los tiempos, como la Mitología.

![Asturias septiembre 2012 549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoEpUjcJu5KhEgMuHLjfMme4v2sznkauQ4Hd64Sfz7gpLdK9aCeG77uABK7R3df7tfR.jpg)

Quizás por eso, los entornos rurales conserven, por su cercanía, la facultad de intuir o de presentir unas intrigantes presencias, que, dependiendo de ese metafórico laberinto, que es, todavía el entorno poco o nada alterado por la mano del hombre, conserva toda la fuerza de su vigencia, aunque generalmente se nos presente con el nombre de Folklore.

![Asturias septiembre 2012 551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EogLusNTobRgcCa71Bpin8TfQ26LYdPgJi7tFzKW48cf4Nd5awV5g1krWy8RM62s2PN.jpg)

En Asturias, todavía sobreviven lugares así, como el misterioso Desfiladero de las Xanas, coincidente, además, con la denominada Ruta de las Reliquias, que, atravesando diferentes concejos montañosos finaliza en la cumbre del Monsacro, donde todavía incluso el aventurero de ciudad puede percibir, a poco que se adentre, que, en realidad, nunca está solo.

![Asturias septiembre 2012 553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoyGm36pukmXoEkHdT9GnJicMfuH3549Gq8QdLX6ZswSGSGP64EPQvRA12Hgo3iqffY.jpg)

body.title: El mapa de los imposibles/Concurso la banda sonora de tu historia
body.body: Esta canción la de sobrenatural de Marcos witt me hace imaginar la historia de una persona que siente que nunca logrará todo lo que desea en la vida. Para él, muchos de sus sueños parecen imposibles de alcanzar. A menudo siente que las cosas son demasiado difíciles y que las mejores oportunidades les suceden a otras personas, mientras él permanece observando cómo pasan frente a sus ojos.
alt=\

> Foto creada con flow El protagonista se llama Luis. A lo largo de su vida ha tenido que adaptarse a muchos cambios: ha cambiado de ciudad, de municipio, de amigos y de entorno. Cada transformación lo ha obligado a aprender nuevas formas de relacionarse con los demás y de comprender el mundo que lo rodea. Aunque siempre se ha esforzado por alcanzar sus metas, en muchas ocasiones siente que no logra convertirse en la persona que los demás esperan que sea. Esa sensación de no encajar lo acompaña con frecuencia, alimentando sus dudas y temores. Sin embargo, cuando escucha la canción \

, algo cambia dentro de él. La música despierta su esperanza y le recuerda que vale la pena seguir adelante. Le inspira a creer que el destino aún puede sorprenderlo y que el universo guarda oportunidades que todavía no ha descubierto.
alt=\

> Foto creada con flow Luis suele escuchar esta canción mientras camina por las calles de la ciudad donde vive actualmente. Cada nota se convierte en un recordatorio de que no debe rendirse. La canción le ayuda a mantener la fuerza, la esperanza y un espíritu inquebrantable, recordándole que, aunque el presente parezca difícil, la vida siempre puede cambiar de formas inesperadas y extraordinarias. Luis siente que, al escuchar la canción, puede recuperar las energías, la fe y todo aquello que ha perdido en el camino. A veces siente que el tiempo ha pasado demasiado rápido y que aún no ha logrado muchas de las metas que soñó alcanzar. Sin embargo, cada vez que escucha \

, algo dentro de él despierta.

La canción le ayuda a reconocer que existe una fuerza más grande que sus propios miedos. Le inspira a improvisar ante los desafíos de la vida, a fortalecer su autoestima y a seguir creyendo en sí mismo. Sobre todo, le recuerda que Dios posee un poder sobrenatural capaz de transformar cualquier circunstancia.

Luis tiene muchos temores. Teme quedarse estancado, ver pasar los años sin avanzar y descubrir que todo sigue igual. También teme quedarse solo con sus pensamientos, sin encontrar un propósito claro o un lugar al que pueda llamar hogar.

Desde muy joven ha sido un viajero. Le encanta conocer nuevos lugares, descubrir otras culturas, hacer amistades y aprender de las personas que encuentra en el camino. Sin embargo, esa misma vida de constante movimiento le ha dejado una sensación extraña: la de no pertenecer completamente a ningún lugar.

Ha cambiado de ciudad varias veces. Se ha adaptado a diferentes ambientes, ha trabajado en distintos oficios y ha aprendido a sobrevivir en circunstancias muy diversas. Gracias a ello ha desarrollado una gran capacidad para afrontar los retos de la vida, aunque en ocasiones el cansancio emocional le hace preguntarse hacia dónde se dirige realmente.

Por eso escucha \

todos los días. La canción le devuelve la esperanza cuando las dudas aparecen. Le recuerda que aún hay luz en medio de la oscuridad y que siempre existe una razón para seguir adelante. Cuando la escucha, vuelve a sentir la emoción de estar vivo. Con el paso de los años, Luis ha conocido personas que también viven viajando de un lugar a otro. Algunos buscan aventuras, otros oportunidades y otros intentan encontrarse a sí mismos. Al compartir historias con ellos, comprendió que no era el único que se sentía perdido algunas veces.
alt=\

> Foto creada con flow Gracias a esas amistades comenzó a sentirse parte de algo más grande. Aprendió que cada persona enfrenta sus propias batallas y que existen muchas maneras de interpretar la vida. Descubrió que la fe puede adoptar diferentes formas y que, incluso cuando todo parece incierto, siempre es posible seguir avanzando. Al final, Luis comprende que no necesita poseer todas las respuestas. Lo más importante es conservar aquello que siempre ha llevado consigo: su corazón, su fe y la capacidad de creer que lo mejor aún está por venir.
alt=\

# The Map of Impossible Dreams The song **\

by Marcos Witt** makes me imagine the story of a person who feels that he will never achieve everything he wants in life. For him, many of his dreams seem impossible to reach. He often feels that life is too difficult and that the best opportunities happen to other people while he simply watches them pass by.

Although he has always worked hard to achieve his goals, he often feels that he cannot become the person others expect him to be. This feeling of not fitting in follows him everywhere, feeding his doubts and fears.

However, when he listens to the song **\

** something changes inside him. The music awakens his hope and reminds him that it is worth moving forward. It inspires him to believe that destiny can still surprise him and that the universe may hold opportunities he has not yet discovered.

![Luis listening to music in the city](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/isaacmartiubeda/AJkQr1fe9XHJwmomM9dD3j6VQQFViKoe5vZx1fYR6ggtBDE5igPe7u3Cy7c4jLL.jpeg)

**Image created with Flow**

Luis usually listens to this song while walking through the streets of the city where he currently lives. Every note becomes a reminder that he should never give up. The song helps him maintain his strength, hope, and unbreakable spirit, reminding him that even when the present seems difficult, life can change in unexpected and extraordinary ways.

When he listens to the song, Luis feels that he can recover the energy, faith, and confidence he has lost along the way. Sometimes he feels that time has passed too quickly and that he still has not achieved many of the dreams he once envisioned. Yet every time he hears \

something inside him awakens.

The song helps him recognize that there is a force greater than his fears. It encourages him to face life's challenges, strengthen his self-esteem, and continue believing in himself. Most importantly, it reminds him that God possesses a supernatural power capable of transforming any circumstance.

Luis carries many fears. He fears remaining stuck, watching the years pass without progress, and realizing that everything remains the same. He also fears being left alone with his thoughts, unable to find a purpose or a place he can truly call home.

Since he was very young, Luis has been a traveler. He loves discovering new places, cultures, friendships, and perspectives. Yet this life of constant movement has left him with a strange feeling: the sensation of never fully belonging anywhere.

He has changed cities many times. He has adapted to different environments, worked various jobs, and learned how to survive under many circumstances. These experiences have given him remarkable resilience, although emotional exhaustion sometimes makes him question where he is really headed.

That is why he listens to \

every day. The song restores his hope whenever doubts appear. It reminds him that there is still light in the darkness and that there is always a reason to keep moving forward. Whenever he listens to it, he feels alive again. Over the years, Luis has met many people who also travel from place to place. Some seek adventure, others pursue opportunities, and some are simply searching for themselves. Through sharing stories with them, he realizes that he is not the only one who has ever felt lost. ![Luis around the campfire](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/isaacmartiubeda/AK54aBaWxDtYsr6pZiD8T8Z83rzMGJJV6yoSYbbqxrCssRjTep444QirdYRAeFF.jpeg) **Image created with Flow** Thanks to these friendships, Luis begins to feel part of something greater. He learns that every person faces their own battles and that there are many ways to interpret life. He discovers that faith can take different forms and that, even when everything seems uncertain, it is always possible to keep moving forward. In the end, Luis understands that he does not need to possess all the answers. What truly matters is preserving what he has always carried within himself: his heart, his faith, and his ability to believe that the best is yet to come. ![Luis and his Schnauzer at sunrise](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/isaacmartiubeda/AK9Pu5w8viF1WF4Tu81wDYWe57XJyrNjqMBqLiQy7SFYQYTytvuPLBHYWKFsXwM.jpeg) **Image created with Flow**

body.title: The Real Street FIFA.
body.body:
I love my childhood so much. And I always find myself smiling each time I remember certain memories. They are memories that cannot be bought. All of my siblings were boys, we were all males, except for my mum. And you can tell what a house/home full with make childrens can look like.



![1001148154.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xVJvh1LUB8DoJHB6rCcdTMxpQ9QMqLfwhFf9sXCiLRdhxxCCdrx1X2n1diVtSHXovzw.png)


So, when I saw this prompt, a lot of things actually came to mind, and I find it a little bit hard settling for just one, but then I've decided to talk about a particular game we do play back then. I don't think females can really relate with it, but I'm sure most guys will. I'm actually settling for this not because it was the best game, but because of the memories I have of it with my older siblings each time we play it.





It is a Canter football game. Yes, let me explain. You don't really need anything out of the blue, what we refer to as Canter is that cover of bottled drinks, either of coke, 7up, mirinda, malt... And such. Any of those canters will be bent a little in a way that would make it stand on it's own, it will be the goal keeper, while th rest of the canters remain as they are, they are ehe players, then we make goalpost with sheets of paper, and we make use of small buttons from clothes as the football. I really hope someone reading this can relate with me, that feeling of playing against each other is top notch. I really hope I'm able to prompt AI to help generate the best image that will really describe and capture it.



You won't believe how it feels like you're in a stadium, especially when our friends come by and you have people sitting behind you, either supporting you or your opponent and chanting your name. We can spend hours playing it, we argue a lot on it, and wished there was a way we could replay certain goals and such so it wouldn't lead to an argument.


![1001148155.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wX12yu186mwfe3wPeqZ1sAEggLxsJigwnV3noV9qDPccBxGmqS3sKEt6QKSBwHSkY1E.png)



Honestly, we enjoyed it. Is still find myself smiling as I write now. We don't own a phone, internet connection or anything back then.. it was just what was/we created. And it was fun.


If I could bring it back into this modern world, I will gladly do so. I won't mind if it will be in screen though. I mean if it could be made into a app game that can be downloaded and played, or of there's a way it can be retouched to make it more modern with the use of better improved materials.




🌹

body.title: From Voting to Real-World Projects — The SDA Model
body.body:
![header](https://media.sdafintech.com/sda-voting-realworld-landscape-20260616.png)

![SDA — From Voting to Real-World Projects](https://media.sdafintech.com/sda-voting-realworld-landscape-20260616.png)

*Originally published on the [SDA Medium](https://medium.com/@SDA-token/from-voting-to-real-world-projects-the-sda-model-6c60709d35ef).*

## Your token is a vote, not a ticket

Most tokens are built to be traded. SDA is built to be used. Holding it gives you a **non-custodial vote** — each funding cycle — on which renewable-energy projects get funded: solar arrays, wind farms, battery storage. One token equals one vote, with a **30-day minimum hold** to be eligible, which keeps governance manipulation-resistant.

## What holders decide

Holders govern the things that matter:

- **Financial oversight** of the platform
- **Project selection** — which solar, wind and battery initiatives proceed
- **Administrative governance**
- The **timing of the Phase 2 transition**

## From the ballot to the ground

In Phase 1, this is governance. In **Phase 2**, voted projects move from the ballot into construction and become **operating, revenue-generating assets** — producing energy, revenue, and on-chain performance data. At that point the regulatory framework shifts from **MiCA to MiFID II**, and the dashboard adds construction progress, energy production and per-project reporting.

*(Revenue distribution begins after Phase 2 regulatory acceptance.)*

## The takeaway

SDA is governance with a real-world output: every solar array, wind farm and battery system in the model starts as a decision made by holders.

**Read the full explainer on Medium:** https://medium.com/@SDA-token/from-voting-to-real-world-projects-the-sda-model-6c60709d35ef

---

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVQVgccR5sif6iMArvbDvZGAy6UievC34giSCSctfHFQD/1781633673702.jpg)

Сьогодні забігла в чудову кав'ярню в глибині однієї непримітної вулиці. Втекла туди з чергового дурдому людей і власних обов'язків, які тиснули на мене з самого ранку.
Там звучала тиха музика, а люди тихо сиділи за столиками, накритими картатими пледами. Дівчина продовжувала робити і виносити малесенькі філіжанки кави і розставляти їх перед своїми гостями. Для мене це був справжній ковток свіжого повітря — з людьми, які були тут і зараз. Це був простір, який не вимагав від мене бути ідеальною донькою чи зразковою громадянкою. Тут я могла бути просто жінкою, яка чекає на свою каву і розглядає цікавий інтер'єр.
**\

**, — прочитала я на відривному календарі. Я почала перегортати сторінки і з цікавістю читати наступні дні тижня.
Нарешті дівчина змогла приділити мені увагу і створила для мене капучино. В око мені потрапило печиво з передбаченням. Може, це дуже наївно, але це весело — дізнатися, що про все це думає пані Співпадіння.
В печиві було таке передбачення:
**\

**
Спочатку посміхнулась, а потім подумала: а й справді. У світі, де всі вимагають ідеальності й підконтрольності, найбільша перемога — просто продовжувати рух і не зупинятися. Дозволити собі цей неідеальний хаос.
Подумки закриваю справи, які залишилися незавершеними. Розмови, думки, рахунки. Залишаю їх там, за дверима цієї вулиці.
Підіймаю філіжанку за всі наші **\
** цього літа!

body.body: <div class=text-justify>\n\

.....is there anything like a natural cruelty? Well, now that I think about it, I guess there is. Like when in the wild, a new male lion will have to kill off all the cubs of the defeated lion so that the lionesses will be in heat again to bare his own cubs. Or when a predator targets a young prey because of its vulnerability. And so on. ![Snapchat-1678476038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyinye-chi/23tbo2h1eCdEUde3X8ykcHasNDQs79g1gGTNUwgr8N7SwyRYo5vgKn6iVuRq6Jcx23MMD.jpg) Now, an unnatural cruelty is another ball game all together. There are few that history has that is coming to my memory now. But let me state a few more recent ones. A few days ago, I saw a video of a man that was carrying a child that maybe around two to four years old. The child was crying. The next thing I saw was that the man threw the baby hard on the concrete floor. At first I thought it was due to severe annoyance, and that he would pick up the baby as he realised what he had done, but no. Instead, he pick up the baby by his legs, lifted him up, and flung him on the group again and again (it hurts remembering this). By the time neighbours would come out to see what was going on, the child had hit the ground at least seven times. When the neighbours finally understood and tried raising an alarm, it was too late. The bones of the child was already shattered. I know because when he carried the child to run away, the body was too flexible. The man had to use his hand to support the body as it was pressed against his chest. I can't even begin to imagine what was going through his head as he was doing such a demonic thing. What level of anger can warrant one to treat a child or even a human being in that manner? Let me stop here because I'm already getting emotional. Thanks for stopping by my blog. See you soon. 🤗 ### peace out ✌️ ##### ALL PICTURES ARE MINE

body.title: Bike trip after the rain: Fresh nature, childhood memories and some sweet realizations
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXw8TnUqAfc1kuftXDLB7SntKs1dfvTaekbjnQHAKhAoL/polish_20260616_235601439.jpg)


It's as if nature gets a new life right after the rain. The dust in the wind washes away all the dust and sand, and the surrounding area becomes as clean as a mirror, and the sweet smell of the earth fills the mind with a strange peace. It's impossible to stay indoors on such a balmy afternoon! So, as soon as the rain stopped, I took my bike out to enjoy this refreshing form of nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbDRTjhkXbeqRebGjcEAUMwGs6KejKLKLutwPBtjjfjPm/20260616_155412.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdi291ak9gWKjink8hrogKUdKCba4WguWiDJRHvmBuTkD/20260616_181031.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY6kRW9xgfBRuZGU8uVFroNCLNVTdv9BrSauLBmRSHiSu/20260616_181057.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeuGdFXiRjdrNphJqigiyh4523k2sD6iboexdrzp9gBr/20260616_154700.jpg)

​Picture-perfect road and the beginning of the journey
When I rode my bike onto the empty, muddy rural road, the green leaves of the huge trees around me seemed to welcome me. The sight of the fresh green trees on both sides of the muddy, dark road soaked in rain was very soothing to the eyes. The feeling of riding a bike along such a quiet, deserted road is different, where there is no mechanical noise, only the chirping of birds and the sound of the wind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbLaYDd3ZXjKaXFpj6FPGFe8tquYPvPFLqfxEzwbk8eG/20260616_180838.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVt4hrGeXN3EZfDHwY5QkHh3QzX7bLLbhTiy1oNTxfdQC/20260616_183651.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaWsgnrBmpYJ5kA98paMykMSt5EcvEXojDUmLuLi8NDah/20260616_183718.jpg)

​The calm form of the river and the simple lesson of life
After going a little way, I came across a calm river. The floating leaves on the riverbed and the faint glow of the setting sun in the distance created a magical atmosphere. On one side of the river, I saw a flock of domestic ducks swimming to their hearts content. Seeing this scene, I stopped my bike and stood for a while. In our urban or busy lives, we are always worried about so many things, but there is no rush between this flock of ducks or the calm stream of the river. Nature teaches us - life should be taken easily, everything flows beautifully in its own way with time.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfHDHNfoteESUUg2epDessqn71MXnExxgGNtMZNZkdSsP/20260616_173443.jpg)

​Childhood excitement and muddy football
As I rode my bike a little further, my eyes caught sight of a village field. A group of teenagers were playing football barefoot and happily on a muddy field! None of them had boots on their feet, nor were they wearing expensive jerseys, but the smiles on their faces and the concentration on the game could not be found even in the best stadiums in the world. This scene taught me a great lesson. True happiness does not depend on expensive arrangements; happiness is hidden in small moments and togetherness. Seeing them reminded me of my childhood that I had left behind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTxA8NKdjbvTeRs1bAwhd6aMrh2srakv1xMnLzgSHiScD/20260616_155158.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeh6FDb4E5NFZtb1uaNKsU1sQhuVzQBEtSZvqeBqoRknF/20260616_155211.jpg)

​The vast green horizon and the flowers of the kachuripana
The most beautiful canvas of nature was waiting for me at the end of the journey. The vast green fields of crops under the cloudy sky. And amidst that greenery, thousands of light purple kachuripana flowers bloomed! We usually know kachuripana as a weed, but when that weed blooms in groups, it can rival any expensive garden. This beauty made me think that nothing in the world is trivial. Everything has its own beauty and value at the right time and environment.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqWr8hrRQnjYtbHro5vkNPV4jThF1kjg13BskMFoYYUX/20260616_180922.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZy2obV4Xnpkr2HVxTKHp6HNoFBznk6gdTECT7tejtvJp/20260616_180940.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtSNhNCpeY4f2Msi9dtL4TNo1g1sXBt9bDmjAtcjhVP5/20260616_155417.jpg)

​Last words
This short bike ride after the rain not only relaxed my eyes, but also refreshed my mind greatly. This silent language of nature, the excitement of children and the calm flow of the river taught me to think anew. Sometimes we all should take such a small break from the busyness of mechanical life.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQgEkRd682yVarr33ZtMrgUDK9d1AEWttvL41Fmb4Xey1/20260616_181157.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmapM55VajB88hnhXLwzthpXBzZ2LvWmYWmquswVzYd591/20260616_181246.jpg)

​How did you like my travelogue this afternoon? Don't forget to let me know in the comments section.

body.title: Hearing but not listening  To God's Word
body.body:
It's  God's  commandment  that we be not only hearers of the word but also doers, at some point in David's life  he wrote that Once Have God's  spoken twice has he heard it, what that means to me is that we can hear God's  word then go back to checking  it out to understanding it better...


there was a parable that Jesus gave in the scriptures  about a sower who went out to sow  and the different  kinds of soil which represent the hearts  of men, its a very familiar  parable and we all can relate, in as much as we all believe to be the fourth ground in reality we're  not.

I know I'm  also guilty of these, going to church  taking note, then never going back to open that note and cross check what we wrote while in church, for emphasis  sake I'll  love to reiterate the fact that  there's  a clear difference  between hearing  and listening...


the former is an involuntary  act while the later  is an intentional act, more  like paying attention  to something  with your mind and spirit , listening deep to understand  and assimilate, 

in this aspect doing becomes  easy. it's  in doing that we obtain results  and our lives are transformed daily through the word of God..

ladies and gentlemen me let's be doers and not just hears alone.

body.title: Det er trist at blive angrebet af sin egen familie på åben gade
body.body:
Ann Mølskov Pagh bor i Herlev (nær København), Ålbrobuen 7, 2730 Herlev, gift med allan pagh og har tre børn.... jeg går på gaden hvor jeg bor for at gå i supermarkedet, jeg passer mig selv og går i mine egne tanker.. der går en gruppe mennesker foran på, som jeg ikke kigger på, pludselig kommer en af dem hen til mig og jeg ser det er Ann, som jeg har kendt hele mit liv... en familiemedlem, gift med min mors halv onkel... umiddelbare reaktion er glæde ved at se hende igen efter en del år hvor jeg ikke har set hende og en belastende kontakt ved de seneste to fødselsdage hvor jeg har inviteret...


Så taler vi lidt mens vi går.. det hele går meget hurtigt, og jeg var lige vågnet og fuldstændig afslappet... indtil det mentale angreb helt uventet kom på gaden fra en jeg burde kunne stole på... jeg husker ikke hvornår det var, for min hjerne har været i alarmberedskab i 22/27 år som man kan læse om i andre indlæg... og jeg husker ikke den præcise samtale...

det var meget hurtigt... og jeg følte lige med det samme at jeg skulle forsvare mig.. igen jeg husker ikke ordvekslingen.. men noget med \

? Jeg havde på ingen måde en dårlig dag... jeg var veludhvilet i mit eget område og bliiver kastet ind i at skulle være i alarmberedskab vde blot at gå i supermarket tæt på mit hjem... jeg bliver overrasket fordi angreb kom så hurtigt, nogle af de andre i gruppen, som primært var nogle muslimske kvinder, men også andre, jeg nåede ikke at se dem alle sammen.. vendte sig om og nærmest grinede mig lige op i ansigtet... selvom jeg var i alarmberedskab, var det enormt ubehageligt... de kaldte mig reelt en sindsyg person, en gruppe ukendte mennesker, som jeg intet har gjort sammen med Ann fra min barndom...

Det er ikke godt Ann... det er mental vold på åben gade... jeg vidste jo heller ikke hvor længe jeg skulle forsvare mig, men det var meget kort, ikke noget med at stoppe op og have en reel samtale, da jeg skulle om hjørnet 20 meter længere hende var det tydeligt de skulle en anden vej...

Jeg tror det var for et par år siden... jeg skrev en besked til Allan Pagh som hun bor med i Herlev og skrev at det var helt uacceptabelt... hvad tror I Allan svarede??? Intet.. selvfølgelig lammende tavshed som i mange år....

Nu det skrevet ind i historien.. og min styrke har aldrig været større... hvis noget lignende sker igen er jeg styrket til ethvert forsøg på angreb... 

Ann for helvede har du mistet din hjerne da du blev født???? Jeg har hele tiden vidst at jeg havde ret i det jeg sagde og min adfærd, det bare først nu jeg har fået styrken efter at have skullet leve i kaos og totalt beredskab i mange år, blandt andet på grund af sådan en adfærd med psykisk vold...

body.title: ‎Saudi Arabia Showed Great Character Against Uruguay
body.body:
‎When I saw the fixture between Saudi Arabia and Uruguay, I expected Uruguay to dominate the game and possibly secure all three points. They have more experience on the world stage and plenty of quality players in their squad. However, football has a way of surprising us and there have been a lot of surprises in this world cup, and Saudi Arabia proved that once again with a spirited performance that earned them a valuable 1-1 draw.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTBAfjTnBE3FjFwJvsJ9q2DrhdEqWGEDmgLmdPrbLJvYr/g4T5hKgb1wmE_K7R626JK4mwe_1440x960.png 

‎[Source](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/live-blogs/saudi-arabia-vs-uruguay-live-updates-world-cup-2026-score-result/69nsNqgcLx1t/)
‎
‎For me, the biggest talking point from the match was the performance of Saudi goalkeeper Mohammed Al-Owais. He was absolutely brilliant from start to finish. Uruguay kept creating chances, but Al-Owais seemed determined not to let them get past him. Every time Uruguay looked close to scoring, he came up with another important save. It was one of those performances that reminds everyone how influential a goalkeeper can be.
‎
‎Saudi Arabia took the lead late in the first half through Abdulelah Al-Amri. The goal came after Uruguay goalkeeper Fernando Muslera could only push a header back into a dangerous area. Al-Amri reacted quickest and made no mistake. At that point, Saudi Arabia had every reason to believe they could pull off a memorable victory.
‎
‎The second half was much tougher for them. Uruguay increased the pressure and attacked with greater intensity. They pushed Saudi Arabia deeper and deeper into their own half, creating several good opportunities. Despite all that pressure, Saudi Arabia continued to defend bravely and relied on Al-Owais to keep them ahead.
‎
‎Eventually, the resistance was broken when Maxi Araujo scored the equaliser after another Uruguay attack. Considering Uruguay finished the match with 27 shots, it was hard to argue that they didn't deserve a goal. Still, Saudi Arabia will probably feel proud of the way they battled throughout the game.
‎
‎What impressed me most was the team's fighting spirit. They never looked overwhelmed by Uruguay's reputation and stayed committed to their game plan. A point against a strong side like Uruguay could prove very important as the tournament progresses.
‎
‎In the end, both teams will probably see positives from this result. Uruguay managed to avoid defeat thanks to a late goal, while Saudi Arabia showed they are capable of competing with some of the biggest teams in world football. If they continue to play with this level of determination, they could have a real chance of reaching the knockout stage.
‎

body.title: Steam Demo Festival: Games we can play right now for FREE! [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wzzVsuMEg86jMovbBfNZd2pKcVAthTb7wzmXUiCFSaxdLyEiuNDxCV1HG9GyDU311FE.png) It turns out that every year, Steam selects creators to promote upcoming games—a festival I hadn't heard of before but found fantastic. These are usually playable demos of games that are already well into development, and most of them are excellent. With nearly five thousand demos available, choosing where to start can be tricky. That’s why we’re taking a look at four of the most interesting games generating buzz during this edition of the festival. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xeb79TM9vbkjCe6zLBidmKa69YJaXx8x6hrE38FrM3iaXTLnNMafR8mdT4S8vymrEdD.jpg) --- # EMPULSE Fans of fast-paced shooters will find EMPULSE very appealing. Developed by 1047 Games—the studio behind *Splitgate*—this title focuses on frenetic combat where mobility takes center stage. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wC1BnhmuK53xmrA5qEZe2JHxzGWY9MrLX5xAdk6p94S3D26iqniWttpw5pnsyRqNwC9.png) --- The game is reminiscent of modern classics like *Titanfall*, thanks to its agile movement, jumping mechanics, and combat encounters that reward both precision and reflexes. The demo lets you experience much of the movement system and offers a clear idea of ​​what to expect from the Early Access launch, scheduled for late June. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u62kBxzh7nDwdmrfHAyUVtQ3AH8pVHPBz3Jc6W5he7TUi8XwrAmWeLD1wRNu2JVkSBM.png) --- ## The Sinking City 2 If horror and mystery stories are your thing, *The Sinking City 2* is one of the festival's must-play demos. Inspired by the universe of H.P. Lovecraft, the game blends exploration, survival, and combat against grotesque creatures in a city consumed by chaos. The demo offers a glimpse into its atmosphere—enough to show that developer Frogwares is aiming for an experience that is much darker and more survival-focused than the original title. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGXzL3a5LYMnR1XJMwM1AhaWRa2mM9SD4HHMsB4yW7oCnSAXR9hw1wnvB5auqxje92G.png) --- ### Mistfall Hunter Fans of action RPGs should also check out *Mistfall Hunter*, a title that combines cooperative exploration, battles against massive enemies, and a challenging combat system. The demo lets you try out various character classes and take on some of the game's early challenges. Its dark fantasy setting and emphasis on teamwork make it an intriguing choice for those seeking a high-difficulty multiplayer experience. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x154zuMLUce8654rup5WxUm5cJKmspsNaanAtuaGS8z948R1LNVfBdFLJcpEXpB1ANp.png) --- ### Echoes of Aincrad Finally, *Echoes of Aincrad* is catching the eye of Japanese RPG fans. Clearly inspired by the concept of *Sword Art Online*, the game tasks players with traversing a massive castle while developing their character, upgrading skills, and switching between different combat styles. The demo offers access to the adventure's opening levels and showcases a solid progression system, featuring extensive customization options and dynamic encounters that point toward a focused single-player experience. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/24246fLAqs8th1ZPBYTpJdLKMbgnFhUKRtKBjpnUeQFVZEm8HnpYQ8GTMzvC4x4TF7t9N.png) --- Steam Next Fest once again demonstrates why it has become one of the most anticipated events for PC gamers. Beyond serving as a showcase for major productions, it is also the perfect opportunity to discover indie projects and upcoming surprises before their official launch. With thousands of free demos available for a limited time, it is the ideal moment to try out new games, expand your wishlist, and decide which titles are worth buying when the Steam Summer Sale kicks off.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)







### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wzzVsuMEg86jMovbBfNZd2pKcVAthTb7wzmXUiCFSaxdLyEiuNDxCV1HG9GyDU311FE.png) Un festival del cual no tenia idea pero me ha parecido estupendo, resulta que todos los años steam elige a unos creadores para promocionar sus juegos aun por lanzarse, normalmente son demos jugables de jueos que ya estan avanzados y la mayoria se podria decir que son excelentes Con casi cinco mil demos disponibles, elegir por dónde empezar puede resultar complicado. Por eso, aquí repasamos cuatro de los juegos más interesantes que están dando de qué hablar durante esta edición del festival. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xeb79TM9vbkjCe6zLBidmKa69YJaXx8x6hrE38FrM3iaXTLnNMafR8mdT4S8vymrEdD.jpg) --- # EMPULSE Los aficionados a los shooters rápidos encontrarán en EMPULSE una propuesta muy atractiva. Desarrollado por 1047 Games, el estudio detrás de Splitgate, este título apuesta por combates frenéticos donde la movilidad es la protagonista. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wC1BnhmuK53xmrA5qEZe2JHxzGWY9MrLX5xAdk6p94S3D26iqniWttpw5pnsyRqNwC9.png) --- El juego recuerda a clásicos modernos como Titanfall gracias a sus desplazamientos ágiles, saltos y enfrentamientos que premian tanto la precisión como los reflejos. La demo permite experimentar buena parte de su sistema de movimiento y ofrece una idea bastante clara de cómo será su acceso anticipado, previsto para finales de junio. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u62kBxzh7nDwdmrfHAyUVtQ3AH8pVHPBz3Jc6W5he7TUi8XwrAmWeLD1wRNu2JVkSBM.png) --- ## The Sinking City 2 Si lo tuyo son las historias de terror y misterio, The Sinking City 2 es una de las demos imprescindibles del festival. Inspirado en el universo de H. P. Lovecraft, el juego mezcla exploración, supervivencia y combates contra criaturas grotescas en una ciudad consumida por el caos. La demostración presenta una pequeña parte de su atmósfera, suficiente para comprobar que el estudio Frogwares apuesta por una experiencia mucho más oscura y centrada en la supervivencia que la entrega original. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGXzL3a5LYMnR1XJMwM1AhaWRa2mM9SD4HHMsB4yW7oCnSAXR9hw1wnvB5auqxje92G.png) --- ### Mistfall Hunter Los amantes de los RPG de acción también tienen una cita con Mistfall Hunter, un título que combina exploración cooperativa, enfrentamientos contra enormes enemigos y un sistema de combate exigente. La demo permite probar varias clases de personajes y enfrentarse a algunos de los primeros desafíos del juego. Su ambientación de fantasía oscura y el énfasis en el trabajo en equipo lo convierten en una propuesta interesante para quienes buscan una experiencia multijugador con un alto nivel de dificultad. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x154zuMLUce8654rup5WxUm5cJKmspsNaanAtuaGS8z948R1LNVfBdFLJcpEXpB1ANp.png) --- ### Echoes of Aincrad Finalmente, Echoes of Aincrad llama la atención de los seguidores de los RPG japoneses. Inspirado claramente en el concepto de Sword Art Online, el juego propone recorrer un gigantesco castillo mientras el jugador desarrolla su personaje, mejora habilidades y cambia entre distintos estilos de combate. La demostración ofrece acceso a los primeros niveles de la aventura y deja ver un sistema de progresión bastante sólido, con abundantes opciones de personalización y enfrentamientos dinámicos que apuntan a una experiencia enfocada en un solo jugador. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/24246fLAqs8th1ZPBYTpJdLKMbgnFhUKRtKBjpnUeQFVZEm8HnpYQ8GTMzvC4x4TF7t9N.png) --- Steam Next Fest vuelve a demostrar por qué se ha convertido en uno de los eventos más esperados por los jugadores de PC. Más allá de servir como escaparate para grandes producciones, también es una oportunidad perfecta para descubrir proyectos independientes y futuras sorpresas antes de su lanzamiento oficial. Con miles de demos gratuitas disponibles durante unos pocos días, es el momento ideal para probar nuevos juegos, ampliar la lista de deseados y decidir qué títulos merecerán una compra cuando comiencen las rebajas de verano de Steam.

body.body:
> I am not sure I understand this part. The worker sells his wages for next to nothing (say minimum wage) but then has to sell the products also for nothing, but presumably something, so they get poorer?

The difference between wages and profit keep the workers from being able to buy back their own products.
The crapitalust wants the highest prices, but the worker gets the lowest wage, this disparity keeps the poor poorer.

> Because his administration work is exploitation? 

No, because in a co-op the shareholders are the workers.
Not people who had nothing to do with the work at any point, as in most corporations.

>Interesting perspective, perhaps modern entrepreneurs have rosy colored glasses on.

Nah, they were born into a game that favors them, they have no incentive to change things.

> Because his administration work is exploitation?

Because his contribution to the production warrants less than one share.
He produced zero of the products.

> The world in which this was written was certainly more exploitive than the one we are in today, but I do understand the parable of examples describing these conditions.

No.
Get out of line and see how fast it is you under the bridge.
Today the enslavement is much more nuanced and the crowd less aware.

You use company script in the company store, but you call that freedom, because you don't know the nuance of how money works.

As long as it is work to make somebody even richer, or starve, we are all simply slaves of the having classes.

> Is it inherently wrong to accumulate capital, and earn interest?

No.
You are trapped in a game that will allow you to rise, IF you play by the rulz.

IF you save your money, buy what is necessary to conduct your business, and employ yourself, none of this applies to you.
You cannot exploit yourself, only your customer.
Keep prices reasonable, ie, less than what the corporations are charging, and you can still be a good force in the world.

I'd suggest appliance repair.
You can start in a car, with very few tools, and in a few years have enough to build a shop.
No boss, just the risk of crappy customers, but the only way to learn to spot them is to get out amongst them.

>There are social supports now for people, in many places it is more profitable to be unemployed today than to risk and toil for wages. 

So, hire armed, uniformed thugs to lock granny up when she doesn't want to pay her extortion fees so some can live and not have to do productive work?

Probably better to set up employment places that folks can go to get day work.
The system is really set up for failure.
Otherwise the skool to work pipeline would be more certain.

>Maybe hunger is the real enemy. 

Charging money to eat outside overflowing warehouses is the real enemy.
The pareto principle says we only need 20% of the population to maintain 80% of what we have.
IF we expand workers to 50% of the population we should see no drop in living standards.

Were the workers to band together to continue production while refusing wages or to pay to take things from the warehouses, everything is free.
No rent.
No car payment.
No cell phone bill.
No taxes.

As long as the work is done, the shelves stay full.

Simply go to where the work is done and fulfill your needed contributory number of hours.
([Math that will have to be worked out.](https://theanarchistlibrary.org/library/petr-kropotkin-the-conquest-of-bread))

Dividing all the work hours needed among the population means most of us don't work and we have more than ever before.

The neighbors will know who the bums are, proper socialization of the girls keeps the bums from out [reproducing the productive](https://archive.org/details/revoltagainstciv00stod).

> Am I communist now?

Lolz, just about.
[This book](https://archive.org/details/lookingbackward01bellgoog) finally clued me in to admitting that I was [an-commie](https://theanarchistlibrary.org/library/alexander-berkman-what-is-communist-anarchism).

body.title: Another small update on houseplants used in food preparation, plus a surprise that nature provides
body.body: <div class=\

> Thank you, Hivers friends, for a new update on the plants we have here at home, along with some great surprises I found. I hope that soon we'll be able to harvest food for our meals, such as these in particular: Chinese Garlic, Tomato, and small Sweet Pepper plants. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeR9KiTd2cQ6q3dFhLFVC2tSGPSN4UFHb1yUJFYFhP9eA/1781632781490.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPSffqrj11kob2BTxn8Vh6jhHtywuQb7e6Z222KYTLEmU/1781632781821.jpg) Let's start with the Chinese Garlic. A few days ago, my mom cut some to add to the dishes she's been preparing. In this case, it's stewed fish, but it's great for everything, even for decorating our plates with its vibrant green color. It also adds a unique aroma, and the best part is that it's 100% natural. At the same time, I noticed that they're growing back, so in a few days we'll be harvesting again. It's a plant we love having for that reason: you can cut it and quickly have more. Finally, I cleaned them up a bit since there were weeds growing inside, and I also removed the leaves that had been picked. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfZmDXWPg5CcAwyCMxtXTeNBgNrmpepLFXZPBFg3RZufz/1781632823924.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTYsWngNzMfWQHongTkerJzfgoZoGmkMSksB2DZzvxXKU/1781632824218.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxCTkGegtxZQf6xNL8Kt9VYt4BTWHUbYp78CGeKk2nQM/1781632824478.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUvsv51k3qKMt7wDWLwPkvFnNeEVWGDvs9TZGesJmB3NC/1781632824742.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3JLwSVnS61f4j7J5y5YLaH3SeTQpEmWb1fCoTe9pWUr/1781632824984.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfARBXuQC4TsWui2JwuVBz3cvGpe3zS7NpdvgKiWw5UjF/1781632866370.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPG2sR69WpDtYFSVn5Bw3SyxNX3AvRrqh9fBYmQwtQm57/1781632866774.jpg) Then I have the tomato plants in the seed tray, which, thank God, have recovered very well, as you can see in the photos. I've even started transplanting them into plastic cups while I wait to find the right spot for them so we can harvest some wonderful tomatoes. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVMQrtKuqDiwMYHJq1s2zjb1AAe2XXZJ5FwghKBViMBT/1781632900909.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma6dq2CmftvdLTUmDYdaoT1iRGt5TwhLMjvQ6p4xCv3zS/1781632901223.jpg) Now for the surprise I mentioned: right below, very close to the roots of the avocado plant, some sweet pepper plants are growing. I imagine they've grown there because that's where water sometimes collects when cooking over a wood fire and washing vegetables. It's amazing to see them growing; it's not only an unexpected place, but also one that happens unintentionally. That's how wonderful nature is. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxzVyeBFQpVsSRQC9tvj2uEhHtzcGKKehAZxAG9C5vDn/1781632929022.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeNFMdeqR84wxRarPnq8mmXCeLb7zJKPJF8vUypx9yK5R/1781632929410.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY9QpVWgMqiVUYAHs1nrfn3GssDAj7LEub8EppQZft1Rs/1781632929725.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT1iwLAM87cH7TA5dxw4cbXXmf5Lw8iKPHXPmKc4njQA7/1781632930011.jpg) This is a small update on the plants we have at home and use for preparing our daily meals. As always, I'll share these details here in the #hivegarden community, which is undoubtedly one of my favorites in the #hive ecosystem, where we are truly blessed to have this opportunity.

body.title: The Importance of Homesteading in Rural Communities.
body.body:
Homesteading plays an important role in rural communities by helping families become self-reliant and improve their quality of life. Through farming, livestock keeping, gardening, and other traditional activities, families can produce their own food, earn income, and reduce dependence on outside support.
In our village, homesteading is more than just a way of farming. It is a cultural practice that brings families together through shared work and responsibility. People grow crops, raise animals, collect firewood, and maintain their homes while teaching younger generations valuable skills and traditions.
Homesteading also strengthens community cooperation. Neighbours often help one another during planting, harvesting, house construction, and community events. This spirit of teamwork promotes unity and supports the well-being of the entire village.
In addition, homesteading contributes to food security by ensuring that families have access to fresh and nutritious food throughout the year. It also creates opportunities for families to sell surplus produce and improve their household income.
Therefore, homesteading remains an essential part of rural life, preserving culture, promoting self-sufficiency, and building stronger and more resilient communities for future generations.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3S68yE7xQz2Fd7TCaKB6N35EoWp74tyzwSooarZ5yCd/1781632357494.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdZDvbMTmwi7Qke618EifqP6NfYLU9cjaBQA8i61DDaH5/1781632357308.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRWaWpcuzS1otJsBYmdGoximeC1CXTF3saTkWM3eWhWne/1781632357138.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvHNkC64S4vbXfhFxUjJmVAdzzTkn4mHXyNdwSYzRhXt/1781632356806.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaFMBwaspqhhiSLSkuyGgMc2zAuUx5GkqsrADtqUGDhmA/1781632356990.jpg)
Homesteading helps protect the environment by promoting sustainable farming practices such as composting, planting trees, conserving water, and using natural fertilisers. These practices keep the soil fertile and ensure that future generations can continue farming successfully.
It also creates opportunities for income generation. Surplus vegetables, eggs, milk, fruits, and other farm products can be sold to earn extra money for school fees, healthcare, and household needs.
Most importantly, homesteading preserves traditional knowledge and cultural practices. Skills such as cooking with firewood, seed saving, animal care, food preservation, and community farming are passed from one generation to another, keeping village traditions alive.
Homesteading is not only about farming; it is about building a strong, healthy, and self-sustaining family and community. It promotes responsibility, hard work, resilience, and a deep appreciation for nature and local culture. Through homesteading, we can create a better future for our families while supporting the growth and development of our village community.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSh4GiXXyPf7VJ3FexfwxuBySpRxeXC4sE3ERgJ4KtKBM/1781632870018.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmToy9CA2x2Noq3CsfE5p7dWmWdA1gkp2rg35sU6n3fr3x/1781632870554.jpg)
