body.title: Land Manager: New Production Tab
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23uFPdKf8W8ZX71NBX84EzrbuDWKc44PmSAcGwNRzkmS25BuzUm5ySwCMfrXuThayhsbT.png #
Production Management Arrives in Land Manager
Welcome back everyone, We have another update for you all. This release took a little longer than expected. I originally hoped to get it out during the weekend, but after some additional testing I decided it was better to spend a few extra days making sure things behaved properly before releasing it. This week brings two new features to the Land Site: https://land.spl-stats.com/ One is a small quality of life improvement requested by none other than the legend himself, **@goldmatters** . The second is a much larger addition that introduces an entirely new way to manage and optimize your land operation. #
🙌 Support the Project
✅ Upvote this post – it really helps! 👉 [Vote for My SPS Validator Node](https://monstermarket.io/validators?validator=beaker007) 💬 Ideas and feature requests are always welcome. No promises but I will take a look and try my best. ##
A Luxury Problem: Plot PP Alerts
The first feature came from a conversation on X. Goldmatters asked if it would be possible to create an alert whenever a plot exceeds **100,000 Base PP**. A luxury problem to have if you ask me. My highest plot doesn't even reach 30,000 PP yet. 😆 Still, it was a simple request and a useful one for larger landowners who are constantly optimizing their production. ![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 08.33.33.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tRrDD92sWhyZGiN44Aoq945E3cB5sqbRHnnMms1A8ng2yReADP94Vt56dabxEEPf7Yj.png) ![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 08.34.19.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t7Dit5SwPaNfYhkuBum2RDfsqrUKssbekq4xGM6xFiTuV61Q7H377AebqV1eHERCGnC.jpg) Once the alert appears you can immediately jump to the plot and manage your workers if you want to further optimize production. Small feature. Simple request. Useful result. I always enjoy these kinds of community suggestions 😍. ##
The New Production Tab
The second feature is a much larger addition. To be honest, parts of it are still being tested in the real world, especially around card assignment and filtering. But I've learned over time that eventually you need to release features and let people use them. ![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 08.36.24.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23sweNGo1UCVK33ZxSnND346njAkiDitW9V6HD7WddGs8XbmZ2pz4p1myNX1aJd9QoXza.png) Real usage uncovers things that no amount of local testing ever will. One of the biggest think i missed on the official spl site while managing land was not having a complete overview of all the assets that could potentially be assigned to plots. ![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 08.38.38.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swkXp3m7S3iQRai47XuvCTWJhygY5MDpMgF4uZXzGmSNUyhcvRaUjz9LHpbywthB5Pz.png) Splinterlands typically only shows cards that are currently available for land. While that works, I often wanted to see cards that were: * In a set * On a wagon * Delegated * In cooldown * Otherwise unavailable Not because I could use them immediately, but because I wanted the full picture of my collection. That idea became the foundation of the new **Production Tab**. ##
Production Overview
The new Production tab provides a complete overview of your plots. For every plot you can now see: * Rewards per hour * Net DEC * Harvest PP * Boosted PP * Total PP The Net DEC calculation reuses the same logic already available in the deed overview, making it easier to compare the profitability of plots. The tab supports: * Standard deed filters * Powered/unpowered filters * Worker status filters * Local sorting on every column * Flat list view * Grouped by region view * Region collapsing and pagination This makes it much easier to identify weak plots, high performers, and opportunities for optimization. ##
Bulk Actions and Plot Management
Managing large land operations can involve a lot of repetitive clicking. To reduce that workload, the Production tab now includes both individual and bulk actions. ![Bulk action (comes with dialog to confirm)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tRqt6CC3zXsR9QVMoEtEQ9FVhwR5w9RkCqaP46HdAKiy3Eq8gwF5gpmeJPZ3TsDcMeC.png) ![Individual Actions (comes with dialog to confirm)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t72sRa8VuFwXb2FZ3EgF8Zt943wL3Vc5xeH8zkqrC1TFfJMZoJQue9ocDfPpi3br68b.png) Available actions include: * Power On * Unpower * Remove Workers * Empty Plot Bulk actions work on the currently filtered results. Because some of these actions can trigger auto harvests or remove staked assets, confirmation dialogs and warnings are shown before execution. https://images.hive.blog/400x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tGZrKM8yeELtYnKa29z2cYCyRkuhSvBZGHZC29LLx464ULaJJbzc812315TwnkcgHek.png The goal is simple: fewer clicks and faster management. ##
Advanced Plot Configuration
The feature I am personally most excited about is the new Configure panel. Expanding a plot now reveals all available slots: * Power Core * Runi * 5 Worker slots * Totem * Title You can assign new assets, replace existing ones, and save everything in a single operation. Instead of multiple staking and unstaking transactions, the system prepares one combined action. ![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 08.59.33.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t756ZdUQmKyh8sXYuXa4YqVWSDp1UJxMgZT7gsRo6TnFaCK8YatFGdKvpwjjZN7x7rg.png) When editing a plot you'll also see projected changes before saving: * Δ PP * Δ Rewards per hour * Δ Consumption cost * Δ Net DEC This allows you to evaluate changes before committing them. ##
Better Worker Selection
One area where I wanted to improve the Splinterlands experience was worker selection. The worker picker now provides a much broader view of your collection. It hides cards already staked on land while still showing cards that exist in your collection but cannot currently be used. A tooltip explains why a card is unavailable. Tip: **Hover over the checkboxes.** ![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 09.09.17.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/Eo45HnQpBDYDneEz9pEHJkjrcdt6jQxohBKXfi86L3wiCDiw9bUQcryiYZzJ7jpZXpg.png) The reason a card cannot currently be placed is often different depending on the situation. This might help you decide if you might want to remove it from your wagon or market for exmaple. The picker also includes filters for: * Modern and Wild * Individual sets and editions * Owned cards * Delegated cards * Land cooldown * Survival cooldown * Recently used cards
https://images.hive.blog/350x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tbMB26N9kynXSAhGfrHSWTVmutgkWjqqyK6Xzaqzua4PQhHUiVLWfjvuz1VkpqYR6Mw.png https://images.hive.blog/350x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tGZrN4UwiAnxrhr9MPpcgQqrL1PBCMcbcZcUWSBL7HURuw58SJ7J3CCEV4YW3W1w6me.png
Every column can be sorted. ![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 09.17.15.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t7BGgrsGsALfG7T7hAtnqcviHpNY3wfSooqMSrBLmZbTezDi44ucxTyxWu5uE7QbSmf.png) Because this workflow is significantly different from the standard Splinterlands interface, I would really appreciate feedback on it. If you think something is missing, confusing, or simply not useful, let me know. ##
What's Next?
These are the major changes implemented over the past week. As always, I'm looking for feedback. If you encounter unexpected behavior, missing functionality, or have ideas for improvements, please leave a comment. One question I currently have for everyone: **Should I add rental functionality directly into the Production tab?** The current Rental tab will eventually be renamed and repurposed. My plan is to evolve it into a more complete asset management section that can handle renting, buying, and staking directly onto land from a single location. That's still a future release, but it's the direction I'm currently exploring. For now, I hope this update helps make managing your land operation a little easier and a lot more efficient.
Beaker signing off. See you on your land journey or on the battlefield 😄 https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/splinterlands_logo.png Want to be part of this amazing play-to-earn game? Consider using my [referral](https://splinterlands.com?ref=beaker007) link!

body.title: Beeley Brook: A Little Adventure Through Moors, Brooks and Trees
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmSmtb2odbxMGZiBSr2gCN3oVzTzAv6yqoH6WQrmPzttjZ/InCollage_20260616_185651993.jpg

This morning, I enjoyed a walk near a place called Beeley Brook,  a nice spot with lovely views.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHo7Ny3q9QJ5YGMdBv1u3M54eRrQbhSrUebW86jrJgYH/20260615_102838~2.jpg

As it was a weekday, there was hardly anyone about so parking was very easy this time.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmX3PJb7uJiQzWSJrQ8ZF6CbrQmEbGRMmjoXtqiPAiHMwT/20260615_103204~2.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWVg1HUhk8yJsQG2GFZq9xAnMtUkZCXssPozWX9P55yj4/20260615_103215~2.jpg

One of the highlights of the walk was the expansive views stretching out over the moors. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYSS4gbhJ8XJNqXwNhAdSQLe4qTgqsHE92apAhAkAM3Z1/20260615_102940~2.jpg

This is one of the trickier parts of the walk, along a cart track that is always flooded.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmeBYaRrUsuZYaNmbYhJTsgCunQrdXamZBQ6qE25Pz7cNo/20260615_103519.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWx3FGUXNqKtQLMVs4e2dkg5Z6CygJUa89W2gouaGZsZh/20260615_103626.jpg

The walk also took me past an area where tree felling was still taking place. A large pile of logs lay beside the path.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZFwW4rKYKbx1coEEiSLwBN4izDYkHdE7AemCvTmFvheB/20260615_103950.jpg

I wandered through a woodland area. The trees provided a cool shelter from the sun, the birds were singing and it was good to be surrounded by greenery.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3JPXhQagKVgDBirBYucDfVKx43gvsq1NzZMUMdnpDcE/20260615_104343~2.jpg

As I walked further, I spotted pink campion flowers growing along the hedgerow.  It is a  common wildflower found in the UK but still very pretty. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmfShfEAspa2SCk1P3qd1hNQZuDP1EDBUzv98efD7HxBGm/20260615_104145~2.jpg

At one point, I had to carefully make my way over the brook. It was a bit of a precarious stride as the rocks can be slippery.  I managed to do it without any problem, though. I'm glad I've got long legs!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaPSoaipYUxHvdNwi1LX7WWSot8G13ixzgvicfN5duRk8/20260615_103920~2.jpg

It was a good place to walk, with a mixture of open moorland views, flowers, flowing water and woodland paths.  Next time I visit, I might go a little further.  I'm sure there are plenty of other paths to explore.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

body.title: The Tale of Romy - ENG- SPA
body.body:
![1770659818314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23yJEJkmkdLY6yAofbfDPnBtvbPJAb4iTiFUuCtPACTa7jWAt3w8ziKPyZWGohvB6GGc5.jpg)

<div class = \
>\n<div class = \

> How wonderful it would be to achieve success quickly in music, without having to invest years in studies and preparation. Just use your talent, no more complications. This has always been Romy's wish. She loves spending hours imagining what it would be like to achieve everything in music in the blink of an eye. Sometimes she listens to her favorite song and imagines herself singing it, with many people adoring her and loving what she does. But when the song ends and the noise of the world returns, she realizes that it was all a fantasy and that her wish can hardly be fulfilled in the way she wants, quickly and without complications. Despite the setback she feels every time she finishes dreaming, she doesn't lose hope of finding a way to achieve what she wants. She feels a voice inside telling her that the universe will favor her if she keeps searching and doesn't stop trying. While waiting for the opportunity, she learns to sing at home, often watching tutorials. She doesn't have the money to attend music school or the time to take a formal course, so she learns on her own whenever she can. Learning this way gives her a lot of flexibility with her time, because she can do it whenever she wants and at her own pace. But of course, it's not the same as learning in a specialized place, since there's no one to correct your mistakes or point out areas for improvement. And without that feedback, you can start to think you're doing everything right and that you've mastered singing. That's exactly what she was experiencing; she'd been learning on her own for a while and already believed she could sing very well.

> Qué bueno fuera poder alcanzar el éxito rápidamente en la música, sin tener que invertir años en estudios y preparación. Solo usar el talento y ya, sin más complicaciones. Este siempre ha sido el deseo de Romy. Le gusta mucho pasar horas imaginando como seria poder alcanzar todo en la música en un abrir y cerrar de ojos. A veces se pone a escuchar la canción que más le gusta y se imagina que es ella la que está cantando, con muchos adorándola y amando lo que hace. Pero cuando se acaba la canción y vuelve el ruido del mundo entonces se da cuenta de que todo fue una fantasía y que su deseo difícilmente se pueda cumplir en la manera en que lo quiere, rápido y sin complicaciones. A pesar del golpe que se da contra la pared cada vez que termina de soñar ella no pierde la esperanza de poder encontrar la forma de llevar a cabo lo que quiere, siente alguna voz que le dice en el interior que el universo la previlejará si continua buscando y no para de intentarlo. En lo que llega la oportunidad ella aprende canto desde casa, suele ver muchos tutoriales. No tiene dinero para entrar en una escuela de música o el tempo para pasar un curso formal, por eso aprende por su cuenta cuando puede. Aprender de esta forma le da mucha flexibilidad con su tiempo, porque puede hacerlo cuando quiera y al ritmo que más le convenga. Pero claro, no es lo mismo que aprender en un lugar especializado, pues no hay quien corrija lo que haces mal, o lo que debes mejorar. Y sin ese contrapeso uno puede llegar a pensar que lo está haciendo todo bien y que ha dominado el canto. Y es justo lo que estaba experimentando ella, llevaba tiempo aprendiendo por su cuenta y ya se creía que sabía cantar muy bien.
![pexels-bigbagfilms-8512616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23xp4XEn25JWznC3xEHXaj3iVDZx6VpHcS2nSqiFYBsxmue1tcAJ6LRqvEJuGyN5ZP1cN.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...
>\n<div class = \

> Who would have thought it? Without expecting it or even calling for it, it seemed like opportunity was knocking on her door, and it was something she was eager to see. She was watching a movie at home when, as usual, an annoying commercial came on. Normally, she'd mute the TV at that point to avoid the ads, but not this one, because it piqued her interest. The commercial was about a talent competition in town. Contestants would come from various locations, but the venue would be right there in her own town. The competition was about talent, especially singing. The winner would take home a substantial cash prize, and the best part: a scholarship to study music for free. And of course, the added bonus was the media exposure it would bring. Romy realized that this competition was exactly what she'd been waiting for. If she won, she'd get the media attention she needed to get started, money, and the scholarship to further her education. It seemed the universe was answering her wishes. She rushed in without thinking and signed up for the auditions; it was time to show what she was made of. But in her haste, she forgot many things. She had never sung in public, never sung for someone with experience to receive constructive criticism, and her knowledge was purely self-taught. That would obviously take its toll. Who would think about all that when you're excited and believe that this is your lucky break? Besides, everyone who seeks finds. She had the desire and believed she had the talent, and that was all it took. Well, the day of the competition arrived, and there she was, eager to shine. She knew she would win.

> Quien lo iba a decir porque sin esperarlo ni llamarlo parece que la oportunidad iba a tocar a su puerta sola, y era algo que le gustaría. Estaba viendo una película en la casa, y como siempre llegó un anuncio molesto. Normalmente ella ponía en silencio en ese momento el TV para no escuchar los anuncios pero este no porque le interesó. El anuncio era sobre que se iba a crear un concurso en el pueblo. Vendrían concursantes de varias localidades, pero la sede estaría en el mismo pueblo en donde ella vivía. El concurso era sobre talento, en especial sobre canto. El que ganara se llevaría una buena suma en efectivo, y además lo más jugoso, una beca para estudiar música gratis. Y claro el plus era la cobertura mediática que eso le traería. Entonces Romy se puso a pensar que ese concurso era la lo que ella llevaba esperando desde hacia tiempo, pues si ganaba tendría la cobertura mediática necesaria para comenzar, dinero y la beca para prepararse mejor. Parece que el universo estaba respondiendo a sus deseos. Se apresuró sin pensar y se anotó en las audiciones, era el momento de demostrar de lo que estaba hecha. Pero en su apuro olvido muchas cosas, ella nunca había cantado en público, no había cantado para alguien con experiencia para escuchar críticas constructivas, y su conocimiento era meramente autodidacta. Eso obviamente pasaría factura por algún lado. Quien iba a pensar en todo eso cuando estás emocionada y crees que esa es la llamada de la suerte. Además todo el que busca encuentra. Ella tenía el deseo y creía que el talento y eso era lo que hacía falta. Pues nada llegó el día del concurso y allí estaba ella con muchas ganas de brillar. Sabía que ganaría.
![pexels-jibarofoto-1659740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23w2exgGUEVqcL9h8cyy5k5U1YFL7DnJoPC2JWresnXLNEg9ukst7BqxK5VWbuLGLKhVV.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...
>\n<div class = \

> One after another, each contestant took their turn, and she began to realize something: her skills were far from reaching her level. Therefore, it would be an uneven playing field, but she should have known this before entering the competition. There was no turning back now; it was her turn, and what had to happen, happened. Although she desperately wanted to sing that day, her abilities were nowhere near up to the task. Her dream evaporated quickly, and she made a fool of herself in front of everyone. She received one of the lowest scores and branded herself with the audience as someone without talent. The saying that those with talent and desire achieve what they want didn't hold true, and that was because she hadn't listened to her limitations beforehand. Nor did she have anyone to point them out to her. No matter how much you want something, if you know you're not up to the task, it's best not to force things, and Romy unfortunately learned this the hard way. All is not lost, though; she'll just have to prepare better for next time, but without rushing. She will, however, have to live with the initial failure.

> Uno tras otro cada concursante fue pasando, y ella empezó a darse cuenta de algo, sus habilidades estaban muy lejos de llegar a su nivel, por tanto sería una competencia en desigualdad de condiciones, pero ella debió saberlo antes de entrar al concurso. Ya no había vuelta atrás, fue su turno, y pasó lo que tenía que pasar. Aunque tenía muchos deseos de cantar ese día sus habilidades no estaban ni mínimamente a la altura para aquel evento. Su sueño se evaporó rápido, y hizo el ridículo en frente de todos. Recibió unas de las puntuaciones más bajas y se marcó con la audiencia como alguien sin talento. No se cumplió el dicho de que el que tiene talento y ganas consigue lo que quiere, y fue porque ella de ante mano no escuchó a sus limitaciones. Tampoco tuvo a nadie que se las dijera. Por muchas ganas que tengas si sabes que no estás a la altura es mejor no forzar las cosas, y Romy lamentablemente lo aprendió de la peor manera. No todo está perdido, solo tendrá que prepararse mejor para la próxima, pero sin apurarse, eso si tendrá que vivir con el fracaso inicial.
![pexels-karola-g-7681199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/242NsqiT8xoLnwmzDa2rDxhFY71J4RPrH5wSMAfnevBXni2nvsnnkg1bZC34koFkxZGrp.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

The English version was translated using Google Translate. Esta publicación es completamente original, y de mi autoría. NO se han usado programas para modificar el texto o para reparar la gramática. Tal cual lo lees así lo escribí. La versión en ingles fue traducida usando Google traductor.

body.title: GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7: the new bar for autonomous models
body.body:
In March 2026, GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 defined the state of the art. In April, both companies released updates that were not fine-tuning increments — they were revisions of architecture and objective that change what these models are designed to do. The focus is no longer to answer better: it is to execute with more autonomy.

## GPT-5.5: rebuilt from scratch

GPT-5.5, released on April 23, 2026, is unusual in OpenAI's history. According to the company, it is the first time since GPT-4.5 that they rebuilt the architecture, the pre-training corpus, and the training objectives simultaneously — it was not an adjustment on top of the previous version.

The design of 5.5 was driven by a specific premise: the model needs to function as an autonomous agent, not as an answer generator. This implies the capacity to call chained tools, maintain state across long tasks, and recover from errors without human intervention.

In practice, the improvements most reported by developers are:

**Persistence of instructions in long tasks.** Previous models tended to \

instructions given at the start of long conversations or complex pipelines. 5.5 treats this as a design requirement, not a secondary characteristic.

**Tool orchestration.** In pipelines with multiple tools — external APIs, code execution, file reading — 5.5 demonstrates better judgment about when and how to combine capabilities. The error rate in tool sequences dropped measurably.

**Improved computer use.** The ability to interact with graphical interfaces more reliably, which opens up automation use cases that were previously too fragile for production.

5.5 is available via OpenAI's API with the same endpoints as 5.4. The model is proprietary, with no weights available.

## Claude Opus 4.7: a measurable leap in software engineering

Claude Opus 4.7, released on April 16, 2026 by Anthropic, has a precise differentiator: the benchmark numbers are not modest. The leap from 4.6 to 4.7 is the largest between consecutive versions that Anthropic has ever published.

SWE-Bench Verified: from 80.8% to 87.6%. SWE-Bench Pro: from 53.4% to 64.3%. MCP Atlas tool-use performance: 79.1% — the best of any model on the benchmark. And the price remained identical to Opus 4.6: US$ 5 per million input tokens, US$ 25 per million output.

For those who use models in production for code and agent tasks, this leap has concrete implications. SWE-Bench measures the ability to resolve real issues from GitHub repositories — not just generating code, but understanding an existing repository, identifying the problem, and implementing the fix. 87.6% on SWE-Bench Verified is the best mark of any commercially available model.

## The Claude Mythos Preview: beyond Opus

Separate from Opus 4.7, Anthropic also presented the Claude Mythos Preview in April 2026 — in restricted access to approximately 50 partner organizations via Project Glasswing.

Mythos is described by Anthropic as \

in three areas: cybersecurity vulnerability detection, advanced reasoning, and programming. On GPQA Diamond — the most discriminative scientific reasoning benchmark — Mythos Preview scores 94.6%, currently the best mark of any public or semi-public model.

The fact that Mythos is in restricted preview while Opus 4.7 is widely released suggests a segmentation strategy: Mythos is positioned for security and advanced research use cases, with a partner verification process, while Opus 4.7 serves the general production market.

## The convergence on autonomy

The pattern that emerges from the GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 updates is not just better benchmark performance. It is a redefinition of what a language model should do: not generate answers, but execute tasks.

This has implications for the way systems are designed. A model that maintains state, orchestrates tools, and recovers from errors autonomously is not just a better component — it is a component that changes the architecture of the system around it.

## Gemini 3.1 Pro: the cost context

In the same period, Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro consolidates itself as the cost-effectiveness reference at the frontier: US$ 2.00 per million input tokens and US$ 12.00 output, with 1 million tokens of context and 80.6% on SWE-Bench. It is also the only frontier model with native input of text, image, audio, and video in a single model.

GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.7 are more expensive. The justification lies in the performance in specific autonomy and software engineering use cases where the gaps are significant. For general use, Gemini's cost difference is hard to ignore.

## What this means

The message of the first quarter of 2026 is that the frontier of closed models has not stopped. GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 represent real capability increases — not incremental, but of scale. And the shared focus on autonomy indicates that the next battlefield is not chat, but the agent that works while you sleep.

Rather, it is presented as the result of a person's relationship with God, faith in Him, and obedience to His will. God desires all people to be saved, but He also gives each person the freedom to choose whether to follow His ways or reject them.

Heaven is a place where we go to for eternal life, it is mainly for the righteous people not for sinners. body.title: Seven Months of Silence and the Space to Think
body.body:
My last post was about how, after years, I was coming back to Hive to find a little bit of meaning when it disappears in working for an employer, and how I was just about to dive into that magical atmosphere of publishing once again... That post was 7 months ago.

What can I say? It turned out that on the other side of the fence there were plenty of other interesting things to do, and it's actually quite nice to be in a position where you receive a salary without the need for a constant career race.

A lot happened during these 7 months. A lot of things worth thinking about, worth sharing, and worth hearing other people's opinions on.

I'm not saying these were 7 months of transcendence and revelations. Rather, they were 7 months of peace and reflection laid on top of my 37 years of life, combined with various events that change the meaning of different aspects of life.


<center>![0.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdfLNL8vonkE62xVw9sKKcWt7dzCAhYjP9UvTWTwYR4Ck/0.jpg)</center> <center>It's like finding quiet corners of nature in a megalopolis.</center>


I simply had some space to think.

About career: I no longer believe in career ladders. For the first time in my life, I didn't get an offer because of being overqualified. A mixed feeling. I used to dream of escaping enterprise and joining a startup, but now I want to work for an even bigger enterprise. I stopped suffering from impostor syndrome and almost stopped feeling guilty about doing nothing at work and watching time slip away.

About health:

If you're 35+, just one year of intense sedentary work is enough to ruin what took years to build. I quit smoking in a single day, even though I couldn't do it for 15 years. Now I know a thing or two about healthy and unhealthy food, and for some reason many things no longer taste good.

About family and home:

The only thing that hasn't changed and remains a reliable foundation through every storm. Make more children. The hardest thing is raising a human being. Is it really worth spending a huge amount of money on buying real estate?

About life and happiness:

If I could, I would spend entire days walking through the world with the people I love and wouldn't suffer for a single minute from a lack of self-realization... Or maybe I would.

<center>![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme9bW3aiZKxk3vVZ8BvAeRRkQs88AAWcK7R4zaATSTXkK/1.jpg)</center> 

It seems I have quite a few things to share. Not as a guide. Not as a collection of advice. And certainly not as an attempt to teach anyone anything. Rather, as an honest attempt to document my own experience and make sense of what I have come to understand over the past few years. 

And then, ten years from now, read it all again and laugh at my own \

body.body:
----
Sabang Island, the jewel of Aceh Province, is a tropical paradise renowned for its crystal clear waters, colorful marine life, and rich cultural charm. Located on Weh Island, Sabang offers a variety of must-see destinations for every type of traveler, from friendly locals, fresh seafood, to breathtaking sunsets. Sabang Island is a perfect hidden gem that combines nature, history, and tranquility.
----

![IMG-20260616-WA0099.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcdEyJqiEMUoW33ntqvNHYir8HggePeUHGhrbKh9eW9eV/IMG-20260616-WA0099.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Good evening HIVE friends, everyone in this beloved community. I hope you are all healthy and happy so you can carry out your daily activities as usual, and I hope you all have a pleasant day.

In this blog, I will finally share some pictures about *Sabang* and finally the word *Sabang* is not only on the map anymore, a few days ago I actually set foot on the western tip of Indonesia for the first time. Please follow my simple blog to see the beauty of the island when I first arrived there with some pictures that I will share later.

![IMG-20260616-WA0094.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYZ6muuNoUQYvnMGktvASiwwwr1UcofpDSenUbpYkTZWo/IMG-20260616-WA0094.jpg)

After a 45-minute boat trip from Ulee Lheue Harbor, which felt incredibly long, my fatigue vanished as I disembarked and arrived at Balohan Harbor, greeted by the Welcome to Sabang City gate. The gate didn't look grand like an airport, but rather warm, like a beautiful small island town waiting for me for a long time.

My friends...
Sabang Island is one of the places I've been dreaming of for the past few years—to visit and enjoy the ocean views, famous for its coral reefs. This opportunity finally came true a few days ago. Upon arriving at the harbor, I immediately paused, took a breath, and enjoyed the serene atmosphere of the Balohan Harbor area.

![IMG-20260616-WA0091.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQiFbZ5UtgdSm54e8ZKYYhXu2vKuRtu7c5csLKt8rpQz6/IMG-20260616-WA0091.jpg)

As I mentioned above, Sabang Island is renowned for its beauty, one of which is its eye-catching beaches. Black coral reefs meeting turquoise waters are a common sight on the island. The waves aren't big, but the views are truly captivating.
For me personally, the atmosphere on this island is so calming—not crowded, not forced, but rather soothing to my mind, which was previously filled with noise when I was in Banda Aceh exploring several tourist destinations.

Then the weather on this small island changed. The past few days have been unpredictable. When I first arrived at the harbor, the weather was sunny and the scenery beautiful, but now the weather has changed, with a light drizzle beginning to drench Sabang Island. Here are some pictures I took in the urban area after the drizzle began to drench the city.

Well, my friends, those are some of the pictures and short posts from me on this blog. I hope you all enjoyed and enjoyed what I've shared. I also extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you who have taken the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me so I can make this blog even better in the future. Stay tuned for my next blog, featuring some of the tourist destinations I've visited on Sabang Island and my personal experiences to share.

That's all for now.
Greetings everyone, and see you in my next blog.

body.title: The Kingmaker
body.body: data-align=\

>In this modern world, I have realized one thing: teacher is the most underrated character in our lives. Yes, you may not agree with me on this stance, however, look around your surroundings and everyone will accept this simple observational fact.

History remembers kings, scientists, presidents, revolutionaries, even the heinous monsters; but when it comes to the one who lead toward this history, they are totally forgotten. To put it simple, before Alexander became \

there was Aristotle. Yet, what good is Aristotle without Plato? And what about the legend - Socrates? Without Socrates, there may have been no Plato; without Plato, no Aristotle; and without Aristotle, no the Great Alexander.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRQDM5aXmwqa3xGHrz3XoFJvXrEFnLsAXiQnLRTbofoUu/1781631776955.jpg) >**\
- Socrates**.\n\n
data-align=\

>
A teacher is not someone who simply transfer information from books to minds. A true teacher shapes the way a person thinks, questions, doubts, dreams, and ultimately, who or what will become of them. A king may inherit his thrones, a landlord's property goes to his heritage and politicians will win once again, but behind many of them stands someone who once recognized their potential. Aristotle did not hand Alexander an empire; he helped him shape such a mind that would one day accomplish it. That is the real power of a teacher. The teacher may never wear a crown themselves, yet they queitly prepare those who will. And, in this sense, teachers are not some mere information providers, rather they are kingmakers. >**Deterioration** Alas! There is a visible trend of disrespectful behaviour towards spiritual fathers i.e. teachers. The concerning thing is this attitude is slowly being normalised, even glorified, especially among the younger generation. In some spaces, mocking teachers, challenging their authority without any valid reason and treating classrom discipline as something outdated is now seen as a new \

. Young folks aoften call it as a sign of confidence. Back in days, we, too, used to prank and share joyful moments with our teachers, and it was all done in a respectful manner. Even today, whenever we come across our teachers, we recall those moments and share the nostalgic laughter. However, the same teachers complain about students dirty manners.

In this aspect, I believe social media culture - with its sarcastic and rebellious nature - has played a significant role in shaping this mindset. Similarly, some movies and digital content romanticize such attitude. This whole thing has blurred the line between healthy trolling and outirhgt ddisrespect. To keep it neutral, I am not saying that teaching system is flawless and some responsibility also lies with educators who fail to adapt or connect with the modern needs. There are teachers who consider their field as an \

, nothing else.

Moving forward, one of the reason behind this change is the shift in today's educational landscape. There is degradation in the value of knowledge. Previously, education was approached with patience, something which was meant to be taken serious. There was a bridge that differentiated between ignorance and understanding, and teacher used to be that bridge. Thanks to endless tutorials, summaries and AI tools, many students begin to believe that learning no longer require guiadance. For a moment, I accept that these things are necessary to grow, truly are, but are not the only things one need. A human really needs someone wiser, someone who humiliates us, someone who can bring depth to us. Information is maybe accessible infinitely, but wisdom, I believe, strongly requires a teacher.

>**Temporary Service** There is another important aspect: student-teacher bond. In the past, the connection moved beyond academics. Teachers were considered as moral anchors, and students too, carried a responsibility to uphold utmost respect, not just to get marks or pass exams. Today? The relationship revolves around favor-for-favor condition. You pay me; I teach you. Once the syllabus is finished or the exam is over, the bond disappears. There is less gratitude, weak reflection and almost no recognition of the teacher's effort. However, despite all these changes, the essence of teaching is not completely lost. It has only become more necessary. In a whorld full of infinite distractions, opinions and absurd noise, a teacher is the one of the few voices that can still offer direction. But this direction requires patience, clarity and dedication. There is a need to understand that guidance is not a weakness but a strength. If society is to restore this balance, it must also reform the culture of respect along with the infrastructures. Because without teachers, we not only lose the traditional values, we also lose the meaning of learning itself, even the purpose of life. In the end, there is an attributed quote to ALi ibn e Talib: **\
.** Whether it is authentic or not, however the said thing is meaningful.

body.title: Local Food Cooking as a Cultural Activity
body.body:
Hi, my lovely brothers and sisters, today is a good day, as our Creator allows us to share what I require.  My dear Hive followers, I want to say something about cultural practices. Cultural practice involves many different types of lifestyles. Today, I was practising my lifestyle activities by cooking in our cultural methods.  These methods of coking are the way our oldest grandfathers were involved in their lifestyles in our community  in the village.  
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVsWPsnwmX6LEYXjNk3pZxkxNVUepciGqgVzhNGhsf9W9/1781631165617.jpg)
Today, I participated in a local food cooking activity in our village, where traditional meals were prepared using firewood. This cultural practice has been passed down through generations and helps preserve our community's heritage and traditions.
During the activity, I had the opportunity to learn from experienced community members and elders about traditional cooking methods, food preparation, and the importance of using local ingredients. The food was cooked in traditional pots over an open fire, giving it an authentic taste and connecting us to the customs of our ancestors.
This experience taught me valuable cultural skills and helped me better understand the importance of preserving our traditions. It also brought community members together, promoting unity, cooperation, and respect for our cultural heritage. Through activities like this, we keep our traditions alive and pass them on to future generations.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRk2rKoeDVb65CwN4SwWZ5aaCATfDQutpnVKhKfQ8T741/1781631166201.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW4Q6Gdp1Ldgn12LXaMnrLhzZnakbynLR4UupsNN8sJiw/1781631165918.jpg)
After I put the firewood on the fire and place the sufuria (cooking pot) on top, I add clean water and wait for it to boil. Then I prepare the local food ingredients, such as maize flour, cassava, sweet potatoes, beans, vegetables, or bananas, depending on what is available in our village. As the food cooks, I carefully stir it using a wooden cooking stick to make sure it cooks well and does not burn.
While cooking, family members and neighbours often gather around the fireplace, sharing stories, advice, and village news. This traditional way of cooking helps preserve our culture and strengthens community relationships. I learned these cooking skills from elders in our village, and today I continue practising them as part of our cultural heritage. Through these activities, I gain knowledge, respect our traditions, and help keep our local customs alive for future generations.

body.body:
As I promised 2-3 weeks ago, I managed to photograph a few more butterflies.As I said, I don't know much about butterflies, so if anyone has a volunteer to identify them, I'd be interested.
I'm assuming this is a white cabbage patch, although it's still early for the cabbage harvest.
![20260531_115208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23vhwsMtuaqhcb3WKzwyQeT73J5DgWQ6iEN8418bRfVZFTxeeK4LmLjYdhuH43WojT8ec.jpg)

![20260531_115216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23zbPyCJqaFq7KtjubuxYdXPE3am2HMBi6dduxdkc7VaiogynU1VjmuSU91C9JqnS1Bxj.jpg)
In previous posts I said that I leave the part of the yard where chamomile and other herbs grow uncut. It's good for all the pollinators and for my garden, which is already here.
![20260531_115322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23tSWU6Pi6QVxfxGeskwB3cQBNgkSGfcg2nAMFEgeaVyLXLLRPfg3UdaLbwgCskQAyNm9.jpg)

![20260531_115324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23tmFr3kX7ECyQnm7yn3pgPQtfsyg9JAikgiEt9AcXyXrUmLkDDwostBkMuVQtqUJhyHs.jpg)
Even though I grew up in the countryside when I was younger, I didn't understand it. How can such small animals like insects have such a big impact? Over time, I learned that everything is actually connected in a continuous cycle of biodiversity and that one thing affects the other.
![20260531_115423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23tSW6w5mpqBScBJH4gjpFTNThtb6vZaS6MnhuHN1hT3F2wQRCfwR9vQLgY484fepcUA7.jpg)

![20260531_115443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23uFYCtSwqMDWCh8YYmAsXr373U8LtqnfnNnnqkHxrm1dtVHYme36L2pvGyuGKV8i31YZ.jpg)
As I grew up and took over the job from my parents, after they moved away. Then I got married and had a child, and my wife had similar ideas to me. Why would we mow the grass every 3-4 days Just to make the lawn look nice. Besides, it's a bit too much useless work. Of course, we mow the grass where we pass by the path, to the soup, to the garage. But where we don't have to, we let the plants bloom. Which also attracts a lot of insects.
![20260531_115526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23uQtNZt2q3h9R4vvbkhmxCTaeL6cJjfU3ZqLxDafrMt1EKnL51L3KNFBaa23U1QN5H6q.jpg)

![20260531_115528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23u64u1qzxcQd7BYw4BeaNhp6wn1LEBtPrKbJsq3UPG4z6xchpkkRz1E9SK8nKyLKtHXr.jpg)
Although my wife was a little wary of wasps and bees because she has a painful reaction. She is not allergic but she swells up. I convinced her that it depends on her. Mostly. Not to panic, she waves her arms and shows aggression.
![20260531_115536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/EoEqZK6dprgujip4f44ChrAGiagW3JM9wBGkMJ7xvYA23KTA9aZDXvvEgWkpjVHGVwr.jpg)


![20260531_115539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/EoAajAB8zymgiWK4KqW4qn3eEu2AZuNNoctf1yLR9FapjkhoXu9un8rRQmMmRRXwWpi.jpg)I'm not allergic to stings, but I've also learned that I don't have to tempt happiness. That I don't look for the devil where there isn't one. And butterflies, they are simply a beautiful decoration for any garden.![20260531_131529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23yTb7gH6nT26w7gzDbUk4q61bKSPZ9uWdQLMgs3mVKahZFXJyqd7ErC6RJUZ2AmG374k.jpg)


---
Thanks for reading.
Until next time.
Stay healthy.
Markone85.

body.body: alt=\

Hello everyone! How’s it going?

Hey everyone! How’s it going? Honestly, it feels crazy logging back into my Ecency account (@bendany) today after a whole three years. I was looking through my old stuff and seeing my reputation score still at 59 and realizing that 679 of you are still following me... wow. It brought back a lot of good memories. Three years is a really long time, and to be honest, I wasn't even sure if anyone would still remember this account

* * *

Where Have I Been for 3 Years?
------------------------------

Back in 2023, when I suddenly stopped posting, life just got super busy. Offline life threw a lot of responsibilities my way, and I had to put all my energy into my career and setting up some real-world business stuff.

During this time away:

*   **Freelancing & Digital Work:** I spent a ton of time learning the digital marketing world, managing client projects, and figuring out how to actually survive and grow as a freelancer.
    
*   **Gaming:** No matter how tired or busy I was, gaming was the one thing I never dropped. Whenever work got too stressful, sitting at my PC or grabbing my phone for a quick game was my escape.
    
*   **Photography:** I kept taking random photos of birds, street views, or nature wherever I went, just using whatever device I had on me. It's just a habit I can't shake off.
    

But even with everything else going on, I always missed Hive. On regular social media, you just scroll mindlessly, but Hive is different because you actually get to connect with a real community that values what you create.

* * *

What's the Plan for This Blog Now?
----------------------------------

Now that I'm back, I want to do this properly and stick around for the long run. I’m planning to stay consistent and share content around the things I genuinely enjoy:

1.  **My Photography:** Mainly nature shots, birds, and random daily life clicks that I take myself.
    
2.  **Gaming & Tech:** Honest thoughts on games I'm playing, casual reviews, and sharing screenshots from my gaming sessions.
    
3.  **Freelancer Life Vlogs:** Just raw, real stories about what it’s actually like navigating daily life as a digital creator—the good days and the struggles.
    

* * *

Let’s Reconnect!
----------------

To my old followers, are any of you still active around here? If you read this, please drop a comment below! I’d love to reconnect and check out your profiles to see what you've been creating while I was gone.

And if you're new to my blog, welcome! I'm really looking forward to connecting with you.

Take care, everyone, and talk to you in the comments!

body.title: Virtual Therapy for Addiction Recovery: Does It Work?
body.body:
## Introduction

Addiction recovery has always been a complex, deeply personal journey requiring structured medical and psychological support. In recent years, virtual therapy has emerged as a major shift in how treatment is delivered, especially as digital healthcare becomes more widely accepted. This raises an important question: can addiction recovery truly succeed through a screen?

Virtual therapy promises accessibility, affordability, and privacy—three factors that can significantly influence whether individuals seek help in the first place. However, its effectiveness depends on multiple variables, including the severity of addiction, patient engagement, and the quality of care provided.

## Understanding Addiction Recovery and Treatment Modalities

Addiction is not simply a behavioral issue; it is a chronic medical condition that affects brain chemistry, emotional regulation, and decision-making processes. Traditional recovery methods often include inpatient rehabilitation, outpatient counseling, medication-assisted treatment (MAT), and peer support groups.

Each of these approaches aims to address both the physical dependence and psychological triggers behind substance use. Modern recovery models increasingly emphasize integrated care, where therapy, medication, and social support work together.

## What Is Virtual Therapy?

Virtual therapy refers to the delivery of psychological counseling and psychiatric services through digital platforms such as video calls, mobile apps, or telehealth systems. In addiction treatment, it replicates many aspects of in-person care but through remote communication tools.

### Types of Virtual Therapy Used in Addiction Care

Common approaches include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), motivational interviewing, family counseling, and structured group therapy sessions. Some programs also incorporate digital monitoring tools that track mood, cravings, and relapse risk indicators in real time.

This flexibility allows patients to receive consistent care even when geographic or logistical barriers exist.

## How Virtual Therapy Supports Addiction Recovery

One of the strongest advantages of virtual therapy is accessibility. Individuals who live in rural areas or lack transportation can still connect with licensed professionals without disruption to their daily lives. This reduces one of the biggest barriers to recovery: simply getting to treatment.

Privacy is another critical factor. Many individuals avoid seeking help due to stigma or fear of judgment. Virtual platforms can create a more comfortable environment where patients feel safer discussing sensitive issues.

Consistency also improves outcomes. When therapy sessions are easier to attend, patients are more likely to remain engaged over time, which is essential in addiction recovery.

## Effectiveness of Virtual Therapy: What Research Shows

Research over the past decade suggests that virtual therapy can be as effective as in-person treatment for many mental health conditions, including substance use disorders. Studies show comparable outcomes in terms of relapse reduction, treatment retention, and patient satisfaction.

However, effectiveness depends on program structure. Highly structured telehealth programs with regular monitoring tend to perform significantly better than informal or self-guided digital interventions.

Patients dealing with moderate addiction often benefit the most, while severe cases involving medical detoxification may still require in-person supervision at certain stages.

## Limitations and Challenges

Despite its advantages, virtual therapy is not without limitations. Technology access remains a major issue, particularly in low-income or rural populations where internet connectivity may be unreliable.

Another challenge is the lack of physical presence. Therapists may find it harder to observe subtle behavioral cues, such as body language or signs of withdrawal distress. This can impact clinical judgment in some cases.

Emergency situations also present risks. If a patient experiences severe withdrawal symptoms or suicidal ideation, immediate in-person intervention may be necessary.

## Comparing Virtual vs In-Person Therapy

In-person therapy offers a level of immediacy and human connection that digital platforms may struggle to replicate. Many patients feel more accountable when attending physical sessions, and clinicians can better assess non-verbal communication.

On the other hand, virtual therapy provides unmatched convenience and continuity. For many individuals, especially those balancing work or family responsibilities, this flexibility can determine whether they stay in treatment at all.

Increasingly, hybrid models are being adopted. These combine virtual check-ins with periodic in-person sessions, offering a balanced approach that maximizes benefits of both systems.

## Integrating Medication and Medical Supervision

Successful addiction treatment often requires coordination between therapists and medical professionals, especially when medication-assisted treatment is involved. Virtual platforms are increasingly capable of supporting this integrated care model through secure communication systems and remote monitoring tools.

Patients using prescribed medications for withdrawal management or cravings benefit from consistent oversight and adjustments based on progress.

In some cases, medical considerations overlap with other health conditions, making awareness of drug interactions especially important. For example, understanding topics like [3 Side Effects of Mixing Benzonatate and Alcohol](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/3-side-effects-of-mixing-benzonatate-and-alcohol/) can help patients avoid unintended complications when managing multiple prescriptions or symptoms during recovery.

## Best Practices for Successful Virtual Recovery Programs

Effective virtual therapy programs rely on structured engagement strategies. Regular scheduling, consistent therapist follow-ups, and clear recovery goals help maintain accountability.

Therapist training is equally important. Clinicians must be skilled not only in addiction treatment but also in digital communication techniques that build trust without physical presence.

Security is another key factor. Platforms must ensure encrypted communication to protect patient confidentiality, which is critical in sensitive addiction cases.

## Risks, Safety Considerations, and Co-occurring Conditions

Addiction rarely exists in isolation. Many individuals also struggle with anxiety, depression, or other medical conditions that complicate recovery. Virtual therapy must therefore include careful screening and ongoing risk assessment.

One concern is ensuring patients understand how different substances or medications may interact during recovery. Educational resources such as [Fluconazole and Alcohol Interaction: A Medically-Reviewed Guide](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/fluconazole-and-alcohol-interaction-a-medically-reviewed-guide/) highlight the importance of medical awareness when dealing with overlapping treatments and health risks.

These considerations emphasize that virtual therapy should not function independently but as part of a broader, medically supervised recovery ecosystem.

After reviewing current clinical perspectives, authoritative health organizations such as the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration ([SAMHSA](https://www.samhsa.gov/)) emphasize that telehealth-based addiction treatment can be effective when properly structured, regulated, and combined with clinical oversight.

## Future of Virtual Addiction Treatment

The future of addiction treatment is likely to be increasingly digital. Artificial intelligence may soon assist therapists by identifying relapse patterns through behavioral data, while wearable devices could monitor physiological indicators of stress or substance cravings.

Global access to therapy is also expected to expand. As telehealth infrastructure improves, individuals in underserved regions may gain access to high-quality addiction care that was previously unavailable.

However, the human element will remain essential. Technology can enhance treatment, but recovery still depends on empathy, trust, and consistent human support.

## Conclusion

Virtual therapy has proven to be a powerful tool in addiction recovery, offering accessibility, flexibility, and comparable effectiveness to traditional treatment in many cases. While it is not a universal solution, it significantly expands the reach of care and helps bridge critical gaps in access.

The most effective approach is often a blended one—combining virtual care with medical supervision and, when necessary, in-person intervention. As digital health continues to evolve, virtual therapy is likely to become a permanent and essential part of addiction recovery systems worldwide.

---

body.title: Hive Through My Eyes: Draining or Empowering?
body.body: Hive is a blockchain that has been around for years and has had lots of impact on people's lives. But talking about the impact it has had, are they positive ones or negative impacts? To be honest, no one is perfect, and that includes platforms like Hive, but then I believe different individuals have different thoughts about Hive because what I experienced about it might totally be different from what someone else's is. And that's why below I'll be talking about my take regarding if Hive is draining or helping me, so without further ado let's get to it. ![1000315991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/EqYsczWJh7X3bvrRcuCTp3W9KTfjP9xw2iu3qNJw8UR3BcJSKt6irpHt5JNVJGUtLVR.jpg) You see, when I first joined Hive and even before I did, I was made to understand that the more you give is most likely going to determine how much you get back and also how it's more or less a game of luck, and I've seen that evidently in the lives of some authors who I believe are devoted and at the same time talented in their skills or writing and yet don't get the rewards they seem to deserve for what they're inputting onto the blockchain. Meanwhile, there are others who are giving the same energy or even less and are getting recognized and rewarded for their input, and it makes you wonder what it really takes to get noticed and rewarded. The above scenario I painted is just to help you understand how different people will think about Hive. Someone who's putting lots of effort and getting little would feel like Hive is draining rather than helping them, and for that reason, they would quit. While those who are getting a kind of recognition or rewards would think the opposite, because HIVE is obviously helping them. But what is HIVE doing to me personally? To me, Hive is helping me, and I'd state how below. You see, the first reason Hive was helping me was in the finance aspect, meeting my financial needs and helping me get some necessities I wouldn't have been able to afford if Hive hadn't helped me. Even though the value of Hive is deep, it's still playing some sort of role in helping me in the financial aspect, although little, but it's something. But different from that, it's also helping me fulfill my hobby of writing and giving me a platform to drop my pieces, which in itself is helping me to be me, and so for that reason I'd say Hive is helping and not draining me; after all, I do things here at my own pace. *** All photos are mine. ***

body.title: JUST ANOTHER DAY
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

I like celebrating people when I can, I believe it shows them how special they are to me. Right now I owe certain people in my life birthday presents, but then again, I love it when I can make them smile because of their special day. Celebration for me comes for a reason and this reason does not include birthdays and that is why I do not celebrate myself. If I am going to be celebrating my birthday for any reason, it would be because that year something spectacularly out of the ordinary happened for me to celebrate life.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcbwjj9Xi8gZqZvniMaNNjcivspzoaouXHaXT1wreNZtX/2149891220.jpg 

<a href=\

>Image by freepik My birthday scares me, it reminds me of how old I am getting and the tons of things I am yet to do. This realization makes me sober and that is why I always ask for quiet moments during my birthday. I see it as a time to reflect on how the year has been for me and then make new decisions that have the potential of changing my life. It is also a time I set new goals and make resolutions with the hope that the next birthday is even better. I will only celebrate after reflecting and discovering I am in a better place than I was a year ago. The level of growth I have made would determine the level of celebration. From buying myself something special to inviting friends to celebrate. I have never intentionally invited friends to celebrate with me except the time I would never forget when my girlfriend gave me a surprise birthday celebration. She’s very good with those kinds of plans unlike me lol. Apart from that day, I have never really called people to celebrate with me for any birthday at all. But when it comes to celebrating with others, I would prefer to sit, plan and try to do something nice. But in a really long while I have been restrained from doing such, guess I need to start again lol. >THIS IS MY RESPONSE LADIES ON HIVE [CONTEST](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-293) #293 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqbQGFerHXinrqqmfCGrRHtwdZRhqAtCVWMna3geK2vc/20230716_224852_0000.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@kilvnrex/just-another-day-4z5)

links.title: Updates to Hivelytics 2.0 and Compare Authors Tool as Well as a New Hive Author Toolkit Dashboard
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbwGSmiMZQdf1JwDVkWo1Xa9fyUArT5pnuYm55PMGzhaJ/image.png)

## Introduction
Over the past week I have been working on further maturing the [Hivelytics 2.0](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/hive/default.html?account=azircon) and added Top Voter Concentration chart and numbers to further improve the view of where your author rewards are coming from and their concentration and trends.

I have also added some new data and charts to my [Compare Authors](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/compare-authors.html?range=100&fetch=100&authors=seattlea%2Cazircon%2Ctarazkp%2Ccryptoandcoffee) tool as well as created a new entry page to make the tools easier to find and even added a work bench style Tool Switcher where you can use all three tools without leaving the page you are on.

## Hivelytics 2.0 Updates
Updates to Hivelytics 2.0 or an open source Hive Stats included adding Gini-style concentration numbers, Top Voter Concentration numbers, Trend indicator as well as a Top Voter Concentration Trend chart:

 ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZZFihVaDEaTua8M4r4R4Cfi79zXNuDYSiya46WN8LLM/image.png)

Here you see my numbers and you can see that overall trend is improving decentralization meaning that the top voter share of rewards is decreasing which means the rewards are coming from more voters that are not concentrated as much in the top twenty voters by HP. 

Please note that if you visited my tools in the past you may need to press F12 and right click the reload button and select an option of Empty Cache and Hard Reload to make sure that updated CSS and JavaScript files are loaded in your browser.

## Updates to Compare Authors Tool
I have also made some updates and additions to my [Compare Authors Tool](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/compare-authors.html?range=100&fetch=100&authors=seattlea%2Cazircon%2Ctarazkp%2Ccryptoandcoffee). Most notably I have added a Cross-Author Overlap Analysis:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPSq6divbG2Jhahun5XECBC7bKHaGY55dqDmSZvRdGFsT/image.png)

This shows how many voters you share with the authors you would like to compare yourself to, your shared topics with those authors as well as what are your shared windows for posting. Posting windows are in (UTC): Shared windows means authors publish in similar parts of the day.

Here is how these windows are defined:
Night: 00:00-05:59 | Morning: 06:00-11:59 | Afternoon: 12:00-17:59 | Evening: 18:00-23:59

I have also added a visualization for this data:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXXc2foVMJna57WJan4Aw1cSfK7ZYLB8T3fGMWYmpGJAV/image.png)

Mouse over the bright colored squares to see the details of the author comparison. There is also a Focus Mode where you click on the author in this case @tarazkp to visualize things even more clearly:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSomWosmVP8TVEMfyK8NkMovP6ZRt9LgVs4xG462gpzC2/image.png)

## Hive Author Toolkit Launch Page
In order to better organize the Hive Author Tools, I have added a new Hive [Author Toolkit Launch Page](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/) that provides user a clear choice of the three available tools: [Author Report Card](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/report-card.html), [Compare Authors Tool](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/compare-authors.html?range=100&fetch=100&authors=seattlea%2Cazircon%2Ctarazkp%2Ccryptoandcoffee) and [ Hive Stats - Hivelytics 2.0](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/hive/default.html?account=azircon):

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgwCJpkiDHQHTJRrRfrNmKJ1FUSKK4BMaPkNfDZC38d8/image.png)

I have also built an new [Tool Switcher](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/workbench.html?authors=seattlea%2Cazircon%2Ctarazkp%2Ccryptoandcoffee&range=90d&author=seattlea&tab=compare), which is basically and advanced workflow where you can switch between all three tools without leaving a page.

This makes using the Hive Author Tools easier and brings everything in one place where you can research the authors on Hive and improve your own content strategy or compare yourself to the top Authors on Hive. I hope that curators can also use these tools to improve their curation.

A good point to start using these tools is visiting the [Hive Author Toolkit Launch Page](https://seattlea.z5.web.core.windows.net/)

<hr/>

I am a Hive Witness and would really appreciate your vote for me as a witness: https://vote.hive.uno/@seattlea

If you prefer your Hive Witnesses to never power down I am one of those Hive Witnesses. I believe that unless you are a top 20 witness and running more than just a Hive Witness node then you don't need to power down.

links.title: I LOVE BIRTHDAYS
links.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog 

For the past two years , my birthdays haven't been my favorite days, it has just been a day to me. Days I find myself sitting on my own, reflecting on my growth and actions over the past years . Birthday's give us opportunities to reflect on our growth.

Regardless , I love seeing people happy on their birthday. I love it when they feel celebrated and special on their birthday, especially those I love and appreciate. I really appreciate the blessings and gifts on my birthday, and also appreciate everyone .Birthdays of those that I respect and care about is something I anticipate for, just like my parents and siblings.

Whether it is organizing a small gathering, sending heartfelt messages, or simply spending quality time with a friend or family member, I enjoy helping others feel celebrated .I also like celebrating the birthdays of people around me, It is nice to make someone feel loved on their special day I do not need to do something expensive, sometimes a simple message or a phone call can make their day special.

When it comes to my own birthday, yes I like to do something nice for myself, i do not need a party with plenty people, sometimes I just want some time to myself to relax and think about the year.part of the reason I don’t really celebrate my own birthday is money. Not always having enough finances kind of makes me stop thinking about big plans for myself. So over time, I just got used to treating my birthday like any other day. No expectations, no pressure.

My next birthday is in October, and to be honest, I haven’t really thought about it at all until now. I don’t have any big plans or ideas. I’ve never really had to plan anything for myself before, so it feels a bit unfamiliar but I'm sure something will come up.


Thank you for stopping by my blog

links.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AJhXzMALWZCdj9Z2nddamCbGuko9dp6KL96TFrmrK9hv5B5GaiJfvjbUT7KA8kr.jpg)

----

**T**he story behind this series of photographs that I am sharing with you today is quite simple: this happened to me one morning last week when, returning from making some product deliveries at a client's establishment, I stopped to rest for a bit on the northeast corner of the town's central square (better known as \

) and, as was to be expected, I had my camera hanging around my neck. 

So, when I saw a friend named Antonio leaning against one of the edges of the square's planters, I decided to take a picture of him (the first photo in this post, by the way) from a relatively wide distance; enough so that Antonio wouldn't notice he was being photographed by me and the photo would look quite natural and unposed. 

But, immediately after taking that photo, I noticed that several interesting scenes were happening around me at the same time; even Antonio got up from where he was and started walking down the boulevard in the direction of where I know his house is. So, realizing all of this, I started shooting, trying to make the best possible use of what was happening around me. 

But all of this lasted barely about five minutes, I think, and then the square became almost empty and silent; but, by that time, I had already captured these photos that are now here on #Hive for you...


>**L**a historia de esta serie de fotografías que comparto hoy con ustedes es bastante simple: esto me sucedió una mañana de la pasada semana cuando, volviendo de hacer algunas entregas de productos en el establecimiento de un cliente, me detuve a descansar un poco en la esquina noreste de la plaza central del pueblo (mejor conocida como \

) y, como era de esperarse, llevaba mi cámara colgada al cuello. >Así que, cuando miré a un amigo llamado Antonio recostado en uno de los bordes de las jardineras de la plaza, decidí hacerle una fotografía (la primera foto en esta publicación, por cierto) desde una distancia relativamente amplia; lo suficiente como para que Antonio no se percatase de que estaba siendo fotografiado por mí y la foto quedase bastante natural y sin pose. >Pero, de inmediato después de hacer esa foto, me percaté de que a mi alrededor estaban ocurriendo varias escenas interesantes a un mismo tiempo; incluso Antonio se levantó de donde estaba y comenzó a caminar por el bulevar en dirección hacia donde sé que está su casa. Así que, percatándome de todo esto, comencé a hacer disparos intentando aprovechar lo que ocurría alrededor de mí lo mejor posible. >Pero todo esto duró apenas unos cinco minutos, creo, y luego la plaza quedó casi vacía y en silencio; pero, para ese momento, yo ya tenía capturadas estas fotos que ahora están aquí en #Hive para ustedes... ----- ![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uFRq9qbQT9ucsbxQhsA2f6fM6tA6yZzwnwZwCaW9Gh1J1ap1Nmo6h6mPDF3ixJffgxL.jpg) **📷 01 - links.body:
https://youtu.be/ILlEsshEbc0?si=3W6tbg5HIzU99iiu
We should not ask whether there are demons because the very world around us is so full of evil that we do not need to ask whether demons are around or not. The very presence of evil in this world is an expression of the presence of demons. Demons are the ones influencing humans to behave the way they are behaving. There are demons everywhere. What could make a very good and perfect world which God created to become a den of evil and wickedness? This is the work of evil spirits. These spirits are the demons. They are in the world. This is why the Bible says in the book of Revelations “Woe unto the inhabitants of the earth because the devil has been cast down.” The devil was cast down and all the rebellious angels with him.

We should avoid being the abode of demons. Demons use human agents to execute most of their evil missions. Those who are practicing witchcraft are directly serving the devil. It is the demon who coordinates their activities. Demons can take up human form or whatever kind of body to implement what they want to do. So, we should not live in carelessness. We must understand that there are demons who want to have their evil plans executed in our lives.

links.title: PhotoFeed Contest - Landscape Photography Round 174
links.body:
***I took this photo from the bus on my way from Montevideo to Punta del Diablo, Uruguay. I was traveling with other photographers on a photography trip, and during the journey—which is quite long—I amused myself by taking pictures out the window. Many of those shots were discarded, but I managed to salvage some worthwhile ones. This is one of the best, and I chose it as my post for this week.***

Esta foto la tomé desde el bus que me llevaba de Montevideo a Punta del Diablo, Uruguay. Viajaba en compañía de otros fotógrafos en una salida dedicada a la fotografía, y durante el trayecto —que es bastante largo— me entretenía capturando imágenes desde la ventanilla. Muchas de esas tomas quedaron descartadas, pero entre ellas logré rescatar algunas que valen la pena. Esta es una de las mejores y la elegí como mi entrada para esta semana.

As usual, I always try to make the best of a bad situation. Aprovechando el momento, vi muchas sombras dispersas alrededor de las piscinas. ![IMG_20260609_154137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoCj9grGASCPRmxGrQVTMQApaHJd11NcHRdTkRnU1VNnkUA8cvvrdLfHbNQmAA1GZxA.jpg) ![IMG_20260609_154245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoK7HXbsR1onnr7UAq5skoj9anAyyncWdwrn82eHRB1NXDPKjCNV1CqsZQcEhCSvUsA.jpg) And I set about photographing a selection of them. Cuando el sol está fuerte, se acentúa más su luz y se proyecta con mayor precisión en los objetos, revelando formas muy interesantes. ![IMG_20260609_154226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eonm4VsNUFKER7MhCbRFdsyUNnx9zVoQMeeJL55vBwYPU7G6gu6TcTJCcvUvvZokeH6.jpg) These sequences capture the shadows of tree branches, the edge of the wall separating the garden, the slide's staircase, and the slender lampposts. Hay un lugar donde vamos todos 
unos llegan de día 
otros llegan con la luna 
algunos arriban al amanecer 
o cuando cae la tarde y el sol se despide.
Lo más jodío 
es que te fuiste primero 
algo nos salvo en aquella tormenta 
pero no somos inmortales 
con la lluvia crecen las estaciones 
que se agolpan sobre nuestras espaldas 
cuando un silencio infinito se interpone 
en la danza de quienes te abrazan.
Que decir del hermano fiel
crecer junto a ti fue un privilegio 
un designio luminoso en el camino 
y ahora serás estrella 
acompañando con tu risa nuestros días. 
No podrás irte 
lo hemos decretado 
hasta que al último de nosotros 
se lo trague el infinito.

There is a place where we all go 
some arrive by day 
others arrive with the moon 
some arrive at dawn 
or when evening falls and the sun says goodbye.

is that you left first 
something saved us in that storm
