body.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Sí, la verdad es muy dura pero hay que decirla: los Rojos de Cincinnati han decepcionado a todos. En descargo de ellos, son muchas las \

que podríamos esgrimir en su defensa: un hospital a bordo comenzando con su abridor más connotado desde el vamos, pasando por su jonronero insignia quien estuvo de baja más de un mes y las horas bajas de su ofensiva porque Ely De La Cruz y cia. no han podido carburar de manera coordinada. Si no están peor, ha sido porque su cuerpo de pitcheo ha respondido a medias y no los tiene tan alejados de la probabilidad de trascender a la postemporada. 3 juegos de distancia del 3er. comodín de la liga, no suena a una brecha insalvable e incluso, una buen encendido del motor -cómo el partido de anoche ante los Mets- podría marcar su regreso a los puestos de vanguardia de su división, dado que es la más equilibrada en balance de ganados y perdidos de todas las mayores. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Yes, the truth is brutal but it has to be said: the Cincinnati Reds have let everyone down. In their defense, there are plenty of \

we could throw out there: a total graveyard of an IL starting with their ace out of the gate, their premier slugger sidelined for over a month, and an offense in a major slump because Elly De La Cruz and company just haven't been able to click. If they aren't completely buried, it's only because their pitching staff has held it together just enough to keep them within striking distance of a October run. Sitting just 3 games back of the third Wild Card spot doesn't sound like an insurmountable hill to climb, and a hot streak—like last night's blowout against the Mets—could easily spark a comeback in their division race, especially since it's the tightest, most back-and-forth division in all of baseball.

# ---

![Suárez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/244Uwxff49vtJX1grtoLBc6FPXr7HiBqmUGDsWevJCfR11RPArT2ZEWPGs1C9YRQVwP1z.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/mets-vs-reds/2026/06/15/824505/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Noche de pelota en día de viaje para los demás equipos, en el hermoso Great American Ball Park, donde los Rojos reciben a los Mets de New York ¿Podría haber sido el partido bisagra de la temporada para los muchachos de Ohio? Lo ignoramos, pero lo cierto es que los monstruos ofensivos despertaron y el pitcheo tuvo la calidad de siempre, para obtener una pizarra de 12 carreras a 0. Mientras Chase Burns tejía \

desde la lomita, el tercera base nacido en Valencia Eugenio Suárez, hacía lo que mejor sabe hacer: batear jonrones. En el primer inning se voló la cerca con uno en base, para poner las cosas 3-0. Pero fue cerrando el segundo tramo donde terminó de mandar a la nevera el juego: bases llenas y un despiadado swing que sacó la pelota por el jardín derecho (su banda contraria), para un \

que formó parte de un ataque de 6 carreras, poniendo distancia insalvable para la batería de la gran manzana. Sí, Cincinnati tiene con qué, sólo deben creerlo ellos mismos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      Getaway day baseball at beautiful Great American Ball Park, where the Reds hosted the New York Mets. Could this have been the turning point of the season for the Ohio boys? Hard to tell, but one thing is for sure: the bats finally woke up and the pitching was dealing as usual to lock down a 12-0 blowout. While Chase Burns was spinning donuts from the bump, Valencia-born third baseman Eugenio Suárez did what he does best: leave the yard. In the first frame, he launched a two-run jack to make it 3-0. But he put the game on ice in the bottom of the second, stepping up with the ducks on the pond and unloading a vicious swing for an opposite-field grand slam to right, capping off a 6-run explosion that put the game completely out of reach for the Big Apple squad. Yes, Cincinnati has the tools, they just need to believe it themselves.

# ---

![Rojas.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23x17QTGQjMXArFDu19bDaASrVtByKUtHbKkstHS58dbrDprt5RXnFsw8mx3PBNLfXgVu.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/rays-vs-dodgers/2026/06/15/823938/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Un serie esperada en Los Ángeles por la significancia de los visitantes, respecto a medir el propio chance que se tiene de renovar el título de campeón mundial, fue el partido donde los Dodgers recibieron a los poderosos Rays de Tampa ¿Por qué? Digamos que los cartilaginosos le respiran en la nuca a los Yankees en la vanguardia del este de la Americana y estos pueden ser, el baremos para una eventual serie mundial contra los mulos. Y el juego se dió como se pensaba: cerrado ¿Cómo se decidió? 3-3 en el cierre del séptimo, el utility Miguel Rojas fue llamado como bateador emergente con Ohtani prevenido en el circulo de espera detrás de él. Una sinker a 94 MPH atravesó el cielo de la noche angelina y Miguel la devolvió por sobre la pared del jardín izquierdo, causando un momento divertido al llegar a la goma para anotar. En la gráfica sobre éstas líneas, al señalar la pizarra hacia arriba, parece decirle a Ohtani: \

4-3 terminó el juego y Rojas se convirtió en el héroe por enésima vez, en un turno gigante para los esquivadores. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     A highly anticipated series in LA because of what the visitors bring to the table in terms of measuring the team's chances to repeat as World Champions, as the Dodgers hosted the powerhouse Tampa Bay Rays. Why? Let's just say the Rays are breathing down the Yankees' necks at the top of the AL East, making them the perfect yardstick for an eventual World Series matchup against the Bronx Bombers. And the ballgame played out exactly as expected: a total dogfight. How was it decided? Tied 3-3 in the bottom of the seventh, utility man Miguel Rojas was called upon to pinch-hit with Shohei Ohtani loitering in the on-deck circle right behind him. A 94 MPH sinker caught too much of the plate, and Miguel launched it into the Los Angeles night sky over the left-field wall, triggering a hilarious moment as he crossed the dish. In the photo above, pointing up at the scoreboard, he seems to be telling Ohtani: \

The game wrapped up 4-3, and Miggy Ro became the hero yet again with a massive, clutch AB for the Blue Crew.

---

![Altuve.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23xp8Z4Nd7Pjr65YzWW9mVNivd9PAHEjBSHhXHtbtZzGb9tBvnc8KiAf51KqpTiskML7F.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/tigers-vs-astros/2026/06/15/824181/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Sí, hemos dicho otras veces que no escribimos sobre los venezolanos si el partido de su equipo fue derrota. Pero a veces, tenemos que hacer excepciones dado lo especial del momento. Todo el mundo se ha dado cuenta que el venezolano José Altuve ya no es el mismo de antes. Yordan Álvarez, la estrella cubana del momento, es quien se ha convertido en la cara de los siderales. Y a los Astros se les ha dificultado la zafra (Yordan no puede con todo). Anoche perdieron el juego ante Detroit 9-3, pero una de las carreras de Houston fue impulsada por medio de un cuadrangular de José, quien parece mostrar destellos de encendido. Ha estado bateando muy mal y cualquier pequeño destello de su pasado, que le ayude a colaborar más con el equipo, será bienvenido. Es tan malo su momento, que le han bajado hasta el quinto turno de la alineación, con la finalidad de quitarle presión. Ojalá se recupere, ya que es muy triste ver a una otrora estrella, siendo pelotero de relleno. Así sea. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Yes, we've said it before that we don't write about Venezuelan players if their squad takes an L. But sometimes we have to make an exception when a moment is this special. Everyone has realized that the Venezuelan star José Altuve just isn't the same guy anymore. Yordan Álvarez, the Cuban superstar of the moment, has officially become the face of the franchise for the Astros. And Houston has been scuffling through this campaign because Yordan simply can't carry the load all by himself. Last night they dropped the ballgame to Detroit 9-3, but one of Houston's runs came courtesy of a solo jack by José, who seems to be showing flashes of getting hot. He's been mired in a brutal slump lately, so any tiny glimpse of his vintage self that helps him chip in for the ballclub is more than welcome. He is struggling so badly right now that they even dropped him to the five-hole in the batting order just to take some pressure off his shoulders. Hopefully he bounces back, because it's truly tough to watch a former superstar turn into just another guy in the lineup. Let's hope he figures it out.

body.title: The Date I Keep Like a Secret #293
body.body:
Exactly a week ago today, I was in one of my friend's houses, and we were having some discussions. In between, he looked at me, and what came out of his mouth was that when it comes to celebrating my own birthday, I am the worst. I burst into laughter because I knew he was telling the truth, even though I had to think for a while over what he said, then I expected. He was right because it's the absolute truth. Those who are not in my circle or are outside hardly know my birthday. Meanwhile, I am always posting others on their special days. In fact, before writing this post, I just celebrated two beautiful ladies who are friends of mine who are celebrating their birthday today on my WhatsApp status, writing a lovely caption and making sure their day feels seen and glamorous. The funny thing is that I happen to have the same birthday and month as my elder sister, though we are not twins. But I only post her pictures. Now I am less certain that this is generosity. Because that is what I used to think. But there is something incredible I love about celebrating others, and that is, I give attention without receiving it and becoming the center of it myself. There's no one to examine me when I am the one who is in charge of the noise for someone else's special day. And this has given me another thought, which is, being looked at directly started to feel like exposure rather than joy. What my friend told me on this day, seven days ago, compelled me to ask why receiving celebrations feels harder than giving them. And this this moment that I am writing this post. No clear answer has come to my mind. And maybe it's modesty. Or maybe it is something not as loud as that, like never fully believing I deserve the same fuss I happily give everyone else. For my next birthday in August, I think I will post one of my pictures along with my elder sister. Small step, right? But not throwing a party lol. body.body:
Indeed, for most people, AI is still just a chatbot — and a pretty good one already. So more “AI innovation” can start to feel redundant: better answers, faster answers, slightly smarter answers.

But I think the real shift is not the chatbot itself.

It is AI acting as your personal agent.

Something that does not just answer questions, but helps you carry out tasks, remembers your context, understands your preferences, stays proactive, makes small decisions within your rules, and gradually becomes a kind of always-on personal assistant with PhD-level knowledge across many domains.

That is where the next battle is.

The big frontier AI companies are not just competing to build better models. They are competing to become the default agent ecosystem around each person.

And that matters because if your personal agent lives entirely inside one closed platform, then your privacy, autonomy, and control depend on that platform’s incentives and rules. It may optimize for more usage, avoid certain answers, filter sensitive topics, or steer you toward outcomes that are not fully aligned with your interests.

That is why open source and open models matter so much.

The goal is not necessarily that your personal agent never uses frontier models. It can use whatever model is best for a specific task. But the agent itself should be yours: private, portable, and centered on your interests.

And that is what makes the progress in open models so interesting. They are not just “catching up” in a passive way. The gap is shrinking faster, and that makes truly independent personal AI agents much more realistic.

body.body: Finding inner peace is a mission of any religion. And any religion contains tons of anti-scientific beliefs. The advantage of Buddhism is that some Buddhists teachers openly say: if some ideas from our scriptures don't match the reason and science, we are ready to abandon these ideas. None of other religions has this flexibility. Moreover, the atheistic core of Buddhism matches feelings of Christians who can't believe in god anymore but still need spirituality. Buddhism is based on faith too, but it doesn't require believing in samsara, karma, nirvana, non-existence of the soul, etc. You have a right to doubt. You can practice Buddhism just to feel better.\n\nMost people won't probably follow any formal type of Buddhism but rather practice its components and components of its \

, Hinduism - New Age stuff.

However, moral wellness doesn't help to answer the main question: why is it worth living and what is worth fighting. Without these answers, Buddhism will die off with its European followers.

Now, we are at the point when most people, believing in science, consider humans a sort of biological filth killing mother-nature. This attitude will disappear at some point, as the century-long paradigm \
ended. We'll find an answer and self-respect as a species, will mix it with Buddhism-like wisdom... and hopefully will find the civilizational balance.

I believe sunset is that instant when the day, tired of its own light, surrenders without reservation to the embrace of the water, unhurried and in silence.

body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

###### <center>✨¡Hola amigos amantes de la creatividad! Espero que estén todos bien.✨</center>

<center>¡Buenas tardes, amigos! Espero que estén pasando una excelente semana. Por mi parte, estoy contenta de pasar por acá a compartir una linda idea con ustedes. En esta ocasión les comparto el paso a paso para elaborar una linda cajita para el Día del Padre. Hace mucho que no les compartía o elaboraba alguna creación que tuviera que ver con un día, celebración o fecha específica, pues siempre hago creaciones para el día a día, bien cotidianas diría yo, jaja. Pero bueno, justo hace unos días una amiga me pidió una pequeña cajita temática para dar algunos dulces extras o un obsequio específico en ella para ese día.</center>

**🔸Sin más que añadir, a continuación los dejo con el paso a paso:**

> ###### <center>✨¡Hello friends who love creativity! I hope you are all well.✨</center>

> <center>Good afternoon, friends! I hope you're having a wonderful week. I'm happy to stop by and share a lovely idea with you. This time, I'm sharing the step-by-step instructions for making a cute little box for Father's Day. It's been a while since I've shared or made anything related to a specific day, celebration, or date, as I usually make everyday things—pretty ordinary things, I'd say, haha. But anyway, just a few days ago, a friend asked me for a small themed box to hold some extra sweets or a special gift for Father's Day.</center>

> **🔸Without more to add, then I leave you with the step by step:**

---

<center>![portada defi.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tvifvJkcAWuJxorUJA6UeVmFv72ezvaPeUadL9g6hPQ35A33DwYhPeBkbskd1G3WwMH.JPG)</center>

---

<div class=\

> **♥️ESPERO QUE TE GUSTE, ¡Empecemos!**
**♥️I HOPE YOU LIKE IT, Let's start!**
---
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> # ✂️ MATERIALES | ✂️ MATERIALS
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> - Caja de bombillo. - Cartulina blanca. - Foami crema. - Foami negro. - Foami azul. - Foami escarchado plateado. - Foami amarillo. - Tela del color o diseño deseado. - Pinturas y marcadores. - Pegamento. - Tijeras. - Regla. - Hoja blanca. - Lápiz.
- Light bulb box. - White cardstock. - Cream-colored foam sheet. - Black foam sheet. - Blue foam sheet. - Silver glitter foam sheet. - Yellow foam sheet. - Fabric in the desired color or design. - Paints and markers. - Glue. - Scissors. - Ruler. - White paper. - Pencil.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> # 🌟 PROCEDIMIENTO | 🌟 PROCESS
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
>\n\n<div class=\

> ###### ✨PASO 1: Lo primero que hice fue buscar el tamaño de caja correcto y, para las indicaciones que me dieron, quedaba perfecto en una cajita de bombillo. En este caso, yo utilicé una de 12 cm x 6 cm a la cual le retiré una de las paredes laterales y pegué muy bien la tapa para que quedara más firme. Seguido de esto, recorté una tira de tela que rodeara las paredes de la caja (en este caso, las medidas fueron de 37 cm x 6 cm) y para la base una medida de 12 cm x 6 cm, y pegué hasta forrar las paredes.

> ###### ✨STEP 1: The first thing I did was find the right size box, and according to the instructions, a light bulb box was perfect. In this case, I used one measuring 12 cm x 6 cm, from which I removed one of the side walls and glued the lid down securely for extra sturdiness. Next, I cut a strip of fabric to go around the sides of the box (in this case, the measurements were 37 cm x 6 cm) and a 12 cm x 6 cm piece for the base, and glued them down until the walls were covered.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260609_111001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Ep7vcoa2C47rPeoRP2aeCCLYgaAFfifEhyQcsZjaWtF2hWsyNR9JkxKQv2ASMmJBcat.jpg)|![IMG_20260609_111029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EqBbfzaVB9DfhPnwQLGhshZWcVUNZYz35XoYaaaYcD8gekrvtmaL1gCJLTrbLRRz8A3.jpg)|![IMG_20260609_111510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EpA3SuhNAc5vmqE86Yyj3KCG7JgQzscBa47ZRtuvot7Fha2jYWmQjeyFHxeHAJokKvs.jpg)| |-|-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
>\n\n<div class=\

> ###### ✨PASO 2: Ahora sí, vamos con la decoración. Para eso, lo primero es tomar una hoja blanca y dibujar los diseños que tengo en mente; pero como me pidieron algo sencillo y que tuviera que ver un poco con la mecánica, pues simplemente me centré en hacer a un hombre con bigote, o bueno, con las características que me dieron. Además, tenía pensada una caja de herramientas, pero me gustó más que fuera un bolsillo tipo overol. Al tener lista la idea, es momento de transferir a los colores correspondientes de foami, como explico a continuación: ✨Cabeza: 3.5 cm x 2.5 cm en foami crema. ✨Cabello: 3.5 cm x 1.4 cm en foami negro. ✨Bigote: 1.3 cm x 0.5 cm en foami negro. ✨Herramientas: 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm, 1.5 cm x 1 cm y 2.3 cm x 0.7 cm en foami escarchado plateado. ✨Mango: 2 cm x 0.5 cm y 2 cm x 0.6 cm en foami amarillo. ✨Bolsillo: 4 cm x 2.5 cm en foami azul.

> ###### ✨STEP 2: Now, let's get to the decoration. The first step is to take a blank sheet of paper and sketch the designs I had in mind; but since they asked for something simple and somewhat related to mechanics, I just focused on drawing a man with a mustache, or rather, with the characteristics they gave me. I had also planned on a toolbox, but I liked the idea of ​​it being a pocket-style overall better. Once you have your idea ready, it's time to transfer it to the corresponding colors of foam, as explained below: ✨Head: 3.5 cm x 2.5 cm in cream foam. ✨Hair: 3.5 cm x 1.4 cm in black foam. ✨Mustache: 1.3 cm x 0.5 cm in black foam. ✨Tools: 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm, 1.5 cm x 1 cm, and 2.3 cm x 0.7 cm in silver glitter foam. ✨Handle: 2 cm x 0.5 cm and 2 cm x 0.6 cm in yellow foam. ✨Pocket: 4 cm x 2.5 cm in blue foam.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260609_111903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EowKyNj1EEX2fJZ4w47bS8PQUy6Mda2NwvjxPGW2ALevShC9bjbTfa66yCTbL8JMEmW.jpg)|![IMG_20260609_111940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EogPpVMS5TBffcFHqNGb5H6UQbNh8vT7V24qR14YgzhqP1SHuPC9fAnvMevGcPof7bB.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
>\n\n<div class=\

> ###### ✨PASO 3: Al estar todo recortado y listo, es momento de dar color a los bordes, como siempre, con pinturas o marcadores que hagan contraste o combinen con el color del foami. En este caso, di un color marrón a la cabeza, al bolsillo un color azul más oscuro y al mango de las herramientas un color naranja.

> ###### ✨STEP 3: Once everything is cut out and ready, it's time to color the edges, as always, with paints or markers that contrast with or complement the foam color. In this case, I colored the head brown, the pocket a darker blue, and the tool handles orange.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260609_112443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoK8CBJKV2CFyhhMvDenRdLtsExVYCPDHvQPjbC7CqBLY8mZUpwYJQCLxNfoeG9gVUV.jpg)|![IMG_20260609_112430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoiXDgWanuj59tP3JLxVYaShAwphAcyLmqT832YmeZM6jd4iDQE1KSjKR68EuAesW1F.jpg)| |-|-|

>\n\n<div class=\

> ###### ✨PASO 4: Al estar secas las piezas, es momento de dibujar detalles específicos con marcadores, como lo serían los ojos, cejas, boca, orejas; definir mejor el cabello, el bolsillo y detalles a las herramientas. Al estar listas, las pegué hasta formar las decoraciones.

> ###### ✨STEP 4: Once the pieces were dry, it was time to draw specific details with markers, such as the eyes, eyebrows, mouth, and ears; further define the hair, the pocket, and add details to the tools. When they were ready, I glued them together to create the decorations.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260609_112800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoGzKa8pqkFQDeYXoXUiL1Miw3yYmK2knauQvquWtn3MqKWD6QyyFLQhL5VjLS9UsdW.jpg)|![IMG_20260609_113111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoEsVNX7HquzpxnEGK4HAqLaoT6aK3xgBtgroif4CusVf7MEMJRk5ZYkHoucf3Ue87h.jpg)| |-|-|

>\n\n<div class=\

> ###### ✨PASO 5: Luego, las pegué en la pared que escogí para el frente de la caja. Seguido de esto, es momento de tomar la cartulina blanca y recortar una pieza de 11.6 cm x 10 cm, en la cual escribí en la parte superior “Feliz Día” con marcador negro y di algunos detalles extras con marcador azul y, por último, la pegué en la pared trasera de la caja, pero por la parte interna.
> ###### ✨STEP 5: Then, I glued them to the wall I had chosen for the front of the box. After that, I took the white cardstock and cut out a piece measuring 11.6 cm x 10 cm. I wrote \

at the top with a black marker and added some extra details with a blue marker. Finally, I glued it to the back wall of the box, on the inside.

body.title: Simpsons Hit and Run Now Stable on Android
body.body:
Over three decades after its initial release, Simpsons Hit and Run is now playable on the go without a laptop. Before we get too far into this, this project is similar to the recompile projects for console games, you will need the original Hit and Run game to source copyrighted and trademarked files. Particularly the PC version, have that and follow some simple instructions and you are off playing Simpsons Hit and Run on your Android device.

Hit and Run Finally Truly a Hit and Run Release

This project has been in the works for a while but recently hit version 1.0.3, the most stable, playable version yet. This is great news for fans of Simpsons Hit and Run, me being one. I remember the first time I played this game on the original Xbox; I loved it. This was odd to me since I was not a fan of Grand Theft Auto when it went to 3D. The embedded video below by [YouTube creator, VP REBORN]( https://www.youtube.com/@VPREBORN) shows off Simpsons Hit and Run running on Android. It looks great, as it should be since it is not a port and is using official media. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XxgyuZL3F4c

Those Controls

While the game allows a lot of things to happen at once, the controls are simple. The buttons are context sensitive – no need to worry about honking a horn if you are not in a car for instance. This means touch controls, while still annoying, will be decently acceptable. Obviously, if you have a controller your experience will be much better. Head over to [Github to grab the files]( https://www.bing.com/search?FORM=U523DF&PC=U536&q=simpsons+hit+and+run+wiki+android&PC=U316&FORM=CHROMN) and follow the instructions. Please remember, you will need an original copy of the PC game to grab assets from. Here is an [affiliate link for eBay]( https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=simpsons+hit+and+run+PC&_sacat=0&_from=R40&_trksid=p2380680.m570.l1313&mkcid=1&mkrid=711-53200-19255-0&siteid=0&campid=5338976226&customid=&toolid=10001&mkevt=1) to help if you need a copy.

body.title: The Most Important Relationship You Will Ever Have Is the One With Yourself
body.body:
I did not like myself much for a long time. Would not have said that out loud back then. Would have deflected or made a joke. But if i am being completely honest the way i spoke to myself privately was something i would never have said to another person i cared about.

Every mistake kept score. Every embarrassing moment replayed. Every flaw examined closely. A constant low level harshness that just lived in the background like noise i had gotten so used to i stopped noticing it was there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRcDoj6SnDyNjCoFMQ5dftqhmjTVyoxhLeqkfYbYN6tWB/1781626626402.jpg)
[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-making-a-heart-shape-with-their-hands-ciGwxgEihck)
And i kept looking outside myself for things to fill what that created. Needed validation from people. Needed approval from places it was never guaranteed. Built relationships where i quietly required the other person to make me feel acceptable because i had not figured out how to do that for myself.

That is an unfair amount of pressure to put on another person. And it does not work the way you hope it will. Because the thing you are trying to fill is on the inside and external things patch it temporarily at best.

The relationship you have with yourself quietly sets the standard for everything else in your life. How you allow people to treat you. What you believe you are allowed to want. Whether you speak up when you should or shrink when it matters. How much you trust your own instincts. Whether you believe your needs are worth taking seriously.


All of it traces back to that private ongoing conversation you are having with yourself that nobody else hears.
Rebuilding that is not fast work. It is not linear either. Some weeks genuinely feel like progress and then something happens and you are back talking to yourself the same old way. That is normal. It does not mean you are failing.

But the work is worth doing. Not because it makes you confident all the time or free from self doubt permanently. But because it makes you honest with yourself. Grounded in yourself. Actually yours.
You will spend more time alone with your own thoughts than you will spend with any other person in your entire life.

That relationship deserves the same patience and care you give to everyone else.
Start there. Build from there. Everything else follows.

body.title: Web Apps are the Future!
body.body: alt=\

> **The Learning Pages project aims to equip subscribers with tools to enhance their learning and boost productivity. Apps are a great way to do this, but developing apps for every platform is a lengthy and difficult task for solopreneurs.** It is also costly. For example, being part of the Apple Developer Program to keep iOS apps available and prevent frightening malware warnings when installing macOS apps costs $100 a year. ### Python I am a fan of the Python programming language and use it to create tools that assist my writing and publishing. Python can also be used to create desktop programs using a GUI (Graphical User Interface). Users need to have Python installed on their desktop computers, but this can be a bit tricky. Smartphones are used more than desktops to run apps, but Python doesn’t run natively on the web. You can use apps like Flask to do this. A simple example is shown below:

></center>

The app then needs to be deployed on a platform such as Render or Railway.

### Web apps

Why use the above options when you can create apps using a combination of JavaScript, HTML and CSS, which all developers understand?

Web apps need an internet connection and work best on phones.

Most native apps require an internet connection, and most people use apps installed on their phones.

The major benefit of writing web apps is that the same app can be installed and used on both Android and iOS phones.

For these reasons, I will now concentrate on developing web apps.

body.title: What Drives Me To Help Others.
body.body: <div align=\
>\n<div class=\

>
![20260616_091248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23tSUEVFHySBYyjXbudz4F5HpNcpMXq6i5DN9p2BJQ1fqczKiXNyqw3xZDfR2sX6jx696.jpg)
Good day, people of Hive! Welcome to my blog. Today's topic is from Hive-Reachout which says: **What Drives You To Help?** So let's dive in. Honestly, people help others for different reasons. Just like the topic said, some people help because of sympathy, some because they have enough, and some even help just for validation. But for me, I will talk about why I reach out to people.
Just like the Bible teaches us that when we give, it will be given back to us. It also encourages us to help others whenever we can. Just like what these three Bible scriptures says in **Luke 6:38:which says that when we give, it will be given back to us in good measure.** Another Bible scripture says in **Proverbs 19:17: which says that whoever is kind to the poor is lending to the Lord, and God will reward them for what they have done**. And lastly there is also **Galatians 6:2: which tells us to carry each other’s burdens.** These verses always remind me that helping others is not a waste, but something meaningful. For me, the main reason I reach out to people is because I feel the need to give, especially when I have enough money. And Sometimes it is also sympathy. Honestly, whenever I see people who are hungry or in need, I feel a kind of pain in my heart because I can imagine what they are going through. I have also been in situations where things were not easy, so I can relate to their struggles. Until you put yourself in someone else’s shoes, you can never truly understand what the person is going through.
![20260616_091336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23ywuBm1RNGeLrcmZbbUXrRqkcWGeC7dvGMs22vN2qG5uDsLfxWw2tDxguBPvnGbgqiUK.jpg)
Whenever I see small children begging on the street or along the roadside, I just ask myself why life has to be that way. I am the kind of person who does not find it hard to help when I have, because I believe whatever I have was given to me by God through someone, so I should also be willing to share it with others. Another reason that drives me to help is **gratitude**. I always tell myself that me being alive, able to eat, drink, sleep, dress well, or even have something extra means I should not take it for granted. There are many people out there wishing to have even the small things I have, yet they are unable to get them. So that is why I feel it is only right to extend a helping hand when I can. In conclusion, the reason I always give is mainly out of sympathy and the belief that helping others is the right thing to do. If I have, I will give. And if I don’t have at that moment, I will honestly tell the person I will help next time, and I try my best to keep that promise. Helping people, to me, is just something I naturally do because I believe we are all one, and it is not bad to help people in need. **This is my entry for the Hive-Reachout Weekly Prompt 104.** **Thanks for reading💞💞💞💞💞.** **Images are mine.**

body.title: Balance and the Vestibular System: Our Internal Compass
body.body:
## Balance and the Vestibular System: Our Internal Compass

Balance is the ability to maintain posture and to move and orient ourselves in a stable and coordinated way in space. It is a fundamental function of our daily life, allowing us to walk, run, jump, and perform activities without falling or losing orientation.

It results from the integration, at the brain level, of information coming from three systems: the vestibular, visual, and proprioceptive systems.

L'Equilibrio e il Sistema Vestibolare: la nostra bussola interna

L'equilibrio è la capacità di mantenere la postura e di muoverci ed orientarci in modo stabile e coordinato nello spazio. È una funzione fondamentale per la nostra vita quotidiana, che ci permette di camminare, correre, saltare e svolgere attività senza cadere o perdere l'orientamento. Esso è frutto dell'integrazione a livello cerebrale delle informazioni provenienti da tre sistemi: vestibolare, visivo e propriocettivo.

body.body:
Greetings!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQqjp5kiTDKHZdTpVnMNFavpGnEAdg5JKmrci1GLweBxS/1781626266387.jpg)

Punishment to me is the best form of corrections in the whole wide world. Although there's been a series of criticisms against punishment, I will not lie to us, there's no society that can exist without punishment. Bring or tell me about a society that has ever existed without a punishment, then, I will tell you there's none.

Without punishment, the society will be full of chaos and danger and this is because, when there's no punishment, people will just be doing whatever they like as they already know that nothing will be done to them even if they commit their greatest crime. However, once there's a punishment in place, there will be orderliness in the society as people would have known that there's a penalty to whatever wrong or crime they are trying to perpetuate.

Having talked so much about punishment and its effect on the people and their society, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is all about, \

in the Hive learners community.

One thing I want us to know is that, wherever there's rules and regulations there will be punishment and it's this punishment of a thing that can make the society a safe place for all.

To me, the effect of punishment in our society has not lost its value and objectives. Although, it's like people are committing more crimes even with the punishment measures being put into place. Yeah, that might be the truth of the matter, but one thing thing I have seen overtime is that, many that have been known as criminals have now become a better person due to the punishment being metted out to them. Some of them have been jailed and it was during the process of them being put into the correctional center that they became a new person and by the virtue of this, turned a new leaf.

However, I have equally seen another set of criminals that came back from the prison and became more notorious. Well to me it's not their fault as some of our correctional system are not in place to correct, but to hardened the mind of the criminals the more and this is because, the way the accused were being treated in those places has nothing to do with corrections and it's from those places that dreadful gang were being formed to terrorize the people the more whenever they are released from the prison.

Also, the effect of punishment has been diminished due to our judicial system. When the judicial system is being corrupted, then, the effect of the punishment being pronounced by the judiciary would not be as effective as it ought to be. This happens when judgments are being brought and also, when the offenders are being set free of his offense and those that are not guilty are being punished for the offense they know nothing about.

In conclusion, there's nothing wrong with punishment as it would always be effective as it should only if the system itself is not tampered with.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 16 2026
body.body:
I only planned to hit 11k today. The extra 15k happened one walk at a time 😄 The morning started the usual way—an easy walk, some light jogging, and a few exercises to get the body moving. Nothing suggested it would turn into a 26k-step day. In fact, I was already thinking about crossing the target early and having a relaxed evening. But throughout the day, I kept choosing movement without really noticing it. Instead of sitting down right after lunch, I went for a walk. Did the same after dinner. A few daily tasks turned into extra trips, and by the evening I felt like heading out for another walk rather than staying indoors. What surprised me most was how natural it felt. A few weeks ago, I would've been checking my tracker every hour. Today, I was just enjoying the process and letting the steps accumulate in the background. By bedtime, the total had climbed to 26k steps. The lesson from today? Big numbers are usually the result of small decisions repeated throughout the day. Rarely one giant effort. Day 19/30 complete ✅ What's your favorite way to sneak extra movement into your day without it feeling like exercise? #actifit #11kchallenge #day19 #dailywalks #consistencyjourney #keepmoving

This time we went to an area about 25 km from our home , it's a little paradise for birds and a protected area during the breeding season . The Area we went to is called Eemmeer and it's about 5.2 squaremile according to wiki pedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eemmeer . We parked the car on the far west side of the lake here https://maps.app.goo.gl/EiyujcJZ5vmk6f4b6 , there are several birdwatchers spots in the area but that is not why i came here today. Ok that seems true.

> \

If everyone sees the role they play and the cause of those conditions perhaps. A worker given the opportunity to work. A capitalist with an opportunity to create a business and hire labour.

> \

Ok so there is no love in it,

> \

The misery of the proletariat, fascinating phrase.

> \

Minimum wage sucks, it is true.

> \

Yes competition. The workers compete with other workers, but today the poor are getting richer faster than at any time in history. I understand in the past it was not so, and perhaps in many places it is still like this.

> \

I am not sure I understand this part. The worker sells his wages for next to nothing (say minimum wage) but then has to sell the products also for nothing, but presumably something, so they get poorer?

> \

Bleak, but in the old arm-grinding mills this perhaps was true, when you were forced to work for one employer who wouldn't offer you any compensation for your arm getting broken even if you were trying to save the machine. And colleagues who would not defend you against the corporation, who had a responsibility to pay their shareholders profits that might be lost to accident claims.

> \

What if the employer prefers the worker who is most efficient? Rather than cheapest?

> \

Ok so I get what this is saying. Pay workers too much and they can have families and that creates too much future labour, but pay them too little and they die, decreasing the future labour supply. Makes sense, i've never been able to earn enough to justify having a family. Therefore I am not producing any 'excess forward labour supply'.

> \

Interesting, the levers of capital and labour being reasoned here. I don't argue, I am just trying to interpret this work.

> \

Ahh the struggle for workers rights, and equitable reward for their labour.

> \

Interesting perspective, perhaps modern entrepreneurs have rosy colored glasses on.

> \

I suppose the Capitalist is not the same character of the Salesman, who works and earns his fortune through dilligent efforts. The capitalist is more like a mean Ebinezer Scrooge, working through Christmas and declining to pay his employees bonuses until the three haunting spirits of christmas past present and future torment his soul.

> \

So herein lies the motives;

> \

So therefore if the organization is a co-op and the profits are sent as dividends to the shareholding workers, that is not exploitive, but if done as a Capitalist owning business where the Capitalist runs the business for his own profit, then it is inherently exploitation. Because his administration work is exploitation? Sounds like communist propaganda haha 😛 but I follow.

> \

Ok so being the boss is less painful than being a labourer, perhaps, but there is more responsibility for sure. Especially today with all the labour-won rights and regulations and rules that must be followed to legally run a business. The world in which this was written was certainly more exploitive than the one we are in today, but I do understand the parable of examples describing these conditions.

> \

There it follows, precisely.

> \

There are social supports now for people, in many places it is more profitable to be unemployed today than to risk and toil for wages. In the past there was infinitely more risk, and difficulty starting a small business too. Although I don't deny that losing your job can destroy the life you have built up, I do not protest.

> \

True true.

> \

Who doesnt?

> \

Hey man I didn't invent this system. I wanted to build a theatre where people could come and do passionately what skills they wanted to demonstrate, but apparently people don't believe in such idealism, and fewer might pay for the spectacle.

> \

This Capitalist is cruel, I would prefer in my fantasy world to pay high wages to my employees, as much as they wanted to earn. I suppose the laws of the jungle don't work that way. 

> \

Perhaps, perhaps. Maybe we can do better, or maybe these laws and levers say otherwise.

> \

Now I feel bad about my blog here, talking about how I am saving money trying to build up wealth. Is it exploitation to invest the wages I earn?  Is it inherently wrong to accumulate capital, and earn interest?

> \

Is it not better to have a little capital than to starve? I am empathetic, as a worker myself, recognizing the absurdity of my ongoing toil and trying to lift myself up to a middle class? 

> \

\n\nI see I see, and I also recognize that I am far from being in a position of the wealthy Capitalist who can sit back and relax, choosing to employ or not employ, to invest and labour instead, but I am attempting the latter. To \

Yeah this is how it feels to be an employee. 

> \

I re-listened to Jordan Peterson's refutation of Karl Marx's theories the day before last, while I was travelling. He argues that Marx was wrong, but we can leave that discussion for another day.

> \

Today there are often other opportunities for employment one can seek, even if not the preferred type.

> \

Maybe hunger is the real enemy. If we could solve world hunger, that might go a long way to relieving the proletariot of the suffering. Is that not the role of 'fast food' in modern times?

> \

Hey man I didn't come up with this system, I came to this planet for the tasty food like everyone else. They didn't say 'you have to be a slave', and isn't the real slavery to our impulses and desires? Isn't that why nobody ever leaves, and we keep reincarnating again and again? Sorry I am straying from the topic into the woowoo realm.

> \

Fascinating read. I understand, although I would argue like a prisoner against the merits of them prison. Thank you for sharing, it does refresh my perspective a bit to read this essay. Hmmm... So the system is all exploitation or starvation. And both the Capitalist and the Worker need one another, but the Capitalist is better off though morally inferior. They can invest instead of employ, and may even in bankruptcy be better off than the worker. Well, the clever worker can invest a percent of their wages and hopefully one day become the capitalist, but will then do the exploiting. Is there no better way? 

Thanks for the recommendation, as a philosopher I will ponder and deliberate this for a while, as I sell my time and labour today for the wages I am lucky to earn.

> \
\n\nAm I communist now? LOL what is the nature of this text? I still think it is better to be the capitalist than the poverty stricken labourer. I work too hard to stay in one place, such as ruin.

body.title: Oberek Mix
body.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Oberek Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/789e4ff4-38a1-419e-bf98-b546773dc6a2.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/sQDari5M5qvE8Esp1kQFeX) 
 
 En los bosques de Mazovia, donde la tierra parece respirar al ritmo de las estaciones, nació una danza que no pedía permiso para existir. El oberek, con su nombre derivado del verbo polaco *obracać się*, que significa girar, no fue concebido en salones palaciegos ni bajo la mirada severa de maestros de capilla, sino en el polvo de las aldeas y bajo la luz tenue de las tabernas rurales. Es un género que huele a resina de pino, a sudor y a celebración comunitaria, una expresión visceral que precede a cualquier intento de catalogación académica.

A diferencia de sus primos más solemnes, como la polonesa, o incluso del mazurka, que aunque rústico posee cierta elegancia contenida, el oberek se caracteriza por una velocidad vertiginosa y un compás de tres tiempos que empuja hacia adelante sin descanso. Los músicos tradicionales, aquellos violines rasgados por años de uso y los acordeones de fuelle pesado, entendían que aquí la técnica debía subordinarse al impulso. 

No se trataba de tocar notas perfectas, sino de mantener el trance del giro. La melodía suele ser improvisada, fluida, cambiando según el estado de ánimo del intérprete principal, generalmente el violinista, quien lidera la conversación musical mientras la sección rítmica, compuesta por bajos y percusión mínima, sostiene el suelo firme para que los bailarines puedan volar.

Durante el siglo XIX, mientras Europa se obsesionaba con la estructuración formal de la música clásica, el oberek permaneció fiel a sus raíces orales. Fue Chopin quien, desde la distancia del exilio parisino, capturó el espíritu de estas danzas populares, aunque tendió a estilizarlas, limando las aristas más salvajes del oberek para adaptarlas al piano de concierto. 

Sin embargo, en los pueblos, la esencia primitiva se mant intacta. Era la música de las bodas interminables, de los domingos después de la misa, de la resistencia cultural silenciosa frente a las ocupaciones extranjeras que dividieron Polonia durante décadas. Bailar oberek era una afirmación de identidad, un acto de alegría obstinada.

Con la llegada del siglo XX y la industrialización, el sonido comenzó a transformarse. Las grabaciones de campo realizadas por etnomusicólogos revelaron una diversidad regional sorprendente; cada valle tenía su propia manera de acentuar el segundo tiempo, cada aldea su propio repertorio de giros melódicos. 

Pero fue la formación de conjuntos folclóricos estatales tras la Segunda Guerra Mundial lo que estandarizó ciertas interpretaciones, llevando el oberek a los escenarios teatrales. Aunque esto le dio visibilidad global, también introdujo una coreografía fija que contrastaba con la libertad espontánea de la tradición campesina. Aun así, la energía cinética del género sobrevivió a la politización.

Hoy en día, el oberek experimenta un renacimiento interesante. Ya no es solo una reliquia de museo ni un espectáculo turístico. Jóvenes músicos en Varsovia, Cracovia y más allá están recuperando los archivos sonoros antiguos, mezclando la crudeza del violín rural con texturas electrónicas o jazzísticas, pero respetando la métrica implacable de 3/8 o 3/4. Se ha descubierto que la urgencia rítmica del oberez resuena con la ansiedad y la vitalidad del mundo contemporáneo. 

No necesita traducción ni explicación extensa; basta con escuchar el primer compás acelerado para sentir esa necesidad física de moverse, de girar sobre uno mismo hasta perder la noción del norte y del sur, quedándose solo con el presente inmediato del sonido. Es una historia escrita no en partituras, sino en el movimiento corporal y en la memoria colectiva de un pueblo que aprendió a celebrar a pesar de todo.

La huella del oberek en la cultura polaca trasciende lo auditivo para infiltrarse en la narrativa escrita, donde autores como Henryk Sienkiewicz o, más tarde, los escritores del realismo socialista y posmoderno, utilizaron la danza como metáfora de la condición nacional. En las páginas de *Los Caballeros Teutónicos* o en las obras de Bruno Schulz, el movimiento giratorio y vertiginoso no es solo un adorno folclórico, sino una representación del caos histórico que envuelve a los personajes. 
La literatura captura esa sensación de mareo colectivo, esa pérdida de equilibrio controlado que define al género, transformando el ritmo musical en una estructura sintáctica acelerada, donde las frases se atropellan imitando la respiración agitada de los bailarines.

En el cine, directores como Andrzej Wajda o Roman Polanski han empleado la estética del oberek para subrayar momentos de tensión extrema o euforia desbordante. No se trata simplemente de incluir una banda sonora tradicional, sino de utilizar la cámara para replicar la perspectiva del giro. Los planos circulares, los desenfoques de movimiento y la edición rítmica buscan transmitir la desorientación física que provoca la danza. 

En películas como *Tierra prometida* o *El pianista*, la presencia implícita o explícita de esta música sirve como ancla temporal y emocional, recordando al espectador una vitalidad que persiste incluso en los contextos más oscuros. La pantalla se convierte en una pista de baile donde la violencia y la celebración a menudo comparten el mismo pulso acelerado.

La moda también ha bebido de esta fuente, aunque de manera más sutil y simbólica. Los diseñadores contemporáneos polacos, al revisar el traje regional de Mazovia, no se limitan a copiar los bordados rojos y blancos, sino que reinterpretan la silueta fluida necesaria para el giro. Las faldas amplias, los cortes que permiten la expansión cinética y el uso de telas que capturan el aire al moverse han influido en colecciones de alta costura que buscan dinamismo. El oberek exige ropa que viva con el cuerpo, rechazando la rigidez, y esta filosofía de movilidad ha permeado en tendencias que valoran la funcionalidad elegante sobre la estática monumental.

Musicalmente, la influencia es aún más palpable y diversa. El jazz polaco de mediados del siglo XX, con figuras como Krzysztof Komeda, absorbió la asimetría y los acentos inesperados del oberek, integrándolos en improvisaciones complejas que sorprendían a las audiencias occidentales acostumbradas al swing estándar. Más recientemente, la escena electrónica y el folk experimental han sampleado grabaciones antiguas de violines rurales, superponiendo beats industriales sobre la métrica ternaria tradicional. 

Bandas de rock progresivo y metal folclórico utilizan la velocidad endiablada del oberek como base para riffs agresivos, demostrando que la energía primitiva de la danza campesina tiene la capacidad de adaptarse a cualquier instrumento o tecnología sin perder su esencia visceral. Esta permeabilidad demuestra que el oberez no es una pieza de museo, sino un organismo vivo que muta y se alimenta de cada nueva expresión artística que toca.

El oberek se erige como un monumento invisible en la arquitectura cultural de Polonia, no construido con piedra ni mármol, sino con la memoria muscular de generaciones enteras. Su estatus de hito no proviene de decretos oficiales ni de reconocimientos internacionales, aunque los tenga, sino de su capacidad inquebrantable para actuar como columna vertebral de la identidad mazoviana y, por extensión, polaca. 

En un continente donde las fronteras han sido dibujadas y borradas repetidamente por ejércitos y tratados diplomáticos, esta danza ha permanecido como una geografía interna inmutable, un territorio que cada ciudadano lleva consigo en la forma en que entiende el ritmo y la comunidad.

Funciona como un código social compartido, un lenguaje no verbal que permite a individuos de distintas clases, edades y trasfondos políticos encontrar un punto de encuentro común. Cuando suena el primer acorde acelerado, las jerarquías sociales se disuelven momentáneamente bajo la exigencia física del giro. Este aspecto egalitario es crucial para comprender su peso histórico: durante los periodos de partición y ocupación, el oberek fue un acto de soberanía privada. 

Bailarlo era afirmar que, aunque el estado hubiera desaparecido del mapa, la cultura seguía viva, respirando y moviéndose al compás de sus propios tambores. No era resistencia armada, pero sí una resistencia espiritual profunda, una negativa a dejar que el silencio impusiera su dominio.

Además, el oberez representa un equilibrio fascinante entre la tradición y la improvisación, reflejando la dualidad del carácter nacional. Por un lado, respeta estructuras rítmicas ancestrales; por otro, celebra la libertad individual del intérprete y del bailarín para decorar, acelerar o modificar la ejecución según el instante. 

Esta flexibilidad ha permitido que sobreviva a la modernización sin convertirse en una pieza estática. Es un hito porque demuestra que la tradición no es necesariamente conservadora en el sentido de inmovilista, sino que puede ser dinámica, adaptativa y sorprendentemente contemporánea.

En la conciencia colectiva, el oberek ha dejado de ser solo una danza para convertirse en un símbolo de resiliencia alegre. Enseña que la gravedad puede vencerse, aunque sea por unos segundos, mediante la fuerza centrífuga de la voluntad compartida. Los festivales, las bodas y las reuniones familiares que aún lo practican no están realizando una recreación histórica, sino manteniendo vivo un vínculo emocional con el pasado que informa el presente. Es un recordatorio constante de que la cultura no se preserva encerrándola en vitrinas, sino usándola, gastándola y renovándola en cada nuevo giro, asegurando que el legado no sea algo que se observa desde la distancia, sino algo que se vive en la piel.

Es todo por hoy.

     Hi, everyone. **@Sakana** here. I'm now taking over Top 3 so I'm here with 3 posts from some nice people in ASEAN Hive and I sorry for the delay. The first post is made by @usagigallardo015. When I was studying in Cambodia, my parents would go to town and take me or my sister or both with them to pick out stuff for school and usually it would take about an hour shopping for school supplies and an hour for buying food and random stuff.      The next post is made by @davidke20. My dad loves Indian food the most I think but that would kind of make sense because he has been to India before and I like it too but not as much as Asian food especially when my mom cooks it. Both my parents love cooking so sometimes for lunch my mom would cook stir fried noodles ( The classic Cambodian food ) and sometimes my dad would cook Indian food for dinner.      The last post is made by @kellyane. It is always good to plant your own veggies so then you won't have to go to the store to get vegetables for cooking. My mom loves planting vegetables and at my house in Cambodia the dirt is basically about maybe seventy percent clay and thirty percent dirt so it's hard to plant some veggies but she was able to plant tomatoes, sweet potato, pineapple, and a lot of herbs in pots.

We’re back today, in TWO hours, on the [Hive Discord](https://discord.gg/3sUqmmxwWm) focused on the Hive Community. 

This post is letting you know, there is two hours until we start. 

That will be at  6pm UTC | 2pm EDT | 11am PDT

#### What is the Hive Thrive Community Hour?

A HIVE discord show that will have a town hall feel to it.

We see a real gap between devs, projects, witnesses, community leaders, and everyday Hive users. There are so many people looking to feel more connected, engaged, and informed—and we want to bridge that gap. This show is about:

✅ Learning about the Hive Blockchain
✅ Sharing what what’s available to use or being worked on
✅ Exploring where Hive is headed (or could be)
✅ Identifying roadblocks—and, more importantly, finding solutions
✅ Fostering constructive and proactive discussions
✅ Providing another space for the community to engage

===
#### Meet our guest @igormuba
Igor has become one of the more active voices in the ongoing conversations around Hive’s future. He’s questioned assumptions around the DHF, challenged the way we think about incentives and accountability, and recently found himself in lengthy public discussions with @blocktrades about governance, spending, and whether Hive’s current trajectory is sustainable. 

What we’ll dig into:
- The recent discussions that have captured Hive’s attention.
- Why continue buying and supporting Hive while raising concerns about its direction?
- Is the DHF helping Hive thrive, or is it time for a serious rethink?
- What did Igor take away from his public exchanges with @blocktrades?
- Why keep building on Hive instead of taking those ideas elsewhere?
-  Does Hive have a discoverability problem, or are we simply overlooking the things already being built?
- What products, tools, and priorities should Hive actually be focused on?
- And if Igor could change one thing about Hive tomorrow, what would it be?

Join us live and jump into the conversation with the community. Whether you are deep into Hive already or just trying to understand why people are still here after all these years, there is always something worth exploring.

🎤 As always, the chat is open during the show, and the after-show continues the conversation

—————

This isn’t just another talk show—it’s modeled after a town hall for the Hive community. Whether you’re a dev, a content creator, a witness, or just someone who wants to learn and be more engaged, this is your space.

To learn more about this show and see a list of past shows visit: [Hive Thrive Show](https://peakd.com/hive-170475/@buttcoins/hive-thrive-show-60-guest-igormuba)

So mark your calendars, join the discussion, and let’s build the Hive we want to see!

🚀 See you today, June 16th @ 6 PM UTC!

# Splinterlands and Accessibility: A Practical Guide for Blind and Visually Impaired Players 🎮👁️

Hello everyone, Hive friends!

I do not claim to write a perfect guide, but anyone who, like me, uses JAWS, a screen reader for blind people, can easily enter the world of Splinterlands. Blockchain gaming offers incredible opportunities for earning and entertainment, and with the right tools and some strategies, it is possible to navigate the game ecosystem independently.

---

### 🔑 Step 1: Access and the Role of Hive Keychain

To start playing Splinterlands, the very first step involves account creation and login. At the beginning, it is not strictly necessary to install additional tools, as the game allows you to register and log in the classic way. However, my advice for those using a screen reader is to set up **Hive Keychain** right away.

#### Why does it make the whole system easier?
This tool securely manages your cryptographic keys on the Hive blockchain. Once installed, it saves you from having to continuously copy and paste long text passwords every time you need to take an action in the game, reducing the risk of typos to zero and speeding up navigation with JAWS.

#### A quick note: What are these \
?\nUnlike traditional websites that use a single password, on Hive and Splinterlands you will have several private \

available (such as the *Posting Key* or the *Active Key*). Each has a specific task: one is used only for playing and posting, the other for managing your earnings. Hive Keychain stores these keys for you, so you will never risk exposing your most important one (the Master Key) during your gaming sessions.

#### How to download Hive Keychain
The installation on a computer is very simple and is the method I personally use:

* **From Computer (PC or Mac)**: If you play from a browser (like Google Chrome, Brave, or Firefox), you just need to search for \
on the Chrome Web Store or your browser's extension catalog. JAWS recognizes the \
or \

button without any problems. Once the download is complete, the extension will be ready in your browser's toolbar.

*(Note: For the record, there is also an official application for smartphones on both Android and iOS, but not having tested it personally in this guide, I will focus exclusively on the computer experience, which I know perfectly).*

#### That's it: Ready for registration
At this point, the technical part concerning the extension is completed. You can temporarily leave it aside: it will stay there in the browser, ready to intervene automatically when necessary. 

Now we are finally ready to take the big step. You can connect directly to the official website by clicking on this link: [Splinterlands.com](https://splinterlands.com). Once the page is open, we will be ready to start the actual registration procedure.

---

### 🃏 What is Splinterlands in a few words?

Before registering, let's spend a couple of words on this title. Splinterlands is a strategic collectible card game based on the blockchain. Each card represents a monster or a summoner with unique abilities and stats. The fantastic thing for us who use a screen reader is that it is a tactical, automated \

game: once the team is deployed on the field based on the text and numbers of the cards, the battle resolves itself. No quick visual reflexes or fast mouse movements are needed, only strategy matters.

---

### 🔎 Finding the \

button with JAWS

As soon as the Splinterlands page loads in the browser, the interface might seem full of graphic elements, but for us, navigation is very simple. To find the registration command right away without scrolling down the whole page with the down arrow, I recommend using shortcut keys:

* Press the **B** (Button) key on JAWS to jump directly from button to button.
* Alternatively, open the list of buttons on the page with the combination **Insert + F5**.

Look for the button that JAWS will read as **\

). Once found, press **Enter** to open it.

### 📝 How to enter your registration data

After pressing the button, an overlay window (a pop-up form) will open. 

* **Practical tip for the screen reader**: To jump straight to the first input field and avoid scrolling through the internal graphic elements of the form, you can conveniently press the **E** (Edit) key. JAWS will instantly take you to the correct text box.

Next, you can move between the various elements using the **Tab** key. The procedure will ask for very little data:

1. **Enter Email**: In the first editable field (reached with the E key), type your email address.
2. **Confirm Email**: By pressing Tab, you will move to the second field where you will need to type the same email again for confirmation.
3. **Acceptance of Terms**: Continuing with Tab, you will reach the checkbox to accept the terms of service. Simply press the **Spacebar** to check it.

At this point, one last Tab will take you to the final button to confirm the submission of the registration.

### 📧 Checking email and choosing your username

Once the form is submitted, the Splinterlands system will send a verification email to the address you just entered. 

1. **Email Verification**: Open your email inbox, look for the message sent by Splinterlands, and click on the confirmation link inside. JAWS will easily detect the link within the email text.
2. **Choosing your Username**: After clicking on the verification link, you will be redirected back to the Splinterlands website where you will be asked to choose your username. This name will be very important: it will not only be your game nickname, but it will become your public account name on the Hive blockchain for all intents and purposes. You can use the **E** key to position yourself on the text field and type the name you prefer.
3. **The Security Password**: Immediately after confirming the name, the system will generate a complex password (your Hive private key). It is vital not to lose it: copy it carefully using JAWS commands and save it in a safe place on your computer (for example, in a protected text file). You will need this password in a few moments to configure the extension we downloaded at the beginning.

---

### 🎒 Surprise: You have just created your Hive Wallet!

There is an extraordinary detail that many new players do not know at the beginning: by completing this registration, you have not created a simple game profile, but you have opened a **Wallet (digital wallet) on the Hive blockchain** for all intents and purposes. 

This means two very important things for us navigating with JAWS:
* **One account, infinite possibilities**: With the exact same username and password you just saved, you can access not only Splinterlands, but also Ecency to write posts (just like this one!), PeakD, or any other platform in the Hive ecosystem.
* **Your earnings are safe**: The cards you win or buy and the game coins will not be saved on a company's servers, but will be deposited directly into your personal wallet, under your total control.

*Note: This is a huge and extremely interesting topic. I don't want to put too much on the table right now, so I promise I will talk about it much better and in depth in my next guide posts!*

---

### 🎮 Start playing (for free!) and the Spellbook

The best news is that at this point you are officially ready to take the field. You do not have to invest a single cent to start: Splinterlands allows you to play practice matches and start getting familiar with the interface, cards, and first battles completely for free. This is the perfect time to explore the site with JAWS, understand how monster data is read, and start testing your first strategies without any financial pressure.

If you later want to get serious and start earning real money in the form of tokens (SPS) or win tradeable cards, the game offers the opportunity to purchase the \

. This is a one-time pass that costs 10 dollars (conveniently payable with both PayPal and cryptocurrencies) that will grant you access to ranked matches. Finding the purchase banner on the site is very simple using the **B** key on JAWS, and the entire payment procedure is fully accessible.

---

### 📝 Conclusion and Next Steps

We have reached the end of this first part of the guide. I really hope that these small practical tips based on my personal experience can help other blind or visually impaired users approach this splendid game independently.

As promised, this is just the beginning! In next week's posts, we will dive into the action and see together:
* How to concretely configure the Hive Keychain extension with your keys.
* How to navigate the game board and deploy your first team.
* How to look deeper into how the Hive Wallet works.

Thank you all for reading this far! Leave me a comment to let me know what you think, if you encountered any difficulties, or if you have any tips to share. See you soon on my blog!

Yuors
Zumzulik

# Splinterlands e Accessibilità: Una Guida Pratica per Giocatori Non Vedenti e Ipovedenti 🎮👁️

Ciao a tutti, amici di Hive!

Non ho la presunzione di scrivere una guida perfetta, ma chi come me usa JAWS, uno screen reader per persone non vedenti, può tranquillamente entrare nel mondo di Splinterlands. Il gaming su blockchain offre incredibili opportunità di guadagno e intrattenimento, e con i giusti strumenti e alcune strategie è possibile navigare nell'ecosistema di gioco in autonomia.

---

### 🔑 Passo 1: L'accesso e il ruolo di Hive Keychain

Per iniziare a giocare a Splinterlands, il primissimo passo riguarda la creazione dell'account e l'accesso. All'inizio non è strettamente necessario installare strumenti aggiuntivi, poiché il gioco permette di registrarsi e accedere in modo classico. Tuttavia, il mio consiglio per chi usa uno screen reader è di configurare subito **Hive Keychain**.

#### Perché facilita tutto il sistema?
Questo strumento gestisce in sicurezza le tue chiavi crittografiche della blockchain di Hive. Una volta installato, ti risparmia il dover copiare e incollare continuamente lunghe password testuali ogni volta che devi fare un'azione nel gioco, riducendo a zero il rischio di errori di battitura e velocizzando la navigazione con JAWS.

#### Un piccolo accenno: Cosa sono queste \
?\nA differenza dei siti web tradizionali che usano una sola password, su Hive e Splinterlands avrai a disposizione diverse \

private (come la *Posting Key* o la *Active Key*). Ognuna ha un compito specifico: una serve solo per giocare e pubblicare, l'altra per gestire i tuoi guadagni. Hive Keychain custodisce queste chiavi per te, così non rischierai mai di esporre quella più importante (la Master Key) durante le tue sessioni di gioco.

#### Come scaricare Hive Keychain
L'installazione su computer è molto semplice ed è il metodo che utilizzo personalmente:

* **Da Computer (PC o Mac)**: Se giochi dal browser (come Google Chrome, Brave o Firefox), ti basta cercare \
sul Chrome Web Store o sul catalogo delle estensioni del tuo browser. JAWS riconosce senza problemi il pulsante \
o \

. Una volta completato il download, l'estensione sarà pronta nella barra degli strumenti del browser.

*(Nota: Per dovere di cronaca esiste anche l'applicazione ufficiale per smartphone sia su Android che su iOS, ma non avendola testata personalmente in questa guida mi concentrerò esclusivamente sull'esperienza da computer, che conosco alla perfezione).*

#### Il gioco è fatto: Pronti per la registrazione
A questo punto, la parte tecnica riguardante l'estensione è completata. Non serve fare nient'altro, né perdersi in configurazioni complicate. Potete momentaneamente lasciarla da parte: rimarrà lì nel browser, pronta a intervenire in automatico quando sarà necessario. 

Ora siamo finalmente pronti per fare il grande passo. Potete collegarvi direttamente al sito ufficiale cliccando su questo link: [Splinterlands.com](https://splinterlands.com). Una volta aperta la pagina, saremo pronti per avviare la procedura di registrazione vera e propria.

---

### 🃏 Cos'è Splinterlands in poche parole?

Prima di registrarci, spendiamo due parole su questo titolo. Splinterlands è un gioco di carte collezionabili strategico basato sulla blockchain. Ogni carta rappresenta un mostro o un evocatore con abilità e statistiche uniche. La cosa fantastica per noi che usiamo uno screen reader è che si tratta di un gioco tattico \

e automatizzato: una volta schierata la squadra sul campo in base al testo e ai numeri delle carte, il combattimento si risolve da solo. Non servono riflessi visivi pronti o movimenti veloci del mouse, conta solo la strategia.

---

### 🔎 Trovare il tasto \

con JAWS

Appena la pagina di Splinterlands si è caricata nel browser, l'interfaccia può sembrare piena di elementi grafici, ma per noi la navigazione è molto semplice. Per trovare subito il comando di registrazione senza scorrere tutta la pagina a freccia giù, vi consiglio di usare i tasti di scelta rapida:

* Premete il tasto **B** (Button) su JAWS per saltare direttamente di pulsante in pulsante.
* In alternativa, aprite la lista dei pulsanti della pagina con la combinazione **Insert + F5**.

Cercate il pulsante che JAWS leggerà come **\

). Una volta individuato, premete **Invio** per aprirlo.

### 📝 Come inserire i dati di registrazione

Dopo aver premuto il pulsante, si aprirà una finestra sovrapposta (un modulo pop-up). 

* **Consiglio pratico per lo screen reader**: Per saltare subito al primo campo di input ed evitare di scorrere gli elementi grafici interni al modulo, potete premere comodamente il tasto **E** (Edit). JAWS vi porterà istantaneamente nella casella di testo corretta.

Successivamente, potete muovervi tra i vari elementi utilizzando il tasto **Tab**. La procedura vi chiederà pochissimi dati:

1. **Inserimento Email**: Nel primo campo editabile (raggiunto con il tasto E), digitate il vostro indirizzo email.
2. **Conferma Email**: Premendo Tab, vi sposterete sul secondo campo dove dovrete digitare nuovamente la stessa email per conferma.
3. **Accettazione dei Termini**: Continuando con il Tab, arriverete sulla casella di controllo (checkbox) per accettare i termini di servizio. Vi basterà premere la **Barra Spaziatrice** per spuntarla.

A questo punto, un ultimo Tab vi porterà sul pulsante finale per confermare l'invio della registrazione.

### 📧 Controllo della mail e scelta del nome utente

Una volta inviato il modulo, il sistema di Splinterlands vi invierà una email di verifica all'indirizzo che avete appena inserito. 

1. **Verifica della mail**: Aprite la vostra casella di posta elettronica, cercate il messaggio inviato da Splinterlands e cliccate sul link di conferma contenuto all'interno. JAWS rileverà facilmente il link all'interno del testo della mail.
2. **Scelta dello Username**: Dopo aver cliccato sul link di verifica, verrete reindirizzati sul sito di Splinterlands dove vi verrà chiesto di scegliere il vostro nome utente (Username). Questo nome sarà importantissimo: non sarà solo il vostro nickname di gioco, ma diventerà a tutti gli effetti il nome del vostro account pubblico sulla blockchain di Hive. Potete usare il tasto **E** per posizionarvi sul campo di scrittura e digitare il nome che preferite.
3. **La Password di sicurezza**: Subito dopo aver confermato il nome, il sistema genererà una password complessa (la vostra chiave privata di Hive). È fondamentale non perderla: copiatela con cura utilizzando i comandi di JAWS e salvatela in un posto sicuro sul vostro computer (ad esempio in un file di testo protetto). Questa password vi servirà tra pochissimo per configurare l'estensione che abbiamo scaricato all'inizio.

---

### 🎒 Sorpresa: Avete appena creato il vostro Wallet Hive!

C'è un dettaglio straordinario che molti nuovi giocatori all'inizio non sanno: completando questa registrazione, non avete creato un semplice profilo di gioco, ma avete aperto a tutti gli effetti un **Wallet (portafoglio digitale) sulla blockchain di Hive**. 

Questo significa due cose importantissime per noi che navighiamo con JAWS:
* **Un account, infinite possibilità**: Con lo stesso identico nome utente e la stessa password che avete appena salvato, potete accedere non solo a Splinterlands, ma anche a Ecency per scrivere post (proprio come questo!), a PeakD, o a qualsiasi altra piattaforma dell'ecosistema Hive.
* **I vostri guadagni al sicuro**: Le carte che vincerete o acquisterete e le monete del gioco non saranno salvate sui server di un'azienda, ma saranno depositate direttamente nel vostro wallet personale, sotto il vostro totale controllo.

*Nota: Questo è un argomento vastissimo ed estremamente interessante. Non voglio mettere troppa carne al fuoco adesso, quindi vi prometto che ne parlerò molto meglio e in modo approfondito nei miei prossimi post guida!*

---

### 🎮 Iniziare a giocare (senza spendere nulla!) e lo Spellbook

La notizia migliore è che a questo punto siete ufficialmente pronti per scendere in campo. Non dovete investire un solo centesimo per iniziare: Splinterlands permette infatti di fare partite di prova e iniziare a prendere confidenza con l'interfaccia, le carte e i primi combattimenti in modo totalmente gratuito. Questo è il momento perfetto per esplorare il sito con JAWS, capire come vengono letti i dati dei mostri e iniziare a testare le vostre prime strategie senza alcuna pressione finanziaria.

Se in seguito vorrete fare sul serio e iniziare a guadagnare denaro reale sotto forma di token (SPS) o vincere carte scambiabili, il gioco offre la possibilità di acquistare lo \

. Si tratta di un pass unico che costa 10 dollari (pagabile comodamente sia con PayPal che in criptovalute) che vi darà il diritto di accedere alle partite classificate. Trovare il banner per l'acquisto sul sito è molto semplice usando il tasto **B** di JAWS, e l'intera procedura di pagamento è pienamente accessibile.

---

### 📝 Conclusioni e Prossimi Passi

Siamo arrivati alla fine di questa prima parte della guida. Spero davvero che questi piccoli accorgimenti pratici basati sulla mia esperienza personale possano aiutare altri utenti non vedenti o ipovedenti ad approcciarsi a questo splendido gioco in totale autonomia.

Come promesso, questo è solo l'inizio! Nei post della prossima settimana entreremo nel vivo dell'azione e vedremo insieme:
* Come configurare concretamente l'estensione Hive Keychain con le vostre chiavi.
* Come navigare la plancia di gioco e schierare la prima squadra.
* Come approfondire il funzionamento del Wallet di Hive.

Grazie a tutti per aver letto fin qui! Lasciatemi un commento per dirmi cosa ne pensate, se avete riscontrato difficoltà o se avete suggerimenti da condividere. Ci leggiamo presto sul mio blog!

Il vostro
Zumzulik
