‎In a world where money perform wonders, its impact is still being undermined by most people. The reason is quite simple, most people have never experienced what it feels like to have enough, it is quite sad. Financial stability is a dream of everyone, a dream many might chase till the end of their days and yet not taste what it feels like. We chase financial stability to be able afford our wishes and dreams, this is why it is so important because money plays a significant role in turning our dreams into reality.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQudcw3JQwjkCzs6nSY1rNMAfcfHoRHyaLBqTTmoQnNKQ/1781625004589.png)

‎If there is something that haunt my mind, it is definitely ideas. I have and will always continue, to be an ambitious person but it comes with limitations, Which is lack of adequate funds to implement my ideas. ***What will I do if I won 1 million dollars tomorrow?*** Firstly, I will dive into the archive of my business ideas. It is very tormenting to have rare business ideas and still lack capital to achieve it. Ideas will always remain ideas without funds, but without such limitation, the height of the empire I would establish will go far beyond international but inter-universe kind of trades.
‎
‎I have had something I haven't been able to achieve for years now, it is so huge that it feels like it might take a lifetime to get it done. A fully registered self sufficient livestock farm with natural animal feed production, has always been my dream. I broke it down into little achievable goals and every single day I get closer to it but then, the closer I get - the more it feels like I still have so much to do. It might look like I have come so far but why does the end line seems so far away. Every single moment I find myself reviewing things to be done, setting new goals to be achieved.
‎
‎Everyone keep saying, you might end up drowning yourself if you keep aiming at this dream of yours, which is something I'm quite aware of. I myself once wrote a post on it and titled it [A billion dollars dream](https://ecency.com/@emrysjobber/or-or-s-0fe63be72b2f7) which means I'm quite aware of how difficult it is to get it done, I'm never in denial of my own weakness but all I could say to these people is, \
‎‎What will you do, if you won, $1 million tomorrow?\

Greetings Hivers.

There is something admirable about stray cats. They move through the noise and rush of everyday life as if they belonged to another time, observing everything with a calm that seems unshakable. body.title: Cultura callejera// ​Street culture (ENG-ESP)
body.body:
**English**

Hello to the whole community. On Sunday, there was a special performance by the National Circus of Cuba in Guanabacoa. The celebration is part of the municipality's Culture Week. It had been a while since we've seen this kind of movement in the streets, so it was a great opportunity to practice documentary photography.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS9TwaXmpmaAjp9THWAANzt7St5qW5tmHXYU4U8pqPJPX/1781539411381.jpg)</center>

​The crowd was small, unlike past street cultural activities. Nonetheless, the atmosphere was very cheerful. There was a puppeteer, a clown, a magician, and a fire-eater. They all performed brilliantly, completely capturing the children's attention and leaving them amazed.

In the crowd, there was a little boy who was afraid of the puppets and would funnily run away from them every time the puppeteer tried to get close to him.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNq1LyjvJaXKuHTjNFCmAsLG8cyHiwcTTtV6mL238zJmo/1781539411137.jpg)</center>

These kinds of street shows move very fast—neither the performers nor the kids stand still, and the sun was already very harsh. I loved the fire-eater's performance and felt dynamic but unsatisfied with the few photos I got of his act. However, maybe I'll catch another similar event in the future, and now I know the exact moment I want to freeze.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgehTAYtaxVuCFSmbyMQd7dvpBX3JAbVefUwbBfQdDC2/1781539452386.jpg)</center>

The show started a bit later than planned, perhaps because they were waiting for a larger audience to show up, or maybe the performers ran into some kind of mishap. I imagine that these days, with all the struggles we face, artists have to fight tooth and nail to keep their passion alive.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQDqEhz3PCpKxu6YcihviKDNYGPBdGbxAwjefNZY7KrdA/1781539452540.jpg)</center>

Before things got started, I took advantage of the majesty of the Guanabacoa church and the circus's colorful banners to take a photo that contrasted the town's colonial architecture with the joy of the show.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4JmgamcEa8DZYHrPL8AhGTpzLMMyNRST9kQAFFqZ4YF/1781539411639.jpg)</center>

​The fire-eater's act was truly impressive, and when I looked at the photos, I had a good laugh seeing the children's expressions. Maybe I looked just like them, except I was focused on capturing the best expression with my phone's camera.
​I think these kinds of cultural activities provide a healthy distraction for Cuban families without them needing to leave their own neighborhoods.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtnssoeSUz2uezKmk1U1RkhDaJ3QX63bByF9kT5eKu1k/1781539452655.jpg)</center>

***
***

**Español**

Hola a toda la comunidad. El domingo hubo una presentación especial del Circo Nacional de Cuba  en Guanabacoa. La celebración viene dada por la Semana de la Cultura en el municipio. Hacía tiempo que no habían movimientos de este tipo en las calles, así que fue una oportunidad genial para practicar fotografía documental. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS9TwaXmpmaAjp9THWAANzt7St5qW5tmHXYU4U8pqPJPX/1781539411381.jpg)</center>

El público era pequeño, a diferencia de otras actividades culturales callejeras en otros tiempos. No obstante, el ambiente fue muy alegre. Hubo un titiritero, un payaso, un mago y un tragafuegos. Todos actuaron de forma genial, hasta el punto de captar toda la atención de los niños y asombrándolos. 

En la multitud, había un niño pequeño al que le daban miedo los títeres y huía de ellos de forma graciosa cada vez que el titiritero intentaba acercarse a él.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNq1LyjvJaXKuHTjNFCmAsLG8cyHiwcTTtV6mL238zJmo/1781539411137.jpg)</center>

Estos tipos de espectáculos callejeros son muy rápidos, los artistas ni los niños se están quietos  y el sol ya estaba muy fuerte. Me encantó la actuación del tragafuegos y me sentí insatisfecha con las pocas fotos que me salieron de su presentación. Aunque, quizás vuelva a estar presente en otras actividades parecidas y ya sé el momento exacto que quiero congelar. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgehTAYtaxVuCFSmbyMQd7dvpBX3JAbVefUwbBfQdDC2/1781539452386.jpg)</center>

El espectáculo comenzó un poco tarde a lo que habían planeado, quizás esperando que apareciera más público o a los artistas se le presentó algún tipo de percance. Imagino que en estos tiempos, con todos los problemas que enfrentamos, los artistas tienen que luchar a pulmón para mantener viva su pasión. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQDqEhz3PCpKxu6YcihviKDNYGPBdGbxAwjefNZY7KrdA/1781539452540.jpg)</center>

Antes de comenzar, aproveché la majestuosidad de la iglesia de Guanabacoa y las banderas de colores del circo para hacer una foto que contrastara la arquitectura colonial de la villa con la alegría del espectáculo.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4JmgamcEa8DZYHrPL8AhGTpzLMMyNRST9kQAFFqZ4YF/1781539411639.jpg)</center>

El acto del tragafuegos fue verdaderamente impresionante y cuando vi las fotos me reí bastante viendo las expresiones de los niños. Quizás yo también estaba como ellos solo que concentrada en tomar la mejor expresión con la cámara de mi celular.  

Pienso que estos tipos de actividades culturales distraen de manera sana a la familia cubana sin tener la necesidad de salir de sus propios barrios.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtnssoeSUz2uezKmk1U1RkhDaJ3QX63bByF9kT5eKu1k/1781539452655.jpg</center>

***
***

body.title: Splinterlands game new Escalation pack opening experience and card analysis
body.body: <div class=\

> Hello splinterlands One of the most interesting aspects of the Splinterlands game is its ever-changing meta and the inclusion of new card sets. Conclave Arcana Escalation is one such new edition, which has given players the opportunity to create new strategies. In such card games, each card has its own characteristics, and using the right card at the right time can determine the outcome of the match. Today, we will discuss the cards received after purchasing a pack of this new set and their general functionality. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXqXzMbkLk2gf6XbdUBFb3zuUXN4jYZA6UAyrmMov8b3z/1781625062996.jpg) The entire process of purchasing the pack is quite simple and straightforward. This Escalation pack is collected by spending 5,000 credits from the game shop. After purchasing the pack, the account balance can be changed, which is part of the normal transaction process of the game. Each pack contains five cards and according to the game rules, at least one card is guaranteed to be rare or better. To open the pack, you have to go to the game's 'Mana-Well' interface. There, the gorgeous red and gold design on the back of the cards appears on the screen, which creates a kind of curiosity among players. Then the cards are flipped one by one and revealed. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYq4UdaDiXUpxDVu2q4oXRZkABmy35PNsp7wPHcp8mCRc/1781624912767.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdGgKR2NSdTACBNmKy5KLetpvTRECFEz8GgwTxku6nsPW/1781624912841.jpg) The first card obtained from this pack opening is the Earth element's 'Living Berm'. It is a common card with a mana cost of 10. Analyzing its stats, it can be seen that it has 3 micro attack, 3 armor, and 6 health. Although this card is difficult to use in normal small matches due to its high mana cost, it can play a very effective role in large-scale or high-mana cap battles. Due to its good combination of armor and health, it can survive on the frontline for some time. The second card found is the only rare card in this pack, 'Drifting Manatee'. It is a water element card with a mana cost of only 3. The specialty of the card is its relatively high health (6) against its low mana cost. In addition, it has 1 magic attack and 2 armor. It is usually difficult to find good quality defensive cards in low mana matches, in which case this card can be a good addition for water deck users. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZkBRUTwfBX64LXHpTpuGWXF3YvipVD5cuSpfgHkbMfk/1781624936626.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZGqEChFci36aBYyRvV3HzuTH7kcGBhnmyKoNqVxydHk2/1781624936670.jpg) The third card is the Life Element's 'Steelshield Arbalest'. This is a common card with a mana cost of 9. It has 5 speed, 5 armor and 5 health, as well as a ranged attack of 2. Due to its high speed, it will have the opportunity to attack before the opponent's cards. It is a useful card for long-range attacks from the back line. The fourth card is the largest and heaviest card in this pack, called 'Doomshield Warden'. This Life Element common card has a mana cost of 14, which is one of the highest mana cost cards in the game. However, its power is not small either. It has 4 micro attack, 7 armor and 9 health. With a large amount of armor and health, it will be able to withstand major attacks from the opponent. Especially in matches where there is no or very high mana limit, this card can be a great strength for the defense line. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUanC138cTGQJFSJjDwXSBV5LbPenBKSeE4Sy4EzP4yqz/1781625008556.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdMZj4G8vpykTBeNYwGVidZ8q7JCAHzDVW3NEDPsCEVYA/1781625008603.jpg) The fifth and final card is the Death Element's 'Shire Knocker'. This 5 mana common card has 2 ranged attacks, 1 armor, and 4 health. This medium-quality card can be used as a backup ranged attacker in any normal match. An overall assessment of these five cards shows that there is quite a variety in the mana of the cards obtained. There are small cards of 3 mana, as well as huge cards of 14 or 10 mana. Card games have to face different situations, so these cards will help to increase the diversity of the deck. New cards will enrich the player's collection a bit and create opportunities for using some new strategies in future matches. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRZtMskgn8d4zcpv27xJwmGJvq247fQB6ZBKsC1JU4JT/1768123335168.png)

body.title: Starting in December, social networks will not be what they are.
body.body:
Starting in December, social networks will not be what they are.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYvwT62B6MQRa71N43m4wVbkmzPWFt97gsQvUAvo4UarN/image.png
AI

> It is truly amazing that something as serious as what I am going to tell you goes completely unnoticed and only a few comment on it, the rest seem to live in Narnia, and that is that the largest YouTube video platform can disappear.


YouTube may have its days numbered, specifically until December 26 of this year, from that date onwards, goodbye, and with YouTube Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and many other social networks may be gone. I know that at this very moment you are thinking that I am an exaggerator, a conspiracy theorist, that I am doing this to achieve something, but, yes, there is a but.


Think what you want about me, but at least give me the opportunity to tell you and then call me whatever you want, but at least read until the end; Social networks are going to disappear in the European Union and I know how they are going to do it and I am going to tell you, the quickest measure of the typical dictatorships like they do in China or North Korea is to simply block the platforms, ban them, so that you cannot connect to them.


But the European Union is more civil, it is going to do the same, but without being noticed. But the same. There are two ways to end someone who is annoying, eliminating them directly or taking control of them, and to do this, before jumping into the law of prominence, the regulation of algorithms, and the list of truthful information, let me give you an example that you will all understand.


Imagine that the European Union wants to prohibit you from consuming meat, does not want you to consume meat and does not like you to go to Burger King, they have Burger King in their sights because it is the temple of meat. The European Union has two options, ban Burger King and close it or take control of Burger King and that is what the European Union is going to do with YouTube.


Imagine that you enter Burger King, you go to get your whopper, but it surprises you and this is going to happen starting December 26 on YouTube, you enter Burger King and say, \
You stand in front of the order board and say, \

And instead you see a list, tofu burger, lentil pasta burger, soy burger, beetle protein burger, cochineal protein burger and you don't see a single Whooper on the menu. You go to the vending machines, you start looking at the screen like crazy, promotions, we have soybeans on sale, we have chickpea pasta on sale. where is my whopeer? It's not at the end or you order what you see on the menu, you have to go.


This is what the European Union is going to do with YouTube, it is going to decide what it is going to offer you, starting in December, when you enter YouTube, you will not see the channels that go against the official media, and the others will not be there because the algorithm is going to sink us to the basement.


You will surely prefer to leave YouTube and not watch anything, others will leave YouTube angry because YouTube may have the same logo, the same system. But it will no longer be YouTube, because if what you find is precisely what you have heard about, television and the major media, what you are going to see is one more terminal. It will continue to be YouTube, but it will not be YouTube, it will have died, it will have disappeared.


And how many people who are now working and making an effort and eating every day to denounce everything that happens and see that their views will be seen by 800, 900 people, 1000, 2000, they will leave little by little, they will leave and other people will also leave YouTube and YouTube will disappear because, even if Burger King continues with the logo, if it sells tofu it is no longer Burger King. Yes, YouTube, although it still has the logo, is a cloned repetition of the media, but it will no longer be YouTube. This is the European Union. This does not happen in the United States, it is protected by the first amendment.

Es importante tener estos espacios neutros siendo niño, lugares seguros donde simplemente puedas ser. Recuerdo que estaba de vacaciones con mi familia y mi abuelo me daba moneda local para las máquinas mientras él veía el espectáculo y se tomaba una cerveza. Muy especial. --- Français: J'aurai toujours de beaux souvenirs des arcades. C'est important d'avoir ces espaces tiers quand on est enfant, des endroits sûrs où on peut juste... être. Je me souviens qu'on était en vacances en famille et mon grand-père me donnait de la monnaie locale pour les machines pendant qu'il regardait le spectacle et prenait une bière. Précieux. --- Português: Sempre vou ter boas memórias dos fliperama. É importante ter esses espaços neutros quando você é criança, lugares seguros onde você pode simplesmente ser. Lembro de estar de férias com a minha família e meu avô me dando moeda local para as máquinas enquanto ele assistia ao show e tomava uma cerveja. Muito especial. --- বাংলা: আমার সবসময় আর্কেড মেশিনের সুন্দর স্মৃতি থাকবে। ছোটবেলায় এই ধরনের তৃতীয় স্থানগুলি থাকা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ, নিরাপদ জায়গা যেখানে তুমি শুধু থাকতে পারো। মনে আছে পরিবারের সাথে ছুটিতে ছিলাম আর দাদা আমাকে মেশিনের জন্য স্থানীয় টাকা দিচ্ছিলেন, আর তিনি বিনোদন দেখছিলেন এবং বিয়ার খাচ্ছিলেন। সত্যিই মূল্যবান। --- *Originally published at [https://sett.ee/2026/06/16/ill-always-have-fond-memories.html](https://sett.ee/2026/06/16/ill-always-have-fond-memories.html)* ---

body.title: The South Africa Economy Is On Life Support
body.body: Dong business in South Africa is a struggle at the best of times due to the lack of customers and disposable cash. When you consider there are an estimated 60% of the population unemployed. Adding to that percentage a high percentage of the middle income group is heavily in debt with something like 60 -70% of their income pay being used to pay for existing debt. Businesses have a mountain to climb in order to succeed with a heavy tax system being one of the issues plus regulations of who you can and cannot employ based on skin color and not necessarily their experiences or knowledge. Over the last 3 years there has also been additional local municipal regulations put in place which only adds to the burden. Being involved in business myself you can see how other businesses are struggling and it is not easy to make ends meet. In the last two months we have seen two of our clients voluntarily liquidate which was a new experience for myself and fully understand the reasoning behind what they did. These companies have not disappeared entirely, but most definitely changed how they conduct business and was more of a survival type must do or disappear scenario. One of the companies that tracks the data for liquidations in South Africa has revised how they collect and read the data and have realized what they had compiled previously was not necessarily showing the reality. Logically with the unemployment rate being so high there has to be many companies that have vanished form the scene never to be seen again.

/></center>

[source](https://businesstech.co.za/news/business/861762/liquidations-in-south-africa-much-worse-than-previously-reported-as-233-more-companies-shut-down/)

As you can see by the above data the under reporting does make a big difference and this is more in line of what I had expected to see over the last few years. These are businesses of varying size and represent real time jobs that have simply vanished.

Since 2023 the curve is increasing and this is the tend I have noticed in the business world and why one has to be so careful who they have as a client. One business hitting the wall can have a domino affect taking dozens with them through money owed and you need to be aware.

With ever increasing running costs such as interest rates, electricity and fuel the challenges of staying alive are that much harder. One can only increase their prices so much before it directly impacts the business so the profitability is not maintaining the same rate as inflation. Salaries are worth less than they were 5 years ago with regard to buying power and employees cannot complain as they are lucky to have employment.

Just this last week I had a chat with my employees as I know how tough things are for everyone. As owners we have not taken a salary for the last two months because keeping the business a float is what counts and not about you personally. Sacrifices have to be made in order to see this through and this does depend on how deep your pockets are. Thankfully we are more than comfortable for now, but not everyone is so lucky as every business has different circumstances and challenges unique to themselves.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/the-south-africa-economy-is-on-life-support-evm)

links.title: Sapien Loop 3 – Part Three
links.body:
Hi Everyone,

![Sapien_Loop_3_Part_3.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVfVcRD9tPzeqbs18eVXia2qDjodssR.gif)

With the resistance out of the way, Tiberius shifts his focus on Orcilla and the cult tribe. He decides he will go to the West Camp to lead a military campaign against them. He leaves his adopted son, Duffo, in charge while he is gone.

Orcilla has recreated Pardi’s 19CE serum. She tries it out on a follower, and when it proves successful, she gives it to the High Philosopher. A short while later, Demadrian finalises his version of the serum. He instructs Orcilla to administer it to him and Julio. Demadrian goes through a tumultuous transformation but is able to survive. Julio does not seem to respond at all but remains alive in a deep coma.

Miro comes up with a plan to drive the cult tribe out into the open. This involved disrupting their power supply and source of light. The High Philosopher, Orcilla and Demadrian decide they need to act before they are forced to the surface. They make a move towards the Downs Region. This forces Tiberius and his enforcers out of the West Camp to confront them.

The cult’s bold move towards the Downs Region left the underground city unguarded. Tiberius anticipated this would be the case. He sent Cecil and another contingent of enforcers to invade them.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Part 3: The War Begins and Chapter 35: Fool’s Wealth](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-part-3-the-war-begins-and-chapter-35-fool-s-wealth)

Hermon, the new head of the Economic Institute, issues the new currency to the technicians and the very few remaining Downs residents. 

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 36: Forgiveness](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-36-forgiveness)

Walter finally forgives Phillip for eating Julie’s cakes. Cecil returns to the West Camp with a massive army. Octavius and his Sentray are forced to leave.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 37: Family and Friends](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-37-family-and-friends)

The Downs workers and technicians in the camps are finally given the opportunity to speak directly to their family and friends. Freddy becomes deeply distressed when his family does not make the timeslot to speak with him. Tiberius decides to leave Downs Region to lead the war effort against the cult. 

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 38: Test Day](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-38-test-day)

Orcilla has recreated Pardi’s 19CE serum. Julio has decided that one of the followers tries the serum before it is given to the High Philosopher. Orcilla comes up with an idea to lure the enforcers out of the West Camp.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 39: Cruelty Knows No Bounds](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-39-cruelty-knows-no-bounds)

Before leaving the Downs Region, Tiberius visits Lily one more time. He continues to use his enforcers to torture her. Afterwards, he meets with Duffo. He manipulates him into continuing the torture.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 40: It’s His Day](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-40-it-s-his-day)

Pardi’s 19CE serum has been proven to be safe. The High Philosopher is now ready for his dosage. 

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 41: Painful Lessons](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-41-painful-lessons)

Tiberius, Miro, and the imperial guards have arrived at the West Camp. Tiberius is unhappy with Revals over Walter’s training. He decides to punish him brutally to scare Walter into behaving himself.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 42: Plans Start To Roll](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-42-plans-start-to-roll)

Demadrian feels confident his serum is ready. Orcilla sedates both Demadrian and Julio and then injects them with the serum. After losing his hand, Revals is extremely depressed. Walter feels bad for him and makes an effort to cheer him up.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 43: This Will Push Them Over the Edge](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-43-this-will-push-them-over-the-edge)

Tiberius calls another meeting with his military leadership team to discuss how to draw the cult followers from their underground city.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 44: Lights Out](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-44-lights-out)

Power has been cut from the West Tribe’s underground city. Frank is deeply upset as it stops him from running full rehearsals for his musical. The West Tribe agrees to join the Cult Tribe to take on the Empire.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 45: The Chase Begins](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-45-the-chase-begins)

The West Tribe and Cult convoy of vehicles have reached the surface and are heading east towards the Downs Region. Miro and his convoy of enforcers have set off in pursuit of them.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 46: Doubting Allegiances](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-46-doubting-allegiances)

RJ has decided to make some extra money from his cakes. Walter puts an abrupt end to this plan. Meanwhile, something else strange appears to be going on.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 47: The Race Is On](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-47-the-race-is-on)

Both convoys are racing towards the Downs Region. Miro’s convoy is falling behind. Tiberius orders Miro to move faster, leaving the slower vehicles behind.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 48: Who Am I?](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-48-who-am-i)

Maskameera returns to the cult’s underground city. She takes advantage of their weak defences to capture the High Philosopher. She uses his connection to the bones of the Linap he was cloned from to reveal a shocking history.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 49: The Great Battle Above](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/saien-loop-3-chapter-49-the-great-battle-above)

The first group of Miro’s convoy cuts off the cult’s convoy. Despite being outnumbered, the cult has a few surprises that even the playing field. The second group of Miro’s convoy encounters another problem, which might have swung the battle in favour of the cult.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 50: Terror Below](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-50-terror-below)

The enforcers have arrived at the cult’s underground city. Maskameera is still holding the High Philosopher hostage. Things are about to take a horrible turn for the worse.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 51: Aftermath](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-51-aftermath)

Miro and a group of surviving enforcers have safely reached the Downs region. He calls an immediate meeting with the executive council. The cult convoy and Sentray have departed the second site of the Great Battle. Orcilla makes contact with Frank demanding an explanation for why the West Tribe abandoned them at the last minute before the battle.

-----

## The Sapien Loop Series

![Loop_Series.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uFHJ6RctoaR7JdX6JCqpxxZqfbR1uEmwbcd6NoJfaiCzK5S3sGDs5tFqqvNGY7ouzYh.gif)

I am writing a trilogy of books titled Sapien Loop. The first in the series is [Sapien Loop: End of an Era](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CSF3TTVF) and the second is [Sapien Loop: Frozen in Time](https://www.amazon.com/Sapien-Loop-2-Frozen-Time-ebook/dp/B0DSWKGXX3). I published both of these books as ebooks on Amazon, and I have posted completed chapters to my @captainhive account. I anticipate publishing the third book in early 2027. I expect to title this book Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide. 

In 2025, I wrote a [short stories book](https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0G1MP5JVF) about some of the characters and their adventures. This book is now available on Amazon. I have also posted these stories to my @captainhive account.

## Brief Summary of Sapien Loop: End of an Era

<center>![Sapien_Loop_Full_Hive.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23zGebDBwFPpB2PMXWTHr428cPjoJbzCFpWmGn1aJSFQreBA9aboCEQK6LUQK1X2xGW21.gif)</center>

This story is based on the fictional planet Sapia and its sole country, Sapey. Sapey is portrayed as a form of utopia for all its citizens. No poverty. No war. Almost no crime. Opportunities for all.

This was enough for most citizens, but not all. In one of the small regions, some of the citizens had become discontent. They felt something important was missing in their lives. Their discontent did not go unnoticed. Some of the Sapey elite wanted to weaponise this discontent to gain more power. This created more chaos than they anticipated. This led to further widespread social unrest.

On top of the chaos, ambition and greed provoked another enemy. This enemy was on a mission to settle both new and old scores.

## Brief Summary of Sapien Loop: Frozen in Time

![Sapien_Loop_2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uQJt3boCwrJj4ViDQL1SJTiJ3bTX3AMwAvGktY4ybQ6eTZqU23Y1Fzwg68Rvat9MiV7.gif)

This story is based six years after the original story. The Downs Region is still suffering from a serious health crisis caused by the contaminated water. The main characters are desperately trying to find a cure for the illness that has been caused by the water. 

One of the main characters has discovered frozen humanoids in hidden chambers. It appears they have been frozen for a long time. These chambers connect to a vast network of tunnels. While exploring the tunnels, one of the frozen humanoids disappears. It appears he has been stolen. 

The story takes a step back in time to tell the story of the frozen humanoids. How and why were they frozen? This part of the story also explains the fall of ancient Sapey and the birth of the Sapiens. Can those from the past be able to coexist with those from the present? 

## Hive: Future of Social Media
 
<center>![Hive_Social_1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23tm96bQUYSEwtpU7PHnXP8Fjqn3JtUYpHHKRWVvqVv7aoA2CgZbcoEsXGuCUFgpSWEmn.gif)</center>
 
## Spectrumecons on the **Hive Blockchain**
 
<center>![2025_GIF.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uEwxs5ePX1jsTBhQNdrKritHJcVuek3QXFfqRXv4k6sjwADjCmCSoLrx8XGTVeTntZs.gif)</center>

links.body:
Introduction


Hello everyone, @glecerioberto here, and welcome to today's #TravelDigest! Who’s up for some incredible adventures today? Our Top 3 travel posts are sure to inspire you. We start with a stroll through the iconic canals and history of Hamburg in Germany. Then, we head into nature to explore the dramatic waterfalls and mountain villages of northern Portugal, followed by a beautiful hike along the quiet woodland trails of Spain. If you wish to continue your journey around the globe, check out our Honorable Mentions featuring fantastic locations from Australia, France, Indonesia, and the Czech Republic. Enjoy!


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Our Second Day in Hamburg by @rebet

Hello everyone. I actually started writing about our second day in Hamburg a while ago, but due to a busy schedule I couldn't share it until now. On our second day we slept in and turned on full lazy mode, waiting for the weather to warm up a bit. Once we finally got up, we headed to the city center and got off at Hauptbahnhof Nord. It turned out that the day before, we hadn’t even set foot in the main area where all the canals and ports are. In other words I had completely missed the most iconic spot of these famous canals and harbors on our first day. I had actually marked it on the map the previous day and was heading right toward it. But I fell victim to the navigation and passed right by it without noticing. We stepped onto a promenade near the train station. Along the way, we encountered the classic shops you see everywhere. McDonald's, Primark, shoe stores, Mango and denim shops.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 Hiking trails, natural pools, waterfalls and mountain villages in northern Portugal by @digi-me

A visit to the Paneda-Gerês National Park was one of the best excursions I did on my ten day visit to Porto. This park covers 270 square miles of forrest, mountains, rivers and waterfalls. The park, which is the only national park in Portugal, is located in the north-east corner, bordering Spain. When the park was established, there were villages in the mountains. These villages are still inhabited. If you are lucky you might encounter wildlife like wild horses and even wolves. There are more than a hundred trails to choose from. You can do day trips or multiday hikes. The variaty of trails are vast. But, the most popular are the trails that lead to waterfalls and river pools with crystal-clear water. I joined a tour with a guide, which was probably the best choice for me.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Hiking, new trails and a viewpoint overlooking the sky beyond the sun 📷 Málaga – Spain by @avdesing

Green spaces, woodland parks and botanical gardens are like giant lungs that breathe life into every human being, and visiting them transforms a simple walk into a sublime and extraordinary experience.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin

Hello everyone...

My name is Marsdave, and this is my entry for the contest.
*\

*
It's a story about finding my place on Hive, discovering a community that believes in creators, and ultimately finding a home.

(This month, rather than appearing on screen, I chose a different path).

I really hope you enjoy it 😊

When I just joined hive, it felt like I was in an unknown land, and I'm sure a host of others creating on here feel the same too.


You put your work out there and keep checking to see if someone has noticed it. Sometimes you feel like quitting; at times you think about the hours you spent engaging, and creating contents, still it feels like you're doing nothing. 

I know that feeling so well. I was there for a long time until I found Neoxian. It looked like every other community at first, but the more I searched, the more I realized how different it was.

I made it to Neoxian City, and I was amazed at the welcome I got. I wasn't treated differently; rather, I was encouraged and supported. 

Neoxian City, a city where there's no competition, where everyone is helped to grow, supported, encouraged, and seen.

A city protected by the Great Neoxian himself, we call him Mr. Dragon. A city with various jobbers who work tirelessly while creating a good environment that helps talents and various creators to thrive.

Neoxian City, I'm glad I found you. A city filled with various talents and creators from different parts of the world.

I'm proud of Neoxian City, not just as a fellow creator, not just as a participant of this contest, but as a bonafide citizen of Neoxian... The city that never sleeps.

links.title: [Es-En] Tutorial Traje Negro & Blanco DIY Outfit Black & White
links.body: >Muy buen martes queridos hivers y amantes de las costuras. Hoy estoy feliz porque me hice un conjunto abrigo y pantalón ¡SOÑADO! Hace mucho habia visto eso en pinterest, luego una amiga decide festejar su cumpleaños de blanco y negro, en la busqueda de vitrina tras vitrina decidí hacerlo. Pues, no suelo usar ropa de esos colores, me gusta más andar estilo guacamaya y realmente me parecía todo muy costoso para algo que probablemente no vuelva a usar. Happy Tuesday, dear Hivers and sewing enthusiasts. Today I’m happy because I made myself a coat and pants set that’s just DREAMY! I’d seen something like this on Pinterest a long time ago, and then a friend decided to celebrate her birthday in black and white. After searching through store window after store window, I decided to make it. Well, I don’t usually wear clothes in those colors—I prefer a more vibrant, colorful style—and it all seemed really expensive to me for something I probably wouldn’t wear again. --- ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23zSNJN9ikEfvhvY8QUJP5xJBfi3jT2ULzLnMDp41iXTqaC4tarZW3nXoAhrtGmmBSN8e.png) ---

>Entonces, una tarde luego del trabajo, me fui a una venta de telas cercana, entre el mapa y mi sentido de ubicación que no es muy bueno, llegue justo antes del cierre, menos mal ya sabía yo que era lo que quería, por eso es muy importante tener una referencia visual, bien sea dibujado a mano o una fotografía como fue mi caso: un pantalón de pepas y un abrigo blanco porque acá ya empezó el frío. Yo tomé un diseño de pinterest y con chat gpt empecé a cambiar la combinación, hasta elegir la que más me favorece. So, one afternoon after work, I went to a nearby fabric store. Relying on a map and my not-so-great sense of direction, I arrived just before closing time. Luckily, I already knew what I wanted—that’s why it’s so important to have a visual reference, whether it’s a hand-drawn sketch or a photograph, as was the case for me: a pair of polka-dot pants and a white coat, because it’s already starting to get cold here. I took a design from Pinterest and, using ChatGPT, started changing up the color combination until I found the one that looked best on me. --- ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23z7aj8HEYsFVQYRADoFTMgirqmvqMdHzqzU3bh7QY7DL2rvBTfKT3RfvqFvqc82pGkJd.png) --- ![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23yJbg7YRwRfFay98vvJ3YU1VLEQNNwuuAbRUVBWDQ6HeMiR4Y3TqPcTFuGRmTFVp2VPp.png) ---

>Gracias a eso pude elegir las telas fácilmente, ya que no podía divertirme con colores, los hice con textura, para el abrigo elegí la tela corderito, es como para peluches, de algodón y suave, para el pantalón elegí la lycra Sofía. Compré 1m ⅕ de cada uno, por eso de los márgenes de costuras y por si me equivocaba, pues, tenía un poco más de un año sin tocar la máquina de coser. Thanks to that, I was able to choose the fabrics easily. Since I couldn’t play around with colors, I went with textured fabrics instead. For the coat, I chose the “corderito” fabric—it’s like the kind used for stuffed animals, made of cotton and very soft—and for the pants, I chose the “Sofía” Lycra. I bought 1m ⅕ of each, to account for seam allowances and just in case I made a mistake—after all, it had been a little over a year since I’d last used the sewing machine. --- ![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23zGye2Z7gJwhVwt28zjsXTZ3jRJAfnHxdXfa1UZRVE5CqsTvoseQr3AKLGLwPSE8t4P2.png) --- ![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23xpTS9zebNsr9es7StFpxomC6gcmGrgEWde448ZJD7KpasbuSim4hX2kicuzzffksooL.png) ---

>Luego de 2 días me puse manos a las telas, entonces corte lo que consideré más difícil: primero el abrigo, tomado desde uno que ya tengo y me gusta como me queda, cuidando muy bien cada paso confiando en lo que una vez aprendí aún lo recuerdo. Las piezas cortadas para el abrigo fueron: la parte delantera, la trasera y las 2 mangas, quería bolsillo, pero realmente con tan poco tiempo no quería estresarme más XD, ustedes me entienden. After two days, I got down to work on the fabric, so I cut out what I thought would be the hardest part: first, the coat, based on one I already own and like the way it fits me, taking great care with each step and trusting that what I once learned, I still remember. The pieces I cut out for the coat were: the front, the back, and the two sleeves. I wanted pockets, but with so little time, I didn’t want to stress myself out any more XD—you guys know what I mean. --- ![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/242YV44uv1roQhwhg4GmsiiyXNXSkhF5MwkdLTi4xA8Tu62Kb2Wg6G9VvU7W4Q5Nvhdcv.png) ---

>Uní las partes grandes por los hombros, con una costura que asemeja la overlock, con paciencia y cariño, luego mejoré el recorte de las mangas y la uní al abrigo, con el mismo tipo de costura, hice dobladillos en todos lados, pero acá no termine, yo quería un cuello fabuloso y lo hice. Medí de punta a punta el cuello del abrigo y subí lo necesario para que me tape todo el cuello y tenga un doblez que le da el toque elegante al abrigo. I sewed the large pieces together at the shoulders—using a seam that resembles an overlock stitch—with patience and care. Then I refined the sleeve openings and attached them to the coat using the same type of seam. I hemmed all the edges, but I didn’t stop there—I wanted a fabulous collar, so I made one. I measured the coat’s collar from end to end and added enough length so that it would cover my entire neck and have a fold that gives the coat an elegant touch. --- ![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/242hoGcAfCmmJJ7718bNEbGKsHuauQC4ooaze6BWPKaxkCeLapY5UPebtUP2oc628mGZe.png) ---

>Al cortar el rectángulo del cuello, cosí los límites laterales, uniendo la pieza, quedando un aro, o algo así. Luego, lo doblé, dando la forma de lo que quería y lo uní al abrigo, con una costura más floja y ayuda de un punzón ya que son varias capas de tela gruesa. Así queda listo el abrigo. After cutting out the rectangular neckline, I sewed the side edges together to form a loop, or something like that. Then I folded it into the shape I wanted and attached it to the coat using a looser stitch and an awl, since there are several layers of thick fabric. And that’s how the coat is finished. --- ![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/243qVyFKxjbPDqPAFzy6SJsWCQTumwzTEy2S79qZDDZpA9rJsfHrnjUYRw399R8GNbpSn.png) ---

>Al día siguiente me activé con el pantalón, desde uno que me encanta como queda y es del mismo material. Aquí el reto era la cinturilla, entonces vamos paso a paso primero: desde el revés del pantalón-patrón lo puse en la tela y corte primero el lado delantero marcando con alfileres y jaboncillo, respetando los límites de costura, luego lo mismo para la parte trasera. Es importante que las diferencies porque los tiros y las alturas no son iguales. The next day, I got started on the pants—a pair I love the way they fit and that’s made of the same fabric. The challenge here was the waistband, so let’s take it step by step: first, I placed the pattern (with the wrong side facing up) on the fabric and cut out the front piece, marking it with pins and a little soap while keeping the seam allowances in mind; then I did the same for the back piece. It’s important to distinguish between them because the inseams and waist heights aren’t the same. ---

>En total serían 4 partes y la cintura o cinturón que es la media de la cintura y el borde del pantalón, primero: unimos las partes delanteras por el tiro, lo mismo con la parte trasera, ahora, la tener 2 piezas, las enfrentamos por el derecho de las telas y las unimos por las entrepiernas hasta el ruedo. Luego, cosemos la parte de afuera de las piernas, con la misma costura estilo overlock pero más apretada la tensión porque la tela estira. In total, there will be 4 pieces, plus the waistband, which is the midpoint between the waist and the bottom of the pants. First, sew the front pieces together along the inseam; do the same with the back pieces. Now that you have two sets of pieces, place them right sides together and sew them together from the crotch to the hem. Next, sew the outer leg seams using the same overlock stitch, but with tighter tension because the fabric stretches. ---

>Ahora, es momento de coser los ruedos, con doble costura. Finalmente, pegamos el cinturón, primero aseguramos con alfileres por todo el borde y luego pasamos la costura semejante a la overlock, y ya quedó todo el outfit, quedó tan linda que yo me sorprendí y mis amigas también, recuerden siempre darle una planchada a las posturas para que todo quede bien prolijo. Espero sus preguntas y sugerencias. Now it's time to sew the hems with a double stitch. Finally, we attach the belt—first, we pin it all along the edge, then we sew it with an overlock-style stitch—and the whole outfit is done! It turned out so cute that I was surprised, and so were my friends. Remember to always iron the seams so everything looks neat and tidy. I look forward to your questions and suggestions. --- ![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23x1WNnpF6mNsGqw9yFED8b1VTBx8xJAA8g4p5CVn6wPLbjEwzfBmqVbuugLrD47YBn9F.png) #
[AFRIKA](https://www.instagram.com/afrikalienzo/?hl=es)

links.title: Corruption An Aid To Why Punishment Doesn’t Work
links.body:
Things are really working so differently in our world 🌍 of today when compared to the days of our forefathers when evil 👿 is paid for evil, justice served in the right manner because of the beliefs of those days even when many of our forefathers are truly not serving God wholly.

Punishment we all know is the end result one gets after doing something wrong 😑. In more understanding, a consequence of a crime when it has to do with breaking a law, going against rules and regulations of a country. A way to pay those who has violated a lay down  rules in a nation.

The problem of today’s world 🌍 is that corruption has eaten deep into those who are seated 🪑 in the seat 💺 where punishment are supposed to be carried out. Hence punishment is no longer working in our society the way it’s supposed to work. Offenders and law breakers have gotten the hint that when a nation is corrupt, nothing works with the law again. Rules and regulations are no longer in place and this helps law breakers to buy justice with money 💰.

I will give you a simple example of what happens here in my country Nigeria 🇳🇬. Why would some serious crime of murder where the criminal was arrested, kept in jail for trial that will commit him to go to prison for life sentence, the victim parents will be kept under emotional trauma for months, if not years with the court adjoining the case from time to time because the offender has someone either in the government or a top businessman who is dishing out money 💰 to those involved with the case to keep adjoining so that the case will become obsolete with time and not fresh in the mind of people.

Another is that there is a law against drugs, weed smokers, marijuana and other hard drugs. The boys who are involved with these set of drugs usually has a hide out where they meet, seat to enjoy themselves smoking, and in the night might turn into criminals who snatches phones 📱, money 💵 and other valuables from passersby. The police 👮‍♀️ being those who are to protect the citizens will go to their hideout to raid them, put them in cell overnight and bill 💵 them =N= 20,000 or =N= 30,000 each for bail. And this does not just happen once , but has become a constant practice and a way to eat from these boys.

A country with this kinds of happenings will never be able to succeed in using the law, rules and regulations to punish offenders and law breakers because corruption is the root why punishment could not be served. And apart from these kinds of crime, the rich 🤑 who are behind these boys are the ones making things worse. The rich feels that they can always navigate things because of money and prominence, put the country so much in jeopardy.

The issue here is not the kinds of punishment that has been laid down for crime offenders, but how punishment is not being served to those who has committed various kinds of crime, especially when the rich is involved. It appears its only the poor people punishments are made for because many who are saving most of these punishments are the poor and even some being innocent. 

In all, because of how the poor has no connection in the country, they are the ones suffering in the hands of the government. The rich 🤑 will never go to prison because they have connections and these had made the masses to keep loosing their trust in the government. Many of the rich men only go for hours arrest where they keep living their usual life with everything made available to them. This I can say is the highest rate of corruption with punishment only being for the poor citizens while the rich keep acting that they are above the law. And until punishment is served the right way, offenders will keep going back to committing more crimes.

links.title: On the outskirts of the second oldest cemetery. | En las afueras del segundo cementerio más antiguo.
links.body:
>

**Gratos saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos de esta linda comunidad en este martes.**

>**Warm greetings to all my dear friends in this lovely community on this Tuesday.**

Sigue sigo recorriendo los lugares de historia en la ciudad de Maracaibo y esta vez fue la oportunidad del panteón que lleva por nombre, \

, debido a su forma circular es el segundo más antiguo del estado Zulia, y se encuentra localizado justamente en toda la avenida principal de las Delicias, realicé este recorrido con mi hermano, estaba dando esperando que nos pudieran dejar ingresar hacia la parte interior del lugar, pero debíamos esperar al economo, encargado y en verdad, estabamos sobre reloj y sentía que iba a perder tiempo si lo esperaba en el interior de este lugar, se encuentran enterrado varios personajes emblemáticos de la ciudad. >I’m still exploring the city of Maracaibo’s historic sites, and this time I visited the cemetery known as ‘El Redondo’ so called because of its circular shape. It is the second oldest in Zulia state and is situated right on the main avenue in Las Delicias. I went on this tour with my brother; we were waiting to be allowed into the inner part of the cemetery, but we had to wait for the treasurer, who is in charge. To be honest, we were pressed for time and I felt I’d be wasting time waiting for him inside the cemetery, where several of the city’s most iconic figures are buried. ![Collage de Fotos Inspiración Naturaleza Azul _20260616_104233_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYnZPCuea7J5hZh1XK2QXZYgbPZomSdU2JMYkMgP8N1xV/Collage%20de%20Fotos%20Inspiraci%C3%B3n%20Naturaleza%20Azul%20_20260616_104233_0000.png) Bien este lugar durante el siglo pasado era considerado como el panteón de los trabajadores petroleros, ya que las famosas empresas europeas que residían en esta ciudad y le daban vida a la industria petrolera, tenía panteones para cada uno de sus trabajadores, así como también, eran empresas americanas en este tiempo según la historia morían, mucha las personas debido a que las condiciones, no eran las ideales y es por eso que en su interior podemos apreciar según la historia de que estos se encuentran, así como también, es un cementerio netamente privado quién actualidad no posee bóvedas a la venta porque son parte del patrimonio de las personas que son enterradas allí las que tienen sus tumbas desde hace mucho tiempo. >Well, during the last century this place was regarded as the cemetery for oil workers, as the famous European companies based in this city which were the lifeblood of the oil industry had cemeteries for each of their workers. Furthermore, according to history, many people from American companies working here at the time also died, many people died due to working conditions that were far from ideal. That is why, as history tells us, we can see their graves here. It is also a strictly private cemetery which currently has no burial vaults for sale, as they form part of the heritage of the people buried there, who have had their graves for a very long time. ![20260512_072754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcEg1B36WsJpFd7ZqzXG87FbKXmdboUQxDPFwjxztNaTd/20260512_072754.jpg) --- De los personajes históricos de nuestra ciudad, podemos encontrar a Juan bessón, un gran historiador que fue el escritor del primer libro de historia del estado Zulia muy recordado reconocido en la localidad, también podemos encontrar enterrado Armando Molero, conocido como el cautador de todos los tiempos, ya que era un gaitero, demasiado conocido en ese tiempo por ver, compuesto varias gaitas insignes de la ciudad así como también el gran arquitecto ingeniero belga Jerónime Joet, quién quién fue el responsable de edificar muchas obras de gran importancia para la ciudad gran contribuidor en el desarrollo arquitectónico de la ciudad, entre ellos el más reconocido el teatro Baralt. >Among the historical figures of our city, we find Juan Bessón, a great historian who wrote the first history book on the state of Zulia and is well remembered and highly regarded locally. We also find Armando Molero buried here, known as the ‘greatest bagpiper of all time’, as he was a bagpiper who was extremely well known in his day for having he composed several of the city’s most famous bagpipe tunes. Also buried here is the great Belgian architect and engineer Jerónime Joet, who was responsible for constructing many buildings of great importance to the city and made a major contribution to its architectural development, the most famous of which is the Baralt Theatre. ![20260512_072803.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjHnfrWaixHdxfz5VTgKh59dMwPxYqau4vbMLhFYWimw/20260512_072803.jpg) --- A pesar de que no puedes visitar su interior me gustó mucho la arquitectura, que posee su fachada de frente que podemos ver este estilo bastante Art Deco, en la cual, en su parte superior, podemos apreciar cómo se encuentran una antorcha con una paloma haciendo referencia a que este es un campo santo, este lugar se encuentra en excelente mantenimiento, ya que debido a que es un lugar y que es patrimonio de la localidad debe estar en muy bien estado porque anteriormente era un lugar que se encontraba completamente en estado de abandonó. >Although you cannot visit the interior, I really liked the architecture; its façade clearly displays a distinct Art Deco style, and at the top you can see a torch and a dove, signifying that this is a cemetery. This site is very well maintained; as it is a local heritage site, it must be kept in excellent condition, particularly as it was previously completely derelict. ![20260512_072849.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXzEUs9tkescCvCF1i9oRAZ8s4Xq2x6nKGUgweDGWpoUv/20260512_072849.jpg) Por último fue un buen recorrido espero que les haya gustado mucho mi publicación, me despido hasta una próxima oportunidad mis amigos para seguirle mostrando lugares de mi ciudad hasta pronto. >All in all, it was a great tour, I hope you really enjoyed my post I’ll say goodbye for now, my friends, and look forward to showing you more places in my city next time. See you soon. ![20260512_073108.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQetLSz6xdHxMGu2NcnYuUXEU6wqPoga9Huy7Erri7bLn/20260512_073108.jpg)

links.title: Garden in June
links.body:
I often didn't feel satisfied at work. I had a great position in a multinational company, but it felt like all I was doing was writing emails and spending time in calls. At the end of the day I didn't see any results of my work and after a while it became frustrating. Gardening is the exact opposite. I spend a lot of time outside 'playing' with soil, talking with our neighbours and I see the results of my work almost immediately. June and July are the months when I see the difference every single day. 

Let's see what happened in the last couple of weeks...

I planted my basil about 3 weeks ago and today I was already able to harvest it for the first time! I have learned how to harvest it to promote its growth and like this I can enjoy it until the first frost. This is one of the things that I don't plant from seeds because the slugs always get to them first and it's a wasted effort on my side. I rather buy 2 pots full of tiny seedlings, split them and plant them around my greenhouses. 

And yes, as you can see, we have started enjoying raspberries too!

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoGxpxXuhHdpd61mibERREfrJVEYcnUQz5njLK854tSGdBgZy2jpLLmFLHJGXbHApqM.jpg)
----
Most of our neighbours try to limit raspberries. I do understand it as they spread like crazy, but I let them grow as long as they are not in the way. My raspberries grow on old wood which means that the ones ripening now are hanging on the branches from last year. I will cut them to the ground in autumn and only leave new branches that grew this year. 

This autumn, I will also plant yellow and black raspberries to make it a bit more colourful.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EogMqhxH7CCRZoGNSeEAvXZTa8ygeXHeFGq9dGnDwpyuNPr1XUPNQqbhV6Z9RC2BtWe.jpg)
----
Honestly, I don't even know how many varieties I have at the moment, but what I can say for sure is that there are at least 3 of them. 

You can see it on the size of berries as well as their flavour. 

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoK6nFtbmCbXakP1XwAYUihMGYqqMV2GXSNpuZR8ELMjnEA9JidKAKpTPVwLBvEa1nV.jpg)
----
There are a couple of days when I can enjoy strawberries together with red currants and raspberries 😊

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EopuMM6YhonFS6QL3sbBmomyNE6ioWccFRCCwYdHqBVhM8xTdMCF5VFNYWaBPGus1Bs.jpg)
----
Peppers are coming up! The plants are quite strong and if all goes well I'm hoping for a good harvest. 

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Ep3epD93ZVF8JpuUcRddqBXcAbL3S5bvEiVeBskpuWWNKWfGZDKA4ckqaKR4YwLMb5t.jpg)
-----
Some of the tomatoes are exploding! I keep watering them, pulling out the weeds and pruning the low hanging leaves. The plants seem to like it. 

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Eou9BNFcZMjfagnK77Cr6BEMiqASSVgX9ssHz12WGWyEMRHWHd5GwjexQdDy8zK2PtP.jpg)
----
You might think that it is too early and I should have removed those tomatoes, but this is how I've been doing it for years and I'm always more than happy with my harvest. I don't need 5 super large tomatoes. I'm much more happy if I get 25 smaller ones. 

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Ep5o9uVn2ua8g8TutccvQ35rYJh7A14vt9Y3gdZ8QBxTy5VKdRpFNqQRoTaPv5FzbK2.jpg)
----
This year, we will have many surprises in the garden because I didn't start tomatoes from seed for the first time. We were busy with the move, so my mom bought some seedlings for me and my sister brought them to Switzerland. She had no idea which plant was which variety, so I'm letting myself be surprised. 

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Eoc9RajxKwZSjapJe5vPCAfeADRQYwVueRisVvBkbgn9orX5i8ztTuMgbamqPqTstEk.jpg)
-----
I'm so proud when I see them grow! Growing tomatoes is not so easy if you're doing everything organically because they could get so many diseases, but it is so rewarding to see them happy. I just hope they don't get blight again because last year I had to remove affected leaves twice a day to save the harvest. It did help though...

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoK6EpLgMoW2coUUeyH41aJvzRHiPyRgd7hTVwLvdTswY7PzrLfFsmm9N6RASUqJx1u.jpg)
---
My volunteer potato is 'potatoing' 😊

It didn't choose the best location as it's kind of in the way, but well, nature has her own plan...

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EowGXC4gijE397yXWv93Ans2TDAu1HJAFMrTMvfuCxxj3hFkgwH9M1t67F1RWNZe8qu.jpg)
----
This kohlrabi is almost ready to harvest. Many of them split this year, and I'm not so sure if it's because of the storms or too high temperatures. We will eat them anyway, but I need to figure out why it has happened to try and avoid it for my next kohlrabi generation.

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoEq525BXYGfdXeSWACgaPYNh6BSLVzDXcxnUxQpkpPEu1xDwsYoo5fFXr49ARsmyAE.jpg)
----
And this is it - the next generation...

You can grow kohlrabi almost all the time, and I have 3 generations so we don't have to eat dozens of them at the same time.

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EowH3mgoYBHWLSaTnQsNf6yFjYNTqfCDWh1pvuUem9x5LSxCh9YdBDsfwGL1T4zGK7w.jpg)
----
My pickling cucumbers are growing nicely, and I give them a couple of days before the first flowers will start appearing...

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoCj5x3qtxVzTZwZgaxLTYChS2HmPSk7d5UdvqMDLEFwzVGxc9fPsSzjUquX5tUFe2v.jpg)
----
As usually, zucchini are pushing female flowers first, so they won't be pollinated and will die out. I can see some male flowers too, so I hope that they will sync soon...

![12a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EonkvRS86DVwrnqSREmm3vEt3f12G1rktZdLU13Kikx4LN5aCS4gmgBdkTQHYVnCT9a.jpg)
----
I've started pulling oud the weeds around my beans, and it's been a nightmare. They are so tiny and it takes ages, but I have to pull them out because beans are heavy feeders and don't like to compete for water and nutrients... well, still a few hours to go...

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoptQ4dpm3sPzvL7B9pxXquKngVkUbQAvHA9PKmfwt2U6tyXHK8Pex2oGNqzLJ1kiuN.jpg)
----
My father-in-law gave me some celery seedlings. We almost never eat celery, but my husband promised that he will eat it, so I planted it. Let's see how it goes. Last time, I planted 6 seedlings and we ended up throwing it away after 2 years in the freezer. I don't like wasting food, but celery had such a specific flavour that I can only enjoy in certain dishes. 

![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoyPymsrFtqDtYeMb8QwB44ETZvu9vpdEWHfTkAmtoSyrHLimD8qkYxY58R3r5qGoRv.jpg)
----
Today is a focaccia day, so I took some rosemary twigs home...

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoGzsTPjvs6kwNMYYz5SLsEY7MWHAzfXLympWbCK9eaoyfutGA5U93WiVtZeW8fpx89.jpg)
----
Forest strawberries are entering their second bloom...

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Eo8ToQ1UuCapLBrm28n5DiKRJeBsEFzXGc5378X2Ff4qFdzQH513xLF6JsmXaLh1t2k.jpg)
----
This is such a stunning bush, but I had to cut half of it as I kept hanging on its thorns. It still looks good! 

![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EokbE5tUoHqGdMpxAE55FQZ9APGvui3nXzMGtB5qCR4zd2thJPWbarTCJ86X5LdnatC.jpg)
----
My romantic Astilbe makes me smile every time I see it...

![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Eo6HXfVUq2H5rz8PR79TeYrQoR61fEacZT9C578Z8fS1z8c5fHGoSpmL1FZWfKgwnjz.jpg)
----
Snow hydrangea has started blooming. Those green 'balls' will soon turn white. It's one of the most beautiful hydrangeas, but it has fragile branches and bends to the ground after strong rain, so I try to enjoy it while it lasts. 

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoGwWker9qQVvQJ4jxeMUsJ6TbW2y62MNeTkXt6VSAUoHGa9PM9MN6isB76vPtyaxXg.jpg)
----
Another hydrangeas are coming to life too...

![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoiTkBYLS1MEo4kdgYaDzRUbbmJLWBvmgKVV9KGiFXttcoN1oWGVurAkgDke5UaDsqk.jpg)

![21a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoEp4uxxq3JrEkp72eHHtGynsHpVexh4gWvE19dWdHZEXfvsMr75LSxBB8pLzh5BZvd.jpg)
----
Each year I forget to water my Phlox and then one day it dries out. This year, I have decided to pay attention and water it deeply now and then. So far, so good! 

![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoGvzoWAkzfJwyyFBUDMWkFnzVYhatNSWabjZUiesvRQvmwsNYLMtmjmfUf4vYPsQam.jpg)
---
Calendulas are popping everywhere...

![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoeGRJ6JSSbNMwTc6mJVsD6DshdSNHVJrS9ezCRMwkurNYCHzN4DVvPNTfHwepNFrwe.jpg)
----
Lemon balm is growing out of proportions and I really have to do something with it. I thought I would use it to make anti-mosquito spray because mosquitos love me. Today, I tried to use anti-mosquito spray with lemon balm from a pharmacy, and it did indeed kept mosquitos at distance, but all other bugs loved me. I got attacked by wasps! So I think that I won't use it in the end. I might dry it up and give it to friends as tea. Any other ideas?

![24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoeDsz7mcKWnK18ZWcBsNhrDkDgridrzx9J3ff1LZGezr7StGrVitT3VAUWffxviewq.jpg)
---
My green manure is perfect! It keeps the weeds out and it has started flowering already. It also looks like mess, but that's exactly how I like it. 

![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoCi7VifXU9SgRmd9CEC7j4YwysepJYq19tepBK9WYUe68u3QjptoqXeAQWYBCQ1bhJ.jpg)
----
And let's finish this post with some lavender that I took home. In the past, I didn't appreciate growing flowers as you can't eat them, right? Now, I appreciate the beautiful things in life too, and not everything has to be practical anymore, so the flowers found their way to my garden and now I'm happy to take care of them and maybe take a few of them with me from time to time. 

![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EokfVRezvJBeNSuKPD8pj3Uou9DsZEDmEwMhJmYyX2KMYXMDBjusvnNHHdFLnfJQqx9.jpg)
----
Thank you and until next time...

links.title: Let the punishments of criminals be useful.
links.body:
The crime graph of many countries are increasing day by days. There are law in place for every country to punish the offenders yet, the criminal always ready to negotiate the consequences. Or they are ready play with the lack Lustre judicial system. Recently, there was an instance in our country, when a rapist who is out on bail from prison, committed the similar crime again. It was one of the scenario where the rapist instead of regretting his deed was ready to bear the Punishment. This indicates that Punishment alone is often insufficient to deter crime. 


![20250901_072145(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/48QtxGwD1r31V98i8fKDkEd4yiamynF2eWsVbR2vU5rpgthEBbid7e4XXo92WDFBsm.jpg)
*(own edited image)*



Punishment alone fails to reduce crime because it ignores the root causes. Punishment only tells a person what not to do, but provides zero guidance on the correct behavior they should be using instead. Many offenders do not expect to get caught. Increasing penalties does not deter crime if individuals believe they will evade law enforcement entirely. Instead of learning, the punished individual often learns to simply hide their actions to avoid future consequences. As in the case of the rapist, he was aware that he is already undertrials and committing a similar crime wont going to make it worse. Punishment, plays a crucial role in justice, criminological research shows that the certainty of being caught is a far stronger deterrent than the severity of the punishment. Many offenders do not weigh the long term consequences when committing a crime.To truly reduce crime rates, experts emphasize a combined approach of swift consequences alongside rehabilitation.  

> ***Double the trouble, twice the fun.***


We have seen in our day to days cycle that mere punishing a kid wont make them correct. They should be taught about tye right things, which helps them to learn and grow. Likewise, while punishing any individuals, we should understand how it going to impact the person life. I personally belive that, the \

punishment depends heavily on the severity of the crime and the goal of the justice system. A punishment should be like one whoch, requires the offender to make amends directly to the victim or community, such as through community service, financial restitution, or mediation. A punishment, should uses strict penalties like heavy fines, public shaming, or prison terms to discourage the offender and the general public from committing future crimes. It shpuld be like to ensures a proportional **\

** punishment, ensuring the offender suffers a consequence equal to the harm they caused.



**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

links.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=dmann/a1gtxeoi

Hello friends, how are you all, especially my dear friends, you must be well and healthy, by the grace of Allah, this prayer is for you. I am also well and healthy, by your prayers and the grace of Allah, friends, today I have come with a new video for you, may Allah tell you some details about this video, so keep watching and give your feedback.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdT4uVNs3JWrxYV1fjXw5pgTn6uhAExVRAEa993vrFXiL/1781617552759.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPP5dg6HgFqBKsHKqmLi7MB2FC6buC4WL6VxKwmhSn43u/1781617552902.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX816W3vTr4AS9kMEMjQb6ppMPnpUwB8kJKaWcaPdYBxj/1781617553013.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJzBT2BTa9iLF5bam7oxVhHpJ23FB7j7NuhNcpiPtPpS/1781617553123.jpg)

Friends, today I have come to you with a fruit video, so you must love eating fruits and people who love eating fruits are hard to find because in the midst of this scene, I have come to you with a video of mangoes and bananas, which are available in abundance in our summers. So today I have come to you with this video. Friends, summer has ended in our country, so the ripe mango season is also almost over. There are only a few mangoes left, that is, those mangoes that bloomed a little later on the trees, but now there are a few. Moreover, mangoes in our country are now at their last stage because summer has also ended.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUs8su3vQAJH8qQwmqr5iuR68ogUuJHMtkvENp79oPfW6/1781617577482.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhai7eDD7zQ8zuG3h5f27EKMDCVPvVk2iBiUbp1PCvnj/1781617577600.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRd2ps1dwvVg24o8ZNpexhkgxfjJJWvzXAzQAaAMG1fDt/1781617577706.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWd3mSCmifcSkCRRLWkEYuSYKgtgU8rNMB81LzS3NAuvs/1781617577857.jpg)

And this thought kept going around in my head as if the summer is over, will I be able to buy and eat mangoes again? Anyway, friends, today I got the opportunity to buy some mangoes from the market, which are ripe mangoes. In our country, these mangoes are called Amrupali. Friends, when it comes to talking about Amrupali mangoes, it cannot be finished. It is such a desirable, delicious and nutritious mango that it is very popular with everyone. Everyone, young and old, loves to eat this Amrupali mango. So I bought 2 kg of Amrupali mangoes from the market and brought a banana with it. Anyway, friends, my daughter loves to eat bananas, so I brought these bananas from the market and brought mangoes for all of us. That is, the whole family will eat mangoes because the mango season is over. Maybe this year we will not have any luck because mangoes are not in the market.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUTerpED1M4m4uWTztw8gzAqvw3aG13y4rptvm7vmhiM7/1781617601661.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXX6KZTqhTCahBTTfoArKuMRpcSry6QnGj2q8TjxztED3/1781617601789.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWGzbSRdUHxUgg8NXUYXRsSuoRqQKRYrgSWCRa2NVcUb/1781617601914.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVGYPF84SFXEwbimahzcwnmC9jdZ57h2hqUYNVMLAT7Cm/1781617602006.jpg)

So friends, I brought the mangoes to our floor to cut and eat and you can see in the video my daughter is washing these mangoes nicely then my daughter gave these mangoes to me to cut and the mango that my daughter was cleaning nicely with water was a little hard because she prefers to eat a little hard mango when it is ripe but she cannot eat this mango comfortably so I like it a little hard so I gave this mango to her first and she started eating it with a lot of fun as you can see in the video then I peeled a very ripe mango for me and cut it into pieces with a spoon and started eating it while my daughter sat down and started eating that hard mango

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRqXsXKdTNZr2FNSdU3fZ38TjzB8DS3dTSkZgFSkJ87fH/1781617629801.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRd2ps1dwvVg24o8ZNpexhkgxfjJJWvzXAzQAaAMG1fDt/1781617629908.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNtz6yW6NwcSwQpphUdyxcQRu5Vcn2X75V4v9bztEBLti/1781617630043.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXX6KZTqhTCahBTTfoArKuMRpcSry6QnGj2q8TjxztED3/1781617630157.jpg)

To tell you the truth, friends, the mangoes were so sweet that I cannot explain them to you. However, I had a lot of fun eating the mango and a few more mangoes, but we kept them in the fridge because when my daughter wants to eat again, I will not be able to give them to her. And as a father, it will be a matter of great pain for me. Then I saw my daughter eating a banana very beautifully. She snatched this banana at once. This is a formalin-free banana because I bought it standing up and asked the shopkeeper repeatedly that only a child can eat formalin. Don't give me any food containing formalin. But friends, the price of this banana is very high. 50 taka, that is, the price of four bananas is 50 taka. However, I have no problem with money because as long as my daughter is healthy, this is enough for me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWGzbSRdUHxUgg8NXUYXRsSuoRqQKRYrgSWCRa2NVcUb/1781617651308.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWym8m52YfMgapcBuPbAfF3Roj3ABb8m3UFRyZywU6fca/1781617651424.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSWz2GughyPD3yu3Mu6Bo7jk6f7mu9rkgYVpwhshLwLMC/1781617651547.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma5mR8gwyRdXAiD1Wa7e4P7E5BVbC1Kitn4oF31PCpHYj/1781617651655.jpg)

Friends, the fruits that I showed you in the video today are really very nutritious fruits and their nutritional value is naturally created by Allah. This fruit is very beneficial for our body and is a very healthy food for the body, which is known as a favorite fruit by everyone in our country. One is mango, the other is banana. Anyway, friends, how did you like my video today? Of course, you will give your important opinions and I will come to you with a new video later. I am saying goodbye to you today with the hope and expectation that you will give me your important opinions and I will come to you with a new video. Thank you all for watching my video carefully. Farewell. Finally, I wish everyone good health. Allah Hafez

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjfY77wSGHdEvrmU2ZzX3EujBLjyTmZ9GF43tdgegmAS/1781617682830.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhai7eDD7zQ8zuG3h5f27EKMDCVPvVk2iBiUbp1PCvnj/1781617682973.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWd3mSCmifcSkCRRLWkEYuSYKgtgU8rNMB81LzS3NAuvs/1781617683067.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXX6KZTqhTCahBTTfoArKuMRpcSry6QnGj2q8TjxztED3/1781617683174.jpg)
