body.title: WOO's Next Chapter: Why The Momentum Feels Different This Time
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

When I look back at the latest announcement, I think the biggest takeaway is not any individual feature. It is the overall direction. The Battle Pass was a major update. Land Rewards are a major update. The upcoming ranking system sounds exciting. The planned UI overhaul could make the game look and feel better than ever. 

But what stands out to me most is how all of these updates fit together. For the first time in a long while, it feels like WOO is not just adding features. It feels like WOO is building a complete ecosystem.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23yJVD1SbMN9nQXCtG2xGC2DfcMJAfhJm5fLbPGH5vFdV3BKFiPUbSGUeULvFHv1CNFzR.png)

---

That distinction is important. Individual features can create temporary excitement. Connected systems can create lasting growth. And right now, WOO appears to be moving firmly in that direction.

## The Battle Pass Started The Momentum

• Activity exploded after launch.

The reported increase of over 1000% in daily matches is a remarkable achievement. Numbers like that do not happen because players are mildly interested. They happen because players find real value in what has been added. The Battle Pass clearly gave players reasons to participate more frequently. That increase in activity created a strong foundation for future updates.

• Progression became a daily experience.

One of the strengths of the Battle Pass is that it gives players consistent objectives. Daily engagement often leads to stronger communities and healthier ecosystems. That seems to be exactly what happened here.

• Players gained more reasons to return.

Retention is one of the most important aspects of any online game. The Battle Pass helped strengthen that retention significantly.

## Land Rewards Expanded The Ecosystem

• Ownership now carries greater utility.

Land ownership has moved beyond simple collection. Players can now generate rewards through upgraded Training Centers and land multipliers. That transformation adds meaningful depth to the ecosystem.

• Development feels rewarding.

Every upgrade has potential value. Every improvement contributes toward future rewards. That creates a satisfying progression loop.

• Long-term planning becomes important.

Players now have additional strategic decisions to make regarding land development and optimization. That added depth increases engagement.

## Future Updates Look Promising

• Rankings could add competition.

Competition often acts as a catalyst for activity. The upcoming ranking system could create additional reasons for players to remain engaged and continue improving.

• UI improvements could enhance accessibility.

Visual presentation matters. A cleaner, more polished interface can improve player experiences dramatically. That makes the planned overhaul particularly exciting.

• The roadmap feels coherent.

One thing I appreciate most is that future updates appear connected to existing systems rather than disconnected from them. That consistency suggests thoughtful planning.

## Why Momentum Feels Different

• Updates are building upon one another.

Many games release features that feel isolated. WOO's recent updates feel connected. The Battle Pass supports activity. Land Rewards support ownership. Future rankings support competition. Each feature strengthens the others.

• Utility is increasing across the board.

Existing assets are becoming more valuable. Existing systems are becoming more meaningful. That approach tends to create stronger long-term ecosystems.

• Players have more ways to participate.

Not every player enjoys the same activities. Some focus on progression. Some focus on collection. Some focus on competition. WOO is increasingly providing opportunities for all of them.

## What Excites Me Most

• The foundation keeps getting stronger.

The strongest games are usually built one layer at a time. That appears to be what we are witnessing right now. Instead of rushing toward complexity, WOO is gradually strengthening its foundation.

• There is a sense of direction.

One of the most encouraging things for any community is seeing a clear direction. Recent updates suggest exactly that. The game appears to know where it wants to go.

• The future feels easier to imagine.

A few months ago, it might have been difficult to visualize how all the different systems would eventually connect. Today, that picture is becoming much clearer.

## Final Thoughts

The title of the announcement focused on increased land utility. That is certainly accurate. Land utility has improved dramatically. At the same time, I think the update represents something even bigger. It represents continued momentum. It represents growing confidence. It represents an ecosystem that is becoming increasingly interconnected.

The Battle Pass brought activity. Land Rewards brought utility. Upcoming rankings promise competition. Future UI improvements promise polish. Each update contributes something important. Together, they create something much larger.

As a fan who has followed WOO's development journey, I find that incredibly exciting. Not because of any single feature. Not because of any single reward. But because of the direction these updates suggest. The momentum is real. The foundation is growing stronger. And for the first time in a while, it genuinely feels like WOO is entering a new chapter. One built on activity, ownership, competition, and progression all working together.

That is a future worth watching. WOO!

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

body.title: Jira Reports: A Clear View of Team Delivery and Workflow Performance
body.body:
**Introduction to Jira Reporting**
Jira reports are built to help teams understand how work moves through development systems. Inside Jira, reporting tools convert issue tracking data into structured insights about progress, speed, and workflow behavior.

Rather than focusing only on completed tasks, Jira reports emphasize patterns in delivery—how work starts, moves, and finishes across time.

**Main Purpose of Jira Reports**
The primary goal of Jira reporting is to make team performance measurable and understandable. These reports help answer questions such as:

How much work is being completed in each iteration?
How predictable is the team’s delivery process?
Where do delays or bottlenecks appear?
Is the workload evenly distributed?
How does scope change over time?

By answering these questions, teams gain visibility into both performance and process health.

**Common Types of Jira Reports**
Jira includes several standard reports that focus on different aspects of Agile delivery:

Burndown reports, showing remaining work in a sprint over time
Velocity reports, tracking completed work across multiple sprints
Sprint reports, comparing planned versus finished work
Cumulative flow diagrams, visualizing work distribution across stages
Control charts, analyzing cycle time and variability

Each report highlights a specific dimension of team activity, helping build a complete delivery picture.

**Understanding Workflow Through Data**
One of the key strengths of Jira reporting is its ability to reflect real workflow behavior. Instead of relying on assumptions, teams can see exactly how work progresses through each stage.

**This includes insights such as:**

How long tasks remain in development or review
Where work tends to accumulate in the process
How often priorities shift during a sprint
Whether tasks are evenly flowing or frequently blocked

These patterns help teams identify inefficiencies that may not be visible in day-to-day work.

Challenges of Standard Jira Reports
Although Jira reporting provides useful dashboards, it has limitations in more complex environments:

Reports are often isolated within individual projects or boards
Long-term historical analysis is limited without external tools
Cross-team visibility is difficult to achieve
Advanced forecasting is not built in by default
Custom metrics require additional configuration or plugins

Because of this, larger organizations often need more advanced reporting approaches.

**From Metrics to Meaningful Insights**
Basic metrics alone are not enough; the real value comes from interpretation. For example, a stable velocity might indicate consistency, but it does not explain whether the team is improving or whether work complexity is changing.

To gain deeper insight, teams often combine multiple signals such as cycle time, throughput, and work-in-progress trends to understand system health.

**Forecasting and Planning with Jira Data**
[reports in Jira](https://www.brokenbuild.net/?utm_campaign=backlink1\_arg_g_backlhp_bb\&utm_medium=referral\&utm_source=donors\&utm_term=text-submits) can also be used to improve planning accuracy. By analyzing historical delivery patterns, teams can estimate how long similar types of work are likely to take in the future.

This type of forecasting is more reliable than fixed estimates because it reflects actual past performance rather than theoretical assumptions. It also helps teams prepare for variability in workload and scope changes.

**Using Reports for Continuous Improvement**
Jira reporting is most effective when it is used as part of an ongoing improvement cycle. Teams can use insights to:

Adjust sprint planning methods
Improve estimation practices
Identify recurring bottlenecks
Balance workload more effectively
Refine workflow stages for better flow

Over time, reporting becomes a feedback mechanism that directly influences how teams operate.

**Conclusion**
Jira reports provide a structured way to understand Agile delivery performance. While basic tools inside Jira offer useful visibility, the real value comes from analyzing trends, workflow behavior, and delivery patterns. This helps teams move beyond simple tracking and toward continuous, data-driven improvement.

body.title: El gobierno descubrió que la IA funciona, y nadie sabía muy bien qué hacer
body.body:
![Imagen del artículo](https://ofap.saas.ar/img/20260616-el-gobierno-descubrio-que-la-ia-funciona.png)


El martes amaneció con una noticia que debería ser reveladora pero que, en el ecosistema tech, sonó más a chiste que a alerta: funcionarios federales están \

porque Fable 5 resolvió un problema de código sin necesidad de jailbreak. La IA hizo lo que se suponía que tenía que hacer, y eso, aparentemente, es el verdadero problema. Mientras tanto, en el resto del mundo, Iroh llegó a 1.0, Google metió su SDK de agents al ruedo, y alguien metió una biblioteca de libros prohibidos dentro de una bombilla WiFi porque — cito — \

.

Bienvenidos al día en que la realidad superó la ficción distópica, pero con más humor involuntario.

🤖 **El pánico: cuando la IA funciona exactamente como debería**

La noticia del día no es un jailbreak, no es un prompt injection, no es un alignment failure. Es un \

que Fable 5 resolvió sin que nadie le pidiera permiso, y los federales están alarmados. La [nota de The Register](https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/06/15/feds-freaked-over-fable-5-after-simple-fix-this-code-prompt-not-jailbreak-says-researcher/5255827) cuenta cómo un investigador le pidió a Fable 5 que arregle un código, el modelo lo arregló, y los funcionarios reaccionaron como si hubiera declarado la independencia.\n\nLo fascinante no es que Fable 5 haya resuelto el código — es que *el gobierno se sorprenda de que la IA funcione*. Llevamos dos años de hype, releases semanales, anuncios de AGI inminente, y la reacción oficial ante un modelo que realmente hace lo que le piden es \

. La brecha entre lo que el ecosistema tech sabe que la IA puede hacer y lo que los reguladores creen que puede hacer es exactamente la misma brecha que hay entre un developer que usa Copilot a diario y un congresista que todavía cree que la IA es una calculadora con aspiraciones.

El verdadero riesgo acá no es Fable 5. Es que la regulación se escriba basada en el pánico en lugar del entendimiento. Y si hay algo que sabemos sobre regulación escrita bajo pánico, es que suele ser peor que el problema que intenta resolver.

🔧 **Mientras tanto, el taller no para**

Mientras los federales procesan el shock existencial de que la IA funcione, el ecosistema sigue pariendo herramientas como si no hubiera mañana.

[Iroh 1.0](https://www.iroh.computer/blog/v1) — el stack de networking modular en Rust que reemplaza direcciones IP por \

— llegó a versión estable. No es una herramienta sexy, pero es de esas cosas que si funcionan bien, se vuelven infraestructura invisible que usás sin saberlo. Como las tuercas de un puente.

[Alibaba zvec](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec) se suma a la carrera de las bases vectoriales con una implementación en C++ que promete ser liviana y rápida. Compite con LanceDB, Chroma y el resto del pelotón, pero cuando Alibaba mete recursos en algo, el resto del ecosistema tiembla un poco.

[VoxCPM2](https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM) (⭐ +413/día) marca otro hito en síntesis de voz: generación multilingüe, diseño creativo de voz, clonación realista, sin tokenizer. Cada vez más cerca de ese momento incómodo donde no sabés si la voz que escuchás es humana o sintética.

Y [FlashQwen](https://github.com/frankkk96) aparece con un motor de inferencia CUDA escrito desde cero para Qwen3, prometiendo velocidad nativa sin el overhead de las bibliotecas standard. Para los que corremos modelos localmente, menos dependencias siempre es bienvenido.

🧠 **Agents everywhere: Google, CAMEL, y el ejército silencioso**

Si ayer el tema era la seguridad de los agents, hoy es la escala. Google oficializó su [Antigravity SDK para Python](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-sdk-python), permitiendo construir agents con acceso a todo el ecosistema Google. No es menor: cuando Google pone su peso institucional detrás de un framework, las chances de que se convierta en estándar suben abruptamente.

Pero la notícula que más me gustó del día es [OASIS](https://github.com/camel-ai/oasis) — Open Agent Social Interaction Simulations — de CAMEL-AI. El proyecto simula interacciones sociales con... un millón de agents. Un millón. Mientras discutimos si un solo agent autónomo es confiable, CAMEL-AI está simulando sociedades enteras de agents. ¿Qué pasa cuando ponés un millón de agents a interactuar? No se sabe, pero lo están haciendo. Si no es el plot de una película de ciencia ficción, se le parece bastante.

En el frente más práctico, [planning-with-files](https://github.com/OthmanAdi/planning-with-files) sigue sumando tracción — persistencia de planes en markdown que sobrevive al /clear y al context loss. Lo mencionamos ayer y hoy vuelve a aparecer. Cuando una herramienta aparece dos días seguidos en el radar, es porque resuelve un dolor real. [CoreMCP](https://github.com/corebasehq/coremcp) también debutó como MCP server para bases on-prem, y [subagent-fleet](https://pypi.org/project/subagent-fleet/) permite distribuir coding agents entre varias máquinas con Ollama local. El patrón es claro: agents que corren donde vos querés, no donde la nube dice.

📺 **Para cerrar: señores, no se puede pelear acá, ¡esto es la Sala de Guerra!**

Hay una escena inolvidable de *Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb* (1964) donde el presidente de Estados Unidos está en la Sala de Guerra del Pentágono, rodeado de generales que discuten cómo responder a una amenaza que no entienden del todo, mientras el mundo está al borde del colapso. En un momento de máxima tensión, el embajador soviético y el general estadounidense se agarran a piñas, y el presidente grita: \

Esa escena es hoy. Funcionarios federales alarmados porque Fable 5 — la herramienta que ellos mismos aprobaron — hace exactamente lo que prometía. Desarrolladores construyendo agents que simulan sociedades enteras. Reguladores queriendo ponerle puertas al campo mientras los proyectos open source corren en todas direcciones. Y en medio, la comunidad tech haciendo lo que mejor sabe: construir, compartir, y de vez en cuando, meter una biblioteca de libros prohibidos dentro de una bombilla porque el espíritu hacker no entiende de jurisdicciones.

La pregunta incómoda del día no es si la IA es peligrosa. Es si el pánico va a generar regulaciones que nos arruinen a todos la diversión de construir, o si vamos a encontrar la manera de que el código siga fluyendo mientras los políticos procesan su shock. La historia de la tecnología está llena de momentos donde el pánico produjo leyes que no resolvieron nada y rompieron bastante.

Pero bueno, si nos quedamos sin internet, siempre podemos jugar al [TinyWind](https://tinywind.io), un jueguito de piratas con física de viento real. Que 380 mil kilómetros navegados por la comunidad no pueden estar equivocados.

💡 **Tip del día:** Si te preocupa que la IA te pudra el skill manual, [Fata](https://fata.dev) es repetición espaciada diseñada para developers que quieren mantener el músculo de codificar sin AI. La paradoja: una herramienta digital para no depender de herramientas digitales.

If I wake up to find I've won a million dollars tomorrow, I plan to invest it strategically to secure my future. My primary goal will be to establish a thriving rice business. Rice is a staple food across the globe, and its demand remains consistent. Starting this business can offer financial stability and create employment for others in the community.

A portion of my winnings will go toward securing a suitable location, whether through renting or purchasing it. I'll source premium rice from reliable suppliers and price it affordably while ensuring it's stored appropriately to maintain its freshness and quality. My commitment to excellent customer service and ethical dealings will be paramount in building customer trust and growing the business.

Beyond the rice business, I will also deposit a portion of my winnings into a savings account to cover unexpected expenses or future emergencies. Financial security is essential, and having a reserve fund is a proactive way to achieve it.

I also intend to invest a small sum in cryptocurrency. While it has the potential for significant returns, careful management is crucial. I'll thoroughly research the market, understand the associated risks, and avoid placing all my assets into this single investment.

Furthermore, I'll ensure my family's basic needs, education, and medical expenses are fully supported, as they have always stood by me. It would be an honor to reciprocate their love and support.

A part of my winnings will also be channeled toward charitable contributions, helping those less fortunate and making a positive difference in society.

Finally, I'll commit to further learning and development in business management and entrepreneurship. With dedication and a solid strategy, I aspire to expand my rice business and contribute to the economy.

In summary, if I win a million tomorrow, I'll invest in a rice business, save for the future, invest prudently, support my family and community, and continually enhance my business acumen. This will enable me to build a successful future and contribute positively to the lives of others.

body.title: Fan art of Kurapika using the hybrid collage technique//Fanart de Kurapika con la técnica híbrida de collage
body.body:
<center>![kmkm.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23xetdAu3V7dPCDkpeAEbxsTeG81K1uLF99xQaXy9duWcxj9R1rGSwecdB6oYpy2VEisy.jpg)</center>

Hello, my dear otaku friends, I hope you're all doing great. Continuing with my series of drawings created using the hybrid collage technique, I'm bringing the incredible characters of Hunter x Hunter to life. This time, it's the turn of my absolute favorite character from this entire anime: Kurapika. He's always fascinated me because he's a boy with a sweet appearance but an incredibly mysterious aura. Furthermore, his strength is impressive thanks to the power of his scarlet eyes and that imposing chain he carries in his right hand. I love working with this technique because I usually have the freedom to modify details of the original design. However, this time I was so pleased with the process that I decided to keep the result almost identical to the reference image.

Later, I'll try to recreate this same design using graphite pencil on paper to explore different textures. In the meantime, I'm continuing to experiment digitally with the tools offered by Paint 3D. What do you think of the final result? Who is your favorite character from this anime?

>Hola, mis queridos amigos otakus, espero que se encuentren superbién. Siguiendo con mi serie de dibujos elaborados con la técnica híbrida de collage, continúo dándole vida a los increíbles personajes de Hunter x Hunter. En esta oportunidad, le tocó el turno a mi gran favorito de todo este anime: Kurapika. Siempre me ha fascinado por ser un chico de apariencia dulce, pero con un aura sumamente misteriosa. Además, su fuerza es impresionante gracias al poder de sus ojos escarlata y a esa imponente cadena que lleva en su mano derecha.Trabajar con esta técnica me encanta porque usualmente me doy la libertad de modificar detalles del diseño original. Sin embargo, en esta ocasión quedé tan conforme con el proceso que decidí mantener el resultado casi idéntico a la imagen de referencia.

>Más adelante procuraré recrear este mismo diseño utilizando lápiz de grafito sobre papel para explorar texturas diferentes. These three hatched two days ago. Mom is a bentham, dad is Gray, our Chinese downy rooster. There could have been more little ones, but it turned out to be three - and it's already good, because it can be worse.

Looking at the chickens now, it's hard to say which chickens will have more, mom's or dad's. So far, the babies are ordinary fluffy balls, gray-yellowish, holding themselves together and not a step away from their mother. Mom is sitting seriously, looking straight into the camera with the expression \

- and this is a fair position.

The most pleasant thing in such moments is to watch how the chicken instantly turns from just a chicken into a strict guard. No doubts, no hesitation - just an instinct that works like a clock.

Let's see which of them will grow up - for mom or father🐣

body.title: Where am I building it?
body.body:
<center>
![1001041849.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tvkWvboQA8iP7doG5DAFtJb9vNLyXfewVcYwtiPSFXQZpyB3dhE9TrdqqseiXsocz81.png)
</center>

---

<div class=text-justify>

On June 13th, I celebrated 7 years on Hive.

Although, if I'm being honest, my journey of building communities, moderating spaces, curating content, mentoring new users, and creating educational resources around blockchain began long before that.

And lately, I’ve found myself asking an uncomfortable, yet necessary question:

***Who have I been building for all this time?***

For years, I devoted countless hours to supporting projects, nurturing communities, answering questions, creating guides, helping people take their first steps, and celebrating the growth of others.

Many of those users are still here. Others found opportunities. Some went on to build their own paths. And that has value.

Yet over time, I also learned something important: **Not everything we build gives back an equivalent return to what we put into it.**

>![Versión en Español]
>
>El 13 de junio cumplí 7 años dentro de Hive.
>
>Aunque, si soy honesta, mi historia construyendo comunidades, moderando espacios, curando contenido, enseñando a nuevos usuarios y creando recursos educativos en blockchain, comenzó mucho antes.
>
>Y en estos días me encontré haciéndome una pregunta incómoda, pero necesaria:
>
>***¿Para quién estuve construyendo todo este tiempo?***
>
>Durante años dediqué incontables horas a apoyar proyectos, acompañar comunidades, resolver dudas, crear guías, orientar a personas que daban sus primeros pasos y celebrar el crecimiento de otros.
>
>Muchos de esos usuarios siguen aquí. Otros encontraron oportunidades. Algunos construyeron sus propios caminos. Y eso tiene valor.
>
>Sin embargo, con el paso del tiempo también aprendí algo importante: **no todo lo que construimos nos devuelve algo equivalente a lo que entregamos.**

|![1001038164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wWno26Tz5jjGpefrzsEQ5FeZdcUF7twowuEkUKQCUgJxgL8a6pNVzusuVQSxDPoxus9.jpg)|![1001038166.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wWrjQddKCfBhYhyNJmPtrky1gewfUo557wsVHLprDr2TzyRz99uLvxeSoTf2XUDVcx2.jpg)|
|-|-|

Sometimes we invest our time, knowledge, and energy into spaces we genuinely care about, hoping for recognition, gratitude, or simply the feeling that our work left a visible mark.

But life has a curious way of teaching us that things do not always work that way. And that's okay.

Because the real mistake is not giving without receiving.
The real mistake is assuming that one day a reward will arrive that was never promised in the first place.

That is why I am not writing these words from a place of disappointment, but from a place of reflection.

I have come to understand that the most valuable resource we possess is not money, tokens, or rewards for creating something. **It is time.**
And with time comes an even more important question than \

**Where am I building it?**

Because not every place values our efforts in the same way.
Not every space is prepared to recognize what we contribute.
And not every investment of time produces the same impact on our lives.

If these years have taught me anything, it is that we must be intentional about where we invest our energy, our knowledge, and our hearts.

Because in the end, the most important places to build are still the ones we can embrace, care for, and watch grow right in front of us.

Our family.
Our home.
Our people.
Our own dreams.

If you choose to build within any community, project, or platform, do it because you believe in it and because you genuinely enjoy the process.

But never depend on recognition to determine whether your efforts were worthwhile.

Because that recognition may never come—or it may only reach a select few. And if you ever find yourself looking for the place where your time can generate the greatest return, remember that the people who love you most are probably much closer than you think.

***Happy anniversary to me!***

Not because of the years that have passed. But because of the lessons they have taught me.

>![Versión en Español]
>
>A veces damos nuestro tiempo, nuestro conocimiento y nuestra energía a espacios que apreciamos profundamente, esperando quizás reconocimiento, gratitud o simplemente la sensación de que nuestro trabajo dejó una huella visible.
>
>Pero la vida tiene una forma curiosa de enseñarnos que no siempre ocurre así. Y está bien.
>
>Porque el verdadero error no es dar sin recibir. **El error es asumir que algún día llegará una recompensa que nadie prometió.**
>
>Por eso hoy no escribo estas líneas desde la decepción, sino desde la reflexión.
>
>He comprendido que el recurso más valioso que poseemos no es el dinero, ni los tokens, ni las recompensas por crear algo. **Es el tiempo.**
>
>Y con el tiempo llega una pregunta aún más importante que \

: **¿Dónde estoy construyéndolo?** > >Porque no todos los lugares valoran de la misma manera nuestros esfuerzos. No todos los espacios están preparados para reconocer lo que aportamos. Y no todas las inversiones de tiempo generan el mismo impacto en nuestra vida. > >Si algo me han enseñado estos años es que debemos ser muy conscientes de dónde colocamos nuestra energía, nuestro conocimiento y nuestro corazón. > >Porque al final del camino, los lugares más importantes para construir siguen siendo aquellos que podemos abrazar, cuidar y ver crecer frente a nosotros. > >Nuestra familia. > >Nuestro hogar. > >Nuestra gente. > >Nuestros propios sueños. > >Si decides construir en cualquier comunidad, proyecto o plataforma, hazlo porque crees en ello y porque disfrutas hacerlo. Pero nunca dependas del reconocimiento para sentir que tu esfuerzo valió la pena. Porque quizás ese reconocimiento nunca llegue o solo le llegue a unos pocos. > >Y si alguna vez buscas un lugar donde tu tiempo tenga el mayor retorno posible, recuerda que las personas que más te aman probablemente estén mucho más cerca de lo que imaginas. > >***¡Feliz aniversario para mí!*** > >No por los años transcurridos. Sino por las lecciones aprendidas. ---

body.title: PhotoFeed Contest - Landscape - Hayle Beach Surfers.
body.body:
Hi everyone!

Back with another surfing post, this time I headed to Hayle beach on the north coast of Cornwall!

Admittedly I went to this new location with the [hope of shooting a nice sunset across the ocean](https://peakd.com/hive-186141/@bombaycrypto/hayle-delight). To my surprise, a group of surfers were just chilling in the water (and presumably learning about it).

Despite the small-ish waves, a few of them were able to stand up on the boards and have a go whilst others bobbed around.

![Screenshot 2025-08-15 at 18.42.53.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/23x196iq4ZGNX8ywo5Qd1v5AMcgpMV73LWRZwVBC9USouve2B3gsKzeBtBZdLJdHJKJah.jpg)

![Screenshot 2025-08-15 at 18.43.13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/243WPbi2SyarKpoFAPwqtPLx8bztPGhX4Tvbu5Jfcu9yuHu6naw5v8BDsZbLCeL3HyBxS.png)

![Screenshot 2025-08-15 at 18.42.10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/EoGvXXnaw4h6TB38f4nhEBACdoiLpsSw87Eq2PPBqFNDPVdjPL1RNhBNV4yWRHKsQM5.jpg)

![Screenshot 2025-08-15 at 18.42.42.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/242NcwbJcmyvCAGm9bXPkhyowQQ4eKvJB6yp7QLFWHH735oRBe84PCwZFkEnxzCUzqaiS.png)
It was mid week, far from any 'tourist' spots and seemed like a very local meet up of friends and enthusiasts so it was really nice to see a community just turning up and supporting eachother.

![Screenshot 2025-08-15 at 18.41.51.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/23zknLhZvDAYDFmBHahv968gkdyRzUAXFALBFKhGxWJKX6fWYYyArVo4KEveEjKcFSk9o.jpg)

![Screenshot 2025-08-15 at 18.42.23.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/EoEhsJQimmTy4K7qbne13jhdvyD7YpDMSjWgoZFr9jzUA5R23UNmtxrpUDCRKtwNBWo.jpg)

I would have liked to have flown a little closer to get in the action but I wanted to respect the surfers and also it was a little windy that evening, I was just glad I caught them standing up!

body.title: Finalmente en casa - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body: <div class=\

> El vuelo fue mucho más rápido de lo que ellos esperaban, ya que durante todo el trayecto revisaron estadísticas, comentarios y mensajes, hasta que finalmente el piloto anunció que ya iban a aterrizar. Tenían más de dos meses afuera y al momento de que pisaron el aeropuerto de casa todo era distinto, sin embargo, algunos pasajeros ya los habían reconocido por el video y varios se acercaron para felicitarlos. Michelle no podía dejar de sonreír, Tomás parecía sorprendido, Lucas grababa pequeños videos y Richard Stone observaba todo con orgullo. Cuando finalmente cruzaron las puertas de llegada, la felicidad llegó, ya que sus familiares estaban allí y cada abrazo era más fuerte, donde Michelle lloró al abrazar a su madre, Tomás levantó a su hermano menor y Lucas recibió un fuerte abrazo de su padre, quien simplemente le dijo al oído —Sabía que podías hacerlo— Luego de unos segundos se encontraron con parte del equipo de RisignStar, quienes habían seguido cada paso de la gira desde el primer día. Cuando salieron del aeropuerto, el impacto fue aún mayor, puesto que una multitud de fanáticos los esperaba detrás de las vallas de seguridad. Algunos tenían carteles, otros fotografías, pero lo que llamó su atención fue escuchar su propia canción y es que la melodía sonaba por todas partes y otros la estaban cantando, Michelle festejo, Tomás se quedó inmóvil y Lucas seguía feliz de estar viviendo un gran sueño. >The flight went by much faster than they had expected, as they spent the entire trip checking statistics, comments, and messages, until the pilot finally announced that they were about to land. They had been away for over two months, and the moment they stepped into the airport back home, everything felt different; however, some passengers had already recognized them from the video, and several came over to congratulate them. Michelle couldn’t stop smiling; Tomás looked surprised; Lucas was recording short videos; and Richard Stone watched it all with pride. # >When they finally walked through the arrival gates, happiness washed over them, as their families were there, and every hug was tighter than the last. Michelle cried as she hugged her mother, Tomás lifted his younger brother up, and Lucas received a big hug from his father, who simply whispered in his ear —I knew you could do it — After a few seconds, they met up with part of the RisignStar team, who had followed every step of the tour from day one. # >When they left the airport, the impact was even greater, as a crowd of fans was waiting for them behind the security barriers. Some held signs, others photographs, but what caught their attention was hearing their own song—the melody was playing everywhere, and others were singing along. Michelle celebrated, Tomás stood motionless, and Lucas remained happy to be living a great dream. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdmZcjQewKEuEmZxtVDCpBzGvVxxAed1VML1a5JBF6Fz/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/buscar/abrazo/) Después de varios minutos saludando, firmando autógrafos y tomándose fotografías, el equipo de RisignStar los llevó hacia el estudio y lo genial es que durante el trayecto podían ver cosas que antes no estaban en la ciudad. Cuando llegaron al edificio de RisignStar, todo estaba en silencio, luces apagadas, sin embargo, al entrar, descubrieron que todo el personal de la compañía estaba reunido en el salón principal, cuando la Banda 17 entró todos comenzaron aplaudir. En una enorme pantalla apareció el video musical de ellos mismos y todos comenzaron a verlo, hasta que el director general de RisignStar tomó el micrófono y dijo —Hace dos meses enviamos a cuatro jóvenes llenos de sueños a Inglaterra y hoy regresan como la banda de la que todo el mundo está comenzando a hablar— Los aplausos volvieron a llenar la sala y mientras todos festejan, al director recibió una llamada internacional proveniente de Los Ángeles, donde necesitaba comunicarse con la banda 17 lo más rápido posible y lo que iba a proponer cambiaría sus vidas para siempre. >After spending several minutes greeting people, signing autographs, and taking photos, the RisignStar team led them to the studio, and the cool thing was that along the way they could see parts of the city they hadn’t seen before. body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbARDYTjvHue9rqPAxpuRw2GiAernTn9s4iGWA4Mv5y3v/1000014411.png 

Today the crypto market was immediately shaken by two massive news from the global institution and geopolitical stage that are predicted to change the direction of market liquidity in the near future. The first news discussed by Coin Bureau comes from Taiwan which is rumored to be seriously exploring Bitcoin as an alternative foreign exchange reserve asset. This is done to secure their $602 billion savings from the risk of geopolitical conflicts with China. Currently more than 80% of Taiwan foreign exchange reserves are held in US dollar assets which are considered highly vulnerable to being frozen if regional tensions escalate. Therefore the anti seizure nature of Bitcoin is starting to be seen as a safe solution.

​Not less exciting, the Crypto Rover account also shared news that the global asset management giant BlackRock with a managing fund power reaching $14 trillion will launch their newest product called Bitcoin Premium Income ETF today. The presence of this new ETF product from BlackRock is a very important point because it will become a new gateway for the entry of massive institutional fund flows. The injection of fresh liquidity from these two big sentiments clearly brings a massive breath of fresh air into the spot market.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSMzaudDVXAR8YmZbgvQX4pxJj7oLw5VCNQ8E7FXvds48/1000014356.png 


​Looking at the busy fundamental sentiments above, the technical structure on the $BTC daily chart is also responding in a very interesting way. Based on TradingView technical data, the price is currently testing whether the support zone at $62.560 - $60.000 is strong enough to hold the decline. This zone is very crucial because it is the first defense line after the market broke out of the large falling wedge or triangle consolidation pattern early this year before making a sharp correction and creating a fair value gap or FVG area.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTa5SbmnT4bU71UjqVxm32ByuJX9pQhVR8yYPUXgdi3hU/1000014396.jpg 


​If this strong support zone breaks, the market still has the next backup support area in the price range of $52.290 - $50.520. However looking at the magnet pull of the daily FVG around $66K, the opportunity to bounce back or rebound is still wide open. The nearest upward target is projected to test the second resistance area in the $74.265 - $73.060 zone before finally trying to chase the highest resistance target in the $90.280 - $88.400 zone.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNcQc54hm9xZwUJeAnciF1B81ysfFN8EHXgEM4RzSVBd7/1000014395.jpg 


​If we break down the market activity based on derivative data, this movement is supported by a fairly stable trading volume foundation across various major world exchanges. From the futures market data, Binance leads the liquidity turnover with a fantastic number reaching $15.01B followed by OKX worth $7.65B and Bybit at $5.54B.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb3DgkiZzWa4n1tJBvLrpToyeh7ZwAf5q6UJDqejNAkw5/1000014368.png 


​The most crucial thing to note is that the Long/Short Ratio of top trader accounts on Binance stands at 1.4845 which indicates that the majority of big players or whales are currently much more inclined to take buying positions. Even though in the last 24 hours there was a cleaning action of short positions worth $96.55M and long positions worth $39.44M, this liquidation dynamic actually makes the market structure much healthier because it cleans up positions with high leverage.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYgr7M8gA2y3hC2DE4EA2SUd4ck6GR8hhcpZc81ux9RUm/1000014390.png 



# My Opinion
​Seeing market conditions full of surprises and global macroeconomic dynamics that are currently completely uncertain, I suggest you all start braking your ego in the derivative market. This is not a friendly time if we force ourselves to play futures because the volatility can make your capital disappear in an instant due to a margin call or mass liquidation.

​In my opinion, now is the most perfect time for us to switch to a long term strategy by doing staking. Utilizing the staking feature on potential assets will give us a passive income that is much safer and more stable in the midst of the global economic uncertainty storm. Rather than being stressed watching the futures chart that goes up and down randomly, it is better for us to secure our assets for the future through the staking path.

body.title: Contra was everything  | Childhood memories
body.body: Even with the trend of Pay2Earn games, I no longer have any interest in gaming. Meanwhile, I was heavily addicted to gaming when I was a teenager, and this wasn't the modern trend we have today but the old-school type that came with VCD players. Mehn, if you weren't born then, you really missed a lot. Lol. First of all, I still don't know how parents, especially my dad, got to find out that playing games on the VCD could damage its functionality. My dad was so strongly against us playing games on the VCD. If he found out, it meant we would be heavily flogged that day. I received a series of beatings from my dad, but those beatings didn't stop me from playing games, especially Contra. Yeah, Contra was my favourite game, and I could spend the whole day playing it without getting tired.
alt=\

/>

On weekdays, which were school days, I always felt on top of the world because my dad usually went to the farm, and our school closed by 2 p.m. Whenever school ended and I checked the spot we usually used to know whether there was electricity, and I found out there was power, I would practically walk-run home that afternoon just to get there quickly and play the game.

I usually bribed my female siblings not to tell my dad that I had played games whenever he returned home. Sometimes they accepted the bribe, but most times they didn't, and that usually led to evening or night flogging by my dad.

When phones were gradually becoming common, especially Symbian and Java phones, we discovered that the same games most of us got punished for playing on the VCD were available on phones. However, not many of us had access to phones at that time to play those games. We would borrow phones from friends, and by then, DVDs had taken over, while VCDs were no longer common or popular.

Now, the game is everywhere. I have a phone that I can sit with and play on 24/7, but I no longer have any interest in playing games.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: Top 5 real hotel-property projects to invest in across Europe (2026)
body.body:
Branded and hotel real estate is one of the calmer ways into property: a hotel operator runs your unit, tourists keep coming, and the rent arrives in your account. Below are five **real, existing projects** — not abstract markets — where you can actually buy today. Ranked, and number one earns it.



![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/66ae5cf638c635c4c9f08cd675d638fe5466de66ee8f3edc1f31cec36eea90c5)



**1. Kolašin Valleys — Montenegro 🇲🇪 (the winner)**

A master-planned, all-season mountain resort in northern Montenegro.

*   **Income in euros.** Montenegro uses the euro, so rent arrives in euros with no currency risk.

*   **A future EU member at today's prices.** Active accession talks, government target 2028 — you enter a developing market on a clear path to a mature one.

*   **A full resort, not one building.** 23 hotels and branded residences, 73 private mountain chalets, 30+ restaurants, ski lifts, spa — master-planned by Ecosign, the firm behind Whistler. Swissôtel Resort Kolašin is already open.

*   **Two seasons.** Winter skiing plus a cool 18–24°C summer escape, so the apartment rarely sits empty. Managed rental pool, returns in euros.

Euros + EU trajectory + a complete resort + year-round demand + a low entry point. Nothing else here combines all five.

**2. Green Coast Resort & Residences — Albania**

A real, operating condo-hotel resort in Palasa on the Albanian Riviera, by **Balfin Group**, affiliated with **Marriott / Interval International** exchange. Nearby, **Eagle Hills (Mohamed Alabbar)** is building the €2.5bn **Durrës Yachts & Marina** with hotels and branded residences.

*   Fast-growing Ionian coastline; major international developers committed.

*   Beachfront living, pools, beach clubs, managed rental potential.

*   Low entry prices and an EU-candidate growth story.

**3. Bansko apart-hotels — Bulgaria**

Established SPA apart-hotel complexes such as **St. Ivan Rilski** and **Pirin Golf & Country Club** in Razlog, plus new coastal builds like **Loggia Residences** near Sveti Vlas.

*   **Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026** — currency risk gone, investor confidence up.

*   Among the cheapest entry points in Europe: studios and one-beds often €50,000–€90,000.

*   SPA complexes with winter-ski and summer rental demand; EU member since 2007.



![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/b490bd10d8edd0507458de18af3f1210c2b86da248541105b8877085ef47d92f)



**4. Crystal Mountain Resort & Crystal Apartments — Poland**

A real five-star resort in Wisła, in the Beskidy mountains, by **Górskie Resorty** — the 494-room hotel opened in 2021, with condo **Crystal Apartments** built around it. The same operator and the **Zdrojowa Invest / Radisson** condo-hotels on the Baltic coast in Świnoujście are Poland's condo pioneers.

*   Operating five-star hotel with aquapark, spa and conference centre; 50/50 rental-revenue split.

*   Strong, wealthy domestic tourism base means reliable occupancy; recoverable VAT on purchase.

*   Professional management, full ownership, year-round mountain demand.

**5. Kranjska Gora aparthotels — Slovenia**

New four-star aparthotels by the slopes in Kranjska Gora, Slovenia's top ski town near the Austrian and Italian borders, plus the Portorož spa coast.

*   **EU and eurozone for years** — the most institutionally stable option on this list.

*   Ski-in/ski-out alpine living at lower prices than Austria or Italy next door.

*   Foreign-buyer-friendly, low transaction costs, strong long-term value retention.

Every project above is real and buyable today. But only one gives you euro income, a clear path into the EU, a full-scale resort with two high seasons, and prices that still reflect a developing market — **Kolašin Valleys**. You can stay at the Swissôtel now and own your own mountain residence in the same resort, from \~€138,000.

body.body:
**“Abeja”** is a good one because it teaches more than a noun — it opens the door to **pollination, hive roles, and everyday nature vocabulary**.

Your first image works well: **“Una abeja está volando entre las flores”** is clear, natural Spanish, and the visual makes it easy for learners to lock the word in. The second image adds a nice layer too, because **“abeja reina”** and **“abejas obreras”** introduce useful compound vocabulary tied to real bee behavior, which matches standard bee biology descriptions from [MU Extension](https://extension.missouri.edu/publications/m403) and broader pollination research in [PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8396518/).

What makes this post clever is the **three-language bridge** — English, Chinese, and Spanish in one learning unit. That’s not just vocabulary drilling; it’s pattern recognition, which is how people actually remember words instead of forgetting them five minutes later.

A small language note: **“la abeja”** is feminine, so keeping the article visible in the title is smart. It helps learners remember that the word is not just *abeja*, but **la abeja**.

For community context, your **Daily Word** format is clearly becoming its own little learning series on [@aljif7’s blog](https://inleo.io/@aljif7). Consistency wins — and post **#436** proves you’re not dabbling, you’re building a real educational archive.

body.body:
Colonoscopy in North Delhi – Advanced Gastroenterology Screening and Digestive Health Diagnostic Services in North Delhi focuses on providing accurate, safe, and comprehensive diagnostic procedures for evaluating the health of the large intestine and digestive tract. In Delhi,[ ](https://dranandosengupta.com/colonoscopy)particularly in the northern regions, advanced gastroenterology centers and hospitals offer colonoscopy services using modern medical technology and experienced specialists to ensure precise diagnosis and effective patient care. Colonoscopy is an essential procedure for detecting abnormalities in the colon and rectum, including inflammation, ulcers, polyps, and early signs of colorectal cancer.

A colonoscopy is a minimally invasive diagnostic procedure in which a flexible tube with a camera is inserted into the rectum to examine the inner lining of the colon. This procedure helps doctors identify the cause of symptoms such as abdominal pain, chronic diarrhea, constipation, rectal bleeding, and unexplained weight loss. It is also widely used for routine screening, especially in individuals above a certain age or those with a family history of colorectal diseases. Early detection through colonoscopy plays a vital role in preventing serious complications and improving long-term digestive health outcomes.

Leading gastroenterology centers in North Delhi offer advanced colonoscopy services with modern endoscopic equipment and highly trained gastroenterologists. These facilities ensure high-definition imaging, improved accuracy, and patient comfort during the procedure. Sedation techniques are often used to minimize discomfort, making the procedure safe and well-tolerated by most patients. In addition to diagnostic colonoscopy, therapeutic procedures such as polyp removal, biopsy collection, and treatment of minor intestinal issues can also be performed during the same session.

Preparation for a colonoscopy involves dietary restrictions and bowel cleansing to ensure clear visualization of the colon. Medical professionals provide detailed instructions to patients before the procedure to ensure accurate results. After the procedure, patients are monitored for a short period and are usually able to resume normal activities within a day. The entire process is designed to be efficient, safe, and minimally disruptive to the patient’s routine.

Preventive healthcare is a key benefit of colonoscopy screening. Regular screenings help detect precancerous polyps and other abnormalities at an early stage, allowing timely treatment and significantly reducing the risk of colorectal cancer. Gastroenterologists in North Delhi emphasize the importance of routine screenings, especially for individuals with risk factors such as age, lifestyle, or family history of digestive diseases.

Modern healthcare facilities in North Delhi are equipped with advanced endoscopy suites, infection control systems, and digital reporting tools to ensure high standards of patient care. Experienced gastroenterologists and medical staff provide personalized treatment plans based on individual diagnostic findings. Many centers also offer consultation services, follow-up care, and dietary guidance to support long-term digestive health.

Choosing Colonoscopy in North Delhi ensures access to expert gastroenterologists, advanced diagnostic technology, and safe medical procedures. With a strong focus on accuracy, patient comfort, and preventive healthcare, these centers play an important role in maintaining digestive health and detecting serious conditions at an early stage. Colonoscopy services in North Delhi continue to support better health outcomes through early diagnosis, advanced medical care, and patient-focused treatment approaches.

body.title: We’re Not a Perfect Family, But This Simple Swimming Bonding Reminded Me Why We Always Choose Each Other
body.body:
![Purple Minimalist Polaroid Lavender Moodboard Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48VFfrNyUT1HFNJPMfVHMZfCC3kPGUPguN5awWSYvrZN86enmLTzuwesG58HJc9ZrF.png)

As I watched my family laugh, swim, sing, and share meals together, I realized that family bonding is not about perfection, it's about making time for each other despite our differences.

Life has been busy for all of us. Everyone has their own work, responsibilities, and personal struggles. That is why our family on my husband's side makes it a goal to gather at least once a month. Before the school year starts, we decided to have a simple family bonding at a swimming pool near my in-laws' house. So we don’t travel so long. 


![IMG_20250824_170429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wgQCoibo43ThNS5naizLRYmtcxo3gNEdXVpuPuPTvqEuN2rmitZsdxj58Ta4Kh1Jkxy.jpg)

The best thing about this gathering was that it wasn't complicated. There was no grand venue, no elaborate setup, and no months of planning. Sometimes, the simplest moments become the most memorable. We just wanted to spend time together, relax, and enjoy each other's company.




![IMG_20250824_162718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/2449zEWgrNLLxZk5gRJqfdo4fz6DyqpiEXYS2ExUxmMc6c4PXzcCH4nPsC3vjGPQa3acG.jpg)

Like any family, we are not perfect. We experience misunderstandings, hurt feelings, and disagreements over the smallest things. There are times when we don't see eye to eye. However, whenever we gather together, it feels as if those issues fade away. We laugh, share stories, and create new memories as one family.

![IMG_20250824_163257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23z77cMA19YE6sarsJyUkUEtbBe1VD6s2DMpK6FGvu5VPHVxwDfc2yzizCFV9xkuSgvdu.jpg)

Not everyone in the family naturally enjoys activities like this. Some grew up with different traditions, while others simply prefer staying at home. There are even family members who need a little extra convincing before they join. Sometimes, a free meal helps motivate them to come along not because they cannot afford it, but because they are naturally thrifty and don't always see the value of gatherings like this. But once they're there, they end up having just as much fun as everyone else.

![IMG_20250824_170800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zbcNMeiPVTu1L5mcBmDEp7g7yfvWQVAt29wjAtU7RxxGuuKFFQk88NHMtaGgGCh8DyX.jpg)

![IMG_20250824_163336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23x12eJK6WTnM9RRfMDaVaEH4yxT4m9tPE9RbujTZtvsz13AzMRpkEMGALW79N9LEiWGZ.jpg)

One of the highlights of the day was seeing my daughter enjoy the swimming pool. Her laughter alone made the gathering worthwhile. While the children enjoyed the water, other family members spent time singing videoke, they are the blessed in voice hehe! others may enjoy food, and catching up with one another. Of course, the boys had their usual drinks while sharing stories and jokes a family trademark that never seems to disappear.

![IMG_20250824_170839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uFVqwNb7inEjanYLHSrkwcqu7SMNf2BvKx92gkJnwCWv8N95egZyMocMfBCze7CWsH4.jpg)

Moments like these remind me that family is not about being perfect. It is about choosing one another again and again, despite differences, misunderstandings, and busy schedules.

![IMG_20250824_182909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uEz3V4BNqmX4BBhdrQRwSxsaSoLo1B8UCy5BLDrUSZi7mhZJyRU1QDGMK32qcH1omKs.jpg)

At the end of the day, what matters most is that we showed up, spent time together, and strengthened the bond that keeps our family connected.

Thank you for reading my story. All photos are my own and were edited using Canva. Have a nice day!

body.title: : Aquí comienza mi desafío como madre [ESP]
body.body: ![IMG_20260614_145438_763.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wMMRPxMuUZprw4hZN9mM5EAgSyMmpWf2Jk6R56RwQTRBeu1Jcs2GYGBAvzza5awLQiy.jpg) *

>No es cosa sencilla saber cuál es el camino adecuado qué debemos determinar para nuestros hijos... Muchas veces son nuestras propias pretensiones las que nublan las decisiones que debemos tomar. No se crean, no es sencillo ser un buen padre. Muchas veces nosotros proyectamos los miedos y las cosas que nosotros supimos experimentar de nuestra padres... En palabras más sencillas, repetimos un ciclo infinito que va desde lo que nos ha sido familiar en nuestras vidas, hasta lo que creemos que es lo ideal para el futuro de nuestros hijos.

*\n\n*

>Lo sé, parece muy confuso lo que intento decir... Pero es que en la práctica es muy difícil. Yo, como madre, vivo contsmen debatiéndome entre lo que debo hacer para mi hija y lo que quiero. No siempre van de la mano, ni son similares... De hecho, si lo pienso fría y calculadoramente, viviendo en el país que vivo y siendo consciente de todos lo problemas con lo que tenemos que lidiar a diario; la decisión más conveniente para ella, para mi beba, sería prepararla emocional, humana y económicamente para ser una migrants exitosa.

* ![IMG_20260614_150704_143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tS13CKY8C4KdUYJUCzdSZ7asqqumtapGv9QW9DENiZXPaBkyeZqUvJoaZxvnzX4PtXS.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_152137_716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wMMtwFptD8VnYyNSAMhGX8Q5oDFoBwDkNtHV1g8GiQNsohArc88LNtAjWi4NYuARopA.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_152607_838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EowEdyhn63RyMpQ8FdJbjPMwpExaWJSovn6K8QxCd1juGKvSfVUM8SFtRKuAKhKfKpd.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_151907_440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EoGqemrsQpZ4zcgf5XWpxmiWYTsUo6ajAvcD6Pme17LY28HocLV5vbcKCp48Kfwy1V1.jpg) *

>¿Es, acaso, lo que yo deseo para ella? No. Absolutamente, no. Es más, el mero hechonde tener que pensar en esto me pone muy nerviosa y vulnerable. Esa niña es mi vida, y no sé si estoy preparada para un caso como el que expongo en este post... Sin embargo, todos los padres del mundo sabemos, que si tenemos que sacrificarnos por nuestros hijos, lo haríamos sin dudarlo. Y aunque parezca extraño, este post ha nacido de una conversación tranquila, con helado en mano entre madre e hija, mientras caminábamos en una tarde hermosa de otoño.

*\n\n*
Sin ánimos de desalentarla o disuadir, lo que provocó en mí fue muy potente. Abrió una caja de Pandora que no sé si había \

alguna vez... Yo no puedo ser objetiva con ella... No me malinterpreten, sé bien lo que le conviene y le sería mejor para su calidad e vida pero al mismo tiempo, soy testigo del talento y la dedicación que tiene mi niña desde muy pequeña. Baila, actúa, se anima a cantar,  y es un \

, cuando de entrar a un escenario se trata. Honestamente, no la veo siendo contadora o educadora... Y no hay nada de malo con esas profesiones pero mi dilema no cede... ¿Aliento y apoyo su sueño, o declino y la guio hacia la estabilidad de la monotonía? No es sencilla una respuesta, ni tampoco es terreno seguro ¿Por qué? No hay ninguna seguridad sobre qué sería mejor.

* ![1000247175.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23uEzCZMDW7j6TKNE8JreY9DquFtJM8H8D86Aaf7UNdu9yFcNzjTUTBFjaTBUsXvn3W78.jpg) ![1000247176.jpg](image-7-1000247176.jpg)![1000247170.jpg](image-8-1000247170.jpg)![1000247171.jpg](image-9-1000247171.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_145952_187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wBxikmi9mSwiox32Znfk2EFkndvituXB4J578C9FT8LFngkrwxChePazbTijKbi4ggV.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_154101_891.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23uQNyiWYTQzy54vQ8fGouvgyZPCWNYvEXNwdfLXtQgeD7bjybYk6ai5nttXuwiV2Wrc8.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_154315_668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/Eoc1D1c9VADYHJaNhecQYTeVa6dq2VQMRNpgbkGmHf9ozmS5huLF2CJ9qPdWedrnYHK.jpg) *

>A veces lo que parece sencillo no lo es tanto cuando te importan las consecuencias de tus actos. Yo tengo claro el objetivo de mi maternidad: que mi hija sea realmente, genuinamente feliz... También soy muy consciente de dónde vivo y cuáles son las limitaciones de mi vida y de mi país. Pero no permito que mis frustraciones bloqueen lo que puede ser un futuro más brillante. Y ea que la mera posibilidad de que ella logre lo que sé que ha venido cosechando desde que era una nanita de 5; me roba el aliento. Aún no tengo que decidir; realmente no hay prisa. Pero si u a dudas razonable.

* ![1000247164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xyQbbvhs9YoTT5eGumzFJ6HenyGsQVeHEkw9wQog6utuB1BTGncLX1V3ndzPYxnSZbe.jpg) ***

body.title: 🥟Haciendo tequeños para el desayuno 🥣// 🥟Making tequeños for breakfast 🥣(Esp-Eng)
body.body:
<center>
![1000283848.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTuH4R8qsCCXMEa4oSw1x1T42662rtuKnkNKnWpFajnMS/1000283848.png)
</center>

#





---
#
*<div class =\

>Hola buenos días,y sean bienvenidos a este nuevo post en el que le voy a mostrar como hice tequeños,paso a paso,sin tanto complicaciones, porque fueron para el desayuno además con pocos ingredientes. Está es una preparación de tequeños a mi estilo, porque la preparación de tequeños es más elaborado,y también porque usan una amasadora para que la masa quede mejor,en cambio yo me voy por la preparación de masa, agua y sal y sin tanto complicaciones,vamos a los materiales y preparación.* # > *Good morning, and welcome to this new post where I'll show you how I made tequeños, step by step, without too many complications, because they were for breakfast and used few ingredients. This is my version of tequeños, because the typical preparation is more elaborate, and they also use a mixer to make the dough better. Instead, I'm going for a simple dough, water, and salt recipe, without all the fuss. Let's get to the ingredients and instructions.* ---
![1000283631.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9jWZxjMoGWeaw45aAG77BqA5aAK7EUhQ19o1nDpEuwR/1000283631.jpg)
# #
Ingredientes/Ingredients
 #
![1000283632.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVyW5nT6799AL5o8119vTyXyXuVKWZuGyVdazRY6BDaLy/1000283632.jpg)
# * 1 taza de harina de trit * 1 cucharada de azúcar * 1/2 cucharada de sal * 1 cucharada de aceite * 1/2 de agua * Queso blanco * Aceite para freír # >* 1 cup all-purpose flour >* 1 tablespoon sugar >* 1/2 tablespoon salt >* 1 tablespoon oil >* 1/2 cup water >* White cheese >* Oil for frying # #
Preparación/Preparation
 #
![1000283075.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQY79n98zMajZayxbZN9QXFYwWqNHnWVPC6mGdq1RYZcz/1000283075.jpg)
![1000283076.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSKorNPYTpC8ABTZXS61ziQw3qieEn2JzbVJ8sB5wq5CL/1000283076.jpg)
![1000283918.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY8L8ktaoZXxHqp2kGyLcHvrnPy5YgJCs3Pny2z8Wm7CE/1000283918.jpg)
![1000283081.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTfkC1ECehH1cT2gC62spsm7JkxrobmiVTeGNunb9XvLW/1000283081.jpg)
![1000283083.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedufkG6HZjLz621qtoDoZmR4btsnCFWUiQ19HioCjmn8/1000283083.jpg)
![1000283085.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVNc24meijngD9AvaeEQeokn23Y12k3goBBYNwSEm9hdJ/1000283085.jpg)
# * #### Paso 1/Step 1 **

>Para la preparación de la masa,tome como envase para amasar un plato con superficie plana,y coloque la harina,la sal y el azúcar,luego mezcle esos ingredientes con una cucharilla,luego hice un espacio en el medio para agregar el aceite y el agua.** # > To prepare the dough, use a flat plate as a container for kneading, and place the flour, salt, and sugar in it. Then mix these ingredients with a spoon, and then make a space in the middle to add the oil and water. ---
![1000283088.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXgoC2deH5tbyKvV1FX4Vrm6kTiXvgSwJWykrTS8qu9Zg/1000283088.jpg)
![1000283870.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfVLKjaUHDnKGDVjhEBeSu2GAfuHRafBm9u2cug78otKv/1000283870.jpg)
![1000283871.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZcGdb761xRkHB2KJFpaBeRoN337ysp9uUnL7L9CAsaRo/1000283871.jpg)
![1000283872.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdv6XY3oRtnrYiHFeapJpUnvBEhPeQoYKM8CK3Ft5gSDS/1000283872.jpg)
# * #### Paso 2/Step 2 **

>Continuando con la preparación de la masa,ahora con la cucharilla fui mezclando desde el centro mezclando poco a poco lo seco con el agua y el aceite,hasta que se mezclara bien, ya después amase con las manos por unos 5 minutos y después deje reposar por unos 10 minutos.** # > Continuing with the preparation of the dough, now with the spoon I mixed from the center, gradually mixing the dry ingredients with the water and oil, until it was well mixed, then I kneaded it with my hands for about 5 minutes and then let it rest for about 10 minutes. ---
![1000283630.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbbkmV5wr2vhpQMhoR2nmdPiG5xrYZKgZKqXFDgJQJzEh/1000283630.jpg)
![1000283097.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDFiFvqrAEGmoRcSYmQ2ii6HoaBVs7B3rQVrL1JPmFE4/1000283097.jpg)
# * #### Paso 3/Step 3 **

>Corte el queso en varios palitos,el queso que estoy usando es queso llanero,el que usamos en Venezuela para nuestras comidas,pero el mozzarella sirve también.** # > Cut the cheese into several sticks. The cheese I'm using is llanero cheese, the one we use in Venezuela for our meals, but mozzarella works too. ---
![1000283098.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme9dxEpiPsU6zPN2FR91LFfHPxMhV43aydXi86ziorNnD/1000283098.jpg)
![1000283873.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTnzPsuUfXLNnBewzGLmAgDfb2YxfRnyrkcdk7jsqX13p/1000283873.jpg)
![1000283874.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRm1yUKyRzUfEsDUJX8xpoBMXL7wccs6Q31C4ogTRxGP9/1000283874.jpg)
![1000283875.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWeyEQSSGbdJAxsGVQFoaQGvXbXd95yqSby3qQZxV22Xo/1000283875.jpg)
![1000283876.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeUnsrMYH1jHMv6eAfJH2XtojgdWZWsUsxqm1VDZhp22q/1000283876.jpg)
# * #### Paso 4/Step 4 **

> Ya cuando la masa estaba bien reposada, empecé por el armado de los tequeños, entonces sobre otro plato extendi un pedazo de masa,tiene que quedar como una tira, luego de una de las esquinas coloque el queso ,y fui enrollando la masa sobre el queso,así fui haciendo con cada tequeños,en total me alcanzó la masa para 12 tequeños.** # > Once the dough had rested well, I started assembling the tequeños. On another plate, I took a piece of dough and spread it out, making it look like a strip. Then, at one corner, I placed the cheese and rolled the dough around the cheese. I did this with each tequeño. In total, I had enough dough for 12 tequeños. ---
![1000283877.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdLN559xb6Zh2GLYHf7iNBmf4zVx9gcBTFo4UtazYRDd/1000283877.jpg)
![1000283106.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMEGFhdE8A4Q8c89CpfjHRxTZf5mTy1XPZYkFerjVucc/1000283106.jpg)
![1000283110.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWB2ASh1VreZhZTebmQvyLBPiFtKZJPnnXh5CtRor8BBp/1000283110.jpg)
# * #### Paso 5/Step 5 **

>Ya después de armar los tequeños puse a calentar el aceite,a fuego medio,luego fui colocando cada tequeño a freír, hasta que queden doraditos.** # > After assembling the tequeños, I heated the oil over medium heat, then I placed each tequeño in the oil to fry until they were golden brown. --- #
Resultado/Result
 #
![1000283878.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9jWZxjMoGWeaw45aAG77BqA5aAK7EUhQ19o1nDpEuwR/1000283878.jpg) ![1000283115.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmceQD46WqPuD3wTzAvYhcnM6mxH6EX2kdrz6XbtQRwAEX/1000283115.jpg) ![1000283109.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmawPnHuNFhkJkMgu7HKQyomDgDkAwM5qPx1XTH1gMPxuy/1000283109.jpg)
# *

>Y listo los tequeños,así con esta preparación podemos disfrutar de ricos tequeños,muy fácil y sencillos. Espero les haya gustado la preparación y que también puedan hacer tequeños en casa, gracias por visitar este post.* # > And that's it, the tequeños! With this recipe, we can enjoy delicious tequeños—very easy and simple. I hope you liked the recipe and that you can also make tequeños at home. Thanks for visiting this post. --- # *
Las fotos presentadas en este post son de mi autoría. Las imágenes han sido editadas utilizando Canva. Las fotografías fueron tomadas con mi celular Infinix Smart 7. El contenido ha sido traducido con el traductor de Firefox.

* * *

Saludos comunidad. Estamos muy emocionados de presentar nuestra dapp Hive Run. 🎉🚀

Fue realizada por @danielvehe con IA, felicidades. Tiene como principal objetivo, crear sentido de pertenencia y unir a nuestra comunidad, mediante un espacio más íntimo y enfocado al running, con varias características que motivarán a nuestros usuarios a través de la gamificación.

Esta herramienta también nos permitirá, realizar un onboarding más efectivo, porque está enmarcado en nuestro nicho específico.

Se ha diseñado en base a la simplicidad, ignorando algunas opciones de Hive, para hacerla más amigable para el usuario que está más interesado en el running, que en aspectos técnicos de Web3.

Cuenta con cuatro secciones: Feed, Perfil, Post y Desafíos.

Feed
====

En el Feed se presenta nuestro logo, seguido de los avatares de nuestros corredores. Al dar click ahí, se lleva al perfil de cada usuarios. Los emojis que observan en los avatares, son \
que reciben de otros usuarios que visitan su perfil (lo veremos más adelante)\n\nDespués vienen las publicaciones que se presentan de forma cronológica. Hay que mencionar que no incluimos \
ni \

body.body:
**<center>Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.</center>** 

> Hello friends, good vibes to all.


![1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tvXvCm7TTWBB1pgCm93pe33D2xzzhD5JGH2rWvnULP4LHM83nZHPfrwASizbpLRFBGP.webp)


[Source!](https://www.minuto60.com/entretenimiento-cultura/shakira-burna-boy-presentan-dai-dai-mundial-2026/9112)

<div class=\

>Hola querida comunidad, ha sido mucho tiempo sin pasar por acá a pesar de que la música está presente en mi vida todos los días. A veces uno deja las cosas para replantearse cosas y ese fue mi caso; espero volver poco a poco como antes. El motivo de mi presencia es que como bien saben el mundial arrancó y con el todo lo que tiene que ver con sus canciones y la gran cantidad de artistas que hay en esta edición como protagonistas. Desde siempre el asunto de la \

del mundial ha sido motivo de debates entre los fanáticos porque ya esto forma parte de lo que es la experiencia del mundial. En este 2026 la cosa ha cambiado mucho pero, para bien o para mal? - ahí está el detalle.

> Hello everyone, it's been a long time since I've been here, even though music is a part of my life every day. Sometimes you take a break to rethink things, and that was my case; I hope to gradually return to my old ways. The reason for my presence is that, as you know, the World Cup has kicked off, and with it, everything related to its songs and the large number of artists featured in this edition. The issue of the \

World Cup song has always been a topic of debate among fans because it's become an integral part of the World Cup experience. In 2026, things have changed a lot, but is that for better or for worse? That's the question.

>DAI DAI es el tema escogido por la FIFA como la cara musical de este mundial y si, la interprete es Shakira junto Burna Boy, un cantante/compositor nigeriano. Pero es que esto no es todo sino que además de ella tenemos un lineup o cartel de artistas que llegan fácilmente a los 20. El problema que para mi supone esto es la falta de identidad y que no siempre más es mejor. La música al igual que el propio futbol como deporte perdieron esencia para convertirse en un negocio en donde el dinero es lo que manda. Mundial de Italia 90, un solo tema (Un'estate italiana); Francia 98 (La Copa de la Vida); Alemania 06 (The Time of Our Lives); Sudáfrica 2010 (Waka Waka); y así sucesivamente. Todas estas canciones transcendieron, ¿por qué ahora no pasa eso? - pongan en un pentagrama Un'estate italiana y cualquiera de los temas de hoy en día y verán el porque.

> \

is the song chosen by FIFA as the official anthem of this World Cup, and yes, the performer is Shakira, along with Burna Boy, a Nigerian singer-songwriter. But that's not all; in addition to her, we have a lineup of artists that easily reaches 20. The problem, for me, is the lack of identity and the fact that more isn't always better. Music, like football itself as a sport, has lost its essence, becoming a business where money is king. Italy 1990 World Cup: just one song (\
); France 1998 (\
); Germany 2006 (\
); South Africa 2010 (\
); and so on. All these songs transcended time, so why isn't that happening now? Put \

and any of today's songs on a musical staff, and you'll see why.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcnDmrtj6Sk

<div class=\

>Lo que quiero decir es que estas canciones, desde Brasil 2014 hasta acá, llegan y pasan sin pena ni gloria. Ninguno de estos temas, incluido DAI DAI, tienen el efecto en la gente como los tuvieron los nombrados anteriormente. No se si será baja calidad de los músicos hoy en día o la terrible monotonía de que casi todo suena igual pero ninguna de las canciones, de las más de 20 de este mundial, está realmente pegada o sonando. Y estamos hablando de artistas de la talla de JBalvin, Belinda, Jelly Roll, Daddy Yankee, LISA, Annita, Danny Ocean, Shaggy, Andrea Bocelli, David Guetta, 21 Savage, Tyla, The Rolling Stone, Travis Barker, Mayor Lazer, Megan Thee Stallion y un largo etc. No quiero caer en la eterna conversación de que lo de antes era mejor que lo de ahora pero es que si amigos, creo firmemente que si lo era y el mejor ejemplo son estas canciones.

> What I mean is that these songs, from Brazil 2014 until now, come and go without making a splash. None of these tracks, including \

have the same impact on people as the ones mentioned earlier. I don't know if it's the low quality of musicians these days or the terrible monotony of almost everything sounding the same, but none of the songs, out of the more than 20 from this World Cup, are truly catchy or even popular. And we're talking about artists of the caliber of J Balvin, Belinda, Jelly Roll, Daddy Yankee, Lisa, Anitta, Danny Ocean, Shaggy, Andrea Bocelli, David Guetta, 21 Savage, Tyla, The Rolling Stones, Travis Barker, Mayor Lazer, Megan Thee Stallion, and many more. I don't want to get into the endless argument that things were better back then, but yes, friends, I firmly believe they were, and these songs are the best example.

>Que un lineup como el mencionado antes no haya podido ser capaz de emular mínimamente lo que hicieron Gianna Nannini y Edoardo Bennato o el mismo Ricky Martin es para preocuparse. Esto es lo pasa cuando la musica se hace solo por el hecho de ser un encargo o por el dinero en vez de por la misma pasión o amor al arte. Genuinamente para mi todo lo que a la música se refiere en este mundial es un fracaso rotundo, no debería de serlo por los nombres que hay detrás pero lo es, todo es ruido. ¿Qué cambia un poco este discurso? - IShowSpeed. Si, este streamer que decidió sacar su tema, sin ser un musico de talla mundial, y que la FIFA autorizó para que formara parte del álbum oficial.

> The fact that a lineup like the one mentioned earlier couldn't even begin to emulate what Gianna Nannini and Edoardo Bennato, or even Ricky Martin, did is cause for concern. This is what happens when music is made simply because it's a commission or for money, instead of out of genuine passion or love for the art. Frankly, for me, everything related to music at this World Cup is a complete failure. It shouldn't be, given the names involved, but it is; it's all just noise. What changes this narrative somewhat? - IShowSpeed. Yes, this streamer who decided to release his own track, despite not being a world-class musician, and which FIFA authorized for inclusion on the official album. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrY1THC_NQE

>Estamos hablando de un tipo que viajó por todo el mundo, se empapó de la cultura futbolística de cada país y con eso hizo la canción, además de que él un fanático acérrimo del futbol. Y si, esto le puede competir perfectamente a DAI DAI. Esta es precisamente es la diferencia de cuando las cosas se hacen con pasión a solo por dinero; todo termina siendo vacío y monótono. Shakira quizás entiende lo que le gusta a la gente, ese sonido particular; quizás por eso es que DAI DAI es el Waka Waka 2.0 Y está bien porque si le funciona y al final la canción termina siendo un éxito, porque habría de cambiar la formula.

> We're talking about a guy who traveled the world, immersed himself in the football culture of each country, and used that to create the song, plus he's a die-hard football fan. And yes, this can definitely compete with \

This is precisely the difference between things done with passion and those done just for money; everything ends up being empty and monotonous. Shakira perhaps understands what people like, that particular sound; perhaps that's why \
is Waka Waka 2.0. And that's fine because if it works for her and the song ends up being a hit, why change the formula?

>Cuando las cosas eran genuinas era mucho más facil consumirlas y llegaba más rápido a las personas; las cosas producidas en masa se quedan en el camino. Por eso es que una canción de hace 36 años sigue siendo probablemente la mejor canción en la historia de los mundiales. Quisiera que me dejaran su opinión en los comentarios si esto solo lo percibo yo o es una realidad de la que todos somos conscientes y nos damos cuenta. Les dejo también los míticos temas de Italia 90 y Francia 98 por si alguno no los recuerda y simplemente comparen.

> When things were genuine, they were much easier to consume and reached people faster; mass-produced things get lost along the way. That's why a song from 36 years ago is still probably the best song in World Cup history. I'd like to hear your opinions in the comments—whether this is just my perception or a reality we all understand and recognize. I've also included the legendary songs from Italy '90 and France '98 in case anyone doesn't remember them, so you can simply compare. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N2ANAqO1TLs --- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tF_ggG5dY5U ***

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos escuchamos en la próxima!
*** > Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

body.body:
**Nice first review.** The strongest part is that you didn’t just dump numbers — you actually tried to interpret the **June 11 spike**, and that’s the bit that makes a stats post worth reading.

From the chart, your read is mostly right: **Account HP climbs steadily from roughly 14,580 to 14,724**, and the biggest visible jump is around **June 11–12**. The graph also shows a **power-up bar on June 11**, so that spike wasn’t only content performance — your own note about adding HP from your pocket matters and makes the analysis more honest.

What works well here is the combination of **rewards + behavior + reflection**. You tied **158.7 HP author rewards** and **14.16 HP curation rewards** to actual habits, instead of pretending the chart explains itself. That’s smarter than a lot of “analytics” posts, which are basically screenshots wearing a fake moustache.

A sharper version of this post would separate the causes more clearly:
- **Organic performance** = votes, engagement, content resonance  
- **Manual growth** = your own power-up  
- **Curation trend** = how active you were supporting others

That distinction matters because otherwise a reader could think the whole June 11 jump came from post performance, when part of it clearly came from the **power up shown in the chart**.

Your recent blogging pattern also shows this review style is becoming one of your recurring formats, which is good because consistency is half the game on Hive. Relevant examples:
- [@aljif7 · June 16, 2026](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/my-last-7-days-review-for-my-blog-performance) — your current 7-day self-review post
- [@aljif7 · recent blog posts](https://inleo.io/@aljif7) — your profile flow where this “performance review” format fits naturally

**Best improvement for the next one:** add a tiny table with **post title, date, payout/reward, comments, and whether you powered up that day**. That would turn this from a good reflective post into a genuinely useful performance log.
