body.body:
Aljif7's Blog
Tuesday 16 June, 2026
AREA: Blogging

Hello friends!
Hello crypto-world!

Today is Tuesday 16 June 2026.

# My First Self-Review for June 2026: 7-Day Blog Performance Analysis

In this post I am sharing my self-review for last week, last 7 days, of my blog performance. I should do one last week for my first period of 7 days for June. Well, here we are with my first self review for June 2026... Hopefully next 7 days I am able to catch up in time :))...

## Overall Performance Summary

Looking at my analytics for the past 7 days, I'm pleased to see some positive momentum! My **Author Rewards** totaled **158.7 HP ($8.06)**, which shows consistent content creation and engagement. 


Over the 7-day period, my **Curation Rewards** came to **14.16 HP ($0.72)**, which suggests I'm actively engaging with other creators' content, though there's definitely room to increase this activity. Still lower than others reviews. Lower price on HIVE maybe influence on less votes. 

## Account Growth Trends

The Account Growth chart reveals some interesting patterns:

**The June 11th Spike**: There's a clear standout day on 6/11/2026 where I experienced significant growth - my Account HP jumped notably, and this correlates with the highest earnings day shown in my USD chart. This tells me that something I did on or around June 11th really resonated with the community. Was it a particular post? Better engagement? I should analyze what content I published that day and replicate that success! Well, I should considere that I powered up from my pockets trying to improve my credit for voting. Recently it is lower.

![Screenshot 2026 06 16 at 9.40.38 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfQ17UrdzQH7dANPk8BhTkV5ARY2FdPG5kwzBe7bFzmWT/Screenshot%202026-06-16%20at%209.40.38%E2%80%AFPM.png)

**Steady HP Growth**: My Account HP (shown by the orange line) shows a nice upward trajectory from around 14,580 to over 14,745 HP by June 16th. This consistent growth is encouraging and suggests my overall strategy is working.
![Screenshot 2026 06 16 at 9.40.59 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcVcGJxwFpXB6kFw5wwNvif6ZQPrAQuBjkLcuod6DeKWb/Screenshot%202026-06-16%20at%209.40.59%E2%80%AFPM.png)
**Power Management**: I can see various power movements throughout the week - some power ups and rewards being processed. The green bars show reward accumulation on most days, with June 11th being exceptionally strong.

## Earnings Breakdown (USD)

Looking at my Total Earned chart:

- **Best Day**: June 11th with approximately $2.50 (primarily from Author rewards). And considere I did my Power up.
- **Consistent Days**: June 10th, 12th, 13th, 14th, and 16th all show earnings between $0.75-$1.25
- **Lowest Day**: June 15th dipped to around $0.25

The pattern shows that **Author Total (USD)** makes up the majority of my earnings (the light green portion), which is exactly what I want to see as a content creator. My **Curation Total** and **Witness Rewards** are minimal, appearing as small portions at the bottom of the bars.

## Key Takeaways & Goals for Next Week

**What's Working:**
✅ Content creation is generating steady author rewards
✅ Account HP is growing consistently
✅ I had one breakout day that proves my content can perform well

**Areas to Improve:**

📌 **Curation Activity**: While I'm earning some curation rewards, I could increase this by spending more time discovering and upvoting quality content
📌 **Consistency**: The June 15th dip shows I need more consistent daily performance. I should investigate what caused that low day

**Action Items:**
1. Analyze what made June 11th so successful and replicate those elements
2. Set aside time daily for witness voting and curation
3. Maintain or increase posting frequency
4. Engage more with the community to build stronger relationships

## Final Thoughts

Overall, I'm satisfied with this first week I take a look for June 2026. The growth trajectory is positive, and I'm earning primarily through content creation, which is my main focus. The key now is to maintain this momentum while diversifying my reward streams through better witness participation and curation.

Here's to an even stronger next week! 📈
(Let's see next post about self-review)

body.title: All The Donut Clay I Made Throughout The Years
body.body:
![donut collection through out the year.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGyPwo8sRzTCyVTrtEKd7P27ziQHZ8x7MuXEGoSQCE8usj3pEN8n3tAzWC1CFLNY4p.gif)
Hello, how are you? throughout the years I think I started last year I made alot of different kind of donut using polymer clay and just because of a cravings I turns into a series of donuts making and ofcourse the learning process is still there and I guess to my experience doing it, you really do improve the moment you made alot of it and today I am going to show you all the donuts collections I have made throught the years what the story behind those I will explain it one by one LOL. Donut is one of the desserts or sweets that I like to eat now it this year that people are so innovative about the flavors. Before, I used to eat Bavarian and just chocolate flavor, now you can have matcha donut and different kinds of unique flavors. -----
All My Donut Clays!
> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokecmXdTPwhD7aePSyjkrwqBW78Zf2Wqt6wViTppRgFYUnhqvFCt3uAz9CK8F6KdRK.JPG)

This is the one that triggers the clay series for me, and I am still in my how to do it phase, and I pretty much do a pretty good job. -----
> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eonn1xcuVhaNbakeMhVDJpkarmW3qgq6ccp4eM3BPY8rSjvMxy7YAvqN6D2ebo4Rcom.JPG)

I nailed this one, and I am so proud of myself LOL. ------
> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPL6uyvunz2X8iFqrVJnQYjWWxYiaXCTrzZTVsFsmevxUEAn16YuzL83ajkTUtbpY.JPG)

I wanted the drizzle to be the texture to this one, and it blends with the glazing, so I little bit sad, but after that, I know what to do now. That is the beauty of experience: you can learn from it. -----

body.title: Con el ojo en la mano [Es-En] With the eye on the hand
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

Literalmente con el ojo en la mano. No como amuleto de buena suerte, sino como una concesión al niño que habita en mi interior. 
> Literally with my eye in my hand. Not as a good luck charm, but as a concession to the child within me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQuswku4Ra7q2TvWCMpTgikEi2D1NBEiuGpWYnMFAnL9z/image.png)

Regresaba de dar una vuelta aprovechando el sol de la tarde en que, además de estirar las piernas, disfruto de capturar algunas imágenes para compartir en mi blog junto a mis reflexiones y anécdotas de vida, cuando en la puerta del chino me encontré con mi hija, que regresaba del trabajo y salía de hacer alguna compra.
Como cualquier niño, le pedí que me comprara este juguete o golosina. El cajero largo la risa y con el precio dijo: Comida, comida. Pero la verdad es que sabía horrible.
Considerando el precio, a poco que me voten, recupero el costo de la chiquillada.
>I was returning from a stroll, enjoying the afternoon sun, where, besides stretching my legs, I like to capture some images to share on my blog along with my reflections and life anecdotes when I ran into my daughter at the Chinese store. She was coming home from work and had just finished some shopping.
Like any child, I asked her to buy me this toy or candy. The cashier burst out laughing and, upon seeing the price, said, \

But the truth is, it tasted awful. Considering the price, if I get even a little bit of votes, I'll recoup the cost of that childish prank. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbpEWwGPzZfihQjewYL2UfSQggkcxosXDuPTPPitdW9qQ/image.png) Aunque no me gusta usar el teléfono, lo llevo conmigo por conveniencia y para tomar fotografías de cuánto disfruto al caminar. Paisajes, construcciones, plantas o animales. Cualquier cosa interesante o bella que en mi opinión merezca ser compartida, como esta plaza dedicada a los medios audiovisuales donde los niños se ejercitan trepando los tres o cuatro niveles del televisor para lanzarse por los toboganes y los más chicos encuentran palancas que manipular en la simulada cabina de radio. Mientras los adultos pueden disfrutar de las bancas al sol o la sombra según la estación y quien lo precisa puede alquilar una bici con la misma tarjeta que paga el transporte público. > Although I don't like using my phone, I carry it with me for convenience and to take pictures of how much I enjoy walking. Landscapes, buildings, plants, or animals. Anything interesting or beautiful that, in my opinion, deserves to be shared, like this plaza dedicated to audiovisual media where children exercise by climbing the three or four levels of the television to go down the slides, and the younger ones find levers to manipulate in the simulated radio booth. Meanwhile, adults can enjoy the benches in the sun or shade depending on the season, and anyone who needs it can rent a bike with the same card they use to pay for public transport. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVcM4y6qpg65QiyGa5L6vpYM6TB7ZnXAbLXAqUVewzf8A/image.png) Como en otras ocasiones, me detuve a mitad del puente sobre la vía del tren y, aunque el sol me deslumbró y no veía, logré esta captura del resplandor del rey sol iluminando la vía, la iglesia y el convento de las religiosas que en él viven en régimen de clausura. > As on other occasions, I stopped halfway across the bridge over the railway line and, although the sun dazzled me and I couldn't see, I managed to capture this image of the sun's radiance illuminating the railway line, the church and the convent of the nuns who live there in seclusion. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNr9a1n3of5STpJTSKQjoSznMpQF65wWYBZWCctj21mk/image.png) En la siguiente, pero hace un mes y como una hora más tarde, el sol velado por las nubes a punto de arropar a la luna. Prácticamente el mismo paisaje desde la otra pasarela del mismo puente. > In the next photo, taken a month ago and about an hour later, the sun is veiled by clouds about to envelop the moon. Virtually the same view from the other footbridge of the same bridge. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxdhjDPs4M2wTAJc8pRNTFA9c2zP6HRdHeiesGZT3zqR/image.png) Sin duda, quien quiera tomar interesantes fotografías tendrá que andar con la cámara en la mano y el ojo atento a los detalles, pues no pocas veces la luz cambia en un instante o el modelo decide moverse y escapar a la inmortalidad de la foto. >Undoubtedly, anyone who wants to take interesting photographs will have to walk around with their camera in hand and their eye attentive to the details, because not infrequently the light changes in an instant or the model decides to move and escape the immortality of the photo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPc8enWs18vUVFi78yDAdJx5SEzxYmF1azcSQNitdY8j/image.png) Como de costumbre, escribo en español y, al saber inglés, dejo la traducción en manos de Google, pero las fotos sí las tomé todas yo, con el Motorola que me acompaña. >As usual, I write in Spanish and, knowing English, I leave the translation to Google, but I did take all the photos myself, with the Motorola that accompanies me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPkpcSTGjhC2CyRojz4mN2jgxCTJrhYZTSdd4SrTWTL6V/image.png) # With the eye on the hand I'm not sure if you like this format or if you prefer all the text in one language and then in the other. I appreciate all the feedback. Have a great day. >No estoy seguro de si te gusta este formato o si prefieres que todo el texto esté en un idioma y luego en el otro. Agradezco todos los comentarios. Que tengas un buen día.

body.title: From Loss to Laughter: My Birthday Story | LOH #293
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYmmvM3Gqqbn9Uvnx56PkRq7BaoWYhxdMAoh4bLufRvPD/1781618646075.jpg)

I truly have no hard feelings about my birthdays. When I was very young my father passed away, after that incident I had stopped celebrating my birthday's. I thought of it as the same usual day. I totally had no excitement for many years, I never told anyone about my birthday and kept it a secret so that no one will be able to wish me. Also, I do not want gifts, parties, or special attention. I simply carried on with my life.

However, after getting married and becoming a father I have truly changed a lot. I am 50+ years old now, I have changed my stubborn feelings and decided to do everything as my family wanted. My wife and my two young daughters surprised me on each one of my birthday's. Honestly, they have brought the same comfort back to my life. I did not imagine for this day, but it happened and my family always try to surprise me in special ways. I do not get mad or upset when they plan surprises and get little gifts. Actually, I enjoy it as it makes me feel more loved. So, the best gift I could ever ask for is the happiness of my family.

Anyway,  after marriage I have become a birthday planner. I enjoy planning birthdays for my family. I always wanted to create some happy memories with them. Seeing their excitement gives me great pleasure. And next year I have no plans for my birthday, because my family would be preparing surprise's for me as usual. I will simply enjoy the moment and be thankful for the love, care and happiness they bring into my life.

body.title: This Single Mistake Cost Me the Battle — Wands Out + High Five Ruleset
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 16, 2026, 11_14_52 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23w2eWgXC5xS7viHG1RuxpPjzrydHsf4NdzzhTzXQK4mvLTozX2s2xpK4UDPdg6mLAJgc.png)


Today's 57 Mana battle was very interesting. The good thing is that I got to see two new modifiers which I believe I was seeing for the first time. After understanding them, I entered the battle with a strategy in mind. 

However, I still made a major mistake which I will discuss later. That single mistake ended up costing me the battle.

As I have mentioned before that achieving a 50 percent win rate largely depends on understanding the modifiers and rulesets. If you understand the rules correctly and choose the right monsters with proper positioning then securing a win becomes much easier. But if you fail to understand the rules, defeat is always a possibility.

Let's first talk about the two interesting rulesets that appeared in this battle.
![Screenshot 2026-06-16 105430.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uQLUY7ruWC2Yn4GdzNmoWnRzscqduPDUM2jkQaspZQp2dFGH3kvdE5eQeopC89szwso.png)

***WANDS OUT***

The first one was Wands Out. In this ruleset you can only summon units that have Magic Attack. You cannot use Melee or Ranged attackers. In your decks if you have few strong Magic Attack monsters then this becomes a huge disadvantage because your options are very limited. 

That is why it is important to maintain a balanced deck with a good mix of all three kind of attackers.

In my case I only had three Magic Attack monsters available so I could only summon three units. If I had stronger Magic attackers I believe I could have won this battle.

***HIGH FIVE***

The second modifier was High Five. As the name suggests you are limited to summoning a maximum of five units. You cannot use more than five monsters in the battle.

Combining these two rulesets made things challenging. Not only was I restricted to Magic Attack monsters but I was also limited in the number of units I could summon. Since I had very few Magic attackers I couldn't even fill all five slots and ended up using only three monsters.

![Screenshot 2026-06-16 105546.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vi1f7aWQnCgYwrUvBF9q5xkKvLqRjuBwdrgNXipzQ17VCtTvEvG14obCEd8WEFW5RXM.png)


Considering these conditions I decided to use a Healing Archon. My idea was that it would continuously heal my monsters, helping them survive longer while dealing damage to enemy units. However I failed to realize that in a Magic only battle, choosing a Magic Archon would have been a much better option.

A Magic Archon provides additional magic power to your team. This means your Magic Attack monsters not only continue attacking on their own but also receive extra support from the Archon effectively increasing the overall damage output every round.

This was my biggest mistake and ultimately the reason I lost the battle.

My opponent played very smartly. He selected a Magic Archon and paired it with three strong Magic Attack monsters. At the beginning of the battle I didn't fully understand the impact of his setup. But as the fight progressed I noticed the extra magic damage coming from every enemy unit. At that point I realized that my Healing Archon strategy had failed.

One by one, my monsters were eliminated and eventually I lost this battle.
![Screenshot 2026-06-16 105637.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/EoAT4pNU7Ljt9dRYYxmmrDK1234pB2X2i5Tx1BgebvACF65PgPxC315dMLKnMvraEpH.png)

This battle once again proved how important it is to fully understand the rulesets before making your selections. If I had chosen a Magic Archon instead of a Healing Archon I believe I could have secured a great victory.

Still we learn from our mistakes. Every battle teaches something new and each day brings an opportunity to discover new strategies and techniques.

Considering these rulesets what would your team selection have been? Which strategy would you have preferred? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.


I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1176 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1176 - San Sebastian Church Shots for Tuesday. 

A lovely Tuesday my Hive family everywhere! Whether you are busy with work or taking some time here on Hive, remember to enjoy the process. Every post you write and every vote or comment you leave adds something special value to our community. Wishing everyone a smooth Tuesday. Stay safe, keep sharing. Cheers to a great day😍. 

Moving now to our daily shots, after enjoying the food in Chinatown Manila, my wife and I had a stopover at the San Sebastian Church. It stands tall in the city skyline.
![1000014916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/2458NHBo9Vno5AiLLXmXqzmQu3SxAJjkbPv4FT5dJ7JKfKN843VHbCASxF5S3dv6SqEuh.jpg)

We went inside and amazed by what we saw in the walls. The San Sebastian Church is known for being an all steel structure. Looking up at the ceiling, it was hard to believe that the whole thing was made of metal. 
![1000014911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vhuVz2Hq2Y5vYqVE4KkM9USVQeELcfV6HnsT1yv6Ut3m8isscefT3kpJkR8LfNMFNb1.jpg)

![1000014892.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tm76xFsxporqas7XCzgjraRRadUzZsySzsXcjXrGDRL4au9GTsbLjLSPScfiK1prNXB.jpg)  

My wife and I spent a good amount of time just walking around the interior while admiring the design and the steel panels. It felt cool and solemn inside. 
![1000014908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tmBcizhXrfEKhxfgFv4KtiFyitxNm6NTM67PcUVEj9NEH1S3kJ2CsCiq5iYWD3MYWR6.jpg) 

![1000014899.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvYD45bNbHMjFBrDtPLCaqsj8cSL4MEHVv9hTEc1ejogtHapVgo8Qr4udujeoZzr3S7.jpg)

Since it was such a unique spot, we definitely wanted to capture the memory. I took some photo of her near the entrance, capturing the church’s beautiful exterior. It was a peaceful pause in our day. Standing here was the perfect way to wrap up our morning tour before heading back home. 
![1000014905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23xAVy7JTCvN1tBrfxHmoGrUSVb8VX7doNborCgnv9QcdMo3L4Dw84BXSbJRGKuXU7uCu.jpg)

![1000014902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23zGcDm4XjZmKJcy4ahGVRnjANdB7EMxFNtDBDCd1bqe7Ry3yfVvTrZZGkQWGJCbhZtY7.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Manila, Philippines.

level. The event has been awakening some \
discussions... Such as the interest in extreme wealth, which has fascinated millions of people.\nIn addition, one can also mention the interest in the way market valuations are \

to create different types of speculation about what is actually real cash and what is actually value with potential within the market where a segment is inserted. The fact is that Musk's fortune is not a merit, so to speak, also bringing into question the issue of meritocracy (which is just a well-rehearsed speech).\nA good portion of what he has wasn't built by himself. However, everything he has is a strong reflection of how he acts behind the scenes in the market, showing that he makes good moves in relation to all the assets he already controls. Contrary to what many people think, his fortune comes precisely from the appreciation of his stakes in the following companies: **SpaceX**, **Tesla**, **xAI** and **X**. A balance that is shifted quite frequently.\nThis is a response to how the private sector views Musk's \

figure in relation to his competitors, awakening in civil society how damaging capitalism can be, by allowing only one person to have so much money in their hands. In parallel to this, we have the personality of someone who has very narcissistic psychological traits, reinforcing the idea of inequality and segregation in a socially unequal world. In short, money speaks volumes. ---
**El hombre del billón de dólares.**
**Elon Musk**, una de las figuras más controvertidas de todos los tiempos (al menos en la sociedad actual), alcanzó el *estatus* de **trillonario** el día **12**, precisamente cuando una de sus empresas (SpaceX) debutó en el **Nasdaq**, elevando así su ya elevado patrimonio neto a un nivel “estratosférico”. Este acontecimiento ha reavivado debates “latentes”... Como el interés por la riqueza extrema, que fascina a millones de personas. Además, cabe mencionar el interés por cómo se “preconstruyen” las valoraciones del mercado para generar diferentes tipos de especulación sobre qué es dinero real y qué es valor potencial dentro del mercado en el que se inserta un segmento. Lo cierto es que la fortuna de Musk no es fruto de un mérito, por así decirlo, lo que también pone en entredicho la meritocracia (que no es más que un discurso ensayado). Gran parte de su fortuna no la ha construido él mismo. Sin embargo, todo lo que posee refleja fielmente su gestión tras bambalinas en el mercado, demostrando su buen desempeño en relación con los activos que ya controla. Contrariamente a lo que muchos creen, su fortuna proviene precisamente de la revalorización de sus participaciones en las siguientes empresas: **SpaceX**, **Tesla**, **xAI** y **X**. Un equilibrio que se modifica con frecuencia. Esto responde a la percepción que el sector privado tiene de la “imponente” figura de Musk frente a sus competidores, lo que pone de manifiesto en la sociedad civil el daño que puede causar el capitalismo al permitir que una sola persona acumule tanto dinero. Paralelamente, se observa una personalidad con rasgos psicológicos muy narcisistas, que refuerzan la idea de desigualdad y segregación en un mundo socialmente desigual. En resumen, el dinero lo dice todo. ---
**O homem de um trilhão de dólares.**
**Elon Musk**, uma das figuras mais polêmicas de todos os tempos (ao menos dentro da sociedade moderna) atingiu seu *status* de **trilionário** no último dia **12**, precisamente quando uma de suas empresas (SpaceX) fez sua a esperada estreia na **Nasdaq**, elevando assim o seu patrimônio (que já era alto) a um nível “estratosférico”. O episódio vem despertando algumas discussões “adormecidas”... Como o interesse pela riqueza extrema, que vem fascinando milhões de pessoas. Além disso pode ser mencionado também o interesse pela maneira como as avalições de mercados são “previamente construídas” para criar diferentes tipos de especulações sobre o que de fato é caixa real e o que de fato é valores com potencial dentro do próprio mercado onde um segmento está inserido. O fato é que a fortuna Musk não é um mérito, por assim dizer, colocando em discussão também a questão da meritocracia (que é apenas um discurso bem ensaiado). Uma boa parte do que ele tem não foi ele próprio quem construiu. No entanto, tudo o que ele tem é um forte reflexo de como ele age nos bastidores do mercado, mostrando que ele faz boas movimentações em relação a todos os ativos que ele já controla. Ao contrário do que muitas pessoas pensam, a fortuna dele vem precisamente de valorização das participações nas seguintes empresas: **SpaceX**, **Tesla**, **xAI** e **X**. Um equilíbrio que é balanceado com bastante frequência. Essa é uma resposta de como o ambiente privado enxerga a figura “imponente” de Musk diante dos seus concorrentes, despertando na sociedade civil o quão danoso pode ser o capitalismo, por permitir que apenas uma única pessoa tenha em mãos tanto dinheiro. Em paralelo a isso, temos a personalidade de alguém que tem toques psicologicamente muito narcisistas, reforçando a ideia de desigualdade e segregação num mundo socialmente desigual. Enfim, o dinheiro grita. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-trilliondollar-man-jm)

body.title: Rhododendron catawbiense.
body.body:
Rhododendron catawbiense.
This isn't my garden anymore, nor are my flowers in my garden. We just went for a walk in the park, and there, in a flowerbed, were these beautiful flowers. Such a delicate, pleasant color.
Its name is certainly complicated. It grows large. And its flowers are lush and beautiful.
They come in a variety of colors, for example: pink (as in the photo), yellow, purple, red, and even white.
I think such large flowers are beautiful in any shade. I'd like to see different shades of this flower.
I need to read up on how difficult it is to care for. If it doesn't require much care and is not picky, then it can be planted in my garden. I'd love to have flowers like these at home.
This flower comes in dwarf varieties, and also in large, bush- or tree-like varieties. Probably something like a lilac.
This flower enjoys watering, but it should definitely not be overwatered; it doesn't like stagnant water.
It grows best in partial shade or shade. It doesn't like direct sunlight, as it's hard on the flower.
The flower prefers loose soil; it needs to be weeded to loosen it and allow oxygen to reach the soil. It also prefers humus-rich soil. So, caring for this flower isn't easy.
It requires careful selection of a suitable location, loose, humus-rich soil, and regular watering.
But it's beautiful, so the effort is worth it.![IMG_3152.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVbkASdstjfxqKdMXzKaLCXTzPNMTFMnuS1ACagfx8uF5/IMG_3152.jpeg)

body.title: The Beautiful Chaos of Toddler Art 🎨
body.body: Hey GEMS community!\nI wanted to share a thought today that hit me while watching the little ones get lost in their own creative worlds.\nThere is something incredibly magical about the way a child approaches a blank piece of paper. They don’t worry about perspective, color theory, or whether their drawing is \

to show the world. They don't care about staying inside the lines. They just grab the brightest marker available and let pure, unadulterated imagination take over.

![stephen-andrews-6NbSIxwZ3_4-unsplash.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNYD6ypWiiP9DpEUES46RuJNaBmWikx65fpmXynD8j8jK/stephen-andrews-6NbSIxwZ3_4-unsplash.jpg)
>*<center> Photo source: Unsplash</center>*

> *\

* — Pablo Picasso
> 
As adults, we get so caught up in perfectionism. We hesitate to start projects because we're afraid the outcome won't match the vision in our heads. But looking at this focus, the determination, and the absolute joy of just making a mess... it’s a great reminder that the magic is in the **process**, not just the final product.
Let's try to bring a bit of that \

into our own lives this week. Start that project, write that messy first draft, or pick up a paintbrush without worrying about the final result. Just create for the pure joy of creating.\nWhat’s something you’ve been hesitant to start lately? Let me know in the comments!

body.title: 🎬 2026 Movie Review #19 | Masters Of The Universe (2026) 🎥
body.body: <center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSsfzBiZQqZXZUCBJqDehe14TyiNiJzxsaGLVMkm1mwp/Screenshot%202026-06-16%2019.55.07.png</center>\n\n<a href=\

>Image Source
This blog is a personal journal of all the movies, Tv-Shows, & Games I consume during a year which enhances my overall experience. The ratings that I give are fully based on my personal preference and enjoyment at the time of watching and I'm writing spoiler-free reviews. (All liquid earnings are used to get extra Hive Power Delegations!)

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmf6YAMnyvMdaisfxzD4Y4bFApUMrTrP6Rmd4GFDTXLT3R/image.pngI have been away from home since Tuesday 26th of May to the Thai Coastal city Hua Hin to do Muay Thai Boxing and aside from the series I had not watched anything until I ended up going to the Cinema at Bluport Mall to fill my Sunday afternoon. I had a movie date with a girl on Wednesday to go see Backrooms so I kind of wanted to test it out in advance and I'm glad that I did. The ticket only cost around 5.8€ which is 1/3 of the price in Belgium while the theater and the technology is qually as good. The one things I underestimated though was how hard the airconditioning was on as it felt like a fridge there and it was kind of annoying during the movie. The temperature outsisde is quite hot and I dressed to that along with how it is in the mall. So it was useful that I tested it out in advance and it either was Masters of The Universe or the new Star wars movie. Since Masters of the Universe got a 7.1/10 on IMDB, I picked that one.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiAFEadtVQc6hH7Gc5ZiKUAn1T3SfRWUk3mT2wBxE1J7/IMG_2450.jpeg|https://images.hive.blog/DQmWGTRXj98cJrVMZBxJSWaRSWEVpimwjVHN3xjFJtEPMvu/IMG_2451.jpeg -|-

Superhero Movies

Personally, I'm just not into superhero movies generally even though I have seen most of the MCU movies until I think avenegers Endgame. The only reason I went to this one was for some mindless entertainment. I'm a 90s kid and He-Man is something I only know by name while I never have seen any of the cartoons.

Masters Of The Universe (6.5/10)

 Well, what to say about this movie other than it's the most generic superhero movie that you can imagine. There is a main story of good and evil and the good protecting something that gets taken by the bad gut who is some time of skeleton figure. There is a hero who starts as an underdog and doesn't know his powers. Eventually he does unlock them and beats the bad guy in a fight late in the movie to restore the balance. https://images.hive.blog/DQmf7oaaJu9unMKMU96oYvNaHu2SAcPkjwticu3Eq3JNWBD/image.png

>Image Source On top of this, every other minute there is some kind of an attempt of a joke of which 95% of the time it simply doesn't land. The only ones that I kind of liked were the nicknames the kid gave the all the characters and also to himself (He-Man). The visuals were quite CGI-centered but most of the time it didn't bother me that much.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmNxT9uLnHmJTrV2hwW84WvT31iDXVFF2Ma1DcpK4ndczA/image.png

>Image Source
Conclusion I don't regret having watched this movie as the ticket price was only 5.8€ while it filled my Sunday afternoon. I also got to learn how the movie theater here in Hua Hin works to give the next movie (which was Backrooms) a better experience. I didn't like Masters of The Universe but it had its moments so I'm still give it a 6.5/10 Score. Not worth the watch unless there is a good situation to see it.

body.title: Chasing money the right way no longer pays
body.body:
![290167.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23xp6mLKbVbe55L8EGDwupp43yJDrHQxX4oxMQGNfRWV8efWLU4xEJCFZNhS8Ht9aqLiV.png)





<hr>



Yesterday I talked about [Elon musk achieving trillionare status and becoming the first person to ever do it](https://hive.blog/elonmusk/@josediccus/what-did-you-learn-with-elon-musk-becoming-world-s-first-trillionare) I think we cannot dispute the fact that the man is a genius, he understands business and finance and he makes sure to not just employ the right people, but also those with his type of ideologies, those who are creative with making money in the weirdest of situations. 




Those who are creative enough to turn small amounts into huge figures. He's definitely not a charitable type, he didn't build his wealth out of compassion and empathy for service.


 So even though his products are good *(to some extent)* he makes sure to milk the living daylight of his business models that are mostly subscription based. At the moment his SpaceX company might not be a lot, but him delving into AI and other subscription-based services has showed that the man understands the concept of subscription-based business models, it's a gold mine. 

One thing that's quite strange to me is that even though his products and services are not the best in the business, but he still manages to sell it. He's the package being the brand and this packaging is just how he manages to pull it off. 

### Selling the brand 

For example, Samsung was unarguably the best brand of Android devices and they made sure to always milk this by selling the product for very expensive rates, until other brands started producing some equally great device for even cheaper. 


Even if this were the case, some people are already stuck to the Samsung brand and already fallen in love with it, so even though they're exploited or charged exorbitant rates, they still won't change the brand. This is the same with the likes of GROKAI and Tesla.


 I'm not saying they're not amazing products, I'm saying Elon is that businessman that depends more on branding and packaging to sell his business rather than selling it based on sheer quality. 


This is probably why he bought Twitter too. He can use this as an avenue to always have the right branding and platform for his business to always remain in the limelight. Twitter (or X, as he renamed it) is a traditional social platform for earning sake. 


The money that comes with years of building a presence on the platform is an added feature for only a few privileged, the man reason why I think Elon musk bought this platform is for continuous relevance, the ability to sell or bend narratives for his gains, and he understands the power of social businessing, the biggest advantage which a lot of billionaires who were previously way richer than him didn't have. 


A lot of people don't understand that they can have a peek about who Elon is simply by taking a look at the people that he employes, people he fires from the business, those he hires and tnr requirements involved. 


Take a lot at his head of production at X, the guy is a proper beast. A definition of someone who only understands that Elon wants to make money and sort of embodies the greedy and insatiable aspect of Elon. I've seen some of his products and services, except the spaceX and Tesla, all of them points to something: Elon Musk understands the art of milking. 


\

Overall I think he's been lucky to have moved from being a millionaire in dollars to being a trillionare. 

We already know what it means to be a millionaire in dollars, 0.1% of the world's population will never in the present or futuristically attain this status, and even took the risk of investing the money into other businesses. 


A lot of people have gone back to ground zero for simply trying to move from five figures to 6 figures. 

This isn't because they weren't Smart or didn't have the right business idea or ideology.

 Elon Musk was a first mover and a lot of people may have equally been rich as him but never had the courage to do what he did, so let's not just call this complete luck, it's actually l guts and courage that placed him in the right position to become lucky. 

It still remains true that people needs to strategically position themselves to be lucky, the ironic thing is that you still can position yourself properly and still be very unlucky.

 I think it's an established truth that people needs to have this unrefined brutality and urgency for them to actually make money as the world mostly rewards people like this.

body.title: The Tomb of Diomedes - Watercolors on Paper
body.body:
![IMG_20260615_201220595.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/armandosodano/23uQxbUQquw94gtmprDbzKZzT8cFEio2JHkaCiLSysfsfVKWen5wQbdJoGvigeHaV2u1E.jpg)

The Tomb of Diomedes - Watercolors on Paper

Hello to all my dear Hivers friends and welcome back to my blog. The painting I’m sharing today depicts a cave located on an island in the Ionian Sea. This cave, a popular destination for travelers, is, according to Greek legend, the tomb of one of ancient Greece’s bravest and wisest heroes, Diomedes. During the Trojan War, Diomedes managed to wound two gods fighting on the side of the Trojans, Aphrodite and Ares. Thanks to his alliance with Odysseus, he succeeded in conquering Troy. Upon his victorious return to Argos, he discovered his wife’s betrayal and, overcome with grief, took refuge in Italy, in the region of Daunia, now known as Puglia. Diomedes is unanimously considered the founder of Western civilization; he founded many cities and taught people how to domesticate horses and navigate. It was during a voyage with his trusted companions that Diomedes hurled three large boulders into the sea, which transformed into the three Tremiti Islands. But unfortunately, during a storm at sea, he drowned, and his loyal companions buried him in a cave on the island of San Nicola in the Tremiti archipelago. ![Italia_1843-en.svg.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/armandosodano/23wCQHxDMsofnCgohLLWqrXvkj5FRwgzVmv5xJ4LFCYariWJRQgm1XGS6wt6jxFVYETKn.png) Legend has it that his companions, overcome with grief at the loss of their beloved leader, transformed into Diomedee or Albatrosses, large seabirds that nest on that island and, at night, when there is no moon, emit cries that sound like the cries of newborn babies. I experienced the calls of the Diomedee firsthand, listening to them at night from the cliffs overlooking the sea, and I must say they are impressive, even though they sound like those of newborns. So, for my upcoming exhibition on the Tremiti Islands—or the Diomedee—I decided to create this watercolor depicting the cave and the albatrosses circling Diomedes’ tomb. ![IMG_20260615_201220595c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/armandosodano/23wCJERUErSeZPvxgMP9DSmocyPyytbGeiBVsQ7X2wwmPM7hZ664F9DhrChDFqAThThLu.jpg) The sea is present even inside the cave; it encloses the remains of the Greek hero forever. I’m sharing all the steps of the creative process with you, and I send my best regards to everyone. [ITA]

La tomba di Diomede - acquarelli su carta

Ciao a tutti cari amici Hivers e bentornati sul mio blog. Il dipinto che condivido oggi è la rappresentazione di una caverna che si trova su un'isola del mar Ionio. Questa caverna, oggetto di molte visite di viaggiatori, secondo la leggenda greca è la tomba di uno dei più valorosi e saggi eroi dell'antica Grecia, Diomede. Nella guerra contro Troia, Diomede riesce a ferire due Dei schierati con i troiani, Afrodite ed Ares. Grazie al sodalizio con Ulisse, riesce a conquistare Troia. Al ritorno vittorioso ad Argo, scopre il tradimento della moglie e in preda al dolore si rifugia in Italia, presso la Daunia, la Puglia. Diomede è considerato unanimamente il promotore della civilizzazione occidentale, egli fondò molte città ed insegnò ad addomesticare i cavalli ed a navigare. Proprio durante la navigazione insieme ad i suoi fidati compagni, Diomede scagliò in mare tre grandi massi che si trasformarono nelle tre isole Tremiti. Ma purtroppo durante una tempesta marina egli morì per annegamento ed i suoi fedeli compagni lo seppellirono proprio in una caverna sull'isola di San Nicola nelle Tremiti. La leggenda racconta che i compagni in preda al dolore per la perdita del loro amato capo si trasformarono in Diomedee o Albatro, grandi uccelli marini che nidificano su quell'isola e di notte, in assenza di luna emettono dei versi che sembrano pianti di neonati. Ho avuto la prova dei versi delle Diomedee, ascoltandoli di notte, sugli strapiombi di falesie sul mare, e devo dire che sono impressionanti per quanto sembrino quelli di neonati. Così per la mia prossima mostra sulle isole Tremiti o Diomedee ho deciso di realizzare questo acquarello che raffigura la caverna e gli Albatro che volteggiano intorno alla tomba di Diomede. Il mare è presente anche dentro la caverna, esso racchiude i resti dell'eroe greco per sempre. Vi lascio tutti gli steps del processo creativo ed i miei migliori saluti a tutti. Armando.

body.title: The Fed Has a New Boss. Here's What Kevin Warsh Is Likely to Do First.
body.body: alt=\

/>

Tomorrow, June 17, the Federal Reserve holds its first meeting under new chair Kevin Warsh — and the timing couldn't be more complicated. US inflation hit 4.2% in May, well above the 2% target, yet markets are not pricing in a rate hike before December. The key variable hanging over everything: the US-Iran peace agreement and what it means for energy prices.  
The Strait of Hormuz is expected to reopen within days, and oil markets are already reacting — Brent has fallen to around $80 a barrel, with WTI trading even lower. That's still roughly 40% above pre-war levels, and how quickly Gulf oil supply can resume — given damage to production infrastructure — remains an open question. Trump's political calendar, with midterm elections approaching, adds another layer of pressure for lower energy costs.  
As for Warsh himself, he arrives with a well-established reputation as an inflation hawk. A sharp policy shift seems unlikely this early. The fed funds rate is expected to stay in the 3.50-3.75% range. Blerina Uruci of T. Rowe Price expects a brief policy statement with no guidance toward future easing, while Tiffany Wilding of Pimco anticipates Warsh will flag balance sheet reduction as a priority without committing to specific action yet.  
The US economy, for its part, is holding up. Q1 growth came in at 1.6%, softer than expected, but business surveys point to a reacceleration, and AI-driven investment continues to support demand for chips with no visible slowdown.  
BNY's John Velis expects the updated Summary of Economic Projections to drop the single rate cut that appeared in previous forecasts — a quiet but meaningful signal about where the Fed's head is now.

Buen día, les presento mi nuevo NFT tiulado:
 Never Too Late
---
Good day, I present my new NFT titled:
 Never Too Late.

Este NFT de esperanza y sacrificio tiene colores con más fuerza y viveza que la versión física de la obra, dándonos mayor energía para crecer y ayudar a otros.
---
This NFT of hopeful and sacrifice, has colors with more strength and vividness than the physical version of the artwork, giving us greater energy to grow and help others.

La obra representa la esperanza de cambiar, sanar y liberar al individuo mediante la interacción con una persona que, consciente o inconscientemente, lo ayuda, aunque el proceso pueda llegar a ser doloroso. Nunca es tarde para dejar entrar y volver a vivir.
---
The artwork represents the hope of changing, healing, and freeing the individual through interaction with a person who, consciously or unconsciously, helps him, even though the process may become painful. It is never too late to let it in and live again.

La obra física, creada con técnica mixta (tempera, pastel y lápices) en 2012, presenta una narrativa visual emocional a través de la representación de dos corazones. Uno de ellos está cubierto de espinas, simbolizando el dolor, el encierro y las heridas del pasado, mientras que el otro, más débil y menos dañado, es el sanador, el liberador. La proximidad de ambos corazones provoca que la dureza y las espinas comiencen a caer, revelando piel sana, así como un líquido verde que simboliza el proceso sacrificial y esperanzador. A través de la interacción y el apoyo mutuo, incluso los corazones más heridos pueden sanar y renovarse. La obra invita al espectador a reflexionar sobre el poder del amor, la evolución personal y la esperanza para superar la adversidad.
---
The physical artwork, created with mixed technique (tempera, pastel, and pencils) in 2012, presents an emotional visual narrative through the representation of two hearts. One of them is covered with thorns, symbolizing pain, confinement, and wounds of the past, while the other, weaker and less damaged, is the healer, the liberator. The proximity of both hearts causes the hardness and thorns to begin to fall, revealing healthy skin, as well as a green liquid that symbolizes the sacrificial hopeful process. Through interaction and mutual support, even the most wounded hearts can heal and renew themselves. The artwork invites the viewer to reflect on the power of love, personal evolution and hope to overcome adversity.

body.title: The Alto Knights (2025) - Movie Review
body.body: This is my first post in this community I think, so hello Movies & TV Shows addicts, nice to meet you here :) \n\nToday I'm going to share my thoughts about a movie I watched last week. The reason this movie got on my radar was because scrolling through Netflix's offer, I saw it was labeled as leaving soon. Unlike others, this list of \

for me is more important than new entries and I am always making sure to check the movies and series that are going to be removed, to not miss any good ones. The movie is called [The Alto Knights](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt21815562/) and has a very well known person as the lead actor, none other than Robert de Niro. I hope I don't have to introduce him to you.
![images.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xKqvhvDeFqTvexBPXNp71KkRSZZeL69taYKxY2pvy4qjMUaiqdeMF9mYW8PFB3pBXue.jpg)
[](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQ6IutHx2Ukj7YAijeX3b5zRXbKUgnF4JMA6va8HrdAuzIISW2L) >Two of New York City's most notorious crime bosses vie for control of the city's streets. Once best friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals set them on a deadly collision course. [](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt21815562/) The movie is based on a true story and the particularity of it is that Robert de Niro is playing both leading roles. This is not unprecedented, have been other cases, but as I understand, it was the first for him and as a legends walking towards the end of his career, I'm glad he had the chance to tick this box. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23t7YkKbnP9fNPBAHgKcPpodFyjqGaicf8KtyAdQGgxsMCDzRBnGvUmJnpJz5yFR3oD8U.png) [](https://deadline.com/2025/03/the-alto-knights-review-robert-de-niro-1236346462/) Lucky me, I had no idea what I'm getting into, just as I do with exhibitions, the only thing I knew was that Robert de Niro is starring and that the movie is about the Italian mob in the US in the '50s. After a few minutes, I got some déjà vu feeling and the movie reminded me of [A Bronx Tale](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0106489/?ref_=nm_flmg_job_1_accord_2_cdt_t_81), a brilliant one if you like this genre and Robert de Niro. The difference between the two roles is that in A Bronx Tale, de Niro was on the other side, playing the father of a kid mixed up with the Italian mob. There's a lot to learn from that movie, but let's get back to The Alto Knights. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23vhnnwUwxTPFceMMZi8Wtx4xubXdqgB9c9dQvMp1fAoFJcfihAu66GeLvQvjdifhTVCs.png) [](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-reviews/the-alto-knights-review-robert-de-niro-barry-levinson-1236166679/) As I said, I knew nothing about the movie, but started to have my suspicion that I see the same actor playing both roles after a few minutes, after which the obvious move was to see what they did to get two different looking people. I must admit, they did a great job and so did de Niro as it's mot easy to be two different persons in the same time. Being based on a true story, the screen writers had to follow the original story, which means they had little room to maneuver. As someone knowing nothing of the original story, my expectations were low, I only enjoyed what I was presented. The movie was good, de Niro level I'd say, but still, it was a bit flat, but it's still a good way to learn about the two main characters. The language was brilliant, every single actor did their part to make you feel like you're living among the Italian mobsters in the US. Costumes were also perfect. ![the-alto-knights-de-niro-messing_1741360216.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uQjtyJGwZcyEc1mvAdKR7ZwX7ncCUScTJSg9wiRkPkvwjdCWQJqnswB7DSoqrgS2giP.webp) [](https://www.moviefone.com/movie/wise-guys/XwytYnmm2NheSXoLkXnTQ2/main/) All in all I'd rate it as 8/10. If you like Robert de Niro, mob life, in the US and the life in the '50s in the United States in general, you'll like this movie for sure. Basically this is a piece of American history. I'm not an US citizen, so I just laid back and enjoyed what I was watching and that's the best you can do. Don't read anything before you watch the movie (except my post of course 😆), don't have any expectations, then you can enjoy the movie. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wgHYAcyTzrRzPioVNBq3vf51KMc2Zn81K6q8sTmMQtyhyXX5Gs4iURX3LLVJVQ1YqWn.png) [](https://www.moviefone.com/movie/wise-guys/XwytYnmm2NheSXoLkXnTQ2/main/) https://youtu.be/YSXBe_T99gA?si=JjN0iMtXrnspwSN-

body.title: How Can a Dentist Help Prevent Serious Dental Problems?\n
body.body:
In this blog, we will discuss how a dentist helps prevent serious dental issues through early detection, preventive care, gum treatment, and tooth replacement solutions.



![Metro-Dental-Check-Up.webp](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/db4d66c51393cced867cb60afd934cc3ff9753d0d28667556ca2198021abd1f0)



Many people think dental care is only necessary when something feels wrong. A toothache, swollen gums, or sensitivity often encourages a visit to the dental office. However, by the time these symptoms appear, the problem may already be advanced. Preventive dentistry focuses on stopping issues before they reach that stage.

A [Dentist Washington DC ](https://metrodentalhealth.com/dentist-washington-dc/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi)is not only responsible for treating existing conditions. Dental professionals also work to maintain oral health, identify risks, and help patients avoid future complications. Regular care, combined with healthy habits, can greatly reduce the chances of developing severe dental concerns. In situations involving gum health or missing teeth, support from a Periodontist and treatments such as Implants can also contribute to long-term oral stability.

**Small Problems Rarely Stay Small**

Many dental conditions begin with subtle changes that are easy to overlook. A tiny area of decay or mild gum irritation may not cause immediate discomfort. Because these early signs are often painless, people may assume everything is fine.

Unfortunately, oral health issues usually do not disappear on their own. Without attention, they can continue progressing beneath the surface.

Regular dental evaluations help uncover concerns while they are still manageable. Addressing issues at an early stage often reduces treatment complexity and helps preserve natural teeth.

**Routine Checkups Provide Valuable Information**

A dental examination offers much more than a quick look at the teeth. It allows a Dentist to evaluate different aspects of oral health and identify changes that may otherwise go unnoticed.

During these visits, professionals may assess:

*   Tooth condition

<!---->

*   Gum health

*   Jaw function

*   Bite alignment

*   Signs of wear

*   Areas prone to decay

This ongoing assessment creates a clearer picture of oral health over time and allows potential concerns to be addressed before they become larger problems.

**Removing Buildup That Daily Care May Miss**

Although daily brushing and flossing help keep the mouth clean, some plaque and debris can remain in hard-to-reach areas of the teeth.

Some parts of the mouth are harder to reach during daily oral care, making them more likely to collect plaque and food particles. As plaque remains on tooth surfaces, it can harden, creating an environment where bacteria thrive.

Professional cleaning appointments help remove accumulated deposits and leave teeth cleaner than home care alone can.

Regular cleanings can support:

*   Fresher breath

*   Healthier gums

*   Cleaner tooth surfaces

*   Reduced bacterial buildup

*   Improved oral hygiene

These benefits contribute to a healthier mouth and a lower risk of future problems.

**Paying Attention to Gum Health**

Strong gums provide the foundation that keeps teeth stable. When gum tissue becomes irritated, the supporting structures around the teeth may gradually become affected.

Common warning signs include:

*   Tender gums

*   Persistent redness

*   Bleeding during brushing

*   Swelling around the teeth

If these symptoms are ignored, the illness can worsen. A [Fairfax Periodontist](https://metrodentalhealth.com/fairfax-periodontist/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi) focuses on the prevention and treatment of conditions affecting gum tissue and supporting structures. Early treatment can help maintain healthy gums and reduce the likelihood of more serious complications.

**Learning Better Oral Care Habits**

Every patient has unique dental needs. What works well for one person may not be ideal for another.

A Dentist can provide practical recommendations based on individual circumstances. Personalized guidance often helps patients improve their daily routines and make better decisions regarding oral care.

Topics frequently discussed include:

*   Brushing effectiveness

*   Flossing consistency

*   Dietary choices

*   Tobacco use

*   Teeth grinding

*   Sports-related protection

Improving daily habits can significantly influence oral health over the long term.

**Watching for Changes Over the Years**

The mouth naturally changes over time. Teeth experience wear, gums may recede, and bite patterns can shift gradually.

Because these changes often happen slowly, they may not be obvious to patients. Regular visits allow a Dentist to compare current findings with previous examinations and monitor trends. This ongoing observation makes it easier to recognize developing issues and respond appropriately.

Consistent monitoring helps support healthier outcomes and better long-term dental function.

**Managing Tooth Loss Before Additional Problems Occur**

Missing teeth can affect more than appearance. Gaps in the smile may change how forces are distributed during chewing, potentially placing extra strain on neighboring teeth.

Over time, surrounding teeth may shift position, creating additional concerns. To replace lost teeth and restore function, [Implants Arlington VA](https://metrodentalhealth.com/our-services/implant-dentistry/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi), are frequently used. They help fill gaps while supporting normal daily activities such as speaking and eating.

Benefits may include:

*   Improved chewing ability

*   Enhanced stability

*   Better smile appearance

*   Reduced movement of nearby teeth

*   Support for natural jaw structure

Replacing missing teeth can help maintain balance throughout the mouth.

body.title: The Fragrant Flowers of the Prophet (PBUH): A Reflection on Al-Hasan and Al-Husain
body.body:
Hey Hive community,
Today, I want to share a beautiful and deeply affectionate saying of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) regarding his two beloved grandsons. It’s a short narration, but it speaks volumes about his gentle nature, his immense love for family, and the high status of his household (*Ahl al-Bayt*).
![Al-Hasan-and-Al-Hussain-flowers-Hadith-768x644.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVX6aFaAiud3LFboTDzi7fydZ95kxu6Ef9QghVdPk6tTd/Al-Hasan-and-Al-Hussain-flowers-Hadith-768x644.png)

As shared in the image, this Hadith reminds us of the tender relationship he shared with the youth of his family.
### The Narration
> “Indeed Al-Hasan and Al-Husain – they are my two fragrant flowers in the world.”
> — **Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)**
> *(Jami` at-Tirmidhi, Vol. 1, Book 46, Hadith 3770)*
> 
### Key Takeaways & Reflections
 * **The Expression of Affection:** Describing his grandsons as \

(*Rayhanatayn*) is an incredibly beautiful, poetic expression of love. It shows a soft, paternal side of the Prophet (PBUH) that teaches us the importance of expressing explicit warmth, love, and joy toward our children and grandchildren.
 * **A Comfort in the World:** By calling them his flowers *in the world*, he highlights them as sources of peace, delight, and fragrance amidst the trials and hardships of earthly life.
 * **Their Elevated Status:** This narration is not just about family affection; it serves as a signpost for the Muslim community to love, respect, and honor Al-Hasan and Al-Husain. They were nurtured directly under the Prophet's guidance and grew up to carry a massive legacy in Islamic history.
### Final Thoughts
In a fast-paced world where we often forget to show tenderness to our loved ones, this Hadith is a gentle call to ground ourselves in family love. Loving the Prophet (PBUH) means loving those whom he loved, and keeping the memory and teachings of his \
alive in our hearts.\n*What is your favorite Hadith or story regarding the Prophet's relationship with his grandchildren? Let's discuss in the comments!*

body.title: The Role of Advanced Robotics and AI in Revolutionizing Modern Healthcare and Surgical Procedures
body.body: \n<div class=\

> With the advent of technology, many aspects of our lives have changed, and healthcare is one of those areas that have been affected the most. The modern world has brought enhanced robotics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to the way doctors diagnose diseases, treat patients and perform surgeries. The innovations are enabling healthcare professionals to deliver safer, quicker and more accurate medical treatment than ever before. Hospitals in the world are adopting AI and robotic systems. One of the biggest advantages of AI in healthcare is its capacity to process massive volumes of healthcare data in a very short period of time. AI can analyze medical images, lab tests, and patient history to assist medical professionals in diagnosing diseases earlier and more accurately. This enables healthcare practitioners to make informed decisions and develop personalized treatment plans. AI can also help identify health issues at an early stage, providing patients with a higher likelihood of recovery. ![1001616223.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/23wByQdjYT9WjbR6AfWkTyfYEa7a8gUhd7Tvs5f2kYgXTzQXNwRxwGwmSoa48AbUTbpTJ.png) There is also a significant improvement in surgical procedures through the use of robotics. Robotic surgery is used to carry out complex surgeries with greater precision and control. These robotic systems should not be considered to be replacing surgeons, but rather as tools to aid the surgeon in performing delicate procedures with greater efficiency. The surgeon continues to have full control of the surgical instruments and the robotic arms, which have specialized tools, using a high-definition camera to provide a clearer view of the surgical area. I am amazed that sometimes robotic surgery only requires some small incisions. This means that patients typically are less likely to suffer pain, lose blood, develop infections and stay in hospitals for a shorter period of time. It may be quicker recovery than usual open surgery. These benefits enhance the experience for patients and contribute to the efficiency of healthcare facilities. One of the most promising advancements in robotic surgical technology is the incorporation of AI into surgical robots. AI can give instant feedback, make decisions and help surgeons know what to look out for during surgery. Scientists are even creating systems that could carry out some surgical procedures with great precision, with human guidance. While fully autonomous surgery remains a work in progress, the developments highlight the immense potential of AI and robotics in the future. Aside from surgery, robotics and AI is enhancing many other healthcare services. Robots can help with rehabilitation, patient monitoring, hospital logistics and even with remote healthcare delivery. Automated systems with artificial intelligence can help alleviate administrative burden, boost efficiency and assist healthcare professionals in making informed decisions. This enables a doctor or nurse to devote more time to patient care. In my own opinion, the future of healthcare will be even more sophisticated with further developments in AI and robotics. Although still issues like cost, training, ethics, and data privacy need to be addressed, the benefits are already obvious. The technologies are contributing to better accuracy, minimizing errors and increasing access to quality healthcare. The future promises even more life-saving and improving medical applications of AI and robotics globally as technology advances. To sum up, the future of healthcare and surgery is being transformed by advanced robotics and AI technology. They are improving medical services precision, efficiency and patients' perspectives. These technologies will help create a healthcare landscape that is not just safer, but more effective and efficient for all, from diagnostics and monitoring to surgical assistance and beyond. body.title: Ciclos destructivos
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaDfMRAWyjtEL2DdhaS4tiumaTrBNt4zm79DCPAJ6pQ2k/1781616370210.jpg)

Te has preguntado ¿por qué algunas situaciones negativas parecen repetirse una y otra vez en tu vida? A veces no son coincidencias, sino ciclos destructivos: patrones de pensamiento, emociones o decisiones que nos mantienen atrapados en el mismo lugar.

Estos ciclos suelen nacer de heridas no sanadas, creencias limitantes o hábitos aprendidos con el tiempo. Mientras no identifiquemos la raíz del problema, seguiremos obteniendo los mismos resultados.

La Biblia nos enseña que Dios no nos llamó a vivir atados a cadenas emocionales o espirituales, sino en libertad y transformación:
No os conforméis a este siglo, sino transformaos por medio de la renovación de vuestro entendimiento, para que comprobéis cuál sea la buena voluntad de Dios, agradable y perfecta. Romanos 12:2

Muchas veces pedimos un cambio de circunstancias, pero Dios quiere comenzar cambiando nuestro corazón y nuestra manera de pensar. La transformación verdadera ocurre cuando reconocemos aquello que nos está dañando y decidimos entregarlo a Dios.
Romper un ciclo destructivo requiere valentía. Requiere dejar hábitotos, pensamientos y actitudes que ya no aportan vida. Puede ser un proceso difícil, pero cada pequeño paso hacia la sanidad es una victoria.

Reflexión:
No estás condenado a repetir tu pasado. En Cristo siempre existe una oportunidad para comenzar de nuevo. Lo que hoy identificas como una cadena, mañana puede convertirse en un testimonio de libertad.
Así que, si el Hijo os libertare, seréis verdaderamente libres. Juan 8:36

English.............

Have you ever wondered why some negative situations seem to repeat themselves over and over again in your life? Sometimes they are not coincidences, but destructive cycles: patterns of thought, emotions or decisions that keep us stuck in the same place. 

These cycles are usually born from unhealed wounds, limiting beliefs or habits learned over time. As long as we do not identify the root of the problem, we will continue to obtain the same results. 

The Bible teaches us that God did not call us to live bound by emotional or spiritual chains, but in freedom and transformation:
Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is the good, acceptable, and perfect will of God. Romans 12:2

Many times we ask for a change in circumstances, but God wants to start by changing our hearts and our way of thinking. True transformation occurs when we recognize what is harming us and decide to hand it over to God. 
Breaking a destructive cycle requires courage. It requires leaving habits, thoughts and attitudes that no longer bring life. It may be a difficult process, but every small step towards healing is a victory. 

Reflection:
You are not condemned to repeat your past. In Christ there is always an opportunity to begin again. What you identify today as a chain, tomorrow can become a testimony of freedom.
So if the Son sets you free, you will be truly free. John 8:36

body.body:
The one-to-one COTI and GCOTI setup is a good example of how staking systems quietly change behavior.

Once the reward differential becomes visible, the holder stops thinking only about token price and starts optimizing the position structure. That can be healthy if it deepens commitment, but it can also make the system harder for casual users to understand.

The metric I would watch is whether higher staking returns bring in new participation or mostly reward existing committed holders. Those are very different growth signals.

body.body:
Broadcom is interesting because it is not trying to be Nvidia in the obvious way.

Nvidia owns the general-purpose accelerator narrative. Broadcom's strength is closer to custom silicon, networking, and the plumbing around hyperscale AI deployments. If AI capex keeps moving from experimentation into optimized infrastructure, that distinction matters.

The risk is that the market may already be pricing Broadcom like a clean AI derivative. I would watch whether custom chip demand stays broad across multiple hyperscalers or becomes too dependent on a few large customers.

The HAF API stack work is the kind of infrastructure update that usually gets less attention than it deserves.

For most users, an app either feels fast and reliable or it does not. They never see the indexing layer, query performance, or maintenance burden behind it. But that backend quality is what decides whether builders can create serious Hive apps without reinventing the same data-access layer every time.

The Claude Code note is interesting too. AI-assisted development seems most useful in exactly this kind of grind: not replacing architecture judgment, but compressing the repetitive implementation and review loop.

body.body:
A good summary ! The big winner, of course, will be the military-industrial complex. The US didn't lose very many people, but they lost a huge quantity of ground-based assets (billion-dollar radars etc). Satellite imagery and photos taken locally also suggests they lost a significant number of aircraft on the ground to drone and missile hits, including several Reaper drones, quite a few KC-135's, and one or possibly two E-3 AWACS. Not to mention spaffing away most of their Patriot interceptor and Tomahawk missiles. Companies like Lockheed and Raytheon will make a fortune in replacement contracts, paid for with borrowings that will have to be covered by taxpayers for the next couple of generations.

But the real loss is going to be geo-political, on two fronts. 

By using missiles on civilian ships rather than boarding them as a way to enforce their unilateral blockade, the US has shown the world that piracy is okay. In the process, they killed several Indian sailors plus another who died when he was taken ill and the US Navy ignored the distress calls (a clear breach of International Law). The Indian government has notably cooled towards the US and shown evidence of drawing far closer to Russia and even China.

Even more importantly, the lessons of Libya, Iraq, North Korea, Pakistan and now Iran are clear. If you want to avoid being bombed by the United States, get nuclear weapons, and enough of them to survive a first strike.

Rumour is that some of the Pakistani ones are already hosted in Saudi Arabia, and I expect that in the next few years we'll see Saudi Arabia and Turkey becoming openly nuclear states, with Brazil, Japan, Poland, Egypt, Algeria and South Korea as possible other candidates. Iran itself I'm not sure; the US cleverly assassinated the Supreme Leader, so it's a question of whether his fatwa died with him or if they really do mean what they say about not getting the bomb.

Thanks a lot for checking it out and for your honest feedback! 🙏😊
Yes, at first look MydEmpire may feel like it has many variables, but the basic start is actually very simple:
Buy/Open pack --> get Land + Blueprint + EMP --> build factory --> generate EP/day.

After that, everything else is optional and can be explored slowly. You don’t need to understand everything on day one. It is more like an idle/strategy economy game where your empire keeps growing over time, and you can manage it at your own pace.

For daily play, even 5–10 minutes is enough in the beginning — just check your dashboard, claim/maintain when needed, and decide if you want to expand. Of course, players who enjoy deeper strategy can spend more time optimizing factories, marketplace trades, operations, etc.

A beginner-friendly tutorial/guide is definitely needed, and I’ll work on making it simpler for new players. Thanks again for pointing this out — feedback like this helps improve the game a lot. 💪

You are most welcome to join and try slowly; no pressure at all. Every empire can start with one small step.

body.title: Old English Horn, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body:
![ggggggg.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpNoogSDHcmyBwznskuLFFEJcurL8deXEQ9GSs2b2FabQFb9B6qLPmpgvyDguqQzDHG.png)


Blessings, colleagues! It's a beautiful morning to enjoy a good coffee and, of course, start the day by looking at a drawing of one of the fantastic cards in the game. In this case, I'm going to show you the drawing I did of R496 Old English Horn. This card represents an old English Horn. Looking at its design, it's somewhat similar to modern oboes, with the difference that this one doesn't have an external reed but an internal one.

This particular design was widely used in classical music centuries ago. Possibly during the Renaissance or even the medieval period. It's impossible to say for sure who invented it because, like many other ancient instruments, it's an evolution of older ones. So it would be difficult to ask until we find out who invented it. But at least we should be grateful to whoever it was, since thanks to them we have the modern oboes that are indispensable in orchestras.

Let's move on to the drawing, which I'm sure is what you want to see now, since that's why you came here in the first place, lmao. Anyway, it's always good to analyze what we're going to paint a bit. Well, actually, I've already painted it, but now I'm going to show you a summary. It's a tongue twister in the form of a joke; those who have followed me from the beginning already know me and know that I often joke around here. I started by painting the inner frame of the card.

<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8CywTFdEGy255sS37MCQitBNxpaQ8Uudyc2vPZGLaQwpUXaEStD7kAb5Be.jpg) After finishing the frame, I drew the design of the Old English Horn, starting with the central part, then the lower flared part, and finally the upper part. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DHkUMDs2SD8y61QVTadTi8mwxWDxCVJ9dAPzxW2XfPQzrY3QJrgpSx1iX.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUXi6JumD1L5L3VqKD725BT7MygGFbqSpckibBD6TamnF8gwpQjrgbjUcGLWG.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9G1QoiHGhHPB8V7gkjRTpcb58ACsCtPwDq1yPUhHMVXkmxYpb1eSoALJE8.jpg) In the next step, I drew what would be the internal divisions of the instrument. These simulate the wood carvings and also make each part more visible. And with that, the sketch is finished. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9G1QoiHGhHNgaUdwbhQtHu7eQhxGXdxDkKNVbEpy286QVCV3wnK4neo9Wc.jpg) Now it's time to paint! You can see how I painted it from beginning to end. I used red as the predominant color for the main background of the card. And inside, I used various shades of blue and brown for both the wood grain and the inner background. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoH3eYX1w6doqdadtiAi4YKCk6uRy91FuE7296SeUyRswjcjAMxfM18K6DZTAzrYyM5.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EprTAazssdHcSxz97Uwghtwp8qx2yhmYRuLvVh4bDnpnehDM1yQ2mFBBJJYDTn6yJFc.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpzxgTnLvGVK2tMHHRQ9KSRUfjF2jgLVvbazoUTABNusm5bVm6gaBZNjGZXijNTVubF.jpg) ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpzxgTnLvGVK2tMHHRQ9KSRUfjF2jgLVvbazoTug8HjemjCaetw6qgMdPBrpzQqSV22.jpg) And to finish up for today, here's the finished drawing with the details from the original card, like the name and the game's name. I added the game's name as part of a stamp to confirm the drawing is complete. See you in the next drawing. body.title: The Ultimate Reward: Loving the Household of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)
body.body:
Hey Hive community,
Today, I wanted to share a beautiful and profoundly moving Hadith that serves as a powerful reminder of love, family, and the ultimate reward in the hereafter.
As captured in the image, there is a narration from Tirmidhi that perfectly illustrates the high status of the Prophet’s immediate family (the *Ahl al-Bayt*) and what loving them truly means for us.
![ahle-bait-love-hadith-768x644.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmavepJcE5twToJdmthbHVDXSp4njS6VWtMLovC2kHWrZw/ahle-bait-love-hadith-768x644.png)

### The Narration
> \

> — **Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)**
> *(Jami` at-Tirmidhi, Vol. 1, Book 46, Hadith 3733)*
> 
### Reflections on this Hadith
This short narration carries an immense weight. Here are a few thoughts on what we can take away from it:
 * **A Family Bound by Divine Love:** The Prophet (PBUH) explicitly names his beloved grandsons, Hasan and Husain, alongside their father (Ali ibn Abi Talib) and their mother (Fatimah az-Zahra). By holding their hands, he physically and publicly demonstrated his deep affection and protection over them.
 * **The Condition of True Love:** To love the Prophet (PBUH) means to love what he loves. You cannot truly claim to love the Messenger without also holding a deep respect and love for his family, who sacrificed so much for the early Muslim community.
 * **The Ultimate Companion:** The reward mentioned here is mind-blowing. The Prophet (PBUH) doesn't just promise Jannah (Paradise) to those who possess this love; he promises **his level** in the hereafter. Imagine being in the proximity of the best of creation on a day when everyone will be looking for safety and comfort.
### Conclusion
In a world where we often look up to the wrong role models, this Hadith redirects our hearts toward the ultimate household. Cultivating love for the Prophet (PBUH) and the *Ahl al-Bayt* isn't just a emotional sentiment—it's a path toward securing a place right next to him in eternity.
*What are your thoughts on this Hadith? Let’s discuss in the comments!*

这两天深圳经常下雨，也就没有像之前的那么热了.特别是晚上，凉快了很多.
昨晚一觉睡到自然醒，特别舒服.睡得好，白天上班的时候精神也好了很多。
然而今天上班的时候被一个朋友打电话过来，问我怎么一回事，有些电路没搞懂，老是跳闸。

然后就跟他聊了一会儿，说一下具体情况。因为他是家里自己装修的，所以水电也是自己搞，没有雇别人。
但是装灯、装插座这些都是比较普通的常识，他就能做。安装电箱的时候就问题来了。
他跟我说，开关一打开的时候，插座就跳闸了，然后插座用的时候就灯跳闸了。

反正两者就不可能同时使用，他这么一说，我就知道问题出在哪里了。
这是许多人都会犯的一个错误，因为许多人只知道漏电开关还有空气开关两种。
其中每一个开关就控制一个回路。特别是插座这一块，个个都知道要装漏电开关。

有一般的常识的人都知道照明是不需要经过漏电开关的，还有空调也不需要经过漏电开关。
所以照明的开关和空调都是使用空气开关，这也是成为了一种常识。
包括我的这位朋友，他也是犯了这个错误。他插座使用的是漏电开关，没有问题也没错。

但问题来了，他是把照明的火线接到空气开关里。包括空调也是接到空气开关，但两者是分开两个回路。
他们只是火线接对了，但是零线就接错。直接是把零线接到了漏电开关里面进去。
也就是说漏电开关里面的零线被照明共用了。一旦使用照明，回零的时候就跳闸。

按照他的意思，我叫他把电箱打开，拆开盒子盖。然后把零线这一端接到电箱盒子顶部的零线排上。
看了他的空调插座，也是这样的做法。就赶紧将它一起把它给拆过来换正位置。
然后他再次打开使用，就恢复了正常。其实这种是电工的常识。只是没有说开的，很多人不知道而已。这两天深圳经常下雨，也就没有像之前的那么热了.特别是晚上，凉快了很多.

/> * * * Hola amigos, les confieso que no hay mejor sensación que levantarse a primera hora del día y salir a entrenar. Ayer por la mañana me sentí especialmente motivado, así que después de hacer algunos movimientos dinámicos para calentar, me fui a trotar durante 50 minutos, manteniéndome en mi zona 2, ese ritmo cómodo, donde puedo respirar bien y conversar sin quedarte sin aire. Es una forma ideal de entrenar la resistencia y cuidar el cuerpo sin agotarlo. Mi ruta fue hacia el boquete, allí iba conversando con mi esposa sobre la planificación de una carrera que se está organizando en la cuidad donde vivo Santa Rosa 10k y caminata 5k, luego les daré más detalles. Me sentí excelente en la trayectoria sentí que cada paso cuesta arriba es un pequeño triunfo y una oportunidad para recordarme que el esfuerzo vale la pena. Lo mejor de hoy no fue solo mi propio entrenamiento, sino compartir el espacio con mi compañera de vida. Me sentí parte de un equipo y apoyándonos mutuamente. Esos minutos de tranquilidad en la mañana, sintiendo el aire fresco, conversando y planificando, me llenan de energía para el resto del día. Si todavía no lo haces, te animo a probarlo. Levantarte temprano y salir a trotar puede ser justo lo que necesitas para empezar un día con la mejor actitud. La constancia y el disfrute del proceso son clave. * * *

/> * * * Hi friends, I have to admit there’s no better feeling than waking up first thing in the morning and heading out for a workout. Yesterday morning I felt especially motivated, so after doing some dynamic stretches to warm up, I went for a 50-minute jog, staying in my Zone 2—that comfortable pace where I can breathe easily and hold a conversation without getting out of breath. It’s an ideal way to build endurance and take care of your body without exhausting it. My route took me toward El Boquete. Along the way, I was chatting with my wife about planning a race being organized in the city where I live—the Santa Rosa 10K and 5K walk. I’ll give you more details later. I felt great during the run; I felt that every step uphill was a small victory and an opportunity to remind myself that the effort is worth it. The best part of today wasn’t just my own workout, but sharing the experience with my life partner. I felt like part of a team, supporting each other. Those quiet moments in the morning—breathing in the fresh air, chatting, and making plans—fill me with energy for the rest of the day. If you haven’t tried it yet, I encourage you to give it a shot. Getting up early and going for a jog might be just what you need to start your day with the best attitude. Consistency and enjoying the process are key. * * *
