body.title: Fledgling: Part 131
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmboLyS7bf3NC7WHdkYBgXkbreHyci9vcH3WNBMjZq9Bjs/fell_dragon_3_no_text.png)
Greeting all

Latest update! I hope you all enjoy it!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGgGR4jMjqWAtnrsAQ473w3LqzGE2xiaqkC4u5gva4Hf/fell_dragon_3_divider.png)
The world was hot. The sky was a smoky red and stank. Saita couldn’t place the smell at first. She had never experienced mass burnings before, but when she had found the first crematorium, still working after being abandoned, she started to understand why the sky was the colour it was.
This world, no, the universe had even less energy than the world she had just left. Returning would be difficult, and she would have to make use of much of her marks once more, but it was possible.

All around her there was chaos as Wolven ran people down and devoured them. Saita’s instinct was to step in, but she had to stop herself. There was nothing she could do. This world was done for. She could feel what energy was left slowly being drained toward a certain part of the planet. She knew that this was the Fell Dragon of this timeline, and it was unlike Kay.

While not bestial, it wasn’t like anything Saita had ever sensed before. Yet, the Wolven, she knew, and they were swarming around it. That and one more person.

Saita was aware that there was another person, but she couldn’t read the energy as well as she could others. It was similar with Kay and was likely that their energy was too much the same. Just like you couldn’t recognise your own scent while others could smell it.

Saita took a deep breath and visualised the woman that caused Bolx to eventually fall in love with her. Then, as she released her breath, she teleported to her. Saita had to ready her replaced arm to backhand a Wolven as it tried to latch its jaws around the kneeling woman’s throat.

“Not yet.” Warned Saita.

The creature, an amalgamation of metal and flesh, landed hard and struggled to get to its feet. It seemed to do a double take and then fixed the new threat with a confused look while the rest of its kind tried to swarm.

Saita wasn’t sure how it would affect time, but she had no qualms in destroying anything that came her way in this moment. The confused Wolven yipped a few times, and the attacking Wolven skidded to a halt. It then stood up and seemed to weigh its chances of taking on the new warrior before it.

Then a mournful song came floating toward the gathered humans and Wolven. Saita allowed her eye to wander to where the Fell Dragon stood. It was too far away to gather much more information than that it had red skin, and it was walking on two legs. It stood on the top of a crumbling building with a massive pack of Wolven. Saita could feel its eyes on her, but it didn’t make a move to get to her. It was as if it recognised what she was, whether a Champion or a Fell Dragon, and it didn’t seem to want to take her on.

“So, you made it.” Came a voice behind her. “The old softy.”

“Yeah.” Said Saita, not taking her eye off the Fell Dragon and the writhing mass of furred bodies behind it.

“It’s here for me. You don’t…”

“Leave.” Ordered Saita as she looked at the Wolven that surrounded them.

As one, all tails were tucked between legs, and the beasts leapt back to rejoin their master. Saita could feel the surprise of their master and its indecisiveness. She needed to route it now, or she would have to fight.

“You too. There is nothing here for you.”

The creature seemed to raise its arm in a salute, and then it was gone, along with the pack that followed it. However, Saita wasn’t sure if all the beasts had been taken by their master or there were a few that remained on the planet to complete the harvest.

That was what Saita had felt. A harvest. This was the power of a Fell Dragon at the peak of its power, a power that she too would wield one day. She slowly released the breath she was holding and turned to the woman kneeling in mud mixed with her own blood. She was almost glad that Bolx wasn’t here to see this.

Kaiden had a gash across the right side of her face that had opened her oral cavity to the outside world. One arm hung limply at her side while her other was trying to hold back whatever internal organs were trying to escape through several deep slashes.

“Thank God the General didn’t come himself.” She muttered, her speech impacted by the gaping hole in her cheek.

“I don’t think he had the strength to see the outcome.” Admitted Saita. “Here.”

Saita wrapped her right hand around the blood-soaked top of Kaiden’s head and gave her the ability to deaden the pain she was experiencing. She even helped her kick-start it, as she didn’t have much energy remaining.

It wouldn’t be long now.

Kaiden sighed and sat down. She looked up to where the Fell Dragon was and then looked up at the sky. She was silent for a long time before she asked.

“He had a good life?”

“Yes.”

“Children?”

“Yes.”

Kaiden released a sound that made Saita think she was choking back a sob.

“Was he happy?”

“Yes.”

Kaiden looked up at Saita and smiled grotesquely. “I did my best.”

“Thank you.”

Kaiden nodded her head. They didn’t speak again. There was nothing worth talking about. Each had gotten what they needed from this meeting, and there was nothing else that could be gained.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGgGR4jMjqWAtnrsAQ473w3LqzGE2xiaqkC4u5gva4Hf/fell_dragon_3_divider.png)
A short, final goodbye to the woman that brough Bolx into Saita's life. I hope you all enjoyed the upodate!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGgGR4jMjqWAtnrsAQ473w3LqzGE2xiaqkC4u5gva4Hf/fell_dragon_3_divider.png)

body.body:
Howdy Folks!

Well here we go, the second half, the B-Side of the Calgary Stampede album is in the shoots!

Today we have for you the 14th song on the B-Side Friends!

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/821d09d0-b485-47fc-b113-9fb71494d8f7.jpg)

Steel Ink Band~ B-Side~ #14. Hell or High Water?

https://youtu.be/aE7-IXHlLAw?si=dG3wh_a-a6UNhtFJ

Song #14 description:

Positioned deep on the B-side, \

is the explosive payoff to the album's mid-record wake-up call. Taking the raw energy injected by the interlude and channeling it into a massive, stadium-sized anthem, this track captures the absolute peak of the Calgary Stampede experience. It’s the sound of local grit meeting late-night, neon-soaked euphoria.\nThe song launches straight into the heart of the grounds, painting a vivid picture of the dust settling on the track and the unmistakable buzz overriding Nashville North. Musically, it balances a driving, heavy rock rhythm section with soaring, defiant melodies. The verses build a palpable tension, mirroring the spinning lights of the Midway and the thunder of the rodeo, before exploding into a cathartic, alcohol-and-adrenaline-fueled pre-chorus.\nWhen the chorus hits, it hits like a freight train. It’s an anthem of survival and triumph, explicitly honoring the resilient spirit of a city that has weathered its share of literal and metaphorical floods. Anchored by the iconic, roaring battle cry of \

, the track mimics a literal ascension—climbing higher and higher, fueled by heavy guitars and relentless energy, until it pushes past the limits of the city and rises right over the Rockies. --- ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3ce8a9ba-ee45-4614-b60d-22d3a3071612.jpg) --- ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6f702d0c-933b-465f-aebc-305e1960c027.jpg) --- --- Get ready to dust off your boots and embrace the spirit of the west! Over the next couple of weeks, I'm going to be sharing all the incredible tracks from the B-Side of the Steel Ink Band's Calgary Stampede Album. The first side was just the beginning, but the flip side is where the real ride begins. We’ll be diving into the grit, the glory, and the wildest chapters of western life, capturing the true energy of wide-open lands and the rumble of the grandstand. Buckle up, lean back, and let the record spin—welcome to the flip side of the Calgary sun! --- ---

/> **_This is my first time to post in this wonderful community. 🙏_Hello Hive Fam!** Most especially to my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world, I hope you’re all doing well today! 💖 I’m dropping by with a little life update that turned into a story worth sharing.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> Earlier today around 4pm Philippine time, we experienced an unscheduled brownout in our area. It lasted for almost an hour, and because of the heavy rains, my house was quite dim. Instead of letting the gloomy atmosphere take over, I remembered a very useful parcel I received a few weeks ago: my **three-source light**. As shared before, this has been recommended to me by Boss @chinito . I ordered it via **_Shopee_**.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> This little gadget became my hero of the day! I placed it on my workstation, tried it on my chair, and even brought it outside to see how it looked against the rainy backdrop. Of course, I couldn’t resist capturing some random photos of it in action. Sometimes, small things like this make a big difference in our daily lives.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> Moments like these remind me how important it is to appreciate the simple tools that bring comfort and convenience. A brownout could have been frustrating, but instead, it turned into a chance to enjoy my new light and share the experience with all of you here on Hive.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/> It’s these little updates that connect us, showing how we adapt, stay creative, and keep moving forward no matter what life throws our way.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/>\n\n**Thank you so much for reading my update today, Hive Fam.** Your support and presence always brighten my day more than any light could. Sending love and positivity to each of you across the globe! 💕

body.title: Inihaw na Tilapia: Cooked in a Multicooker
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmef3tz9hezCwtavh7Pdu4rxBJZQbJofQoQzFYjczrhy73/1781614954937.png)

‎One morning, a mobile fish vendor came around. They're selling big tilapia. 
‎
‎As soon as I saw it, I already imagined Inihaw na Tilapia.
‎
‎It's juicy and flavorful grilled fish... One of my favorites. 
‎
‎But there was one problem... we had no charcoal. But because we had a small trusty multicooker, I thought why not try using it? 
‎
‎Maybe it can do the job. I just wanted to taste the inihaw, so I gave it a go.
‎
‎**Ingredients:**
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmShPMDo2fharj7j4kJMk7c3janM7h6sKAsVDP2SKbs24P/1781615004708.jpg)
‎
‎• 1 big tilapia
‎• 2 medium tomatoes 
‎• 2 small red onions
‎• 3 cloves garlic
‎• 1/2 teaspoon salt 
‎• 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 
‎• 1 tablespoon soy sauce
‎• 1 tablespoon cooking oil
‎
‎**Let's cook!**
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaeDLpaVRP3nMzGg28yPe1ikmuoNuwHw9AoBrzTUMjmZ/1781615031977.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHDCZ24ijgi49rtaDNmUkeTD5BFTP3EHktWFuhmp57yK/1781615032193.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBLjYpKxPVdpBk7A2M42mQx5x1HCbrMA3dmpKELZWEBD/1781615032423.jpg)

‎First, I prepared the filling and seasoning. I sliced and chopped the tomatoes, onions, and garlic. Then I added the salt, pepper, and soy sauce, and mixed everything well.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbFpT6YdxdBori6wvq7mmRyRN6YfocTM6EoD2Jdiv4XU6/1781615059876.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQc97FuKMi5mTx9E1MbPkTr7VzC4JWj9MdZaejkfiviW/1781615060047.jpg)
‎
‎Next, I rubbed a little salt, pepper, and cooking oil all over the fish. 
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdi9Gkn2dXgyYJsGGQsk7XtdFJoPxtVWjEgakczFVSjEG/1781615086117.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMY9YxMgUwRJyqnAX2yfg8MF141kQGofjMChZqQz5NWD/1781615086292.jpg)

‎I also stuffed all the mixture inside the tilapia... even into the gill part so the flavor could go deep.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmrn4BVRKu4icsgNkPr9RUtE7VgTKvtUZ3PwDsdUDAVG/1781615118077.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVVRS7EEqDpTm7ZZw1a1oYahsVk9CkrB84LMsi6RfeQSv/1781615118289.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXe2QrF37UJsbcxY2ZdtpGXSwu4cMzroreU3FtEnsWDWp/1781615118472.jpg)
‎
‎Then, I put salt inside the multicooker and a little oil, and carefully placed the fish in. But because the fish was too big, and the cooker was too small... The tail part stuck out, and I couldn’t fit it all the way. 😂 But still I stayed positive and told myself it would turn out fine.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTMZLvc78wTVv9Th1Jxnh1mgSCEHDYdc4WS91Hfi3wqMo/1781615140474.jpg)

‎After a few minutes, the part inside was cooking nicely, so I tilted it and moved it to let the tail cook too. 
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYNB3GcNUMt9dsX53kq7GpW1UMhtQRNXooJkb6SJ9Efga/1781615160305.jpg)

‎Once one side looked good, I flipped it over to cook the other side. To be honest, this isn’t really what multicookers are made for. 😂 But I just wanted to try anyway.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdKXTeM9fVH29AFiZB19t3gbfh931Uw9GMBX86CBxdEt/1781615177295.jpg)
‎
‎Then, as I flipped it again to make sure every part was done… it started to deform! 🤦🏻‍♀️ The fish looked so kawawa, falling apart and losing its nice shape. I just laughed and kept going until it was fully cooked.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPub2ufjc2E9QmP72DsiQ6ZMaqtsuWUe7RrVBrkdhzNE8/1781615203232.jpg)

‎I put it on a plate. Well… it was cooked, no doubt about that. But it didn’t taste like real inihaw at all! There was no smoky grilled flavor, just steamed fish with seasoning. 😅
‎
‎But what did I really expect? I used a multicooker instead of charcoal. 😂 Still, I’m happy I tried it. It was a fun experiment, and now I know next time, I won’t do it again! 😂
‎
‎Until my next inihaw...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwGy1PepFwdzckxAm8fJT2BtNG3DHPuCTBsrcmCAb78j/1778497869588.png)

body.title: 大佛寺&茶暖人心
body.body:
一路风光一路景，跟妹妹一边聊天一边走，不知不觉就来到了大佛寺，看了下时间差不多50分钟左右。大佛寺的正门很是气派，进入正门，看到右手边一座气势恢宏古朴的中式殿宇，以及前方还有一座千佛阁，殿前宽阔的石台上一尊巨大的鎏金弥勒佛自在依坐，瞬间吸引了所有人的目光。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBLhvzQ1TMj6KFPw4EcaxAVbC53YvB5wYz82T4qLp87C/zhengmen.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW6q7PgtTAw6uEs1GWX7ypmipN8Q9D62mBdUC6xMqJCNQ/bei.jpg)


这大佛身披红色袈裟，肚腹圆润，眉眼弯起，嘴角挂着豁达温和的笑意，仿佛看透世间所有烦恼，单单望着他，心底便涌起快乐，浮躁感顿消。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTU1jyHwginNX5nAhX5BXLnHwtXoYG64ogNgiRsnaYsAu/fo.jpg)


站在大佛脚下，抬头仰望，青山做背景，古殿为依托，大度弥勒佛包容万物的气度铺面而来，也忽然懂得了牌匾上“拜弥勒平步青云，礼慈容扶摇直上”，不求富贵荣华，只求一份豁达通透的心境。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPGAN8yC9zx5MoiXmepw94XL6Qtd1uiD4vsprCYLpNJXv/dian.jpg)

 ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpNNGM1b5BAxKFqV7w3c7ucoRJSgDz2ueQthwVUfM9mT/yangqi.jpg)

不远处有个千佛阁的导览牌，原来那座层层阶梯之上的古建筑便是它了。千佛阁享有世界三最的美誉：世界唯一结构独特的古典阁楼，造像最全的弥勒艺术，体量最大的弥勒菩萨造像。远看千佛阁做工精巧，背衬青山，仿佛一幅绝美的水墨画。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMsCvEaLpQjVSfowHZWaztzhk5ygj4zCsw87f6uU84ui/mile.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYSydZA8QcCU2YXb6CNUhp29fKZH4Xqu1cWn8hUP5nhZ2/walk.jpg)


山路旁还有一个大红“福”字，石头后面还有一凉亭，悬挂一个古铜钟，游人驻足可以祈福，抬手撞钟，钟声悠扬回荡山谷。墙壁 在它的下面有一棚子，原本我想过去看看有没有饮料或者水，没想到，这里竟然是免费的舍茶。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmewDsjzkkJdSECJtmYhFUG5Ef6GHW4AzvsAvxXqZu5rpw/zhong.jpg)


这个搭起来的凉亭下有长条桌子还有椅子，能容纳20多人在此休息品茶。 这里有志愿者义工师傅们，他们招呼我们坐下之后，便给我俩倒上一杯热茶。 让我们好好歇歇。 并且说这里的茶水都是大佛寺免费捐赠给游客的。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV4EUe7H9DW6JkrfuhzvbjV7DiivvSUWzag5eBxSQmsoE/shecha.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb5jXJTfffmngGmjCfiWzbYS5zvXYcWxeVHpsonJm9rV2/teahouse.jpg)


这对于走了那么远的路的我们来说，能够有地方休息，还能品尝这里的茶，那感觉真是太好了。 茶水有白茶，黑茶， 大红袍，还有香茅茶，四种茶叶随意品尝，多少都免费。有水杯的还可以倒点到水杯里，走到这里的人都能坐下来喝上一杯茶。 

我尝了一下香茅茶，那味道也很难忘，有种肥皂的味道，但喝了之后又唇齿留香，很是特别。 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ2tGShdTuiMLaqrE2fQMQZAyjeBoW1G3jSsyYxHkJRjN/cha.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVZmhsmt8YAPr9iXZiijBSH64tYuDjXWFAZu4wULpXXkh/shui.jpg)

义工师傅们说，他们在这里是免费做义工的，有的一做竟然十多年呢！当我们问做义工的好处时，他们说这里面环境好，清净，可以修身养性，再者能够为全国各地的游客服务，也是他们求之不来的。 

其实我也去过很多地方，很多地方都是商业消费，而且价格都很高，甚至景区里卖的东西都加价，翻倍，但是千山风景区里面不仅仅是吃的还是喝的，价格都很亲民，没有太离谱的加价。 

更可贵的是在大佛寺这里还有免费提供的四种好茶待客，就这一点就让人心生敬意。 要知道如果是旺季，这里的师傅们根本就忙不开，只不过我们来的这个时候，人不多，情况还好。

能在走累的时候，有一处地方可供休息，还有一杯热茶来喝，真是解乏又高兴，对千山的印象好感倍增，让人觉得以人为本，在这里人与自然和谐共处，真是一块宝地。 妹妹问我，千山是不是很好？而且仅仅来一次怎么够？因为还有很多地方还没去呢？

所以我们以后肯定还会再来千山的！

body.title: Wisely Used
body.body:
Greetings, everyone!


>Theme-: \

To this question, what I will do is not to quit my job or travel around the world, this is the right channel to use the money. When it comes to this point, we need wisdom, and we need to strategize. There are things you can put into this money and it will yield more for you.



![1000819123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/245THr2ghHthFWJ6GCE332oUYkacmagqBmWe6PYM8uTqKZpPBgW8hb8K1AsdPgQwMta6w.jpg)


The first thing, I will do is to pay my tithe, which is very important. Then, support my parents, and the remaining part of the money is for me. I will think of what business to start with that will satisfy people's needs. Now the capital is available. It's left for me to search for people's needs, what's that business when I establish, people would be like, this is what I was looking for, and they rush in to get it for their satisfaction. The more you satisfy people's needs, the more you get money. You can sell the business for billions, bigger than the capital you used to start the business.

If the money won remains from the business I have started, I can use it for an investment that will yield another income every day. I'm not talking about cryptocurrency; this line of investment can swallow my whole money, so I will not invest here, but elsewhere that is genuine.

The idea of using one million, to travel is not beneficial or profitable. If you use it to tour around, it will finish on the way. To quit my job is also not sensible. 

Enrolling in my job and business is a big way of progress and prosperity. Doing both or more will help me to strategize and bring balance to my life. 

Even the Bible says:

>Proverbs 24:27 TPT
[27] Go ahead, build your career and give yourself to your work. But if you put me first, you’ll see your family built up!


When we put God first, He will give us the wisdom to build our careers and the strength to give ourselves to work efficiently or effectively.

Part of the money will be used for orphans too. 

The money won, should be used wisely for the Glory of God and to the satisfaction of others in a saleable way.

_**This is my response to the #indiaunited weekly contest**_

_**I love, I care, and I forgive**_

body.title: Resetting My Mind at Woodlands Waterfront
body.body:
Today I felt so exhausted that I decided to go somewhere that could make me feel calm again. City life can be really tiring sometimes. The constant movement, the noise, the work routine, and the feeling that everything is always moving fast can really drain me. So from time to time, I feel like I need to escape the busyness of the city and go to a place where I can just stare at the water, the sky, and especially the sunset.



![1000180189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnaYHEvqpzUGeuQKjewjCJKRnj2Mu247fJScqyLob1LX2Y1k9x3yJQSu5pFkoD3eCie.jpg)


And luckily, there is one place in Singapore where I can almost forget that I’m still in the city.

I’m talking about Woodlands Waterfront.


![1000180182.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eqd2DxVMbwtVTuVehQKC9kAZKoJVEtjeLdJHncCrZZyjDECft6czsweUfzgG2frCNc9.jpg)


This place is located at the outer edge of Singapore, and I think that is also what makes it special. It feels far from the usual city center vibe. When I arrived and stood on the deck, I felt like I was already at the border of another world. From there, I could literally see Malaysia across the water. I even joked to myself that if I shouted toward Malaysia, maybe someone there could hear me. LOL.


![1000180183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep5kBUG7E8iARxHgTwXU4a25k9YYpe6xtkXx43DBWGMsHn6ycwZxLkctfgPeiNnwGuo.jpg)

![1000180184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeErsjqz7SCMmdL7qHzFR4XNHwiU1dX5Sw5Kcccym2x1iwa14KKmBxrewSPruNCJ6M.jpg)

![1000180185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eow9mezgCWxUrvh2mXF4hN4v3uY2HE8NzqXU8RgmhGQswGSFdTVwwG4656Hhwj77eqK.jpg)

![1000180186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqDiagY9c3F4ox8EdGXppQGxYqHQqWHZN4gqULeFMFXDC4zYLjYt3CFxqqccVeqMjD4.jpg)

![1000180188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqNDfyi34QJy2rd27akc4J4Vn7sGEiAU9AgpAKEHGxSTUf2ym68EjWw99xZ4BMhcMzt.jpg)


But jokes aside, the feeling here was really peaceful.

The water was very calm that evening. There were no dramatic waves, just soft movements on the surface, almost like the sea was also resting after a long day. It was the perfect place to zone out and let the mind become quiet for a while. Sometimes, I don’t really need a big adventure. I just need a wide open view, a cooling breeze, and enough space to breathe.


![1000180191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoMDBpJewULp3ZtF8RJpSGn7mFczwxQoGJzBKA2KH2MANd3HR633RFZ1d6c8rDktw9L.jpg)

![1000180192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoPKEA7M46cPrPK51ciYG825qu8ustqk1EUcF58JLuSf5swSHNQzGnM5sJHA8F4MQfA.jpg)

![1000180193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnoHpcgQX4rZxYJYoUNAf72K8f6vvKTZZHjqHdXAi6wriKGwWyXBpMjbnu3DHuNLNMW.jpg)

![1000180199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnYQPYxtxZsx3v4uKj1z1RfdFcEKDmsfyepW4rCAxzNMzUaGXKV58Yft5KoNUXfQ8Z4.jpg)

![1000180202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnoJfS5pSyBn759bQiH5nkAmzBQcwbcoxfNtZEEwJeiwVkxLuvauBhs5YMAuEJhEjq1.jpg)


The timing of my visit was also perfect. The sky had this beautiful blend of blue and warm sunset colors. On one side, the sky was still bright and cool, while on the other side, the sunset slowly painted the horizon with soft golden tones. The clouds also made the view even more dramatic, like they were stretching across the sky just to add more texture to the evening.

I really love this kind of sunset. It is not too loud, not too fiery, but very calming. It feels like the day is slowly closing in the gentlest way possible.


![1000180204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqQMhkdHMATCPjmy3HyK6zeATt1Y4jMZw1iNcvQNZSbpCgTwRd4QNwE1jLB9z9u3gK6.jpg)

![1000180209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Epvit3uUTCVkfVRaB1UEKtdAmp2MoSR7kmRxVMixPanCthRhQgybP45HaJj6YaEhuNu.jpg)

![1000180213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoPLBcK9rkgJ5Z9zPZuHVexVXtpGoJK57WiPvrb6Co6Zq3PZaNAZ2PhHcBogLVyV4UE.jpg)

![1000180221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnsYZBk1GRK7thGRG8AS7FsHoGk4uydKGv4LH4TKkT9Lgyn1rQx8pyNGioPkTWnuUxH.jpg)

![1000180224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EphvXt3F7rjPnhRPo4H46DfmjQM7b81i4DDfJmCUDtL43SEVy3oRX94qUmULgCNMkbM.jpg)

![1000180217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoTbvqS8qpxXfu7oCif9VKfKJpHNMEa5ZbDHyU98k3c7ikC1sgrHxsUpEcG2s8ZShB5.jpg)


From the waterfront, I could see the skyline of Johor Bahru, which is one of the cities in Malaysia. Seeing it from this side made it feel so close. It’s funny to think that another country is just across the water. Actually, it probably takes only a few minutes to cross this distance by sea, and maybe one day soon, I will go to Johor Bahru just for a few hours to wander around and explore. That sounds like a fun mini-adventure waiting to happen.

But for today, I didn’t really want to go anywhere else.

All I wanted was to stay there, watch the sky, and reset.


![1000180226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpzvizufKtWEJX6yuYG57qKe9KDd5zcwxQEatmGuAhevmBwCGJ8669koSs6DoA9iTix.jpg)

![1000180187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnoJHoGp9sAQuAhCQGc7QWmvGSJf352LDAWJt2JN6jXqGRVHgxZBXrQaAN6g1p1yLq7.jpg)


There were other people at the waterfront too, some walking, some cycling, and some simply enjoying the same view. But even with people around, the place still felt peaceful. Maybe because everyone seemed to be there for the same reason: to enjoy the breeze and let the evening pass slowly.

Tomorrow is already happy hump day, so this little adventure came at the perfect time. It gave me the pause that I needed before facing the rest of the week again.

***So I’m sharing these photos with the hope that you will also feel the calm that I experienced during my visit. Woodlands Waterfront may be far from the usual city spots, but that is exactly why it feels special.***

## See you on my next adventure!





***

body.title: Verse of the Day | Tuesday, June 16th
body.body:
Psalm 84:5 and 7***

Today's verse reminds us that true strength is not born from personal effort or human self-sufficiency — it is born from leaning on God. The person who finds in Him their source of energy and sustenance is not worn down by the journey, but advances progressively, accumulating strength rather than losing it.

That is why in moments of exhaustion and weakness we must not seek more strength within ourselves, but return to the One who is the inexhaustible source. With God as our foundation, each stage overcome does not leave us emptier, but stronger and closer to His purpose for our lives.

</br>

## Versículo del Día | Martes 16 de Junio

> ***\

Salmo 84:5 y 7***

El versículo del día nos recuerda que la verdadera fortaleza no nace del esfuerzo propio ni de la autosuficiencia humana — nace de apoyarse en Dios. El hombre que encuentra en Él su fuente de energía y sustento no se desgasta con el camino, sino que avanza progresivamente, acumulando fuerza en lugar de perderla.

Es por eso que en los momentos de agotamiento y debilidad no debemos buscar más fuerza en nosotros mismos, sino volver a Aquel que es la fuente inagotable. Con Dios como fundamento, cada etapa superada no nos deja más vacíos, sino más fuertes y más cerca de Su propósito para nuestra vida.

body.title: Man Eater          …Part 8                …Romancing a Ghost
body.body:
*Every love story is a ghost story. — David Foster Wallace*


![ghost.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUQtXQ6vwZ36ycQ6pYX31Yr8dfAp8NDp79Wd896nNCkZM/ghost.png)
*The Consummate Femme Fatale*


I was beginning to figure out how I managed to open a portal to the past and make contact with Blythe Summers back in the Jazz Age when she was the celebrated star of the silver screen. It was as easy as taking a lesurely stroll through Blythe’s garden. I began as I did several days before, walking the turf maze and resting at certain points to pause and reflect. It really was quite calming walking the curving paths in the rain, and I felt peace and joy in doing it. After some time, I sensed I entered into a deep, meditative state, and knew it was time to go back into the house. I walked back up the gentle grassy slope and entered the kitchen. She was waiting at the entrance to the dining room, as if expecting me.

“I suppose I’ll have to accept you as a houseguest,” she whispered. Her beauty struck me—I don’t know why it didn’t at our first meeting—perhaps it was the shock of an unexpected first encounter. “You’re staring,” she said. “I’m sorry—you’re very beautiful.”

A tiny smile played across her lips, “Oh, I see. The first time you detained me because you admired my poetry—but now, it seems, you admire my beauty. I would think with a surname like Wesley you’d be a man of good intentions.” “I am well-intentioned,” I protested, “I just admire beauty. I guess that’s the reason why I put your discarded portrait back on the wall above the mantel—it’s lovely, but it doesn’t do you justice, in real life.”

Her eyes danced, mischievously, “And so you think this encounter of ours is ‘real life’, Mr. Wesley?” “I don’t know what to think,” I said frankly. “To tell you the truth, I’m confused. I hoped you might clear up the matter.” “Really? And you think I’ve been privileged with some sort of preternatural insight into The Mysterious Realm?” “Yes, I was hoping you might know more than me, because I have absolutely no idea what’s going on. I have no experience talking with ghosts.”

Her face darkened with anger. “You think I’m a ghost? —You… you interloper!” “Well, it seems a sensible conclusion seeing as you’re dead.” “What—what did you say?” “Look, I don’t mean to offend you, but it’s the year 2014 and you were thirty in 1935—so, do the Math.” She stood there, mouth partly open, a terrified look in her eyes. I stared back.

After what seemed an eternity, she began to shake and waver unsteadily on her feet. I ran instinctively to her and grabbed her arm to support her, and to my surprise, she was not ectoplasm, but flesh and blood—her skin as warm and solid as mine. “You’re real,” I gasped. “I’m not feeling very real,” she said, “help me sit down.” I helped her to a dining room chair and sat down beside her at the oak table. “Are you okay?” She placed a finger to my lips to silence me, looked deeply into my eyes and gently kissed me.

I had never been kissed like that before. The blood was rushing in my ears and I was breathless and tingling all over. “Are you satisfied?” she whispered. I stared at her but couldn’t speak. “I think you must know by now that I am not dead,” she smirked, “and I can tell by your reaction that you’re certainly alive as well.” Again, I found myself blushing like a schoolboy.

“This is awkward, Blythe.” “What is awkward—your ineptitude with women or our meeting across time?” I colored again. “I’d hardly describe myself as inept with women. I have been married you know.” “Ah, I see—you ‘have been married.’ Delightful. How long did it last?” “Two years. What’s that got to do with anything?” “And how long have you been single again, Mr. Wesley?” “Please, call me Theo. And it’s been six months—does that matter?” “Well you used the present perfect tense to describe an action that took place at an unspecified time. I just like to be accurate.”

“Are you married?” I had to ask—I couldn’t recall any details of a specific man in her life. Her face fell and she grew somber. “You don’t have to answer that,” I said, feeling miserable for asking. She lifted her chin and said haughtily, “No—fair is fair. I asked you and now I have to answer. I have never been married—nor ever been in love.” I was devastated. That certainly wasn’t the picture the media created. She was portrayed as the consummate femme fatale. And now that I penetrated the veil of her mystery and found her disarmingly vulnerable, I had to accept the undeniable truth—I had fallen in love with a ghost.

To be continued…

body.title: Florecen los Apamates - Mi temporada favorita
body.body:
Hola amigos de Hive! El día de hoy quiero mostrarles unas fotitos que tomamos junto con mi novio en una de las épocas del año es que es de mis favoritas: cuando están los Apamates florecidos, siento que la ciudad se vuelve como un mini Tokio, con sus flores de cerezo endógenas, pues para quien no lo sabe, los Apamates son árboles propias de Venezuela. 

Lo bonito de esto es que hay de estos árboles por toda la ciudad, entonces por las grandes avenidas principales hay una alfombra rosada de florecitas caídas y se ve todo muy lindo, como un animé. 

Así que aprovechando está época, fuimos a uno de los parques de la ciudad a tomar algunas fotitos para dejar para el recuerdo y honestamente, siento que quedaron muy bellas, sobretodo porque a mí me cuesta demasiado posar jajaja, pero juzguen por ustedes mismos ¡Saludos!

> Hello, Hive friends! Today I want to show you a few photos my boyfriend and I took during one of my favourite times of year: when the Apamate trees are in bloom. I feel like the city turns into a mini Tokyo, with its native cherry blossoms – because, for those who don’t know, Apamate trees are native to Venezuela. 
The lovely thing about this is that there are these trees all over the city, so along the main avenues there’s a pink carpet of fallen blossoms and it all looks so pretty, like something out of an anime. 
So, making the most of this time of year, we went to one of the city’s parks to take a few photos as a keepsake, and honestly, I think they turned out really lovely, especially as I find it so hard to pose, ha ha ha, but judge for yourselves! Cheers!

body.title: Learning to Embrace Uncertainty in Splinterlands' Second Escalation Conflict
body.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23u5zbHkYmnerd4oVAr7kCmfSCkRSCH5VGGNoB8jKJAp4XQLL687ieu7zrEYt5dTi7ZcB.png

Hello, fellow Splinterlands warriors.

It feels like only yesterday I was still trying to keep up with all the changes introduced in Conclave Arcana. Before I could fully digest one new feature, another one was already knocking at the door. Praetoria seems to be going through an exceptionally busy season. If this world truly existed, perhaps its blacksmiths would be working overtime, healers would be running out of potions, and Battle Mages would have forgotten the last time they enjoyed an afternoon nap.

This time, the news revolves around **The Second Escalation Conflict**, scheduled to begin on **June 22, 2026**. Much like the first conflict that introduced Meredrool, this second chapter arrives with a reward that immediately sent many players reaching for their calculators, estimating their chances, and taking another look at their card collections.

That reward is called **Ghezira**.

A legendary Feliform from the **Drybone Badlands**.

Honestly, the first time I saw Ghezira's design and abilities, my immediate thought was, *\

*

Ghezira looks like the kind of leader who doesn't waste time with lengthy introductions during meetings. She points at the objective, gives clear instructions, and expects everyone to move quickly.

And I like characters like that.

As a Splinterlands player, I found Ghezira's arrival quite surprising because she offers a strategic approach that feels very different from Meredrool. If Meredrool was all about brute force and high-risk aggression, Ghezira feels slippery, unpredictable, and just a little bit annoying when she's fighting on the opposing side.

But isn't that exactly what makes a great opponent?

## A New Archon, A New Way to Play

Ghezira is a Legendary Archon with a mana cost of only **3**.

That's remarkably cheap for a card capable of changing the course of a battle.

She brings **Bloodline Dominion: Feliform**, allowing Feliform units to be summoned from any available mana element.

<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23uQE3XMKh7dHtyiK8bFbDZFmu8CzmuyMPxBaYwmkogCFp6QobCef5i9XaJ4WwgXH8YUb.png</center>

To me, this is one of the most fascinating aspects of Conclave Arcana. Bloodlines are becoming increasingly important. We're no longer thinking solely in terms of elements. We're also beginning to consider the relationships between cards through their shared ancestry.

For veteran players, this is exciting because it opens the door to entirely new formations and strategies.

For newer players, it may feel confusing at first.

But perhaps that's exactly where the fun lies.

We're forced to learn again.

Forced to step outside our comfort zones.

## Flying or Weary?

The part that really made me raise an eyebrow was the tactical choice Ghezira brings to the table.

<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23w2HV7aShqBGtdqhWVV9oFgJLtVkuhHqdwJguE8d82M8Qm6726ABnUm9y2ZXMun9ELXS.png</center>

The first option is **Flying**, which can be granted to up to three units.

This ability increases their chances of dodging melee and ranged attacks, grants immunity to Earthquake damage, and offers no advantage if the attacker also possesses Flying.

<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/AJmsi23tiukRk3pPkxJbR822xFY9ohE3HJnN2GLrzgsKWSqnK2yXuyQEkU1xtL2.png</center>

The second option is **Weary**, which can be applied to two units.

And this is where I couldn't help but chuckle.

Weary feels like a perfect representation of many Splinterlands players near the end of a season.

Exhausted.

Starting from the first round, Weary units have a 10% chance to become **Exhausted**. That chance increases by 10% each round until it reaches a maximum of 80%.

An Exhausted unit skips its turn and cannot perform Retaliate.

Imagine carefully crafting the perfect strategy, only for your key monster to suddenly say,

*\

*

Funny?

Absolutely.

Frustrating?

Without a doubt.

But that's exactly what makes it interesting.

## The Challenges I Anticipate

If I'm being honest, the biggest challenge isn't figuring out how to obtain Ghezira.

It's learning how to use her effectively.

Flying seems like the safer choice.

Everyone loves a little extra evasion.

But Weary offers something entirely different. It can become a powerful tool for disrupting an opponent's carefully constructed plans.

I can already imagine creative players intentionally building formations designed to exploit the chaos caused by Exhausted units.

And as always, the Splinterlands community has an incredible talent for discovering combinations that no one else had even considered.

Usually, within two days of release, someone will unveil a strategy that leaves everyone else saying,

*\

*

## What I Learned

Ghezira reminded me of something important.

The best strategy isn't always about owning the strongest cards.

It's about understanding when to take risks.

Do we choose Flying, the relatively safe option?

Or do we embrace Weary, with all its uncertainty and potential to dismantle an opponent's plans?

Life, it turns out, sometimes resembles a match of Splinterlands.

Not every decision comes with certainty.

And not every risk is meant to be avoided.

## Closing Thoughts

For me personally, Ghezira makes the Second Escalation Conflict far more exciting to follow.

She isn't merely another Archon to display in a collection. She represents Splinterlands' willingness to continue experimenting with new game mechanics and challenging players to rethink how they approach battle.

Some players will fall in love with her immediately.

Others may choose to wait and observe how the meta evolves.

And that's perfectly fine.

What matters is that we continue enjoying the process of learning and adapting.

My advice is simple: don't rush to judge a card solely by the text printed on its abilities. Try to understand how it changes the way we think about combat itself.

Because sometimes, the greatest victories don't belong to the player with the strongest monsters.

They belong to the player who is most prepared to embrace the unexpected.

See you on the battlefields of Praetoria.

body.body:
![7364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/23vsNg7oh8WwxoZktanCeVuGku73ijyk4mRZd2M2mBeYosf6JffQKdhfg3xq7toBkKUjh.jpg)


Some nest are special, because a lot of kind of creatures live  in there, for example bees, ant, birds, termites and all kind of other animals that we can not see.



![7695.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/23vhyWEzzqxPqbAHcF1PK5aQFZfqWpvgFrHHkRJDQtpbKVnyZUGsqJ2SNuLYQk12Wc7Pf.jpg)

The nest have a lot of forms but the normal are in oval forms like you can see and their function of this is protecting their guests, who building it with soil and saliva or a lot of substances produces by their bodies.



![7554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/23vhwxcwUYdUDnTnaQjbMhgJYerLzfM9WpcvGGHDMBCK6MY7ms1DhxXLj4E2bqxuEQusQ.jpg)

The nature are rounder bu all kind of plants too here some ferns which have a great function and their body are parts of the diet of this animals.


![6129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/23tbiEa9eQ4oLPeFbirJdvJGKtAe9YUAgQLHwgqettLx57rvNWf2tpUPnWNGnHv3LqR3o.jpg)

![7556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EogKvfbPbCxHM9LPMzB5Aa9zrsvhV4CTXDJNu3NoEqwoAodvn4p32HvrywNmo86KXE8.jpg)

![10893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EoeCWV3wGE39TLzNyiSmJ7bL2QtNCxBnh4wpLHssEosMibLWie4dMbbq1wqSrTFU446.jpg)

![6962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EowEiDebbhXwvCDehZLGuGcsfzCwPg1bzwJLEx44MiG8wkT4DwFkHaDkbqFSSyBzsSy.jpg)

And finally some cows excretion which give to us a big quantity of fertilizer for a lot of plants and of course our magical mushrooms.

![7501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EogLnM87vcAMPwFcMZHcPPnjdTa6oHjGwdJf3WvXZX8xKxC8W8RhQnQkGamef3j2hCG.jpg)

body.title: A small update for the OffChain family. 🧡
body.body:
A small update for the OffChain family. 🧡

Today.. there won't be a Letz OffChain.

But don't worry, nothing happened!

Quite the opposite.

With summer arriving, terraces filling up, holidays approaching and everyone's schedules becoming a little more unpredictable, we've decided to move Letz OffChain to a bi-weekly format for the summer season.

That means more time to enjoy summer, more time to recharge and still plenty of opportunities to meet, discuss, network and share ideas together.

Our next Letz OffChain will therefore take place on Tuesday, 23 June, at Kirchberg Qosqo!

Not an Innopay partner at the moment, but you never know.. 

Thank you all for making these gatherings so special over the past two years. 🧡

Enjoy the beginning of summer and we'll see you again very soon.

Next stop: Tuesday, 23 June, Kirchberg Qosqo

Stay tuned🧡 
![Screenshot 2026-06-16 at 14.57.12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ocln-content/23tSUftucY49RNmgJqTuuzALdNDvjWeyXsUgmdGgTmWEQrruxfPtCY5goSjaxNBAg7FAr.png)

Hola, comunidad, me presento: mi nombre es Edwing Jesús Muñoz Méndez, tengo 48 años. Soy electricista y mecánico automotriz. Me gusta mucho leer y aprender sobre diversos temas. Creo en un Dios Padre Creador, pero después de haber pasado por diversas religiones, debo confesar que me siento mejor lejos de ellas que cerca 😁 >Hello everyone, let me introduce myself: my name is Edwing Jesús Muñoz Méndez, I'm 48 years old. I'm an electrician and automotive mechanic. >I really enjoy reading and learning about different topics. I believe in God the Father, but after having experienced various religions, I must confess that I feel better far away from them than close to them 😁
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwinghive/23xySzYz3uzFRoy7aqkvcjQWjGnYFnn8y6BQW2CBMDbtaXM5tLX3mVnkeRAiJgxR7nvzk.jpg

Vivo en Las Mercedes, Villa de Cura, estado Aragua, Venezuela, con mi familia más cercana que son mis cachorritos Charlie y Canelo. Tienen alrededor de dos meses y medio de nacidos, son hermanitos entre sí. Charlie es tranquilo mientras que Canelo es muy tremendo. >I live in Las Mercedes, Villa de Cura, Aragua State, Venezuela, with my closest family: my puppies Charlie and Canelo. They're about two and a half months old and are brothers. Charlie is calm, while Canelo is very mischievous.
. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwinghive/1000946406.jpg

Cuando llego del trabajo se vuelven locos de alegría, me saltan encima, mueven la cola, corretean de un sitio para otro. Cuando voy en camino a casa m e gusta mucho el saber , que tengo alguien que espera por mi presencia.  Esto me hace sentir muy feliz . >When I get home from work, they go crazy with joy, jumping all over me, wagging their tails, and running around everywhere. >When I'm on my way home, I really like knowing that I have someone waiting for me. It makes me very happy. Esto es bueno porque  alegran mis días.  Cuando  salgo a trabajar tengo un propósito que son mis cachorros,  me llenan de alegría cada día. Son traviesos pero tomo en cuenta también que es porque están pequeños 🙏👌👍 pero como dije antes, ellos alegran mis días.  Lo que más me alegra es que tengo un motivo en mi vida y doy gracias a Dios por permitir que estén conmigo, que formen parte de mi vida.  Los amo como si fuesen mis hijos  y  me hacen sentir feliz. Espero que duren mucho tiempo a mi lado. >This is wonderful because they brighten my days. When I go to work, I have a purpose: my puppies. They fill me with joy every day. They're mischievous, but I also understand that it's because they're little 🙏👌👍. But as I said before, they brighten my days. What makes me happiest is that I have a reason for being in my life, and I thank God for allowing them to be with me, to be a part of my life. I love them as if they were my own children, and they make me feel happy. I hope they stay by my side for a long time. Me gustaría tener suficientes recursos económicos para  tenerlos mejor, con una buena alimentación, control veterinario y todas esas cosas, pero actualmente la situación económica en Venezuela es bastante difícil y complicada. >I would like to have enough financial resources to take better care of them, with good food, veterinary care and all those things, but currently the economic situation in Venezuela is quite difficult and complicated. Acerca de esta red social me habló la profe María Teresa Fuenmayor, conocida acá como @sayury. Me dijo que era un sitio web bastante serio, ordenado, dónde tendría la oportunidad de compartir mis saberes y adquirir otros nuevos interactuando con personas de todo el mundo. Unos con mis mismas aficiones y otros con aficiones diversas. También me  dijo que esta red es como un \

que uno nunca termina de conocer totalmente. body.title: # ¡Explorando Splinterlands por primera vez! | Mi primera racha de batallas 🐉🎮 ## Exploring Splinterlands for the First Time! | My First Battle Streak 🐉🎮
body.body:
---

| [ESP] | [ENG] |
|---|---|

---

### 🇪🇸 ESPAÑOL

¡Hola, comunidad de Hive Gaming!

Aprovechando que acabo de encender los motores otra vez en la plataforma, decidí que no me iba a quedar solo escribiendo reflexiones. Si algo me gusta es pasar de la teoría a la práctica y documentar mis procesos, así que hoy me metí de lleno a explorar el ecosistema de juegos en la dApp de Hive Keychain. El que más me llamó la atención por su nivel competitivo y estrategia fue **Splinterlands**, y decidí probarlo para ver qué tal se me daba.

Al principio, cuando entras al panel principal, te abrumas un poco con tanta información. Ves barras de energía, misiones diarias y diferentes formatos como Modern, Wild o Frontier. Como me gusta explorar las cosas a fondo por mi cuenta, decidí dejar seleccionado el formato *Frontier* (que era el que venía marcado por defecto en la interfaz) y le di sin miedo al botón gigante de **BATTLE**.


![477853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erickmaurice/Eoc65jRyaJepsNJSw7DXZ2nKYQFiwHoYf5JcazcpACTeV7PGvTYm459p2DNGXXvMoyF.jpg)


### ⚡ La adrenalina de armar el equipo con el tiempo encima

La primera sorpresa fue que el juego no es solo dar clics. Te emparejan con un rival, te dan un presupuesto de \

(en mi caso fueron 50 puntos, una locura para meter cartas pesadas) y arranca un contador de 3 minutos para armar tu estrategia.

Tuve que aprender rápido la regla de oro: colocar un buen tanque que resista los golpes en la primera casilla (línea de fuego) y acomodar a los magos y atacantes a distancia atrás para que disparen seguros. Es un ejercicio de pura lógica y optimización de recursos, muy parecido a armar un rompecabezas bajo presión.

### 🪙 Cumpliendo la primera meta: ¡300 Glints y a la tienda!

Me propuse completar la misión diaria de jugar 10 batallas. Ganes o pierdas, cada partida te va enseñando cómo se mueven los elementos (Fuego, Agua, Tierra...). Al terminar la racha, el sistema me soltó un aviso brutal: *\

*.\n\nCon mis primeros 300 puntos en los bolsillos, me fui directo a la sección de recompensas (**Glint Shop**). Había cofres y varias opciones, pero preferí irme por lo seguro para empezar a construir mi propio mazo desde cero. Gasté mis 300 puntos exactos en dos tiradas de *\

* (150 Glint cada una) que te garantizan cartas propias.


![477835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erickmaurice/23tS2pLD2K66FgQF7KdeC8ukJbYMWBmqRTAdGfB8Z95XFPnkZkwzwZ1Rnc2dAVoMGSjja.jpg)


### 🔮 ¿La suerte de principiante? | Mis primeras cartas de recompensa

No les voy a mentir, abrir los primeros paquetes siempre da esa intriga de ver qué te depara el sistema. Las cartas que me salieron me ayudaron a empezar a entender cómo funcionan las diferentes facciones del juego, y una de las que capturé en el momento fue:

* 🌿 **Stonebind Matron:** Una carta del elemento Tierra que funciona como un soporte muy interesante para el equipo, ideal para ir probando combinaciones con tanques de su misma división.

![477836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erickmaurice/23tRtDR9j1QfqzFM8GSABmvsAbhfLb1RKDFkAkWNd5rkTwAfDRecKXNh9syBairxhwSNE.jpg)

---

### 🇺🇸 ENGLISH

Hey there, Hive Gaming community!

Taking advantage of the fact that I just fired up my engines on the platform again, I decided I wasn't just going to sit around writing reflections. If there's one thing I love, it's moving from theory to practice and documenting my journeys. So today, I dove headfirst into exploring the gaming ecosystem within the Hive Keychain dApp. The one that caught my attention the most due to its competitive edge and strategy was **Splinterlands**, and I decided to give it a shot to see how I'd do.

At first, when you enter the main dashboard, you get a bit overwhelmed with so much information. You see energy bars, daily quests, and different formats like Modern, Wild, or Frontier. Since I like to explore things thoroughly on my own, I decided to leave the *Frontier* format selected (which was the default option on the interface) and fearlessly hit that giant **BATTLE** button.

![477853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erickmaurice/Eoc65jRyaJepsNJSw7DXZ2nKYQFiwHoYf5JcazcpACTeV7PGvTYm459p2DNGXXvMoyF.jpg)

### ⚡ The Adrenaline of Building a Team Against the Clock

The first surprise was discovering that this game isn't just about mindless clicking. You get matched with an opponent, given a \

budget (in my case, it was 50 points—insane enough to drop some heavy-hitting cards), and a 3-minute countdown starts to set up your strategy.

I had to quickly learn the golden rule: place a reliable tank to soak up damage in the first slot (the frontline) and position your mages and ranged attackers in the back so they can shoot safely. It's a pure exercise in logic and resource optimization, very much like putting together a puzzle under pressure.

### 🪙 Hitting the First Goal: 300 Glints and Off to the Shop!

I set a goal for myself to complete the daily quest of playing 10 battles. Win or lose, every single match teaches you how the elements move (Fire, Water, Earth...). Once I finished the streak, the system popped up an awesome alert: *\

*.\n\nWith my first 300 points in my pocket, I went straight to the rewards section (**Glint Shop**). There were chests and multiple options available, but I preferred to play it safe to start building my own deck from scratch. I spent my exact 300 points on two draws of *\

* (150 Glint each), which guarantee you own the cards.

![477835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erickmaurice/23tS2pLD2K66FgQF7KdeC8ukJbYMWBmqRTAdGfB8Z95XFPnkZkwzwZ1Rnc2dAVoMGSjja.jpg)

### 🔮 Beginner's Luck? | My First Reward Cards

I'm not going to lie, opening your very first packs always brings that awesome suspense of seeing what the system drops for you. The cards I pulled really helped me start understanding how the different factions in the game work. One of the ones I managed to capture on screen was:

* 🌿 **Stonebind Matron:** An Earth element card that acts as a pretty interesting support unit for the team, perfect for testing out synergies with tanks of the same element.

![477836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erickmaurice/23tRtDR9j1QfqzFM8GSABmvsAbhfLb1RKDFkAkWNd5rkTwAfDRecKXNh9syBairxhwSNE.jpg)

---

### 🚀 Mis metas a futuro / Future Goals

**🇪🇸 Español:**
Este primer día me demostró que el juego tiene muchísima profundidad. Mi meta a partir de ahora es seguir jugando mis misiones diarias para acumular más Glint, probar el formato **Modern**

¿Hay algún jugador veterano de Splinterlands por aquí que me deje un buen consejo para combinar habilidades? ¡Los leo en los comentarios!

**🇺🇸 English:**
This first day proved to me that this game has an incredible amount of depth. Moving forward, my goals are to keep grinding my daily quests to accumulate more Glint, try out the Modern format, and use the very earnings generated by this blog to fund the Spellbook, unlocking real play-to-earn rewards on the blockchain without having to spend a single cent out of my own pocket.\

body.title: How do we overcome our doubts and anxities
body.body: The bible teaches us to always take away fear of the unknown, by coming to him with our problems. God is the only person who is capable of solving our problems. When doubt arises, it is often a sign that our focus has shifted from God’s promises to our own limitations or circumstances. Strengthening faith through consistent reflection on God’s word helps to replace fear with assurance, reminding us that God remains faithful even when situations seem uncertain.\nhttps://youtu.be/sDcWPF8W4QQ?si=DIdkHXwLncV_PvFG\nOvercoming anxiety biblically also involves prayer and surrender. Instead of carrying worries alone, believers are encouraged to bring their concerns to God and trust Him with the outcome. Peace comes when we intentionally release control and rest in God’s guidance, allowing His presence to calm our hearts and redirect our thoughts toward hope and confidence in His care.

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   The Broken Mirror.   ||   El Espejo Roto.
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> I unlock the screen and the blue glare hits my face before my brain is ready to process it. Another notification. Another headline that the world would quickly label *unnatural cruelty*. It's a phrase that sounds elegant, almost technical, but it contains a contradiction that burns inside me.
# ***
The Broken Mirror
*** Historically, we've told ourselves the story that cruelty is an accident, a deviation from the norm. But if we look at the chronicles of humanity—from ancient funeral pyres to 20th-century concentration camps—blood has always been the primary ink. The only real difference between the man wielding a club in the Neolithic era and the one today pressing a button thousands of miles away—is the speed of Wi-Fi. Now we learn in real time about our own capacity for destruction. Horror no longer waits for history books; it's served hot, at breakfast, through a scroll.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23tGa9B6LoKkMZpiXLAM2QtXngUHZtTohaCndUNKnXDcKJPDyeWZiBEtB88MjbbHU6e6N.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
When we read about these acts, we usually say they are \
We search for words that distance us from the perpetrator. The term *unnatural* functions as a psychological boundary: \

we tell ourselves to be able to sleep. It's a defense mechanism. Because accepting that such cruelty is, in fact, a possibility within the catalog of what it means to be human is accepting that the mirror is broken for everyone.\n\nHowever, there is a breaking point where language falls short and only the judgment of the soul remains. There are acts that not only violate the law but also fracture something invisible that unites us. Faced with certain events that I see parading through the news, that label of \
takes on a new meaning, one that has nothing to do with biology, but with belonging. It is then that I think, with a certainty that chills me to the bone: **\

**

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23u5TEBD8FksYFzZhraXRFfnhJEjb64VecU6HXnLVdVh8xaYVXWpaeL3Ft9GNdtyxR9U7.png)
</center>

I don't say this as a metaphor; I say it as an expulsion. It's as if, by crossing that line of perversion, the individual ceases to inhabit our same moral species. We call it \

not because it doesn't occur in nature—since we are the ones who commit it—but because we refuse to let that be the end of our story.\n\nPerhaps cruelty has always been our shadow, but our insistence on calling it \
is, perhaps, the only genuinely human thing we have left: the visceral rejection of becoming the monster we see on screen, while others revel in it. *** ***

> Come and participate, there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:
# **
[PROMPT: «unnatural cruelty»](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/16-june-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3136-unnatural-cruelty)
**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJmudPPCWGA6FfcXPrAmdLk2CY4mxGWYvbsFs8KPohCx9wnhBrpjcwmEyvYmxqn.jpg Cover of the initiative.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23swkfAXGs5WxHg49jyEWGAanWReDpMUQbxUB4FYX98iMaztGejMtj5HJUN6abwpCZhUN.png)

*** *** ### **
Dedicated to all those writers who contribute, day by day, to making our planet a better world.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***

>


# ***
***

> Desbloqueo la pantalla y el brillo azul me golpea el rostro antes de que mi cerebro esté listo para procesarlo. Otra notificación. Otro titular que en el mundo etiquetarían rápidamente como *unnatural cruelty*. Es una frase que suena elegante, casi técnica, pero que encierra una contradicción que me quema por dentro.
# ***
El Espejo Roto
*** Históricamente, nos hemos contado el cuento de que la crueldad es un accidente, una desviación de la norma. Pero si miramos las crónicas de la humanidad —desde las piras antiguas hasta los campos de concentración del siglo XX—, la sangre siempre ha sido la tinta principal. La única diferencia real entre el hombre que empuñaba una maza en el neolítico y el que hoy oprime un botón a miles de kilómetros —es la velocidad del Wi-Fi—. Ahora nos enteramos en tiempo real de nuestra propia capacidad de destrucción. El horror ya no espera a los libros de historia; se sirve caliente, en el desayuno, a través de un *scroll*.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23tGa9B6LoKkMZpiXLAM2QtXngUHZtTohaCndUNKnXDcKJPDyeWZiBEtB88MjbbHU6e6N.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
Al leer sobre estos actos, solemos decir que son \
. Buscamos palabras que nos alejen del perpetrador. El término *unnatural* funciona como una frontera psicológica: \

, nos decimos para poder dormir. Es un mecanismo de defensa. Porque aceptar que esa crueldad es, de hecho, una posibilidad dentro del catálogo de lo humano es aceptar que el espejo está roto para todos.\n\nSin embargo, hay un punto de quiebre donde el lenguaje se queda corto y solo queda el juicio del alma. Hay actos que no solo violan la ley, sino que fracturan algo invisible que nos une. Ante ciertos hechos que veo desfilar por las noticias, esa etiqueta de \

cobra un sentido nuevo, uno que no tiene que ver con la biología, sino con la pertenencia. Es ahí cuando pienso, con una certeza que me hiela la sangre: **«esto es tan horrible que quien lo cometió ha perdido su condición de ser humano»**.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23tv8iJpXg3323bt881PwRMBgSmr93Jh2BDiCiq5jYE2B1W7Bxhv4kZpe96mhr8dABoJ6.png)
<sup>[](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

No lo digo como una metáfora; lo digo como una expulsión. Es como si, al cruzar esa línea de perversión, el individuo dejara de habitar nuestra misma especie moral. Lo llamamos \

no porque no ocurra en la naturaleza —pues somos nosotros quienes lo cometemos—, sino porque nos negamos a que ese sea el final de nuestra historia.\n\nQuizás la crueldad ha sido siempre nuestra sombra, pero nuestra insistencia en llamarla \

es, tal vez, lo único genuinamente humano que nos queda: el rechazo visceral a convertirnos en el monstruo que vemos en la pantalla, mientras otros, se deleitan en ello.
*** ***

body.title: Free Blurt Steemit and Ecency Art Giveaway
body.body: If you're at Camden Market in London on a weekend day, you can stop by my [Camden Market Free Art Man](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/) display between 12pm and 3pm (unless the weather's bad or I'm sick) and get some of my artwork for free, including multiple series based on Blurt, Steemit and Ecency. Original paintings and drawings, not prints. All part of [FREE ART FREES ART](https://freeartfreesart.com/) where we cut out the middleman gallery, and give our work directly to the public in exchange for a short video interview. Last weekend was the most popular so far for [my crypto-social artworks. 12inch vinyl LP's](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/05/10/crypto-social-lps/) painted in acrylic on the theme of the three main platforms I'm currently using: Blurt, Steemit and Ecency.\n\n
alt=\

/>The Ecency LP has, so far, been the most popular with its blue and white heart design. I don't think any of the Blurt have gone yet, but I'm sure they'll start catching up in the not too distant future. I have loads up in my attic, all numbered in unlimited editions (I don't make limited editions) waiting for new homes and walls to be hung on. Here's a couple of YouTube shorts showing members of the public browsing and choosing which of the three designs to take: [https://youtube.com/shorts/UO7Fw\_bPnHA?feature=share](https://youtube.com/shorts/UO7Fw_bPnHA?feature=share) [https://youtube.com/shorts/g2TzykAr\_Ww?feature=share](https://youtube.com/shorts/g2TzykAr_Ww?feature=share) I've also made other crypto-social artworks. The first series was started in rural Thailand of Blurt posters. Our dustbin lid just happened to be the perfect size for the paper we'd taken there. I'll be making some for Steemit and Ecency soon:
alt=\

/> Above is in the apartment my girlfriend and I are still renting in Isaan, standing on a bed we forgot we had when we went to the store to buy its furniture, so ended up with two double beds for the two of us. It will be good though for when visitors come round for sunny countryside art retreats. After this photo was taken, I painted the eyebrows black. An initial oversight. There's eight in this edition so far, but there will be many more, glued to cardboard and taken out to Camden soon. All Camden work is on a support to try and ensure as many are hung on the wall as possible. A key concept of [Advertism](https://advertism.org/) is to minimise the possibility of our work being hidden in draws and other forms of storage instead of being out in the open promoting our work. Then there's the [crypto-social BlondCards](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/04/29/blurt-and-steemit-at-camden/) that also promote a couple of friends I have in crypto-social world @ronthroop and @offgridlife Below are two. I thought I had some Blond Cards for Ecency but can't find a photo of one. If I haven't, they'll be coming soon:
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/>Each day at Camden sees about 40 artworks given away to the public. I'm planning on having a day dedicated to crypto-social series but don't have enough yet. I did a couple of days dedicated to [artwork themed on Nirvana](https://edgeworth.blog/canvas/nirvana/) which went quite well. Hopefully, through FREE ART FREES ART awareness and use of crypto-social platforms will increase, but it's early days yet as far as Camden Market's concerned.

body.body:
<center>
![Hiatus or the End.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/newageinv/Eo4A3LBERkEb2MU136xwTn67EFw7czoYUaGnqm5ivCUPYrRaqHh9JpSrhNfwff9Gj6G.png)
</center>

I recently took a break from everything HIVE and Splinterlands related. It also marked the end of my daily manual play within the Frontier game mode. I had recently completed the Foundation card set (until the recent new cards issued) so really had little incentive to play except for the enjoyment. However, the card set is not deep enough to keep me engaged with the meta.

I had hoped that when I got back, I would try Modern mode to play manually again but after a handful of matches, I could not keep up with the new abilities and rulesets which got me a bit overwhelmed.  I could no longer really enjoy it so I find myself at a crossroad of continuing to learn the meta and play or just focus on land. I am still playing Brawls which is what keeps me somewhat engaged on the gameplay but not to much success either.  I will have to reflect on how to approach it all going forward.

Bizim ölkədə onlayn əyləncə dünyası sürətlə dəyişir və [https://pinupazerbaijan.it.com/](https://pinupazerbaijan.it.com/) kimi platformalar bu dəyişikliyin önündə gedir. Crash oyunları bir neçə il əvvəl sadəcə maraqlı bir eksperiment kimi görünürdü, amma indi artıq hər kəsin dilindədir – adrenalin, ani qərarlar və böyük uduşlar üçün ideal seçim. Pin-Up Azərbaycan bu trendi ölkəyə gətirəndə çoxları tərəddüd etsə də, indi hamı bu oyunların niyə bu qədər bağlayıcı olduğunu anlayır.

## İlk Addımlar: Sadə İdeya Necə Partladı?

Crash oyunlarının tarixi əslində çox sadədir. Bir təyyarə qalxır, çarpan artır və sən vaxtında çıxmalısan. Çıxmasan – hər şey yanır. Pin-Up Azərbaycanda bu mexanika ilk dəfə peyda olanda çoxları “bu nədir ki?” deyə baxıb keçdi. Amma bir neçə həftə sonra sosial şəbəkələrdə videolar dolaşmağa başladı: biri 100x vurur, digəri son anda çıxıb böyük qazanc əldə edir. İnsanlar maraqlanmağa başladı.

Platforma bu oyunları ən yüksək səviyyədə təqdim etdi – sürətli yüklənmə, rahat interfeys və ədalətli nəticələr. Azərbaycan oyunçuları isə riski sevən xalqdır. Beləcə, təcrübə mərhələsi çox tez bitdi.

## Niyə Məhz Crash? Azərbaycan Oyunçularının Sevgisinin Sirri


![Screenshot_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miguelra/23vhunppRDtid3b5LSrhiJsw9Fiu9RfXxnpaBoeWwAXQ7H9C9cNrt8SPzpSCPTLTVKw24.jpg)


Slotlar və ya klassik rulet çox vaxt gözləmə tələb edir. Crash isə fərqlidir – hər tur saniyələr ərzində bitir. Bu dinamika bizim tempimizə tam uyğundur. Bir ara verib oynayırsan, işdən sonra dostlarla müzakirə edirsən, hətta ailə yeməyindən sonra da bir tur atmaq istəyirsən.

-   Çarpanların ani artımı – həyəcanı zirvəyə çıxarır
-   Avtomatik çıxış funksiyası – emosiyalara qapılmadan strategiya qurmaq imkanı
-   Kiçik stavkalardan böyük uduşlara keçid – hər kəsə uyğundur
-   Sosial element – dostlarla birlikdə izləmək və yarışmaq
-   Pin-Up Azərbaycandakı kimi şəffaf RNG sistemi – inam yaradır

### Real Hekayələr: Oyunçular Necə Dəyişdi?

Bir çox tanışım danışır ki, əvvəllər sadəcə vaxt keçirmək üçün girirdilər. İndi isə öz strategiyalarını inkişaf etdiriblər: bəziləri 2x-3x-də çıxır, digərləri isə yüksək risklə 50x-ə qədər gözləyir. Pin-Up Azərbaycanın turnirləri və bonusları da bu populyarlığı daha da artırdı. Hər həftə yeni kampaniyalar, cashback-lər və liderlər cədvəli – hər şey düşünülüb.

## İndi Nə Baş Verir? Gələcək Trendlər

Bu gün crash oyunları artıq Pin-Up Azərbaycanın ən çox oynanılan bölmələrindən biridir. Yeni versiyalar, temalı oyunlar və hətta mobil optimizasiya ilə oyunçular hər yerdən – evdən, yolda, istirahətdə əla vaxt keçirirlər. Təcrübədən trende keçid o qədər sürətli oldu ki, bir çoxları hələ də “bu necə baş verdi?” deyə təəccüblənir.

Əgər sən də bu həyəcanı hiss etmək istəyirsənsə, vaxt itirmə. Bu oyunlar sadəcə əyləncə deyil, həm də bacarıq və soyuqqanlılıq sınağıdır.

body.title: RECREATION AREA // Finding a peaceful open space on the shore of a tawar sea
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXet8NNBs4jSTLtTMGU318xuWXKMty4j1xVaVXz8rtyTW/1781611024606.jpg) While my partner and I were traveling around tawar sea, we unexpectedly came across an open area that was already crowded with many people. It is important to note that this area was affected by a landslide disaster, and many places had been damaged or lost, including several tourist destinations that previously existed. There was a parking area located along the roadside, and its condition was severely damaged. The scene was quite heartbreaking, with a large amount of building debris and fallen trees mixed with the soil. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjzaEBFhNjfBVJTZm9AMGWMfuJ3zsQXcWTJyhHTHMLKN/1781611024684.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb9M2P4VKhD8MVQYhoSzhUiz9934MzaDWUDVEdoTXnB15/1781611024805.jpg) I no longer remember what this place looked like before the landslide occurred, but I do know that this area once had several tourist attractions, including cafés and food stalls. Now, the area has become an empty space covered with bushes and wild grass, and we can also find wooden debris almost everywhere. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYSMoFRjGyczEqrN5vvhdQmwDhpGuBAZ7VV39mCXMrKyJ/1781611024910.jpg) However, the beauty of this place has not completely disappeared,from here we can still enjoy beautiful views of tawar sea and the towering mountains that surround it. At that time, I saw many visitors coming with their families, and some even brought mats and various cooking utensils. Most of them seemed to treat this place as a perfect recreational destination, where they could cook, swim, relax, and enjoy many other activities. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUm1c3RZVJDFfh3AsapobhPXgPL1epJV53fyEN9vP5CAB/1781611024998.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPP8txdPjqbxGxvP3jkT6vR8uPuRGXojN7Jdq2HVLS8sH/1781612513932.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcX7crPC8hdpD2gMpVrnborPacYBLeykr5j31Wf9tCeo9/1781612514021.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcKhxwUovGjo5DxNjGcNrkBcJtpqVbbsLgwNXmvSLe3em/1781612514106.jpg) From some of the images above, we can see that the landslide originated from the mountains behind this area,i cannot imagine how devastating this disaster was. I could not even see the remains of the cafés and food stalls that once stood around this place, as everything had been buried beneath rocky mud. However, the mud has already dried, creating a thick layer of dust,but when it rains, though, the ground becomes wet again and turns into very slippery mud. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ7ywnt1Hy186E9bMrxh89h2XttCc13NumZoKF9hF5mUY/1781612801694.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8HbzwzN57Btya9aJYTAtCoi1fCfYagR67wY5rETBzYz/1781612801796.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbnAkrTXW6s2LGafAQtC99T2uRQxvbqAjGrB2P3TSAPnb/1781612801891.jpg) There are so many visitors who come with their families, on the mats they sit and relax as if this place is destined to make them happy. My partner and I can only sit on a large rock and see everything that happens in this place, the noisy voices of the visitors can be heard from almost anywhere, and that indicates that this place has succeeded in bringing happiness to many people. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNmLD3RaTyQvkgUUTzhkuRYqQNAqMdCPoEeQquxnvomNa/1781613177643.jpg) From what I observed, most of the visitors who came to this place were local residents. There were also several young people who seemed busy taking photos and capturing their memorable moments in the most interesting way possible. If we don't come to this place directly, maybe we can only see its beauty on social media, but if we come to this place ourselves, we will realize that this place is really damaged and needs our help to repair and renovate it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRMCRYn3Y6yYULKuoZwrNay1RzKD9q3kaGqiSQrQY4QD/1781613177730.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzCbJBEYiaon3XGprfq8fCdCUo1g7KbSn1iRj8cc86Gz/1781613177823.jpg) The natural scenery that I could see was very beautiful, but there was another view that made me feel very amazed and scared at the same time, there were several small children swimming on the edge of the tawar sea, we could see that the condition of the sea was very blue which indicated that the condition of the water was very deep, they were swimming happily and the sound of their laughter could be heard clearly to where we were sitting. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

> Hola a todos, mi querida comunidad de @motherhood, espero que estén teniendo un día hermoso. Hoy me paso por aquí con el corazón lleno de emoción para compartirles una de esas alegrías que se quedan grabadas para siempre en el alma. Hace ya dos semanas vivimos un momento increíblemente especial en casa. Mi hijo Santiago tuvo una competencia de atletismo. Santiago ya pasó a la categoría infantil, lo que implica nuevos retos y mayores exigencias. Antes corría la distancia de 80 metros, pero esta vez le tocaba enfrentarse por primera vez a la pista de los 100 metros planos. Imagínense mis nervios y mi emoción como mamá. Esta fue su primera competencia oficial en esta distancia y el resultado fue excelente. No se imaginan lo orgullosa que me siento. Con todo el esfuerzo del mundo, Santiago quedó en el primer lugar de su hit y logró alcanzar la cuarta posición en la clasificación total general. Verlo correr con tanta determinación y darlo todo en la pista fue una experiencia maravillosa. Como siempre, su familia estuvo ahí, al pie del cañón. Estuvimos apoyándole en cada segundo, motivándolo desde las gradas y gritando con todas nuestras fuerzas. Siempre hemos creído firmemente que en el apoyo familiar está la verdadera fuerza. Ver que él sabe que estamos ahí para sostenerlo le da el impulso que necesita para superarse. Este logro nos demuestra que la constancia y la disciplina siempre traen buenos resultados. No hay un camino corto para el éxito y ver que él cosecha los frutos de su entrenamiento es la mejor recompensa. Ese día de la competencia fue muy particular para su club actual. Por diversas razones, solo participaron dos atletas en la pista. Sin embargo, el resto de los compañeros del club no se quedaron en casa; asistieron para ser la barra de apoyo. Ver ese espíritu de compañerismo, donde los que no compiten van a alentar a sus amigos, fue algo hermoso y digno de admirar. Gracias a Dios, a ambos atletas les fue súper bien y el esfuerzo colectivo valió la pena. Además, el evento nos regaló un momento muy emotivo. Tuvimos la oportunidad de encontrarnos y saludar a varios compañeros del club de atletismo donde Santiago entrenaba antes. Aunque ya cambiamos de equipo, en ese lugar quedan muy buenos amigos y personas sumamente especiales a las que les guardamos un cariño enorme. Fue genial verlos, recordar viejos tiempos y compartir la pasión por este deporte que une a tantas familias. Para finalizar, quiero agradecerles a ustedes queridos amigos, por estar siempre presentes, por leer mis publicaciones y por apoyarme con tanto cariño en cada una de las historias de mi vida como mamá. Les mando un abrazo gigante y que tengan una semana espectacular. Saludos y Bendiciones. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
**ENGLISH**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
Hello everyone, my dear @motherhood community, I hope you’re having a wonderful day. Today I’m stopping by with a heart full of emotion to share one of those joys that stay etched in your soul forever. Two weeks ago, we experienced an incredibly special moment at home. My son Santiago had a track and field competition. Santiago has now moved up to the junior category, which brings new challenges and higher expectations. He used to run the 80-meter dash, but this time he had to tackle the 100-meter dash for the first time. Imagine my nerves and excitement as a mom. This was his first official competition at this distance, and the result was excellent. You can’t imagine how proud I am. Giving it his all, Santiago took first place in his heat and managed to finish fourth in the overall standings. Watching him run with such determination and give it his all on the track was a wonderful experience. As always, his family was there, right by his side. We were cheering him on every second, motivating him from the stands and shouting with all our might. We’ve always firmly believed that true strength lies in family support. Seeing that he knows we’re there to support him gives him the boost he needs to push himself. This achievement shows us that perseverance and discipline always yield good results. There’s no shortcut to success, and seeing him reap the rewards of his training is the best reward. That competition day was very special for his current club. For various reasons, only two athletes competed on the track. However, the rest of the club members didn’t stay home; they came to cheer them on. Seeing that spirit of camaraderie, where those who aren’t competing go to cheer on their friends, was beautiful and admirable. Thank God, both athletes did really well, and the collective effort paid off. In addition, the event gave us a very emotional moment. We had the opportunity to meet and greet several teammates from the track and field club where Santiago used to train. Although we’ve since switched teams, we still have very good friends and extremely special people there whom we hold very dear. It was great to see them, reminisce about old times, and share the passion for this sport that brings so many families together. Finally, I want to thank you, my dear friends, for always being there, for reading my posts, and for supporting me so warmly through every chapter of my life as a mom. I send you a big hug, and I hope you have a wonderful week. Best wishes and blessings.

body.title: Learn Ethical Hacking (#59) - Python for Pentesters - Automating Everything
body.body:
# Learn Ethical Hacking (#59) - Python for Pentesters - Automating Everything

![leh-banner.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2LpoeHUPesc4Dy8haRKLJgfuDY6UBKdc3sED8Dz3JH9/leh-banner.jpg)

### What will I learn

- **Why Python is the pentester's language** -- speed of development, library ecosystem, and cross-platform support make it the default choice for security tooling;
- **Network scripting** -- building port scanners, banner grabbers, and service enumerators with sockets and threading;
- **Web exploitation automation** -- scripting SQL injection detection, parameter fuzzing, and response analysis with requests;
- **Packet crafting** -- using Scapy for ARP scanning, network discovery, and protocol-level attacks;
- **Password attack tools** -- building HTTP form sprayers with rate limiting and error handling;
- **Reverse shells** -- understanding how basic C2 communication works in Python (lab use only);
- **Log analysis and forensics** -- parsing auth logs, correlating events, and detecting brute force patterns;
- **Nmap integration** -- automating scan workflows and parsing XML output for programmatic analysis;
- Defense: understanding attacker tooling to build better detections.

### Requirements

- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- Python 3.11+ installed;
- Understanding of the Learn Python Series (episodes 1-57 recommended);
- Familiarity with web attacks (episodes 11-28) and network attacks (episodes 29-30);
- The ambition to learn ethical hacking and security research.

### Difficulty

- Intermediate
