Episode 58 covered the AI security landscape -- attacking and defending AI systems. We walked through the AI-specific attack surface (prompt injection, training data poisoning, adversarial examples, model extraction, and model inversion), the architectural root cause of prompt injection (mixing data and instructions in the same channel -- identical to SQL injection from episode 12 except there is no parameterized query equivalent), indirect prompt injection (the variant where malicious instructions hide in emails, web pages, PDFs, and database records -- stored injection like episode 14's stored XSS but with potentially wider blast radius), adversarial examples that fool image classifiers with imperceptible perturbations (the WAF bypass of episode 25 applied to ML), training data poisoning and the model supply chain (Hugging Face's 500,000+ unaudited models -- episode 45 all over again), LLM agent vulnerabilities (when prompt injection meets tool use the result is functionally equivalent to RCE), the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (7 of 10 map directly to the traditional OWASP Top 10), AI in offensive security (lowering the barrier for existing attack techniques -- acceleration, not revolution), and defense strategies built on layered controls because no single defense against prompt injection is sufficient.

Today we start building.

Welcome to **Arc 5: Offensive Tooling and Automation**. For 58 episodes, we used tools other people built -- Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Wireshark, binwalk. We pointed them at targets, interpreted the output, and understood the underlying vulnerabilties. That was necessary. You cannot build tools until you understand what the tools need to do. But the line between a security hobbyist and a security professional is this: **professionals build their own tools**.

Not because existing tools are bad. Nmap is excellent. Burp Suite is excellent. But every engagement, every target, every network has something unique -- a custom protocol, an unusual authentication scheme, a specific business logic flow that no off-the-shelf tool understands. When you hit that wall, you either adapt or you stop. Python is how you adapt.

### Why Python

Python is the pentester's language for three reasons, and I want to be specifik about each one because this matters.

First, **speed of development**. In a pentest, you often need a custom tool RIGHT NOW. The client's authentication endpoint uses a non-standard token rotation scheme. You need a script that handles that token rotation and replays requests with modified parameters. You can write that in Python in 30 lines in 10 minutes. In C you would still be parsing HTTP headers by hand. In Java you would still be configuring your Maven project. Speed of development is not a luxury -- it is a tactical requirement.

Second, the **library ecosystem**. Scapy for packet crafting. requests for HTTP. pwntools for binary exploitation. Impacket for Windows protocols (NTLM, Kerberos, SMB, WMI -- the same protocols we attacked in episodes 33 and 34). paramiko for SSH. BeautifulSoup for HTML parsing. Every protocol you need to speak and every attack you need to automate has a Python library. You are never starting from scratch.

Third, **cross-platform**. The same script runs on your Kali VM, your macOS laptop, and (if you get that far) the compromised Linux server. Write once, run everywhere -- except this time it actually works, unlike Java's version of that promise ;-)

### Packet Crafting with Scapy

Moving down the stack from HTTP to raw network packets. Scapy lets you craft, send, and receive packets at any protocol layer. It's what you use when you need to speak a protocol that the `requests` library does not understand -- or when you need to manipulate protocol headers in ways that higher-level libraries do not permit:

```python

\

import sys

```

ARP scanning is the most reliable way to discover hosts on a local network because ARP operates at Layer 2 -- below IP, below firewalls. A host that drops ICMP pings (and many do) will still respond to ARP because it MUST respond to ARP to participate on the network at all. This is the same technique we discussed in episode 29 (network sniffing) but now you control every byte of the packet.

The `ether / arp` syntax is pure Scapy -- the `/` operator stacks protocol layers. An Ethernet frame wrapping an ARP request, broadcast to `ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff` (all hosts on the segment). `srp` sends at Layer 2 and collects responses. Every host that answers reveals its IP and MAC address. Simple, reliable, and nearly impossible to filter without breaking the network.

The `time.sleep(0.5)` is not politeness -- it is operational security. Without it, 1000 login attempts in 2 seconds triggers every account lockout policy and every rate limiter on the planet. With a 0.5 second delay, 1000 users take about 8 minutes. Still fast enough to be useful, slow enough to fly under most detection thresholds. In a real engagement you would tune this based on the target's lockout policy (which you would discover during reconnaissance in episode 4).

The `allow_redirects=False` is important. Many login forms redirect on success (302 to `/dashboard`) and return 200 with an error message on failure. If you follow redirects, you lose the ability to distinguish success from failure based on status code. Redirects are success indicators -- catch them, don't follow them.

```text
   predictable        a detection signature list. Same data, both sides.
   patterns

3. Password sprayers  Alert on ONE password tried against MANY users
   add delays         (not many passwords against one user). Our sprayer
   between attempts   used 0.5s delay -- correlate across a wider window.

4. Reverse shells     Monitor for outbound connections to unusual ports
   use raw sockets    from non-browser processes. The connection pattern
                      (short inbound, large outbound, irregular) is
                      distinctive.

5. ARP scanners       IDS rule for ARP requests exceeding the normal
   generate broadcast baseline. Our scanner generates one ARP request
   traffic            per host in the subnet -- 254 ARP packets in a
                      few seconds is abnormal.
```

This duality -- the same knowledge that makes you a better attacker makes you a better defender -- is the core thesis of this entire series. The tools we built today are offensive by nature. The detection strategies are their defensive mirrors. A security professional who can build attack tools AND the detections for those tools is vastly more valuable than one who can only do one or the other.

### The AI Slop Connection

AI code assistants generate \

that look functional but have subtle, dangerous flaws. I have seen all of the following from AI-generated pentest code:

A port scanner that does not handle connection timeouts correctly -- it hangs on filtered ports instead of moving on, producing false negatives that cause you to miss open ports behind a firewall. An SQLi scanner that checks for error strings but does not implement time-based detection -- missing the entire class of blind SQL injection that makes up the majority of real-world findings. A password sprayer with no delay between requests -- guaranteed to trigger lockouts and get your testing IP banned within seconds. A reverse shell that writes its received commands to a log file on disk -- leaving forensic evidence that defeats the entire purpose.

The tools in this episode are simple by design. Each one is under 50 lines. You can read every line, understand every decision, and know exactly what the tool does and does NOT do. That is the point. When you build your own tools, you own them completely. You know their limitations. You know their detection signatures. You know what they write to disk, what they send over the network, and what artifacts they leave behind.

_Write your own tools. Understand what they do. Trust nothing you cannot read._

### Exercises

**Exercise 1:** Build a **directory brute forcer** in Python. The tool should: (a) take a URL and wordlist file as arguments, (b) try each word as a path (e.g., /admin, /backup, /config), (c) report paths that return 200, 301, 302, or 403 status codes, (d) use threading with a configurable number of workers (default 10), (e) support a configurable request timeout. Test against a lab web server (DVWA, Juice Shop, or similar). Compare your output against `gobuster` to verify you are finding the same paths. Save to `~/lab-notes/dir-bruteforcer.py`.

**Exercise 2:** Build a **credential sprayer for SSH** using the `paramiko` library. The tool should: (a) take a target IP, username list file, and single password as arguments, (b) attempt SSH login for each username with `paramiko.SSHClient`, (c) report successful logins, (d) implement a configurable delay between attempts (default 1 second), (e) handle connection errors gracefully (timeouts, refused connections, authentication failures -- each handled differently). Test against your lab VM with a known weak credential (e.g., user `test` with password `test`). Save to `~/lab-notes/ssh-sprayer.py`.

**Exercise 3:** Build a **log correlation tool** that reads Linux `auth.log` and identifies potential lateral movement. The tool should detect: (a) successful SSH logins from unusual source IPs (compare against a whitelist you define), (b) `sudo` usage by accounts that do not normally use sudo, (c) rapid succession of failed + successful logins (potential credential stuffing that found a hit). Output a timeline of suspicious events sorted by timestamp. Test with auth.log from your lab VM after running your SSH sprayer against it -- your own sprayer's attempts should show up in the analysis. Save to `~/lab-notes/log-correlator.py`.

body.title: The Complete Guide to Lumy AI and the Lumy Node Ecosystem: Unlocking the Future of the Lumy Token ($LUMY)
body.body:
The digital landscape is undergoing a massive shift with the rise of Lumy AI. For years, artificial intelligence and blockchain technology existed in separate silos. Tech enthusiasts understood the power of both, but bringing them together through a Lumy node network in a way that benefits everyday users remained a complex puzzle. That puzzle is finally being solved by the Lumy token ecosystem.

![photo_2026-06-09_01-13-03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNfGRTUKJrJm6erDCoMrghpwtKTCuXiY3qNmPBbT1RtzE/photo_2026-06-09_01-13-03.jpg)

Today, we are taking a deep dive into an ecosystem that is fundamentally changing how we think about decentralised computing. We are talking about the complete integration of Lumy AI with distributed ledger technology, powered by a community-driven Lumy node network. This guide will explore every facet of Lumy AI, the operational mechanics of the Lumy node, and the underlying utility of the Lumy coin. By the time you finish reading, you will understand exactly why the Lumy token ($LUMY) is positioned to become a central pillar of the decentralised economy.

### The Intersection of Lumy AI and Web3

To truly understand the value of this ecosystem, we first need to look at the current state of digital intelligence. Artificial intelligence requires massive amounts of computing power. Traditional AI models are controlled by large centralised tech companies. These corporations dictate who gets access, how much it costs, and what data is used. This centralisation creates a bottleneck. It limits innovation and keeps the financial rewards in the hands of a very small group of corporate executives.

The blockchain was built to solve exactly this kind of centralisation problem. By distributing power across a global network of participants, blockchain technology returns control and financial upside to the actual users. When you combine the computational demands of artificial intelligence with the decentralised incentive structures of Web3, you create a system where everyone can contribute, and everyone can be rewarded.
This is the exact gap in the market that the Lumy AI developers recognised. The community needed a way to democratize access to high-level machine learning tools while rewarding the people who help keep the Lumy node network secure and operational.

### What is Lumy AI?

![photo_2026-06-16_01-07-14.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdMuJrhJb4aVKzthPUs9jiZV5aqTft48MYYTQAWL4GhrY/photo_2026-06-16_01-07-14.jpg)

At its core, Lumy AI represents a paradigm shift in how artificial intelligence algorithms are hosted, trained, and executed. Instead of relying on expensive server farms located in remote corporate data centres, this protocol leverages a globally distributed network.

When a developer or a business needs to process complex machine learning tasks, they tap into this decentralised grid. The system routes the computational requests through a highly secure, cryptographic pipeline. This ensures that the data remains private and the outputs are verifiable. It is a brilliant approach because it lowers the barrier to entry for developers who want to build smart applications, while simultaneously creating a robust economy for hardware operators.

The beauty of Lumy AI lies in its accessibility. You do not need to be a prominent software engineer to benefit from it. The platform is designed with an intuitive interface that allows regular users to interact with advanced algorithms seamlessly. Whether you are automating digital tasks, analysing massive datasets, or building decentralised applications, the protocol provides the necessary infrastructure without the traditional corporate roadblocks.

### The Power of the Lumy Node Network

![photo_2026-06-09_01-13-11 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfWEwku21r2XB8dsyi8HoeZ4kr9EQR5vbWchJB2ZQEw9j/photo_2026-06-09_01-13-11%20(2).jpg)

A decentralised network is only as strong as the infrastructure supporting it. This brings us to the most critical component of the entire operation, which is the Lumy node.

Think of a node as a digital engine. Every time a user interacts with the AI protocols, data needs to be processed, verified, and recorded on the blockchain. The Lumy node operators are the individuals providing the computing power to make this happen. By running a node, you are essentially renting out your idle computational resources to support the global network.

Setting up and operating a Lumy node is an incredibly straightforward process, which is a significant competitive advantage for this project. Historically, running blockchain architecture required advanced programming knowledge and highly specialised, expensive hardware. The development team completely removed that friction. They built a lightweight software client that can be deployed by almost anyone with a reliable internet connection and standard computing hardware.

When you operate a Lumy node, you are doing much more than just processing data. You are securing the network, verifying transactions, and ensuring that the artificial intelligence models execute flawlessly. In exchange for providing this vital service, node operators receive automated rewards. This creates a powerful flywheel effect. As more people use the AI services, the network requires more nodes. As more nodes join the network, the system becomes faster and more secure, attracting even more users.

### Understanding the Lumy Token ($LUMY) and Lumy Coin Utility

You cannot have a functional decentralised network without a robust economic engine to power it. This is where the Lumy token comes into play. It is the lifeblood of the entire ecosystem, serving multiple highly specific functions that drive demand and maintain network stability.

First and foremost, the $LUMY token acts as the primary medium of exchange within the protocol. When developers and enterprises want to utilise the AI processing capabilities, they must pay for those services using the native token. This creates a constant, organic buying pressure in the market. The more the technology is utilised by real-world applications, the higher the baseline demand for the token becomes.

Secondly, the token is used to incentivise the infrastructure providers. The people running the nodes are compensated directly in $LUMY. This creates a sustainable passive income generation model for community members who believe in the long-term vision of the project. Instead of spending thousands of dollars on centralised cloud providers, the network redistributes that wealth back to the everyday users who keep the system running.

Finally, the token carries significant governance utility. In the spirit of true decentralisation, the core development team understands that the community should have a voice in the future direction of the platform. Holding the Lumy token gives you the ability to vote on critical protocol upgrades, fee structures, and strategic partnerships. This ensures that the ecosystem evolves in a way that benefits the users rather than a centralised board of directors.

### The Market Positioning of the Lumy Coin and Lumy Token
When evaluating any digital asset, SEO professionals and market analysts look closely at the narrative surrounding the project. The cryptocurrency market moves in cycles, and the current cycle is heavily focused on real-world utility, DePIN, and artificial intelligence. The Lumy coin sits directly at the intersection of these growth sectors, supported by the utility of the Lumy token and the physical infrastructure of each Lumy node.

Unlike many legacy projects that rely purely on marketing hype or speculative trading, the Lumy coin is backed by actual technological utilisation. Every transaction, every smart contract execution, and every data processing request requires the native coin. This intrinsic utility separates it from the thousands of digital assets that lack a clear use case.

Furthermore, the tokenomics have been structured to promote long-term holding rather than short-term speculation. By creating strong incentives for node operators and offering attractive staking mechanisms, the protocol effectively removes a significant portion of the circulating supply from the open market. When supply is constrained, and organic demand increases through network usage, the economic fundamentals become incredibly attractive to both retail participants and institutional observers.

### How to Get Involved with Lumy AI and the Lumy Node Ecosystem
One of the hallmarks of a successful Web3 project is how easily new users can onboard and participate. The team has made community integration a top priority. Whether you are looking to run hardware, utilise the technology, or simply become a supporter of the digital asset, there are multiple pathways to get involved.

The first step is always education. You should visit the official website at https://www.lmos.info  to read the foundational documents and understand the technical roadmap. The website serves as the central hub for all verified information, software downloads, and protocol updates. It is highly recommended to bookmark this page to ensure you are always accessing official resources.

For those interested in the infrastructure side, the website provides detailed, step-by-step documentation on how to provision and launch a node. The process has been streamlined to ensure that even those with minimal technical backgrounds can successfully contribute to the network security.

If you are looking to acquire the $LUMY token, the platform provides direct links to the official decentralised exchanges and trading pairs. Always ensure you are verifying contract addresses through official channels to protect your digital assets from sophisticated phishing attempts.

### The Power of Community in the Lumy AI Revolution
Technology alone does not guarantee success in the decentralised economy. The most advanced code in the world will fail without a passionate, engaged community to champion it. 

The developers behind this ecosystem understand that human connection and shared vision are the true drivers of adoption.

The community is growing rapidly across all major social platforms. The conversation is active, educational, and focused on long-term growth. To stay updated on the latest partnerships, technological releases, and market strategies, you need to plug into these communication channels immediately.

For real-time updates and official team announcements, following the project on X at https://x.com/lumyinfo is essential. This is where you will find breaking news and strategic insights directly from the core contributors.

However, to truly feel the pulse of the project, you must join the Telegram channels. The announcement channel located at https://t.me/LUMY_Announce will ensure you never miss a critical update regarding network upgrades or token events. For networking with other node operators, discussing tokenomics, and asking technical questions, the main community hub at https://t.me/LUMYCommunity is an incredible resource. The environment is welcoming, and veteran members are always willing to help guide newcomers through the setup processes.

### A Technical Look at Lumy AI Security and Scalability
Search engines and prospective users both prioritise security. When dealing with decentralised finance and Lumy AI, the cryptographic architecture must be flawless. The protocol utilises state-of-the-art consensus mechanisms to ensure that all data passing through the Lumy node network is immutable and tamper-proof.
Scalability is another major factor that sets this project apart. Early blockchain networks suffered from severe network congestion and astronomical transaction fees when user activity spiked. This ecosystem was engineered from the ground up to handle high throughput. As more developers build AI applications on the network, the infrastructure scales dynamically. 

The node operators handle the increased load efficiently, ensuring that transactions remain lightning fast and incredibly cheap.
This technical superiority is why so many developers are migrating away from legacy systems. When you can execute complex smart contracts and machine learning algorithms without worrying about network bottlenecks, the possibilities for innovation become endless.

### The Lumy AI Roadmap and Global Adoption of the Lumy Token
Looking ahead, the roadmap for this ecosystem is exceptionally ambitious. We are currently witnessing just the foundational layer of what will become a massive digital economy. The integration of artificial intelligence is progressing at a breakneck pace, and decentralised platforms are the only logical evolution for hosting these powerful tools securely.

The development team is actively forging strategic partnerships with major data providers, enterprise software companies, and cross-chain liquidity protocols. These integrations will continue to drive external value into the ecosystem, further solidifying the utility of the $LUMY token.

As the global regulatory environment becomes clearer, projects that offer genuine utility and transparent operations will command the market. The transparent nature of the node network, combined with the verifiable utility of the AI protocols, positions this project perfectly for mainstream institutional adoption.

### Final Thoughts on the Decentralised Intelligence Revolution
We are standing at the edge of a major technological frontier. The convergence of machine learning and decentralised networks is no longer a theoretical concept. It is happening right now, and the infrastructure is being built by everyday people rather than isolated corporate monopolies.

Understanding the mechanics of Lumy AI gives you a significant advantage in navigating the Web3 space. By grasping how the Lumy node secures the network and processes complex data, you can see the tangible value backing the entire system. And by recognising the economic forces driving the Lumy coin, you position yourself to benefit from the ongoing transition toward decentralised infrastructure.

The $LUMY token is not just another digital asset. It is a key that unlocks access to the next generation of artificial intelligence, a tool for community governance, and a mechanism for equitable financial distribution.

If you are ready to take the next step in your Web3 journey, now is the time to get involved. Review the documentation at https://www.lmos.info, join the active discussions at https://t.me/LUMYCommunity, and follow the latest developments at https://x.com/lumyinfo. The future of decentralised intelligence is here, and it is being built by the community, for the community.

body.title: The beauty of station in red
body.body:
## Hello everyone ! 


While returning home to an another home a girl always feel a lot . Sometimes she feels lucky that she has two wonderful home , one where her mother and whole family lived and another belong to her husband. 

This vacation I spent 20 days at my mom home and back via train . Usually we prefer road trip but this time due to heat and petrol crisis we choose train . 
There is no direct train so we had to come first Jodhpur and then we return to gujarat . 

We had to wait for 5 hours at Jodhpur station ,at first it seems us a challenge but time passed quickly . First we wait in the waiting room where I feel so overwhelmed to leave mom home again , watch whole trip pictures 100 times and feel heavy. Than my husband brought dinner , we enjoyed McDonald burger which made my mood as my husband know that it is my favourite 😜. After dinner we decide to walk . This time I thought to spent some time alone so I came alone while my hubby in kid was in waiting room with luggage 😜😜. When I was walking I saw the beauty of the station . I never saw this station from outside , first time I saw and I was amazed with its beauty . 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmReiEchS6khzViVocAb1ky5ovEHxALTvRExNuRbmYf2pr/img_9030.jpg)


The station looks so mesmerising in red lighting and the big flag looks wonderful . 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZAWApuYsTGV126rdqx4jpfWM4oBJ2bSNjm3V7GyusnSW/img_9029.jpg)


In the darkness the station looks just wow , dark sky , star , red building with clock tower and Indian flag just attract whole attention and I spent almost 30 minutes there . 



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUP9haLaaZAWQVRJvNHQNiqRaiSsJ7NjmA4yRCZPkS4j/img_9022.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPbAhhDfpCAh8Kw9HkWBsCe9Dycb4X6JPAD7WqzEgF5B/img_9023.jpg)


Here I capture some more shots which cover whole area . It was crowded . 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV6Y5J2LkyFwcLYCMc9qL32p3cmiv3oPKTtZfjWRNkWED/img_9041.jpg)

And here one more evening shot captured by my husband when he came outside to receive the food parcel. 

In our busy life we always travel in hurry but sometimes it is better to just spend hours at station and watch the beauty of station ,  spend time  with yourself  , observe the people , talk to yourself and just relax without any tension . 


I enjoyed this time and the wonderful rubyred station building . I hope you also like it . 

<hr>
<hr>

So this is my submission for the #quratorphotoquest weekly challenge which topic is #rubyred . Thank you @qurator team for this amazing challenge . 
Here  is the [link](https://ecency.com/@qurator/qurators-photo-quest-or-ruby-red) for this challenge and I wanna invite my 2 friends @inuke and @gargi 😃😃. 


<hr>

### Thank you so much everyone for your valuable time , support and love 🤍🌸

body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1934
Tuesday 16, June 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1999
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Super Power Tuesday. 

Flex’em up mi gente. 

With the current Elite Supremacy system exposed, in chaos and collapsing, we, especially those of us who were raised within this system and told it was, “culture,” can get a clearer picture of what it’s really all about. And, that there are alternatives, at least in mindset and behavior.  

Certainly our beliefs are our own, or should be. This vessel could never quite reconcile the man on the cross mythology, but it was the only platter on offer in our formative years. But it never took form.  We would ask the deity to help us find lost items, but later decided it was better to keep track of items, so as not to lose them in the first place. Prevention became a better solution.  

We eventually learned that Universe was bigger than the Father of Christ. That’s when events started going our way. Way more often. 

Our hero’s journey is encoded. It has been so from the start. It’s for a very small population of humans who already have a clue to the code, or are curious, and seeking something different, or more than what they were offered during their maturity. 

We are doing the same. We are in our sixth year of this journey. It can be compared to maturing from crawling, to standing, to walking, to skipping, to running, to climbing. Just because you have achieved one, you don’t abandon the others. This envity crawled as a child before it could stand, and crawled again as a daddy with blossoming seeds on our back. We may yet find ourselves on all fours for exercise or necessity. 

We use a lot of metaphors in our sets because they are accessible. Intangible concepts are not easy to grasp, especially when one finds a scimitar upon one’s throat. 

There are many belief systems that have risen and been suppressed and “extinctified” by a, “race” of religious zealots. Nonetheless, the spirit of those beliefs remained within. Located in the remote recesses of common senses. Maybe what we call, “memory.” Perhaps even, “common memory.” That seems to be what’s going on with this emerging shift. The global diaspora, reconnecting or strengthening connections with memory. With, the ancestors. Some say, nostalgically, “it didn’t have to be this way.” However, fatalistically, “it can be no other way, than the way it is.” 

But it certainly doesn’t have to stay this way. 

Stay strong, stay safe, stay savvy, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign,  stay subscribed.  

PEACE. 


Septonomial Afrocentrism 
Charisma
Final Fibonacci
From Elite Supremacy to Afrocentrism?   

![1999.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbRczxRzTSNQX2BseQvmugEoLy8CBiG61SasDZG9yAUuV/1999.png)

Today's Episode: https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1934_full_6-16-26_1999_afro:2?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9
Septonomial Afrocentrism is another one of these paths that we are walking. Sometimes they come to Us, and beckons us to follow. 
Program notes. Maybe until the end of this month, we will do a short paragraph followed by the Noxsoma TV Guide. 
Here’s what we didn’t include in the following schedule.
Long Play Stand-up Philosophy videos every five days. 
The Hepdekad, is our 17 day check in episode, where we check on our health, fitness, attitude, environment, hopes & dreams, and the progress of the shows. You will only have to listen to this audio once. TV Guide coming next.  
TV Guide (note, the voice over DOES NOT include the URLs). 
I joked in one of these episodes about needing a TV Guide of sorts, so that our ever-expanding audience can keep up with our offerings. It’s the same product wrapped in different packages. 
We publish the Daily Ox Drops on three platforms. None of them are YouTube.
Rumble https://rumble.com/user/Noxsoma – Daily at 3:00 AM  (EST)
Odysee  https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2 – Daily at 2:00 AM  (EST)
Bitchute https://www.bitchute.com/channel/fi6jhTIVbbe1 – Daily 4:00 AM (UTC)  (sometimes). 
Our, 20 years running YouTube channel; (https://www.youtube.com/user/noxsoma) is basically a closet. A legacy channel. We were on this platform early, and we keep it for mostly fitness stuff. If you want to watch or listen to your humble vagabond work out and talk about working out. This is for you. 
We have a spinoff channel channel on Rumble (https://rumble.com/c/c-6500221) that we use for throwbacks. The series that preceded Full Metal Ox launched at about the same time as the Covid Op, in 2020. We went outside daily-ish, sometimes even in the rain, and observed what was happening in the community we did not plan to stay in. It’s a regular guy, real time archive of the “two weeks to flatten the curve” era.  
Substack, (noxsoma.substack.com), is a mini creative community in itself. We post articles, the occasional short videos, text to voice articles, “live” voice over commentaries, and our de facto “novel,” in the form of a comic strip. 
Behind the pay-wall, is where Secret City resides. It’s exclusively for those who would like to help build our future podcast, which is the next level of what we’re doing now. We are eventually going to have content on Substack around the clock. Maybe 6 pieces daily, including the notes & comics, video shorts and some uplifting messages from our simulation. 
If Substack is Moonbase, the video platforms are satellites. This brings us to the blogs. Legacy blogs that still manage to exist. They are our billboards. We’ve already written the articles. We’ve had the accounts for years. Some, for as long as a decade or more, others very close to ten years. So what the heck. Might as well. 
Hive  https://hive.blog/@noxsoma  
Steemit  https://steemit.com/@noxsoma/posts 
Minds https://www.minds.com/Noxsoma/ 
Gab https://gab.com/Noxsoma 
We post reliably every day, despite receiving little if any feedback. It’s become more of a ritual than an ambition. 
We are also, believe it or not, on Mixcloud, Soundcloud & Podomatic, (we post audio voice tracks on Podomatic from time to time, just to see if anyone stumbles upon the files.) 
Hardly worth mentioning, but we are also on X, and Telegram. We “scavenge” on these platforms, for “news,” animation, some shorts that we can weave into our video collages. But we have no significant presence on either.  
We do this because, this is what we do. It’s our dharma. We, The Trinity, & The Collective, that is, everything within this vessel and its cosmos, enjoys the process of creating much more than the sharing. But we share anyway. Even if our esoteric mindset, weird sense of humor, and cynically-optimistic cosmogony stimulates 1%, or even less, of the global population, that’s a good vibe.

body.title: Zscaler ZDTA Exam Complete Study Guide 2026: Syllabus, Question Formats, Free Practice
body.body: As you go through the Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator (ZDTA) certification exam blueprint, what grabs your attention is not its price, but the content of the blueprint, which begins with \

This isn't a know-your-acronyms exam where you match SAML to a one-line definition. It's an exam that hands you a situation, a misordered firewall rule, a user who can't reach a private app, an audit log that looks slightly off and asks you to act like the administrator actually in the room.

That can be scary if all you know is flashcards. Sixty Zscaler ZDTA test questions in ninety minutes using technology relating to identity, connectivity, policies, threat protection, data security, risk, digital experience, and automation. Knowing what each piece does is one thing. Knowing it well enough to read someone else's mess and pick the right fix in under ninety seconds a question is another.

This guide breaks down exactly what's tested. How the ZDTA exam questions are actually built and where to spend your prep time, find Zscaler ZDTA practice questions and answers that mirror the real scenario format instead of recycled trivia.

## Who This Certification Actually Targets

Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator certification isn't gatekept by a prerequisite exam, but it's not a beginner credential either. Zscaler built it for security professionals, network engineers, security architects, and the partners and customers who deploy and support the Zero Trust Exchange day to day.

Officially, there's no mandatory prerequisite to register. Unofficially, Zscaler recommends candidates bring around five years of combined IT networking and cybersecurity experience, plus three to six months of hands-on time inside the Zscaler platform itself. Read about ZIA and ZPA in a slide deck without ever touching a console, and the scenario questions will find you out fast.

The recommended on-ramp is the Zscaler for Users – Administrator (EDU-200) course and its hands-on lab. You don't have to take it, but if you haven't configured a forwarding profile or a posture check yourself, that lab is the fastest way to close the gap before ZDTA exam day.

## Sixty Zscaler ZDTA Exam Questions, Ninety Minutes, One Twist

Here's what the numbers actually look like:

*   60 ZDTA exam questions, almost entirely scenario-based rather than definition recall

*   90-minute time limit, call it a minute and a half per question

*   Professional-level difficulty, delivered as a proctored exam

*   $300 USD per attempt, one credit, English only

*   No hard prerequisite, though hands-on Zscaler experience is strongly recommended

The twist isn't the topic list, it's the phrasing. A typical question doesn't ask \

It hands you a setup instead: a contractor who needs access to exactly three internal apps and nothing else, or a private application that works fine for most of a team but drops intermittently for one specific user.

You're not recalling a fact. You're diagnosing.

That's why memorizing feature names from a brochure won't carry you through. You need to have actually worked through [ZDTA exam questions and answers](https://www.certboosters.com/exam/zscaler/zdta) built the same way, situation first, decision second, so the format itself stops being the hard part on test day.

## The Six ZDTA Exam Domains That Decide Your Score

Zscaler publishes an official blueprint with six scored ZDTA exam domains. The weighting tells you exactly where to spend your study hours before you open a single chapter.

*   Policy & Security Configuration: 29%, covering SSL bypass decisions, URL filtering, sandbox actions, DLP rules, and least-privilege App Segments

*   User & Device Management: 18%, identity groups, ZIdentity administration, device posture, and audit log interpretation

*   Platform Management: 18%, TLS decryption placement, connectivity tunnels, M365 optimization, and App Connector deployment

*   Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics: 13%, reading web and firewall logs, executive summaries, and ZDX diagnostics

*   Troubleshooting & Incident Response: 13%, policy hierarchy conflicts, intermittent access issues, and blocking known threat actors

*   Integration & Optimization: 9%, performance tuning and large-scale policy rollouts

Notice Policy & Security Configuration alone is worth almost a third of your score more than Monitoring and Troubleshooting combined. A study plan that gives every domain equal attention is quietly underinvesting in the one area most likely to decide whether you pass.

Beneath those six graded domains is the actual content divided into nine chapters within Zscaler’s own guid: Identity Services, Connectivity Services, Platform Services, Access Control Services, Cyberthreat Protection Services, Data Security Services, Risk Management, Zscaler Digital Experience, and Zero Trust Automation. Think of the six domains as the grading rubric and the nine chapters as the syllabus you actually read. There will always be an overlap among all those chapters. It is for this reason that ZDTA practice questions from different domains are better than reading any one chapter twice.

## How to Actually Pass Zscaler ZDTA Exam

Start with the source Zscaler points you to directly: the official ZDTA blueprint and study guide are free, current, and the only documents guaranteed to reflect what's actually tested. Read them once, start to finish, before touching anything else.

Then get your hands on the platform. If you can access the [EDU-200 lab](https://customer.zscaler.com/zscaler-for-users-administrator-edu-200-hands-on-lab), use it. There's no substitute for configuring a forwarding profile or a DLP rule yourself. If you can't, spend time in your own organization's Zscaler tenant, even if it's just reviewing existing policies and logs.

Here's the part most study plans skip: reading the blueprint will get you to \
It won't get you to \
That second skill only comes from working through enough realistic, scenario-style ZDTA questions and answers that the \

phrasing stops feeling like a trick.

That's the gap you can fill using **CertBoosters ZDTA practice questions**, which are mapped to the actual blueprint weighting. So you spend more reps on Policy & Security Configuration than on Integration & Optimization. The same way the real ZDTA exam questions do. Every practice question comes with an explanation of why the right answer is right, and just as importantly, why the tempting wrong ones aren't.

One honest caveat: skip anything calling itself a \

Zscaler ZDTA exam dumps. Reusing live exam content violates Zscaler's certification agreement, and whatever you find online is usually outdated anyway, since the blueprint can change without notice. Realistic practice that mirrors the current format beats memorized leaks that mirror nothing current.

## Ready to Schedule Your ZDTA Exam?

Walking into the Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator certification exam without scenario practice is like memorizing traffic laws right before your first time behind the wheel. You know the rules, but applying them under a clock is a different skill entirely. Now that you know the real Zscaler ZDTA exam questions leans almost entirely on judgment calls, and that Policy & Security Configuration alone carries 29% of your score. You can study with intent instead of hoping the right topics show up. Start with the free official blueprint and study guide, get whatever hands-on platform time you can, then drill scenario-based ZDTA practice questions from CertBoosters that actually look like exam day. Sixty questions, ninety minutes, one $300 attempt: make sure the only surprise on exam day is how ready you feel.

     Se prendió la fiesta del mundial de fútbol del 2026, cargada de expectativas y también de novedades, como por ejemplo, el tener 3 países diferentes como sedes.

Y aunque nuestra comunidad no es exclusiva para hablar sobre deportes, nos permitimos estar a la par de este magno evento, pero desde otro punto de vista.

body.title: The Darkness of Cruelty
body.body:
Unnatural cruelty is behavior that goes beyond the limits of humanity, compassion and mercy. When a person displays unnecessary harshness, ruthlessness or oppression toward others, it can be called unnatural cruelty. This behavior not only causes pain to others but also breeds hatred and unrest in society. 

Love, compassion, and caring for one another are part of human nature. When a person abandons these qualities and chooses the path of cruelty and cold heartedness they distance themselves from their human values. Such actions leave deep wounds on the hearts of others. 

History teaches us that no matter how powerful oppression may be, it never lasts forever. Justice and truth ultimately find their way. That is why every person should treat others with kindness, respect, and fairness. 

Unnatural cruelty isn’t just about causing physical harm. Hurting someone’s feelings through words can also be part of it. Sometimes harsh and bitter words can cause a person as much pain as any other form of abuse. 

A better society is only formed when people respect each other’s rights and make compassion a part of their lives. Love, empathy and justice are the qualities that eliminate the darkness of cruelty and spread the light of hope.

body.title: Unnatural cruelty- dailyprompt
body.body:
The villagers feared the old well, claiming it whispered at night. Curious, Amir peered inside and found dozens of trapped birds, their wings clipped by someone for amusement. Amir was a young lad. He was just 15 years old when he saw what he saw. It was so damaging to his young personality.  The cruelty wasn’t hunger or survival, it was pleasure. That realization haunted him far longer than the well’s eerie whispers ever could. He had never seen anything like that before. After so many years of therapeutic sessions and shifting to a different city, he was finally able to move on with his life and family. He got married to his colleague Sharmeen. She was the one who helped him move on from that unnatural cruelty.

In this post, I will briefly share my thoughts and opinions about the Korean drama Teach You a Lesson. I personally watched the drama and collected all the screenshots used in this post. For today, I will only provide a short discussion so that you can get at least a basic idea about the drama. So, let's begin by discussing Season 1, Episode 1, Part 1 of this drama. ##### explain type The image will be shown above, and I will discuss and explain that particular image below it.

>\n
width=\

> the episode, we see a student named Park Dae Seok going to the rooftop of his school to commit suicide, and he eventually takes his own life. A little later, we are shown the reason behind this tragic incident. It is revealed that he was being severely bullied. He had even been labeled as a student whom everyone was allowed to bully, and he was given no right to defend himself or speak out against it. The following scenes then show us why he became the target of such bullying and humiliation in the first place.

After that, Jun Hyeong's friends beat Dae Seok and continued to bully him constantly.

> At this point, we see Gyeong Min sweeping outside the classroom. A student named Kim Gwang Su approaches him, starts hitting him for no reason, and continues to harass him. When Gwang Su repeatedly tells Gyeong Min to hit him back, the main character of the drama, Na Hwa-jin, arrives and slaps Gwang Su very hard. He continues slapping him several times. Later, during the confrontation, Jun Hyeong arrives and tells Na Hwa-jin, You cannot just hit students whenever you want. He then tells everyone to record a video of the incident. Seeing this, Na Hwa-jin continues slapping Gwang Su, and the video of the incident quickly goes viral. Afterward, the school principal arrives and stops the situation. He asks Na Hwa-jin who he is and why he is using physical force against students. Na Hwa-jin then replies, I am an inspector from the ERPB, and this organization has given me the authority to do this. Starting today, I will teach all of you a lesson. ![17.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23u5XSyq4UY4zeNWNdEaxrP1n2hesfy11DP9tQzxYtMMxXbPWng38vd1rfUGV47NFhGqf.png) After that, the principal takes him to a private room and tries to persuade him. > The next day, Na Hwa-jin comes to Gyeong Min's classroom and announces, From today, I will be your class teacher. He then begins taking attendance. At one point, when he notices that Dae Seok is absent, he asks about the reason for his absence. A student makes fun of the situation and says that Dae Seok committed suicide because he was afraid of studying. Na Hwa-jin immediately punishes the student. After noticing that no one in the class showed any sadness or sympathy for Dae Seok's death, he orders the entire class to do push-ups as punishment. However, Jun Hyeong tells everyone not to do them. Out of fear of Jun Hyeong, none of the students obey Na Hwa-jin's order. Na Hwa-jin then says, So, if one person intimidates , they will all listen to me instead of him? After saying that, he grabs Jun Hyeong and presses his head down onto a desk. Seeing this, Jun Hyeong and the rest of the class finally begin doing the push-ups.

There, Na Hwa-jin tells him to go to the back of the line, otherwise he will not be allowed to receive any food. Despite the warning, Jun Hyeong behaves disrespectfully and uses his hands to take food onto his plate. He then throws the food into a trash bin. Seeing this, Na Hwa-jin kicks him, causing him to fall into the trash bin, and garbage ends up all over his body. Afterward, Na Hwa-jin wipes Jun Hyeong's face with a dirty floor-cleaning rag, humiliating him in front of everyone. #### My review In Part 1 of today's first episode, our protagonist teaches a very valuable lesson. While watching this story, I laughed some time. It truly shows that everyone is equal, and no one should be humiliated or looked down upon. Everyone deserves respect, which is one of the important messages we can learn from this K-drama. I have divided Episode 1 into three parts to make it more interesting and easier to follow. body.title: Top back-office BPO firms 2026?
body.body: Honestly, the site visit thing is all about looking past the shiny reception area. When I did mine, I asked to use the restroom unaccompanied and took the long way back to the conference room, just walking past the actual production floor. You want to see if the agents look completely drained or if the screens show personal emails instead of work tools. Another huge tell is how the management talks about their employees when you're just chatting casually. If they refer to them as resources or FTEs instead of people, run. I once overheard a team lead publicly dressing down an agent over a tiny error, and that told me everything about their culture. The biggest green flag for me, and what eventually led me to the site [back office outsourcing companies](https://helpware.com/blog/back-office-outsourcing-companies) which has the best business process outsourcing around today, was seeing team leads sitting alongside agents, coaching in real-time, not hiding in a glass office. You should also check the age and condition of the monitors and headsets; it’s a small thing, but it shows whether the company invests in making the actual work comfortable or just the client-facing lobby.

body.title: Poema: No busco reflejarme/Poem: I'm not trying to reflect myself(ESP-ENG)
body.body:
Hola amigos, he regresado al sitio que me vio nacer, el espacio que me larga la vida, esta comunidad de literatos que me hace un ser libre entre las letras, espero que este poema les guste.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyfje4rxNdeaciS7FPdnfj7aHxsHJoeaSvPo1EnwHxC5/20260522_174152.jpg)
Esta misma tarde, para no ir tan lejos,
no buscaré reflejarme en los espejos de la isla.
En la camisa rasgada y piel tan sucia 
del que parece un carbón más de los que vende,
o el que refleja la corbata en el Mercedes
con aire majestuoso.
Y no culpo al amor de esta tierra
por vender mis reflejos .
Solo bastará con abrir una puerta,
encontrar a mi madre
tejiendo el hilo de la patria
en el trayecto que nos deja la existencia.
Regresar a los lugares donde una vez fui feliz,
sin mirar atrás,
porque la patria es un hilo que tiende a crecer
y bordar nuestras historias.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSc7JwGNfhUMw5Wywv3gQkhRwF3jo366vaiZUD2UNGYAt/texto_12_.jpg)

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUNqDXZ5CVYPvhJr369ApccLYKQU3ANCKR6XqUPbQJhB/versi_n_en_espa_ol_3_.jpg)</center>

Hello friends, I have returned to the place where I was born, the space that gives me life, this community of writers that makes me a free being among letters, I hope you like this poem.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyfje4rxNdeaciS7FPdnfj7aHxsHJoeaSvPo1EnwHxC5/20260522_174152.jpg)
This very afternoon, so as not to go too far,
I won't look for my reflection in the island's mirrors.

In the torn shirt and filthy skin
of the man who looks like just another piece of coal he sells,
or the one whose tie is reflected in the Mercedes
with a majestic air.

And I don't blame the love of this land
for selling my reflections.
It will be enough to open a door,
to find my mother
weaving the thread of the homeland
along the path that existence leaves us.

To return to the places where I was once happy,
without looking back,
because the homeland is a thread that tends to grow
and embroider our stories.
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXMP5ERFBMvo2ajfgAwH2M7djPwMprKo3b9nnRoo5wjWt/texto_11_.jpg)

body.title: La idea de un torneo - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body: <div class=\

> ![torff.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxCDXp4nyfoeCXRTuETfkfvFSm7RqV1TdEHsqU7mbtr2/torff.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/oficina-mesa-espacio-de-trabajo-pantalla-13162091/) Todos en la sala HOLOZING seguían trabajando en aquel tema nuevo para la criatura de SHINAARA, pero las pantallas parpadeaban como si algo intentara volver a arrancar desde un principio tal como una canción. El empresario simplemente observaba cómo el sistema de audio se activaba solo, como si el propio estudio hubiera decidido reproducirlo. Hasta que se escuchó el sonido de un violín, pero esta vez no era el violinista del equipo quien tocaba, el sonido venía de aquella computadora. Con todo lo extraño que ocurría en ese estudio la melodía era hermosa y perfecta, donde cada simulación hacía que todo fuera real, ya que mostraba a SHINAARA caminando, su cuerpo rodeado por una luz plateada, como si hubiera aprendido a controlar ese poder. La batería entró de golpe, donde el estudio entero vibró, puesto que la imagen cambió: SHINAARA levantaba la cabeza. Claudio sonrió y dijo —Esto no es solo una canción, tenemos que aprovechar eso y crear un torneo— el empresario simplemente movió la cabeza como de aceptación. El violinista del equipo, que hasta ahora había estado en silencio, levantó su instrumento y en la pantalla, SHINAARA giró lentamente hacia la cámara, como si ya estuviera esperando a todos los demás. >Everyone in the HOLOZING room was still working on that new track for SHINAARA’s project, but the screens were flickering as if something were trying to start over from the beginning, just like a song. The producer simply watched as the audio system activated on its own, as if the studio itself had decided to play it. Until the sound of a violin was heard, but this time it wasn’t the team’s violinist playing—the sound was coming from that computer. # >Despite all the strange things happening in that studio, the melody was beautiful and perfect, where every simulation made everything feel real, as it showed SHINAARA walking, her body surrounded by a silvery light, as if she had learned to control that power. The drums kicked in suddenly, causing the entire studio to vibrate, as the image changed: SHINAARA raised her head. # >Claudio smiled and said, “This isn’t just a song; we have to take advantage of that and create a tournament.” The businessman simply nodded in agreement. The team’s violinist, who had been silent until now, raised his instrument, and on the screen, SHINAARA slowly turned toward the camera, as if she were already waiting for everyone else. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcYg9Qm2FSw5AJVTwRhkhFXo2gTesxKRh97eEYix2rQaa/image.png) [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/new-creature-reveal-holodust-december-claims-and-more) Los días siguientes, HOLOZING dejó de ser un simple estudio de creación y se convirtió en un centro de observación de cada una de las posibles criaturas que podían participar en ese torneo, ya que tenía que hacer algo muy grande. Mientras que en otra computadora estaba SHINAARA, comenzando algunos entrenamientos, donde al principio fallaba, pero despues cambiaron el enfoque con una secuencia simple y allí la criatura si supo cómo reaccionar. La segunda parte de este torneo era lograr que cada una de las criaturas debía sincronizar su ritmo, ya sea respiración, sonido, reacción, intención. Además, el empresario añadió — Si el torneo existe, no será ganado por fuerza, será ganado por coherencia.— Se mencionaron muchas criaturas, que todas eran capaces de competir y que reaccionaban al sonido como si fueran organismos musicales, como también se necesitaban arenas de mucho nivel, tiempo y jueces para cada una de las batallas de ese torneo. Donde todos confiaban en la capacidad de SHINAARA, y el torneo ya no era una idea, era un proceso en marcha, que dentro de poco el primer combate estaba a punto de empezar. >Over the next few days, HOLOZING ceased to be a mere creative studio and became an observation center for each of the potential creatures that could participate in the tournament, as it had to accomplish something truly monumental. body.title: Exciting Evening on the Rooftop
body.body: ![Tra (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUwbn9HRvc7xuWWHoFNAGaPgoobEtDHp97TeEj2xNPCtc/Tra%20(1).jfif)\n\n<div class=\

> Tonight was somehow different from the beginning. One of my friends had a birthday and invited us to a magical place. My friends and I couldn't wait to go there and have fun looking at the city from above for an hour soon. ![Tra (8).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVnhUrrcyxNhZDT5dXQf6iYvW8kvPsLPicMrNC9Eh2GQv/Tra%20(8).jfif) When we entered the establishment, we were greeted by a unique view of Vienna. The city was illuminated in the soft light of the street lights. One of the things that caught my eye was a glowing fountain in the center of the garden below. The domes towered majestically over the cityscape, their tops gleaming against the twilight sky. From where we were, we imagined how the former residents looked at this same view, connecting them to the city's past. ![Tra (7).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYshyp4ynukMqtjurR8aySx2KVJETpx2Ueip1xhjmaF2/Tra%20(7).jfif) When we entered the establishment, we were greeted by a unique view of Vienna. The city was illuminated in the soft light of the street lights. As we sipped our drinks, the atmosphere was relaxed, perfect for pleasant conversation. But just as we were getting comfortable, a distant rumble echoed in the sky, signaling the approach of a storm. ![Tra (6).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZRoySPREeRF7J8NFdpsqBH2Ez73pHjH6AHcaMUnwXEau/Tra%20(6).jfif) At first we ignored the sound, hoping it would pass quickly. It wasn't long before it became clear that the storm was coming. The thunder grew louder and closer, accompanied by flashes of lightning lighting up the night sky. Instead of being afraid or rushing to leave, we all decided to take the moment and see what the storm would show us. ![Tra (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjdBS6SAoPB5LPK9aACiF8x3adrZBDyykTrP5zopKvH8/Tra%20(5).jfif) As the night wore on, the wind picked up, causing the trees in the parks below to sway violently. The rain began to fall, first lightly, then gradually turned into a downpour. Instead of detracting from our experience, these elements added a sense of excitement and adventure to our evening. Huddled in our warm clothes, we continued to talk, our laughter echoing through the restaurant as the storm raged around us. ![Tra (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSW4BgwmpVkpJREJc8zfhVRrUCs5ThpkitYygcQ4RxCFX/Tra%20(4).jfif) As the storm reached its peak, the city lights flickered and flickered, creating a mesmerizing light show. The sight was indescribable, with every building and monument illuminated by the dancing raindrops. At that moment we realized that we were in the heart of a natural wonder, completely surrounded by the beauty of nature. ![Tra (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXX1dGTssYpvNMa7cz1SkExgoBYNyRJaZGdN5kKnTe5Pb/Tra%20(3).jfif) Just when it seemed the storm would never end, it began to weaken as suddenly as it had begun. The clouds parted, revealing a starry sky studded with twinkling stars. The city came alive again, its lights shining brightly in the fresh, clean atmosphere. It was a surreal experience to witness such a dramatic contrast within a short period of time. ![Tra (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc1RSsnJcH9bjMNMm2xmTYpmthUoKKScFTU78wVWdq45h/Tra%20(2).jfif) This unforgettable evening on the roof showed us several important things. First, sometimes the best experiences come from embracing the unpredictability of life and letting things unfold naturally. Second, even in the face of disaster there is beauty to be found if we just stop and assess the situation. Finally, shared experiences with loved ones can create memories that last for years to come. Whether it's watching a sunset from the top of a cliff or enjoying morning coffee from a window overlooking a busy square, these moments remind me of how interconnected we all are and how even in chaos there is harmony :) [//]:# (!worldmappin 48.20334 lat 16.35862 long d3scr)

body.title: I'm Looking Forward to the Future, But My Eyesight is Going Bad
body.body:
Yeah, you heard that right—that's Patrick Stump. Who says this cute dragon doesn't know how to party? Reliving my college emo-punk days with Fall Out Boy for #ThreeTuneTuesday #ttt this week. 🎸

Last Sunday, while I was drying my hair with the fan (Asian thingz), I caught myself staring blankly at the ceiling. Exhausted and with a pulsating headache, I suddenly remembered my college days.Played some FOB (Fall Out Boy) from my playlist, and the memories just started flowing back... I wasn't like this years ago.


Can people die of sleep deprivation? I understand that it is unhealthy to catch up on sleep in one blow and then dperive yourself again over the next few days. Handling students who are taking the Gaokao—the most notorious exam in China for upcoming college students—is the hardest task for me every year. It has been extended this year because of the many holidays, all while I am still managing normal tutorial classes in the evening.

Back then, I remember partying all weekend and going straight to school on Monday to take an exam on little to no sleep, passing with flying colors, and then partying again that same night. And repeat. It was the same cycle for all four years of college. Good times. I didn't know how... but i survived. I am just not sure now! LOL 😅😮‍💨

![Image_20260616133654_3230_3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/Ep1YknnXCU7W9hUoBPVxHCQu2igG2eZrQ7Z4a2TNHcvSZSrxox56ehQ7Hj2oqm9P9fy.jpg)
*It was taken during a weekend getaway on Saturday!*

![1000020223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23wqke1pjENJgTNTmknjbpcT7qih8EVVqhrp8ctQLbpef63uHQ91D8U6BepdTkjBaaR6y.jpg)


![1000020219.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/EpVCbm4TMJcg1dkufuQhfQmdTstrBmW1WRZPxX5PH7aU7LTasLJkBwAAtG5Cm4B8MBC.jpg)


![1000020222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/Ep7u2RmHkkpKRqUuy13FGY4bRV3zUcs7UUh4Mpdgmpa3a94MtwU9KSHwHN4n4Tt4UVS.jpg)

*and yep, Monday came... This was just a few hours after our first exam. Look at my friend who just passed out beside me, lol.*


![Image_20260616133936_3236_3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23ywu7WrWhMXAqZoJsWbEiWiry1PFmwC84thPieeH2REAExysp5Gwv8eWgF6DfBPayCW3.png)


![Image_20260616133655_3231_3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/EorzKJnibLqSPqcr5unhxRqke9C6KudCWsUeGqnfHWGmbwPdcHt3EK75ccbz6V8zoYU.jpg)

My alcohol tolerance is incredibly high, which I think is an advantage for a woman. But sleep? Never... *Ellie is a snoozer par excellence!*

I remember sleeping for the whole day just so my body could recover. My mom would quietly creep into my room to check if I was still breathing, 🤣 and my bros (cousins) would carry me from my room to the living room just to force me to wake up and eat! 😅

Alright, let's begin: Fall Out Boy is famous for their alternative, rock, and emo-punk sound. To me, they're the ultimate anthem of my college days.

***Warning: The guitar intro is a major 'eargasm'. Make sure to listen with high-quality headphones or speakers.***

**Beat It**
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sk8Pb17pcQI&list=RDsk8Pb17pcQI&start_radio=1

[Story behind the song](https://www.reddit.com/r/FallOutBoy/comments/1iclhrk/asking_your_opinion_every_day_about_a_fall_out/)

Back in 2008, Fall Out Boy dropped a high-octane, pop-punk spin on Michael Jackson’s 1982 masterpiece, \

They even brought in John Mayer to shred an incredible guest guitar solo. Ultimately, the band wasn't trying to compete with the King of Pop—the track was just a pure, loving tribute.


**Sugar, We're Goin Down**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uhG-vLZrb-g&list=RDuhG-vLZrb-g&start_radio=1

Sugar, We're Goin Down was primarily inspired by their Chicago hardcore-punk roots, slurred vocal delivery, and a cinematic, Wes Anderson-style treatment for the song's infamous music video. I find this song very romantic, like being the weirdest but eventually meeting a partner who turns out to be your forever ride-or-die.

[Wikipedia Source- Sugar We're Goin Down (FOB)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sugar,_We%27re_Goin_Down)


**Thnks fr th Mmrs**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=onzL0EM1pKY&list=RDonzL0EM1pKY&start_radio=1

\
\n\n\

This is actually my personal favorite song of them. Patrick Stump's lyrics slap! Need I say more? Dope, he's dope.

Did i yap a lot today? 😁 there you go, I hope you enjoyed them all, but before I end this post, I want to thank @ablaze for this wonderful, weekly event where people get together, jam and chill. It's a nice place to hang out, actually, especially if you just had or having a rough week. 

I'm so happy to have a weekend break for the Dragon Boat Festival! I really wanted to go out and chill, but my body is literally saying, 'Ellena... please sleep.'

Anyway, just two more weeks until freedom. Share your playlists, friends—let's hang out and chill. This post is scheduled at around 8:30 pm (PH time), I am still working by then, but I promise to check on your posts the second I get online at midnight! Let's catch up.

## 𝐄𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐞💕

body.title: Departure to Harrachov - Day 1 | Wyjazd do Harrachova - Dzień 1
body.body:
![A01.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/EogNKtz5eWiC16rd5KEGnsks2YrDNSoM6kdXgjwvFkaT75Ex4usgvpRL6pbEafkexpA)


Last year, we decided to visit the Czech Republic with my wife's father in 2026. Working on my book has limited my contact with most people, so it's time to start catching up. We really enjoyed Harrachov in 2025, except for the fact that it was quite cold and, above all, windy. Today, June 8th, the thermometers showed between 29 and 31 degrees Celsius in the afternoon, and as soon as the sun disappeared behind the mountains, I was reminded how severe mountain frost can be.


![A01.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/EogNKtz5eWiC16rd5KEGnsks2YrDNSoM6kdXgjwvFkaT75Ex4usgvpRL6pbEafkexpA)

![A2.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/23xozKH6dPqUkxeWQjM8cWJFuU8Md87Ra8suyyZzX2pFejr9JPGPZiVvktiJeoWVB6LVB)

![A3.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/EpQvkEqaT7Tjx6VLYs6VhBKZ5WhKGR2gswAY8AfxqnkjXBJbx3QWGF1TAuGXrzHffnA)

![A4.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/Eqd8yV3go9e7tyE6ZgEVd5avf7w6kjxFMsvAjCRmgkL3A4mwCAkofXwcnbjMCJJE3f9)

![A5.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/Eq36e5XYMPbdCt77PUh8Uv7M9sttyv2DXdFTeMkyjSXUtpJRd53XTfS3YfzVGk6WckH)

![A6.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/23x1FU3yTRFL8GcRQwaRxEovQo2AqDYcmfFtvyCP8rvuR72dVu2iabGz9fqz79Z1uKHJE)

![A7.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/23xARkhPWMMLaWYSc5Coh3RkvfTxvWVbnwBtt9bNiUQNNBgceJqRHs8Bk3mkPtL4kkTYn)

![A8.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/23tvefZ7HuJxzHDCLFWkSaVVcML56HcYiyoyJkJuVsVWTcLgRsRfVWHBkuSTL56nSyLg5)


Although the value of these areas has increased (as evidenced by the numerous tourism investments in southwest Poland – hotels, surrounding infrastructure, new fast-food restaurants, well-known franchises, and other attractions – I don't see any), I don't see significantly more visitors compared to what we saw in winter. Maybe my assumption is wrong, but it doesn't look like there will be many people. Most shops are closed, and there are significantly fewer ice cream shops, souvenir shops, etc., than on the Polish side of the border. Just as we saw some establishments full in winter, now guests are limited to strolling. Bar and restaurant owners and staff stood on their porches chatting among themselves. I didn't see any sports enthusiasts either, only cyclists or runners. Or, to put it another way, some establishments are struggling because breakfast and lunch are taken over by the restaurants. It's often a buffet, so people stuff themselves right under the tap, and on their walks, they'll just buy a snack or ice cream… Assuming they don't do it at the Czech discount store. We're staying in such a hotel, so paying for meals is out of the question. Some establishments will stay afloat, but others will face losses. Unfortunately, mountains are always less attractive to tourists.

![A9.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/herosik/EogLL2w6pyjJvD9XFTzvswbTzehc8trK9NX1NYxUA4sbtYcEMQSceJ8Svv9wWc19bw1)

As for us, aside from the numerous walks, we're considering bobsleighing. I think I went to Zakopane once; it was quite fun, but a quick ride. We probably won't visit the ski jumping and ice skating museums. I don't like either, and my partner only watches it on TV.

The town itself, however, is like something out of a fairy tale. I often hear complaints about Czechs that they rarely repair things, etc. For example, detached houses often haven't been renovated at all since they were built. This is largely true, but thanks to this, this town has retained its unique atmosphere. No matter how many words I write, the photos will convey much more. Even in the very center (whoa, strong words for this village), it's impossible not to gaze at the mountains or the wonderful, huge, green trees. Like something out of a nonexistent, colorful Disney fairy tale set in Eastern Europe. Foxes, frogs, and the Mole (after all, one of the Czech national symbols) are surrounded by old cottages, a few modern apartment blocks, and numerous colorful guesthouses. There are also equally beautiful gardens filled with colorful flowers or remnants of bygone times. Sometimes symbolic, but some people like to create truly attractive gardens.
