body.title: Why Amiri Streetwear and Chrome-Inspired Fashion Still Lead Modern Style
body.body:
## Streetwear Became More Than Just Casual Clothing

Streetwear stopped being simple casual fashion years ago. It slowly turned into a way people show personality through color, fit, and texture. That shift changed how oversized hoodies, distressed denim, and layered jackets fit into everyday life. A relaxed outfit can now look polished without feeling stiff or uncomfortable. I’ve noticed that the best streetwear pieces usually feel better after several washes because thicker cotton softens naturally over time. Cheap fabric rarely does that. Instead, it becomes rough near the cuffs and collar. That difference matters when you wear the same hoodie every week. Good streetwear also balances comfort with structure. Oversized clothing should still sit properly across the shoulders and sleeves. Otherwise, the outfit looks sloppy instead of intentional. Many people chase giant logos, yet fabric quality often matters more than branding. Heavier cotton blends, reinforced stitching, and durable zippers usually tell you far more about a garment. Personally, I prefer slightly faded black clothing because it feels lived-in instead of overly polished. Streetwear also works well because it adapts to different settings easily. You can wear relaxed denim with sneakers during the day and still keep the same outfit for dinner later. That flexibility explains why luxury streetwear continues growing even while trends change quickly. Some oversized styles do become impractical, though. Extra-long sleeves and exaggerated pants can make daily movement annoying after a few hours. Comfortable proportions still matter more than dramatic styling.

## Why Fabric Quality Separates Premium Fashion From Fast Fashion

Most people first notice graphics or branding, yet fabric decides how clothing performs after months of wear. High-quality cotton keeps its shape better around the neckline and shoulders. Meanwhile, thinner materials start twisting after repeated washing. That’s especially noticeable with oversized hoodies because poor fabric sags quickly near the elbows and waist. Denim quality matters too. Better denim softens naturally while keeping structure around the knees and pockets. Cheap versions often feel stiff at first and then become weak after a short time. I once handled two black hoodies under bright fitting-room lights, and one had a strange purple tint around the seams after stretching the fabric slightly. The stronger hoodie kept a rich charcoal tone even under direct lighting. Details like that separate premium clothing from average products. Strong stitching also improves comfort because seams don’t rub awkwardly during movement. Streetwear fans usually inspect cuffs, zippers, and hems before checking logos. They know durability matters when clothing becomes part of daily life. Dark luxury fashion especially depends on texture and weight instead of bright color palettes. Collections connected to[ https://chromeheartsstoreus.com/](https://chromeheartsstoreus.com/) often reflect that heavier visual style through darker tones, layered silver details, and structured cotton pieces. However, no fashion brand gets every fit perfect. Some oversized cuts still feel too exaggerated for practical everyday wear, especially during warmer seasons.

## Building Better Streetwear Outfits Without Trying Too Hard

Strong outfits usually come from balance rather than expensive pieces stacked together. Streetwear works best when proportions feel natural and movement stays comfortable throughout the day.

1.  Start with one statement item instead of several bold pieces at once.

2.  Use neutral tones like washed black, grey, cream, and olive for easier layering.

3.  Pair oversized hoodies with slimmer pants to keep the outfit balanced.

4.  Choose sneakers that support the outfit instead of overpowering it.

5.  Focus on texture through denim, suede, or heavyweight cotton instead of giant graphics.

Many people think luxury streetwear requires constant trend chasing, but consistency often looks stronger. A reliable jacket worn repeatedly usually feels more stylish than several loud pieces bought for social media photos. Comfort also matters more than online fashion culture admits. If you keep adjusting your hoodie or pulling at your jeans all day, the fit probably isn’t right. Real confidence comes from forgetting about your clothes once you leave home. That’s why relaxed tailoring remains popular every season. Good streetwear should move naturally while still holding shape. I also think slightly imperfect outfits often look better because they feel authentic instead of staged. Sneaker creases, faded cotton, and softened denim can actually improve an outfit over time. Clothing gains personality through regular use, not just from expensive branding.

## Music Culture Continues to Shape Modern Fashion

Streetwear has always stayed connected to music scenes. Punk, hip-hop, underground rock, and skate culture all influenced oversized silhouettes, graphic prints, and layered accessories. You can still see that influence in modern collections today. Distressed denim, silver hardware, washed cotton, and darker color palettes often resemble old concert clothing from the late 1990s and early 2000s. City life also changes how people style outfits. Someone living in Los Angeles dresses differently from someone walking through London or Tokyo every day. Weather, transportation, and nightlife shape clothing choices naturally. Warmer climates lean toward lighter layering, while colder areas rely on oversized jackets and heavyweight hoodies. Some fashion brands copy these styles without understanding where they came from originally. That usually creates outfits that feel forced. Real streetwear grows from daily habits instead of marketing campaigns. Emotional identity also plays a bigger role in fashion now. People increasingly choose clothing based on mood and comfort rather than pure status. That shift explains why softer streetwear labels continue attracting attention. Pieces connected to [mixedemotionshops.com](http://mixedemotionshops.com) often reflect that emotional side of modern fashion through relaxed silhouettes and mood-driven styling. Streetwear feels stronger when it mirrors real personality instead of chasing internet attention. At the same time, some trends disappear quickly because they focus too heavily on shock value instead of wearability.

## Small Construction Details Change Everything

Premium streetwear often succeeds because of smaller details people notice only after repeated wear.

*   Double-stitched hems usually survive washing much longer than thin seams.

*   Heavy zipper pulls feel smoother and reduce twisting near hoodie pockets.

*   Dense cotton softens gradually without losing structure around the shoulders.

*   Strong denim keeps cleaner fading patterns near knees and pockets.

*   Ribbed cuffs with better elasticity help oversized hoodies maintain shape.

Those details become obvious after several months of regular use. I once compared two pairs of black denim jeans in the same fitting room, and one pair folded naturally around the ankle while the cheaper version created stiff horizontal creases. Construction quality caused that difference immediately. Good garments should move with your body instead of fighting against it. Streetwear also depends heavily on layering, so comfort matters throughout the entire outfit. Weak stitching around pockets becomes especially noticeable once heavier phones start pulling fabric downward. Fashion brands sometimes focus too much on visible logos while ignoring practical construction. That usually creates clothing that photographs well but feels disappointing after repeated wear. Comfortable pieces naturally become favorites because people actually want to keep wearing them week after week.

## Why Distressed Denim Still Dominates Luxury Streetwear

Denim remains one of the few fabrics that often looks better with age. Natural fading, softened texture, and subtle wear patterns give clothing personality over time. That lived-in appearance fits perfectly with modern streetwear styling. Distressed jeans especially became popular because they instantly add texture to simple outfits. However, low-quality distressing usually looks fake after close inspection. Better denim creates softer transitions around knees, thighs, and pocket edges. Machine-made distressing often appears too sharp and unnatural. I’ve also noticed that darker denim works especially well with oversized hoodies because it grounds the entire outfit visually. Light-wash jeans usually pair better with minimal layers and cleaner sneakers. Streetwear today combines luxury tailoring with vintage inspiration more than ever before. That balance explains why premium denim continues attracting attention despite changing trends. Clothing inspired by [Amiri](https://amirishop.com.mx/) often highlights distressed finishes, layered textures, slimmer denim cuts, and relaxed outerwear in a way that feels modern without becoming overly polished. Heavy denim does have one limitation, though. It can become uncomfortable during hotter months, especially when paired with layered hoodies or jackets. That’s why lighter cotton pants and shorts continue growing in popularity beside traditional denim pieces.

## Sneakers Became the Foundation of Daily Outfits

Sneakers shape modern outfits more than almost any other item. The wrong pair can completely disrupt proportions, especially with oversized silhouettes. Chunky sneakers dominated fashion for years, yet cleaner low-profile designs have slowly returned because they feel easier to wear daily. Comfort matters more now too. People increasingly avoid footwear that looks impressive but becomes painful after an hour outside. Better sneakers usually combine supportive cushioning with durable materials that soften naturally over time. Leather quality also changes how shoes age. Strong leather develops character through creasing, while cheaper synthetic materials often crack near flex points quickly. I once wore the same pair of leather sneakers through an entire rainy concert weekend, and the creases actually improved the overall look afterward. Cheap sneakers rarely age that gracefully. Neutral color palettes also create stronger combinations because they support the rest of the outfit instead of demanding attention constantly. Sneakers should complement clothing rather than dominate the entire look. That subtle balance keeps streetwear versatile across different situations and seasons.

## Why Streetwear Continues Growing Across Generations

Streetwear keeps expanding because it adapts faster than traditional fashion categories. Younger buyers care about comfort, identity, and flexibility all at once. Meanwhile, older shoppers increasingly appreciate relaxed tailoring and durable materials too. That overlap keeps luxury streetwear relevant across multiple age groups. Fashion trends usually disappear once they become too rigid, but streetwear changes constantly through music, internet culture, sports, and art influences. One season may favor oversized silhouettes, while another shifts toward slimmer fits and cleaner layering. The core idea still remains personal expression through comfortable clothing. Social media accelerated trend cycles dramatically, yet it also helped smaller designers gain attention worldwide. However, online hype sometimes creates unrealistic expectations around limited releases. Expensive clothing doesn’t automatically guarantee quality. Often the strongest pieces are simple garments made with good fabric and thoughtful construction. I think people increasingly value emotional connection over flashy branding alone. They want outfits that feel authentic during daily life rather than costumes designed for photos. That desire keeps modern streetwear evolving while still maintaining its original spirit.

body.title: DIY!! Step-by-Step Guide to Recycling Old Jeans trouser into a Skirt
body.body:
Hello hive.




![Collage 2026-06-16 12-40-44.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AKLsiAKBBhpVW2MXiwFfju8x5rTnS5AnKLaX1JnXFuffpHB7Cfeyxt85uLuLXTp.png)

Good afternoon, DIYhud community! ✂️✨

Today, I’ll be sharing how I transformed my old jean trousers into a beautiful skirt. This is actually my first time trying this, and I must say—the result turned out amazing! I’m so excited to show you the process and the final look. ✨


How to Convert Jeans Trousers into a Skirt (Step-by-Step Guide)
Transforming an old pair of jeans into a stylish skirt is a simple and creative sewing project. Follow these steps carefully to achieve a neat and professional result.



![IMG_20260616_091133_451~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23zbKXmJWmivqQ9EDyYeFCrcTdK83z7LhVN3uPwZDy2Pd52Wen7Qh1JcmdjcD12kYM2zg.jpg)




Step 1: Measure and Mark the Length
Start by folding the jeans trousers evenly, aligning both legs together. Decide on the desired length of your skirt.  measure 22 inches plus 1 inch for hemming allowance, making it 23 inches in total. Use a chalk or fabric marker to draw a straight line across both legs. Cut off the excess fabric neatly.




![IMG_20260616_092121_394.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AK54rAKuU2trojhUUUDALWS7HNmZFkaHhQiGQ7Dj52WMqGfseNhxgLV3prYY8qo.jpg)

![IMG_20260616_091921_412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AJmr34yuFwsPVP11aBFUfvdKdWURDAzwpTtX23VGhSAtzgvrnAezGNAwk99EPY1.jpg)



Step 2: Open the Side Seams
Next, use a seam ripper or razor blade to carefully loosen the side seams of the trousers. This will help you reshape the jeans into a skirt more easily. Be gentle to avoid damaging the fabric. Once the sides are open, lay the jeans flat on your working surface.



![IMG_20260616_094743_103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AJoJc8jo9xWtFXoPkpEbi3QRNwdV43SJxKHpaoVgBHDrHHDnZtdm5DDKdRzauYk.jpg)

![IMG_20260616_094718_860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AJoJtcvygBSVFw921PawB2WAeLibLRogCoN94BbTSVPWAvyjd46zUoi6EYKSvMD.jpg)

![IMG_20260616_094418_667.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AKpADsQxNwD7hYSYFxDYTxh8tF4fHb21Zb739T3GMyYeoTY13uiC5KNm9ojUctY.jpg)




Step 3: Open and Reshape the Crotch Area
Now, focus on the crotch (curve) area of both the front and back. Carefully unpick the stitches in this area so the fabric can spread flat. After opening it up, rearrange the fabric so it forms a straight line rather than a curve. You may need to overlap the fabric slightly to achieve a smooth shape.
Once satisfied, sew a straight stitch along the new seam line. For durability and a clean finish, add a topstitch both inside and outside of the seam for both the front and back sections.




![IMG_20260616_102126_442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AKbE4YRVPZ6fCMd2HAh4DarsLt9hch3RC4c6yMtdrSsoVNPqdM3BkYefqBSmzaA.jpg)

![IMG_20260616_101144_010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AK6Y2CuYcwNpikMVUAXc59w9CuMWqw6YEBQGjyK4n2AMtHPTBzudp39DbVBSPxX.jpg)

![IMG_20260616_100902_562.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AK56BfKYh2t5gripFsxJpTcCxy1Y8myFQRoyx6ft2d8gGq39RnW13AQ8ovCHr12.jpg)




Step 4: Shape the Skirt to Fit
Turn the skirt inside out and begin shaping it according to your body measurements. In this case, use waist: 27 inches and hip: 35 inches. Pin along the sides to achieve a fitted look, then sew along the pinned lines. Trim off any excess fabric and neaten the seams.
Finally, fold the bottom edge (hem) by the 1-inch allowance you added earlier. Sew a straight stitch around the hem to give your skirt a polished finish.
With these steps, you can easily turn an old pair of jeans into a fashionable skirt perfect for casual wear.

body.title: A  Day in My Life Blog: Thank God for His Blessings as We Received a 10 Kls. Rice from the National Government. A Rice for all Filipinos! 🤗😇🙏
body.body: **Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!** I am not able to share my blog post yesterday as I slept early for I am a bit busy with many things that I've did. I needed to rest knowing that my body is still on process of recovery. We also take good care of our body as God entrusted it to us. So whatever happened to our body, it is us to be blame and we can't do anything if our body is weak and the worst thing if we have illness be happen that is why we should always take good care of our body and our health. Now, with regards to my blog post today. It will be all about the distribution of 10 Kls. Rice from the National Government and it is all household to be received, and thank God for we also received. I am happy to share the happenings during the distribution as it is a blessings from God. But before I get started, I will never forget to share my thanksgiving first most especially to God, to all Admins, all Curators and even to all commenters, thank you di so much. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVAYq9xJaKYzSbsmRTacZSZ1wb81dsvaqWHHPXZy1C2Xh/1781609509766.png) The distribution of 10 Kls. Rice happened today held in our Barangay's Covered Court. At first, I didn't know about this rice distribution but thank God as one of our Church Members told me about this as we met each other when I sent my Nephew at their School. At the time I know about this, I immediately told my Mother as she is the beneficiary of the Rice as she is our household head. When she knew about this, she immediately prepared all requirements needed. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXs6nmFD19ob7u11FqpFkQ9m5LdUfBzCPpMFW4PtdhXT/1781610361529.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbfhD1vrKU4MuxoLYLkz1wBsaX7dLbD5KFen76X8RE53j/1781610361681.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcSdB3tStecPJm5Kg7YyhTWHsbsCEJ6DPyjQ3yG4CtbUB/1781610361810.jpg) The program which is the distribution of Rice was told to start by 8:00 in the morning, and so we prepare ourselves immediately so we can go to the Covered Court immediately too. As we arrived, it was already started but the distribution is not yet started. Many people were here already as it is for all housrhold members of the Barangay. So many people will receive a rice from the Government. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNxdAdhZ2PB9peFxUfeuVq7a8eWUN5vy6E4ZUtZrhpP7/1781610687859.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaD4RoyphYeQnXzJz4L5yZsr6fcisgdaiKhTsXK8vw2kP/1781610687991.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeEzHmQRejqNxmwxPzhek6N1tKG9pM4D4ZnZZsLyJBfgt/1781610688162.jpg) As we arrived, my Mother immediately looked for the table assigned for our Purok which is Purok 3 where her name be found for verification and many were already fall in line. But since she is a Senior Citizen, she has will going to line to the priority lane where all Senior City will go to fall in line and they will be much priority to be served and that she immediately finished the verify process. It is also good to know that aside from the distribution of rice, their is also a medical checkup for monitoring. And since my Mother immediately finished the verification process early, she also went to the medical area to check her Blood Pressure and good know it is good. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYz9nVaEyvuaZJUTDqPDWwP6ZrvVTuiv4exN23z7Ezfu9/1781611017627.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTmxSzXifXBX3iCfcfoDKRLrHmvfWy7rF4hmnJsgxaVph/1781611017762.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYVgBFKp9LJE9rVZzBsxWjEDDKFbiac7YUVLPK95ZDbt8/1781611017870.jpg) That was around 9:00 in the morning when the program has officially started as our Municipal Mayor and Officials had finally arrived as with their coordination, this distribition made happened in reality. They have been given a time to share a short message and to explain why this happened and telling that this program from the National Government were also happening all over the Philippines. It takes only around 20 minutes the program has been ended as they needed to end this early as they will be going to other Barangay for distribution of rice also. But before they left, a picture taking has been happen for documentation purposes. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmThc8uyRPNNJXBMAdiMVpCWjAzUJspcYck26FDpd5LPos/1781611357929.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeU4z1QjKu3BG1uFjB76rQbwT1JG4QgBbMNbtGioTboVp/1781611358098.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcJhbk7YsnvBDjgkPwDiTKf52pB4ziXFqCvfW48c2T9DG/1781611358140.jpg) After that the program has been finally ended, it is now time for the distribution of 10 Kls. Rice to all who has been verified wnd and they have already their claim stab to be presented when claiming. Knowing that many people will be given a rice, and it is hard if it will not be properly distributed. What they have instructed is that, the first to be given are the Person with Disability and to all Senior Citizens. It is good that this instructions are given as we all know that they were needed to prioritize most especially with their conditions. And so my Mother immediately go first and fall in line so she will receive her allocation. She took only for a while and finally she received her rice, and I immediately get it as she can't carry it with her own. We then immediately went back home after. We just thank and praise God for this blessings He has given to us. Even if it is just 10 Kls of Rice but still it is a big help for us most especially in this crises we feel this year. All of this, I thank God above all and to all who organized this from the National Government. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

body.title: Rare Action Figure Values Across Vintage Toy Market Trends
body.body:
Have you ever found an old toy tucked away in storage and instantly remembered childhood days? Many collectors still search for figures they missed years ago or once owned as kids. [Action Figure Values](https://brianstoys.com/we-buy-modern-star-wars-toys/) may increase when figures include original packaging, bright colors, and untouched accessories. Vintage toys connected with popular movies, cartoons, and comic characters continue drawing attention from collectors who enjoy displaying nostalgic pieces inside personal collections for many years with lasting memories and strong emotional childhood connections.

## Exploring Action Figure Values in Collector Communities

**Vintage Packaging and Display Appeal**

When acquiring vintage figures, collectors often examine card backs, plastic bubbles, and printed artwork. The use of bright package coloring and presentation seals tends to have more collector appeal when selling privately and at conventions. Minor packaging marks or faded printing can influence purchasing decisions among experienced enthusiasts worldwide today.

**Character Releases from Earlier Eras**

Established toy lines that relate to famous movies and cartoons are still known by those who are long-time collectors. Figures issued in original production years tend to garner more debate in collecting circles. Most fans generally contrast the early versions with the later ones to detect some manufacturing details and packaging variations across generations with caution.

**Rare Accessories and Factory Variations**

Some collectible figures are sought after since original accessories are hard to find decades after the figures have been in circulation. Minor variations in production that include paint applications, accessory molds, or labeling on their packages are common topics of interest among collectors. Usually, the Action Figure Values change very quickly when unusual variations are accepted all over collector markets and auctions around the world.

**Convention Trading and Collector Interest**

Toy conventions generate dynamic trading situations in which collectors seek hard-to-find inventory and rare figure releases. During these events, sellers usually show older collectibles that are related to science fiction, comic characters, and action franchises. Trends in regional demand sometimes vary when something that was not given a wide audience is introduced during appearances at conventions.

**Figure Grading and Preservation Standards**

Professional grading services are also gaining popularity with collectors who want documented condition ratings of older figures and sealed packaging. Verified assessments of encased collectibles are often found in premium auctions and in dedicated retailer listings. Detailed condition reviews also aid the collecting community in comparing similar issues, as well as keeping orderly records to track such issues long-term.

## Conclusion

Action Figure Values are also tightly linked to the quality of packaging, the collectible rarity, production information, as well as the continued demand of the collectors in the specialized markets. Hobbyists still seek out older toy releases via conventions, auctions, and reputable collectible dealers when seeking preserved figures that are associated with popular entertainment properties that remain popular with serious collectors today across all generations around the world.

body.title: To come back with teeth
body.body: I will say, editing a book is nothing like writing a book. It's full of lessons in humility and going \

. All sorts of violent predicaments ensue, but I manage to pick my way through most of them. Right now, the biggest challenge is to (in the words of a great writer whose name eludes me) pick apart everything that is not the story, and kindly set it aside. It's not easy, especially when you're so keen on introspection and self-discovery, but I force myself to put aside my psychologist's glasses, and look at it from a writer's perspective.
alt=\

> There comes a time when I get to look at it from a reader's perspective, and it was here a while ago, but it's not here now. I'm having a good time, though. I realize how much work goes into writing properly. How little I thought of it, when I was younger. How I thought I could just write anything and call it a masterpiece, except it doesn't really work like that. It's grueling, and I am, as I go, a little worried about getting trapped inside this never-ending process. I hope not. I've promised myself one more round, and then I'll give it out for beta reading. We'll see from there on how many more rounds come up. Down the process, I've come up against several worthwhile questions. Like. > Who is speaking? How are the characters distinct enough from the beating core of them all, which is myself, to be on their own recognizable? > Why is this story worth telling? And why is it worth telling now? In a way, it's a story as old as time. All of them are. Which isn't necessarily a good answer. I have some idea why now, and even why it's worth telling in the first place, but I think I'm still defining this answer. > How is the story salting the protagonist? Because if it's not, what is the point? I find this one particularly difficult to answer, because I observe myself, and see the ways in which my own story has salted me, but know also of the secret, sacred place in which I am still a child, and find it hard not to remember that place also, for my characters. It's quite an interesting ride, one I'm very excited to be on at the moment. And all this ramble, just to tell you I haven't had much time for music, so I've gone, as is my custom, back to songs I carried with me through my own salting. Songs that helped me come back with teeth, which now help me edit this story. Ahoj, @ablaze! https://youtu.be/n839w0UrXZk?si=KtYtpbBUP36WjolA In many ways, it is a story about living a life not meant for you, about having your life blocked (if not always through malevolence). Perhaps that's why I've come back to this now. https://youtu.be/RFfsKNqmiGc?si=Fz0-xrI8MTY8Z6e- > Cause I can make you every inch a king Before I do it, tell me, tell me what's in it for me? Because as I mature with my writing, I find ways to include my sexuality into my work without it being wanton, or just for the sake of provocation. https://youtu.be/r6sRKbzXzPM?si=1gp5dsQ_rHjDkAYK Because sure, isn't it also in many ways a story of coming back with some fucking teeth? ### What are you listening to?

body.title: We’re Running, But Where?  / Koşuyoruz Ama Nereye?  ( EN-TR)
body.body:
![IMG20241116132902-EFFECTS.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3Pjy7evkFN9VBWrapksXXrA3PUqki6SS1gLMdW4zsSS/IMG20241116132902-EFFECTS.jpg) 

Although living in big cities may seem advantageous, we have begun to feel the challenges of this lifestyle more acutely, especially in recent years. This is because living in big cities has both physical and psychological effects on people. Looking at the present day, the majority of the population lives in large cities. This proportion is increasing day by day. Due to rising demands, cities often begin to grow not in a planned manner, but in an uncontrolled and disorderly way. This situation also leads to a decline in quality of life. It directly affects not only the physical environment but also people’s social lives and their mental and psychological well-being.

>Büyük şehirlerde yaşamak her ne kadar avantajlı gibi görünse de  özellikle son yıllarda bu yaşam biçiminin getirdiği zorlukları daha fazla hissetmeye başladık. Çünkü büyük şehirlerde yaşamanın insan üzerinde hem fiziksel hem de psikolojik etkileri oluyor. Günümüze baktığımızda insan nüfusunun çoğunluğu büyük şehirlerde yaşıyor. Bu oran  gün geçtikte artıyor. Artan talepler sebebiyle şehirler çoğu zaman planlı bir şekilde değil, kontrolsuz ve düzensiz bir şekilde büyümeye başlıyor. Bu durum yaşam kalitesinin düşmesine de neden oluyor. Bu durum yalnızca fiziksel çevreyi değil, insanların sosyal yaşamını ve ruhsal olarak psikolojik sorunlarını da doğrudan etkiliyor. 
  ![IMG20260606193353.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNmqBJfuDusRMzr11jiZduQDhAmQmyfJUonFsNEnVZ8dz/IMG20260606193353.jpg) 

   ![IMG20240922115422.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNUMnmr446ZLHQWnZXcBUGM5XfU3uE7oomSTKuM4DsK9Z/IMG20240922115422.jpg) 

Although I don’t particularly like being in the city center, my job sometimes requires me to pass through the streets and routes right in the heart of downtown. I see that there are always more people, more cars, and a serious traffic problem around me. People living in big cities spend a large portion of their time stuck in traffic just to get from one place to another. This situation forces people to endure a noisy environment, excessive exhaust fumes, and constant stress. 

>Şehir merkezinde olmayı pek sevmesemde işim dolayısıyla bazen merkezin ortasında caddelerde ve yol güzerhahlarından geçmek zurunda kalıyorum. Etrafımda hep daha fazla insan daha fazla araç ve ciddi bir trafik sorunu olduğunu görüyorum. Büyük şehirlerde yaşayanlar bir yerden bir yere ulaşmak için zamnının büyük bir bölümünü trafikte geçiriyorlar. Bu durumda insaları gürültü ortamda, aşırı dozda ezgoz salınımına ve stres altında kalmaya itiyor. 


 ![IMG20240922134137.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ287EodXaVCcb7PJHBdYKJShLbJxttuRdp5xQQsR6pW3/IMG20240922134137.jpg) 

  ![IMG20240922132414.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP56pdFSZ9ysAZ1nyQppee3jwsUFrgxes1g6dG8SmEe2e/IMG20240922132414.jpg)

When I compare the cities of my childhood with today’s cities, it’s impossible not to notice the difference. We used to have neighborhoods. Now those neighborhoods have been replaced by housing complexes and apartment buildings. Back then, when we went outside, we could run through the greenery on open fields. Now there are buildings that even block out the sky. These ever-rising concrete structures are slowly pushing nature and people into the background. 
  
>Çocukluğumdaki şehirlerle, şimdiki şehirleri karşılaştırınca aradaki farkı görmemmek mümkün değil. Eskiden mahallelerimiz vardı. Şimdi o mahallelerin yerini siteler ve apartmanlar almış durumda. Eskiden dışarı çıktığımızda boş arazilerde yeşilliklerin üstünde koşabiliyorduk. Şimdi gökyüzünü bile kapatan binalar var. Her geçen gün biraz daha yükselen beton yığınları, doğayı ve insanı yavaş yavaş arka plana atıyor. 

 ![IMG20260606185024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf3566iM2P4UsT5gr7EX3kBviJgcEntBD3NEe68yARpjX/IMG20260606185024.jpg) 

  ![IMG20241018124631.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNvKMkdms5FA9ztt68uHXxQ7KtJ7Ft61TqsTDNFxKMPCi/IMG20241018124631.jpg) 

   ![IMG20241029152524.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVPpAuSiFQXKxYByCae8aXg9KXzxJ9N1VmbyXNsscE18/IMG20241029152524.jpg) 

  ![IMG20241004130906.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWuKf9m8KBH8D2XHA42hLJFjtGpQFw4pKuSJJfC6SeJc9/IMG20241004130906.jpg) 

As technology advances, the internet has become central to our lives. But for some reason, many of us feel like we have less time. Everyone I’ve spoken to says the same thing: “I don’t have time; I can’t keep up.” People living in big cities know exactly what I mean. Once, I drove to an area in the city center that the navigation app said would take 15 minutes, but it took me 50 minutes. When you’re sitting in the car waiting, you can’t help but think. You realize how time is being wasted and that none of this is worth it. 

>Teknoloji geliştikçe, internet hayatımızın merkezi haline geldi. Ama nedense belki de çoğumuz daha az zamana sahipmiş gibi hissediyoruz. Kiminle konuştuysam herkes aynı şeyi söylüyor. \

Büyük şehirlerde yaşayanlar ne demek istediğimi daha iyi biliyorlar. Bir keresinde şehir merkezinde aracımla navigasyonda 15 dakika gösteren bir bölgeye 50 dakikada gittim. İnsan aracın içinde beklerken ister istemez düşünüyor. Zamanın  nasıl boşa geçtiğini ve tüm bu yapılanlara değecek bir şeylerin olmadığının farkına varıyor. 

 ![IMG20240920122743.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYehdhyNNHWaH2UkJBVcR6P3iSGaXtLZK1k5EYgYjTHoW/IMG20240920122743.jpg) 

  ![IMG20240920122248.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYX8qcKsxqY7mr35C7KezeaiQyvwunSZjqvZsietFJHe3/IMG20240920122248.jpg) 

Surveys are conducted worldwide to assess people’s quality of life. One of the most frequently asked questions regarding life is, “Are you happy with your life?” In fact, this question encompasses many details. It involves factors such as education, health, leisure, and entertainment, as well as man-made amenities and employment opportunities. 


>İnsanların yaşam kaliteleriyle ilgili dünya genelinde anketler yapılıyor. Yaşam konusunda en çok sorulan sorulardan biri de \

Aslında bu sorunun içinde bir çok detay yatıyor. Eğitim, sağlık, dinlenme ve eğlence gibi hizmetlerin yanında insan eliyle yaratılmış özelliklerin ve iş olanaklarının yer aldığı faktörler yatmaktadır. 

 ![IMG20241104124346.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJiHLV2oMPv9WiS8jZ4kJ6YKX3noZ8bKQP6sX5XRRzQq/IMG20241104124346.jpg) 

  ![IMG20260501164748.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdSAao7KnKtmiCwucXPTjgo22jpbSTMNebPXUYS1unjQr/IMG20260501164748.jpg) 

The country’s culture of prosperity and equality takes shape based on the opportunities society offers its citizens. As a result, income levels, educational attainment, and social life begin to take shape. Ultimately, this system determines people’s quality of life. I’ve noticed recently that people tend to think they’ll be happier as their quality of life improves—that is, as their income rises. Yet there is very little connection between happiness and money. The connection lies in the fact that happiness comes when money is spent wisely. 


>Toplumun bireylere sunduğu imkanlar doğrultusunda ülkenin ferah ve eşitlik adateti şekilleniyor. Bunun sonucunda da gelir düzeyi, eğitim düzeyi ve sosyal hayat belirginleşmeye başlıyor. Bu sistemin sonunda kişilerin yaşam kalitesi ortya çıkıyor. Son zamanlarda dikkat ediyorum, insanların yaşam kalitesi arttukça yani gelir seviyesi yükseldikçe mutlu olacaklarını düşünüyorlar. Oysa mutluluk ile para arasında çok az bir ilişki var. O ilişki de para doğru harcandığında mutluluk getiriyor ilişkisidir. 

 ![IMG20260424101639.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVpTGJc5eU11wjS7yhkqdQSfpEe5CxLQN2Un5fbTqtKt4/IMG20260424101639.jpg) 

  ![IMG20260424105026 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbVGBGySz7sTfJ8crpx68798XEr9kMNpTmekY7VGbxWDP/IMG20260424105026%20(1).jpg) 

Everyone wants to secure their future in some way. That’s only natural. We’re constantly striving to earn more and live better. In fact, we’ve entered an era where there are more ways than ever to make money through social media. Amid all this chaos, we can still hold on to the beautiful things in life. I see people going for morning walks. There are people who bike to work. I see people reading books under the shade of a tree or on a park bench. I feel happy whenever I see people stepping away from their phones just to watch the sunset. 

>Herkes hayatını bir şekilde güvence altına almak istiyor. Bu çok doğal. Daha fazla kazanmak, daha iyi yaşamak için sürekli bir çaba halindeyiz. Hatta sosyal medyayı kullanarak para kazanma yollarının son zamanlarda daha çok olduğunu bir döneme girdik. Bütün bu kargaşanın içinde hala güzel şeylere tutunabiliyoruz. Sabah yürüyüşe çıkan insanları görüyorum. Bisiklette işe giden insanlar oluyor. Bir ağacın gölgesinde ya da bir parkın bankında kitap okuyan insanları görüyorum. Telefonundan uzaklaşıp sadece gün batımını izleyenler insanları gördükçe mutlu oluyorum. 

 ![IMG20260424105715 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJ3nVLmUCkmSZux8i4gFsfmuugMJrurHbpPmGTYigToA/IMG20260424105715%20(1).jpg) 

  ![IMG20241116133829.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaWPLRxttXbdKrU1h5gwwFJWKrMJ2panC7vCTFuSjXYTQ/IMG20241116133829.jpg) 

I’d also like to touch on Monday—one of those days we choose to start anew and refresh ourselves. When the alarm goes off on Monday morning, let’s set aside the sadness of the week ending and the feelings that the start of the week will set the stage for new stresses. Actually, there’s no point in blaming Monday for everything. It’s just one of those innocent days that suddenly erases the traces of a wonderful weekend. But turning the situation to our advantage is still in our hands. Now, look in the mirror and give yourself a wink. Start the day strong and energetic.

>Birde her şeye yeniden başladığımız ve kendimizi yenilemek için seçtiğimiz günlerden biri olan Pazartesi gününe değinmek istiyorum. Pazartesi sabahı alarm çaldığında hafta bitişinin üzüntüsü ve hafta başının yeni streslere zemin hazırlayacağını düşündüğümüz duygularımıız bir kenara atalım. Aslında bütün suçu Pazartesi gününe atmanın da bir anlamı yok. O sadece güzel geçen bir hafta sonunun izlerini bir anda yok ettiği masun günlerden biridir. Ama durumu lehimize çevirmek yine bizim elimizde. Şimdi aynaya geçip, kendinize bir göz kırpın. Güne güçlü ve enerjik başlayın.

 ![IMG20241116133947.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZGFJRN9Hw6TgBw7MPJwtioArtLccy1McD2sacP3Weudw/IMG20241116133947.jpg) 

We may not be able to solve the world’s problems, but we can take a break from the hustle and bustle of our lives, take in the beauty around us, and make time for ourselves. Because for a fulfilling life, it’s not just about what we have; it’s also about with whom, where, and how we spend a large part of our time and energy. 


>Belki dünyanın sorunlarını çözemeyiz ama, kendi hayatımızın temposuna biraz ara vererek etrafımızdaki güzellikleri görerek  kendimize vakit ayırabiliriz. Çünkü kaliteli bir hayat için, sadece sahip olduklarımız değil; zamanımızı ve enerjimizin büyük bir bölümünü kiminle, nerede ve nasıl geçirdiğimiz de önemlidir.

body.title: Which is the Best Month to Visit Odisha?
body.body:
Odisha is one of India's most culturally rich destinations, known for its ancient temples, tribal communities, wildlife, and scenic landscapes. For travelers planning an [Odisha trip in India](https://www.brahmandtour.com/odisha-tribal-tour-package), the best time to visit is between October and March when the weather is pleasant and ideal for sightseeing.

Why is Winter the Best Season?

During the winter months, temperatures remain comfortable, making it easier to explore the state's diverse attractions. This is also the perfect season for an Odisha tribal tour, as visitors can comfortably travel through remote tribal regions and experience traditional weekly markets, local customs, and authentic village life.

What Can You Experience During This Period?

Popular experiences include:

*   \- Visiting tribal villages in southern Odisha

*   \- Exploring ancient temples and cultural heritage sites

*   \- Discovering tribal culture in India

*   \- Experiencing traditional festivals and local markets

*   \- Enjoying cultural tours in Odisha and rural landscapes

Is Odisha Worth Visiting for Cultural Travelers?

Absolutely. Odisha offers a unique blend of history, spirituality, and indigenous traditions. Travelers interested in tribal tourism in India often choose Odisha because of its diverse tribal communities and well-preserved cultural heritage.

For those seeking authentic experiences beyond mainstream destinations, an Odisha tribal tour during the winter season provides one of the most rewarding cultural journeys in India. Whether you are interested in heritage, photography, or local traditions, this is the ideal time to plan your Odisha trip in India.

body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdnYTErfH9yg1wsRQgcAUdEAYdttncaAiHoXKauC7NfdH/PXL_20240324_163250649.webp)

----------------------------

The news dropped yesterday that Tiffin University softball head coach Paige McMenemy will be leaving her position with the Dragons at taking the top spot at Division I Ohio University.  This is a big move up for Coach Paige who started her career with the Division II Tiffin Dragons five years ago.  She was a big part of the reason my niece decided on Tiffin for her university career.  

When she was hired in the 2022 season, she inherited a roster of scholarship athletes with just a handful of players she had hand picked.  My nieces was one of those players.  Through the years, she built the Dragons into a successful GMAC powerhouse through strategic transfers and recruitment.  

Her overall record is 152-108 with a conference record of 79-41.  As I said before though, a lot of those early loses were with a team that wasn't fully her own.  She had obligations she had to fulfill to scholarship players who didn't necessarily fit into her culture of softball.  As those players graduated or transferred out, she was able to put together a tight knit group of ladies with a solid commitment and work ethic. 

The teams peak came in 2025 when they had a record of 43-14 and then they had similar success in 2026 with a record of 34-16.  It will be interesting to see how many players decide to move with her from Tiffin to Ohio or if she has to completely start over.  Given that both schools are in Ohio, it might not be a big move for some of the players.  The other thing you have to take into account is the fact that in a Division II school, your sport isn't usually your life. If some of these players are close to graduating, they might just stay so they can be done.  That or end their softball career all-together.  

I've had the chance to meet coach on a few occasions and she has always seemed like a wonderful genuine person who cares about her players and how they are doing more than she cares about winning. Though winning is important too.  Even after she had her daughter and took a break from the team before finally retiring from softball, the coach always kept her involved and made her feel like part of the team.

That's the kind of coach you want to have, and the players at Ohio as well as the entire student body are lucky to have Coach McMenemy on their team.

body.title: Welcome to Macahambus Cave Lumbia Cagayan De Oro : A Historical Hidden Place During Philippine -American Battle
body.body:
One of the famous tourist destination aside from water rafting activity is visiting Macahambus Cave a historical nature destination experience nature escape located in Lumbia Cagayan de Oro City.




![Brown Collage Quote Instagram Post (11).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/AK9QDjEvjfEYD1u9Sd9ZMCGhzw6rE7MjWCQzMyEqpLUa9A3EaGfiLDqtPsGfkJm.png)

It was dicovered during the battle war  of Kagay anon's and americans during 1900 which became a hidden place of kagay anon soldiers.




![e3df12e9-5593-4d4d-bef8-0f55b7936fa0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23zRxjGTxRDdEuMH99HDdSgeGarnszt7C16A9VjCAeTLwfSHDvgDeRMt2keuBCvJDAhQ9.jpg)

![00c7471a-6584-464b-aa6d-4c2a952440eb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23uFUA9kee9za8j3gLqjqmgNCztZYMKiE1e8DBe2oFF7GEPsAUY2ABHAJ1cFoTKsvYJDo.jpg)

My first visit here was when I was in my first year high school when my classmates invited me to visit macahambus cave and became my first cave adventure.I didn't expect at first that at the end of the tunnel cave there is an exit going to the other mountain where you could see nature forest and mountains.




![3181dc83-17dd-4577-aa51-5f5d2ba3ecea.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23xAVbsBF3De2hRMQMjHNoRmeKk7coRxcAf6QWXk3Xj2bst793Ua7nXdDYEpDMwAF4PjW.jpg)

![1a59687b-a310-4a5d-8a38-7fe608322cff.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23x15Ee5njMPDWF9sR14w5HTyRRbRmn1qFsXs2Q4hxQ29dWRCAz7JBuDVda95y6To6sKW.jpg)

A few days ago while we are having a mall visit at SM Uptown I decided to try visiting back again Macahambus cave as it is 30 minutes away from SM Uptown going to Lumbia where the cave is located.



![e029bf49-a56b-44e6-b757-4c8649b60aeb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23v4QiX6yx2a1DzmeUBajcaCnUEdfrb1h5KdA1J9Zjbd9stR2KfQe4xwUi97B81SiFF3T.jpg)

![275f7641-68be-4600-834e-530b6044ac70.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23v4R1TgYm5QUNMJVQJ8k4yeybybf1ry4WYJn76Zbgp4Dh9h3XP32tKZ2LTiKs8rCsbSK.jpg)


We took a Lumbia jeepney to get to Macahambus cave as it is very accessible to travel now unlike way back during my high school days.I noticed that it is well developed already by the Cagayan de Oro City government.




![eb53cd99-d29c-4380-92df-77849acd9f9d.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23wMRnU7nCNRFNY1cK1iFpibxV1xeEpqFoUUea9iZX59N4mgThRaPRsyVuiw9tP2oPFeU.jpg)

![4669efb5-257e-45cf-a0ec-efd1405d2ba7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23wMQEKh9zUkk1jFx1RPnDjRaro3KBdbgTEJPgKaAn429SQcdDTv3ZPVULJWHvmCawB5t.jpg)

It is covered with limestimes with different rock's formation that adds attraction and if you bring flashlights you will see some bat's too.

This is my second time visit and I am surprised that the hallway of the cave is not that rough with stones like before and there is already a stairway going down to the river which before there is no stairway.


How to get to Macahambus Cave :

It is easier now to visit Macahambus cave unlike before as there are too many jeepneys passing by and it is located along Lumbia highway.

-From Carmen Market Cagayan de Oro City you can take a jeepney going to Lumbia

- the fare of the jeepney going to Lumbia is only 50 pesos

- the travel from Carmen Market to Lumbia took only 1 hour

-Just tell the driver to stop by in front of Macahambus Cave entrance




![a6f76569-ed5d-4cdc-8167-711ffc122305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23zv9DrFPK8qr59MaGkgBrtKdZJ6zEJCcGnvZupTwVHdk1RveAizf8VYQa4cyGw4GKquz.jpg)

![63db99ac-23c5-4c05-b6cd-59a755dcead1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/241QM9kKcseg3pMkik9LpFddAmm5ZW1u2kCPGXc6AXfz8VQ7FvipEzp7XkkUzj5VvTdFV.jpg)

Another option is you can also take a jeepney from SM uptown mall going to Macahambus cave.



![0d573da2-edab-4385-9774-3ac6063a15d6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23xVPAa8UZy4e1t7cb4UFUzbE8JzMDNHzWet4nFWMAaxfnu5bfYzoqMkd2pTyyYZhdrRs.jpg)

![386c7c83-795c-4cf8-8ce4-7f3f53db7d59.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23x1BcGyjd5cRazsAi5CiVYTnPDhVM8svhKJrbVqbpRnm4cxTY8VbuCE55Sa9nDk1xngP.jpg)

In the next day were planning to visit a waterfalls in Baungon Bukidnon.I never thought that there is a waterfalls in Baungon until my relative told me then I am excited to visit.


Pictures are mine edited by canva

body.body: ![56463293-A3CE-41D2-BB19-88D2D3604AFD_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eonm4c9fqmUKnqcUgy9grpzuYM1iAkBnH3E2xnv84TDHS2Ytpq3G1hMvBTWkXa2ioNH.jpeg) [Click here to read this post in **English**](#english)

> Hola querido hiver. Era una tarde del mes de diciembre. Había quedado con unas amigas para visitar el mercadillo navideño y llegué con bastante tiempo de antelación para hacer un recado previo. Al terminar más pronto de lo esperado me encontré con más de una hora libre en un día con espesa niebla que enfriaba hasta los huesos. Recordé que había cerca un centro cultural en el que casi siempre se encuentra alguna exposición interesante. Era perfecto para estar entretenida y caliente al mismo tiempo, por lo que allí me encaminé. Lo que encontré es lo que aquí te comparto. ![3F49F690-E37D-4F7E-BF51-CA9FB1A2EDA8_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EouB8QP5mKiLkhD2tAFpDmY1oTjXktDCGob8zj7bS6gbGKBqBtYSzUsDCwAVMnGGSGG.jpeg) ![E66C0B12-4885-47D4-9FFA-A364F1F41327_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/23ydEAqP572v6tbkZKe2KWbar8pHCxxwz11uPVkojMTYBXZrdLbwh7FaNMd6iivFEX3qG.jpeg) ![AF3CBCC0-340C-4052-A6F3-89677D15A054_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EprVbAMYyHCSQCtZ8DWVsYyKMGr9z13YFTR8N6HFzAisfbPSfBX7pziWu7JFGB5ipYR.jpeg) Cuando vi los colores llamativos y las formas sencillas pero sugerentes no pude más que disponerme a disfrutar de las obras de arte. ![3074DCB8-4B0C-4C8F-86C6-B9F32748106E_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EowH3kwg9wYPbP3v4ymNzqrz7oEgp1RqmPMtYMWrhwrP1zANHqLMTw6XtCvnL15DqAE.jpeg) ![59173AA6-32DA-4FCE-8CBB-CB8D777D40A1_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/23r1kquvwkvxXV9GBgMbc7xszddT1GgKQC1LcHH1gHXKZeonjFaUKKMP5XdPBG8ZEZ2EG.jpeg) ![B1BE3F63-4D23-43A2-896A-D3A8DBD47C15_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoeFtHQhj176sGXDX5Sqe38ejovjT2ciM4EqMDmNnP9Qxhv9qGyxRvXU8w7avEdfsZF.jpeg) El cartel introductorio de la exposición, titulada *Ande o no ande* indicaba que los artífices eran el grupo artítico Andar de Nones. Era la primera vez que sabía de ellos. Definían estas pinturas como un caos controlado que es fascinante de contemplar en formato gigante. body.title: Beyond Punishment: Understanding the Roots of Crime
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhiREjieMcfbepCh1nuEiC6bqsqN1Ah2QwMsxntQdQg8/1781611002768.jpg)

\

This question came into my mind so many times after seeing the condition of my own country. Even though they're many laws created for crimes yet the justice is not served. Before doing any crimes, people would not fear that much because they know that nothing will happen to them. They stay relaxed because getting away is really easy. After committing crimes barely a few got justice and the rest of the cases are still on waiting list for years and years. The greatest suffering is faced by the victims' families who keep returning to court in the hope of justice only to face delays and disappointment. As the justice system is very poor in our country that's why the crime rate is increasing day by day. Victim blaming is very common here, more than the criminals the victims suffers the most. When a girl is molested, people often question what they were wearing or why they were outside at night instead of focusing on the person who committed the crime. No one is concerned about the victim. On the other hand if it was a boy who was molested people would laugh and make fun of it. So, If the people of a country continue to think this way, I do not believe that any form of punishment alone can stop such crimes. Because the citizens are already clarifying and justifying why the criminal attempted such an inhuman act. This sends the message that such inhuman behavior can be excused rather than condemned. Well, if there was no punishment then there would be more crimes than it is now. Some people might have wild thoughts but they fear of getting punished and avoid doing it, but those who doesn't have any kind of fear who will stop them? Anyway, punishment seems logical many people would avoid crime. However, crimes still happen every day. In my opinion, punishments work only when people think about them before acting. They would only think about it when they know that their excuses will never be accepted by the society, that they are the one who did wrong not the victim. It will make the criminal feel guilty when no one will take their side. But if people justify criminals crime then it would encourage other criminal minded people to attempt crimes. There are currently many child abuse cases where they were molested and later deceased. It was both girl and boy and I don't know how they are going to justify it now, like what could a child wear? It was never about the clothes; it has always been about people with dirty minds. I believe if someone is having such bad thoughts they should consult a doctor because they are not in their right mind. It's not a normal thing at all. This kind of behaviour is a sign of a deeply disturbed mindset. So, let's not blame the victims for the choices that criminals make. As we can already see that the fear of punishment was weaker than their harmful impulses and distorted thinking. Punishment alone is not enough. But punishments are necessary so that victims family can get justice, and people needs to pay for their karma. That doesn't doesn't mean we should view punishment as a magic solution because crime will decrease only when society understands the psychological reasons behind criminal behavior as well as the legal consequences. ____ The thumbnail is created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com). ____

body.title: PEOPLE DONT FEAR PUNISHMENT AS MUCH AS WE THINK.
body.body:
Hello Community,

When it comes to crime, one idea that invariably crops up is that harsher punishments would deter criminals from committing crime.

In a superficial sense, this makes sense.

After all, most people are aware of the repercussions of serious crime. They understand that they may be sent to prison if they rob. They understand that fraud can ruin lives and the individuals can be sent to jail for a long time. In other countries, some crimes can even merit the death penalty.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVzdSAsNoyBAJdcpXD889oxGFtCfKYh7LWahsDwuSvoDB/1781611219187.jpg)

However, crimes still occur on a daily basis.

Why?

Does this imply punishments don't work?

I feel like punishments work, but not too much.

Well, it's not as easy as counting the costs and the benefits of human behavior. If the consequences were sufficient to deter crime, then there would be no theft, frauds, drug trafficking, or violence because the risks are all too familiar.

But people still do.

One of the reasons is that many crimes are made in a second when no one is thinking about any punishment at all.

An angry person can assault someone without accounting for the years that they may serve in prison. A person that is drowning in debt can be more concerned about getting through the day than the legal repercussions of their behavior same as When a young person is affected by peers they might make rash choices because acceptance is more significant than risk.

In such cases, the punishments are in force, but are not being decided at the present time.

A second is the idea that, “I won't get caught.”

Not all criminals are criminals because they are looking for punishment.Not all criminals are criminals because they're looking for punishment. They make the mistakes believing that they are smarter than the system, luckier than those who came before them, or that they can beat the system.

This attitude is everywhere: in everyday thievery, from the big time cheats.

The problem is that the punishment isn't severe enough.

The problem is people do not think punishment is coming to them.

However, I feel punishment is still needed.

If there were no consequences in a society, it would quickly become chaotic. Laws are in place to safeguard people and penalties are in place to warn people that bad behaviour has bad consequences. They also serve as a source of justice for the victim and a way of keeping social order.

But punishment is not sufficient.

However, in the quest for reduced crime, it is important to consider the conditions that bolster crime.

Poverty.

Lack of education.

Unemployment.

Drug addiction.

Broken homes.

Lack of mental health care.

These can be no justification for criminal acts, but they can lead to conditions that make crime more likely.

Instead of being more effective at sending people to jail, addressing those root causes could be more effective at preventing more crimes.

I believe that rehabilitation needs to be given more attention, too.

Not all criminals are irretrievably lost some of them are truly feel remorse for their actions, and with the appropriate help, they can become useful members of society. If prisons provide only punishment without any opportunity for reform, then the mindset that got many people in the prison system may be the same one that will get them out.

For me the best justice system is one that is based on accountability and rehabilitation.

Individuals should be held accountable for their behavior, Victims deserve justice, Society deserves protection.

However, if all we can do is punish, then we risk getting the symptoms and not the disease.

Therefore, is punishment effective?

Yes, they do.

They discourage some, set limits and maintain righteousness.

However, they're not 'magic bullets.

Crime is a human issue – and fear is not a solution to human problems.

Safer societies cannot be achieved through tougher punishments.

What we need are stronger communities, better opportunities and systems that will enable people to make better choices, before they even get to the point of committing a crime.

body.title: Strategy stacks $100M in Bitcoin as buyers accumulate 259K BTC
body.body:
Good Morning Lions,

I've been watching accumulation patterns for years, and the signal I'm seeing right now is loud. Strategy just dropped $100 million on 1,587 Bitcoin while their USD reserves hit $1.1 billion — that's two weeks in a row of buying into weakness, not panic selling into it. On top of that, Glassnode's data shows investors have purchased a net 259,298 BTC between early June and now, picking away at prices between $59K and $67K. You don't buy like that if you think prices are headed lower — you buy like that when you believe you're getting a deal.

To me, this matters more than any headline about regulation or macro headwinds. When the smart money — the guys with real balance sheets, the guys who've survived cycles — starts stacking, it's worth paying attention. Could be wrong. But I'm not selling into this.

body.title: Gregarious Imp
body.body:
![1000137920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kemmyb/48SMu1ZCN1yHokEVQZc5guk1tpJUKSjP1nvFrTdLbCL8rUwYa2LQN3o5iSK3Pii1P3.png)![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

<div class=text-justify>

“What a *gregarious imp*!” 

Mabel shrieked, her deep-toned voice sounding in the kitchen like the wail of a banshee as she watched her nephew, Zack, scramble down the pastry shelf and zoom away like flash with three cupcakes clutched to his chest.

The tiny rogue even had the audacity to cackle like a villain who had just conquered a kingdom and made off with its treasures. 

Three cupcakes meant that Zack wasn't alone in this pastry heist. He and his partners in mischief, Jimmy and André, would devour the sugary delights and became even more hyperactive than they already were. 

She had placed the pastries on the top shelf in the pantry confident the boys wouldn't be able to reach them. It seemed their determination proved stronger than her logic.

Mabel stood with her hands on her hips, her eyes narrowed in concentration as an idea dropped into her mind. A slow smile spread across her face. 

She slipped out of the kitchen quietly to find the boys sitting in a circle under the old mango tree nibbling at the cupcakes. The boys froze when they saw her with a large bowl covered with a cloth.

“What have you got there?” André asked suspiciously. 

Mabel smiled sweetly. “Nothing. Just a special treat I was keeping for well behaved boys.” The boys immediately looked sober, glancing at each other and the cupcakes in their hands. “Not for boys who steal cupcakes from the pantry,” she added.

In a flash, they apologised blaming it all on Zack. Mabel tried to maintain a stern expression but their cute faces made her smile. “Fine. You can have the cupcakes if you help me with some chores in the kitchen, yeah?”

“Yes!” They chorused and followed her back into the kitchen.

body.title: The Danger of Seeking the Unseen: Understanding the Hadith on Fortune-Tellers 🔮🚫
body.body:
Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu, dear brothers and sisters of the Hive Islam community.
![images (1).jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWc8ia48cf2MtRMkD2zsRmz4BygnuqQmAefqCFwyhTaFh/images%20(1).jpeg)

In our fast-paced world, filled with uncertainties about the future—whether it's about our careers, marriages, or personal lives—it can be tempting for some to seek quick answers. Today, social media is flooded with modern \

disguised as tarot card readers, astrologers, and psychic mediums.
However, as Muslims, our faith firmly anchors us in the belief that the future (*Al-Ghaib*) belongs solely to Allah (SWT).
I wanted to share this crucial reminder with everyone today:
### 📖 The Hadith
As beautifully captured in the image above, the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) gave us a stern warning regarding this matter:
> **\

**
> — *Sahih Muslim (2230)*
> 
### 💡 Key Takeaways from this Reminder
 * **The Severity of the Act:** Just *asking* a fortune-teller out of curiosity, even if you don't necessarily believe them, carries the heavy penalty of having your prayers (*Salah*) unaccepted for 40 days. (Note: Scholars clarify that you must still pray your obligatory prayers, but you lose the spiritual reward for them during this period).
 * **The Trap of Shirk:** Believing that a human being has knowledge of the absolute future compromises our *Tawhid* (the oneness of Allah). Only Allah knows what tomorrow holds.
 * **The Modern Disguise:** Today's fortune-telling isn't just someone sitting with a crystal ball. It includes looking up daily horoscopes, psychic apps, and \

online personality predictions about the future. We must remain vigilant.
### 🤲 What Should We Do Instead?
Instead of looking to the creation for answers about the future, Islam provides us with the perfect alternatives:
 1. **Trust in Allah’s Decree (*Tawakkul*):** Know that whatever is meant for you will never miss you, and whatever misses you was never meant for you.
 2. **Pray *Istikhara*:** When facing a difficult decision about the future, turn to the Prayer of Guidance (*Salat al-Istikhara*) and ask the All-Knowing to guide your path.
 3. **Make *Dua*:** If you are anxious about what lies ahead, raise your hands and ask Allah for *Aafiyah* (well-being) and barakah in your future.
May Allah protect our Iman, keep us away from major and minor Shirk, and grant us steadfastness in our daily prayers. Ameen.

Salvation is a free gift which all mankind is expected to get from God for free. For us to gain salvation is through our good will and obedience to God, but not how often we go to church to pray. body.title: DeepSeek V4: the open source model that reached the level of closed ones
body.body:
For a long time, the divide was clear: proprietary models like GPT and Claude delivered the best performance, while open source ones stayed a step or two behind. In April 2026, DeepSeek V4 made that line hard to see.

## What DeepSeek V4 is

Released on April 24, 2026 by the Chinese company DeepSeek, V4 arrived in two versions: V4-Pro, with 1.6 trillion total parameters and 49 billion active per inference, and V4-Flash, with 284 billion total and 13 billion active. Both use a Mixture of Experts architecture, an MIT license, and support a context of 1 million tokens.

An MIT license means: it can be used commercially, modified, redistributed. No royalties. No usage restrictions based on company size. This combination — frontier capability with a fully open license — is what makes V4 different from any previous release.

## Architecture: real technical innovations

DeepSeek V4 is not just a bigger model. The team introduced three significant architectural innovations:

The first is the hybrid attention mechanism, combining Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA). The practical result: at a context of 1 million tokens, V4-Pro requires only 27% of the single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of the KV cache compared to DeepSeek V3. This matters for those who operate infrastructure — cost and memory drop significantly.

The second is Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), which replaces conventional residual connections. The goal is to improve signal propagation between layers without sacrificing the model's expressiveness — one of the classic tensions in deep architectures.

The third is the use of the Muon optimizer in training, which provides faster convergence and greater stability. The model was pre-trained on more than 32 trillion tokens.

## Benchmarks: numbers that matter

V4-Pro-Max scores 80.6% on SWE-Bench Verified — the software engineering benchmark that tests the model's ability to resolve real GitHub issues. For reference, Claude Opus 4.6 scores 80.8% on the same benchmark. The difference is statistically irrelevant.

On LiveCodeBench, specific to competitive programming, V4-Pro-Max reaches 93.5 — leading all available open models. On GPQA Diamond, an advanced scientific reasoning benchmark, the model reaches 90.1%.

In agentic capabilities — execution of multi-step tasks, tool use, code workflows — V4 leads open source and effectively ties with the leading closed models.

## What changes for those who build systems

The combination of closed-level benchmarks, an MIT license, a 1 million token context, and a cost of US$ 0.30 per million input tokens via API changes the calculus for developers and companies.

Until V4, choosing a high-performance open source model meant real quality tradeoffs. Now, for most use cases — coding, analysis, agents — the tradeoff has disappeared. The decision between closed and open becomes a matter of governance and compliance, not technical capability.

For datacenter operations, this has direct implications. Running V4-Flash (284B, 13B active) on your own infrastructure is now a viable option for high-volume workloads where cost per token matters. V4-Pro requires more hardware — but the choice exists.

## The geopolitical context

It is impossible to discuss DeepSeek without mentioning the context. The company operates under American export restrictions that limit access to cutting-edge chips. The fact that V4 reaches parity with models trained on far larger hardware budgets is, in itself, a relevant technical data point.

V4's training and inference efficiency is not accidental — it is a direct consequence of operating under restrictions that force architectural innovation. HCA and mHC are ingenious responses to compute limitations, not marketing features.

## Open source reached the frontier

DeepSeek V4 is not solely responsible for this change — Llama 4, Qwen 3.5, and Gemma 4 also contribute to the ecosystem. But it is the model that most directly eliminated the quality distinction between open and closed in the benchmarks that matter for production.

In 2024, the question was: \
In 2026, with V4, the question has changed: \
\n\nThe answer may exist — enterprise support, SLAs, native integrations, specific use cases. But the answer is no longer technical quality. And that changes the market.

body.title: Street Artists  [ENG-PT/BR]
body.body:
![1-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23wC9Lnw6wjjVW76n59MEHPRjMVGXJa6Nh6xVYcWJYrHo6eDsSmU5hoQWv4GeFswqtEV2.jpg)
Culture remains the poor relation of government policy in countries considered to be the most developed.

In a European country like mine, Portugal, public investment in cultural services amounts to 0.3% of GDP. This is one of the lowest rates in Europe, where the average is 1%. Eurostat data reveal enormous disparities.

Eastern Europe and the Nordic countries invest the most, both in artistic production and in infrastructure for the arts. Iceland (1.1%), Estonia (1.0%), Hungary (0.9%), Latvia (0.9%), Malta (0.9%), and Croatia (0.8%) lead the ranking. Only Greece (0.2%), Ireland (0.2%), and Greece (0.2%) trail behind Portugal.

Beyond European borders, funding models for the arts change drastically, and new global giants have recently emerged.

The Middle Eastern model and the Asian model are the new “whales” of cultural investment. The United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia are the world’s largest investors in cultural infrastructure in absolute terms. Billions of dollars are being injected to create museums and mega-heritage projects. The Middle Eastern economy relies heavily on state sovereign wealth funds; investment in culture—relative to non-oil GDP—has skyrocketed to the global top.


![2-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23uQiGwSaS4VHQ7XJXR2gqSSZqY44ShGiJRfFchz8RGY1Z9Bd6ufYoU6zUvJBRJ99CLw7.jpg)

In Asia, the South Korean Ministry of Culture’s strategy has become a global case study. Not only do they invest in preserving historical heritage, but they also have a massive budget to fund creative industries: music (K-Pop), film, video games, and TV series. Furthermore, they have developed an economic export strategy through culture: the so-called Hallyu, or Korean Wave.

If we shift the metric from % of GDP to “how many dollars the government spends per citizen on culture,” Luxembourg and Switzerland lead global rankings with $500 per capita.

And then there are the United States of America, the world’s greatest cultural power. While they dominate the global market for film, contemporary art, and music, there is virtually no public investment in culture. The budget of the equivalent of the Ministry of Culture, the National Endowment for the Arts, is minimal—insignificant.

U.S. policy is based on a model of aggressive tax incentives: it allows multimillionaires and corporations to deduct taxes if they donate fortunes to museums, theaters, universities, and cultural organizations. Funding in the United States is almost entirely private.

![3-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tSPzzerSCEi7KdhcEbbVD4ycrA1mHHiWFxYKUm7bjz8QXxS5hxqi6umdXnzYMsRKPQ9.jpg)
Given the current situation, which affects every country, artists are finding new ways to make a living on the streets. They have always been there throughout history, but today they have a greater presence on the streets of major cities. Although I know of some who choose the street as their stage out of conviction, preferring closer interaction with the audience. 

Livening up the streets and entertaining passersby are musicians, living statues, performers, dancers, jugglers, and magicians. It is the latter—jugglers and magicians—that I feature in this series of photographs.

![4-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tbM6eW1ujdNoi739Ncg2KuaSAF7TSAdXHUKsDh7x4dW3KHK5rhDdDTzqijMQQih3y4d.jpg)

![5-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23uQp2WaZvHhGawNip5f4UH7Y62nyPrt1XRQ9mgB5dcCBJGGLkhjGsv2RWhyhyPBme621.jpg)

![6-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23vhwxcwJmJXYR3ymMqvkXepgAsHGxuATwjkNtAyd6SLjfyenMWp5iZBz94Dt5m8rJuDK.jpg)

![7-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t7AySupaPC9xjQxfgcM7EX6teWmE5tgMDXTJZUowBfqMzMxBv5iazskEQjm2HWzQNZz.jpg)

![8-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes-9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23uQiGZHogyw2W6hVEEAet1y8HAqApkkG16Uk7jMCXXk3hFNwyCjYDAD6vHTJNA9H2eKt.jpg)

![9-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23u5bTutPQ7xDH4PmYW3eD66PUVDG1hJudWn4vjKbtBGdH9ct1XbH4AiydGhXmuh14zgM.jpg)

![10-Street Artists©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23w2ig7z4SNuXMTeZHCM4WjHGXQAkTaxj4NsPBbF6PpFEB2dKh93yCoJvzy8ZZBPninCU.jpg)

>! [PORTUGUESE VERSION] 
**Artistas de Rua**
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23wC9Lnw6wjjVW76n59MEHPRjMVGXJa6Nh6xVYcWJYrHo6eDsSmU5hoQWv4GeFswqtEV2.jpg
A cultura ainda continua a ser o parente pobre da política dos governos dos países considerados mais desenvolvidos.
 
Um país europeu como o meu, Portugal, o investimento publico na de Serviços Culturais é 0,3% do PIB. É um dos piores da europa, onde a média é 1%. Os dados da Eurostat demonstram enormes assimetrias.
 
O Leste Europeu e os Países Nórdicos são os que mais investem, tanto na produção como infra-estruturas para a arte. Islândia (1,1%), Estónia (1,0%), Hungria (0,9%), Letónia (0,9%), Malta (0,9%) e Croácia (0,8%), lideram o ranking. Só a Grécia (0,2%), Irlanda (0,2%) e a Grécia (0,2%) estão atras de Portugal.
 
Ultrapassando as fronteiras europeias, os modelos de financiamento para as artes mudam drasticamente e ultimamente surgiram novos gigantes mundiais.
 
O modelo do Médio Oriente e o Modelo Asiático são as novas “Baleias” do investimento cultural. Emirados Árabes Unidos e a Arábia Saudita são os maiores investidores mundiais em infra-estruturas culturais em termos absolutos. Estão a ser injectados milhares de milhões de dólares para criar museus e mega-projectos de Património. A economia do Medio Oriente depende fortemente de fundos soberanos estatais, o investimento na cultura - face ao PIB não petrolífero - disparou para o topo global.
 
Na Asia, a estratégia do Ministério da Cultura sul-coreano virou um caso de estudo à escala global. Não só investem em preservar o património histórico como têm um orçamento massivo para financiar industrias criativas: música (K-Pop), cinema, videojogos e séries. Além de que, através da cultura, têm uma estratégia de exportação económica. A chamada Hallyu ou Onda Coreana.
 
Se mudarmos a métrica da % do PIB para “quantos dólares o Estado gasta por cada cidadão em cultura”, Luxemburgo e Suíça lideram rankings mundiais com $500 por habitante.
 
E depois há os Estados Unidos da América, a maior potência cultural do mundo. Além de controlarem o mercado global do cinema, arte contemporânea e música, não há praticamente investimento publico na cultura. O orçamento do equivalente ao Ministério da Cultura, o National Endowment for the Arts, é mínimo - insignificante.
 
A política dos Estados Unidos é assente num modelo de incentivos fiscais ferozes: permitem que multimilionários e empresas deduzam os seus impostos se doarem fortunas a museus, teatros, universidades e agentes culturais. O financiamento nos Estados Unidos é quase totalmente privado.
 
Com a conjectura actual, transversal a todos os países, os artistas encontram na rua novas formas de sobrevivência. Sempre houveram na história, mas actualmente têm mais presença nas ruas das grandes cidades. Embora eu conheço alguns casos que escolhem a rua como palco por convição, preferem a interacção com mais proximidade com o publico. 
 
A animar as ruas e as pessoas que passam encontramos músicos, homens estátua, perfomers, dançarinos, malabaristas e ilusionistas. São estes últimos (malabaristas e ilusionistas) que partilho nesta série de fotografias.

body.body:
###@# The employer of my friend  have a big house. There's a little vacant space to plant but she is not allowed to plant. Only flower plant are there.

When she came to our house, she picked all. No problem for me, I am.just around anytime. She needs good appetite to increase her eating healthy foods.


![received_957850317088832.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olivia08/23ydAT1QNeVezjR3bZNxHYRTWV3Uuw54UjiKnxouqJPasfW8AdcmWBwZQMafz6ZK8ZjAH.jpeg)

![received_1647747960115788.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olivia08/23y8mWNRNHwFeQL52bbjLxgrrEoRrWJyCDSv7GgnWbmvCf8zkApH6oR4hkuNLGQip12Kq.jpeg)

![received_1492069892066191.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olivia08/23xAPWTRq7a65tYLzt1ccHNJf8R8U29qGk6RGSHFs4v8ZseqPr1NbPo7KT3Fy5Bcxp1At.jpeg)

![received_27123999047269499.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olivia08/23wzvi4iDZZsTQBDmTnXriGLR9bJqDixkHXZ1aSKGXzhLCgZnVBWS5SuSZ3XKxwfh2SZ6.jpeg)


![received_1577080320531145.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/olivia08/23xAMMbpCZetkuk1yHS7aowjLKonwvFv34Eg3DfKa7FQgNEWRmmECsAqB7qCcVWycYJtj.jpeg)

She ended enjoying harvesting my vegetable.No matter nothing left, what is important it could help her eating fresh organic vegetables. Many time I also buy vegetable for her. I want her to gain her weight. I'm worrying about her . I told her to go to our country but she told me that she need to work for two years and done.

Her husband was already dead last two years ago and she didn't able to go home.She helped here niece and nephew whose parent was separated The brother of my friends ask her help his son and daughters for school in college. Their mother left them long time ago and never come back until now. My friend shoulder their studies in elementary and high school now in college. Then her son is still in senior high. I feel the sacrifice of my friend like me , we are the bread winner. Imagine, she never get home for 17 years and all her life in prison of her employer's house. No day off and just get out during the time we renew our contact and for hospital. Other than that nothing else she want outside.

Being an ofw  is not a joke. Her boss is not perfect but they always give her salary monthly enough reason to stay though many time she spent his own money for food and wifi.These are all called sacrifices.

Being a friend, I'm willing to render effort and extend helping hands for the sake of friendship and being a Filipino family.

That's all for today.

### Love,
##### @olivia08
