body.title: Hiking trails, natural pools, waterfalls and mountain villages in northern Portugal
body.body: <center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCiGQuXcb5vE86yZXREdY9iYQwiz8MYB5buekfwscyMm/01.jpg)</center>\n\n<div class=\

>A visit to the Paneda-Gerês National Park was one of the best excursions I did on my ten day visit to Porto. This park covers 270 square miles of forrest, mountains, rivers and waterfalls. The park, which is the only national park in Portugal, is located in the north-east corner, bordering Spain. When the park was established, there were villages in the mountains. These villages are still inhabited. If you are lucky you might encounter wildlife like wild horses and even wolves. There are more than a hundred trails to choose from. You can do day trips or multiday hikes. The variaty of trails are vast. But, the most popular are the trails that lead to waterfalls and river pools with crystal-clear water. I joined a tour with a guide, which was probably the best choice for me.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmUqr8ii6yyV2BQoDdzHSbcg1wqcNnA8RyEWmkb9y7Y6W6/02.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmUkEizLZrHHrPGcr8PbTZYhYKNDEnwVF3oNNZEdzHMNf9/03.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmUWXMFJ7rBLonyYr781KmmuaUiY9ye5UHff49PxyLgEMk/04.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmUpzKp7oWPCWgTT8swD2fi7oVCAVArSzhmUGL5wF2YEft/05.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmbDej5fNWocuqMkRxyS1ciaFnEfTQnCnZ6q9H8BwsnQDs/06.jpg After crossing a dam, we drive into the park and uphill on a dirt road until we park and get ready to spend some hours of walking. That is hike I chose to do. It was a day trip from Porto to spend some 7/8 hours in the park. The trail we chose is probably considered as a medium hard trail because of the rather steep and rocky terrain. It was necessary to look to the ground to watch my steps. Some stretches of dense forrest that did provide shade. It was a warm day.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeBpjLMUeJh6vzBraDMe8MCqXTeWBF6izLiEoHd6AFrV/07.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmUtiJTfXrn85P8qoaq1r5aE9nZJF3U7M8AVKDG1cQ42F7/8.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgTFJKYoXBYkmFpBqJg2ihpLu437ob4i3SJahrMk84rU/9.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUCsTdjUbHVnLtZfPhdieE35Aa7M4bjAzJkQg1V4Dxw3/10.jpg After some rather rough walking, we reached the river with waterfall and the natural pool below. There were already several people who had found their way before us. But it was refreshing with a dip into the water to wash of the dust of the trail.
https://i.ecency.com/DQme4u5Tuj4yeec3TPfm8CJMBZBipCCQhBoK7bJJEKzec5u/11.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGKFk2FPKcvYcfVvokPqFuT76rGjtKxxKX3DiCPkdkav/12.jpg We didn't see any wild horses, the Barrosã cattle or herd of sheep. But we saw these two lizards and a couple of small frogs when we continued our hike.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEdLDMroQ7tP2VfuNVemiyASaF17JAfcy39xijfQE6Pd/13.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmWGjp6bdFbvvbE97vamDg2mvidsVotpk1hCaAMvzuMyHf/14.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmUwjwiyy8SyUC83sm7mfzmLpMGHN46tPkg4L75bqKAXp5/15.jpg In the small village of Fojo de Lobo Fafião we had a lunch break. As we came into the village we saw a couple of posters advertising a festival for wolves - «Aldeia de Lobos» . Our lunch was at the restaurant Reteiro do Geres. Starting with a soup, we continued to lots of tasty, local dishes. Notice the white cup. It is not for coffee, but for wine. When the shepherds are up in the mountains looking after their sheep and goats, they use the cup both for soup and for wine.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmefqLxVpV4n1DeUbZ2XDb2qcHCG91x1W11AWtPDFBDwcs/16.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmSfSQFsGcacsGmiJvYy7fRKv3VLytut1j6zxWfTgp6pN7/17.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmdMo6u79CYND4uoXCxV1eey2NTDh3YgfWn4cW8jzX2JPu/18.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmcCG2oKNFVKaEoUq6u1qwgJuvYeq6ZJXW2RKMu6iv2ck1/19.jpg Then we continued through the village. It was nice to have a guide who could tell us about the village and how the villagers preserve their old traditions. Many of the traditional houses are built in stone. Then there are the famous graneries on stilt – the so called «espigueiros». This is where the villagers keept their grain. Because they are on stilts, mice and rats aren't able to reach the grain. When looking at them, I find them similar to the Norwegian \

used for storing food. The difference is that the Norwegian graneries were built of wood.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3F16m9bA2ttnQxwBjCLbvfut7WDXEYN97xHHXnVMjLj/20.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmScsuRwcZxxB9SSn9rVeN1QEfuyzUXNQMhXxRdVGoGmB6/21.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmQnWVoAcwBEVXEZnDY46uC4xrSzjeuHHPZeMkttYTveex/22.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmXu5dkczRUZobeipakT2NkxiJh6Emu5AZ7sw1PsquZrUL/23.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmTTAG9Zufb6AM3s5iWveE8ZbWvv1WHQs9CPpEx8aAVj9D/24.jpg In the outskirts of the village we made a stop at this information board and the stone walls. The walls are part of an old wolf trap the villagers were using in order to protect their livestock. It is not know excactly how old the trap is, but it does look well-preserved. The two walls are more than 60 meter in length and more than 2 meters high. It says on the board that it was in use for the last time in 1948. To day the village of Fafião is now a great defender of the Iberian wolf that might be among the endangered species in the park.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmZJ8EsyMLdYPahgpk8xQpUkMMr5MyZao6uYhMZ4LPXU77/25.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmU6bmC6V8J3PcbvENsWhBuBbvNqWQGvpXrB7xWwqhZfkW/26.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmV2TqiMR9RH3F92oxq72Cga71F2xDyVbsDBJqzXmdbiJQ/27.jpg The trap seen from above (on the board) does give an impression of the size. The national park is definitly worth a visit. It takes only 80 – 90 minutes to drive from Porto to the entrance, which makes it easy accessible from Porto. body.title: 🇵🇱 Wracam do gry 💪 / \n🇬🇧 Back in the Game 💪: June 16 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cd54f7f7-3df4-4599-b755-b82ba0052fcf.jpg)
---
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0aacee65-6f0d-4fa6-8ecf-27f20e1c1406.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6e41b23f-3143-41dd-9a12-169796d21a3b.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/933a1bfe-57a3-4642-bc2c-401a165b9594.jpg)
🇵🇱 Poniedziałek to powrót do sprawdzonego rytmu. Dzień zacząłem od krótkiej rozgrzewki na bieżni, a później wjechał trening push – klatka, barki i triceps. Nic nadzwyczajnego, ale właśnie na takich zwykłych treningach buduje się formę. Wracam do układu poniedziałek, środa i piątek – siłownia plus spokojne bieganie, bo przez ostatnie tygodnie trochę mi tego brakowało. --- 🇬🇧 Monday means getting back to my regular routine. I started the day with a short treadmill warm-up followed by a push workout focused on chest, shoulders and triceps. Nothing extraordinary, but those ordinary sessions are what build long-term fitness. I'm returning to my Monday, Wednesday and Friday schedule of gym work plus easy running, something I've missed over the past few weeks.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8880cbb4-7c20-40cc-afb8-073eb46034b4.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b94e76e5-4bd3-4169-8f2f-728901f95577.jpg)
🇵🇱 Powoli wracam też na właściwe tory z wagą. Średnia z ostatnich tygodni wynosi około 80,9 kg, a poziom tkanki tłuszczowej utrzymuje trend spadkowy. Nie ma tu żadnych spektakularnych zmian z dnia na dzień, ale właśnie takie spokojne i regularne postępy najbardziej cieszą. Po roku walki o lepszą formę wiem już, że cierpliwość daje lepsze efekty niż szukanie skrótów. --- 🇬🇧 My weight is gradually moving in the right direction as well. The recent average sits at around 80.9 kg, while body fat continues to trend downward. There are no dramatic overnight changes, but steady progress is always the most rewarding. After a year of working on my fitness, I've learned that patience delivers far better results than looking for shortcuts.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3d493000-393e-41de-ae71-027376f916b8.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1344c136-785c-4b7d-9af0-9a26cb728842.jpg)
🇵🇱 Ostatnia noc też była całkiem udana – prawie 7 godzin snu, dużo snu głębokiego i niewiele wybudzeń. Po południu zamiast kolejnego treningu przeniosłem się do ogrodu. Kilka tygodni temu wysiałem trawę i teraz zaczyna już przebijać się przez ziemię. Fajnie obserwować takie małe efekty codziennej pracy. Niezależnie czy chodzi o ogród, bieganie czy siłownię, zasada jest podobna – robisz swoje, a rezultaty przychodzą z czasem.🌱 --- 🇬🇧 Last night's sleep was pretty solid as well – almost seven hours, plenty of deep sleep and very little time awake. In the afternoon, instead of another workout, I spent some time in the garden. A few weeks ago I seeded the lawn, and now the first blades of grass are finally starting to appear. It's satisfying to watch those small signs of progress. Whether it's gardening, running or strength training, the rule is the same – keep doing the work and the results will come with time. 🌱

body.title: Office Chronicles 1: Between The Files, A Tuesday Diary!
body.body:
***Hello everyone here and all across the globe!***👋😊

***Hello to all of my friends and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this lovely @dailyblog community!***😍

***How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing well and happy right now. It's been a while now but here I am again, @lj1728 to share another simple life story with you all.***💕

![June 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23uFibSYyyNdQkScLHa7pG9zbKpzZL85JZ6L7LxUyeyetZXrwVcHjc417r6iVoSjDroyZ.png)

***Today felt like a rare, gentle breeze at the office. Unlike the usual whirlwind of a Monday. The workload today was incredibly light.*** There weren't many files to process, which allowed the atmosphere to remain calm and relaxed throughout the morning. ***It's such a relief when things flow smoothly, giving me a moment to actually breathe amidst the usual routine.***

![IMG_9111.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xVTPRu8WKqxmnGrZg9kn27aDabpciWhXP96SnVFSBdjGMmZKK2Ta4eJFB8646echA3o.jpeg)

![IMG_9112.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xVTMTtQc7zg5tyMoU2M2pNNbJzAaFoLJndSPzJAUvtiBxezT92nKBv4CS5uNERskVWQ.jpeg)

Around mid-morning, I decided to take a quick break and headed down to the canteen for a snack. I ended up picking up some sotanghon and puto, a simple combination that hit the spot perfectly. ***When I got back, our head announced that our new polo shirts, meant for our every-Friday attire, were finally ready for collection. Getting new gear always feels like a nice little morale booster.***

![IMG_6363.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpNqKpCTVe9RmvKP5ZnNq8443kaXQveuYCJH9zr6UBzr2vDMZrh3RyTgdyCfj5byHqw.jpeg)

![IMG_8626.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23x1HuDLEDxU3y6UqLCnHm5ws6Tc2CQhjjKPBSXVuUJRhseyJzSj45chrgi7tLVZFFUuL.jpeg)

The surprises didn't stop there, though. Right as I headed home for my lunch break, several of my long-awaited parcels arrived at the doorstep. ***There is something uniquely satisfying about unboxing some packages after a busy week. It felt like a small reward just for making it through the day.***

![IMG_9063.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMggHTwEPUE8LYAKStWbxJ4Hh4yDqygp2fZ6kJVKt5jmZJMd2PkEhNUFRoXdPWWHPAg.jpeg)

![IMG_9066.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ywwZc99upvaoJk7svWDKY7fQkwSqpkqC2CwNfC1kiMFi6ZxMiHUPtyegj6M2kcwMuUb.jpeg)

***The highlight of the afternoon was the unexpected treat from one of my friends, who is a nurse here. She surprised us with a generous serving of Mexican Platter during our afternoon snack time.*** The food was delicious and we enjoyed that simple snack party that we had which made the rest of the workday fly by in a blur of good vibes.

![IMG_3762.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/243znT6YPUnBBG11iAuNTN7RpAFsEdD1kqKgCnwbCvo6Co3ubZv1AcCSsSvsbzmEPEVia.jpeg)

***These are the kinds of days I try to hold onto. They remind me that even in the middle of the standard work week, there is always room for a little bit of joy and connection.***


***And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.***😍

***These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.***✍️👩‍💻

**Lots of love,
LJ**💗

这里有些很生活化的剧情，比如女主签约前会悄悄发给身为律师的男友掌掌眼。他们住的很远但周末会在男友的小出租房约会，两人做做饭窝在一起看的电视，平平淡淡。

如果男主没有出现的话，男配应该算个没那么完美但很寻常的对象。女主会跟他一起苦哈哈的朝九晚五挤地铁，在上海这座大城市里艰难生活，也许最后买个小小的房子。

但就像男主说的那样，他给了女主很高的起点也带她出去拓宽眼界，他们后期在考量事情角度已然不同的。当然两人会分手的直接导火索是男主，他给男配安排了考验。

其实就男配选择服从安排去西北出差包括打算在那里发展，我觉得都可以理解为在为未来打算。甚至包括男主给他安排的酒局和女人，但是第二天起来还do就有问题。

我觉得哪怕没有男主搅局，女主和男配分手也是必然。看得出男配是比较自我的人，很多细小的行为习惯源自他觉得女主会喜欢。遇到危险的时候，他首先想到也是自己。

这种男人平时看着没啥，遇到事儿会极其自私的。


（本篇完）

# ⚙️ Clockwork is LIVE — A Steampunk Auto-Battler Where Your Cards Are Real NFTs

The gears are turning. The boilers are lit. **Clockwork is officially live** — and you can start playing right now.

This is a steampunk Web3 auto-battler card game built on **Immutable zkEVM**, where every card you collect is a real on-chain NFT that *you* own. Not a database entry that vanishes when the servers go dark. Not a \

you rent. An actual asset in your wallet that you can trade.

No download. No install. Just open it in your browser on PC or Mobile and go.

👉 **Play now: https://web3gaminghut.com/clockwork/**

---

## ⚔️ What is Clockwork?

Clockwork is an **auto-battler** — you build your team much like in Splinterlands, pick your heroes, and watch your strategy play out. The skill isn't in twitchy reflexes; it's in the synergies you assemble before the battle even begins. Stack the right cards with the right hero and the machine does the rest.

Here's what's waiting for you when you log in:

- **65 collectable cards**, each one a genuine NFT on Immutable zkEVM
- **Hero synergies** that completely change how your deck performs
- 21 Items that change the rules of the game, 20 Unique Card Abilities
- **PvE battles** to grind, learn, and climb
- **PvP** to prove your build against real players
- **An Upgrade Workshop** where you level cards up and watch the progress bars fill
- **A Quest system** to keep the rewards flowing
- **A dual economy** — earn **Gold** in-game, or use **Cogs** as the premium currency to unlock items faster

Everything you see in your collection is *yours*. Open a pack, pull a card, and it lands in your wallet on the blockchain.

---

## 🔋 The Energy System — Built for Real Players

Let's talk about the part I'm proud of. Clockwork is completely cypto native game, buying 5 packs (10$ in IMX) gets all the game features unlocked for players, in week 2 you already get your money back with earnable Gold that unlocks NFT packs. Clockwork runs on an **Energy system** — 100 max, recharging 4 per hour. It's right there in your HUD the moment you log in.

Why does that matter? Because it means the game respects your time *and* keeps the economy healthy. You can't just botfarm infinite battles into the ground. Energy creates rhythm — log in, spend your charges, plan your next deck, come back. It's the heartbeat of the whole machine. You can unlock 3 NFT packs per week with ingame earnable Gold.

---

## 💎 Your Cards Are REAL — Own Them, Trade Them

This is the line that separates Clockwork from a thousand free-to-play card games that came before it:

**You own your cards.**

They're minted as NFTs on Immutable zkEVM (Chain ID 13371). Immutable means **zero gas fees** for you as a player and lightning-fast transactions — none of the friction that scared people away from blockchain gaming in the first place. You get the ownership without the headache.

Pull a rare card? It's yours. Want to send a duplicate to a friend? There's a transfer system with per-level buttons built right in. Built a collection you're proud of? It lives in your wallet, not on my servers.

---

## 🎴 Packs, Pulls & The Collection Grind

The loop is simple and addictive:

1. **Open packs** and pull cards
2. **Watch them mint** straight to your collection
3. **Level them up** in the Upgrade Workshop
4. **Battle** in PvE and PvP to earn Gold
5. **Climb the seasonal Leaderboard** and get more free Packs

Every card has levels. Every level makes it stronger. And every upgrade is tracked on-chain. The deeper you go, the more your collection is genuinely worth.

---

## 🏆 Seasons & Leaderboards

Clockwork runs on **seasons** with a live Leaderboard tracking the best players each cycle. If you want bragging rights — and a name at the top of the rankings — now is the time to start climbing. Early players have the cleanest shot at the top before the meta settles.

---

## 🚀 Why Now Is the Best Time to Jump In

Launch week is *the* moment in any Web3 game. The collection is fresh. The leaderboard is wide open. The packs are unopened. Players who get in early build the deepest collections and learn the synergies before everyone else catches on. 100k total number of packs makes the packs more scarce over time.

I built Clockwork to be the kind of blockchain game I actually wanted to play — real ownership, low wallet friction (you only need email to login), no gas fees, fast battles, and a steampunk world with gears, cogs, and clockwork heroes. No fluff. No empty promises. It's live, it works, and it's waiting for you.

So wind up your spring, load your deck, and let the gears turn.

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday </center>

#

That's right, it's Tuesday folks and for our merry little band of ladies and lads, that means sharing tunes, good vibes and engagement. As another week disappears in the rearview mirror, we have loads of engagement and tunes flying around on Three Tune Tuesday and sure isn't that bloody fantastic! I hope you're ready to share three tunes from wherever you find yourself on this magical spinning lump of rock that we all call home and sure you might even sing us a tune if we're lucky?

It's a time of the week when lovers of music, tunes and craic bring their blockchain community three of their finest and brightest tunes to share and celebrate, so let's roll on and let the tunes flow free.

This is my 263rd week waxing lyrical for Three Tune Tuesday and we are still going strong.

It started off with me just sharing tunes into what seemed like a void, but little by little others joined and now I'm thrilled that we have a little corner of Hive where we come and share our tunes every Tuesday, and long may it continue. I almost stopped posting the songs and thoughts a few times, but I stuck with it and now interestingly it is my favorite thing about Hive. I love music and now I have a network of folks around the world who love music too and we share our tunes and catch up with each others tunes and discuss them each week. We get Pop, Metal, Rock, Gospel, Folk, Jazz, Rap, Hip-Hop, Trip-Hop, Reggae, Bippy bappidy Flange Hop. Ok I made that one up, but you get the idea, we are all learning about new artists, bands, back stories and sure isn't it just mighty!

Something that excites me the most is that we even get musicians sharing their covers of famous songs and even their own songs from time to time here on #ThreeTuneTuesday, which is a real favorite of mine, as that takes talent, time and dedication.

We are adding New posters and retaining our core of regulars here on #TTT which is fantastic. Let's keep it growing. Over the years, I have listened to fantastic music shared from like-minded folk from around the globe and interacted with their posts. This has led me to genres I don't know well and to some amazing new bands and artists and has even introduced me to some musical instruments I did not know existed. It also allows me to upvote smaller accounts and find some really interesting people from all over the world, which is heartening.

I hope you enjoy the tunes - be sure to tell me all about it in the comments below and above all else, please enjoy the rest of your Tuesday - smile at a stranger, rub a dog, be a nice human to someone who was not expecting it - peace out.

For those unfamiliar with TTT or Three Tune Tuesday....

# <center> The jist is as follows </center>

#

Every Tuesday I'm going to share 3 songs which I like to listen to and I invite your feedback in the comments below. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention me in the post and I'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use #threetunetuesday tag that would be great, as that is what I use when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the prize - more on that later.

# <center> HBI contest - win up to 6HBI </center>

#

Share your Three Tune Tuesday songs below or create a post with #ttt or #threetunetuesday and mention me so I can find the post.

I'll pick the three songs I enjoyed the most each week as the winner and transfer 1 share of HBI to the winner when this post pays out 7 days from now, but wait there's more...

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday Sponsors </center>

#

We have a sponsor list of six people who selflessly offer HBI in addition to my one. They are as follows @tengolotodo @bozz @coquicoin @ablaze @seki1 @inthenow

Due to a very busy life on my side, the winner posts often come after a delay and may come over 4 to 8 consecutive days. That's just how I do it, so please be patient while awaiting HBI and understand that only my 1HBI is guaranteed. The others are dependant on our lovely sponsors seeing these posts and sending on the HBI. That means some weeks winners may get 3 shares and other weeks they may get more.

Thanks a million to our sponsors above once again and any winners please bear in mind that some people only pop on here every few months, so be patient while waiting for the HBI.

<center> Best of luck!

# <center> Sin é, That's all folks, thanks for stopping by. </center>

That's it for another week. Those are your three songs for this week. Let me know what you think - good, bad or indifferent? Did you like them all or just one or two?

Also, as I said before, I love getting good steers for new tunes, so please tell me about the latest and greatest from your playlist below and I'll be sure to check em out.

body.title: Splinterlands: Season-end report shows massive improvement in win rate!🔥
body.body: >\n\n
data-align=\

>I can't say for certain, but my win rate in the previous season-end report was under 50%; in fact, looking back at my entire Splinterlands journey, I recall my peak win rate never exceeding 54–55%. However, things feel different this time around. As I mentioned, there was a significant period when I wasn't active in the game, and when I did play, I split my time between the Modern and Frontier modes—so my focus was somewhat divided. Yet, I managed to improve my win rate. I believe this is the first time I’ve finished a season with a win rate of 58.90%, having played a total of 146 battles and achieved a maximum winning streak of 11—so, for me, this is definitely something worth celebrating.

\n\n
>\n\n
data-align=\

>Despite playing less this season, I finished in Gold League Tier 2; consequently, even after the new season reset, I’m starting at Silver 1—which is actually a good thing, because dropping another tier would have landed me in Bronze, where rewards are significantly lower. Moving from Silver to Gold will be tough, but the rewards along the way will keep things interesting, and the battles will undoubtedly be challenging. That said, I managed to clear Silver League Tier 1 and unlock the next tier just this morning; I’m currently at a rank of 1920 with an 87.5% win rate. However, that win rate doesn't mean much yet since it’s based on just one day of data—the true win rate is best assessed at the end of the season. Having earned around 62,000 Glint since the last season, my current focus is earning enough to purchase a Legendary card; I need about 8,000 more Glint for that, and I’ve already earned roughly 4,000 of it today alone.

\n\n
>\n\n
data-align=\

>So, hopefully, within the next day or two, I’ll accumulate 70,000 Glint and purchase a Legendary Draw. After that, I plan to save all the Glint earned throughout the season for Common and Rare Draws. I adopted this strategy last season—purchasing one Legendary Draw per season while spending the rest of my earnings on draws of other rarities—and it has resulted in a deck featuring a variety of cards that are leveling up at a decent pace. In this new season, I’ll aim to push my win rate to 60% and improve my leaderboard ranking. I’ll keep you updated on everything else.

body.title: photography flower Orchid
body.body:
Flowers are one of the most resilient flowers to the environment, especially during the dry season. Furthermore, these flowers can live for years even during the dry season, which is why people like to plant orchids. Orchids are actually difficult to grow because they have hard stems. If you've ever planted an orchid, you'll probably know the advantages and how they thrive. It's very difficult for a tree to flower quickly; we have to wait a long time for it to flower...

There are many other types of plants, but flowers are different from flowers in general. While others, like paper flowers, flower easily, orchids can take a long time; we have to wait for them to flower. We've planted the tree for over a year, but it's only been a long time since it first flowered.


After I saw the orchid tree, I looked for other photography, but I only got one picture of a small animal resting on a green tree. It was so sensitive when I took a picture with my cell phone camera. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXMLyPkX9ko1NWJaAazAZRvJm92iK8c4Bm5Zp9jXXxWb2/IMG_20260616_184126.jpg

Program notes. Maybe until the end of this month, we will do a short paragraph followed by the Noxsoma TV Guide.

The Hepdekad, is our 17 day check in episode, where we check on our health, fitness, attitude, environment, hopes & dreams, and the progress of the shows. You will only have to listen to this audio once. TV Guide coming next.  
TV Guide (note, the voice over DOES NOT include the URLs). 
I joked in one of these episodes about needing a TV Guide of sorts, so that our ever-expanding audience can keep up with our offerings. It’s the same product wrapped in different packages. 
We publish the Daily Ox Drops on three platforms. None of them are YouTube.
Rumble https://rumble.com/user/Noxsoma – Daily at 3:00 AM  (EST)
Odysee  https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2 – Daily at 2:00 AM  (EST)

Our, 20 years running YouTube channel; (https://www.youtube.com/user/noxsoma) is basically a closet. A legacy channel. We were on this platform early, and we keep it for mostly fitness stuff. If you want to watch or listen to your humble vagabond work out and talk about working out. This is for you. 
We have a spinoff channel channel on Rumble (https://rumble.com/c/c-6500221) that we use for throwbacks. The series that preceded Full Metal Ox launched at about the same time as the Covid Op, in 2020. We went outside daily-ish, sometimes even in the rain, and observed what was happening in the community we did not plan to stay in. It’s a regular guy, real time archive of the “two weeks to flatten the curve” era.  
Substack, (noxsoma.substack.com), is a mini creative community in itself. We post articles, the occasional short videos, text to voice articles, “live” voice over commentaries, and our de facto “novel,” in the form of a comic strip. 
Behind the pay-wall, is where Secret City resides. It’s exclusively for those who would like to help build our future podcast, which is the next level of what we’re doing now. We are eventually going to have content on Substack around the clock. Maybe 6 pieces daily, including the notes & comics, video shorts and some uplifting messages from our simulation. 
If Substack is Moonbase, the video platforms are satellites. This brings us to the blogs. Legacy blogs that still manage to exist. They are our billboards. We’ve already written the articles. We’ve had the accounts for years. Some, for as long as a decade or more, others very close to ten years. So what the heck. Might as well. 
Hive  https://hive.blog/@noxsoma  
Steemit  https://steemit.com/@noxsoma/posts 
Minds https://www.minds.com/Noxsoma/ 
Gab https://gab.com/Noxsoma 
We post reliably every day, despite receiving little if any feedback. It’s become more of a ritual than an ambition. 
We are also, believe it or not, on Mixcloud, Soundcloud & Podomatic, (we post audio voice tracks on Podomatic from time to time, just to see if anyone stumbles upon the files.) 
Hardly worth mentioning, but we are also on X, and Telegram. We “scavenge” on these platforms, for “news,” animation, some shorts that we can weave into our video collages. But we have no significant presence on either.  
We do this because, this is what we do. It’s our dharma. We, The Trinity, & The Collective, that is, everything within this vessel and its cosmos, enjoys the process of creating much more than the sharing. But we share anyway. Even if our esoteric mindset, weird sense of humor, and cynically-optimistic cosmogony stimulates 1%, or even less, of the global population, that’s a good vibe.

body.body:
<center>

# ENGLISH</center>

---

<div class=\

> # Greetings @theanimerealm community… ---
![REVIEW (2).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoyQXk7mszNNNNPTWnrJLf39oibkXxtauWPN2pTZWDspAy785R4iQ8CsM6Kp1vtUmvk.gif)
---

>Today I'm here with a recommendation. The story is quite calm, taking its time to tell each case. It doesn't have much action, but it can be entertaining for those looking for something relaxing about antique objects. So, I hope you enjoy my review. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205541_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EpnEHPUVjHB9L6gJtKmLxG6qMmVC92gqi8VbFMhAv2fpoTKxBmDozq3odzcEjskiHxb.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm2067888384/?ref_=ttmi_mi_30_2) ---
> # Holmes of kyoto (京都寺町三条のホームズ)… ---

>This anime premiered in 2018, with a total of 12 episodes. It was produced by Seven and directed by Tokihiro Sasaki. This mystery and romance story has an ongoing light novel series, while its manga concluded in 2025. Incidentally, the Japanese title is Kyoto Teramachi Sanjou no Holmes. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205646_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23x1DBTiKGt2q6qvP9LNNneuj9aCXHyaPREstRAsctH6Q7TX56dT8Y79r6Pc89yKp8Nvg.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm2034333952/?ref_=ttmi_mi_30_1) ---
> # Regarding the plot… ---

>The story begins when Aoi Mashiro, a high school student going through a difficult time after moving to Kyoto, breaks up with her boyfriends and distances herself from her friends. She decides to take some valuable family antiques to a shop in the Teramachi district to pawn them and get money to return to Saitama, her birthplace. There she meets Kiyotaka Yagashira, the charismatic grandson of the owner, a 22-year-old university student with such a brilliant and deductive mind that everyone nicknames him \
---

>Noticing Aoi's natural and intuitive talent for perceiving the value and authenticity of art, Kiyotaka offers her a part-time job as his assistant. Although she brought him a valuable piece of art, he couldn't buy it because she was underage. Hearing about her past and their similarities, he offers her this opportunity. From that moment on, the story unfolds as the two young people solve various everyday mysteries, family disputes, and hidden secrets that clients bring with them along with their precious objects. They also encounter a character behind some very well-crafted forgeries. Who is this recurring enemy in Kiyotaka's life? Will the two protagonists be able to heal their past wounds? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205732_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xyVMSSurEAqMqW1F2BCYRMXBtuuNHKmB2nLFhCbJkK5ebxjrAy9EkpjTC7JB2axmoaN.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm1246508801/?ref_=ttmi_mi_23_2) ---
> # Personal opinion ---

>The first thing I should clarify is that you won't find violent crimes here, but rather intellectual mysteries deeply connected to the history of Japanese art, the authentication of ancient artifacts, and the complexities of human relationships. Therefore, some episodes might seem repetitive, and you might think it's something much more mysterious because of the title, which is what drew me in, along with the animation. Even so, I ended up watching it all, mainly for the art and how they connected those culturally rich objects to everyday events and human relationships. But beyond that, well, I feel the anime left much to be desired, as far as I'm concerned. It's that kind of storytelling that I wouldn't watch again. I remember it primarily for how they handle the topic of ancient artifacts, and that's about it. ---

>Regarding the characters, let's talk first about Kiyotaka. He's not an arrogant know-it-all; he's a traditional Kyoto gentleman. His upbringing and respect for the past are what truly bring the character to life, and he's probably one of the reasons you'll find this anime captivating. As for the girl, Aoi, she's the kind of character you can easily empathize with. She represents anyone who has felt lost after moving to a new place. Her growth from an insecure girl to someone who trusts her own judgment is very satisfying to watch. The chemistry between these two develops rather slowly, so don't expect anything particularly passionate. Finally, the animation is also very beautiful. The color palette is warm and inviting; the backgrounds aren't generic. You really feel like you're walking through Kyoto, experiencing it firsthand, seeing the temples, and feeling the changing seasons. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205810_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wMcbDuQfLwUeyZMpfBqbPoe41CcQtsicxtmFHWo3NJZXnHjbqVJJ7Bk7jdw4CkuscYJ.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm3528144641/?ref_=ttmi_mi_28_2) ---
> # Positive points… ---

> - Spectacular atmosphere and setting: The anime is, quite literally, a love letter to Kyoto. The level of detail in the landscapes, the real temples, the traditional festivals, and the local cuisine is beautiful; you feel transported there. - Genuine learning about culture and art: It's not just entertainment; the series educates you in a very engaging way about Japanese art, calligraphy, ceramics, and how experts assess the value and authenticity of antiques, which is why I kept watching. - Mature character development: The relationship between Aoi and Kiyotaka is healthy, respectful, and constructive. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205838_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tH3MRGD2aDep7QqspbsrkDtuAQis81qw7o7XiCeuGcwauAPkBXqox6ggbyRFnCUpv3c.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm808138497/?ref_=ttmi_mi_12_2) ---
> # Negative points… ---

>

- Excessively slow pacing (Slow-burn): If you're looking for a fast-paced plot or one that will leave you on the edge of your seat at the end of each episode, this anime isn't for you.
- Lack of ambition in the main plot: Although there is an \

(the forger Enshou), the rivalry doesn't reach the levels of peak tension found in other mystery anime. - Very subtle romance: If you're expecting a passionate romance with grand declarations of love, you'll be disappointed. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205920_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23w2mG6AC79zdNwRrcZErW1oo4fXu5FACGwfrySEeptYRVAjXDFP8RbHhCtbKzqwXvFv5.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm170604289/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_1) ---
> # My score… ---
>7/10 Story │ 7.5/10 Animation │ 7/10 Sound │ 7.5/10 Character Design │ 7/10 General ---
>If you're looking for something feel-good, you like Japanese aesthetics, enjoy \
mysteries like gentle detective stories, and value character-driven narratives over explosive action, then don't expect intense, action-packed, or mysterious stories. ---

> # Saludos comunidad de @theanimerealm… ---
![REVIEW (2).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoyQXk7mszNNNNPTWnrJLf39oibkXxtauWPN2pTZWDspAy785R4iQ8CsM6Kp1vtUmvk.gif)
---

>Hoy vengo con una recomendación, donde la historia es bastante tranquila, se toma sus pausas para contarnos cada caso, no tiene mucha acción, pero puede resultar entretenida para aquellos que busquen algo relajado y sobre objetos antiguos, así que, espero que disfruten mi reseña de la misma. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205541_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EpnEHPUVjHB9L6gJtKmLxG6qMmVC92gqi8VbFMhAv2fpoTKxBmDozq3odzcEjskiHxb.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm2067888384/?ref_=ttmi_mi_30_2) ---
> # Holmes of kyoto (京都寺町三条のホームズ)… ---

>Este anime fue estrenado para el año 2018, con un total de 12 episodios, el estudio a cargo fue Seven y dirigido por Tokihiro Sasaki; esta historia de misterio y romance su serie de novelas aún está en curso, mientras que su manga dio por finalizado en el 2025. Por cierto, el nombre en japonés es Kyoto Teramachi Sanjou no Holmes. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205646_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23x1DBTiKGt2q6qvP9LNNneuj9aCXHyaPREstRAsctH6Q7TX56dT8Y79r6Pc89yKp8Nvg.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm2034333952/?ref_=ttmi_mi_30_1) ---
> # En cuanto a la trama… ---

>La historia comienza cuando Aoi Mashiro, una estudiante de preparatoria que atraviesa un momento personal difícil tras mudarse a Kioto; este hecho hace que rompa con sus novios y mantenga distancia con sus amistades, por lo que decide llevar unas valiosas antigüedades familiares a una tienda del distrito de Teramachi con la intención de empeñarlas y obtener dinero para volver a Saitama, su lugar de nacimiento. Allí conoce a Kiyotaka Yagashira, el carismático nieto del dueño, un joven estudiante universitario de 22 años, poseedor de una agudeza mental tan brillante y deductiva que todos lo apodan \
. ---

>Al notar que Aoi posee un talento natural e intuitivo para percibir el valor y la autenticidad del arte, Kiyotaka le ofrece un trabajo de medio tiempo como su asistente, pues, aunque le haya traído una pieza de arte de gran valor, no podía comprársela por ser menor de edad y al escuchar su pasado y su similitud con él, le ofrece esta oportunidad. A partir de ese momento, la trama se sumerge en una dinámica donde ambos jóvenes se dedican a resolver diversos enigmas cotidianos, disputas familiares y secretos ocultos que los clientes traen consigo junto a sus preciados objetos y un personaje que está detrás de falsificaciones muy bien logradas ¿Quién será este enemigo tan recurrente en la vida de Kiyotaka? ¿Serán capaz de ambos protagonistas sanar sus heridas del pasado? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205732_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xyVMSSurEAqMqW1F2BCYRMXBtuuNHKmB2nLFhCbJkK5ebxjrAy9EkpjTC7JB2axmoaN.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm1246508801/?ref_=ttmi_mi_23_2) ---
> # Opinión personal ---

>Lo primero que debo aclararles es que, aquí no encontrarás crímenes violentos, sino misterios intelectuales profundamente ligados a la historia del arte japonés, la autentificación de piezas antiguas y las complejidades de las relaciones humanas, por lo que, a su vez, puede resultarles repetitivas algunos episodios y piensen que es algo mucho más misterioso por el nombre, algo por el que me deje llevar, además de la animación. Aun así, terminé viéndolo todo, más que nada por el arte y como relacionaban esos objetos de gran riqueza cultural que manifestaban en referencia a eventos cotidianos o relaciones humanas, pero más allá de eso, mmm, siento que el anime dejo mucho que desear, en lo que a mi respecta y es ese estilo de historia que no repetiría varias veces, lo recuerdo es más que nada por ese motivo a como abarcan el tema de los objetos antiguos y ya. ---

>En cuanto los personajes, hablemos primero de Kiyotaka, no es un sabelotodo arrogante; es un caballero tradicional de Kioto, su educación y su respeto por el pasado son lo que realmente da vida al personaje, por él también puede que les resulte cautivador este anime, y con la chica, Aoi, pues es el tipo de personaje con el que logras empatizar, pues representa a cualquiera que se haya sentido perdido al mudarse a un lugar nuevo; su crecimiento de una chica insegura a alguien que confía en su propio juicio es muy satisfactorio de ver y con respecto a la química entre estos dos, es bastante lenta, por lo que no esperen algo realmente apasionado. Y, por último, la animación también es muy bonita, la paleta de colores es cálida y acogedora; os fondos no son genéricos; realmente sientes que estás caminando que estas viviendo la experiencia de Kioto, viendo los templos y sintiendo el cambio de estaciones. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205810_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wMcbDuQfLwUeyZMpfBqbPoe41CcQtsicxtmFHWo3NJZXnHjbqVJJ7Bk7jdw4CkuscYJ.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm3528144641/?ref_=ttmi_mi_28_2) ---
> # Puntos positivos… ---

> - Atmósfera y ambientación espectaculares: El anime es, literalmente, una carta de amor a Kioto. El nivel de detalle en los paisajes, los templos reales, los festivales tradicionales y la gastronomía local es precioso, parecieras transportarte a ese lugar. - Aprendizaje genuino de cultura y arte: No es solo entretenimiento; la serie te educa de forma muy amena sobre el arte japonés, la caligrafía, la cerámica y cómo los expertos tasan el valor y la autenticidad de las antigüedades, y fue por este motivo el que me quedé viéndolo. - Evolución madura de los personajes: La relación entre Aoi y Kiyotaka es sana, respetuosa y constructiva. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205838_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tH3MRGD2aDep7QqspbsrkDtuAQis81qw7o7XiCeuGcwauAPkBXqox6ggbyRFnCUpv3c.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm808138497/?ref_=ttmi_mi_12_2) ---
> # Puntos negativos… ---

>

- Ritmo excesivamente lento (Slow-burn): Si buscas una trama que avance rápido o que te deje al borde del asiento al final de cada episodio, este anime no es para ti.
- Falta de ambición en la trama principal: Aunque hay un \

(el falsificador Enshou), la rivalidad no llega a niveles de tensión máxima como en otros animes de misterio. - Romance muy sutil: Si vas con la expectativa de ver un romance apasionado con grandes declaraciones, te vas a quedar con las ganas. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-15_205920_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23w2mG6AC79zdNwRrcZErW1oo4fXu5FACGwfrySEeptYRVAjXDFP8RbHhCtbKzqwXvFv5.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt8683066/mediaviewer/rm170604289/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_1) ---
> # Puntaje que le doy… ---
>7/10 Historia │ 7.5/10 Animación │ 7/10 Sonido │ 7.5/10 Diseño de personajes │ 7/10 General ---
>Si buscas algo que te haga sentir bien, te gusta la estética japonesa, disfrutas de los misterios \
tipo detectivesco suave y valoras la narrativa centrada en personajes más que en la acción explosiva, por lo que no esperes cosas intensas, llena de mucha acción o misterio. ---

body.title: Crows Nest wander and pickleball : June 15 2026
body.body:
A challenging night. Went to bed earlier than normal - does not work for me. Sleep 3 hours and then awake from 2 am onwards. Was churning whether I had got my bonus page loaded up correctly. Checked when I did get moving - was done right ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9af209ec-ea92-4c11-ab65-63b6e2150a59.jpg) Caught the train up to Crows Nest for pickleball. Was a bit early - walked up and down a few streets. A bit of Victorian red brick to start. Home to one of Sydney's best known Greek restaurants. Still got armoured cars delivering cash ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/295f1369-25d0-4f10-bb51-f35122991d86.jpg) Another Victorian red brick building with interesting towers ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1150bcf9-d8fd-4f5d-8657-b8cdbbe6ae36.jpg) Crows Nest Hotel - also a red brick Victorian ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/23d4ce9a-26ed-4ad5-9936-72215f8a82b3.jpg) A bit of 1890s red brick on the Pacific Highway ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/33220a70-5380-4c0d-948b-a018eba1dc2c.jpg) One of the hip pubs in a building that has been changed a few times. Was probably Victorian too but had a bit an Art Deco uplift Had a good pickleball session. 5 players of whom I plated with 2 weeks back. One new. Skills are improving and a friendly group. Can sure feel the body is not 30 anymore ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/81bd4f66-5626-4fb4-8550-914e86a79f8d.jpg) New signage on the courts. A place for play. Not a place for bossy bullies like the visit before Stopped at shops on the way home. No dinner cooking tonight as my wife had lunch provided in the office ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/79f3f6ee-7575-46ad-9061-bfbfee38efcc.jpg) Did get the review of the latest Tiffany Lambert product posted - read it here https://mclnks.com/trafficcapturereview

body.title: Bitcoin $66k rally and $150m short liquidation: New turn in the market
body.body: <div class=\

> Good afternoon, how are you all? Of course, you are all well. Today, I am going to share some information with you about the current crypto currency mcryptocurrencyou like it. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWGHdmTxCXGSewMdf1y5USPJ1hq5o4smTwuEuettdoXD8/IMG_20260616_193645.png Today's market situation was actually quite interesting, wasn't it? On the one hand, prices are rising rapidly, and on the other hand, the behaviour of big investors seems a bit mixed. Especially what has happened in the crypto market in the last few days has come as a surprise to many traders. Recently, Bitcoin's price suddenly rose above $65,000 again, then came close to $ 66 K. The main reason behind this rapid rise was a major short squeeze, where short positions worth about $150 million were liquidated at once. The main event began when there were some signs of peace in the international political situation, especially the news of a decrease in tension between the United States and Iran. Due to this news, the interest in taking risks among investors increased again, and its impact directly affected the crypto market. When the price of Bitcoin suddenly started to rise, traders who had taken short positions expecting the price to fall came under pressure. As the price rose, many of them were forced to close their positions. This process is actually a short liquidation, and when there are many liquidations at once, the price in the market increases even faster. During this whole event, a change was seen not only in crypto but also in the global market. Oil prices fell by about 4%, which created some relief among investors about inflation. As a result, interest in risky assets increased again. However, everything cannot be said to be completely positive. Because,f rom the institutional side, it can be seen that the outflow is still going on in spot Bitcoin ETFs. About $316 million has left the market in a week. This means that big investors are still not completely confident, but are somewhat cautious. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS3mkEcED3oJNPaSXyVPS5hUZcVh2e1Ptv5LHJXApt5aY/IMG_20260616_193654.png If we look at these two aspects together, it can be understood that the market is now in a state of balance. While the short squeeze is driving the price up rapidly, institutional outflows are raising some questions about future trends. The direction Bitcoin will take in the coming days will largely depend on whether new investment flows return and how stable the global political situation remains. body.body:
Dein Beitrag hat mich weniger über Hive als über Systeme im Allgemeinen nachdenken lassen.

In meinem Berufsleben habe ich viele technische Systeme kommen und gehen sehen. Manche waren hervorragend durchdacht, andere eher fragwürdig. Interessanterweise war der langfristige Erfolg nur selten eine technische Frage.

Fast immer ging es um Menschen.

Wer baut es?
Wer pflegt es?
Wer investiert seine Zeit, obwohl der unmittelbare Nutzen oft gering ist?
Und wer hält durch, wenn die anfängliche Begeisterung nachlässt?

Deshalb kann ich deinen Gedanken zum Fork nachvollziehen. Technisch kann man vieles neu bauen. Die schwierigere Frage ist für mich jedoch, ob man damit auch die Menschen mitnimmt oder lediglich den Ort wechselt.

Bei der Demokratie-Frage bin ich etwas zwiegespalten. Geld und Beziehungen hatten schon immer Einfluss auf soziale Systeme. Das gilt für Staaten, Unternehmen, Vereine und vermutlich auch für Hive.

Die spannendere Frage ist für mich daher nicht, ob Geld Einfluss hat, sondern ob daneben noch andere Wege existieren, Wirkung zu entfalten.

Denn wenn nur Kapital zählt, wird es irgendwann langweilig.
Wenn nur Beziehungen zählen, wird es irgendwann unerquicklich.
Wenn aber Wissen, Ausdauer, Ideen, Hilfsbereitschaft und Kreativität ebenfalls Gewicht bekommen, entsteht etwas, das für mich näher an einer Gemeinschaft liegt.

Vielleicht ist Hive deshalb weder kaputt noch fertig.

Vielleicht ist es einfach ein Ort, an dem dieselben menschlichen Fragen sichtbar werden, die wir überall finden.

body.title: What is the Best Itinerary for 2 Days in Mumbai?
body.body:
Mumbai is a city where colonial heritage, vibrant markets, and modern attractions come together. If you are planning a [Mumbai tour package for 2 days](https://www.brahmandtour.com/mumbai-tour-package), a well-planned itinerary can help you experience the city's highlights without feeling rushed.

Day 1: Explore Mumbai's Iconic Landmarks

Begin your journey at the Gateway of India, one of the city's most famous attractions. Continue to the historic Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Later, visit Marine Drive and enjoy stunning views of the Arabian Sea.

Popular attractions for the first day include:

*   \- Gateway of India

*   \- Marine Drive

*   \- Colaba Causeway

*   \- Prince of Wales Museum

What Should You See on Day 2?

Day two can focus on culture and local experiences. Visit the fascinating Elephanta Caves, known for their ancient rock-cut sculptures. Explore local markets and discover Mumbai's diverse food culture.

A well-designed 2 days tour package from mumbai may also include nearby attractions and guided sightseeing for a hassle-free experience.

Why Choose a Guided Mumbai Tour?

A professional Mumbai sightseeing tour helps visitors cover major attractions efficiently while learning about the city's rich history. Whether you are interested in heritage sites, local culture, or coastal views, a carefully planned Mumbai travel itinerary ensures you make the most of your visit in just two days.

body.title: If God created everything in Love why is there Suffering | The Oldpath
body.body:
https://youtu.be/1-jrjpAkiXg?si=SbXDBPe7dWD3krkW

God's love for us cannot be totally explained. Pain and suffering were never in the plan of God for us. He takes no pleasure in seeing His people entangled in misery. That's the last thing He would have in mind for the people He made in His own image.
‎
‎But somehow, we still undergo suffering. This is not because God stopped at some point in time in loving us. This is majorly because many people have decided to go outside the plan of God. Things are most likely to not end up well when we do things or own way and not the ways of God.
‎
‎God gave us the right to decide on our own. But sadly, most people went on to choose wrongly. People are too quick to blame God but fail to realize that their actions can bring about consequences such as the ones they are facing. The Bible made brought to our understanding that we must surely reap what we sow.
‎
‎But God is too merciful to abandon us despite our disobedience and unfaithfulness. Some things we consider to be problems could have been a lot problematic if not for the mercies of God upon our lives. Some of these experiences are processes we must go through for us to reach our full potential.

body.title: Writing Prompt: “I can’t drive that!”, entry posted by thepavsalford
body.body:
Writing Prompt: “I can’t drive that!”, entry posted by thepavsalford

My warm greetings to fellow Freewriters!

This is my entry to the Writing Prompt by @mariannewest for [15 June 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3135: I can’t drive that!](https://ecency.com/@daily.prompt/15-june-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3135-i-cant-drive-that)

A week had already passed since he was made redundant.

As time was going fast, he started to doubt whether he would be able to find another job in the next week, not to say in the next month or months.

There weren’t many jobs available in the local area that could match his qualifications and experience, so he soon realized that he would have to lower his expectations, and accept a job just to get paid a salary and make ends meet.

When he finally got a job offer at a local packaging factory, he sighed with relief, because luck had  
decided to smile at him after so many fruitless applications and interviews.

He drove to the site of the factory, and asked for Mr. Jameson, the HR manager.

Mr. Jameson informed him that, unfortunately, the post he had applied for had been covered, but they were urgently looking for a forklift truck driver, so he might consider this option and give it a try.

He didn’t tell Mr. Jameson that he didn’t have a license to drive a forklift truck, but he thought it wouldn’t be very different from driving a car, so, why not, he would give a try.

After that, they decided to test his driving skills immediately, and put him on the driver’s seat on a forklift truck.

They told him to take some pallets and move them to another location inside the factory, and put him to some more tests.

When he realized that driving a forklift truck required a certain level of skill and experience that he apparently lacked, he thought that it was about time to stop fooling himself and others and acknowledge his ignorance.

“I’m sorry, but I can’t drive that!”, it was the only words that he could say.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vW-KWUKOspY&pp=ygUoaG93IGVhc3kgaXMgaXQgdG8gZHJpdmUgYSBmb3JrbGlmdCB0cnVjaw%3D%3D

body.body: Me ha gustado mucho este reportaje sobre los perfumes en el Antiguo Egipto. Soy una enamorada de esa cultura y ya conocía casi todo lo que comentas, pero por ejemplo me has descubierto esa costumbre sobre los conos de cera de abeja perfumados, jeje. Un solo detalle: los frascos de alabastro con cabezas de dioses se llaman vasos canopos y no eran para los ungüentos, sino para contener los órganos internos del difunto, debidamente embalsamados y perfumados, eso sí. 😆\nEn cuanto a los aromas modernos, he pasado por diferentes etapas en las que prendía inciensos, velas perfumadas o aceites esenciales para enmascarar el mal olor del tabaco en casa, pero cuando dejé de fumar también lo detuve, me lo has recordado y rescataré esa sana costumbre. El simple ritual de prender una vela ya me traslada a un estado de más calma...\nNo soy de llevar perfumes caros, la verdad. Además, en mi región hay una empresa (Caravan Fragancias) que hace imitaciones de marcas conocidas y la relación calidad-precio es excelente, desde que la descubrí solo compro de esas. Me gustan las que imitan la Million Dollar Lady de Paco Rabanne, Good Girl de Carolina Herrera y For Her de Narciso Rodríguez.

body.title: DAO DEC Report 16/06
body.body:
Changes:
- I removed the credits.for.dec table, seemed like not the most useful information now that we have enough data for the average to matter. It is still available, if someone misses it, let me know.
- The average daily mint for SPS burn and cards now goes back to January instead of May to verify that there was a mistake in how DEC was counted before the audit in March. The number shouldn't be compared to last report.

In the 46 days since the DAO took over he credits.for.dec account about 560m DEC was sold, which is about 12m a day, an increase of 1,5m. The average stabilized a bit together with the DEC price, but we are now well past half the initial billion DEC, which leaves the DAO with about 1,4b DEC and 1b DEC in the reserves.

The average daily DEC income of the DAO picked up quite a lot and is now 567k, which is an increase of about 300k. The majority of which are escalation packs, which makes sense, considering DEC fell so fast that it is very close to the SPS discount on escalation packs now. Since the increase in DEC spending by the DAO increased more the DAO now loses about 11.5m DEC a day.

The average daily DEC mint from burning SPS is about 85k DEC, a total of 14m this year, but the majority happened in January. For cards it has been about 100 DEC a day on average, so nothing.

DEC burn details:
|account|total_since_2026_01_01|avg_daily|
|-|-|-|
|LP_FEES|31.653k|190k|
|$GUILD_STORE|269k|2k|
|$MARKET_LIST_FEE|0|0|
|$ENERGY|10.844k|66k|
|$WILD_PASS|35.297k|213k|
|$UNBIND_ACCOUNT|13.405k|125k|
|$UNBIND_BURN|3.571k|22k|
|$RANKED_PASS|1.345k|8k|
|$SHOP|16.648k|100k|
|$MARKET_BURN_FEE|47.236k|285k|
|$RENTAL_BURN_FEE|0|0|
|$TOKEN_RENTAL_FEE|31k|0|
|$TOKEN_RENTAL_BURN_FEE|645k|4k|
|$LAND_GRAIN_AUTOPURCHASE|0|0|
|$LAND_TC_DECBURN|517k|3k|
|$LAND_POWER_CORE_PURCHASE|5.666k|34k|
|$LAND_GRAIN_PURCHASE|0|0|
|TOTAL|167.127k|1.051k|

The burns are still stable at about 1m DEC a day. Keep in mind the API still doesn't allow reading of all accounts, so it is likely more. With regard to the DAOs daily obligations, which comes 5500 USD per day or, at course of 0.000255 for DEC, 21.5m DEC the burn would equate to 4.6%. By not burning the DEC the DAO could reduce its daily net negative for DEC by 8.6%.

For credits the average mint per day is 4.021k, so 4021 USD a day average income for the DAO, which is 73% of the daily expenses. This means the DAO is about 1.5k short of its daily obligations. Note that it is hard to track how many CREDITS are in player hands or how many are spent daily as it would require a lot of digging through chain data. For now it is enough to look at how much USD comes in for cash flow reasons. What is relatively easy to determine is, that about 3k USD of credit obligations are settled through the secondary market daily.

Lastly, some data on the land pack sale. The DAO offers a 5% discount if the packs are bought in DEC, currently 7450 DEC, which, assuming all packs are being sold in DEC, would equate to a 25k USD buyback of DEC, the amount of DEC depends of course on the price development. 

Contrary to the above this is paragraph is opinion:
Personally, I don't think this is a great way to do the buyback for the DAO, since the DAO will accept DEC while it is moving up its bump and sell it over the coming months. This, yet again, opens the door for currency risk. I would have preferred that 5% of the sales are set aside and used for a buyorder at lower prices. As it was done it yet again incentivizes people to buy cheap DEC and unload it once it goes higher. In the end the DAO not only has the cost of the 5% discount, but it basically signals \

.

The TL:DR:
- The DEC course is worsening and with it the DEC outflow increases and does so faster even though DEC income more than doubled due to escalation pack sales in DEC picking up. A total of 560m DEC have been put back into circulation, which is more than 25% of the DAOs initial liquid DEC.
- The DAO earns an average of 4021 USD per day, which means we are 1489 USD or 27% of the daily obligations short of being profitable.
- Burns are still stable around 1m DEC a day and still do absolutely nothing other than making the DAO run out of DEC faster.

body.title: Amman Tours Guide Complete Travel Information for Visitors to Jordan
body.body:
![Amman Tours Guide Complete Travel Information for Visitors to Jordan.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/2f4af1893de6668f709f255b2923db81210bcf18773bcf6f6abeff06c4b38c13)



Amman is the capital city of Jordan and one of the most important cultural and historical destinations in the Middle East. It is a city where ancient heritage meets modern urban life, making it a must visit location for travelers exploring the region.

This Amman tours guide is designed to help travelers understand the city in a simple and practical way so they can plan their visit efficiently and enjoy the best experiences.

Amman is known for its historical landmarks, local markets, cultural sites, food experiences, and easy access to some of the most famous attractions in Jordan such as Petra and the Dead Sea.

## Important Places to Visit in Amman Tours Guide

### **Amman Citadel Historical Site**

The Amman Citadel is one of the most important historical places in the city. It is located on a hill that gives a wide view of Amman.

Visitors can explore ancient ruins that include Roman, Byzantine, and early Islamic structures.

*   Key highlights include

*   Temple of Hercules

*   Umayyad Palace ruins

*   Panoramic city views

This location is ideal for travelers who are interested in history and archaeology.

### **Roman Theatre and Downtown Amman**

The Roman Theatre is one of the most iconic landmarks in the city. It reflects the Roman history of Amman and is still used for cultural events today.

Downtown Amman is located nearby and offers a local experience with markets, street shops, and traditional food.

Visitors can expect

*   Historical architecture

*   Local shopping streets

*   Cultural atmosphere

This area is best for walking tours and photography.

### Cultural and Religious Attractions

Amman also offers important cultural and religious landmarks that reflect the identity of Jordan.

One of the main sites is King Abdullah I Mosque which is known for its large blue dome and peaceful environment.

Other attractions include

*   Local mosques

*   Cultural museums

*   Traditional neighborhoods

These places help travelers understand the cultural background of Jordan.

### Food Experience in Amman Tours Guide

Food is an important part of visiting Amman. The city offers a wide variety of traditional Jordanian dishes and street food.

Popular foods include

*   Mansaf which is the national dish

*   Falafel sandwiches

*   Hummus and fresh bread

*   Shawarma

*   Sweet desserts like kunafa

Best areas to explore food include downtown Amman and Rainbow Street.

### Day Trips from Amman

Amman is also a great starting point for exploring other famous destinations in Jordan.

Popular day trips include

*   Petra archaeological city

*   Dead Sea floating experience

*   Jerash Roman ruins

*   Wadi Rum desert adventure

These tours make Amman a central travel hub for visitors in Jordan.

### Who Should Use This Amman Tours Guide

This guide is useful for different types of travelers including

*   Backpackers who want budget friendly travel options

*   Tourists who want structured sightseeing plans

*   Culture lovers interested in history and local traditions

*   Digital nomads exploring Middle Eastern destinations

*   Travel bloggers creating content about Jordan

### Why Amman is a Special Travel Destination

Amman is unique because it combines ancient history with modern city life. Travelers can experience historical ruins in the morning and enjoy modern cafés and restaurants in the evening.

Reasons travelers choose Amman include

*   Rich historical background

*   Friendly local culture

*   Affordable travel experience

*   Easy access to major attractions in Jordan

### Travel Insight for Amman Tours Guide Keyword

The keyword [Amman tours guide](https://journeyinjordan.com/destinations/amman/) is highly relevant for travelers who are actively planning trips to Jordan. It represents strong search intent because users are looking for complete travel information, itineraries, and guided experiences.

*   Related search interests include

*   Amman travel itinerary

*   Jordan city tours

*   Best places in Amman

*   Amman sightseeing guide

## Conclusion

Amman is one of the most important travel destinations in Jordan. It offers a balanced experience of history, culture, food, and modern city life.

This Amman tours guide helps travelers understand the city in a simple and practical way so they can enjoy their visit and explore Jordan more confidently.

Amman is not just a city to visit but a starting point to discover the beauty of Jordan.

body.title: El tiempo no borra aquellos recuerdos que se quedan en el alma/Time cannot erase those memories that remain in the soul [ESP/ENG]
body.body: <div class=\

> Hola queridos amigos de @holos.lotus, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión paso para hablarles sobre una reflexión de un tema que siempre me ha causado inquieto y que con el pasar de tiempo a través de lo que he visto he podido reflexionar de ello, sobre todo a raíz de la enfermedad de mi mamá, lo cual fue una prueba clara de cómo hay recuerdos que aunque la memoria ya no lo pueda mantener, se queda de alguna manera clavados en el alma. --- ![REVIEW (8).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wMPrk7YtZrQZdLpjUoAqC9Nuj3xehqGB5D9X5xc8SP54M49yG7SWUwgrmx4ksgrGFjb.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Cuando hablamos de que el tiempo no lo borra, de cierta manera no solo nos apoyamos en la memoria, sino también en las fotos, videos que podamos tener de ellos, pero que pasa cuando ni ello es suficiente, ¿se borran por completo? Recuerdo que una tía me decía que quizás no se recordaba mucho cuando era pequeña y como era la cara de su abuela que a temprana edad la perdió, pero que de alguna manera ella así sea una silueta con una cara algo confusa pero que de alguna manera la podía tener presente, también que a pesar de los años y que quizás no recordaba exactamente las cosas que pasaron de alguna manera mantenía vivo esos recuerdos de alguna u otra manera. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>Cuando mi mamá enferma, pensé que eso que me contaba mi tía sería más difícil ya que su memoria se iría deteriorando cada vez más, por lo que quizás ni un destello de lo que alguna vez vivió tendría, sería algo complicado para ello, claro quizás nombres, o identificar exactamente quien es quien se torna algo difícil para ello, así como recordar exactamente lugares donde estuvo, personas con las cuales convivió, vivencias que fueron en su momento importante, si resulta muy difícil recordar con la mejor exactitud, sin embargo, en algún punto los recuerdos pese a todo prevalecen como una ráfaga que viene y te indica que eso de alguna manera sucedió, que de alguna forma esa persona existió, que de alguna manera si estuviste ahí y por lo que vale la pena mantener así sea en tu alma. --- ![margarita_kochneva-text-4095909_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/243g35dTjrSQjs5ZW3nrpfnsuyvU2Aimbc6hVkfycduBhSstr2VmesX5NHQkSQemLtyK9.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-4095909_1920.jpg) ---

>La memoria realmente es una herramienta muy útil, pero cuando esta ya no puede ser usada, hay cosas que quedan guardadas dentro del corazón como si pese al tiempo, los daños ocasionados en el mismo, siempre habrá algo que los mantengan ahí de alguna u otra manera, como la necesidad de preservar aquello que vale la pena preservar, aquello que se vuelve importante para lograr conservar, el tiempo no deja que eso se escape por completo, quizás como recuerdos comunes que podemos tener ya no lo son, pero de alguna manera se quedan ahí resguardados como un tesoro que no se puede de alguna forma olvidar pese a todo pese al pasar de los años. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello, dear friends at @holos.lotus, greetings and blessings, On this occasion, I’d like to share some thoughts on a topic that has always troubled me. Over time, through what I’ve witnessed, I’ve been able to reflect on it—especially in the wake of my mother’s illness, which was a clear reminder that there are memories that, even when the mind can no longer hold onto them, remain somehow etched in the soul. --- ![REVIEW (9).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wMPrkT9UpU9VqUxsf7Gy9Q3dQPQzd1Mbs84Bfy2QmcFVCuKqaP48FtcYcLAKKLBthjQ.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>When we say that time doesn’t erase them, in a way we rely not only on our memories but also on the photos and videos we may have of them. But what happens when even that isn’t enough? Do they fade away completely? I remember an aunt telling me that she didn’t remember much from when she was little—like what her grandmother’s face looked like, since she lost her at a young age—but that somehow, even if it was just a vague silhouette with a somewhat blurry face, she could still keep her in her mind. She also said that despite the passing years and the fact that she might not remember exactly what happened, she somehow kept those memories alive in one way or another. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>When my mom got sick, I thought that what my aunt was telling me would become even harder, since her memory would keep getting worse and worse, so she might not even have a single glimpse of what she once experienced—it would be quite difficult for her. Of course, perhaps names, or identifying exactly who is who, becomes difficult for her, as does remembering exactly where she was, the people she lived with, and experiences that were important at the time. It’s very hard to recall them with complete accuracy, however, at some point, memories prevail despite everything, like a gust of wind that comes and tells you that it somehow happened, that in some way that person existed, that in some way you were there, and that’s why it’s worth holding on to, even if only in your soul. --- ![margarita_kochneva-text-4095909_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/243g35dTjrSQjs5ZW3nrpfnsuyvU2Aimbc6hVkfycduBhSstr2VmesX5NHQkSQemLtyK9.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-4095909_1920.jpg) ---

>Memory really is a very useful tool, but when it can no longer be used, there are things that remain stored within the heart as if, despite the passage of time and the damage inflicted upon it, there will always be something that keeps them there in one way or another—like the need to preserve what is worth preserving, what becomes important to keep. Time does not let that slip away completely; perhaps because the shared memories we once had are no longer there, but somehow they remain there, safeguarded like a treasure that cannot be forgotten, despite everything, despite the passing of the years. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Thank you very much for reading. I hope you enjoy it. I’d be happy to answer any questions, and if you’d like to know more about me, here are my:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
**Translated Using Deepl** ![separadoryasma2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23t7FGcw1y2pTi43pMTQS2Uf1P9xBf6q2kKE6KtQauS4SiaTXef14CAYFekYSHP5WkfUy.png)

body.title: Marvell Technology CFO Files to Sell $60M Worth of Shares
body.body:
Marvell Technology’s Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Willem Meintjes has filed a Form 144 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), indicating plans to sell 207,329 shares of the company’s common stock.

According to the filing, the estimated value of the sale is around $60.13 million, based on an average share price of approximately $290.03.

The planned sale represents nearly 48% of Meintjes’ current holdings and has been described as a non-planned transaction. The shares are expected to be sold through Morgan Stanley Smith Barney on the Nasdaq market.

The transaction date is listed as June 15, 2026.

Marvell Technology, headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, is a major semiconductor company focused on data infrastructure and technology solutions.

📌 Market Insight:
Large insider share sales do not always indicate negative sentiment, as executives may sell shares for personal financial planning or other reasons. However, investors often monitor insider transactions as part of their overall marStonalysis.

body.title: Coffee Tovar: aroma, flavor and tradition
body.body: “Coffee, coffee, coffee with milk, coffeeeee... Bring on the coffee pot with the coffee, with the coffee” 🥳🥳🥳 That's what I used to sing back when I was a camp counselor, hahaha. The song popped into my head because it inspires joy and wonder when you discover something fascinating. I was out for a walk with my boyfriend in Colonia Tovar, in the state of Aragua, Venezuela, and the first thing I noticed was how crowded the place was, which I really liked because it’s a sign of prosperity; you can also see strawberry fields, among other fruit crops, and of course, coffee; although we didn’t see the coffee plantations themselves, we did spot a roadside stand right across from the church, and I couldn’t help but stop. I’m talking about Café Tovar—it’s artisanal, wood-fired roasted by a family that has kept the tradition alive for four generations. The aroma is intense, divine—and their slogan is spot-on: “Flavor that begins with the aroma.” As for the taste, it’s very, very rich. It has body, intensity, and a variety of flavors. You can find the traditional blend, as well as ones with hazelnuts, ginger, coconut, vanilla and cinnamon, cardamom, chocolate, and almonds. There are many varieties available; we bought two 50-gram packs to try, one with hazelnuts and the other with ginger. I tried the hazelnut one at home with my son, and he asked me why we didn’t buy more—hahaha, it’s that tasty. In future posts, I’ll continue sharing other discoveries from Colonia Tovar. For now, you know what to do—time for coffee. Thanks for reading. Text and images are my own. Translated by DeeplL

🥳🥳🥳 así cantaba en mi época de recreadora jajaja. Me vino a la mente la canción porque inspira alegría y asombro para cuando descubres algo fascinante.

Estaba de paseo con mi novio por la Colonia Tovar en el estado Aragua, Venezuela y lo primero que noté es lo poblado que está el lugar, lo que me agradó muchísimo porque es señal de prosperidad; además se ven los cultivos de fresas entre otras frutas y por supuesto, café; aunque no vimos la siembra de café como tal, sí apreciamos un punto de venta en plena calle, diagonal a la Iglesia y no pude evitar detenerme.

Hablo de Café Tovar, es artesanal, tostado a leña por una familia que mantiene la tradición por cuarta generación. El aroma es intenso, divinooo pues su eslogan no tiene desperdicio \

; y de sabor, es muy, muy rico. Tiene cuerpo, intensidad y variedad de sabores. Puedes encontrar el tradicional, con avellanas, jengibre, coco, vainilla y canela, cardamomo, chocolate, y almendras.

Tienes muchas presentaciones, compramos dos de 50 gramos para probar, una con avellanas y otra con jengibre. La de avellanas la probé casa con mi hijo y me preguntó por qué no compramos más jajaja es sabroso.

En otras publicaciones seguiré compartiendo otros descubrimientos de la Colonia Tovar. Por ahora, ya saben, a tomar café.

Gracias por leer. Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad. Traductor DeeplL

body.title: The Great Mystery of the Stinky Living Room
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma64f7ko5s2Nu9UFNThVS3SGKixCzUjfMbwuqezFtTKY4/1781576824118.jpg)





So, for the last few weeks, my son has been complaining about this weird, \

smell he kept catching first thing in the morning while making coffee. Naturally, he blamed the cat, Busek. They completely deep-cleaned the litter box, replaced all the litter, and when the smell didn't go away, they were totally convinced it was the cat himself 

Yesterday, while they were watching a movie, the smell hit them again. They even started sniffing their own feet to make sure it wasn't them! They gave Busek a good sniff and decided he was definitely the culprit—he’s not exactly a fan of baths, so they figured he was just due for a scrub. They were all set to bathe him this morning.

Then, the plot twist happened. Busek went to curl up in his bed, which is tucked under the side table where their Hoya plant, Frederick, lives. Frederick’s branches hang down right over the bed, so Busek basically sleeps in a little plant jungle. My son crawled down to check the spot and insisted, “Yep, it’s definitely him—that’s the smell!”

. My daughter- in-law leaned in to confirm, but as she got close to the cat, her nose brushed right against Frederick’s blooming flowers. It hit her instantly: the smell wasn't Busek at all—it was the plant! Poor Busek has been getting framed for weeks because of Frederick’s questionable floral scent. Busek is officially innocent, and Frederick is officially on notice for being the stinky houseguest!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRoW1hnVH42DrHynZ7SBqQdWCAnyhsSK7MAqC6eb3W5M/1781576824180.jpg)

After doing some research we learned the reason Frederick has been  crop-dusting the living room after dark comes down to his evolutionary design as a moth magnet! Many varieties of *Hoya* plants have adapted to be pollinated exclusively by nocturnal insects, meaning they intentionally conserve their energy during the daylight hours and only unleash their potent volatile compounds—which can unfortunately mimic that distinct \

aroma—at night when their target pollinators are actively flying around.

 By the time they settle in for an evening movie or when my son wakes up to make his morning coffee, Frederick's nighttime perfume is at its absolute peak concentration in the enclosed air, creating the perfect botanical frame-job for poor, innocent Busek.
