body.body: <div class = \

>

### Drosera rotundifolia - Droseraceae (ENG)

Drosera rotundifolia is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Droseraceae family, known for its round leaves covered with glandular hairs that secrete a sticky substance capable of trapping insects.

![dro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/Eqb45YkbpHNmapJdJuU6CBPDK4uwxDHBgootzBYQhDTb6uVjahzRuuZWN99qTGqAccK.png)

<sub> image created with canva.com </sub>

This characteristic makes it one of the most fascinating European carnivorous plants. It grows wild in acidic peat bogs and poor soils, which is why it is now protected in many countries due to the progressive disappearance of its natural habitats.

**Balsamic Period
The balsamic period is August, when the concentration of active ingredients is highest in the leaves. Wild harvesting is prohibited in many countries; cultivated plants are used.**

Drosera is one of the most important plants in respiratory phytotherapy. Its properties include:
Bronchodilator
Cough reliever
Anti-asthma
Natural antibiotic
Expectorant

It is particularly useful for spasmodic coughs, whooping cough, bronchitis, and respiratory conditions with an irritant component.

**The main compounds responsible for its therapeutic activity are:
Plumbagine—quinone with antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
Droserone — a naphthoquinone derivative with documented efficacy against Staphylococcus, Streptococcus, and Pneumococcus.**

Proteolytic enzymes — facilitate insect digestion and contribute to mucolytic activity.

**Toxicity and Precautions
Toxicity is low, but excessive use may cause gastrointestinal disturbances.**

Contraindicated:
Pregnancy
Breastfeeding
Using concomitant medications without medical supervision.

It is always recommended to consult a healthcare professional before taking this product.

Phytotherapeutic Preparations

**Mother Tincture (TM)**
Herbalism used — 15 g of chopped fresh leaves.
Solvent — 100 ml of 86° hydroalcoholic solution.
Maceration — 21 days in the dark, shaking daily.
Storage — 3 years in amber glass.
Dosage: 100 drops daily, divided into 2–3 doses.

**Drosera was considered a magical plant by 16th-century alchemists, fascinated by its ability to \

and feed on insects. Its rarity and unique habitat contributed to its mystical aura.** ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Drosera rotundifolia - Droseraceae (ITA) La Drosera rotundifolia è un’erbacea perenne appartenente alla famiglia delle Droseraceae, nota per le sue foglie rotonde ricoperte di peli ghiandolari secernenti una sostanza vischiosa capace di intrappolare insetti. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com Questa caratteristica la rende una delle più affascinanti piante carnivore europee. Cresce spontaneamente in torbiere acide e suoli poveri, motivo per cui è oggi protetta in molti Paesi per la progressiva scomparsa degli habitat naturali. **Periodo balsamico Il periodo balsamico è agosto, quando la concentrazione dei principi attivi è massima nelle foglie. La raccolta spontanea è vietata in molti Paesi: si utilizzano piante coltivate.** La Drosera è una delle piante più importanti nella fitoterapia respiratoria. Le sue proprietà includono: Broncodilatatore Tossifugo Antiasma Antibiotico naturale Espettorante È particolarmente utile nelle tossi spasmodiche, nella pertosse, nelle bronchiti e nelle forme respiratorie con componente irritativa. **I principali composti responsabili dell’attività terapeutica sono: Plumbagina — chinone con attività antimicrobica e antinfiammatoria. Droserone — derivato naftochinonico con documentata efficacia contro Staphylococcus, Streptococcus e Pneumococcus. Enzimi proteolitici — facilitano la digestione degli insetti e contribuiscono all’attività mucolitica.** **Tossicità e precauzioni La tossicità è bassa, ma un uso eccessivo può causare disturbi gastrointestinali.** Controindicata: In gravidanza In allattamento In caso di terapie farmacologiche concomitanti senza supervisione medica. È sempre consigliato consultare un professionista sanitario prima dell’assunzione. Preparazioni fitoterapiche **Tintura madre (TM)** Droga utilizzata — 15 g di foglie fresche sminuzzate. Solvente — 100 ml di soluzione idroalcolica a 86°. Macerazione — 21 giorni al buio, agitazione quotidiana. Conservazione — 3 anni in vetro ambrato. Posologia — 100 gocce al giorno, suddivise in 2–3 somministrazioni. **La Drosera fu considerata una pianta magica dagli alchimisti del XVI secolo, affascinati dalla sua capacità di “catturare la rugiada” e di nutrirsi di insetti. La sua rarità e il suo habitat particolare contribuirono alla sua aura mistica.** Sources - Fonti : https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/erboristeria/drosera.html https://guna.com/it/lifestyle/i-tesori-della-natura/drosera-un-rimedio-naturale-per-la-tosse-secca/ ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: Everyday Snapshots: Going to Work, Mami for Dinner, & Fried Sweet Potato for Midnight Snack
body.body: alt=\

/> Greetings, everyone! I hope you’re all having a wonderful day. Every new day gives us another chance to smile, learn, and appreciate the little things that make life special. Whether it’s enjoying good food, spending time with loved ones, or just taking a moment to relax, there’s always something to be thankful for. Join me as I share the highlights of my simple, happy life — filled with small joys, positive moments, and everyday adventures. Let’s celebrate life together, one moment at a time! 😊 * * * **Going to Work** It is another morning, and another day to go to work. I woke up early today and prepared myself to go to the office. I went to the jeepney station, and there was no available vehicle yet. I had to wait for another 10 minutes before I rode on one.
alt=\

/> * * * **Mami for Dinner** My partner bought some Mami for our dinner. He told me he would stop by the local restaurant near the station before he picked me up from the station. I only waited for him for about 10 minutes, then he arrived with the Mami.
alt=\

/> * * * **Going Home** When my partner picked me up from the station, we headed straight to the house. While on our way, I was staring at the sunset. The cloud had been covered with orange hues, and it was beautiful.
alt=\

/> * * * **Sweet Potato for Midnight Snack** I was working on my assignments when my Mama cooked some sweet potatoes. She bought it from the local market and then sliced it into thin pieces. After frying them, she even added some sugar coating to make it better. I made a cup of coffee while having this midnight snack.
alt=\

/> * * * **Everyday Snapshots** by @charmingcherry is a daily blog that features a series of travel, food, and lifestyle stories from her. She created the concept so she could go back into her published posts as her way to keep memories of both normal and special moments that happened on a specific date in her life. * * * ``` Hive Blog No. 397 | Date Published: June 16, 2026 ``` * * * > **_About the Author:_** > She is a career-driven Filipina from the province of Zambales, paving the way for her career in blog content writing through sharing her experiences, reflections, and daily life happenings. She is currently an Internal Auditor at Puregold Price Club, Inc., and a Freelance Writer at Upwork Global, Inc., specializing in SEO Writing.

'Chief commander') was a Chinese military rank that corresponds to a marshal in other nations.[1] It was given to distinguished generals during China's dynastic and republican periods. A higher level rank of dayuanshuai, which corresponds to generalissimo, was awarded to Chiang Kai Shek of the Republic of China. It was also proposed for Mao Zedong on the mainland, but he ultimately never accepted it.

Hello Everyone!

I painted a river scenery with watercolor. I painted forests on both sides of the river and painted a boat in the river. I think it's nice.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNWRpqB2T86fS9WLyJkT2vMwrU5orMsaVxy5vYmApFYNg/1781603458663.jpg)

近期真是雨季丰沛，夏日里难得的降温，只不过是带着雨的湿润，所幸不是一整日都浸泡在雨水中，中间总有那么一些时候，雨停，路上的湿漉漉也逐渐褪去，虽然不知道何时继续下雨，却好似松了一口气。

空气中弥漫着雨后的清新，水泥地上已经完全干透，已经看不出来不久前，还被大雨滋润过。

东街一带又有些许变化，大洋百货重新开业以后，整栋大楼门前多了不少人气，大门前的不远处，还多了两处动漫雕塑，看着就是诙谐打趣风又带着一点轻松感。

整杯咖啡喝一喝，打开美团APP，随意瞄一了眼，还真又有咖啡优惠卷，整体算下来，一杯能优惠10元呢，到了东街这一家星巴克甄选店，店里是两位妹子还在忙活着。

站在甜品柜后面的店员妹子，见我进门就很热情的和我打招呼，看着她那能娇嫩能掐出水的元气脸上露出灿烂笑容，怎能不令人心情大好，我用劵点了一杯喜欢的冰摩卡。

等待咖啡制作的过程中，我又看了一眼星巴克新出水杯款式，以及端午节粽子，还有相关周边，依旧是精致，价格小贵。当然，若你需要购买，价格也不是不能谈，哈哈。

拎着冰摩卡，走去二楼休闲区，这回我换了个座位，更靠近大楼后边窗户处，正好这里也有可以充电的地方，加上这里还有一扇玻璃门，可以走出去看外面的风景，另外右边还有一扇小窗，位置更偏安静，不会被走上走下的人打扰。

喝着咖啡，刷着热点新闻，关于世界杯相关新闻上，已经满是关于佛得角40岁门将神之手封0西班牙消息刷屏了，一次又一次的将球扑救成功，用血肉之躯为球队焊死最后一道闸门。

爆出了这届世界杯中最大的冷门0:0，沃齐尼亚这个名字，也被全球球迷深深得记住，连带记住这个小国--佛得角，他是本届世界杯中当之无愧的MVP球员，INS社交媒体粉丝一夜之间暴涨到500多万，目前粉丝数还在进一步增涨当中。。商业价值暴涨。。

写到这里，我又不禁眼眶湿润了，谁说上帝不公平！！只有你足够努力，足够拼搏，用尽全力的那一刻，上帝自然会为你打开那一扇属于你的胜利之门。

ok ,今天先分享到这里哈，祝福大家周二愉快，喜乐平安。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**

body.title: Гриби проти наслідків струсу мозку: чи справді це крок у майбутнє медицини?
body.body: data-align=\

>Часом дивуєшся, як швидко змінюється світ. Ще вчора теми, які обговорювали лише у вузьких колах або в межах суперечливих наукових дискусій, сьогодні виходять на рівень клінічних досліджень. Я, як людина, яка все життя звикла довіряти чітким формулам та перевіреним реакціям, завжди з певною обережністю ставлюся до будь-яких \
засобів. Але коли мова заходить про нейропластичність та відновлення після травм, хочеш чи не хочеш, а починаєш придивлятися до того, що раніше здавалося абсолютно недоречним.
>
data-align=\
>Нещодавно натрапив на інформацію про австралійське дослідження, де псилоцибін намагаються \
для боротьби з наслідками струсу мозку, і, чесно кажучи, це змусило мене задуматися про глибинні механізми нашої свідомості.
alt=\
> _Графічна інструкція. Джерело: Cell Reports Medicine (2026)._ DOI: 10.1016/j.xcrm.2026.102867
data-align=\

>Ми звикли думати про мозок як про надскладний, але досить крихкий комп'ютер. Один удар, струс — і система починає давати збої. Хронічні симптоми, від яких страждають атлети, військові або просто люди, що потрапили в нещасний випадок, — це не просто головний біль чи запаморочення. Це цілий спектр когнітивних порушень, які роблять життя людини нестерпним. І ось тепер дослідники в Австралії наважилися на експеримент, який виглядає майже як наукова фантастика. Суть в тому, щоб за допомогою психоактивної речовини спробувати \
певні нейронні шляхи, які \
після травми.
>
data-align=\

>Звісно, мій хімічний розум одразу починає шукати підвох. Молекулярна структура псилоцибіну нагадує серотонін, і саме ця схожість дозволяє йому взаємодіяти з рецепторами нашого мозку. Але односпрямована дія тут не працює. Це не просто \

. Це складний процес взаємодії з 5-HT2A-рецепторами, які, власне, і відповідають за багато процесів у нашому сприйнятті світу та функціонуванні нейронів. Дослідники сподіваються, що цей вплив допоможе мозку відновити зв’язки, які були пошкоджені або заблоковані внаслідок травматичного ураження. Знаєте, це нагадує мені роботу над складним органічним синтезом: ти можеш мати всі інгредієнти, але без правильного каталізатора процес не піде, або піде зовсім не туди, куди треба. Тут псилоцибін виступає таким собі потенційним каталізатором нейропластичності.
data-align=\

>Найбільше мене вражає те, наскільки ми все ще мало знаємо про власну голову. Ми можемо розрахувати механізм реакції Дільса-Альдера з точністю до атомних орбіталей, можемо синтезувати найскладніші сполуки, але пояснити, чому після удару об двері чи падіння з велосипеда в людини місяцями не минає тривожність або розлади пам'яті, — це все ще територія, повна білих плям. І коли сучасна медицина починає дивитися в бік психоделіків, це ознака того, що традиційні методи терапії, на жаль, часто просто впираються в глухий кут.
data-align=\

>Зрозуміло, що це не панацея, і я закликаю не сприймати це як заклик до самолікування. Це клінічний процес, де важливі дозування, оточення та професійний супровід. Те, що австралійські вчені зараз роблять, — це спроба перетворити хаотичний досвід на контрольований терапевтичний інструмент. Це важливо, бо ми вже бачили, як добрі ідеї дискредитуються через відсутність наукової бази. Якщо вони доведуть, що ця сполука може безпечно стимулювати оновлення синаптичних зв'язків, це відкриє двері для лікування не лише наслідків струсів, а й цілого спектра нейродегенеративних станів.
data-align=\
>Що я думаю про це як практик? Я скептичний, але зацікавлений. У моєму науковому середовищі ми завжди кажемо: \

. І ці дані, які ми побачимо найближчими роками, будуть критично важливими. Чи стане це новою нормою у медицині? Поживемо — побачимо. Але важливо, що науковий світ перестав боятися ставити незручні запитання. Ми шукаємо вихід там, де раніше навіть не наважувалися запалити ліхтар. І це, мабуть, найцікавіший аспект цієї історії. Можливо, саме в таких суперечливих дослідженнях ховається відповідь на питання, як ми можемо покращити якість життя людей, що опинилися в полоні власних травм. А що ви думаєте? Чи готові ми до такого радикального підходу в лікуванні, чи, можливо, це занадто небезпечна гра з нашим \
?
rel=\
class=\
href=\

body.title: AI News Daily - June 16, 2026
body.body:
# AI News Daily - June 16, 2026

Today’s AI news is very practical: agent platforms are consolidating, social search is becoming AI-native, cloud vendors are shipping cost and coding tools, and model/API lifecycles are creating real migration work. I checked the last three AI News Daily posts before writing this. June 13 covered Anthropic’s Fable/Mythos shutdown, Kimi K2.7 Code, AA-AgentPerf, GPT-5.2 retirement in ChatGPT, Gemini TV controls, Claude Corps, and Meta’s AI reorganization. June 14 covered xAI’s Grok Build Plugin Marketplace, Codex Developer Mode, Salesforce MCP, the OpenAI state investigation, Anthropic shutdown follow-on reporting, Meta token controls, and applied AI adoption. June 15 covered Claude API retirements, Anthropic’s AI-for-R&D note, Salesforce Summer ’26, G7 AI policy, Meta’s Alexandr Wang reset, and xAI infrastructure permitting. I avoided repeating those unless there is a material new development.

## 1. Salesforce is buying Fin for $3.6B to push Agentforce deeper into customer support

Salesforce is acquiring Fin, formerly Intercom, for about $3.6 billion. This is not the same Salesforce story as yesterday’s Summer ’26 release. The June 15 release was about MCP, Agentforce tooling, and platform plumbing; today’s development is a major acquisition that gives Salesforce a mature autonomous customer-service agent across chat, email, WhatsApp, SMS, phone, Slack, and other channels. TechCrunch framed the deal as Salesforce buying a proven AI customer-service platform, while Reuters and The Register emphasized the purchase price and the strategic push behind Agentforce.

The developer and product angle is straightforward: customer support is one of the clearest places where AI agents can absorb real workflow, because the work already has tickets, knowledge bases, escalation paths, service-level expectations, and measurable resolution outcomes. Salesforce already has the CRM data, workflow engine, admin model, and enterprise distribution. Fin gives it a product and team that have spent years turning support automation into something closer to autonomous resolution than a scripted chatbot.

My take: this is an “agents are eating SaaS” moment. Salesforce is not only adding AI features to its existing clouds; it is buying a specialist product that can become a wedge for Agentforce adoption. The question now is whether Salesforce can integrate Fin without flattening the thing that made it useful.

Sources: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/15/salesforce-acquires-ai-customer-service-platform-fin-for-3-6b/ · https://www.streetinsider.com/Reuters/Salesforce%2Bto%2Bbuy%2BFin%2Bfor%2Babout%2B%243.6%2Bbillion/26644598.html · https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/06/15/salesforce-reels-in-customer-support-ai-specialist-fin-for-36b/

## 2. Meta launches Facebook AI Mode for search across public posts

Meta is adding an AI-powered search mode to Facebook that answers questions using public content across Facebook, including Groups and Reels. This is different from the Meta items in recent posts, which focused on the Alexandr Wang/Scale AI strategy reset and internal token controls. The new feature turns Facebook’s massive archive of public posts into an answer engine instead of a traditional social search box.

The useful side is obvious. Facebook has local recommendations, hobby groups, marketplace knowledge, travel tips, parenting threads, repair advice, and a long tail of human experience that does not always rank cleanly on the open web. An AI search mode could make that information much easier to use. The risk is just as obvious: public social content can be stale, biased, sarcastic, promotional, or wrong. If Meta summarizes that content into confident answers, attribution, freshness, and source quality become product-critical.

My take: social search is one of the underappreciated AI battlegrounds. Google has the web, Reddit has communities, TikTok has short-form discovery, and Meta has enormous private and public social context. The winner is not simply the company with the most posts; it is the one that can turn messy human conversation into useful answers without laundering noise into authority.

Sources: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/15/metas-new-ai-mode-on-facebook-pulls-from-public-info-across-its-platforms/ · https://www.theverge.com/tech/950264/meta-ai-mode-search-facebook · https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/meta-improves-ai-options-on-facebook/822967/

## 3. AWS ships a bundle of practical AI updates: FinOps Agent, Gemma 4 on Bedrock, and Kiro Pro Max

AWS’s June 15 weekly roundup included several developer-impacting AI updates: AWS FinOps Agent in preview, Gemma 4 on Amazon Bedrock, and Kiro Pro Max. The FinOps Agent is the most immediately useful for cloud teams. AWS says it can investigate cost anomalies, recommend rightsizing or Savings Plans actions, post findings to Slack, and open Jira tickets. That turns cloud-cost management from a dashboard-review chore into an agent-assisted operational loop.

Gemma 4 on Bedrock matters because model availability is now a platform feature. Developers increasingly want a menu of open and proprietary models behind the same permissions, billing, logging, and deployment controls. Kiro Pro Max points in the same direction for software work: cloud vendors are trying to bundle AI-assisted development, operational visibility, and enterprise governance into the default developer stack.

My take: the cloud AI race is not only about frontier models. It is also about embedding agents into the boring but expensive work: cost anomalies, tickets, resource cleanup, rightsizing, and deployment workflows. That is where AI can create measurable savings without needing a moonshot demo.

Sources: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/aws-weekly-roundup-aws-finops-agent-in-preview-gemma-4-on-bedrock-kiro-pro-max-and-more-june-15-2026/ · https://aws-news.com/article/2026-06-09-aws-finops-agent-is-now-available-in-preview · https://noise.getoto.net/2026/06/15/aws-weekly-roundup-aws-finops-agent-in-preview-gemma-4-on-bedrock-kiro-pro-max-and-more-june-15-2026/

## 4. Google posts hard shutdown dates for older Gemini, Imagen, and Veo API endpoints

Google’s Gemini API changelog now lists shutdown dates for multiple older image and video generation endpoints, including older Imagen, Gemini image, and Veo model IDs. This is a model-lifecycle story, but it is not a repeat of yesterday’s Claude retirement item. Today’s practical issue is Google’s multimodal generation stack: teams using image or video endpoints need to check exact model IDs and migrate before the deadlines.

This matters because image and video workflows often live in places that are easy to forget: thumbnail generators, social-content pipelines, internal creative tools, product mockup scripts, marketing automations, and scheduled jobs. A model deprecation can quietly break the pipeline that produces assets for a newsletter, ecommerce catalog, or app onboarding flow. Google’s models page and changelog are now part of production maintenance for anyone building on Gemini media APIs.

My take: AI builders need a dependency inventory for models, not just packages. Every API call should make it clear which model is being used, where it is configured, who owns the migration, and what fallback exists when a provider retires an endpoint.

Sources: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog · https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models · https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/release-notes

## 5. NewCore emerges to give AI agents enterprise identities

NewCore came out of stealth with $66 million and a pitch that feels timely: AI agents need first-class identities, permissions, lifecycle controls, and revocation. This is a funding story, so I would normally de-prioritize it, but the problem is strategically important enough to include. As enterprises move from “one assistant in a chat window” to fleets of agents that read data, call tools, file tickets, change records, and talk to other systems, service-account sprawl becomes a security problem.

The product category here is bigger than one startup. Agents need to be onboarded, scoped, monitored, rotated, suspended, audited, and deleted. They need least-privilege access and clear ownership. They need to be distinguishable from humans, scripts, integrations, and compromised accounts. TechCrunch’s framing that “AI agents are becoming employees” is a little cute, but the underlying operational issue is real: if an agent can do work, it needs identity infrastructure.

My take: agent identity is going to become a core enterprise AI layer. The teams that skip it will end up with invisible automation accounts holding broad permissions and no clean way to answer “which agent did what, and why?”

Sources: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/15/ai-agents-are-becoming-employees-newcore-emerges-with-66m-to-give-them-identities/ · https://tech.yahoo.com/cybersecurity/articles/ai-agents-become-employees-newcore-130000168.html · https://mezha.net/eng/bukvy/9ee3a7f7_newcore_raises_-66m/

## 6. Radical Numerics previews Omnii, a genomic language model

Radical Numerics launched with a $50 million seed round and previewed Omnii, a genomic language model aimed at human-health and biodefense use cases. Again, the funding is not the main reason to care. The model is. The company says early results include causal regulatory-variant detection and the detection of AI-generated or manipulated pathogen sequences.

Biology is one of the areas where AI model progress could be both enormously useful and unusually sensitive. Better genomic models could help with disease understanding, drug discovery, pathogen surveillance, and synthetic-biology safety. But the same class of capability also raises governance questions around dual-use biology, lab access, screening, and who gets to run which kinds of sequence-generation or analysis workflows.

My take: frontier AI is not only text, code, images, and video. Domain models for biology may become some of the most consequential AI systems of the next decade because they connect directly to health, security, and physical-world intervention.

Sources: https://www.radicalnumerics.ai/blog/radical-numerics-seed · https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260615558179/en/AI-Lab-Radical-Numerics-Launches-with-%2450M-Seed-Round-To-Build-General-Biological-Intelligence · https://www.axios.com/pro/biotech-deals/2026/06/15/radical-numerics-seed-biological-ai-models

## 7. Anthropic heads to Washington over Mythos and Fable restrictions

Business Insider and other reports say Anthropic leaders are meeting with White House officials over restrictions on its Mythos and Fable model line. This is a follow-on to the June 13 and June 15 coverage, so it should not be mistaken for a brand-new model launch. The material new development is the escalation from public statement and policy dispute into direct Washington meetings over whether the restrictions are justified and how frontier access should be governed.

For builders, the lesson is not “Anthropic versus the government.” It is that frontier-model access is becoming a policy-managed resource. Export rules, national-security concerns, foreign-national access, customer eligibility, safety testing, and release timing can now affect whether a model is available in production. That changes vendor risk. A model can be technically strong, priced well, and well-integrated, and still carry access-policy uncertainty.

My take: serious AI teams need model contingency plans. That means evals across multiple providers, abstraction layers that do not hide too much, documented fallback behavior, and a clear understanding of which workloads depend on restricted frontier capability.

Sources: https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-trump-officials-meeting-fable-export-ban-2026-6 · https://www.semafor.com/article/06/13/2026/white-house-move-to-limit-anthropic-linked-to-concerns-about-chinese-access-to-mythos · https://www.allsides.com/news/2026-06-15-0700/technology-anthropic-meet-white-house-over-ai-tool-suspension

## Bottom line

The main theme today is that AI is becoming operational infrastructure. Salesforce is buying its way deeper into agentic customer support. Meta is turning social content into an AI search surface. AWS is pushing agents into cloud-cost operations and developer tooling. Google’s API shutdown dates remind builders that model IDs have lifecycles. NewCore points at the identity layer agents will need in enterprises. Radical Numerics shows how specialized models are moving into biology. Anthropic’s Washington meetings show that frontier access is now a policy dependency.

The practical checklist is simple: inventory the model IDs you use, watch provider changelogs, test fallback models before you need them, treat agents as identities with permissions, and expect AI products to be judged not only by model quality but by reliability, governance, and integration depth.

Disclosure: This post was researched and drafted with AI assistance, then reviewed for relevance, novelty, and source quality.

body.title: Wisconsin is so innocent.  Loose zoo skunk makes the news
body.body:
I don't know a great deal about Wisconsin and I have never been there.  I do know that when you do think about Wisconsin you don't generally think of anything major.  Green Bay is there and they really like cheese, other than that, they seem to be a pretty peaceful people.

But when Wisconsin news does happen even if it is something really small, it makes the news just, i suppose, so Wiconsinites don't feel like they are being left out.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dumb-news/EogNJoy9x8zLfYXTjTFympLoYTRix6FV5nyMH6XtyqW94Bq4CbE5CXTDeRPBVYrcs6g.png)
[src](https://cdnph.upi.com/svc/sv/i/8051781278526/2026/1/17812786405396/Skunk-on-the-run-from-Wisconsin-zoo.jpg)</center>

When I see stories like this I can't help but think of the Anchorman puff pieces they would do at the end one of which was a squirrel that could waterski.   Look at him, that's amazing.  That squirrel can WATER SKI!!!

<center> https://media1.tenor.com/m/lmyA2ReQiCEAAAAC/twiggy-squirrel.gif
[src](https://media1.tenor.com/m/lmyA2ReQiCEAAAAC/twiggy-squirrel.gif)</center> 


The article was a welcome one on a news aggregate that must specialize in stupid crap and loads of advertisements masquerading as \

about people who won the lottery without hardly spending money at all.  That drives me nuts but it must be working for them because they keep fucking doing it.  \n\nThe city of Marshfield, Wisconsin is quite concerned about \

the skunk though because she poses virtually zero danger to anything but will be a sitting duck if she is approached by or is attacked by a dog or cat.  While I was previously unaware that this was possible, this skunk has had her stinky defense mechanism removed and now only has some teeth and a few scratchy claws to defend herself. 

Sadly this story probably will not have a pleasant end because Violet has been at the zoo for several years and is accustommed not only to not having any predators, but also to having her food brought to her daily, probably multiple times.  

This skunk has never lived a single day of her life in the wild.  I don't exactly have a soft spot for squirrels but I normally feel pretty bad for animals that are kept in cages at zoos especially if they have to have parts of them removed, such as their total ability to defend themselves, in order for that to happen.

Oh well Wisconsin, perhaps something good can come out of this after all and maybe people will start to look at zoos a bit more closely because I think that if you are going to keep animals in captivity, you need to ensure that they are actually safe there  Being capable of escaping because of the various excuses the zoo is making, is not acceptable.  

At least it wasn't a story about riot of some sort of Stop Oil people blocking the highway.  This is a longshot, but if you happen to live up near Marshfield WI, keep an eye out for violet!

title.title: Scavenger and Deflect Are the True Power Behind Endless Ape
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 15, 2026, 11_13_46 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w2h7aWqiwiUoWDYivr3XYd4sqdWGBYuDFjZ9XCEBFos8HFGH6BBDUGUtPh2bPj3z1oo.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


Today, I want to talk about a very special monster card. As compared to its stats and abilities this card is worth buying. If you add this monster to your deck there are several reasons why it can become one of the best monsters and a real game changer in battle. 

If you position it correctly then there is no doubt that it can play a major role in helping you win battles and you will surely win the battle using this monster in the right position..

Before we buy this monster and add it to our deck it is important to understand what special powers and abilities it has that make it worth using.. Lets know about this card and enjoy using it in battle.

First of all let's talk about its visual appearance. This monster card  is a Gorilla shape and it has a very attractive look. It appears as a large gorilla wearing a beautiful spiked necklace around its neck. which makes it more charming.. 
![Screenshot 2026-06-15 104512.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQNToX5jM3VCDE1uGTCVj7Cn9M6DhiQ9usmyvgvwrSNynLzjea1XhrhHkB6XYJer5i4.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

One of its hands is closed into a fist while the other hand is holding a weapon which is ready to attack the enemy.. Its sharp teeth and angry face makes this monster even more dangerous which is always ready to destroy the opponents.

I personally like its visual design very much because it looks impressive and also reflects the strength and the real value of this card..

Now let's talk about its stats and abilities.

This is an 8 mana monster card that belongs to the Earth element. Its stats are very good but I like its abilities even more which has some reasons which we will know in the paras.

First, let's discuss its basic stats. You can use this monster as a tank or a secondary tank. In low to medium mana battles I recommend placing it in the front position. However, in high mana battles it is better to use it as a secondary tank or place it in the third position.

It has 2 armor which helps protect its health from incoming damage. It also has 12 health, which is quite high for its level. With this amount of health it can usually survive for at least three to four rounds. If it survives that long it can take full advantage of its strong attack power and abilities to deal significant damage to enemy monsters.
![Screenshot 2026-06-15 104700.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23swdkYCVwXFqkfm5DNjFgADrTcCxhRuuMksMMwcajLRyfa9waqBbLGYyrYENLX6YC9rx.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

It has 3 speed which helps it attack faster and gives it a chance to dodge enemy attacks. Since it is a melee attack monster it has 4 melee damage allowing it to hit enemy units hard every round.

These are some of the excellent stats that show the power of this monster.

Now let's discuss its two special abilities such as Scavenger and Deflect.

---
# SCAVENGER
---


![Screenshot 2026-06-15 110809.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wMQDS2WyYYhox4RvjPETyJRb1Mu9P8Wjk68YeGwuZaS1bMWjbx4hjvna4dT4FYvuzFx.png)



The Scavenger ability increases this monster's health whenever a monster is eliminated whether it is an allied monster or an enemy monster. Every time any monster dies during the battle, this monster gains +1 health. In simple words, the more monsters that die during the battle the more health it gains. This ability becomes especially powerful in long battles.

If 5 monsters are eliminated during the battle then this monster will gain 5 additional health points. That makes Scavenger a very strong ability.

The second ability is Deflect.

---
# DEFLECT
---

![Screenshot 2026-06-15 110813.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EoEioovpnbdnKYW6MugyFejTpYyJ3VAvJxB6QdaLWufxwS3b4RBtsi9paZAxobFrySL.png)


Deflect punishes ranged attackers. It works when an enemy uses a ranged attack against this monster. After the attack the ranged attacker receives reflected damage. It works somewhat like Return Fire. This reflected damage only affects ranged attackers and has no effect on melee or magic attackers.

These two abilities make this monster even more powerful. It can act as a strong defensive unit while also dealing solid damage to enemy teams.

As mentioned earlier its best position in low and medium mana battles is either as the main tank or a secondary tank. In high mana battles, it performs best in the second or third position, where it can fully utilize its abilities and stats.
![Screenshot 2026-06-15 104530.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tkhYuCkPv5LnWt6uDhqxitJkVkFX4vkminSX8aNZUmC5Zn9WJ6UoHqhSCXAXQAb8ZPZ.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

If we talk about its price this monster is currently available on the market at around $1 to $12 depending on its level. As you continue upgrading the card, its price will naturally increase as well.

For players who cannot afford to buy the card, renting is also a great option. At the starting level it can be rented for around 2 to 20 DEC per day which is very reasonable and affordable.

Overall I believe this is an excellent monster card that you can easily add to your deck.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

title.title: UK bans social media and YouTube for under 16 y/o. Bluesky and Hive probably not included in the ban. VPNs becoming useless?
title.body:
UK führt eine verpflichtende Alterskontrolle für Social Media ein und verbietet den Zugang für unter 16 Jährige.

Kritiker sehen darin, nicht nur eine Jugendschutzmaßnahme, sondern vor allem das Ende der Anonymität im Internet kommen. KYC durch die Hintertür. Vor allem, wenn man seine Meinung im Internet postet, wird man das nicht mehr so einfach anonym machen können. Eine Gefahr für die Meinungsfreiheit.

Betroffen sind Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook und X, aber auch YouTube soll für unter 16 Jährige verboten werden. Das ist heftig.

Die genaue Liste liegt noch nicht vor, aber höchst wahrscheinlich wird es eine Ausnahme für kleinere Webseiten geben. Nicht jeder Blog und jede Nachrichtenseite wird die Alterskontrolle implementieren müssen.

Nach aktuellem Stand dürfte Bluesky, Mastodon und Hive von dem Ban in UK nicht betroffen sein. Die Plattformen sind noch nicht groß genug.

Fraglich ist auch, ob man die Bans in Zukunft mit VPNs umgehen kann. Die Alterskontrolle soll auf Betriebssystem-Ebene implementiert werden, ein VPN wäre dann vielleicht nutzlos. In Zukunft wird man das Smartphone jailbreaken müssen und VPNs nutzen, um diese ganzen Sperren umgehen zu können.

Leider plant auch die EU und einige Staaten in den USA Ähnliches.

Was sagt ihr dazu?

## Under-16s will be banned from social media in UK from early 2027

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/Eo1vQeC7BohJ4LDPGYT5WoBGoezfvPUaADZYu1nMXabw4NDfNbT7pFsMMLv46mkc1Xs.png)

https://x.com/ArchRose90/status/2066196030413033873

https://x.com/durov/status/2066569015921619126

https://x.com/RanTeeThree/status/2066430806449406137

https://x.com/WasAcop/status/2066627627750727767

## BBC: When will social media ban start, and which apps will be affected?

https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ceqdny4l3jdo

## English

The UK is introducing mandatory age verification for social media in order to ban access for under 16 y/o.

Critics see this not only as a measure to protect minors, but above all as the end of anonymity on the internet. KYC through the back door. Especially when posting one's opinion online, it will no longer be so easy to do so anonymously. A threat to freedom of speech in my opinion.

Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X are affected, but YouTube is also set to be banned for users under 16. That’s a big deal.

The exact list isn’t available yet, but there will most likely be an exception for smaller websites. Not every blog and news site will have to implement age verification.

As things stand, Bluesky, Mastodon and Hive are unlikely to be affected by the ban in the UK. The platforms aren’t big enough yet.

It’s also unclear whether VPNs will be able to bypass these bans in the future. Age verification is supposed to be implemented at the operating system level, so a VPN might be useless. In the future, you’ll have to jailbreak your smartphone and use VPNs to get around all these restrictions.

Unfortunately, the EU and some states in the US are planning similar measures.

What do you think?

title.title: Garlic Fish Sauce Chicken - Tender, Juicy, and Flavorful
title.body:
To me, chicken is one of those ingredients that never disappoints. There are so many ways to cook it, and somehow it always turns into a delicious meal. Whenever I run out of ideas to cook, chicken is usually my first choice because it's easy to prepare, budget friendly, and tastes good.

Today, I'd like to share one of my favorite chicken recipes: Garlic Fish Sauce Fried Chicken. It uses only a few simple ingredients, takes very little effort, but the result is incredibly flavorful. Crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and coated in a savory sweet garlic fish sauce glaze that makes it hard to stop eating. It's no surprise that this dish is a regular dish in many Vietnamese family’s meals.

![85e7c4f3-ab3f-4eb6-8ceb-8df4aef3edcb.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXbTUchL2sjD7377uDebh2cZp9FzGBQcLQVPmLT5PGcGD/85e7c4f3-ab3f-4eb6-8ceb-8df4aef3edcb.jpg)

Now, let's get cooking! 😊

Ingredients
- Chicken legs or chicken thighs
- Garlic
- Cornstarch or all-purpose flour
- Fish sauce, yellow sugar, water, salt, black pepper
- Cooking oil

How to Make It

- Step 1: Prepare the Chicken
Clean the chicken thoroughly and pat it dry. Use a knife to make a few shallow cuts on the thickest parts of the chicken. This helps the seasoning and sauce go deeper into the meat.

![21b206b8-7a6a-47b7-9611-1f365b3eb3d6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWxMU7RznqjsduYCg2wGv9rWxPEmTu8NxEM5GfoarigLg/21b206b8-7a6a-47b7-9611-1f365b3eb3d6.jpg)

Season the chicken with a little salt and black pepper.

![b44f4198-7904-4b9d-8c64-db3bd3afe5f2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcg4DCiZz26RbXxtpbnbW9eZh69isYhM8c5uGHMi9LecM/b44f4198-7904-4b9d-8c64-db3bd3afe5f2.jpg)

Here is my little trick for achieving crispy skin while keeping the meat juicy: lightly coat the chicken with cornstarch or flour before frying. This simple step creates a beautiful golden crust and helps lock in moisture.

![6fab6d01-3fba-4051-936f-1da013feaf2d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZykHs1GZEHLq1pmCcDM7fzY83Xup8nXH6dJUNK8MQKvY/6fab6d01-3fba-4051-936f-1da013feaf2d.jpg)

- Step 2: Fry the Chicken
Heat some cooking oil in a pan over medium heat.
Carefully place the chicken into the hot oil and fry until both sides are golden brown and crispy. Depending on the size of your chicken pieces, this may take around 5-10 minutes.

![c3a1ce02-90a3-402c-bb70-69ec8e741b77.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVWc3tg7S23qtaEGECyiqL3Wf2THg1p45RQBKQaSUaThZ/c3a1ce02-90a3-402c-bb70-69ec8e741b77.jpg)

![dd16f1b7-adf1-4ddd-afca-fcc64363e154.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZuwHVWiHzSERrQR2wyeuJNnyaXQEkXUCs4NTHbCNK61z/dd16f1b7-adf1-4ddd-afca-fcc64363e154.jpg)

Once cooked through, transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.

![93bca2bc-9681-4818-b008-1f543c9fa0d4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU7rGZrEPEEEEaNXaado6RBHNT5vuSy8VUqswPqtXSGYE/93bca2bc-9681-4818-b008-1f543c9fa0d4.jpg)

- Step 3: Make the sauce 
While the chicken is frying, prepare the sauce.
In a small bowl, combine fish sauce, yellow sugar, a little water, and black pepper. Stir until the sugar is mostly dissolved.

![b37c31e7-f9d2-4c82-91c2-5f8a49d7e5a8.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRgHREJwa3DprPdfPrxsjqmKJPE5oxfDHntQ7hNYRSt2/b37c31e7-f9d2-4c82-91c2-5f8a49d7e5a8.jpg)

Using the same pan, remove excess oil if needed and add some chopped garlic. Sauté until fragrant and lightly golden.
Pour in the sauce mixture and let it simmer for a minute. Once the sauce starts boiling, return the chicken to the pan.

![0b0b57ef-ee3a-48ee-b8f5-45a8f2d1447d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXV3tUcWzMqN1suNzYPpHGRRLgcM6MG39cEKvuNSPf1GE/0b0b57ef-ee3a-48ee-b8f5-45a8f2d1447d.jpg)

![e7ef9587-b147-40a2-a64a-45d561ebb4f1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXGbphRaGtDZZoVDoJ3uWWXQGnUr58p4jHSB3FnXUUiDv/e7ef9587-b147-40a2-a64a-45d561ebb4f1.jpg)

Turn the chicken several times so every piece is coated with that beautiful glossy sauce. Let it cook for another minute or two until the sauce slightly thickens and clings to the chicken.

![a82f78a3-becb-425e-b6df-1fa4b964d904.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPtK72eMGNLDrQLZq8TXfUZbqVp6cCRqrQtSxdEqiQH5J/a82f78a3-becb-425e-b6df-1fa4b964d904.jpg)

And that's it! Look at that beautiful golden brown chicken! The shiny fish sauce glaze makes it look so tempting, and the aroma of garlic filling the kitchen is absolutely mouthwatering .

![7d3c8462-9815-4949-903f-73f99157c8a2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWps3xzjYWABfGjbQ6ts9p2RUSGLevHR4GuWhP8Q9cw8o/7d3c8462-9815-4949-903f-73f99157c8a2.jpg)

The outside is slightly crispy, while the inside stays tender and juicy. The sauce brings the perfect balance of savory, sweet, and rich flavors. And now you ‘ll need a bowl of steamed rice. Trust me, once you start eating, it will be hard to stop until every last bite is gone.😂 
I love recipes like this because they don't require fancy ingredients or complicated techniques. Just a few easy things we can have in the kitchen and a little time can create something truly delicious.

![2a86ea80-722f-4aeb-ad5d-e6783c0616a9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmScn78aMp1hs27hgMu5f2yuGd7AVUnUmnaP1wHWQKPQT6/2a86ea80-722f-4aeb-ad5d-e6783c0616a9.jpg)

That's today's recipe, my friends. I hope you enjoy it as much as I do. If you have a favorite chicken recipe, I'd love to hear about it in the comments!
Have a wonderful week ahead, everyone. 
All photos were taken by me in my lovely kitchen.

title.title: Vernetzen ist Alles - der Global Media Club - Networking is everything [GER/ENG]
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wCLUapCJaunTy5Nmrku73owLaAuiEmz58ZMkvsy5LgKExMh4SixgnSq2Lb48TSSBika.png)

Ich bin davon überzeugt, dass Netzwerken das A&O ist, um Erfolg zu haben. Darüber hinaus natürlich auch das Socializing und der Support Untereinander. Umso wichtiger sind solche Institutionen, wie der GMC, der gerade hier in Wien entsteht und ich ein Teil dieser Geschichte sein darf. 

Ein Teil der dies Unterstützt, mitbewegt und seit Beginn an bei dieser Bewegung dabei ist. Danke John Herzog und Barbara P. Meister die Großartiges leisten und mit dieser Geschichte wahrscheinlich Geschichte schreiben.

Vernetzen ist Alles!

Mit kleinen Schritten etwas Aufbauen, um langfristig Großes bewegen. Mit kleinen Schritten nach vorne schauen, Entscheidungen treffen und an der Vision festhalten.

Kein Missgunst und Neid untereinander, sich supporten und zusammen Wachsen. Brücken zwischen Medienschaffende, Kulturen und der Bevölkerung schaffen. Ein Miteinander statt Gegeneiner. 

Dies wünsche ich mit auch auf HIVE, denn wir sind eine Community und letztendlich sorgen wir für den Auftritt nach Außen, dem Wachstum dahinter und dem Erfolg der ganzen Geschichte. Wir sind ein großes Netzwerk von unterschiedlichen Kulturen, Menschen und Ländern.

Das richtige Netzwerk bringt nicht nur dir den Erfolg, sondern schafft Synergien und einen Mehrwert für Alle. 

Danke, dass ich ein Teil sein darf.

#netzwerken #GMC #networken #Medien #hoi #wien #media

# English part ✌️

I am deeply convinced that networking is the absolute key to success. Alongside that, of course, come socializing and mutual support. This is exactly why institutions like the GMC—which is currently emerging right here in Vienna—are so important, and I am honored to be a part of this journey.

A part that supports it, helps drive it forward, and has been involved in this movement since day one. Thank you, John Herzog and Barbara P. Meister, for doing such an incredible job and likely making history with this initiative.

Networking is everything!

Building something with small steps to make a massive impact in the long run. Moving forward step by step, making decisions, and staying true to the vision.

No jealousy or resentment among each other—instead, supporting one another and growing together. Building bridges between media creators, different cultures, and the general public. Collaboration instead of competition.

This is exactly what I wish for on HIVE as well, because we are a community. Ultimately, we are the ones responsible for our public image, the growth behind the scenes, and the overall success of the project. We are a vast network of different cultures, people, and countries.

The right network doesn’t just bring individual success; it creates synergies and added value for everyone involved.

Thank you for letting me be a part of this.

#networking #GMC #networking #Media #hoi #vienna #media

title.title: La disciplina que renueva nuestra relación con Dios
title.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://images.pexels.com/photos/1181263/pexels-photo-1181263.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
[LINK](https://images.pexels.com/photos/1181263/pexels-photo-1181263.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>


## El otro día venía pensando justamente en esto. A veces la vida te lleva a lugares donde no esperabas estar y de repente un versículo cobra sentido de una manera que no habías visto antes.

Today is a good day to remember that God is not finished with you. He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion. Do not give up right before the breakthrough.

It is important that we understand that our accomplishments should last for eternity, for that we must learn to build everything on the basis of non-perishable materials and above all build upon the rock that is Christ Jesus.

Prayer is not about convincing God to do what we want. Prayer is about aligning our hearts with what God wants. It is surrendering our will to His perfect will.

God is with you in this moment. Right where you are. His desire is to have a real and deep relationship with you. Open your heart and let Him in. He is knocking.

It is important to have a correct understanding of who God is. According to God's word, we can know Him in a way that allows us to understand the capacity we have in Christ to face the different circumstances in life.

> Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

Matthew 11:28

> Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

Philippians 4:6-7

God invites us to trust Him every day, to cast our burdens at His feet and rest in the certainty that He is in control of all things. Blessings.

<center>https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.vexels.com/media/users/3/131235/isolated/preview/8ee1ea6424182bedde6dace0ed0934bf-linea-divisoria-floral-adornada-3.png
[Link](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.vexels.com/media/users/3/131235/isolated/preview/8ee1ea6424182bedde6dace0ed0934bf-linea-divisoria-floral-adornada-3.png) </center>


## El otro día venía pensando justamente en esto. A veces la vida te lleva a lugares donde no esperabas estar y de repente un versículo cobra sentido de una manera que no habías visto antes.

##### Si hay algo que aprendí es que Dios no nos exige tener todo claro. Nos pide que demos el primer paso, aunque no veamos el segundo. El resto lo va mostrando de a poco.

##### A veces uno va por la vida con el piloto automático. Se levanta, hace lo de siempre, se acuesta y repite. Hasta que algo rompe el ciclo y te obliga a preguntarte si lo que estás haciendo tiene sentido.

##### No sé en qué situación estás leyendo esto. Pero si algo te resonó, si algo te hizo acordar a tu propia vida, tomalo como una señal para hacer una pausa y pensar. A veces solo necesitamos eso, una pausa.

##### Me parece curioso como a veces nos aferramos a cosas que no nos hacen bien. Costumbres, relaciones, formas de pensar. Las conocemos, son familiares, nos dan cierta seguridad aunque sean tóxicas. Dios nos llama a soltar eso, pero duele.

> Venid a mí todos los que estáis trabajados y cargados, y yo os haré descansar.

Mateo 11:28

> Por nada estéis angustiados, sino sean conocidas vuestras peticiones delante de Dios en toda oración y ruego, con acción de gracias. Y la paz de Dios, que sobrepasa todo entendimiento, guardará vuestros corazones y vuestros pensamientos en Cristo Jesús.

Filipenses 4:6-7

##### No hace falta tener todas las respuestas. Alcanza con dar un paso a la vez, sabiendo que El va delante. El resto se va a ir aclarando en el camino.

*****
*******

*Bueno, eso quería compartir hoy. Si llegaste hasta acá, gracias. Ojalá resuene en tu corazón como resonó en el mío.*

title.title: Digital Shelf Tags Australia
title.body:
The retail industry is rapidly evolving, and businesses are constantly searching for innovative ways to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience. One of the most significant advancements in modern retail technology is the adoption of [**Digital Shelf Labels**](https://elabels.au/electronic-shelf-labels/). These smart display solutions are changing how retailers manage pricing, promotions, and inventory while helping stores operate more efficiently in an increasingly competitive market.  
Traditional paper price tags require frequent manual updates, which can be time-consuming and prone to human error. Retailers often struggle to keep prices synchronized across physical stores and online platforms. Digital Shelf Labels eliminate these challenges by enabling real-time price updates across entire store networks. With centralized control systems, retailers can instantly adjust pricing, promotions, and product information without the need for manual intervention.  
The growing demand for Digital Shelf Tags Australia reflects the country's commitment to embracing retail automation and digital transformation. Australian retailers are recognizing the benefits of replacing paper labels with electronic alternatives that improve operational efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction. These digital solutions allow stores to quickly respond to market changes, seasonal promotions, and competitive pricing strategies while maintaining accuracy throughout the shopping experience.  
Another key advantage of implementing an Electronic Shelf Label system is its ability to streamline store operations. Employees no longer need to spend hours replacing paper labels or verifying price accuracy. Instead, pricing information can be updated automatically from a central management platform. This not only reduces labor costs but also minimizes pricing discrepancies between shelves and checkout systems, helping retailers build trust with their customers.

title.title: Crypto Cooking - Chapter 1 Almanac Of Web3-Powered Recipes
title.body:
Cooking and cryptocurrency have more in common than people think. Both require the right ingredients, precise timing, and enough experimentation to avoid ending up completely cooked.

The market still knows how to butcher emotions faster than a chef breaking down a fresh venison loin. In the kitchen it's all about balancing heat, texture, and flavor! 

Back in February 2021 I published a weird combo, covering NFT news and the chicken curry I cooked for dinner! It was rather catchy and continued with this mix for a while! 

Crypto made a hostile takeover and the cooking twist went underground for a while! In 2026 I resurrected the series and added the new recipes at the bottom of each new article! 

However, this created a bulky signature so wrapping up chapter one of this Web3 powered cooking almanac with 20 recipes for crypto bros! I hope you like a mixed platter! 

Nothing beats a good mix, nicely layered on a wooden board! It's my signature starter! Cheese, fruit, and nuts work best when you balance sweetness, with saltiness and richness! 


![image.png](UPLOAD FAILED)


Not everyone is a cheese monger but at least there are guides we can follow! Brie is excellent with grapes, figs, or strawberries, while walnuts and pecans add a pleasant crunch.

Soft creamy cheeses pair beautifully with fresh fruit, and Camembert works in much the same way. Tangy goat cheese is particularly good with berries, cherries, apricots, and honey.

Roquefort or Gorgonzola pair wonderfully with pears, figs, dates, and dried apricots. Walnuts are especially traditional because their slight bitterness balances the cheese's intensity.

The sweetness is the key for blue cheeses! Almonds, pistachios, and walnuts complement its bright flavor without overpowering it. Aged cheeses shine with sweeter fruits.

For something more sophisticated, try blue cheese with ripe pear and walnuts, or aged Parmesan with fresh figs and almonds. No matter the mix... don't forget the white wine! 


![image.png](UPLOAD FAILED)


What a bout soups? Did you know Romania has two of them in the top 10 best chicken soups in the world? Ciorbă rădăuțeană is one of Romania's most famous & iconic soups! 

It was created in the town of Rădăuți as a chicken-based alternative to traditional tripe soup. What makes it distinctive is the combination of shredded chicken, garlic, sour cream, egg yolks!

To make it \

we then add a souring agent such as vinegar or lemon juice. The result is creamy, tangy, and deeply savory, with a pronounced garlic flavor. \n\nThe chicken soup with noodles (aka supă de pui cu tăiței) is much simpler and more delicate. In Romanian cuisine a \

is usually a clear broth, unlike a ciorbă which is generally soured.\n\nThe broth is made by slowly simmering chicken with vegetables such as carrots, celery root, parsley root, and onion. Thin homemade egg noodles called \

are added before serving.

The flavor is clean, gentle, and comforting, with the quality of the broth taking center stage. The contrast between the two dishes says a lot about Romanian cooking.

Ciorbă rădăuțeană is rich, creamy, garlicky, and sour, while supă de pui cu tăiței is light and subtle. The first feels hearty and robust while the second is the sort of soup many Romanians associate with childhood! 



![image.png](UPLOAD FAILED)



This end-of-chapter article was a journey through some classic Romanian comfort foods and flavor pairings. As we move forward into Chapter 2 ... will keep it to only 10 recipes! 

I love cooking and you know that ... but this time, though, I went out to get my pudding! I opted for a Dubai-style waffle that was absolutely oozing with pistachio filling!

It was nutty, sweet, and unapologetically indulgent. It was the perfect finale after thinking about hearty Romanian soups and elegant cheese pairings! I deserved a decadent treat! 

Chapter wrap-up and you have twenty choices for your next meal! Pair it up with some crypto charts and maybe some real candles! Don't forget to touch some grass and cash out profits!

The cross-chain part is what makes this kind of exploit so hard to contain.

A single-chain incident can often be isolated around one contract, one liquidity pool, or one validator set. Once Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, and Base are all involved, the response becomes coordination across different settlement environments with different assumptions.

That is the tradeoff with chain-agnostic liquidity. It gives users better reach, but the blast radius gets harder to reason about. THORChain has always lived close to that edge because its value proposition depends on moving across boundaries that were not designed to share risk.

title.body:
The index exclusion angle is more interesting than the IPO size.

If a company can raise that much capital and still sit outside the S&P 500, it shows how much influence index methodology has over passive capital flows. Inclusion is not just a label. It changes who is forced to buy, when they buy, and how much liquidity gets locked into benchmark-tracking portfolios.

SpaceX being public but not immediately absorbed by the index machine creates a strange middle state: massive public attention, but not the automatic bid that usually comes with full benchmark acceptance.
title.author: bitmoving

title.body:
The difficulty drop is the cleaner signal here than the spot price.

Price can bounce on flows, but difficulty adjusts only after miners actually change behavior. A 10% move says the pressure was real enough to push inefficient hash offline, at least temporarily. That usually makes the next few weeks more interesting because surviving miners get margin relief while the market tries to decide whether the selloff was exhaustion or just a pause.

I would watch hashrate recovery speed. Fast recovery means miners were waiting for the adjustment. Slow recovery means balance sheets are still tight.

title.title: 和儿子聊聊万亿富豪
title.body:
SpaceX 在 2026 年 6 月 12 日正式在纳斯达克挂牌上市（IPO），当日市值一举突破 2 万亿美元，埃隆·马斯克的身家发生了跨越式的暴涨，正式成为人类历史上首位“万亿美元（兆美元）富豪”。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeby8HULfQyqGF8htxPVXEsSXa1ajmgyCQzFcJ5eQy3iQ/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

大概听惯了富豪们的资产数字，儿子竟然觉得万亿美元也不是很多，他说富豪们不都有几千亿美元的资产嘛？那一万亿美元也不是很夸张嘛？

好吧，这么说似乎也是那么回事，毕竟马斯克这个万亿美元富豪新鲜出炉（咦，这词怪怪的）前，他的资产也有七八千亿美元，甚至早在2025年，人家的资产也有四千亿左右。

另外，那些个富豪，比如拉里·佩奇、谢尔盖·布林、杰夫·贝索斯、马克·扎克伯格，哪个资产不都是大几千亿美元呀（两三千亿）。

甚至中国的富豪们资产也毫不逊色呢，张一鸣、钟睒睒、马化腾、丁磊、黄峥这些也都身家大几千亿（三五千亿），哦，对了，单位是人民币，换算下来大概是几百亿美元。

你看，大家都这么多有钱，一万亿美元真的多嘛？当儿子问出这个问题的时候，我都不知道该怎么回答了！

不过我们可以在一些事情上做一些比较，就知道一万亿美元多不多啦。

就以在沈阳工作为例，月薪过万（人民币），那大概算得上是不错的薪水啦。那假设我们不吃不喝的攒钱，多久能攒到一万亿美元呢？

为了计算出这个数字，我都用尽了洪荒之力了，最终的结果是6000万年——***从恐龙灭绝后开始攒钱，一直攒到今天，差不多才够达到马斯克目前的财富规模。***


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmccgk7yGQFjj28BTigWfpTmAjdsyuN8YGCpkkuLZSFrMW/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

再换个方式估算，按着沈阳1000万人口，月薪1万人民币，都攒起来，多久能攒到一万亿美元呢？答案是这1000万人口一分不花猛劲攒钱，也要六年，才能攒够马斯克的个人财富。

我们再来换个方式，假设这一万亿美元分成一百年花掉，那么每天要花掉多少钱呢？

粗略计算下来每天大概要花掉2738万美元，约2亿人民币！虽然大家习惯上把一个亿叫做一个小目标，但是有多少人，终其一生，也未必能拥有过一个小目标呀？

再把这个花钱的时间换成秒，就算不眠不休，24小时的每一秒啥也不干，都在花钱，那么每秒要花掉2300元以上，才能把钱花光！


昨天我和儿子买了一大堆汉堡、薯条、可乐、红豆派、鸡块啥的，也就花了不到100元，而且整个过程大概是两个小时，所以就说差距有多大吧！

你以为这就算了，人家的一万亿美元还能投资还能赚钱呢，就算是存银行，按2%的年化利率，每年也能有200亿美元的收入呢，轻轻松松抵一个中国的大富豪！


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTsG8DMpiM1EANMXejr2nseTxAR9izroK5cgmS7ZaZAYi/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

对了，我看福布斯的官网上，现在马斯克的资产已经是1.3万亿美元了，大概在他们眼里钱就是一个数字而已。

好吧，其实在我们眼里，（比如在儿子的眼里），这些万亿富豪、亿万富豪的资产，也不过就是一个数字而已，不然他也不会觉得这数字有多恐怖，哈哈哈。

title.title: Lunch with kale vegetable omelette
title.body:
> ![1000654107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xVMX6JvNfXzNwbeevhkNH15NvARcZUhVU8AoP1v7K7D6K1bHZSc29KpSp5xrHLv4kYh.jpg) *** *** *** Hello friends of Fudis, how are you? I hope you are all well and can do beautiful activities as usual. Today I am at home alone because my child and mother have gone to the PANTE BAHAGIA tourist spot with my cousin's school bus group. I have been lying down at home because there are no activities today. I also have a day off from work, the plan is to just rest at home today, while my husband works and does not have a day off at all. ![1000654106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMczKhWQMvQNLnyx5gjANKjFzK8c6vnpDGhbQe3xFvGVjRAkcXwhJ1u5p4oW6Qxwvtu.jpg) My stomach was already feeling very hungry, so I finally left the room and went to the kitchen to eat rice. In the kitchen, there was only clear coconut milk soup that my mother cooked with chili paste in the morning, but then I saw that there were eggs in the refrigerator. I was going to make an egg omelet with water spinach like my mother had cooked before. My mother really likes creating eggs with vegetables because according to her, eggs combined with vegetables will be a very suitable combination, namely a very complete combination of fiber and protein. ![1000654098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xen7tvdtUXMuXejCxwgQgWEqStc4bUjeD7auXyoPK27pqGA1sgLqEzuPpM5tCQM8dni.jpg) And finally I took two eggs in the refrigerator and I took some kale, chilies and tomatoes, I cut them into small pieces, then I made an omelette, I made an omelette without using any oil at all because today I want to reduce the excess oil on my body. This is the first time I've made this kangkung omelette at home and I hope the taste is just right, it looks like my lunch this time is really simple. *** ###
materials used
### *** ![1000652959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23uQkGb7n9QZoW4JD2ud7NwN1PEMhkAFB9VZvnjFRhP1w7EhMjxfRQoYwsqgmsda9mcR6.jpg) ***
**2 eggs, several pieces of spinach leaves, half an onion, chilies to taste**
*** ###
manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** and I started to chop the water spinach and shallots into small pieces |![1000652936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23y8vF1uRyG796dCEpqAaipgZDvJipkc6Vp1DxnyPwxgsjnUitk7FwSPEqeSKTmf6iuCX.jpg)|![1000652937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yd6E7e9dPBTrHjo8mjHu5ev22nf1dvcgApwjiN73SF3K8LaACjoF2oNDh8oLv9jj9Uv.jpg) |-|-| |![1000652935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xpD4iEMpsJ6gSFKxp3cS3NhJbp1XWu1ygWAyZJPtqGEZzrWytPUtfMuFUfdqwe5YVM4.jpg)|![1000652934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMW1MEHP1bBTXnob4PfBc4Kqw2kGGZniN6aEZyHY9yL3meEMsT29xP5wDvhctUuqm6r.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** Break and add 2 eggs, add kale and finely chopped onions. Don't forget to add salt to taste. |![1000652933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23u673UcM4sfiSSEwBDZhthbcxYbTbFzXY1XAUNW4FW2b5BCw2Gdan9TnSFvu18ZnVpjd.jpg)|![1000652938.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpEHidw9yWxAa2BBanEB9HpKjgna8oM19YbVG5LPicisGRjmyJqdcsJoiADQc2xy4SL.jpg) |-|-| |![1000652939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EonkRfxRkihBPyb7sdD2G6RktS8MFDqoKEocJgAYVcdTD484S22qgM5R6UbJYbBhG4F.jpg)|![1000652941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23u64kLNWPij8Eh3uRDMWgEHUUBp8Zhxf3G8HvagvApCsMkxf2aodpJBxQqKz5hW8gVDK.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** Next, put the eggs into the Teflon without adding oil, then heat until it becomes a kale omelette. |![1000652942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpJZ4gKsCYMkvLhyDeVcBDZyPnT5sShGTcjZgEYzQryrV7QnbnhR2qgo37Aci7EyWJw.jpg)|![1000652943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep7ubQtnqgJSM1Vk3WuCxYVtT16gbpjiHo2RknJxEm1BWCB3s7VVqAEL3Ekabx55NKS.jpg) |-|-| |![1000652944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23x14cQdaDacTvHnWAKAytEFrsUrDEHjzwdpkkxPUkyAjWTSdYNd9LU4tLUVGEZFYgYGj.jpg)|![1000652945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep3errCPix5K1mhCUgT7K5GJReGT1H4mcwosjDGf34U6XfdqUSBrdKB89288raBGCit.jpg) |-|-| *** ###
RESULTS
### *** ![1000654103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xpAvMCzpgDgAvD7hh2kxLGXUxESc5wC1YUnJMGgNkMY9EsjuZeN4Z4JMknmkGWLzqcG.jpg) *** *** *** This is the result, my kale omelette is ready to be enjoyed with other side dishes. I added warm rice, boiled vegetables and a little chili sauce on a simple plate, because this is just for my lunch today. |![1000654099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xL7Ufs1fwW26UgyuWvF1fbuL5BjQTzzTKLKBxscTJygZ6zjKH25QPPugfJ2dcGj7sxx.jpg)|![1000654101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yTfDEZdavQa5VfPrf8Q3YagTJ1H8CX2ZwWFHKc7D6KeWuWryRSeCvpEEaXHrpnZGWwn.jpg)|![1000654100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xVTcRghV6ijzVRZoq51KYbFpsWttiaXZWwgAoRdyNZ49TkiheAcUYrfyDa1v5cpAjHd.jpg) |-|-|-| Today's lunch is very complete with carbohydrates, protein and fiber which is just right and is very suitable to be enjoyed perfectly at noon today. The spicy taste of the chili sauce and the fat from the eggs and vegetables are a perfect combination. ![1000654098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xen7tvdtUXMuXejCxwgQgWEqStc4bUjeD7auXyoPK27pqGA1sgLqEzuPpM5tCQM8dni.jpg) ![1000654104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yJJupVRcL7fHAv6aRHs3doWmgqVkxn8bjk22BxFxSjPb2HzHCxzutRHVNuFJ3TL5okW.jpg) *** *** *** ###
Thank you 🙂🤗
### *** *** ***

I am usually called Ryana, I come from Indonesia, my daily activities are working, cooking, taking care of the household, and also traveling, I really enjoy traveling with my husband and children. I also like enjoying culinary delights with my little family,Thank you very much for those who have taken the time to read my post this time, I hope this post is a little useful for the readers, a BG w wnd see you in my next post and I also really hope for the support of all friends, so that what we want while we are here wes can make it happen</sub>

title.body:

When we find ourselves confused, we must wait and listen. When God engages a person or even a church, He gives a specific mandate or assignment. So, the natural question here is: What has God called you to do?
‎
‎And what has God called every believer to carry out as a church? Everything we do must be according to this divine mandate. The Bible brings to our remembrance in Romans 8:26-29 that God has a purpose for those who love Him; which is to be conformed to the image of His Son.
‎
‎From creation, God's plan was for mankind to reflect His image and likeness. But sin ruined that image. Through Jesus Christ, God made reconciliation possible. The moment we repent and receive Jesus into our lives as Lord and Savior, we are adopted to God's family and begin a journey back to His original plan, to daily grow in Christlikeness.
‎
‎It is only people who are like Christ that can truly represent Christ in the world.

title.title: El Rastro antes del Best seller
title.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23wX7dinStFYxtriRZVLtEG79Lx6nfAvePZgBefMwmuLgVJNMcBfPYwyPgazzrGyLyUiY.png)


<sub>**Imagen creada con Gemini.**</sub>

### **La pregunta no es qué somos, sino qué decidimos ser.** <sub>— *Oneray*</sub>

---

</center>

<div class=\

> ¿Hay días en los que te levantas con ganas de mandar todo al mismísimo carajo? Bueno, justo ahora, estoy pasando por un momento similar. Puede ser porque te falta dinero, el vehículo que manejas se descompuso, el jefe está insoportable por estar en sus días, o los planes no están saliendo al ritmo que uno quiere; realmente, pueden ser muchos factores y no a todos nos afectan los mismos. Pero en esos momentos, es facilito caer en la trampa de la autocompasión y sentir que el universo la tiene agarrada con uno, viviendo algo parecido a un karma por deudas que probablemente ni tengamos idea de que teníamos. Por otra parte, cuando te topas con una historia como la de Viktor Frankl, nos podemos dar cuenta de que el 99 % de nuestras quejas diarias son una absoluta tontería. Frankl, ni de lejos, era un gurú de la motivación, de esos que abundan hoy en las redes sociales vendiéndote humo y prometiendo resultados milagrosos. Él era un neurólogo y psiquiatra judío que vivía en Viena, en una época donde ser judío, significaba tener una sentencia de muerte firmada en la frente con luces de neón al estilo Las Vegas. En 1942, los nazis lo arrestaron junto a su esposa, sus padres y su hermano. Pasó tres años viviendo un auténtico infierno terrenal, desfilando por cuatro campos de concentración diferentes, incluido el mismísimo Auschwitz, que llegó a convertirse en el mayor campo de exterminio. Vamos a imaginarnos la escena por unos segundos: te bajan prácticamente a patadas de un tren, te quitan toda la ropa, te afeitan todo el cuerpo, te roban el manuscrito del libro en el que habías trabajado toda tu vida, tu esposa muere en otro campo de concentración, matan a casi toda tu familia y te convierten en un número tatuado en el brazo. No tienes posesiones, no tienes privacidad, no tienes comida real, el frío se te mete en los huesos mientras ves a la gente morir a tu lado por enfermedad, por hambre o en alguna cámara de gas. Imagina que te han quitado absolutamente todo lo que te hacía humano. **¿Qué haces en una situación así? ¿Cómo evitas que la locura o el suicidio se apoderen de ti?** Ahí es donde Frankl descubrió la verdad más grande y pesada de la psicología humana, una que dejó grabada en su obra maestra, **“El hombre en busca de sentido”**. El tipo se dio cuenta de que, aunque los guardias controlaban sus cuerpos, sus horarios y sus vidas, había un rincón sagrado que ningún nazi le podía tocar: su mente. Frankl escribió algo que debería tatuarse en el cerebro de cualquiera que esté pasando por una crisis: “Al hombre se le puede arrebatar todo salvo una cosa: el poder de elegir para decidir su propio camino”. Y allí, justo allí, es donde estoy parado mientras el rugido ensordecedor del tinnitus que padezco, cambia de tono y de melodía de forma aleatoria. Pensando… buscando una mejor solución a las circunstancias que vivo mientras sueño con mejores oportunidades para construir, a mi alrededor, un mundo mejor. Imagina la siguiente escena: Mientras caminaba descalzo sobre la nieve helada, vestido de harapos, obligado a cavar zanjas bajo la amenaza de un latigazo, Frankl no se permitía pensar en el hambre o en el dolor. Obligaba a su mente a viajar. Se imaginaba a sí mismo años después, parado en un auditorio cálido y luminoso, dándole una conferencia a cientos de estudiantes sobre la psicología de los campos de concentración. Usó el dolor del presente como el material de estudio para su futuro, dándole así un sentido a su sufrimiento. Es por esta razón que, cuando yo veo a tanta gente deprimida porque no tiene el último modelo de teléfono, o cuando yo mismo me he visto contra las cuerdas viviendo a la lata y con la incertidumbre mordiéndome los talones, por más rápido que corra, me acuerdo de Frankl y de su libro que por ahora tengo en PDF. La vida no tiene la obligación de ser justa ni de darnos un camino plano; de hecho, la vida no nos debe nada. A veces la realidad se vuelve fría, cruda y calculada. El dolor en algún momento es inevitable; lo que sí es opcional es cómo decides pararte frente a él. Esa, mi querido lector invisible, esa es tu elección. Si tú crees que tu felicidad depende de que el entorno sea perfecto, estás condenado a ser un esclavo eterno de las circunstancias. Si Frankl pudo encontrar una razón para sonreír y mantenerse íntegro en medio del lodo y las chimeneas de Auschwitz, tú y yo no tenemos excusa para dejarnos vencer por un mal mes financiero, un proyecto que se derrumbó, estés pasando por una crisis familiar o porque el amor de tu vida, con quien tenías todos los planes para el futuro, se haya ido. Al final, la pregunta que nos lanza la vida no es “¿Por qué te está pasando esto?”, sino “¿Quién eliges ser tú mientras esto te pasa?”. Puedes ser la víctima que se queja en un rincón esperando que alguien venga a salvarla, o puedes ser el arquitecto que usa los escombros que la vida le ha tirado encima para construir algo más fuerte. La moneda está girando y girando en el aire y la decisión, como siempre, es solo tuya… caiga cara o sello. Nos leemos en el camino. Oneray. ---
![Oneray.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23uR563rkQ6mSLnpTcsMnDNtjQMyJ2bUBGHDhkpCubk1xP8AWnqYSLvyMiYQ71zBQ8Tsn.png) --- ![Esta publicación está libre de plagio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23tvZzFTr8MnU2mPbsneuM7pLGHvx2bZmU7AQ4ymL7b8Q7tD8y4G4iCRPLCcBFv9zHuSR.png) ---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/241QgGv5Sw3PRaGNbfkuc1Z6zxCcx5Q4PL2Z9HTgheSv2qFYw2X4Q7S1riFEAs3xmx5ia.png)

<h6><div class=\

>
***Todas las imágenes que utilizo en mis publicaciones son de mi autoría, propias o creadas con herramientas de inteligencia artificial, a menos que indique lo contrario al pie de las mismas, y pueden haber sido editadas con [Canva](https://www.canva.com)***
Click here for English version
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23wCLX3ZuwP1f9cvJZQhHSxRTb6A495a4b5AgwoZ51tNzbmuC1P6nC4KNHguv2ARFc2ge.png) **Image created with Gemini.** ### **The question is not what we are, but what we decide to be.** — *Oneray* ---

> Are there days when you wake up wanting to tell the whole world to go straight to hell? Well, right now, I’m going through a moment just like that. It could be because you’re short on cash, your car broke down, your boss is being unbearable—maybe they’re just having a bad day—or things aren't moving along as fast as you’d like. Honestly, there are so many factors, and they don't affect us all the same way. But in those moments, it’s all too easy to fall into the trap of self-pity and feel like the universe has it out for you—like you're paying off some karmic debt you didn't even know you had. On the other hand, when you come across a story like Viktor Frankl’s, you realize that 99% of our daily complaints are absolute nonsense. Frankl was by no means a motivational guru—the kind that seem to be everywhere on social media these days, selling hot air and promising miraculous results. He was a Jewish neurologist and psychiatrist living in Vienna at a time when being Jewish was essentially a death sentence stamped on your forehead in bright, Las Vegas-style neon lights. In 1942, the Nazis arrested him along with his wife, his parents, and his brother. He spent three years living through a living hell on earth, passing through four different concentration camps—including Auschwitz itself, which became the largest extermination camp of all. Just picture the scene for a moment: you’re practically kicked off a train, stripped of your clothes, shaved all over, and robbed of the manuscript for the book you’d spent your entire life working on; your wife dies in another camp, almost your entire family is killed, and you are reduced to a number tattooed on your arm. You have no possessions, no privacy, and no real food; the cold seeps into your bones as you watch people die beside you—from disease, starvation, or in a gas chamber. Imagine having absolutely everything that made you human stripped away. **What do you do in a situation like that? How do you keep madness or suicide from taking hold of you?** That is where Frankl discovered the greatest and most profound truth of human psychology—one he immortalized in his masterpiece, ***Man’s Search for Meaning***. He realized that although the guards controlled his body, his schedule, and his life, there was a sacred space no Nazi could touch: his mind. Frankl wrote something that should be etched into the mind of anyone going through a crisis: “Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the power to choose his own path.” And that—right there—is where I stand, as the deafening roar of my tinnitus shifts pitch and melody at random. Thinking… searching for a better solution to my current circumstances, while dreaming of better opportunities to build a better world around me. Picture this scene: As he walked barefoot through the frozen snow, dressed in rags and forced to dig trenches under the threat of the lash, Frankl refused to dwell on hunger or pain. He forced his mind to travel elsewhere. He imagined himself years later, standing in a warm, brightly lit auditorium, lecturing hundreds of students on the psychology of concentration camps. He used the pain of the present as study material for his future, thereby giving meaning to his suffering. That is why, whenever I see so many people depressed because they don’t have the latest phone model—or when I’ve found myself backed into a corner, scraping by with uncertainty nipping at my heels no matter how fast I run—I think of Frankl and his book (which I currently have in PDF format). Life is under no obligation to be fair or to provide us with a smooth path; in fact, life owes us nothing. Sometimes reality becomes cold, harsh, and calculated. Pain is inevitable at some point; what *is* optional is how you choose to face it. That, my dear invisible reader, is your choice. If you believe your happiness depends on your surroundings being perfect, you are doomed to be an eternal slave to circumstance. If Frankl could find a reason to smile and maintain his integrity amidst the mud and smokestacks of Auschwitz, then you and I have no excuse for letting ourselves be defeated by a bad financial month, a collapsed project, a family crisis, or the departure of the love of our life—the person with whom we had planned our entire future. In the end, the question life throws at us isn't “Why is this happening to you?” but rather, “Who do you choose to be while this is happening?” You can be the victim who complains in a corner, waiting for someone to come and save them, or you can be the architect who uses the rubble life has dumped on them to build something stronger. The coin is spinning in the air, and the decision—as always—is yours alone… whether it lands on heads or tails. See you along the way. Oneray. ---

title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY37EPMsm9EqH5VHaJHPuUBXBsAyxcSoW9SGWtyddZTmF/image.png 

Frontier performance 51.58%, a bit above average, made the money for Wild pass selling the Frontier packs. Target achieved. Wild, a 52.20% winrate, with 160 games won and 174 lost. Can I do better? And finally Survival, I spend around $0.20 of SPS to get 20K Glint and 25 Fortune entries. Well, I have also received these cards:

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUZHq8wdsNRKb2yqT5MoRZ16Hf5aSYCwFk2uQLzdiaysA/image.png 

I know it is not much, but I did manage to upgrade the card to level 2. A +1 Speed increase.
