Looks like it is really good at high levels, so I will keep upgrading it. Next, what shall I do with my 250K of Glint?

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcV9iF8caToWDLjTdruuAAopMs4erEj6NmYTmyiK5hfcJ/image.png 

I leveled my exemplar another 2 levels, to raise the melee attack to 5. I am building my hero slowly slowly. I am thinking to increase the Speed a bit more. Maybe up to 10. But then all the return damage may be useless. Health instead? Hmm, difficult choice. Back to shopping, next, Merits time. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYkzsq2x21xVoeR6X1Js1vTZDsQF3u5grT7wAewuadFvr/image.png 

I have enough Merits to buy 9 packs, so, what cards will I get? Just look at this! One Gold card, two Epic, one of them Quora, seven Rare and Common for the rest.

No Gladiator card gained levels, but I am very close with some of them. Next, my favorite part, buy two Legendary cards:

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZiEJ67nejkJJNVu4gYNtxMh9kuSpk2F7rrDgNhi33rcE/image.png 

One of them got level 2, but how is this even working? Got +1 HP and a 2 Ranged attack, but also Reckless skill, damaging its allies. Well, I presume it may be fine on the last spot. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUcUB6JnzEGbEsGfriDrvSbR8H7StSk7Szu3HSacefmLx/image.png 

Epic cards time, and I can afford to buy 6 of them, But wait a minute, who got a Epic Gold here? Me.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQTyQMATjVBApqRLg9ozMdutWCTQsmGynMSapmzpZw8Cb/image.png 

One of them went up to level 4, gaining some extra Armor and HP. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYGDpwmR1Kms9WLoF8RYu9vu1QAnXA4NmR6bFNdQJKtMy/image.png 

And with this, I will stop here for now, as I may save my Glint to buy a few more Legendary cards. We are getting there. As the Epic Gold card is worth $4.50, I decided to put it on sell, to get some DEC for the Bloodlines packs. Other than that, good luck with your shopping!

title.title: Punishment Works, We Just Don’t Use It.
title.body:
Talking of if punishment actually works, well I would say yes. When punishment are really done and carried out the way it is supposed to, then it will definitely work.




And I say that because what we see today isn't actually punishment. Punishment is what you get after you break a law, go against a rule and regulations or do something that's wrong. Punishment we can also say is the end result or consequences of going against a laid down rule. It is designed to make the offender and law breaker pay for the wrong they did and to as well discourage potential offenders from doing or repeating the same thing.


![66992.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/betheloji12/EoCfjgsFVxsFT6v9uy9sVvpcrFxM4s7KnPAf3EuWdutAQefzBzX3EiJ6SYEmJN7v95f.jpg)



And a lot of people often argue that punishments don't actually work, which I won't blame them for, it's because of the situation we've found ourselves. One that makes it feels like only the poor gets punished while those who are rich and well connected often find a way to navigate their way through.


And that is why we find out that crime keeps happening, I love the various punishments that had been assigned to each crime and offense, so I won't say the punishment is not enough, the problem is that the punishment are not exactly carried out.



Like I was saying earlier, a lot of people feel they are above the law and can't get punished,some feel they are too connected and know who and who to reach out to just so to avoid the consequences of their actions/punishment. And with that kind of thing happening, there's no way crime wouldn't continue.




Some months ago a popular Nigerian celebrity has an issue, Bobrisky to be precise. We were all told that he/she was serving some jail term, but later we got to know and find out that he/she wasn't jailed and not even in the prison premises, rather a place was rented for him/her to stay outside of the prison premises. All because he/she has connections and was able to put some call through to people who feel, nah, she/he can't be jailed/stay in a prison premises.



Now think of the effect such will have on the masses. It will definitely ruin the trust we have in our systems. It makes us believe that punishment is only for we the ordinary citizens who don't have any connections while the rich and well connected ones will always find a way around whatever crime they commit.





I will also love to cite the happenings in Nigeria presently, how armed kidnappers, abductors, killers were being apprehended by our security operatives, and instead of them being jailed for life, get death by hanging or by firing squad or something of sort, we find out that they take them to rehabilitation centers and reintegrate them back into the society... Like, can you even imagine. Not as if I'm against rehabilitation, but not for heartless k!ller's like this people.


![1001146677.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23uEzR35VoNYPacvWFNs9a4wiPdnLu6xM8NDWL9pfYAGbEgTd8ZeZdgzcZggxjeRWaSBw.png)




Now, tell me why such offenders who have been reintegrated back into the society won't go back to what they were doing before, because their believe now is that nothing serious will happen to them, they believe of they're being apprehended again, they will take them to a rehab and at the end reintegrate them back into the society.





Also, punishment cannot always be the solution to everything. A lot of problems and crimes we are seeing today are as a result of bad governance, poor systems, poverty, unemployment and the likes. I'm not saying all of that should be a reason why we should commit crime or a justification for crime, no, what I'm saying is if this issues are addressed, crime itself will reduce.




In conclusion, punishments definitely works,so far it is been carried out the way it is supposed to. We shouldn't give room to anyone to believe they can bribe or navigate their way out of getting punished. Nobody is, and should be above the law.



🌹

title.title: Childhood Experience- If Only I Could Turn  Back The Hands Of Time
title.body:
NOSTALGIA AND CHILDHOOD
Hello #scifimultiverse friends. Happy new week. Growing up, I grew up in a rural locality. However, we went to a mission school. And as a result, we belonged to special wings of the school, such as the marching and sports teams. Then, my dad was a civil servant; he always took us to the urban city to get a taste of what it felt like. When we get there, my elder brother will use that opportunity to get enough chocomilo. I don’t understand how he convinces my Dad to buy a packet for him. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPiaCPTHBULGzXqGazomWeBypCeWYezUqN35gseyUNJE/image.png) However, when he is given an assignment at the farm, he will take us with him, convincing us to help him while promising us Chocomilo as a reward. There is a clause that we should be singing “choco choco chocomilo, take your own one by one, choco choco, chocomilo.” This was the rhyme associated with the brand while we were growing up. However, other favourite snacks motivate me to go to school; they include Nasco, Rover, and curly worly biscuits. Once I remember those snacks, I feel motivated to go to school. There is a supermarket where my Dad always takes us in the early morning to get the biscuits. Each time I ask him if we are going to the supermarket and he affirms, I feel excited and very happy that day. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTSLemCkM2gN2aYhN8xML2g5qY5Ycf32jdLgur6bMD6EH/image.png) Furthermore, there are local snacks such as kulikuli, Gurundi, and chin chin, which I also love eating. Each time my Mum goes to the market, I do ask her to buy some for me. After the purchase, I use it to prepare my homework. Sometimes it is brought to pacify me while my hair is plaited to distract me from the pain. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWbaTAFWNabbi4ggRVh8HxjDHPkKgwS5dhbyvrdp6StpN/image.png) Additionally, growing up, I played some interesting games with my friends, including Ludo, Nyo, and what. Then, if you win me many times, I will become emotional and sometimes cry. So to avoid such embarrassment, once I am beaten several times, I will run away lol. But that does not change the fact that I love the game and can play it for hours without getting bored if only I am on the winning side. But you know, once the game turns against me once or twice, I pick race. Because once bitten, twice shy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcjyZFyS43GofXU9pbZhXW5SWknD9jKWm7yLBQBj9ptz5/image.png) If I’m to bring back a snack, it would be Nasco biscuit and Trebor sweets, because they are our family's favourite snack and sweets all the time. This is because my mum won’t allow us to buy other ones. If it is not a Trebor or Nasco biscuit, forget it. Today, I searched and kept searching for the Trebor sweet to no avail. The mint is second to none. On the Nasco biscuit, the shortcake is a full meal for me. I use them sometimes for breakfast or lunch snacks. These moments are unforgettable; such times will remain evergreen in my memory. How I wish I could bring back the hands of time. Feel free to join [here](https://ecency.com/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-week-72-edition-or-nostalgia-and-childhood) **P:S Images were generated using ChatGPT** ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbU2hSgaX1Af4R4dWfwNG3TcPhZMquzbJbmqGKqd7BpTd/1781573438558.gif)

title.title: Hiking, new trails and a viewpoint overlooking the sky beyond the sun 📷 Málaga – Spain
title.body:
> --- >Green spaces, woodland parks and botanical gardens are like giant lungs that breathe life into every human being, and visiting them transforms a simple walk into a sublime and extraordinary experience. --- ![Image_1781450385494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMaCRNBvbnTo55Lm6GWuQoadDngv9tnd21od5a3TQn8bBqzYUstaj7rWFQybMRDo4Te.jpg) --- I haven’t yet managed to explore any of the city’s woodland parks in their entirety; each one covers so many hectares that it’s impossible to do so in a single day, and my eagerness to discover and explore them is immense, but I recognise that it’s better to appreciate one path at a time, just like life itself. What’s more, there are many other natural spots I haven’t yet visited, which I hope to see very soon. As I always say, this is a city that expands as I explore it, and I am increasingly certain of it: it is endless. A while ago I discovered a new forest park, which I visited with my mother a few days before she had an operation on her eye. How things change when you can’t be there; life is sadder. I promised myself I’d return, though exploring new paths, once she’d had the operation and could see the colours and clarity and experience it in a different way, and I did. --- ![20260515_182742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsScVZyYBU11oUF4wLb3uA1veA4tZYriU3E7AywTYQzjorLmwarfvo59PrJZ411fES9.jpg) ![20260515_182805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xARfoSQMFp9qMTq4eJFg1KYTgauSrNSSKPXUCEtTnv7rJ4S5c6W7kCkTMbiRTby988Z.jpg) ![20260515_182812.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243q2Xbj5PT1Bn4huoxRyZnWXemLui7pB5SvxGS2Ei9QAdeqQh8Zm7T3hGwFfdprGTYoE.jpg) ![20260515_182832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xoz2W1LZzTQrp4Dty9XXTis7dKaSfBqHRQRkZTZYebJgXQeaQoVzKbHQq8vhR4TrD73.jpg) ![20260515_182941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKxwAgPR6KFq3k7Hd95zRA7g7s1MCMvbR1MfNqG3cMMkYTKyHu9SLbmHVGHbd6QdZpG.jpg) ![20260515_183054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJ6AnbUy6pKGuj9LeqBSNoEzJLdvJMF5BYu7zGDd2ZevJ6YHiJxZGiCbabHqA4pnb2T.jpg) --- The universe has blessed me with very good eyesight and hearing, so for me it’s normal to see a multitude of colours, their intensity, their brilliance, and also to hear the birds, the water running, the crunch of leaves under my feet, but not everyone can. So a few days ago I planned a new hiking route, consulting my friend, Google Maps. And whilst researching, I found there was a high-up area that isn’t marked as a viewpoint, but which seemed like a good opportunity to explore new paths. Of course, I took my mum with me; it was a family outing, and my brother joined us too. The experience was incredible. My mum could see the edges of the leaves, the shades of green, their intensity, the different colours, and all the earth tones ranging from light browns to reddish hues. All the city’s forest parks have them. --- ![20260515_183214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFPdRZa9mv4ssHnhiYjA4f2M6v8Zv1p4Jez4rzMjXCuAX7qAMv6VrXXiyzgzV6piqx8.jpg) ![20260515_183317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsLXdMoc2qZLGhAyF9PYmsEAT8odHS41mN8vd7bsnRUoxDMog64KxwfqgrAvpgWsJ7t.jpg) ![20260515_183405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u62jnoRegysegdnwvrYRQrE4vLAK9ydjEMhZZNzdBYE9sogffsmxp6CHcn9KkAQoevo.jpg) ![20260515_183418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ynNWkk5JXhJvP2AXWa7GArejV6gnFGGsSG6NHznCGePPNBV8TRFqYQiNuyekdmTKXjC.jpg) ![20260515_183443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245w6uu69VZbhJGkfk4o2Uf1f6Y3mbKEoqoiiaUdsrSUmYbXfLomJH9HdcVb2ncF6trrU.jpg) ![20260515_183501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsHwk8SqoPhZxV4AVUXeki7WoWZtFzMbCucM2ZZt2C8E6sLjH5PHvBs4igtA8x1vgDT.jpg) --- A sign on this new path mentioned the nature trails and described the route I took on my first visit, but expanded on the text to also mention those paths that aren’t tarmac, but are dirt tracks, which I walked along this time, even passing through areas where they were working with forestry machinery to remove dead trees and reforest. This is an activity that never stops in these places, and I love that it’s that way. --- ![20260515_183549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wC3d8E9QRK5m1TTvLsko18oSUhJuYSZxuv7qSFSoT4fih5c4tNB89hM2cm7PWU3p8tM.jpg) ![20260515_183814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMSHXSKm51UJEHMdYpVZjzxuybLFY43WtTYZdbgrJr68N6eXcXz2DvEcmtgiLRtpui3.jpg) ![20260515_183853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQnD3GHpxJeN1NdNCWoLj6jLkcqZWk3mGVwwJMY6sbw7naSUMtxXSMorUPVXvuhFM5D.jpg) ![20260515_183910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbHEABqfkkciZz5gz1dnjmqVwbW7uKCrJ5XiqNLHENxWFNKC3x5enu4jaWdWMTFvCfd.jpg) ![20260515_183928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVFDo61qT8bhK2c7sejnCeLqgKUAvryfz8JuBpsy5hE1szN1xrPXoGwqgBSTZcuFasW.jpg) ![20260515_183933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2ik1r2CYVqSSLauiWoQorgiiKiU73cXaDTkZEHa1PN8bQmkmUiFMvwcpMsCZdmmKcZ.jpg) ![20260515_183939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244oLJ8fZ1Sv4kfjCDNknfd9wuJ3rZVWQEGfJqoFWZFg7QC2bXuG8KhdEGCYF3sXPdGcU.jpg) --- On my walk, I was able to see the species mentioned on the sign, such as wild olive, eucalyptus, Aleppo pine, common in all the Parks, thuja, bolina and carob. And although I didn’t see any large lizards, I did spot a small one that quickly disappeared from view, vanishing among the plants. Despite the heat, I managed to avoid seeing any snakes, which was a relief, even though they say they aren’t dangerous. --- ![20260515_184027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqfzVhyLrvD2D7QwmkwjbS3nvKNqQ4wiqHhPLnN1J2Adeof8UiVVeFzMHBH4MDcNefU.jpg) ![20260515_184030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqgaGVw4GNdu122Zv2rEEiKwG6LjkSWKkhKmcK1UE4nNmFWdokrcQtUhyFh67eDk7Wp.jpg) ![20260515_184041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQpHTuKFFnbPJc9bWoieYVxJ2o3E8pGw4k6kJYmfHsBQkAxKz65MEVzWZpaw4H8QeQ5.jpg) ![20260515_184045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2gXoX8Ak9twV1qm3JpLgoVb7DbfmesSyiSo3QS3aBvrVRsLqBiqLaJriphL1ByvJLg.jpg) ![20260515_184101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFS1JgVDMqY5vk6PdDYZiX4mugtLPabdGjTocdmpG71F2sMqpGgKpCkMEUvksJERr63.jpg) ![20260515_184108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yTYRQcUHskww8HvXgt3FkGSYXne7zo7TrvvGKtzSVo9iApLzwA9hAfTS6Pm7e19YhcE.jpg) ![20260515_184113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hMq1N1jJWHY53BziqdLNNFchu7XknvX338x4EtvZEcd1GTLxHPUBuFpyx831Wchcq7.jpg) --- There were blackbirds and sparrows all along the route, and when I reached a rest area with benches for a quick picnic, drinking mate with apple cake with my family, I could watch the squirrels running from tree to tree. They’re so cute. Meanwhile, along the way, I was paying close attention to my mother’s experience. For me, the encounter with silence, peace and mental relaxation is what I seek, as well as physical exercise and a deep connection with nature. But her case is different; she had been there before and now she saw everything differently and was in awe. Of course, you can’t cover 11 hectares in a few hours, let alone whilst resting; there’s still a long way to go, but nature is so wonderful that in this case I thought about how much it’s worth seeing it and experiencing it fully with all it has to offer. --- ![20260515_184154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243LviToHBVEB7i3FTLbRgv4XDou8DBsnu4Tw46PA3bpQ1r8m3D7ixHS5V55MP4X9Hfj7.jpg) ![20260515_184324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2449scAd8XJQszYPJCbNoivUHDhdVxvyQpmM7NnBBDMzvGv4sM1pQVXETM5upkFDqsBoE.jpg) ![20260515_184333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRpDBsHUWNiTCrGTYmkEjhrp6uedxEDAFTRv2BgnM3TLF73ydys1vv5xFPErWW1mScu.jpg) ![20260515_184346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2h7cHHGTpjfayvYWLhyFMXKwBVtPVfpQdskCMf8cSgtpcpjMdsPLiBfwSsxMEsi2z4.jpg) ![20260515_191804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244UjGgpWsaM3oHRktLKhCX3awc1PK9LkJBQKDos8QBe3NLo9zV4AofzHpF4AH9HeBHqs.jpg) ![20260515_191821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245HeV4TVVZLdQKf1qXQAcBB7BqgnSzZopWg8C7ZEWuyAdddPyYLMtgMP3R2mVcjWtPFh.jpg) ![20260515_191847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2458Hv7iJMEr1FdGNmqYipVVDKGkyuJebaaTxE5xgiED7SuRif9c1s3zgCoeqLkZVrgqo.jpg) --- For most of the walk, there was plenty of sunshine; indeed, it filtered through the trees and the few clouds in the sky, but as time went on, I thought I could see a storm approaching from the north. It is very rare for it to rain in the city, both in the month before summer and during the summer itself. In fact, in the eight years I have been here, it has not rained in any summer. --- ![20260515_191852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWvt1pnNiMq9ctMvxYGYpTZFaj8d8nM4tN3pXwL4Si2CqjeB7rT94GzBCHZoJSD5adg.jpg) ![20260515_193302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243qAhR1CbbX2S7CMX43MSrR9z18FsvPVnSWyKHJd8EVNZpFVnURUugKvfFBi63w8tJtR.jpg) ![20260515_193306.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2ipRACqyxTMzYteaDJqw8XZCMckYPpHxsBhNArkgGkpBLXECKQoWUoUKxkamLKCbUP.jpg) ![20260515_193314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKrV1eFLFxw13MncGFKyY66c42NHw3h97PJQiX25P1hxsxRnZsajvFr3VevtTSAdsQc.jpg) ![20260515_193318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242DDrZ3shR5gZdJx3NpJGDWvpxyR5WLEhsk8gUqDLKjWhJMN67eox5pd4MaTdZfnmCZe.jpg) --- I saw the clouds gathering, looking quite dark, from the north, but I had planned to go to that spot up high that looked like an unmarked viewpoint; I didn’t want to miss it, and I didn’t. --- ![20260515_193701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23qrFxwkS24eF6AUTebJmxjwZ1RMBxZaBnQs9uPdW5Ctef9fWaJFSXPuS5NmtNWZ4mqHw.jpg) ![20260515_193704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fn6uKhxP725T1ZRt7DEP5TcdzkZNLxpw4YBVwt53NKY5fS6ZMArQJD4yKxiMMjYdkX.jpg) ![20260515_193714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241tUh5n4CHkSMndE4CxcVAvdpQ27FAuRDPxMC9nNBfgjaSTCQhkynoawoE28ddFFhj87.jpg) ![20260515_193736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23s9PB2CjdNnUWgL4r9mzdYwUakkvjc5N5g46N9SqWebJdgHU58swqcmhTf4xbdkpB9q2.jpg) ![20260515_193742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245wDaXYqHQ4EzYS9ygy571Jz7vowBYqPXdBbh6y1KbXATnkrgfwo96RvEk86RvoD6kfA.jpg) --- I made my way round the areas where the machinery the council was using to reforest the site was operating, they were even clearing new paths, and as there was no one there at the time, I headed for the spot I’d marked on the map, and this is what I saw: yet another marvel. The views from this spot didn’t face the sea as on the previous occasion, but rather the western part of the city, and it was so high up that I could see the mountains surrounding the whole city in that area. I took in everything around me, and there were no sounds there anymore, just the distant chirping of birds and the breeze carrying the scent of rain, a smell I love. --- ![20260515_193916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hSD6GJzfDjvEJBEM3YR9oLwb84tFqP8HzeCMQCy6QEWG7VMJrVxiS8C8brTiLWtqef.jpg) ![20260515_194022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243ze6514XtqA5cbKufJewN3Ro5Y7T6ygT6jt5Fz5sPwRG1Zzu7jkt6krPRpbwK66hFvz.jpg) ![20260515_202914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zZaTGTrkTbvE5Q9YMnnEbmdSYYC6Whg9PfZvvSEthuVr44vE5uGohZrpbJLPfjjkFF.jpg) ![20260515_202917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245wHG7aVC4sNzyLS9QAhTpyG7phMN4Tj5fASs5K3W7eQZmBBc9rsSpkHVf1CNfionSKN.jpg) ![20260515_202923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8mdb1KJU9Suu2PQKFTV36Lod9SMJNDGToG52uVWJsMD3yNtTepeopYc9fvZWah8CrN.jpg) --- I zoomed in a few times to get a closer look at those landscapes, it was incredible. Then, as it looked like rain was on the way, I decided to head back, not for my own sake but for my mother’s, who had stayed behind on a bench to rest. It was a wonderful shared experience, an unforgettable one, because whilst there will be other moments, there will never be another first time out in nature witnessing its magnificence. Thank you all for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

title.title: A Simple Day Here at The Farm, Checking The Plants and Checking The Proposed Project Chicken Pen
title.body: >\nGreetings Aseanhivers around the World, A simple farm activities here at the farm and one of this the proposed building of a simple big and wide chicken pen. We started to build last day and round timbers are the only materials we used to built the foundation of the chicken pen. We decided to placed near at the bamboo trees so the place can be more relaxing, cool and have a shady areas. We brought this round timbers from the mountain and carried one-by-one because it is very heavy. We do not yet clean the entire place because the first thing we did is to built the foundation. I am excited to see this when it finished and delighted to placed my chickens here. It will surely safe from harmful animals like Snakes and dogs. \n</div class=\

>

![IMG_20260615_093403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoiX72KrTzZt8vQNnAriqmqTfLujMHZZBBXqQybAd6GveELcbPpNLEMpXu4MZT5ZLrZ.jpg)
</center>
This is one of the chicken I have here and she only lay her eggs in this pig pen. It is not safe here because it can easily reach by dogs and snakes that is why we built a simple big chicken pen. I brought this from my Grandpa during our visit there and now she already lay lots of eggs. This pig pen will be use on next month because we also planned to cultured pigs for business. 

![IMG_20260615_093312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EpT3Eswvha2VZPZexFMVx2gvQmYEUUwehoMTWRW4aWq5Vvh272uknuX7j17GiV7SLcM.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260615_093341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoEqynj8kj8MT3382zWKoVHyr75D4H7QqYFGEuQcsJotRHcYHL8y8HNShoPn42D44HH.jpg)
</center>
My madre de Agua plants also grows in stabled conditions. But it is also dangerous and unsafe from our Farm animals like Our cows and goats. This kind of plants is their favorite to eat that is why we decided to built a simple fence made of Bamboos. In this kind of way, our plants will become safe from animals. I brought the cuttings of the plants in online selling and each cuttings costs 12 Pesos. I really did my best to take care this slight expensive kinds of plants. Gladly all of the cuttings I ordered are already grows producing young leaves and small branches.

![IMG20260616061359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/Ep5knKGKYY7XdveDLn8Jz7Zt17ha8ia11Z5TxPfGd737UGN4AJYNA9MBGZRYJveJwD9.jpg)
</center>
My Young chilli plants are nearly grows stabled and good to replant at the Garden. I used a recycled seedling tray I found at the garbage. I felt very sad because some of the seeds I've planted are not grows but despite of that, there are still few of it that successfully grows but it is not yet ready to replant. I will kept waiting for a few days before replanting it in the garden. This will be very perfect for business and also family consume specially when I make simple sauce with chilli peppers.

![IMG20260616061416_01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EokceDAbkbh7xdZndwuS7n1EWkkK6QF8GPLH8YyFgF6PJHFeoW4YW2FGTLCc9KQ3Q7a.jpg)
</center>
The Eggplant I really take care for how many days and Months is also grows in stables condition. I also kept waiting for the flowers to come out because it will indicates that eggplants vegetables will secondly come out. For now the eggplants I have here continues to produced lots of young leaves and small branches and loosen the soil is very important so the roots will quickly expand resulting the plants will grows quickly also. Adding organic fertilizers are also very important but I did not yet make a simple organic fertilizer due to a very busy life I had. But making organic fertilizer is the second activities I will make for my plants.

![IMG20260616061438_01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/Ep7tcxrceNJQyVEDvKcYFCxr2Ljnms42fdjpqFYxxcE6VXZj369rdLqacAzh4qstTHR.jpg)
</center>
As I checked my ornamental plants, some of it are grows very healthy and I planned to sell some of it online. I choosed the best plant to sell online and I really hope it will sold all the plants I will sell. Today, I have few vacant time here at the Farm that is why some of the activities I did was to roamed around and caring and checking my plants here at the Garden. 

Until next post, have a nice day to all of us.

title.title: Correction: Punishment is not the path to liberation.
title.body:
Hello friends. Where people break the rule they are punished by the authority. From ancient time to modern era the system of gving punishment is a continues rule. Without punishment the bad people never fear anyone. They become more harmful and dangerous for the society. In every society and religion punishment is must for the criminal.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf3X8jKjeMyxayNm37nMdtTbx5x7AcJEuFXiEWPD2kgSW/1781599957117.png)

We know that in society, the punishment for committing a serious crime can be imprisonment, life imprisonment, or even the death penalty. These tough laws have been created to keep people away from crime. But the reality is that despite such strict laws, people are not stopping committing crimes. There may be various psychological, social, and economic reasons behind this.

Many times, criminals are not afraid of being caught. They think that they can hide the crime. Again poverty, scarcity of work, low incom also increase the tendency to commit crimes. The main purpose of punishment is not only to hurt the criminal but also to keep society safe and give the criminal a chance to reform. But if punishment cannot prevent the repetition of crimes, is there a deficiency in our current justice system? In Bangladesh few organisations are trying to drug rehabilitation. But those are not sufficient. Now a days a large number of crimes are occurring for raising money for drugs.

There is no way to deny that punishment increases fear in people. it is not possible to eradicate crime through only fear. In order to reduce crime, social awareness, good education, and economic security are also needed beide punishment. If people can properly fulfill their basic needs and justice is ensured, crime rates will decrease significantly.

Using this opportunity, we can discuss this complex relationship between crime and punishment in more detail.
We need to understand that prison is not a permanent solution to any problem. If a criminal come out of prison as a more dangerous criminal, then it is time to change our system. To bring about real change, we need to identify and eliminate the root causes of crime. To eliminate crime from society, it is most important to awaken morality and human values ​​in every person. 

Without raising consciousness it is not possible to erase crime frm the society. Beside this well education should be confirmed for all especially for the women. A good mother can build a good character of his child. Children generally follow his mother in childhood. Most of the significant quality build up in childhoid by see his mother's activities. So an educated mother much better to guide her children than an uneducated mother.

Finally, it can be said that punishment may temporarily keep people away from crime, but to make a society crime-free, we need to build a humane society along with the rule of law. Let us dream of building a society where the conscience of people will play a more effective role in curbing crime than the fear of punishment. Thinking deeply and discussing this issue is very relevant for the present time. The government should take significant  scientific steps  to rehabilitation for criminals and decrease crimes from society.

title.body: Hey, good crowd here, this topic always makes my brain split in two a little. Jackpot slots can be fixed, local, networked, or those wild progressive ones where the prize keeps swelling like it has somewhere to be. I usually check this stuff before spinning, and [https://mostbet-app.net/](https://mostbet-app.net/) felt pretty clear to browse when I was comparing games late at night, half-focused, coffee gone cold. Fixed jackpots feel calmer, almost tidy; progressives are chaos with shiny shoes. One round you get nothing but dead reels, next one the bonus tease lands and your pulse gets stupid for five seconds. My small rule: don’t chase the huge number on top like it owes you rent. I pick the jackpot type first, set a limit, then let the game breathe. Big prizes are fun, yeah, but the best sessions are the ones where I don’t leave annoyed.

title.title: Мовчазні титани: як українські лісоруби будували Канаду
title.body: >Часто, коли я занурююсь у спогади або гортаю старі історичні хроніки, мене не полишає одна думка: як багато ми насправді не знаємо про ціну нашого успіху за океаном. Ми звикли до картинки «українця-фермера», який стоїть посеред безкрайніх прерій, притискаючи до грудей жменю рідної землі. Це гарний образ, безперечно, але він приховує за собою іншу, набагато суворішу реальність. Реальною точкою відліку для тисяч наших земляків стали не родючі чорноземи, а темні, холодні хащі канадських лісоповалів.

>Уявіть собі початок ХХ століття. Ви приїжджаєте в далеку країну, де замість затишних хат вас зустрічає віковий ліс, що виглядає як стіна, яку неможливо пробити. Тут немає розмов, немає романтики — тільки звук сокири, що вгризається в дерево, та скрип снігу під ногами. Робота в лісах Британської Колумбії чи Онтаріо була для багатьох українців першим «іспитом на міцність» на новій землі. Мене досі вражає той факт, наскільки мовчазними були ці люди. Вони не скаржилися на відсутність житла чи на неймовірний холод — вони просто працювали, бо іншого шляху вижити в них не було.

>Погляньте на світлину вище, яка передає атмосферу того часу. Це не просто історичний кадр, це візуалізація того, що означало бути «будівельником Канади». Кінь, запряжений у величезні сани, навантажені колодами, які здаються важчими за життя — це реальність, у якій гартувалися чоловіки. Люди, що сидять зверху, — це не туристи, це лісоруби, для яких кожна поїздка цим «транспортом» була небезпечною пригодою. Дивлячись на їхні обличчя, я бачу не просто втому, а якусь дивну, майже містичну зосередженість. Вони знали, що кожен день може стати останнім, але продовжували робити свою справу.

>Робочий день у лісі — це ціла епопея виживання. Вставали ще затемна, коли морози сковували навіть дихання. Сокири та ручні пили були єдиними «партнерами» в цій битві з природою. Жодних механізмів, жодної безпеки — тільки м’язи та неймовірна витривалість. Мені важко уявити, як вони справлялися з цією вологістю та холодом, не маючи того спорядження, яке ми маємо сьогодні. Будь-який невірний крок міг призвести до жахливої травми, а лікарня була в сотнях кілометрів. Але вони йшли в ліс знову і знову.

>Ці люди були справжніми титанами, хоча про них рідко згадують у підручниках з такою ж повагою, як про політиків чи відомих громадських діячів. Саме їхніми руками будувалися перші канадські міста, саме їхній ліс ставав будинками, в яких виростали майбутні покоління української діаспори. Вони залишили частинку своєї душі в кожному зрубаному стовбурі, в кожній стежці, прокладеній через нетрі.

>Іноді я думаю: чи змогли б ми сьогодні, з усіма нашими сучасними технологіями та комфортом, пройти через те, що проходили вони? Чи вистачило б нам того терпіння та мовчазної впертості? Відповідь залишається десь там, серед засніжених лісів Канади, де досі відчувається дух тих, хто не шукав легких шляхів. Вони не просто працювали — вони закладали фундамент для того, щоб ми сьогодні могли пишатися своєю ідентичністю навіть за тисячі кілометрів від дому. Можливо, саме тому важливо пам’ятати: будь-який успіх — це результат чиєїсь надлюдської праці, про яку часто забувають, але яка назавжди змінила світ. А як ви вважаєте, чи доречно сьогодні вимірювати успіх імміграції лише фінансовими показниками, забуваючи про такий важкий, але героїчний старт?

title.title: Вечірка кольорового пилу
title.body:
![colors 1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23rz4wirt72DVJQ9mozk8itrDvfZupxjMfTP611gDf7UXqwU1DGDiuDCcsQrCiKa6azrq.jpg)

Привіт, друзі!

У неділю їздили з дітьми на день народження до моєї подруги та куми. Вона вирішила святкувати спільний день народження своїх двох хлопчиків і запросила купу дітей, родичів, друзів, знайомих та кумів. Загалом зібралося аж 37 людей разом із дітьми! Народу було справді дуже багато, але водночас було надзвичайно весело.

Спочатку дітей повезли на своєрідний квест - щось на кшталт козацьких забав із лазінням по канатах, різними перешкодами та випробуваннями. Дітям дуже сподобалося. Хіба що Маркіян цього дня був трохи плаксивий. Він часто пасує перед складними перешкодами, кілька разів упав і, відповідно, засмутився. А от Даринка була в захваті від усіх розваг.

Коли діти повернулися, їх почастували піцою, хот-догами та іншими смаколиками - словом, усім тим, що вони так люблять. Потім почалися різні конкурси та забави, які придумала й організувала моя кума.

До речі, я теж долучилася до підготовки. Для одного з конкурсів власноруч написала сертифікати, такі собі нагородні грамоти, бо подруга не встигла їх роздрукувати. Але в підсумку вона забула їх роздати переможцям. Ось такий мій внесок у свято виявився нереалізованим. Буду плакати 😥. Ха-ха! Жартую, не буду ))).

Фінальною родзинкою святкування стала справжня битва кольоровим порошком. Не знаю, як правильно називається ця розвага, але дітям вона дуже сподобалася. Тривала вона всього кілька хвилин, але емоцій було море.

Спеціально для цього чоловік куми покосив траву на закинутій ділянці неподалік, щоб діти не вимастили подвір'я, квіти чи газон. Туди всі й пішли веселитися. Для безпеки взяли старий одяг, хоча ця фарба досить легко відмивається. Після забав усі по черзі милися в душі.

Мушу сказати, що організовано все було дуже відповідально. Порожні пакетики позбирали, сміття прибрали. Залишилися хіба кольорові плями на траві та землі, але зараз дощова погода, тому думаю, що їх уже давно змило.

Було дуже весело. У наш непростий час дітям особливо потрібні такі моменти радості, коли можна побігати, покричати, посміятися і просто випустити пару.

![colors 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23uaHTafoMYPmyeEFvh81gRBvZFYTQnrsCaRvEGpA1XyAQy7PeR5YwXmESb6GyQnNQRFF.jpg)

title.title: Exam in the Tower
title.body: When they reached the tower after passing through the ruined streets of Aeltharion, Kael and Lira felt both fear and curiosity in their hearts. From the outside, the tower appeared half-destroyed, but the moment they stepped inside, they were met with an entirely different sight. The interior was alive. The walls were covered with glowing symbols, crystal chandeliers hung from the ceiling, and magical patterns were carved into the stone floor. Elandor struck his staff against the ground. “This is the Crystal Tower. Long ago, it was the center of wisdom and light. Now, it is a place of trials. Everyone who enters here learns the true weight of their heart.” Kael raised the crystal shard. Its light guided them toward the center of the tower. There stood a large circular platform, and at its center rose three stone pillars. Each pillar bore a different glowing symbol: **Courage, Wisdom, and Loyalty**. “The first trial,” Elandor said, “will reveal which of these virtues is strongest within your heart. But be careful: a wrong choice may lead you down a path of darkness.” Kael and Lira approached the pillars. Kael’s eyes were drawn to the symbol of Courage. A fire ignited within him, and the crystal shard responded with a bright glow. Lira, meanwhile, turned toward the symbol of Wisdom. She held her book tightly, her expression calm and determined. Suddenly, the pillars began to tremble. The patterns on the floor shone brilliantly, and two doors appeared before them. Kael’s door opened into a dark cavern from which an ominous hum echoed. Lira’s door led to an endless library whose shelves stretched all the way to the sky. “Each of you will face your own trial,” Elandor said. “But remember: your journey is shared. Though your trials are different, your destination is the same.” Kael took a deep breath and stepped into the cavern. Darkness enveloped him instantly. Within it lurked creatures made of shadow, each reflecting one of his fears: loneliness, failure, and loss. Kael raised the crystal shard. Its light did not destroy the shadows; it merely revealed them more clearly. Then he understood: these fears were not meant to be defeated, but accepted. “I do not deny my fears,” Kael said. “They are a part of me.” One by one, the shadows faded away. At the end of the cavern, a glowing stone door opened. Kael had passed his trial. Meanwhile, Lira wandered among the countless books in the library. Each offered a different kind of wisdom. Yet behind the shelves, one book shone brighter than the rest. Its cover was marked with three crystal rings. Lira opened the book, and a voice emerged from within: “Wisdom is not merely knowing; it is speaking the right truth at the right time.” Lira closed the book and pressed it against her heart. Instantly, the library filled with light, and then vanished. She too had passed her trial. They reunited in the center of the tower. Elandor smiled. “Courage and Wisdom. Both of you have achieved victory. Now the next stage of your journey begins. But remember: the third virtue, Loyalty, has not yet been tested.” Kael and Lira looked at one another. The road ahead was going to be even more difficult. Notes: Translation and photos were created by artificial intelligence.

title.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZqh5CptB8WfKt7P3zEzzP8m6s6rJmr7oGXSGUoToC1GZ/1000071401.jpg Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. English is an international language. And almost all people in our world speak English. It is true that the most people in the world speak Mandarin, which is basically one of the languages ​​of China. However, if you talk about the size of the world, the most widely spoken language is English. You can communicate with people in any country very easily through English. For which students are currently very interested in learning English in our country. Since the education system of the country is very bad, due to which students are now very interested in going abroad. They prepare themselves psychologically to go to another country whenever they get the opportunity. It is not only English that they learn to go abroad. English is needed to work in various organizations in our country. There are currently many organizations in our country that give more jobs to those who know the most English or can speak English. The main reason for this is that English is a perfect language for talking to different people abroad. Due to which, if you have learned English or have good skills in English, people can deal well with other organizations. Especially in the corporate world, the demand for people who know English is the highest. Currently, there are various organizations in our country that mainly teach English online or offline. However, it is most often seen that more people are available to learn English online. Especially, people learn English the most to take the IELTS exam. By doing IELTS, a student can easily go abroad and continue his studies there. Apart from that, it is very important in various jobs. Actually, I think there is no better medium to get a job in the current world than skills. However, there are many countries in the world that are very developed countries without learning English. However, in my opinion, the demand for people in South Asian countries to learn English is the highest. I am also trying a little to learn English online. But I hope I can achieve this. title.body:
The commercial incentive is hard to ignore here.

Once a hydration break becomes a predictable broadcast window, it stops being only about player welfare. It becomes inventory. That does not mean the welfare argument is fake, but it does mean the rule can be optimized for television before it is optimized for the match.

The broader pattern is that major sports keep finding ways to convert stoppages into monetizable moments. Fans experience it as care for players or game management, but broadcasters see scheduled attention.

title.body:
The punishment side gets most of the public attention, but the investigation side is usually where trust is won or lost.

If people believe powerful criminals are protected, even a harsh sentence in one case does not restore confidence. It starts to look selective. That is why transparent process matters as much as the final verdict.

Social media makes crimes more visible, but visibility is not the same as justice. The harder problem is whether institutions can act consistently when public pressure is not focused on a case.

title.body:
The partially offline point is underrated.

A lot of people talk about productivity as if the problem is time management, but the bigger issue is interruption density. Even when the calendar is open, the mind is not really free if every device keeps offering another path away from the task.

Trains are strange that way. They can be productive because movement removes choice: you are already going somewhere, the scenery changes, and the work becomes the only stable thing in front of you.

title.title: Tomatoes, peppers, and basil in the garden.
title.body: After the heavy rains stopped, we started focusing on gardening. We planted all the crops that needed to be grown in the garden. In this post, I will talk about the tomatoes, peppers, and basil we planted. I previously shared a post about the onions and sugar beets we planted. _Yoğun yağışların durmasından sonra bağ bahçe işlerine ağırlık vermeye başladık. Bahçede ekilmesi gereken tüm ekinleri ektik. Bu gönderimde bahçeye ektiğimiz domates , biber ve reyhandan bahsedeceğim. Daha önce bahçeye ektiğimiz soğan ve şekerpancarı hakkında gönderi paylaşmıştım._

/> We planted the tomatoes about a week ago. We bought the tomato seedlings from the market. Actually, we could have grown the seedlings ourselves. That way we would know the quality of the tomatoes, and we wouldn't have had to pay for seedlings. This is what happens when you don't step outside your comfort zone, when you're lazy. _Domatesleri yaklaşık bir hafta önce ektik. Domates fidelerini pazardan satın aldık. Domates fidelerini kendimiz de üretebilirdik aslında. Hem domatesin kalitesini bilirdik hem de fideler için ödeme yapmamıza gerek kalmazdı. Konfor alanının dışına çıkmayınca, tembellik yapınca böyle oluyor._

/> In previous years, as soon as we planted the seedlings, mole cricket-like insects living underground would damage them. We would have to plant new seedlings to replace the damaged and dried-out ones. This year, we haven't encountered anything like that. I didn't see any mole crickets while digging the soil either. Honestly, I don't know what happened to the mole crickets. _Önceki yıllar fideleri eker ekmez, toprak altında bulunan danaburnu benzeri böcekler fidelere zarar verirdi. Zarar gören, kuruyan fidelerin yerine yenisini ekmek zorunda kalırdık. Bu yıl hiç böyle bir şeyle karşılaşmadık. Toprak kazıma esnasında da danaburnu hiç göremedim. Danaburnulara ne olduğu doğrusu bilemiyorum._

/> We planted the pepper seedlings on the same day. We got the pepper seedlings from the market as well. This year we planted more peppers than in previous years. Peppers are one of the vegetables we consume. We dry some of them in the sun to consume in the winter. Then we use them in some dishes during the winter. _Biber fidelerini de aynı gün ektik. Biber fidelerini de pazardan temin ettik. Bu yıl ektiğimiz biberler geçen yıllara göre daha fazla. Biber tükettiğimiz sebzelerden biri. Bir kısmını kışın tüketmek için güneş altında kurutuyoruz. Ardından kışın bazı yemeklerde kullanırız._

/> This is some basil we planted. We planted very little because we don't consume much basil. Some people use basil fresh in their dishes, while others dry it and use it that way. _Bunlar da bir miktar ektiğimiz reyhan. Reyhanı çok fazla tüketmediğimiz için çok az ektik. Reyhanı yaş olarak yemeklerde kullanan var, kurutup o şekilde kullananlar da var._

/>

There are a few vegetables left in our garden that I haven't mentioned yet. These are green beans, cucumbers, and zucchini. I plan to talk about them in a few days. The crops in the garden are slowly growing. It's a great pleasure to witness this.

_Bahçemizde ekip de bahsetmediğim bir kaç sebze kaldı. Bunlar yeşil fasulye, salatalık ve kabak. Bunlardan da bir kaç gün sonra bahsetmeyi düşünüyorum. Bahçedeki mahsüller yavaş yavaş büyüyor. Bunlara tanıklık etmek büyük keyif veriyor._

Walking through the grand corridors in tehran bazaar feels like stepping into another world entirely 

This is the historic Grand Bazaar of Tehran and its architecture is truly special with those iconic brick vaults and arched ceilings that have stood the test of time 

Every single day countless tourists visit this place to soak in the atmosphere while local residents move through the hustle and bustle to get their daily shopping done 

It is a place where history meets modern life and everyone is welcome to explore its endless winding paths 

Cheers 🥰

Morteza Yousefi


The architecture of traditional Persian bazaars like the one in Tehran is deeply rooted in history and serves as a blueprint for marketplaces across many Iranian cities 

These markets were historically designed as the economic and social centers of a city featuring long covered pathways that protect shoppers from the heat in summer and the cold in winter 

A defining feature of these markets is the organization of trades where similar businesses are grouped together in specific sections called 'Rasteh' 

This traditional layout means you can find dedicated areas for carpets jewelry spices or copperware which allows customers to compare quality and prices easily 

These bazaars are incredibly vast and labyrinthine so it is not at all uncommon for a first-time visitor to lose their way while wandering through the maze of shops 

This size is a reflection of their importance as historical hubs where merchants from the Silk Road would gather to exchange goods and culture 

Even today this structure remains a practical way to manage the massive variety of goods while maintaining the unique social fabric of Iranian commerce 

When you get lost in these aisles you are essentially experiencing a layout that has been perfected over centuries to facilitate trade and human connection in the most organic way possible 

---

title.title: Ignorierte Grundwerte: Wie mit Sprachtestes diskriminiert wird
title.body:
/>

Es waren nur ganz wenige, kaum der Rede wert. Zwar hatte das Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge Betrügereien bei den vorgeschriebenen Sprachtests vor der Einbürgerung Nochnichtsolangehierlebender bestätigt. Doch schon  die Wortwahl rückte die Dimension des Problems ins richtige Maß zurück. Es gebe
, gab die Behörde bekannt. Betrug also gab es nicht - kein Grund zur Beunruhigung. Die Lage ist unter Kontrolle. Die Aufregung, die
> rechte Blätter und Kommentatoren im Netz mit klarer Zweckbindung geschürt hatten, war völlig übertrieben.

>Hochentwickelte Willkommenskultur

Dass selbst seriöse Politiker aus Parteien der demokratischen Mitte angesichts der vermeintlichen Gefahr, dass Ausländer die deutsche Staatsbürgerschaft mit gefälschten Sprachzertifikaten erlangt haben könnten, eine Kontrolle bereits abgeschlossener Einbürgerungen forderten, passt allerdings in die Zeit. Deutschland, das seinen historisch gewachsenen schlechten Ruf durch seine hochentwickelte Willkommenskultur hatte kräftig aufpolieren können, ist heute längst nicht mehr das Land, das die frühere Kanzlerin Angela Merkel einst stolz als das mit dem

bezeichnet hatte. 

Statt sich über den anhaltenden Zustrom meist junger, kräftiger Geflüchteter zu freuen, die allein es schaffen können, die nur noch auf einer dünnen Spitze balancierende Alterspyramide zu stabilisieren, herrscht Ärger über jeden, der kommt. Und die offenen Arme, die die Verfolgten aus aller Herren Länder noch vor zehn Jahren begrüßten, haben sich in Bürokratengreifer verwandelt, die jedem, der bleiben will, vor der Einbürgerung eben einen solchen Sprachtest abnötigen.

>Bezeichnende Lage 

Bezeichnend für die Lage im Land zehn Jahre nach der Öffnung der Grenzen, von der Barack Obama später aus lauter Unkenntnis über die europäischen Verhältnisse sprach, ist die Reaktion auf die hier und da vermuteten

>Geschäfte mit gefälschten Sprachkundenachweisen. Nicht nur die AfD witterte massenhaften Betrug bei den Sprachtests, sondern auch Regierungsvertreter zeigten sich entsetzt, nachdem einige wenige tausend Fälle bekannt geworden, in denen Betrüger Sprachzertifikate für Einbürgerungen gefälscht und online angeboten haben sollen. 

Die Polizei ermittelte. Die Medien empörten sich. Die politischen Parteien riefen nach härteren Maßnahmen und strengerer Prüfung. Selbst die Illustrierte \

beklagte, dass Betrüger für die \nvermeintlichen Zertifikate zwischen 750 Euro und 2.700 Euro verlangten - viel Geld für Menschen, die mit nichts nach Deutschland gekommen sind und wegen mangelnder Sprachkenntnisse oft noch immer keinen Vollzeitjob gefunden haben.

>Ignoriertes Grundrecht 

Auffallend dabei ist: Die gesetzliche Regelung, die den Geschäftemachern erst Tür und Tor für ihre dunklen Machenschaften liefert, wird von keiner Seite infrage gestellt. Obwohl das Grundgesetz in seinem Artikel 3 Abs. 1 einen Gleichheitsgedanken festlegt, der schlicht lautet \

, hat es dem Gesetzgeber gefallen, mit der Zertifikatepflicht eine Vorschrift einzuführen, die dieses Prinzip demonstrativ ad absurdum führt.

Kein in Deutschland geborener Mensch wird vom Staat verpflichtet, Prüfungen absolvieren, um sich seine Sprachkenntnisse mit einem \

genannten Zeugnis bestätigen zu lassen. Nicht nur dass: Kein deutscher Staatsbürger ist überhaupt verpflichtet, auch nur ein einziges Wort Deutsch sprechen zu können. Natürlich darf jeder zur Amtssprache greifen, wenn er sich verständlich machen möchte. Aber ebenso selbstverständlich darf jeder versuchen, sich mit einer anderen Sprache seiner Wahl zu behelfen.

>Die lingua franca der Deutschen 

In modernen, vielfältigen und bunten Metropolen wie Berlin oder Frankfurt ist es oft das Englische, das als lingua franca die Funktion übernimmt, als gemeinsame Verkehrssprache eine Kommunikation von Sprechern unterschiedlicher Muttersprachen und Dialekte zu ermöglichen. Sachsen, Hessen und Polen, Bayern, Dänen und im Wedding geborene Alt-Berliner zeigen in hippen Kaffeeshops und Weinrestaurants, dass Deutschland nicht mehr das Land der Knobelbecher und des preußischen Kasernenhofgebrülls ist, in dem jeder Fremde verloren ist, wenn er sein Anliegen nicht in korrekter deutscher Grammatik formulieren. 

Es ist der Staat, der sich dem Trend entgegenstellt.

, behaupten die Ewiggestrigen und was sie meinen, ist nicht etwa, dass ein Mensch sprechen können sollte, sondern dass er gefälligst Deutsch zu sprechen habe. Die von der SPD unterhaltene Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung hat sogar Aydan Özoğuz, ehemals Beauftragte der Bundesregierung für Migration, Flüchtlinge und Integration, gewonnen, um die krude These von der angeblich überall in Deutschland vorgeschriebenen Einheitssprache in einer sich wissenschaftlich gebenden Studie zu verbreiten.

, vertritt die frühere Staatsministerin dort genau die schräge Auffassung, die die Mütter und Väter des Grundgesetzes noch rundheraus abgelehnt hatten. Sie verzichteten auf eine Festlegung der deutschen Sprache als Amtssprache oder Landessprache, weil sie überzeugt waren, dass jeder sprechen solle, <a href=\

(Niederdeutsches Sprichwort). Verständnis  untereinander, für den Nächsten und die gesamte Gesellschaft werde nicht durch eine bestimmte Sprache begründet, sondern durch gegenseitige Rücksichtnahme, Respekt und die Bereitschaft, zuzuhören.

Siebeneinhalb Jahrzehnte später leben diese Bereitschaft Millionen Menschen jeden Tag, wenn sie zur Schule gehen und in drei, vier oder fünf Sprachen mit ihren Klassenkameraden oder Schülern kommunizieren, wenn sie Bus und Bahn benutzen und sich in einem babylonischen Sprachgewirr wiederfinden. Es sind Politiker und Behörden, die ihren Hang zum Hineinregieren ins Private, zu Prüfung, Kontrolle und Bestrafung nicht zügeln können.

>Gleiches wird nicht gleich behandelt 

Mit den willkürlichen Kategorien Muttersprache und Herkunftssprache und Vorschriften zur Prüfung von Sprachfähigkeiten als Voraussetzung zur Verleihung der Staatsbürgerschaft eines Landes, das weder eine gesetzliche Landessprache noch einen gesetzliche vorgeschriebenen Grundwortschatz für seine  Bürger kennt, verletzt der Staat selbst die ihm vom Grundgesetz auferlegten Vorgaben: Gleiches wird nicht gleich behandelt, Menschen werden einsortiert in Kategorien, für die unterschiedliche Regeln gelten. 

Der Sohn eines Ehepaares mit deutscher Staatsbürgerschaft wird niemals einen Sprachlehrgang machen und ein echtes oder falsches Zertifikate zum Nachweis seiner Deutschkenntnisse vorlegen müssen, selbst wenn er keinen einzigen geraden Satz formulieren kann. Zugezogene hingegen, Aydan Özoğuz nennt sie Gewanderte, müssen es sich gefallen lassen, auf diese Weise als Menschen zweiter Klasse behandelt zu werden. Und alles, was den Oppositionsparteien, den engagierten Nichtregierungsorganisationen und den großen Medienhäusern dazu einfällt, sind Schlagzeilen darüber, dass womöglich ein Problem existiert, es aber nicht sehr schlimm ist und Hilfe bereits unterwegs.

title.title: Do punishments work? [EN/PT]
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23t79F4qaft9zmuPAM2hehGn9xpDMrE8QZQRfYYP6d45WvSRkrKv1WYvvqb54zAetDQ9x.png)
[FONT](https://images.pexels.com/photos/6077181/pexels-photo-6077181.jpeg)


# [EN]
Hello friends, let's reflect on another good topic, so let's think about it together.
Today I bring a question that has surely crossed the minds of many people: do punishments really work? We live in a society where everyone knows that committing a crime can have very serious consequences. Depending on the situation, a person can be sentenced to several years in prison, life imprisonment, or, in some countries, even the death penalty. Despite this, we continue to see robberies, homicides, fraud, and so many other crimes daily. So the question arises: aren't punishments enough to prevent people from committing crimes?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

In my opinion, punishments do have an important role. They exist to protect society and to show that certain behaviors cannot be accepted. Many people avoid committing crimes precisely because they are afraid of the consequences. The fear of losing freedom, family, job, and reputation acts as a brake for many individuals. However, it is also true that punishment alone does not solve everything. There are people who commit crimes driven by anger, despair, or the influence of drugs and alcohol. At these times, they don't think about the consequences or the punishment they might receive. Others grow up in difficult environments, lacking opportunities, with poor education, or living with violence daily. In these cases, the mere threat of punishment may not be enough to change their behavior.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

Another interesting aspect is that, often, it's not the severity of the punishment that most influences people, but the probability of being caught. If someone believes they are unlikely to be discovered, they may feel more tempted to commit a crime, regardless of how heavy the punishment is. Therefore, in addition to strict laws, it is important to have an efficient and reliable justice system. We must also consider the objective of punishments. Is it only to punish or also to try to rehabilitate the person who erred? Many argue that prisons should invest more in education, vocational training, and psychological support for detainees. If a person has the opportunity to change their life and return to society with new perspectives, perhaps there will be less chance of them committing crimes again.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

On the other hand, some believe that certain punishments should be even more severe, especially for very serious crimes. These people argue that the fear of extreme punishment could deter potential criminals. However, reality shows us that even in countries with very harsh penalties, including the death penalty, crime does not disappear completely. All this leads me to believe that punishments are necessary, but they are not the only answer to combating crime. It is necessary to invest in education, create job opportunities, support vulnerable families, and promote values ​​such as respect and responsibility. A more just society with more opportunities can contribute to reducing the causes that lead some people to choose the path of crime.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

In conclusion, I believe that punishments work to a certain extent. They help maintain order and protect society, but they cannot completely eliminate crime. Human beings are complex, and the reasons that lead someone to commit a crime are also complex. Therefore, in addition to punishing those who err, we must seek to understand the causes of the problems and work to build a better society for all. Reflecting on this topic is important because it helps us realize that justice depends not only on the severity of punishments, but also on the ability to create conditions that allow people to make better choices and live in harmony within society.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wBg94ASTsmaz2mio7tqLmnGmbUNa7sNc7z1sd7Yi6vcSqnCDTMZtPnhv5Exc4cjoWUK.png)
[FONT](https://images.pexels.com/photos/10474995/pexels-photo-10474995.jpeg)

# [PT]

Olá amigos, vamos refletir sobre outro bom tema, por isso vamos pensar juntos sobre ele.
Hoje trago uma questão que certamente já passou pela cabeça de muitas pessoas: será que as punições funcionam mesmo? Vivemos numa sociedade em que todos sabem que cometer um crime pode ter consequências muito graves. Dependendo da situação, uma pessoa pode ser condenada a vários anos de prisão, prisão perpétua ou, em alguns países, até à pena de morte. Apesar disso, continuamos a ver diariamente roubos, homicídios, fraudes e tantos outros crimes. Coloca-se então a questão: as punições não são suficientes para impedir que as pessoas cometam crimes?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

Na minha opinião, as punições têm, de facto, um papel importante. Existem para proteger a sociedade e para mostrar que certos comportamentos não podem ser aceites. Muitas pessoas evitam cometer crimes precisamente por medo das consequências. O medo de perder a liberdade, a família, o emprego e a reputação funciona como um travão para muitos indivíduos. No entanto, também é verdade que a punição por si só não resolve tudo. Há pessoas que cometem crimes movidas pela raiva, pelo desespero ou pela influência das drogas e do álcool. Nesses momentos, não pensam nas consequências ou no castigo que podem receber. Outros crescem em ambientes difíceis, com falta de oportunidades, educação deficiente ou convivendo diariamente com a violência. Nestes casos, a mera ameaça de punição pode não ser suficiente para alterar o seu comportamento.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

Outro aspeto interessante é que, muitas vezes, não é a gravidade da punição que mais influencia as pessoas, mas sim a probabilidade de serem apanhadas. Se alguém acredita que é improvável que seja descoberto, pode sentir-se mais tentado a cometer um crime, independentemente da gravidade da pena. Por isso, para além de leis rigorosas, é importante ter um sistema de justiça eficiente e fiável. Devemos também considerar o objetivo das punições. É apenas punir ou também tentar reabilitar a pessoa que errou? Muitos defendem que as prisões deveriam investir mais na educação, formação profissional e apoio psicológico aos reclusos. Se uma pessoa tiver a oportunidade de mudar de vida e regressar à sociedade com novas perspetivas, talvez haja menos probabilidades de voltar a cometer crimes.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

Por outro lado, alguns acreditam que certas punições deveriam ser ainda mais severas, especialmente para crimes muito graves. Estas pessoas argumentam que o medo de punições extremas poderia dissuadir potenciais criminosos. No entanto, a realidade mostra-nos que mesmo em países com penas muito severas, incluindo a pena de morte, o crime não desaparece por completo. Tudo isto me leva a crer que as punições são necessárias, mas não são a única resposta para combater o crime. É necessário investir na educação, criar oportunidades de emprego, apoiar famílias vulneráveis ​​e promover valores como o respeito e a responsabilidade. Uma sociedade mais justa, com mais oportunidades, pode contribuir para reduzir as causas que levam algumas pessoas a escolher o caminho do crime.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23u5tdGjMHy2qvsxjc4JJXKQdoWz25pAdrX1t5e3AspVfLugjWNN9tWMfafXKwkEbnUFq.png)

Em conclusão, acredito que as punições funcionam até certo ponto. Ajudam a manter a ordem e a proteger a sociedade, mas não conseguem eliminar completamente o crime. Os seres humanos são complexos, e as razões que levam alguém a cometer um crime são também complexas. Por isso, para além de punir aqueles que erram, devemos procurar compreender as causas dos problemas e trabalhar para construir uma sociedade melhor para todos. Refletir sobre este tema é importante porque nos ajuda a perceber que a justiça depende não só da gravidade dos castigos, mas também da capacidade de criar condições que permitam às pessoas fazer melhores escolhas e viver em harmonia na sociedade.

title.title: Elegía del primer amor  //  Poema
title.body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.

---


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxSzwizPLeS9WitRFRPSZegxHBjQypVLZ7UiqX4SsmL1/1781579450689.jpg) *Editado en PhotoCollage*

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/fantas%C3%ADa-ventana-chico-ni%C3%B1a-hombre-4065900/) *de la imagen utilizada*

---



# *Elegía del primer amor*


*Ambrosía de un verano, 
nos dimos el presente,
criaturas recién salidas del tiempo.
Tus manos, islas todavía,
mis manos, semillas a merced de ti.
Desconociamos del deseo
sin tacto, 
sin sumergirse en la carne*.

*Los arquitectos del adiós alzaron un templo de distancia.
Se cartografiaron los mapas sin un  nosotros.
Tomé las maletas llenas de ti sin saberlo
como un dios menor al que le niegan el fuego*.

*Y el mundo acarició veinticinco cosechas de lluvias,
de inviernos con sus muertes pequeñas.
Yo aprendí a nombrar otros cuerpos,
tú, a dormir en otra piel.
Pero el amor de juventud
es un fantasma que no necesita sangre*.

*Y entonces, cuando enfrentamos los años
el aire no se rompió.
Fue más sutil,
una vibración casi inaudible,
como si el mundo hubiera sido un espejo húmedo 
y alguien, por fin, pasara sus manos*.

*No hubo beso.
En la mochila había historias verdaderas,
otros amores con sobrenombres y facturas*.


*Ahora somos dos extraños corteses,
dos mensajes de luna llena,
de silencios que aprendieron a ser amables.
Y sin embargo,
hay un lugar donde aquel verano sigue ardiendo,
cuando tus dedos no se movieron de mi cintura, 
donde nunca nos separaron,
y el sexo fue un verbo que no fue imperioso conjugar*.

*Y allí, 
se tatuó una herradura en mi pecho.
No duele ya.
Duele menos que la dicha,
que es siempre un poco falsa.
Duele como duele lo que nunca fue,
con la dulzura absurda de lo imposible*.

*Hoy solo se que si tu rostro se cruza en una foto,
o se pixela en la pantalla,
me vuelvo una joven de agosto 
que te miraba
como quien mira el mar por última vez*.

*No me envuelve la nostalgia
porque soy fiel a algo que no nos dejaron vivir.
Es un juramento sin palabras
de aquella tarde en que el sol se demoró
solo para vernos ser felices
sin hacer nada*.

---
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)


---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---



# *Elegy for the First Love*

*Ambrosia of a summer,
we gave each other the present,
creatures freshly emerged from time.
Your hands, still islands,
my hands, seeds at your mercy.
We knew nothing of desire
without touch,
without submerging ourselves in the flesh*.

*The architects of farewell raised a temple of distance.
Maps were charted without an us.
I took the suitcases full of you without knowing it
like a lesser god denied fire*.

*And the world caressed twenty-five harvests of rains,
of winters with their small deaths.
I learned to name other bodies,
you, to sleep in another's skin.
But young love
is a ghost that needs no blood*.

*And then, when we faced the years,
the air did not break.
It was more subtle,
an almost inaudible vibration,
as if the world had been a damp mirror
and someone, at last, had wiped their hands across it*.

*There was no kiss.
In the backpack were true stories,
other loves with nicknames and bills*.

*Now we are two courteous strangers,
two full-moon messages,
silences that learned to be kind.
And yet,
there is a place where that summer still burns,
where your fingers never left my waist,
where we were never parted,
and sex was a verb that didn't need to be urgently conjugated*.

*And there,
a horseshoe was tattooed on my chest.
It doesn’t hurt anymore.
It hurts less than joy,
which is always a little false.
It hurts the way what never was hurts,
with the absurd sweetness of the impossible*.

*Today I only know that if your face appears in a photo,
or pixelates on a screen,
I become a girl from August
who looked at you
the way one looks at the sea for the last time*.

*I am not wrapped in nostalgia,
because I am faithful to something they wouldn't let us live.
It is a wordless vow
from that afternoon when the sun lingered
just to watch us be happy
doing nothing*.

# *Elegia do primeiro amor*

*Ambrosia de um verão,
nos demos o presente,
criaturas recém-saídas do tempo.
Tuas mãos, ilhas ainda,
minhas mãos, sementes à tua mercê.
Desconhecíamos o desejo
sem tato,
sem mergulhar na carne*.

*Os arquitetos do adeus ergueram um templo de distância.
Cartografaram-se os mapas sem um nós.
Peguei as malas cheias de ti sem saber
como um deus menor a quem negam o fogo*.

*E o mundo acariciou vinte e cinco colheitas de chuvas,
de invernos com suas mortes pequenas.
Eu aprendi a nomear outros corpos,
tu, a dormir em outra pele.
Mas o amor de juventude
é um fantasma que não precisa de sangue*.

*E então, quando enfrentamos os anos,
o ar não se rompeu.
Foi mais sutil,
uma vibração quase inaudível,
como se o mundo tivesse sido um espelho úmido
e alguém, por fim, passasse as mãos*.

*Não houve beijo.
Na mochila havia histórias verdadeiras,
outros amores com apelidos e contas*.

*Agora somos dois estranhos corteses,
duas mensagens de lua cheia,
silêncios que aprenderam a ser amáveis.
E no entanto,
há um lugar onde aquele verão ainda arde,
onde teus dedos não se moveram da minha cintura,
onde nunca nos separaram,
e o sexo foi um verbo que não foi imperioso conjugar*.

*E ali,
tatuou-se uma ferradura no meu peito.
Já não dói.
Dói menos que a alegria,
que é sempre um pouco falsa.
Dói como dói o que nunca foi,
com a doçura absurda do impossível*.

*Hoje só sei que se teu rosto cruzar numa foto,
ou se pixelizar na tela,
me volto uma jovem de agosto
que te olhava
como quem olha o mar pela última vez*.

*Não me envolve a nostalgia
porque sou fiel a algo que não nos deixaram viver.
É um juramento sem palavras
daquela tarde em que o sol se demorou
só para nos ver ser felizes
sem fazer nada*.

title.title: I like to celebrate my birthday #293
title.body:
Hello, ladies of Hive!


I am so honored to be here, especially in the midst of women, to contribute my thoughts to the contest.

I am not just a celebrant of people's birthdays, but I am a celebrant of my birthdays, and I will continue to celebrate them year after year because it's an opportunity or privilege to be alive and another year to be added. 

I take time to celebrate myself a lot, and I give myself presidential treatment on my birthday, so I don't take that time, day for granted, it's always for my God and me, who created and woven me in my mother's womb, and on that particular day, at the set time, the exact 9 months, the day the Lord has made for me I came out of my mother's womb.


![1000820388.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23yJJpxrbNDMNeNwXRmS2nHqLSnSCmrU6cEp7FnWHYeGYGDtV2JUKFra8hHmKjdbq2oL4.jpg)

Gone are the days when I didn't see light, I was still in the village, I didn't know or understand the importance of birthday celebrations, and I didn't care about them.

Now that I have seen the light, I have come to understand what a birthday celebration means, and I have every reason to celebrate myself when that day, month comes.

This is what I used to do on my birthday. First of all, create time and give praise to God, for the mercy and grace over the years, whether I call my mom or she calls me, and pray for me. And then, take myself out with my friends. I will spend on myself and my friends get things for themselves too. 

In this young age till my old age, I will celebrate my birthday, my children will celebrate with my grandchildren, and I will celebrate with them, and I will pour my blessings upon them, and wish them a good old age birthday celebration.

Thank you, #ladieaofhive contest, for this question. I appreciate. #293

title.title: Venus meets Jupiter 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
title.body: ![IMG_9352.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23swcDRiy7TT389jCqYVsVkVMHcQU3Vgq4WpRNN127JDbd8XrbPAQbmFcKEqSccuKu6ec.JPG)! When it comes to astronomy—that is, all the celestial bodies you can see above us—I honestly don’t know all that much. However, when the weather is clear, I enjoy looking up at the night sky. Even though I often don’t really know what I’m actually seeing up there. But over time, you do start to get a sense of what’s twinkling up there. Of course, most of the time they’re stars, but every now and then you can even spot a few planets from our own solar system. Just like these days, when two planets have arranged a little rendezvous in the northwestern night sky. They were aligned almost vertically, with the upper one appearing about twice as large. But size is a tricky thing when dealing with such vast distances. As I had correctly assumed, the upper planet is Venus, and a smartphone app helped me identify the one below it. That’s Jupiter, which I might have guessed. Of course, Jupiter isn’t half the size of Venus, but about 11.5 times larger. But it’s farther away from us and therefore just looks smaller. To be precise, Venus is currently about 180 million km from Earth and Jupiter about 900 million km, making it roughly five times farther away from us. This wasn’t a one-time thing either; the two planets were out to have several dates together, even if they now seem to be drifting apart again. Let’s see if I can catch them together again in the coming days, and if there’s maybe more to see up there. Perhaps I should go out again today after all... ![IMG_9350.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tmDV8xhpCu62Sao7DYzHPUorgisSayPSM1QGzpRyS1kcEfyyPp8SBmTdarUJKFajEYj.JPG) DEUTSCH Wenn es um Astronomie geht, also um all die Himmelskörper, die man über uns sehen kann, habe ich ehrlich gesagt, nicht ganz so viel Ahnung. Aber auch ich schaue gerne nach oben und sehe mir bei klarem Wetter den Nachthimmel an. Auch wenn ich oft gar nicht so richtig weiß, was ich dort eigentlich sehe. Aber mit der Zeit bekommt man dann doch ein wenig Gefühl für das, was dort über einen so blinken tut. Meist sind es natürlich irgendwelche Sterne, aber ab und zu sieht man sogar ein paar Planeten aus unserem eigenen Sonnensystem. So wie in diesen Tagen, wo sich am nordwestlichen Nachthimmel zwei Planten zu einem kleinen Treffen verabredet haben. Sie lagen auf einer fast vertikalen Linie, wobei der obere rund doppelt so groß erschien. Aber Größe ist bei den riesigen Entfernungen so eine Sache. Wie ich richtigerweise angenommen hatte, handelt es sich bei dem oberen Planeten um die Venus, und bei dem darunter half mir dann eine Smartphoneanwendung weiter. Hier haben wir es mit dem Jupiter zu tun, was ich vielleicht hätte erraten können. Der Jupiter ist natürlich nicht halb so groß wie die Venus, sondern rund 11,5 Mal größer. Aber er ist weiter von uns entfernt und sieht deshalb halt kleiner aus. Um es genau zu nehmen, ist die Venus in diesen Tagen etwa 180 Millionen km von der Erde entfernt und der Jupiter etwa 900 Millionen km, und damit rund 5 Mal weiter weg von uns. Das Ganze war auch keine einmalige Sache, die beiden Planeten hatten gleich mehrere gemeinsame Abende eingeplant, auch wenn sie sich jetzt wieder voreinander zu entfernen scheinen. Mal schauen, ob ich sie diese Tage noch einmal zusammen sehen kann, und ob sich dann vielleicht noch mehr über uns tut. Vielleicht sollte ich heute ja doch noch einmal raus gehen... ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

title.title: Marinera de carne de res con arrozºººººBeef marinara with rice
title.body:
Hola a todos, sabemos que cuando hace frio las comidas son siempre mas contundentes, con esto quiero decir que no interesa mucho nuestra silueta jajajaj, por eso para el almuerzo de hoy que mejor que el de degustar marineras de carne de res con arroz con queso, lo cual es ua buena combinacion para la misma.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbuQt4TSGZn8Xn41YCRZ84TgLyuxAvJtGiAnhzxTfpAheVrxy9NwUUt4TBpdtEkEd7r.png)

Hablando de marinera, la misma es de la siguiente manera, tenemos la carne de res, cortada como para milanesa, con la diferencia de que esta lleva masa y no pan rallado, pero su proceso es igual y la verdad sale muy sabrosa, porque como se ve en un volts vatimos el huevo, luego le vamos agregando harian y sal a gusto, hasta obtener la masa ideal para cubrir la carne.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23u61B4KhVbarYzQjnN7tGGqFjeXXKcA9hwuTyEdJ87Ztf5GrTkfh25Jo6DLiKaCVxgFK.png)

Luego de pasar por dicho volts la carne, la misma la freimos en una sarten a la que le agregamos un poco de grasa de cerdo y aceite, de esa manera la marinera sale mas seca una ves cocinada.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uFPfuPJWR1qPt8YL3tZyLdv4eQBVtVkQfrcYBshzXyXkAPTQwYfGtbJVdhwgwEUvU6t.png)

Para que salga asi la agregamos en un volts con papel de servilleta para que se termine de salir el aceite que queda en la misma.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uFRNChcqR1j1rhvmoqZjMnNDAAUcUomWSN3SHkTR689Zn4LjiJ2xoMKNsJwpYLQTneC.png)

Tambien para una comida de esta indole no debe de faltar el el arroz, el cual se cocina de la siguiente manera, tomamos un olla con agua y la agregamos en la hornalla de la cocina, luego le agregamos el arro y una ves cocinado le quitamos el agua y listo, para luego agregarle el queso y mesclarlo bien.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23vsJNHhFrFUhDj5RPseqspctBBf5xSSH4BVw8Lbtn2SBiRvJ2vgXKpxmXm53f9mKfVCv.png)

El tema para preparar la marinera es que dicha masa tiene que estar en su punto justo, tambien porque la agregamos en un papel servilleta asi queda bien seca y sabrosa.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE PASEN UN BELLO DIA.
