title.title: Why Endpoint Security Is Critical in Today’s Hybrid Work Environment\n
title.body:
![Untitled design (1).png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/6a8ea69a0218ced8be77410c0f5e4a54b45fe58859595f1bcabff7dc31396735)

The modern workplace has fundamentally changed. Employees now access corporate resources from laptops, smartphones, tablets, and remote workstations across multiple locations. While this flexibility improves productivity and business agility, it also creates significant cybersecurity challenges.

Every connected device represents a potential entry point for cybercriminals. As organizations embrace hybrid and remote work models, endpoint security has become one of the most important components of a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy.

Protecting endpoints is no longer limited to antivirus software. Today’s threat landscape requires intelligent, proactive, and adaptive security measures capable of defending against sophisticated attacks.

## Understanding the Growing Endpoint Threat Landscape

Endpoints include any device connected to a business network, such as:

*   Laptops

*   Desktop computers

*   Smartphones

*   Tablets

*   IoT devices

*   Remote workstations

Cybercriminals increasingly target endpoints because they often provide direct access to sensitive business systems and data.

Common endpoint threats include:

*   Ransomware attacks

*   Phishing campaigns

*   Malware infections

*   Credential theft

*   Insider threats

*   Fileless attacks

As endpoint numbers grow, so does the complexity of securing them effectively.

## Why Traditional Endpoint Protection Is No Longer Enough

Legacy security solutions were designed for static corporate environments where devices operated behind secure network perimeters.

Today’s decentralized workforce requires a different approach.

Modern [endpoint security](https://tinyurl.com/3wmh8dec) solutions provide:

### Advanced Threat Detection

Cyber threats continue to evolve rapidly.

Advanced endpoint protection platforms leverage:

*   Behavioral analytics

*   Machine learning

*   Threat intelligence

*   Real-time monitoring

These capabilities help identify malicious activity before significant damage occurs.

### Continuous Visibility

Security teams need complete visibility across all connected devices.

Continuous monitoring enables organizations to:

*   Detect suspicious behavior

*   Identify vulnerable endpoints

*   Monitor compliance status

*   Respond to threats quickly.

Visibility remains one of the most effective defenses against modern cyberattacks.

### Automated Incident Response

Speed matters in cybersecurity.

Modern endpoint security solutions can automatically:

*   Isolate compromised devices

*   Block malicious processes

*   Remove threats

*   Alert security teams

Automation reduces response times and minimizes potential business disruption.

## Key Components of a Strong Endpoint Security Strategy

Organizations should focus on several core areas:

### Identity and Access Control

Strong authentication mechanisms help prevent unauthorized access.

Recommended practices include:

*   Multi-factor authentication

*   Role-based access controls

*   Privileged access management

*   Continuous identity verification

### Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)

EDR platforms provide advanced monitoring, investigation, and remediation capabilities.

They help organizations identify sophisticated attacks that traditional antivirus solutions may miss.

### Security Awareness Training

Employees remain a critical line of defense.

Regular training helps users recognize:

*   Phishing emails

*   Social engineering tactics

*   Suspicious downloads

*   Credential theft attempts

Human awareness significantly reduces risk exposure.

## Business Benefits of Strong Endpoint Security

Effective endpoint protection delivers several advantages:

*   Reduced risk of cyberattacks

*   Improved regulatory compliance

*   Enhanced business continuity

*   Better protection of sensitive data

*   Faster incident response

Organizations that prioritize endpoint security often experience stronger cyber resilience and lower recovery costs following security incidents.

## Preparing for the Future of Endpoint Protection

Emerging technologies continue to reshape endpoint security strategies.

Future-focused organizations are investing in:

*   AI-driven threat detection

*   Zero Trust architectures

*   Extended Detection and Response (XDR)

*   Unified endpoint management

*   Cloud-native security platforms

These innovations help organizations stay ahead of increasingly sophisticated cyber threats.

## Final Thoughts

As digital workplaces continue to expand, endpoint security plays a vital role in protecting business operations, employees, and sensitive information. Cybercriminals frequently target endpoints because they provide direct pathways into organizational networks.

By implementing modern endpoint security solutions, strengthening identity controls, and maintaining continuous visibility, organizations can significantly reduce cyber risk while supporting workforce flexibility and business growth.

For a deeper understanding of how advanced endpoint protection can strengthen your organization’s security posture, explore additional endpoint security resources here:

[Know More](https://tinyurl.com/3wmh8dec)

title.title: The Moments That Stay With Me
title.body:
As I get older, I’ve noticed something shifting in me. The things I used to think that mattered so much, the thing I always see as big goals, achievements, always trying to do more, don’t really sit at the center of my thoughts anymore.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUniizyEMmDJ3Kg4dempqrdxphiwzSX7H1YNKi1yxmoUH/1000231343.jpg 


[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/portrait-artwork-photography-8106539/)

Now it’s the small stuff that sticks with me, the normal, messy, everyday moments with my kids. The noise in the house, the random conversations that start out of nowhere and somehow turn into laughter. The way they come to me for the simplest things, like it’s the most natural thing in the world.

I didn’t always realize it at the time, but these are the moments I end up thinking about later in the day, or even long after they have passed. Not the big plans or special occasions, but the ordinary days that didn’t feel like anything important while they were happening.

Life gets busy, of course. There is always something to handle, something to think about, something that needs attention. And I used to feel like I was always behind on something. But being a mother kind of changes what I count as enough.

Now, even a quiet evening at home feels meaningful in a way I didn’t expect when I was younger. Just being there, hearing their voices, watching them grow into themselves bit by bit… it all adds up in a way that is hard to explain.

I’ve also stopped thinking so much about life as a list of accomplishments. It feels more like a collection of moments now. Some big, most of them small, but all of them tied together by the people I love most.

And honestly, when I think about what I will remember years from now, it won’t be the pressure or the stress or the things I thought I needed to achieve. It will be them, the everyday version of them. The real, unfiltered, sometimes chaotic but always honest version of family life. That is what feels like the heart of everything for me right now.





**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

title.title: El contraste entre la vida idealizada y la vida real: El camino hacia la reconciliación interior
title.body:
>

Aunque es fácil analizar la vida humana desde muchos ángulos diferentes, la realidad desde un sentido esencial es muy simple: Para muchos de nosotros el asunto es que la vida está marcada por una constante y perpetua búsqueda de un estado de bienestar, felicidad, perfección, y plenitud interior, que generalmente buscamos en lo externo. Por paradójico que pueda resultar, esto sucede porque desde tiempos inmemoriales, el ser humano ha tenido ideales que simbolizan y encarnan la versión más deseable (desde un sentido estético, funcional y sensorial), de su propia y personal existencia, pero partiendo desde lo subjetivo y lo objetivo en diferentes medida, según la persona de la que se trate.

Los ya mencionados ideales pueden estar relacionados o vinculados con aspectos positivos como la felicidad, la salud, el éxito financiero, las relaciones personales, e incluso, la realización espiritual, entre muchos otros. Pero también puede estar asociado a factores negativos como el propio ego, la necesidad de control y el miedo. 

No obstante, partiendo de la base de que debemos centrarnos en los aspectos positivos de esta necesidad de tener ideales, podríamos asentar que es normal y deseable tenerlos, pero sabiendo muy bien, sin embargo, que la realidad cotidiana (lo factual) rara vez coincide plenamente con estas expectativas idealizadas. De lo contrario, el profundo contraste profundo que se genera (el conflicto entre lo que se sueña y lo que verdaderamente se vive) puede generar infelicidad en nosotros.

# El origen de la vida idealizada: La necesidad y la enajenación
La vida idealizada surge, en gran medida, de factores que bien podríamos delimitar como culturales, personales, sociales y psicológicos. Porque desde la infancia, la realidad es que los individuos somos expuestos a modelos de conducta y narrativas que nos guían, conducen u orientan hacia ciertas formas o estilos de vida (considerados óptimos), que nos \

hacia ellos.\n\nLo que nos deja entrever que tanto la educación y los medios de comunicación como las noticias, modas, y, especialmente, el arte en todas sus formas de expresión (tales como la literatura, la música, la pintura, la escultura, etc), contribuyen, y mucho, a construir o edificar imágenes de lo que una vida \

debe ser.  Algo que, desde luego, se nota mucho cuando vemos, por ejemplo, cómo se idealiza o mentaliza actualmente a la familia, los amigos, el trabajo, la pareja, el país, la salud y la estabilidad financiera, esperando que todo sea perfecto, inmaculado, cónsono con lo se quiere y se sueña.\n\n<div class=\

>Fuente de la imagen Pero es lógico querer lo bueno y rechazar lo malo, es humano y una tendencia innata perfectamente comprensible. Sin embargo, si bien es cierto que estas imágenes idealizadas fungen en cierto sentido como metas o guías aspiracionales que orientan las decisiones y comportamientos humanos, conviene estar atentos a ello para no disociarnos de la realidad. Teniendo eso en consideración, la idealización es, entonces, una función totalmente natural del pensamiento humano que le ayuda a dar sentido al todo: al presente, al pasado y al futuro. Esto, desde luego, es una necesidad fundamental para el ser humano, que le ayuda a dar propósito a su experiencia vital. Es decir, la idealización es un fenómeno que proviene de la necesidad del ser humano de darle sentido y coherencia a sus esfuerzos; por cuanto es una forma de procurar crear una versión mejorada de la propia vida, lo que a su vez se configura en un mecanismo que impulsa el progreso personal y social. No obstante (como ya hice alusión anteriormente) si no se tiene cuidado, este proceso también tiene el riesgo de que puede conducir a expectativas poco o nada realistas y a una absoluta desconexión con la experiencia concreta que se experimenta. Esa forma de enajenación mental, es la que se debe procurar limitar o neutralizar a fin de evitar sus estragos. Por lo tanto, todo lo expresado hasta esta parte nos encausa o posiciona en el hecho que cuando surge de la necesidad o como modo de impulso, el factor idealismo (en la forma de vida idealizada) es deseable, siempre y cuando se mantengan los pies en la tierra, pero cuando sale de lo real, y entra en el absurdo de la enajenación, pasa a convertirse en un problema. # La naturaleza de la vida real: Lo que nunca debemos olvidar Algo de lo que podemos estar muy seguros (y que nunca debemos olvidar), es que la vida real, al contrario de la ideal, está minada de complejidad, cundida de incertidumbre y rodeada de contradicciones inherentes. Lo que se traduce en que puede estar compuesta por momentos de lo más diversos y antagónicos, tales como alegría y tristeza, amor y odio, éxito y fracaso, orden y desorden, aprecio y desprecio, estabilidad y desequilibrio o caos, etc.

>Fuente de la imagen En la realidad cotidiana, se enfrentan desafíos, imprevistos y se experimentan limitaciones personales, sociales, físicas, geográficas, culturales, etc; así como también pérdidas inevitables o insalvables. Por lo tanto, esta dimensión tangible de la existencia revela (sin lugar a dudas) que la perfección absoluta, si es que existe tal condición, es inalcanzable; y que la imperfección es una variable inseparable de la vida humana. Como resultado de la naturaleza real que le caracteriza, la vida exige una capacidad de adaptación constante, pero también resiliencia y aceptación. Porque reconocer la realidad obliga o demanda confrontar no solo las dificultades o problemas, sino también valorar efectivamente las pequeñas satisfacciones y, sobre todo, aprendizajes que emergen de la experiencia directa. Por cuanto la realidad es plural, amplia y diversa, y el reconocimiento o identificación de esta diversidad se torna clave para desarrollar o sostener una visión más equilibrada, responsable y saludable de la propia existencia y de la de los demás. # El impacto psicológico del contraste entre lo real y lo ideal Como es fácil intuir, por mera lógica, el contraste que hay entre la vida idealizada y la vida real tiene connotaciones significativas en la salud mental y emocional de cada persona. Para explicarlo mejor; debemos saber que cuando las expectativas idealizadas son excesivamente rígidas o elevadas, se deriva o genera frustración, insatisfacción, infelicidad y un sentimiento de fracaso constante. Porque la persistente comparación entre lo que “debería ser” y lo que “es” conlleva a una percepción negativa del ser mismo y de su entorno, forjando y haciendo crónicos estados de ansiedad y depresión que a su vez derivan también en baja autoestima. Pero por otro lado, este contraste también puede transformarse en un motor de crecimiento personal si se asume con verdadera entereza y madurez. Por cuanto la discrepancia que subyace entre el ideal y la realidad puede ayudar a fomentar la reflexión crítica, la capacidad de observación, la evaluación y reevaluación de objetivos y la persecución de un equilibrio más razonable, alcanzable y flexible. Viéndolo, asumiéndolo y manejándolo todo de este modo, la tensión entre ambos planos se convierte en una oportunidad de oro para desarrollar una identidad mucho más auténtica, sólida y resiliente. # La influencia de las redes sociales y la cultura contemporánea en la percepción de lo ideal y lo real

>Fuente de la imagen Sumergidos, como estamos, en la era digital, la brecha que existe entre la vida idealizada y la vida real se ha amplificado de forma monumental por la omnipresencia de las redes sociales, puesto que en estas plataformas, las personas tienden a exhibir versiones editadas, magnificadas y selectivas de sus vidas, resaltando logros, experiencias felices y momentos gratificantes, a la vez que ocultan dificultades, obstaculos y contrariedades. Esta representación sesgada refuerza y mantiene ideales con frecuencia inalcanzables y fomenta presiones sociales para alinearse con ellas, emulándolas. Es entonces que el hedonista fenómeno de la \

en redes sociales intensifica sobremanera el sentimiento de insuficiencia y la exagerada tendencia a la comparación social (a medirse en función del supuesto éxito de otros), problemando aún más la aceptación de la realidad tal cual es, tal cual existe. 

Las comparaciones personales en este terreno, además de odiosas, tienden a ser sobredimensionadas y/o subdimensionadas, lo que obviamente degenera en discordancia entre la apreciación de la vida propia y la ajena. En respuesta a esto, expertos en salud mental sugieren procurar y mantener el uso consciente, analítico y crítico de dichas herramientas, para facilitar conexiones más genuinas y obtener así un mayor bienestar emocional a nivel personal.

# La reconcialiación o paridad entre ideal y realidad
Tan curioso como puede parecer, lo ideal y lo real, son elementos complementarios, que podrían verse como los dos extremos de una balanza. Si te inclinas demasiado por uno de los lados, entonces el desequilibrio genera caos en la vida personal, por lo que lo lógico es siempre buscar el justo punto medio.

Vale aclarar que aceptar el contraste entre la vida idealizada y la vida real es fundamental. Porque quienes se inclinan solo por lo que le parece mostrar la realidad, pueden carecer de imaginación, aspiraciones y motivación personal (lo que lleva a la mediocridad), pero quienes se orientan solo por lo que su ideal les dicta, pueden caer en la parálisis, la auto-exigencia excesiva y la depresión, y de nuevo, ello puede conducir a la mediocridad, junto a un estado de infelicidad total.

<div class=\

>Fuente de la imagen Aceptar el contraste entre ideal y realidad más bien atañe a algo más; implica saber de antemano que la perfección en sí misma no es un punto fijo e inmutable sino un horizonte o guía hacia el cual se encaminan todos los esfuerzos, aunque con pasos imperfectos. La reconciliación entre ideal y real se logra, entonces, por medio de la integración de la capacidad de soñar con la disposición real de aceptar las imperfecciones y limitaciones propias y del entorno. Es obvio y fundamental además, para que este enfoque sea efectivo y sincero, cultivar la capacidad de resiliencia y autocompasión (en el buen sentido) para hacer frente a las dificultades sin caer en el pesimismo y la desesperanza total. Y por supuesto, requiere además, de revisar, controlar y ajustar periódicamente los ideales personales para mantenerlos realistas, coherentes y motivadores en relación con los esfuerzos que se realizan para conseguirlos, buscando siempre que no se conviertan en fuentes de estrés desmedido. En mi opinión, finalmente, es esencial valorar (en su justa dimensión), la riqueza de la experiencia humana en toda su diversidad. Porque no solo los grandes éxitos son remarcables y relevantes, sino que también lo son las pequeñas victorias diarias, aunado a los momentos de aprendizaje. Esto es vital recordarlo siempre. ### En fin, ¿qué opinan ustedes sobre el tema tratado hoy? No olviden comentar... #### Hasta la próxima. ### Artículo escrito por José Quintana.

Triyuginarayan Temple has become one of the most popular destinations for pilgrims and tourists visiting Kedarnath in 2026. Located in the beautiful hills of Uttarakhand, this ancient temple is famous for its religious significance and peaceful surroundings.

### 1. Sacred Wedding Site of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati

According to Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati were married at Triyuginarayan Temple. This makes it a highly revered pilgrimage destination for devotees.

### 2. Eternal Sacred Fire

The temple is known for its eternal flame, called the Akhand Dhuni, which is believed to have been burning since the divine wedding ceremony. Visitors consider it a symbol of blessings and prosperity.

### 3. Perfect Addition to Kedarnath Yatra

Many travelers now include Triyuginarayan Temple in their Kedarnath itinerary because it is located near the Kedarnath route and offers a unique spiritual experience.

### 4. Beautiful Mountain Views

The temple is surrounded by stunning Himalayan landscapes, making it an attractive destination for nature lovers and photographers.

### 5. Convenient Group Travel

Families and groups from Gurgaon prefer traveling by Tempo Traveller, which provides a comfortable and economical way to visit Kedarnath and Triyuginarayan Temple together. Many travelers also compare the [tempo traveller rate per km in Gurgaon](https://www.tempotravellergurgaon.com/) before planning their journey to estimate their overall travel budget.

links.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=colinpowerman/elzhi95g

Where the sagebrush and salt-spray finally meet,
A line of six riders moves steady and slow,
Across sands where the tide used to ebb and to flow.

The sky is a canvas of brilliant, deep blue,
With clouds like white mountains, towering and true,
Stacked up in the heavens like pillows of fleece,
Presiding o'er a landscape of quiet and peace.

In the lead is a stallion of golden-tan hide,
With a rider in crimson, a guide for the ride;
His hat tilted forward, he scans the far shore,
As the rhythmic sea-breath begins its soft roar.

Behind him, the others in sequence appear,
In jackets of azure and ochre and gear,
Their horses—dark bays and chestnuts so bold—
Tread light through the pebbles and dust of the gold.

To the left rise the mountains, a jagged, red spine,
That traces the coast in a long, dusty line;
To the right is the ocean, a shimmering turquoise,
Distant and vast, drowning out human noise.

The waves roll in gently with crests of white foam,
Far from the ranch and the comforts of home,
While a sliver of moon hangs pale in the light,
Waiting for stars and the coming of night.

No words pass between them, just leather and hoof,
Underneath the sky's high, vaulted roof;
Between the high peaks and the white-watered sea,
They ride through the edge of the world, wild and free.

links.title: DOSE PUNISHMENT STOP CRIME
links.body:
Hello everyone your to my blog today 

Crime has grown to become a part of life. We all do bad things regardless of how much of a saint we think we are. Sometime we do these things intentionally and other times we do it intentionally but without a choice. Life can be hard, and as much as I don’t want to make an excuse for people who commit crimes, some people commit some crimes because they have no option. Imagine a mother stealing a loaf of bread to feed her hungry children. Punishment has been used for centuries as a means to control people and prevent illegal actions.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcjTW8UqURrgRXM3G9cqhQdabM5T7QLaffX79wRRyS7Ej/66699.png 




No matter how much we try to get rid of crime, it will still be in our societies and counties at large. Because we can’t all be saints. Someone will most definitely to something that one supposed to be done, and there’s nothing we can do about it. At the end of the day, just make sure to be in control of your mind, your thoughts and your actions because these are the things that drive us. Knowing who you are is the beginning of finding yourself. Don’t get caught up in the crime life because you’re confused and still finding yourself. Calm your nerves and walk the road because life is a journey of discovering….


 Every country has its own set of laws that impose penalties on criminals, such as imprisonment, fines, life sentences, or even execution, based on the severity of the crime.The main idea behind using punishment is to frighten people so they think twice before committing a crime. Despite this, crime continues to happen daily in many parts of the world. 

This raises the question: do punishment actually work.Despite knowing the consequences some people still break the law, Why? Because I think people sometimes do things because of how they feel at that moment, Human beings are emotional creatures, sometimes they allow anger takes over, sometimes greed takes over, sometimes desperation takes over, people convince themselves that they won't get caught when they are in the act of committing this crimes, or they convince themselves that it's only going to happen once.


However, despite the fact that many people are being punished for their actions, it's surprising to see that the crime rate kept increasing when it ought to reduce, and this leads to people questioning the effectiveness of punishment, wondering if it's effective or why it seems not to deter people from committing crime. Below I would state what I believe is the cause of these.the question now is that do punishments actually really work?

 I think they don't work in some cases, I think that they are not enough to stop people from committing crimes , the reason I say this is because a lot of people don't commit crimes partly because they know there are consequences attached to them, the existence of laws and punishments creates some level of order in society imagine a world where there were no consequences for wrongdoing,i honestly think things would be much worse than they already are.

I will not be one to judge others because if I’m to find myself in others shoes, I might do worse. And that makes me know that crime to some extent can never be understood. Some people don’t choose the crime life, they somehow find themselves roped up in that life thanks to the company they keep. And who’s to be blame for that? No one but themselves. It could be me and it also could be you. We know the price but we stop do it. This should tell us that it isn’t always about the act but the state of mind.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today

https://youtu.be/nJVJeFuG5GQ?si=_43XKskLDGwcFwQK


Holiness is one of the most precious qualities a believer can pursue. It is not measured by outward appearance, religious activities, or the praise of people. Genuine holiness comes from within—a heart that is fully surrendered to God and committed to living according to His will. It is a daily decision to honor God through obedience, faithfulness, and a desire to reflect His character.

The Scriptures remind us in 1 Peter 1:15–16, “Be ye holy; for I am holy.” This command reveals that holiness is not merely a suggestion but a calling for every child of God. The Lord desires His people to be set apart from the ways of the world and to live lives that glorify Him through their words, actions, and thoughts.

A holy life brings a sense of peace and confidence that comes from walking closely with God. While we may face weaknesses and make mistakes, God's mercy allows us to repent, grow, and continue our journey of faith. The pursuit of holiness helps us resist sin, develop godly character, and remain focused on what truly matters.

Furthermore, holiness has a powerful impact on those around us. When we live according to God's principles, we become examples of His love and grace. As Jesus taught in Matthew 5:16, our lives should shine in such a way that others see our good works and glorify our Heavenly Father. A holy life can encourage, strengthen, and inspire others to seek a deeper relationship with God.

As we continue our walk with the Lord, let our prayer be that He shapes us into people who honor Him in every area of life. Holiness is beautiful because it draws us nearer to God, transforms our hearts, and prepares us for eternity with Him. As Psalm 29:2 declares, we are to worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness. Rather than seeing holiness as a burden, we should embrace it as a privilege and a blessing that brings glory to God and joy to our souls.

**Thanks for reading.**

links.title: Chlupáč's Museum of Earth History / Chlupáčovo muzeum historie Země
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmadZB3AQRuvyLRALCgK6MZHQEZgw2FkMRRbt5LJ51JPWi/20260613_191048.jpg)
Last Saturday, Prague hosted its annual event—Museum Night. This was the nineteenth edition. My family and I decided to visit the museum mentioned in the title of this article. The museum is located on the campus of the Faculty of Science. It was established in 2008 and named after a prominent Czech geologist and educator who died in 2002. However, the fossil collection has been growing at the Faculty of Science since the 19th century.
>Minulou sobotu se v Praze konala každoroční akce - Muzejní noc. Už podevatenácté. Rozhodl jsem se s rodinou navštívit muzeum, které je v názvu tohoto článku. Muzeum se nachází v areálu přírodovědecké fakulty. Bylo zřízeno v roce 2008 a pojmenováno po význačném českém geologovi a pedagogovi, který zemřel v roce 2002. Ale sbírka fosílií vznikala při přírodovědecké fakultě už od 19.století.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZN5aMb4FRDB1zjKG71MkkTmDRkYRp7NQ8TKNmossNuy/20260613_191155.jpg)
Profesor Ivo Chlupáč, 1931 - 2002 on a stamp.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYmKBtCJ1Ks8GgkMUxgxXgi2Ybsibs4Xia8Dup76tUqaU/20260613_190855.jpg)
The museum is relatively small. The collection was originally assembled for the educational needs of the faculty’s students, not for the general public. The most popular exhibit among visitors is this Karnosaurus.
>Muzeum je poměrně malé. Sbírka byla původně sestavena pro výukové účely studentů fakulty, nikoli pro širokou veřejnost. Nejoblíbenějším exponátem mezi návštěvníky je tento karnosaurus.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeDTp1TrKSXgSe1ScW5ffty7mUBVfWbfKcz67HU5HWx8W/20260613_190945.jpg)
It isn't explicitly stated anywhere—or perhaps I just couldn't find the information—but I assume that the items on display are merely casts of the originals.

>Nikde to není výslovně uvedeno – nebo jsem tu informaci možná jen nenašel –, ale předpokládám, že vystavené předměty jsou pouze odlitky originálů.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUiBnUMFBSDL5FRDg4EPeiU1ivLtGFVqmdeeAnedi4Vqa/20260613_190953.jpg)
Of course, everyone here would agree that it’s a good thing this creature isn’t living in our time.
>Asi se všichni shodneme, že je dobře, že tenhle tvor není naším současníkem.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfUYEvnUhJCniAWCenS9jVFnNaNJCjoiPohv4bMeXcxtR/20260613_191117.jpg)
Or is it actually different? A saddle is attached to the exhibit.
>Nebo je všechno jinak? K exponátu je připevněno jezdecké sedlo ...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQDAEEfgLP3BfGVuAUqe164LW7iTGEMwPS2vSeZYXtWTo/20260613_191555.jpg)
I remember a time when people used to place a matchbox next to the subject being photographed to give a sense of its size. Or they would stand next to it. That’s probably the case here, too. But I have no doubt that there are people who believe that prehistoric dinosaurs lived at the same time as humans.

This photo gives you an idea of the museum's size. It isn't much bigger than what you see here.
>Vzpomínám si na doby, kdy fotografové kladli vedle fotografovaného objektu krabičku od sirek, aby se dala odhadnout jeho velikost. Nebo k velkému předmětu někoho  postavili. To je pravděpodobně i tento případ. Ale nepochybuji o tom, že se najdou lidé, kteří věří, že prehistoričtí dinosauři žili ve stejné době jako lidé.

>Podle této fotografie si můžete udělat představu o velikosti muzea. Není o moc větší, než co tu vidíte.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQVGuG1SrNpuc8NDv1X7WGk7f15fGtLzSjNph4ed8RD3/20260613_191747.jpg)
The person who put the exhibition together was brimming with ideas. Here’s a comparison of a stegosaurus and an M1 Abrams tank. It’s just a model, of course.
>Ten, kdo výstavu připravoval, sršel nápady. Tady je srovnání stegosaura s tankem M1 Abrams. Je to jen model, samozřejmě. Někdy moc kreativity škodí ...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWqC5kC1Ze9K6NwKhYmTN2X3eTGWvpA7rsp5xAzPkKkTj/20260613_191251.jpg)
What can you find here? Lots of bones, of course. And lots of descriptions. Some of the bones are quite small.
>Co tu všechno najdete? Samozřejmě spoustu kostí. A spoustu popisků. Některé kosti jsou celkem malé.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNopFZzb13Fd5tqKuGtCJCg44DkPQpbtnzJKNiDzEDb6G/20260613_190909.jpg)
Some bones are larger.
>Některé kosti jsou větší.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQLehKNCYZ5gDJBRcZhcimFku7i9U1fyFLZkT5WpjcNng/20260613_190915.jpg)
Some of the bones have been arranged to resemble animals. Even I can recognize a pterodactyl, though I’m no naturalist.
>Některé kosti jsou sestaveny do podoby zvířat. Pterodaktyla poznám i já, ač nejsem přírodozpytec.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaizqRF9h6texxrF2Vx5RNNaeVb5AGrXAs2YYDjdLjdYE/20260613_191134.jpg)
There are very small models of some animals here.
>Jsou tu velmi zmenšené modely některých zvířat.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwdrtyJQbJ2agH7gxbXxQKFJmKbHcKsn25b2QsumDdzs/20260613_190927.jpg)
Some models may even be built to a 1:1 scale, since their prototypes were quite small.
>Některé modely mohou být i v měřítku 1:1, protože jejich předlohy byly celkem malé.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUV3mh1Q6LXchWWqABVmpqzikWVxnzkRQU9fcQnHeYugi/20260613_191212.jpg)
And, of course, the imprints of plants and animals in the rock.
>A samozřejmě otisky rostlin a živočichů v hornině.

I definitely don’t regret coming here. As you can see, the museum isn’t crowded. More well-known and popular museums were certainly dealing with larger crowds that day. But next year, during the next Museum Night, I’ll choose a different museum to visit.

>Rozhodně nelituji, že jsem tu byl. Vidíte, že muzeum není přeplněno lidmi. Známější a atraktivnější muzea se ten den určitě potýkala s větší návštěvností. Ale za rok, o příští muzejní noci, si vyberu k návštěvě jiné muzeum.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVSuUCvGmeVzxmS9xUsKmxezXfkVCFRx3mURkPiLJDHc9/image.png)

title.title: Are We Experiencing Reality or Our Interpretation of It?
title.body:
Strange, isn't it?

Maybe it's both.

Often times we assume our immediate experience is the reality that matters most. We also end up believing it strongly enough that it turns our intellection into... subtle arrogance. Not necessarily a bad thing, for it's just part of the process of reflection and illuminating our selves. Creating actions that will thus form stronger bonds towards BEing our authentic selves, but only through disciplined perseverance past the difficult art of commencing.

I have oftentimes observed man of all taste and lifestyle and a certain pattern emerges amongst all who are subject to being changed in some way. Whether that be through his own intellectual discovery, an outside influence such as a loved one questioning their claims of reality, events that forces change through tough times, a man beliefs of what he interprets as reality becomes tested and put on trial by the universe itself. This trial breaks his self perceived character he has so long built up. For some it is harsh and for others, no so much. 

> \

- Another We.


![1000029862.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhshrooms/242hNG8TMDpPd3SbE6Hi3BSHeXQUBJfnowDh84MiHYddWsVcgRMDVKDtNUweM7tTYhe8z.png)


You may call it God, the higher self, the universe, gia, nature, etc, it doesn't matter. What matters is that our actions are met with some judge that will question our very reality whether we are ready for it or not, and whether we can perceive it or not. 

When I said our character will be broken, I put a the question into yourself that probably instilled some fear, but I promise I do not mean it in any way for it to mean a bad thing. Our obsession with attachments to identity is what is being dissolved here. That said, I say, our characteristics, our personalities and our egos are only layers stacked over who we truly are. This ot is why I said, man can become subtlety arrogant because it is this attachment to what we believe reality to be.

But what is reality and are we actually capable to perceive it?

This comes with no easy answer to say but personally believe it is a strong no. Physically, Man is limited to his understanding of all that he can perceive and the amount Man is able to perceive is limited in itself. 

I cannot say much on the spirit, for the spirit is not limited to perception unlike the physical form, but within our physical, we can still perceive the spiritual self and the spiritual self communicates to us in many ways as well. Whether that be in dreams, real life experiences that trigger deep emotions or lack thereof where it deems it necessary, such as the rare moments of quietness and stillness we feel inside of a dramatic and traumatic dream filled with heavy symbolic imagery and fascinating marvels. 

Though, as I have observed, not many of our kind has awareness that this is even happening or that our spiritual gift is connected to the dream state, the state of being while we are awake and with our personal experiences. Many, as I have seen upon further questioning them, believe that going to temples, churches and mosques is that connection but it is not. It is an illusion. The temples, churches and mosques, that is. 

It is something within the actions of following a routine tuned into revelation of oneself such as meditation, song and prayer or even a combination of the three at once, that is connected to the spiritual being living inside us, waiting to be heard and understood with unfathomable patience towards our own development.

But Man is a fool. His attachment to labels, names, character, personality, etcétera, as I have said before, makes him subtly arrogant. Not in the way as to call him or her arrogant, but what I am merely trying to describe here is that, every attachment to identity carries a corresponding attachment to a model of reality. It is an interpretation of the self that, inevitably and also forthrightly become face to face with change. A change that can either break or make him. 

The intensity of such a change is a variable based on their own personal experiences, attachments, and willingness to change with what is necessary. It the result of what happens when Man becomes so tied to his own interpretation of reality that he forgets and fails to realize that it is just an interpretation of reality. In other words the universe's \

is so disruptive that it isn't merely challenging an idea, but challenging the identity that has fused with that idea.

The next step is inevitable. Man, now forced to see past his illusion, sees a path he must take and he may or may not know what to do, but most likely, is already doing what must be done subconsciously. He is taking actions that may seem small and insignificant and may make his life even more difficult, but it is necessary. It is as necessary as feeling a burn before healing, as necessary as feeling the drowning before taking in air for the first time. It is a cold reminder that healing is not always what we think it healing will feel like.

He may not understand why he has made the choices, but the choices have already been made. And, if he is unwavering and accepting of his unconscious decisions, over his spiritually guided subconscious choices, and sticks to them, he will see his self emerge from the depths of his own hell like a balloon held down and trapped in mud. Once man has removed the mud through perseverance, disciplined actions, will his spirit rise like helium filled balloon rises up naturally inclined to rise above the filth.

## Support The Work

If you found value in this article and would like to support my work, consider leaving a donation.

Everything I write is built upon years of self-education, reading, research, observation, contemplation, and lived experience. None of this was handed to me in a classroom. It has been a lifelong pursuit of understanding, refining ideas, and finding the words to express them in ways that are readable for the common layman and invite others to think more deeply.

Your support helps me continue dedicating time to writing, studying, and sharing these explorations with everyone.

Thank you for reading.

Lo cuentas con mucha serenidad, y eso ya es media batalla: **escuchar el cuerpo sin dramatizarlo, pero sin hacerse el héroe**. Esa idea de seguir subiendo la montaña quizá más despacio, pero seguir, está muy bien plantada.

En la imagen se aprecia una comparación entre ambas rodillas, y la izquierda **parece mostrar algo de cambio leve en la zona frontal** respecto a la otra, aunque una foto por sí sola no sentencia nada. Con molestias intermitentes al caminar, estirar el brazo y esa sensación rara de “fuga de fuerza”, haces bien en esperar los análisis y no improvisar conclusiones con palabras pesadas como sarcopenia o artritis reumatoide antes de tiempo; esas cosas requieren evaluación clínica seria, no imaginación con wifi.

Sobre los **10K pasos**, mi toma es simple: **el objetivo no debería mandar sobre la rodilla**. En artrosis o dolor de rodilla, caminar suele ayudar si la molestia es leve, pero cuando protesta más de la cuenta conviene ajustar carga, ritmo o incluso alternar con opciones menos agresivas como bici estática o natación, como resume [Bellvitge](https://bellvitgehospital.cat/es/aula-de-salud/artrosis-de-rodilla-comprender-el-dolor-y-como-gestionarlo). Y cuando aparecen dudas de componente reumatológico o neuromuscular, la mezcla de dolor, debilidad y compensaciones al caminar merece atención más fina, no terquedad épica, como explica este material de [AAOT](https://raaot.org.ar/index.php/AAOTMAG/article/download/1116/3882?inline=1).

En comunidad, el tema de **seguir en movimiento sin negar el desgaste** aparece bastante en posts de salud y bienestar, aunque pocas veces con esta honestidad tranquila. Tu texto no va por el cliché de “todo bien”; va por algo mejor: **aceptar el límite sin rendirse del todo**. Eso pega.

title.title: How Structured Seasonal Camp Programs Help Children Grow Beyond the Classroom
title.body:
You may find that certain Holiday related activities will enhance growth and help children develop socially both economically \[Find out more] On the other hand, if you are thinking about structured activities for children that offer an excellent chance of experiential learning- Overnight March Break Camps in Mississauga is a good option. Young participants learn new skills and interests, meet lifelong friends and acquire some independence away from daily routines. They provide a unique combination of athletic contests, creative workshops and life skills training in immersive environments.

With so many different kinds of programs out there, how do you know what it will take for your seasonal program to make a difference? Families should choose comprehensive curriculums that push kids to grow both physically and intellectually. High quality camp experiences emphasise character building, team participation and resilience which enables them to go home confident and with better social skills.

**Operational Frameworks for Immersive Camp Programs**

Safety, supervision and training for staff is literally the absolute backbone of any quality youth holiday organization. Parents can totally relax because Overnight March Break Camps in Mississauga or neighbouring regional facilities have all credentials checked and safety protocols vetted. Competent suppliers’ history tiny staff-to-camper ratios, which contain noticed attention and the thorough observations along all of the prepared regular activities. This supportive system builds a space in which children feel safe to go outside of their comfort zones.

![](https://whimuc.com/BQFw2ppo572trRRAxKGkg8/CZ8C4XPx8c1km3.jpeg)

And of course, safety, but even on top of that the range of tracks available allows the kids to tailor experience over the break based on special personal interests. Such programs may vary from advanced athletic training, outdoor wilderness adventure camps, in-depth sciences to exposure in the digital arts. Providing different pathways helps sustain engagement and avoid the inevitable slide into stagnation that comes with concern over lengthy periods out of school.

Physical movement is the second pillar of health and wellness which should be included in daily activities as a habit by modern youth programs. Structured team sports, swimming, and other kinds of cooperative group games helps reverse this sedentary lifestyle that increased screen time seems to promote. It has been shown that exercise is naturally a way to relieve stress, improve sleep quality and teach children sportsmanship and how to work together in a healthy manner.

Businesses like [Overnight March Break Camps in Mississauga](https://www.stjudesacademy.com/athletics-programs-mississauga/sja-march-break-camps-mississauga/) do not only assist families with finding the perfect camp for their child, but also help them organize every detail of their logistics. Preparing early allows parents to register their children in advance and helps with the mental preparation for communal living. If you know what to pack and how your child is expected to behave, then there will be minimal day-of-check-in anxiety that comes from the unexpected.

The social payback from your specialized holiday programs that outlast the final afternoon pickup session. Through immersive group dynamics, children learn to solve conflicts on their own, effectively communicate ideas, and collaborate with peers from different backgrounds. These important soft skills lay the foundation for future academic environments and collaborative real-world settings.

Moreover, these programs promote self-sufficiency where campers are responsible for their own stuff and follow a daily schedule outside the home. The adaptive skills of executive functioning are further enhanced by the new routine and tendencies to create proper autonomy. They also escort these transitions deliberately, turning mundane acts of everyday life into deeper lessons on accountability and self-care.

**Conclusion**

Creating structured seasonal experiences is a great way to utilise school holidays and help foster powerful personal development. Providing them with a firm adherence to safety, some recreational balance and alternative education routes will make all the difference in providing families an experience that will last a lifetime. Time spent investigating regional youth programs helps parents choose a program that fits their family values and development aspirations.

title.title: Western Video 6 (Riders of the Painted Range)
title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=colinpowerman/w7wp9udh


The sky hangs like a canvas, broad and impossibly blue,
Where towering clouds of ivory rise, fresh with morning dew.
They drift like silent ships of steam across a mountain crest,
Whose jagged, distant shadows guard the secrets of the West.
Beneath this grand theater, where the earth and heaven meet,
 untamed and bittersweet.

A sea of amber prairie grass moves softly in the gale,
A golden floor that stretches wide beyond the dusty trail.
And scattered through the waving stalks, a sudden, bright design—
Wildflowers bloom in scattered bursts along the valley line.
Bright crimson cups and golden heads, with flecks of pink and white,
They paint the rugged desert floor with pockets of delight.

Across this field of quiet grace, five steady riders stand,
A brotherhood of leather, iron, and the open land.
Perched high upon their patient steeds, they form a rugged line,
Silhouetted sharp against the clouds, a classic, bold design.
One sits upon a snow-white horse, a beacon in the herd,
While others ride on deepest bay, without a spoken word.

With wide-brimmed hats and steady hands, they watch the valley floor,
Inheritors of frontier paths and generations' lore.
A few lone horses wander free across the golden space,
While distant cattle graze at peace within this quiet place.
The air is thick with freedom, and the horizon stretches long,
Where every hill and open plain hums an old cowboy song.

This is the spirit captured here, where time itself slows down,
Far from the iron, bustling streets of any modern town.
A painted dream of old frontiers, of wind and prairie grass,
Held frozen in a beautiful frame, as shifting seasons pass.

title.body:
Blog de aljif7
@aljif7
PLATAFORMA: Hive
FECHA: Martes 16 de junio de 2026.
Área: Blogging


Cuando el tiempo nos alcanza hasta el interior, cuando nos dice que ya va siendo hora de empezar a descender. Te das cuenta que la montaña se vuelve más hermosa. 
Hoy finalmente me rendí ante los pequeños malestares que he venido acumulando de la rodilla izquierda que desde marzo ha estado protestando. Molestias que van y vienen. Que de repente me permiten seguir el día a día normal. Pero luego ahí está otra vez tocando paredes... más allá de sus dominios. 
Al parecer se le ha dado la gana de empezar e molestar hasta mi brazo izquierdo. Son malestares pequeños, casi imperceptibles excepto por los momentos en que quiero estirar el brazo repentinamente para tomar algo... Y ahí está un dolor que no alcanza a ser dolor, sino una especie de aviso de que las fuerzas se están escapando. Como si una astilla larga e imperceptible de la rodilla estuviera provocando una fuga de energía en el algún lugar del lado izquierdo. 🙂

![Screenshot 2026 06 16 at 2.49.15 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmejJmnFSsJe1tagdgeQ3XjJjEoU5Rz13ueuvg2pDaEayd/Screenshot%202026-06-16%20at%202.49.15%E2%80%AFPM.png)
(2024, sin señales de molestia alguna)

![IMG 7915](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVDVki49xN3FtoKFvFXgM6oYZwWjUJziqeDUeBK7iWPBY/IMG_7915.jpeg)
(2026, silencioso inicio)

Pues, queda conservar la calma y buscar las estrategias más adecuadas para conservar el paso en la montaña de la vida, si acaso habrá que ir más despacio... pero mis 10K pasos diarios aún siguen siendo un objetivo. 

Mientras tanto a esperar la próxima consulta con resultados de análisis. Y aprendiendo nuevas palabras que antes ni imaginaba: sarcopenia, artritis reumatoide, conexión neuromuscular...
Quizás como en las películas que se tienen  que deshacer de la carga para que el barco no se hunda (o el avión no se caiga) habrá que aligerar la mochila de la vida :))

¡Bendecidos días, tardes, noches, según de dónde lean!

title.body:
Hi, guys!

Today I have a huge backlog of videos to shoot again, and I really don't have the energy for anything. I need to finish reading books, filming, get everything done, and I'm just not in the mood. And yet, I have to keep moving forward, because otherwise everything will just fall apart. So now I'll finish my coffee and go to work. One way or another, I need to finish all my current projects and check them off by the end of the week.

I've accumulated a huge backlog of unshot material, and I hate it when that happens. But it's happened again, and now I need to fix it all. So today I want to try to finish all the commercials, unboxings of things I've been unpacking for a long time, and get down to book reviews that I'm really due to publish. There are quite a few of those, too.

My blog has been on hiatus for four days now. I want to keep it up tomorrow and get back to posting on Thursday. I don't know if this break has yielded any results, but I really hope it has. I'll find out on Thursday. If not, I'll have to switch back to advertising and think about what else I can do. But I'd like to see some organic views start coming in.

So, I'm working on filming again today and tomorrow, and then we'll see when I can afford to take a break. It's unlikely to happen anytime soon, so I'll have to be patient.

Have a great day, everyone!

title.title: Western Video 5 (The Valley of the Golden Sun)
title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=colinpowerman/knv717lu

A tapestry of canvas wakes to greet the morning sky,
Where painted mountains rise to meet the clouds that drift on high.
Like monuments of indigo, they guard the sweeping plain,
A sanctuary far removed from heavy city rain.

A timeless hymn of wilderness, of peace and liberty.

Down from the rugged, distant peaks, a ribbons’ path is spun,
A winding river, bright and blue, that dances in the sun.
It cuts a line of liquid glass across the golden mead,
Where gentle currents softly flow and secret waters lead.
Along its banks, the smooth, gray stones sit silent in the stream,
As cool and clear as memories within a passing dream.

Upon the left, a burst of life erupts from fertile ground,
A symphony of petaled joy where brightest hues abound.
Crimson cups and ivory stars, and violet-shaded bells,
A festival of summer growth that naturally swells.
They lean toward the water’s edge to catch the passing breeze,
Beneath the tall and watchful guard of deep green poplar trees.

Across the stream, the valley rolls in waves of amber light,
Where golden grasses gently sway before the coming night.
A cowboy sits upon his steed, a figure calm and still,
Surveying all the quiet space from hill to distant hill.
Beside him stands a riderless horse, a partner on the track,
With leather saddle waiting for the journey to head back.

In distant fields, the cattle graze, like dots upon the plain,
Content within the open air, untamed by bit or chain.
The sky is wide, the air is clean, the colors bold and bright,
A stylized world of painted brush, of shadow and of light.
For here within this peaceful place, the restless spirit heals,
Capturing the quiet grace the open country feels.

title.title: My 100-Day Hive Challenge: Stepping Up My Game and Growing with the Community  🚀🔥
title.body:
Hey Ecency and Hive family 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT3BFsvBPc5wVC32vG3ti8tp2PQdXjSM1Kz1mXBNMCujm/1781592661564.png)

We all look for spaces where our voices are heard  our creativity is valued, and our efforts are genuinely appreciated. For me, that space is Hive. Recently  something amazing happened that completely shifted my perspective and boosted my confidence I was selected as one of the winners in the Ecency Weekly Engagement Leaderboard Challenge! Seeing my name up there next to so many dedicated creators made me realize the true power of this decentralized community. It’s not just about posting and leaving; it's about connecting, sharing vibes  and lifting each other up.

This win made me think: Why stop here Why not push my limits and see what I can truly achieve if I give my 100% to this platform 

So, today, I am officially launching my 100-Day Hive Challenge! This isn't just a challenge to post more; it is a personal commitment to self-discipline, massive networking, and becoming a deeply rooted member of this ecosystem.



🎯 My Core Goals for the Next 100 Days:

To keep myself accountable, I have set three clear rules for myself during this journey:

1. Quality Over Quantity: I will focus on sharing well-thought-out, meaningful  and engaging content. Whether it is photography, deep personal reflections, tech  or creative arts I want my blog to bring real value to your feed 

2. Massive Daily Engagement: Winning the leaderboard proved to me that engagement is the heartbeat of Hive. For the next 100 days I will actively discover at least 5 to 10 new creators every day, read their blogs, and leave genuine, detailed comments to build real friendships 

3. Building Hive Power (HP): I believe in the long-term future of this platform. Instead of focusing on quick cash-outs  I will dedicate my earnings to powering up my account. Building my Hive Power means growing my influence so that I can reward other amazing creators in the future 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRn9PXkDSUEJomxBzM95ynuzZhUbyzzS4ws7R33M3f5cj/1781593137423.jpg)


🤝 Let’s Connect: I Need Your Support!

No one can survive or grow alone in a web3 space  The beauty of Hive is that your growth is tied to the community's growth. I am highly motivated  but I know I will need guidance, tips, and constructive feedback from all the experienced authors  curators, and whales out there 

If you are reading this, please drop a comment below! Tell me what kind of content you love to read  or share one piece of advice that helped you when you were starting out. I promise to visit your blog and connect with you 

If you want to join me in this challenge or do it alongside me  let’s team up and grow together 

Thank you so much to the @ecency team and everyone who has supported my journey so far  Day 1 starts right now, and I am ready to give it everything I’ve got 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQaXk3vrpUwJpFyQhHShSPbD9QtooWPDFz99oKNaSYaP/1781593153461.png)

Let's make these 100 days unforgettable. Hive on  🚀🌐


NOTE 


 I want to be completely honest and transparent with my community. The thoughts, the goals  and the core message of this challenge are 100% mine, written from my heart. However since I am still improving my language skills  I took a little bit of assistance to fine-tune the grammar so that it is easily readable and clear for everyone here. Also, the cover image has been generated using AI prompts after hours of hard work and multiple attempts to match the vibe of this post. A lot of time, dedication  and effort went into creating this post and the art. Thank you for your understanding and support  ❤️

title.title: Taxi Simulator - DON'T EVER BUY THIS GAME!
title.body:
![featured image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23w2gjp8wd5XYUEon2K49p8e1BUi1KL2uvorn6FLKf4MTH3atAQUoZ8HQeGbnJM2UW4xh.png)

![gabriela travels divider gaming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/Eo8L1q1q6J3nWWpu8NRh7jbJkzcHsrSTzBzVoM4DUXdS2497yfcDaSySrzHN2sFApL2.png)

I usually start this kind of post with an introduction, but this time I'll do things differently. Before getting into my actual review, I strongly recommend spending just 1 minute and 17 seconds watching the trailer below.

Why am I placing it at the beginning instead of the end, as I normally do? Because after waiting seven years since the game's original presentation/trailer, it seems the developers are now making an effort to remove as much evidence as possible of what the game was originally presented as. So I definitely believe it's important to see those expectations before reading the rest of my review, for as long as they last.

https://youtu.be/G8H-nPalm0Q?si=XTS_Gw_CRI20atEJ

Finished watching it? Good. I hope it's still available by the time you're reading this.

As I mentioned earlier, this won't be one of my usual game reviews where I go through the pros and cons and discuss whether it's worth playing because in my honest opinion, this release has nothing to do with the original game presented and it is difficult to point out any real pros. Even if I would have been blind of the last few years and only discover this game now.

To start from the beginning, I'll leave below a screenshot of the email I received last night.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23x16vvinroSQscPULxoDFjNT6HSvhHt1sVH13z6MxtipwEewNgYq4eodwuk7wkWTrupT.png)</center>

I usually don't read my emails when it comes to Steam notifications because I have a little over 200 games on my wishlist, and I am used to seeing emails related to having some of them on sale, in most cases, not being able to afford getting them anyway. 

But last night it was different because the part with having a demo from my Steam Wishlist available to play, made me jump off my bed, turn on the computer and let the game download so I can try it out in the morning, expecting to spend lots of time playing the demo and having fun, a thing that I wasn't able to do since it was quite late at night when I got the email notification.

Do I feel bad for not playing it last night? Absolutely not. It would turn into a waste of time, a change in my sleeping schedule which I have respected for over 3 years now, as well as possibly having sleep troubles due to becoming pissed off pretty quickly.

Why am I saying that? Because the developers literally peed on everyone who had their game on the wishlist, which was initially presented as you already saw in the video from above, almost 7 years ago. And yes, I was one of the people they peed on, believing in their game and that the long wait is so much worth it, already saving for having enough money to purchase it, even if it would cost as an AAA title, which is around 60-70 EUR usually. But a thing that I forgot about, is that this game was never going to be GTA or any big title that is actually worth the wait and money, but rather a lie developed by some random guys no one ever heard about.

And I am not the only one, there are people from that time already starting community discussions on the game's forum.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23t72fR3oSHqPAvBZas13mGP1jD8ydWFa1gTphiiMD1SCXYywoKDByuFDjg5FFYvksq5n.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uEwyof81wM35RaRMAw23Zth2a66sd5uNVsdynkbTHSf4XYgGbNmvE6NFzGYuP9A11AS.png)

Wondering what the developers had to say? Have fun reading.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/48FEAfiqxFkywMLd2RN7wK4jG4rVdY2X3DfPp4R5mDjqrm9pWLhtH3AiDERh6Ycw5j.png)

To me, this already gives the impression that the developers are trying to distance themselves from the opinions of the people who have had this game on their wishlists for the past seven years. The ironic part is that they continue to ask for feedback.

My concern is that the attention will go mainly toward positive comments or feedback from players who have only just discovered the game in its current state, rather than from those who followed the project from the beginning and remember what was originally promised. What a joke!

![20260616073311_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23u62jhZnEiZrNU4MaTWAhFayWuffQLW3cJaEigEW8AjptgXuY3kFi7Sy5odsyzcPHJyV.png)

Oh, and speaking about the feedback/report section, keep in mind that there is no proper thing for that. They basically ask for bug reports, but you are not able to submit one because whenever you try to make a ticket with that purpose, the game freezes and you will need to force restart it from the task manager. 

Don't get me wrong, it's not my first time playing a DEMO for a game. Hence, I know that miracles don't happen. It's true that this kind of demo versions are usually full of bugs and are meant to get free help from people interested in playing the game on what things need to be fixed or improved, instead of paying a whole team to spend time looking for these bugs and reporting them further.

What is not fine here is presenting a game back in 2019 and then returning with a demo on the same game, which has nothing to do with the first version announced, other than the title, which remained the same. And the first red flag on that is that developers tried to delete all their traces of what they promised to deliver, changing the whole appearance of the game on the Steam Market and replacing the original images and gameplay with what you get to play today, being a whole different game.

They also tried to fool us one more time, having a red message displayed for the first time when you start the game, that this is still in development and that the graphics are not done yet. LOL! If it is so, then why don't leave the original game announced, promising to aim for those graphics? It just makes no sense.

![20260616073110_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23wzzvNWzVYPeesqgetTCdUm6Nqo9bRFLabxqvyunyX7zguLvnSD71MViTdAeLB2MWR7L.png)

I am not even sure if I should spend any more of my precious time showing all the things wrong with this game, since it's already crystal clear it has nothing to do with the original game the devs promised, but since I am assuming not a lot of people heard of this game before, unless you are a real fan of Simulators and especially Taxi Simulators I will keep writing a bit more, with the hope that you won't fall for purchasing this when it's being released.

The first image from the top shows how the POV when driving the taxi should be, with a rebel taxi driver who listens to music, has fun while being at work, sometimes even having a drink even if it's not recommended, but hey! That was supposed to be the whole fun around this game, keeping away the classic things you usually see in Taxi Simulators.

The reality? Check the 2nd picture. A very boring landscape, where you don't even have hands, lol! Nevertheless, when it rains, you are not able to wipe the windshield because there is no button command for that... and for many more things that should never be missing in simulator games.

Funny thing is that there is no bug with this since some of these buttons are set if you are playing via keyboard, but are completely missing on the controller. And don't worry, even if you have them on your keyboard, it doesn't necessarily mean you can use them when not being able to press them on your controller, because in most cases, random buttons stop working during gameplay, not doing anything whether you press them from your controller or the equivalent from the keyboard.

![20260616074036_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23tbLvXjYU2A63Df2irJR48ZHRJPJMH1mJCVQdosR2hmByp8D9FTg4xF4UxYEUozwtqVg.png)

For example, you were supposed to be able to call Kate during your rides when you get a strange passenger in the back seat, who might speak something of interest to the police. But the surprise comes when you are not able to use your phone while driving, nor call the Police or Kate. 

These actions, however, are available when sitting still and not having a passenger.

![20260616074239_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23yd5nTfCyP6YvxXiwqCgzBWC8T1eYQSZAGhkPW5CZ6kh4QY3574QX9CcQyh61ZCbjo6z.png)

At first, I thought I was doing something wrong because I could call both the police and Kate before picking up a new client, thinking that this is how it should work. To have a call still going on way before having a client enter the car. But nope, it turns out that even if you call any of Kate or the police, they will answer, but without speaking and then, one or two seconds later, they will close the call. 

Even if you try to call them moments before reaching the next client, the call will still be turned off automatically by the game. So there is no chance to have them listen to your ride with a strange passenger, as they asked at the beginning of the game.

![20260616074149_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/241tT77wQe9tXJosdfrcsjJeoPwGQVTcVdAK8Sk1rBxR7RvK8KZGe7ASU8L5xM7ANvzsb.png)

And speaking of passengers, I think you already have an idea of what the game promised to be looking if you checked the video attached at the beginning of this post.

Strange situations like people having sex on the backseat of the car, driving drunk people at home, assisting a lady in giving birth during your ride, checking if any client forgot their house keys or money on the backseat, are just some of the situations they promised to deliver with their game.

The reality? You can see in the picture where my logo is attached. A blank backseat which you only get to see when the passanger/s enter or exit your car. Because there is no way to get a view of that during a ride or check on your client manually while driving or looking in the rearview mirror.

And speaking about passengers, do note that it doesn't matter whether you have a ride with a single passenger or more, the game will still display a single person entering or exiting your car. LOL!

![20260616074045_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23tGa1WGsjtrJVg6VgVXGyNVKxJqVMsVNHMYAeCkZwTDBnqcjXDSYueKEtPPWj4he1q7A.png)

![20260616074705_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23wgMWgfH356v2TfGfrW7Je3GNPLVAV7ybhPzCLB4fnnePzua4ScTrxWRx56uvchwZ8pb.png)

![20260616075610_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uFMgDR7F1e7RWnzDJNMujuB4z2UZhtBg1Aq9wmhzCciFe2wEhkD3MPHE8GfQeb5mQXA.png)

Cool NPCs? You can already forget about that. 

Nevertheless, it was supposed to be a very interactive game where people randomly ask for a taxi ride while passing by, some other people speaking with you while waiting for the green light at the traffic lights, or other things. 

Instead, expect lots of cars randomly accelerating and breaking in front of you, hitting you, passing over people on the sidewalk with no consequences, as well as traffic jams with no proper reason for doing so.

This is actually a thing that I kind of expected since more and more games are using Artificial Intelligence to set up their NPCs in video games, but this game feels like it was never checked by the developer team before launching the demo. I do agree that it's cool to release a demo so fans can dig deeper and find possible bugs, but when you release a game that is full of bugs from the first 2 minutes of gameplay, it's crystal clear that no one really checked this.

![20260616073152_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23tbF5jen1n7H1kunA8TyQbjvY7nBuRchq9j3b3rBDsmBW8JDbeiN5YkHLDNgEtdZASxN.png)

The audio setting is another joke of the game. From the images on the right, which are shown from games that have nothing to do with Taxi Simulator, to the settings that are not working, it's just the beginning of another round of anger on this game.

For example, images from the right are usually displayed on the video/graphics settings, where people should be able to see the difference between setting higher and lower quality on the game's graphics or if they turn on/off some other settings. So they were NOT supposed to be part of the audio settings from the start.

Secondly, what's the purpose of showing images from other games? It just makes no sense.

Thirdly, the bar where you are supposed to set Master/Voices/Sound Effects or Music is useless. The single thing working on this section is setting your Audio Output, but all the other things, even if you set the music volume at 50%, for example, as soon as you \

the new settings, it will go back to 100. They are literally set to be fixed on 100 without actually allowing you to customise your audio experience while playing the game.

![20260616074851_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23wX1BDF6KSJvdzeVikxVaQ3vAk4xX2qgjH8oFSBfXZVk4PqBHKGkeQZmVHSf16zw2CeF.png)

Next up, the damage you get to your car is literally another joke. You get hit in the front or back of your car, and nothing happens on these sides, but you see a window crack on the sides, haha. Should I repeat again that this has nothing to do with what they showed in their trailer? I think you already figured that out by this point.

Oh, and I almost forgot about my level/reputation on this game. On the top left of the image, you can see that I was already level 22. That happened in JUST 40 MINUTES of gameplay!! So after a full day of playing this game, I would have, like, what? Level 1000?

![20260616080140_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23vsQXwVG8woLgeLwZXzfNYyq4DjeTZ2ekwNM6qonCj3D9GWZt73ECG4pWPeZ5XotFwm9.png)

Another thing that is really funny is how they decided to create the characters where no face matches the voice or personality they used for the characters, having them constantly look at different sides than the camera. Plus, the way you look in the 'so called cinematics' doesn't match how you look while you're driving, neither have your mouth move while speaking with the passengers or on the phone in the car. 

So... two separate characters for the same character for a separate game than the original one... that is wild!

![20260616080214_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23tH5PR87zaC55FTsH48xKMyBfgFVc1rybKm615EXTMsPHJRcjuPKrDi967r58Hdn78ij.png)

They did put effort into making the thank card by the end of the demo though, lol, which is like trying to calm people down after wasting their time playing their shitty game.

Don't get me wrong, if it had been a random game dropped in the store with DEMO ready to be played, it would have been totally fine, as bugs and mistakes are not missing, no matter how big a game is.

The problem here is promoting a game for one full year back in 2019, asking people to wishlist it, and then returning 7 years later with a whole new game while they try to delete all the traces of what they were supposed to deliver. This is where I strongly believe this should be a jail event. 

Just imagine if they had the game set on pre-order with what they promised to deliver, lots of people would purchase it, and then get to play what we have with their demo version. Wouldn't that be theft? Nevertheless, this kind of things should be illegal, and Steam should do better research on what developers upload when listing a game, because a single check on what they initially listed would already show that none of these was real.

<center>![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/6sCR-rG_0IYAAAAC/ban.gif)</center>

But the developers had a really smart move, releasing only the demo for this instead of putting it on early access, as most of the games do when they look for genuine feedback. That would also allow people to leave a review on the Steam Store on their overall experience playing it, and developers would pay a lot more attention to fix possible reports since their reputation could be seen by everyone in real time.

Instead, they set it as a demo so people couldn't list their review in a public way, deleting lots of discussions started on the forums and making the report submission not work, even if you want to do all this from the game, where no one else would see what you would write anyway.

So, since I already spent a lot more time both playing and writing about this game, I'd like to stop here, but not before suggesting everyone to do a better research on what is real and what it's not.

This game was presented in a fake way a lot more before the AI became a thing, and still turned out not to exist. So what is actually real anymore?

Personally, I feel disappointed and sad at the same time for falling on this one, waiting years and expecting that the wait is well worth it at the end of the day. At one point, I even thought the game was never going to be released anymore, which is also what I was hoping to actually happen now that I've checked the DEMO version. 

Nevertheless, I already submitted a report ticket directly at Steam, and I am waiting for their response, if there is going to be any. But I really hope this game will never get to be ever released, and it will face the consequences it deserves.

title.title: Western Video 4
title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=colinpowerman/hl58zbea

The ancient mountains rise where eagles fly,
Their jagged peaks of slate and silver-gray
Reach up to touch the soft, retreating day.
A sliver of a moon, a pearly crest,
Sits quiet in the clouds above the west,
While cumulus in towers, white and grand,
Cast rolling shadows o'er the sun-drenched land.



Through the valley’s heart, a ribbon flows,
Where the sapphire water winds and goes,
Its banks are lined with stones of tumbled quartz,
A liquid road where every wild thing thwarts
The summer heat, as ripples catch the light
And dance in shades of teal and cobalt bright.
It carves a path through meadows deep and wide,
With golden grasses swaying at its side.



On the southern slope, where the sagebrush grows,
A group of riders follows where it goes;
A man in crimson leans against the wind,
Upon a bay whose strength is disciplined,
While nearby companions, hats pulled low,
Move with a rhythm that the frontiers know.
Across the stream, beneath the mountain’s face,
Others emerge in a slow and steady pace,
Their silhouettes against the amber field
Are ghosts of legends that will never yield.



Scattered like seeds across the verdant floor,
The horses graze beside the river shore;
A pale white steed stands lonely by the bend,
Waiting for the journey’s quiet end,
While others, brown and dappled, roam the grass,
Watching the slow and heavy seasons pass.
Green pines like sentinels guard the rising hill,
the wild is breathing still.

title.title: The Beauty of Holiness//Mcgi Topic Review (part 3)
title.body:
https://youtu.be/nJVJeFuG5GQ?si=_43XKskLDGwcFwQKhttps://youtu.be/nJVJeFuG5GQ?si=_43XKskLDGwcFwQK

**Greetings everyone,** and welcome to my blog. It is another wonderful opportunity to listen to the word of God through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.

One of the greatest treasures a Christian can possess is holiness. It is far more than outward appearance or gaining the approval of others. True holiness begins in the heart. It is a life devoted to pleasing God, walking in obedience to His commandments, and reflecting His character daily. Holiness is an expression of our love, reverence, and devotion to God because He Himself is holy.

In 1 Peter 1:15–16, the Bible says: “But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation; because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.” This passage reminds us that holiness is not optional for those who follow God. It is a divine calling. God desires that we become more like Him in our thoughts, words, attitudes, and actions.

Living a holy life brings peace, joy, and a deeper relationship with God. Although no one is perfect and we may stumble at times, we can always return to Him in repentance and continue striving to follow His ways. Holiness helps us avoid things that draw us away from God and encourages us to pursue what is right and pleasing in His sight.

Holiness also strengthens us spiritually and allows us to be a positive influence on others. Jesus taught in Matthew 5:16, “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.” A life of holiness serves as a testimony that can inspire others to seek God and walk in His ways.

As I continue my journey of faith, my prayer is that God will help me remain faithful and holy before Him. Holiness is truly beautiful because it draws us closer to our Creator and prepares us for His kingdom. As Psalm 29:2 teaches us, we should “worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.” Holiness is not a burden but a blessing, bringing honor to God and enriching the lives of those who pursue it.

**Thanks for reading.**
