![GENESIS pack token](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/golem.overlord/Eo6BfaASAWaSBuVkuSjYmx7zGFDZLuZb2DAFhNVjQQAgCvLJNbXEDSBfDbA2aTmt7pp.png)

**GENESIS** is the card pack itself, as a token. One token is one sealed pack. You open it in-game to get the cards inside.

And if you'd rather not touch crypto at all, there's a normal fiat onramp. You can pay how you want and still get exactly the same thing.

---

## What I'm building before closed alpha

This is the honest scope of what I'm working on right now, before alpha opens. It's a lot, and I'd rather show you the real list than wave vaguely at \

**The competitive and social heart of it:**

- Guilds, with proper guild management built in, not duct-taped on the side.
- Brawls. The thing I missed most, and the part I most want to get right.
- End-of-season tournaments.
- Season rewards and daily rewards, so showing up is worth it.

**Ownership and the economy:**

- Building whole decks, and renting, delegating or selling them as a single unit, not just card by card.
- Proper trading with double-sided accept, so a trade is safe by design and nobody gets tricked out of anything.
- STEL staking, and working out what governance should actually look like in practice.
- Battle passes.

**The stuff that makes it feel like a real place, not a spreadsheet:**

- Finishing the chat.
- A proper support system, so when something breaks you can get help fast.
- Avatars and profile pages.
- Skins.
- Maybe account levels and that kind of fun, optional progression.

**Getting in, your way:**

- More chain logins, and the option to create a Hive account right inside the game if you don't have one yet.

Some of this is close. Some of it is further out. And a few of these I'm honestly still working out, which I'll get to. But that's the real roadmap, not a teaser reel.

---

## I don't have everything figured out

And I'm not going to pretend I do, because pretending is exactly how you end up making promises you quietly bury later.

There's real stuff I haven't solved yet. How rewards should scale so a big collection doesn't just steamroll a new player. How the leagues should breathe so every tier feels worth playing. What governance should actually look like once STEL means something. A few other things. Some of it is built and running already, some of it is still a question mark on my own board.

That's fine, and it's on purpose. The best parts of Golem Overlord didn't come from me sitting alone in a room being clever. They came from building it with the people actually playing it, watching what they did, and listening when they told me something felt off. Same plan here. **The open questions, we work out together.**

---

## Want in?

Stellarch isn't open yet. I'm still getting it ready, and **closed alpha is close.**

Get on the waitlist at **stellarch.io**. Every confirmed pilot gets the free, max-level gold **\

card** when we open the doors. It's yours, it's real, it's tradeable, and it carries through every phase from here on.

And come hang in the **[Discord](https://discord.gg/K3geA9hD28)** while you wait. I'm building this whole thing in the open, the good calls and the messy ones, and I'd genuinely rather have you in the room for it than announce it at you later.

That's the post. That's the plan. **Come build the rest of it with me.**

title.title: Western Video 2
title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=colinpowerman/2t8qdaqz

The canvas opens wide and grand,
Upon a sun-bleached, rugged land,
A frontier town of wood and stone,
Where history's quiet seeds are sown.

The sky explodes in brilliant blue,
While massive clouds of dynamic form
Roll over hills like a silent storm.

Down the center of the thoroughfare,
A dusty road lies cracked and bare,
Paved with earth and dried-up clay,
Where pooling shadows stretch away.
Wild sage and desert grasses grow
In scattered, untamed clumps below,
Anchoring the weathered scene
Where nature meets the town machine.

A solitary, ghostly steed—
A riderless white horse, freed—
Stands quietly upon the left,
Of saddle and of rein bereft.
Beside it rides a cowboy tall,
Whose dark-brimmed hat begins to fall
In shadow o’er a stoic face,
As his dark mount keeps steady pace.

Across the lane, the main street fills
With riders heading toward the hills;
A slow procession, two by two,
Under the sky of midday blue.
They pass the storefronts, old and dry,
Whose wooden faces greet the sky—
From sun-baked gold to brick-red tones,
Built over desert sand and stones.

An American flag hangs small and still,
Untouched by any sudden chill,
While wagon wheels and hitching posts
Stand guard like wooden, silent ghosts.
Far in the distance, soft and gray,
The mountain ridges fade away,
An endless bound of stone and crest
That marks the edge of the wild West.

Every brushstroke, sharp and clear,
Brings the old horizon near,
Preserving in this painted view
The classic myths we thought we knew.
The trail goes on, the riders ride,
With vast expanses at their side,
Forever frozen, proud and free,

title.body: Вийшов новий кліп на пісню Олександра Положинського, написану для альбому \

минулого року. Зйомками кліпу і його монтажем займався відомий український режисер та оператор Тарас Химич. В результаті вийшла дуже емоційна робота, де візуальний ряд підкреслює глибокий та драматичний сенс композиції.
Знімати про війну непросто. Біль, рани, стислі зуби поранених і їх рятувальників. Задушливі окопи, смертельно небезпечні дрони, що переслідують кожного. І проміж всім цим - мрійливий погляд запиленого, втомленого молодого бійця, що пронизує наскрізь...

![Fullscreen capture 16.06.2026 81104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/radiogaga/23wWT29kaYRmwWqTqyDstdtH8gvLQLeQuqPxybJBiiwUdj6dNWwZFg7uFrcPqsDJs6vAp.jpg)

Відеоряд для кліпу \

створювався із максимальним прагненням до реалізму, оскільки сам Олександр Положинський є військовослужбовцем ЗСУ. Його особистий бойовий досвід безпосередньо вплинув на те, як саме відтворювали атмосферу передової на екрані. Для відтворення позицій, де відбуваються події кліпу, використовувалися реальні інженерні фортифікаційні споруди.  А режисер Тарас Химич наповнив кадри справжніми елементами військового життя : кадри руху всередині траншей знімалися з ручних камер або стабілізаторів на низьких ракурсах. Такий прийом допомагає глядачеві відчути замкнутість простору та постійну напругу, в якій перебувають захисники.\nГлядачі кліпу вже написали багато хороших коментарів авторам композиції. Спільним є таке:  \

- це влучні слова, чудова музика і реалістичний відеоряд.

title.title: To exist and not have a name... what's it like?
title.body: To exist and not have a name... what's it like?\n\nProbably the ones who know this best are ownerless mongrels who will never hear the words \

addressed to them. ![1dd1DSC06893.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmU7TSoTyfEqHfR6LtaJL3sezVMr8U5vEvNLSoKRerg3sp/1dd1DSC06893.png) Almost everything that surrounds us has a name, whether it's a forest... you've heard of Sherwood Forest, or you've seen oceans, seas, and lakes with names on world maps. Moreover, even the smallest lakes have names on maps, which is unfair to puddles, because puddles after rain, whether small or large, certainly never had names, or don't have them. You might say that puddles dry up after rain and there's no point in giving them names, lol. ![1dd1DSC06892.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVWE5aEQ13qni6sYp1zMyy3ZMBVpFKXF6biERMkkWfpFL/1dd1DSC06892.png) Here lies the source of injustice, because I've personally seen rivers and lakes that have ceased to exist, and some that could disappear, like the Aral Sea. Once navigable rivers, like the Cahul River in Moldova, now look like a stream you can step over, but the river's history hasn't been abolished. But puddles, no matter how small, will never appear on the world map, although there's a puddle near my house, on the side of the road, that hasn't dried up for several years now. LOL. It's good that there are light-hearted topics for reflection that make us smile. ![1dd1DSC06891.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXXZMME1DyJVT2gBPvto4eJfT4M6TAqL6tyk6kuBRKMR1/1dd1DSC06891.png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. 附近開了一家新的咖啡店，鄰居妹妹說要去看看便約好一起在這天來到這裡喝咖啡，一樓的位置挺少的，所以我和鄰居妹妹來到二樓，因為很新，所以看起來的確是挺明亮舒服，人也不算多，聊起天來也算是自在。

令人意外的是，只要掃瞄桌上條碼點餐，餐點就會由服務生送上來，光這一點就比很多咖啡店好了，尤其對我這種手無縛雞之力的人來說，太需要人家幫我拿餐點，不然光上樓的樓梯都會讓我端咖啡端到手抖XD真的是德政啊，我很喜歡~~

妹妹點了蜜柚茶飲，我則點了冰拿鐵，出門在外喝咖啡點冰拿鐵是最不會出錯的，但這家的冰拿鐵有點淡，沒有露易莎的好喝，但看在一切都挺不賴的份上，就算有點淡也是可以接受的，哈哈，好笑的是因為是試營運所以只開到下午四點，昏倒，根本聊沒幾句就要解散了......

總之，有一間新開的咖啡店還是很讚的喔。

The sky hangs heavy with an amber hue,
In the stylized landscape of
Where the old frontier is born anew,
Painted in shades of copper and rust.
A dusty highway cleaves the town,
Under the gaze of the canyon’s crown,
Where towering buttes of ancient stone
Watch over the valley, silent and lone.

Two lone riders on horseback pace,
Divided by time, or perhaps by space,
One draws near on a chestnut bay,
While the other follows further away.
With wide-brimmed hats and steady hands,
They navigate these sun-drenched lands,
Past wooden storefronts, low and wide,
Where secrets of the border hide.

The desert brush in clumps of green
Dots the edges of the quiet scene,
While fluffy clouds of cream and white
Catch the last of the fading light.
An unexpected dome of pale, clean stone
Sits where the rugged trail is blown,
A touch of order, sharp and grand,
Amidst the wild, untamed sand.

No bustling crowds, no hurried rush,
Just the wind through the sagebrush,
And the rhythmic thud of horses' feet
Echoing down the empty street.
Captured here in 
The spirit of the West remains,
Bound by the cliffs and golden plains.

title.title: Dino Crisis [Let's Play] - 05
title.body:
*Found the 3rd Energy Room, and finally captured Dr. Kirk. I like Dr. Kirk's character, he's a egoistic genius who thinks he has everything under control, while the whole facility is overrun with Dinosaurs because of him.*

*Also, we fight T-Rex again!!*

-----

**Dino Crisis** is a survival panic game developed by the same team behind Resident Evil. It swaps out zombies for dinosaurs. The game follows Regina, a special agent sent to investigate a mysterious island facility after an experiment for a new energy source went horribly wrong!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQz7BtVkjKVHjdCHxokMKPfzanNQgqy9vfSB5dZeEnFZe/VeniceAI_vFc26C8_@2x.webp 




The first **Dino Crisis** game first released on PS1 and features real-time 3D environments with dynamic camera movement. The dinosaurs serve mostly as a background threat as Regina explores the facility and learns more about the 3rd Energy Project!

***This playthrough uses the ReBirth Mod on top of the GoG version of the game.***

I played Dino Crisis during my teenage years. I already played the first hours of Dino Crisis 2 at the time, and with my little English knowledge, Dino Crisis 1 felt complicated in comparison... I didn't know where to go 2 hours into the game. Finally finishing the game now with the GoG version felt incredibly satisfying.

Despite the clunky controls, the game still holds up surprisingly well. With its tense atmosphere and the constant threat of raptors lurking around every corner. The story adds some interesting sci-fi elements, though the the time travel aspect turned out to be more a plot device to introduce the Dinosaurs, rather than the actual main plotline.

While I'd recommend this game to survival horror fans, I did run into some technical issues... FMVs kept skipping themselves which broke some of the cinematic flow. The game features huge amounts of backtracking, especially near the end, so much that I kept a guide open so I figure out what I was missing. Still, the ending was satisfying and worth the journey. You can watch my playthrough below:

Ich fuer mich persoenlich sehe es als schlimmen sozialen Fehler an, wieder zu forken.

Das moechte ich selber auch nicht.

Hochvoten lassen und den Hive von innen heraus aendern ist eine extrem Zeitintensive Aufgabe, die kann ich fast nicht mehr annehmen fuer mich und wer macht es dann mit dem Umbau? Wir haben ja auch ein paar findige und faehige Programmierer, aber ich denke das die auch ihre Zeit besser gesehen haetten, in ihren vielversprechenderen eigenen Projekten zu arbeiten? 

Ich fuer mich denke eher darueber nach, was Neues und wesentlich Moderneres zu bauen und den Hive einfach dranstoepseln zu lassen, wie alles andere auch, wenn es das will.

So ne Art digitaler Symbiont, der Hive existiert weiter wie er ist, und kann dann andocken im neuem System.

Aber es gibt keine Kriege und sowas zwischen den Orten.

Wir koennten ihn auch einfach so Lassen, wie er ist, aber werden dann immer das Wort Demoktratie als Witz empfinden muessen, wenn es in Wahrheit die Herrschaft des Geldes und der guten Kontakte ist.

Was wuerdest Du machen wenn Du die technishen Faehigkeiten und die Zeit und Energie damit haettest den Hive umzubauen oder zu veraendern???

Das ich heute drueber schreibe haben wir @kadna zu verdanken, wer sie noch kennt, weis Bescheid. Lasst ihr mal ein bisschen Sprachpower da, damit sie Schreiben kann, wenn ihr Lustig seid.

content.description:
HiveSuite improves snap sharing reliability and adds searchable game discovery inside the new Search experience.

# HiveSuite

## Hive Suite — Snap Composer Cleanup

### Duplicate Hashtag Cleanup

- Game result snaps no longer display duplicate hashtag lines inside the post body.  

- Tags now appear only in the official post tags section:
  - No repeated hashtag text inside the message content  


### Unified Across All Games

- Cleanup applies consistently across all supported games:
  - Aviator 1942  
  - Battleship  
  - Breakout  
  - Infinity Loop  
  - Ludo  
  - Snakes & Ladders  
  - Stack  
  - Water Sort  


### Draft Persistence on Wallet Cancellation

- Fixed an issue where cancelling:
  - Keychain  
  - HiveAuth  
  - Peak Vault  


- Previously caused:
  - Composer text loss  
  - Missing attached recap images  


### Safe Retry Flow

- After cancelled or failed share attempts:
  - Draft content now remains fully intact  


- Users can retry publishing without rebuilding:
  - Text  
  - Images  
  - Attachments  
  - Game recap content  


### Improved Wallet Cancel Detection

- Expanded wallet cancellation handling to support:
  - `declined` responses  
  - `denied` responses  


- Failed approvals now show:
  - Friendly cancellation feedback  


- Prevents unnecessary scary error states during normal user cancellations.  


- Outcome:
  - More reliable game-sharing workflow  
  - Safer publishing experience  
  - Better wallet interaction UX across HiveSuite  


Game Snap Composer Cleanup
![Game Snap Composer Cleanup](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaDXVcPcdrpQ1mewqhrpuLpkmubr5ELpJwqTX5Rv45Q36/image.png)



Draft Persistence After Cancel
![Draft Persistence After Cancel](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjvMaXvdEpZ1XawDxeEGW53VTTRqgTfHg8oS3knRNRos/image.png)



---

## Games Search Integration

### New Games Search Tab

- Added a dedicated `Games` tab inside the HiveSuite search experience.  

- Expands search coverage beyond:
  - Users  
  - Blogs  
  - Communities  
  - Media feeds  


### Keyword-Based Game Search

- Users can now search games using:
  - Game names  
  - Related keywords  


### Example Searches

- Supported keyword discovery examples:
  - `shoot`  
  - `puzzle`  
  - Other gameplay-related terms  


### Shared Game Card Layout

- Search results use the same game card UI as the main Games page:
  - Consistent layout  
  - Familiar interaction flow  


### Direct Game Navigation

- Tapping a search result opens the selected game directly:
  - Same behavior as the Games page  


### Persistent Search URLs

- Search keywords are now stored in the page URL:
  - Refreshing keeps results  
  - Shared links preserve searches  


### Automatic Future Expansion

- Newly added games will automatically appear:
  - On the Games page  
  - Inside Games search  


- No additional search wiring required for future game integrations.  


- Outcome:
  - Better discoverability for games  
  - More scalable search architecture  
  - Improved navigation consistency across HiveSuite  


Games Search Tab

- Contributing towards a cleaner, more reliable, and feature-rich Hive ecosystem

Actually, it was a family festival at preschool, after all, we had to go! First, I rushed to pick up the kids, skipping work, which I then had to make up for that evening—but for a good cause, because I went to the doctor with two little bombers. At the doctor's, more referrals to specialists; my schedule was bursting at the seams. After the doctor's, a moment at the playground, and then—off to the festival. ![obraz.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSxNqmbWHG396jHJMTex7TNwGYRDQgGg2Xebv5mCgbM4Z/obraz.png) Było fajnie, pomimo że moje dzieci obierały zgoła odmienne kierunki, więc podczas gdy ja biegałam za Loczkiem, Bombel był pod opieką rodziców swoich kolegów. title.title: Daily prompt : I can't drive that !
title.body:
He walked across the snow. The sun had not risen yet. The whiteness of the snow calmed him. Why did he have to be here? Why had he distanced himself from everything? What was he searching for in his solitude? He missed his favorite café and those carefree gatherings with friends, yet he still had not found the strength to return to the city. His own city, or any other city. A city with buses that picked people up and dropped them off. A city crowded with moving shadows that paid no attention to his pain.

Now, in this distant mountainous place, the nightly howls of jackals had become a comfort to him. How could he return to the city and its bus stations when there was no longer a beloved waiting to step off the bus with that magical smile? It was this very city, these very frantic crossings of bodies, that had taken his love away from him. One day she confessed that she had met someone else and left him. Everything had happened so quickly. It was as if, in the city, there was not even enough time for goodbye.

And from that day on, he hated the city. He gave up his apartment and fled without saying goodbye or informing anyone. It was as though the city had killed him, and now he had become a sad and wandering ghost. Now he spoke with objects, insects, animals, the wind, and the rain, while his loneliness grew larger and larger.

title.title: They say that reality is something we should accept for granted...
title.body:
They say that reality is something we should accept for granted, and indeed, it's hard to argue with that, just like the idea that a snowman is made of snow, and if you start rolling it out of mud, then, in theory, you can't call it a snowman anymore (lol, or can you?) But what is reality? There are many opinions here. Perhaps it's the place where we are at this very moment, and where we are not, the reality of those places loses all meaning. For me, as a city dweller, reality was contained within the city limits, and when I managed to leave the city, it seemed as if I had entered a different reality. ![1x1DSC06429.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWXkDySK7Sty3ftkZjTp8WxGcYmuEhPFuACuFFUGo1FNz/1x1DSC06429.png) Don't believe anyone that there's a door between realities, and when you open it, you immediately enter another reality. In reality, the path from one reality to another passes through many doors: the door of the apartment, the door of the entrance, the door of the car, or the bus, and, after a while, again, the door of the vehicle that took you to the new reality. ![1x1DSC07459.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZ2WXJcrWbj9mkM5TeUrXJx2dTX3iDmy2KoJ8DEVoibPe/1x1DSC07459.png) The perception of a new reality directly depends on many external factors. So, when I found myself in the village, it seemed to me that this was real reality, this was true freedom! But, after sitting on a bench across the endless steppe in the freezing cold, waiting for the bus, I came to the feeling that urban reality, with its centralized heating system, isn't such a bad thing at all. ![1x1DSC01470.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXPtDLQ4SrS3hkkhMfaC6UDcVrPVLqdDc9yYR8FuQMqwv/1x1DSC01470.png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. title.title: Why Your Family Should Be Your Greatest Priority
title.body: >\n\nI overheard one of my friends, during a discussion he was having with someone, make a statement that made much meaning to me. He said \

Without any doubt, family is among the best gifts that you will ever have. As a matter of fact, long before you started to make friends, or even achieved anything significant, family was the first support system you had. They stood by you even when you could not stand for yourself. At various points in your life, they were there for you. They celebrated your victories, encouraged you during the trying and challenging times of your life, and they stayed around even when others had reasons to leave you. This is part of the reasons why family should top your priority.
![pexels-rhea-jabagat-50266004-15077113.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdEdzWVA8N7786DAm94QCg4CzewsNDCQDDFFcpJTu7dmF/pexels-rhea-jabagat-50266004-15077113.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-family-smiling-at-the-camera-15077113)
Story was told of a young man. He finished school and left home in pursuit of greener pastures. He started a business in another state. With time, he became successful, but then he also got busier. This also made him to stop visiting his parents and his family members who were at home. He believed that there was plenty of time to spend with them in the future. He could stay months without even going to visit them, and even in festive period, he hardly went home because he believed that it is at this period that he would make the most sales in his business. This thing kept happening, then one day, he got a news that his father was seriously sick. He had to rush down home to see him. The same home that seemed far to him suddenly became close. When he came to the hospital in his home town, he entered the room and his father did not even know he entered because of his health condition. He sat beside his father on the sick bed, and that was when he realised the moments he had missed while chasing success. With tears running down his eyes, he asked himself what is the purpose of the insatiable quest for more success if you do not have your own people to celebrate with you? It was at that point that he decided to make family his priority. He decided to be visiting home more often, connect more with his family, and share love with them. In the world of today, and at this present time, a lot of people spend so much time in the pursuit of money, fame, education, career advancements, and many other achievements. Well, all these things are good, no doubt, but they should not come at the expense of your family. What makes success more adorable is when you have people to celebrate it with. Just to let you know, someone can achieve success, own a lot of possessions, cars, house, etc, but may still feel very empty on the inside because of broken family. There is a kind of emotional support that the family can provide, which cannot be easily replaced. During moments of disappointment, uncertainty, or even failure, your family might become your source of strength. Their encouragement and their support can go a long way to remind you that your worth is not determined by your achievements or your mistakes. Trust me, when you know that people genuinely care about you, it will make you to face the challenges of life with confidence. A lot of the people who make impact have strong support from their family. There are things that you can achieve alone, but there are other things that you need the support of the people around you. If not for anything, at least for the mental support and strength.
![pexels-askar-abayev-5638414.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfANMrU1UuXid9MdMZTCYjQYrgjwMhom5TWMzJqH2pGV6/pexels-askar-abayev-5638414.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/people-smiling-at-the-camera-5638414)
It is worthy to note that family is also where value and character are shaped. A lot of people learn honesty, respect, responsibility, discipline, and compassion first at home. This is why it is observed that strong families will generally raise strong individuals, and these strong individuals will contribute positively towards the building of strong society. When families are healthy and united, it will reflect in the community, and it will create a stronger and more peaceful society. A lot of the things that happen in any society have their root in the individual's family. Making family your priority will require intentional efforts. It includes spending quality time time together even with your busy schedules. It also includes listening to one another, being there for them, supporting them, showing up for them during important moments. This will make them to feel that they are part of a family that cares for them, and they will also do the same for you. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

title.title: ‎Dusty Streets, Childhood Games, and the Biscuits I Still Mis ‎
title.body:
‎Hello Hive,
‎
‎Whenever people talk about childhood memories, my mind immediately goes back to the days when life was much simpler. We didn't have smartphones, social media, or endless entertainment at our fingertips, but somehow we always found a way to have fun. Looking back now, some of my happiest memories were made right outside my house with friends from the neighborhood.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYDzcNay7ZqJQVwE3CSLfkKPserpV4t1qhn5V8vVrGpfM/file_00000000df4871f499d4cf5ef52742fb.png 

‎
‎One thing I could do for hours without getting bored was playing football on the dusty streets. Every evening after school, we would rush through our chores just so we could meet up and play. We didn't care whether we had proper football boots or jerseys. Sometimes our goalposts were just two stones placed a few feet apart. All that mattered was getting enough players for a match.
‎
‎Those games were always full of excitement. We argued over fouls, celebrated goals like professional footballers, and occasionally had disagreements that were forgotten a few minutes later. The funny thing is that the dusty field where we played probably wouldn't impress anyone today, but it felt like the biggest stadium in the world to us.
‎
‎Apart from football, I also enjoyed games like ten-ten, suwe, and hide-and-seek. These games brought children together and kept us active for hours. Whenever I see children spending most of their time indoors with phones and tablets, I can't help but remember how different things were during my own childhood.
‎
‎If I had the opportunity to bring back one thing from those days, it would definitely be some of the biscuits I grew up eating. Coconut biscuits, digestive biscuits, and especially Speedy biscuits were among my favorites. I still remember stopping by a small shop with a few naira in my pocket and feeling excited because I knew I could buy one of those treats.
‎
‎What makes those biscuits special isn't just the taste. They remind me of a period in my life when things were carefree and simple. Sadly, they are not as common as they used to be, and some are quite difficult to find these days.
‎
‎Although childhood is long gone, the memories remain. Whether it's the football matches on dusty streets or enjoying a pack of biscuits after a long day of playing, those moments still make me smile. They remind me that some of the best parts of life are often the simplest ones.
‎
‎Thanks for reading!!!!

title.title: Nature's Superfruit: Our Healthy and In-Demand Passion Fruit Harvest
title.body:
![Green and Orange Illustration Travel Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48UmcBhMqo8PCw4Q2TuE8UDhVKqCDkXozwNA93Y38DDh9sGtPrKKJshsnzFtqhUKhg.jpg)

Hello everyone! One of the things I love most about living close to nature is being surrounded by fruit-bearing plants. Among all the fruits growing around our place, passion fruit is one of the most rewarding and exciting to harvest. Not only is it delicious and refreshing, but it is also packed with health benefits that make it a favorite in our community.




![IMG_20260213_105554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tvXiBnLEDNGWwFu6AQDK5Bto8b7sqNJrRmggQbvBn8rCqZgjodCNsmwR87jLSSD75ex.jpg)


We have plenty of passion fruit plants growing around our area. They are surprisingly easy to grow, which is one reason why many gardeners love them. Passion fruit can grow from seeds, and sometimes even fruits that fall to the ground will sprout into new plants on their own. They are fast-growing vines that can thrive with little maintenance once established. Need only a space where they grow freely. 

![Green and Orange Illustration Travel Photo Collage (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48GhefAC8kfMeP2i7L4RuLTMfxQMiTVdnfubRVq1niae5cBuEEX8BVv8keygZAE7Jm.jpg)

Years ago, our passion fruit vines would produce fruit three times a year. These days, they usually bear fruit twice a year, but when they do, the harvest is often abundant. During the season, the vines become covered with beautiful fruits, and it feels like nature is rewarding us for our patience.

![Green and Orange Illustration Travel Photo Collage (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48GDUJx718dqo2ggY59QEBNKZPa6g1hjMnyGePPRx5ksjsjW67hAZL3Vdgm3ws6oxb.png)

![Green and Orange Illustration Travel Photo Collage (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48WgYEfFPEwL5MWDrcabu5AjqwQgzPRZfwSiLmUB5xCrLfAHjyyRFE2ks56xzUZCK5.png)


This week, we decided it was time to check the vines and harvest the ripe fruits. Many of them had already fallen to the ground, which is a sign that they are ready to eat. As we walked around the garden, we found passion fruits everywhere. It was exciting to see so many fruits waiting to be collected. My daughter is the one who is ready and excited she bring a sack. 


![IMG_20260213_105506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23u5vsvNjTuWLmdgMYTSgBPoTGTHckHhNxzBCK5ASyRqBQjnyiMwpDDkvJU8sDetA77Mx.jpg)

The most excited harvester in our family was my daughter. She eagerly helped gather the fruits and enjoyed every moment of the harvest. Seeing her happy and curious about where food comes from is one of the best parts of gardening together.

What makes passion fruit so special is not only its sweet and tangy flavor but also its nutritional value. Passion fruit is rich in vitamin C, which helps strengthen the immune system and protect the body from illness. It is also a good source of vitamin A, which supports healthy eyesight. The fruit contains dietary fiber that promotes good digestion and helps keep you feeling full longer. In addition, passion fruit contains antioxidants that help protect the body from damage caused by free radicals. This is based on our friend google. 


Many people also enjoy passion fruit because it can be used in different ways. It can be eaten fresh, added to juices, smoothies, desserts, salads, and even homemade jams. Its unique flavor makes it a favorite ingredient for many recipes.

![Green and Orange Illustration Travel Photo Collage (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48XAdHSWwXEpe1KGVec4Qjbhv9GTD5hgEtmEsVWe9BvYGXHrPeK8s4WLXhBZQPkaZA.png)

Because of its health benefits and delicious taste, passion fruit is always in demand in our area. After posting online that we had fresh passion fruits available, several members of our community immediately placed orders. We were thrilled by the positive response.


Soon, our harvest day turned into packing and weighing day. My daughter happily helped weigh the fruits by the kilo and felt very proud of her little job. It was both fun and rewarding.

![IMG_20260614_161649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xAc9A1eXoGaoHoUVpduBk8nNeHnmNFpQJKdShCgLvi7TGPUbJXGzYqsbhJJp2s3dtQN.jpg)

From tiny seeds to a plentiful harvest, our passion fruit garden continues to provide healthy food, extra income, and precious family memories. Every harvest reminds us that gardening is not just about growing plants, it's about growing joy, gratitude, and connection with nature.

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture and edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

title.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/3772532/pexels-photo-3772532.jpeg [source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-person-in-pensive-mood-3772532/ ) In fact, if we try to do the work we are going to do quickly without thinking much before doing it, maybe sometimes that work will be solved, but most of the time that work may not be solved correctly. That is, before doing anything, we definitely need to think about that work. And if we can do every work by thinking before doing it, then you will see that that work is being solved very nicely. One thing we have to remember is that in this world, those who always think before doing every work and try to do that work are always ahead. In some cases, we see such fast people that they have no time to think. Although they are very hardworking people, but their hard work becomes completely useless when they try to do a work without thinking. In fact, the work we are going to do will not be good for us or bad, so we should first do some research on that work. In fact, it may waste some of our time, but if the work we are going to do is done correctly, then you will see that this little time will become much bigger for you. We should always move forward with thought in every aspect of life.use they are not letting us move forward, but we should never listen to them, we should keep taking initiative constantly to fulfill our dreams. title.title: Trying to stay focus
title.body: > As I said yesterday, I actually went to the gym today. I worked my hamstrings and glutes, and while it might seem simple, for me it means more than just completing a workout. After several weeks dealing with emotional ups and downs, fatigue, and some health issues, showing up and getting the job done feels like a small victory. I know I won't be going tomorrow. I want to prioritize rest and catch up on other things that also need my attention. But this time, the difference is that I don't see it as abandoning the routine, but rather as part of it. My intention is to become more active again, find a balance, and gradually return to that version of myself that enjoys being active, whether it's at the gym, running, or learning something new.

> Como lo dije ayer, hoy sí cumplí y fui al gimnasio. Entrené isquiotibiales y glúteos, y aunque puede parecer algo simple, para mí significa más que solo haber completado una rutina. Después de varias semanas donde he estado lidiando con altibajos emocionales, cansancio y algunos problemas de salud, volver a presentarme y hacer el trabajo se siente como una pequeña victoria. Mañana ya sé que no voy a ir. Quiero priorizar el descanso y ponerme al día con otras cosas que también necesitan mi atención. Pero esta vez la diferencia es que no lo veo como abandonar el ritmo, sino como parte de él. Mi intención es mantenerme más activa nuevamente, encontrar un equilibrio y volver poco a poco a esa versión de mí que disfruta estar en movimiento, ya sea en el gimnasio, corriendo o aprendiendo algo nuevo.

А найкраще зараз фотографувати троянди, що саме починають квітнути.\nЯ вже плутаюсь у цих кількох кущиках куплених позаминулого року квіток. Але точно знаю, що лиш одна із них відповідає замовленню. title.title: Key Engineering Principles Behind Successful Medical Dental Building Construction
title.body:
Healthcare facility development is known to follow strict technical and clinical zoning standards. To realize high-performance clinical spaces, medical systems can turn to specialized providers in Medical Dental Building Construction processes that successfully translate raw square footage into yield. Such developments are very complex and demand a specialized knowledge of heavy structural engineering, holistic radiation shielding and distribution modalities for the best possible fusion of medical utility. The architecture is built to ensure that the resulting building can support state of the art diagnostic equipment, whilst retaining complete safety for the patient.

In the schematic phase of a contemporary healthcare facility, structural architects together with mechanical engineers and healthcare compliance inspectors should work seamlessly. Heavy vacuum lines and specialized chemical waste disposal systems require teams to map out these high-capacity electrical grids and plumbing networks. Initial phase planning protects the structural underpinning due to moisture saturation or systemic vibration which will lead to premature decay. So long-term operational maintenance costs are greatly reduced for institutional property owners due to this proactive technical coordination.



![](https://whimuc.com/Co5iab8259K4TyxXn2tiMZ/84oRn9oRf4sWoP.jpeg)



**Targeted Spatial Zoning and Structured Management**

If a dental specific infrastructure is not incorporated during the early stages of structural framing, it could lead to major retrofitting costs in the future. Collaborating with licensed engineers at[ Medical Dental Building Construction](https://dentalconstruction.ca/about-us/) projects can save developers from routing issues that push back completion dates. Soil compaction metrics and concrete slab thickness to support heavy specialized operatory chairs and heavy Panoramic scanning equipment safely are evaluated by experienced commercial contractors. All these preparations are done meticulously to ensure developing a strong block of foundation for healthcare such as planned systems of medical operations.

Air filtration is yet another major environmental factor that joint clinical architects must resolve at the rough-in stage of mechanical airing apartment. Operatory zones produce aerosols, MHz mean a vast quantity of airborne particles that are microscopic and need to be evacuated by high-efficiency particulate air filtration arrangements to prevent involuntary contraction of diseases during dental procedures. Treatment rooms are individually ventilated and kept from shared waiting lobbies to eliminate cross contamination while ensuring excellent indoor air conditions.

Additionally, it is a legal obligation to scene such lead-lined drywall panels throughout some diagnosis imaging locations for the protection of personnel and patients in close proximity. Specialized builders meticulously compute the radiation spreading proportions to figure out the actual density of protective shades needed by state health departments. These discreet safety structures protect neighbouring office suites and shared corridors from constant x-ray exposure.

Approaching the CDM requires searching full structural compliance manuals from Medical Dental Building Construction indices on a per-sector basis; doing so allows development teams to secure municipal building permits without exertion. Aspects such as structural fire ratings, requirements for barrier free accessibility ramps, emergency exit routes are looked up against local commercial codes before excavation begins. With clear regulatory alignment, projects are designed, built and can be safely kept on schedule without the risk of unanticipated work stoppages at the building department.

In addition, in the case of modern medical facilities, great care should be taken with installing acoustic dampening measures in cavity walls to protect patient confidentiality. Dense mineral wool insulation and acoustically rated drywall sheets help prevent voices from spilling into common corridors or administrative areas. The silent architecture enhancements that bolster the wellbeing of patients and fulfil the neighbourhoods acts on healthcare secrecy.

**Conclusion**

So, putting together a successful healthcare property transformation is almost entirely dependent on the complex interplay of using sophisticated spatial engineering combined with thorough compliance management. Focusing on complex utility mapping, structural reinforcement review and advanced atmospheric filtration ensures that the development teams provide high levels of resiliency in these facilities. Time spent on rigorous regulatory research equips owners to create modern medical spaces that protect the public and raise the bar in clinical practice.

title.title: ¿Quién soy cuando estoy solo? [ESP - ENG]
title.body:
>


Hola comunidad de @holos-lotus . Por estos días he tenido bastante movimiento, lo que no me ha permitido cumplir con la meta del post diario, pero lo importante es que lo tuve presente y siempre es un buen momento para recomenzar, a la par de comprender que nuestras metas y objetivos no son una mordaza, sino un ideal al cual debemos apuntar para superarnos. De igual manera, la experiencia me sirvió para comprender aún más el tema del post. Luego de estar rodeado de muchas personas en varios eventos sociales, surge esa mágica pregunta: ¿quién soy cuando estoy solo?

Hay que tener en cuenta una distinción relevante: estar solo (el hecho físico) no es lo mismo que sentirse solo (experiencia emocional). De ahí que en muchas ocasiones podamos sentir que no estamos acompañados cuando estamos rodeados de muchas personas en un lugar o momento determinado. Claramente, estar solo es diferente a sentirse como tal. La primera de estas experiencias es elegida; la segunda, impuesta.

#### El valor de la soledad elegida
Cuando elegimos estar solos, podemos acceder a un mayor autoconocimiento y autenticidad. Es un momento donde no existe nadie más; por ello, tendemos a volcarnos sobre nosotros mismos sin filtros. Ese diálogo interno, aunque a veces puede ser difícil, es muy reparador. Tenemos que enfrentarnos a nuestros propios pensamientos (que muchos no son agradables) cuando no hay nada más que hacer. En los tiempos actuales se ha perdido esa costumbre debido a lo fácil que es acceder a entretenimiento rápido en redes sociales y otras plataformas dentro de internet. Aunque a veces no somos conscientes, desaprovechamos esa gloriosa oportunidad \

, cuando el impacto que puede tener en nuestras vidas es muy grande: aumento de la capacidad de concentración, de la creatividad, claridad y descanso mental, entre muchas otras. #### La soledad y el Flow Realizar una actividad concreta en soledad también puede ser muy provechoso. La misma propicia un estado de inmersión total en la tarea que se está realizando. Cuando estoy escribiendo, leyendo o realizando algún tipo de acción que lleva mi atención total (como escribir este post, hacer música, etc.), pido a familiares en la casa que, en lo posible, no me interrumpan (a menos que sea algo extraordinario). También desactivo notificaciones del teléfono o cualquier otra cosa que pueda pausar lo que hago. Este espacio sin distracciones me permite terminar las tareas en un tiempo menor y con una calidad mayor, y así puedo estructurar mi día en estos bloques en los cuales le dedico toda mi atención y luego puedo realizar otras actividades. Actualmente, en el área de la productividad, a este estado se le dan muchos nombres, pero el que más me gusta es Flow. Como dice la propia palabra, se trata de fluir en ese momento donde ni siquiera se nota el paso del tiempo; solo importa lo que se hace y nada más. #### El contexto físico y la mente predictiva Para lograr todo lo anterior, es importante también comprender que el espacio que nos rodea es un factor fundamental. No da lo mismo estar solo en una habitación luminosa que en una calle oscura y desconocida. Nos sentimos con más confianza cuando conocemos el espacio y sabemos cómo funciona cada elemento en su interior. Obviamente, esto puede tener matices a partir de las diferencias culturales de cada persona. Volviendo al ejemplo del trabajo, algunos prefieren la noche y la oscuridad, mientras que otros necesitan un entorno con más iluminación natural. En otros casos, también se contraponen los espacios perfectamente organizados a los que no. Poniendo un ejemplo a una escala mayor, algunas personas de ciertas regiones pueden sentir ansiedad en entornos no tan familiares, como las personas de Latinoamérica, que están más acostumbradas a lugares coloridos con variedad arquitectónica, frente a las construcciones y clima de lugares como el Este Europeo, donde hay un clima más árido con combinaciones más neutras y monótonas. Del espacio seguro al refugio personal Si elegir estar solos en un espacio confortable y seguro puede ser gratificante, tener un refugio personal ya es el punto cúspide de la soledad. La principal diferencia radica en que, cuando uno se encuentra en su refugio, ya siente que tiene libertad absoluta. Es ese lugar donde no hay que justificar nada y se puede ser uno mismo, sin miedo a ninguna crítica o juicio. Es la diferencia entre un lugar que te protege del mundo exterior y uno que te permite explorar tu mundo interior con total libertad. --- Estar solo, siempre que sea por elección propia, puede ser un momento muy íntimo y de expansión personal. En mi caso, yo aprovecho cada uno de ellos, y sería bueno que todos, más allá de tener momentos casuales, seamos capaces de construir nuestros propios refugios. Quizá el mayor descubrimiento sea que nuestra propia compañía puede ser tan fascinante como la de cualquier otro, siempre que hayamos construido un lugar donde recibirnos. Al final, tras todo esto, quizá la respuesta a: ¿quién soy cuando estoy solo? no sea un nombre, sino una sensación: la de poder ser sin tener que mostrar. Me gustaría saber cuáles son esos espacios de calma y cuáles les generan inquietud. Los invito a dejarme su opinión en los comentarios. --- Foto generada con GPT-Image-2 Gracias por la lectura!!! ## English Version Hello @holos-lotus community. These past few days I have been quite busy, which hasn't allowed me to keep up with my daily posting goal. But what matters is that I kept it in mind, and it's always a good time to start again, while understanding that our goals and objectives are not a straitjacket, but an ideal we should aim for in order to grow. In the same way, the experience helped me understand the post's topic even better. After being around many people at several social events, that magical question arises: who am I when I am alone? We must keep in mind a relevant distinction: being alone (the physical fact) is not the same as feeling alone (the emotional experience). Hence, on many occasions we can feel unaccompanied even when surrounded by many people in a given place or moment. Clearly, being alone is different from feeling alone. The first of these experiences is chosen; the second is imposed. #### The value of chosen solitude When we choose to be alone, we can access greater self-knowledge and authenticity. It is a moment where no one else exists; therefore, we tend to turn inward without filters. That internal dialogue, although sometimes difficult, is very restorative. We have to face our own thoughts (many of which are unpleasant) when there is nothing else to do. Nowadays, that habit has been lost due to how easy it is to access quick entertainment on social media and other internet platforms. Although we are not always aware of it, we waste that glorious opportunity \

when the impact it can have on our lives is enormous: increased concentration, creativity, mental clarity and rest, among many others. #### Solitude and Flow Engaging in a specific activity in solitude can also be very beneficial. It fosters a state of total immersion in the task at hand. When I am writing, reading, or doing any activity that demands my full attention (like writing this post, making music, etc.), I ask family members at home not to interrupt me if possible (unless it's something extraordinary). I also turn off notifications on my phone or anything else that might pause what I am doing. This distraction-free space allows me to complete tasks in less time and with higher quality. This way, I can structure my day into blocks where I dedicate my full attention, and then move on to other activities. Currently, in the area of productivity, this state has many names, but my favorite is Flow. As the word itself suggests, it is about flowing in that moment where you don't even notice the passage of time; only what you are doing matters, and nothing else. #### The physical context and the predictive mind To achieve all of the above, it is also important to understand that the space around us is a fundamental factor. It is not the same to be alone in a bright room as it is to be on a dark, unfamiliar street. We feel more confident when we know the space and understand how each element within it works. Obviously, this can have nuances depending on each person's cultural background. Returning to the work example, some prefer night and darkness, while others need an environment with more natural light. In other cases, perfectly organized spaces are contrasted with less organized ones. On a larger scale, some people from certain regions may feel anxiety in less familiar environments. For example, people from Latin America, who are more accustomed to colorful places with architectural variety, may feel uneasy in places like Eastern Europe, where there is a drier climate with more neutral and monotonous combinations. #### From safe space to personal refuge If choosing to be alone in a comfortable and safe space can be gratifying, having a personal refuge is the pinnacle of solitude. The main difference lies in the fact that, when you are in your refuge, you already feel absolute freedom. It is that place where you don't have to justify anything and you can be yourself, without fear of criticism or judgment. It is the difference between a place that protects you from the outside world and one that allows you to explore your inner world with total freedom. --- Being alone, as long as it is by choice, can be a very intimate and personally expansive moment. In my case, I make the most of each of them, and it would be good if we all, beyond having casual moments, were capable of building our own refuges. Perhaps the greatest discovery is that our own company can be as fascinating as anyone else's, as long as we have built a place to welcome ourselves. In the end, after all of this, perhaps the answer to: who am I when I am alone? is not a name, but a feeling: that of being able to exist without having to show. I would like to know what those spaces of calm are for you, and which ones generate unease. I invite you to share your thoughts in the comments. --- Picture Generate by GPT-Image-2 THANKS FOR READING!!!

title.body: /> A beautiful morning to us all, I hope that we are enjoying the cooler weather of this wet season. Even though the weather cannot be the same all around the world from our understanding of geography. While we are in the raining seasons, I understood that people in other locations are currently in the dry and heat seasons. I hope that we will all find the weather favorable. It is really cold this morning and very difficult to get out of bed 😂 I learnt that the cold makes people sleep a lot of which I often fall victim but trust me go beat this weather when we have a lot of farm goals and activities that needs to be met

/> Yesterday at the farm we did a little bit of weeding here and there. Checked on the rice in the nursery where we have planted them to ensure that they weren't being eaten up by rodents or birds as such is a common happening. Each time you plant some rice in the nursery, it is a must go carry out mulching until the seedlings have grown to a certain length.
/> After that we have moved on to some other location where I had hoped to collect some potatoes stems for planting

/> Remember that I have planted some potatoes about a month ago in a portion of the farm. I have just discovered that the specie of potatoes I have planted aren't producing well. And this new species I have seen are so enticing. There are different specie of thesame crops, particularly for the crops in which the seeds we plant are a vegetative form like potatoes, it is sometimes difficult to know, understand and identify which of the vegetative form will give you the best crops. But different farmers in different locations that have planted any form of the different specie can tell you the characteristics of such specie.

/>\n\nThe owner of this one I took interest in had explained the product and quality/type of potato harvest we will be getting if we planted these. He said that they are the type his family has planted over the years due to its very good quality. Having compared the two specie of potatoes, the ones I had planted earlier and this one I have decided to plant some of these as well. All of these activities are such an important farm quest that we engage in, the search for quality seeds that will yield better outcome of products for us.

title.title: I’m back after 4 years – from single mom to married mom of two, entrepreneur, author, and still a lover of life
title.body:
Hello again, Hive.

It has been about four years since my last post. Back then, my world revolved around my firstborn son – just him and me. I was a single mom before I even knew what that meant. His dad passed away while I was still pregnant, so from the very beginning, it was the two of us against the world.

If you scroll back through my old posts, you’ll see his tiny face, my endless questions, and a woman who was scared but determined.

So much has changed. And I’m so happy to be back to share it with you.

**First, the biggest news:**

I now have two boys. My firstborn, is now 5 years old – curious, sweet, also full of energy. My second son, arrived September 2024 and has already turned our house upside down in the best way.

I got married to the most wonderful man I can describe. After being a single mom for 3,5 year, life brought me someone who loves my first son like his own and who makes me laugh even on the hardest days. We got married on September 2022. I still can’t believe I get to do life with him. (He also happens to be a pastor.)

*I wrote a book!* Yes, a real one – and it’s on Amazon, it's called **\

**.  That was a dream I didn’t even know I had until I started writing it.

I’ve been a graphic designer for years.
That’s how I supplemented my income to pay bills while raising my first son alone. But now I’ve moved into video editing and instructional design. It’s a whole new creative world, and I’m loving it. If anyone else on Hive works in instructional design or video editing, please say hi – I’d love to connect.

And I’m still a lover of life. Even on hard days – when both kids are crying and a deadline is looming – I try to find one small joy. A hot cup of tea. A hug that lasts three seconds longer than usual.

**Why did I come back to Hive?**

Because I missed writing. I missed the feeling of sharing real life and being rewarded for it – not just in crypto, but in connection. As a mom, entrepreneur, author, and now wife, every little bit helps.


**I want to write about:**

- The honest, unfiltered side of raising two boys – from single mom to married mom
- How I balance marriage, motherhood, business, and creative work
- My journey from graphic design to video editing and instructional design

**I’d love to hear from you.**

- If you’re a parent – how did you handle the transition from one kid to two?
- If you’ve written a book – what was the scariest part of publishing?
- If you’ve also gone through loss and found love again – I’d love to know your story.
- If you’re returning after a long break – say hi so I can follow you back.

**Next post preview:**

The biggest lesson I learned from my first year with two children. You won’t want to miss it.

Thank you for welcoming me back. It feels good to be home.

With love,
Boysmomhustling

title.title: The magic of collecting biscuit children [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQv3wNvVevnSA38fzrrC5k5U1JSki62kU9Dpddi71CaWG/1781561512062.jpg)


***
***
There is a small collection in my house that constantly steals a smile from me. They are not valuable objects or museum antiques. They are six biscuit children, the kind made of matte porcelain, who live on a shelf in the living room, right next to the old stereo system.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmefTdijs2EhuAfF5hWkzowX9tH3hhvGD93yu8uW2m812D/1781561155458.jpg)

***
They have been there for as long as I can remember, arriving one by one as gifts from aunts or finds at fairs. My mother arranged them with that logic of hers that only she understands. One stands with an enormous hat, another talks on the phone, a girl holds a tiny insect, and two are playing in a very funny way. They are small and fragile, the kind that makes you unconsciously lower your voice when you look at them.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbBgnZrjJC25MgJq1bCz5R27XW5DWrL1iTuXA4pwZpRDk/1781561155697.jpg)


***
But what has always captivated me about them is not the delicacy of their clothes or the matte sheen of the porcelain, it is their gaze and their little faces.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxXzRfkZYroxXsR1yurHY8kME9MaNGeNQ94MycxCerqP/1781561155777.jpg)

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHYUXikPQJi1gGwPMCGcceqsD6PidYBSYJUQLB6zeK4M/1781561178720.jpg)


***
The porcelain, in the hands of the artist who shaped them, managed to capture innocence. Their cheeks are round, slightly pink, and their big eyes look forward with a mixture of curiosity and wonder, as if everything they see were new and marvelous. They do not have that forced pose of some ornaments; on the contrary, there is a naturalness about them like real children, with a barely trembling lower lip, a clear forehead, and their head slightly tilted.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdDvtbHPNRNFrBYs7hZWdLLJdQzQTCnzxpGyS9BKjcuHT/1781561178929.jpg)
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJXfEK6cPwhVZSkTjjqyjpSapKrLGwzQdKoJocNMBoUq/1781561178977.jpg)


***
There is one in particular, a seated one, that melts my heart. Its little face has such a pure expression of tenderness that it makes you want to hug it. I do not know exactly what it is, but it reminds me of those photos of my dad when he was little, before life etched worry lines onto his face. That same light in the eyes, that same trust that everything is fine.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejPUHweGKMf639dowe8igBeoQESZ5JaH2mVjdfv8Ymsu/1781561178793.jpg)
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbdjqgWh2UZLKauUDuqu1Zg9A5jYWq5Mm2SnuXGQUBvki/1781561178849.jpg)


***
Sometimes I spend a while looking at the biscuit children and think about how fragile innocence is, just like porcelain, so beautiful, so easy to break, where a single fall or moment of carelessness shatters the charm into pieces, just like in real life.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQRaNvJbA4adqyquaKC3JpN6Ny1aCiDiLt11ZYRwfvAt/1781561203075.jpg)


***
But there they are, unchanging, oblivious to the evening news or the bills piling up on the table, living in their eternal bubble of quiet games and rosy cheeks. Mom cleans them every week with a soft cloth, arranges them, and looks at them, telling me they bring her peace.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNPLHVD1QER9uD1QicN3T1j2vNrwePL9uCoR3aUstcHux/1781561155563.jpg)


***
Maybe that is why she keeps them. These six biscuit children are a silent reminder of a part of ourselves that we do not want to fully lose. I know it sounds corny, but there is something on that shelf next to the old portraits that anchors me. In a world that sometimes insists on making us hard, those porcelain faces remind me that it is okay to keep a corner for tenderness.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpConUjEWoQ1Q7Uogd3qCvfhG4AMDhXKvxjMd965kv2z/1781561155639.jpg)


***
So yes, my mother has a collection of biscuit children, but I actually believe she takes care of a small garden of gazes that have not yet lost faith in the simple things.

<center>❤️‍🩹</center>
<center>❤️‍🩹</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeTdEXkKDvQsv1MkcAEMthgQ3dA9hMceEye4t8ViLUQc/1781521114750.jpg)

### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>La magia de coleccionar niños de biscuit</center>





![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma3sQYW3VXmfzpKgmtfiFeVZG2ZwbGvpFvAqxfokaAGK4/1781561511942.jpg)



***
***

Hay una pequeña colección en mi casa que a cada rato me roba una sonrisa. No son objetos valiosos ni antigüedades de museo. Son seis niños de biscuit, de esos de porcelana mate, que viven en una repisa de la sala, justo al lado del viejo equipo de sonido.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmefTdijs2EhuAfF5hWkzowX9tH3hhvGD93yu8uW2m812D/1781561155458.jpg)


***
Llevan ahí desde que tengo memoria y llegaron uno a uno, regalos de tías o hallazgos de ferias, y mamá los fue acomodando con ese criterio suyo que solo ella entiende. Una está de pie con un sombrero enorme, otra llama por teléfono, una niña sostiene un insecto diminuto y hay dos que juegan de manera muy divertida. Son pequeños, frágiles, de esos que uno mira y, sin querer, baja la voz.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbBgnZrjJC25MgJq1bCz5R27XW5DWrL1iTuXA4pwZpRDk/1781561155697.jpg)


***
Pero lo que siempre me ha atrapado de ellos no es la delicadeza de sus ropas o el brillo mate de la porcelana, es la mirada y las caritas.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxXzRfkZYroxXsR1yurHY8kME9MaNGeNQ94MycxCerqP/1781561155777.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHYUXikPQJi1gGwPMCGcceqsD6PidYBSYJUQLB6zeK4M/1781561178720.jpg)


***
La porcelana, en manos del artista que los modeló, logró atrapar la inocencia. Las mejillas son redondas, ligeramente rosadas, y sus ojos grandes miran al frente con una mezcla de curiosidad y asombro, como si todo lo que vieran fuera nuevo y maravilloso. No tienen esa pose forzada de algunos adornos, al contrario, hay en ellos una naturalidad de niños de verdad, con el labio inferior apenas tembloroso, la frente despejada y la cabeza ligeramente inclinada.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdDvtbHPNRNFrBYs7hZWdLLJdQzQTCnzxpGyS9BKjcuHT/1781561178929.jpg)
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJXfEK6cPwhVZSkTjjqyjpSapKrLGwzQdKoJocNMBoUq/1781561178977.jpg)


***
Hay uno en particular, uno sentado que me parte el alma. Su carita tiene una expresión de ternura tan pura que dan ganas de abrazarlo. No sé bien qué tiene, pero me recuerda a esas fotos de mi papá cuando era chico, antes de que la vida le pusiera arrugas de preocupaciones. Esa misma luz en los ojos, esa misma confianza en que todo está bien.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejPUHweGKMf639dowe8igBeoQESZ5JaH2mVjdfv8Ymsu/1781561178793.jpg)
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbdjqgWh2UZLKauUDuqu1Zg9A5jYWq5Mm2SnuXGQUBvki/1781561178849.jpg)


***
A veces me quedo un rato mirando a los niños de biscuit y pienso en lo frágil que es la inocencia, como la porcelana, tan bella, tan fácil de romper, que con una caída o un descuido el encanto se hace pedazos, igual que en la vida real.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQRaNvJbA4adqyquaKC3JpN6Ny1aCiDiLt11ZYRwfvAt/1781561203075.jpg)


***
Pero allí están ellos, inmutables, ajenos al noticiero de la tarde o a las cuentas que se acumulan en la mesa, mientras viven en su burbuja eterna de juegos callados y mejillas sonrosadas. Mamá los limpia cada semana con un paño suave, los acomoda y los mira, mientras me dice que le dan tranquilidad.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNPLHVD1QER9uD1QicN3T1j2vNrwePL9uCoR3aUstcHux/1781561155563.jpg)


***
Quizá por eso los conserva. Es que esos seis niños de biscuit son un recordatorio silencioso de una parte de nosotros que no queremos perder del todo. Sé que suena cursi, pero hay algo en esa repisa, junto a los retratos viejos, que me ancla. En un mundo que a veces se empeña en hacernos duros, esas caritas de porcelana me recuerdan que está bien guardar un rincón para la ternura.

title.title: Which Factors Should You Consider Before Installing a Home Elevator in Delhi?
title.body:
![A Complete Checklist Before Installing a Home Elevator in Delhi.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/0b5498ad21f64f48a04e0dd53b532064e2d1341583a02d5787478b8ff5a0a6a3)



Installing a home elevator is a significant investment that can improve convenience, accessibility, and property value. However, before making a decision, homeowners should carefully evaluate several important factors to ensure a successful installation.

The first consideration is available space. Assess whether your property has sufficient room for the elevator shaft, pit, and overhead clearance. Understanding the structural requirements beforehand can help avoid costly modifications later.

Next, determine the right elevator type based on your home's layout and usage needs. Options such as traction, hydraulic, and [MRL elevators](https://atticoelevators.com/our-products/mrl-elevator/) offer different benefits in terms of performance, maintenance, and space requirements.

Budget planning is equally important. Beyond the elevator's purchase price, consider installation costs, customization options, maintenance expenses, and future servicing requirements. A clear understanding of the [home elevator installation process](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/complete-checklist-before-installing-home-elevator-delhi-1vflc) can help homeowners plan timelines and budgets more effectively.

Safety features should never be overlooked. Look for essential features such as automatic rescue devices, emergency alarms, battery backup, door interlocks, and overload protection systems.

Finally, choose a reputable elevator company with proven experience in residential projects. Professional consultation, quality installation, and reliable after-sales support are key factors that ensure your home elevator operates safely and efficiently for years to come.

Another season of Splinterlands has come to an end and this time I tried a different strategy.
For the last few seasons I had been focusing more on Foundations mode but this time I played Survival mode.

It was much more fun for me as I could use the Chaos and Untamed cards I had not used for ages. Using the old strategies and combinations was nostalgic.


![Survival Silver III Rewards.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4jmhfdNiqSeFEDm3aoWRZ1Eaht9kcp987gLLD5sosrN/Survival%20Silver%20III%20Rewards.png)

When I look at the overall season stats I do feel proud as despite the heavy competition I faced after Bronze III I was able to manage 74% win rate. 
I think very few people are playing Survival which makes it easy to have a high win rate initially but as you move into Silver league you realize the few people playing have fully loaded collections so beating them is nearly impossible.

The rewards of 40,000 Glint made the effort worthwhile. I am not sure what the Ascension Token does. If you know then let me know in the comments.

I also got 3 Foundations pack from the matches played in that mode. I am wondering what to focus on this season. Should I focus back on Foundations or continue to play Survival mode to collect higher amount of Glint. Maybe like last time balance between both modes.

title.title: Fasciated Soldier Fly
title.body: > In a quiet corner of the forest, damp with morning dew, I once again discovered a beautiful insect resting peacefully on a blade of grass. It was a Fasciated Soldier Fly, a member of the Stratiomyidae family. This fly is one of the more difficult to find, and it's not easy to approach. Most of them are quite wild. There are many similar flies in the area I visited, but most of them didn't want to be approached.

> When I saw this fly didn't leave when I approached, I was delighted and couldn't wait to photograph it. The fly's long, delicate body made it a bit difficult to photograph. During the photo session, there was also a gust of wind, which made it even more challenging. The wind continued to dance the leaf, but the fly didn't waver. It remained calmly standing there, as if it had fully understood that life isn't always smooth sailing.

> As the sun began to shine and touched the fly's body, its tiny body reflected a beautiful sheen. The golden brown blended beautifully with the metallic green. The brilliance of nature is truly stunning and often overlooked. Amidst this expanse of fresh grass, this tiny fly is proof that nature's charm doesn't always come in the form of something grand and majestic. Sometimes it's tiny and rarely noticed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc73Szo4Q3FU4gZkWmyx61FYsUfmZ5iT8CmoaXea1BHv3/1781576444132.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZJnD7xJgggxxT56px84cuGNuYWdmeNSnp32uSWqdGeZw/1781576444258.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSqAesyLjZT3uKq5MzbFuzHLvDxoMq4ZZWMV9NwP3xNjL/1781576444382.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcM7GxUyubynhdESCdgqfwq4LAyVBAkbH3ibcwjDDn1rm/1781576444530.jpg) Latin name | Sargus fasciatus | - | - | Observation date | 16 Jun, 2026 Camera used | realme 7 Pro Photographers | @reachdreams Location | Aceh, Indonesia | Link to original community | | - | https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/372157277 Latitude | Longitude | Map | - | - | - | 4.695135 | 96.7493993 | https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=4.695135&mlon=96.7493993

title.title: Partially Offline
title.body:
>


> Not a relaxing coffee.

I am on the train to a customer this morning and bought a coffee, since I didn't have time to brew one at home before leaving. Once on the train, I had a sip, grabbed my laptop out and started reading a few random things before settling into write, as I booked a seat with a table in the middle, as normal - if I can. There are several on each train that don't require extra payment and since I am heading into the middle of nowhere, there is space. I took another sip and noticed a wet coffee ring. That's weird - I don't remember slurping it and I always triple check the lid to ensure it is secure. 

> Bloody cup was leaking. 

The seal at the bottom was rapidly giving way and with it full and nowhere close by to pour it out, I had to scull it down like a frat boy losing at beer pong. Suffice to say, it wasn't the relaxing coffee I had in mind when I bought it. I guess the caffeine still works the same though. 

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/242DGWoDjY4ndXwsajgQp7mm8miZZtM39Go7VywSs9Wv4pVdsifpntGxHLsuXyBNJTxkm.png)



---

And I think I will need it, as I only scraped in at five hours of sleep last night, since I can't sleep too early, and had to be up again at five in the morning to get to the train on time. That is okay - five hours is only an hour or so less than what I normally get, but, it does make a difference. I think that while I sleep quite little in comparison to many, I reckon I am a pretty efficient sleeper, mostly falling asleep within 10-20 minutes, and not waking up too often throughout the night, especially now that I have the CPAP machine for my sleep apnoea. So, this means that losing an hour or so has more of an effect on me, as it really makes an impact on the quality. However, I also have plenty of experience living life on too little sleep, so the noticeable effect to others is probably pretty low. 

I decided to write a post rather than answer comments first, because the connection is cutting in and out. This way, I can write and it will save occasionally, without me losing it. However, I think I will have a break for lunch (not always guaranteed) that I can get to some comments. 

While it is frustrating to lose connection on the train, I am not one of those people who complain too hard about it, considering that we are travelling 200 kilometres an hour through the middle of nowhere, and I am sharing my phone connection to the laptop. I could connect to the train wifi, which would likely work fine, but you know - public networks and me are not the greatest of friends. So, given all this, I can understand a few connection issues and going offline. 

> I think we get spoiled too quickly.

Once we have access to something, we seem to expect we are entitled to always have access to it. A new technology advances and we rapidly forget what it was like not too long earlier. Dial up 28.8k modems was where I started on the internet, with pictures loading visibly a pixel at a time. Downloading even relatively small warez programmes took up to a week. And internet porn was only images. 

We are now living in the lap of digital luxury (in much of the world) yet forget that we are actually not entitled to anything in this life at all. It doesn't matter what we think we deserve, or even what the norms are, the universe just doesn't care. So while we feel we should get something, it doesn't mean we will. And being a good person or a bad person, doesn't really affect some of our outcomes. The \

is far from the whole truth, but what it represents is that no matter what one does, randomisation doesn't care about *just desserts.*

> Justice is a human concept.

And when it comes to being \

I think that we should probably spend more time at least *partially offline,* as the view from the digital landscape warps the perspective of reality. Just like becoming accustomed to technological advancement, we start to expect certain outcomes based on what we consume digitally, which shifts our own behaviours and expectations of others. We create personal filters and heuristics on our consumption, and they don't always align well with the reality we face, so we end up in situations we are unprepared for, and unable to cope with well. Disconnecting for a while and actually living in reality with some level of awareness, will very quickly uncover many of our various biases that we have created and allow us to reprogramme our conditioning. And it is conditioning, which yes, is largely engineered by corporations to control and milk us, but we have to be a willing partner in the crime, choosing to keep on consuming blindly. Like many, I have been limiting my own connection to the digital world for some time, and spend very little of my screen time on pure entertainment. Instead, I see screen time as an opportunity to do something useful, not as an escape from doing something useful. Not always of course, but probably ninety percent of the time. > I guess I am not an outlier. But I do think that on average, most people use digital spaces as an escape and avoidance tool a lot of the time, but justify their activity under various reasons, like relaxation. Yet, I wonder if it really is a good way to relax in front of a screen, or if it is like smoking where the relaxation comes from the easing of the desire, the addiction. I suspect a lot of the latter. Maybe I am justifying also. title.title: Una Sorpresa en la Olla / A surprise in the pot
title.body:
<center>

Va caminando un insecto,
por la cocina sin misterio,
es azul con un ojo inmenso,
un animal bastante excéntrico.

Lleva sujetado a su pata,
una olla con tapa,
la arrastra con gracia,
y cuando está cansado a su lado descansa. 

>An insect is walking,
through the kitchen, nothing out of the ordinary,
it’s blue with a huge eye,
a rather eccentric creature.

>Clamped to its leg
is a pot with a lid,
it drags it along gracefully,
and when it gets tired, it rests right next to it.


![69974.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xpD98SAC944ikxFX8eCM6sT8FuXfHki7vNQG15UVRUBma2HW1AGF1kZc9EuhmyaPNHV.gif)

Cuando se queda dormido,
entro sin hacer ruido,
la olla con cuidado reviso
y descubro que es un recipiente vacío. 

Esto, lo puedo solucionar 
y me voy a buscar material,
dibujo un huevo frito con habilidad
y con esto la olla vacía no estará. 

>When he falls asleep,
I slip in quietly,
I carefully check the pot
and find it’s empty.

>I can fix this,
so I go look for some supplies,
I skillfully draw a fried egg,
and now the pot won’t be empty anymore.


![69976.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xybWfYn1xaJgZJBhYxmpfJxapYHjGgAUdv7AcjsqoXDoAy9s5o1qDZYGMdWi3LwHLST.gif)

Me voy caminando de regreso
y el insecto sigue durmiendo,
pongo en la olla, el huevo 
y me marcho bien lejos.

Y cuando el animal despierta,
revisa la olla y comida encuentra,
esto es un milagro, ya tiene la cena
y no importa que de papel sea. 

>I walk back home,
and the insect is still sleeping,
I put the egg in the pot
and walk far away.

>And when the animal wakes up,
it checks the pot and finds food,
it’s a miracle—it already has dinner,
and it doesn’t matter that it’s made of paper. 


![69975.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23wqnWs2RdELRaxYE5Bm5edNjaKW7ekmyXAX1BWoQAjy5PBesrVH8kmcrwa15UJKk2rCk.gif)

What is the most beautiful and powerful biblical teaching in forgiveness of sin?
So that portion that I wish God has mercy on us, give us the opportunity to live a righteous life again.

 That has been the teaching of God to live a life of love and the will of God is to save the human race. Forgiveness is not just that spiritual concept, it is a life transforming and profound process. This gives us peace, liberty and healing.

When we discuss forgiveness of sins, we have to know what that sin truly is. Sin is like the opposite of the commandment of God. The issue is that none of the human beings has done nothing wrong before God, but it could be lies and robberies and pride and hatred. These are all sins that go against the commandment of God.

The MCGI has given us the message that forgiveness is achieved through repentance. Without repentance, we cannot receive forgiveness. We must admit our wrongdoings first.

Repentance is just a message that I'm sorry and I'm willing to amend my ways. So we have been, this has helped us to realize that forgiveness is also made possible through Jesus Christ. This is a very significant teaching. So in our self-reflection, we have to understand that forgiveness has no forgiveness without repentance.

https://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=E7dqa18WKjASgIVK

Our internal life is also obeyed by the forgiveness of our sins. This is a great guarantee that we have to keep doing what is right. Forgiveness is not a one-time action, it's a way of life which shows the art of God.
