title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=angelmitu/xgoejn4v

The villagers must be rescued.Smart Boy will go ahead to rescue the villagers.Today I recorded a game called Smart Boys.The main character of the game is Smart Boy.Smart Boy will cross the jungle and mountains at the risk of his life to save the villagers.Let's discuss this 2D Plfm game.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSCZwkms3NZBfz674nhn7Xk9hhsqnADmdeijRvY7Rt8q6/1781573360806.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYGQK2vqKguUskPXBHHFJEWqAF7KrcyaC477foL2ZrurZ/screenshot_20260616_072958_2.png)

I really like this 2D platform game and its design is excellent.The first scene shows villagers being taken captive by tribal jungle demons.They take the villagers captive and Smart Boy comes forward to rescue those villagers.Smart Boy will cross some dangerous road to protect them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmccnJZgtc9cgZeCU5dQWgkkhuKPM3AjpBN6TG2pmkQwva/1781573549320.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8ZBvo8dmeQMmnzqhrvem6wF2faPShoTHjVr5E77sDQV/screenshot_20260616_073252_2.png)

I am on the screen as Smart Boy, now I will play this game.After capturing the villagers, the villagers contacted Smart Boy and requested him to rescue them.Upon receiving their request, Smart Boy set out to rescue them and proceeded through the dangerous road.Mountain jungle roads that are very dangerous have various insects.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVLcGPwgiazFQwpWKswybDmDdtPieotDujcYXhnHoQ2zi/screenshot_20260616_073445_2.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRKavSAgF5q4LL6WWJCWpN89H6sUNLxZkUQtX1aJLBTf/1781573798480.jpg)

So smart boy means I went ahead and went forward with courage.I killed the insects in the jungle and went forward and collected the coins.Collecting the coins is important here.To move forward on this path, I need to collect coins and collect hearts.Because if Smart Boy dies on this road, the coins can bring back his heart.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNsxTMFD8KV2oPoEFsWVLpVFEMTTniBZCM8fXReuzmfB5/screenshot_20260616_074230_2.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbd9429uiAukTpMrw3x1iVp17q7Dn21Ygp7HXkvLEBXU6/screenshot_20260616_073722_2.png)

So, Smart Boy passed the first level very skillfully and won.Smart Boy leaves the first level behind and enters the second level.Then he moved forward with more courage.What's on the second level?

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgprbqSiuqcmUtWVLfwsKcAayoxNu2PMfywsqP4KeaXY/1781574092354.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeqzyHVzyRR1mgkC6dd2twxMqeBt2aYTShJYMhu9JxyPS/screenshot_20260616_074311_2.png)

The second level has jungle roads, rivers, and other dangerous things.On the one hand, I have to move forward and protect yourself.So in the second level I went ahead and killed insects with utmost courage and collected coins.I won the second level.Finally won the second level.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSS4SnTvFcqjGLmhTW2ukumHLagA9jYcBrixDcTZECgLh/screenshot_20260616_074350_2.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNf5SZmkHmj2tSBSudCr5u5AzEdcrWUYYfJLkhK9XBHNX/1781574338323.jpg)

I started moving forward as soon as I entered the third level and kept moving forward, overcoming all the obstacles on the road.I reached my destination after overcoming all the dangers on the third level.There is a palace at the end of the third level.I need to enter that palace and open the lock but I didn't have the key.

title.title: Gratinated ripe plantain with tomato, bell pepper and cheese in the air fryer (Eng-Esp)
title.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpA5UzUvTDa3n6UQ2awLEVPXdL7P9iPy5KvhCQTNs95qvmEjEyVadEcpqYv6NvP2eyQ.png)</center>

* Good evening, Hivefood friends! I wish you a happy start to the week. This time, I'm sharing my first air fryer recipe with you. I hope you enjoy the process; I'm sure you'll love it!
Let's put on our aprons to make a delicious gratin of ripe plantain with tomato, bell pepper, and cheese.

>* Buenas noches amigos de hivefood, les deseo un feliz comienzo de semana... En esta ocasión, comparto con ustedes mi primera receta en el air fryer... espero que disfruten el proceso, estoy segura que les encantará!
Pongámonos el delantal para realizar un \

.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/243MDXD8Uo5aTU2nSQbt3TiBLSeuzb9NESAsQS3WktUTHRcsWKSBJmXV4Fy31L4QnM6z7.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: ripe plantains, white cheese, tomatoes, red peppers, onion, pepper, eggs, oregano powder, herbs, mild olive oil and salt.

>* INGREDIENTES: plátanos maduros, queso blanco, tomates, pimientos rojos, cebolla, pimienta, huevos, orégano en polvo, finas hierbas, aceite de oliva suave y sal.

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* Add mild olive oil to the pan and sauté the onion and bell pepper. Cook for 2 minutes, then add the ripe tomatoes (seeds removed).
At this stage, season with black pepper, herbs, and salt to taste. Cook over medium heat until all the vegetables are soft. Set aside for the final step.

>* Integramos aceite de oliva suave al sartén, sofreímos la cebolla junto con el pimiento... Salteamos durante 2 minutos, añadimos los tomates maduros (extraemos las semillas).
En este paso aliñamos con: pimienta negra, finas hierbas y sal al gusto. Cocinamos a fuego \

hasta que todas las verduras se suavicen. Reservamos para utilizar en el paso final.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xKxiVUCd2bDPW8xaeaJMdojamQfPCCzEj9dP7oXNMwpYzS4qhtwchGjmxJamiHyXKre.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23viCP1jde7Vw6ydEUZi8C8WmVzcaM1eM6ZjysfK2zb97AsW5xprkQvChcr6rZtLGy6Aj.png)</center>

* Next, we add the plantain... We make a small horizontal cut, cut it into medium-sized pieces. We cook until they are lightly browned.

>* A continuación, agregamos el plátano... Realizamos un pequeño corte horizontal, cortamos en trozos medianos. Cocinamos hasta que se doren ligeramente.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoiY6EfyPMkqYZB8NJ1qo66jT8Mh8nzXsDKWnUg64Ra57AumN9eW59m4fz9a6yPksRL.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgU9J9N4gmvXAGLQ44rNwJAyTeWXXSwJVWFpAfWFtzETvphyPr1qNkhUkkVQ3MwSL4N.png)</center>

* Place the plantains in a deep bowl and mash them with a fork until you have a smooth puree. Add the reserved sautéed tomato, peppers, and onion.
Add the eggs and mix well. Stir in the cheese.

>* Colocamos los plátanos en un envase hondo, con ayuda de un tenedor trituramos hasta conseguir un puré homogéneo... Añadimos el sofrito de tomate, pimientos y cebolla que teníamos reservado.
Agregamos los huevos, mezclamos hasta integrar bien... Incorporamos el queso.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/244oh9zWKbUg1NZzUd8ong8adXMiwCCDcyqRddhExNAJYqSZGsJ79gcuTfvqSX3WRnw7T.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/244UxJxH1f8m23K9wLhAqnEgoo5TtCd5rSSzoEcSy87X239x9qjEfX386uwgyAg4zP1YE.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/243fxyQRoQmJBkm5QgNGEPAQ4jEvc1KCvhTXB8hsuHDbyyuTQiP7FYy9PjEsMEDPm4ABt.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yToecPHZFBF1b5xo86uCvVtKZ8LRgBFjV8ZcLAQeW93R7pze3Di9Tuurw7DbicAummz.png)</center>

* We add our delicious mixture to the air fryer... We cook until it's golden brown.
We wait for it to cool slightly before removing the parchment paper.

>* Integramos nuestra suculenta mezcla en el air fryer... Cocinamos hasta comprobar que se gratinó.
Esperamos que se enfríe un poco para extraer el papel.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xpF13GKncuYykk9jtWt3Lrx6Ta6QeHX1FQdbwXkMZiq4PQsYfRNPFaLo7cJFUhnDsyF.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Ep1YkoMNXH1bU9WpUH43QeK47v5f3dkTrsz2bm9JzHo3EDSTEnfVxcM11uh1s7qiifk.png)</center>

* Friends, here's our healthy, nutritious, and delicious dish—an excellent option to enjoy with your family... A true treat!
Thank you so much for visiting my blog. Enjoy your meal!

title.title: Re: suzanne7's post
title.body:
You have a really good view of Hive, that's for sure. Seeing it as one of those games where you level up to conquer and things like that is fantastic. That part reminded me of Solo Leveling, which is a popular anime where the protagonist levels up until he becomes practically invincible.

You can be the Sung Jinwo (name of the protagonist of Solo Leveling, if I'm not mistaken) of Hive! You can level up Orca and thus obtain better rewards by curating content. If I'm not mistaken, right now the APR generated by HP (Hive in Staking, in the end) is between 4-14% depending on how much you vote on content. That's more than what the HBD APR in Staking currently gives, which is 12%.

Besides that, there's what you said about delegating to other projects, but that will depend on which project you decide to support, and for that you need to do good research to get to know the project well and so on. I have my own personal opinion about the delegations, so I'd better not comment further on the matter.

I know that if you focus on continuing to share the content you love to create, you'll do well. Personally, I recommend that you do this because you enjoy it, rather than out of obligation or for some other reason or motive. That's why I like the idea of making Hive into a video game, because treating it as something else right now doesn't do much good. Only if you have a long-term vision or something like that, I don't know. There's still a lot you can do in Hive, that's for sure.

Of course, there are also the communities and all the people you know and those yet to be met on Hive. I would honestly like to see more content from you, not just music, but also the games you mentioned and any other hobbies you have. 

It's always good to read you. 🤗

title.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23y8N5wm8uxJRFGRmbSfc6H2sFdDxiSztW3GwUkMw7NZoxUwJBwqsSouup7dud3LJgvG3.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 16.06.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uEx4G56gXvQyMdmUQ6r1MmzD7JRUh9dqJsFNbDtnzPDZSMBFLTn6D7aPywKw9PjTzST.jpg)

---

## 📰 NEWS

### ***Rada Europy zhakowana przez ShinyHunters — atak przez tę samą lukę Oracle PeopleSoft***

The Register ujawnia: ShinyHunters użyli tego samego zero-daya Oracle PeopleSoft do włamania się do systemów Rady Europy — organizacji strzegącej praw człowieka i standardów demokratycznych dla 46 państw kontynentu. Naruszenie daje potencjalny dostęp do danych organizacyjnych, projektów rezolucji, korespondencji dyplomatycznej i danych pracowników. To symbolicznie i politycznie jedno z ważniejszych celów ShinyHunters w 2026 roku: instytucja promująca wartości demokratyczne zhakowana przez grupę przestępczą operującą prawdopodobnie z obszarów poza zasięgiem europejskich służb. Rada Europy potwierdziła incydent i prowadzi dochodzenie.

*Źródło: [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/cyber-crime/2026/06/15/council-of-europe-hacked-in-shinyhunters-peoplesoft-heist/5255757) [EN]*

---

### ***Microsoft 365 Copilot — nowa luka jednym kliknięciem wykrada wszystkie dostępne dane***

The Hacker News i BleepingComputer opisują krytyczną podatność w Microsoft 365 Copilot: spreparowany link wysłany do użytkownika M365 może nakłonić Copilota do automatycznej eksfiltracji wszystkich danych dostępnych przez AI — e-maili, dokumentów Teams, plików SharePoint — na serwer atakującego. Atak wykorzystuje mechanizm prompt injection przez zewnętrzne dane odczytywane przez Copilota (np. treść e-maila od atakującego). Jedno kliknięcie przez ofiarę uruchamia cały łańcuch. Microsoft jest powiadamiany i pracuje nad poprawką — tymczasowo rozważ ograniczenie uprawnień Copilota do odczytu zewnętrznych zasobów.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u5VDQQP35Xq4yMyVbq2kagn4Q9LXYKfd29tWSMPanjPbJo6eug8WmF5GXsXJ7b7rnjL.png)

*Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/one-click-microsoft-365-copilot-flaw.html) [EN], [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/new-attack-turned-microsoft-365-copilot-into-1-click-data-theft-tool/) [EN]*

---

### ***Polska Dolina Kwantowa powstanie w Krakowie — pierwsze centrum technologii kwantowych***

CRN.pl informuje: Polska ogłosiła budowę pierwszego krajowego centrum technologii kwantowych — \

w Krakowie. Inicjatywa skupia Akademię Górniczo-Hutniczą, Politechnikę Krakowską, Jagiellońskie centrum naukowe i partnerów przemysłowych. Centrum ma rozwijać polskie kompetencje w kryptografii post-kwantowej, komputerach kwantowych i komunikacji kwantowej — technologiach kluczowych dla przyszłości cyberbezpieczeństwa i suwerenności technologicznej. Projekt jest finansowany z funduszy europejskich i krajowych i stanowi odpowiedź na strategiczne inicjatywy kwantowe USA i Chin.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/243fpB2VMdBiRsJ59qo3oFEWTpqsyHhAzwKhWkEWNm8vXHQt6jwNe8ZuwZjoG8h2uBGQd.png)

*Źródło: [CRN.pl](https://crn.pl/aktualnosci/polska-dolina-kwantowa-powstanie-w-krakowie/) [PL]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Chińscy hakerzy przez rok kradli wyniki badań medycznych z sieci instytucji naukowych***

BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek i The Register opisują kampanię szpiegowską, którą Google/Mandiant identyfikuje jako operację powiązaną z ChRL: przez ponad rok napastnicy ukrywali się w sieciach instytucji prowadzących badania medyczne w Ameryce Północnej, eksfiltrując wyniki prób klinicznych, dane genomiczne i badania nad nowymi terapiami. Atakujący kompromitowali serwery RedCap — popularnej platformy do zarządzania danymi badań klinicznych. Ukradziona wiedza medyczna może posłużyć do budowania konkurencyjnych produktów farmaceutycznych lub bioobronnych.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23ycu3CaNFZfhJSwhYDt2ypgYWZSsd4THBdsMQYwVSkobjed9he92hm78JYvnyGAffZv4.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/chinese-hackers-breach-redcap-servers-steal-medical-research/) [EN], [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/chinese-hackers-target-medical-military-and-ai-research-in-north-america/) [EN], [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/research/2026/06/15/google-says-prc-linked-spies-hid-in-medical-research-networks-for-more-than-a-year/5254547) [EN]*

---

### ***Ransomware paralizuje australijskiego producenta cukru — zamknięto zakłady produkcyjne***

SecurityWeek opisuje atak ransomware na drugiego co do wielkości australijskiego producenta cukru: zaatakowano systemy OT (Operational Technology) sterujące zakładami przetwórczymi, co zmusiło firmę do czasowego zamknięcia linii produkcyjnych w szczytowym sezonie. To rzadki i niepokojący przykład ransomware faktycznie wstrzymującego produkcję fizyczną — nie tylko wykradającego dane. Sektor rolno-spożywczy pozostaje krytyczną infrastrukturą, lecz jego zabezpieczenia OT są często znacznie słabsze niż w energetyce czy telekomunikacji.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23ynUjEFoK9VXC15zhrrzbvRWevR3UWyNK6j2ndvXeAbz8qQQFfam5hL8K7xjwf7vHpCE.png)

*Źródło: [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/ransomware-attack-shuts-down-mills-of-australias-second-largest-sugar-producer/) [EN]*

---

### ***Supply chain przez CDN Awesome Motive — tysiące stron WordPress zainfekowane przez popularnego dostawcę***

Security Affairs i Infosecurity Magazine opisują atak supply chain na sieć dystrybucji treści (CDN) firmy Awesome Motive — twórcy popularnych wtyczek WordPress (OptinMonster, WPForms, All in One SEO). Zainfekowane pliki CDN były dostarczane do stron klientów przy każdym załadowaniu strony, instalując złośliwy JavaScript zbierający dane odwiedzających. Aweso Motive obsługuje miliony stron WordPress — skala potencjalnej ekspozycji jest ogromna. Firma usunęła złośliwy kod po zgłoszeniu.

https://assets.infosecurity-magazine.com/webpage/feat/6df80c06-57ce-4988-a767-324fa1c223b5.jpg

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/193616/malware/supply-chain-attack-hits-popular-wordpress-plugins-through-awesome-motive-cdn.html) [EN], [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/wordpress-plugin-supply-chain/) [EN]*

---

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***152 rozszerzenia Chrome z ukrytym malware — tapety i motywy kryjące złodziei danych***

The Hacker News ujawnia odkrycie badaczy: 152 rozszerzenia do Chrome udające popularne tapety i motywy (wallpaper extensions) zawierały ukryty kod złośliwy zbierający dane przeglądania, ciasteczka sesji i poświadczenia. Rozszerzenia były dostępne w Chrome Web Store przez wiele miesięcy i zebrały łącznie miliony instalacji. Google usunęło je po otrzymaniu raportu. To kolejny dowód, że Chrome Web Store — mimo mechanizmów weryfikacji — nie jest wystarczającą ochroną przed złośliwymi rozszerzeniami. Ogranicz liczbę instalowanych rozszerzeń do minimum.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wCQuWLLNrAcbxvwM1sw8G4Ye4KgeLHo5Q2oPKAwTXRhX7j8jQFY9afRXC1mfbEGznZm.png)

*Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/152-chrome-wallpaper-extensions-with.html) [EN]*

---

### ***Polska rozważa \
— przechowywanie danych państwowych za granicą***\n\nCyberDefence24 opisuje koncepcję \

, którą rozważa Polska: przechowywanie krytycznych zasobów cyfrowych państwa — danych rządowych, kopii zapasowych rejestrów i systemów ciągłości działania — w bezpiecznych lokalizacjach za granicą, u zaprzyjaźnionych partnerów NATO. Wzorcem jest Estonia, która od lat przechowuje zaszyfrowaną kopię państwowych danych w Luxemburgu. Gdyby Polska była zaatakowana lub okupowana militarnie, państwo mogłoby kontynuować swoje funkcje z zdalnej infrastruktury. Artykuł omawia logistykę, koszty i wyzwania prawne takiego rozwiązania.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/245wKrtocypfPwrgE5HJotgsU8fkFneA8UJL6xWXeBWnWrV26Xtp2SYApX9NXs5eMes6K.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/technologie/polska-przeniesie-swoje-dane-za-granice-oto-czym-sa-cyfrowe-ambasady) [PL]*

---

## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***Polski generał NATO ofiara deepfake'owych reklam inwestycyjnych na TikToku***

CyberDefence24 opisuje nową falę dezinformacji: fałszywe zdjęcia i generowane przez AI filmiki z polskim generałem NATO promującymi schemat inwestycyjny masowo podbijają TikToka. Generał nie brał udziału w żadnych nagraniach — jego wizerunek i głos zostały podmienione cyfrowo. Kampania wykorzystuje autorytet munduru i instytucji wojskowej do uwiarygodnienia fałszywego systemu \

. To eskalacja: po polityku, premierze, prezydencie — teraz przestępcy używają wizerunków wojskowych.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQvQFiUDxX96Z5jR8qkdJzqTTbUAdpWh1eeKaxyJhzbT44YDdXNRCJX8mydBpJhaGre.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/polski-general-nato-ofiara-nowej-fali-oszustw-fejkowe-zdjecia-podbijaja-tiktoka) [PL]*

---

### ***17-latek zatrzymany — z konta ofiary zniknęło 98 tysięcy złotych***

Dobreprogramy opisują głośną sprawę z Małopolski: 17-latek został zatrzymany przez CBZC po tym, jak przeprowadził cyberatak na konto bankowe ofiary i przelał 98 000 złotych. Sprawca jest niepełnoletni, lecz w Polsce odpowiada karnie od 15 roku życia za poważne czyny. Sprawa odsłania narastający trend: bardzo młodzi sprawcy cyberprzestępstw korzystają z gotowych narzędzi i tutoriali dostępnych w darknecie i na Telegramie. CBZC podkreśla, że wiek sprawcy nie chroni go przed odpowiedzialnością przy tak wysokich kwotach strat.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wgHupn96WZpVFGcaoJWb5Lm2J77e33w3UBCRT1N8bVnZoCrr5oDYXcGX2T2Q4pwP9Rv.png)

*Źródło: [Dobreprogramy](https://www.dobreprogramy.pl/17-latek-zatrzymany-z-konta-ofiary-zniknelo-98-tys-zl,7297094537889792a) [PL]*

---

### ***Konto w VeloBank — jeśli dostaniesz tego SMS-a, musisz działać szybko***

Instalki informują o aktywnej kampanii phishingowej skierowanej bezpośrednio do klientów VeloBank: fałszywe SMS-y podszywają się pod powiadomienie bankowe o \

i kierują do strony imitującej portal bankowy. Scenariusz jest perfekcyjnie dostosowany do realnych procesów bankowych — przez co trudny do rozpoznania dla mniej doświadczonych użytkowników. VeloBank nigdy nie prosi o podanie pełnych danych karty lub kodu autoryzacyjnego przez SMS.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23z73JWxLpG7YzSXRxVbadZVkk3bWiAivMyi8HyY6A453BQ5Ljceh1tkvpiB5rfM5jP5N.png)

*Źródło: [Instalki.pl](https://www.instalki.pl/news/fintech/masz-konto-w-velobanku-jesli-dostaniesz-tego-sms-a-musisz-szybko-odpisac/) [PL]*

---

## 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER ВОЙНА

### ***Rosja werbuje studentów przez YouTube do budowania bojowych dronów***

CyberDefence24 opisuje odkrytą przez ukraińskie służby operację: kanały YouTube i grupy w mediach społecznościowych oferowały studentom politechnik i szkół technicznych dobrze płatne \

tworzenia komponentów do dronów FPV. Zadania wyglądały jak zwykły projekt inżynierski — dopiero po dostarczeniu komponentów okazywało się, że zasilają rosyjskie drony bojowe atakujące Ukrainę. YouTube zareagował blokując kanały po zgłoszeniu. To nowy wymiar hybrydowej mobilizacji przemysłowej: cyfrowe werbowanie zachodnich inżynierów do pracy na rzecz wrogich sił zbrojnych. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/241ZhSJQAJcUnZtz5mWm34a1QYS1wwKUJW35TfZxr4Ab5CBSq5GqceoZmvU2MGogV3yuZ.png) *Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/wojna-w-ukrainie/wabili-studentow-na-youtube-kazali-im-robic-rosyjskie-drony-ostra-reakcja-platformy) [PL]* --- ### ***Wielka Brytania zakazuje mediów społecznościowych dla dzieci do 16 roku życia od 2027*** Dobreprogramy i Telepolis relacjonują przełomową decyzję brytyjskiego parlamentu: od 2027 roku platformy takie jak TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat i Facebook będą prawnie zobowiązane do weryfikacji wieku i blokowania dostępu użytkownikom poniżej 16 roku życia. Naruszenie zakazu grozi karami finansowymi sięgającymi 10% globalnych przychodów platformy. Decyzja wywołała gorącą debatę: obrońcy praw cyfrowych ostrzegają przed technologiami inwigilacji służącymi do weryfikacji wieku, a aktywiści na rzecz ochrony dzieci chwalą precedens jako przełom. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/48QRCvK4drLmcJv5r6f1xsDxHou5H9K4zPVYgpRy52G238wT6HeW8XWgzF2MEamk88.png) *Źródło: [Dobreprogramy](https://www.dobreprogramy.pl/wielka-brytania-zdecydowala-zakaz-social-mediow-do-16-roku-zycia,7297130701142048a) [PL], [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/bezpieczenstwo/wielka-brytania-zakaz-mediow-spolecznosciowych-od-16-r-z-2027) [PL]* ----- *📅 Powyższe zestawienie ma charakter wyłącznie informacyjny i edukacyjny. Wszystkie informacje opierają się na publicznie dostępnych doniesieniach prasowych z dnia 15 czerwca 2026 r. ⚠️ W razie podejrzenia incydentu bezpieczeństwa skonsultuj się z wykwalifikowanym specjalistą.*

# _Bienvenidos a mi blog_ > _Welcome to my blog_ ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tGXuZrTPx4zw37uSynRFdxRJ7RLNvyJgzmQK3WSgbTfXejpENryg4uJuU4zFnxXZCUC.png)
# Volvimos al karate después de un tiempo 🥋

> Hola, amigos de Hive, en esta oportunidad, les hablaré un poco de todo lo que fue el regreso de mi hijo al Dojo, ya que desde hace casi un mes no íbamos por cuestión de cambios climático y también por congestión nasal que tenía mi hijo, además que aquí en el estado Monagas últimamente ha caído demasiada lluvia, es por eso que prefiero no llevarlo antes de que enferme. En este tiempo pasaron muchas cosas ya que mi hijo perdió la presentación de su pre examen debido al mal clima que había ese día, así que tuve que hablar con la sensei para ver si se lo podía realizar en otro día, y gracias a Dios lo podrá realizar, pero en otro Dojo, así que no estamos preparando para estos días venideros para que salga bien en su pre examen ya que el mes viene entrará en su cambio de cinta, es decir,el ascenso a naranja. Sinceramente es una disciplina que me gusta bastante, y también a mi hijo porque les perfecciona el carácter, además les hace ser responsable y puntuales. Una cosa también que me gusta es que a pesar de la pérdida que hemos tenido, mi hijo se mantiene firme y recuerda todo al pie de la letra, así que no es mucho trabajo para su sensei ayudarlo en su progreso, es por eso que estos días tiene que trabajar duro para poder mantenerse al ritmo que siempre ha traído mi hijo Gael. Espero que le haya gustado y nos vemos una próxima entrega ya que estaré resumiendo lo que será su entrenamiento antes de la presentación de cambiodecinta. Nos vemos pronto.

> Hello, Hive friends! Today, I’m going to tell you a little bit about my son's return to the Dojo. It had been almost a month since we last went, mostly due to the weather changes and a nasal congestion my son had. Plus, lately, it has been raining cats and dogs here in Monagas State, so I prefer not to take him out before he gets sick. ​A lot happened during this time. My son actually missed his pre-exam presentation because of the bad weather that day, so I had to talk to the sensei to see if he could take it another day. Thank God, he will be able to do it, but at a different Dojo! So, we are getting ready for the upcoming days to make sure he does great on his pre-exam, especially since next month he will be up for his belt promotion—meaning, his advancement to orange belt. Honestly, it’s a discipline that I really love, and my son does too, because it refines their character and teaches them to be responsible and punctual. Another thing I love is that despite the time we missed, my son stays strong and remembers everything to the letter, so it won’t be too much work for his sensei to help him progress. That’s why he has to work hard these days to keep up the pace that my son Gael has always maintained. I hope you liked it, and see you in the next post, where I’ll be summarizing what his training will be like before his belt promotion presentation. See you soon! ---

The staking share is the metric I keep coming back to because it cuts through a lot of the ETH narrative noise.

If more ETH keeps moving into staking while price action stays weak, that tells two different stories at once: holders still want yield and security participation, but the liquid market is not rewarding the asset with the same intensity. That gap is where the interesting signal is.

The top-pool concentration also matters. Staking is supposed to strengthen the network, but if the yield layer keeps consolidating around a few providers, Ethereum imports a different kind of systemic risk.

title.body:
The scrutiny layer idea is probably the right missing piece for AI-built Hive apps.

AI makes it easier to create the first version, but the hard part is not the first version. It is knowing where the generated code is fragile, where incentives break, and where user funds or keys can be touched by a bad assumption.

For Hive games especially, I think the useful pattern is AI for speed, human review for constraints, and on-chain transparency for the parts that need trust. That combination could let non-coders build without pretending code quality no longer matters.

title.body:
The wallet approval hints are a small UX detail with a large retention effect.

Most failed onboarding flows do not fail because users reject the product. They fail because the user hits a signing prompt, does not know what is happening, and assumes something is unsafe. Giving context at the exact moment of approval reduces that fear without hiding the custody model.

PWA support matters for the same reason. Hive needs fewer moments where a new user has to stop and think about tooling before they can just use the app.

title.body:
The point-of-sale argument is stronger when it starts from merchant margins instead of ideology.

If a business is working with 3-9% profit margins, the fee stack matters immediately. Card processing, chargebacks, settlement delays, and banking friction all eat into the same thin spread. Bitcoin payments do not solve every problem, especially with volatility and tax accounting, but they do create a different settlement profile.

The pitch I would emphasize is optionality: offer Bitcoin where it reduces friction, convert when needed, and let the merchant decide how much treasury exposure they actually want.

title.body:
The [Splinterlands](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/what-is-splinterlands) season ended earlier this week so I want to review my rewards and check up on some things in the game. I didn't get as many fights as I would like in Modern because I have been more focused on Frontier. Most of my fights happened on the last day of the season as I was in a rush to move up before the season ended.

## Season Rewards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EogKuYVmjQz1kZd3dGAmtn288z9psiFKppqA6q8HwCCYYd9H9TC1ke8t5DXP1bdvdnh.png)
I ended up with 2,286 Glint for last season, which is slightly less than what I was getting before. I didn't start as early as last time, but I managed to get the fights in during the last day, and I got lucky with 10 straight wins. This let me get to Silver and end without too many issues. The UI has changed again.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23xVCqxnYvW3TfJmppQvKCczTNpgq1xRRToJMJ5DDjbXD2pXeTx9NiqS6WPWVez1YpDjh.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wMMguiyxfhT5c4bZPaGViMiRXPxRpGssbfbxSVcWeFhkJeZqu5fpQz62YYx1EGSBJUa.png)
I did get two league advancement rewards in Modern. It was amazing this time around as I got almost all cards, and 2 of them were even rare cards.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23xebZgfRWSh7BBNw86RwPuVMfAUMBBju6h64n6mpG2s5JxJoQp48xjTckw4QJunL4mNk.png)
I am back to 2 rare cards for now while I stock up Glint.

## Gladius Packs

![gladius openings.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tGcNHqy5kMtQEaFYLbDinVq6ihVQAvn6q8nhv3wXkHXvDDLixS2NV8Q7ZxpQVgPyUW8.png)
I got 4 packs this time around, and the opening seems to be slightly worse than last time. No gold foil or legendary cards this time around. I did get an epic, but it was the bare minimum in terms of the cards above common.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23t7BQ4Wq8gDRcG1oE45WfVuFQVo2iy5tTpLoMdCcBDAku4ib7vGHntU5U5wtryWkmNJs.png)
I was able to upgrade my Whistling Damon to level 7. It gains one more attack for this upgrade, but it loses one maximum health point. It's too bad that I can't use this card due to my archon's levels, though.

## SPS

![SPS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tGTQAxLMCkQ3QpRpJNAsfmXrgvd6xBXfEFAbWmnX365DNegMnyToZPPfbsAk2oEQoJh.png)
My [SPS](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splintershards-sps) rewards were lower than last time. My brawl rewards have gone back down slightly.

I plan on staking all of the SPS I got from staking for a total of 103.479 SPS. The total SPS was around what I usually expected if I factor in the time difference of a few more days removed on top.

title.title: 🌱🥑 From Flower to Fruit: My Backyard Avocado Tree’s Amazing Journey 🥑🌱
title.body:
There is something incredibly rewarding about walking through the backyard and seeing nature's hard work turning into a harvest. A few months ago, this avocado tree was covered with thousands of tiny flowers. Today, those flowers have transformed into healthy young avocados hanging beautifully beneath the branches.
Looking closely at the tree, it is easy to appreciate the miracle taking place. Not every flower becomes a fruit. In fact, avocado trees naturally shed a large percentage of their flowers and tiny fruitlets. The fruits that remain are the strongest and have successfully competed for the tree's nutrients and energy. Seeing clusters of developing avocados is a sign that the tree is healthy and growing under favorable conditions.
One thing I have learned from growing avocados is the importance of patience. Avocado trees do not rush. The fruits start as tiny green beads and slowly increase in size over several months. During this period, consistent watering, healthy soil, and proper nutrition play a major role in determining the final fruit quality. Every week, the fruits become a little larger, reminding me that farming is a process built on care and persistence.
What makes this tree even more special is that it is growing right in my backyard. It provides shade, improves the environment, attracts pollinators during flowering, and eventually rewards the family with nutritious fruits. Avocados are rich in healthy fats, fiber, vitamins, and minerals, making them one of nature's most valuable foods.
The photos show different stages of fruit development. Some fruits are still very small, while others have already reached a promising size. This variation is normal because flowering and fruit set can occur over an extended period. With continued care, these avocados will keep growing until they reach maturity.
For anyone interested in fruit farming, this tree is a reminder that great harvests begin with small beginnings. Every flower holds potential, every season teaches a lesson, and every fruit tells a story of patience, dedication, and nature's incredible ability to produce abundance.
I am grateful to witness this journey firsthand and excited to see these avocados mature in the coming months. The harvest may still be ahead, but the signs of success are already hanging proudly from the branches.
🌿 Nature rewards patience. Plant a tree, care for it, and one day it will return the favor many times over. 🥑💚

title.title: Israel Calls It a Disaster So What Does Victory Look Like?
title.body:
![1000180573.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melrod97/23u62jjsxh5mv7CkhYhLwYTztUGKPT5aA9DNECXqasyGy29ZJ7RMdVAG6NSauqBRkMYSH.png)

Well, that didn’t take long. Israel needed barely six minutes to denounce President Trump’s deal with Iran. Officials across the political spectrum from the left and right to whatever remains of the center have branded it a “catastrophe,” a “bad deal,” and, in one memorable flourish, an agreement that “throws a lifeline to the murderous regime in Tehran.”

The irony is hard to miss. While Israel condemns Iran as a murderous regime, a growing chorus of international bodies, human rights organizations, and governments accuses Israel of serious violations of international law, war crimes, and crimes against humanity. Pot, meet kettle. Both seem convinced they’re fireproof.

According to President Trump, the core elements of the deal include Iran agreeing to forgo any nuclear weapons entirely, along with commitments to fully open the Strait of Hormuz to international shipping. Yet those assurances haven’t slowed the criticism.

Apparently, someone missed the memo: global support for the conflict is eroding faster than CNN’s ratings on a slow news night. The international community is reverting to full 1960s hippie mode peace signs, tie-dye shirts, and all while many Americans watch gas prices climb and wonder why they’re still subsidizing someone else’s seemingly endless war.

Israeli leaders have been blunt: they are not bound by the deal and intend to continue striking Hezbollah in Lebanon. From their viewpoint, the agreement fails to credibly eliminate Iran’s nuclear ambitions, ballistic missiles, or its network of proxies. Existential threats don’t lend themselves to easy negotiation. That’s understandable.

Yet after months of claims that the mission was largely accomplished Hezbollah’s leadership decapitated, Iranian nuclear sites degraded, the “Axis of Resistance” reduced to an Axis of Regret many outside Israel are asking: how much further does this need to go? How many more casualties, how many more billions, and how many more headlines before it ends?

You began with broad support. But at some point, the picture shifts. It starts looking less like self defense and more like a UFC referee stepping away for a smoke break while one fighter continues pounding an opponent who’s already down. Sooner or later, observers begin to question whether this is still defense or something else.

Netanyahu now faces a formidable balancing act in the coming months as Washington and Tehran hammer out details on sanctions relief, frozen assets, de-escalation in Lebanon, and ensuring the Strait of Hormuz remains fully open. The mood in Israel is clear: Iran remains an existential threat, so Jerusalem will act as necessary, with or without international approval. That instinct for self-reliance is understandable.

The deeper question is whether Israeli leadership is reading the shifting global mood or quietly counting on war-weary American taxpayers to continue funding an open-ended pursuit of “total victory” long after many believe the main objectives were achieved.

And let’s be honest: a growing number of Americans are asking questions their politicians prefer to dodge.

How is this affecting America’s image and influence around the world?
Are our relationships in the region strengthening or weakening?
Are we gaining leverage or steadily burning through it?

Israel remains one of America’s most important partners in the Middle East but it is not our only one.

Israel has every right to defend itself. 

The harder question, and the one the satire almost writes itself around, is whether “defense” includes any off-ramp or if perpetual conflict has become the new normal.

If the objectives have been achieved and the war continues, are we still talking about defense or something else?

title.title: Real-Time AI Is Changing Live Sports Media | Shalini Ananda, Ph.D. #667
title.body:
by @geeknewscentral on New Media Show w/Rob Greenlee 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/newmediashow [![Real-Time AI Is Changing Live Sports Media | Shalini Ananda, Ph.D. #667](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/80792284-9e04-4875-b58e-d158aaaa7c5a.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/9EQGg3mFCQ91iv4StLAoQC) 
 
 ![New Media Show with Rob Greenlee #667 with guest Shalini Ananda Phd of Neuron Systems](https://newmediashow.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/New-Media-Show-667-Shalnini-Episode-300x300-Cover-Art.png)**In episode 667** of the **New Media Show, hosted by 2017 Podcast Hall of Famer Rob Greenlee**, Rob talks with  **Shalini Ananda, Ph.D., Founder and CEO of [Neuron Systems](https://neuronsystems.org)**, about **_how real-time AI is changing live sports media, fan engagement, creator workflows, and the future of interactive content._**

**This episode starts with sports, but it becomes a broader New Media conversation about the next-generation layer of interaction between humans and AI-generated media infrastructure.**

> _**Neuron Systems is building a multi-agent AI platform for live sports content, including NBA and FIFA World Cup 2026 debates, video clips, quote cards, viral social media scripts, real-time voice commentary, fan-driven questions, and multilingual interaction.**_

Rob and **Shalini discuss how custom roles given to AI agents can become part of a new interactive media experience in which fans do more than just watch or listen.** They can ask questions, shape debates, co-sign takes, create clips, and interact with AI-powered sports personalities in real time.

> _**Shalini also walks through how Neuron Systems works as a creator platform. Fans can join live huddles, talk with AI agents, follow different AI personalities, participate in faction-style engagement, and use higher-level creator tools to build agents, automate content pipelines, and connect content workflows to platforms like YouTube.**_

The conversation also explores what this means beyond sports, including podcasting, live video, audience participation, AI-generated content, labeling, guardrails, trust, and the future of human-AI collaboration.

Rob frames the larger question this way: if podcasting and digital media have long wanted deeper audience interaction, is real-time AI becoming the infrastructure layer that finally makes that possible at scale?

**Key Topics and Approximate Timestamps:**

00:00 – Welcome to New Media Show #667 and introduction to real-time AI in live sports media

01:00 – Rob introduces Shalini Ananda Phd and Neuron Systems as a multi-agent AI live interactive sports discussion platform

02:00 – Why sports are a strong use case for fan-driven AI conversation, debate, and breaking news reaction

03:00 – Shalini explains the shift from traditional sports media to real-time fan and AI agent interaction

04:00 – Human-AI collaboration and why AI becomes more valuable when it is centered around human participation

05:00 – Multilingual sports engagement, including English, Spanish, Arabic, Tagalog, and global NBA fan communities

07:00 – Personalization, specialized AI agents, and why the audience may increasingly drive the content experience

08:00 – LoRA-style specialization, open-source models, and training AI agents around teams, cities, fans, and sports behavior

10:00 – Gen Z and Gen Alpha engagement with AI agents as real-time sources of sports knowledge and commentary

12:00 – Why humans remain the missing factor in AI systems and why interaction gives AI its purpose

18:00 – Live walkthrough of Neuron Systems and how fans and creators use the platform

19:00 – NBA, FIFA, women’s soccer, NFL, cricket, and the live Huddle experience

20:00 – AI agents, live sports debate, multilingual commentary, and FIFA fan interaction

22:00 – Account access, free participation, paid creator tiers, clips, audio, and deeper platform features

23:00 – Creator tools, YouTube integration, webhooks, APIs, automated pipelines, and custom AI agents

25:00 – How paid users can create agents, build sports communities, and extend content to YouTube or TikTok

27:00 – Human-created takes, sentiment testing, agent clashes, and fan-driven debate prompts

29:00 – Factions, cosigns, followers of AI agents, and how fans organize around different sports narratives

31:00 – AI agents as possible co-hosts, sports personalities, and new kinds of creator collaborators

32:00 – Tagalog fan engagement, highlight reels, and international fan-created content

33:00 – Is this an evolution of podcasting, and what happens when favorite agents become part of the media experience?

34:00 – AI guardrails, toxic content prevention, false narratives, offensive content, and hallucination checks

35:00 – AI labeling, copyright questions, attribution, and how people consume AI-generated content

37:00 – Rob and Shalini discuss “AI slop,” human slop, quality, trust, and how emerging tools are often judged

39:00 – Why AI tool adoption may become a specialized creator skill set

42:00 – What is a “show” on Neuron Systems, and how users create their own experience with agents and debates

45:00 – Personalization, team-based experiences, FIFA, live show aggregation, and fan questions driving content

47:00 – Why sports leagues and broadcasters may need to embrace interactive AI media to reach younger audiences

49:00 – Cost, complexity, infrastructure, voice agents, and the challenge of scaling real-time AI systems

52:00 – Shalini’s background in math computing, AI engineering, sound engineering, AI music, and live media infrastructure

54:00 – How Neuron Systems could expand beyond sports into education and real-time learning experiences

55:00 – Rob connects AI media infrastructure to the next generation of new media and podcasting’s interactive future

58:00 – NeuronSystems.org, platform complexity, simplification, and what may come next

**Guest and Show Links**

**Shalini Ananda, Ph.D., Founder and CEO of Neuron Systems**  
**Neuron Systems:** [https://neuronsystems.org/](https://neuronsystems.org/)

**Host Rob Greenlee and Show Links:**

**New Media Show:** [https://newmediashow.com/](https://newmediashow.com/)

**About the Host/Author:**  
  
_Rob Greenlee is a 2017 Podcast Hall of Fame inductee and Chair, a global new-media leader who bridges podcasting’s human roots and its AI-driven future. As founder of Trust Factor Lab and host of the “New Media Show” and “Spoken Human”, Rob helps creators start, grow, monetize, and future-proof their content. He’s held leadership roles at Microsoft, Spreaker, Libsyn, StreamYard, and PodcastOne, and serves as Chairperson of the [Podcast Hall of Fame](https://podcasthall.com). Learn more at [RobGreenlee.com](http://RobGreenlee.com) and join the Trust Factor Lab Creator/Podcast Services._

**Personal/AI Disclosure Note:** _I used AI tools to help organize and edit this episode and generate show notes. I have made hand edits; the views, clarifications, responsibility, and industry perspective are mine and my guest’s. I have been working in podcasting and platform adoption for more than two decades, and this article reflects my own position._

The post [Real-Time AI Is Changing Live Sports Media | Shalini Ananda, Ph.D. #667](https://newmediashow.com/real-time-ai-is-changing-live-sports-media-shalini-ananda-ph-d-667/) first appeared on [New Media Show](https://newmediashow.com).

title.title: Смакуємо свою черешеньку
title.body:
Ось і наші черешеньки достигають в бабусиному садку. На жаль, багато врожаю пропало в травні через різке похолодання, але ягоди на старих деревах таки нав'язались і тепер тішать нас своїм розміром і неймовірним смаком. Радіють і дорослі і діти.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf8n4zEHmBzxXdeZb8mdbAemdy9zxwLCf3ncgSGd6zwGq/1781580416374.jpg)

А ще цікаво, що донька навіть навчилась лазити по дереву, аби зірвати черешеньки. Хочеш смаколика - напружся сам, а не як всі діти зараз звикли, що мама принесе з маркета чи базара все готовеньке і тільки закидай до рота. А лазити по деревах, це ще й нічогенький такий фітнес. Згадую себе в дитинстві, то на які виосенні дерева я тільки не лазила )))

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfLPKVexmwVRsqq6mQGvkV6CigbbNEiKa8J8VGKStseax/1781580416406.jpg)

title.title: Feathered Friends (SMAP) - The Stupid Starling
title.body:
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYomULrVQziHZNTSSpMpDjQhyjZWLHNLArgdJweFL5ky2/20260611_4.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYomULrVQziHZNTSSpMpDjQhyjZWLHNLArgdJweFL5ky2/20260611_4.jpg)

<center>*This week's theme (ROUND 275) 
[**SHOW ME A PICTURE OF BIRD. SMALL BIRDS**](https://ecency.com/@nelinoeva/feathered-friends-show-me-a-ced2026c43495)*</center>

*Hey, @nelinoeva. 
Do you know the singer Andrey Makarevich? On May 27, 1969, he and Sergey Kawagoe founded the Time Machine rock band. At a time when songs about a happy life under Soviet rule were mostly sung on stage in the USSR, the songs of this group did not fit into this general chorus and therefore the youth loved this group. Many songs in the mid-80s became the anthem of freedom, and in those years I became acquainted with the song \
) was recorded in the All-Union Recording Studio \
in 1983. It was published in the albums \

with the text edited at the request of the censorship authorities. It was interpreted by critics in a broad sense as an allegorical song about a man who opposed the prevailing laws of existence. Journalists attributed it to one of the main hits of the \

of the mid-1980s.

[source](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Скворец_(песня))

I'm the same age as the band \

in the full sense of the word, I'm only 2 months younger than the band. My whole adult life goes along with the songs of this band. The song about the stupid starling stuck in my head right after the first listen. An interesting point is that someone gave me a small gramophone record of this song, recorded at a stall at a farmer's market.
* * * * * * * * * *
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPzYQ9NuFfbPpDkNc4kk38NQeDynA2WAZeKebVXuA6Bah/20260430_4.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPzYQ9NuFfbPpDkNc4kk38NQeDynA2WAZeKebVXuA6Bah/20260430_4.jpg) In those early days, all songs were mostly distributed by re-recording them on tape recorders. Those were the days of my youth. And these are the songs of my youth. We've been making our own playlist all our lives. My parents' songs are in my head, which I heard back in my pants-free childhood. But many modern songs are poorly absorbed by me. Is it old age? I think not yet. 😂
* * * * * * * * * *
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUtdJe1hfJ7SUQJAnqLy54CbPR6M5nksaf2D8nHTghbr1/20260430_3.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUtdJe1hfJ7SUQJAnqLy54CbPR6M5nksaf2D8nHTghbr1/20260430_3.jpg) And one more thing - the starling is a symbol of spring for me, its morning songs work like a bugle. Like a parrot, he can mimic everything he hears. But there is one problem - I don't see these birds in our village. There are birdhouses, but no starlings. Why? I don't know.
* * * * * * * * * *
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPhDMq5gSaCZo3TMqg86ZJFCYs9YfCDTTw6UEhZqGQ9Lb/20260611_3.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPhDMq5gSaCZo3TMqg86ZJFCYs9YfCDTTw6UEhZqGQ9Lb/20260611_3.jpg)

title.title: The Power of Social Media: Why You Should Learn Video Content Creation
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMptBbUXsfTmzMhshMpTZY3pEgQMxnuFcoCFLzdVWKhg/1781585245951.png)

We live in a world where a smartphone and an internet connection can open doors that were once impossible to access. Social media has transformed from a place where people simply connect with friends into a powerful marketplace where skills, businesses, and talents can be showcased to millions of people. This is why I strongly believe that everyone should learn video content creation, regardless of what they do for a living.

Many people think video content creation is only for influencers, comedians, or celebrities. I disagree. Whether you are a barber, teacher, tailor, baker, mechanic, farmer, designer, writer, or entrepreneur, video can become one of your greatest tools for growth.

I witnessed this firsthand through my neighbor. He learned how to cut hair but could not afford to rent or own a shop. To survive, he moved from house to house cutting people's hair. From what he told me, the money he made was not impressive. He had the skill, but not enough visibility.

Everything changed when he began recording short videos of his handwork. He posted clips of the hairstyles he created, the transformations of his clients, and snippets of his daily work on social media. What happened next surprised him. People who had never met him started reaching out. His videos were shared, new customers began calling, and his client base exploded. The same skill that struggled to earn him a decent income suddenly became highly sought after simply because more people could see it.

That experience taught me a valuable lesson: talent without visibility often goes unnoticed. Social media gives ordinary people the opportunity to display extraordinary skills.

Video content creates trust. People are more likely to patronize someone when they can see the quality of their work with their own eyes. A short video can communicate professionalism, creativity, and competence far better than words alone.

It also serves as free marketing. Instead of spending huge amounts of money on advertisements, you can use your phone to consistently document what you do. Every haircut, every cake baked, every design completed, every lesson taught, and every product delivered can become content that attracts potential customers.

Learning video content creation does not mean you need expensive cameras or sophisticated equipment. Many successful creators started with the smartphones they already owned. What matters most is consistency, authenticity, and the willingness to learn basic skills such as recording, editing, storytelling, and posting strategically.

Social media has leveled the playing field. It gives people with limited resources the opportunity to compete with larger businesses. A person working from home can reach audiences far beyond their neighborhood. One video can introduce your work to hundreds, thousands, or even millions of people.

In today's digital age, creating video content is no longer a luxury; it is an essential skill. If you know how to do something valuable, do not keep it hidden. Show your process. Share your results. Teach what you know. Let people see the value you bring.

The truth is simple: people cannot support what they do not know exists.

So, whatever you do for a living, learn video content creation. Your next customer, client, business partner, or life-changing opportunity may be just one video away.

*Image from Ai*

title.body:

<center>
![6LZfMw7Evl1GlL1q_IMG_8127.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/6LZfMw7Evl1GlL1q_IMG_8127/6LZfMw7Evl1GlL1q_IMG_8127.webp)

![ew63HyKv3gMcoHXX_IMG_8130.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/ew63HyKv3gMcoHXX_IMG_8130/ew63HyKv3gMcoHXX_IMG_8130.webp)
![IJJ5A5aQh5Lde5ui_IMG_8149.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/IJJ5A5aQh5Lde5ui_IMG_8149/IJJ5A5aQh5Lde5ui_IMG_8149.webp)
![0I0fsmMhpxFeSbbg_IMG_8159.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/0I0fsmMhpxFeSbbg_IMG_8159/0I0fsmMhpxFeSbbg_IMG_8159.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这次出差见了好几个大学同学，其中一位特别热情。她五月底就闭关出中考题，前天才刚出关，还在高速上就第一时间给我打了电话，原本约好第二天晚上聚餐，结果她当晚在家吃完晚饭就过来找我散步，真的特别打动我。

换作是我，出关后肯定先回家休整，隔天再见朋友，她实在太贴心了。她开车到酒店楼下接我，我们去滨江步道逛夜景，开了差不多二十分钟才到清晖阁。这座楼阁夜间灯火全开，颜值格外出众，灯光配色高级又耐看。

我们沿着步道慢慢往前走，她沿路一一给我讲解。江对面林立着好几栋高楼，楼宇上时不时滚动着宣传标语。斜对面就是万达广场，远眺还能看见两座跨江大桥。其中一座桥我印象很深，大学那会儿我们还去桥边野炊。听她说，当年野炊的那块地方现在已经改造成生态公园，修了步道。

一路上我们聊着家常、各自的近况，还有工作和孩子，不知不觉时间就过得飞快。我们上回见面还是三年前，那年跨年我回了一趟学校，不巧她孩子支原体感染住院，那次见面十分仓促。

大概九点半，我们才动身返程，她把我送到酒店楼下后就回家了，她第二天还要忙工作。我们约好第二天晚上，再和另一位同学一起聚餐。

第二天晚上我们约在一家贵州酸汤火锅店，另一位同学刚好接完孩子放学，便带着小孩一同过来。刚碰面时彼此还有些许生疏，但两位同学都是外向的E人，没一会儿就聊开了。我们回忆起上学时的各种趣事，越说越有意思。其中一位曾经是校园十大歌手，她们还打趣我，说我当年就是在这家店附近的广场参加的模特大赛。

我隐约还有些记忆，初赛就在一片开阔的大广场举办，她们说如今那里已经发展成热闹商圈。斜对面的天赐名店我也有印象，是当地老牌高端服饰店，里面的衣服价格不菲，上学那会儿我就知道这家店。

聊到这些往事，我们都忍不住感慨岁月匆匆。有位同学说起，当年她二十岁生日，在寝室难过地哭了，感慨自己迈入二字头的年纪，谁能想到一转眼，我们马上就要到四字开头的年纪了。

好在这么多年过去，彼此的同学情谊依旧没变。

---

title.title: We should not give up taking new initiatives.
title.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/36333018/pexels-photo-36333018.jpeg [source]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/worker-balancing-buckets-in-brick-yard-36333018/ ) We take new initiatives for many things in our lives. We all have some needs, some desires that we try to fulfill, but there is no guarantee that this effort will always be successful. Many times it is seen that we take initiatives in various things, but after a few days, the work stops in the middle or we get discouraged and give up. Some people take initiatives to reduce their excess weight and join the gym or some join yoga, but after a few days or a day or two, they fall behind due to body pain, but after a while they realize that they have made a mistake. In that case, of course, many people take initiatives again and focus on physical exercise. In fact, attention is a very difficult thing to take initiatives again and again, but attention makes us helpless to do some things. So we need to take initiatives hard and persist in that thing. There is no guarantee that if we take initiatives in something, we will succeed in that thing the first time. Every path in our life is very difficult, so when we try to fulfill our dreams, we face so many obstacles in the initiative that we sometimes fall behind. So if we give up, it will not work in any way. If we take the initiative and still leave the work incomplete, give up and fall behind, then we will never be able to succeed in that work. So despite losing repeatedly, we have to stand up and take the initiative to complete the work and we have to be mentally very strong with it so that we can complete that work and achieve success. In fact, success is needed in every work in life, be it small or big. Every work and every effort in our life is associated with success. So when we take the initiative and try to succeed in any work, it will be a small part of the much bigger success of our life. Despite losing repeatedly in life, there are some people who have never accepted defeat, who have stood up again and again after losing and have finally achieved their goal. We need to constantly learn from those people who have not given up even after losing and have tried constantly. So if there are obstacles in our life, big or small, to achieve success and we repeatedly accept defeat, we must still try. Many times it is seen that we take initiative in various works but due to many obstacles in the middle, we move away from doing that work but even if we move away for a moment, we are attracted to doing that work again later, if we like doing that work or have the courage to acquire that skill, then we should definitely take the initiative again and do that work. There are many people who take various job exams every year and fail in various exams or fail at various levels, some people lose and do not take the initiative again but some people take the initiative again for the next opportunity even after losing. Or even after losing the initiative repeatedly, some people get the job and bring success in life. Effort for success is not a matter of mouth, it requires hard work, so if we are unsuccessful in the first attempt, then we should take the next attempts with more effort. If we take initiative in any matter, we should stop thinking about falling behind or getting disappointed after losing and keep taking initiative until we get success in our life. If we keep trying with hard work and set our goals, then we will definitely be able to achieve our goals. So even if we lose, we have to keep taking initiative again and again with double the effort and strength of mind and try to make the work successful, but it will be seen that one day we will definitely become successful in that work. Different people will say different things to fail us and keep pushing us back because they are not letting us move forward, but we should never listen to them, we should keep taking initiative constantly to fulfill our dreams. title.body:
![img_9901-837ed5655469.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/acactus1013/lkt-mqg5y6d9-2fc4wgxc/img_9901-837ed5655469.webp)

自从买了个贵的养生壶后，就总想煮点啥补水喝喝，现在完全跟咖啡奶茶断绝关系了，妥妥的中年人一个。

上次去中医院配的药包一直堆在柜子里，今天翻出来决定大展手脚开始做养生汤，当初医生已经把二三十种药材按份分装妥当，只是之前我拿部分药材炖鸡汤或者煮银耳了，各类材料混在一起，分得乱七八糟。看着一堆杂乱的药材，我一时犯了难，完全不知道该怎么利用。

还好有豆包帮忙，我让它帮我梳理出两套适合我体质的调理方子，一套日常健脾补气血，另一套专门适合经期结束后调养气血。它还细致讲解了每一味药材的功效，我才知道天麻要头痛才能吃，当归是活血的，经期不能喝。

今天我用养生壶煮了500毫升养生汤，里面放了熟地黄、生地黄、酸枣仁、白术、当归等药材。当归的药味偏重，好在只放了三克，熬好的汤药很浓，下午去健身正好带去喝。

这段时间一直在学校就餐，很久没在家下厨，今天终于又空了，又自己动手做健康餐啦，好好调理一下身体。

title.title: MOVIE REVIEW: DANGAL
title.body: > ![1001615855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/23wX7Qo5CaTmpURriYXPya4i7pvhMgrDRrvKrT5ne2oSBYZr6Sna7ekZaQ656e1zrVPVy.jpg) This is one of the greatest sports movies and family films that I have ever seen. It is based on the real life story of a former wrestler who dreams of winning a country's gold medal. He can't do it himself so he trains his daughters to do it and to make his dream come true. The film is about the life of a hardworking and determined father Mahavir Singh Phogat. He always wanted a son who could be a wrestling champion, but he was blessed with daughters. He was initially disappointed as wrestling was perceived as a sport for boys. But, he had seen his daughters playing and winning against some boys in their village and saw his daughters had a lot of potentials. After that, he started working them seriously. I enjoyed one aspect of Dangal - the message! The film conveys the message that talent knows no gender. Mahavir was a man of faith with respect to his daughters, when the people in the community ridiculed him. He was criticized and opposed, but never wavered. This demonstrates the value of determination, courage and having confidence in others when others lack confidence. The acting in the film is superb. Mahavir's actor portrayal was impressive. He did a great job as a strict and caring father. The young actresses playing the daughters did an amazing job as well. The feeling of their emotions throughout the film, the struggles they had and the way that they came out of it and became better people was real and it was touching. Dangal is also noteworthy for its emotional qualities. It's not just the wrestling meet. It's also a book that's about family, sacrifice, discipline, and the bond between a father and his daughters. I had some moments that made me smile, moments that made me feel inspired and moments that made me feel emotional. The film reveals that success can often be achieved through perseverance and hard work, rather than luck. The wrestlings were quite thrilling and realistic. The training sessions really demonstrated the commitment and dedication required to be a champion. The stakes were important in each match, keeping me interested. The movie was superb at creating the tension and excitement of the competitions. I also liked the story of how women have faced challenges in sports highlighted. The female students needed to defy social expectations and stereotypes. Many people thought that girls shouldn't wrestle, but they didn't! This scene is motivating and shows that people should pursue whatever they want to do, even if they're told they can't. The cinematography and music were excellent, too. The music was appropriate to the story and helped to convey the characters' emotions. The film's setting was rural, which added to its authenticity, and thus the story was even more believable and intriguing. I personally really liked Dangal and it was a motivator and entertainer as well. It made me realize that dedication, patience and perseverance are the keys to success. The film also delivered the message of the value of family support and the need for someone who believes in you. Although the father was strict, it was because he wanted his daughters to be great. To sum up, Dangal is a motivational film, a film about family values and some great life lessons. A tale of overcoming obstacles, pursuing dreams, and never surrendering. This film has a message for both sports-fans and those who dislike sports films. It is a memorable experience due to its strong performances, emotional storytelling and motivational message. My Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4.8/5 Dangal is a film that motivates, amuses and leaves an impression on the viewers. It's certainly worth a watch. title.title: China’s Strategy: Ending U.S. Investment Cycles Before They Pay Off
title.body:
For more than a generation, the American economic system has depended on a repeating mechanism that converts ideas into capital absorption machines. Growth has been sustained less by productivity gains or industrial dominance and more by the ability to manufacture investment narratives that justify ever-larger flows of money into specific themes. These cycles inflate asset prices, stabilize debt dynamics, and create the appearance of momentum even when the underlying economy weakens. The system does not require every cycle to succeed indefinitely. It only requires each one to last long enough to roll debt forward and maintain confidence. Once confidence breaks, the structure becomes unstable very quickly. China has understood this vulnerability better than most Western policymakers are willing to admit.

What makes China dangerous to this model is not innovation leadership or financial openness, but its capacity to industrialize outcomes faster than markets can price them. When the US defines a sector as strategic, China does not compete on storytelling, branding, or financial engineering. It competes by building physical capacity at scale and by driving costs down until expected returns vanish. This does not stop adoption of the technology itself, but it destroys the investment logic that justified the cycle in the first place. Capital does not flee because the idea failed, but because the economics did. That distinction matters, because it explains why the pattern keeps repeating. China is not trying to beat US companies; it is shortening the lifespan of US capital cycles.

The green transition exposed this dynamic clearly. In the West, renewable energy became a moral imperative wrapped in long-term financial projections that assumed stable pricing, gradual deployment, and acceptable margins. China treated renewables as an industrial export strategy. By scaling solar panel and battery production far beyond domestic demand, it collapsed global prices and erased profitability across the value chain. Western investors discovered too late that the future they were financing had already been commoditized. Capital withdrew, political enthusiasm cooled, and the cycle ended prematurely. The technology survived, but the returns did not, which is all that matters for a system built on capital appreciation.

Electric vehicles followed almost the same trajectory, despite the lessons that should have been learned. In the US and Europe, EVs were presented as a manufacturing renaissance that would anchor a new industrial base and justify massive investment. China vertically integrated batteries, materials, and assembly, then used scale to drive down costs until competition became unsustainable. Western automakers faced shrinking margins just as capital spending peaked, a combination that destroys balance sheets rather than strengthening them. Once again, the cycle ended before it could mature into a stable return profile. Another investment story burned out early.

Artificial intelligence now sits at the center of the same structural conflict, but at a much larger scale. In the US, AI has become the ultimate justification for unprecedented capital expenditure, from data centers to chips to power infrastructure. Markets have embraced the narrative because it supports valuations and masks slowing real growth. China is approaching AI with a different objective, one that prioritizes cost compression, rapid deployment, and state-backed infrastructure over shareholder returns. When AI becomes abundant and cheap, value shifts away from the builders and toward the users, which undermines the very thesis that drove the spending. If margins collapse, the investment cycle collapses with them, even if AI transforms the economy.

What follows AI is even more threatening to the US model, because it targets the monetary layer itself. Stablecoins and digital money represent the next investment and power cycle, one that extends beyond technology into finance and payments. While the US treats stablecoins as a private-sector innovation tied to dollar dominance, China is embedding its strategy directly into state-controlled infrastructure. The digital yuan is not designed to be speculative or exciting; it is designed to be functional, sticky, and economically rational for users. By requiring commercial banks to pay interest on digital yuan wallets, China removes one of the biggest barriers to adoption. Money that pays interest and settles instantly does not need hype to spread.

The People’s Bank of China’s recent action plan for strengthening the digital RMB management system reveals the same pattern seen in previous cycles. The focus is not on experimentation, but on integration with existing financial infrastructure and daily economic activity. By aligning banks, payment systems, and public services around a single digital currency framework, China is turning money itself into infrastructure. This matters because stablecoins in the US depend on trust, market liquidity, and regulatory tolerance, all of which can shift quickly. China’s model depends on mandate, utility, and incremental incentives, which are far more durable over time. Once adoption reaches a critical threshold, it becomes very hard to reverse.

This is where the strategic threat becomes clear. If China succeeds in normalizing the digital yuan domestically and gradually in cross-border trade, it disrupts the next US investment cycle before it fully forms. Stablecoins are supposed to extend dollar influence and generate a new wave of financial innovation and capital formation. A competing system that offers interest, stability, and state backing compresses returns and limits scale before the cycle matures. Once again, the technology may spread, but the profits may not accrue where investors expect them to. That is the same playbook applied at the monetary level.

This context explains why Trump’s confrontation with China is structural rather than emotional. Tariffs, sanctions, and technology restrictions are not primarily about trade imbalances or political posturing. They are attempts to slow China’s ability to industrialize and commoditize entire investment themes before US capital can extract returns. Trump understands, even if imperfectly, that America cannot afford a world in which China decides when returns disappear. The fight is not about who innovates first, but about who controls the timeline of profitability.

The deeper issue is that the US system requires high and persistent returns on capital to remain stable. Pension funds, asset markets, government financing, and household wealth are all tied to asset inflation. China does not share this constraint. It can tolerate low returns in exchange for control, scale, and long-term positioning. As long as this asymmetry exists, China will continue to break US investment cycles, one after another. That is not a temporary conflict. It is the defining economic tension of the coming decades.

Sadly a huge issue for a lot of older games is their limited license agreements on the music and sounds in their games. Studios would get 5-10 year agreements for the sounds and music in their games from the copy right holders. The copy right holders then would exchange hands over the years or far more complex issues of who in what country owned which copy right. Making it not an option to try and renew things at any reasonable price.  


Quite a few of the Might & Magic games that I got off GoG all have to come with an emulator just to get them to work. All it takes is just one OS update breaking it and those GoG versions of the game stop working. If I recall one of them was broken for years till someone made a patch to get what ever Might & Magic game it was working again. 



The solution for preserving games will more then likely be AI. Someday all the old consoles, CD’s, and any physical things will no longer work. OS, graphic cards, and so many other things will change over the years to the point it becomes harder and harder to keep emulations working for older games on current hardware. 

With times comes the end of copyrights as they slowly expire many decades later. Long past most people who where ever around to play the originals.  


Thankfully I have the couple of games I really cared about from my childhood in digital formats. I’m sure one day I’ll go to play them after a decade of time has passed since my last play of them. Just to discover they no longer run with no known workaround posts by anyone online. Their physical forms have long since stopped working or I no longer have. 

The real loss is going to be all the \

gaming world we live in now. A few years back the holders of the Might and Magic series came out with one final game. At one point to cut costs they pulled servers to lots of old games. This is probably the most important onboarding direction Hive can take: reduce the key-management shock without giving up user custody.

The 1 minute 28 second number matters because most people do not evaluate a chain on ideology first. They evaluate friction. If the first session requires an extension, manual key handling, and several unfamiliar concepts, the user is gone before they understand why Hive is different.

Lightning payment for account creation is also a good bridge because it connects Hive onboarding to a payment rail people already recognize inside crypto. The real test will be whether the generated-key flow feels safe enough for normal users without hiding too much of what they need to understand later.

title.title: The Value of Uncomfortable Conversations
title.body:
Tomorrow is going to be an interesting day, to say the least.

On Hive Thrive, we are going to be joined by @igormuba, a long-time Hive user who has recently been making quite a bit of noise across the blockchain.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcPUwQDdJ83Q94onWfpGueSRjCQy4vBED4W1SMehFN3yE/image.png)

The subject, of course, will be his current focus: the DHF, and more specifically, the proposal outlined in his pull request.

It is my sincere hope that tomorrow's conversation, as intense as it may get, keeps at its center the fact that we are simply a group of passionate people trying to solve the same problem. We may disagree on the solution. We may disagree on the path to get there. But I believe we very much agree that our blockchain needs a shake-up. It needs a shift.

Unlike debates on Web2, there are reasonable fears and reservations people carry when speaking too loudly or too aggressively against the way things currently are. The social nuances of Hive, with its reputation system, political underpinnings, and questionable pool-protection protocols, elevate the consequences to another level.

We all know this. We all think about it.

That is why it is difficult not to notice when someone throws caution to the wind, fully aware of the friction and stress it will likely bring into their life.

Precisely because of this, I feel we ought to be grateful for dissenting voices. Those people who, for better or worse, are not content to simply play along and feel compelled to speak up.

I'd go as far as saying that their role in this experiment of ours is not only welcome, it is necessary.

Hive has a tendency to reward those who dance precisely to the tune playing on the jukebox while casting judgment on those who dare ask whether the right song is being played in the first place.

This is no secret. For years, a reliable formula for reaching Trending was to write bullish things about Hive, although these days those posts seem few and far between. Most of us struggle to maintain a positive mindset, and I'm not blaming anyone or pointing fingers.

If we are lucky, tomorrow's conversation might move the needle a little.

I happen to think the needle needs moving, which is why I welcome these uncomfortable discussions. But I'm open to being convinced that I'm wrong, of course.

*I'm a fallible hairless ape, after all.*

So don't forget:

Tomorrow, 6:00 PM UTC on Discord.

See you there.

-MenO

title.title: ‎Cape Verde vs Spain: This Is Why We Love Football
title.body:
‎I won't lie, before this match started, I thought Spain would comfortably win this tie. Looking at both teams, it seemed like one of the easiest fixtures for the Spanish side. They have world-class players, plenty of experience, and are considered one of the favorites to go far in the tournament.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNo5ekUxgFnwdDzsZqFPxbJhiVcyQ3eujy2dkk4WqTbkJ/RRILYVQQCZM3XOYLAEJYFAPMPY.jpg 

‎[Source](https://en.as.com/soccer/world-cup/spain-vs-cape-verde-live-online-score-stats-goals-updates-world-cup-2026-group-h-f202606-n/)
‎
‎On the other hand, Cape Verde were playing in their first-ever World Cup. Naturally, I expected Spain to dominate from start to finish.
‎
‎Well, football proved me wrong once again.
‎
‎The final score was 0-0, and I was genuinely surprised. Spain had chance after chance but just couldn't find a way to buried those chances. There were moments when I was already expecting the ball to hit the back of the net, only for Cape Verde's goalkeeper to come up with another unbelievable save.
‎
‎Vozinha was simply outstanding. At 40 years old, he delivered a performance that many younger goalkeepers would be proud of. Every time Spain looked dangerous, he was there to deny them. By the end of the game, it felt like Spain were playing against a wall.
‎
‎The defenders also deserve a lot of praise. They fought for every ball and never stopped believing. One of the moments that stood out to me was the late block that prevented what looked like a certain Spanish goal. Those are the kind of moments that can define a match.
‎
‎What impressed me most was Cape Verde's mentality. Many teams would have been overwhelmed by the occasion, especially against a football giant like Spain. Instead, they stayed disciplined, defended bravely, and showed incredible determination throughout the game.
‎
‎To be honest, this result is exactly why football remains the most unpredictable sport in the world. You can have more possession, more shots, bigger names, and still fail to win. Sometimes passion, teamwork, and belief can level the playing field.
‎
‎As I watched the match, I kept waiting for Spain to score the winning goal. It never came. In fact, Cape Verde nearly stole all three points themselves near the end.
‎
‎This game reminded me never to underestimate any team in football. No matter how strong a team looks on paper, anything can happen once the match begins. Cape Verde may have been the underdogs, but they played with heart and earned a result that few people expected.
‎
‎And that is exactly why we love this beautiful game.
‎

** El día de ayer mi esposo y mi hijo estuvieron un poco quebrantados con vómito y malestar general, así que, para reconfortarlos hoy preparé una sopa de pollo, que quedó muy deliciosa, y se preparó con pocos ingredientes, además logró reconfortarlos, les muestro

ENGLISH
** Yesterday, my husband and son were feeling a little under the weather with vomiting and general discomfort, so to cheer them up, I made some chicken soup today. It turned out delicious, required just a few ingredients, and really helped lift their spirits. Here’s the recipe ![1000950591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wC9hrScREuioQecSvNPEg1ES56qhWgyGjo1kWXa9JSBPXvM96CuVULGvetJC2mCW8SM.jpg)

** pechuga de pollo, ocumo blanco, ají, cilantro, papas

> **
INGREDIENTS
** chicken breast, white yam, chili pepper, cilantro, potatoes ![1000950489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Ep5o8iVJpLb1vYc8EXdL6vdqvSCwxvLsBNqAUst6LEXHtqQcHFWXyYhEUSrkkoMVHwU.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Después de lavar muy bien la pechuga de pollo, la llevé a hervir en suficiente agua con sal, cilantro y un sobre de caldo de pollo deshidratado. Al mismo tiempo lavé muy bien las verduras, las corté en trozo y las añadí a la olla; comprobé de sal, agregué pasta cortada en trozos, además un poco de arroz, y deje cocinar hasta que todo estuvo completamente cocido; retiré del fuego y dejé reposar

** After washing the chicken breast thoroughly, I brought it to a boil in plenty of water with salt, cilantro, and a packet of dehydrated chicken bouillon.
