title.title: GRAVITY
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR18fsGci6QTnwJGrnrfyS6JrrrogWU4EXryccLzxEpkw/1781584395851.png)


Gravity

Gravity is a natural force that pulls objects toward each other. Every object that has mass creates gravity, but larger objects have stronger gravity.

The best example is Earth's gravity. It pulls everything toward the center of the Earth, which is why people, animals, buildings, and trees stay on the ground. Without gravity, everything would float away into space.

When you throw a ball into the air, it eventually falls back to the ground because Earth's gravity pulls it downward. The same force causes rain to fall from the clouds and keeps oceans, rivers, and lakes on Earth.

Gravity also plays an important role in space. It keeps the Moon orbiting the Earth and the Earth orbiting the Sun. In fact, gravity helps hold the entire solar system together.

Importance of Gravity

Keeps us on the ground.

Causes objects to fall toward Earth.

Keeps planets, moons, and satellites in orbit.

Helps maintain the structure of the solar system and the universe.


Simple Example

If you drop an apple from a tree, it falls to the ground instead of moving upward. This happens because gravity pulls the apple toward the Earth.

Conclusion

Gravity is an invisible force that attracts objects toward each other. It affects everything around us, from everyday activities on Earth to the movement of planets and stars in space. Without gravity, life as we know it would not be possible.

title.title: Salteado de carne con cebolla, zanahoria y salsa de soya de champiñones.[Esp-Eng]
title.body:
>    
<hr>
Feliz y bendecido inicio de semana, un gusto compartir una vez más con ustedes, hoy les quiero compartir la receta de un salteado de carne con cebolla, zanahoria y un toque de salsa de soya de champiñones ideal para acompañar con el contorno de nuestra preferencia es fácil de preparar y además queda deliciosa aquí les dejo el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

>Happy and blessed start to the week! It’s a pleasure to be sharing with you once again. Today I’d like to share a recipe for a stir-fry made with beef, onions, carrots, and a touch of mushroom soy sauce—perfect as a side dish with your favorite accompaniment. It’s easy to prepare and absolutely delicious. Here’s a step-by-step guide to this simple recipe.

<hr>

![GridArt_20260519_205201944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoEszeW9rN6TNygTqf3siwcUFhSU2ZBXYJLCnpXfmc6deeJJDQpeFM9F2og2pZcbHKX.jpg)



<hr>

# <center> *INGREDIENTES/INGREDIENTS* </center>

<div class = \

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoGyuKJCwa6DrE25B4QL19JNTCFmPSTHRTk3o6EkZ4pBcR6Us17LndJ6aCE89NNG9pc.jpg - 350 gramos de carne de res - 1 zanahoria - 1 cebolla - 1/2 cucharadita de ajo en polvo - Orégano molido - Salsa de soya de champiñones - Sal y pimienta al gusto - Aceite de oliva >- 350 grams of beef >- 1 carrot >- 1 onion >- 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder >- Ground oregano >- Mushroom soy sauce >- Salt and pepper to taste >- Olive oil
#
*PREPARACIÓN/PREPARATION*
Lo primero que haremos es aderezar la carne con sal, ajo en polvo y orégano lo dejamos reposar por una hora; lavamos y rallamos la zanahoria y picamos en tiras la cebolla y reservamos. >First, season the meat with salt, garlic powder, and oregano, then let it sit for an hour; wash and grate the carrot, slice the onion into strips, and set aside.
![GridArt_20260519_205600960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eonn1y4PuG8fqXn1pT5WrHdYT7Tex7wFXuvpgScuLVpKVbWCqn8xs1aKMPENV8ncG58.jpg)
En un sartén colocamos un chorrito de aceite de oliva y ponemos la carne a dorar, la retiramos de la sartén colocamos otro chorrito de aceite y ponemos la cebolla a sofreír. >Pour a splash of olive oil into a skillet and brown the meat. Remove the meat from the skillet, add another splash of oil, and sauté the onion.
![GridArt_20260519_210051643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoAbEz6f9Tqtqc7KZa66ZerCWGXXCGNE3AJzvXXx3BLTZnE5LK4QtdJM8YVxRVqhbdt.jpg)
Le agregamos la zanahoria y un chorrito de agua o caldo y cocinamos por tres minutos, luego volvemos a introducir la carne removemos y le agregamos salsa de soya de champiñones volvemos a remover y cocinamos por un par de minutos hasta que se integren los sabores. >Add the carrot and a splash of water or broth, and cook for three minutes. Then return the meat to the pan, stir, and add the mushroom soy sauce. Stir again and cook for a couple of minutes until the flavors blend together.
![GridArt_20260519_210324333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoeFqyL3dx3zcQzr4EbSNW4iZSysma5TkwG1s5bv7QeiJXagYsNrgiVVYRBuggNW9hJ.jpg)
Una vez lista la carne servimos caliente y acompañamos con el contorno de nuestra preferencia yo combiné con arroz y ensalada para disfrutar de un plato balanceado en mi almuerzo. >Once the meat is ready, serve it hot and pair it with your favorite side dish. I served it with rice and a salad to enjoy a balanced meal for lunch.
![GridArt_20260519_205345492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eoc9rNNjUZiEkQEr2jeqpCAeZZ9tXUBxd8dRVxP61aBeGPtzjAKfPEgw7GgzxHqTKxR.jpg)
Espero que esta sencilla receta que les comparto el día de hoy sea de su completo agrado hasta la próxima y muchas bendiciones. >I hope you enjoy this simple recipe I’m sharing with you today. Until next time, and many blessings.

title.title: Las famosas arepas venezolana reina pipiada [ESP/ENG]
title.body: # Las famosas arepas venezolana reina pipiada [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigas del buen comer y del buen paladar que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que todos se encuentren bien de salud. Los invito a que sean bienvenidos a mi blog. 

![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zbYHB1ubGNbipw9pUkRwouLjK8c4FfSteDnHoaen6GYohRxEj1cQhLyw5cMUkDrHoiY.jpg)

Hoy les voy a presentar una receta sencilla, fácil de preparar y que a su vez es un plato muy famoso, deliciosa y saludable llamado: arepa venezolana llamada reina pipiada. 

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGRce7KAxXRw59JS9upYthVwgL19tAbtJimpQ9sYpB9nXAcVVY8mkX9mYKAKs2coEt.jpg)

La reina pipiada es la arepa más famosa de toda Venezuela, sin lugar a dudas, es demasiada deliciosa. Es un tipo de arepa asada que se rellena con una rica mezcla de pollo desmechado, mayonesa, aguacate en rodajas, cilantro y especies; sin embargo como no tenia pollo desmechado en casa opte por colocarle tomate picado, aguacate, mayonesa, la mezcla quedo super buena de chuparse los dedos, muy rica.

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uR12fbta87yznyx8RxPGc6ZKLA8GGunxgBwRbX4o88NyECFEYapxY6wXNaL2LzMN478.jpg)

Les comento que este plato lo prepara para mi cena, estaba antojada de comer aguacate, a mi me encanta. El aguacate que use para rellenar estas arepas estaba bastante maduro, lo que hizo que le diera esa cremosidad a la mezcla que prepare.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tmNAJdR1SbEmXhANSASiDSnA42RLdufABv7Rf26Vo1Aot7ZADXsivSgEoFWL9JkcAH8.jpg)|![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7G8nzVRmrpAGHJx1BjqW4quH15hUv3GAYyVih1S3HaVXfrzUVPG3ectWVAbz8wRbRy.jpg)
-|-

Ahora bien, les voy a indicar los ingredientes que utilice y el paso a paso para su preparación, la cual es super sencilla, este tipo de arepa nos sirve para sacarnos de apuro cuando tenemos que preparar algo fácil y sencillo, que no lleve mucho tiempo su preparación.

# Ingredientes
* 1 aguacate de 500 gramos
* 2 tomates
* 2 cucharadas de mayonesa.
* Harina pan
* gua y sal al gusto

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpCAt6c33VFjgu3fkbD5iNrj75ZvmZ7jZH9YyGkLKMqqrwMVTeRJSX2qpGnZ2fjZAZN.jpg)

# preparacion
Lo primero que hice fue preparar las arepas con la harina pan, la sal y el agua, amase muy bien. a la par coloque la plancha en la estufa y deje que se calentara muy bien por 10 minutos, tendí las arepas, las coloque en la plancha y las deje cocinar 20 minutos volteando por ambas caras, al estar doradas las baje, deje enfriar.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23w2jFzEAFBN4QwcxzhFMrrdLxUWZWTm1Z4pkz66CwZ2eKhqX7gDEzfzojyh2GEg2AQLG.jpg)

Posteriormente pase a preparar el relleno con el aguacate cortado en trozos pequeños y el tomate, le agregue la mayonesa, revolví muy bien en forma envolvente para proceder hacerle una abertura a la arepa en el medio, las rellene con esta deliciosas y nutritivas crema que prepare , este fue mi cena que me ayudo a matar el antojo que tenia, la acompañe con un delicioso jugo de melón que prepare y me la tuve que degustar a la oscura ya que justo en lo que termine de preparar todo como de costumbre me quitaron el servicio eléctrico.

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgSMZsza6nr1RsKFFxqiNuPhFwCZrBxdVQVB9dug7gES2jJSo9hmMN2tuNbK4Ek6oxX.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tmNAJdR1SbEmXhANSASiDSnA42RLdufABv7Rf26Vo1Aot7ZADXsivSgEoFWL9JkcAH8.jpg)|![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvkphrszTskW6YJYsvhomtb847KwEu1rkRZbZAj5rb54DhT4ZHmMJ66sW99r4h4DMnJ.jpg)
-|-|-

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x17EJJh3BNEibje5iRsaVB9gUa5wXWYrfB4HopfzZy38LCfPpd4d6b6g7ytxumxhwXe.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJG8m78UywJYU1dEg3BgRrQbE3Bx1V7G5JdyMfpW6UmC4c6N9q7Gj3pAdRPYHkiapoN.jpg)
-|-

<div class=\
> # English Version # The Famous Venezuelan Arepa Reina Pepiada

> Hello, fellow food lovers and connoisseurs reading this in the @hivefood community! I hope you’re all in good health. Welcome to my blog. ![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zbYHB1ubGNbipw9pUkRwouLjK8c4FfSteDnHoaen6GYohRxEj1cQhLyw5cMUkDrHoiY.jpg) Today I’m going to share a simple, easy-to-make recipe for a very famous, delicious, and healthy dish called the Venezuelan arepa known as reina pipiada. ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGRce7KAxXRw59JS9upYthVwgL19tAbtJimpQ9sYpB9nXAcVVY8mkX9mYKAKs2coEt.jpg) Reina pipiada is undoubtedly the most famous arepa in all of Venezuela—it’s absolutely delicious. It’s a type of grilled arepa filled with a rich mixture of shredded chicken, mayonnaise, sliced avocado, cilantro, and spices; however, since I didn’t have any shredded chicken at home, I decided to use chopped tomato, avocado, and mayonnaise instead. The mixture turned out absolutely delicious—finger-licking good! ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uR12fbta87yznyx8RxPGc6ZKLA8GGunxgBwRbX4o88NyECFEYapxY6wXNaL2LzMN478.jpg) I’ll tell you that I made this dish for dinner; I was craving avocado—I love it. The avocado I used to fill these arepas was quite ripe, which gave the mixture I prepared that creamy texture. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tmNAJdR1SbEmXhANSASiDSnA42RLdufABv7Rf26Vo1Aot7ZADXsivSgEoFWL9JkcAH8.jpg) |![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7G8nzVRmrpAGHJx1BjqW4quH15hUv3GAYyVih1S3HaVXfrzUVPG3ectWVAbz8wRbRy.jpg) -|- Now, I’m going to list the ingredients I used and the step-by-step instructions for making this dish, which is super simple. This type of arepa is great for when we need a quick fix and have to prepare something easy and simple that doesn’t take long to make. # Ingredients * 1 avocado (500 grams) * 2 tomatoes * 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise. * Bread flour * Water and salt to taste ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpCAt6c33VFjgu3fkbD5iNrj75ZvmZ7jZH9YyGkLKMqqrwMVTeRJSX2qpGnZ2fjZAZN.jpg) # Preparation The first thing I did was prepare the arepas with the bread flour, salt, and water, kneading them thoroughly. At the same time, I placed the griddle on the stove and let it heat up well for 10 minutes. I shaped the arepas, placed them on the griddle, and let them cook for 20 minutes, flipping them on both sides. Once they were golden brown, I took them off and let them cool. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23w2jFzEAFBN4QwcxzhFMrrdLxUWZWTm1Z4pkz66CwZ2eKhqX7gDEzfzojyh2GEg2AQLG.jpg) Next, I prepared the filling with the avocado, cut into small pieces, and the tomato. I added the mayonnaise and stirred it in thoroughly, folding the ingredients together. Then I made a slit in the center of the arepa and filled it with this delicious and nutritious mixture I had prepared. this was my dinner, which helped satisfy my craving; I paired it with a delicious melon juice I made, and I had to eat it in the dark because, just as I finished preparing everything, as usual, the power went out. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgSMZsza6nr1RsKFFxqiNuPhFwCZrBxdVQVB9dug7gES2jJSo9hmMN2tuNbK4Ek6oxX.jpg) |![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tmNAJdR1SbEmXhANSASiDSnA42RLdufABv7Rf26Vo1Aot7ZADXsivSgEoFWL9JkcAH8.jpg) |![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvkphrszTskW6YJYsvhomtb847KwEu1rkRZbZAj5rb54DhT4ZHmMJ66sW99r4h4DMnJ.jpg) -|-|- ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x17EJJh3BNEibje5iRsaVB9gUa5wXWYrfB4HopfzZy38LCfPpd4d6b6g7ytxumxhwXe.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJG8m78UywJYU1dEg3BgRrQbE3Bx1V7G5JdyMfpW6UmC4c6N9q7Gj3pAdRPYHkiapoN.jpg) -|- That’s all for now. I hope you enjoyed this post. See you soon with new content. title.title: The Magnificent Sam's Mountain View Resort
title.body:
As I have come along with this platform to finally share the places that I've been to, whether mountains, beaches, resorts, and museum, I am so excited to share one of the best mountain view resort that I have visited- The Sam's Mountain View Resort at Quirino, Philippines.

![8f30fb3f-d4ea-4108-aab9-be0a201d61fc (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU8zkvZCm2pUK9HLe1XPYY4YKkougYsT8hezr5XLobJ5U/8f30fb3f-d4ea-4108-aab9-be0a201d61fc%20(1).jpg)

What's so special about it is you could enjoy the sunset or sunrise as the salmon started to paint the sky. It's giving so much relaxation as you just sit on the rocks and enjoy the show of clouds and orange lights in the sky. 
![c023708c-189b-4f01-a0d2-04d09c03a87f.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSes6EufwxiuLjW1SXei8nz1dR8AzeqyKZivWLTNN1NR/c023708c-189b-4f01-a0d2-04d09c03a87f.jpg)


Be captivated by the breathtaking mountain and rocks view with its crystal clear pools. Aside from the view at the top you'll also love their famous octopus slides which has various levels from slow to fast slides. Rock formations are also superb as they are intricately formed. ![78daeb22-f1a9-422e-8d61-1fed48c47b4d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPKPz1FcPdxyuje68doJuob3XCVrs6i6KQMomomAiCjYa/78daeb22-f1a9-422e-8d61-1fed48c47b4d.jpg)

As the evening comes, you can enjoy their pools with some beach chairs to relax. Night swimming is always perfect  especially when you do it with your family or friends. You can play and have fun in their night pools as they ensure safety and satisfaction of your family or group of friends. 
![355e6cdc-67c1-4760-b07f-a6c3be5b718c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPEwcnkZa55FReeTUgren5fBzdjr4pbZa9Cmb43e1Z4AP/355e6cdc-67c1-4760-b07f-a6c3be5b718c.jpg)



One of the children's favorite in this place is their giant mushrooms and cave water pools. It's truly amazing how these simple things can turn into something that my loved ones indulgent. 
![ed4d956c-936e-4c6f-8be3-71fe8088cbec (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXX6vVWzTweDtWwr7yDSmiMeuFAb5xBvsRCRdKdwoy6Mk/ed4d956c-936e-4c6f-8be3-71fe8088cbec%20(1).jpg)

The accommodation is also really nice you can spend the night in their triangle house as it's very clean and nice place to stay after all the adventure that you have done in the whole resort. The triangle house is more that wide enough to accommodate the whole family or friends. 
![8e0ffa21-9eb4-4c4f-ad5a-5657d7478cd7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcYwCpyqwQcHYFDwxWdQfNXH4M3MpyYbxLKqrtTFjWsyN/8e0ffa21-9eb4-4c4f-ad5a-5657d7478cd7.jpg)
 
Enjoy the cave pools with the stunning rocks that will leave you amazed when you go trough it. It's perfect for those who don't want to be directly be under the heat of sun. The water in the caves is colder than the pools outside, it's also good for playing hide and seek in a cave pool, as I have already tried. 
![b70456f5-549d-4b41-b1fc-46e90c1f6f95.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme6Lq3mnU7ZBvkbq7uWorKYxgXDPRLNPJH893gSDPo9ZH/b70456f5-549d-4b41-b1fc-46e90c1f6f95.jpg)

My experience in Sam's mountain view resort is so amazing that I forgot other endeavors for a while. All I just have done during our stay in this resort mis to relax and enjoy the place and the activities that I can do there. So, if you happen to visit Quirino, Philippines, you shouldn't miss this one. 
![1c34a6cf-e82c-4325-a3bf-f76c8ad1a783.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV6BvJ1SizRz1mNqM2JNrhe5iJeh5qzKe13Zgb77kZnwJ/1c34a6cf-e82c-4325-a3bf-f76c8ad1a783.jpg)

title.title: The Problem with Old Editions in Splinterlands (Part 2)
title.body:
>

<center> **Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚</center>

In the first post of this series, I discussed the issues surrounding older editions: the lack of trading volume, the very low demand, and what this means for these cards that marked the beginning and success of Splinterlands over time. While I understand that new cards need to be stronger and more useful in battle, the reality is that we need to find a way to make these cards more valuable within the economy so that loyal, long-time players can still benefit from them.

That’s why, if you’re not familiar with all the issues surrounding these editions, clicking [HERE](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@cieliss/the-problem-with-old-editions-in-splinterlands-part-1) will let you read about what I’m talking about. Although in this second part we’ll now focus more on practical steps and ideas that can be implemented to try to resolve all of this and boost the volume and demand for these cards, because—even if players see it negatively—the more volume and liquidity there is overall, the more activity there will be on the chain, which ultimately is very important for the entire ecosystem.

**So, if you want to know what ideas I have for breathing new life into old cards, keep reading this post until the end, and I hope you'll let me know which one you like best:**

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>Proposals to “Revitalize” Demand for “Wild” Cards</center>
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

Okay, in this section I’ll discuss three proposals related to mechanics that already exist in the game. While practically everything I’ll mention relates to existing game elements, a few of them might include something new—but I’ll cover that in the next section. With that out of the way, let’s dive into the content and proposals that could revitalize the much-needed demand for “Wild” cards.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Proposals for Revitalizing Old Menus</center>

* **GLINT Multipliers Based on Ownership History:** The current way GLINT is earned is based solely on matches won in ranked battles. That’s why we could implement a system where players who own cards from these older editions receive a higher bonus than the one already in place for “Wild” battles. As I mentioned, this already exists, but the BONUS should be higher than the current one and should only affect the GLINT we can earn, not the SPS.

* **“Legacy” Tournaments with VOUCHER Entry:** This is a simple idea that could be easily implemented, where tournaments are created for a specific edition—such as “Untamed” or “Chaos”—and the entry fee is the VOUCHER. I think that if these types of events are held more frequently, demand for the cards could rise; however, it depends on the prize being offered—if it’s substantial, many people will be looking for cards from older editions to play and win the rewards.

* **Integration with the Exemplar System:** I love this system because it lets you customize a card based on the player’s “Avatar”—something that’s never been seen in any other game. However, getting straight to the point, it would be interesting to allow the Exemplar system to interact with cards from older editions, where our Exemplar could gain abilities from one of our older cards through a burn process, with certain clear limits, of course.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>Other “Offers” (Themed Seasons, Exclusive Titles, and more…)</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

In this second part of the post, the ideas are a bit different and, if you will, more versatile than the previous ones; however, I think they’re good ideas that could revive demand for older cards and allow capital (liquidity) to flow much more freely throughout the game. After all, a liquid market is what everyone wants to be able to move freely, because, sure, it’s fine to spend money on the game—the team has to get paid somehow— but we, as players and long-time supporters of the project with capital tied up, would also like to have new cards—and we would have them if the market were liquid.

---

**Anyway, I got a little off track, but let's get back to the remaining points to wrap up this post:**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>More versatile general options</center>

* **Themed Seasons (The Awakening of the Alphas):** The idea is simple: over the course of several seasons, certain changes will be implemented in the game, but they will focus exclusively on older cards, giving these cards a \
that directly impacts their stats—and only in the \

This would undoubtedly create demand, forcing players to buy or rent these cards to stay at the top of their rankings. * **Exclusive Achievements and Titles for “Collectors”:** Titles in Splinterlands serve certain purposes within the game; one of the most important is to demonstrate a player’s status. The idea is to introduce titles that are non-transferable and are automatically earned by having a complete SET of an older edition at the maximum level. The idea is that these titles grant certain benefits, such as obtaining resources in lands, discounts on energy, and so on. * **The arrival of “Ancient Essence”:** This is one of my favorites, but it might never come to pass. The idea is to create a mechanism that directly benefits land cards through ancient cards, where those cards can be converted into a resource called “Ancient Essence,” which would be used during the land’s third phase to craft spells and artifacts that enhance various aspects of the lands and our own cards. If this comes to pass, I’d need it to improve in “Modern,” but you’d need to leverage the ancient cards to achieve it—a win-win for everyone. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif I hope you enjoyed this post, and especially the ideas that could be implemented to improve demand, liquidity, and volume for these cards—something that would benefit the entire ecosystem if one or more of these ideas were to be implemented in the game. One thing I didn’t mention is that it would be great to hold special “Black Foil” giveaways and raffles for all these types of rarities for those who have older cards in their collections; this could also help. If you have any questions about this, please feel free to comment on this post.

上周末我就用电脑搜了枪版的《给阿嬷的情书》一个人在酒店观赏，也许是环境，也许偶尔开小差，也许是画质及声音（影院偷拍屏幕晃动加之观众笑声） 干扰，时而字幕覆盖，听着潮汕话只能盲猜。我第一次看这部影片时只有浅显的感动。

接下来的几天时间里不断刷到有关这部电影的评价，让我了解这段真实的历史故事。在我国近现代有几次人口大迁徙：下南洋、走西口、闯关东。

影片中的郑木生就是几百万潮汕人下南洋谋生的真实事件。他首站去了马来亚，后来辗转到了暹罗，也就是现在的泰国。

大家说这部电影后劲很足，没错，我有了二刷的冲动。买了一张电影票到了现场却空无一人--我，包场了。

没二刷之前我在想我一定要好好感受这部电影，把看到的、想到的都写出来。当键盘敲下来的这一刻，我沉默了，我无法用文字轻描淡写那段历史，无法形容木生对淑柔的爱、对家庭的责任以及南枝替木生写了18年的侨批，帮他养了18年的儿女。网友说，在这满是预制菜的年代有人突然用心给你熬了一锅砂锅粥，让你无比动容，这就是这部影片的魅力之处。

看电影时，我会自动带入接下来会发生什么，但这部电影好几次都在我的意料之外：

1.我以为长期的相处木生与南枝互生情愫，还没看到最后我也给故事开头下了定论——木生移情别恋。实际上，从头到尾他们都未曾有过想法。
2.旅店着火，木生背出南枝父亲后，又冲进火海拿他辛苦积攒下来的钱，我以为木生就葬身在这片火海中。
3.木生与劫匪发生搏斗，重伤之后掉进河里，我按照以往的电影剧情：他有主角光环最后肯定得救了。然而，这不是影片这是真实发生的事件，他的确是在又一次的见义勇为中牺牲了性命。

这部电影的高明之处在于总是在你的预判之外，该煽情的时候都是一笔带过，得知木生去世南枝与淑柔都没有歇斯底里的哭喊，老年的淑柔与南枝见面没有抱头痛哭的委屈，只有心照不宣的情谊。

这份情谊是南枝为报木生救父之恩，为不忍淑柔承受丧夫之痛，她替他爱了她十八年，写了十八年的情书。

江海万里，心中念你，便不觉遥远。

暹罗没有春天，你就是我的春天。

这份情谊是在淑柔得知真相之后，掏出全部积蓄哪怕变卖房产也要偿还，拖着年迈的身躯跨国与南枝相见。

那时候的感情就是这么纯粹：我什么都不图，我只要你们幸福。

此次出差还有了想去揭阳的冲动，查看车票从我这里出发高铁一个多小时。影片取景处不少网友前去打卡拍照。我倒不是刻意为了拍照，而是想身临其境的感受潮汕人民居住的地方，亲耳听一听潮汕话，看看当年珍藏下来的侨批，尝一尝当地的无米粿。然而，我依然没有踏出这一步，来日方长，往后总有机会。

潮汕人在每年的农历七月都有祭祀活动——施孤。政府为了支持这一传统特意安排了一片空地给居民：家家户户准备竹筐，内有白米饭、影片中的油柑还有无米粿及纸钱与寒衣等，放在地上烧香祭拜。而放地上的原因竟是担心有些腿脚不便的海外孤魂方便他们拿取。

通过影片与查阅资料，我对潮汕人衍生出了敬佩之心，就如同影片中所说：
做人得有情有义，无情无义的人不能交往。

我想，这就是刻在潮汕人骨子里的为人根本！

---

>Hola amigos, hoy les quiero compartir un poco de lo que es la cámara de este celular nuevo que compre es de la marca Tecno spark 40C, ya tenía claro que la cámara no era su fuerte, pero soy de las que piensa que no se necesita una cámara demasiado buena para tomar buenas fotografías, aunque aun estoy explorando como manejar esa nueva cámara, no ha sido facil. > Hi everyone, today I want to share a little bit about the camera on this new phone I bought—the Tecno Spark 40C. I knew going in that the camera wasn’t its strong suit, but I’m one of those people who thinks you don’t need a top-of-the-line camera to take good photos. Even though I’m still figuring out how to use this new camera, it hasn’t been easy.
![IMG_20260614_080207_919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23yTYq8yP6gJKggGRopRTzfoFeZHnB2WUhxPoag4mV6rEGM93TA7qvwvk4fM4g5BvaCsX.jpg)

>Las fotos salen bastante bien con mucha luz sobre todo luz del día, pero en lugares menos iluminados se ve bastante mal, los colores son un poco desaturados y la textura de las cosas parece verse muy “HDR” Sin tener activada esa opción. > The photos come out pretty well in bright light—especially in daylight—but in dimmer settings, the quality is pretty poor; the colors are a bit desaturated, and the texture of objects looks very “HDR”-like even though that option isn’t enabled. ![IMG_20260614_080227_157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/242hRzT2Wba9WQWyzTYecDtsWNuHV9bCN5LZLc3dK82cRbTyAEnqVQzjQLjSiY4Hy4zTR.jpg)

>Este celular cuenta con una cámara trasera de 13MP y una cámara delantera de 8MP, como les dije… los colores se ven un poco apagados, me di cuenta sobre todo cuando le tome fotos a mi gatito, en mi antiguo celular siempre sale bastante nítido y con buen color… Sin embargo, considero que se ve bastante bien y quizás con los ajustes correctos podría capturar una foto muchísimo mejor. > This phone has a 13MP rear camera and an 8MP front camera. As I mentioned… the colors look a little dull; I really noticed it when I took pictures of my kitten. On my old phone, the photos always came out pretty sharp and with good color… However, I think it looks pretty good, and maybe with the right settings I could take a much better photo. ![IMG_20260614_085413_823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23zbPXekJUfhXcEowtfqrtTashQYJDMVw17GEQnWvtauVMkzKqSPTuFGzcVBoALqayzEj.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_085554_909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23zS9cj55Sj4FYBM9nyiinkwpcnzYYtXiyVqdQoWEMKmR9qPigsKD2V2w6sk23keCK9NZ.jpg) ![IMG_20260615_155116_703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23ynMwThYCMw1nRjFLz2AaRNm6PxShCcbwKtFKAW6BsHvAM5NopZQ8GEMbsnitFoj8hrr.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_080148_353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvnpN68Q9xiMSAukahKjd7cREfw89VivJLNhF2v23EnxtPMtpV4uym6ZwWHXvNHCMrs.jpg)

>Y aunque en lugares no tan iluminados la calidad baja considerablemente, logre captar unas fotos que me gustaron mucho de mi gatito viendo hacia el sol usando el modo PRO, el cual descubrí después de un buen rato de tomar fotos jaja ni me había dado cuenta, tambien tiene una opción de cámara IA donde te toma 4 fotos y te cambia el peinado y vestuario pero es bastante bizarro, te pone caras de otras personas. > And even though the quality drops significantly in dimly lit areas, I managed to take some photos I really liked of my kitten looking toward the sun using PRO mode—which I only discovered after taking photos for a while, haha, I hadn’t even noticed it. It also has an AI camera option that takes four photos and changes your hairstyle and outfit, but it’s pretty weird—it puts other people’s faces on you. ![IMG_20260614_080544_941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tkk7iq4zL9dWu54FkjWAsaaWWxhgsLCsKysmEBvCSSBGnL7zSBYfhZpruRJ847ryKTi.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_080537_122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tbM6HJwU8WJAZEoQjCAYzUto5qfTHUNrBJaPsAJfwC1HFPTwTWXUtBm3AiXfKkmZq7h.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_080539_310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tbJxPARvZicQoELhVe8iZawq4ZUbtjmM5TzRZLY4rDHVk5QmsBFNRLjC6Hsr61HEW6y.jpg)

>Captar atardeceres es lo que mas me gusta y lo probe ayer al atardecer, la cuestión es que el encuadre no me gusto mucho y además el cielo tenia una pequeña luz rosa al final que no se veía demasiado en esta cámara. > Capturing sunsets is what I love most, and I tried it yesterday at sunset. The thing is, I didn't really like the composition, and besides, the sky had a faint pink glow at the edge that didn't show up very well on this camera. ![IMG_20260614_185839_641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23zkc2Ux2UE4FzXCfC9aWCV2brk3XWd2PdtjSPxxiKmSuWxZZ41xkmNL3Kxy396mntCnV.jpg)

>Y finalmente la cámara de selfie que, si me gusto bastante, se ve incluso mejor que mi celular antiguo, aunque en modo retrato como podrán apreciar en esa foto, el fondo se pone borroso, pero a veces no cubre por completo todo el fondo asi que termina viéndose una mancha extraña.- Aun asi me pareció bueno por su precio, teniendo en cuenta que no busca ser un celular de gama alta… De igual manera, mi celular Xiaomi aun enciende de vez en cuando jaja y lo usare cuando necesite fotos muy especificas ya que su cámara es insuperable. > And finally, the selfie camera—which I actually really liked—takes even better photos than my old phone. Although, as you can see in that photo, the background blurs in portrait mode, but sometimes it doesn’t completely cover the entire background, so you end up with a weird smudge. Still, I thought it was good for the price, considering it’s not meant to be a high-end phone… That said, my Xiaomi phone still turns on every now and then, haha, and I’ll use it when I need very specific photos since its camera is unbeatable. ![IMG_20260614_085736_218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vi1nRY8o1cgKZGANXmDMqdvNymkgLUCbdq5F6QWqbnnnaGVu4fc6eEMn35CLRo9oZzD.jpg)

# Shanksville, Pennsylvania

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanksville,_Pennsylvania

Shanksville is a borough in Somerset County, Pennsylvania, United States. It has a population of 199 as of the 2020 U.S. census.[2] It is part of the Somerset, Pennsylvania, Micropolitan Statistical Area, and is located 78 miles (126 km) southeast of Pittsburgh and 226 miles (364 km) west of Philadelphia.
Shanksville garnered global attention during the September 11 attacks when United Airlines Flight 93, bound from Newark, New Jersey, for San Francisco, crashed in adjacent Stonycreek Township after its passengers rebelled against the flight's al-Qaeda terrorist hijackers. It was the only one of the four hijacked planes that failed to reach the terrorists' intended target.

Ida's, Shanksville's general store
Shanksville is located at 40°1′2″N 78°54′21″W﻿ / ﻿40.01722°N 78.90583°W (40.017182, -78.905891),[4] with the borough covering 0.2 square mile (0.5 km2), all land; it also has the seventh-highest elevation of boroughs in Pennsylvania, peaking at 2,230 feet (680 m).[5]

![Image 1](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/14/Shanksville_main_street2.jpg/250px-Shanksville_main_street2.jpg)

Historical population
CensusPop.Note%±
1920260—19302724.6%194032419.1%19503425.6%1960314−8.2%1970275−12.4%1980273−0.7%1990235−13.9%20002454.3%2010237−3.3%2020199−16.0%2024 (est.)190[3] −4.5%Sources:[6][7]

As of the 2000 census, there were 245 people comprising 96 households and 69 families residing in the borough.[7] The population density was 1,391.9 inhabitants per square mile (537.4/km2). There were 100 housing units at an average density of 568.1 per square mile (219.3/km2). The racial makeup of the borough was 100.00% white.
There were 96 households, out of which 32.3% had children under the age of 18 living with them, 54.2% were married couples living together, 12.5% had a female householder with no husband present, and 28.1% were non-families. 22.9% of all households were made up of individuals, and 9.4% had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or older. The average household size was 2.55 and the average family size was 3.06.
In the borough, the population was spread out, with 26.5% under the age of 18, 10.2% from 18 to 24, 28.2% from 25 to 44, 19.6% from 45 to 64, and 15.5% who were 65 years of age or older. The median age was 36 years. For every 100 females there were 94.4 males. For every 100 females age 18 and over, there were 93.5 males.
The median income for a household in the borough was $29,980, and the median income for a family was $40,833. Males had a median income of $25,250 versus $25,917 for females. The per capita income for the borough was $14,500. About 4.8% of families and 9.1% of the population were below the poverty line, including 4.7% of those under the age of 18 and 12.5% of those 65 or over.

![Image 2](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/84/Somerset_County_Pennsylvania_Incorporated_and_Unincorporated_areas_Shanksville_Highlighted.svg/250px-Somerset_County_Pennsylvania_Incorporated_and_Unincorporated_areas_Shanksville_Highlighted.svg.png)

Christian Shank, a German immigrant, built a cabin on Stony Creek in 1798, later building a grist mill and two saw mills in the vicinity. Emmanuel Shaffer opened a store at the site in 1828, and the following year Shank laid out the town of Shanksville. The town was the home of John Suhre, a Union army private who was fatally wounded at the Battle of Fredericksburg and whose last days are described in Louisa May Alcott's short novel Hospital Sketches. The Shanksville post office was opened in 1874. Shanksville was incorporated as a borough on January 25, 1913.[8]

September 11 attacks[edit]

![Image 3](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f9/Pennsylvania_in_United_States_%28US48%29.svg/250px-Pennsylvania_in_United_States_%28US48%29.svg.png)

U.S. President George W. Bush and first lady Laura Bush visit Stonycreek Township near Shanksville on the first anniversary of the September 11 attacks.
On September 11, 2001, during the terrorist attacks on the United States, Shanksville received worldwide attention after United Airlines Flight 93 crashed into a field in Stonycreek Township, 1.75 miles (2.82 km) north of the town of Shanksville, killing all 40 civilians and four al-Qaeda hijackers on board. The hijackers had intended to fly the plane to Washington, D.C. and crash it into either the Capitol or the White House. However, after learning from family members via airphone of the earlier attacks on the World Trade Center and The Pentagon, the passengers on board revolted against the hijackers and fought for control of the plane, causing it to crash. It was the only one of the four aircraft hijacked that day that never reached its intended target.[9]
There are two memorials to the event. The original, temporary Flight 93 National Memorial to the passengers and crew of Flight 93 was located on a hill, about 500 yards (460 m) from the crash site. On July 8, 2010, a new temporary entrance and memorial were opened at an area called \

. It is where the FBI set up their command center and where family members first saw the aftermath of the crash, bringing their own memorials, and where visitors can leave them today. The initial phase of permanent construction of the Flight 93 National Memorial, including the visitors' center, was completed by the 10th anniversary in 2011. The memorial is built around the crash site, following the plane's flight path, and protecting the area of impact, known as the \

, which remains protected and accessible only to family members of the passengers and crew.
Shanksville's volunteer firefighters and emergency personnel from the nearby towns of Central City, Somerset, and others rushed to the crash scene to search for survivors. Members of the New York City Fire Department donated to the Shanksville Volunteer Fire Department a cross-shaped piece of steel salvaged from the World Trade Center. Mounted atop a Pentagon-shaped base, it was installed outside the firehouse and dedicated on August 24, 2008.[10][11]

Shanksville Borough Hall
The mayor of Shanksville is Chris Baeckel.[12]

![Image 4](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/55/WMA_button2b.png/20px-WMA_button2b.png)

The Shanksville-Stonycreek School District  is the area school district and operates public schools.[13]

title.body:
<center>![Llavero_Clutch_Khawamaru.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXcxb1EXQzGygHoWN3JitWYxm8zkzvoXCxf7ZTkjJPDhj/Llavero_Clutch_Khawamaru.jpg)
</center>
¡Hola, espero te encuentres de maravilla!
*Hi, I hope you are feeling great!*

<div class=\

>

Ya empezó el Mundial y quise diseñar a las 3 mascotas. Esta vez tamaño llavero. Estoy comenzando con Clutch el águila calva muy conocido de Estados Unidos de Norte América. >*The World Cup has already started, so I decided to design the three mascots. This time, they're keychain sized. I'm starting with the bald eagle, a famous bird in the United States.* ---------------------------- ---------------------------- ###

¡Hamuy!
###
*Let's go!*
![c1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTAzqEQwDneAfJK3FPWrh2LAEnWkJFr8F6KzJRFBHx49k/c1.jpg)
Cuando empiezo a **diseñar la cabeza de un muñeco**, estoy entre comenzar con un **anillo mágico de 6 ó 7** puntos bajos. Esto dependerá del personaje y las características que quiero plasmar. También veo el **tamaño de los ojos** que llevará, o si serán bordados. >*When I begin **designing a doll's head**, I'm torn between starting with a **magic ring of 6 or 7** single crochets. This will depend on the character and the features I want to capture. I also consider **the size of the eyes** and whether they will be embroidered.*
![c2_aguila_khawamaru.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaYHWiL1DuXyqqQBPX13Vccrye1U3rfC81UexjLYVgCbf/c2_aguila_khawamaru.jpg)
Mientras formaba la cabeza del águila, por un momento parecía un pulpo o medusa bebé, jaja. Cuando pasa esto, toca resaltar más las características del personaje. Sé que el bordado del rostro será de gran ayuda. >*While I was shaping the eagle's head, for a moment it looked like a baby octopus or jellyfish, jaja. When this happens, it’s time to really highlight the character’s features. I know that the facial embroidery will be a big help.*
![c3_clutch_khawamaru.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQc8w4LVfUyjX4SQJRN6jW28bEUaqJS7o8QKijREYc8DU/c3_clutch_khawamaru.jpg)
Esta versión será un llavero o mini muñeco. Por eso, estoy diseñandole una gran base para que se pare. Justo aquí viene el azul... es uno de mis colores favoritos. Y me alegra que este águila lo lleve como uniforme de fútbol. >*This version will be a crocheted keychain or mini toy. That's why I'm designing a sturdy base for it to stand on. Here comes the blue... it's one of my favorite colors. And I'm glad this eagle is wearing it as a soccer uniform.*
![c4_clutch_khawamaru.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYtkDynqJZYGRFY5qLDHybgo826MHnRqxvxTjB8JTSNxj/c4_clutch_khawamaru.jpg)
Las mini zapatillas en camino. Estoy utilizando el color lila porque creo que no tengo el lila fosforescente. Espero me quede como quiero. Si es así, en estos días estaré subiendo el video tutorial y comenzaré con Canadá. >*The mini running shoes are on their way. I'm using the lilac color because I don't think I have the neon lilac. I hope it turns out the way I want it to. If so, I'll be uploading the video tutorial in the next few days and will start with Canada.* ¡Y eso es todo! ¡Hasta la próxima! *See you next time!.* ----------------------- ----------------------
![crochet toys_amigurumi toys_khawamaru.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWEZxhxVLxJKjs39rSyMz4GZdtV2sf1Vgkjn6gZzyJQPX/crochet%20toys_amigurumi%20toys_khawamaru.jpg)

title.title: Memento (2000) | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
title.body: >\n\nHello, cinema fans. Today we’re kicking off another installment of our “Cult Directors” special, but this time with another great director who has proven himself to be one of the greatest cinematic geniuses of this century. We’re starting with one of his earliest films—the first one that left us utterly baffled by its baffling ending, to be honest. Based on a short story written by his brother
>Memento mori,” Memento was written and directed by the great
>Christopher Nolan. The film stars Guy Pearce, Carrie-Anne Moss, and Joe Pantoliano. Discover the film that managed to confuse an entire generation.

>
Hola, fanáticos del cine. Hoy damos inicio a otra sección del especial “Directores de Culto”, pero esta vez con otro grandioso director que ha demostrado ser uno de los grandes genios del cine de este siglo. Empezamos con una de sus primeras películas, la primera que nos dejó alucinando con su incomprensible final, en realidad. Basado en un cuento corto que escribió su hermano Jonathan titulado “Memento mori”, Memento fue escrito y dirigido por el gran Christopher Nolan. La película cuenta con el protagonismo de Guy Pearce, Carrie-Anne Moss y Joe Pantoliano. Conoce la película que logró confundir a toda una generación.

>

Plot

The film opens with a shot of a hand holding a Polaroid photograph of what appears to be a dead body against a bloodstained wall. As the seconds tick by, we see the hand shaking the photograph, and the image gradually fades away. Next, we see a flashback of a murder, followed by a photograph of the body. The next scene shows the same individual who committed the murder at the beginning waking up in a hotel, completely disoriented and unable to remember anything recent. Meanwhile, we hear his voice in what appears to be an internal monologue describing the situation.

>

Trama

La película inicia mostrándonos una mano sosteniendo una fotografía Polaroid con lo que parece ser un cuerpo muerto con una pared manchada de sangre. Mientras pasan los segundos, vemos cómo la mano agita la fotografía y la imagen se va desapareciendo poco a poco. Acto seguido, vemos una escena en retroceso de un asesinato, seguido de una fotografía del cuerpo. La siguiente escena es la del mismo individuo que asesinó al principio despertando en un hotel completamente desorientado e incapaz de recordar nada reciente. Mientras tanto, escuchamos su voz en lo que parece ser un monólogo interno describiendo la situación.

> What a way to kick off this special, really. I’m not just saying that because the movie I’m bringing you is one of the most confusing and difficult to watch and understand that I’ve ever seen, but also because this is the first time I’ve seen it—even though it’s apparently so well-known. Memento is a film that, in my opinion, serves perfectly as an opening to what you’ll see in the coming weeks, which will be dedicated to the “Cult Directors” special featuring Christopher Nolan. Surely many of you reading this are already familiar with his work, as some of his films have made history across various fields, genres, and eras. I decided to continue with this special, now talking to you about the Christopher Nolan films I know that have made history, since he is another director with a relatively small filmography, yet one that is just as powerful as that of many other well-known directors. Returning to Memento, the film is a perfect masterpiece for fans of psychological thrillers, puzzles, and plots deconstructed along a timeless and perfectly structured timeline. It’s a film I don’t recommend to everyone, especially those with such short attention spans due to heavy use of social media platforms like TikTok, for example.

>
Vaya forma de empezar este especial, de verdad. No solo lo digo porque la película que les traigo es de las más confusas y complicadas de ver y entender que he visto en mi vida, sino también porque es la primera vez que la veo, aún con lo conocida que es y todo, al parecer. Memento es una cinta que, opino yo, sirve perfectamente como una apertura a lo que verán en las siguientes semanas que estarán dedicadas al especial “Directores de Culto” con Christopher Nolan. Seguramente muchos de los que me leen conocerán su trabajo ya que algunas de sus películas hicieron historia en varios ámbitos, géneros y épocas. Decidí continuar con este especial, ahora hablándoles de las películas de Christopher Nolan que conozco y que han hecho historia ya que es otro director que tiene un repertorio filmográfico relativamente pequeño, pero igual de potente que el de muchos otros directores conocidos. Volviendo con Memento, la película es una cátedra perfecta para los que son fanáticos del thriller psicológico, los acertijos y las tramas deconstruidas en una línea atemporal y perfectamente dividida. Es una película que no recomiendo a todo el mundo, menos a los que tienen tan corta capacidad de atención debido al alto consumo de redes sociales como TikTok, por ejemplo.

> With Memento, you have to pay close attention—not only to each scene, but also to what’s going on around it, as well as to the dialogue and the vast number of clues, signals, and details the film offers throughout its nearly two-hour runtime. All of this is so that you can understand a little of everything happening around our protagonist, who is also a very special case due to a serious mental condition called anterograde amnesia, which prevents him from retaining memories made after the incident that caused his disability. To carry on with his life, he created a complex system that allows him to retain certain important information. The problem with all this is that, due to the incident that left him in this state, he decides to embark on a dark path of revenge and has spent a long time searching for the culprit, not only of his disability but also of the loss of his beloved wife. One interesting thing to keep in mind about this movie—whether you watch it now or later—is that it tells two sides of a story that unfold in parallel. In other words, there are two parts to the story: the first is told in color, but in a descending or backward chronological order, while the second part is told in black and white, but in an ascending chronological order.

>
Con Memento tienes que prestar bastante atención, no solo a cada escena, sino a su alrededor, además de los diálogos y la enorme cantidad de pistas, señales y elementos que nos ofrece a lo largo de sus casi dos horas de duración. Todo esto es con tal de que comprendas un poco todo lo que ocurre alrededor de nuestro protagonista, quien también es un caso muy especial al tener un serio problema mental llamado amnesia anterógrada, lo cual le imposibilita retener recuerdos recientes o posteriores al incidente que le ocasionó dicha discapacidad. Para poder seguir con su vida, creó un complejo sistema que le permite retener cierta información importante. El problema de todo esto es que, debido a dicho incidente que lo dejó así, decide recorrer un oscuro camino de venganza y lleva mucho tiempo buscando al culpable, no solo de su discapacidad, sino también de la pérdida de su querida esposa. Una cosa interesante que deben de tener en cuenta de esta película ahora o luego si desean ir a verla es que la misma nos cuenta dos lados de una historia que se van construyendo de forma paralela. O sea, que hay dos partes de una historia: la primera es contada a color, pero de forma descendente o en retroceso, mientras que la segunda parte es contada en blando y negro, pero de forma ascendente.

> What’s interesting is how the film itself presents both stories, distinguishing them not only visually but also by playing with the order of the sequences, moments, cuts, and transitions. Another thing worth noting is the way the film draws our attention to all the details surrounding our protagonist in every scene, gradually giving us the context of what he does—since it seems that before his incident he was some kind of investigator—and we notice certain habits or actions that stand out quite a bit. There are also characters who appear throughout the film who also draw a lot of attention. The first to stand out is Teddy, the man we see at the beginning with the protagonist and who seems to suspect that he is the person he’s been looking for all this time. However, as the minutes pass, we reach a point where we don’t know who he really is (or was, but anyway). We also have Natalie, a woman whom our protagonist seems to be connected to because of a favor he asked her to do. While in the first half-hour the story seems straightforward—with what appeared to be the ending right from the start—soon we find ourselves asking more and more questions about everything that’s happening.

>
Lo interesante es cómo la misma película nos muestra ambas historias, diferenciándose no sólo a nivel visual, sino también jugando también con el orden de las secuencias, los momentos, los cortes y las transiciones. Otra cosa a destacar es la forma en la que la película centra nuestra atención a todos los detalles que hay alrededor de nuestro protagonista en cada escena, dándonos poco a poco el contexto de lo que él hace -ya que parece que antes de su incidente era una especie de investigador- y notamos ciertos hábitos o acciones que resaltan bastante. También están los personajes que aparecen a lo largo de la película que también llaman mucho la atención. El primero que resalta es Teddy, el hombre al que vemos al principio con el protagonista y que parece sospechar de que él sea la persona que ha estado buscando todo este tiempo. Sin embargo, con el paso de los minutos, llegamos a un punto en el que no sabemos quién es realmente (o fue, pero bueno). También tenemos a Natalie, una mujer que parece que nuestro protagonista está relacionado con ella debido a un favor que le pidió que hiciera. Si bien en la primera media hora vemos cómo la historia llega a ser fácil de entender, viendo lo que pareció ser el final al principio, luego son más y más las preguntas que nos hacemos de todo lo que está ocurriendo.

> And it’s normal to have so many questions, even as we reach the film’s climax, where everything leads to a completely mind-blowing conclusion. The way it all ends—so natural, yet so macabre and nonsensical—is truly absurd. Well, let’s keep in mind that the movie itself takes a downward turn to a certain extent, and everything we discover about our protagonist—like his name, his past, and everything he’s been doing since the incident—is so complex that it’s hard to draw a definitive conclusion about it all. But this is mainly due to the protagonist’s own inability to retain recent memories. Who knows how many years he’s been doing this—seeking revenge for his wife’s death by investigating and catching the killer—whether he managed to catch and kill him in the end or not, whether everything he knows or has managed to investigate and retain all this time is true or not, and so on. So many things happen in such a chaotic and timeless way that it’s understandable that one ends up feeling more disoriented than Leonard Shelby himself. A notable detail is the entire relationship and dialogue our protagonist has with the other characters mentioned throughout the film. All of this is done with the specific intention of confusing us and making us experience what the protagonist is going through.

>
Y es normal que te hagas tantas preguntas, incluso cuando llegamos a la parte final de la película donde todo nos lleva a un desenlace final que es completamente alucinante. La forma tan natural y a la vez tan macabra y sin sentido en lo que finaliza todo es absurdo, de verdad. Bueno, tengamos en cuenta que la propia película va de forma descendente hasta cierto punto y todo lo que descubrimos de nuestro protagonista como su nombre, su pasado y todo lo que ha estado haciendo luego del incidente es tan complejo que es difícil sacar una conclusión acertada a todo. Pero esto se debe principalmente a la propia incapacidad del protagonista de no retener recuerdos recientes. Quién sabe cuántos años ha estado haciendo esto de ir a vengarse de la muerte de su esposa al investigar y atrapar al asesino, si lo consiguió atrapar y matar al final o no, si todo lo que sabe o ha conseguido investigar y retener por todo este tiempo es verídico o no, etc. Son tantas cosas que suceden de una forma tan desordenada y atemporal que es comprensible que uno se quede más desorientado que el mismo Leonard Shelby al final. Un detalle notable es toda la relación y diálogos que tiene nuestro protagonista con los otros personajes ya mencionados a lo largo de la película. Todo esto está hecho así con dicha intención de confundir y hacernos vivir lo que vive el protagonista.

> This is something I really liked about the movie—the way it made me rack my brain with its unique storytelling and structured the narrative so that we could experience exactly what Leonard is going through. Needless to say, that confusing ending is also perfect for this movie, as it leaves it up to the viewer to draw their own conclusions after everything they’ve just seen. Personally, I don’t know if what I just watched was a complex story of revenge, betrayal, manipulation, and murder, or if it was actually the rambling confession of a serial killer who’s perfect for the job because of his mental disability. But anyway, those of you who have seen this movie can tell me what you think about it and what conjectures or assumptions you drew after watching it. What fascinates me most about this psychological thriller is the way it gnaws at your mind with so many ideas, assumptions, questions, and issues that make you doubt even your own existence. Because yes, Memento can even be considered a very specific case of a lack of or search for identity, and the entire story it tells us about Sammy Jankis and how he relates to the protagonist is a perfect example of this. What if, in reality, the final fate of Leonard Shelby’s wife was the same as that of Sammy’s wife?

>
Esto es algo que me gustó mucho de la película, que me quiebre la cabeza con su forma tan única de narrarnos dicha historia y construirla de una forma que podamos experimentar lo que experimenta Leonard. No hace falta mencionar que dicho final, todo confuso, es también perfecto para esta película ya que deja a consideración del espectador qué conclusiones sacar luego de todo lo que uno acaba de ver. Personalmente, no sé si lo que acabé de ver fue una compleja historia de venganza, traición, manipulación y asesinato o fue en realidad la confusa declaración de un asesino en serie perfecto debido a su discapacidad mental. Pero bueno, ya me dirán los que sí hayan visto esta película qué opinan al respecto y qué conjeturas o suposiciones sacaron luego de haberla visto. Lo que más me fascina del thriller psicológico es la forma como te carcome la mente con tantas ideas, suposiciones, preguntas y cuestiones que te hacen dudar hasta de tu propia existencia. Porque sí, Memento incluso se puede considerar como un caso muy particular de falta o búsqueda de identidad y toda la historia que nos cuenta de Sammy Jankis y cómo se relaciona con el protagonista es una razón perfecta de esto. ¿Y si en realidad el destino final de la esposa de Leonard Shelby fue el mismo que el de la esposa de Sammy?

> The film also stands out visually and aurally, especially considering the era in which it was made. And that’s to be expected, given that Christopher Nolan himself was behind this film. Not only do we see his ingenious ability to tell mind-blowing stories, but we also see the first cinematic evidence of his mastery of the audiovisual medium. The use of cameras, the shots, the film’s cool, grayish palette, the use of light and shadow, the visual elements, and the vast array of practical resources and elements in the film are fascinating. Another aspect that really stands out is the production, composition, and cinematographic styles in the various settings and scenes we see throughout the film. I really love how it plays with all the visual elements to convey everything our protagonist sees, thinks, and feels. And not only that, but the sound effects and the film’s soundtrack also contribute greatly to this. You can perfectly feel the moments of tension and mystery throughout the film just by listening to the background music and watching the changes in the cinematography. Anyway, here’s this perfect movie to leave you thinking for quite a while.
Personally, I give it a rating of 8.5/10 in terms of the psychological thriller, mystery, and drama genres.

>
La película también logra destacarse muy bien a nivel audiovisual, considerando la época en la que fue producida. Y es de esperarse al saber que es el mismo Christopher Nolan quien estuvo detrás de esta película. No solo vemos su capacidad ingeniosa de contarnos historias que nos vuelan la cabeza, sino que también vemos los primeros registros cinematográficos de su maestría para lo audiovisual. El uso de las cámaras, los planos, la paleta fría y grisácea que tiene la película, el uso de las luces y las sombras, los elementos visuales y la enorme cantidad de recursos o elementos prácticos que tiene la película es fascinante. Otra cosa con la que se luce también es la producción, orden y estilos de fotografía en los diferentes escenarios o fragmentos que vemos a lo largo de esta película. Me gusta mucho cómo juega con todos los elementos visuales para transmitirnos todo lo que ve, piensa y siente nuestro protagonista. Y no solo eso, sino que también los efectos de sonido y la banda sonora que tiene la película colaboran mucho con esto. Se puede sentir perfectamente los momentos de tensión y misterio a lo largo de la película con tan solo escuchar la música de fondo y ver los cambios en la fotografía. En fin, aquí les dejo esta película perfecta para que te deje pensando por un buen rato.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 8.5/10 en lo que respecta al género de suspenso psicológico, misterio y drama.

>
Tell me, have you seen this movie yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿ya has visto esta película? ¿Qué te ha parecido? Puedes dejarme tu respuesta en los comentarios.

title.body: ![ye - 2026-06-15T184542.041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23yJbNFSbbAcGihqED2gwqAZsK28ZUyXNywSaw48Kj5PHDPBGfvHHHdQUpbaUvbKyCC1r.jpg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23w2exJn87nDqqpAWsGGyYyKPBAGm1LkTE49wzd7Dz285BTDydHtUokkZjsgqtnhvrUxw.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EprU4VVe7B2BVY5ki2EbiSEkNfe7R1REdk3Cak7SaQqi59nGv6XUgNrf4ui9sYirA4g.png) # Tarjeta Pop Up / Papelería creativa

> [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! ¡Qué viva el amor! Hice esta tarjeta inspirada en el amor, quizá manifestándolo también, llevo mas de 5 años en soledad, me acostumbre a ella, pero tal vez algún día vuelva a sonreírme el amor. Amo ver las parejas y las personas que se aman de verdad, me encanta. No he podido publicar como lo hacía con regularidad, me está costando mucho la verdad, con los cortes de servicio eléctricos prolongados por hasta 8 horas y el calor me descompensa mucho, durante ese tiempo sin poder hacer nada, pienso que llevo casi 10 años que no salgo de vacaciones como acostumbraba hacer, pero vacaciones de verdad, la economía no permite por ahora, también he andado en consultas médicas y mi cuerpo se ha sentido increíblemente cansado. Así que mejor pensemos bonito e inspirémonos de lo bonito, el amor es el mejor rincón donde podemos sentirnos a gusto. Espero les guste.

> [Eng] Greetings, everyone! Long live love! I made this card inspired by love—perhaps as a way of expressing it too. I’ve been on my own for over five years now; I’ve got used to it, but maybe one day love will smile on me again. I love seeing couples and people who truly love each other; I absolutely adore it. I haven’t been able to post as regularly as I used to; to be honest, it’s been really tough. With power cuts lasting up to eight hours and the heat, I feel completely out of sorts. During that time, when I can’t do anything, I realise it’s been nearly ten years since I last went on holiday as I used to, but a proper holiday – the economy doesn’t allow for that at the moment. I’ve also been to see the doctor and my body has felt incredibly tired. So let’s think positively and draw inspiration from the beautiful things; love is the best place where we can feel at ease. I hope you like it. ---

> [Esp] Para mí es muy divertido esto de la papelería creativa. Toma una cartulina tamaño carta y corta una sección de 7 centímetros. Dobla la cartulina por la mitad, luego la parte delantera la doblas por la mitad para hacia afuera. Toma la medida de la parte interna de la tarjeta y corta una sección, repite el paso anterior, dobla por la mitad y luego esa mitad la doblas hacia afuera.

> [Eng] I really enjoy this creative card-making. Take a sheet of A4 card and cut off a 7-centimetre section. Fold the card in half, then fold the front half outwards. Measure the inside of the card and cut off a section; repeat the previous step, fold it in half, and then fold that half outwards. ---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 |||| |-|-|-| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoGyM6pFhFyjEzgJb8m7L6cyRfvkGevzZYPAqrLZJ7RKYCURsAsZbPybWrkpW6fymEK.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EopuMLa6ZYc57KuR2yPQciKMirvFcDVRdKu8LBTs2mMwgynnbaiRqL91nNDiXPjWqsv.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eos2jYMQ6Y6W9e2c3i5kkSwGsfRiVj45tmMce4cmCMJjvJtKHc1DktnxfZkbhPx1Nqo.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eoke6iqdugU9viCjXqHbKiPjVS9ah1SXBHrnV7bAnakYNhw1Hbh2n2vtRDbp3wLeTHz.png)

> [Esp] Pega la segunda cartulina doblada en la parte interior de la tarjeta. Luego pega la imagen central en la parte delantera de la tarjeta, esta debes pegarla por la mitad dejando la otra mitad libre. En un texto de tu preferencia, recorta y pega un pedacito de cinta doble faz por detrás y luego la pegas en el centro del corazón este le dará un efecto 3D Recorta corazones de cartulina escarchada o foami escarchado y pegas delante. Agrega más palabras si deseas.

> [Eng] Stick the second folded piece of card onto the inside of the card. Then stick the central image onto the front of the card; you should stick it down halfway, leaving the other half free. Choose a text of your choice, cut it out, stick a small piece of double-sided tape on the back, and then stick it in the centre of the heart to create a 3D effect. Cut out hearts from glitter card or glitter foam and stick them on the front. Add more words if you wish. ---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 |||| |-|-|-| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eo8TGipUbbYn8X3pC5ra2ih3qhR6na9CKGEA7xtunHWZwmVnRFaGWQwNaUMwsGvLHX4.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EokedsthEV573GmTg7ASpy8wouput4YRyDS7qm8bDDjtnYUZTzRygDrmN3v6f43Q188.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eoc9XGgX5RyXaS6rcDptoaerkChJcwfB7oWaqQsGs5jpDgcHdf17sGH1AprSZydsfda.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoK7hmrzxoaTDebiLznjZtEpQqYYZBpGez6znw9aR9hPYCDKNyeYWQwJeosb3sK3UiU.png)

> [Esp] Recorta unas tiras de cartulina de color, estas tienen 1,5 centímetros de ancho. Pega tres separados en la parte interior de la tarjeta. Ahora pega la figura central procurando que no se vea en la parte de afuera.

> [Eng] Cut some strips of coloured card, each 1.5 centimetres wide. Stick three of them separately to the inside of the card. Now stick the central figure in place, making sure it isn’t visible from the outside. ---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 |||| |-|-|-| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eou9gX7Liab6RG1vRvNTVwX5X17rXPB393wSF3kCrRK6EyyPdsgMDZZXkoWoK79ymMi.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoeFt4KbsxkzqrFABo5G8Ptr6tk6Bp6NBskPMd89LVd8D7gh2o3hbLLMAdyKtLPCo1t.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoK7GMXyzHFyPDHtqhVE5UiAGXPsngqQ993myLW61j5Aw86WUpftz4aZP4NmyiqRt97.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eoke3fdm132dVoDaFpBXigAG1fKG4SMkEcofN6nqGTAiGMm365mKPCyC5FXSELPsTy9.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Ep3fKup39jtDpgmaxbQ2NtHTyPEQ7jgSqgSs7YMer5TsutNacHBmTWbmTCXkEfmvz3q.png)

> [Esp] En el doblez de la parte interna de la segunda pieza, decora a tu gusto, he colocado un texto de dedicatoria. Ahora nen la parte delantera del mismo, coloco otra dedicatoria pero queda escondida. Para decorar agregue detalles de corazones con el marcador blanco y realicé un cuadro en la pieza interna central. Esta es una tarjeta popo up muy linda y colorida que he tenido el placer de hacer, me encanta pues es muy estilo scrapbook. Espero les guste.

> [Eng] On the inside fold of the second piece, decorate it however you like; I’ve added a dedication message. Now, on the front of the same piece, I’ve added another dedication, but it’s hidden. To decorate it, I added heart details with a white marker and drew a square on the central inner panel. This is a lovely, colourful pop-up card that I’ve had the pleasure of making; I love it as it has a real scrapbook style. I hope you like it. ---

title.title: UFC Freedom 250 gives us one of the best fights of all time
title.body: I had my reservations about this event because I knew it was going to be missing a lot of the electricity of a normal stadium event that UFC would normally have.   I also thought that it could have easily become a political thing but despite all the whining that was going on and how some lunatics out there tried to stop the thing from happening with a last-minute BS lawsuit, the event was actually done very well even though the noise around the actual octagon wasn't as loud as it normally would be.   I didn't really notice it at the time but apparently there was a gigantic \

near the White House that I was told had 80,000 people in attendance.  That's pretty wild.

<center> https://media-cldnry.s-nbcnews.com/image/upload/c_fill,g_auto,w_2500,h_1776/rockcms/2026-06/260614-UFC-white-house-ww-1744-b22c5f.jpg
[src](https://media-cldnry.s-nbcnews.com/image/upload/c_fill,g_auto,w_2500,h_1776/rockcms/2026-06/260614-UFC-white-house-ww-1744-b22c5f.jpg)</center>

For me personally, even if it was free, I would never go to this but a lot of other people had fun and apparently there were no major incidents so that is a good thing.   

The fight card was pretty good and I really feel as though the fighters were really \

on this one because it was such a momentous event that won't be repeated again probably in my lifetime at least.  All of the fights ended in finishes by KO and this is something that is truly special.  I have always said that at a lot of these events the participants don't seem to be trying to win, they seem to be trying to NOT LOSE.  This results in dancing and hugging competitions rather than the brawls that we all tune into these things for.  \n\nOut of all the competitors it looked like everyone came there to brawl except for Derrick Lewis who is always incredibly unreliable, has no \

to speak of, and honestly, should seriously consider retiring.  Since this loss will likely take him out of the top 10 and UFC is really trying to make the heavyweight division a big thing again, it might not be left up to him.  I wouldn't count on seeing him in major events anytime soon, maybe a Fight Night here and there.   

The biggest fight of the night was one that a lot of people kind of thought was going to be a farce because many were saying that Justin Gaetje didn't deserve to be in there at all vs Topuria but got the job because he is American and pretty well-liked by everyone.  He also puts on amazing performances whether he wins or loses.  He never has a boring fight.  

<center> https://www.aljazeera.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ap_6a2f96261f0b6-1781503526.jpg?resize=770%2C513&quality=80
[src](https://www.aljazeera.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ap_6a2f96261f0b6-1781503526.jpg?resize=770%2C513&quality=80)</center>

At the beginning of the fight Justin was all over the place and clearly looking to be the aggressor but any time that Topuria would strike back it looked really scary for Gaetje because the Spaniard champion was taking a lot of hits but didn't seem all that phased by them.   When Topuria got Gaethje rattled in round 2 and then took him to the ground, I was just stunned that Justin made it to the round break.   There's no way for me to know this for sure, but I think maybe Topuria wasn't trying as hard as he could for the submission because he was trying to conserve energy or maybe he had a bit of arrogance because nobody has come even close to defeating him in his last 17 matches.  

At one point he was a 6 to 1 favorite to win this fight and virtually nobody in the press was picking Justin for the win.  One person did though and it was announced during the event that the day of the fight, somebody put a $150,000 bet on Gaethje to win and well, that guy is pretty happy because as the fight went on Gaetje was taking control as Topuria's face started to look like it was going to fall off of his skull.

<center> https://platform.mmafighting.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/109/2026/06/gettyimages-2281639496.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0%2C0%2C100%2C100&w=2400
[src](https://platform.mmafighting.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/109/2026/06/gettyimages-2281639496.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0%2C0%2C100%2C100&w=2400)</center>

Gaethje tooks some shots as well, but nothign like the really hard ones that he doled out.  It is amazing to me that Ilia remained conscious through some of those extremely hard shots.  

Some crazy stuff happened as well and at the time this pissed me off.  The ring doctor was brought in to determine whether or not Ilia was medically cleared to carry on fighting between rounds 3 and 4 and when this happens, it is supposed to happen in the normal allotted time between rounds.  This took longer than usual, a full minute longer, and this looked really unfair because not Topuria, who had just been completely battered in round 3, was getting additional rest time. 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/23u5tiWDHU8CRbQCvomE3PxUACeuUGazckTxAVmu3mgz5DWdfeko2DumEQfNvZbUJzXSh.png)
[src](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTNwrAcMyWxNPqpfUEEDYN6I7UH-8VzO42NBnlblkNY1yf499YelBl3bhNl&s=10)</center>

At this point the announcers were saying that Ilia was saying he couldn't see out of his right eye but when the ringside doctor tried to call the fight off the Spaniard pleaded with him to allow the fight to continue and carry on they did.  

Round 4 did not get any better for the champ though and there were some crazy strikes that happened in that round as well including a knee to the ribs that at least from our TV perspective, looked like it went 25% of the way through his damn body.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/EorzmCDTddpdXHLcu3zYktCpm7sSJj1ncJEJ7KykPoMc3tXV24GdSDevvWKPwg8QEGM.png)
[src](https://s.yimg.com/ny/api/res/1.2/BSd_3yAB.JYwMhdshyX66g--/YXBwaWQ9aGlnaGxhbmRlcjt3PTY0MDtoPTQyNztjZj13ZWJw/https://d29szjachogqwa.cloudfront.net/images/2026-06/192e0539-1634-46cd-97a3-e9082529db45)</center>

By the time the break for round 4 was upon us. Topuria's corner said they do not wish to continue.   While many look at this as quitting, just look at that guy's face.  His eyes are swollen shut, his nose is twice the size it was at the start, and he was partially in dreamland at least twice in the fight as he struggled to remain conscious.   For a normal person they would have had all of their ribs on the right side of their body destroyed as well.   

As far as the publicly released medical report is concerned, Topuria suffered an orbital fracture around his right eye and well, you need those if you want your brain to remain inside your head.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/23vsJAHFjLTRkzComa4GXyETvvBZxefpgJK5Wdc6CF5mZ9PasoqW3Lah1XZkuJegEo7VP.png)
[src](https://images.foxtv.com/static.fox5dc.com/www.fox5dc.com/content/uploads/2026/06/932/524/ufc-white-house-getty-1.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)</center>

Justin Gaethje, a guy that almost nobody picked to win this fight and most of us were just hoping he could last long enough to not destroy his career, is the new Lightweight Champion of the world.

this is no fluke either.  He basically dominated that fight especially after the 2nd round.  It was touch and go in the first and I was standing in my room because of nerves even when it was clear Justin had the advantage.  

<center> https://d.ibtimes.co.uk/en/full/1813079/gaethje.jpg?w=736&f=03ee21ae8291d587e17981cea617e88e
[src](https://d.ibtimes.co.uk/en/full/1813079/gaethje.jpg?w=736&f=03ee21ae8291d587e17981cea617e88e)</center>

his post fight interview with Joe went well, he kept it apolitical, and was very gracious to his opponent that he had just defeated.  Honestly, this couldn't have happened to a better guy and he deserved the \

![JAJ6H1jypespcfPN_mmexport1781440394473.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/JAJ6H1jypespcfPN_mmexport1781440394473/JAJ6H1jypespcfPN_mmexport1781440394473.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

武汉的夏天还是非常燥热的，但是武汉依旧有很多火锅店营业的时候，人还挺多的。在这个热辣的夏天，在空调房里吃上一顿酸爽酸辣的火锅，其实也挺到位的。
 
特别是在这种以云南口味为主，然后里面选了酸辣锅底的这种，再配上气泡冰爽的雪碧可乐饮料简直不要太爽了。我们那天晚上出去两三个人聚餐，就选了这家火锅店。
 
感觉它里面的肉还挺新鲜的，摆盘也还挺好。然后锅底的佐料和小龙坎海底捞那些都不太一样，有那种云南特有的风味，口感还挺好的。然后它里面的服务也还行。
 
到了晚上 8 点钟多的时候是人最多的，服务员有些忙忙不过来。里面的吊龙牛肉强烈推荐哟！

马上转眼又要期末考试，唉，有点淡淡的担心。我们武汉这边学校五年级原调和六年级原调，也就是说五六年级期末考试的成绩会在初中分班的时候做一定的参考，所以还是有一点担心这个小朋友的，唉，怎么办呢？每次成绩忽上忽下，发挥不稳定，真是让我有些纠结。😓囧
