title.title: Delicioso almuerzo// Arroz, frijoles negros y pescado frito// (Esp/Eng)
title.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![1000497643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2uN1p1fyDMoKLhuuGriP271p4LpKJf7wWNWBXGvrdmnU1EAcda5bzH1Uifg8231Fhk.jpg)

> Hola, amigos, nuevamente estoy por aquí para compartir con ustedes una receta para un almuerzo. Les cuento, amigos, que este tipo de almuerzo es muy nutritivo y reconfortante; ademas, es muy popular en mi región. Se trata de unos frijoles negros, arroz blanco y pescado frito; como muchos saben que cuando acompañamos estos frijoles con carne desmechada, es el plato típico de nuestra región conocido como el pabellón. Este pescado con que acompaño este plato lo conocemos como picua y es un pescado de carne blanca, y lo podemos preparar de diferentes maneras; esta vez lo cortamos en filetes, ya que queda más delicioso. Espero que a ustedes les guste esta receta. Aquí les dejo el paso a paso. > Hi, friends, I’m back again to share a lunch recipe with you. Let me tell you, friends, this kind of lunch is very nutritious and comforting; plus, it’s very popular in my region. It consists of black beans, white rice, and fried fish; as many of you know, when we serve these beans with shredded meat, it’s the typical dish of our region known as pabellón. The fish I’m serving with this dish is called picua—it’s a white-fleshed fish that can be prepared in various ways; this time, we’re cutting it into fillets, since that makes it even more delicious. I hope you enjoy this recipe. Here are the step-by-step instructions. --- ![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)

>

![1000494703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsQpxqkQoKkZyRwWbwijhWwz6c6RUkcsEmWHkkXXn7scCo3eLmNPS3ovEvg8xiZ38Ka.jpg)
![El texto del párrafo (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EowNPiUud55yj2BkuDpKGUA8asqcUnP2g4hytTz9iUtwoeMREbopLjBeaQpT27KBKrK.jpg)
## Preparación de los frijoles negros - Para ello, lo primero que hacemos es dejar en remojo toda la noche los frijoles, luego los lavamos bien y los ponemos a cocinar en una olla con abundante agua en la cocina a fuego alto hasta que estén blandos. Luego agregamos en una sartén aceite y, cuando esté caliente, añadimos la cebolla, y los ajíes dulces cortados en cubos pequeños previamente lavados. Seguidamente, el ajo triturado, y dejamos sofreír y, cuando esté listo, añadimos el sofrito a los frijoles y dejamos cocinar por unos minutos; añadimos sal al gusto, pimienta y un poco de panela rallada para darle el dulzor, ya que a la familia le gusta con el toque dulce. Ya pasados los minutos. Listo estos deliciosos frijoles negros. > ## Preparing the black beans > - To do this, first soak the beans overnight, then rinse them thoroughly and cook them in a pot with plenty of water on the stove over high heat until tender. Next, heat oil in a skillet, and once hot, add the onion and the sweet peppers, which have been washed and diced into small cubes. Next, add the crushed garlic and sauté until fragrant. When ready, add the sautéed mixture to the beans and let them cook for a few minutes; add salt to taste, pepper, and a little grated panela to add sweetness, since the family likes a touch of sweetness. After a few minutes, these delicious black beans are ready.
|![1000494608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMUEF6APiFn4ai4jdKnLuFjU8nbK7XacAcDbSboXSPjg2TZykJPzPDxyWwq4KNk2yVs.jpg)|![1000494609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vhwxbwc8rqBNz18NFSivBNVPYfyNZ313LHyEw2ruC5Hb3KHtWCD2UdzDqLsGRoHnKLN.jpg)| |-|-| |![1000494650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2gxLjaQAzBaZz9Cc9ATZXP8C3QCQX9FMsEBjqd1nnhpSBuwLLctJmWZZrSYssw7YQH.jpg)|![1000494651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vhyWDtfj1cM5Qe7ERVYKGYT7PJwN5EdhucdmMtxUYFP93j4o6NvSPG5R5DwDHnaUhPm.jpg)| |![1000494652.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u63AJCUGAWGDYd2S3Gd8tHQi4mJfjJRU1ZQmyv1pCHiLemii66AYHmjeL5xP6TRZKuM.jpg)|![1000494702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xyTN9qDc1LKfw6n35tEDPByjEpRLLKzjJE2dSAp4qsm3JVYhLTKVP4rdHwMyA8h19Pi.jpg)| |-|-|
![1000494786.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wC9VUdDJ1UgB5VAWxQxafPfr8xEvSaTRy1XfohTKTu9PUE43FwsodxcK5MERQRMEMno.jpg)
## Preparación del arroz blanco - Para la preparación del arroz, lo primero que hacemos es lavar el arroz y dejar escurrir. Luego colocamos una olla con agua en la cocina a fuego alto y, cuando esté caliente, añadimos el arroz y sal al gusto y dejamos cocinar; y cuando ya el agua se evapore, le colocamos la tapa y dejamos cocinar a fuego bajo hasta que el agua se evapore. Ya está listo este arroz.
|![1000494753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCDwGzqRe6EYJT6SvmPEJwxFqgecuA4tp6G3zVdcZ6SC3Q1tZ8tUA1LZmgXQihnj7hq.jpg)|![1000494754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tmPoPKvHVqtFYTsgK5gPs8F4rrvU7qdN1HysE99pXqkeSdPQ2XjQfbdmZmeL63amfNg.jpg)| |-|-| |![1000494788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x172EoWjkfd2x26ivm4zn9si15sMLzAkxNMCPux45GHmy3ncec2iweuvSb8QNyRvvFB.jpg)|![1000494801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xei6ubEZyFUL71JLgoLnErpEm5kcsCrnNemK7Kfqp1D5PzsKLwt5SMy9b4F7DbvHSGy.jpg)|
![1000494802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2sDCbcQ14gDQKMk3KdjFg9pCH5LN7xqDkUp18N4VYgqkDRG8iaSZhsUdxe8tQGeUUd.jpg)
## Preparación del pescado - Para la preparación del pescado, lo primero que hacemos es arreglar el pescado. Este se llama picua y lo cortamos en forma de filete, pues así es como le gusta aquí en casa. Luego lo lavamos muy bien para retirar la sangre. Ahora colocamos una sartén en la cocina a fuego alto y le añadimos aceite, y cuando esta esté caliente, pasamos primero el pescado por harina de trigo y lo agregamos a la sartén para que se vaya friendo de ambos lados. Una vez frito por ambos lados, se retira; el pescado está listo. > ## Preparing the Fish > - To prepare the fish, the first thing we do is clean it. This fish is called picua, and we cut it into fillets, since that’s how we like it here at home. Then we wash it thoroughly to remove any blood. Next, we place a skillet on the stove over high heat and add oil. Once the oil is hot, we first coat the fish in flour and add it to the skillet to fry on both sides. Once fried on both sides, we remove it; the fish is ready.
|![1000494747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uFc5WnBTGZNttJAWpgEjeKydwWxkozUr16BoT16ymxgW7vFgcXJFVgseKP6w93Key6E.jpg)|![1000494751.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zbU4C7d8CRfygBXQLaASiE5MrpBjEDDEJ3iTKcu42ChwfDrXN1XsfjRaKxWHtXH1pFV.jpg)| |-|-| |![1000494748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tmLE81Ciy5CBzZZxD8n5GtZdJoLh2m6r9mBvwAFscUqukCHjvrTJMCk9SfF99WJDiwh.jpg)|![1000494783.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2qZJmHUS6vjWPrBGGtzeV3BjWuiLwxPh9WJ688bsD5vtrwnfG1yY16w8rKE2fddRRw.jpg)|

title.title: Common Cerulean Butterfly.
title.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUCiqMQUTnKK3Udsjwt95KZDFZyEhxdacVPk56uW8NLPT/1781581669868.jpg) When we look away from the hustle and bustle of our busy lives, we see all the wonderful creations of nature. One such wonderful creation is depicted in the film. In the picture, we see a very beautiful and delicate butterfly, which sits calmly on a green leaf. It is actually the Common Cerulean or a small butterfly of the Lycaenidae family. This beautiful design on the underside of their wings is a unique work of nature. If you look at the picture, you can see that the butterfly's gray-brown wings are covered in fine white and dark stripes. It has a nice pattern like spots or zebra crossings. But the most interesting part is the small eye-like dot or eyespot on the underside of its wings, black and shiny, surrounded by an orange circle. This bluish spot not only adds to its beauty, but is also one of the butterfly's survival strategies. When predatory birds or insects come to attack it They then mistake this fake eye for the butterfly's real head and strike it there. As a result, the butterfly escapes serious damage and can easily fly away. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVwWmXtXXq4YWVrShjKUzshda8GiNndvecTeonrzJXn2a/1781581670019.jpg) The presence of this butterfly amidst the green background is a perfect example of biodiversity. They roam the gardens, bushes or forests around us. When they spread their wings, The bright blue color of the inner part of the wings creates a magical scene. However, when they close their wings and sit on a leaf, they blend into the surrounding environment in such a way that it is difficult to find them easily. Beautiful moments like the picture remind us of how important these tiny creatures of nature play in maintaining the balance of our environment. Through pollination, they help plants reproduce and maintain the beauty of nature. Therefore, we should protect the habitat and natural environment of these small but beautiful creatures So that future generations can also enjoy this colorful gift of nature.

title.title: 公积金可以交物业费了
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![Z5yJzjTFZfyZGWFl_MEITU_20260530_141652141.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/Z5yJzjTFZfyZGWFl_MEITU_20260530_141652141/Z5yJzjTFZfyZGWFl_MEITU_20260530_141652141.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近看到一条消息，说的是公积金的后面有大的政策调整的，完全解决了我的痛点。

具体来说，就在今年6月份，城乡建设部发了一个文件，就是对公积金的管理条例的一个修改。说白了，公积金的制度已经20多年没怎么变过了。那这次调整了啥呢？

**公积金未来可以用来交物业费，交房租，房子装修等等。**并且不影响后面买房的贷款额度。

以前，公积金主要是用来买房，担心很明显现在买房的这个需求下降了。但是公司还在交公积金。

这就导致，大量的资金就躺在公积金上，所以这次改变调整，就是适应现在新的环境需求的。

我之前还一直纠结，公积金里面的钱，后面不买房子了，取出来可是个头疼的事。

现在能直接交物业费，那方便多了，看到这个政策我是举双手欢迎。

不过现在还是征求意见阶段，我相信很快可以落地。

---

title.title: A Coin Series That Ended Too Soon
title.body: I normally don't collect a lot of coin series. One reason is they're usually grossly overpriced. On the off chance they're not, the series typically goes on far too long and the designs toward the end feel like they're grasping at straws. It's sad when you find a series that isn't overdone and is reasonably priced, and it only lasts a few years. A great example of this is the Valkyries series of coins from the Germania Mint. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWGoDUpU6STsfC9QFtQVMxsUX8HKDvHjSSGBRLVRt6ao3/1781580698316.jpg) ([Source](https://germaniamint.com/series/valkyries/)) They started the series in 2022 with Hildegard. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmavR8Di426send8VLK9tqEEo4KbiTKWABgqhji7zjpu8q/1781581128205.jpg) This piece instantly caught my eye and I was hooked. I think they were priced around $40-50 for this brilliant uncirculated version. In 2023 they introduced Ostara. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRjbbNNCNsarATBCWp9L1e6y2jJSYNA6JGWc61hqM5BrJ/1781581169519.jpg) The piece wasn't quite as good as the first in my opinion, but it's still a solid design. Then in 2024 they released Solveig. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmefKYFRBkkQux652qKWp4uPvyoEyDnQBmF57R6bjY2mSQ/1781581236494.jpg) A lady with an axe and a bear in the background? What's not to like? In 2025 they released Arnhild. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWde24tFguKuZMwsUpbbENYt7ecUoCT6jjXuQtachzbMN/1781580936818.jpg) A classy lady outfitted with a bow, and the coin also depicted the two ravens that serve as Odin's eyes, Huginn and Muninn. And that's where they concluded the series. Four coins that were all moderately priced, had great designs and were well-executed. I was hoping there'd be another one out, but they've already moved on to another series. Maybe there's hope they'll bring another series like it out. Only time will tell. All I know is this series was ended far too soon. ![1000017156.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulliontools/23uEyyyWCHidcDUBLiCySb4thnoMosshmypAS8GVUkhHC52LCiQqrB6L9Fom29shmtCMN.gif)

title.title: Vince's Story, Ascent and descent
title.body:
Warm greetings and good evening, dear friends of Buskeria. I'm back to share my new story with you. Today's story is dedicated to Vince. In this story, I wanted to capture some of the emotions someone might feel when they are surpassed by someone younger than them in every way. The title of this post already gives you a hint of what we'll see. I hope you enjoy the story. I invite you to leave your opinions in the comments. Let's begin.

> Saludos cordiales y buenas noches queridos amigos de Buskeria. Estoy de regreso para compartirles mi nueva historia. Esta de hoy se la he dedicado a Vince. En esta historia he querido capturar un poco de las emociones que puede sentir alguien cuando es superado por alguien menor a el en todo sentido. Ya el titulo de este post les da una pista de lo que veremos. Espero que les guste la historia, les invito a dejarme sus opiniones en los comentarios, comenzamos.

<div class=\

> ![1772303822345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xVHHNGLvcawbkuKKYKdWfoiRRbgnxBarUj3YRRVicnMKRXRQ1haKXj3qoQgGz7Vx9hj.jpg) Image created by me in canva Vince is someone who has built his career from the ground up, without shortcuts. His focus has always been on doing things right. He's been a singer for a long time with an impeccable track record. He's never been involved in scandals, excesses, or controversies. What he's achieved is purely thanks to his own talent and perseverance. He's been in the business so long that pressure and expectations no longer surprise him. He's learned to live with them. He often reminisces about how well things have gone for him, and it fills him with happiness. Things have turned out well, but in his memories, there's a period in his life that tested him. It was a situation he didn't expect to evolve in that way or end like that. He had to make important decisions that, if he'd chosen poorly, could have tarnished or perhaps destroyed what he'd built. It all happened just a few years ago; he already had a well-established career and was quite successful. But during a visit to a recording studio, he met Miguel. Miguel was an inexperienced young man who wanted to be a singer but lacked the necessary resources. > Vince es alguien que ha construido su carrera desde abajo, sin atajos. Lo suyo ha sido siempre el trabajo bien hecho. Es cantante desde hace mucho con una trayectoria impecable, Nunca estuvo implicado en escándalos, ni excesos, o polémicas. Lo que ha logrado ha sido puramente gracias a su propio talento y constancia. Lleva tanto tiempo en esto que ya no le sorprende la presión, ni la expectativa. Aprendió a convivir con ellas. Muchas veces se pone a recordar lo bien que le ha ido y eso lo llena de felicidad. > Las cosas han salido bien, pero en sus recuerdos hay una etapa de su vida que lo puso a prueba, fue una situación que el no se esperaba que evolucionara de esa forma ni que terminaría así. Tuvo que tomar decisiones importantes que si las hubiera elegido mal hubieran manchado o quizás destruido lo que ha construido. Todo ocurrió hace apenas unos años, ya el tenia toda su trayectoria establecida y tenia buen reconocimiento. Pero en una visita a un estudio de grabación conoció a Miguel. Miguel era un joven inexperto que quería ser cantante, pero no tenia los recursos necesarios.

> ![marlon-soares-PN8rffYnta8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23vrrswfcbgwN69vFeBHJQdJEfN9zUttr6PutmgkgVvcKFhZJ58h2xpmBHaoj9Egjwkwy.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) He didn't have the money to pay for specialized studies, nor did he have the budget or the preparation to make his own music on his own. Vince, on the other hand, had everything he lacked, but above all, he had a big heart. He saw in Miguel the son he never had, and he also saw himself when he started out, with the same problems he had to overcome. He felt compassion for him, so that day when he met him, he decided to help him. This was something he had never done before; he had never mentored anyone, so he would have to learn how to do it. This decision was difficult because one wrong step could affect his financial stability or his reputation as someone who didn't know how to teach well. But he was so impressed by Miguel's desire to succeed in music that he felt he had to help him despite the risks. After that meeting, they exchanged numbers and began a great professional friendship. A little while later, Vince began advising him on important industry matters. He helped him see, from his own experience, the steps he needed to take and what he should strive to achieve. Then he began to take action to help him. He started providing him with funds from his estate so he could complete some extra studies and also learn to sing better. In addition, he personally taught him all his skills and tricks for improving his singing. Miguel was a boy who was very eager to learn, so he absorbed everything he was told. At the same time, his ability grew, and their friendship strengthened. > No tenía dinero para pagar estudios especializados, tampoco tenía el presupuesto o la preparación para hacer su propia música por sí solo. Vince por su parte tenía todo lo que él no tenía, pero sobre todas las cosas tenía un gran corazón. Vio en miguel el hijo que nunca tubo, y también se vio a sí mismo cuando empezó, con los mismos problemas que tuvo que superar. Sintió compasión por él, por eso ese día cuando lo conoció tomó la decisión de ayudarlo. Eso era algo que nunca antes había hecho, nunca había asesorado a alguien, así que tendría que aprender como hacerlo. > Esta decisión era difícil porque un paso en falso y podía afectar su estabilidad económica o su reputación como alguien que no supo enseñar bien. Pero le causó tanta admiración las ganas que tenía Miguel de salir adelante en la música que sentía que tenía que ayudarlo pese a los riesgos. Luego de ese encuentro ellos intercambiaron números y comenzaron una gran amistad profesional. Un poco después Vince comenzó a asesorarlo en los temas importantes de la industria. Le ayudó a ver desde su experiencia los pasos que tenía que dar y en que debía esforzarse por alcanzar. > Luego comenzó a pasar a la acción para ayudarlo. Le empezó proporcionar fondos de su patrimonio para que completara algunos estudios extras, también para que aprendiera a cantar mejor. Sumado a eso el mismo le enseñó todas sus habilidades y trucos para cantar mejor. Miguel era un chico que tenía muchas ganas de aprender así que absorbía todo lo que el le decía. Al mismo tiempo su habilidad iba creciendo al mismo tiempo que su amistad se fortalecía.

> ![jordan-mcdonald-QEggW80ocm8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wBbW5AdizFjPHPkfPw3tHkYaDNn36uG5WiyRK7CQxESo7gsFPhK5xotr3CLn7CfmBjj.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) Since Miguel didn't have much influence in the music industry, Vince used his platform to give him a boost. He featured him alongside him on his social media, took him to interviews, and brought him along to concerts and events. Vince's goal was to use his influence to help Miguel take off and build his own audience. And this worked very well; it really helped a lot. Because Miguel was still a minor, Vince handled all his finances and also co-owned his songs. He was his mentor and the one responsible for guiding him to the top, so it was natural that he managed these aspects. Furthermore, Vince always provided the money from his own funds, so there was never any lack of trust. The time came when Miguel started writing his own songs and performing them at his own concerts. He began generating his own income and gradually stopped depending on the funds that Vince had selflessly given him for so long. They both celebrated these achievements because their hard work was finally paying off. The moment arrived when Miguel released his first album, completely produced and financed by himself, although with the advice of his friend. > Como miguel no tenía mucha influencia en la música Vince usó sus plataformas para impulsarlo. Lo presentó junto a él en sus redes, también lo llevó a entrevistas y cuando iba a conciertos o eventos lo llevaba con el. El objetivo de Vince era que su influencia lo ayudara a despegar para que pudiera crear su propio público. Y esto funcionó muy bien, porque de verdad ayudó mucho. Como miguel aún era menor de edad Vince se encargó de todas sus finanzas y también tenía la propiedad de sus canciones junto a el. Era su mentor y en el encargado de llevarlo a la cima así que era normal que llevara estos aspectos. Además el dinero siempre lo ponía Vince de sus fondos así que nunca hubo falta de confianza por esto. > Llegó el momento en que Miguel comenzó a hacer sus propias canciones y a Cantarlas en conciertos propios. Comenzó a generar sus propios ingresos y poco a poco dejó de depender de los fondos que Vince desinteresadamente le había dado por mucho tiempo. Ambos celebraron estos logros porque el trabajo ya estaba dando sus frutos. Llegó el momento en que Miguel lanzó su primer disco completamente producido y financiado por el mismo, aunque con la asesoría de su amigo.

> ![jacob-mejicanos-iA3y-m3zrzs-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xA1fJHfuCchyTju6P4dnHerk7My6xLVfTTp2AdkuYM8sq9Lsx1xqRGGdFzm711hdRSC.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) This album exceeded all expectations overnight. It was such an overwhelming success that it propelled Miguel to the top of the charts. It also opened doors to numerous record deals and collaborations of all kinds. He earned millions from the album. At this point, Miguel no longer needed Vince because he was now of legal age and possessed the experience Vince had imparted. Furthermore, he now had more resources and popularity than Vince himself. Vince never imagined this moment would arrive so quickly; he thought he would have to help his friend for many more years, but now everything had changed. Miguel had surpassed him in every way. He had more experience with new generations, knew what they liked, and had far greater popularity and wealth. And it was here that the decision arose that could change his future and the reputation he had built. He had legal control over Miguel's material; he could claim credits, money for his years of assistance, and generally seek compensation in various respects. But Vince made the right decision. He never let envy control him, even though he had the power to easily do those things; he didn't. > Este disco superó todas las expectativas de la noche a la mañana. Fue un éxito tan abrumador que puso a Miguel entre los más populares cantantes. Además le abrió las puertas a muchos contratos con disqueras, y colaboraciones de todo tipo. Ganó millones con el disco. En este punto ya Miguel no necesitaba a Vince porque ya era mayor de edad, y tenia la experiencia que le había enseñado. Además ahora contaba con más fondos y popularidad que el mismo Vince. Vince nunca se imaginó que este momento fuera a llegar tan rápido, pensaba que tendría que ayudar muchos más años a su amigo, pero ahora todo había cambiado. > Miguel lo había superado en todos los aspectos, tenía más experiencia con las nuevas generaciones, sabía lo que les gustaba y tenía mucha más popularidad y dinero. Y es aquí donde se encontraba la decisión que podía cambiar su futuro y la reputación que alcanzó. Tenía poder legal sobre el material de Miguel, podía reclamar créditos, dinero por su ayuda durante años y en general pedir compensación en varios aspectos. Pero Vince tomó la decisión correcta, nunca dejó que la envidia lo dominara, aunque tenía el poder para hacer fácilmente aquellas cosas no las hizo.

> ![vitaly-gariev-hoBlV3lpevI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/2423kyMfXUoQTtsjA1stvvXtdj5iJRFrdD7WReEisw1J6qfh6Asy4GAr7F4gZB4RroCkU.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) He handed over all the legal and financial assets of his business to his friend and continued to advise him as much as he could until Miguel could manage on his own. Vince felt immense satisfaction seeing the fruits of their labor come to fruition. It was obvious the student had surpassed the teacher, but when that happens with someone you care about, it only brings joy. The wise decision preserved their friendship, and they still work together. And best of all, Vince's career is now impeccable, and he's happy. > Le entregó a su amigo todas las propiedades legales y financieras de su trabajo y lo siguió asesorando en lo que pudo hasta que Miguel pudo hacerlo por si mismo. Vince ganó una gran satisfacción por el, por ver que el fruto del esfuerzo de ambos se materializó. Era obvio que el alumno superó al maestro, pero eso cuando sucede con alguien a quien aprecias solo te da alegría. La buena decisión conservó su amistad y ambos trabajan juntos aún. Y lo mejor Vince tiene su carrera impecable y se siente feliz.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2433).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23uQvjXAnDcPidmESyoFtRBknYrVMpwqSyPrLCAi2UEiyA8wSeHqqxD4AUo1DGwBirRsD.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

title.title: The Irony of the Market 🎲 [Eng+Spa] La ironía del destino y el mercado
title.body:
* * *

* * *

(Versión en español más abajo).
-------------------------------

* * *

* * *

Today I stumbled upon a story that seems like it was written by a screenwriter with a great sense of humor 😅: an anti-capitalist woman created a game to criticize land monopolies, and decades later that same spirit ended up becoming a global brand of tabletop capitalism. 😂

The Unexpected Twist
--------------------

The protagonist of this little paradox is Lizzie Magie, who designed and patented **The Landlord’s Game** between 1903 and 1904 as a way to show the negative effects of land monopolies and defend the idea of ​​a land tax as a solution.

In other words, it wasn't a game to celebrate the big landowner from the movies, but rather to say, \
Thanks for the critique; now I'll take it, make merchandise, and sell it.\

Hola! 😊 Yo también me he visto en esa situación de guardar algo para una ocasión especial y cuando me doy cuenta son muchas las cosas que reúno para según yo esperar el momento perfecto o la ocasión ideal...

Sin embargo hay veces que no tenemos esa oportunidad y dejamos pasar el momento, por eso ahora en mi caso si me compro una blusa, al menos la uso para ir a la iglesia ó para ir a la universidad y ciertamente me genera alegría. 

Me encantó mucho tu post porque recuerdo que yo guardé unas sandalias y las empecé a usar solo para ocasiones especiales y las volvía a guardar nuevamente en su caja, y resulta que se vencieron jajajaj cuando me las puse estaban súper peladas, se estaban esconchando, ya tenían varios años y solo las usé en escasas oportunidades, es decir, aparentemente estaban nuevas.  😆

Por eso ahora dije: Lo que vaya comprando, me lo pongo y ya. 

Me encanta estrenar, me emociona mucho! 🤭😄😊 Jajaja

Un fuerte abrazo y muchas gracias por compartir esa experiencia de tu blusa. 🫂♥️✨
